groups.name: Undergo State Change · 转变与质变 (Change, Transform, Convert)
groups.tip: 状态或性质发生改变

items.def_zh: 改变，发生改变；更换；兑换
items.def_en: 1. to become different, or make someone or something different. 2. to exchange or replace something with another.
1. to begin to be or grow into; to come to be. 2. to suit or look attractive on someone.
to become green, or make something green or environmentally friendly.

items.def_zh: 转变，改变；转换，交换；开/关（电器）
items.def_en: 1. to change or turn from one thing to another; exchange. 2. to turn an electrical device on or off using a switch.

items.def_zh: 变化，改变；（使）不同，呈现差异
items.def_en: to be different or change according to conditions; to make changes in something so it is not always the same.

items.def_zh: （使）转变，转化；（使）改变信仰，皈依；兑换
items.def_en: 1. to change from one form, system, or state to another, or cause something to do so. 2. to change one's religion or beliefs.
to change or transition from one state, condition, or style to another.

items.def_zh: 使彻底改变，使改观，转化
items.def_en: to change markedly the form, appearance, or character of something.

items.def_zh: 改变，更改；改动（衣服使其合身）
items.def_en: to change or make someone or something different; to adjust the fit of clothing.
[I/T] to change or cause someone/something to change completely into another entity
(+ sth) to stop being one thing and become another, or make sth do this
(+ to sth) to change from one system, method, or state to another
(+ sb/sth) to completely transform the appearance or structure of sb/sth
to make bitter in taste; to make someone resentful or cynical.

items.def_zh: 给……镀青铜；使晒成古铜色；变成青铜色
items.def_en: to give the color or appearance of bronze to something; to become or make sun-tanned or bronze in color.
to convert coal into coke by heating it in the absence of air, or to undergo this process.

items.def_zh: 使复杂化；使变得世故，使精明；篡改
items.def_en: to make more complex, refined, or worldly; to alter or adulterate deceptively.
to use machines or computers to control or perform a process automatically.

items.def_zh: 改变……的形状或结构，重塑；翻新，改造
items.def_en: to change the structure, layout, or appearance of a building, room, or system.

items.def_zh: 使成麦芽，用麦芽处理；发麦芽
items.def_en: to convert barley or other grain into malt by steeping and germinating, or to treat with malt.

items.def_zh: （使）图像平滑变换；逐步演变成，变化
items.def_en: to change smoothly and gradually from one image, shape, or state into another.
to undergo genetic mutation, or cause a gene or organism to develop new characteristics; to change into a different form.
to shape again or give a new form, structure, or direction to something.

items.def_zh: 彻底变革，使发生革命性剧变
items.def_en: to completely change the way that something is done, thought about, or made.

items.def_zh: 用硫酸（盐）处理；使硫酸盐化
items.def_en: to treat or combine with sulfuric acid or a sulfate, or coat with lead sulfate.

items.def_zh: 使计算机化，用电脑处理
items.def_en: to equip with computers or convert a process or system to automatic computer operation.

items.def_zh: （动词）列出词形变化；（使）结合，配对
items.def_en: 1. (grammar) to list or change the different forms of a verb according to tense, person, etc. 2. to join together or unite.
to convert pictures, sound, or information into a digital form that can be processed by a computer.
to convert an atom or molecule into an ion, or become converted into ions.
to change completely into something very different, or cause someone or something to do so.

items.def_zh: 使发酵；使生动，给……增添趣味
items.def_en: 1. to add yeast or a leavening agent to dough so it rises. 2. to make something less serious or more enjoyable by adding humor or variety.
to make an area or population more urban in character, infrastructure, or lifestyle.

items.def_zh: 使磁化，使带磁性；吸引，强烈吸引
items.def_en: 1. to make something magnetic. 2. to attract or fascinate people strongly.

items.def_zh: （词）发生曲折变化，改变词尾；使弯曲；改变音调
items.def_en: 1. (grammar) to change the form of a word, typically the ending, to show tense, person, or number. 2. to alter the tone or pitch of the voice.

items.def_zh: 使多样化；使成杂色，使斑驳
items.def_en: to make varied or diverse; to mark with different colors or patches.
to heat sugar or food containing sugar until it turns brown and sweet, or to undergo this change.
to change completely, or change something, into a different form, substance, or state.
to treat or combine an organic substance (such as liquid vegetable oil) with hydrogen.

items.def_zh: 重塑了，改造了（remodel 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: (chiefly British English) past tense and past participle of remodel; altered the structure or appearance of.
to adopt or cause to adopt the customs, ideas, or culture of Western countries.

items.def_zh: 使变性（改变天然性质）；使（酒精等）变性以不可饮用
items.def_en: 1. to alter the natural qualities or structure of a protein or other molecule. 2. to add a toxic or foul-tasting substance to alcohol so it is unfit to drink.

items.def_zh: （使）升华；使高尚化，净化（本能冲动）
items.def_en: 1. (physics / chemistry) to change directly from a solid to a gas or vice versa without becoming liquid. 2. (psychology) to redirect primal or unacceptable impulses into socially constructive activities.
to make or become feminine or more suitable for or typical of women.
to convert or be converted into a mineral substance; to impregnate with minerals.

items.def_zh: 使具有性色彩，使性感化
items.def_en: (British English) to make something sexual in character or quality, or view someone primarily in sexual terms.
to transfer from religious to civil ownership or control; make secular.
to transform into something more beautiful, spiritual, or elevated.
to make or become English in form, pronunciation, character, or customs.
to introduce a carboxyl group (-COOH) into a chemical compound.

items.def_zh: （使）恢复原状，（使）再转变；（使）重新皈依
items.def_en: to convert back to a previous state, use, or religion.

items.def_zh: 使成复数形式；使多元化
items.def_en: 1. (grammar) to make a word plural, or become plural. 2. to make a system or society more diverse.
to remove the magnetic properties from an object or material.

items.def_zh: 使失去个性，使非人化；使客观化
items.def_en: to deprive of personal qualities or individuality; to make cold or impersonal.
to give male physical traits or masculine characteristics to someone or something, or develop them.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an entity undergoing or being subjected to a transition in physical nature, internal form, function, or status (often taking prepositions like 'into' or 'to'). They range from basic general shifts to deep structural, mechanical, or biochemical transmutation.
groups.summary_zh: 描述事物形态、性质、功能或状态发生实质性转变与重塑。

groups.name: Visual Gaze & Scrutiny · 凝视与审视 (Look, Gaze, Stare)
groups.tip: 目光投向目标的多样方式

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to look quickly at sb/sth and then look away

items.def_zh: 匆匆一瞥，扫视；掠过，擦过
items.def_en: 1. to look quickly and briefly at someone or something. 2. to bounce off a surface at an angle.
to see someone or something very briefly or only partially.
(+ sth) to look closely or with difficulty into sth

items.def_zh: 看见，看到；理解，明白；查明；经历
items.def_en: 1. to perceive with the eyes. 2. to understand, realize, or find out.

items.def_zh: 看，注视；寻找；显得，看起来
items.def_en: 1. to direct one's gaze towards someone or something. 2. to appear or seem.
1. to look at or inspect something carefully. 2. to regard or consider something in a particular way.

items.def_zh: 看见，发现；用瞄准器对准
items.def_en: 1. to manage to see or catch sight of something, especially from a distance. 2. to aim a weapon or telescope at something.
1. to look at something with eyes partly closed, such as in bright light. 2. to have an eye that turns inward or outward.

items.def_zh: 凝望星空，眺望星辰；遐想，做白日梦
items.def_en: 1. to look at or observe the stars. 2. to daydream or engage in aimless contemplation.
(+ sb/sth) to look steadily at sb/sth for a long time, often in wonder or thought
(+ sb/sth) to look directly at sb/sth for a long time with wide open eyes

items.def_zh: 观看，注视；看守，监视；注意，留心
items.def_en: to look at someone or something attentively over a period of time; to observe, guard, or monitor.
to look at someone or something closely, attentively, or with suspicion.
(+ at/into) to look narrowly or searchingly, as if trying to see clearly
to look steadily and intently at someone or something for a long time, often in admiration, wonder, or thought.
(literary or archaic) to see, view, or look attentively at someone or something.
1. (informal) to look closely or stare directly at someone or something. 2. to estimate without measuring tools.
to stare openly and stupidly or rudely at someone or something.

items.def_zh: 看见了，注视了（behold 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: (literary) past tense and past participle of behold; saw or observed.

items.def_zh: 目瞪口呆地凝视，张着嘴看
items.def_en: (chiefly British informal) to stare openly and stupidly, often with the mouth open.
to look directly and continuously at someone or something with eyes wide open.

items.def_zh: 瞪大眼睛看，惊愕地注视
items.def_en: to look at something with wide, staring eyes, often in surprise, disbelief, or admiration.
[I/T] to stare at someone in an overtly amorous, lustful, or intrusive manner

items.def_zh: 目瞪口呆地凝视；张开，裂开
items.def_en: 1. to stare at someone or something with an open mouth, usually in surprise or shock. 2. to be or become wide open.

items.def_zh: 怒目而视，恶狠狠地瞪着
items.def_en: to look at someone in an angry, sullen, or threatening way.

items.def_zh: 怒目而视，怒瞪；发出刺眼的强光
items.def_en: 1. to look at someone in a very angry or fierce way. 2. to shine with a very bright, uncomfortable light.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express directed visual attention, characterized by duration, openness of eyes, and underlying emotional states (such as wonder, shock, hostility, or curiosity). They distinguish brief casual glances from prolonged, fixed, or socially intrusive stares.
groups.summary_zh: 以特定眼神、时长及情绪状态对目标进行注视、打量或审视。

groups.name: Physical Impact & Striking · 殴击与猛击 (Hit, Strike, Batter)
groups.tip: 各种力度的物理击打

items.def_zh: 急敲，急击；严厉斥责；说唱
items.def_en: 1. to strike sharply and quickly, producing a knocking sound. 2. to criticize sharply. 3. to perform rap music.
to hit something, especially an insect, with a sharp, flat blow.
(+ at sb/sth) to hit or try to hit sb/sth with force

items.def_zh: 击打，碰撞；击中；袭击，造成严重不良影响
items.def_en: 1. to bring a hand, object, etc. forcefully against someone or something. 2. to affect adversely.

items.def_zh: 连续击打，敲打；战胜，打败；（心脏等）跳动；搅拌
items.def_en: 1. to strike repeatedly with a hand, stick, or implement. 2. to defeat in a game or contest. 3. to throb or pulsate. 4. to mix vigorously.

items.def_zh: 击打，碰撞；罢工；侵袭；给……以特定印象
items.def_en: 1. to hit someone or something forcefully. 2. to refuse to work as a form of protest. 3. to affect suddenly or give a particular impression to someone.
1. to strike a surface noisily, especially to attract attention. 2. to collide with or hit someone or something forcefully.

items.def_zh: 击打，撞击（strike 的过去式和过去分词）；给……留下印象
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of strike; hit forcefully, or impressed/affected deeply.
(informal) to hit someone on the head, especially with a thrown ball.

items.def_zh: 掌掴，猛击；使劲撞；有……意味
items.def_en: 1. to hit someone or something forcefully with a flat hand or object, making a loud, sharp noise. 2. (smack of) to suggest or have a trace of something bad.
[I/T] to hit heavily, producing a dull, resonant thud
(+ sb) to hurt sb badly by hitting and kicking them repeatedly
(+ sb) to attack sb violently with physical blows

items.def_zh: 用拳猛击；按（键），打（孔）；冲压
items.def_en: 1. To hit someone or something hard with a clenched fist. 2. To make a hole or pattern in something using a tool. 3. To press a button or key.

items.def_zh: 猛击，痛击；撞坏；严厉批评
items.def_en: 1. (+ against/into) (informal) To hit someone or something hard and violently. 2. (informal) To criticize someone or a group harshly.

items.def_zh: 连续猛击，殴打；使受损，使受重创
items.def_en: (+ at/on) To hit someone or something repeatedly and violently with heavy blows; to damage or affect severely.

items.def_zh: （用能量、激光等）击打，摧毁；快速击中；快速移动
items.def_en: (informal) To hit, destroy, or attack someone or something suddenly using a weapon, electric current, or laser; to move very fast.
(+ into/against) (informal) To hit or crash into something violently with a loud, dull impact.

items.def_zh: 重击，猛打；彻底击溃，大胜
items.def_en: (informal) To hit someone or something very hard; to defeat an opponent decisively.
to strike repeatedly and violently; hit very hard

items.def_zh: 猛击，重击（smite的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: (archaic) Past tense and past participle of smite; struck heavily.

items.def_zh: 猛击，重打；重创（smite的过去式）
items.def_en: (archaic / literary) Past tense of smite; struck heavily or afflicted severely.
(informal) To hit someone very hard on the head.
to hit repeatedly with a heavy club or blunt instrument

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote an agent forcefully delivering an impact against a person or surface, varying from light, sharp raps to brutal, bludgeoning blows. Register ranges from casual/colloquial smacks to formal or literary strikes and sustained beatings.
groups.summary_zh: 施加物理外力进行击打、猛击或连续殴打。

groups.name: Expansion & Proliferation · 暴增与膨胀 (Grow, Surge, Skyrocket)
groups.tip: 从平缓生长到急速膨胀剧增

items.def_en: (+ sth) to increase in amount, size, or strength over time

items.def_zh: 增长，扩大；生长，成长；逐渐变得；种植
items.def_en: 1. To increase in size, amount, degree, or power. 2. To develop or mature naturally as a plant or animal. 3. To become gradually. 4. To cultivate plants.

items.def_zh: （月亮）渐圆，渐满；变大，增大；给……上蜡
items.def_en: 1. (literary) When the moon waxes, it appears to become larger and rounder. 2. To increase in size, strength, or degree. 3. To polish or coat with wax.
To become larger or greater in number, amount, size, or degree; to make something become larger or greater.

items.def_zh: 膨胀，增大；（健身）增肌；使变大
items.def_en: 1. ('bulk up') To become larger, thicker, or heavier, especially by gaining muscle mass. 2. To appear large or take on a bulky shape.

items.def_zh: 膨胀，肿胀；（数量或体积）增加，扩大
items.def_en: 1. To become larger and rounder than normal, often due to injury, fluid, or pressure. 2. To increase in size, number, or volume.
[I/T] to increase or intensify by rapid stages

items.def_zh: 长得过大而不适于；长得比……快（或高、大）；因长大而改掉
items.def_en: 1. To grow too big for clothes or an environment. 2. To grow bigger or faster than someone or something else. 3. To stop doing or needing something as you become more mature.
(+ sth) to increase sharply or make sth increase significantly in amount, speed, or size

items.def_zh: 猛增，急升；刺穿，扎破；在（饮料）中掺烈酒（或毒药）
items.def_en: 1. To rise sharply and suddenly to a high peak. 2. To pierce or fasten with a sharp spike. 3. To secretly add alcohol or a drug to a drink.

items.def_zh: 急剧增加，激增；膨胀如气球
items.def_en: 1. To increase very rapidly in amount, degree, or size. 2. To swell out like a balloon.

items.def_zh: （使）急剧增长，（使）大幅提升（尤与up连用）；狂暴地冲撞
items.def_en: 1. ('ramp up') To increase the level, speed, or amount of something sharply. 2. To behave wildly or furiously.

items.def_zh: 剧增，急升；汹涌奔腾，急冲
items.def_en: 1. To increase suddenly and strongly in level, value, or intensity. 2. To move suddenly and powerfully in a particular direction.

items.def_zh: 迅速增长，雨后春笋般涌现
items.def_en: To increase, spread, or develop at an extremely rapid rate.

items.def_zh: 成金字塔式递增，急剧增加；使呈金字塔状堆叠
items.def_en: To increase rapidly in amount, size, or stages; to arrange or pile up in the shape of a pyramid.
1. To rise very quickly to a high level or amount. 2. To fly or glide high in the air.

items.def_zh: 滚雪球般迅速增长，急剧扩大；掷雪球
items.def_en: 1. To grow rapidly larger, more serious, or more intense at an accelerating pace. 2. To throw snowballs at.

items.def_zh: 迅速生长，繁荣发展；萌芽
items.def_en: (formal) To grow, expand, or develop rapidly and successfully.
To increase, multiply, or spread rapidly in number or quantity.
to increase or rise very suddenly and rapidly
to increase suddenly, dramatically, and precipitously in quantity
To increase extremely fast to a very high level.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail an escalation in size, volume, price, or quantity, progressing from steady organic increases to sudden, explosive, vertical spikes. Nuances distinguish continuous accretion, physical swelling, and explosive exponential multiplying.
groups.summary_zh: 数量、规模或程度由缓步扩增至剧烈爆发式膨胀暴涨。

groups.name: Defeat & Overpower · 战胜与溃败 (Defeat, Overcome, Rout)
groups.tip: 战胜压制并征服对手

items.def_en: to defeat an opponent by a very narrow margin

items.def_zh: （在最后一刻以微弱优势）险胜，击败；破壳而出；唧唧叫
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly British informal) To defeat someone by a very narrow margin, especially at the last moment. 2. To peck through an eggshell; to chirp.
(+ sb) to defeat a challenger or opponent in a contest or fight
to succeed or prevail after a prolonged contest or struggle

items.def_zh: （在体育比赛中）封杀，使对手一分未得；使模糊，抹去
items.def_en: 1. (North American sports) To prevent an opposing team or player from scoring any points. 2. To become blank or cause something to become blank.

items.def_zh: 以多数票击败，以票数胜过
items.def_en: To defeat someone or a proposal by winning a greater number of votes.
1. To be successful or victorious in a game, fight, or competition; to defeat an opponent. 2. To achieve or gain something through effort.

items.def_zh: 击败，胜过；出王牌赢过；优先于
items.def_en: 1. To beat someone or something by doing or saying something better, or by having a stronger advantage. 2. To play a trump card that beats another card.
(formal) To defeat someone completely in a fight, argument, or competition.
1. To win a victory over someone in a battle, contest, or competition. 2. To prevent a plan, aim, or proposal from succeeding.
to overwhelm, subdue, or defeat utterly and decisively

items.def_zh: 战胜，征服；克服（困难等）；受到……强烈压倒（或影响）
items.def_en: 1. To defeat an opponent or enemy. 2. To succeed in dealing with a problem, emotion, or difficulty. 3. (usually passive) To affect someone deeply or overpower them.
(North American informal) To defeat an opponent completely in a game without allowing them to score any points.

items.def_zh: 在谋略上胜过，智胜；侧翼包抄（敌军）
items.def_en: 1. To gain an advantage over a rival by using cleverer tactics. 2. (military) To move around the side of an enemy army.

items.def_zh: 以谋略击败，在策略上胜过
items.def_en: To defeat or gain an advantage over an opponent by using superior tactics or cleverness.
To be much better, stronger, or more capable than an opponent.
To conquer and take back land or control from an enemy.

items.def_zh: 以谋略击败，在策略上胜过
items.def_en: (British English spelling of outmaneuver) To defeat or gain an advantage over an opponent by using superior tactics.
(+ sb/sth) to completely destroy or overwhelmingly defeat an opponent
To defeat an army or opponent completely and force them to flee in disorder.
to thoroughly defeat in battle, contest, or conflict

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe prevailing over an opponent, competitor, or obstacle, graded by the margin and decisiveness of victory. They span from narrowly edging past someone or tactical outmaneuvering to overwhelming subjugation and complete, chaotic destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 在竞争或冲突中战胜对手，从险胜智取到全面溃败征服。

groups.name: Locomotion & Rapid Striding · 奔跑与疾行 (Run, Sprint, Gallop)
groups.tip: 步伐加快的高速奔跑

items.def_zh: 慢跑，缓步跑；轻推；唤起（记忆）
items.def_en: 1. To run slowly and steadily, especially for exercise. 2. To nudge or push gently. 3. ('jog someone's memory') To cause someone to remember something.
When a horse canters, it moves at a smooth, easy running pace between a trot and a gallop; to ride a horse at this pace.
1. To walk around while asleep. 2. (figurative) To act in a way that risks danger without realizing it.
To walk or travel across deep snow wearing snowshoes.

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地走；吃力苦干
items.def_en: (+ along/through/on) To walk slowly with heavy, tired steps; to work steadily and unexcitingly at a boring task.

items.def_zh: 踩，踏，行走（tread的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of tread; walked, stepped on, or pressed down with feet.

items.def_zh: 徐徐前行，行进（通常用 wend one's way）
items.def_en: ('wend one's way') (literary) To travel or walk slowly in a specified direction.
to leave a place very quickly on foot

items.def_zh: 奔跑，疾行；运转，运行；经营，管理
items.def_en: 1. To move swiftly on foot with both feet leaving the ground simultaneously at each stride. 2. To operate or function. 3. To manage or oversee.

items.def_zh: 匆忙赶路，急忙疾行；催促
items.def_en: 1. To move or act very quickly or fast. 2. To urge someone to act or move faster.

items.def_zh: 大步快走，阔步行进；跨过
items.def_en: 1. (+ across/into/along) To walk quickly with long, confident, decisive steps. 2. To step across or over.

items.def_zh: 疾跑，急步走（常作 hoof it）；踢
items.def_en: 1. ('hoof it') (informal) To run or walk briskly somewhere. 2. To kick a ball hard.
to run away at maximum speed over a short distance
to move or run somewhere very quickly and excitedly

items.def_zh: 疾行，狂奔；赛跑，竞赛；使飞速运转
items.def_en: 1. To run or move very fast in a hurry. 2. To compete against someone in a speed contest. 3. To operate or cause to operate at high speed.
(+ to/into) to run or move suddenly and rapidly over a short distance
(+ across/out) to move rapidly and suddenly like a projectile
(+ off/away) (chiefly British informal) To run very fast, like a hare.
to run away with sudden, uncontrolled speed, often in alarm
To run or move at maximum speed over a short distance.

items.def_zh: （马）飞奔，全速跑；疾驰，急速前进
items.def_en: When a horse gallops, it runs at its fastest pace; to move or progress very quickly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate self-propelled terrestrial locomotion, graded by gait, velocity, and exertion. They separate slow, heavy plodding from rhythmic jogging, sustained long running, and full-effort, high-speed sprinting.
groups.summary_zh: 以不同步态、速度与发力程度进行地面奔跑或疾速行进。

groups.name: Settle & Disburse Funds · 支付与费用结算 (Pay, Remit, Defray)
groups.tip: 付款买单结清账目

items.def_zh: 支付，付款；偿还；付代价；值得，带来收益
items.def_en: To give money for goods, services, or debts; to yield a return or benefit.

items.def_zh: 给……开账单，向……收费；把……宣传为，将……列入节目单
items.def_en: To send a bill or charge an amount to someone; to advertise or promote in a specified way.

items.def_zh: （pay的过去式及过去分词）支付，付款；偿还
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of pay: to give money for goods, services, or debts.

items.def_zh: 支付，负担（费用，尤用于 foot the bill）；步行
items.def_en: To pay for something, especially a bill or expenses (most commonly in 'foot the bill'); to walk.

items.def_zh: 付酬金给；出资聘用（尤指专业人士）
items.def_en: To pay a fee to someone (especially a lawyer, doctor, or agent) for their services.
(+ with) to pay what is owed so that debts between parties are cleared
to reluctantly provide or pay an amount of money demanded
(+ sth) to finish paying all the money that you owe for sth

items.def_zh: 结清欠款；全额付款（尤指勉强）
items.def_en: to give sb the money that you owe them, especially when unwilling

items.def_zh: 支付；掏腰包（尤指迫不得已）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to spend a lot of money on sth, especially reluctantly
(British English variant of check) To pay by writing a cheque.
to repay money that someone has spent on official business or services

items.def_zh: 下赌注；付款，出资（尤用于 ante up）
items.def_en: (+ up) (gambling / informal) To put money into the pot before cards are dealt; to pay an amount of money required.

items.def_zh: （prepay的过去式及过去分词）预付，先付
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of prepay: to pay for in advance.

items.def_zh: 汇出，汇寄（款项）；免除，赦免（债务、惩罚）；提交，下呈（审理）
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) (finance) To send money in payment or transfer funds. 2. (formal) To cancel a debt, penalty, or prison sentence.

items.def_zh: （underpay的过去式及过去分词）少付……报酬，付给……过低的工资
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of underpay: to pay too little money for work done.

items.def_zh: 划拨，支付（官方/基金款项）
items.def_en: to pay out money from an official fund or institutional account
(formal) To pay or contribute money toward the cost or expenses of something.
(formal) To pay someone money for work, services, or expenses provided.
To pay for goods, services, or postage in advance before receiving or using them.

items.def_zh: 少付……报酬，付给……过低的工资
items.def_en: To pay a worker less money than they deserve or less than the statutory rate.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail transferring monetary compensation in satisfaction of a debt, invoice, service, or shared cost. Distinct scenario variants encompass advance payment ('prepay'), legal reimbursement/coverage ('defray'), transmitting institutional remittances ('remit'), or footing the entire bill.
groups.summary_zh: 就商品、服务或债务结算款项，包括垫付、汇付及结清。

groups.name: Deceive & Mislead · 欺骗与误导 (Dupe, Swindle, Delude)
groups.tip: 虚假陈述或故意误导他人

items.def_en: (+ into) To deceive someone, often in order to get them to do something foolish
(informal) To confuse, baffle, or trick someone.
(+ into/out of) To trick somebody, especially to gain money or a dishonest advantage
(+ sb) to deceive or trick sb into believing sth false
(+ sb) to mislead sb or encourage them to believe sth that is not true
(+ sb out of sth) to trick sb into giving you money or property
To cause someone to believe something that is not true, especially by giving false or incomplete information.
(+ into) To deliberately make someone believe something that is false, often to gain an advantage.

items.def_zh: 虚张声势，虚张声势地吓唬，蒙骗
items.def_en: To deceive or mislead someone by pretending to be stronger, more confident, or better prepared than you really are.

items.def_zh: 哄骗，戏弄，搞恶作剧欺骗
items.def_en: To trick or deceive someone into believing something false, especially as a practical joke or public fraud.

items.def_zh: 使误入歧途，不当地指引，错误地引导
items.def_en: To lead someone into making wrong judgments, unwise choices, or mistaken actions.
(+ into) To deceive or trick someone, especially someone who is naive or unsuspecting
(literary or dated) To fool, cheat, or deceive someone easily.

items.def_zh: 欺骗，迷惑，哄骗（使产生错觉）
items.def_en: To trick or mislead someone or oneself into believing something that is not true.

items.def_zh: 欺骗，蒙混（尤用于 fob off：用假货或托辞打发）
items.def_en: (chiefly British informal) To deceive someone into accepting something inferior, or to get rid of someone with an excuse (usually in 'fob off').
(+ out of) To cheat someone out of money or property using deceit
To give someone false or inaccurate information, causing them to be mistaken.
(+ into) (informal) To confuse, cheat, or deceive someone completely so they do not realize what is happening.
(+ into) To deceive or trick someone, especially by hiding your true intentions.
(+ into/out of) (literary or archaic) To trick, deceive, or swindle someone into doing or giving something.

groups.summary_en: Communicative verbs where a speaker or actor deliberately misinforms, tricks, or misguides an agent into false beliefs or poor decisions. Register spans informal swindling to literary craftiness.
groups.summary_zh: 蓄意隐瞒真相、欺诈或误导他人使其受骗上当。

groups.name: Acquire to Forcibly Seize · 获取与夺取 (Get, Obtain, Wrest)
groups.tip: 从普通获取到强行夺取

items.def_zh: 获得，得到；取得，拿到；变成；到达
items.def_en: 1. To obtain, receive, or acquire something. 2. To become. 3. To arrive at a place.

items.def_zh: 侵吞，私吞；将……收入囊中；装入衣袋
items.def_en: 1. To take or steal money or valuables dishonestly. 2. To win or earn an amount of money. 3. To put something into a pocket.

items.def_zh: 继承（财产等）；经遗传获得
items.def_en: 1. To receive property, money, or a title from someone after they die. 2. To derive a characteristic from parents or predecessors.
(+ sth) to seize or gather sth suddenly and eagerly

items.def_zh: 夺取，占领；拿取，获取；接受；乘坐
items.def_en: 1. To seize, capture, or gain possession of something by force or authority. 2. To reach out and grasp or obtain something. 3. To accept or receive.
1. To obtain something useful, advantageous, or necessary, especially through effort. 2. To increase in amount or value.

items.def_zh: （经过努力）争取到，获得；固定；使安全
items.def_en: 1. To obtain or achieve something, especially after a lot of effort. 2. To fasten or attach firmly. 3. To protect against danger.

items.def_zh: （通过努力或购买）获得，赢得；存在，流行
items.def_en: 1. To get or acquire something, especially through effort, planning, or request. 2. (formal) To exist, be established, or apply as a custom or rule.

items.def_zh: 取得，获得；购得，收购；学到
items.def_en: 1. To gain possession of something, especially by buying or being given it. 2. To learn, develop, or master a skill or habit.

items.def_zh: 重新获得，收复，夺回；重返
items.def_en: To obtain possession or control of something again after losing it; to reach a place again.
(formal) To obtain something, especially with care or special effort; to buy or acquire goods.

items.def_zh: 夺取，抢去；抓住，拿走（常与 onto 连用）；偷
items.def_en: (North American slang) ('glom onto') To seize, grab, or steal something; to latch onto.
(+ sth) to take sth violently, abruptly, or by surprise
to take hold of suddenly and forcefully; confiscate by legal or physical force
to grasp or seize hastily, eagerly, or violently

items.def_zh: 抢夺，夺取；费力取得；猛扭
items.def_en: (+ from) To take power, control, or an object away from someone violently or with great effort.

items.def_zh: 收回，强制收回（抵押品、未付款财产等）
items.def_en: When a lender or landlord repossesses property, they take it back legally because payments were not made.
(+ sth from sb) to take sth away from sb with a violent twist or heavy struggle

items.def_zh: 篡夺，强行霸占（权力/职位）
items.def_en: to take a position of power, right, or property illegally or by force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail obtaining possession of a physical or abstract asset, arranged along an intensity continuum from neutral receipt or standard acquisition to assertive securing, forceful wresting, and violent expropriation.
groups.summary_zh: 占有所有权或控制权，从常规获取递进至强行夺取与霸占。

groups.name: Curtail & Diminish · 缩减与削减 (Reduce, Decrease, Deplete)
groups.tip: 指标数量由多变少逐步下调

items.def_en: 1. To reduce in amount, price, degree, or value. 2. To move something down to a lower position.
1. To make something smaller or less in size, amount, degree, or price; to become smaller or less. 2. To force into a particular condition.

items.def_zh: 下降，减少，衰落；婉拒，谢绝
items.def_en: 1. To gradually become less, smaller, or weaker in number, amount, or quality. 2. (formal) To politely refuse an offer or invitation.
To become less or smaller in size, amount, degree, or number; to make something less.
(+ sth) to reduce the number, size, or amount of sth
(+ sth) to reduce the size, scope, or extent of an operation or plan
to gradually decrease in amount, rate, or intensity

items.def_zh: 将……减到最低程度，降低；贬低，低估
items.def_en: 1. To reduce something to the lowest possible level, amount, or degree. 2. To make something seem less important than it really is.

items.def_zh: 大幅削减，腰斩（价格/开支）
items.def_en: to reduce drastically, violently, or sharply

items.def_zh: 减弱，抑制；减小（振动），阻尼；弄湿
items.def_en: 1. ('damp down') To make something such as enthusiasm, excitement, or sound less strong or intense. 2. To make something slightly wet.

items.def_zh: 逐渐减少，逐渐变小（常与 off 连用）；（使）逐渐变细
items.def_en: (+ off) To become gradually smaller in amount, degree, or intensity; to become narrower at one end.
To become smaller, less, or weaker; to make something smaller, less, or less severe.
To reduce something, especially supplies, energy, or money, by a large amount.
(+ from) To take away an amount or part from a total sum.

items.def_zh: 削减，缩短（开支/权利/活动）
items.def_en: to cut short, diminish, or reduce in extent or duration
To reduce an amount by fifty percent, or divide something into two equal parts.

items.def_zh: （使）裁员；（使）缩小规模；换搬到较小的住宅
items.def_en: To reduce the number of employees or operations in an organization to cut costs; to move to a smaller home.

items.def_zh: （shrink的过去式及过去分词）变小，缩小；退缩
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of shrink: to become or make smaller; to move back from fear.
[I/T] to become less intense, or cause something to diminish in degree

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express causing a quantity, magnitude, level, or extent to become smaller, or the process of decreasing autonomously. Nuances range from standard arithmetic/volume reduction to strategic downsizing, depletion of reserves, or gradual tapering off.
groups.summary_zh: 指数量、幅度、规模或储备的降低、压缩或耗竭削减。

groups.name: Fasten & Secure · 固定与系紧 (Anchor, Moor, Tether)
groups.tip: 纽扣、拉链或绳缆等固定方式

items.def_en: 1. To attach a bell to an animal or object.

items.def_zh: 扣上纽扣，系紧纽扣；用纽扣扣住
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To fasten a garment with buttons.

items.def_zh: 拉上拉链，用拉链扣紧；飞速移动，疾驰
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To fasten a garment or bag with a zipper. 2. (informal) To move very quickly or briskly.

items.def_zh: 用胸针别住，用别针固定；佩戴胸针装饰
items.def_en: 1. (archaic) To fasten or adorn a garment with an ornamental brooch or pin.
(+ sth) To fasten or secure hatches or objects firmly with battens or ropes
(+ sth) To secure something tightly in place with ropes or chains
(+ sth) To fasten or secure an object firmly to a structure using ropes or cords
(+ to) To attach or fix something firmly so that it cannot move or fall

items.def_zh: 用钩子钩住，扣紧；钩住，捕获；吸引
items.def_en: 1. (+ up/onto) To fasten or secure something with a hook. 2. To catch or hold something with or as if with a hook.

items.def_zh: 用钉子钉牢，把……钉住；抓获，逮住；圆满完成
items.def_en: 1. (+ down/to) To attach or fasten something somewhere by means of nails. 2. (informal) To catch someone or succeed completely at something.

items.def_zh: 用别针/大头针别住，钉住；按住，压住使不能动弹；把（希望、过错等）归咎于
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/onto) To fasten or attach something with a pin. 2. (+ down/against) To hold someone firmly so that they cannot move.

items.def_zh: 抛锚，使固定；紧紧固定，使稳固；主持（电视或广播节目）
items.def_en: 1. To lower an anchor to hold a ship firmly in place, or to fix something firmly and stably to a support. 2. To host a television or radio programme.

items.def_zh: 用绳索捆绑，拴紧；用套索抓捕（牲口）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in/up/off) To tie, bind, or secure something firmly with ropes. 2. To catch an animal using a lasso.

items.def_zh: （用缆绳等）系泊，固定（船只）；泊船
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/at) To secure a boat or ship in place using ropes, cables, or an anchor.

items.def_zh: 扎紧，扣紧，系紧；使固定，固定住；把（目光等）集中于
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/on/up) To close or attach something firmly with a button, zip, belt, or lock. 2. To fix firmly or become fixed in position.
(+ to) To tie an animal or object with a rope or chain to a fixed point to restrict movement

items.def_zh: （登山中）用安全绳系牢，保护；（航海中）把缆绳拴在系索栓上
items.def_en: 1. (climbing / nautical) To secure a climbing rope or ship's line around a pin or device to hold someone or something safely.
(+ sth) To fasten something firmly to the floor or a surface using bolts
(+ to/together) To tie something firmly with a rope or cord

groups.summary_en: Physical manipulation verbs where an agent attaches, anchors, or immobilizes an object or vessel to a fixed structure using fasteners, lines, or mechanical hardware.
groups.summary_zh: 使用绳索、扣具或硬件将物体固定在某处防脱移。

groups.name: Reprove to Fiercely Condemn · 谴责与痛斥 (Criticize, Censure, Excoriate)
groups.tip: 从口头挑错升级为严厉谴责

items.def_zh: 发啧啧声（表示不满、责备或遗憾）
items.def_en: (+ at) (chiefly British) To make a clicking sound with your tongue against your teeth to express disapproval or annoyance.
(+ sb) to scold or reprimand sb severely and formally
(+ sb) to speak angrily to sb because they have done sth wrong
To express disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults; to analyze and evaluate a work.
to express sharp, stern disapproval directly to someone
to rebuke someone formally or officially for a wrongdoing
(informal) To criticize someone severely or say unkind, damaging things about them behind their back.
(+ at sb/sth) to criticize sb/sth suddenly and very angrily

items.def_zh: 贬低，把……说得一文不值，猛烈抨击
items.def_en: (chiefly British & Australian informal) To criticize someone or something severely as worthless or completely wrong.

items.def_zh: 公开谴责，强烈反对，抨击
items.def_en: (formal) To publicly state that you strongly oppose or disapprove of something.
(formal) To criticize or condemn someone officially and severely for bad behavior.
(+ for) To criticize or scold someone angrily and at length.

items.def_zh: 严厉批评，痛斥；体罚，惩罚
items.def_en: (formal) To criticize someone severely for bad behavior; to punish someone physically.
(formal or archaic) To condemn, reject, or express strong disapproval of someone or something.

items.def_zh: 玷污，使蒙受耻辱，给……贴上耻辱的标签
items.def_en: (British English spelling of stigmatize) To treat or mark someone or something as socially unacceptable or shameful.

items.def_zh: 痛斥，公然谴责；告发，检举
items.def_en: (+ as/for) To criticize someone or something publicly and strongly; to accuse someone publicly of illegal or evil acts.
to criticize, reprimand, or punish someone severely

items.def_zh: 严厉指责，痛斥；擦破，损伤（皮肤）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To criticize someone or something severely and mercilessly. 2. (medical) To scratch or scrape off skin.
(+ against) (formal) To speak, protest, or write angrily and fiercely against someone or something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify evaluating someone or something negatively and expressing disapproval, ranging from quiet scoffing ('tut') and formal institutional reprimands ('censure') to blistering, vehement moral assaults and blistering public denunciations ('fulminate', 'excoriate').
groups.summary_zh: 表达不满与批判，从口头轻责递进至严厉谴责与公开痛斥。

groups.name: Ring & Clatter · 鸣响与叮当声 (Tinkle, Clink, Toll)
groups.tip: 大钟沉重悠远敲响报时

items.def_zh: （钟表等）发滴答声；给……打勾，打钩标出；起作用，运转
items.def_en: 1. When a clock or watch ticks, it makes a regular, soft clicking sound every second. 2. (chiefly British) To put a checkmark (✓) beside an item.

items.def_zh: （使）发出叮叮声，发出清脆的金属声
items.def_en: 1. To make a high, clear metallic ringing sound like a small bell or glass.

items.def_zh: 叮咚作响；发出清脆的细响
items.def_en: [I/T] To make a light, clear, delicate ringing sound
to produce a resonant musical ringing sound together or in sequence
to make a continuous series of short, sharp, percussive noises

items.def_zh: （使）发砰/乒的尖锐脆响，发叮当声；（向……）发送简讯或提示音；（计算机）发送ping测试信号
items.def_en: 1. To make a short, sharp, high-pitched ringing sound. 2. (computing / informal) To send a quick message or network signal to check a connection.

items.def_zh: （使）发叮当声，发出金属撞击声；（口语）轻微撞凹；惩罚，扣除
items.def_en: 1. To make a clear metallic ringing sound like a small bell. 2. (informal) To dent something slightly, or to penalize or criticize someone.

items.def_zh: （使）发出哔哔声，嘟嘟响；按（汽车喇叭）
items.def_en: 1. When a horn, alarm, or electronic device beeps, it makes a short, high-pitched sound.

items.def_zh: （钟等）鸣响，敲出和谐的乐声；（钟表）打钟报时；插话，附和 (chime in)
items.def_en: 1. When bells or a clock chime, they make a clear, musical ringing sound. 2. (of a clock) To indicate the hour by ringing musical strokes.

items.def_zh: （使）发出叮当声；（诗歌等）押韵工整
items.def_en: 1. When keys, coins, or small bells jingle, or when you jingle them, they make a light, pleasant metallic ringing sound.

items.def_zh: （油煎等时）发出嘶嘶声；（情感、气氛等）极具吸引力，非常热烈
items.def_en: 1. When food sizzles in a hot pan, it makes a sharp hissing sound; (informal) to be extremely hot, exciting, or passionate.

items.def_zh: 发出哔哔声；（在广播电视中用哔哔声）遮蔽敏感词
items.def_en: 1. To make a short, high-pitched electronic sound, or censor a swear word on television or radio with a tone.
[I/T] (+ against/together) To make a short, light, sharp ringing sound like glassware or metal touching
to make a clear, resonant, and loud sound

items.def_zh: （缓迎慢送地）敲（钟），鸣（钟）；（钟）沉重缓慢地鸣响；征收（通行税等）
items.def_en: 1. When a large bell tolls, or someone tolls it, it rings slowly with deep, solemn strokes. 2. To collect a toll or fee from.

items.def_zh: （使）发出咯咯声/咔嗒声；使慌乱，使紧张；喋喋不休地说
items.def_en: 1. To make a rapid series of short, sharp knocking sounds, or shake something so it makes this noise. 2. (informal) To make someone nervous, frightened, or upset.

items.def_zh: （大钟等）发咚咚声，沉重地鸣响
items.def_en: 1. When a large heavy bell dongs, it makes a deep, resonant ringing sound.

items.def_zh: （大钟或锣等）咚咚地响，发出低沉悠长的撞击声
items.def_en: 1. When a large bell or gong bongs, it makes a deep, resonant booming sound.
[I/T] To ring loudly and resonantly, especially a set of church bells

groups.summary_en: Auditory perception verbs depicting the production of metallic, high-frequency, or percussive ringing and striking sounds, differing by resonance, sharpness, and duration.
groups.summary_zh: 发出清脆、金属撞击或深沉悠扬的敲击鸣响声。

groups.name: Slide & Glide · 滑动与滑行 (Slide, Slip, Glide)
groups.tip: 表面平滑无阻前行

items.def_en: to move smoothly and effortlessly across a surface or through the air
To glide smoothly across an icy or slick surface
(+ sth) to move smoothly down a slippery or inclined surface
to slide smoothly or accidentally away from a surface or position

items.def_zh: （车辆等）滑行，惯性前行；轻易成功，得过且过
items.def_en: To move effortlessly without using power or pedaling; to succeed or make progress with little effort.
(+ on/across) To slide accidentally for a short distance, often losing one's balance

items.def_zh: （使）滑行，（使）滑动；悄悄移动；滑落，下跌
items.def_en: To move smoothly along a surface, or to make something do this; to move quietly or drop gradually.
To glide smoothly over ice on ice skates, or over a hard surface on roller skates or a skateboard.
To move smoothly over snow or water on a pair of skis.

items.def_zh: 滑行，滑翔；轻快平稳地移动
items.def_en: (+ across/through/down) To move smoothly, quietly, and effortlessly; to fly without engine power.

items.def_zh: （slide的过去式及过去分词）（使）滑动，（使）滑行；滑落
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of slide: to move smoothly along a surface; to decline gradually.

items.def_zh: 乘雪橇滑行；用雪橇运送
items.def_en: (chiefly North American) To ride down snow on a sled, or transport loads using a sled.

items.def_zh: 乘雪橇滑行；用雪橇运送
items.def_en: (chiefly British) To slide or travel over snow on a sledge; to carry loads on a sledge.

items.def_zh: （自行车等）滑行，不用脚踩骑行；随心所欲，不受拘束地行事
items.def_en: To travel downhill or forward on a bicycle without pedaling; to live or act freely without strict controls.
To slide uncontrollably across a wet road surface on a thin film of water
(of a vehicle or wheel) To slide uncontrollably sideways on a wet, icy, or loose surface.
To glide down snow-covered slopes while standing on a snowboard.

items.def_zh: （蛇般）蜿蜒滑行，滑动；不稳地滑动
items.def_en: (+ across/into/down) To slide smoothly along a surface with a twisting, sinuous motion; to slip or slide unsteadily.

items.def_zh: 坐平底雪橇滑行；暴跌，骤降
items.def_en: To slide down a snow-covered hill on a toboggan; to fall or drop sharply.

groups.summary_en: Manner-of-motion verbs where an entity moves smoothly, continuously, or involuntarily over a low-friction surface without taking steps. Distinctions relate to friction control, equipment used, and surface type.
groups.summary_zh: 沿光滑表面平稳、低阻力或失控地滑动前行。

groups.name: Surpass & Exceed · 超越与胜过 (Outdo, Eclipse, Surpass)
groups.tip: 在数量能力或地位上凌驾压制

items.def_en: (+ to sb/sth) to be as good as expected or reach a necessary level or competitor
(+ of sb/sth) to overtake and establish a lead over competitors
To surpass or do better than someone or something; to improve upon a previous standard or record.
To win more points, goals, or marks than an opponent in a game or contest.
To be more successful or do something better than someone else

items.def_zh: 在军衔、地位或级别上高于
items.def_en: To hold a higher official rank, position, or status than someone else.

items.def_zh: 高于，高耸于……之上；超越，胜过
items.def_en: (literary) To rise higher than or tower above something else; to surpass.

items.def_zh: 做得比预期更好，超水平发挥，取得超出预期的成就
items.def_en: To perform better or achieve greater success than expected from past ability or standards.
(+ sb/sth) to be vastly superior to or far surpass others in quality or achievement

items.def_zh: 超过，胜过，优于；位居……之首；给……加顶
items.def_en: To surpass or be superior to someone or something; to be at the top of a list or rank.
To be greater than a particular number, amount, or limit; to surpass expectations.
To be better or greater than someone or something; to exceed a record, expectation, or standard.
To be exceptionally good at doing something; to perform better than others.

items.def_zh: 使显得矮小，使相形见绌
items.def_en: To make someone or something seem very small or insignificant by comparison.

items.def_zh: 超越，超出（通常界限、范围或经验）
items.def_en: (formal) To go beyond the usual limits, boundaries, or human understanding of something.
To be so prominent or remarkable as to diminish the apparent importance of another

items.def_zh: 占优势，占主导地位；数量上占多数
items.def_en: (+ over/in) To be the largest in number, most noticeable, or most powerful element in a group or situation.
To grow, develop, or improve much faster and surpass another completely

items.def_zh: 使黯然失色，使相形见绌；遮蔽，掩盖；（天体）形成日食/月食于
items.def_en: 1. To make someone or something seem far less important, successful, or impressive by comparison. 2. (astronomy) To block the light from a celestial body.

groups.summary_en: Gradable verbs indicating one entity being greater than another in quality, number, or achievement. Nuances scale from simply topping a threshold to utterly outclassing and overshadowing rivals.
groups.summary_zh: 在数量、程度、能力或声望上高出并超越对手。

groups.name: Think & Deduce · 沉思与推断 (Ponder, Deduce, Conclude)
groups.tip: 动用脑力进行逻辑推理

items.def_en: (dated) To have only a superficial knowledge of something, or to speak or think superficially about it.

items.def_zh: 思考，考虑；认为，以为；料想
items.def_en: To use the mind to consider, reason, or solve problems; to hold an opinion or belief.

items.def_zh: 仔细考虑，斟酌；认为，看作；顾及
items.def_en: To think carefully about something, especially before deciding; to regard in a specified way.

items.def_zh: 想知道，纳闷，琢磨；感到惊奇，惊叹
items.def_en: To think about something with curiosity or doubt and try to understand it; to feel surprise and admiration.

items.def_zh: 认为，料想，猜想；计算，估计
items.def_en: (+ that) (informal) To think, believe, or expect that something is true; to calculate or estimate.
To understand or solve something through sustained thought or trial
(+ sth) to consider all the possible details and consequences of sth carefully
(+ sth) to solve or deduce the answer to a problem by thinking

items.def_zh: 推论，推断；逻辑思考，讲理；劝说
items.def_en: To form conclusions or judgments through logical thought; to persuade someone using rational arguments.

items.def_zh: 抽象地考虑，把……抽象出来；提炼，提取；作摘要
items.def_en: To consider something theoretically or separately from concrete realities; to extract or remove; to summarize.
[I/T] (+ on/over) To think about something carefully and deeply, especially before making a decision

items.def_zh: 忧思，沉思，焦虑地思索；孵（蛋）
items.def_en: 1. (+ over/about/on) To think deeply and unhappily about something for a long time. 2. (of a bird) To sit on eggs to hatch them.
(+ from) To form an opinion or deduce a conclusion based on evidence and reasoning.

items.def_zh: 建立理论，推测，提出假说
items.def_en: (+ about/that) To develop or propose a theory or explanation to account for something.

items.def_zh: （依据已知事实）推断，推知；外推
items.def_en: (+ from) To estimate or predict unknown facts or values by extending known information and data.

items.def_zh: 重新解释，作出新理解，重新诠释
items.def_en: To understand or explain a text, concept, or event in a new or different way.
(+ sth) to find an answer or solution by logical thought and deduction
(+ that) To form an opinion or decide something after considering all available evidence

items.def_zh: 演绎推导出；根据已知推断出
items.def_en: (+ from) To reach an inescapable conclusion using logical reasoning based on known facts

groups.summary_en: Cognitive verbs where an agent applies deliberate mental effort to process facts, weigh possibilities, and draw inferences. Nuances range from casual pondering and deep brooding to formal logical deduction.
groups.summary_zh: 运用心智思考、考量并依据线索推导出结论。

groups.name: Annoy & Provoke · 激怒与惹恼 (Irritate, Exasperate, Enrage)
groups.tip: 从小事烦扰逐步升级到怒火中烧

items.def_en: (informal) to deliberately annoy, tease, or provoke someone, especially with repeated remarks.
to annoy, irritate, or provoke someone slightly.
(+ sb) To annoy or exasperate someone
(+ sb) To deliberately say or do things to tease, irritate, or anger someone

items.def_zh: 烦扰，惹恼；在……安装窃听器
items.def_en: 1. (informal) to annoy or irritate someone persistently. 2. to place a hidden listening device in a room or phone.

items.def_zh: 惹恼，折磨，戏弄；用辛辣调料烹制
items.def_en: 1. to cause annoyance in or harass someone with petty irritations. 2. to coat or cook food with hot, pungent seasonings.

items.def_zh: 使烦躁，激怒；刺激（身体部位，引起疼痛或发炎）
items.def_en: 1. to annoy someone or make them impatient. 2. to make a part of the body sore, red, or inflamed.
To annoy somebody intensely, often worsening an already strained situation

items.def_zh: 使恼怒，激怒；磨伤，擦破（皮肤）
items.def_en: 1. to make someone feel very annoyed, bitter, or resentful. 2. to make skin raw or sore by rubbing.

items.def_zh: 使耿耿于怀，使怨恨，令人生怨；化脓
items.def_en: to cause continued anger, annoyance, or resentment over a long period.
(+ sb) To annoy, infuriate, or make someone very angry
(+ sb) To stir someone up to intense irritation, agitation, or anger
1. to deliberately annoy or anger someone so that they react aggressively. 2. to cause a particular reaction, feeling, or situation.
To annoy and irritate somebody intensely, especially through persistent friction

items.def_zh: 激怒，使极度愤慨；触犯，违犯
items.def_en: to make someone extremely angry and shocked, especially through an unjust, cruel, or offensive action.
To make someone extremely angry or furious

items.def_zh: 激怒，使大怒；焚香，用香熏
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) to make someone extremely angry and indignant. 2. to perfume or burn with incense.
to make someone extremely angry.

groups.summary_en: Emotion-induction verbs describing acts that stimulate negative affective responses, scaling from minor prickling irritation to unbearable provocation and blind fury.
groups.summary_zh: 引发不快情绪，从轻度烦躁惹恼递进至怒不可遏。

groups.name: Decorate & Adorn · 装饰与美化 (Embellish, Bedeck, Garnish)
groups.tip: 添置饰物装点以增加美观

items.def_zh: 为……增色，使优美，装饰；使荣耀，赏光
items.def_en: 1. to make something more attractive or pleasing; adorn. 2. to bring honor or dignity to someone or something by being present.
(+ sb/sth) To make someone or something look neater, cleaner, or more attractive
(+ sb/sth) To decorate or dress someone or something in a very elaborate or festive way
(+ sth) To furnish, equip, or decorate something elaborately or attractively

items.def_zh: 收拾美化；整理得焕然一新
items.def_en: (+ sth) To improve the appearance of something by cleaning or decorating it

items.def_zh: 装饰，装点；粉刷，装修；授予勋章
items.def_en: 1. to make something more attractive by adding ornament, paint, or details. 2. to paint or paper the interior of a room or building. 3. to award a medal or decoration to someone.

items.def_zh: 用羽毛装饰；长羽毛；（划船等中）转桨（以减少阻力）
items.def_en: 1. to cover, line, or decorate something with feathers. 2. to turn an oar blade or propeller edgewise to reduce air or water resistance.
to decorate or embellish something to make it look more attractive.
to decorate or embellish someone or something with attractive objects or features.
(+ with) To make something more beautiful by adding decorative features or details
(+ with) To add a decorative embellishment, especially a small piece of food to a dish

items.def_zh: 以杂色斑纹装饰，给……饰以菱形花纹
items.def_en: to decorate or variegate with a pattern of bright, contrasting diamond shapes or patches.

items.def_zh: 用闪烁的小饰物装饰，点缀；（使）闪烁
items.def_en: (often passive) to decorate or cover something with small sparkling objects, lights, or spots.

items.def_zh: 镶嵌，嵌饰（inlay的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: (past and past participle of inlay) to decorate a surface by embedding pieces of wood, metal, or stone into it.

items.def_zh: 用纹章（或图案、文字）装饰；醒目地展示；赞美
items.def_en: 1. to decorate something with a coat of arms, crest, or vivid pattern. 2. to display a design, name, or symbol conspicuously.

items.def_zh: 使显现斑驳光影，使缀满斑点（或斑纹）
items.def_en: (often passive) to mark or decorate a surface with spots of light, shadow, or color.

items.def_zh: 以彩带（或花环等）装点，张灯结彩
items.def_en: (often passive) to decorate a place with hanging chains or garlands of ribbons, flowers, or lights.
(+ with/in) To decorate or clothe somebody/something in a showy, lavish way

groups.summary_en: Verbs of surface enhancement and decorative design, where an agent adds artistic ornaments, colors, or materials to improve visual appeal. Nuances differ by formality and aesthetic style.
groups.summary_zh: 通过增设饰品、花纹或点缀物使事物更加美观华贵。

groups.name: Apportion & Distribute · 划分、分配与拨给
groups.tip: 把物资分发配给各方

items.def_en: to distribute something to people, often in large amounts or in a casual manner
(+ sth) To share or divide something up among several people
to give out something in small amounts, often reluctantly or charity-style
(+ sth) To distribute things by hand to each member of a group
(+ sth) To divide something into parts or portions and distribute them
(+ sth) To divide something into specified amounts or shares and distribute them

items.def_zh: 分摊，分配；分享，共享；共有
items.def_en: 1. To divide something into parts and distribute them among several people. 2. To have, use, or experience something together with others.
To put someone on a fixed allowance, or supply goods in limited, regular rations.

items.def_zh: 分发，分配（parcel out）；打包，裹好（parcel up）
items.def_en: 1. (parcel out) To divide land, money, or work into shares and distribute them. 2. (parcel up) To wrap something into a package.

items.def_zh: 给予；分发（处罚、正义或份额）
items.def_en: to dispense or apportion justice, punishment, or harsh treatment
To divide into lots or parcels, especially of land or goods for distribution or sale.

items.def_zh: 分发，分配；分销；散布，分布
items.def_en: To give or share something out to a number of people, or supply goods over an area.
To officially assign or distribute resources, money, or tasks for a specific purpose or person.
(+ to) to give a particular amount of time, money, space, etc. to someone or something as a share
To share or distribute wealth, land, goods, or responsibilities again in a different or fairer way.
To divide and share out money, resources, or responsibilities fairly among people or groups.
To distribute money, resources, or duties again in a different way or to different people.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to dividing up a finite quantity of goods, funds, or responsibilities and dispensing parts to different recipients or destinations. Distinctions center on whether the division is formal and budgeted (allocate, apportion), shared mutually (share), or parcelled out in discrete physical shares (parcel, lot).
groups.summary_zh: 将资金、份额、土地或责任依特定原则或份额分派与拨付给各方。

groups.name: Cut, Snip & Sever · 切割、修剪与劈削
groups.tip: 借助刀锯切割分段或修边

items.def_en: (+ sth) To remove something with a quick, short cut using scissors or shears

items.def_zh: 割伤；划出缺口，刻痕于；偷窃
items.def_en: 1. To make a small, shallow cut in something or someone. 2. (informal) To steal something.

items.def_zh: 修剪，剪下；夹住，扣牢；轻撞
items.def_en: 1. To cut short or trim something with shears or scissors. 2. To fasten something with a clip or clamp.

items.def_zh: 剪短，修剪；裁剪（照片）；收获，种植
items.def_en: 1. To cut or trim something very short. 2. To cut off the edges of a picture or photograph.
to cut away irregular or unwanted parts to make something neat and tidy

items.def_zh: 用剪刀剪；（使双腿等）像剪刀般开合移动
items.def_en: 1. To cut something with scissors. 2. To move, or move your legs, in a sharp crossing motion like scissor blades.
To cut something quickly with small, short strokes using scissors.
(+ sth) To remove or sever a piece of something using a sharp instrument

items.def_zh: 切，割，剪，砍；削减，降低；中断
items.def_en: 1. To divide, trim, or make an opening in something using a sharp instrument. 2. To reduce the amount, size, or number of something.

items.def_zh: 锯，锯开；拉锯般来回移动
items.def_en: To cut something using a saw, or make a back-and-forth cutting movement.
[I/T] to cut something into pieces with repeated downward strokes of an axe, heavy knife, etc.
to cut the wool off a sheep, or cut hair or foliage using large scissors or shears

items.def_zh: 用长柄大镰刀割；扫除，迅猛穿过
items.def_en: To cut grass, grain, or weeds with a scythe, or sweep through something rapidly and powerfully.
(+ sth) To sever or detach something with a forceful blow using a blade or axe
(+ sth) To sever something roughly and violently with repeated clumsy chops

items.def_zh: 劈，砍；非法侵入（计算机系统）；应付，搞定
items.def_en: 1. To cut or chop something roughly or violently with heavy blows. 2. To gain unauthorized access to a computer system.
to cut completely through something, dividing it cleanly into separate parts

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe dividing, incising, or removing portions of a physical entity using a sharp-edged tool. Nuances depend heavily on tool type and kinetic force: light quick snips with scissors (snip, scissor, clip), agricultural swinging strokes (scythe, sickle), toothed abrasions (saw), or rough, forceful chops (hack).
groups.summary_zh: 使用利器或刀刃实施切开、剪短、劈削或锯断等动作。

groups.name: Damage to Annihilate · 破坏、毁损与彻底湮灭
groups.tip: 毁坏并使之彻底瓦解消亡

items.def_zh: 毁灭，摧毁；撤销，使归于乌有（unmake的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: (past and past participle of unmake) To undo, destroy, or reverse something that has been made or established.
(+ sth) To violently and severely damage or destroy something by hitting it
(+ sth) To deliberately demolish or take apart a building or structure
(slang) To murder or kill someone intentionally.
To damage something so severely that it no longer exists or cannot be repaired; to ruin or put an end to something.

items.def_zh: 破坏，毁掉；使（船只、车辆等）失事
items.def_en: To severely damage or destroy something; to cause a ship or vehicle to be wrecked in an accident.

items.def_zh: 毁坏（建筑物等）的内部；取出……的内脏
items.def_en: 1. To destroy the inside or contents of a building, especially by fire. 2. To remove the internal organs of a person, animal, or fish.
to cause extensive damage or utter destruction across a wide area
to completely pull down or knock down a building or large structure
To destroy or be destroyed deliberately, especially a rocket or missile for safety reasons.

items.def_zh: 采伐……的森林，砍光……的树木
items.def_en: To clear an area of trees or forests.
(+ sth) To destroy something or be destroyed completely by an explosion
(+ sb/sth) To destroy, eliminate, or eradicate completely
To spoil or destroy something completely; to cause someone to lose all their money, power, or status.
to remove all signs of something, totally destroying its existence
to destroy something or someone completely so that nothing remains

items.def_zh: 切开……的肚子取出内脏，开膛；彻底破坏……的内部
items.def_en: To cut open a body and remove its internal organs; (figurative) to remove the essential contents of something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale frame denote causing structural impairment, catastrophic ruin, or total elimination of an entity. They progress in severity from spoiling or breaking functionality (unmade, ruin), to severe physical wrecking (gut, wreck, disembowel), up to absolute total annihilation (destroy, destruct, off).
groups.summary_zh: 从使之失效、局部毁坏，递增至开膛破坏与彻底摧毁消灭。

groups.name: Insert & Embed · 插入与嵌入 (Incorporate, Imbed, Lodge)
groups.tip: 将物体塞入、穿插或嵌入缝隙

items.def_en: (+ sth) To insert or place something quickly and easily into a small space or opening
(+ sth) To slide or fit neatly into a narrow opening, groove, or space
(+ sth) To push or fold the edges of something neatly into an opening or under something
(+ into) To put or position something neatly and securely into a specific place

items.def_zh: 把……塞进，塞入；卷起，收拢；缝褶裥
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/under/away) To push loose edges neatly into a space, or insert something snugly to keep it tidy or secure.

items.def_zh: 在……中插入（页、层或数据块）；交错排列
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To insert blank or different pages, layers, or data blocks alternately between existing ones.

items.def_zh: （在历法中）插入闰日/闰月；插入，嵌入（地层等）
items.def_en: 1. (calendar / geology) To insert an extra day or month into a calendar, or insert a layer between existing rock strata.
(+ in) To set or place an object firmly into a ground or substance

items.def_zh: 夹入，把……夹在两物之间；挤在狭小空间或时间中
items.def_en: 1. (+ between) To fit or squeeze someone or something tightly between two other things or people.
[I/T] (+ in) To become firmly fixed, embedded, or stuck in a narrow or solid space
1. (+ into/between) To put or introduce something into something else.

items.def_zh: 嵌入，插入；深深刻入，使铭记
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To fix an object, idea, or code firmly and deeply into a surrounding mass or system.

items.def_zh: （给……）注射；注入，灌注（资金、想法等）；引入
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/with) To put a drug or liquid into a body using a needle and syringe. 2. To introduce or add a new quality, idea, or money into something.

items.def_zh: 置于……之间，插入；介入，干预；插嘴
items.def_en: 1. (+ between) (formal) To place something between two things or people. 2. To interrupt a conversation with a remark, or intervene in a dispute.

items.def_zh: 嵌入，插入；深深刻入（同 embed）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) (variant spelling of embed) To fix an object, idea, or code firmly and deeply into a surrounding mass or system.

items.def_zh: 给……插管，将导管插入（气管或体内）
items.def_en: 1. (medicine) To insert a breathing or feeding tube into a patient's windpipe or stomach.
1. to insert something, especially an affix into the middle of a word. 2. to implant or fix firmly in the mind.

groups.summary_en: Spatial manipulation verbs where an agent introduces, slides, or firmly nests an object into an opening, tight container, or surrounding solid matrix.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品置入间隙、夹层或紧紧嵌进外部实体之中。

groups.name: Join, Fasten & Interlock · 物理连接与嵌合
groups.tip: 采用铰接或联轴结为复合体

items.def_en: (+ sth) To connect or fasten mechanical or electrical components together
(+ sth) To join various parts or fragments together to create a single complete entity
(+ to/together) to connect two or more things physically or mechanically
To join, link, or combine two things, vehicles, or concepts together.
To connect two words or parts of a word with a hyphen.
To fit or interlock closely together so as to form a rigid whole

items.def_zh: 连接，接合；联合，结合；加入，参加
items.def_en: 1. To connect, fasten, or link two or more things together. 2. To become a member of a group or participate in an activity.

items.def_zh: 连接，联结；接通（电话、网络）；使产生联系
items.def_en: To join or link two or more things together; to establish a relationship or communication channel.

items.def_zh: 绞接，拼接（绳索、电线、胶片等）；使结合
items.def_en: To join the ends of two ropes, wires, or pieces of film together so that they form one continuous piece.
To fit or lock firmly together so that the movement of one part affects the other.

items.def_zh: 给（牲畜）套上轭；连接，使紧密结合
items.def_en: To join two animals together with a yoke, or link two things closely together.

items.def_zh: 以鸠尾榫接合；严密嵌合
items.def_en: [I/T] to join two pieces of wood with interlocking tenons; to fit together closely and neatly
To connect or link two or more things closely together so they depend on or relate to each other.
To join two pieces of wood or molding at an angle, usually a 45-degree bevel, to form a corner.

items.def_zh: （使）连锁，连结成串；（计算机）连接（字符串或数据）
items.def_en: To link things, such as strings of text, data, or events, together in a continuous chain or series.
[I/T] to join together physically by melting, blending, or heating
(+ together/to) to join pieces of metal or plastic by heating them until soft or liquid and hammering or pressing them

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the mechanical or physical union of two or more entities into a continuous whole. The manner varies from simple adjacency (join, connect) to mechanical harnessing (yoke, couple), structural overlapping (splice, miter), and interlocking configurations (interlock, interlink, concatenate).
groups.summary_zh: 通过机械、嵌合、拼接等物理方式将两物连接或合为一体。

groups.name: Assess & Evaluate · 评估、估算与再评价
groups.tip: 对价值或状况全面估量

items.def_en: to form an approximate judgment or calculation concerning the size, value, or cost of something
To evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, or value of someone or something.
To judge or calculate the quality, importance, amount, or value of something.
(+ sb/sth) To carefully examine and form a judgment or appraisal of someone or something
(+ sth) To evaluate the pros and cons or relative worth of something before deciding

items.def_zh: 判定；估算；判断（态度或反应）
items.def_en: to make a judgment about people's feelings, opinions, or a complex situation
to fail to recognize the true quality, value, or importance of someone or something
To think or judge that someone or something is better, stronger, or more important than they really are.
To calculate or estimate an amount, value, size, or person's ability too high.
to judge the value, quality, or condition of someone or something, often in an official or professional capacity
To examine and judge the value, quality, or importance of something again.

items.def_zh: 重新评估，重新审视；重新核定
items.def_en: To think carefully again about a situation, value, or person in order to decide if your opinion or plan should change.

items.def_zh: 高估（价值、重要性）；对……估价过高
items.def_en: To think or decide that something is worth more money or importance than it actually is.

items.def_zh: 预先判断，先入为主地评判
items.def_en: To form an opinion or judgment about someone or something before knowing all the facts.

items.def_zh: 重新评估（财产或资产价值）；使（货币）升值
items.def_en: To assess the worth of an asset or property again, or officially raise the exchange value of a currency.
To examine and judge the value, quality, or situation of someone or something again.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the cognitive act of judging the quality, importance, value, or performance of something or someone. They range from neutral, objective appraisal (assess, evaluate) to subjective misjudgment or bias (prejudge, overrate, overestimate) and formal revisitation (reassess, reevaluate).
groups.summary_zh: 对事物或人的价值、能力、质量进行考量、估测或二次评价。

groups.name: Bind, Tether & Restrain · 绑缚、栓系与物理束缚
groups.tip: 打结穿带紧紧系在一起

items.def_zh: 用系带束紧，系紧；使交织；在……中添加（烈酒、毒药等）
items.def_en: 1. To fasten or tighten shoes or clothing by pulling strings or cords through eyelets. 2. To add a small amount of alcohol, drug, or poison to food or drink.
(+ sb/sth) To tie or wrap tightly with cloth, rope, or bandages
(+ sb/sth) To bind someone or something tightly with ropes or cords so they cannot move
(+ with/to) to tie someone or something tightly with rope, string, or tape

items.def_zh: 把……打结，绑紧；（使）纠缠成结；（肌肉等）痉挛紧绷
items.def_en: 1. To tie string, rope, or ribbon into a knot, or become tangled. 2. To become tight and painful from tension, or make muscles do so.

items.def_zh: 用皮带（或绳子）拴住；束缚，控制
items.def_en: To restrain and control an animal with a leash, or curb something tightly.

items.def_zh: 捆绑，绑紧；扎紧（待烹饪的禽类的翅膀和腿）
items.def_en: To tie someone's arms and legs, or a bird's legs and wings before cooking, tightly with string or rope.

items.def_zh: （用绳或链）拴住，系住；束缚，限制
items.def_en: To tie an animal or object with a rope or chain to a fixed point so it cannot move far.

items.def_zh: 用紧身胸衣束紧；严格限制，约束
items.def_en: 1. To dress or bind someone tightly in a supporting corset. 2. To restrict or constrain someone or something strictly.
(+ sb/sth) To tie up someone's limbs or an animal tightly and securely
To put handcuffs on someone to restrain them; (figurative) to restrict someone's freedom of action.
to put handcuffs, fetters, or chains on someone to prevent free movement

items.def_zh: 捆绑（两臂）；绑住，压住；剪去（鸟的）飞羽
items.def_en: To tie or hold someone's arms tightly to stop them from moving; to cut off the wing tips of a bird to prevent flight.
to tie someone's feet together with chains; to heavily restrict freedom

items.def_zh: 使不能移动，使固定；使瘫痪，使丧失机动性
items.def_en: To prevent someone or something from moving or functioning normally.
to bind someone's hands or legs with metal manacles

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to restricting the physical movement or freedom of a person or animal using ropes, chains, cords, or mechanical restraints. Differences hinge on the restraining device (handcuff, leash, tether, lace), binding complexity (knot, truss), or targeted limb restriction (pinion).
groups.summary_zh: 使用绳索、系带、手铐等用具使对象固定或剥夺其行动自由。

groups.name: Harden, Congeal & Solidify · 硬化、凝结与固化
groups.tip: 物理结壳或化学交联变硬

items.def_en: to change from a liquid or soft state into a firm, solid state
To form or become covered with a hard outer layer or crust.
To become firm, rigid, or solid, or make something do so
To gradually become rigid, stiff, or less pliable
[I/T] to become solid or firm, or to cause a liquid or gas to do so

items.def_zh: （使）变硬，（使）僵硬；（使）变坚定，增强
items.def_en: To become firm, hard, or rigid, or to make something firm, hard, or rigid; to become or make more determined.
(often callus over) To form or cause to form thick, hardened patches of skin.

items.def_zh: （对金属、玻璃等）进行退火处理；锻炼，磨炼
items.def_en: To heat metal or glass and allow it to cool slowly to make it harder, tougher, or less brittle; (figurative) to strengthen or temper.

items.def_zh: （使）钙化，（使）硬化；（态度、制度等）僵化
items.def_en: 1. To become or cause to become hard by the deposition of calcium salts. 2. (figurative) (of attitudes, beliefs, or institutions) to become rigid and unchanging.
To become thick or solid, or cause a liquid to thicken into a solid or semi-solid state, especially upon cooling.
(especially of blood or liquids) To change from a liquid into a thick, semi-solid mass.
To become completely solid or immobilized through freezing
[I/T] to become hard like bone, or turn into bone tissue

items.def_zh: （使）玻璃化，（使）变成玻璃状物质
items.def_en: To convert or be converted into glass or a glassy substance, especially by extreme heat.
To treat rubber with sulfur at high temperatures to increase its strength, elasticity, and durability.
[I/T] to change into stone or a stony substance by chemical mineral replacement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the phase change or physical transformation of a substance from soft, liquid, or malleable into a firm, rigid, or glass-like solid. The process may be biological (callus, calcify), chemical/thermal (anneal, vulcanize, vitrify), or colloidal/viscous (coagulate, congeal, stiffen).
groups.summary_zh: 物质由软变硬、由液体或可塑态转化为坚硬固体或凝胶态。

groups.name: Increase & Expand · 增加与扩大 (Enlarge, Augment, Amplify)
groups.tip: 通过添加扩充或倍增扩大规模

items.def_zh: 增加，添加；做加法；补充说
items.def_en: 1. to put something together with something else to increase the size, number, or amount. 2. to calculate the total of two or more numbers. 3. to say something further.
to add something extra to an existing thing in order to improve or complete it.
(+ sth) To gradually increase in amount, size, or strength over time
(+ sth) To sharply increase the rate, volume, or intensity of something
(+ sth) To increase the size, amount, or extent of something proportionally
(+ sth) To boost or increase the speed, intensity, or level of an activity
[I/T] (+ into/by) To become greater or make something greater in size, scope, or extent
To make something increase, become better, or be more successful

items.def_zh: 扩大，扩展；放大（照片等）；详述，阐述
items.def_en: 1. to make something bigger or to become bigger. 2. to produce a larger print of a photograph. 3. (+ on/upon) to speak or write about something in greater detail.
to increase the size, amount, value, or strength of something by adding to it.

items.def_zh: 变宽，变阔；扩大，拓宽（范围、经验、知识等）
items.def_en: to become wider, or to expand the scope, range, or variety of something.

items.def_zh: （使）加倍，（使）增加一倍；兼任；折叠
items.def_en: 1. to become twice as much or as many, or to make something twice as large. 2. (+ as) to have a second role, purpose, or job. 3. to bend or fold something over.
to become three times as much or as many, or to make something three times as big.

items.def_zh: 增加，成倍增加；乘，使相乘；繁殖
items.def_en: 1. to increase greatly in number or amount, or to make something do this. 2. to calculate the product of two numbers. 3. to reproduce or cause organisms to reproduce.
To increase the strength, volume, or significance of something

items.def_zh: 使增加到最大限度，最大化；充分利用
items.def_en: 1. to increase something to the greatest possible amount or degree. 2. to make the best or most effective use of something.

groups.summary_en: Quantity and scale transformation verbs where an agent or process boosts the number, volume, dimension, or extent of an entity, ranging from simple arithmetic addition to strategic scaling.
groups.summary_zh: 使规模、尺寸、数量或范围在原有基础上扩张放大。

groups.name: Weave, Knit & Sew · 纺织、针织与缝纫
groups.tip: 穿针引线编结织物成衣

items.def_en: (+ sth) To join or interloop threads or elements closely together
(+ sth) To fasten pieces of textile or material together using stitches
(+ sth) To join or mend fabric or wounds using a needle and thread

items.def_zh: 织入金银丝；织成（花纹织物）
items.def_en: to weave, especially with gold or silver threads, into rich decorative fabric.
[I/T] to join, fasten, or repair something using a needle and thread
[I/T] to make clothes, blankets, etc. by looping yarn with a hooked needle
to join three or more strands of hair, straw, or fabric by interlacing them

items.def_zh: 在（织物）上缝打褶花边，绣蜂巢形褶裥；给……穿上罩衫
items.def_en: 1. to gather fabric into close decorative folds with embroidered stitching. 2. to dress someone in a smock.

items.def_zh: 织反针，织反缝；（溪流等）潺潺流动
items.def_en: 1. To knit with a reverse stitch that creates a raised horizontal ridge. 2. (of a shallow stream) To flow with a gentle, murmuring sound.

items.def_zh: 编织；使紧密结合；（断骨）愈合；皱（眉）
items.def_en: 1. To make clothes or fabric from yarn using long needles or a machine. 2. To join together closely and firmly; (of broken bones) to heal and grow together.
To join, repair, or make clothes and fabric items using a needle and thread or a sewing machine.

items.def_zh: 织，编织；编造，虚构；穿梭，迂回行进
items.def_en: 1. To make cloth, a basket, or a pattern by crossing threads or strips over and under each other. 2. To move along by turning and dodging around obstacles.
[I/T] to decorate fabric with patterns sewn with colored thread
[I/T] to join threads, fibers, or strips by weaving them under and over one another

items.def_zh: 织入锦缎花纹，在……上织出凸纹花样
items.def_en: To weave rich, raised decorative patterns—often with gold or silver thread—into heavy fabric.
To divide, form, or mark into a fine network of intersecting lines or veins.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the interlocking, interlacing, or stitching of yarn, thread, or fabric to construct or decorate textiles. Nuances range from basic joining with needle and thread (sew, stitch) to structured looping (knit, crochet) and perpendicular interlacing on a loom (weave).
groups.summary_zh: 用针线或纱线交错、环套成布或进行缝合加固。

groups.name: Affection & Veneration · 喜爱与崇敬 (Like, Love, Adore, Revere)
groups.tip: 从单纯喜欢到顶礼膜拜的情感递进

items.def_en: To feel a mild attraction toward or liking for someone or something
(+ sb/sth) feel affection, fondness, or liking toward someone
To find someone or something pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable; to prefer or wish for.
(+ sb) have a great deal of respect and admiration for someone

items.def_zh: 爱，热爱；非常喜欢，倾心于
items.def_en: To feel deep affection, passion, or fondness for someone or something.
To admire someone deeply for their abilities, qualities, or achievements; to treat with consideration or regard.
To regard someone or something with respect, wonder, or approval.
To hold someone or something dear and protect or care for them tenderly
To cause someone or something to be loved or liked (usually followed by 'to').
(+ sb) feel lavish, excessive, or uncritical love and adoration for someone
(+ sb) develop strong romantic affection or infatuation for someone
To love someone very much and feel great admiration or affection for them; to like very much.
To admire or love someone or something to an excessive, uncritical degree
(formal) To feel deep respect, admiration, and awe for someone or something.
To regard with deep religious, moral, or historical respect and awe

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe experiencing or directing positive emotional regard toward someone or something, scaling from mild personal preference to deep devotion and sacred awe.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对人或事物的好感与崇敬，程度由浅喜至深爱与顶礼膜拜。

groups.name: Dash & Hurtle · 疾驰与疾射 (Hurtle, Whizz, Scud)
groups.tip: 极快速度冲刺奔跑或掠过

items.def_en: to move suddenly and rapidly in a specific direction
run or move away suddenly and swiftly
(+ sb/sth) rush past very rapidly, often making a buzzing or whistling sound

items.def_zh: （小孩或小动物）欢快地奔跑，蹦蹦跳跳地跑
items.def_en: 1. (+ away/off/around) When small animals or children scamper, they run quickly with light, playful steps.

items.def_zh: 轻快敏捷地跑，飞掠；使掠过水面
items.def_en: 1. (+ across/along/away) To move quickly and lightly across a surface with rapid, darting steps.

items.def_zh: （发飒飒声或嗖嗖声）飞快掠过
items.def_en: 1. (+ past/through) To move very quickly with a soft, rushing, hissing sound.

items.def_zh: （使）呼呼疾驰，（使）嗖地飞快移动
items.def_en: 1. (variant spelling of whoosh) To move very rapidly with a soft rushing sound.
(+ sb/sth) dart or fly by with exceptional velocity
move or travel at dangerously high speed
to move exceptionally fast, leaving a blurred visual impression
1. (+ across) When clouds or a boat scud, they move rapidly and smoothly driven by the wind.
1. ('hie oneself') (archaic / humorous) To go quickly or hurry to a place.

items.def_zh: 疾驰，飞驰，呼啸而过；（使）发出飕飕声
items.def_en: To move very quickly, often making a buzzing or whistling sound through the air.
(+ through/down) to drive or move fast and often heedlessly or destructively
To move very fast in a particular direction, often in a violent or uncontrolled way.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote moving rapidly across or through an area, distinguishing between light, skittering foot movements and high-velocity rushes that produce audible rushing or whipping sounds.
groups.summary_zh: 指高速穿行或冲刺，涵盖轻捷掠行与带风声呼啸的猛冲。

groups.name: Fasten & Secure · 绑扎与紧固 (Fasten, Secure, Cinch)
groups.tip: 绳带绑扎系牢紧固

items.def_en: (dated) To fasten or support a stocking or sock with a garter.

items.def_zh: 用魔术贴粘紧，用搭扣带固定
items.def_en: To fasten or attach something using hook-and-loop Velcro tape.
(+ sth) fasten tarpaulins or hatches securely with battens or fittings to withstand rough weather
(+ sth) fasten and immobilize securely using one or more straps
(+ sth) secure an object firmly in place using ropes, cords, or straps
(+ down/to) To fasten, secure, or hold in place using a strap or belt.
(+ down/to) To tie or secure something firmly in position with cord or rope.
(carpentry) To fasten two pieces of timber together by driving nails in obliquely.

items.def_zh: 用系缆栓系牢（绳索）；给……加固夹板
items.def_en: To secure a rope to a cleat, or to strengthen something with cleats.

items.def_zh: （用夹板）固定（骨折或受伤部位）
items.def_en: To support and immobilize an injured bone or limb with a splint.

items.def_zh: 用挂锁锁上，用挂锁扣紧
items.def_en: To fasten or secure something firmly using a padlock.

items.def_zh: 用压条（木条）固定；（尤指风暴来临前）钉牢，紧固（舱门等）
items.def_en: To fasten or secure something firmly with wooden or metal strips, especially against bad weather.

items.def_zh: 用肚带（或带子）系紧，勒紧；确保获得，稳操胜券
items.def_en: 1. To fasten or tighten a saddle or belt securely. 2. (informal) To make certain of achieving or winning something.
(+ on sth) hold or fasten an object tightly against a surface using a clamp
(+ down/on) To hold, fix, or secure tightly with a mechanical clamp.

groups.summary_en: Verbs detailing specialized physical interventions used to bind, clamp, tie, or anchor objects firmly to prevent movement, loosening, or detachment.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用特定工具或构件固定、系牢、锁死或稳固物体的机械/手工紧固行为。

groups.name: Give & Bestow · 给予与恩赐 (Give, Accord, Bestow)
groups.tip: 从一般给到隆重赠与

items.def_en: (+ sth) present something freely as a gift or charitable donation
