(+ sth) distribute items or money freely to a group of people

items.def_zh: 递上，端上；提出，提供（建议等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) (formal) To hold out or offer something—such as advice, help, or an object—for someone to accept.
(+ sth) distribute or dispense things lavishly or freely

items.def_zh: 正式签署让渡；过户转赠
items.def_en: (+ sth) legally transfer ownership of property or rights to another person

items.def_zh: 给，送给；提供；交给；让步，变松
items.def_en: 1. To freely transfer possession of something to someone, or hand something over. 2. To produce, yield, or provide. 3. To bend or yield under pressure.

items.def_zh: 给予，授予；与……相符合，一致
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To give or grant someone power, status, or recognition. 2. (+ with) To be consistent or in agreement with something.
1. Past tense of give.
to formally give, allow, or bestow something requested or earned
1. (+ to) (law / formal) To leave money, property, or a legacy to someone in a will after death.

items.def_zh: 授予（神职人员）圣职及俸禄
items.def_en: 1. (historical / ecclesiastical) To grant a church office and its endowed income to a clergyman.

items.def_zh: 授予；赐予（头衔、学位或荣誉）
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to grant an honor, title, right, or favor to someone formally
1. (+ on/upon) (formal) To give an honor, title, gift, or right formally to someone.

items.def_zh: 慷慨给予，过多地给予；过分挥霍
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/upon) To give someone a huge amount of money, praise, care, or attention generously.
(+ with) to provide with a permanent fund or establish through a generous bequest

groups.summary_en: This frame spans the continuum of giving or transferring assets, privileges, or honors, escalating from neutral baseline transfers to formal bestowals and lavish endowments.
groups.summary_zh: 表示交付、赋予或赠予所有权与荣誉，程度由普通移转升至盛大恩赐。

groups.name: Permit to Compel · 许可、规约与强制
groups.tip: 从规劝到硬性强制

items.def_en: (+ sth) To officially approve or grant formal permission for something
to allow someone to do something, especially by an official rule or law

items.def_zh: 可以（表示许可）；可能，也许；祝愿
items.def_en: 1. Used to ask for or give permission to do something. 2. Used to express possibility or likelihood.
1. To allow or permit someone to do something. 2. To rent out a house, room, or piece of land.

items.def_zh: 允许，准许；使成为可能；留出，拨出
items.def_en: 1. To give permission for someone to do something. 2. To make it possible for something to happen or be done.

items.def_zh: 应该，应当；可能，按理会；如果，万一
items.def_en: 1. Used to state what is proper, advisable, or morally required. 2. Used to express that something is probable or expected.
to demand that something must be done according to a law, rule, or contract

items.def_zh: 迫使，强迫；使感激；施惠，帮忙
items.def_en: 1. To force someone to do something because of a law, duty, or necessity. 2. To help or do a favor for someone.
(+ sb into sth) To compel or coerce someone into performing a duty or service
1. Used to express that something is necessary or required by rule, law, or duty. 2. Used to express that something is logically certain.

items.def_zh: 强迫，迫使；用力推开，强行打开
items.def_en: 1. To compel someone to do something against their will using physical strength, authority, or pressure. 2. To push or move something using physical effort.
1. To force or oblige someone to do something. 2. To evoke or bring about a particular reaction or feeling by having strong authority or quality.

items.def_zh: 使承担义务，迫使；施恩惠于
items.def_en: To bind someone legally, morally, or socially to do something.
(+ sb into sth) To pressure or coerce someone into doing something hastily or against their will
(+ into) to force someone to do something that they do not want to do, through threats or pressure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale frame express degrees of deontic pressure and authority imposed upon an agent. They scale upwards from granting permission (may, allow, let), to normative recommendation (should), to legal/moral obligation (obligate, oblige, must), and finally to inescapable coercion (compel, force).
groups.summary_zh: 从给予许可、道义建议，递增至法定规约与绝对强迫。

groups.name: Resound & Sound Out · 物件发声与鸣响
groups.tip: 各种声响与发声方式

items.def_zh: 发出飒飒声，发出沙沙声，呜呜作响
items.def_en: (literary) To make a soft, moaning, or rustling sound, like wind blowing through trees or waves on a shore.
(of a clock or bells) ring together or strike to mark the hour

items.def_zh: 发声，鸣响；使发声，鸣响；听起来；试探
items.def_en: 1. To make a noise, or cause something to produce a sound. 2. To give a specified impression when heard.

items.def_zh: 格格作响；发出连串撞击声
items.def_en: [I/T] to make a series of short, sharp knocking sounds when shaken or moved
[I/T] to make a clear, ringing sound when struck, like a set of bells or clock

items.def_zh: 发出劈啪声，发出咔啦声
items.def_en: To make a series of short, sharp, snapping or popping noises, like dry wood burning.

items.def_zh: 发出嗒嗒声，发出马蹄得得声；嗒嗒作响地走
items.def_en: To make the hollow knocking sound of a horse's hoof hitting a hard road, or move with this sound.

items.def_zh: （渡鸦或野鹅）发出低沉粗厉的叫声，呱呱叫
items.def_en: (especially of a raven or wild goose) To utter a deep, hoarse, croaking cry.

items.def_zh: 响亮地响起；发出清脆回响
items.def_en: sound loudly, clearly, or resoundingly across an area
[I/T] to sound with slow, solemn, regular strokes, especially of a large funeral or church bell

items.def_zh: 咔嗒咔嗒作响；使哐当乱响；喧闹地移动
items.def_en: To make a continuous loud, rattling sound by striking against something, or cause objects to make this noise.

items.def_zh: （风笛等）发出尖厉响亮的声音；高声鸣响
items.def_en: (especially of bagpipes) To make a shrill, piercing musical sound.
(of bells or thunder) ring out loudly and solemnly
[I/T] to make a loud, resonant metallic sound

items.def_zh: 洪亮地鸣响，震响；使大声鸣响
items.def_en: To ring or sound loudly and resonantly, as of bells, thunder, or laughter.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent inchoative or continuous auditory emissions produced by natural phenomena, metal, bells, or hard surfaces. Nuances distinguish between harsh repetitive clicks (clatter, clop, crackle), wind whispers (sough), bell rings (peal, ring), and high-pitched piping (skirl).
groups.summary_zh: 物体撞击、风声刮拂或器物钟乐所发出特有节奏与质地的声响。

groups.name: Scare & Terrify · 惊吓与威慑 (Scare, Frighten, Terrify, Petrify)
groups.tip: 主动施加恐惧或吓唬他人的动作

items.def_en: To cause a sudden shock or alarm that makes someone jump or twitch
(informal) To frighten a person or animal, making them skittish or nervous

items.def_zh: 使毛骨悚然；吓得起鸡皮疙瘩
items.def_en: (+ sb) cause someone to feel nervous, repulsed, or uneasy through creepiness
(+ sb/sth) cause someone or something to leave or stay away through fear
(+ sb) fill someone with an unsettling, eerie sense of fear
To make someone feel afraid, anxious, or shocked.
To make someone feel frightened or nervous; to become frightened.
To frighten or overawe someone, especially in order to make them do what one wants

items.raw_cluster: 恐吓与使恐惧 Frighten & Terrify
items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使胆怯，使丧失勇气
items.def_en: To make someone lose confidence, courage, or emotional composure.
(+ sb) make someone extremely frightened, panicky, or agitated
(archaic or literary) To frighten, terrify, or alarm someone suddenly.

items.def_zh: 使极度恐惧，恐吓，使极其害怕
items.def_en: To fill someone with extreme fear; to frighten severely.
To render someone unable to move or act due to overwhelming fear

items.def_zh: 恐吓，威胁；实行恐怖统治
items.def_en: To fill people with extreme fear by using violence or threats of violence.

items.raw_cluster: 恐吓与使恐惧 Frighten & Terrify
items.def_zh: 使吓呆，使吓得动弹不得；（使）石化，（使）僵化
items.def_en: 1. To frighten someone so severely that they are unable to move or think. 2. (geology) To change organic matter into stone or a stony substance.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inducing varying degrees of acute fear, dread, or shock in a sentient experiencer, from sudden alarm to paralyzing dread.
groups.summary_zh: 通过不同方式引起对方剧烈惊惧，从乍现的心慌到令人僵化的极度恐慌。

groups.name: Boost & Amplify · 提升与增强 (Raise, Enhance, Boost, Amplify)
groups.tip: 把数值强度或高度往上拉升

items.def_en: To raise something to a higher position, level, or moral standard
(+ sth) to make something stronger, larger, or more effective
(+ sth) to increase the level, volume, or intensity of something
(+ sth) to increase the speed, intensity, or rate of effort of something

items.def_zh: 提高，增加；举起，抬高；筹集；抚养
items.def_en: 1. To increase the level, amount, or strength of something. 2. To lift or move something to a higher position.
To help something increase, improve, or become more successful.

items.def_zh: 提高，增强，增进（质量、价值或吸引力）
items.def_en: To increase or further improve the good quality, value, or status of someone or something.

items.def_zh: 大幅提高，猛增（价格、利率等）；徒步旅行
items.def_en: 1. To increase a price, rate, or tax sharply. 2. To go for a long walk, especially in the countryside.
To become or make something stronger, more intense, or higher (such as feelings, tension, or contrast).

items.def_zh: 放大，增强；（用透镜等）放大；夸大
items.def_en: 1. To make a sound, effect, or problem greater, stronger, or more serious. 2. To make something look larger than it really is, especially by using a lens or microscope.
(+ sth) to substantially increase or expand the volume, rate, or level of something
To increase or cause to increase rapidly in intensity or extent
To become or make something greater, stronger, or more extreme

items.def_zh: 放大（声音、信号等）；增强，扩大；阐述，详述
items.def_en: 1. To make a sound, electrical signal, or effect louder or stronger. 2. To explain, expand on, or add details to a statement or idea.

groups.summary_en: Verbs depicting an upward scaling in degree, volume, value, or efficacy, ascending from simple elevation to intense qualitative or acoustic magnification.
groups.summary_zh: 描述数量、品质、强度或声量的级联上升，从简单调高至倍数级放大。

groups.name: Color & Impart Pigment · 染色与着色 (Color, Dye, Tint)
groups.tip: 改变颜色或发生变色

items.def_en: To add a slight, subtle amount of color to something.
(+ sth) fill an outline or shape with colored pigment
(+ sth) apply small amounts of paint or dye to correct or refresh the color of a surface
To become white or cause something to become white.
To make or become blue; to treat fabric or metal with a blue substance.

items.def_zh: 给……着色，染色；（使）变色；脸红；影响
items.def_en: 1. To give color to something, or to take on color. 2. To become red in the face with embarrassment or anger. 3. To influence something, especially in a negative way.

items.def_zh: （使）变成褐色，（烹饪时使）呈棕黄色；晒黑
items.def_en: To become brown, or make food brown by cooking it; to become tanned from the sun.
(biology / technical) To color skin, tissue, or a substance with pigment.

items.def_zh: 给……染上淡淡的颜色，微染，轻微着色
items.def_en: To give a small amount of color to something, such as hair or glass.

items.def_zh: 给（黑白照片或电影）上色
items.def_en: To add color to a black-and-white photograph or film using a computer or other process.
(+ sth) cover or obscure text or an area entirely with dark pigment

items.def_zh: 把……涂黑；（鞋油）擦亮；（使）变黑
items.def_en: 1. To make something black, especially with polish. 2. To become or cause to become black.
To treat a surface (such as wood or microscopic tissue) with a colored liquid to bring out its texture or details.
[I/T] To change the color of something (especially cloth or hair) permanently by soaking it in a chemical solution.

groups.summary_en: Deliberate causative actions whereby an agent applies dye, pigment, or tone to alter the visual coloration of an object or surface.
groups.summary_zh: 指人为通过涂敷颜料、染料等工艺手段使物体呈现或改变特定色彩的行为。

groups.name: Deliberate & Ponder · 沉思与反思 (Ponder, Muse, Rethink, Introspect)
groups.tip: 由漫无边际到深刻自省

items.def_zh: 留待第二天再考虑；慢慢思量
items.def_en: (+ sth) to delay making a decision until the following day in order to think about it more carefully
1. To think again about a decision, opinion, or plan, especially with the possibility of changing it.

items.def_zh: 重新审视，重新考虑；重访，重游
items.def_en: 1. To think about, reconsider, or examine an idea, issue, or policy again. 2. To visit a place or person again.

items.def_zh: 重新思考，反思，重新考虑
items.def_en: 1. To think carefully about a plan, idea, or policy again in order to change or improve it.
(+ sth) to ponder or discuss something thoroughly over time
(+ sth) to think deeply and carefully about something over an extended period
(+ sth) to meditate on, reconsider, or think carefully about past events or decisions
(+ on/upon) To meditate upon or examine one's thoughts, actions, or history
To think deeply and at length about something, often serenely

items.def_zh: 沉思，冥想，若有所思地想
items.def_en: 1. To think carefully, quietly, and deeply about something for a period of time.
1. To think about something carefully and deeply, especially before making a decision.

items.def_zh: 集思广益，头脑风暴，集体献计献策
items.def_en: 1. To hold a lively group discussion to produce ideas or find solutions to a problem quickly.
1. To examine your own thoughts, emotions, and feelings closely.
(+ on/over) To think deeply and repeatedly about something over an extended period

groups.summary_en: Verbs indicating deep, deliberate mental focus, weighing alternatives, reviewing past positions, or plumbing inner cognitive and emotional states.
groups.summary_zh: 指集中精力进行深入、反复或向内的理性思考与权衡检视。

groups.name: Desire & Crave · 渴望与追求 (Want, Crave, Yearn)
groups.tip: 从普通想要到极度渴望的欲望升级

items.def_en: 1. To desire or wish for something. 2. To need or require something. 3. (formal) To lack something.
(+ sth) to have a strong, persistent longing or appetite for something
(rare) To desire eagerly or seek ambitiously.
(+ after/for) To have a strong, persistent desire or craving for something.
(+ sb/sth) to feel an acute, visceral emotional longing for someone or something
(+ sb/sth) to feel a strong desire, craving, or yearning for someone or something
(+ sb/sth) to experience intense, aching grief or longing for someone or something missing or out of reach
(+ for/to do) To have a strong, earnest desire or longing for something.
1. (formal) To want or crave something strongly. 2. (formal) To ask for or request something.
1. (+ for/after) To have a strong craving or desire for something. 2. (archaic) To feel hungry.
to feel an intense, overwhelming, often physical desire for something
(+ for/after) to have a strong, burning desire or need for something
(+ for/to do) to feel deep, tender, or painful longing for something unattainable or distant
(+ for) to yearn deeply and suffer emotionally or physically from unfulfilled desire

groups.summary_en: Experiencers feel a strong internal longing or appetite for an object, state, or outcome, ranging from simple conscious wants to intense, visceral yearnings. Verbs typically take noun phrases or infinitive complements, or collocate with prepositions like 'for' or 'after'.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对特定事物或状态的情感渴望，由浅入深层层递进。

groups.name: Equip & Furnish · 装备与配具 (Equip, Fit, Outrig)
groups.tip: 配置部件以完善其功能

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) supply a vessel, building, or person with necessary furnishings or equipment

items.def_zh: 为……配备全套装备或用具
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) supply someone or something with all the necessary clothing, tools, or equipment
(+ sb/sth) equip or fit out with special gear or garments
1. To provide or equip someone or a carriage with a horse or horses.

items.def_zh: 给……装底，给……配底座；到达底部
items.def_en: 1. To provide or equip something with a bottom or seat. 2. (+ out) To reach the lowest point.

items.def_zh: 给（马）钉蹄铁；给……装护套，给……穿鞋
items.def_en: 1. To fit a horse with horseshoes, or provide someone or something with a protective shoe or covering.
1. To dress or cover someone with a shirt.

items.def_zh: 给……接线，给……安装电线；用金属丝绑扎；拍电报
items.def_en: 1. To equip a building, vehicle, or piece of equipment with electrical wires. 2. To fasten or secure something with wire. 3. To send a telegram or transfer money electronically.
1. (engineering) To fit or line a machine part with a bushing or bush.

items.def_zh: 给……装管；用管输送；把……装入管中
items.def_en: 1. To equip something with a tube or tubes, or insert a tube into something.

items.def_zh: 给……配备仪器（或测量仪表）；为……配器，为……谱写管弦乐曲
items.def_en: 1. To equip a machine, vehicle, or system with measuring instruments or controls. 2. To orchestrate a piece of music.
(+ with/out) to fit a ship, machine, or person with necessary gear or functional equipment
(+ in/with) to encase or provide an object with a protective covering or casing
to equip or outfit something with protective plating or armor

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve supplying, outfitting, or structurally reinforcing an entity with specific functional parts, protective hardware, or necessary fittings.
groups.summary_zh: 指为某物装配、加固或供应特定配件、保护件或设备。

groups.name: Inscribe & Transcribe · 书写与记录 (Write, Jot, Scrawl)
groups.tip: 用笔墨书写或键盘打字记录

items.def_en: (+ sth) to write something down quickly and informally on paper
(+ sth) to write something hastily, carelessly, or untidily
(+ sth) to write notes or transcriptions of words spoken by another person
(+ sth) to record information, words, or figures in writing on a surface

items.def_zh: 打字，用键盘键入；测定……的类型，分型
items.def_en: 1. To write or enter text using a keyboard or typewriter. 2. To identify or classify something as belonging to a particular type.
1. To form letters, words, or symbols on a surface using a pen, pencil, or keyboard. 2. To compose a text, book, article, or piece of music. 3. To send a letter or written message to someone.

items.def_zh: 写博客，在博客上发布内容
items.def_en: To write about something in a blog or online journal.
To write or compose something formally using a pen or ink.

items.def_zh: 用铅笔写（或画）；暂定，初步安排（通常与in连用）
items.def_en: 1. To write, draw, or mark something with a pencil. 2. (pencil in) To arrange or schedule something tentatively.
To write something by hand with a pen or pencil rather than by typing or printing.
(usually 'jot down') To write a brief note or reminder quickly.
To write or draw something hastily, carelessly, and untidily.
[I/T] To write or draw something quickly, carelessly, or untidily.
To write or carve words formally on a surface or in a book.

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing the physical act or manner of putting text on a surface, distinguished by speed, care, medium, and degree of legibility.
groups.summary_zh: 描述将文字落于载体的书写与记录行为，依书写速度、工整度及媒介区分。

groups.name: Metallic & Resonant Impacts · 碰撞与金属鸣响 (Clang, Clink, Jingle)
groups.tip: 金属硬物相碰发清脆声

items.def_zh: 发出叮当声，发出清脆的金属声
items.def_en: To make a light, clear ringing or metallic sound.
To make or cause to make a light, high-pitched ringing sound.
To strike against each other producing a sharp, ringing, metallic or glassy sound

items.def_zh: 使发出轻微叮当声；叮当作响
items.def_en: [I/T] To make or cause to make a light, ringing metallic sound (e.g. keys or coins).
To produce a faint, clear, ringing sound.

items.def_zh: （使）发出叮当响声，（使）丁丁作响；填补裂缝
items.def_en: 1. To make or cause to make a light, sharp ringing sound, like glasses or coins hitting each other. 2. To fill narrow cracks or fissures.

items.raw_cluster: 发出声响 Make Sound & Clatter
items.def_zh: （使）发出清脆的碰撞声，（使）叮当碰响
items.def_en: To make or cause to make a sharp, ringing sound, especially by touching glasses, coins, or metal objects together.

items.raw_cluster: 发出声响 Make Sound & Clatter
items.def_zh: （蒸汽机等）发出突突声，发噗噗声行驶
items.def_en: (especially of a steam engine) To move along making regular, sharp puffing sounds.

items.def_zh: （使）发出啪嗒声，（使）发出咔嗒声
items.def_en: To make or cause to make a sharp, dry sound, especially by striking hard objects together.

items.def_zh: 持续发出当啷金属巨响
items.def_en: To continuously produce loud, resonant, metallic ringing noises

items.def_zh: （使）发出当啷声，（使）发出沉重的金属撞击声
items.def_en: To make or cause to make a loud, heavy, metallic ringing sound.
To make or cause to make a loud, resonant metallic sound.

items.raw_cluster: 发出声响 Make Sound & Clatter
items.def_zh: 发出沉重的闷响；（炮弹等）轰然爆炸
items.def_en: To make a loud, heavy, dull thudding sound, especially when a heavy shell explodes.

items.def_zh: 发出连续响亮的当啷声
items.def_en: [I/T] To make a loud, resonant, continuous metallic clanging sound.

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting sharp, resonant, or ringing acoustic emissions produced when hard objects (especially metal, glass, or stone) collide. They range from delicate, high-pitched ringing to deafening, heavy metallic impacts.
groups.summary_zh: 指硬物（尤其是金属、玻璃）碰撞发出清脆鸣响或沉重撞击声的动词，按音量与沉重度递增。

groups.name: Paint & Render Techniques · 绘画与技法描摹 (Paint, Sketch, Stipple)
groups.tip: 运用彩料与画笔描绘形象

items.def_en: (+ sth) draw lines across an item to eliminate or designate it
To draw lines, shapes, or pictures absentmindedly while thinking about something else.
(+ sth) paint or draw the main areas or background color without fine detail
(+ sth) draw a rough, preliminary outline or draft of a picture
[I/T] to make a rough, preliminary drawing without detailed shading or color
[I/T] to shade an area of an artistic work with closely spaced parallel lines

items.def_zh: 用水彩画，用水彩颜料绘制
items.def_en: To paint a picture using watercolors.
To draw or color a picture using colored wax crayons.

items.def_zh: 重新粉刷；重新油漆；重画
items.def_en: 1. To paint a wall, room, vehicle, or picture again.
1. (art) To paint, draw, or engrave using thousands of tiny dots rather than solid lines.

items.def_zh: 用胶画颜料粉刷（或作画）
items.def_en: 1. (British / art) To paint walls or scenery using water-based paint mixed with glue or egg.
1. (art) To shade an area of a drawing or engraving with two sets of fine intersecting parallel lines.
[I/T] to shade an area with intersecting sets of parallel lines
to apply a very thin, semi-opaque layer of paint over dry paint to soften the tone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe executing visual artwork by applying pigments or rendering lines through specific mediums or technical stroke patterns (such as shading, dotting, or washes).
groups.summary_zh: 指运用特定颜料媒介或笔触技法进行绘制、着色与描摹。

groups.name: Shrink & Compress · 收缩与压缩 (Shrink, Shorten, Diminish)
groups.tip: 尺寸体积收缩变小或被压缩

items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the physical size, scope, or proportion of something
1. (+ down) To lose body weight, or reduce the size, staff, or costs of an organization.
(+ sth) reduce a liquid's volume through heating and evaporation
recede or become physically drawn together and smaller
[I/T] to decrease in size, number, or range by pulling together tightly
1. To become smaller, weaker, or less important, or to make something seem less valuable.
1. To become smaller in size or amount, or make something smaller. 2. (+ away/from) To move back or recoil from fear or disgust.
1. To slide together into a shorter space like sections of a folding telescope, or to shorten a time period or narrative.
1. To become shorter in length or duration, or to cut something to make it shorter.
[I/T] to make something more dense, compact, or concise

items.def_zh: 收缩，缩小（shrink 的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of shrink; became smaller or pulled back.

items.def_zh: 收缩，缩小（shrink 的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. (archaic) Past participle of shrink; having become smaller or shriveled.
1. (technology) To design and build electronic devices or components on a much smaller scale.
[I/T] to make or become narrower, tighter, or physically smaller by encircling pressure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or conceptual reduction in dimensions, volume, or overall scale through contraction, folding, or progressive loss.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或概念在体积、长度或规模上发生收缩、压缩或递减。

groups.name: Soil & Contaminate · 污染与弄脏 (Soil, Stain, Befoul)
groups.tip: 因泥土污渍等破坏原本洁净

items.def_en: (+ sth) make something dirty, unkempt, or stained

items.def_zh: 玷污，弄脏；（被）染上污渍；给……着色（染色）
items.def_en: 1. To leave a mark on something that is difficult to remove, or to become marked in this way. 2. To color wood, glass, or cloth using a special liquid.
To cover, soil, or plaster something with mud.

items.def_zh: 用粘性污垢堵塞或弄脏
items.def_en: (+ sth) foul, clog, or contaminate a mechanism with sticky residue
(+ sth) make something filthy, soiled, or muddy

items.def_zh: 弄脏，搞脏；变脏；玷污，败坏（名誉）
items.def_en: 1. To make something dirty, or to become dirty. 2. To damage someone's reputation; dishonor.

items.def_zh: 使沾上泥，弄脏；使（水等）变浑浊；使（局势或问题）复杂化
items.def_en: 1. To make something dirty with mud, or to make liquid cloudy. 2. ('muddy the waters') To make an issue or situation more complicated and difficult to understand.

items.def_zh: 使积满污垢，使蒙上灰垢
items.def_en: To cover or soil deeply with dirt or soot.
To spoil or mar the purity or cleanliness of something physically or morally.
(archaic or dialect) To blacken or begrime with soot or coal dust.
[I/T] To make dirty, polluted, or smelly, especially water or pipes.
1. To make air, water, or land dirty and dangerous with chemicals or waste. 2. To destroy the purity or sanctity of something; corrupt.
(formal or literary) To make something dirty, foul, or impure; to tarnish.
To make a substance or environment impure or poisonous by introducing unwanted matter.

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing the degradation of cleanliness, purity, or physical integrity of a surface, medium, or substance by coating, soaking, or introducing foul matter.
groups.summary_zh: 指以泥垢、污渍、杂质或废料使物体表面或环境遭到玷污、污染或腐化变质。

groups.name: Speak to Roar · 发声与呼吼 (Say, Shout, Bellow)
groups.tip: 从日常说话到高声吼叫

items.def_zh: 宣告，宣判；正式声明；发音，读（音）
items.def_en: 1. To officially or formally announce or declare a decision or judgment. 2. To make the sound of a word or letter.
to make a sound with your voice, or say something aloud
(+ to sb) speak or utter sth in a raised voice to attract attention
To utter words in order to communicate thoughts, opinions, or information.

items.def_zh: 说，讲（say的过去式与过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of say; to utter words or express in speech.

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地讲；高谈阔论；（尤指为推销而）极力兜售
items.def_en: To speak rapidly, fluently, and at length, especially in a rehearsed way to persuade someone.
make a loud exclamation or shout because of pain, fear, or surprise
(+ sth) say or express sth in a loud, clear, forceful voice
To say something in a very loud voice, or to utter a loud cry from anger, pain, or excitement.
[I/T] to shout something loudly, especially when excited, angry, or in pain

items.def_zh: 自以为是地发表意见，武断地高谈阔论；执行教皇职务
items.def_en: To speak or express opinions in a pompous, dogmatic, and self-important manner.
(+ sth) shout, sing, or roar sth in a very loud, deep, resonant voice
[I/T] to make a very loud, deep, prolonged sound with your voice

items.def_zh: 怒吼，大声吼叫；怒声喝道
items.def_en: To shout in a deep, loud, and angry voice; to roar loudly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover vocal production across a scale of acoustic and rhetorical intensity, ranging from standard verbalization through pompous speech to loud, resonant shouting.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖从普通言语表达、高谈阔论到雷鸣般怒吼呼喊的声强递进过程。

groups.name: Adjust & Calibrate · 调节与校准 (Fine-tune, Regulate, Calibrate)
groups.tip: 按标尺旋钮微调至标准状态

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) adjust, design, or regulate parameters to suit a specific purpose

items.def_zh: 调音；调试检修（引擎或仪器）
items.def_en: (+ sth) adjust an engine, instrument, or machine to proper working order

items.def_zh: 调整，微调（机器或引擎等）；为（乐器）调音；调谐（收音机频率）
items.def_en: 1. To adjust an engine, machine, or system so that it operates at peak performance. 2. To adjust a musical instrument so that it produces the correct pitch.

items.def_zh: 调节，调整，微调；适应，习惯
items.def_en: 1. To change or move something slightly to achieve a desired fit, appearance, or functioning. 2. (+ to) To adapt to a new situation or condition.
to make slight changes to a machine, system, or plan to improve it

items.def_zh: 调节，调整（音量、语气或程度）；【电】调制；【音】（使）转调

items.def_zh: 调整……的大小（尤指计算机窗口、图像或衣物）
items.def_en: To change the physical or digital dimensions of an image, window, or garment.

to make very small adjustments to something in order to achieve the best possible result
to mark units of measurement on an instrument or adjust it so that it gives accurate readings

groups.summary_en: An agent modifies the settings, dimensions, frequency, or operational parameters of a mechanism, instrument, or system to achieve optimal performance, accuracy, or suitability. Nuances range from delicate musical/mechanical adjustments to systematic technical calibration.
groups.summary_zh: 对装置、参数或系统进行微调、校准或适配以达最佳状态。

(+ sb) gain someone's favor, affection, or captivated support

items.def_zh: 迷住，使陶醉，吸引；施魔法于
items.def_en: 1. To attract and delight someone through personal charm or pleasing qualities. 2. To affect or influence by using magic spells.

items.def_zh: 激起……的好奇心（或兴趣）；密谋，搞阴谋

to powerfully attract or entice someone, often with a mysterious or seductive quality
1. (often passive) To fill someone with wonder, delight, and fascination.

items.def_zh: 使入迷，使陶醉；施魔法于
items.def_en: 1. To delight and fascinate someone completely. 2. (literary) To put a magical spell on someone or something.
to hold the complete attention and interest of someone by being extraordinarily charming or attractive
to charm or enchant someone, sometimes in a deceptive or deeply engrossing way
to hold someone's attention so completely that they cannot look away or think of anything else

groups.summary_en: An entity or quality captures someone's attention, curiosity, or emotional affection through pleasing or magical appeal. Verbs scale from mild curiosity and polite attraction up to spellbound, overpowering captivation.
groups.summary_zh: 某人或事物凭借特质唤起他人的兴趣、好感或使其着迷沉醉。

(of blood or fluids) leak slowly out from biological tissues
discharge a massive or fatal amount of blood from the body
to let saliva dribble uncontrollably from the mouth
[I/T] to slowly seep or discharge a thick liquid through pores or small openings
to produce and release a substance from a gland or cell into the body or outside
(of a female mammal) to produce milk to feed babies or young animals.
to discharge or eliminate waste matter from the body.

items.def_zh: 射精，射出；脱口而出，猛然喊出
items.def_en: 1. (physiology) To eject semen from the penis at orgasm. 2. (literary) To say or shout something suddenly.
to produce saliva, especially in anticipation of food

items.def_zh: 流口水，淌口水；（对……）过分谄媚，肉麻地表示喜爱
items.def_en: 1. To let saliva run or drip carelessly from the mouth. 2. (+ over) To show excessive or messy affection toward someone.
1. (physiology) When a woman or girl menstruates, blood and tissue flow from her uterus roughly once a month.
1. (formal) To sweat through the pores of your skin because of heat, exercise, or nervousness.

groups.summary_en: Biological organisms produce, release, or expel natural fluids or waste from internal glands and tissues into the external environment. Verbs range from neutral physiological terms to informal or involuntary secretions.
groups.summary_zh: 生物体通过腺体或器官向外自然分泌、排出体液或代谢废物。

items.def_en: 1. To wash or rub someone or something all over with soap.

items.def_zh: 用毛巾擦干，用毛巾擦拭
items.def_en: 1. (often towel down/off) To dry or wipe yourself, someone else, or an object using a towel.

items.def_zh: 用软布擦亮，打磨；使（皮革等）起绒变软
items.def_en: 1. To polish and make something shiny using a soft cloth or a buffing tool. 2. To give leather a soft, velvety finish.
to clean or wipe a surface with a wet or damp sponge
to clean or wipe a floor or surface using a mop or absorbent cloth
to make a surface smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or compound
1. To clean something using a vacuum cleaner.

items.def_zh: 抛光，打磨（金属等硬质表面）

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cleaning, drying, or finishing a surface through physical rubbing, wiping, or suction with a tool or agent. They range from basic surface washing and drying to mechanical polishing and shine enhancement.
groups.summary_zh: 通过擦洗、擦干、吸尘或研磨等手段处理物体表面的清洁与抛光动作。

groups.name: Compete & Contend · 竞争与抗衡 (Compete, Rival, Vie)

to prepare to fight, argue, or compete against someone

items.def_zh: 向……挑战，向……发起竞争；质疑，对……表示怀疑
items.def_en: 1. To invite someone to compete or fight in a contest or trial of strength. 2. To question the truth, rightness, or honesty of something.

items.def_zh: 斗争，抗争；拼搏，努力奋斗；挣扎
items.def_en: 1. To fight or compete forcefully against a person, group, or opposing power. 2. To make a strenuous effort to achieve something difficult.

items.def_zh: 冲突，抵触，相矛盾；争执，交锋
items.def_en: To be in active disagreement, opposition, or struggle with someone or something.

items.def_zh: 竞争，对抗；参加比赛（竞赛）
items.def_en: To strive to gain or win something by defeating others in a contest, sport, or market.

items.def_zh: 角逐，争夺；质疑，对……提出异议

items.def_zh: 挺胸迎战，顽强对抗；奋力穿过，顶着……前行
items.def_en: To confront or struggle against an obstacle or opposing force bravely; to push through.

(+ with/for) To compete eagerly with someone in order to achieve or acquire something.
(+ with/against/for) To compete intensely or struggle to surmount an opponent or hardship.

groups.summary_en: Verbs encoding dynamic oppositional striving where two or more parties match capabilities, pursue identical finite rewards, or resist antagonistic forces.
groups.summary_zh: 指多方之间角逐有限目标、抗衡争雄或与对手正面抗拒较量的冲突框架。

groups.name: Confuse & Discombobulate · 困惑与错乱 (Befuddle, Flummox, Discombobulate)

(+ sb's head/mind) to cause someone cognitive confusion, distress, or psychological disorientation

items.def_zh: 扰乱；使措手不及而困惑

to totally bewilder or perplex someone so they cannot find an explanation

items.def_zh: 使神秘莫测，使大惑不解
items.def_en: to utterly confound someone by presenting something inexplicable or mysterious

items.def_zh: 使（头脑）昏乱，使糊涂；（蛋）变质

1. (often passive) To confuse someone's mind so they cannot think clearly, especially because of alcohol or complexity.

items.def_zh: 使彻底困惑，使不知所措

groups.summary_zh: 外在事物干扰认知，导致从思维轻微发懵到彻底混乱失措。

(+ sth) to send cargo or goods away to another destination

groups.summary_zh: 指通过汽车、卡车或船舶等工具对货物与旅客进行专业承运与中转。

items.def_en: To bring a dispute, negotiation, or contest to an impasse where no action can be taken or progress made.

items.def_en: (informal) To thwart, hinder, or place someone in a situation where they cannot act effectively.

items.def_zh: 预先阻止；先发制人，先一步行动

to decorate an edge, garment, or object by adding contrasting borders, ribbons, or accessories

items.def_en: to decorate the edge of fabric, pastry, or wood with a series of rounded curves
to decorate a dish of food with a small amount of different food

items.def_zh: 使成方格图案；使交替变化，使多样化
items.def_en: (chiefly British English) to mark or decorate with a pattern of alternating squares or colours
(architecture) to finish or decorate the top edge of a wall or building with a cornice
(+ sth/sb) to decorate or dress someone or something in a very elaborate or festive way
to enhance the beauty or appearance of someone or something, often with ornaments

items.def_zh: 装饰，布置；给（故事等）添枝加叶，润色
items.def_en: 1. to make something more beautiful by adding decoration to it 2. to add details to a story, sometimes untrue, to make it more interesting
to drape or adorn a place or object with ribbons, garlands, or decorative chains
to decorate or cover something lavishly with colorful decorations or jewels

groups.summary_en: An agent enhances the visual appeal or artistic finish of an object or surface by adding decorative motifs, borders, or edible accents. Verbs vary by the specific decorative technique or specialized domain involved (e.g., culinary, architectural, or geometric patterning).
groups.summary_zh: 通过增设饰边、花纹或配料以美化外观或结构。

groups.name: Defeat & Subdue · 战胜与降伏 (Outwit, Overbear, Subjugate)
groups.tip: 以绝对优势压制收服

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to cause a ruler, government, or opponent to fall or lose power
(+ sb) to gradually overcome an opponent's opposition or stamina through sustained pressure
to defeat or gain physical control over someone by greater strength
To defeat or gain an advantage over someone by being cleverer than they are.
(+ sb) to defeat an opponent decisively or crush their resistance by force
to subdue an opponent or rebellion forcefully and completely
to thoroughly defeat an enemy or adversary in a battle or competition

items.def_zh: 战胜，克服，解决（困难）；置于……顶端
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To deal successfully with a difficulty or overcome an obstacle. 2. To be placed on top of something.
(formal) To overwhelm, dominate, or crush someone's resistance by superior force or authority.

items.def_zh: 以技艺击败，在比赛中胜过
items.def_en: To play much better than an opponent and defeat them in a game or match.

items.def_zh: 远胜于，轻易击败，技术显著高出
items.def_en: To be much better than an opponent or competitor in skill, quality, or performance.

items.def_zh: 征服，降服，使臣服；抑制，克制
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To defeat a people or country and bring them under complete control by force. 2. To bring one's desires or impulses under complete control.

groups.summary_en: An agent overcomes an opponent or obstacle, scaling from intellectual and tactical superiority to overwhelming physical dominance and complete institutional or political subjugation.
groups.summary_zh: 从智谋与战术上超越胜过，递进至全面压制并彻底征服降伏敌方。

groups.name: Delight & Enrapture · 欢欣与陶醉 (Gladden, Exult, Enrapture)
groups.tip: 从心生欢喜到狂喜陶醉

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make someone feel happier or more joyful, or to become happier
(+ in/at) to feel or express great joy and satisfaction openly
To entertain or delight someone, especially by telling stories; to feast or provide lavish food and drink.

items.raw_cluster: 使高兴与使满意 Please & Delight
items.def_en: (formal or literary) To make someone feel happy, pleased, or cheerful.

items.def_zh: 使大为倾倒；令人极度叹服
items.def_en: (+ sb) to please, impress, or thrill someone overwhelmingly

items.def_zh: 使沉溺；使陶醉；冲昏头脑
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to be overwhelmed by excitement, delight, or intense emotion
to make someone extremely proud, cheerful, and exhilarated

items.raw_cluster: 得意与幸灾乐祸 Gloat & Exult
items.def_zh: 幸灾乐祸；自鸣得意，沾沾自喜
items.def_en: (+ over/about) To feel or express great, often malicious pleasure or satisfaction at one's own success or another's misfortune.
(+ at/in/over) To feel or show great happiness, triumph, or rejoicing.
to captivate someone completely with enchanting charm or delight

items.def_zh: 使狂喜，使陶醉；强暴；强夺
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To fill someone with intense delight, joy, or enchantment. 2. (archaic or literary) To rape someone; to seize and carry off by force.

items.raw_cluster: 取悦与使高兴 Please & Delight
items.def_zh: 使狂喜，使陶醉，使极度欢悦
items.def_en: (formal or literary, often passive) To fill someone with intense pleasure, delight, or wonder.

groups.summary_en: Experiencers or stimuli evoke increasing degrees of joyful pleasure, progressing from mild heartening warmth to triumphant outward jubilation, and culminating in overwhelming, ecstatic bliss.
groups.summary_zh: 从适度的喜悦慰藉，递进至外显的狂喜胜意，直至极致的销魂沉醉。

groups.name: Describe & Depict · 描述与刻画 (Describe, Depict, Portray)
groups.tip: 生动细致描摹人事物特征

items.def_en: To say or write what someone or something is like.

items.def_zh: 详述，详细说明；派遣，选派
items.def_en: 1. To describe or list something completely and thoroughly. 2. To assign someone to a particular duty.

items.def_zh: 给……写传略（或人物简介）；描出……的轮廓
items.def_en: 1. To write or produce a short description of someone's life, character, or work. 2. To outline or represent in profile.
To reproduce or represent something vividly through artistic or verbal means.
(+ sth) to explain or present facts, reasons, or details clearly and in order

items.def_zh: 展示；具体说明；清晰解释
items.def_en: (+ sth) to explain an idea, plan, or piece of information clearly and step by step
(+ sth/sb) to capture or describe the essential qualities of someone or something concisely
To represent or show someone or something in a painting, drawing, or written description.
1. To represent or describe someone or something in a painting, book, or film. 2. To play the part of a character in a film or play.

items.def_zh: 描绘……的特性，刻画；是……的特征
items.def_en: 1. To describe the distinctive qualities or character of someone or something. 2. To be a typical feature or quality of someone or something.
To bring a feeling, image, or memory vividly to mind through evocative description.

items.def_zh: 详细描述，阐明；描画……的轮廓，标出……的界线
items.def_en: (formal) To describe, draw, or explain something in detail, or mark its exact outline or boundaries.

groups.summary_en: Verbs centered on representing, characterizing, or rendering the details of a person, event, or scene through language or artistic portrayal, ranging from general narration to rigorous analytical specification.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过言语、文字或艺术形象生动传达或细致剖析事物特征的表述动词。

groups.name: Discharge Weapons & Bombard · 射击与炮击轰炸 (Shoot, Shell, Bombard)
groups.tip: 枪炮射击与空中轰炸

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fire a gun or explode ordnance, bombs, or fireworks
(+ sth) to shoot or discharge a weapon, bullet, or volley of shots

items.def_zh: 开火，开枪，射击；解雇，开除；激发，点燃
items.def_en: 1. To shoot a bullet, shell, or other projectile from a weapon. 2. (informal) To dismiss someone from a job.

items.def_zh: 开枪，射击；射门，投篮；拍摄；飞驰
items.def_en: 1. To fire a weapon such as a gun, or wound or kill someone with a bullet or arrow. 2. To kick, hit, or throw a ball toward a goal. 3. To film or photograph.
1. To shoot wildfowl or birds in flight. 2. To fit feathers onto an arrow.
(+ at sth/sb) to shoot repeatedly or bombard heavily using guns or artillery

items.def_zh: 用枪射击，枪杀（常作 gun down）；加足（发动机）马力
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To shoot someone with a firearm (usually in 'gun down'). 2. To accelerate the engine of a vehicle rapidly.

items.def_zh: 轰炸，用炸弹袭击；（演出、计划等）惨败
items.def_en: 1. To attack a place or target with bombs. 2. (informal) (of a play, film, etc.) To fail badly.
1. To fire artillery shells or explosive missiles at a place or target. 2. To remove the shell or pod from nuts, seeds, or seafood.
to continuously attack a place with sustained heavy gunfire or bombs
to attack ground targets with repeated machine-gun fire from low-flying aircraft
to deliver a concentrated artillery or rocket bombardment against a position

groups.summary_en: Military forces or shooters propel ordnance, bullets, or explosive warheads toward targets. Verbs differentiate by weapon type and delivery mechanism, spanning small-arms direct fire, artillery shelling, and aerial bombardment.
groups.summary_zh: 使用枪械、重炮或航空弹药向目标进行直接或范围性的火力打击。

groups.name: Expel & Exile · 驱逐与流放 (Forced Ouster)
groups.tip: 以权力或法令强行逐出境地

items.def_en: (+ sb) to force someone to leave a place, group, or organization
(+ sb) to expel or force someone to leave a property or institution
to legally expel a foreigner from a country for violation of immigration laws

items.def_zh: 驱逐，赶走（尤用turf out）；铺草皮于
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly British) (usually 'turf out') To force someone to leave a place, job, or organization. 2. To cover a piece of ground with turf.
to force someone to leave a building or venue, often physically
to forcibly remove someone from a position of power, office, or place
to formally hand over an accused or convicted person to another jurisdiction
(+ sb) to force someone to leave an area, community, or homeland permanently

items.def_zh: 驱逐，开除；排出（气体、液体等）
items.def_en: 1. To officially force someone to leave a school, organization, or country. 2. To force air, liquid, or gas out of the body or a container.

items.def_zh: 流放，驱逐；消除，排除（杂念或忧虑）
items.def_en: 1. To officially send someone away from a country or place as a punishment. 2. To get rid of or eliminate unwanted thoughts, feelings, or fears.
To legally force someone to leave a house, apartment, or land they are renting or occupying.

items.def_zh: 清洗，清除（异己或有害人员）；净化，肃清
items.def_en: 1. To rid a group, organization, or country of unwanted people. 2. To clear or free something of impurities or guilt.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the compulsory removal or ejection of a person or group from an institution, property, or homeland by authority or force.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、法律或武力将人员从某组织、住所或国家强行驱逐赶走。

groups.name: Explain & Explicate · 解释与阐明 (Clarify, Elucidate, Explicate)
groups.tip: 澄清概念与深入解说

items.def_zh: 讲得一清二楚；详尽解释
items.def_en: to explain something clearly, explicitly, and step by step to avoid ambiguity
(+ sth) to make someone aware of a fact or detail to clarify a topic
(+ sb through sth) to explain or demonstrate a process or topic carefully step by step
(+ sth) to explain complex information by dividing it into simpler, manageable parts

items.def_zh: 详细阐述，进一步说明；详尽制定
items.def_en: 1. To explain, describe, or develop something in greater detail (often followed by 'on' or 'upon'). 2. To work out or develop a plan, theory, or system carefully.

items.def_zh: 阐明，使清楚明了；使（液体等）澄清
items.def_en: 1. To make something clearer or easier to understand by explaining it in more detail. 2. To make a liquid pure or clear by removing impurities.
to analyze the intricate components or hidden implications of a complex statement or concept
(formal) To make something clear and easy to understand by explaining it thoroughly.
[I/T] (+ on) to explain an idea, theory, or belief in detail and with formal analysis

items.def_zh: 改述，重述，换种说法表达
items.def_en: To express an idea, statement, or question again using different words to make it clearer or more acceptable.

items.def_zh: 使明白易懂，使（复杂或神秘的事物）明朗化
items.def_en: To make a complex, technical, or mysterious subject clear and easy for ordinary people to understand.

items.def_zh: 详细阐述，深入剖析，系统解释
items.def_en: (formal) To analyze and explain a complex text, idea, or theory in clear, systematic detail.

groups.summary_en: A speaker or writer makes a complex, obscure, or misunderstood topic clear, accessible, or systematically detailed to an audience. Verbs vary in formality from conversational rewording to scholarly, text-level hermeneutic analysis.
groups.summary_zh: 对抽象或费解的内容进行澄清、深入阐述或学理剖析。

groups.name: Fluster & Mortify · 慌乱与羞惭 (Disconcert, Fluster, Mortify)
groups.tip: 从局促慌乱到羞愧难堪

items.def_en: to make someone feel anxious, upset, or shaken in composure
(+ sb) to confuse, fluster, or upset someone's composure
to cause someone to feel self-conscious, awkward, or ill at ease

items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使局促不安，使胆怯
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly negative) To disturb, shock, or upset someone's calm confidence.
(+ sb) to make someone nervous, flustered, or rattled
(+ sb) to distress, unsettle, or severely disturb someone's composure

items.def_zh: 使尴尬，使慌乱，使局促不安；打乱（计划等）
items.def_en: To make someone feel suddenly uneasy, confused, or embarrassed.

items.raw_cluster: 使困惑与使慌乱 Confuse & Fluster
items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使紧张不安，使心慌意乱
items.def_en: (often passive) To make someone feel nervous, hurried, and confused.

items.raw_cluster: 使尴尬与使困窘 Embarrass & Fluster
items.def_zh: 使窘迫，使难堪，使尴尬；挫败，打乱（计划）
items.def_en: (formal) To make someone feel uneasy, embarrassed, or confused; to thwart or frustrate.

items.def_zh: 使深感羞愧，使难堪，使极为尴尬；克制（肉欲），苦修
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To make someone feel deeply embarrassed, ashamed, or humiliated. 2. (religion) To subdue bodily desires through self-discipline or suffering.

items.raw_cluster: 使尴尬与使困窘 Embarrass & Fluster
items.def_zh: 使羞愧，使难堪，使局促不安
items.def_en: (formal, usually passive) To make someone feel ashamed, embarrassed, or self-conscious.
to crush someone's dignity and pride profoundly in the eyes of others

groups.summary_en: An awkward event, error, or exposure strips away someone's composure, self-esteem, or poise. The emotional intensity progresses from slight unease and agitation to paralyzing, excruciating public humiliation.
groups.summary_zh: 突发尴尬或失态剥夺从容镇定，由轻微局促升格至无地自容的羞辱。

groups.name: Fold & Crumple · 折叠与卷皱 (Pleat, Crimp, Crumple)
groups.tip: 折叠弯曲形成褶皱

to make a line or ridge appear in cloth, paper, or skin by pressing or folding
1. To crimp or form fine crinkles or wrinkles in fabric, paper, or hair.
1. To fold cloth or paper into neat, flat, parallel pleats and press or sew them in place.

items.def_zh: 使起褶，压褶；使（头发）卷曲；阻碍，抑制
items.def_en: 1. To press or pinch hair, fabric, or pastry into small neat folds or waves. 2. To restrict or have a limiting effect on something.
to form thin, shallow folds or fine wrinkles across a surface

items.def_zh: 卷起，收拢（旗帜、帆、雨伞等）
items.def_en: 1. To roll or fold up neatly and securely, such as a flag, sail, or umbrella.
(+ sth) to crush paper, cloth, or metal into a compact, wrinkled mass
(+ sth) to squeeze paper or fabric tightly together into a disordered shape

items.def_zh: （使）起皱，揉皱；（由于受伤、失去意识等）瘫倒，垮掉
items.def_en: 1. To crush or press paper or fabric into untidy folds and wrinkles. 2. To fall or collapse suddenly to the ground from weakness, pain, or injury.
to make something untidy or uneven by forming irregular folds
1. (formal or technical) To fold into neat, fan-like pleats or ridges.

groups.summary_en: An agent alters the planar structure of pliable material (cloth, paper, metal) through regular geometric creasing, decorative rolling, or chaotic destructive crushing.
groups.summary_zh: 对柔韧材质进行规律折裥、卷边起皱或无序揉捏折损。

groups.name: Fret to Infuriate · 恼人与激怒 (Irk, Peeve, Exasperate)
groups.tip: 反复刺激招致反感恼火

items.def_en: to make someone slightly angry or upset, often through repeated actions

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_en: (formal) to make someone feel annoyed, dissatisfied, or unhappy.

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_en: (informal, often passive) to make someone annoyed, irritated, or resentful.

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_en: to annoy, irritate, or bother someone persistently.
(+ sb) to make someone annoyed or angry
(+ sb) to deliberately annoy or tease someone until they become angry

items.raw_cluster: 使不满与使恼怒 Discontent & Irritate
items.def_en: (formal or archaic) to make someone dissatisfied or discontented.
to bring distress, confusion, or sharp annoyance to someone

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often 'rile up') to make someone angry, annoyed, or irritated. 2. to make liquid cloudy by stirring up sediment.
(+ sb) to make someone extremely angry or deeply annoyed

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_zh: 激怒，使极度恼火，使大为气恼
items.def_en: to make someone extremely annoyed, irritated, or frustrated.
to make someone extremely angry and furious beyond endurance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify provoking negative affective reactions in another, mounting from mild irritation and displeasure to utter, frenzied exasperation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示引发他人的负面情绪，自轻微的不悦、厌烦逐渐递进到极度抓狂与暴怒。

groups.name: Grumble & Grouse · 牢骚与怨言 (Habitual or Petty Complaining)
groups.tip: 嘀咕嘟囔、发牢骚的不满态度

items.def_en: (British informal) to mutter repetitively in a grumbling tone
(+ sb/sth) to complain constantly or pettily about something irritating
(+ sb/sth) to complain persistently about something in an annoying or dissatisfied way
(+ sb/sth) to complain repeatedly about something in an irritating, high-pitched, or petulant tone

items.def_zh: 抱怨，发牢骚，挑剔；使侧移，侧滑
items.def_en: 1. (informal) to complain or grumble constantly; find fault. [I, T] 2. to move or cause an aircraft or vessel to move sideways.
(+ about/at) to complain petulantly about trivial matters
(informal) to complain habitually about minor grievances

items.def_zh: 抱怨，发牢骚；发隆隆声，咕哝
items.def_en: 1. to complain quietly about something in a bad-tempered way. [I] 2. to make a low, heavy, continuous sound.

items.def_zh: 哭闹，啼哭抱怨（尤指小孩）；变成灰色
items.def_en: (informal) to whimper, fret, or complain continuously, especially of a child.
(informal) to complain loudly and continuously in an irritating manner

items.def_zh: 吹毛求疵，挑剔，无端抱怨
items.def_en: to complain continually about unimportant things; find fault unreasonably.

items.def_zh: 发牢骚，抱怨，在背后恶语中伤
items.def_en: (informal) to complain persistently, spitefully, or unpleasant about someone or something.

groups.summary_en: These verbs depict the expressive manner of expressing discontent through low, peevish muttering, petty fault-finding, or persistent whining rather than formal protest.
groups.summary_zh: 刻画以嘟囔、挑刺、刻薄咒骂或小声嘀咕等恼人姿态持续发牢骚、发泄不满。

groups.name: Increase & Intensify · 增加与增强 (Amplify, Escalate, Multiply)
groups.tip: 数量成倍增加或强度规模放大

items.def_en: 1. To become louder, or to make a sound louder.
(+ sth) to increase the level, volume, or speed of sth sharply
(+ sth) to increase the amount, speed, or intensity of an activity or effort
to make something stronger, louder, or more pronounced

items.def_zh: 增强（药效、生化反应等），加强
items.def_en: 1. (pharmacology / biology) To increase the power, potency, or effectiveness of a drug or biochemical reaction.
(+ sth) to increase the intensity, volume, or power of sth, especially by turning a control
(+ sth) to increase sth steadily and repeatedly by increments
to increase rapidly in intensity, scale, or severity

items.def_zh: （使组织或器官）肥大，（使）过度增大
items.def_en: 1. (medicine / biology) To enlarge excessively due to an increase in the size of cells, or to cause an organ or tissue to do so.

items.def_zh: （使）加倍，极大增强（努力、力量等）
items.def_en: 1. To become much greater or stronger, or make something much greater or stronger, especially one's efforts.
1. To become five times as great, or multiply something by five.
to increase something to the highest possible degree or amount

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote escalating, multiplying, or augmenting a measurable quality, capacity, volume, or biological dimension across an intensifying scale.
groups.summary_zh: 在数量、强度、体积或效应上呈现级数递增、成倍累加或显著强化。

groups.name: Inform & Apprise · 告知与通知 (Inform, Notify, Apprise)
groups.tip: 向他人传达信息或讲述情况

items.def_zh: 告诉，告知；讲述，叙述；分辨，识别
items.def_en: 1. To communicate information, facts, or instructions to someone. 2. To narrate a story. 3. To distinguish or discern.

items.def_zh: 告诉，告知；讲述（tell 的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of tell: to communicate information or narrate a story.

items.def_zh: 通知，告知；对……产生影响，贯穿于
items.def_en: 1. To give someone facts or information. 2. (formal) To influence or pervade the character of something.
(+ on) to instruct or give detailed background information to someone beforehand
(+ of/that) to formally notify or make someone aware of an official matter or development
(+ sb) to give someone essential information or an explanation about a situation
(+ sb) to give someone the necessary details and background facts about something

items.def_zh: 通风报信；向…透露秘密消息
items.def_en: (+ sb) to give advance, secret, or cautionary information to someone about an upcoming event
1. (+ of/that) To formally or officially inform someone about something.
(+ on/about) to provide explanation or truth to someone who was previously unaware
1. (+ with) To make someone or oneself familiar with or informed about something.
1. (+ of) (formal) To tell or inform someone officially about important facts or news.

groups.summary_en: A speaker or formal authority conveys factual information, official updates, or instructions to another person. Verbs range from general conversational communication to structured administrative or diplomatic notifications.
groups.summary_zh: 向他人传达事实、官方动态或决定，由口头传话延伸至公文通告。

groups.name: Ingestion Manners & Voracity · 进食与狼吞虎咽 (Munch, Devour, Guzzle)
groups.tip: 大口吞吃与咕嘟豪饮的方式

items.def_zh: 无精打采地吃；挑剔地吃

[I/T] take small, gentle bites of food tentatively or slowly

items.def_en: (+ sth) to start eating food eagerly and with relish

items.def_zh: 大声咀嚼，津津有味地嚼
items.def_en: (+ on) To eat food steadily and with a noticeable chewing sound, especially crisp or crunchy items.
1. (formal or technical) To take food, liquid, or medicine into the body by swallowing or absorbing it. 2. (technical) To take in or assimilate data or information.
(+ sth) to eat sth voraciously and in a hurry
(+ sth) to eat food very quickly and greedily

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地咽下（不经咀嚼）
items.def_en: (+ down) swallow food whole or quickly without proper chewing

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃，吞食；如饥似渴地阅读（或观赏）；吞噬，毁灭
items.def_en: 1. To eat food quickly, greedily, and completely. 2. To read, look at, or listen to something with intense eagerness. 3. (of fire, disease, or emotion) To consume or destroy something completely.
[I/T] (+ down/up) eat something hurriedly and noisily in large mouthfuls

items.def_zh: 大口吃（或喝），暴饮暴食；大量消耗（燃料等）
items.def_en: 1. To eat or drink something quickly, greedily, and in large amounts. 2. To use large amounts of petrol, fuel, etc.

items.def_zh: 像狼一样吞食，大口吞吃
items.def_en: (+ down) devour voraciously and messily like an animal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey distinct physical and behavioral manners of consuming food or liquid, spanning rhythmic, noisy chewing (munch), clinical or biological intake (ingest), ravenous, predatory destruction of food (devour), and greedy, rapid drinking/eating (guzzle).
groups.summary_zh: 具体细致地描述进食动作与吃相，包括咀嚼声响、狼吞虎咽与暴饮暴食。

groups.name: Inhabit & Settle · 居住与安置 (Billet, Quarter, Accommodate)
groups.tip: 安居落户生活场景

items.def_en: To inhabit a place or fill it with people or characters.

items.def_zh: 为……提供住处，安置；（鸽子、导弹等）回巢，导向目标
items.def_en: 1. To provide someone or an animal with a home or shelter. 2. ('home in on') To move toward a target or destination directly.

items.def_zh: 为……提供住所，安置；收容，容纳，收藏
items.def_en: To provide shelter, lodging, or living accommodations for someone; to store, contain, or protect something.

items.def_zh: 租房住宿，寄宿，居住；（与……）合住一室
items.def_en: (+ with/at) To lodge, rent a room, or share a room with someone.
to provide lodgings or temporary living quarters for people or troops
[I/T] (+ with/at) to stay somewhere temporarily, or to provide someone with a temporary room
(+ sb) to provide someone with accommodation or a temporary place to sleep

items.def_zh: 安排寄宿；让…住在别人家里
items.def_en: (+ sb) to arrange for someone to live and receive meals in another person's home
to stay or hide inside a safe or secluded dwelling place
to provide lodging, space, or room for guests or travelers
to inhabit an area or supply an area with inhabitants
(+ on/in/with) to lodge troops or official personnel temporarily in private or public quarters

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on providing shelter, placing human occupants into dwellings, or populating a territory, typically featuring institutional, logistical, or domestic housing arrangements.
groups.summary_zh: 指提供居所、统筹安置人员住宿或使某地有人居住的生活与治理框架。

groups.name: Injure & Traumatize · 身体致伤与创伤 (Hurt, Injure, Lacerate)
groups.tip: 身体受损及引发的痛楚

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to physically hurt or bruise someone in an accident or fight
(+ sb) to inflict multiple wounds or lacerations on someone's body

items.def_zh: 使受伤害，使受伤；（身体）感到疼痛；伤……的感情
items.def_en: 1. To cause physical pain or injury to someone, or to feel pain yourself. 2. To cause emotional distress or upset to someone.

items.def_zh: 使（身体）疼痛；使痛苦，使痛心；感到疼痛
items.def_en: 1. To cause physical or emotional pain, distress, or suffering to someone. 2. (archaic) To suffer pain or ache.
to injure a part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin with a weapon
To cause physical injury, illness, damage, or other bad effects to a person, living thing, or object.
To injure someone's brain temporarily through a violent blow to the head; to shake violently.
(+ sb) to violently attack someone by repeatedly hitting and kicking them, causing injury

items.def_zh: 使受伤，弄伤（身体）；损害，破坏（名誉等）
items.def_en: To cause physical harm or bodily injury to someone; to damage or impair something.

items.def_zh: 撕裂，划伤（皮肉）；深深伤害（感情）
items.def_en: (formal or medical) To cut or tear skin or flesh deeply and roughly; (figurative) to hurt someone's feelings severely.
to damage severely, disfigure, or cut off parts of the body
to injure someone so severely that part of their body will no longer work as it should

groups.summary_en: An external force or condition causes physical trauma or distress to bodily tissue or living subjects, scaling in severity from simple pain or superficial harm to severe blunt concussion, deep tearing, and catastrophic mutilation.
groups.summary_zh: 外力或疾患造成机体组织受损，从隐痛轻伤升级至撕裂重创。

groups.name: Irritate & Infuriate · 恼怒与愤懑 (Pique, Miff, Seethe)
groups.tip: 由小摩擦演变为怒火中烧

items.def_en: (informal, often passive) To annoy, offend, or irritate someone slightly.
(+ sb) to make someone become very upset, agitated, or angry
(+ sb) to cause someone to feel agitated, furious, or intensely resentful

items.def_zh: 使愤恨，激怒；激起，引起（兴趣或好奇心）
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone to feel annoyed, hurt, or resentful, especially by wounding their pride. 2. To excite or stimulate someone's curiosity or interest.

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Angered & Aggrieved
items.def_zh: 使愤愤不平，使委屈；侵害（权益）
items.def_en: (usually passive) To make someone feel indignant, resentful, or wronged by unfair treatment.
[I/T] to cause persistent resentment, bitterness, or irritating anger over time

items.def_zh: 怒目而视，阴沉着脸；（天空等）变阴暗
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To frown angrily or look sullen and threatening. 2. (of clouds or the sky) To appear dark, gloomy, and stormy.
(+ sb) to make someone intensely angry or enraged
to feel, show, or express great suppressed anger

items.def_zh: 强忍怒火，生闷气；翻滚，沸腾
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To feel intensely angry while keeping the emotion suppressed. 2. (of a liquid) To bubble, boil, or churn violently.

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使怨恨 Anger & Embitter
items.def_zh: 使心生怨恨，使怨愤；使更加痛苦
items.def_en: (often passive) To make someone feel bitter, resentful, or angry over a long period.
to make someone extremely angry, furious, or enraged

groups.summary_en: An agent, remark, or grievance causes an experiencer to feel annoyance, resentment, or smoldering anger, or the experiencer simmers with inward rage. Verbs range from mild irritation and slighted pride to suppressed, boiling indignation.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因受冒犯或委屈而引发的不快、愤懑乃至暗自暴怒。

groups.name: Kill & Slaughter · 杀戮与屠杀 (Kill, Slay, Massacre)
groups.tip: 出于政治动机秘密暗杀

items.def_en: (+ sb) to murder someone deliberately
to put someone to death, typically as a legal penalty or extrajudicial execution
(+ sb) to assassinate or execute someone in an underworld or gangland context
(+ sb) to kill or assassinate a targeted adversary or enemy

items.def_zh: 大屠杀，残杀（大量手无寸铁者）
items.def_en: to kill a large number of people or animals indiscriminately and cruelly

items.def_zh: 残杀，杀戮；（俚语）深深打动，惊艳
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To kill a person or animal violently or in war. 2. (informal) To impress, delight, or amuse someone overwhelmingly.
(+ sb/sth) to completely destroy or kill an entire group of people or creatures

items.def_zh: 屠杀，残杀；屠宰（牲畜）；彻底打败
items.def_en: 1. To kill a large number of people cruelly and violently; massacre. 2. To kill animals for meat. 3. (informal) To defeat an opponent overwhelmingly.

items.def_zh: 残杀，屠杀；屠宰（牲畜）；（因拙劣而）搞砸，糟蹋
items.def_en: 1. To murder people brutally and indiscriminately. 2. To kill and cut up animals for meat. 3. (informal) To ruin or spoil something by poor execution.

items.def_zh: 处死（以使其成为殉道者）；迫害，折磨
items.def_en: 1. To kill or torture someone because of their religious or political beliefs, making them a martyr.

items.def_zh: 暗杀，行刺；诋毁，破坏（名誉等）
items.def_en: 1. To murder an important political or public figure deliberately, usually for political reasons. 2. To deliberately destroy someone's reputation.
to completely destroy or kill off an entire population or species

groups.summary_en: This frame captures acts of killing another being with escalating brutality, scale, premeditation, or political motive, spanning single assassinations to indiscriminate bloodbaths.
groups.summary_zh: 表达致人死命的行为，从暗杀、斩杀升级至灭绝人性的屠戮。

groups.name: Loiter & Idle About · 游荡与闲晃 (Loiter, Dally, Gad, Vagabond)
groups.tip: 磨蹭时间闲游漫步

items.def_zh: 随波逐流；漫无目的地走
items.def_en: to wander or move slowly from place to place without a fixed plan

items.def_zh: 到处闲逛；无所事事地游荡
items.def_en: to spend time wandering aimlessly and living idly without steady work
to wait or spend time idly in a place with no clear objective
to hang around idly and needlessly in a public place
(+ on/around) to stay in a place longer than necessary because of reluctance to leave

items.def_zh: 虚度光阴；无所事事地闲晃
items.def_en: (+ about/around) to spend time doing nothing productive or walking without aim
1. ('gad about/around') (informal) To travel or wander from place to place in search of pleasure or amusement.
1. (+ around/outside) To stand or wait around in a public place without any obvious purpose.

items.def_zh: 磨蹭，闲荡，虚度光阴；调情
items.def_en: 1. (+ over) To waste time moving or acting slowly. 2. (+ with) To treat something lightly or flirt playfully.
to delay or be tardy in acting or departing; linger unnecessarily (literary/archaic)
1. (literary) To wander from place to place without a settled home or regular job.
(+ about/around) to wander slowly and aimlessly, often looking listless (informal)

groups.summary_en: Moving about aimlessly or lingering needlessly without serious purpose, wasting time, or roving in search of diversion. Distinctions hinge on lingering suspiciously in public places, social flitting, or wandering as a vagrant.
groups.summary_zh: 无所事事地游手好闲、流连盘桓或居无定所地游荡

groups.name: Long & Hunger For · 渴望与渴求 (Aspire, Yearn, Crave, Lust)
groups.tip: 由期盼憧憬加剧为极度饥渴渴望

items.def_en: (+ sth) to want sth very much, often with a feeling of persistent sadness
1. (+ to/after) To have a strong desire and ambition to achieve something great or become someone important.
(+ for/to do) to feel an intense, often tender and painful longing for someone or something

items.def_zh: 苦苦思念；因思慕而憔悴
items.def_en: (+ for) to feel unhappy and miss someone or something agonizingly, losing vitality
(+ sb/sth) to suffer emotionally and waste away with deep longing for someone or sth
(+ sth) to feel an intense, deep emotional longing for sth that is hard to attain
(+ for/after) to feel an insatiable, visceral craving or deep inner urge
1. To have a very strong, urgent, or uncontrollable desire for something (such as food, love, or power).
1. (+ for/after) To have an intense, desperate desire for something; feel a strong physical need for water.
to desire eagerly and greedily something that belongs to someone else

items.def_zh: 极度渴求；贪图；色迷迷地觊觎
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to feel an overwhelming sexual craving or an intense, greedy desire for sth
1. (+ after/for) To have an intense, greedy desire for something (such as power or money), or to feel strong sexual desire.

groups.summary_en: Experiencing an internal drive, desire, or longing for an object, goal, or experience, escalating from lofty intellectual ambition to painful emotional yearning, physical addiction/craving, and overwhelming primal lust.
groups.summary_zh: 从崇高志向递增至揪心渴念、生理性瘾欲与贪婪狂热

groups.name: Mock & Tease · 嘲弄与戏弄 (Deride, Taunt, Jeer)
groups.tip: 言语戏谑或轻蔑嘲弄

items.def_en: to tease someone in a friendly and lighthearted way
(+ sb/sth) to tease or ridicule someone in a mischievous or mocking manner
(informal) To tease or joke with someone in a playful and friendly way.

items.def_zh: 取笑，戏弄，逗弄；梳理（头发或纤维）
items.def_en: 1. To laugh at or make jokes about someone in a playful or unkind way. 2. To comb hair or wool backward to give it volume or fluff it up.
(dated) To tease or joke with someone in a good-humored way.
(+ sb/sth) to make unkind, derisive, or mocking remarks about someone
(+ sb/sth) to subject someone to unkind ridicule, mimicry, or laughter

items.def_zh: 嘲弄，嘲笑；（通过模仿）戏弄；使落空，使显得可笑
items.def_en: 1. To laugh at someone or copy them unkindly to make them look foolish. 2. To make something seem completely useless or ineffective.

items.def_zh: 讥笑，冷笑，轻蔑地嘲弄；冷笑着说
items.def_en: To smile or speak in an unkind, mocking way that shows you have no respect for someone.
to intentionally provoke or insult someone with contemptuous remarks
to treat or speak of someone or something with utter contempt and ridicule
(+ at) to shout loud, rude, and mocking remarks at someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe targeting someone with playful banter, pointed sarcasm, or contemptuous ridicule, ranging from lighthearted ribbing to cruel, malicious derision.
groups.summary_zh: 以言语或表情取笑、逗弄或蔑视嘲弄他人，从善意玩笑延伸至恶毒讽刺。

groups.name: Moderate & Relieve · 缓和与减轻 (Temper, Buffer, Mitigate)
groups.tip: 提供缓冲以减轻冲击

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make sth less forceful, severe, or extreme
to become less severe, intense, or aggressive

items.def_zh: 减弱（痛苦、严厉）；缓和锋芒
items.def_en: (+ of sth) to dull or soften the sharp impact, intensity, or unpleasantness of sth
(+ sth) to dilute or weaken the strength, force, or effect of sth

items.def_zh: 缓和，调和，使温和；使回火，淬炼
items.def_en: 1. To make something less severe or extreme, especially by moderating or softening it. 2. To harden or strengthen metal or glass by heating and cooling.

items.def_zh: 缓和，减轻；使迟钝，变迟钝；使变暗，变暗淡
items.def_en: To make or become less sharp, intense, clear, or vivid.
To protect someone or something from the impact of something harmful, shocking, or sudden; cushion.
To make something bad, such as harm, damage, or risk, less severe, serious, or painful.
To soften the adverse effects of an impact, shock, or blow
[I/T] To make less harsh, severe, or intense
To make suffering, deficiency, or hardship less severe
To appease the anger, anxiety, or severity of a person or situation

groups.summary_en: An agent or intervention reduces the severity, intensity, harshness, or impact of an adverse force, pain, or conflict.
groups.summary_zh: 削弱外来冲击或减缓痛苦、严厉程度，起缓冲平抑作用。

groups.name: Ponder & Contemplate · 思考与沉思 (Weigh, Contemplate, Mull)
groups.tip: 权衡得失利弊并深入斟酌

items.def_en: to spend time thinking carefully about a proposal, plan, or problem before deciding
(+ sth) to consider a matter or proposal thoroughly and carefully before making a decision
(+ sth) to reflect or deliberate deeply on a thought or problem over a period of time
(+ sth) to think long and hard about something complicated or difficult to understand

items.def_zh: 权衡，斟酌，考量；称……的重量；重达；有影响
items.def_en: 1. To consider or compare options carefully before making a choice. 2. To measure the heaviness of something, or to have a particular weight. 3. To have influence or importance in a decision.

items.def_zh: 盘算，深思，考量；凝视，沉思注视
items.def_en: 1. To think deeply or carefully about something, especially a potential future action. 2. To look at something quietly and thoughtfully for a long time.

items.def_zh: 深思熟虑，仔细斟酌；商议
items.def_en: To think about or discuss something very carefully, especially before reaching a decision.
1. (+ on/upon) To think deeply and carefully about something. 2. To focus the mind in silence for spiritual peace or relaxation.

items.def_zh: 深思熟虑，仔细琢磨（常与 over 连用）；加香料温热（酒等）
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'mull over') To think carefully and at length about something before deciding. 2. To heat wine or cider with sugar and spices.
(+ on/over) to think deeply and repeatedly about something over a long period

items.def_zh: 使全神贯注，占据（某人的心头）
items.def_en: (often passive) To fill someone's thoughts completely so that other matters are ignored.
(+ on/upon) to ponder or deliberate intently in a formal, scholarly manner

groups.summary_en: Cognizers engage in deep, sustained, and deliberate mental processing over complex questions, options, or memories. Verbs vary from weighing concrete pros and cons to reflective interior meditation or passive mental absorption.
groups.summary_zh: 对复杂问题、选项或记忆进行深入、持续且审慎的思量与回味。

groups.name: Praise & Exalt · 赞赏与歌颂 (Laud, Acclaim, Hymn)
groups.tip: 从口头好评升华至热烈鼓掌狂赞

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to speak very highly or enthusiastically about someone or something to promote them
1. To clap the hands repeatedly to show approval or enjoyment. 2. To praise and strongly approve of an action, decision, or policy.

items.def_zh: 唱赞美诗歌颂；赞美，称颂
items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To celebrate or praise someone or something in psalms or hymns.
(+ sb/sth) to praise someone or something loudly and publicly
(+ sb/sth) to express enthusiastic and glowing approval of someone or something

items.def_zh: 公开称赞，热烈欢呼，高度赞扬
items.def_en: (+ as) To praise and welcome someone or something publicly and enthusiastically.
(literary) To praise, celebrate, or extol someone or something in song or writing.
To applaud or cheer enthusiastically, especially by shouting 'bravo'.
to praise someone or something lavishly and formally in public

items.def_zh: 热烈赞扬，赞不绝口 (rave about/over)；胡言乱语，狂暴吼叫
items.def_en: 1. (+ about/over) To speak or write with extreme enthusiasm and high praise. 2. (+ at/against) To talk wildly, incoherently, or angrily.
to praise someone or something very enthusiastically and at great length
to praise someone or something very highly, especially in a formal speech or writing

groups.summary_en: A speaker or community expresses vocal, written, or ceremonial approval of someone or something, scaling from enthusiastic public approval up to exalted, near-sacred adulation and singing of praises.
groups.summary_zh: 对某人或事由衷赞赏、公开喝彩乃至作诗赞颂与神圣崇奉。

groups.name: Propel & Hurl · 投掷与抛甩 (Throw, Toss, Hurl)
groups.tip: 扬臂将手中物体飞掷甩出

items.def_en: (+ sth) to toss or throw an object in a high, gentle arc over an obstacle

items.def_zh: 轻抛，轻掷；甩（头）；（使）摇摆，颠簸
items.def_en: 1. To throw something lightly or carelessly. 2. To move or shake gently or violently from side to side or up and down.

items.def_zh: 随手扔，随便抛；放弃，抛弃
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To throw something carelessly or casually. 2. (informal) To give up or reject something.
1. (British informal) To throw or put something somewhere casually. 2. To close or plug a hole with a stopper.
(+ sth) to throw or cast something away forcefully and abruptly
1. To send something through the air by a rapid movement of the arm and hand. 2. To put someone or something suddenly into a particular state or condition.

items.def_zh: 投，掷，抛；投射（视线、阴影等）；铸造；选派（角色）
items.def_en: 1. To throw something, especially by casting a fishing line or net. 2. To direct light, a shadow, or a look at something. 3. To shape molten metal or material in a mold; to assign an actor to a role.
[I/T] To throw an object deliberately toward a specific target or player.
(+ sth) to throw an object back with great strength or violence
To throw or fling something casually yet forcefully with a sweeping arm movement.

items.def_zh: 连续投掷，向……掷击；倾泻；疾驰
items.def_en: 1. To throw a continuous stream of objects at someone or something. 2. (of rain) To fall heavily. 3. (informal) To run very fast.
To throw something with tremendous force, violence, or velocity.

groups.summary_en: Verbs expressing the manual propulsion of an object through the air, distinguished by trajectory, exertion of force, care, and aggressive intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指以手部发力将物体送入空中的动作，按用力强度、随意程度及攻击性排序。

groups.name: Provide & Supply · 提供与供应 (Provide, Supply, Furnish)
groups.tip: 向他人供给所需物资

items.def_zh: 提供，供应；（法律、合同等）规定
items.def_en: 1. To give something to someone or make it available for them to use. 2. (formal) To state or lay down as a condition, especially in a law or contract.

items.def_zh: 提供，给予；表示愿意（做某事）；出价；奉献
items.def_en: 1. To make something available or present it to someone to accept or reject. 2. To express willingness to do something. 3. To propose an amount of money for buying something.

items.def_zh: 供应，提供，补给；满足（需求）
items.def_en: 1. To provide someone or something with things that they need or want, especially in large quantities.

items.def_zh: 为……提供物资（尤指口粮或给养）
items.def_en: 1. To supply someone or a group (such as an expedition, army, or ship) with food and necessary supplies.
(+ with) to provide someone or an organization with a full set of equipment or clothing
(+ with) to supply a person or place with the necessary tools, skills, or items
(+ sth) to distribute food, money, or goods freely or in large quantities
(+ sb) to provide someone or an organization with all the necessary clothing, tools, or gear
(+ sb/sth) to equip or furnish someone or something with special items, clothes, or gear
(+ for/to) to provide food and drink for a social event, or supply what is required

items.def_zh: 提供，供应；为（房间、房屋）配备家具
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To supply or provide someone with something needed or useful. 2. To put furniture and fittings into a room or building.

items.def_zh: （专业地）供应，提供（食物、货物、信息等）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To supply or sell goods, food, or information, especially as a business.

groups.summary_en: A supplier or benefactor makes goods, services, or necessities available to a recipient. Verbs shift across general everyday terms, commercial procurement, formal or legal granting, and specialized food/equipment provisioning.
groups.summary_zh: 向接受方提供物品、设施或给养，涵盖通用提供至商业与官方配给。

groups.name: Reduce & Diminish · 减损与缩减 (Curtail, Deplete, Decimate)
groups.tip: 数量削减或规模由大变小

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce the amount, size, or number of something
[I/T] to make or become smaller, fewer, or less significant

items.def_zh: 减损，贬低（价值、声誉等）；转移
items.def_en: ('detract from') To make something seem less valuable, attractive, or impressive.
To gradually decrease in strength, importance, or size; (of the moon) to show a smaller lighted area.
(+ sth) to gradually reduce something to its essential minimum size or cost
(+ sth) to make something smaller in size, scope, or extent than originally planned
(+ from) To take away a number, amount, or part from a whole.
to cut short or reduce the extent, duration, or quantity of something

items.def_zh: 删节，缩减，节录；剥夺（权利等）
items.def_en: To make a book, play, or other text shorter by removing parts while preserving the core meaning.
to reduce the number or quantity of something so that little remains

items.def_zh: 使人口剧减，使荒无人烟
items.def_en: (often passive) To greatly reduce the number of people living in an area.
to kill or drastically reduce the strength or number of a population or group

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the reduction in number, size, value, or intensity of a target, scaling from mathematical deduction or gradual decline to aggressive truncation and massive depletion.
groups.summary_zh: 表示数量、价值、规模或强度的减弱与消减，从常规扣减渐变至大幅剥夺消减。

groups.name: Relinquish & Cede · 放弃与让渡 (Forgo, Relinquish, Cede)
groups.tip: 交出权力或放弃控制权

items.def_en: to state officially that a rule, claim, or right can be ignored or will not be enforced
(+ sth) to surrender possession, control, or a legal claim to something
(+ sth) to surrender power, responsibility, or custody of something to someone else
to give up position, possession, or control, often reluctantly after pressure

items.def_zh: （尤指不情愿地）放弃，交出（权力、权利或财产）；松开
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To give up power, control, a claim, or possession of something, often reluctantly. 2. To let go of a hold on something.

items.def_zh: 放弃，舍弃（尤指令人满意之物）；居先，在……之前发生
items.def_en: 1. (variant of forgo) To decide to do without or give up something enjoyable or advantageous. 2. (archaic) To precede in time or place.

items.def_zh: 放弃，舍弃，克制不做（尤指令人满意之物）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To decide to do without or give up something enjoyable or advantageous.
1. Past participle of forego: to have given up or preceded.
1. Past participle of forgo: to have decided to do without or relinquished.
(+ sth) to legally relinquish rights, ownership, or property to another party by signing a document
to give up control or possession of something to another person or power under force

items.def_zh: 割让，让给，放弃（领土、权利或控制权）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To formally surrender or hand over power, territory, or rights to another country or person.

groups.summary_en: An agent parts with a right, claim, privilege, or territory, advancing in intensity from voluntarily declining a personal benefit to formally or reluctantly surrendering sovereignty and power under pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 从主动放弃便利与权益，递进至被迫或正式让渡领土与主权。

groups.name: Rest & Relax · 闲歇与怠惰 (Laze, Loaf, Slouch)
groups.tip: 体力耗尽后松弛与歇息

items.def_en: relax completely and take it easy, not doing anything strenuous
pass time idly or stand around without doing anything productive

items.def_zh: 闲荡；懒洋洋地消磨时间
items.def_en: spend time relaxing or doing very little in a lazy way
(+ around/about) To lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed, lazy, or comfortable way.
