items.def_zh: 无所事事地放松，瘫着休息
items.def_en: ('cabbage out') (informal) To relax completely, resting and doing nothing mentally or physically demanding.
(+ around/about) to spend time idly or avoid productive activity
to sit, stand, or lie in a lazy, drooping way
To sit or lie in the sun, especially in order to get a suntan and relax.

items.def_zh: 懒洋洋地坐卧（或靠着）；（舌头、头等）耷拉，下垂
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To sit, lie, or stand in a lazy, relaxed way. 2. To hang or droop loosely.
to spend time in a relaxed, lazy manner without doing much work
to relax completely and do nothing mentally demanding

items.def_zh: 无所事事地生活，过呆板单调的生活
items.def_en: (informal, disapproving) To live a dull, inactive life without physical or mental stimulation.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the manner of idling, lying back, or passing time without mental or physical exertion, contrasting languid leisure with sluggish inactivity.
groups.summary_zh: 指以闲躺、懒散无所事事或无脑放空的方式休憩或度过时光。

groups.name: Rest & Sleep · 休息与睡眠 (Depth of Slumber)
groups.tip: 从闭目小憩到熟睡休眠

items.def_en: to be half asleep and sluggish in a state between waking and sleeping
to sleep lightly or fitfully for a short period, often intermittently

items.def_zh: 慢慢入睡；不知不觉睡着
items.def_en: to gradually, peacefully enter a state of sleep
to succumb to tiredness and slip into sleep
to fall asleep unintentionally for a short period, especially while sitting upright
to remain asleep and stay in bed later in the morning than usual

items.def_zh: 睡，睡觉；提供住宿，容纳……住宿
items.def_en: 1. To rest in a state of natural unconsciousness. 2. To provide sleeping accommodation for a specified number of people.
to take a brief, deliberate period of sleep during daytime
(literary) To sleep, especially peacefully or quietly.
to take a short, comfortable sleep, typically during the day

items.def_zh: 睡，睡觉（sleep的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of sleep; to rest in sleep.
To sleep longer than intended and wake up late.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame scale across states of physical rest and unconsciousness, from light dozing and restful repose to deep, extended, or excessive sleep.
groups.summary_zh: 体现由浅歇小憩到深沉沉睡、以至睡过头的生理睡眠程度变化。

groups.name: Rob & Plunder · 劫掠与洗劫 (Manner of Pillaging)
groups.tip: 战乱趁火打劫洗劫财物

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ through) to search quickly and illicitly through something to steal valuables
(+ sb/sth) completely steal or plunder all money, goods, or possessions from a place or person

items.def_zh: 当海盗，劫掠；从事冒险投机活动
items.def_en: to act as a pirate, raiding ships and coastal settlements, or engage in ruthless, opportunistic ventures.
to search thoroughly through a house or room, causing damage and stealing items
(+ sb/sth) rob a person, bank, or vehicle using a weapon and threats of violence
(+ sb/sth) threaten someone with a gun in order to rob them

items.def_zh: 掠夺，劫掠；盗版，非法复制
items.def_en: 1. to rob or attack ships or coastal areas as a pirate. 2. to reproduce or distribute copyrighted material without authorization.

items.def_zh: 拦路抢劫；扮鬼脸；（考试前）突击苦读
items.def_en: 1. to attack and rob someone in a public place. [I] 2. to make exaggerated facial expressions. 3. (mug up) to study a subject rapidly, especially before an exam.

items.def_zh: 洗劫，掠夺，抢劫（尤指在战乱或动乱期间）
items.def_en: to steal goods from shops, houses, or buildings, especially during a war, riot, or natural disaster.
[I/T] to steal property ruthlessly using force or military supremacy
[I/T] to steal goods violently from a place during wartime or civil unrest

items.def_zh: 劫掠，洗劫（被攻占的城镇）；解雇，开除
items.def_en: 1. to plunder, destroy, and strip a captured city or place of valuables. 2. (informal) to dismiss someone from a job.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote taking property unlawfully by force, piracy, or violent raid, ranging from opportunistic street mugging to the organized pillaging of entire settlements or maritime targets.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过暴力袭击、海盗行径或战乱乘机对人、船只或城池实施抢掠与洗劫。

groups.name: Sew, Knit & Needlework · 编织与缝纫
groups.tip: 穿针引线，纺织缝合手艺

items.def_en: (+ sth) join or interlace threads, fabric, or parts closely together
(+ sth) mend or join a piece of fabric, garment, or tear using a needle and thread
(+ sth) close or repair an opening or tear in cloth by sewing
join, mend, or ornament with individual passes of a needle and thread
make garments or fabric by interlocking loops of wool or yarn with knitting needles
join, fasten, or repair cloth or garments using a needle and thread
form fabric by interlacing warp and weft threads on a loom or by hand
repair a hole in knitted or woven fabric by interweaving yarn

items.def_zh: 缝制（被褥或棉衣），做绗缝；绗缝
items.def_en: To make a quilt, or to stitch layers of fabric together with soft padding in between.
To make delicate lace or ornamental edging by knotting thread with a small shuttle.
decorate cloth with patterns sewn in colored thread or yarn
To make garments, fabric, or decorative items using yarn and a single hooked needle.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to constructing, joining, or embellishing fabric, yarn, or thread using needles, hooks, or a loom. They range from basic utilitarian stitching to delicate decorative textile crafts.
groups.summary_zh: 用针、钩或织机制作、拼接及修饰织物或线料的手工与缝纫工艺。

groups.name: Shape & Mold · 塑造与成型 (Sculpt, Form, Fashion)
groups.tip: 揉塑成形赋予具体轮廓

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove the interior of something to shape it into a cavity or vessel
to bring parts or material together to produce a specified structural shape

items.def_zh: 塑造，做模型；做模特展示；使模仿，模拟
items.def_en: 1. To shape, fashion, or create a three-dimensional figure or object out of clay or other material. 2. To work as a model wearing clothes or displaying products. 3. To design or create something based on another thing.

items.def_zh: 使符合……的轮廓，依形塑造；画等高线于；（用化妆品）勾画轮廓
items.def_en: To shape or mold something along natural curves and outlines; to fit the contours of an object.
(+ sth) fashion, cut, or shape a specific form or structure from a raw material
(+ sth) shape or flatten a piece of metal or pliable material by repeatedly striking it

items.def_zh: 塑造，使成形；决定，影响（发展）
items.def_en: 1. To give a particular form or shape to something. 2. To influence or determine the nature, development, or character of something.
(+ from/into) to make or shape something skillfully by hand or careful effort
to shape molten metal, plaster, or plastic by pouring it into a mold

items.def_zh: 使成阶梯状，把……筑成梯田
items.def_en: 1. To shape a sloping hillside into a series of flat, stepped levels for farming or building.

items.def_zh: 塑造，模压，浇铸；塑造（性格等）；发霉
items.def_en: 1. To shape a soft substance into a particular form. 2. To strongly influence someone's character or opinions. 3. To become covered with mold.
to shape raw solid material into a specific three-dimensional artistic form

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote giving physical or conceptual form to raw or malleable materials by carving, pressing, fitting, or styling into a specific contour or structure.
groups.summary_zh: 对可塑材料或抽象概念进行加工、修整、压制或雕刻，赋予其明确外形与结构。

groups.name: Socialize & Escort · 相伴与随行 (Visit, Accompany, Date)
groups.tip: 结伴而行相随护送

items.def_en: (+ sb) invite someone out socially, especially with romantic intent
(+ sb) have a romantic relationship with someone, regularly going on dates together
(+ sb) accompany someone to a station, airport, or departure point to say goodbye
to spend time with someone in order to win their love and marry them

items.def_zh: 与……约会，谈恋爱；注明日期；确定……的年代
items.def_en: 1. to have a romantic relationship with someone, going on dates regularly. 2. to write or determine the date of something.

items.raw_cluster: 拜访与探望 Visit & Call On
items.def_zh: 拜访，探望；参观，游览；作客，闲聊
items.def_en: 1. to go to see someone socially or spend time with them. 2. to go to a place to look around or stay there as a tourist.
to travel or go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort
(formal or literary) to accompany or be a companion to someone.
to accompany someone somewhere, especially for protection or as an official courtesy
(archaic) to accompany or keep company with someone.

items.def_zh: 遇见，相逢；（与……）会面，结识；满足，达到
items.def_en: 1. to come into the presence of or encounter someone; to get together socially or formally. 2. to fulfill or satisfy a condition or need.

items.def_zh: 遇见，会面；满足（meet 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of meet: to come into the presence of someone, or to fulfill a need.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe personal interactions involving visiting, accompanying, or courting another person, differentiated by social formality and intimacy.
groups.summary_zh: 表现拜访看望、随行陪同或浪漫交往等具有人际陪伴性质的社交方式。

groups.name: Soothe & Comfort · 安抚与抚慰 (Calm, Pacify, Placate)
groups.tip: 缓和紧张情绪抚慰受伤心灵

items.def_en: (+ down) to stop someone from feeling upset, angry, or excited
to make someone feel less worried, unhappy, or distressed
(+ sb) make someone less agitated, angry, or distressed, or become quieter
(+ sb) become calm, tranquil, or quiet, or cause someone to do so
(+ sb) make someone or become less loud, excited, or emotionally disturbed

items.def_zh: 安慰，抚慰，使平静；缓解，减轻（痛苦或不适）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone who is anxious, upset, or angry feel calmer. 2. To relieve physical pain, soreness, or irritation.

items.def_zh: （常与 along 连用）逗乐，鼓励，哄……高兴
items.def_en: 1. (usually jolly somebody along) (informal) To keep someone in a good mood or encourage them with friendly, cheerful talk.
1. To calm someone or prevent conflict by giving them what they demand.
1. (formal) To give comfort, consolation, or emotional relief to someone who is grieving or distressed.

items.def_zh: 哄（某人）入睡；使放松警惕，使平静；变平静
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel calm, safe, or sleepy. 2. To trick someone into feeling safe or complacent. 3. (of a storm or noise) To become quiet or less active.
to stop someone from feeling hostile or indignant by acting conciliatory
to soften someone's anger or anxiety by making gentle remarks or concessions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote easing emotional agitation, physical pain, or distress by providing tenderness, reassurance, pleasant distractions, or concessions.
groups.summary_zh: 通过温柔抚慰、言语开导或让步平息他人的悲伤、烦躁、愤怒或躯体痛楚。

groups.name: Throw & Launch · 投掷与发射 (Fling, Sling, Catapult)
groups.tip: 用力甩出或猛力投掷

items.def_en: (+ sth) throw something away or propel it outward through the air
to throw or hit something in a high, curving arc with gentle or measured force
(+ sth) discard, throw, or push something away with a swift, forceful motion

items.def_zh: 将（球）高高击出（或踢出、抛出）；把……储存于阁楼
items.def_en: 1. To hit, kick, or throw a ball high into the air. 2. To store something in an attic or loft.

items.def_zh: （用力或随意地）扔，掷；（随便地）搭，挂；用吊带吊运
items.def_en: 1. To throw something casually or with great force. 2. To hang or swing something loosely or carelessly. 3. To carry or hoist something with a sling or strap.
to throw something heavy using sustained physical effort

items.def_zh: （sling的过去式和过去分词）扔，掷；搭，挂
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of sling: to throw casually or with force, or hang loosely.
(+ sth) throw something downwards violently and with great force
to throw something with tremendous force, violence, or rage
1. To throw or push someone or something suddenly and with great force. 2. To move somewhere quickly and violently or angrily.

items.def_zh: 用弹射器发射；（使）猛掷，（使）猛冲；使突然跃升（为明星等）
items.def_en: 1. To launch or propel someone or something forward suddenly with great speed. 2. To suddenly push or be pushed into a particular state or prominence.

items.def_zh: 把（某人或某物）抛出窗外；罢免，把……革职
items.def_en: 1. (formal or humorous) To throw someone or something out of a window. 2. (informal) To remove or dismiss someone abruptly from a position of power.

groups.summary_en: An agent propels an object or entity forcefully through the air, distinguished by the bodily dynamic, mechanical mechanism (e.g. catapulting, lofting in a high arc), or specific physical trajectories.
groups.summary_zh: 施力将物体掷向空中，按力道轨迹、身体动作或发射机制细分。

groups.name: Wage War & Clash · 交战与厮杀 (Fight, Battle, Combat)
groups.tip: 交锋肉搏与武装战斗

items.def_en: to fight a war or be engaged in conflict or struggle against someone.

items.def_zh: 搏斗，打架；交战，打仗；抗争，努力争取
items.def_en: 1. to take part in a violent physical struggle or battle against someone. 2. to struggle to overcome something or achieve a goal.
to fight or struggle hard against someone or something, especially in a battle or competition.
[I/T] to enter into military combat against an enemy force

items.def_zh: 与……战斗，同……搏斗；设法消除，制止（不良事物）
items.def_en: 1. to fight or struggle against someone or something in battle. 2. to take action to reduce, defeat, or stop something bad.

items.def_zh: 搏斗，战斗；抗争（fight 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of fight: to take part in a violent struggle or battle.

items.def_zh: 发动（战争），开展，进行（斗争等）
items.def_en: to begin and continue a war, battle, or campaign.
(+ against sb/sth) defend oneself against an opponent or attack by fighting
(+ sb) engage in direct armed combat or hostile physical engagement against someone
(+ sb/sth) fight continuously or fiercely against an enemy or adversary
to come into sharp, violent military or physical confrontation with an opponent
to take part in a short, unplanned fight between small groups

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express armed or direct physical engagement against an adversary, varying from single close-quarters combat to organized national warfare.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖从短兵相接的个体搏斗到国家间组织化宣战与阵地交锋。

groups.name: Wear & Attire · 穿戴与着装 (Wear, Dress, Clothe)
groups.tip: 衣物鞋帽的穿戴状态

items.def_zh: 穿，戴，佩戴；蓄，留（发、须）；磨损，耗损
items.def_en: 1. To have clothing, shoes, glasses, or jewelry on your body. 2. To become damaged or thinner through continuous use, or cause something to do so.
to wear or display a garment, accessory, or feature with prominence or pride

items.def_zh: 穿衣服；给……穿衣；穿着，着装
items.def_en: To put clothes on yourself or someone else; to wear clothes of a particular style or type.

items.def_zh: 给……穿衣；为……提供衣服；覆盖，遮盖
items.def_en: 1. To dress someone or provide them with clothes. 2. (literary) To cover or envelop something.
(formal/literary) to clothe or furnish someone with fine garments
to place a garment, piece of jewellery, or accessory onto one's body
to put on formal, elaborate, or fancy clothes, or dress someone in special attire

items.def_zh: 穿得暖和；裹得严严实实
items.def_en: to dress warmly in many layers of clothing, or wrap someone warmly
to put on a piece of clothing easily, quickly, or smoothly

items.def_zh: 给……穿上长袍（或礼袍、罩衣）
items.def_en: (often passive) To dress someone or oneself in a gown, such as an academic robe or a surgical gown.
(formal) to dress someone in particular, typically formal or elaborate, clothing

items.def_zh: 穿得过于讲究（或隆重、暖和）；使穿得过分华丽
items.def_en: To dress in clothes that are too formal, fancy, or warm for an occasion.

groups.summary_en: An agent has garments, ornaments, or coverings on the body as a state, or puts them on someone or oneself in varying degrees of formality. Verbs contrast in habitual wearing versus ceremonial, elaborately formal attiring.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体穿着衣物或进行特定规格着装的常规及礼仪场景。

groups.name: Whack & Strike Heavily · 猛击与重击 (Whack, Slug, Clobber)
groups.tip: 沉重物体击中发出响亮闷响

items.def_en: To strike someone (especially a child) repeatedly on the buttocks with an open hand or flat object as punishment.
to strike someone or something vigorously with a flat object, making a sharp resonant sound
(informal) To hit or strike something hard with a quick, heavy blow.
(+ sb) hit or kick someone violently and repeatedly, causing injury
(+ sb) render an opponent unconscious or incapacitated with a heavy strike
(+ sb) attack someone forcefully with severe physical blows
to strike someone hard with a fist or solid blow, especially unexpectedly
1. (informal) To hit someone or something very hard, especially with a fist or bat. 2. (informal) To drink a large mouthful of liquor quickly.
1. (informal) To hit someone or something forcefully with a sharp, noisy blow. 2. (informal) To reduce something by a large amount.
to hit someone or something extremely hard with a heavy, swinging force

items.def_zh: 痛打，猛击；彻底击败；重创
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To hit someone or something very hard. 2. (informal) To defeat someone thoroughly or cause severe damage to them.
(informal) To strike heavily and noisily, producing a loud resonant or slapping sound.

groups.summary_en: An agent strikes a person or object with forceful, blunt, and often resounding impact, frequently using a fist, heavy implement, or swinging motion. Verbs differ in informal flavor, acoustic quality, and degree of punishing violence.
groups.summary_zh: 描述以拳头或钝器进行有力、发出声响的猛烈击打。

groups.name: Wipe & Cleanse · 擦拂与揩抹清洁 (Manner and Instrument of Cleaning)
groups.tip: 用海绵、抹布擦掉尘垢

items.def_en: to clean or wash something or someone using a wet sponge
to clean the entire surface of an object by rubbing it with a damp or soapy cloth

items.def_zh: 掸去……的灰尘，擦拭；撒粉（于）
items.def_en: 1. To wipe or clear dust from the surface of something. 2. To sprinkle something lightly with a fine powder or dust.
1. To clean, smooth, or apply something with a brush. 2. To touch or graze something lightly in passing.
to polish a surface smooth and shiny using a soft dry cloth

items.def_zh: 用海绵（或湿布）擦拭；揩油，蹭钱蹭吃
items.def_en: 1. To wash, clean, or wipe something using a damp sponge or cloth. 2. (disapproving) To obtain money, food, or shelter from others without paying.
[I/T] (+ up) to clean or wipe a floor or liquid with a wet mop or cloth

items.def_zh: 用拖把（或棉签）擦洗，擦拭
items.def_en: To clean, wash, or treat a surface or wound with a mop, sponge, or swab.
to remove liquid from a surface using a mop, sponge, or absorbent cloth

items.def_zh: 打扫，清扫；席卷，掠过（sweep的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of sweep: to clean or clear with a broom; to move swiftly across an area.
to clean something thoroughly by rubbing hard with a stiff brush and water
to clean thoroughly by hard rubbing with an abrasive material

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physical actions of clearing dirt, dust, or moisture using specific instruments (sponges, brushes, swabs) or mechanical motions across surfaces.
groups.summary_zh: 运用特定工具（如刷子、海绵、医用棉签、掸子）对表面进行扫拂擦抹清理。

groups.name: Wrinkle & Crease · 起皱与弄皱 (Wrinkle, Crease, Rumple)
groups.tip: 平整表面收缩起褶皱

items.def_en: to make or develop a sharp, distinct fold or line in paper, cloth, or skin
(+ up) To gather skin, lips, or fabric into small tight folds or wrinkles.
(+ up) To form many small, fine wrinkles or folds in paper, fabric, or skin.

items.def_zh: 使起皱褶；变得满是褶皱
items.def_en: to develop or cause to develop unintended lines, folds, or wrinkles
to crush or press paper or fabric into a compact, wrinkled mass, or to become crushed in this way
to tightly contract lips or fabric into small tight folds or wrinkles

items.def_zh: 捏皱，拧成一团；皱起（脸等）
items.def_en: to crush or squeeze something tightly into a ball or wrinkled shape, or contract one's facial features
to crush or press fabric or paper into uneven, messy folds or a compact ball

items.def_zh: 使（眉头等）起皱；在……上耕出沟畦
items.def_en: 1. To form narrow folds or wrinkles in the brow or forehead. 2. To plow or make long narrow grooves or trenches in the ground.
to crush, squeeze, or wrinkle something tightly into a compact mass
(+ up) To make clothes, hair, or sheets untidy and wrinkled.

items.def_zh: 起波状褶皱；起瓦楞形皱纹
items.def_en: to contract or shape into parallel ridges and grooves (of brows, metal, or surfaces)

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing smooth surfaces (such as skin, fabric, or paper) to contract into irregular ridges, folds, or furrows, or becoming so marked. They differ in manner: tight pursing, fine crinkling, deep linear furrowing, or disheveled crumpling.
groups.summary_zh: 平整表面（皮肤、织物、纸张等）因挤压或收缩形成褶皱或皱纹。

groups.name: Write & Compose · 书写与创作 (Drafting & Text Production)
groups.tip: 落笔成文，记录谱写篇章

items.def_en: to originate and write a published book, report, or substantive paper
to write the preliminary version of a speech, essay, contract, or law
to write or compose a letter, poem, or article by hand or authorship

items.def_zh: 写成完整的文章或报告；详述
items.def_en: to prepare a full, structured, or official piece of writing based on preliminary notes
to write, compose, or draw something very quickly and with little effort
to set down words, thoughts, or compositions on paper using a pen

items.def_zh: 匆匆记下，随手潦草写下
items.def_en: to write something down quickly and untidily
to compose verses that use words with matching terminal sounds

items.def_zh: 仓促写下，潦草地书写；乱写，涂画
items.def_en: To write or draw something quickly, carelessly, or untidily.

items.def_zh: 作十四行诗歌颂，用十四行诗写
items.def_en: (literary) To compose sonnets; to celebrate or address someone in a sonnet.

items.def_zh: 用红字书写（或印刷）；在（文稿等）上加红字标题或提示
items.def_en: (specialist or archaic) To write, print, or mark headings, instructions, or liturgical rules in red ink.

items.def_zh: 写作，创作，撰写（诗文、信件等）
items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To write or compose a poem, speech, or formal letter.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario depict the deliberate act of composing, penning, and producing written literary or textual works, ranging from hasty scribbling to formal verse composition.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖动笔书写、文学创作、起草文本及撰写诗文的具体场景行为。

groups.name: Abate & Subside · 减弱、平息与消减 (Subside, Abate, Lessen)
groups.tip: 风暴、强度或痛感趋于平息减弱

items.def_en: to recede, dwindle, or gradually decline in force or quality
to gradually become less strong, active, noisy, or violent until calm returns
to gradually reduce in intensity, severity, pressure, or speed
to stop, pause, or diminish in intensity, especially of bad weather or harsh conditions
to gradually draw to a close or subside in excitement and activity

items.def_zh: 缓解；减轻（严重性或痛苦）
items.def_en: to make something bad, painful, or severe less harsh or intense
[I/T] to make or become less in degree, intensity, or extent

items.def_zh: 平息，减退，消退；（水等）回落，退去；（地面、建筑物等）下陷，沉降
items.def_en: 1. (of pain, anger, storm, or noise) To become calmer, quieter, or less intense. 2. (of water) To sink to a lower or normal level. 3. (of ground or a building) To sink lower into the ground.

items.def_zh: （风暴、痛苦、激烈情绪等）减弱，减退，平息；减轻，削弱
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To become less strong, severe, or intense, or to make something less intense.
to decrease in vigor, power, or extent over time
1. (formal) To make a crime, mistake, or bad behavior seem less serious and more forgivable by providing an excuse.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate a reduction in the violence, intensity, severity, or perceived gravity of an adverse phenomenon, condition, or offense.
groups.summary_zh: 描述风暴、愤怒或剧痛等负面现象的强度自然减退、平息或严重性减轻。

groups.name: Acquire & Purchase · 购买与采购 (Shop, Buy, Procure)
groups.tip: 从日常买到正式采购

items.def_en: (+ sth) buy or obtain something casually, conveniently, or cheaply
to buy things in shops or online

items.def_zh: 掏钱购买；不情愿地支付
items.def_en: (+ for/on sth) pay or spend money to purchase something, often reluctantly
to buy something quickly and eagerly as soon as it becomes available

items.def_zh: 大肆挥霍采购；下本钱买
items.def_en: spend a substantial amount of money purchasing luxuries or special treats

items.def_zh: 购买，买；收买，贿赂；相信，接受（非正式）
items.def_en: 1. to obtain something by paying money for it 2. (informal) to believe or accept something as true
(formal) to buy something

items.def_zh: 买，购买（buy 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of buy; to have obtained something by paying money for it
to buy something again, especially something you previously owned or sold
to obtain or buy equipment or supplies, especially for an organization or government through formal procedures
to purchase all or large quantities of something to gain total control or exhaust supply

groups.summary_en: An individual or organization exchanges money to acquire goods, services, or assets, progressing from casual consumer shopping to deliberate commercial purchase, structured procurement, and full market buyouts.
groups.summary_zh: 从日常浏览消费递增至正式采办与强力收购。

groups.name: Active Participation & Engagement · 参与与互动 (Participate, Engage, Partake)
groups.tip: 投身事务并融入群体互动

items.def_en: (frequently passive or reflexive: be/get involved in) to cause someone to take part in an activity

items.def_zh: 参与，从事；与……建立联系，进行互动；吸引（注意力）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in/with) To become involved in an activity; to interact or communicate with someone. 2. To attract and hold someone's interest or attention.
(+ in) To take part in an activity or event.

items.def_zh: 交流，交往；相互作用，相互影响
items.def_en: (+ with) To communicate or react with someone; to have a mutual effect on each other.
to take part with others in an activity or discussion already underway
to be actively involved in an event, activity, or social gathering
to join with others in contributing effort, work, or money to accomplish a task
to secure a share or become actively involved in an activity, deal, or venture
to join into a conversation or debate by offering an opinion or comment
(+ with/on) to work jointly with others on an intellectual, artistic, or professional task

items.def_zh: 参与，参加；享用（食物或饮料）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) (formal) To take part in an activity. 2. (+ of) (formal) To eat, drink, or share something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an agent actively taking part in an activity, enterprise, or social discourse, either formally or socially.
groups.summary_zh: 主体积极介入、投身或分担某项集体活动与社会交往。

groups.name: Adjust & Coordinate · 调整与协调 (Tailor, Attune, Synchronize)
groups.tip: 量身定制以调整适应

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) design, adjust, or adapt something so that it matches a specific need or purpose
(+ to sth) adjust or attune something so it aligns or operates in harmony with something else
to organize or integrate different elements or groups to work together efficiently
to adjust components or positions so they line up or correspond with an external benchmark
(+ sth) link or synchronize components or parameters so that they operate in fixed coordination

items.def_zh: 使适应，量身定制，调整；裁制（衣服）
items.def_en: 1. To adapt or modify something to suit a particular purpose, need, or person. 2. To make or alter clothes to fit someone.
(informal) To synchronize, coordinate, or match in timing or operation.

items.def_zh: 校准；精确调整（以达精准标准）
items.def_en: to adjust an instrument or plan precisely to ensure accuracy or proper operational alignment
To happen or operate at the exact same time and speed, or to cause two or more things to do so.
to bring elements, rules, or systems into agreeable proportion, agreement, or consistency

items.def_zh: 使协调，使适应，使合拍；为……调音
items.def_en: (+ to) (often passive) To make someone or something sensitive to, aware of, or in harmony with a situation or mood.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote modifying, calibrating, or aligning components, behaviors, or schedules so that they correspond harmoniously or operate simultaneously. They vary by manner: customizing to fit a specific purpose, bringing into cognitive/sensory harmony, or aligning strictly in time and operation.
groups.summary_zh: 依特定需求或节奏对事物进行适配、校准与同步，使其融洽协同。

groups.name: Aggregate & Total · 累计与汇总计算 (Aggregate, Accumulate, Total)
groups.tip: 零散数值累加聚合为总量

items.def_en: to combine into a substantial total amount or continuously increase in sum

items.def_zh: 结清汇总，盘点算出总数
items.def_en: to calculate and record the complete final total of a set of figures or scores
to add individual numbers or items together to reach a final total

items.raw_cluster: 合计与相当于 Amount & Total
items.def_zh: 总计，共达；等同于，相当于
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To add up to a particular total or sum. 2. (+ to) To be equal or equivalent to something.
to calculate or record a running total of points, scores, or amounts
(+ to/from) to accumulate or be added as a natural or regular gain or increase over time
to result in a specific aggregate numerical sum or total quantity

items.def_zh: 总计达，共计；计算……的总和；彻底毁坏（车辆等）
items.def_en: 1. To add up to a particular number or amount; to calculate the total of something. 2. (informal) To damage a vehicle so badly that it cannot be repaired.
To amount to a combined total, or to combine several different amounts or items into a single total.
To gather or collect something gradually over a period of time, or to increase in amount over time.
to collect or gather a large quantity of wealth, materials, or information gradually

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses processes where individual numerical units, values, or tangible quantities grow over time into a collective sum. Distinctions rest on whether the verb indicates natural collection over time ('accumulate'), calculation of a sum ('total'), or synthesizing dispersed items into a whole ('aggregate').
groups.summary_zh: 通过逐步堆积或统合计算，使分散零碎的数据或事物汇总为总量。

groups.name: Alter & Customize · 修改与专项调整 (Modify, Customize, Tweak)
groups.tip: 针对细节参数进行调校改动

items.def_en: (+ sth) Quickly make or adapt a piece of equipment or structure from available parts
(+ sth) Make slight adjustments or modifications to improve performance

items.def_zh: 修改，微调，变更；（语法上）修饰；缓和
items.def_en: 1. To make small changes to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose. 2. (grammar) To qualify or limit the meaning of a word.
to make small adjustments to something in order to improve it or make it work more effectively
to make very small adjustments to an engine, plan, or system so that it works as well as possible

items.def_zh: 倒填日期，回溯（使合同、支票或加薪生效日期提前）
items.def_en: 1. To put an earlier date on a document, check, or pay agreement so that it takes effect from that past time.
to make unauthorized changes to something, especially so as to damage or improperly alter it
(+ sth) Decorate, customize, or equip something in an elaborate or stylish way

items.def_zh: 改装，加大……的马力（通常与 up 连用）
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'soup up') To modify an engine or machine to make it faster, more powerful, or more impressive.

items.def_zh: 定制，定做；按个人需求修改
items.def_en: 1. To modify or adapt something to meet the particular requirements or preferences of an individual.
to modify something, especially a car or engine, to make it more powerful or faster

groups.summary_en: An agent alters the structure, timing, or performance of an object, document, or vehicle to adapt it for a specific purpose or enhance its capability. Verbs range from neutral partial alteration to specialized enhancement or retroactive dating.
groups.summary_zh: 对事物结构、性能或日期等进行局部修改、定制或强化。

groups.name: Amass & Stockpile · 收集与储备 (Collect, Stock, Garner)
groups.tip: 从各处聚拢汇集资源

items.def_en: to buy or gather a large quantity of goods or supplies for future use

items.def_zh: 收集，采集；聚集；领取，收取
items.def_en: 1. To bring or come together from different places; to gather things as a hobby; to pick up or receive money or goods.
[I/T] To gradually gather or increase in quantity over a period of time

items.def_zh: 储存，储备（以备不时之需）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to collect and store a supply of something for future need
(+ sth) to accumulate or gather into a large amount or pile over time
(+ sth) to store or hide money, goods, or valuables in a safe place

items.def_zh: 储备，进货；存有，备有（货物）
items.def_en: 1. To keep a supply of goods available for sale; to fill or supply with goods, food, or livestock; 2. to keep stocks or supplies.

items.def_zh: 收集，获得（支持、荣誉、信息等）；储存
items.def_en: 1. To collect, gather, or earn something through effort, such as support, praise, or information.

items.def_zh: 积攒，积聚（财富、证据等巨量物）
items.def_en: To gather together or accumulate a large amount of valuable material or information

items.def_zh: 秘藏，囤积（尤指出于贪婪或焦虑）
items.def_en: [I/T] To amass money or valued objects and hide or store them away greedily or anxiously

items.def_zh: 大量囤积，储备（以防短缺）
items.def_en: [I/T] To collect and store a large quantity of goods or materials for future use

groups.summary_en: An agent systematically gathers, amasses, or reserves commodities, resources, or intangible assets over time. Verbs range from neutral accumulation to deliberate hoarding or hard-won harvesting of support.
groups.summary_zh: 系统性或大量积攒、储备物资或抽象资源。

groups.name: Appellation & Designation · 命名与赐名 (Name, Dub, Denominate)
groups.tip: 为事物或人赋予名称与头衔

items.def_zh: 自称；尊称为（多用于正式头衔）
items.def_en: designate or address with an official title, honorific, or surname
attach a label, moniker, or descriptive identity to someone or something
give a specific title to a book, article, or other artistic work
(+ sb/sth) Give someone or something the same name as an existing person or thing
(+ sb/sth) Label, describe, or categorize someone or something by a particular designation
(+ sb/sth) Give an unofficial, honorary, or descriptive nickname or title to someone or something
To give an informal, humorous, or descriptive name to someone or something.

items.def_zh: 把……称为，给……起绰号；授予称号（如封爵）；（为电影等）配音
items.def_en: 1. To give an unofficial name, nickname, or title to someone or something. 2. To confer knighthood on someone. 3. To replace the original spoken dialogue in a film or broadcast with another recording or language.
To give a new or different name to a person, place, organization, or object.

items.def_zh: 为……施洗礼并命名；正式命名
items.def_en: give a baby a name at baptism, or give a ship or project a name officially

items.def_zh: 命名，称呼；以某种货币单位计价
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To give a specific name, title, or designation to something. 2. (finance) To express or record a financial sum in a particular currency unit.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote speech acts that assign an identity, title, or label to an entity, covering formal or ritualistic conferring of titles (dub, denominate), colloquial or descriptive monikers (nickname), and modifying existing designations (rename).
groups.summary_zh: 通过言语行为赋予人或事物名称、头衔或称谓，含正式命名与戏称。

groups.name: Astound & Appall · 震惊与骇然 (Shock, Stupefy, Flabbergast)
groups.tip: 由目瞪口呆到惊恐万分

items.def_zh: 使深受震撼，使极其惊愕
items.def_en: (+ sb) Overwhelm, amaze, or intensely impress someone

items.def_zh: 使大吃一惊，使极其震惊
items.def_en: (+ sb) Astonish, surprise, or overwhelm someone completely

items.def_zh: 使惊骇恶心，使毛骨悚然
items.def_en: (+ sb) Disgust, repulse, or horrify someone intensely
to shock, astonish, or deeply unsettle someone with an overwhelming fact or number
to shock or surprise someone greatly by something very unexpected or extraordinary

items.def_zh: 使大吃一惊，使目瞪口呆
items.def_en: (usually passive) To shock, surprise, or amaze someone completely.

items.def_zh: 使呆住，使惊呆不动；刺穿，穿透
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To make someone unable to move or speak because of fear, shock, or fascination. 2. (literary) To pierce or impale with a sharp object.

items.raw_cluster: 使震惊与使困惑 Stun & Baffle
items.def_zh: 使惊呆，使惊愕；使麻木，使昏昏沉沉
items.def_en: 1. To shock or surprise someone so much that they cannot think or speak clearly. 2. To make someone dull or drowsy, as through tiredness or alcohol.
(often passive) To impress or frighten someone so much that they feel nervous or unable to speak or act freely.

items.raw_cluster: 使惊恐与使震惊 Terrify & Shock
items.def_zh: 使惊骇，使大为震惊，使深感厌恶
items.def_en: To shock, horrify, or disgust someone deeply.

items.def_zh: 使毛骨悚然，使极度震惊
items.def_en: to fill someone with deep shock, aversion, or dismay at something atrocious

groups.summary_en: An event, sight, or revelation overwhelms an observer's emotional or cognitive capacity, progressing from intimidating awe and paralyzing bewilderment to utter incredulity and profound moral horror.
groups.summary_zh: 由心生敬畏、目瞪口呆递增至极度错愕与骇然惊骇。

groups.name: Auditory Perception & Attention · 听觉与倾听 (Hear, Overhear, Listen)
groups.tip: 从被动听到主动倾听

items.def_en: (+ sth) Hear and grasp the significance of what is being spoken

items.def_zh: 察觉听到，注意到（声音或暗示）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Detect or notice an audible remark, tone, or clue

items.def_zh: 听见，听到；得知，获悉；审理，听审
items.def_en: 1. To perceive sounds with your ears. 2. To receive information or news about something. 3. (law) To listen to and judge a legal case in court.
To hear what other people are saying without their knowledge or intention.
Listen secretly or attentively to a conversation happening nearby
(+ to) consciously direct one's attention to a broadcast or speaker

items.def_zh: 听见，听到；得知（hear 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of hear: perceived a sound with the ear, or received information about something.
1. (+ to) To pay conscious attention to a sound or to what someone is saying. 2. (+ to) To take notice of advice or instructions and follow them.
(+ to) listen attentively or pay close attention to something
(+ on) secretly listen to a private conversation

items.def_zh: 全神贯注地听（某人的话）
items.def_en: (+ every word/to) listen with intense fascination and undivided attention

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the auditory reception of sound, ranging from involuntary sensory reception (hear) or accidental reception (overhear) to deliberate, focused cognitive attention directed toward sounds or speech (listen, attend).
groups.summary_zh: 从被动感知声音、无意中听到，到主动集中注意力倾听与专注。

groups.name: Bind, Restrain & Secure · 捆绑、拴锁与固定 (Tie, Bind, Lock, Chain)
groups.tip: 用绳链或卡扣锁死位置

items.def_zh: 系，拴，扎，捆绑；（使）打结；与……打成平手
items.def_en: to fasten, attach, or bind something with string, rope, or cord; to make a knot or bow; to finish a contest with equal scores.

items.def_zh: 锁上，锁住；固定，卡住；（使）紧密结合
items.def_en: to fasten or secure something with a lock; to become firmly fixed or held in place.

items.def_zh: 用铁链锁住，拴住；束缚，囚禁
items.def_en: to fasten, secure, or confine someone or something with a chain.

items.def_zh: 捆绑，系紧；使结合，使黏合；约束
items.def_en: to tie or fasten tightly with rope or cloth; to hold or stick together; to impose a legal or moral obligation on.
(+ sb/sth) bind someone or something securely with rope, cord, or string to restrict movement
(+ sb/sth) secure a person, animal, or object in an enclosed space with a lock
(+ sb/sth) fasten or restrain someone or something securely with a chain
(+ sb/sth) hold someone or something firmly against a surface so they cannot move
[I/T] to attach, tie, or secure one object firmly to another or close an opening securely
to tie an animal or object with a rope or chain to limit its range of movement
to fasten someone's limbs with metal restraints to severely restrict physical movement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve physically restraining, tethering, or fastening a person, animal, or object with cords, chains, or mechanical fasteners to restrict movement or hold components firmly together. Nuances vary by the specific binding medium (rope, chain, mechanical lock) and the degree of permanence.
groups.summary_zh: 用绳索、链条或机械构件捆绑、锁闭或固定以限制其移动。

groups.name: Blend & Fuse Together · 混合与融合 (Blend, Intermingle, Coalesce)
groups.tip: 多种成分交融混为一体

items.def_en: Combine seamlessly with surroundings or other components without standing out
(+ sth) Move smoothly into and become joined with another substance or stream
to intertwine threads or diverse strands closely together into one complex fabric
(+ sth) Merge or dissolve so thoroughly into something as to become indistinguishable

items.def_zh: 混合，调和；（使）融合，融为一体
items.def_en: 1. To mix different substances, qualities, or styles together smoothly. 2. (+ in/with) To harmonize or fit in well with surroundings.
to combine two or more things gradually so that the boundary between them disappears
to combine diverse elements, groups, or businesses into one unified body
(+ into/with) To come together to form one larger group, substance, or mass.
(+ with) To mix or mingle together, or to combine two or more things closely.
1. (+ with) (formal) To mix or blend two or more things, funds, or groups together.
to join or become combined into a single, indivisible entity, often under intense conditions

groups.summary_en: Distinct elements, substances, or groups combining into an integrated whole. Distinctions turn on whether components remain identifiable when intermixed or lose their separate identities through seamless fusion and organic coalescing.
groups.summary_zh: 多样成分交错混合或融合成统一的无缝整体

groups.name: Clean & Purify · 清洁与净化 (Cleanse, Sanitize, Disinfect)
groups.tip: 除菌消毒恢复无菌洁净

items.def_zh: 彻底清扫，清除内部脏物
items.def_en: (+ sth) Clean the interior of a space or container thoroughly, removing unwanted dirt or contents
(+ sth) Clean a large surface thoroughly by spraying or splashing water over it

items.def_zh: （用布等全面）擦拭清洁，擦洗消毒
items.def_en: (+ sth) Clean the entire surface of something thoroughly using a damp or disinfectant cloth

items.def_zh: 清洗，清洁（皮肤、伤口等）；净化，清洗（罪孽）
items.def_en: 1. To make skin, a wound, or an area thoroughly clean. 2. (formal) To free someone from guilt, sin, or bad feelings.

items.def_zh: 清洗净化，彻底清除杂质
items.def_en: to rid an enclosed space, conduit, or system completely of impure substances or residues
1. To clean a surface, wound, or room with a chemical substance to destroy harmful bacteria and viruses.

items.def_zh: 给……消毒，实施卫生处理；净化，粉饰（删去令人不快的信息）
items.def_en: 1. To clean and disinfect something thoroughly to remove germs. 2. To alter a report or story to remove offensive, unpleasant, or controversial details.

items.def_zh: （用巴氏灭菌法）对……进行消毒灭菌
items.def_en: 1. To heat milk, juice, or wine to a specific temperature to kill harmful bacteria without altering its flavor.
to make completely free from live bacteria, viruses, and other microorganisms
1. To disinfect or clear a building, room, or crops using chemical smoke or gas to kill pests and germs.
to sterilize medical or laboratory equipment using high-pressure superheated steam

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame identify specialized decontamination and purification methods aimed at neutralizing microbes, pathogens, or pests through specific chemical or thermal protocols.
groups.summary_zh: 通过化学药剂、热力或物理熏蒸等特化手段消杀病原体与污垢。

groups.name: Coat & Smear Viscous Substances · 涂抹与厚敷 (Daub, Smear, Bedirection)
groups.tip: 随手涂抹泥浆漆料

items.def_en: (+ sth) spread a thick, sticky substance crudely or clumsily onto something

items.def_zh: 涂抹，胡乱涂抹；弄脏，蹭污；诽谤，玷污
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/over/with) To spread a soft, greasy, or sticky substance carelessly over a surface. 2. To damage someone's reputation by making false accusations.

items.def_zh: 用棉棒或拭子涂敷（药液等）
items.def_en: (+ on/over) to apply a liquid or antiseptic generously to an area with an absorbent pad
(+ on/with) To spread or smear a thick, wet substance such as paint, plaster, or mud coarsely or clumsily onto a surface.

items.def_zh: 在…上涂厚厚一层；抹上膏/泥覆盖
items.def_en: (+ sth) cover a surface heavily with a thick, sticky, or paste-like substance
(+ sth) spread a thick layer of a substance thickly or lavishly onto a surface
1. To cover or coat a surface with tar. 2. To characterize or damage someone's reputation unfairly.
to cover or smear all over with a greasy, muddy, or staining substance

items.def_zh: 用杂酚油涂抹（木材等），用防腐油处理
items.def_en: To treat or coat wood with creosote to protect it from rot.
(+ with/over) to cover a surface thickly with a sticky or wet paste

items.def_zh: 大量涂抹；厚厚敷上一层
items.def_en: (+ on/with) to spread a thick layer of a substance lavishly over a surface

groups.summary_en: Spreading, layering, or plastering thick, sticky, or viscous substances (paint, grease, tar, preservative) onto a surface. Nuances range from crude, messy slathering to heavy, protective chemical coating.
groups.summary_zh: 将粘稠或油性物质涂敷、涂抹或糊于表面

groups.name: Coat & Treat Surfaces · 表面涂覆与处理 (Tin, Electroplate, Anodize)
groups.tip: 在物体表面镀层或覆盖

items.def_en: (+ sth) lightly cover a surface with a powdery substance
(+ sth) sprinkle a fine layer of flour across the surface of sth

items.def_zh: 镀锡于；（尤指英）将（食品）装罐保存
items.def_en: 1. To coat a metal surface with a thin layer of tin. 2. (chiefly British) To preserve food by putting it into a tin or can.

items.def_zh: 使布满脉纹（或叶脉状条纹）
items.def_en: (usually passive) To cover, streak, or mark a surface with lines or veins like those in marble, wood, or leaves.

items.def_zh: 用帆布覆盖；用帆布装备
items.def_en: To cover, line, or equip something with canvas.
To sprinkle or coat food or a cooking surface with flour.
to cover a metal object with a thin coating of another metal, especially gold or silver
to cover thinly with gold leaf or gold paint
to coat iron or steel with a protective layer of zinc
To coat a metal object with a thin layer of another metal using an electric current.

items.def_zh: 阳极氧化处理（对金属表面进行电解氧化以防腐）
items.def_en: (metallurgy) To coat a metal, especially aluminum, with a protective or decorative oxide layer by electrolysis.

groups.summary_en: An agent applies a protective, decorative, or culinary layer onto an object's surface through industrial treatment, chemical deposition, or cooking preparation. Verbs are distinguished by the specific material applied (e.g., flour, tin, oxide layer).
groups.summary_zh: 通过化学电镀、机械覆盖或烹饪裹粉在物体表面加覆图层。

groups.name: Collate & Systematize · 编目与版式排布 (Arranging by Order or System)
groups.tip: 依序排列或重新规划次序

items.def_zh: 起草，编订（清单、表格或文书）
items.def_en: (+ sth) prepare and write out a structured list, plan, or formal document
(+ sth) arrange text, illustrations, or items in a structured, systematic design
(+ sth) arrange a group of things systematically into order or into different categories
to compile an alphabetized or classified pointer list for information
to collect and combine texts or pages in proper logical sequence
to list items individually and systematically

items.def_zh: 按字母顺序排列；用字母表示
items.def_en: to arrange words, names, or items in alphabetical order.

items.def_zh: 重新排列，重新整理；重新安排（时间等）
items.def_en: to change the position, order, or time of something.

items.def_zh: 重新排列，调整顺序；再次订购
items.def_en: 1. to arrange things in a different order or sequence. 2. to order a fresh supply of something.
to set or arrange written text and characters into type ready for printing.

items.def_zh: 将……列成表格，把……制成表格
items.def_en: to arrange data, numbers, or facts systematically in a table with columns and rows.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the systematic manipulation and structured ordering of items, text, or data into specific sequences, tables, or publication formats.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据字母、数据、逻辑或出版规制对文本和物件进行精细结构化排布。

groups.name: Combust, Scorch & Incinerate · 燃烧、灼烧与焦化 (Burn, Scorch & Char)
groups.tip: 受火热侵蚀发焦燃烧

items.def_zh: 闷烧，阴燃；（情绪）郁积，潜伏
items.def_en: 1. To burn slowly with smoke but without flames. 2. (of feelings) To exist and linger in a hidden or suppressed state.
to burn slightly or superficially, especially at the edges, tips, or surface fibers
(+ sth) blacken or become blackened on the surface by intense heat

items.def_zh: 燃烧；烧毁，灼伤；消耗（能量或燃料）
items.def_en: 1. To be on fire or to catch fire; to destroy, damage, or injure by heat or flames. 2. To consume or be consumed as fuel for energy.
1. To burn or become burned until the surface is blackened. 2. (British, dated) To work as a cleaning woman.
to burn or discolor the surface of something by heat or flame without consuming it entirely
(+ sth) be completely consumed by fire or heat, or destroy something totally by burning

items.def_zh: 烧焦，灼伤；（烹饪中）高温快煎
items.def_en: 1. To burn or scorch the surface of something with sudden, intense heat. 2. (cooking) To brown the surface of meat quickly at high temperature.
1. To catch fire and burn, or to cause something to burn.
(+ sth) be completely destroyed by fire, or destroy a building completely with flame
to burn something completely until it is reduced to ash

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the chemical reaction of burning and thermal surface degradation caused by intense heat or flame. Verbs distinguish between low-oxygen slow smouldering, generic combustion, surface blackening (charring/searing), and complete destructive burning.
groups.summary_zh: 高温引起的缓慢阴燃、明火燃烧、表面焦化或剧烈灼烧。

groups.name: Common Animal Calls & Onomatopoeia · 常见动物拟声叫声 (Meow, Moo, Chirp)
groups.tip: 各种动物发出的叫声

items.def_en: (of a cat) to make a continuous low, vibrating sound expressing contentment
begin to speak or emit a high-pitched cry or chirp
(of a pig) to make its quintessential grunting sound
(of a cat) To make its characteristic crying sound.

items.def_zh: 发出吱吱声（或尖叫声）；侥幸通过，勉强胜出
items.def_en: 1. To make a short, high-pitched cry or sound. 2. ('squeak by/through') To succeed or get through with difficulty by a narrow margin.
(of a cow) To make a long, deep, low sound.

items.def_zh: （小鸟或昆虫）唧唧喳喳叫；轻松愉快地说
items.def_en: 1. (of a small bird or insect) To make short, sharp, high-pitched sounds. 2. To speak in a lively, cheerful way.
(of a duck) To make its characteristic harsh, flat sound.
to make the short, sharp, loud explosive sound typical of a dog
(of a horse) to utter a characteristic high, prolonged whinnying cry
(+ sth) emit a sharp, abrupt, bark-like sound or cry

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent standard, species-defining onomatopoeic cries of domestic animals, songbirds, and small creatures.
groups.summary_zh: 常见家禽、家畜及小动物的特征性拟声鸣叫与呼唤。

groups.name: Complain & Protest · 申诉至愤抗 (Complain to Remonstrate by Intensity)
groups.tip: 从喋喋不休碎碎念到当面抗议

items.def_en: to make weak, low sounds of complaint or unhappiness
(+ sb/sth) complain repeatedly in an irritated or whining manner
(archaic or literary) to complain, lament, or express sorrow and dissatisfaction.

items.def_zh: 大声抗议；表达强烈不满
items.def_en: protest loudly or make a vehement public complaint against an injustice
to express discontent, displeasure, pain, or resentment; make a formal complaint.

items.def_zh: 发牢骚，哭诉，抱怨；发出哀鸣，发出尖锐刺耳声
items.def_en: 1. to complain in an annoying, petulant, or tearful voice. [I] 2. to make a long, high-pitched, complaining sound.

items.def_zh: 抱怨，喋喋不休地发牢骚；大声喧嚷
items.def_en: (informal) to talk loudly and continuously, or whine and complain repeatedly.
(+ sb/sth) complain or protest loudly, bitterly, and forcefully against something

items.def_zh: 喧嚷抱怨；大声抗议要求
items.def_en: (+ for/against) to make an insistent, noisy demand or protest
(formal) to argue, protest, or make a forcefully reproachful objection against an action or decision.
(+ against/at) to complain passionately and furiously using abusive language

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame scale in intensity from ordinary expressions of grievance and petulant whining up to loud, repetitive clamoring and forceful, formal remonstration.
groups.summary_zh: 按不满程度递增，从日常表达委屈、哭丧哀鸣，逐步升级至高声喧嚣乃至正式抗议反驳。

groups.name: Congregate & Swarm · 聚集与汇合
groups.tip: 从四处聚到一起

items.def_en: come together or assemble in one place around a common focal point
(+ sb/sth) gather closely together in large numbers around a person or point
congregate or gather in large numbers in one place
(+ sth) enter and fill a space in very large, tightly packed numbers

items.def_zh: 聚集，群集；使成簇，使聚集
items.def_en: To form or gather into a small, close group, or cause things or people to do this.
come together as a organized group in one place for a definite purpose
(+ to) move or come together rapidly in large numbers like a flock of birds

items.def_zh: 成群移动，涌往；挤满，群集
items.def_en: (+ into/around/with) When insects, birds, or crowds swarm, they move together in large, dense numbers.
(+ on/upon) move toward and meet at a shared point or destination from differing directions
To gather together in a crowd or large group in one place.
flock together or pack tightly into a place in overwhelming numbers

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe animate entities or people drawing together from different points to form a dense crowd, mass, or group in a single location.
groups.summary_zh: 人或动物自发地从各处汇集、聚集到一处形成密集群体。

groups.name: Copulate & Mate · 交配与交媾 (Mate, Breed, Mount)
groups.tip: 两性发生性交与交媾行为

items.def_en: (of a male animal) to climb onto a female animal to mate
[I/T] (of animals) to pair up and engage in copulation to produce offspring
[I/T] to mate and produce offspring, or to keep animals for reproduction
(+ with sb) engage in sexual activity or intercourse with someone
(+ sb) have sexual intercourse with someone
form a romantic or mating partnership with another individual
1. (British taboo slang) To have sexual intercourse with someone. 2. (baseball) To chase and catch fly balls during practice.
1. (taboo slang) To perform anal intercourse on someone. 2. (informal, offensive) To ruin, break, or exhaust someone or something.
(+ with) (formal or biology) To have sexual intercourse, especially for reproduction.
(biology / medicine) To introduce semen into a female human or animal to cause pregnancy.
(formal / law) To engage in anal intercourse with someone, especially by force.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to sexual intercourse or biological reproduction, spanning clinical biology, zoological pairing, and vulgar or colloquial descriptions of the physical act.
groups.summary_zh: 描述生物配种繁殖或人类性行为的动作，涵盖生物学中性、粗鄙口语及特定方式。

groups.name: Cover & Conceal · 隐藏与遮盖 (Hide, Mask, Occult)
groups.tip: 将物体藏起避开视线

items.def_en: to hide, protect, or shelter someone or something by interposing a partition or barrier

items.def_zh: 把……藏起来，遮掩，隐瞒；躲藏，隐蔽
items.def_en: 1. To put or keep something or someone in a place where they cannot be seen or found. 2. To conceal an emotion, secret, or truth.
To put or keep something out of sight; to conceal from view or discovery.
To cover or conceal something so that it cannot easily be seen, heard, or noticed; to hide a feeling, fact, etc. under a false appearance.
(+ sth) place something over an object to hide it from view, or conceal wrongdoing
(+ sth) stop light from entering or obscure something from view by standing in front of it
(+ sth) separate and conceal an area or object from sight using a barrier or screen
to conceal or enclose something with or as if with a hanging curtain
to prevent something from being seen or heard clearly by dimming or obstructing it
To hide or block something from view; (in astronomy) to cut off light from a celestial body by passing in front of it.
To cover someone's eyes with a piece of cloth so that they cannot see.

groups.summary_en: An agent or object places something out of visual or cognitive reach by interposing a covering, barrier, or blind. Verbs range from basic everyday concealment to specialized sensory blocking and astronomical/technical obscuration.
groups.summary_zh: 通过覆盖物、眼罩或物理阻隔将目标置于视线之外或隐蔽。

groups.name: Cover & Envelop · 遮盖与涂覆 (Coat, Blanket, Encase)
groups.tip: 给物体蒙上罩布或涂覆保护层

items.def_en: (+ sth) enclose or cover something completely in paper, cloth, or protective material
To cover or coat something with a layer of copper.
To coat or treat something with rubber.
to cover the surface of an object with a thin decorative or protective coating
(+ sth) cover an entire area or surface heavily with a thick layer of something

items.def_zh: 把…装入硬壳中；密封包裹
items.def_en: (+ sth) enclose something entirely in a protective shell, frame, or container

items.def_zh: 罩上，覆盖；给……戴上风帽（或头巾）
items.def_en: To cover something with or as if with a hood.

items.def_zh: 厚厚地覆盖；在……上铺地毯；严厉训斥
items.def_en: 1. To cover something completely with a thick layer, like a carpet. 2. (informal) To severely reprimand or scold someone.
To cover something completely with a thick, dense layer of something.
to encase or cover something in a protective outer layer of metal, plastic, or wood
to surround or completely enclose something within a hard or protective layer

groups.summary_en: An agent or substance forms an extensive protective, industrial, or insulating layer over an underlying surface or object. The verbs differ primarily in the mechanical manner, medium, or material thickness (e.g., metals, rubber, textile covers, or atmospheric drifts).
groups.summary_zh: 以特定材质或厚重表层对物体进行紧密包裹或涂覆。

groups.name: Damage & Disfigure · 毁损与残损 (Blight, Disfigure, Mangle)
groups.tip: 从外观损毁到功能丧失

items.def_en: to impair the appearance, quality, or perfection of something
(+ sth) spoil the appearance, condition, or proper functioning of something
to spoil the surface or appearance of something, especially by writing or drawing on it

items.def_zh: 击穿（船底），使（船底）破损漏水；（船底）破裂
items.def_en: (nautical) To break or stave in the bottom of a ship, causing it to take on water; to suffer such damage.
(+ sb/sth) hurt someone badly or batter an object by repeatedly striking them violently
(+ sth) damage or mutilate something severely by ripping it violently into pieces

items.def_zh: 破坏，毁害；使染上枯萎病
items.def_en: 1. To spoil, damage, or severely impair something. 2. (of plant diseases) To infect crops or plants with blight.

items.def_zh: 严重损毁，压碎，撕碎；乱改，糟蹋（文句或音乐等）
items.def_en: 1. To damage something severely by crushing, tearing, or twisting it out of shape. 2. To ruin or spoil something, such as speech or music, by performing or rendering it badly.

items.def_zh: 毁容，破损……的外貌，损害……的外观
items.def_en: To spoil or permanently damage the appearance of someone or something.

items.def_zh: 肆意破坏，蓄意毁坏（公私财物）
items.def_en: To deliberately destroy or damage public or private property.
to inflict severe, dismembering, or permanent damage that ruins the structure or form

groups.summary_en: An agent, disease, or external force causes severe structural, functional, or aesthetic harm to a surface, entity, or human body. Verbs vary in intensity from marring aesthetic value or spoiling growth to violently mutilating physical integrity.
groups.summary_zh: 描述对外观、结构或整体完好性造成破坏、残损与损毁。

groups.name: Defeat & Prevail · 击败与战胜 (Vanquish, Overcome, Crush)
groups.tip: 击溃对手并彻底征服占领

items.def_en: (+ sb) defeat an opponent or rival who challenges you, forcing them away
succeed after facing strong opposition or competition; prevail ultimately
to succeed in dealing with or gaining control over an opponent, obstacle, or feeling
(+ sb/sth) defeat an opponent completely or destroy their remaining resistance
1. To take control of a country or territory by military force. 2. To successfully overcome a fear, problem, or difficulty.
(+ over) To gain a great victory or achieve success after a struggle or contest.

items.def_zh: 战胜，击败，获胜；流行，盛行
items.def_en: 1. (+ against/over) To defeat an opponent or succeed after a difficult struggle. 2. To be widespread, dominant, or commonly accepted.
to defeat an enemy or opposing team completely and force them to flee in disorder
(literary) To defeat an enemy, opponent, or fear completely.
(informal) To defeat an opponent completely and by a wide margin.
to defeat or suppress someone or something decisively and completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate overcoming an opponent or obstacle in contest or combat, progressing from winning or asserting dominance to crushing and utterly obliterating an adversary.
groups.summary_zh: 指在竞争、冲突或战争中战胜敌手，由最终占优升华至彻底毁灭性击溃。

groups.name: Defiance & Insurrection · 反抗与叛乱 (Oppose, Resist, Revolt)
groups.tip: 从被动抵制到公然叛变

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) oppose, resist, or actively disagree with an authority's plan or demand
(+ sb/sth) resist or confront a powerful authority or bully courageously without flinching
To disagree strongly with a plan or policy and try to prevent it; to fight, resist, or compete against someone.

items.def_zh: 反抗，抵制，违抗；（马等）猛然弓背跃起
items.def_en: 1. To resist, oppose, or refuse to comply with a trend, system, or authority. 2. (of a horse) To jump vertically with an arched back to throw off a rider.

items.def_zh: 反抗，抵制；忍住，克制；抗拒（疾病、外力等）
items.def_en: 1. To fight against or oppose someone or something. 2. To stop yourself from doing or having something you want.
to openly resist or refuse to obey an authority, rule, or expectation
rebel against an oppressive government or authority, often using violent insurrection
To oppose or fight against people in authority or a government; to take part in a rebellion.

items.def_zh: 反叛，起义，反抗；（使）反感，（使）恶心
items.def_en: 1. To take violent action against a government or authority; to rebel. 2. To feel or cause to feel strong disgust or shock.
to rise up in active, armed rebellion against recognized authority
(especially of soldiers or sailors) to openly rebel against military commanders

groups.summary_en: Verbs tracking escalation in defiance against an authority, policy, or regime—from passive or political disagreement to armed insurrection.
groups.summary_zh: 从政策抵制、公然违抗升级至武装叛乱或暴力颠覆政权。

groups.name: Derision & Open Contempt · 嘲弄与讥诮 (Mock, Ridicule, Jeer)
groups.tip: 以挖苦模仿方式取笑他人

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) tease or mock someone, exposing them to ridicule
(+ sb/sth) make fun of or deride someone in an unkind, mocking way
(+ sb/sth) treat someone or an idea with spoken scorn, disbelief, and open contempt
tease or laugh at in a scornful or contemptuous manner, often by imitating

items.def_zh: 嘲笑，讥讽，嘲弄；狼吞虎咽地吃
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To speak about someone or something in a scornful, mocking way. 2. (informal) To eat food quickly and greedily.
express contempt for or dismiss someone or something as completely worthless
(informal, especially US) To tease, mock, or heckle someone playfully or derisively.
To make fun of someone or something in an unkind or mocking way.
provoke or challenge someone with insulting, hurtful remarks
interrupt a public speaker or performer with aggressive, derisive comments
To laugh at or shout rude, mocking remarks at someone.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent aggressive speech acts intended to belittle, humiliate, or laugh at a target, ranging from spoken scornful dismissiveness (scoff), playful teasing to harsh teasing (razz), direct exposure to laughing absurdity (ridicule), to loud vocal hostility (jeer).
groups.summary_zh: 通过言辞或叫嚣嘲笑、贬低或公开羞辱他人，流露不屑与敌意。

groups.name: Deteriorate & Worsen · 恶化与退化 (Exacerbate, Decay, Devolve)
groups.tip: 不良状况加剧恶化

items.def_en: [I/T] to become of poorer quality or make an existing problem more severe
gradually deteriorate in quality, health, or condition
[I/T] to undergo progressive structural, moral, or biological decline

items.def_zh: （病情）复发；重新陷入（恶习或不良状态）
items.def_en: To become ill again after an apparent improvement, or to return to bad behavior or an undesirable condition.

items.def_zh: 倒退，退化，退回到（较差状态）
items.def_en: To return to an earlier, less advanced, or worse state of development, behavior, or condition.
disintegrate or break down completely in structure or condition
become completely broken, disorganized, or mentally incapacitated

items.def_zh: 加重，使加剧，使恶化；激怒
items.def_en: 1. To make an injury, illness, or bad situation worse. 2. (informal) To annoy or exasperate someone.
To become worse in quality, condition, health, or moral standards over time.
to make a problem, disease, or bad situation significantly worse
(+ into) to degenerate progressively into a lower or disordered state

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the decline of a condition, health, or structure toward a lower, more broken, or more severe state, progressing from setback and regression to compounding decay and acute aggravation.
groups.summary_zh: 指状态、健康或局势向下退化变劣，从复发倒退升级至严重恶化崩塌。

groups.name: Dig & Excavate · 挖掘与开凿铲挖 (Dig, Spade, Gouge)
groups.tip: 从浅层翻土到深层凿坑

items.def_en: (+ sth) create a cavity or remove material with a curved tool or hands
[I/T] to dig a hole or tunnel into the ground, as an animal does

items.def_zh: 挖空成洞穴状；将……置于洞穴中
items.def_en: (literary) To hollow out like a cave; to enclose or place in a cavern.
(+ sth) make a hole or passage in the earth, or excavate something buried
(+ sth) break ground and remove something from the earth by digging
to make an empty space inside something by digging or scooping material out
To break up, turn over, or remove soil or earth with a tool, hands, or a machine.
[I/T] to dig long, narrow ditches or trenches into the earth
To dig, cut, or turn over earth using a spade.
[I/T] to dig out materials systematically or uncover archaeological remains

items.def_zh: （用利器等）挖出，凿出；敲诈，漫天要价
items.def_en: 1. To make a groove or hole in something roughly or with a sharp tool; 2. (informal) to overcharge someone unfairly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on the physical methods, tools, and actions used to break into, scoop out, or hollow subterranean or solid ground, from standard manual spade work to sharp gouging.
groups.summary_zh: 使用工具或手力对地面、固态表层进行挖土、开凿或掏空。

groups.name: Disturb & Agitate · 扰乱与心绪不宁 (Unsettle, Perturb, Fluster)
groups.tip: 打破心绪平衡、给人添堵的打扰动作

items.def_zh: 使心神不宁，使不安；扰乱
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel anxious, nervous, or uncertain. 2. To disturb the stability or established order of something.
to disturb the composure or self-possession of someone
(+ sb) shock or upset someone emotionally and disrupt their composure
(+ sth) provoke strong, unsettled, or troubled emotions

items.def_zh: 使极度激动，使心烦意乱
items.def_en: (+ sb) agitate someone or make them highly nervous and upset
1. To cause someone worry, distress, or physical pain; bother someone to do something.

items.def_zh: 使心烦意乱，使苦恼；扰乱，打乱；打翻
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel unhappy, worried, or angry. 2. To disturb the normal order, balance, or progress of something. 3. To knock something over accidentally.
1. To disturb the normal order, function, or peaceful state of something; throw into confusion.
to make someone nervous, confused, or agitated by putting them in a rushed or awkward state
to cause someone to feel anxious, agitated, or deeply unsettled
to worry or excite someone emotionally so that they cannot rest easily

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe external events, news, or behaviors disrupting a person's inner equilibrium, emotional composure, or mental order. While 'trouble' denotes mild persistent concern, 'unsettle' and 'perturb' shake one's confidence or peace of mind, and 'discompose' implies a loss of visible poise.
groups.summary_zh: 指外界事物打破人的内心平静、从容神态或安稳状态，使其心神不定。

groups.name: Drive & Steer · 驾驶与操控 (Operating Vehicles)
groups.tip: 操纵载具行进

items.def_zh: 驾驶，开（车）；驱使，促使；推动
items.def_en: 1. To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle. 2. To force or compel someone or something into a particular state or action.

items.def_zh: （驾车）闲逛，兜风；用工具加工（或装备）
items.def_en: 1. (informal) (often followed by 'around' or 'along') To drive or travel in a vehicle, especially casually or leisurely. 2. To shape, ornament, or equip something with a tool.

items.def_zh: 驾驶（飞机或船只）；领航，引导；试行，试验
items.def_en: 1. To act as a pilot of an aircraft or ship; to navigate or guide. 2. To test a new scheme, project, or product before introducing it more widely.

items.def_zh: 单独飞行；单飞，独自表演
items.def_en: To fly an aircraft alone without an instructor or co-pilot; to perform a piece of music or an act alone.
steer a vehicle into the flow of traffic or move into another lane
steer a vehicle to the side of the road and stop
maneuver a vehicle in reverse out of an enclosed space
to control the direction in which a vehicle or boat moves using a wheel or rudder
to direct and plan the course of a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle
to steer or move a vehicle carefully and with skill in a tight space
to drive someone around as a passenger in a motor car

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario cover the physical operation, navigation, and maneuvering of wheeled conveyances, aircraft, or marine vessels, ranging from everyday driving to technical piloting.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及机动车、飞机或船只的操控、驾驶与领航等场景动作。

groups.name: Dry & Dehydrate · 干燥与脱水 (Desiccate, Scorch, Wither)
groups.tip: 蒸发或吸除水分至干燥状态

items.def_en: To become dry, or to make something dry by removing moisture or liquid.
become completely dry or cause something to lose all moisture
[I/T] (+ away/up) to become dry and limp from lack of water (especially of plants)
To lose a large amount of water from the body, or to remove all water from food or other substances.
[I/T] (+ up) to shrink, wrinkle, and become dry through intense heat, cold, or age
To remove moisture or humidity from indoor air; dehumidify.
lose all water or moisture completely, especially through evaporation
become dry, wrinkled, and smaller from acute loss of moisture
to dry out or burn the surface of something with intense, sudden heat

items.def_zh: 使干透，使极度干渴；烤干
items.def_en: To make something extremely dry, hot, or thirsty, especially through heat or exposure to the sun.
[I/T] to remove the moisture completely from something, typically for preservation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the removal or loss of moisture from an entity, varying in mechanism from natural evaporation and ambient heating to extreme botanical or biological desiccation.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱除物体或机体水分的过程，涉及日晒风干、抽湿及极度枯竭。

groups.name: Dwell & Reside · 居住与定居 (Reside, Inhabit, Lodge)
groups.tip: 安家落户或长期居住生活

items.def_en: (+ in/down) to establish a permanent residence in a new community or area
reside at the place where one works or studies
(+ with sb) live together as sexual partners without being married
stay or hide in a safe, secluded dwelling for a period
(+ in/at) to live permanently or habitually in a specific place (formal)

items.def_zh: 居住，栖息；老是想着，唠叨（与 on/upon 连用）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in/at) (formal or literary) To live or reside in a particular place. 2. ('dwell on/upon') To think, speak, or write at length about something, especially something unpleasant.
(+ in/at) to stay or dwell in a place (archaic or literary)
to live in or occupy a specific territory, environment, or house

items.def_zh: 开拓定居，建立家园（在政府分配的土地上）
items.def_en: (historical) To settle on and cultivate public land granted by the government.

items.def_zh: 寄居，暂住；（常与up连用）同居
items.def_en: (informal, usually 'shack up') To live or stay in a place; to live together as romantic partners without being married.

items.def_zh: 居住，栖身（dwell的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of dwell; lived or resided in a specified place.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the state or ongoing act of living continuously in a particular home, territory, or condition, ranging from informal living setups to legal and formal residency.
groups.summary_zh: 指在某处持续生活、落户或安居的状态，涵盖非正式寄宿到法定定居。

groups.name: Eat & Partake · 进食与进餐 (Eat, Dine, Feast)
groups.tip: 日常餐饮与聚餐场景

items.def_en: To eat an early morning meal.

items.def_zh: 在餐馆就餐，在外面吃饭
items.def_en: have a meal in a restaurant rather than at home
eat an evening meal away from home, especially at a restaurant

items.def_zh: 津津有味地大吃，开怀畅饮
items.def_en: (+ sth) start eating food enthusiastically and in large quantities

items.def_zh: 尽情享用（美食），大吃大喝；参加宴会；款待
items.def_en: To eat a large amount of food with great pleasure; (feast on) to consume or view something with deep enjoyment.

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃；贪婪地捕食；掠夺
items.def_en: To eat voraciously or hungrily; to hunt greedily for prey or plunder.
To have or take part in a picnic.
to attend or partake in an elaborate, formal celebratory meal with many guests
to eat an evening meal, typically in a relaxed or traditional context
[I/T] to eat large quantities of food greedily and to excess, stuffing oneself
To eat dinner or have a formal meal.

groups.summary_en: People consume food under distinct social, temporal, or behavioral circumstances, ranging from everyday domestic meals (breakfast, picnic) to formal evening repasts, communal banqueting, or voracious animal feeding.
groups.summary_zh: 在不同社交场景、时间或食欲驱动下进餐消费食物。

groups.name: Emphasize & Highlight · 强调与突出 (Underscore, Foreground, Stress)
groups.tip: 用斜体、聚光灯等手法加重语气

items.def_en: (+ sth) draw attention to a fact or detail so it is noticed

items.def_zh: 凸显，衬托出（特征或品质）
items.def_en: (+ sth) make a particular quality or feature clearly noticeable
(+ sth) enhance or emphasize the appearance of something by contrast
to give special importance or verbal emphasis to a point or syllable

items.def_zh: 突出，强调；用醒目颜色标出
items.def_en: 1. To emphasize something or draw special attention to it. 2. To mark text with a bright colour to make it prominent.
to draw a line under text, or symbolically emphasize a key factor
to emphasize the importance or truth of something, as if drawing a line beneath it

items.def_zh: 用斜体书写（或印刷）（以示强调等）
items.def_en: To print or format words in italic type, typically to emphasize them or indicate a title.

items.def_zh: 突出，使受到瞩目；用聚光灯照亮
items.def_en: 1. To direct widespread public attention to a particular person, issue, or event. 2. To illuminate someone or something with a spotlight.
to make something the most prominent or important feature in an analysis or depiction
To emphasize something or make a feature, detail, or contrast much more noticeable.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe communicative or visual techniques used to draw special attention to an element, contrasting rhetorical stress with typographic or compositional foregrounding.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过修辞强调、版式字体或视觉构图来格外突出某项要点。

groups.name: Emphasize & Underscore · 强调与着重 (Emphasize, Stress, Underscore)
groups.tip: 着重凸显核心要点

items.def_en: (+ that) to give special importance or verbal emphasis to a point or fact
to draw special attention to an essential fact, detail, or situation
1. To emphasize or make something more noticeable. 2. To pronounce a syllable, word, or note with special stress.
(+ sth) to highlight or accentuate an important fact or condition to make it clearly noticeable
(+ sth) to make a particular quality, feature, or detail more prominent and easily noticed
(+ sth) to emphasize or exaggerate the importance or value of something deliberately
To give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing.
to underline or clearly emphasize the importance of something

items.def_zh: 强调，突出，使置于突出地位
items.def_en: To give prominence or special emphasis to a particular feature or issue.

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休地阐述，过分强调；痛打，抨击
items.def_en: 1. To explain or insist on something to an excessive and tedious degree. 2. To attack physically or verbally.
To give too much importance or attention to something.

groups.summary_en: A communicator highlights a key fact, idea, or detail to draw distinct focus, attach greater importance, or make something unmistakable. Verbs range from typographical and phonetic accents to vehement reiteration or excessive laboring.
groups.summary_zh: 通过言辞、重音或论证突出某一要点，以引起高度注意或明确其权重。

groups.name: Enchant & Cast a Spell · 蛊惑与迷醉 (Beguile, Bewitch, Enthrall)
groups.tip: 散发魅力令人神魂颠倒

items.def_zh: 令（某人）神魂颠倒；使完全陶醉
items.def_en: (+ sb) to overwhelm someone with intense emotion, wonder, or fascination
(+ sb) to overwhelm or captivate someone completely with beauty, charm, or astonishment

items.def_zh: 使冲昏头脑；使沉醉入迷
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to lose self-control through overwhelming excitement or fascination
fill someone with great delight or hold them as if under a spell
attract and hold the interest and affection of someone completely
hold the complete attention of someone almost to the point of hypnosis
capture the fascinated attention of someone, rendering them transfixed
1. (chiefly British English spelling of enthrall) To capture the fascinated attention and imagination of someone completely. 2. (archaic) To enslave.
1. To attract, delight, and captivate someone so intensely that they lose judgment. 2. To put a magic spell on someone.

items.def_zh: 使迷恋，使神魂颠倒；使糊涂
items.def_en: (usually passive) To inspire someone with an extravagant, foolish, or short-lived passion or admiration.
1. To charm, enchant, or fascinate someone, sometimes in an enticing way. 2. (+ into) To trick or deceive someone into doing something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve exerting an almost magical, deceptive, or intoxicating power of attraction over someone, completely captivating their senses, lowering their defenses, or clouding their judgment through charm or allure.
groups.summary_zh: 借助迷人魅力、魔力或欺骗性手段使人神魂颠倒、丧失防备。

groups.name: Enclose & Shield · 围蔽与掩蔽 (Curtain, Rim, Capsule)
groups.tip: 拉帘遮掩以阻隔视线

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to surround an area or object with a fence or barrier to confine or enclose it

items.def_zh: 用屏风或帷幕隔开/遮蔽
items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide or hide an area or object using a screen, partition, or curtain

items.def_zh: 用帘子遮蔽，给……装帘子（常与off连用隔开）
items.def_en: 1. (+ off) To cover a window or divide an area using a curtain or hanging cloth.
1. To form or serve as an outer edge or border around something.

items.def_zh: 装入胶囊，封装；简要概括
items.def_en: 1. To enclose something in a capsule; to summarize or condense.
to surround something in a circle
(+ sth) to close off an area by placing a barrier of ropes, tapes, or police lines around it
to surround someone or something closely so that movement is restricted
(+ sth) to enclose, separate, or isolate an area by building a wall around or across it

items.def_zh: 用屏风或障壁遮挡避光或遮丑
items.def_en: (+ from/off) to shelter, protect, or conceal someone or something with a partition or barrier

items.def_zh: 用覆盖物完全遮掩或笼罩
items.def_en: to cover or hide something completely, preventing it from being seen

groups.summary_en: An agent or barrier places a border, wall, or hanging covering around an object to seal, hide, or frame it. Verbs in this frame evoke specific structural shapes such as hanging folds, raised perimeters, or protective hulls.
groups.summary_zh: 以帷幔、边框或密闭外壳将目标环绕遮蔽或框定。

groups.name: End & Terminate · 结束与终止 (Cease, Terminate, Abort)
groups.tip: 由自然结束到主动终止

items.def_en: [I/T] To halt an action, motion, or operation either temporarily or permanently
(+ sth) to bring an activity, business, or speech to a planned or final close
(+ sth) to complete or conclude an event, meeting, or process successfully
To finish or stop, or to bring something to a finish or stop.
[I/T] To bring an event, transaction, or speech to a formal or structured close
To stop happening or existing, or to stop doing something.
[I/T] To bring or come to an abrupt or decisive standstill
To cancel an event or operation before or while it is underway
(+ sth) to bring an abrupt or premature halt to a supply, process, or continuity
1. To come to an end, or to bring something to an end. 2. (formal) To end someone's employment.

items.def_zh: 中途终止，夭折；使流产，堕胎
items.def_en: 1. To stop a process, plan, or mission before it is completed. 2. To end a pregnancy before the fetus can survive.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe bringing an activity, state, or process to a halt, ranging from standard natural stops to deliberate legal expirations or abrupt, premature cuts.
groups.summary_zh: 指使活动或进程停止，由自然结束递进至法定终止与强制腰斩。

groups.name: Eradicate & Wipe Out Entirely · 消除与根除 (Dispel, Eradicate, Obliterate)
groups.tip: 连根拔除，使其彻底不存

items.def_zh: 驱散，消除（疑虑、恐惧、谣言等）
items.def_en: To make a doubt, feeling, or belief disappear.

items.def_zh: 彻底抹去；抹杀（记忆、痕迹）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to obscure completely or wipe away all traces of a memory, sight, or existence
(+ sb/sth) to find and completely eliminate a source of trouble, evil, or corruption
(+ sth) to suppress or eradicate something bad or dangerous by forceful measures
to destroy, remove, or kill everyone or everything in a target group completely
to destroy or get rid of something bad completely so that it cannot return

items.def_zh: 连根拔起，根除；使背井离乡
items.def_en: 1. To pull a plant entirely out of the ground, including its roots; eradicate completely. 2. To force someone to leave their home or familiar environment.
to pull up by the roots or completely destroy something noxious or unwanted

items.def_zh: 彻底消灭，毁灭；抹去，擦去（痕迹、记忆等）
items.def_en: To destroy something completely so that nothing remains; wipe out or erase.
to reduce an enemy, structure, or object to complete nonexistence or ruin

items.def_zh: 根除，消灭，灭绝（害虫、群体等）
items.def_en: To kill or destroy all individuals of a group of animals, pests, or people completely.
