groups.summary_en: Causing an entity, population, abstract condition, or trace to cease to exist, ranging from dispelling insubstantial doubts to tearing up deep roots and violently wiping out all visible remnants.
groups.summary_zh: 从驱散虚妄疑虑到连根拔起、彻底抹除灭绝

groups.name: Excrete & Void · 生理排泄与腺体分泌 (Discharge of Bodily Waste/Fluids)
groups.tip: 生理代谢废物的排泄

items.def_en: (+ sth) to eject food or bile from the stomach through the mouth

items.def_zh: 通过出汗排出（毒素、水分等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to eliminate toxins or fluid from the body through heavy perspiration
(+ sth) to expel phlegm or fluid from the respiratory tract by coughing
[I/T] (formal/medical) to discharge waste material such as urine or feces from the body
(informal, impolite) to release intestinal gas through the anus.
1. to let saliva trickle or drip out of the mouth. 2. (informal) to express excessive delight, enthusiasm, or craving for something.
1. (of a cell, gland, or plant) To produce and discharge a substance. 2. To hide or conceal something secretly.
To discharge urine from the body.
to produce and discharge saliva in the mouth
To discharge solid waste from the bowels through the anus.
to excrete sweat through the pores of the skin (formal)

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers the physiological expulsion of metabolic waste products, gland emissions, and natural secretions from human or animal bodies, varying by anatomical pathway and formality.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖人体或生物体经由特定生理器官将代谢废弃物或体液排出体外的过程。

groups.name: Fasten by Mechanical Means · 机械扣合与销夹固定 (Clamp, Latch, Buckle, Peg)
groups.tip: 用夹具栓销牢牢固定

items.def_zh: 系紧安全带；用搭扣扣牢
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten securely with a buckle, especially a vehicle seatbelt

items.def_zh: 用门闩闩牢，上闩；抓住，理解（latch onto）
items.def_en: 1. To fasten a door, gate, or window with a latch, or to be fastened in this way. 2. ('latch onto') To attach oneself to someone, or to grasp an idea eagerly.
(+ sth) to bind, tighten, or secure firmly using a strap, belt, or mechanical tie
(+ sth) to fasten or press an object securely in place using a mechanical clamp

items.def_zh: 用木栓（或钉子、衣夹）固定；使（工资、物价等）与……挂钩，限定
items.def_en: 1. To fasten or secure something with pegs. 2. To fix a price, currency, or rate at a particular level.

items.def_zh: 夹紧，固定；强行固定；严厉打击，取缔（clamp down）
items.def_en: 1. To hold or fasten something tightly in place using a clamp. 2. ('clamp down on') To take strict official action to stop or prevent something.

items.def_zh: 用搭扣扣紧，系紧；（使）弯曲，压垮；屈服
items.def_en: 1. To fasten something with a buckle, or to be fastened with a buckle. 2. To bend or collapse under pressure or heat; to give in.

items.def_zh: 系紧于系缆栓上；用夹板固定
items.def_en: to secure or fasten a rope or object around a cleat
to secure a belt, strap, or girth firmly around something
to fasten or bind tightly using metal loops or shackles
to bind or fasten the arms, legs, or mechanical parts firmly to immobilize them

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe securing an object in place by employing a dedicated mechanical catch, strap, pin, or gripping device. They differentiate through the mechanical mechanism involved: spring/screw compression ('clamp'), pivoting bars ('latch'), interlocking prongs ('buckle'), or dowel pins ('peg').
groups.summary_zh: 运用门闩、卡扣、夹具或插销等机械结构紧固或扣牢物体。

groups.name: Fear & Terrify · 恐惧与惊骇 (Intimidate, Frighten, Petrify)
groups.tip: 从普通害怕递进至极度惊骇

items.def_en: (+ sb) to induce an unsettling feeling of fear, revulsion, or unease in someone
to make someone feel sudden fear or anxiety
[I/T] (+ away/off) to cause sudden fright or nervousness in someone
(+ sb/sth) to drive an intruder, animal, or person away by frightening them
To make someone feel frightened, anxious, or worried that something dangerous might happen.
(+ sb) to experience or cause an episode of sudden, intense fear or panic

items.def_zh: 非常害怕，畏惧，极度担心
items.def_en: To feel great fear, anxiety, or apprehension about something that is going to or might happen.

items.def_zh: 使极度惊恐，使震惊，使厌恶
items.def_en: To shock and frighten someone deeply with something terrible, appalling, or sickening.
To suddenly feel so frightened or anxious that you cannot think or act sensibly, or to cause someone to do so.
to fill someone with acute, overwhelming terror
to paralyze someone with fear so that they cannot move or think

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate states of emotional distress caused by perceived threat or impending danger, scaling from sudden unease and anticipatory dread to paralyzing terror.
groups.summary_zh: 指因感知危险或威胁引发的惧怕情绪，从警觉不安递进至极度惊骇僵死。

groups.name: Fill & Overflow · 充溢与过载 (Inundate, Satiate, Swamp)
groups.tip: 从充盈满溢发展至过载泛滥

items.def_en: to enter or crowd into an enclosed space or vehicle rapidly in large, overwhelming numbers
to flow over the edge of a container, or spread uncontrollably beyond normal boundaries due to excess
(+ sth) to clog or completely fill a passage or space so movement is obstructed
to overwhelm someone or something with an excess of things to deal with
to spread over or occupy a place in large, excessive numbers

items.def_zh: 使过度拥挤，容纳过多的人
items.def_en: (often passive) To fill a place or vehicle with too many people or things.

items.def_zh: 使充斥，使过量供应；使吃得过饱
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To supply a market with far more goods than can be bought or sold. 2. To satisfy an appetite or desire to the point of excess.
(+ with) To give someone or something too much work, worry, or physical load to handle.
To fill a container or space with too much of something so that it overflows.

items.def_zh: 淹没；使应接不暇，使充满
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive, + with) To overwhelm someone with a huge number of things, requests, or questions. 2. To flood an area with water.
to overwhelm with a huge flood of things, requests, or information

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying, filling, or burdening a container, system, or entity with people, goods, or input beyond its capacity, escalating from overfilling to overwhelming inundation.
groups.summary_zh: 指填充、供给或施加负担超出受体的承载极限，由单纯装得过满升级为泛滥压垮。

groups.name: Foretell & Portend · 预言与预示 (Prophesy, Augur, Presage)
groups.tip: 预先预告并昭示将来吉凶

items.def_zh: 预示；表明…很有可能发生
items.def_en: (+ sth) to indicate that a particular future event or situation is likely to happen
(+ sth) to be a sign that a major change or new period is beginning
to act as an advance indication or suggestion of what is to come
(+ well/ill) to be a sign of a particular good or bad outcome in the future

items.def_zh: 预言，预告；（受神启）说预言
items.def_en: To predict or say what will happen in the future, especially through religious or mystical inspiration.
To announce, signal, or foreshadow the approach or arrival of something.

items.def_zh: 预言，预告，预示（foretell的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of foretell; to predict or announce beforehand.

items.def_zh: 预示，是……的征兆；占卜，预言
items.def_en: 1. To be a sign of a good or bad outcome in the future (especially in 'augur well/ill'). 2. To foretell or predict the future from signs or omens.
To predict or say what will happen in the future, especially by using magic or intuition.
to act as an omen or warning of something, typically bad, that is about to happen
To be a sign or warning that something momentous, usually unpleasant, is going to happen.

groups.summary_en: A sign, omen, or human seer indicates future events before they happen. Verbs span divine/supernatural utterances, interpretive omen readings, literary foreshadowing, and symbolic precursor roles.
groups.summary_zh: 通过神谕宣称、卜测征兆或天然迹象在事前预言并预示吉凶。

groups.name: Fortify & Arm · 设防与武装 (Fortify, Arm, Entrench)
groups.tip: 修筑工事与装备武器

items.def_zh: 武装，配备武器；装备，提供防御；备战
items.def_en: 1. To provide weapons or defensive equipment to someone, or to supply oneself with weapons. 2. To provide someone with useful skills, information, or equipment. 3. To make a bomb, weapon, or security device ready to explode or operate.

items.def_zh: 设要塞防守；筑堡设防；（fort up）退入城堡固守
items.def_en: 1. To protect or fortify with a fort; ('fort up') to take refuge in or as if in a fort for protection.
(+ sth) to support, strengthen, or reinforce a weak structure or defensive position
to dig protective trenches or entrench defensive positions in preparation for enemy attack
(+ sb) to block an entrance or confine someone securely behind erected fortifications

items.def_zh: 派兵驻守；防守（城镇、要塞）
items.def_en: to station troops in a town or fortress to defend it

items.def_zh: 筑防御工事保卫，加强防卫；增强，强化；（给食品）添加营养素
items.def_en: 1. To strengthen a place with defenses or fortifications against attack. 2. To make someone feel physically or mentally stronger. 3. (+ with) To enrich food or drink by adding vitamins or minerals.
to block or defend an entrance, street, or building with an improvised barrier

items.def_zh: 供给军需品；为……装备武器弹药
items.def_en: To supply an army, fort, or ship with weapons and ammunition.

items.def_zh: 掘壕固守；牢固确立防线
items.def_en: to dig trenches or defensive earthworks to secure a position against attack

items.def_zh: 使武器化；改造为攻防武器
items.def_en: to adapt or equip something for use as a weapon in combat or conflict

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe preparing a location, military unit, or person for defensive or offensive conflict by installing fortifications, weapons, or protective obstacles. They range from physical reinforcement of a site to supplying weaponry or digging in defensive positions.
groups.summary_zh: 通过构筑防御工事、提供武器弹药或挖壕固守以增强战斗防御准备。

groups.name: Groom, Style & Adorn Hair/Appearance · 理容、修饰与梳理装扮 (Groom & Preen)
groups.tip: 梳理毛发修剪整饰外表

items.def_en: (+ sth) to style or arrange hair neatly, or dress someone attractively

items.def_zh: 抹平；把（头发）梳得油光水滑
items.def_en: (+ sth) to flatten and smooth hair down using water, pomade, or oil
(+ sb/sth) to tidy and groom personal appearance to look neat and stylish

items.def_zh: （给动物）梳刷毛皮；修整（外表），打扮；培养，培训
items.def_en: 1. To clean and brush the coat of an animal, especially a horse or dog. 2. To make your appearance neat and tidy. 3. To prepare or train someone for a special purpose or career.

items.def_zh: 为……理发（或修面）；当理发师
items.def_en: 1. To cut the hair of or shave someone; to work as a barber.

items.def_zh: 梳理（头发或毛发）；彻底搜查，全面搜寻
items.def_en: 1. To untangle, tidy, or arrange hair or fur with a comb. 2. To search a place or an area thoroughly.
1. To apply lipstick to the lips.
to apply pomade or scented ointment to hair to give it a sleek, styled look
1. To make hair curly or wavy by treating it with chemicals.
to spend time making oneself look neat, attractive, and well-groomed
to style or arrange someone's hair in an elaborate or neat fashion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote tending to, styling, cosmeticizing, or maintaining one's personal hygiene, hair, or physical appearance. They vary from basic hair combing and professional barbering to cosmetic application and chemical hair styling.
groups.summary_zh: 梳理毛发、理发修面、化妆修饰或化学美发等外形打理行为。

groups.name: Hew & Sever · 削砍与截切 (Hew, Lop, Bevel)
groups.tip: 斧锯刃具劈砍成形

items.def_en: to shape pieces of wood by carving off thin slices with a knife

items.def_zh: 把……切成斜角（或斜边），斜削
items.def_en: To cut, grind, or shape an edge or surface at a sloping angle rather than a right angle.

items.def_zh: 使成锯齿状；在……边缘切出齿纹
items.def_en: To cut, notch, or form sharp, saw-like teeth along the edge of something.
to cut away a right-angled edge on a block of wood or stone to make a symmetrical sloping edge

items.def_zh: 砍掉，修剪（树枝等）；大幅削减
items.def_en: 1. To cut or chop off parts of something, especially branches of a tree, with a heavy stroke. 2. (informal) To reduce or eliminate a large amount from something.

items.def_zh: （用斧等）砍，劈，砍伐；凿出，劈出；坚守，遵循 (hew to)
items.def_en: 1. To chop or cut something heavily using an axe, sword, or other tool. 2. To shape or carve something out of wood or stone. 3. (hew to) To adhere or conform strictly to something.
(+ sth) to sever an object or protruding part completely using heavy blows of an ax or blade
(+ sth) to sever or cut something off roughly and unevenly using repeated blade strikes
(+ sth) to cut off or sever an unwanted branch or limb with a single sharp stroke
to cut something roughly or violently with heavy, repeated blows of an ax or knife
to cut through something completely, separating one part from another with a sharp instrument

groups.summary_en: An agent shapes, severs, or bevels a piece of wood, stone, or plant using a sharp cutting blade, ax, or tool, either creating specific angled profiles or severing protruding parts.
groups.summary_zh: 使用利刃、斧具对木料、石材或枝干进行成型削边或斩断截落。

groups.name: Illuminate & Bathe in Light · 照亮、照射与投光 (Illuminate & Irradiate)
groups.tip: 强光或辐射光芒投射照亮

items.def_en: to provide light to an area or make an object bright enough to see
(+ sth) to brighten a space completely or bathe an object in sudden light
(+ sb/sth) to direct rays of luminous light onto a person or surface
to cast intense or focused rays of light downward onto an area
to supply a place or object with light, making it clearly visible
to make an area or object lighter, more luminous, or brighter

items.def_zh: 照射，照亮；（使）生辉；放射，以射线照射
items.def_en: 1. To illuminate something brightly; make radiant. 2. (physics, medical) To expose something to radiation.
1. To illuminate a building, sports field, or open area with powerful floodlights.

items.def_zh: 用泛光灯照亮（floodlight 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. (past tense and past participle of floodlight) To illuminate an outdoor area or building with floodlights.
1. (literary) To light up or brighten something. 2. To enlighten spiritually or intellectually.
1. (poetic) To light up, brighten, or illuminate.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe casting light upon or penetrating an object or area with luminous rays. Nuances span from practical physical illumination (spotlights, floodlights) and scientific ray exposure to literary and poetic lighting of scenes.
groups.summary_zh: 向物体或区域投射光线、人工大面积打光或用射线照亮/照射。

groups.name: Integrate & Merge · 混合共溶与化合一体 (Mix, Combine, Merge, Unify)
groups.tip: 将不同要素融为一体

items.def_en: to combine smoothly with the surroundings or other elements so as not to be noticed
(+ sth) to add an ingredient or element into a substance and combine thoroughly
(+ with sth) to fit together or unite closely with something else
to mix substances or qualities smoothly so they form an inseparable, harmonious mixture
1. To combine two or more substances so they become a single substance, or to become combined. 2. To meet and talk to people, especially socially.
To join or bring together two or more things to form a single unit, or to possess two or more qualities together.

items.def_zh: （使）合并，（使）融合；渐渐消失在……中
items.def_en: To combine or cause two or more things to combine into a single entity, or to blend gradually into something else.
to combine two or more organizations, ideas, or materials into one harmonious entity
(of separate parts) to come together to form one larger system or group
To bring different parts, groups, or regions together to form a single, united whole.
to join together securely by or as if by melting, making the constituent parts indivisible

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing discrete entities, ingredients, or organizations together into a single whole. Nuances differentiate simple physical blending where elements may remain distinct ('mix'), systematic integration ('combine'), seamless absorption into a common stream ('merge'), and political or structural consolidation into a singular identity ('unify').
groups.summary_zh: 将独立个体、原料或组织融入为一个整体，从机械混合到有机化为一体。

groups.name: Intellectual Impasse & Disorientation · 困惑与束手无策 (Baffle, Confound, Stump)
groups.tip: 从难解其意到彻底难住

items.def_en: cause someone to feel confused because they cannot understand something

items.def_zh: 使心烦意乱；使思维混乱
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to become severely confused, disoriented, or emotionally troubled
(+ sb) to confuse or distract someone so that they lose their bearings or make an error

items.def_zh: 使陷入困境；使犯错难住
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to stumble intellectually, make a mistake, or become stymied

items.def_zh: 难住，使困惑，使束手无策；迈着沉重的步子走；在……巡回作政治演说
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To be too difficult for someone to answer, solve, or explain; baffle. 2. To walk heavily and stiffly. 3. To travel around an area making political campaign speeches.
complicate matters mentally and cause someone to feel anxious uncertainty

items.def_zh: 使迷失方向；使迷茫，使困惑
items.def_en: To make someone lose their sense of direction, position, or mental clarity; confuse.
1. To confuse or puzzle someone completely; mystify. 2. To control, impede, or absorb the flow of sound, fluid, or gas.

items.def_zh: 使困惑，使惊疑；击败，挫败；弄混，混淆
items.def_en: 1. To confuse and surprise someone, especially by not fitting expectations. 2. To prove someone or something wrong; defeat. 3. To mix up or confuse one thing with another.

items.def_zh: 使迷惑不解；使大惑不解
items.def_en: utterly bewilder someone by presenting things that defy logical explanation
completely baffle and bewilder someone to the point of speechless confusion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark degrees of cognitive paralysis where understanding breaks down, from temporarily halting someone with a difficult problem (stump), through perceptual or mental loss of bearings (disorient), to total explanatory failure (baffle) and bewildering astonishment (confound).
groups.summary_zh: 认知障碍由浅入深，从被难题难住，到方向迷失，再到彻底无法理解与震惊。

groups.name: Lead & Escort Physically · 带领与引导演进 (Guide, Lead, Usher)
groups.tip: 在前引路或导向

items.def_zh: 带领，引路；引领，引导；导致
items.def_en: 1. to show the way by going in front; to take or guide someone somewhere. 2. to direct or control an activity or group. 3. (lead to) to cause or result in something

items.def_zh: 导引，引领（正式陪同步行）
items.def_en: to lead, guide, or accompany people along a route in a formal or ceremonial capacity
1. to show someone which way to go by going with them. 2. to direct or influence the behavior, decision, or development of someone or something
to direct or steer someone safely through a complex physical area

items.def_zh: 领入，领进（房间或建筑物）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to lead or escort someone into a room or building
(+ sb) to escort or conduct someone politely into a room or venue
(+ sb) to guide someone through a place so they can see and explore it
(+ sb) to guide or accompany someone on foot through an area or path
to accompany someone to protect, honor, or show them where to go
to guide or direct a group of people carefully along a desired path

items.def_zh: 引，领，陪同；开辟，宣告……的到来
items.def_en: 1. to guide or escort someone politely where they should go. 2. (usher in) to signal or mark the beginning of something new

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting moving along with someone to show them the path, direct their forward movement, or courteously escort them into a place.
groups.summary_zh: 引路同行，带领某人前往目的地或礼貌引其入座/入内。

groups.name: Leap & Bounce · 弹跳与跃进 (Bound, Spring, Ricochet)
groups.tip: 受力反弹或发力跳

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/over) to move by small short jumps on one foot or both feet
to spring or rebound back after hitting a surface
to jump or bound suddenly forward from a place
to leap or rise very quickly and suddenly from a resting position
(+ up/forward) to move rapidly and suddenly by a spring-like muscular exertion
(+ over/along) to walk or run with long, energetic leaping strides
To move quickly away from a surface after hitting it, or to cause something to do this; to jump up and down repeatedly.
1. To bounce back after hitting a hard surface. 2. To recover in value, strength, or condition after a decline.

items.def_zh: 跳跃，跃过（leap的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of leap; jumped high or far, or moved suddenly.

items.def_zh: （用手支撑或撑竿）跳跃，腾跃；给……建穹顶
items.def_en: 1. To jump over an obstacle in a single leap, especially using your hands or a pole for support. 2. To construct or cover something with an arched roof or ceiling.
(+ off) to rebound sharply and unpredictably off a hard surface after striking it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe explosive ballistic motions or sudden rebounds off a surface, distinguishing between elastic recoil, cleared obstacles, and athletic bodily jumps.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用弹力反弹或发力腾跃的运动方式，包括跨障跃过与撞击反弹。

groups.name: Manufacture & Produce · 制作与生产 (Craft, Manufacture, Fabricate)
groups.tip: 动手加工或工业产出物品

items.def_en: to produce goods in large quantities using machinery
To make or produce something skillfully and with great care, especially by hand.

items.def_zh: 生产，制造，产出；输出（数据或信号）
items.def_en: To produce, manufacture, or generate an amount of goods, power, or data.

items.def_zh: 出产，产生，提供；屈服，让步
items.def_en: 1. To produce or provide a crop, result, or profit. 2. (+ to) To surrender, submit, or give way to pressure.
To make or repair wooden barrels and casks.
to produce something in significant numbers, especially in a factory

items.def_zh: 大量炮制；粗制滥造地生产
items.def_en: (+ sth) to produce large quantities of sth quickly and mechanically, often with low quality
(+ sth) to produce or fabricate sth rapidly or roughly
(+ sth) to manufacture and launch a new mass-produced article onto the market
to construct or manufacture an industrial product or structure from standardized parts

items.def_zh: 使机动化，使摩托化；给……装上马达
items.def_en: To equip a vehicle, machine, or military unit with an engine, motor, or motor vehicles.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe generating, making, or turning out physical goods or industrial outputs through specialized labor, industrial processing, or technical design.
groups.summary_zh: 通过精湛技艺、专业加工或工业流程制造与产出物品。

groups.name: Measure & Quantify Precisely · 测算与量化评估 (Gauge, Clock, Calibrate)
groups.tip: 测定尺寸分量与量化指标

items.def_en: to measure the duration or speed of an event using a stopwatch or clock

items.def_zh: 记录下（速度、时间或距离）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to register or reach a precise measured speed, distance, or time on an instrument
(+ sth) to calibrate or take an exact measured quantity of sth using an instrument

items.def_zh: 测出……的时间（或速度），记录；达到（某速度或时间）；打卡；击打
items.def_en: 1. To measure or record the speed, time, or distance of something. 2. (informal) To reach or achieve a particular time or speed. 3. (slang) To hit someone.

items.def_zh: 用仪表计量（流速、用量等）
items.def_en: to measure the rate or total amount of a substance passing through a meter

items.def_zh: 标出……的尺寸；按规定尺寸制作
items.def_en: To measure or mark the dimensions of an object or design.

items.def_zh: 判定，评估，判断；精确测量
items.def_en: 1. To judge, estimate, or assess a situation, feeling, or measurement. 2. To measure the exact size, capacity, or amount of something.
to express or measure the exact quantity, amount, or proportion of something

items.def_zh: 定量测算分配；精确计量分发
items.def_en: (+ sth) to measure and dispense exact precise amounts of sth according to a meter or standard
to mark units of measurement on an instrument or adjust it to standard precision
(chemistry) To determine the concentration of a substance in solution by adding a measured amount of a reagent.

groups.summary_en: Determining an exact physical magnitude, speed, chemical concentration, or spatial boundary using an instrument, standard scale, or timed procedure. Registers range from workshop quantification to precise lab analysis.
groups.summary_zh: 借助仪器或标准规范对物理量、速率或指标测算

groups.name: Melt & Dissolve · 融化与溶解 (Melt, Dissolve, Flux)
groups.tip: 受热熔化或在溶剂中消融分散

items.def_en: (+ sth) to become warm enough to melt ice or return from a frozen state to liquid/soft state
[I/T] To pass from a frozen to a liquid or unfrozen state by warming
to dissolve or liquefy gradually until entirely gone
1. To change or cause to change from a solid to a liquid state by heating. 2. To become softer or more gentle; soften.
1. To cause a solid to be incorporated into a liquid so as to form a solution, or to become incorporated in this way. 2. To officially end an organization, assembly, or legal arrangement.
(technical) To melt or become fluid, or to treat metal with a flux to promote melting.
To absorb moisture from the air and dissolve completely into liquid
(archaic) Past participle of melt; to have liquefied or melted by intense heat.

items.def_zh: 融化；将（金属或固体）熔毁
items.def_en: (+ sth) to melt an object made of metal or solid substance completely into liquid form
[I/T] To melt together with intense heat so as to join into a single body
[I/T] To convert into liquid form, especially solids or gases under heat/pressure

groups.summary_en: Solids break down their structure through thermal heat, chemical solvent action, or fusing agents, passing into a liquid state or homogeneous solution.
groups.summary_zh: 固体受热液化或在溶剂/助熔剂作用下解构分解成液体。

groups.name: Moisten & Soak · 浸润与浸泡 (Moisten, Soak, Saturate)
groups.tip: 液体彻底浸透渗透

items.def_en: to make something slightly wet or moist
1. To apply a cream or liquid to skin or hair to make it soft and prevent dryness.
(+ sth) to take in and absorb liquid greedily or completely
(+ sth) to absorb a liquid thoroughly into a material or porous surface

items.def_zh: 吸干；用海绵等吸取（液体）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to take up or absorb liquid completely with an absorbent substance

items.def_zh: 浸泡，沏（茶）；使沉浸于，使深谙（be steeped in）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To soak food, tea, or herbs in liquid to soften them or extract flavor. 2. ('be steeped in') To fill someone or something completely with a quality or tradition.
1. (+ in) To put something into liquid until it is completely wet, or to become thoroughly wet. 2. ('soak up') To absorb liquid completely.
1. (+ in/with) To make someone or something completely wet.
(+ with) to thoroughly permeate or saturate with moisture, dye, or a quality

items.def_zh: 使浸透，浸湿；使饱和，使充满
items.def_en: 1. (+ with/in) To make something completely wet; to soak thoroughly. 2. To fill a place or market completely so that no more can be added.
to saturate or fill something completely with water so that it becomes heavy or unmanageable

groups.summary_en: This frame describes the progressive penetration and absorption of liquid into a solid substrate, scaling in intensity from slight hydration to maximum waterlogging.
groups.summary_zh: 液体渗入固体的程度递增，从轻微湿润逐步达到完全饱和透湿。

groups.name: Pack & Crate for Freight · 打包捆扎与装箱 (Bale, Crate, Bundle)
groups.tip: 装入船舱箱盒打包

items.def_en: (often + up) to put items into cardboard or wooden boxes for transport
to put commodities or manufactured goods into protective containers or wrappings

items.def_zh: 在托盘上堆放固定；码盘包装
items.def_en: to place and secure packaged freight items onto a pallet for shipping

items.def_zh: 把（货物或物品）收拾打包装箱
items.def_en: (+ sth) to put items into containers, boxes, or parcels in preparation for moving or shipping

items.def_zh: 装箱，把……装入盒/箱中以便运输
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place goods or possessions into cardboard boxes or crates for storage or transport
(+ sth) to tie or wrap several items securely together into a compact package
(+ sth) to pack items into large wooden crates specifically for shipping or freight
(+ up) to tie, bind, or pack a group of items together into a single unit
To press and tie material (such as hay, cotton, or paper) tightly into large bales or bundles.
To pack goods or equipment into a crate or crates for transport or storage.
(dated or literary) To load cargo onto a ship or other vessel.

groups.summary_en: Workers bundle, compress, or encase goods into boxes, crates, bales, or secure packaging units specifically to prepare them for physical transport, distribution, or shipping.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品打包、压缩捆扎或装入板条箱以供长途物流运输。

groups.name: Paddle, Row & Watercraft Navigation · 驾舟与水上划行
groups.tip: 水上驾船、航行、划艇或漂行

items.def_en: propel a small boat through water by pulling on oars attached to rowlocks

items.def_zh: （乘冲浪板或小舟）划向深水/外海
items.def_en: to move across the surface of the water using your arms or a paddle, especially away from the shore towards waves or open water
to push against the bank or shore with an oar, paddle, or foot in order to move a boat out into the water
to move away from the shore, a dock, or another vessel by rowing or paddling
ride the face of a forward-moving ocean wave while standing or lying on a board
move a canoe, kayak, or small board through water using a handheld paddle
travel in or navigate a lightweight canoe across rivers or lakes
travel across water or run rapids in a kayak using a double-bladed paddle

items.def_zh: 乘摩托艇航行；驾驶汽艇
items.def_en: To travel or cruise on water in a boat powered by a motor.
To propel a boat across water using a pair of oars or a single oar over the stern.
To ride across water standing on a board fitted with a sail.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate steering, propelling, and handling small watercraft, personal boats, or boards across water using manual paddles, oars, small outboard motors, or physical balance.
groups.summary_zh: 操控划艇、摩托艇或滑水板等小型船只及水上器材划行与疾驰。

groups.name: Pant & Gasp · 急喘与呼吸作声 (Wheeze, Gasp, Choke)
groups.tip: 气喘吁吁急促喘气或打鼾

items.def_en: to breathe in short, quick gusts after physical exertion
1. To breathe noisily through your nose and mouth while asleep.

items.def_zh: （因气愤或劳累）大声呼哧，吹气；恼怒，生气
items.def_en: 1. To blow or breathe out air noisily, especially to express annoyance or from heavy exertion.
1. To make a sudden, sharp, involuntary sound in the throat caused by spasms of the diaphragm.
to have difficulty breathing or speaking normally because of throat tightness, smoke, or intense emotion
to breathe rapidly, loudly, and heavily over a period of continuous physical exertion

items.def_zh: 喘气，气喘吁吁；渴望，渴求
items.def_en: 1. To breathe quickly and loudly with your mouth open, as after strenuous exercise. 2. (+ for/after) To long for or desire intensely.
to inhale suddenly and sharply through the mouth from surprise, pain, or breathlessness
to breathe with a rough whistling or rattling sound due to obstructed airways

items.def_zh: 喘着粗气挣扎着吸入（空气）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to struggle violently to breathe in air, especially due to exhaustion, shock, or lack of oxygen

items.def_zh: 过度换气，呼吸急促异常
items.def_en: 1. To breathe at an abnormally rapid and deep rate, typically caused by panic or anxiety.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote involuntary or labored respiratory acts where air intake produces distinct acoustic qualities, irregular rhythms, or signs of oxygen distress.
groups.summary_zh: 由于疲惫、缺氧、惊吓或病理反应导致的急促、费力或发出杂音的呼吸生理动作。

groups.name: Pierce & Thrust · 戳刺与贯穿 (Pierce, Jab, Gore)
groups.tip: 利器或尖角刺穿皮肉机体

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ at/with) to poke someone or something with a finger or a pointed object
(+ sth) to pierce through a surface so that a sharp tip emerges on the other side
[I/T] (+ at/into) to quickly push a finger, stick, or other object into someone or something
(+ sb/sth) to make sudden, aggressive, sharp thrusting motions at a target with a pointed weapon or object
(+ sth/sb) to push a sharp, pointed object deeply into someone or something
1. To push something sharp or pointed into or towards someone or something with a quick, hard movement. 2. (boxing) To hit someone with a short, quick punch.
[I/T] (+ with/into) to pierce or wound someone or something deeply with a short pointed weapon such as a knife
[I/T] (+ through/with) to force a sharp pointed instrument into or through something

items.def_zh: （动物用角或獠牙）顶伤，戳伤，刺穿
items.def_en: (of an animal with horns or tusks) To pierce or wound someone or something with its horns or tusks.
(+ on/upon) to push a sharp point completely through someone's or something's body
to pierce completely through someone or something with a pointed weapon, pinning them in place

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe striking or penetrating a target with a sharp or pointed object or horn. They range from quick, shallow prods with fists or blunted weapons (jab) to deep, tearing bodily puncture typically inflicted by horns or tusks (gore).
groups.summary_zh: 以尖锐物或犄角快速戳刺或深层贯穿肉体。

groups.name: Piercing Cries & Alarms · 尖叫与高声呼喊 (Shriek, Squeal, Yelping)
groups.tip: 情绪激动时失声叫喊或惊呼呼救

items.def_zh: 尖声说话；突然插嘴高叫
items.def_en: to suddenly speak or utter a shrill, high-pitched remark, especially after being quiet
to make a sudden, loud, high-pitched vocal sound in pain, surprise, or fear

items.def_zh: （刺耳的呼叫、警报等）骤然响起
items.def_en: to sound loudly and clearly through an area, typically describing a sudden sharp cry, alarm, or shot

items.def_zh: （因痛苦、受惊或兴奋而）尖叫，短促尖吠；尖声大喊
items.def_en: To give a sudden, short, high-pitched cry or bark, usually because of pain, fear, or excitement.

items.def_zh: （嘲弄或抗议地）大喊，高呼；鸣笛，按喇叭；（猫头鹰）鸣叫
items.def_en: 1. To shout or laugh loudly, especially to show disapproval, amusement, or scorn. 2. To make a loud, deep sound (like a car horn or an owl).
to cry out or scream loudly, harshly, and continuously (often said of infants)
to utter a loud, harsh, piercing, high-pitched scream

items.def_zh: 尖叫，尖声喊叫；尖声说出
items.def_en: To give a loud, high-pitched cry or scream, especially from fear, pain, or excitement.

items.def_zh: 发出长而尖的叫声，高声尖叫；（向警方）告密，告发
items.def_en: 1. To make a long, high-pitched cry or sound. 2. (informal) To inform the police about an accomplice.

items.def_zh: 大声呼喊，喧嚷；吵闹着要求
items.def_en: To shout loudly, make a persistent din, or make a loud and noisy demand as a group.

items.def_zh: 发出尖声哀嚎，尖叫吵闹
items.def_en: to make a shrill, discordant, or wailing cry like a rutting cat

groups.summary_en: Verbs specifying acoustic properties—high pitch, sharpness, suddenness, or shrill resonance—of human or animal alarm cries and shouts.
groups.summary_zh: 因恐惧、疼痛、惊叫或喧闹而发出的尖锐、高亢或刺耳的呼喊叫声。

groups.name: Pilfer & Purloin · 偷窃与窃取 (Pilfer, Filch, Purloin)
groups.tip: 趁人不备暗中顺走财物

items.def_en: (+ sth) to illicitly or surreptitiously take property that belongs to someone else
(informal, chiefly BrE) to take something that belongs to someone else dishonestly
(informal) to take something without permission, especially something of small value
(informal) to steal something quickly and opportunistically while no one is looking

items.def_zh: 偷窃，小偷小摸（尤指零星窃取价值不高之物）
items.def_en: 1. To steal small quantities of goods or small amounts of money repeatedly, especially from work or a store.

items.def_zh: 偷窃，顺手牵羊（窃取小件财物）
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To steal something small or of little value slyly and quietly.

items.def_zh: 顺手牵羊，占为己有；抢先弄到手
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly British) To take, steal, or grab something quickly for oneself, especially without permission.

items.def_zh: 携（赃物等）潜逃；顺手牵羊带走
items.def_en: (+ sth) to steal something and hurriedly escape with it
(+ sth) to secretly take possession of money or property without permission and depart
(formal) to take possession of something, often without permission or legally dubious grounds

items.def_zh: 偷窃，盗取（幽默或正式表达）
items.def_en: 1. (formal or humorous) To steal or secretly take something that belongs to someone else.

groups.summary_en: An agent takes another's property unlawfully and surreptitiously without overt violence, typically involving small sums, office goods, or sneakily seized valuables.
groups.summary_zh: 神不知鬼不觉地顺手牵羊、小偷小摸或侵吞财物。

groups.name: Plant Growth & Vegetative Development · 植物萌发与发育成株 (Sprout, Root, Tiller)
groups.tip: 生命体从小到大发育

items.def_en: to produce lateral stems or boughs from a main trunk or stem
to begin to grow and appear above the soil surface

items.def_zh: 生根，扎根；使生根；（猪等）用鼻拱土；搜寻
items.def_en: 1. (of a plant) To develop roots, or cause a cutting or plant to put forth roots and begin growing. 2. (+ for) (informal) To support or cheer for someone.
to begin to grow or send out new shoots, leaves, or buds
1. (botany, agriculture) (of cereal crops or grasses) To produce side shoots or stalks from the base of the stem.
to cause a seed or spore to start growing after a period of dormancy
to grow upwards very rapidly and noticeably, as young plants or shoots do
(of a plant) to push forth vegetative buds or stems rapidly

items.def_zh: 生长，成长；种植；逐渐变得（grow 的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of grow; increased in size, developed, or cultivated.
to breed or reproduce specimens of a plant naturally or artificially
1. To grow again after being cut, damaged, or lost, or cause something to do so.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures biological, vegetative development in flora, detailing how a plant establishes anchors, sends out shoots, or regenerates tissues. Key verbs distinguish anchoring ('root'), lateral shooting ('tiller'), and regenerative vegetative proliferation.
groups.summary_zh: 专指植物生根、抽蘖、生枝与再生等阶段性生化与植株生理发育过程。

groups.name: Ponder & Cogitate · 深思与反省 (Ruminate, Muse, Meditate)
groups.tip: 反复沉吟深思并检视内省

items.def_en: (+ on/upon/over) to think deeply and dreamily in silence about a matter
(+ sth) to discuss or think about something carefully and thoroughly

items.def_zh: 仔细考虑；深思；反复琢磨
items.def_en: (+ sth) to think carefully about something over a period of time
(+ sth) to think deeply or carefully about a past event or idea
to think about something carefully, weighing consequences, before reaching a conclusion
(+ on/upon) to focus one's mind intensely in silence or spiritual contemplation

items.def_zh: 沉思，反复思考；（动物）反刍
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/over/about) To think deeply and carefully about something for a long time. 2. (zoology) (of cattle and other animals) To chew the cud.
('bethink oneself') (archaic / literary) To remind yourself, reflect, or stop to consider.
(+ sth) to think anxiously or gloomily about something for a long time
(+ on/over) to dwell morosely, resentfully, or anxiously on an unhappy subject
(+ on/about) (formal or humorous) To think deeply, carefully, and seriously about something.

groups.summary_en: A thinker engages in sustained, deep, and often inward intellectual or emotional deliberation over a subject. Verbs vary from cyclical, troubled mental revisiting (ruminate) to quiet philosophical reflection (muse, meditate) and rigorous formal contemplation (cogitate).
groups.summary_zh: 持续专注地反复琢磨、反躬自省或静心思虑。

groups.name: Provision of Sustenance & Overindulgence · 供食与饲育 (Feed, Nourish, Overfeed)
groups.tip: 为幼体或病患提供养分

items.def_zh: 喂养，喂（食），饲养；供养，滋养；供给，提供（原料、信息等）
items.def_en: 1. To give food to a person or animal, or provide nourishment. 2. To supply a machine, system, or organization with material, fuel, or information.
(+ sb/animal) to feed someone or an animal lavishly so they become stronger, healthier, or plumper
(+ sb/animal) to feed livestock or a person a large amount of food so that they gain substantial weight
to eat eagerly and heartily, often consuming generous quantities of food

items.def_zh: 用谷物（或玉米）喂养（牲畜）；用盐腌（肉等）
items.def_en: 1. To feed cattle or other livestock with corn or grain. 2. To preserve meat or other food with coarse salt or brine.
To eat a snack or small amount of food between regular meals.
[I/T] feed on growing grass, or eat small portions of food throughout the day
[I/T] (+ on/oneself) eat large quantities of food until completely stuffed
provide with the food or other substances necessary for growth and health
[I/T] (+ up) feed an animal intensely so that it becomes fat enough to slaughter
To feed someone or an animal too much food, or to eat excessively.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the human or institutional act of supplying food, fodder, or biological nutrients to creatures or humans, covering casual light eating (snack), basic provision (feed), grain feeding of livestock (corn), and harmful excessive provisioning (overfeed).
groups.summary_zh: 提供营养物质与食物以维系生命，涵盖日常喂食、饲喂牲畜及过量喂饲。

groups.name: Purify & Cleanse · 净化与提纯 (Filter, Clarify, Refine)
groups.tip: 滤除杂质提炼出纯净成分

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove unwanted solids or impurities from a liquid or gas by passing it through a permeable medium
(+ sth) to remove dirt, stains, or chemical residues from something by cleaning it with water
[I/T] to pass liquid or gas through a porous device to remove solid particles
to make a liquid clear or pure by heating, straining, or removing solids
(+ sth) to evaporate liquid completely or concentrate a substance by prolonged heating
1. To clean something or oneself with water and usually soap. 2. (of water) To carry or sweep something away, or flow over.
to remove impurities or unwanted elements from a substance through an industrial process
to clean thoroughly, especially the skin, or free from guilt/sin

items.def_zh: 使纯净，净化，提纯；变纯净
items.def_en: To remove dirty, harmful, or foreign substances from something so that it becomes pure.
1. To purify a liquid by boiling it and condensing its vapors. 2. (+ into) To extract the essential elements or meaning of something.

items.def_zh: 除去盐分，使淡化（如海水）
items.def_en: (chemistry / engineering) To remove salt from seawater so that it can be used for drinking or agriculture.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specific physical, chemical, or ritual methods of removing contaminants, impurities, or unwanted substances from a liquid, substance, or entity.
groups.summary_zh: 指采用过滤、沉淀、脱盐或蒸馏等物理化学或仪式手段除去杂质以达纯净。

groups.name: Rebuke & Scold by Intensity · 责备与斥责 (Admonish to Lambaste)
groups.tip: 从轻微批评到严词斥责

items.def_en: to speak to someone in a gentle but firm way, criticizing their behavior or warning them
(formal) to criticize or scold someone gently or kindly for doing wrong
(+ sb) to speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong
to speak angrily and sternly to someone because they have done something wrong
(+ sb) to severely scold or reprimand someone in authority over their mistakes
(+ sb) to attack someone verbally with harsh or angry criticism
(+ sb) to criticize or verbally attack someone with extreme anger and ferocity
to criticize or speak angrily to someone for an extended period
to criticize someone severely in public or with great indignation
(formal) to criticize or scold someone severely for doing something wrong
to criticize someone or something fiercely and publicly; (dated) to beat or hit severely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing verbal disapproval to someone regarding their fault or misconduct, graded from mild formal correction up to furious public dressing-down.
groups.summary_zh: 指就某人过失进行语言斥责，语气从温和告诫递增至极其严厉的痛骂抨击。

groups.name: Record & Document · 记录与记载 (Log, Register, Minutise)
groups.tip: 系统记录与文献归档保存

items.def_zh: 记录，记载；录音，录像；标明，显示
items.def_en: 1. To set down information in writing or other permanent form for future reference. 2. To store sound, music, or moving pictures on disc, tape, or digital media.

items.def_zh: 详细记录，记载；用文件（或文献、证据）证明
items.def_en: 1. To record the details of an event, process, or situation in writing, film, or photographs. 2. To support or prove something with evidence or official documents.
to enter details about someone or something into an official list or public record

items.def_zh: 记录，跟踪记录（进展或变化）；绘制……的图表（或地图）
items.def_en: 1. To record or track the development, progress, or change of something over time. 2. To make a map or chart of an area.

items.def_zh: 记入航海/飞行/工作日志，系统记录
items.def_en: to make a systematic, chronological record of events, measurements, or occurrences in an official log
to write down what is said and decided during a formal meeting
(+ sth) to record information, facts, or data on paper or in a document
(+ sth) to record or enter details, events, or measurements systematically into an official record or system
(+ sth) to transcribe or write down words or proceedings as they are spoken
(+ sth) to write down quickly or briefly on a piece of paper for later reference
to record a related series of events in chronological order

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to transcribing, registering, or recording empirical data, progress, or official proceedings on physical or digital media to preserve an accurate evidentiary record.
groups.summary_zh: 指将数据、进展、实况或会议进程录入介质以备留存查考。

groups.name: Refurbish & Touch Up · 修缮、翻新与补修 (Renovate, Refurbish, Retouch)
groups.tip: 修复破损使旧物换新貌

items.def_en: to repair something quickly and often temporarily or inexpertly
(+ sth) to repair, decorate, and refurbish an old room, building, or car to restore it to good condition
(+ sth) to make a place or object look cleaner, neater, or more attractive with minor improvements
(+ sth) to improve the surface appearance of something by making minor repairs or adding small amounts of paint

items.def_zh: 翻新，修复，修缮（旧建筑、家具等）
items.def_en: 1. To repair, redecorate, and improve a building, room, or piece of furniture so that it is in good condition again.
to examine a machine or system thoroughly and make necessary repairs or improvements
to change or arrange something again in order to improve its appearance or efficiency
to clean, redecorate, and provide new equipment or fittings for a building or room

items.def_zh: 润饰，修补，修整（照片、画作等）
items.def_en: 1. To improve a photograph, painting, or other image by making small changes or removing flaws.

items.def_zh: 拙劣地修补；粗制滥造，草率应付
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly British) To mend, repair, or make something clumsily and carelessly.

items.def_zh: 重修……的表面，为……贴换饰面
items.def_en: 1. To put a new outer surface or finish on a building, wall, or piece of furniture.

groups.summary_en: An agent works on a building, surface, or artifact to restore its condition, improve its aesthetic appearance, or patch up defects. Nuances range from comprehensive overhaul and professional resurfacing to superficial touch-ups or shoddy repairs.
groups.summary_zh: 对建筑物、外观或器具进行翻新、修葺、修饰或敷衍修补。

groups.name: Release from Confinement or Bondage · 释放与解放 (Free, Liberate, Emancipate)
groups.tip: 打破枷锁重获自由与自主权

items.def_en: (+ from) to release someone from captivity, confinement, or physical restraint
(+ from) to allow someone to leave prison, custody, or institutional care formally
to release from fetters or any hindering constraints
(+ sb) to allow someone to leave confinement, imprisonment, or detention
(+ sb) to release someone from captivity, bondage, or imprisonment
(+ sb) to secure the release of an arrested person by paying a required financial deposit
(+ from) to officially allow someone to leave an institution, hospital, or military service
To set someone or something free from control, captivity, or oppression.
To release a prisoner before their sentence has finished, on condition of good behavior.
To remove the chains from a person, animal, or thing to set them free.
To give freedom and equal rights to someone, especially by freeing them from slavery or social and legal restrictions.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote granting physical liberty, political rights, or release from institutional, physical, or social constraints.
groups.summary_zh: 解除人身拘禁、政治压迫或法律枷锁，赋予其自由。

groups.name: Repair & Restore · 修复与恢复 (Restoring Proper Function)
groups.tip: 纠正差错并修复原状

items.def_en: (+ sth) to resolve a confusing, disordered, or problematic situation and restore normal order
(+ sth) to deal successfully with a problem, malfunction, or muddle and put it right
(+ sth) to correct a mistake, fault, or injustice and return conditions to what they should be

items.def_zh: 补救，纠正，矫正（差错、弊端等）；消除
items.def_en: To correct, cure, or put right an undesirable situation, problem, or mistake.

items.def_zh: （使）清醒，醒酒（通常作sober up）；（使）严肃起来，冷静下来
items.def_en: (often followed by 'up') To become or cause someone to become sober after drinking alcohol, or to become calm, serious, and thoughtful.

items.def_zh: 重新设置，重置；（使断骨）复位；重新安装
items.def_en: 1. To adjust a machine, device, or digital system back to its original or default setting. 2. To put a broken bone back into the correct position to heal.
to restore someone or something to a previous position, rank, or functional state
to put right a mistake, imbalance, or undesirable state of affairs

items.def_zh: 修复，改造（建筑等使其恢复良好状态）；使康复，使恢复正常生活；恢复（名誉、地位）
items.def_en: 1. To repair, renovate, or restore a building, environment, or system to good condition. 2. To help someone return to a healthy, normal life after illness, addiction, or imprisonment.
to remedy or set right an unfair situation or grievance
to recover from illness, exhaustion, or severe financial losses

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking corrective action to counter an impairment, reset an abnormal condition, or bring an injured, broken, or troubled entity back to sound health and order.
groups.summary_zh: 采取补救或矫正行动，纠正缺陷或使失调对象重归正常健康状态。

groups.name: Represent & Embody · 代表与象征 (Represent, Typify, Epitomize)
groups.tip: 具象化体现与象征某种特质

items.def_zh: 象征，体现；代表；描绘，展现
items.def_en: 1. To be a symbol or embodiment of something. 2. To act or speak officially on behalf of someone. 3. To describe or portray something in a particular way.
(stand for sth) to serve as a symbol, abbreviation, or representation of something
(+ sb/sth) represent the views, wishes, or character of a person or group
(+ sb/sth) represent or embody the typical characteristics of someone or something
to express, personify, or give a tangible physical form to an idea or quality

items.def_zh: 作为……的典范，体现；例证，例示
items.def_en: To be a typical or perfect example of a quality, style, or rule; to show or illustrate by giving an example.
To embody or represent a quality, spirit, or idea in human or physical form.

items.def_zh: 是……的化身，体现；把……拟人化
items.def_en: 1. To be a perfect example of a quality or idea; to embody. 2. To represent an abstract quality or thing as a human figure in art or literature.
To represent an idea, quality, or entity by means of a symbol; to be a symbol of something.

items.def_zh: 是……的典型特征，代表；作为……的典型
items.def_en: To be a classic or typical example of a particular group, style, or condition; to characterize.

items.def_zh: 作为……的典型，成为……的缩影；概括，摘要
items.def_en: 1. To be a perfect or typical example of a particular quality, style, or type. 2. To give a summary of something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate serving as a visible, living, or archetypal manifestation of an abstract quality, idea, group, or institutional identity.
groups.summary_zh: 指作为某种抽象特质、概念或群体的具象化体现、象征或典型代表。

groups.name: Respiratory Mechanics & Exertion · 呼吸与喘息机制 (Inhale, Puff, Gasp)
groups.tip: 剧烈运动后急促短浅喘气

items.def_en: (+ sth) to take air, gas, or vapor into your lungs through the nose or mouth
(+ sth) to expel air or gas from your lungs through the nose or mouth
(+ air/breath) to pull a breath or volume of air deeply into the lungs
[I/T] breathe out air, vapor, or smoke from the lungs

items.def_zh: 抽鼻涕，吸鼻子（常因哭泣或感冒）
items.def_en: To breathe in repeatedly through a runny or congested nose with a quiet sniffing sound, especially when crying or ill.
breathe with short, quick, labored breaths, typically from exertion or heat

items.def_zh: 气喘吁吁，大口喘气；喷出（烟、气）；抽（烟）
items.def_en: 1. To breathe loudly and rapidly, especially after strenuous physical exercise. 2. To blow or send out bursts of smoke, steam, or air; to smoke a pipe, cigarette, or cigar.
1. To take a sudden, sharp, quick breath through the mouth because of shock, pain, or breathlessness. 2. (+ for) To crave or desperately need something.
1. To breathe air, smoke, or vapor into the lungs. 2. (informal) To eat or drink something extremely quickly.
breathe with a whistling, rattling sound, resulting from obstructed airways

items.def_zh: 过度通气，极度急促呼吸
items.def_en: breathe at an abnormally rapid rate, typically induced by panic or anxiety

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the physical manner and physiological conditions of respiration, including sudden sharp intakes due to shock or oxygen deficit (gasp), labored intermittent expulsion from exertion (puff), nasal inhalation related to irritation or crying (sniffle), and standard deep inhalation (inhale).
groups.summary_zh: 描绘呼吸的具体生理方式与状态，如急促喘气、吃力喷气或深吸气。

groups.name: Restore & Renew · 恢复与更新 (Rejuvenate, Revitalize, Regenerate)
groups.tip: 修整翻新使其重回最初状态

items.def_en: to return something or someone to a former good condition, health, or position

items.def_zh: 使恢复，使更新；延长……的有效期；重新开始
items.def_en: 1. To restore something to a new, fresh, or improved condition. 2. To extend the validity of an agreement or document. 3. To resume something after an interruption.
(+ sth) to return someone or something to a previous healthy, active, or flourishing condition
(+ sth) to make someone or something look, feel, or become cleaner, cooler, or more vigorous

items.def_zh: 重振旗鼓；迅速恢复生机
items.def_en: to recover quickly from an illness, setback, exhaustion, or state of decline

items.def_zh: 使恢复精力，使振作；使想起，提示；刷新（网页等）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel less tired, hot, or weary. 2. (refresh someone's memory) To remind someone of something. 3. (computing) To update or reload a computer screen or display.

items.def_zh: 恢复（原状），重回（旧习）；（财产等）归还原主
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To return to a former state, habit, or condition. 2. (+ to) (law) (of property or rights) To return to the original owner or their heirs.

items.def_zh: 使重获新生，注入新活力
items.def_en: to imbue something with new life, vigor, energy, or economic strength

items.def_zh: 使返老还童，使恢复活力
items.def_en: to make someone or something look, feel, or function much younger or more lively

items.def_zh: 解压缩（数字文件或数据）
items.def_en: 1. (computing) To restore a compressed digital file or data back to its original full size.

items.def_zh: 翻新（废旧轮胎）；重新使用（旧观念、旧素材等）
items.def_en: 1. To put a new tread on a worn tire. 2. (informal) To reuse or present old material or ideas in a slightly new form.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote bringing an entity back to a previous functional condition, youthfulness, freshness, or original uncorrupted baseline.
groups.summary_zh: 消除损耗、疲惫或变化，使事物回归最初的精力充沛、全新运作或原始状态。

groups.name: Rot & Decompose · 腐烂与降解
groups.tip: 有机物质生物降解与腐朽

items.def_en: decay or rot with an offensive, foul odor via bacterial action
decay gradually until nothing or very little remains
decay or decompose biologically or chemically into simpler substances
(of food or drink) become stale, sour, or rotten and unfit to eat
(of food) become unfit for eating through biological aging or contamination
rot or undergo gradual natural breakdown through fungal or microbial activity
undergo natural decomposition; become putrid and break down
decay and break down into constituent physical and chemical elements
(chiefly British spelling of molder) To decay, rot, and crumble away slowly from neglect or disuse.
(US spelling of moulder) To decay, rot, and crumble away slowly from neglect or disuse.
To break down naturally through the action of bacteria or other living organisms, or cause something to do this.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organic matter breaking down, deteriorating, or undergoing biochemical disintegration due to bacterial, fungal, or natural environmental action.
groups.summary_zh: 有机物在细菌、真菌或环境作用下逐渐崩解、腐败、分化分解。

groups.name: Rouse, Excite & Inflame Emotions · 激发、激昂与煽动情绪 (Rouse, Excite & Inflame)
groups.tip: 调动积极热情或煽动情绪的行动

items.def_en: to arouse strong feelings, curiosity, or emotional engagement within someone
to arouse, inspire, or start building up a strong emotion, interest, or hope

items.def_zh: 使兴奋，使激动；激发，引起
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel enthusiastic, eager, or agitated. 2. To cause or provoke a particular reaction or feeling.

items.def_zh: 鼓舞，激励，使振作；（与 away/off 连用）暗中带走，偷偷掳走
items.def_en: 1. (often spirit up) To animate, encourage, or fill with energy and enthusiasm. 2. (spirit away/off) To remove or carry off secretly and quickly.
(+ sb) fill someone with intense enthusiasm, passion, or anger
(+ sth) excite, stimulate, or provoke strong, often disruptive emotions or trouble in people
(+ sth) deliberately excite and encourage very strong emotion or agitation among people

items.def_zh: 激励，鼓舞；赋予灵感；引起，激起
items.def_en: 1. To fill someone with confidence, enthusiasm, or the desire to do something. 2. To stimulate someone's creative capacity or produce inspiration for something.

items.def_zh: 使激动，使兴奋；使电气化，使通电
items.def_en: 1. To fill someone with sudden excitement, thrill, or enthusiasm. 2. To equip a system or railway to operate using electric power; to charge with electricity.

items.def_zh: 激起，煽动（强烈情绪或争端）；使发炎，使红肿
items.def_en: 1. To cause very strong feelings such as anger or passion, or to make an aggressive situation worse. 2. (medical) To cause a part of the body to become swollen, red, and painful.
to shock or stimulate someone into sudden, energetic action or heightened awareness

groups.summary_en: This frame covers causing an emotional surge, inspiring deep passion, or stirring up agitation and intense feeling in people. Nuances range from constructive creative inspiration to thrilling excitement and vehement incendiary stimulation.
groups.summary_zh: 引起强烈心理激荡、点燃热情、鼓舞士气或煽动激烈情绪。

groups.name: Rustle & Whirr · 杂音与摩擦作响 (Rustle, Whirr, Creak)
groups.tip: 器物摩擦或转动发低沉杂音

items.def_en: to make a continuous low, smooth, vibrating mechanical or electrical sound

items.def_zh: （使）发出沙沙声；偷盗（牛、马等牲畜）
items.def_en: 1. To make or cause to make a soft, light sound like dry leaves or paper rubbing together. 2. (informal) To steal cattle, horses, or other livestock.

items.def_zh: 发出尖细声音；尖声作响
items.def_en: make a sudden high-pitched sound or noise
move along quickly while producing a series of sharp, knocking sounds
to make a short, very high-pitched sound due to friction or movement

items.def_zh: 发出嘎吱声，发出咯吱声
items.def_en: 1. To make a harsh, high-pitched squeaking sound, especially when being moved or under pressure.

items.def_zh: 发出呼呼声（或嗡嗡声、飕飕声）
items.def_en: 1. To make a continuous, low, soft buzzing or humming sound, like spinning blades or machinery.

items.def_zh: 发出持续低沉的嗡嗡声；轻弹，拨弄（弦乐器）
items.def_en: 1. To make a continuous low, rhythmic humming or vibrating sound; to play idly or rhythmically on a stringed instrument.
to make a rapid series of short, sharp, knocking sounds when vibrating

items.def_zh: 发出沉闷的金属撞击声，发出哐啷声
items.def_en: 1. To make a heavy, dull, metallic sound, or move with such a sound.

items.def_zh: 发出咔嗒声，隆隆作响；咔嗒咔嗒地奔跑
items.def_en: (dialect or literary) To make a loud, rattling or clattering sound; to run or move with a clatter.

groups.summary_en: Non-vocal acoustic sound emissions produced by friction, mechanical rotation, low-frequency resonance, or structural strain. Verbs depict the specific tactile textures and cadences producing the sound.
groups.summary_zh: 物体因摩擦、旋转、低频振动或受力变形所产生的特定微杂音。

groups.name: Sate & Blase Deadening · 厌倦与麻木脱敏 (Pall, Cloy, Desensitize)
groups.tip: 腻烦生倦直至心神麻木

items.def_en: [I/T] to become tired of something, or cause someone to lose enthusiasm through repetition

items.def_zh: 变得漠然；停止关注与感受
items.def_en: cease paying attention, lose interest, or emotionally detach from what is happening around one
to exhaust interest or emotional energy gradually
(+ sb) gradually reduce someone's physical or emotional resistance, spirit, or enthusiasm through constant exposure

items.def_zh: 使人生厌，变得乏味，失去吸引力
items.def_en: To become uninteresting, boring, or tiresome, especially because of having had too much of something.

items.def_zh: 使醒悟，使幻灭，使不再着迷
items.def_en: (usually passive) To free someone from false illusions so they feel disappointed with something or someone they once admired.

items.raw_cluster: 使麻木与冷漠 Numb & Harden
items.def_zh: 使麻木，使麻木不仁；脱敏，使减弱敏感性
items.def_en: 1. To make someone less emotionally sensitive or shocked by repeatedly exposing them to pain, violence, or suffering. 2. To reduce the physical or allergic sensitivity of an organism.

items.def_zh: （因过多而）使人生腻，倒胃口，使生厌
items.def_en: To become or cause someone to become sickened or bored through an excess of sweetness, richness, or sentimentality.
become completely exhausted and lose motivation or emotional responsiveness through prolonged stress or overwork

items.def_zh: 使厌倦冷漠，使玩世不恭
items.def_en: to make someone dull, cynical, or indifferent through surfeit or overexposure

items.def_zh: 使麻木，使失去一切知觉
items.def_en: to deaden physical feeling or completely paralyze emotional sensation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive loss of interest, pleasure, or emotional responsiveness due to overexposure, excessive sweetness, disillusionment, or repeated trauma.
groups.summary_zh: 表现因过度沉溺、幻灭或持续刺激而逐渐失去兴致直至情感麻木。

groups.name: Scurry & Dart Rapidly · 疾行与穿梭急走 (Scurry, Dash, Scoot)
groups.tip: 步伐急促短快的奔跑

items.def_zh: 小跑，快步走；（马）小跑疾驰
items.def_en: 1. (of a person) to run with quick, short steps. 2. (of a horse) to move at a speed between a walk and a canter
to run away with quick, light, hurried steps, especially like a small child or animal
to leave or dart away very quickly in a hurry

items.def_zh: 急促小跑离开；碎步溜走
items.def_en: to move away with quick, short, hurried steps

items.def_zh: 仓促疾行，慌忙小跑；悬垂，突出
items.def_en: 1. (informal) to hurry or scurry away quickly like a beetle. 2. (of rocks, cliffs, etc.) to project or overhang
to run with quick, short steps, especially when escaping or hiding
to move quickly with short, hurried, agitated steps

items.def_zh: 疾行，快跑，溜走；挪动，移开
items.def_en: (informal) 1. to go or move somewhere very quickly. 2. to slide or move oneself along a surface (especially to make room for someone)

items.def_zh: 欢闹蹦跳地跑；敏捷奔走
items.def_en: to run with quick light steps, especially playfully or timidly
to start moving or running away in a sudden, rapid burst of speed
to move suddenly and rapidly in a specific direction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray small, quick, or hurried foot movements, characterizing animate beings moving rapidly, often in short bursts or with a light, darting, or brisk gait.
groups.summary_zh: 描摹快速轻巧的碎步跑动、急行或短距离迅猛穿梭。

groups.name: Search & Seek · 寻找与搜寻 (Scour, Rummage, Hunt)
groups.tip: 四处探访找寻目标踪迹

items.def_en: search through things in a disordered or messy way to find something

items.def_zh: 寻购古董，搜寻淘宝；使显得陈旧，做旧
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To search for or shop for antiques. 2. To give an object or furniture the appearance of being antique or aged.
(+ for) to wander about widely searching for food or provisions
(+ for) To search for underground water, minerals, or oil using a divining rod or dowsing rod.
(+ sth) search persistently until uncovering hidden or elusive information, things, or people
1. To examine a person, place, or thing carefully in order to find something or someone. 2. (+ for) To try to find something by looking carefully.

items.def_zh: 搜寻，搜查出（常与 out/around 连用）；用雪貂捕猎
items.def_en: 1. ('ferret out/around') To search persistently and thoroughly to find or uncover hidden things or information. 2. To hunt or drive out animals using ferrets.
[I/T] (+ through/in) to search thoroughly and messily among a collection of things
(+ sb/sth) search for someone or something tenaciously until they are found or captured
(+ for/through) to search a place meticulously looking for specific evidence or persons
(+ for) to search an entire area systematically and thoroughly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the sensory or physical manner of actively seeking people, hidden objects, or resources, differing in physical technique, thoroughness, and domain (e.g., using divining tools, rummaging through clutter, or hunting antiquities).
groups.summary_zh: 指通过特定方式或手段搜求目标，包含翻找、探寻及专用勘搜。

groups.name: Search & Seek · 探求与寻索 (Seek, Scour, Rummage)
groups.tip: 多方寻觅目标线索

items.def_zh: （用搜索引擎）网络搜索，在网上查找
items.def_en: To search for information on the internet using a search engine (especially Google).

items.def_zh: 搜罗出；发掘出（秘密或事实）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discover information or facts by careful and diligent searching

items.def_zh: 搜出；查获（隐藏的信息或事物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to search around persistently and uncover hidden secrets, details, or items
(+ sth) to search quickly and untidily through a collection of things, papers, or a container

items.def_zh: 寻找，寻觅；谋求，争取；试图
items.def_en: To attempt to find, obtain, or achieve something; to ask for advice or help.

items.def_zh: 寻找，寻觅，谋求（seek 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of seek; to attempt to find or achieve something.
(+ for) to search widely for food or supplies
[I/T] to search untidily through a mass of things to find something
(+ sb/sth) to search exhaustively until a missing person, desired thing, or information is located
to search thoroughly and systematically through a place or records
to search a place or area thoroughly in order to find someone or something

groups.summary_en: Cognizers actively scan locations, physical domains, or data systems to locate missing persons, facts, or desired objectives. Variations range from high-level aspirational pursuit to digital queries and exhaustive physical scouring.
groups.summary_zh: 为寻获特定人、物或信息而进行的系统查寻或全面翻找。

groups.name: Sell & Trade Commercial Goods · 出售、外销与零售 (Sell, Retail, Vend)
groups.tip: 转让货品换取金钱

items.def_zh: 卖，出售；售出；推销，使接受
items.def_en: 1. To give or transfer something to someone in exchange for money. 2. To persuade someone to buy, accept, or support something.

items.def_zh: 卖，出售（sell的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of sell: to exchange goods, property, or services for money.
1. To sell goods directly to the public in small quantities. 2. (+ at/for) To be sold at a specified retail price. 3. (formal) To tell or recount a story or information in detail.
1. To sell and send goods or services to another country. 2. (computing) To transfer data from one system or application to another.

items.def_zh: 廉价抛售；出脱（货物或资产）
items.def_en: (+ sth) dispose of goods, property, or stock rapidly, often at reduced prices
(+ sth) sell something quickly, cheaply, or unwanted to someone
(+ sth) exchange or sell commercial assets or items for money or another advantage
to promote or sell goods in a systematic commercial way, often using specialized display
to sell commodities in large quantities at reduced prices to retailers rather than consumers
(formal) to offer goods for sale, especially in a street market or through automated means
to go from place to place selling small goods, ideas, or illicit items

groups.summary_en: A seller transfers goods or commodities to a buyer in exchange for money, operating across retail channels, wholesale distribution, or international export markets.
groups.summary_zh: 通过零售、分销或国际贸易将商品与货物出售给买方。

groups.name: Sever & Divide by Cutting · 切断与截半 (Bisect, Chop, Sever)
groups.tip: 锋利外力割裂或击穿孔洞

items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide or bisect a solid object completely into two separate parts with a cutting edge

items.def_zh: 在……上击穿缺口，使裂开；豁开
items.def_en: To make a breach, hole, or gap in something.
To cut something into pieces by hitting it repeatedly with a sharp tool such as an axe or heavy knife.
to cut off branches or limbs cleanly from a trunk or body
to strike or chop forcefully with an axe or heavy cutting tool

items.def_zh: 二等分，一分为二；横切，穿过
items.def_en: To divide a line, shape, or area into two completely equal parts; to cross or intersect.
(+ sth) to sever or remove a part of something with a sharp blow using a knife, axe, or tool
(+ sth) to cut or sever a piece off something roughly, clumsily, or with repeated heavy blows
(+ sth) to cut off an unwanted part, such as a branch or limb, with a single cutting blow
to cut or chop roughly and violently with repeated strokes
to cut off a part completely from a whole, especially with a sharp stroke

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate completely partitioning, cleaving in two, or opening an aperture in a solid object by striking or cutting across its breadth. Actions range from orderly geometric bisection to aggressive chopping.
groups.summary_zh: 指斩断、平分或破开实体造成间隙或两段的动作。

groups.name: Signal & Nonverbally Cue · 示意与发信号 (Gesture, Cue, Telegraph)
groups.tip: 用动作或暗号非言语传达信息

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to/at) to lower and raise the head slightly to acknowledge, greet, or cue someone
(+ sb) to make a gesture with the hand, arm, or head to tell someone to do something or go somewhere
[I/T] (+ to) to use gestures or sign language to indicate meaning or directions
[I/T] (+ to) to direct or indicate by a movement of the hand, head, or eye

items.def_zh: 做手势，打手势；用动作示意
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/toward/at) To move your hands, arms, or head to express an idea, instruction, or feeling.

items.def_zh: 流露，（不自觉地）露出……企图；打电报
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To give an unintentional signal or advance warning of what you are about to do, allowing an opponent to anticipate it. 2. (historical) To send a message by telegraph.

items.def_zh: 暗示，提示；给（演员等）提示
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a signal to do or say something, especially in a performance or broadcast.
[I/T] (+ to/at) to make a gesture with the hand or head calling someone to approach
(+ sb) to signal to someone with a wave of the hand or nod to approach or come closer

items.def_zh: 挥手示意前进；挥手放行
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to signal to a person or driver with a hand motion to proceed or move past
(+ sb/sth) to wave one's arms or a signal to cause an approaching vehicle or driver to stop

groups.summary_en: An agent deliberately or inadvertently transmits information, intent, or timing through gestures, subtle bodily motions, or intentional promptings without full verbal articulation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过手势、暗号或不经意的肢体动作向对方传递指示或预告意图。

groups.name: Sing & Chant · 歌唱与咏唱 (Sing, Croon, Belt)
groups.tip: 伴随旋律或节奏发声吟咏

items.def_en: join in singing or chanting in harmony or unison with others

items.def_zh: 咏唱，诵唱（单调而富有韵律）
items.def_en: [I/T] to sing or utter rhythmic words or phrases in a repetitive, monotone cadence
[I/T] to recite or sing in a solemn, sonorous, slowly modulated voice

items.def_zh: 吟唱，作为吟游诗人演出
items.def_en: 1. (historical) To sing and play music as a traveling medieval entertainer.
1. To sing or hum a gentle song in a soft, low voice.
(+ sth) begin to sing or play a tune or chant, often leading others
1. To sing or play a romantic song to someone, especially outdoors beneath a window.

items.def_zh: 用真假声交替歌唱（约德尔唱法）
items.def_en: [I/T] to sing by alternating rapidly between normal voice and falsetto
1. (of a bird) To sing with a continuous, gentle trilling sound. 2. (of a person) To sing with a warbling or trilling voice.
(+ sth) sing a song or musical passage very loudly, forcefully, and with great energy

items.def_zh: 高声歌唱，大声唱出（尤作 belt out）；猛击；飞驰
items.def_en: 1. (especially 'belt out') To sing a song loudly and forcefully. 2. (informal) To hit someone or something hard. 3. (informal) To move very fast.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail specific vocal production techniques used in musical singing, differentiated by volume, timbre, melodic inflection, and theatrical style.
groups.summary_zh: 体现声乐发声法、情感基调与演唱风格（如低吟、高亢鸣唱）。

groups.name: Slide, Roll & Acrobatic Motion · 滑行、滚转与特技翻滚 (Slide, Roll & Tumble)
groups.tip: 在表面滚动、滑行或身体翻滚

items.def_en: turn over one or more times by rotating one's body along a surface
move across a smooth, slippery surface in varied or uncontrolled directions
1. To roll or move along slowly and heavily, especially on wheels, or to push something in this manner.
fall or roll down rapidly and acrobatically or clumsily
to move smoothly over an icy or smooth surface wearing skates
to roll end over end or perform gymnastic rolls and somersaults along the ground
1. To perform a sideways handspring with arms and legs spread out like the spokes of a wheel.
1. To roll or leap completely head over heels in the air or on the ground.
1. To skate using inline skates with a single row of wheels.

items.def_zh: （滑雪时）作双板平行摆动转弯滑
items.def_en: 1. (in skiing) To ski downhill making a rapid series of short, parallel turns.
to perform a complete rotation along the longitudinal axis while moving forward

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bodily or wheeled movement involving rolling, tumbling acrobatically, or sliding in specific rhythmic or wheeled patterns across a surface. Nuances range from heavy slow rolling to agile acrobatic rotations and specialized sporting maneuvers.
groups.summary_zh: 描述身体翻转、杂技空翻或依靠轮滑、滑雪技巧进行的特种滑滚位移。

groups.name: Smooth & Polish · 平整与打磨 (Buff, Burnish, Sandpaper)
groups.tip: 去除粗糙使外表光滑整洁

items.def_en: (+ sth) polish, smooth, or clean a surface thoroughly by friction or using an abrasive
(+ sth) make a surface level and smooth by scouring it with sandpaper
(+ sth) flatten or remove wrinkles, bumps, or irregularities from a surface
To make clothes or fabric smooth using an iron.
1. To make a wooden surface flat and smooth using a plane. 2. To skim along or glide over the surface of water.

items.def_zh: 用砂纸打磨，磨光；撒沙于
items.def_en: 1. To make something smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper or a mechanical sander. 2. To cover or sprinkle something with sand.
[I/T] to drag a hard, sharp edge across a surface to make it smooth or clean

items.def_zh: 整理，使整洁；使显出一本正经的神态
items.def_en: 1. To make clothes, appearance, or hair neat and tidy. 2. To compress one's face or lips into a formal, overly proper expression.
(+ down) to smooth or shape an edge using a rough metal file
to polish something with a piece of soft material or a mechanical buffer
to smooth and shine a metal or leather surface by rubbing friction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail physical manipulation techniques used to make a surface flat, smooth, or free of wrinkles, using heat, abrasives, or specialized hand tools.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过工具切削、砂纸打磨或高温熨平来消除粗糙与褶皱的工艺过程。

groups.name: Sneak & Creep · 潜行与匿踪 (Stealthy Undetected Movement)
groups.tip: 如幽灵般无声无息滑移潜行

items.def_en: to walk quietly on the tips of the toes

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚地走动；悄悄潜行
items.def_en: move around quietly and cautiously, trying to escape notice

items.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟地走动；偷偷摸摸活动
items.def_en: move furtively or secretly in an area to avoid being seen or heard

items.def_zh: 踮着脚走动；小心翼翼地潜行
items.def_en: walk very quietly on one's toes to avoid making any sound

items.def_zh: 如幽灵般无声潜行，悄悄滑过；突然断绝与……的联系（玩失踪）；代人写作（做枪手）
items.def_en: 1. To move silently, smoothly, or stealthily like a ghost. 2. (informal) To suddenly cut off all communication with someone. 3. To ghostwrite a book or article.

items.raw_cluster: 潜行与蹑手蹑脚 Sneak & Creep
items.def_zh: 悄悄潜行，鬼鬼祟祟地走动；窥探，搜寻；捕鼠
items.def_en: 1. To move stealthily, quietly, or furtively. 2. (+ around/about) To prowl or search around quietly. 3. To hunt or catch mice.

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚地走；悄悄前行
items.def_en: to move slowly and quietly with the body close to the ground

items.def_zh: 悄悄接近；蹑手蹑脚地靠近（某人）
items.def_en: (+ sb) approach someone quietly and stealthily without their knowledge
to go stealthily and furtively so as to evade being seen or heard

items.def_zh: 潜行；偷偷溜出（常带愧疚胆怯感）
items.def_en: to move smoothly and quietly with a guilty, furtive, or cowardly posture
to keep out of sight and move stealthily, especially with sinister intent

groups.summary_en: An agent moves in an extremely cautious, quiet, or surreptitious manner specifically designed to avoid sensory detection or identification by observers.
groups.summary_zh: 压低声响动作、极力隐藏行踪以躲避觉察的潜行移动。

groups.name: Specialized Culinary Preparation · 专业烹饪与酿造技艺 (Spatchcock, Confection, Brew)
groups.tip: 发酵与私酿烈酒的过程

items.def_en: to boil food briefly until it is partly cooked as a preparatory step
(+ sth) prepare a beverage such as beer, tea, or cider by boiling, infusion, or fermentation
(+ sth) reduce the volume and concentrate the flavor of a culinary liquid by gentle boiling
(+ sth) beat cream, eggs, or batter vigorously into a froth, or craft a dish quickly
to undergo or cause to undergo a chemical change catalyzed by enzymes or yeasts
1. (informal) To distill or brew alcoholic liquor illegally.
to fry food lightly and then stew it slowly in a closed container

items.def_zh: 调制（甜食、糕点）；配制（药剂）
items.def_en: 1. To make or prepare something (especially a sweet dish, candy, or pastry) by combining ingredients.
to produce liquor or essential liquids by vaporization and condensation
1. To cook or grill food on a small portable charcoal brazier.

items.def_zh: 沿脊骨剖平（家禽以便烤制）；强行塞入
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To split a whole chicken or bird open flat along the backbone so it cooks faster and more evenly. 2. To insert or force something into a text or plan where it does not naturally belong.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this domain describe specialized, artisanal culinary preparations, preservation, and distillation methods. They emphasize specific technical actions—such as splitting poultry, crafting confections, or fermenting and distilling beverages.
groups.summary_zh: 描述特定的专业料理处理手法与自酿、熬糖等专门烹饪技术行为。

groups.name: Speculate & Assume · 推测与假定 (Hazard, Hypothesize, Postulate)
groups.tip: 依据有限线索进行推测

items.def_en: (+ sth) use information, clues, or assumptions as the basis for an opinion or conjecture
(+ sth) expect, assume, or calculate that something will happen without certain proof

items.def_zh: 大胆猜测，冒昧提出；使冒危险，冒……的险
items.def_en: 1. To risk putting forward a guess, suggestion, or opinion that might be wrong. 2. To put something at risk of danger or loss.

items.def_zh: 假定，推定，认为；擅自，冒昧
items.def_en: 1. To suppose that something is true on the basis of probability, without definite proof. 2. (formal) To be bold enough to do something without right or permission.
1. To form opinions or theories about something without having complete information. 2. To buy and sell goods or assets hoping to make a quick profit from market fluctuations.
1. To suggest a possible explanation or theory for something that has not yet been proved.

items.def_zh: 以……为前提；假定，预先设定
items.def_en: 1. To base an argument, theory, or statement on a particular premise or assumption.
to form an opinion or supposition based on incomplete evidence

items.def_zh: 假定，假设；要求，视……为必要条件
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To suggest or accept that something is true as the basis for a theory, argument, or calculation.
to guess that something is true using circumstantial clues without certainty
to suggest or assume a fact or principle as the basis for an argument or theory

groups.summary_en: A cognizer adopts a provisional belief or theoretical proposition without conclusive proof, varying from tentative, risky guesses to rigorous foundational premises in philosophical or scientific argumentation.
groups.summary_zh: 在缺乏确凿证据下提出假设、推断或前置命题以供论证。

groups.name: Spend & Splurge Money · 消费与挥霍金钱 (Spend, Splurge, Lavish)
groups.tip: 支出金钱或耗费资源

items.def_en: to spend or give away large amounts of money freely

items.def_zh: 勉强掏出；舍得拿出（钱款）
items.def_en: (+ sth) provide or spend money reluctantly, often under pressure
[I/T] (+ for/on) to spend a substantial amount of money, usually with reluctance
(+ sth) spend an amount of money, usually an expensive one
(+ sth) pay a large or unwelcome amount of money for something

items.def_zh: 花钱，花费；花费（时间、精力）；消耗
items.def_en: To pay out money, or use up time, effort, or resources for a particular purpose.

items.def_zh: 花钱，花费（spend的过去式与过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of spend.

items.def_zh: 挥霍；花大笔钱（在奢华物品上）
items.def_en: spend a substantial amount of money freely or extravagantly
to spend all of one's money rapidly and carelessly on temporary pleasures
to waste money, wealth, or resources foolishly and recklessly
(+ on) (informal) To spend a large amount of money extravagantly, especially on something luxurious.

groups.summary_en: An agent expends monetary resources, ranging from routine buying to excessive, self-indulgent, or unrestrained spending. Patterns include spending money on goods or splurging on luxuries.
groups.summary_zh: 个体支出金钱，从日常平稳花费到大手大脚奢靡挥霍。

groups.name: Spin & Swirl · 旋转与涡流 (Spin, Whirl, Swirl)
groups.tip: 围绕轴心打转旋动

items.def_en: (+ sth) move or cause to move around in a graceful, twisting or whirling eddying pattern
(of water, wind, or smoke) To move in a circular motion, forming a whirlpool or whirlwind.

items.def_zh: 脚尖旋转，原地轻快旋舞
items.def_en: to perform a rapid, controlled spin on one foot or on the points of the toes
