(physics, astronomy) To undergo precession; (of a rotating body's axis) to wobble or rotate slowly in a conical pattern.
(+ sb/sth) turn or cause to turn around rapidly in a full circle
rotate or spin very quickly in a circle or vortex
To move or cause to move with a twisting, circular, or spinning motion.

items.def_zh: 剧烈翻腾，搅动；搅拌（奶制黄油）；大量炮制（churn out）
items.def_en: 1. To move violently and turbulently, or agitate a liquid vigorously. 2. To shake cream in a churn to produce butter. 3. ('churn out') To produce large quantities of something rapidly.
to move in a rapidly spiraling vortex or whirlpool formation
[I/T] to rotate or turn around rapidly in a circle or spiral

items.def_zh: 旋转，回旋；（尤指跳舞时）扭动身体
items.def_en: To spin or rotate quickly in circles or spirals; to move one's body or hips in a circular motion.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe circular, vortex-like, or oscillatory fluid/rotational motion, distinguishing smooth revolving, chaotic swirling, and turbulent churning.
groups.summary_zh: 描述环状旋转、涡旋打转或伴随紊流剧烈翻滚的运动方式。

groups.name: Splash & Sluice · 飞溅与冲刷 (Slosh, Spatter, Sluice)
groups.tip: 液体晃动飞溅、喷洒或冲刷

items.def_en: (+ sth) move or cause a liquid to move violently and noisily inside or over a container or surface
move around noisily in water or another liquid, causing it to spray in all directions
to cause liquid to fly in drops by striking it, or to fall in scattered drops

items.def_zh: （使液体）晃荡飞溅，泼洒；涉（水、泥）走
items.def_en: 1. (of a liquid) To move around or splash noisily, or to make liquid do this. 2. To walk noisily or clumsily through water or mud.

items.def_zh: 用大量水冲洗；冲刷干净
items.def_en: (+ sth) clean a large surface or object thoroughly by pouring or sluicing copious water over it
to splash with continuous noisy impact, sending viscous or liquid spots everywhere
To cover someone or something with drops of liquid, mud, etc., or to fall and splash in small drops.

items.def_zh: （水或波浪）哗哗作响地冲击，冲刷；飞溅
items.def_en: (of water or waves) To splash, wash, or surge noisily against something; to pour or dash water violently.

items.def_zh: （在泥水中）扑通啪嗒地飞溅，涉水溅水
items.def_en: To splash noisily through water, mud, or another liquid.

items.def_zh: 喷洒，喷淋；（酿造中）冲洗（麦糟）
items.def_en: To spray or sprinkle a liquid; in brewing, to rinse the mashed grains with hot water to extract sugars.
1. To wash or rinse something by pouring a large quantity of water over it. 2. (of water) To pour or flow rapidly and in large amounts.

groups.summary_en: Liquids surge, strike surfaces in droplets, or are dashed/poured in volume over objects. Manner varies from noisy agitation inside vessels to violent droplet scattering, industrial distribution, and torrential washing.
groups.summary_zh: 液体晃荡溢出、以水花飞溅沾染，或引大水漫浇冲刷。

groups.name: Spoil & Pamper Excessively · 溺爱与过分姑息 (Pamper, Cosset, Mollycoddle)
groups.tip: 自我沉溺或无底线宠溺

items.def_zh: 过分呵护关照；对…小题大做娇宠
items.def_en: (+ sb) pay excessive, overprotective, or anxious attention to someone's comfort and needs
(+ sb) shower someone with excessive, uncritical love, affection, and indulgence
to treat an older person as if they were a delicate, helpless infant
to harm someone's character through excessive leniency or yielding to every wish
to treat someone with excessive luxury, comfort, and attentive care

items.def_zh: 沉溺，沉迷（于情绪或快感中）；（动物在泥水中）打滚
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To indulge excessively in an emotion, condition, or sensation. 2. (of animals) To roll about or lie in mud or water.

items.def_zh: 迎合；纵容（不良嗜好或无理要求）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) indulge or gratify weak, unreasonable, or selfish desires and demands
to protect and care for someone in an overindulgent, protective way

items.def_zh: 溺爱，宠爱（常与 on/upon 连用）；昏聩
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To be extremely and uncritically fond of someone; show excessive love and affection.

items.def_zh: 过度放纵，过度沉溺；过分溺爱，纵容
items.def_en: 1. To indulge oneself too much, especially in food or drink. 2. To give someone, especially a child, too much of what they want; spoil excessively.
(disapproving) To treat someone with excessive indulgence, care, or protection.

groups.summary_en: Treating a dependent, child, or oneself with extreme indulgence, shielding them from hardship, or lingering self-indulgently in an emotional state. Verbs contrast maternal softness, overprotection, and self-absorbed wallowing.
groups.summary_zh: 无节制地迁就、庇护溺爱他人或沉溺于自我心绪

groups.name: Stack & Arrange · 堆叠与排列 (Order, Layer, Heap)
groups.tip: 按顺序层叠或摆列整齐

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) arrange people or objects into a straight and orderly sequence
(+ sth) arrange objects neatly one on top of another in vertical layers

items.def_zh: 堆成土堆；把（土）培在……周围
items.def_en: To form into a mound or heap; to draw earth up around the roots of plants.

items.def_zh: 分层堆放，把……分层排列；用压条法培育
items.def_en: To arrange, stack, or place things in layers.
to arrange things neatly in an orderly, vertical pile
(+ sth) accumulate or gather things into a high heap or mound

items.def_zh: 排列，整理，布置；安排，筹划；改编（乐曲）
items.def_en: 1. To put things in a neat, attractive, or particular order. 2. To plan, prepare, or organize something in advance. 3. To adapt a piece of music for different instruments or voices.

items.def_zh: 按顺序排列，按次序排好；测定（基因或蛋白质等的）序列
items.def_en: 1. To arrange things in a particular order or series. 2. To determine the order of chemical components in (a gene, DNA, or protein).

items.def_zh: 堆积，叠放；拥挤，蜂拥而入（或出）
items.def_en: 1. To put things one on top of another to form a heap; to arrange in stacks. 2. To crowd or push together in a disorganized way.
to gather or place things loosely together in a large mass or mound
to arrange or organize items in progressive rows, levels, or stepped ranks

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote placing physical items or data into organized spatial arrays, stratified layers, or vertical accumulation according to a deliberate system or pattern.
groups.summary_zh: 按特定顺序、层级或空间系统将物体逐一摆放、层叠或聚积成堆。

groups.name: Store & House · 入库装桶与仓储 (Warehouse, Bin, Garage)
groups.tip: 将物资装箱并存入库房保存

items.def_en: 1. To put or pack liquid, food, or goods into barrels. 2. (informal) To move very fast in a particular direction.

items.def_zh: 存入仓（箱）中；扔进垃圾箱
items.def_en: 1. To store or put items into bins or large storage containers. 2. (informal, chiefly British) To throw something away into a rubbish bin.

items.def_zh: 把（车）存放在车库中，停入车库
items.def_en: 1. To put, keep, or store a motor vehicle in a garage.
to store grain, bulk material, or data in a silo or separate container
to place goods or equipment in a storehouse or transport base
(+ sth) pack or store goods, luggage, or equipment neatly in an allocated space
(+ sth) store or put something away safely and securely in an out-of-the-way spot
(+ sth) put items away into storage containers, boxes, or cupboards until needed again
1. To store large quantities of goods or materials in a warehouse.
to pack items into a large wooden or plastic container for transport or storage
to pack or store something carefully and neatly in a safe or compact place

groups.summary_en: An agent deposits goods, vehicles, or bulk materials into specialized storage containers, bays, or commercial facilities for safekeeping or inventory holding.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品或车辆置入专用的容器、车库或仓储设施以供保存。

groups.name: Strengthen & Consolidate · 增强与巩固 (Fortify, Shore Up, Bolster)
groups.tip: 使状态稳定牢靠、增强坚固度

items.def_en: To make or become stronger, firmer, or more effective.

items.def_zh: 使稳定，使稳固；稳住，平静下来；变得稳固
items.def_en: To make or become steady, firm, calm, or balanced.

items.def_zh: 支撑，加固（摇摇欲坠的结构、经济或体制）
items.def_en: to support or hold up something weak or failing, preventing it from collapsing
(+ sth) make something stronger, larger, or more substantial and effective
(+ sb/sth) provide physical support or financial/moral backing to keep something from collapsing
(+ sth) increase, reinforce, or strengthen something incrementally over time

items.def_zh: 加强，巩固，加固；强化（观点、感觉等）；增援
items.def_en: 1. To make a structure or material stronger. 2. To make an idea, feeling, or belief stronger. 3. To send more soldiers, equipment, or staff to strengthen a group.
1. To make a position of power, success, etc. stronger and more secure. 2. To combine several things, especially businesses or debts, into a single, more effective whole.

items.def_zh: 筑防加固；增强（体制、营养或意志）
items.def_en: to strengthen a place against attack, or to make a person, substance, or system stronger and more enduring

items.def_zh: 支撑，支持并加强（士气、信心或论点）
items.def_en: to support or strengthen something that is weak or declining, such as morale, confidence, or an argument

items.def_zh: 支撑；强力支持（论据、体系）
items.def_en: to build a buttress for support, or figuratively to lend decisive strength and credibility to a claim or institution

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to making an existing structure, position, system, or bond more robust, secure, and resilient against pressure or decline. They range from everyday physical or metaphorical reinforcement (strengthen, bolster) to formal structural stabilization and military fortifying (consolidate, shore up, fortify).
groups.summary_zh: 使既有结构、地位或力量更加稳固坚实，抵御削弱或动摇。

groups.name: Strip & Detach · 脱解与剥除 (Doff, Unpin, Debone)
groups.tip: 解开扣件或剥离外层

items.def_zh: 剥下，脱掉（紧身衣物或附着层）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove a tight layer of clothing, skin, or covering by pulling it away
(+ sth) to remove a piece of clothing or an accessory from one's body
[I/T] To open or release a clasp, buckle, or grip
[I/T] To undo the buttons of a garment
[I/T] To make or become loose, open, or unattached by undoing a fastening
(dated or formal) To remove or take off an item of clothing, especially a hat as a greeting or sign of respect.

items.def_zh: 拔掉……的别针（或大头针）；解开，拔去销子
items.def_en: To unfasten, detach, or free something by removing pins.

items.def_zh: 拉开……的门闩，启开；去除障碍
items.def_en: To remove a bar or fastenings from a door, gate, or window; unlock.

items.def_zh: 脱去（全部或大部分衣物）；剥去
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove all or most of one's clothes, or peel away an outer covering
To remove the bones from meat, poultry, or fish.
To remove the internal organs and entrails of an animal before cooking

groups.summary_en: An agent removes a fastener, garment, bone, or barrier from an entity to free it, open it, or prepare it for consumption/use.
groups.summary_zh: 解除扣件、除去衣帽障碍或剔除体内特定部件以使其脱解。

groups.name: Stumble & Hobble · 蹒跚与跛行 (Totter, Dodder, Hobble)
groups.tip: 步伐不稳、摇晃或跛行的走法

items.def_en: to walk lamely or with a favoring of one leg because of injury or disability

items.def_zh: 拖着脚慢吞吞地走；蹒跚慢行
items.def_en: to walk with a slow, heavy, shuffling, and awkward motion

items.def_zh: （如鸭子般）摇摇摆摆地走，蹒跚而行
items.def_en: (+ along/away) To walk with short steps while swaying clumsily from side to side like a duck.
(+ along/around) To walk or stand unsteadily as if about to fall; to be close to collapsing.
(+ along/around) To walk slowly and unsteadily with small trembling steps, especially from old age.

items.def_zh: 一瘸一拐地走；艰难前行
items.def_en: to walk slowly and with difficulty because one leg or foot is injured
to walk unsteadily and awkwardly, tripping or nearly falling frequently

items.def_zh: 踉踉跄跄地走；摇摇晃晃地前行
items.def_en: to walk in an unsteady, staggering manner, especially due to weakness or age
to trip or momentarily lose balance while walking, or to walk unsteadily
to walk with a limp or in an awkward, halting way because of injured or sore feet or legs

items.def_zh: 跛行，一瘸一拐地走；用镶边带装饰
items.def_en: 1. (informal, offensive) To walk with a limp. 2. To trim or edge with gimp cord.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe walking with an unsteady, awkward, or labored gait owing to infirmity, injury, old age, or natural body mechanics. They differ by manner: side-to-side duck-like movement, trembling fragility, halting limp, or acute loss of balance.
groups.summary_zh: 因身体虚弱、伤病或体型原因导致的步履不稳、跛行或颤巍行走。

groups.name: Support & Champion · 支持与拥护 (Support, Endorse, Champion)
groups.tip: 从赞同到出资力挺

items.def_zh: 团结在……周围支持，齐心相助
items.def_en: (+ sb) to unite and come together to give help and support to someone in a difficult situation
(+ sb/sth) to give loyal support or backing to someone or their decision

items.def_zh: 支持，拥护，资助；（使）后退，倒退
items.def_en: 1. To give financial, material, or moral support to someone or something. 2. To move backward or cause something to move backward.
To formally support or endorse a proposal, motion, or candidate in a meeting or debate.

items.def_zh: 支持，拥护；支撑；赡养，供养；证实
items.def_en: 1. To encourage, assist, or advocate for someone or something. 2. To hold up the weight of something; to provide financial maintenance for someone.
(+ with/against) To support or ally oneself with one person or group in an argument or dispute.
To help something develop, progress, or be successful; advance.
to declare one's public, official approval or support of someone or something
to choose to adopt, take up, or support an idea, belief, or cause
(+ sb/sth) to defend or support someone or something that is being criticized or attacked
to vigorously fight for, defend, or advocate on behalf of a person or cause

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote lending approval, practical assistance, or public backing to a person, cause, motion, or proposal, ranging from passive alignment to aggressive advocacy.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对人、动议或事业的赞成、声援、支持与极力拥护。

groups.name: Suppress & Thwart · 镇压与阻截 (Block, Quell, Crush)
groups.tip: 阻挠行动并强势压制

items.def_en: To prevent movement through something, or to stop an action, process, or opponent from making progress.

items.def_zh: 使陷入绝境，逼入困境；（把动物等）赶上树
items.def_en: To drive someone into a desperate situation or corner from which they cannot escape; to force an animal up a tree.

items.def_zh: 挫败，阻挠；使沮丧，使懊恼
items.def_en: 1. To prevent someone's plans, efforts, or desires from succeeding. 2. To cause someone to feel annoyed or impatient by hindering progress.
to prevent something from developing, functioning, or being expressed freely

items.def_zh: 强行压制，实行严厉限制
items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to take forceful and restrictive action to stop or control illicit activities
(+ on sb/sth) to take severe disciplinary or punitive measures against someone or something
(+ sth) to eliminate or suppress something unwanted or rebellious completely by force

items.def_zh: 镇压，压垮，击溃；压碎，碾碎
items.def_en: 1. To use force to suppress or defeat a rebellion, opposition, or spirit completely. 2. To press or squeeze something hard so that it breaks or loses shape.

items.def_zh: 镇压，平定；抑制，忍住；查禁，隐瞒
items.def_en: 1. To end something, such as a protest or rebellion, by using force or authority. 2. To prevent an emotion, reaction, or information from being expressed or revealed.
to suppress or extinguish an uprising, expression, or activity completely
to suppress or extinguish disorder, rebellion, or intense feelings by force

groups.summary_en: An authority or opposing agent forcefully restricts, neutralizes, or suffocates an adversary, uprising, or plan, progressing from spatial blockage and strategic disruption to coercive, violent pacification.
groups.summary_zh: 从空间物理设障到策略挫败，再到强力压制与粉碎。

groups.name: Surprise & Astound · 惊奇与震撼 (Surprise, Astonish, Stun)
groups.tip: 从出乎意料到目瞪口呆的吃惊程度

items.def_en: (+ sb) to surprise or startle someone so much that they are momentarily uncertain how to react

items.raw_cluster: 使惊奇与震惊 Surprise & Astound
items.def_zh: 使惊奇，使感到意外；突袭
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone to feel wonder, astonished, or caught off guard by an unexpected event. 2. To come upon or attack someone without warning.
to surprise someone very greatly with something difficult to believe

items.def_zh: 使极其震惊；令……佩服得五体投地
items.def_en: (+ sb) to astonish, impress, or shock someone deeply

items.def_zh: 使大吃一惊，使震撼得不知所措
items.def_en: (+ sb) to surprise, astonish, or overwhelm someone immensely

items.raw_cluster: 使惊奇与震惊 Surprise & Astound
items.def_en: To surprise someone very much, especially by being extraordinarily impressive or unexpected.

items.def_zh: 使彻底震惊，使目瞪口呆；击倒
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To surprise, shock, or confuse someone so thoroughly that they do not know what to say or do. 2. To knock someone down to the ground.

items.def_zh: 使震惊，使感到惊愕；使触电
items.def_en: 1. To surprise and upset someone greatly with something unpleasant, offensive, or startling. 2. To give an electric shock to someone.

items.def_zh: 使目瞪口呆，使震惊而发懵
items.def_en: to shock or surprise someone so intensely that they are temporarily unable to think or speak
to shock or surprise someone so much that they are unable to react quickly

items.def_zh: 使目瞪口呆，使彻底惊呆
items.def_en: to overwhelm someone with astonishment to the point of complete disbelief

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an unexpected event or revelation striking someone mentally, ranging from mild unexpectedness to overwhelming speechlessness or cognitive paralysis.
groups.summary_zh: 描述出乎意料的事物对人造成心理冲击，从轻微意外到震惊失语。

groups.name: Talk Incessantly or Trivially · 闲聊与唠叨 (Chatter, Babble, Yap)
groups.tip: 嘴碎胡扯东拉西扯，喋喋不休说空话废话

items.def_en: to talk rapidly and continuously about unimportant things

items.def_zh: 东拉西扯；漫无边际地聊
items.def_en: (+ on/about) to talk for a long time in a confused and disorganised way

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休，胡言乱语；牙牙学语；（溪水等）潺潺作响
items.def_en: 1. To talk quickly, foolishly, or incoherently. 2. To make the quiet continuous murmuring sound of a baby or a stream.
1. To talk continuously and annoyingly about unimportant things. 2. (of a small dog) To bark in a sharp, high-pitched way.
To talk for a long time in a silly, rambling, or nonsensical way.
(+ about/on) to talk at length in a foolish or inconsequential manner

items.def_zh: 唠唠叨叨，单调乏味地长篇大论
items.def_en: to talk for a long time in a monotonous and boring tone

items.def_zh: 絮絮叨叨，漫无边际地瞎扯
items.def_en: to talk for a long time in an aimless, confusing, or disorganized way
to talk rapidly, continuously, and casually about unimportant matters
To talk continuously and trivially, especially for a long time.

items.def_zh: 叽里呱啦地说；急促含混地说话
items.def_en: to talk rapidly, excitedly, and unintelligibly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict speakers talking rapidly, incessantly, and casually about trivial or nonsensical matters, often annoying listeners.
groups.summary_zh: 喋喋不休、琐碎无聊地闲扯或唠叨，常含厌烦色彩。

groups.name: Thwack & Whomp · 钝击与重打 (Thwack, Whomp, Drub)
groups.tip: 模拟不同声响与力道的拍击殴打

items.def_zh: 敲打，碰击，轻击（尤指打在头上）；（英，俚）与……发生性关系
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To hit or bump against something, especially on the head. 2. (British informal) To have sexual intercourse with someone. 3. (endurance sports) To suffer sudden extreme exhaustion.
to hit somebody or something violently with a sharp, noisy, cracking blow
to hit someone or something heavily with a fist or heavy object, making a dull sound

items.def_zh: （用扁平物）砰然敲击，使劲拍打，重打
items.def_en: To hit someone or something hard with a flat object, making a loud, sharp slapping sound.
(+ sb) to strike someone repeatedly and violently, inflicting physical injury
(+ sb) to attack someone forcefully with heavy blows
(+ sb) to strike someone repeatedly with hard, violent blows
to hit someone or something with tremendous, uncoordinated blunt force
(informal) to strike someone or something very hard, inflicting severe damage

items.def_zh: （用棍棒）痛打，殴打；彻底击溃，重创
items.def_en: 1. To beat or thrash someone thoroughly, especially with a stick. 2. (informal) To defeat an opponent heavily in a game, contest, or fight.
1. (informal) To hit someone or something heavily with a loud thud. 2. (informal) To defeat an opponent decisively.

groups.summary_en: An agent forcefully strikes a surface or opponent with a flat or heavy blunt implement, producing a distinctive dull or loud smacking sound and causing substantial impact.
groups.summary_zh: 用钝器、手掌或重物沉重击打或拍打，发出钝响并造成强力冲击。

groups.name: Tolerate & Endure · 容忍与忍受 (Tolerate, Endure, Brook)
groups.tip: 克制不满，默默承受逆境痛苦

items.def_zh: 忍受，经受（常与 can/cannot 连用）
items.def_en: (informal, usually negative) to endure or tolerate someone or something frustrating or disagreeable

items.def_zh: 承受，担负（痛苦、悲伤或压力）
items.def_en: to accept, tolerate, or endure heavy pain, misfortune, or emotional strain
1. (usually in negative) To accept, tolerate, or bear something unpleasant. 2. (usually in negative) To eat or digest something without feeling sick.

items.def_zh: 忍耐，忍受（令人厌烦之人或事）
items.def_en: (informal) to tolerate or accept an unpleasant person or situation without complaining

items.def_zh: 忍住，经受住（苦难或悲痛）
items.def_en: to remain brave, resolute, or capable of enduring great hardship or grief

items.def_zh: 硬着头皮熬过，咬牙忍受
items.def_en: (+ sth) to endure an extremely difficult or unpleasant experience with fortitude
(+ sth) to endure a painful or difficult situation until the end

items.def_zh: 容忍，忍受，容许（通常用于否定句）
items.def_en: (formal, usually in negative) To tolerate or allow something, especially dissent, interference, or delay.

items.def_zh: 忍受，忍耐，经受；持久，持续
items.def_en: 1. To suffer or undergo pain, hardship, or difficulty patiently. 2. To continue to exist or last for a long time.

items.def_zh: 容忍，忍受；容许，放任；耐受（药物、恶劣环境等）
items.def_en: 1. To allow or accept behavior, beliefs, or conditions that one dislikes without protesting. 2. To bear or endure pain, hardship, or an unpleasant situation. 3. (biology/medicine) To be able to withstand a substance or condition without adverse effects.

items.def_zh: 容忍，受得住（常用于否定句或疑问句）
items.def_en: (mostly in negative/questions with 'can/could') to tolerate or accept someone or something unpleasant

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict bearing, accepting, or enduring unpleasant behaviors, physical hardship, pain, or objectionable demands without outward rebellion or rejection. They range from everyday passive allowance (tolerate, put up with) to gut-level acceptance (stomach) and austere refusal to permit opposition (brook, usually negative).
groups.summary_zh: 在面对逆境、冒犯或不快时加以容受与忍耐，不予反抗或制止。

groups.name: Torment & Persecute · 折磨与迫害 (Harass, Afflict, Martyr)
groups.tip: 身心遭受严刑拷打与摧残

items.def_en: to trouble, worry, or annoy someone repeatedly with intrusive demands or unpleasantness
(+ sb) to single someone out for unfair, cruel, or harassing treatment
(+ sb) to direct intense criticism, harassment, or hostility exclusively at someone
to cause serious physical or mental pain and suffering to someone
(+ sb) to unite as a group to harass, attack, or bully a single target
1. To cause someone or something continual distress, trouble, or suffering over a long period. 2. To annoy or bother someone persistently.
to deliberately cause persistent severe physical or mental suffering to someone
1. To treat someone cruelly and unfairly over a long period, especially because of their race, religion, or political beliefs. 2. To harass or torment someone persistently.
to cause continuous trouble, worry, or distress to someone or something.

items.def_zh: 拷打，折磨，使剧烈痛苦；曲解
items.def_en: 1. to deliberately inflict severe pain on someone as a punishment or to force them to reveal information. 2. to cause someone extreme mental or physical suffering.

items.def_zh: 残酷对待，残暴折磨；使残忍，使麻木不仁
items.def_en: 1. to treat someone with extreme cruelty and violence. 2. to make someone violent, cruel, or callous.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote subjecting a victim to sustained physical agony, targeted systematic oppression, or severe psychological harassment, scaling up to extreme, agonizing cruelty.
groups.summary_zh: 持续给受害者施加精神重压、系统性政治宗教迫害或残暴肉体酷刑折磨。

groups.name: Transport & Convey · 运送与传送 (Transport, Convey, Teleport)
groups.tip: 通过载具或人力转移物体

items.def_zh: 往返穿梭运送；往返穿梭
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to transport or travel frequently between two specific destinations
(+ sb/sth) to transport someone or something instantaneously via an energy beam
(+ sb/sth) to convey people or cargo across a body of water or gap

items.def_zh: 渡运；来回穿梭运送（人或车）
items.def_en: to carry or transport people or goods on regular short journeys across water or space
to transport or carry goods or passengers from one place to another along a route
to travel or transport someone back and forth frequently between two set locations
(historical or literary) To convey or carry someone or something in a chariot.

items.def_zh: 开车运送，为……当司机；开车
items.def_en: To drive someone in a car, especially as a hired driver or as a favor.
(science fiction) To transport a person or object instantaneously across space without physical travel.

items.def_zh: 派遣，运送，发送；迅速处理
items.def_en: (chiefly UK) To send someone or something somewhere quickly for a particular purpose; to deal with or finish a task rapidly.

items.def_zh: 空运（尤指在紧急或险要地带）
items.def_en: to transport people, medical supplies, or provisions by aircraft in an emergency

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote moving passengers, goods, or messages from one destination to another across physical or conceptual space using specific transport roles, logistical channels, or instantaneous sci-fi transfer.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过专职载具、护送角色、物流派发或即时传送机制运送人员或货物。

groups.name: Transport & Convey · 运送与转运 (Ship, Ferry, Airlift)
groups.tip: 通过交通工具转移

items.def_zh: （用船、飞机、卡车等）运送，运输；装运；上市，交付
items.def_en: to send or transport goods by ship, plane, train, or truck

items.def_zh: 运出，装运发货；（人员）乘船/飞机出发
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to send goods or transport personnel away by sea, air, or freight
(+ sb/sth) to bring supplies, cargo, or personnel into a place by aircraft
(+ sb/sth) to convey or haul goods or prisoners away, especially roughly or abruptly
to pull or transport large quantities of materials or cargo over long distances
(nautical) to transport cargo using a lighter (flat-bottomed barge)

items.def_zh: （乘船或机动车）运送，摆渡；往返运送
items.def_en: To transport people, vehicles, or goods regularly by boat or other vehicle, especially across a short distance.
to transport heavy or cumbersome items in a cart or vehicle, often with effort
to transport bulk commercial goods by water, air, train, or truck

items.def_zh: （尤指在紧急情况下）空运，飞机疏散
items.def_en: To transport people or supplies by aircraft, especially in an emergency or during a conflict.
To transport commercial cargo or goods by aircraft.

groups.summary_en: Freight, passengers, or emergency supplies are conveyed between locations via specialized modes of transport such as watercraft, aircraft, or intermediate feeder vessels. Verbs vary by the vehicle, navigational medium, and operational urgency.
groups.summary_zh: 运用舟楫、航空器等特定载具进行货物与人员转运。

groups.name: Trivial & Foolish Prattle · 琐碎与愚蠢的唠叨 (Prattle, Prate, Blabber)
groups.tip: 语速飞快且口齿不清地嘟囔唠叨

items.def_zh: 含糊不清地碎碎念，絮叨个不停
items.def_en: to speak rapidly, continuously, and incoherently or foolishly

items.def_zh: 童言无忌地唠叨；天真琐碎地扯个没完
items.def_en: to talk at length in a foolish, trivial, or childish way
to talk rapidly, foolishly, or incoherently, uttering meaningless syllables

items.def_zh: 闲聊，喋喋不休，瞎扯（像小孩般没完没了地说琐事）
items.def_en: To talk foolishly and continuously for a long time about unimportant things.
(Scottish / Northern English) To gossip, chat idly, or talk foolishly.

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休地胡扯，信口开河
items.def_en: to talk foolishly, incoherently, or indiscreetly for an extended period
to talk foolishly, senselessly, or childishly
to talk long-windedly without making much sense

items.def_zh: 急促而含糊地说话，喋喋不休；叽里呱啦地说
items.def_en: To talk very rapidly, excitedly, and indistinctly so that it is difficult to understand.

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休，信口开河；走漏风声
items.def_en: (informal) To talk foolishly or excessively without stopping, often letting out secrets.

items.def_zh: 唠叨，空谈，高谈阔论，瞎扯
items.def_en: (dated / disapproving) To talk foolishly and at great length about trivial matters.

groups.summary_en: Verbs highlighting the inconsequential, silly, childish, or indiscreet nature of continuous and senseless vocal chatter.
groups.summary_zh: 无节制、空洞可笑、幼稚或泄露秘密的愚蠢喋喋不休。

groups.name: Unite & Ally · 结盟与联合 (Band together, Confederate, Ally)
groups.tip: 各方聚结形成同盟

items.def_zh: 联合，集合（常与 together 连用）；用棍棒击打
items.def_en: 1. ('club together') To join together with other people to do or pay for something. 2. To hit someone or something with a heavy club or blunt weapon.
To join together in an alliance or league with someone or another group.

items.def_zh: 联合，团结（常与 together 连用）；给……绑上带子（或环）
items.def_en: 1. ('band together') To unite or form a group in order to achieve a common purpose. 2. To put a band or strap on something.
[I/T] (+ with) To combine resources or enter into a formal mutual-defense or supportive pact
(+ with) To join together with someone to perform a specific task
To unite as a group in order to resist an adversary or achieve a shared aim
to combine efforts or resources with someone else to achieve a common goal
(+ with sb) to connect or combine with an ally to act together
(+ with sb) to form a partnership or team with another person or entity
(formal) To bring states, groups, or people into an alliance, or to form an alliance.
[I/T] To organize into or join a formal political federation or governing league

groups.summary_en: Parties, states, or individuals combine forces, form a coalition, or unite their resources to achieve a common goal or defend shared interests.
groups.summary_zh: 个人、团体或政体为共同目标结成同盟或组合联队。

groups.name: Walk & Trudge · 步行与跋涉 (Walk, Wade, Trudge)
groups.tip: 双脚着地步态各异

items.def_zh: （行走或站立时）脚尖朝向；用脚尖触碰（或踢）
items.def_en: 1. To walk or stand with the toes pointing in a specified direction. 2. To touch, reach, or kick with the toes.

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地向前走，迈着沉重步伐赶路
items.def_en: to walk slowly, heavily, and with weary steps over a distance
to continue walking slowly and heavily due to great fatigue or adverse conditions

items.def_zh: 蹚（水、泥等），跋涉；艰难费力地处理（wade through）
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/into/across) To walk with effort through water, mud, or deep snow. 2. ('wade through') To read or work slowly through something tedious.
1. To step or walk on, in, or along something. 2. To press, crush, or injure by stepping on.
[I/T] to walk heavily or noisily, or to travel over long distances on foot

items.def_zh: （因疲劳、负重而）步履艰难地走，沉重慢行
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/along/up) To walk slowly and with heavy, tired steps, especially through mud, snow, or uphill.

items.def_zh: 沉重而缓慢地迈步，步履蹒跚地走
items.def_en: to walk slowly and with heavy, labored steps, typically from weariness

items.def_zh: 在（泥淖、雨雪中）艰难跋涉
items.def_en: (+ sth) to walk laboriously through mud, snow, or tough terrain
1. (+ across/through/to) To make a long, difficult journey on foot, especially across wild country.
(+ through) to walk or make one's way with difficulty through mud, deep snow, or rough terrain

groups.summary_en: This frame characterizes methods of terrestrial foot locomotion constrained by physical drag, difficult substrates (mud, water, snow), or exhaustive fatigue.
groups.summary_zh: 因地形阻力（水、泥、冰雪）或体力耗竭而形成的艰难步态。

groups.name: Wander, Stray & Roam · 漫步、漫游与漂泊迷失 (Wander, Stray & Roam)
groups.tip: 无特定目的地信步漫游

items.def_zh: 随波逐流；漫无目的地走动
items.def_en: to move aimlessly, slowly, or passively from one place or situation to another
(+ sth) to travel or move through an area freely without a specific destination
(+ sth) to wander away or deviate from the proper route, place, or group

items.def_zh: 漫步走开，走失，溜达离开
items.def_en: to walk away aimlessly from a group, designated area, or established path

items.def_zh: 闲逛，漫游；神气活现地走动
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly British) To move or wander about in a relaxed, carefree, or dramatic manner.

items.def_zh: 走散，走失，离开；偏离（主题等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/into) To wander away from a group, path, or place where one should remain. 2. To move away from the main subject or point.
1. To walk or travel around a large area without a fixed purpose or direction.

items.def_zh: 踱步，巡行，漫步走过（正式）
items.def_en: to walk through or around an area in a leisurely, deliberate, or inspectional manner
to walk for pleasure across countryside without a strict predetermined route

items.def_zh: 漫步，闲逛；（河流、道路等）蜿蜒曲折
items.def_en: 1. To walk slowly and without a clear direction. 2. (of a river, road, etc.) To follow a winding, turning course.

items.def_zh: 漫游，漫步，流浪；（目光）转动，环顾
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To travel or wander across an area without a fixed destination. 2. (of eyes) To look in all directions.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict moving without a fixed destination, deviating from a course, or traversing large spaces casually or aimlessly. They differentiate between aimless meandering, deviation from safety, ostentatious wandering, and wide-ranging roaming.
groups.summary_zh: 无固定目的地或偏离路线的漫行、流浪、漫游或四处游荡。

groups.name: Wobble & Sway · 摆荡与失衡晃动 (Unstable, Oscillating Motion)
groups.tip: 失去平衡或左右摇摆震颤

items.def_en: to swing back and forth rhythmically across a central axis
to walk or move with shaky, unsteady steps as if about to fall
To move or cause to move with short, quick movements from side to side or up and down.
to suddenly change direction or swerve away from a straight path
to move unsteadily from side to side in an uncontrolled manner

items.def_zh: 突然转向；猛打方向变道
items.def_en: [I/T] to change direction abruptly, often while moving fast

items.def_zh: 摇晃，踉跄；摇摇欲坠，处于岌岌可危的境地
items.def_en: To stand, move, or balance unsteadily; to be on the edge of falling or collapse.

items.def_zh: （车尾或机尾）摆尾，甩尾，左右摆动
items.def_en: (of a vehicle or aircraft) To slide or swing the rear end wildly from side to side out of control.
(of a voice) To shake or tremble unsteadily because of fear, emotion, or age; to utter with a trembling voice.
to stand or balance unsteadily on the brink or edge of something, threatening to fall

items.def_zh: 疾驰颠簸，摇晃狂奔；（船只）倾侧
items.def_en: 1. To rush forward swiftly and erratically, swaying or tilting from side to side out of control. 2. (nautical) To tilt a ship onto its side for cleaning or repair.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail non-linear physical instability, including erratic vehicle swerving, unsteady balance teetering on an edge, and vibratory vocal/physical trembling.
groups.summary_zh: 描述物体或肢体失衡、左右摆动、偏航甩尾或颤巍颤抖的不稳定动态方式。

groups.name: Write & Compose · 书写与创作 (Pen, Draft, Inscribe)
groups.tip: 动笔书写形成文字篇章

items.def_en: to write something down quickly and briefly
to write something on paper so that you remember or document it
to record thoughts, words, or facts in writing for formal preservation

items.def_zh: （用手）写字，印上字母；用字母标明
items.def_en: To write or mark letters on something by hand or with a special tool.
to prepare a preliminary version of a piece of writing or document

items.def_zh: 动笔写，写作；关入栏中，圈养
items.def_en: 1. To write or compose something by hand. 2. To shut up or enclose animals or people in a pen or small space.
to write or formulate text, speech, or music with careful thought

items.def_zh: 快速炮制出（草稿或文稿）
items.def_en: to produce a piece of writing, draft, or creative work rapidly and informally
To write or be the author of a book, article, report, or other work.
To write the script for a film, play, television show, or speech.
to write or carve words or symbols formally onto a surface or in a book

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the physical or intellectual act of writing, drafting, or formally setting down text in letters, documents, or literary works.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理书写或构思撰写文本、书信或文学著作的创作方式与手段。

groups.name: Accumulate & Amass · 积聚与累积 (Accumulate, Amass, Accrue)
groups.tip: 随着时间推移聚沙成塔渐增

items.def_en: [I/T] to increase gradually in amount, pressure, or size
[I/T] to accumulate in a growing, often disorganized heap or quantity

items.def_zh: 积欠，迅速积累（债务、账单等）
items.def_en: to allow a large amount of debt, bills, or arrears to accumulate rapidly

items.def_zh: 累积获得（分数、利润、债务等）
items.def_en: to gradually collect, achieve, or amass an impressive or large total quantity of something
to accumulate and store large quantities of goods or supplies for future use
[I/T] to collect, gather, or increase gradually in quantity over time
[I/T] to amass and store away valued goods greedily or secretly
1. To collect or accumulate a large amount of wealth, information, or objects over time.

items.def_zh: （利益、利息等）自然增加，逐渐累积；生息
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/from) (finance / formal) To accumulate or increase gradually over a period of time, especially of interest, benefits, or debts.
1. To accumulate an excessive amount of unfinished work, orders, or tasks that need to be processed.

groups.summary_en: Quantities of material goods, money, interest, or unresolved tasks collect and build up gradually over time, either deliberately through collection or incrementally by natural progression.
groups.summary_zh: 资金、物资或未结事务随时间逐渐累积增长或汇聚堆积。

groups.name: Administer Medicine & Immunize · 给药与免疫注射 (Medicate, Dose, Vaccinate)
groups.tip: 按剂量给药以治疗病症

items.def_zh: 给……服药，配药；服药；在……中掺入（化学品）
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To give a measured amount of medicine or a drug to someone. 2. To add a chemical or substance to something.
(archaic) to administer medicine or purges to a person or animal
to give someone or oneself substantial doses of medicine to treat an ailment
to inject a recipient with a vaccine or medication using a hypodermic needle

items.def_zh: 给……大剂量灌注（药物/镇静剂）
items.def_en: to continuously administer large amounts of medicine, drugs, or fluids into someone's body

items.def_zh: 给……下药（或服用兴奋剂、镇静剂）；服用兴奋剂；吸毒
items.def_en: 1. To give medicine, a sedative, or performance-enhancing drugs to a person or animal. 2. (informal) To take illegal recreational drugs or doping substances.

items.def_zh: 给……接种疫苗，给……打预防针
items.def_en: 1. (+ against) To inject a person or animal with a vaccine to protect against a disease.
to treat a patient or condition with medicinal substances

items.def_zh: 给……接种疫苗；给……预防注射
items.def_en: to treat an individual with a vaccine or antigenic substance to produce immunity against a disease

items.def_zh: 使免疫；给……接种以产生免疫力
items.def_en: to make someone immune to an infectious illness, especially by vaccination

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame encompasses administering therapeutic substances, pharmaceuticals, or immunizing biologics to human or animal recipients. Verbs distinguish between routine pharmacological dosing (dose, medicate), prophylactic antibody induction (vaccinate, inoculate), and illicit drug administration (dope).
groups.summary_zh: 指给人体或动物施用药物、计量配药、接种疫苗或违禁给药的医疗/生理行为。

groups.name: Admire & Worship · 敬佩与崇拜 (Admire, Venerate, Worship)
groups.tip: 从由衷赞赏上升为狂热神化膜拜

items.def_en: to regard someone or something with respect, pleasure, and approval
(+ sb) have great respect and admiration for someone regarded as an exemplar
to feel deep respect, veneration, or awe for someone or something
(+ at) To be filled with wonder, astonishment, or deep admiration.
To respect and admire someone or something greatly.

items.def_zh: 崇奉，膜拜（因圣洁或智慧）
items.def_en: to regard with profound and solemn respect, often associated with sanctity or antiquity
(+ sb/sth) display deep reverence, worship, or absolute submission to someone or a deity

items.def_zh: 崇拜，敬奉；崇拜，爱慕；做礼拜
items.def_en: 1. To show deep reverence and adoration for a deity or sacred object. 2. To admire, love, or venerate someone intensely.

items.def_zh: 把……当作偶像崇拜，极度崇拜
items.def_en: To admire, revere, or love someone or something to an excessive degree.

items.def_zh: 奉为神明，神化，极度推崇
items.def_en: To treat or worship someone or something as a god; to idolize.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers affective evaluations of profound respect and reverence, progressing from intellectual high regard and wonder to complete adulation and divine attribution.
groups.summary_zh: 从内心的赞赏敬重逐步递进到狂热崇拜乃至神格化奉若神明。

groups.name: Affirm & Formalize · 确认与正式化证明 (Confirm, Validate, Attest)
groups.tip: 提供证据以核实查证

items.def_en: to state definitively that something is true, or make an arrangement certain
to tell someone that you have received something they sent, such as a letter or payment
to give official or formal approval to an agreement, statement, or document
to assert, confirm, or give personal assurance about the truth, accuracy, or integrity of something or someone
to support, confirm, or substantiate a claim, fact, or prediction

items.def_zh: 作证，提供证词；证实，证明，表明
items.def_en: 1. To make a formal statement of what is true, especially in a court of law. 2. (+ to) To show, confirm, or give clear evidence that something is true.

items.def_zh: 开具收据，在（账单等上）注明已收到或已付讫；确认收到
items.def_en: To mark a bill or invoice as paid, or to write or issue an official receipt acknowledging payment or receipt of goods.
to check or prove the validity or accuracy of something, especially formally or legally
(+ to) to declare or show firmly that something is true, genuine, or authentic
To confirm something again, such as a booking, flight, or agreement, to ensure it is definite.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing formal acknowledgment, legal testimony, or administrative re-verification of receipt, agreements, or established statements.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法律作证、回执确认或再度核准来确证事实、交易或陈述的有效性。

groups.name: Aggregate & Cohere · 聚合与凝结 (Flocculate, Agglomerate, Agglutinate)
groups.tip: 微小颗粒或纤维凝结成块

items.def_zh: （使纤维等）聚结成毡，缠结；制成毛毡
items.def_en: To mat or compress fibers together into felt, or to become matted and compacted together.
[I/T] (+ together) To form into or collect into a compact mass or cluster
to hold or fuse individual components firmly into a cohesive physical unit
to form into a dense mass or cluster, or cause individual particles to adhere together
to tangle or press fibers and particles together into a thick, felted mass
[I/T] To solidify or coagulate, especially by cooling
[I/T] To change from a fluid into a thickened, semi-solid mass
To collect, cluster, or gather together into a dense mass or ball.
1. (biology) To clump or stick together into a mass, as red blood cells or bacteria. 2. (linguistics) To combine morphemes into words.
To form or cause to form into aggregate clumps or fluffy tufts, especially fine particles suspended in a liquid.

groups.summary_en: Individual particles, suspended solids, or distinct matter clump, bind, or mat together into clusters, masses, or larger physical matrices.
groups.summary_zh: 微细颗粒或纤维物聚团、黏连或絮凝成致密结构。

groups.name: Alighting & Vehicle Disembarkation · 下车与离机下船 (Disembark, Alight, Dismount)
groups.tip: 自载具或空中降落停驻

items.def_en: to leave a vehicle or platform by taking a step downward

items.def_zh: 下火车；使（部队等）下火车
items.def_en: to leave or cause passengers to leave a railway train

items.def_zh: 从（公交车、火车、飞机、船等）下来
items.def_en: to exit or disembark from a bus, train, aircraft, or ship

items.def_zh: 跳下（自行车、马匹、公共汽车等）
items.def_en: to step or jump lightly off a vehicle, conveyance, or animal

items.def_zh: 从（马背、高大车辆）爬下，下来
items.def_en: to descend carefully from an elevated vehicle, carriage, or steed to the ground

items.def_zh: （鸟或昆虫）飞落，栖息；（从公共汽车、火车等）下来，下车
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/upon) (of a bird or insect) To land and rest on something. 2. (+ from) (formal) To step down or get off a bus, train, or other vehicle.
1. (+ from) (formal) To leave a ship, aircraft, or train at the end of a journey.

items.def_zh: 下马，下车（自行车、摩托车等）；拆卸
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To get down off a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle. 2. To remove something from its support or frame.
to disembark from an airplane after landing
to leave a ship or aircraft and go ashore

groups.summary_en: This motion frame depicts an agent exiting and stepping down from a conveyance, animal mount, or craft to the ground or platform. Verbs split along vehicle type and stylistic register: dismount for steeds and two-wheelers, disembark for passenger ships and aircraft, step down/off for public transport, and the literary alight for alighting onto a surface.
groups.summary_zh: 乘客或骑手脱离交通工具（车辆、船舶、飞机或坐骑）走下踏足地面的过程。

groups.name: Align & Order · 整饬与配列 (Neaten, Disarrange, Parallelize)
groups.tip: 调整次序使规整或紊乱

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a place or collection of things neat and orderly
(+ sth) to put things into their proper places and make an area neat
[I/T] (+ out/up) To make neat, orderly, or tidy by adjusting alignment
[I/T] (+ up) To bring order and neatness to a place or group of items
(+ up) To make a room, desk, or appearance neat and tidy.
(+ sth) to make something untidy, disordered, or dirty
[I/T] To arrange things in a straight line or into correct relative position

items.def_zh: 弄乱，扰乱，打乱（次序或布局）
items.def_en: To disturb the neat order or arrangement of something.

items.def_zh: 使平行，平行排列；（计算中）使并行化
items.def_en: 1. To arrange in a parallel order or direction. 2. (computing) To divide a computational task so that parts run simultaneously across multiple processors.

items.def_zh: 扰乱，破坏（原有的排列或秩序）
items.def_en: To throw into confusion or completely disturb the normal order and arrangement of

groups.summary_en: An agent imposes geometric order, neat alignment, or intentional disruption upon physical items. Verbs describe precise physical arrangement into tidy arrays or, conversely, disturbing that spatial order.
groups.summary_zh: 整理、顺应几何方向配列物品，或打乱既有整齐秩序。

groups.name: Animal Vocalization & Mimicry · 动物啼鸣与仿声 (Purr, Bray, Mew)
groups.tip: 如驴般刺耳长鸣，粗厉高声啼叫

items.def_zh: （猫）发出呼噜声；（机器等）发出平稳低沉的运转声；娇声低语
items.def_en: 1. (of a cat) To make a low, continuous vibrating sound showing contentment. 2. (of an engine or machine) To make a soft, smooth, continuous sound. 3. To speak in a soft, low, pleasant voice.

items.def_zh: （动物或人发出尖细的声音）啼叫，尖声插话
items.def_en: Begin to speak or make a high-pitched cry or chirping sound
[I/T] make a short, high-pitched sound characteristic of small birds or insects
1. (of a cuckoo bird) To make its characteristic two-note call. 2. To repeat something constantly like a cuckoo.

items.def_zh: （猫、海鸥等）咪咪叫，鸣叫；轻声哀啼
items.def_en: (of a cat, kitten, or gull) To make a characteristic high-pitched, soft cry.

items.def_zh: （蛙、鸦等）发出低哑叫声；哑声说
items.def_en: [I/T] make a rough low sound, like the sound a frog or crow makes

items.def_zh: 厉声喊出，像吠叫般发出短促声音
items.def_en: (+ sth) Utter a command, order, or sound abruptly and harshly, like a dog
[I/T] emit a sharp, explosive cry characteristic of a dog or shout harshly
utter the high-pitched, whinnying cry characteristic of a horse

items.def_zh: （驴）嘶叫；粗声大叫，刺耳地大笑
items.def_en: 1. (of a donkey) To make its loud, harsh cry. 2. (disapproving) To speak or laugh in a loud, harsh, and unpleasant way.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the acoustic production of characteristic animal sounds, expressing particular emotional states (purr for feline contentment, bray for harsh donkey calls, mew for plaintive cat cries, cuckoo for avian mimicry/repetition), or human mimicry thereof.
groups.summary_zh: 指特定动物发出的特征性鸣叫，或人类对动物声音的生动模拟。

groups.name: Arrive & Reach Destination · 到达与抵达 (Arrive, Reach, Make It)
groups.tip: 终点到达或靠近

items.def_zh: 来，来到，到达（come 的过去式）
items.def_en: (past tense of come) Arrived at or moved toward a place.
(informal) to arrive at a particular place or level during a journey
1. To arrive at a place, level, or situation. 2. To stretch out your hand or arm in order to touch or take something.
To reach a destination; to come or happen.
to arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly or late
(+ to) to manage to arrive at a place, especially under challenging circumstances
(+ in/at) to arrive somewhere eventually, often unexpectedly after wandering

items.def_zh: 进站，到达（指车辆或列车）
items.def_en: (of a train or vehicle) to arrive at a station, stop, or destination
to arrive at a place or event, especially casually or unexpectedly
to arrive in a steady, casual, or substantial flow

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing an agent attaining an endpoint, destination, or milestone after traversing distance. 'Arrive' focuses intransitively on reaching the termination point, while 'reach' transitively captures the span crossed to touch that terminus.
groups.summary_zh: 描述行程结束到达终点或触及某一空间或时间节点的动作。

groups.name: Assault & Ambush · 突袭与武装打击 (Ambush, Firebomb, Blitz)
groups.tip: 发起猛烈突袭猛攻目标

items.def_zh: 半路拦截突袭；埋伏守候
items.def_en: to wait in hiding to surprise, ambush, and attack someone on their way
(+ sb) to attack someone by jumping or pouncing without warning
(+ sb/sth) to attack someone or something suddenly and with fierce violence
(+ sb) to attack someone physically with great force and aggression
To attack someone suddenly from a hidden position.
to attack, damage, or sink a vessel using one or more underwater torpedoes
to launch a rapid, concentrated, and devastating military attack on an objective

items.def_zh: 用马刀砍杀，用军刀袭击
items.def_en: To cut, strike, or wound someone with a sabre.

items.def_zh: 扫射突袭（低空用机枪或炮火扫射）
items.def_en: to attack ground troops or locations repeatedly with machine-gun fire from low-flying aircraft

items.def_zh: 用燃烧弹袭击，投掷燃烧弹攻击
items.def_en: To attack and damage or destroy a building, vehicle, or area using incendiary bombs.

groups.summary_en: An aggressor strikes a target suddenly using concealed surprise, explosive/incendiary weaponry, or overwhelming armed violence, intended to devastate or catch off-guard.
groups.summary_zh: 通过埋伏突击、纵火轰炸或冷兵器劈砍发起剧烈武力袭击。

groups.name: Attention to Obsessive Focus · 注意至全神贯注 (Heed, Engross, Rivet)
groups.tip: 从留心注意到全神贯注

items.def_en: (+ to) Pay conscious attention or give careful heed to what is said or observed
(+ sth) to think, speak, or worry persistently about something for an excessive period
Take up someone's full mental attention and interest completely

items.def_zh: 留心，注意，听从（建议或警告）
items.def_en: (formal) To pay close, serious attention to advice, a warning, or a rule.
(+ sb/sth) to focus one's attention or gaze unwaveringly on someone or something

items.def_zh: 把注意力完全集中于，锁定
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to direct all one's attention, focus, or aim closely toward a specific target
Hold someone's attention, eyes, or mental focus completely and firmly

items.def_zh: 使全神贯注，吸引；正式誊写（公文等）
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To hold someone's attention completely so they notice nothing else. 2. (law) To write out an official document in large, clear handwriting.

items.def_zh: 全神贯注于，念念不忘；凝视，注视；使固定
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/upon) To focus your attention or obsession exclusively on one person, idea, or object. 2. To direct your eyes steadily toward something. 3. To make something fixed or stable.
[T/I] Continually preoccupy or intrude upon the mind abnormally to the exclusion of other thoughts

groups.summary_en: This intensity gradient traces mental focus from paying attentive heed to external advice, up to total absorption, and ultimately pathological fixation or unshakeable obsession where all other stimuli are blocked out.
groups.summary_zh: 体现从留意听取、全神贯注到陷入极端执念或牢牢吸引的注意力强度阶梯。

groups.name: Attire & Clothe · 穿戴与盛装 (Attire, Tog, Bonnet)
groups.tip: 穿戴衣物盛装打扮的过程

items.def_en: (+ sb) to dress someone or oneself warmly in layers of clothing
(+ sb) to put on formal, fancy, or special clothing

items.def_zh: 穿上套装或特定防护服/队服
items.def_en: to put on a business suit, uniform, or special gear suited for an activity
1. (dated) To put a bonnet or hat on someone's head.

items.def_zh: 给……穿上衣服，装扮（常与out或up连用）
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'tog out/up') (informal) To dress someone or oneself in particular or smart clothes.
(+ in) to fit or equip someone with a complete set of distinctive clothes
to put on a piece of clothing, hat, or coat (formal or literary)

items.def_zh: 使穿衣，打扮（通常用于被动语态）
items.def_en: 1. (often passive, 'be attired') (formal) To dress someone in a particular, especially fine or formal, style of clothes.

items.def_zh: 盛装打扮；打扮得花枝招展
items.def_en: (+ in/with) to dress or decorate someone or oneself in a very striking, festive manner
(+ in) to dress someone in fine, elaborate, or regal clothing (archaic/literary)

groups.summary_en: An agent puts clothes, hats, or specific ceremonial finery on themselves or another person, typically indicating stylistic distinction, archaic register, or dressing for an occasion.
groups.summary_zh: 给自身或他人穿戴衣冠，多侧重正式穿戴、特定服饰或特殊打扮风格。

groups.name: Attribute Fault & Accuse · 归咎与指控 (Blame, Reproach, Accuse)
groups.tip: 追究责任与严厉批评指责

items.def_en: (+ sth + on sb) to attribute fault, blame, or an accusation to a specific person
(+ sth + on sb) to attribute blame, responsibility, or a crime to someone
(+ sb) to accuse someone publicly of being responsible for a fault or wrongdoing
To hold someone or something responsible for a fault, failure, or negative outcome; to criticize.
To state that someone has done something wrong, improper, or illegal.
to express sharp, stern disapproval or criticism of someone's actions
To criticize or express disappointment to someone for failing to do something or doing something wrong.
(+ with) to publicly or legally state that someone has committed a crime
to criticize someone or something severely in a formal, official statement
to formally charge a public official with high crimes or misconduct

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate holding someone accountable for a wrong, error, or offense, graduating from attribution of fault (blame), moral disappointment (reproach), to formal adversarial accusation (accuse, charge).
groups.summary_zh: 将过错或罪责归于某人，由责任推诿渐升至当面责备与正式指控。

groups.name: Awkward Fall & Loss of Balance · 失足与跌倒 (Stumble, Flop, Tumble)
groups.tip: 失去平衡倒下或翻滚摔落

items.def_en: to lose balance accidentally and collapse or drop to the ground
to slide unintentionally and lose one's footing
(+ sth) to catch one's foot on something and stumble or fall awkwardly
(+ over/on) to catch one's foot on something and stumble or fall

items.def_zh: 绊倒，跌跌撞撞地走；结巴，犯错
items.def_en: 1. to trip and almost fall while walking or running; walk unsteadily 2. to make mistakes or pause hesitantly in speaking

items.def_zh: 沉重地落下，笨拙地下跌（或坐下、躺下）；彻底失败，砸锅
items.def_en: 1. to fall, drop, or sit down heavily and awkwardly 2. (informal) to fail completely

items.def_zh: 跌倒，翻滚摔下；暴跌，骤降
items.def_en: 1. to fall quickly and without control; roll or topple downward 2. to drop rapidly in amount, value, or rate
to become unsteady and fall down from a standing or upright position
(+ down) to sit down or drop heavily and suddenly, usually from fatigue
to fall down suddenly because of a loss of strength, support, or consciousness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict people or things losing balance and descending clumsily, rolling headlong, or dropping heavily without physical grace.
groups.summary_zh: 描述身体失衡后踉跄失控、跌滚或沉重瘫倒的笨拙下坠动作。

groups.name: Bar & Expel · 资格剥夺与社交除名 (Exclusion from Groups or Status)
groups.tip: 取消资格、除名或孤立排挤

items.def_en: (+ sb) to exclude someone from a group or social activity through deliberate coldness or hostility
(+ sb) to force someone to leave an organization, group, or premises permanently

items.def_zh: 将……除名，把……从名单中划掉；使（股票等）退市
items.def_en: 1. to remove from a list, register, or category. 2. (finance) to remove the shares of a company from a stock exchange so they can no longer be traded there.
(+ sb) to banish or completely exclude someone from a community or society

items.def_zh: 剥夺神职资格；开除教籍
items.def_en: to officially deprive a priest or religious minister of ecclesiastical status
to remove an authority figure suddenly and forcefully from high office
to deliberately exclude, avoid, or banish someone from a group, society, or community.

items.def_zh: 取消……的律师资格，开除……的律师会会籍
items.def_en: (law) to officially expel a lawyer from the legal profession so they are no longer permitted to practice law.

items.def_zh: 投反对票排挤；拒绝……入会，排斥
items.def_en: to reject or exclude someone from membership in an organization or social club by voting against them.
to officially exclude someone from participating in the sacraments and services of a religious group

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent exclusionary mechanisms whereby a professional body, club, exchange, or community revokes membership or systematically banishes an individual from social participation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调社会共同体、行业协会或交易场所通过投票或法定程序予以除名与联合排斥。

groups.name: Belittle & Disparage · 贬低与轻视 (Belittle, Disparage, Demean)
groups.tip: 故意压低评价，轻视他人价值与成果

items.def_en: (+ from) to disparage or detract from a person's character, merits, or authority
(+ sb) to criticize someone in a way that makes them feel small, foolish, or unimportant

items.def_zh: 用居高临下的口气对……说话
items.def_en: (+ sb) to speak to someone condescendingly as though they are inferior or less intelligent
(+ sb/sth) to criticize, belittle, or disparage someone or something persistently
To make something seem less important, serious, or valuable than it really is.
To make someone or their achievements seem unimportant, small, or worthless.
To lower someone's dignity, respect, or standing; to demean oneself by acting beneath one's dignity.
To speak of someone or something in a disrespectful or critical way that suggests they have little value.

items.def_zh: 诋毁；恶意贬低（名誉或价值）
items.def_en: to criticize unfairly or disparage someone's reputation, value, or achievements

items.def_zh: 贬低；轻视（功劳或重要性）
items.def_en: to represent something as being of little worth or importance; to belittle

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey expressing a low opinion of someone or something, minimizing their merit, or degrading their dignity. They range from public rhetorical disparagement and minimizing achievements to degrading personal worth and formal censure.
groups.summary_zh: 通过言辞压低他人或事物的价值、地位或重要性，伴有贬损侮慢色彩。

groups.name: Bilateral Consultation & Terms Negotiation · 商讨与条件谈判 (Consult, Negotiate, Renegotiate)
groups.tip: 遇事征询专业意见或共同商定

items.def_zh: 商议，商讨；咨询，请教；查阅，参考
items.def_en: 1. To discuss something with someone in order to reach a decision. 2. To seek information or advice from an expert or reference source.

items.def_zh: 谈判，协商；商定；顺利通过（障碍）
items.def_en: 1. To discuss something formally in order to reach an agreement. 2. To successfully deal with or get past a difficult obstacle or route.
(+ with) to hold talks with an opposing side, especially in warfare, over terms of armistice
(+ sth) to negotiate and reach an agreement or solution after extensive discussion
(+ sth) to resolve minor problems, disagreements, or details through discussion
(+ sth) to discuss something thoroughly and passionately until a mutual settlement is reached
(+ with/over) to discuss prices, conditions, or concessions in order to reach a deal
(+ with) to have formal discussions to exchange opinions or seek advice before deciding
To discuss the terms of an agreement, contract, or debt again in order to change them.
(+ with/over) to dispute or argue persistently over cost or petty terms

groups.summary_en: This frame captures bilateral or multilateral communication aimed at exchanging expert guidance or bargaining toward mutually acceptable contractual terms.
groups.summary_zh: 指双边或多边就协议、条款及专业意见进行磋商博弈与谈判。

groups.name: Bind & Bundle · 捆扎与包扎 (Bundle & Fasten with Flexible Material)
groups.tip: 用绳带束紧包裹并固定成捆

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gather items together and tie or wrap them into a compact bundle
(+ sth) to bind or secure objects tightly together using cord, rope, or string

items.def_zh: 捆扎，扎成包；把……匆忙打发走
items.def_en: 1. (+ up/together) To tie or wrap multiple items tightly together into a bundle. 2. (+ into/off) To push or hurry someone quickly somewhere.

items.def_zh: 用绳索捆扎；将（木柴）堆扎成考得
items.def_en: To tie or fasten something securely with a cord; to stack cut firewood in measured cords.
to wrap someone, especially a baby, tightly in garments or cloths
(+ sth) to wrap tightly or secure firmly with bandages, cords, or strips
to tie or wrap something securely with rope, wire, or ribbon

items.def_zh: 用带子捆扎，束牢；用绷带包扎
items.def_en: (+ to/down/into) To fasten, secure, or bind someone or something in place with a strap or belt.
to press and bind materials (such as hay, cotton, or paper) into a tight, rectangular block
to tie up the wings and legs of a fowl before cooking, or to bind someone tightly so they cannot move

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote gathering items together and securing or wrapping them into a cohesive unit using flexible materials like rope, cords, straps, or bands. They contrast in the type of fastening medium used and the neatness or purpose of the packaging.
groups.summary_zh: 用绳、带或包材将散物聚拢并紧固成包或束。

groups.name: Bind & Fasten · 捆绑与固定 (Fasten, Lash & Tape)
groups.tip: 用绳索或束带绑牢固定

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten or secure something flatly against a surface using adhesive tape
to fasten, join, or seal something using adhesive tape
To bind branches, sticks, or twigs tightly into a bundle.

items.def_zh: 用透明胶带粘住，用胶带封贴
items.def_en: (chiefly British) To stick, fasten, or mend something using clear adhesive tape.
(+ sth) to secure or immobilize an object firmly in place using straps
to tie an animal or object with a rope or chain to restrict its movement within a certain area

items.def_zh: 把绳索拴在系绳木上；保护系牢
items.def_en: [I/T] to secure a rope around a pin or cleat, or to secure a climber with a rope
(+ sth) to tie something down tightly and securely using heavy ropes or cables
to fasten or secure something firmly with a rope, cord, or chain, especially on a ship or vehicle
(nautical) To bind, lash, or wrap ropes tightly around something to secure or strengthen it.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify specialized mechanical techniques for securing, immobilizing, or joining objects using adhesive strips, tightly wound nautical ropes, or binding twigs/faggots together. They differ markedly by technical domain and binding instrument.
groups.summary_zh: 采用胶带粘贴、绳缆盘紧或扎捆等特定手段固定物品。

groups.name: Botch, Ruin & Mutilate · 弄糟、毁损与残破 (Botch, Goof, Mutilate)
groups.tip: 结构松散或遭外力毁损

items.def_en: (chiefly British) to develop a vertical line of unraveled stitches in tights or stockings, or cause this to happen.

items.def_zh: 弄糟，搞砸；出差错；混日子，闲荡
items.def_en: (informal) (often goof up) to make a silly mistake or ruin something; (goof off/around) to waste time lazily.
(+ sth) bungle or ruin something through incompetence or a mistake
(+ sth) bungle, ruin, or spoil a situation, plan, or physical object
(+ sth) completely spoil, bungle, or make a severe mistake in something
(often botch up) to ruin or spoil a task, job, or piece of work through clumsiness or carelessness.
to carry out a task clumsily, incompetently, or carelessly, leading to complete failure
to spoil, demolish, or reduce an object, project, or state to an unusable condition

items.def_zh: 严重损毁，毁损；残害，使残废；使残缺不全
items.def_en: to damage an object, body, or text severely by cutting, tearing, or destroying essential parts.

items.def_zh: 撕扯得血肉模糊，压碎损坏
items.def_en: to sever, twist, or tear severe portions off an object or limb so it is unrecognizable

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this intensity-graded frame characterize human failure that ruins an endeavor, material, or organism—scaling from minor blunders and unraveling textures (e.g., runs in tights) to catastrophic bungling and violent physical disfigurement of living bodies or texts.
groups.summary_zh: 从工作失误弄砸递增至严重残害、割损肢体或整体毁坏。

groups.name: Breed, Procreate & Cross-Fertilize · 生育、交配与杂交繁衍 (Breed & Procreate)
groups.tip: 杂交繁育与孵化繁衍后代

items.def_zh: 通过选择育种消除（某特征）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Eliminate an undesirable trait in animals or plants through selective breeding
(+ sb/sth) Breed or hybridize an animal or plant with another variety or species
to reproduce sexually or produce offspring through controlled selection

items.def_zh: 孵出，孵化；密谋，策划（计划或阴谋）
items.def_en: 1. To break out of an egg, or to cause an egg to break open and produce young. 2. To secretly invent and plan a plot or scheme.
to multiply or reproduce organisms, especially plants, through seeds or cuttings
to breed or cause to breed with an animal or plant of another species or variety
1. (formal) To reproduce and produce biological offspring.
to produce or cause to produce hybrids by crossbreeding; to combine different elements
to breed or cause to breed with a different species or variety of animal or plant
(formal/archaic) to father or produce offspring by sexual reproduction

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses biological reproduction, mating, cross-fertilization, and embryonic emergence. It covers formal procreation, inter-strain and cross-species hybridization, selective breeding, and the hatching of offspring from eggs.
groups.summary_zh: 生物界繁衍后代、卵生孵化、两性交配及品种间杂交繁育。

groups.name: Bring into Being & Produce · 创造与生成 (Create, Produce, Generate)
groups.tip: 从无到有创造制造出事物

items.def_zh: 制造，做；创造，产生；使成为；迫使
items.def_en: 1. To create, construct, or produce something by combining materials or putting parts together. 2. To cause something to exist, happen, or appear.

items.def_zh: 形成，产生；组建，建立；塑造
items.def_en: 1. To begin to exist or cause something to begin to exist or develop. 2. To organize, set up, or establish an organization, committee, or group.

items.def_zh: 创造，创作；建立，设立；引起，造成
items.def_en: 1. To bring something new into existence through skill, imagination, or design. 2. To cause a specific situation, feeling, or problem to occur.
to bring something into existence through a process, effort, or natural growth

items.def_zh: 产生，创造（利益、结果等）；发电，产生（能量）；引起
items.def_en: 1. To produce or create something, such as ideas, wealth, or power. 2. To cause a particular feeling, reaction, or situation to develop.
(+ sth) cause something to happen or bring a new condition into existence
(+ sth) produce or manufacture a quantity of goods or creative works

items.def_zh: 大量炮制；粗制滥造地生产
items.def_en: (+ sth) produce large quantities of something rapidly and automatically, often with little regard for quality
[T/I] to initiate or bring something completely new into being; to start from a particular source

items.def_zh: 产生，引起（特定状况或感受）
items.def_en: (formal) to cause or give rise to a feeling, situation, or condition

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to bringing something new into existence, whether physical, conceptual, or energetic, ranging from general making to systematic generation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过创造、塑造或系统转化使某事物从无到有地生成。

groups.name: Bubble & Foam · 起泡与泛沫 (Bubble, Fizz, Froth, Effervesce)
groups.tip: 产生气体或泡沫翻腾

items.def_en: Rise to the surface in or as bubbles
Produce hissing bubbles and become effervescent rapidly
(+ sth) Form or cause to form a mass of small bubbles on the surface of a liquid
(+ with/up) to form or rise in spheres of gas in a liquid

items.def_zh: 起泡并嘶嘶作响；充满活力
items.def_en: (of a liquid) To produce lots of tiny bubbles and make a hissing sound; to effervesce.
to give off small bubbles of gas rapidly and hiss softly, as carbonated liquids do
Produce so many bubbles that the liquid rises and overflows its container

items.def_zh: （使）起泡沫，（使）泛起泡沫；充满愤怒
items.def_en: To form or cause a liquid to form a mass of small white bubbles on its surface.
to produce a mass of small white bubbles on the surface of a liquid
to create or discharge frothy foam or froth, especially waves or agitated water

groups.summary_en: Liquids produce, trap, or release gas bubbles, differentiating in physical manifestation from steady internal bubbling ('bubble'), light acoustic carbonation ('fizz', 'effervesce'), to dense surface spume formation ('froth', 'foam').
groups.summary_zh: 液体释放气体或形成泡沫的物理状态，由细微滋滋作响递增至涌出厚重泡沫。

groups.name: Calm & Soothe · 平息与舒缓
groups.tip: 平复情绪或紧绷状态

items.def_zh: 使平静，平息，抚平；使静止
items.def_en: To make someone or something calm, quiet, or motionless.
(+ down) to cause someone or something to become quiet, relaxed, and undisturbed
(+ sb/sth) become or make someone or something less agitated, angry, or emotional
(+ sb/sth) become or make someone or an environment quieter, less noisy, or less agitated
relax and unwind after a period of work, activity, or stress
to gently relieve someone's distress, irritation, or emotional upset

items.def_zh: 放松，释怀，平复情绪；解开，展开（卷绕之物）
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To relax and stop feeling anxious or tense after a period of work or worry. 2. To unroll, uncoil, or untwist something that has been wound, or to become unwound.
to suppress or subdue strong unpleasant feelings, unrest, or anxieties
to quell anger, agitation, or hostile discontent in a person or population

items.def_zh: （使）平静下来，（使）安静，平息；抚慰
items.def_en: (+ down) (chiefly British) To become quieter, calmer, or less active, or to make someone or something calm.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe reducing agitation, noise, stress, or excitement in a person, environment, or feeling, returning things to a peaceful or relaxed state. They encompass physical relaxing ('unwind'), calming motion or storm ('still'), and lowering vocal or mental agitation ('quieten', 'soothe', 'quell').
groups.summary_zh: 消除喧嚣、焦虑或动荡，使身心或局势恢复平静。

groups.name: Censure & Denounce · 申斥与痛批 (Reprimand, Berate, Slag)
groups.tip: 指出过失与错误，严厉斥责与追究责任

items.def_en: to speak to someone severely about something wrong they have done, often warning them not to repeat it
to speak to someone in a disapproving way about minor misbehavior
(+ sb) Speak angrily to someone for doing something wrong or unacceptable
(+ sb) Scold someone thoroughly and vigorously for a failure or mistake
(+ sb) Reprimand someone severely and formally for misconduct
(+ sb) Attack or criticize someone harshly with angry words
(formal) To tell someone officially and severely that they have done something wrong.

items.def_zh: 严厉批评，痛骂（slag off）；变成炉渣
items.def_en: 1. (slag off) (British informal) To criticize someone or something harshly and rudely. 2. (metallurgy) To convert into or form slag.
to criticize or speak angrily to someone at length
to criticize someone or something publicly and vehemently

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote verbally rebuking, scolding, or aggressively attacking someone for faults or misconduct, scaling from formal institutional reprimands to vitriolic colloquial abuse.
groups.summary_zh: 对某人的过错进行严正训诫、斥责，直至恶言恶语的猛烈抨击。

groups.name: Coat & Smear · 涂抹与涂覆 (Coat, Lacquer, Enamel)
groups.tip: 在物体表面涂上保护层

items.def_en: (+ sth) cover an object or surface with a thin, glossy protective or decorative layer

items.def_zh: 涂上一层（油漆、釉或薄膜）
items.def_en: (+ sth) apply a thin liquid, glaze, or coating to a surface using a brush
to fit or cover with a smooth, glossy coating or vitreous substance

items.def_zh: 涂以瓷釉，上搪瓷；给……施彩饰
items.def_en: 1. To coat metal, pottery, or a surface with smooth, glossy protective enamel.

items.def_zh: 涂亮漆，喷漆（或定型发胶）于
items.def_en: 1. To coat wood, metal, or hair with glossy protective lacquer or hairspray.

items.def_zh: 用喷枪喷绘；用气刷修饰（照片）；粉饰，掩饰
items.def_en: 1. To paint or retouch a photograph or surface using an airbrush to improve its appearance. 2. (figurative) To alter a situation or history to remove undesirable facts.

items.def_zh: 用蜂蜡涂抹，用蜂蜡上光
items.def_en: 1. To polish and protect furniture or leather using beeswax.
1. To cover or smear something with thick, slippery mucus or slime.
to apply a transparent hard protective resin coating onto wood or metal
to apply a thick, sticky, or greasy substance crudely or unevenly over a surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail the application of a thin protective, decorative, or viscous film/layer over a surface, classified by substance, equipment, and finish.
groups.summary_zh: 使用特定介质、工艺或工具在物体表面涂覆保护层或装饰层。

groups.name: Coax & Wheedle · 诱导与哄骗 (Coax, Wheedle, Inveigle)
groups.tip: 用甜言蜜语巧妙劝诱哄劝

items.def_en: to persuade someone gently and patiently to do something or go somewhere
(+ sb) praise or flatter someone excessively to gain their favor or wheedle something out of them
(+ into) to talk to someone nicely and charmingly in order to persuade them to do something
(+ sb) persuade or coax someone into doing something through persuasive conversation
to coax or cajole someone with gentle flattery or ingratiating speech
(+ into/out of) to persuade someone to do something by sustained flattery or soothing words

items.def_zh: 哄骗，用甜言蜜语劝诱（以获取某物）
items.def_en: To persuade someone to do something or give you something by using flattery, praise, or pleasing words.
To persuade someone to do something or give you something by using clever talk, flattery, or deception.
(+ sb) trick or coax someone into doing something through artful deception
(+ into) to fool, cheat, or persuade someone into doing something by obscure or tricky means

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe persuading or manipulating someone into doing something or giving something up through gentle flattery, artful deception, or persistent charm. They typically take an object followed by a prepositional phrase like 'into doing something' or 'out of something'.
groups.summary_zh: 通过巧言令色、谄媚或诱骗等手段说服他人行事或交出财物。

groups.name: Convey & Transport · 运送与携运 (Convey, Transport, Haul)
groups.tip: 随身或借助工具携带

items.def_en: 1. To take or carry someone or something to a place or person. 2. To cause something to happen or exist.

items.def_zh: 携带，提，扛；运送，输送；承担，承受
items.def_en: 1. To hold and support someone or something while moving from one place to another. 2. To transport or transmit something. 3. To bear or accept a responsibility or burden.

items.def_zh: 携带，带来；引起（bring 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of bring; to have taken, carried, or caused something.
to take or carry people or goods from one place to another by vehicle
to carry something heavy or cumbersome around with you
(+ sb/sth) to convey or transport someone or something away, often forcefully or clumsily in a vehicle
(+ sb/sth) to transport people or goods frequently from one place to another
(+ sb/sth) to send someone or transport goods away to another destination
to pull or transport something heavy over a distance, often in a truck
to carry or transport someone or something from one place to another

groups.summary_en: Carriers move objects or passengers from an origin to a destination across space. Nuances distinguish between manual, person-borne carriage and mechanized, bulk, or heavy-duty logistical transport.
groups.summary_zh: 人或载具承受负重，将货物或人从一处转移运送到另一处。

groups.name: Critique & Denounce · 批评与谴责 (Chide, Lambast, Castigate)
groups.tip: 由温和责备逐渐升级至严厉训诫

items.def_en: (+ for) To scold or rebuke someone mildly or affectionately for behaving badly.
(+ sb) to challenge, criticize, or denounce someone openly for bad behavior or wrongdoing
(+ sb) to speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong
to express sharp, stern disapproval or criticism directly to someone
to express severe, official disapproval of someone's actions
(+ sb) to reprimand or verbally denounce someone with great severity
(+ sb/sth) to criticize, attack, or scold someone in a very angry and aggressive manner

items.def_zh: 严厉谴责，痛斥；猛打，痛打
items.def_en: (+ for) 1. To criticize someone or something harshly, angrily, and publicly. 2. To beat or strike violently.

items.def_zh: 严厉批评，严加申斥；严罚
items.def_en: (+ for) (formal) To criticize or punish someone or something severely, usually in public.
(formal) to criticize someone or something with blistering, scathing severity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve communicating harsh disapproval, reprimand, or moral condemnation toward a person or act. The scale progresses from mild or scolding remonstrance ('chide') to severe public excoriation ('lambast', 'castigate', 'excoriate').
groups.summary_zh: 指表达指责、训诫与严厉谴责，由温和轻责递进至严正斥责。

groups.name: Curtail & Retrench · 削减、紧缩与减少 (Curtail, Retrench, Dwindle)
groups.tip: 数量削减或规模由大变小

items.def_en: to reduce the amount, size, or cost of something, especially financial expenditure
to gradually diminish, become smaller or weaker, and then stop completely
(+ sth) to reduce the size, scope, budget, or extent of an activity or project
(+ sth) to gradually reduce an activity, production, or operation before ending it
(+ sth) to reduce spending, staff, or resources gradually to a bare minimum
1. To become gradually smaller, fewer, or weaker in size, quantity, or strength.
1. To reduce or limit something, especially spending, rights, or the duration of an activity.
to gradually reduce something, such as expenses or numbers, to an essential minimum (+ down)

items.def_zh: 减弱，降低；抑止（呼吸，多用于 with bated breath）
items.def_en: 1. (archaic) To lessen, diminish, or moderate; to hold back or suppress (force or breath).

items.def_zh: 紧缩开支，削减费用；裁员，缩减业务
items.def_en: 1. To reduce expenses, cut costs, or scale back operations during difficult economic times.

groups.summary_en: A quantity, budget, activity, or resource diminishes over time or is deliberately cut back by an entity seeking restraint or facing exhaustion.
groups.summary_zh: 开支、规模或活动等被有意削减、紧缩，或资源自行缩减消退。

groups.name: Cut & Cleave · 切开与劈裂 (Slit, Cleave, Rive)
groups.tip: 利器劈斩开劈分两半

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cut cleanly and effortlessly into or through something using a sharp blade
(+ sth) to make a straight, sharp incision to open something such as an envelope or bag
to cut with a wide, sweeping violent stroke of a blade
To make a long, narrow cut or opening in something with a sharp instrument.
(+ sth) to split or slice cleanly and forcefully through a solid physical object

items.def_zh: 劈开，劈裂；坚持，黏附（cleave to）
items.def_en: 1. To split or cut something apart, especially with a heavy blow from a sharp weapon or tool. 2. ('cleave to') To stick firmly or adhere to something.
to split or tear apart violently or along natural grain

items.def_zh: 劈开，分裂（cleave 的过去分词）；劈成两半的
items.def_en: (archaic) Past participle of cleave; to split or divide into distinct parts.
to tear or split something apart with violent force
to break or wrench apart forcefully into two or more pieces

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe parting a physical object cleanly or forcefully along a line or natural grain using a sharp blade or heavy wedge. 'Slit' denotes a precise, shallow or linear incision, while 'cleave' and related terms imply forceful, deep splitting into two parts.
groups.summary_zh: 强调沿纹理或线条利落切开、劈成两半的动作。

groups.name: Damage & Break · 损坏与破坏 (Impair, Blemish, & Break)
groups.tip: 破坏外观或损害原本功用

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a shallow cut or mark on the surface of something with a sharp object
(+ sth) to break a small piece off the surface or edge of a hard object
[I/T] to break off a small piece from the edge or surface of a hard object
To cause something to have a defect, blemish, or weakness, thereby ruining its perfection or efficacy.
To spoil or damage the appearance, quality, or perfection of something.
(+ sth) to break or smash physical objects violently

items.def_zh: 打破，弄坏；突击搜捕；（使）破产
items.def_en: 1. To break, smash, or ruin something completely. 2. To arrest someone or raid a place.
[I/T] to crack, split, or break a hard object, bone, or structural surface
(+ sth) to destroy or severely damage something by violently breaking it into pieces
[I/T] to break violently into many small pieces

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate impairing the integrity, functionality, or surface perfection of an entity. They scale along an intensity gradient from subtle aesthetic blemish or internal flaw to complete physical breakage or destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 损伤实体完好度，从轻微外表瑕疵到彻底破损断裂。

groups.name: Deceive & Scam · 坑害与诱骗 (Con, Scam, Dupe)
groups.tip: 设下圈套隐瞒真相来行骗

items.def_en: To trick or cheat someone, especially to persuade them to give you money or something valuable.

items.def_zh: 欺诈，诈骗，通过欺诈手段获取
items.def_en: To practice fraud or trickery to obtain money or advantage; cheat someone.
to cheat someone, especially by charging them too much money or selling poor goods
(+ sb) to maliciously manipulate a situation to falsely incriminate or victimize someone
(+ sb) to deliberately deceive someone over a period of time by giving them false hope
(+ sb) to successfully trick, deceive, or perpetrate a scam on someone
(informal) To cheat or trick someone out of money or property through a dishonest scheme.
