(informal) To treat someone unfairly or cheat them out of something.
to trick or cheat someone into believing an untruth or doing something foolish
to deceive or trick someone, especially by concealing one's true intentions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this informal frame describe tricking, manipulating, or unfairly taking advantage of a victim through deceptive schemes, exploitation, or harsh betrayal.
groups.summary_zh: 用圈套骗局引诱受害者上当，或在利益关系中苛待、坑害他人。

groups.name: Decelerate & Halt · 减缓与停止 (Slow, Halt, Cease)
groups.tip: 由放慢节奏到完全终止

items.def_en: to gradually decrease in speed, vigor, or intensity
(+ sb/sth) to reduce speed, velocity, or the rate of physical movement
1. (+ down/up) To reduce speed or move more slowly, or cause someone or something to do so.
1. To stop speaking or doing something for a short time before continuing.
[I/T] to reduce speed gradually or cause a moving vehicle or process to slow down

items.def_zh: 停止，中断；停下；阻止，阻拦；堵塞
items.def_en: 1. To come to a halt, or prevent someone or something from moving or continuing. 2. To prevent someone from doing something or keep something from happening. 3. (+ up) To block or plug an opening.
to bring a vehicle or oneself to a complete stop
[I/T] to bring or come to an abrupt or decisive stop, especially in motion or progress

items.def_zh: 嘎吱作响地停下；陷入停滞
items.def_en: (+ a halt) to decelerate gradually with friction until coming to a complete stop
[I/T] to come or bring to a complete, final end; discontinue entirely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote a progressive reduction in velocity or motion culminating in total cessation, ranging from a slight deceleration or temporary suspension to an absolute, permanent standstill.
groups.summary_zh: 描述运动或过程由减速、暂歇到完全停止的递进过程。

groups.name: Decompose & Spoil Chemically · 腐烂与质变败坏 (Decay, Rot, Spoil)
groups.tip: 有机物自然腐烂分解

items.def_en: to become unfit for consumption due to natural breakdown, or render food stale
to decompose organically or chemically into simpler substances
to become stale, sour, or unfit to eat or drink
1. To rot or cause something to rot through natural organic decomposition. 2. To gradually become bad or deteriorate in quality, strength, or condition.

items.def_zh: （使）变酸，（使）变馊；（使关系或心情）变糟，恶化
items.def_en: 1. To make or become sour or acidic, especially as a result of fermentation or spoilage. 2. To make or become unfriendly, unpleasant, or bitter.
To decay, or make something decay, naturally and gradually through the action of bacteria or fungi.

items.def_zh: 逐渐腐烂殆尽；完全腐化
items.def_en: to decay progressively until little or nothing remains
to decay and break down organically into simpler chemical parts
to become septic, producing pus, rot, or advancing putrid inflammation

items.def_zh: 腐烂化脓；散发恶臭变质
items.def_en: to decompose with the emission of a foul, fetid odor through bacterial action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate biological and organic breakdown, progressive tissue putrefaction, or chemical degradation of perishables from edible freshness into stench, acidity, or decomposed matter.
groups.summary_zh: 指有机物因菌类或化学作用由新鲜变为酸败、腐坏及分解分解。

groups.name: Deep Aversion & Hate · 厌恶与憎恨 (Dislike, Loathe, Abhor)
groups.tip: 从轻微反感到切齿痛恨的负面情感

items.def_en: to experience a feeling of aversion or lack of liking for someone or something
(+ sb/sth) stop liking someone and become hostile, antagonistic, or resentful toward them
to look down on with disdain and intense, contemptuous dislike
(+ sb/sth) experience a feeling of intense physical disgust or strong moral repulsion toward something
To feel intense dislike, hostility, or aversion toward someone or something.
To hate or dislike someone or something very intensely.

items.def_zh: 极其厌恶，憎恨，极其反感
items.def_en: To feel intense hatred and disgust for someone or something.
to detest vehemently and view with profound moral hatred

items.def_zh: 深恶痛绝，痛恨，强烈反感
items.def_en: (formal) To hate a way of behaving or thinking deeply, especially because it seems morally wrong.
(formal) To feel or express extreme hatred or loathing for someone or something; to curse.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey intense emotional repulsion, ranging from conscious strong aversion to moral disgust and vehement denunciation.
groups.summary_zh: 表达从强烈的个人反感、极度厌恶到道德唾弃的情感阶梯。

groups.name: Deflect & Tilt · 偏离与倾斜 (Deviate, Veer, Bank)
groups.tip: 角度倾斜偏转或偏离原定轨道

items.def_en: (+ sth) to hit a surface and deflect away at an angle
[I/T] to tilt sideways when turning, especially of an aircraft

items.def_zh: 倾斜，使倾斜；说黑话，讲行话
items.def_en: 1. To tilt, slant, or lean to one side; to set or turn something at an angle. 2. To use hypocritical, pious, or specialized jargon.
[I/T] to cause something to turn aside from a straight path, or to bounce off at an angle
(physics) (of waves, particles, or radiation) To scatter or reflect back toward the direction of origin; to cause this to happen.

items.def_zh: 偏离直行方向；突然转向
items.def_en: to deviate sharply from an established course or alignment
to abruptly change direction and move away from an intended course

items.def_zh: 突然改变方向；猛然转向
items.def_en: (+ off/away) to change direction or course suddenly

items.def_zh: 急转弯；突然转向以避开
items.def_en: [I/T] to change direction abruptly, especially to avoid an obstacle

items.def_zh: 降落在（跑道）近侧，落后于（目标）；射击脱靶，未达到
items.def_en: 1. (aviation) To land an aircraft short of the runway. 2. To fall short of a target, goal, or expected amount.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical entities or trajectories departing from an intended straight path, horizontal level, or direct alignment, either through mechanical tilting, aerodynamic banking, or physical scattering.
groups.summary_zh: 描述物体或运动轨迹发生角度倾斜、偏离直线路线或散射的动作与状态。

groups.name: Deform, Pulp & Crush Soft Matter · 挤压、捏柔与捣碎 (Squish, Knead, Puree)
groups.tip: 用力挤压使其变形碎裂

items.def_en: (+ sth) to crush food or other soft matter into a soft, pulpy mass
(+ sth) to press or flatten something soft or flexible into a smaller or flatter shape
to crush soft food or matter into a soft, uniform mass using pressure
[I/T] to crush or squeeze something flat, soft, or out of shape through heavy pressure
To crush or squeeze something soft into a flat shape; to make a soft, wet squeezing sound.

items.def_zh: 把（蔬菜、水果等）捣成泥，压成糊
items.def_en: To crush, mash, or blend food into a smooth, thick liquid paste.

items.def_zh: 揉，捏（面团、黏土等）；按摩，推拿
items.def_en: To press, stretch, and fold dough or clay with the hands; to massage muscles firmly.

items.def_zh: 揉皱，压扁，挤压；缩紧；发出嘎吱声
items.def_en: to crush or squeeze something into a tight or compact shape; to make a loud crunching sound.
(+ sth) to crush or reduce pliable matter completely into a wet pulp
[I/T] to press something with extreme force so that it breaks down into small particles or pulp

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcefully compressing, mashing, or manipulating soft, yielding, or pliable substances until their internal structure collapses, softens, or blends into a pulp. They differ by physical outcome, ranging from gentle working of dough to total liquifying or wet crushing.
groups.summary_zh: 施力挤压、揉捏或捣碎柔软易变形物体使其变扁或成糊状。

groups.name: Defraud & Fleece · 欺诈与剥夺 (Defraud, Swindle, Fleece)
groups.tip: 巧取豪夺榨取他人钱财

items.def_zh: (+ sb + out of sth) 骗取（某人的财物）
items.def_en: (+ sb + out of sth) to trick someone into giving away money or property by deceit

items.def_zh: (+ sb + out of sth) 诈取；骗走
items.def_en: (+ sb + out of sth) to cheat someone out of what is rightfully theirs through petty swindling
1. (informal) To obtain a lot of money from someone by overcharging or tricking them. 2. To shear the wool from a sheep.
(informal) To cheat or defraud someone of money; to overcharge someone.
To cheat someone in order to get money, goods, or possessions from them.
to cheat someone out of what is due to them, especially money
to trick or deceive someone in order to take something from them

items.def_zh: (+ sb) 敲诈；狠狠坑骗（钱财）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cheat someone by overcharging them or stealing their money

items.def_zh: 以不正当手段骗取或勒索（金钱）
items.def_en: (+ of) to obtain money from someone by deceit, extortion, or harsh exaction
(+ of) To trick someone in order to get money, property, or rights from them illegally.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe illicitly depriving a person or organization of money or property through calculated misrepresentation, deceit, or exorbitant overcharging.
groups.summary_zh: 以蓄意虚假陈述、骗术或敲竹杠手段非法牟取受害者财物。

groups.name: Demolish & Level · 夷平与摧毁 (Flatten, Demolish, Level)
groups.tip: 彻底扫平建筑夷为平地

items.def_en: (+ sth) to demolish a building or structure so that it falls to the ground
to level or knock down a structure flat to the ground

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 彻底拆毁（大型结构）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to deliberately demolish a building or large structure
(+ sth) to demolish or dismantle a building, wall, or structure completely
to completely flatten a building or area of land
to pull or knock down a building or structure completely
to destroy something or someone completely so that nothing remains

items.def_zh: 夷平，彻底摧毁，把……夷为平地
items.def_en: To completely destroy or knock down a building, town, or settlement to the ground.

items.def_zh: 彻底粉碎，摧毁；将……磨成粉
items.def_en: 1. To crush or grind something into a fine powder. 2. (informal) To defeat or destroy someone or something completely.

items.def_zh: 夷平，彻底摧毁（raze 的变体写法）；擦掉，抹去
items.def_en: (archaic or variant of raze) To completely destroy or level a building or settlement to the ground.

groups.summary_en: Destructive agents systematically or cataclysmically tear down, shatter, or flatten structures, settlements, or physical substances into ground level or fine dust. Intensity escalates from structural flattening to total molecular pulverization.
groups.summary_zh: 对建筑物或物体施加极强破坏力，使其倒塌、平毁或化为碎末。

groups.name: Depart & Exit · 离开与出发 (Leave, Depart, Scram)
groups.tip: 从某处起步动身

items.def_zh: 离开，动身；留下，剩下；委托，交托
items.def_en: 1. To go away from a person, place, or situation. 2. To let something remain behind or remain in a particular condition. 3. To deliver or entrust something to someone.
[I/T] to go out of or leave a building, stage, or enclosed space
(+ for/on) to begin a journey or expedition
to leave a place quickly or permanently, often upon command
to depart, especially in an informal or slightly rude directive

items.def_zh: 离开；动身（尤指匆忙或突然）
items.def_en: to leave or depart, especially abruptly or quickly
to start a journey or leave a place to go somewhere else
to begin moving away from a stationary starting point

items.def_zh: 离开，启程；偏离，背离（常规等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/for) (formal) To leave a place, especially to start a journey. 2. (+ from) To deviate or stray from an established rule, practice, or standard.
1. (informal, chiefly imperative) To leave immediately and quickly.

groups.summary_en: An agent moves away from a place or starting point, spanning neutral daily departures, formal timetabled embarkations, and colloquial abrupt or hurried departures.
groups.summary_zh: 离开某处或动身启程，涵盖日常表达、正式班次出发及口语急促离开。

groups.name: Depletion of Energy & Physical Exhaustion · 疲劳与虚脱 (Tire, Fatigue, Exhaust)
groups.tip: 精力从困倦到彻底耗尽

items.def_en: gradually lose strength, momentum, or stamina until coming to a stop
1. To become tired or make someone feel tired. 2. (+ of) To become bored with or lose interest in something.
(+ sb) reduce someone's health, vitality, or physical energy through strain or overwork
(+ sb) tire someone out thoroughly so they lack energy

items.def_zh: 使筋疲力尽，使极度疲劳；疲劳；（材料）产生疲劳破坏
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel extremely tired, or to become exhausted. 2. (technical) To weaken or become weakened from repeated stress (of materials).

items.def_zh: （使）精疲力竭，（使）疲惫不堪；（因过度接触等而使）厌倦
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To make someone tired, exhausted, or bored through overwork or excess.
become completely exhausted through prolonged overwork or intense effort

items.def_zh: 使筋疲力尽，使疲惫不堪
items.def_en: to exhaust someone's stamina completely through hard labor or exertion
to drain someone completely of energy, strength, or vitality

items.def_zh: 使力竭倒地；使虚脱卧床
items.def_en: to reduce someone to extreme physical weakness, helplessness, or collapse

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale frame denote progressive loss of strength, vitality, or endurance in living beings through exertion or stress. They scale from mild loss of freshness (tire), through sustained clinical wearying (fatigue, jade), to ultimate depletion and collapse (exhaust, prostrate).
groups.summary_zh: 描述体力或精力从轻度发困乏力、持久劳损，到完全衰竭力竭的递进状态。

groups.name: Descend & Submerge · 下沉与沉没 (Sediment, Sink, Submerge)
groups.tip: 由降落沉降直至完全没入

items.def_en: to sink down gradually to the bottom of a liquid
(of suspended particles) separate and sink to the bottom of a liquid
to settle to the bottom of a liquid, or to cause solid particles to settle.
sink beneath the surface of the water

items.def_zh: （使）下沉，（使）沉没；沉降，下陷；下降，衰退
items.def_en: 1. to go down below the surface of water or liquid, or to make something do this. 2. to move downward or fall to a lower level.

items.def_zh: （使）下沉，（使）沉没（sink 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of sink: to go down below the surface of liquid, or cause to do so.
to go completely under the surface of water or liquid, or to put something completely under water.

items.def_zh: （使）下沉，（使）沉没（sink 的过去分词，现多作形容词）
items.def_en: (archaic) past participle of sink: to go down below the surface of liquid.
(of a ship) to fill with water and sink completely beneath the surface
[I/T] to submerge and perish in water, or flood completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame track the physical progression of downward motion into or beneath a liquid or sediment, scaling from slow particulate settling to complete underwater engulfment.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘物体在液体中下落、沉积直至被彻底没顶吞噬的沉溺程度递进。

groups.name: Devastate & Demolish · 摧毁与夷平 (Ravage, Bulldoze, Nuke)
groups.tip: 施加暴力使其倾覆解体

items.def_en: (+ sth) to completely destroy a building or structure by fire, or be destroyed in this way
to level a building or area completely to the ground
(often passive) To cause severe and widespread damage or destruction to something.

items.def_zh: 使（船只）失事，使遭海难；彻底毁灭，破坏
items.def_en: (usually passive) To destroy or ruin a ship at sea; to ruin or destroy completely.
to completely destroy a town or building so nothing remains standing

items.def_zh: 用推土机推倒，夷平；强推，强迫执行
items.def_en: 1. To demolish buildings or clear land using a bulldozer. 2. To force someone into doing something or push a decision through aggressively.

items.def_zh: (+ sth) （用炸弹、重武器）炸碎；彻底摧毁
items.def_en: (+ sth) to utterly destroy or pulverize something with explosive force

items.def_zh: (+ sb/sth) 彻底消灭；全歼；夷为平地
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to destroy, eliminate, or eradicate something completely

items.def_zh: 用核武器摧毁，彻底消灭；用微波炉加热
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To attack or completely destroy something with nuclear weapons. 2. (informal) To heat or cook food in a microwave oven.
to wipe out completely leaving no trace whatsoever

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe total, catastrophic obliteration or systematic clearing of structures, landscapes, or entities. They contrast widespread natural or military pillaging and mechanical leveling with absolute, extreme annihilation.
groups.summary_zh: 描述对建筑、地形或实体实施彻底破坏、夷平或毁灭性打击。

groups.name: Devour & Ingest Hastily · 狼吞虎咽与急吞 (Gulp, Gobble, Wolf)
groups.tip: 大口吞下或急迫吞食的吃相

items.def_zh: 匆忙吞下（未咀嚼直接咽下）
items.def_en: (+ down) to swallow food hurriedly with little or no chewing

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃光（通常作 scarf down）
items.def_en: (+ down) to consume food rapidly, hungrily, and in quantity
to swallow a drink completely without stopping for breath

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 咕咚咽下；大口吞下
items.def_en: (+ sth) to swallow food or drink rapidly and in large amounts

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 飞快吞下；风卷残云般吃完
items.def_en: (+ sth) to eat something voraciously and in a hurry
(+ sth) to eat food very quickly and greedily in large mouthfuls

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃完（常与 down 连用）
items.def_en: (+ down) to eat food very quickly and greedily in large amounts

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽，大口吞食；（火鸡）咯咯叫
items.def_en: 1. To eat something quickly and greedily (often 'gobble up/down'). 2. (of a turkey) To make a characteristic gurgling sound.

items.def_zh: 大口吞下，吞咽；倒抽气，深吸一口气；哽住
items.def_en: 1. To swallow food or drink quickly in large mouthfuls. 2. To take a quick, deep breath, especially from surprise or shock.
[I/T] to drink or eat greedily, noisily, and in large quantities

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the hasty, noisy, or voracious ingestion of food or drink, characterized by taking excessively large mouthfuls, minimal chewing, and rapid swallowing.
groups.summary_zh: 指大口急吞、不加细嚼、贪婪快速地进食或咽下。

groups.name: Dig & Excavate · 挖掘与开采 (Extract from the Earth)
groups.tip: 破土取物挖出地下资源

items.def_en: 1. To dig into the earth to extract valuable minerals, coal, or ores. 2. To lay explosive mines in an area.
To prepare and cultivate land for growing crops by plowing, harrowing, or hoeing.
[I/T] to break up and move earth with a tool, machine, or hands

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 掘出；发掘；翻掘（泥土）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove earth or extract something buried beneath the ground by digging
(+ sb/sth) to locate and remove something buried or stuck in the earth
(+ sth) to hollow out earth or remove loose soil with a shovel, scoop, or heavy equipment
to extract stone, slate, or other materials from an open pit
[I/T] to clear the bed of a harbor, river, or body of water by scooping out mud and debris
[I/T] to dig out earth systematically to reveal buried remains or create a foundation
1. To dig up something buried in the ground. 2. To uncover or bring to light something hidden or forgotten.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe breaking, overturning, or penetrating ground or earth to obtain minerals, reveal buried items, or prepare soil for cultivation. They range from everyday manual digging and agricultural tilling to industrial extraction and archaeological uncovering.
groups.summary_zh: 破开、翻动地表以开采矿藏、培土或掘出埋藏物。

groups.name: Dig & Extract Material · 挖掘与铲掘 (Quarry, Shovel, Spade)
groups.tip: 开掘泥土采石挖掘

items.def_en: (+ sth) lift or remove aggregate material with a shovel, scoop, or cupped hands
to dig, cut, or turn over earth using a spade
(+ into) to dig into the ground with a tool; to search deeply into an area
(+ sth) excavate and extract something deeply embedded in the earth or snow
(+ sth) break up earth and remove an object or material from beneath the ground
(+ sth) clear or extract large quantities of earth, coal, or rubble using a shovel

items.def_zh: 开采，采掘（石料等）；努力搜寻（资料）
items.def_en: 1. To dig or extract stone, slate, or other materials from a quarry. 2. To search deeply to extract information.

items.def_zh: 用铲子铲；狼吞虎咽地把（食物）送进嘴里
items.def_en: 1. To lift, clear, or move earth, snow, or other loose material with a shovel. 2. To put large amounts of food into your mouth quickly.
[I/T] to extract coal, minerals, or metals from the earth by digging pits or shafts
[I/T] (+ up) to clean out or scoop up silt, mud, and material from the bed of a body of water

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on using implements or machinery to dig up, extract, or move aggregates, soil, ore, or stone from the ground. The semantic focus is on the manual or mechanical act of displacing and harvesting raw earth/minerals.
groups.summary_zh: 使用工具或器械铲除、挖掘并提取泥土、矿石等物料。

groups.name: Direct Retailing & Hawking · 叫卖与分销 (Hawk, Peddle, Vend)
groups.tip: 多种方式沿街推销货品

items.def_zh: 征订，招募预订；认购（股份）；定期订购，订阅；赞同
items.def_en: 1. To take advance orders for a forthcoming publication, or agree to buy shares in a company. 2. To pay money regularly to receive a service, product, or publication.
(formal) To sell small items, food, or goods, especially from a street stall, cart, or machine.

items.def_zh: 沿街叫卖，到处兜售；传播，散播（观念、谎言）
items.def_en: To travel from place to place selling small goods; to spread or promote ideas or illegal items.
to solicit orders, subscriptions, or votes door-to-door

items.def_zh: 廉价抛售，兜售（尤指劣质或多余物品）
items.def_en: (+ sth) sell something quickly, cheaply, or aggressively to get rid of it

items.def_zh: 以次充好兜售；硬塞给（某人）
items.def_en: (+ sth on sb) get rid of an inferior or unwanted item by deceitful selling

items.def_zh: 沿街叫卖，兜售；咳出（痰等），清嗓；放鹰捕猎
items.def_en: 1. To travel around selling goods, usually shouting loudly to attract customers. 2. To clear your throat noisily and bring up phlegm.
to solicit patronage or trade importunately or aggressively
to sell goods aggressively or dishonestly, especially cheap wares
To conduct an auction and sell items to the highest bidder.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the manner of selling goods directly to customers, typically on the street, door-to-door, or through public bids and soliciting.
groups.summary_zh: 走街串巷、兜售摆摊或公开叫价拍卖等直接面向客户的推销分销行为。

groups.name: Disavow & Recant Statements · 撤回与收回言论 (Retract, Disclaim, Recant)
groups.tip: 否认权利主张并收回前言

items.def_en: to withdraw or admit to be untrue a remark, insult, or assertion

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 撤回（言论）；收回（声明）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to retreat from or modify a prior public statement, claim, or promise

items.def_zh: 退让；放弃（原有立场或要求）
items.def_en: to withdraw a demand, claim, or assertion in the face of opposition

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 反悔；收回（承诺、协议）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to withdraw from a prior commitment, statement, or agreement

items.def_zh: 撤回，收回（言论、承诺等）；缩回，缩进
items.def_en: 1. To officially withdraw or take back a statement, promise, or accusation. 2. To pull or move back inside, or become drawn back inside.
to state publicly that one has no connection with, knowledge of, or responsibility for something

items.def_zh: 否认，拒不承认；放弃（权利、所有权等）
items.def_en: 1. To state publicly that you have no responsibility for, knowledge of, or connection with something. 2. (law) To formally renounce or surrender a legal right or claim.

items.def_zh: 公开撤回，放弃（先前的信仰、言论或主张）
items.def_en: (formal) To publicly announce that you no longer hold or support a previously stated belief or opinion.

items.def_zh: 发誓放弃（信仰、权利或主张）
items.def_en: (formal) to formally reject or renounce a belief, cause, or claim under oath
(formal or literary) To take back or retract words that you have already spoken.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote repudiating, annulling, or withdrawing a prior statement, belief, confession, or legal claim.
groups.summary_zh: 指公开撤回前言、否认关联、收回指控或正式放弃既有信仰与主张。

groups.name: Discard & Dump · 抛弃与倾倒 (Get Rid of Waste Carelessly or Decisively)
groups.tip: 视作垃圾扔掉或毁弃

items.def_zh: 报废；取消，废弃（计划或物件）
items.def_en: to discard or abandon a plan, system, or object as useless

items.def_zh: 丢弃，甩掉（不再需要的人或物）
items.def_en: to informally abandon or get rid of something or someone no longer wanted
(+ sth) discard an unwanted item or rubbish decisively into the trash
(+ sth) get rid of something no longer useful or needed
(+ sth) casually or unceremoniously dispose of something unwanted

items.def_zh: 丢弃，扔掉；损坏，捣毁；痛斥
items.def_en: (informal) 1. To throw away something that is no longer needed. 2. To damage or destroy something severely. 3. To criticize severely.

items.def_zh: 倾倒，丢弃；倾销；甩掉（恋人）
items.def_en: 1. To get rid of waste, rubbish, or unwanted things, especially carelessly or in an illegal place. 2. To sell goods in another country at an unfairly low price.
to throw something away casually or carelessly
(+ sth) discard or deliberately divest oneself of an unwanted burden, garment, or tie

items.def_zh: 投弃（货物以减重）；放弃（包袱）
items.def_en: to throw cargo overboard to lighten a craft; to decisively drop ideas or burdens

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe getting rid of unwanted items, refuse, or burdens, ranging from unceremonious disposal to careless, bulk unloading.
groups.summary_zh: 强调随意、果断或成批抛弃无用之物与垃圾的动作方式。

groups.name: Discard & Purge · 消除与废弃 (Delete, Scrap, Eradicate)
groups.tip: 清除抹去痕迹或丢弃不用

items.def_en: to get rid of something that is regarded as useless or no longer required

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 扔掉；废弃；否决（提议）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discard something unwanted or officially reject a plan or proposal
(+ sth) to discard or get rid of something that is no longer needed
To remove or erase written, printed, or computer-stored text, files, or information.

items.def_zh: 废弃，取消，抛弃；报废（旧物）；打架，吵架
items.def_en: 1. To cancel, abandon, or discard a plan, system, or object no longer needed. 2. (informal) To have a fight or argument.

items.def_zh: 丢弃，断然舍弃（计划或负荷）
items.def_en: to throw goods overboard, or decisively abandon a plan, idea, or burden
(+ sth) to formally stop using, eradicate, or abolish a practice, rule, or system
1. To completely remove or get rid of something unwanted. 2. To defeat someone so that they can no longer take part in a competition.
to completely destroy or put an end to something undesirable, removing it root and branch
to wipe out entirely so that no trace or memory remains

groups.summary_en: An agent removes, discards, or utterly destroys an entity, record, policy, or project so that it no longer exists or functions. Verbs range in destructive force from routine administrative removal (delete) and programmatic abandonment (scrap) to total annihilation (eradicate, obliterate).
groups.summary_zh: 从常规删除、彻底放弃项目到完全消灭。

groups.name: Discontinue & Terminate · 中止与终止 (Discontinue, Terminate, Cease)
groups.tip: 叫停运转或终止原流程

items.def_en: [I/T] to stop happening or to bring an activity to an end (formal)

items.def_zh: 清算；结束；了结（业务或活动）
items.def_en: to bring a business, meeting, or activity to a planned conclusion
(+ sth) to cancel an event, operation, or planned activity
(+ sth) to stop operating or cause a business, service, or machine to cease operating
(+ sth) to abruptly end a relationship, agreement, or formal negotiation
(+ sth) to stop using or producing something gradually over a period of time

items.def_zh: 终止；使终结；解除（合同/雇佣）
items.def_en: [I/T] to bring an agreement, employment, or ongoing operation to an official end

items.def_zh: 中止，中断，停止；停产，终止提供
items.def_en: to stop doing, producing, or providing something that was previously regular or ongoing.

items.def_zh: 中止；夭折；叫停（任务/计划）
items.def_en: [I/T] to terminate a process, project, or mission before completion due to a problem

items.def_zh: 最后确定，定稿，完成；使定局
items.def_en: to complete and agree on the final details of a plan, deal, or document.

groups.summary_en: An authority, institution, or agent puts an end to an ongoing activity, production line, contract, or service before or upon its completion. Verbs vary in formality from formal business cancellation ('discontinue') to legal or definitive nullification ('terminate', 'sever').
groups.summary_zh: 使正在进行的生产、业务、合同或项目正式停止或终结。

groups.name: Discourage & Deject · 沮丧与消沉 (Discourage, Dishearten, Deject)
groups.tip: 从泄气失落到心如死灰

items.def_en: to cause someone to lose confidence, hope, or enthusiasm for an endeavor
to cause someone to feel extremely sad, downcast, or low in spirits
(+ sb) cause someone to feel depressed, disheartened, or unhappy

items.def_zh: 使心事重重，使消沉压抑

groups.tip: 创立制度并载入法典奉为规范

items.def_zh: 设立；制定实行（规则、体系或调查）
items.def_en: to officially introduce, set up, or initiate a system, law, or process
(+ sth) to formally establish, institute, or organize a system, company, or set of rules
(+ sth) to introduce or establish a new law, policy, or system officially
(+ sth) to establish or implement a system, rule, or mechanism so that it operates

items.def_zh: 牢固确立；使（权利或地位）难以撼动
items.def_en: to firmly establish something, especially a right or attitude, so that change is very difficult

items.def_zh: 重新确立，重新施行（法律、制度等）；重新引入（物种、产品等）
items.def_en: 1. To bring a law, product, or animal species back into use or its former habitat.

items.def_zh: 使制度化；确立为常规体制
items.def_en: to make a practice, value, or convention standard and established within an institution or society

items.def_zh: 庄严载入（法律或宪法等），奉为神圣；把……置于神龛内供奉
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To preserve a right, principle, or tradition in a law or constitution, or keep something sacred in a shrine.

items.def_zh: 编纂（法典）；使（规则或惯例）成文法典化
items.def_en: to arrange laws, rules, or principles into a systematic written code

items.def_zh: 使正式化，以制度形式确立；拘泥于形式
items.def_en: 1. To make a plan, agreement, or relationship official, structured, and legally recognized.

groups.summary_en: Authorities or governing bodies officially implement policies, laws, or traditions into an enduring, legally binding, or standardized system. Verbs range from general procedural formalization to deeply safeguarding core principles in constitutional law.
groups.summary_zh: 官方或权威机构将规则、惯例或原则正式确立并载入体制或法律。

groups.name: Exceed & Surpass · 超越与胜过 (Surpass, Exceed, Outstrip)
groups.tip: 在数量、速度或权重上胜过他人

items.def_en: to be greater in number, degree, or extent than an established limit or quantity
(+ sth) to exceed an expected limit, scope, or normal degree of something

items.def_zh: 超时；超过（预定数量或限制）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to go beyond an allotted limit, budget, or timeframe

items.def_zh: 超过，超越（在品质或成就上）
items.def_en: to be greater, better, or stronger than another in capability or achievement
(formal or archaic) to go beyond or surpass someone or something

items.def_zh: （在重量、重要性或价值上）超过，重于
items.def_en: to be greater or more important than something else

items.def_zh: 超过，赶超（跑得更快或发展更迅猛）
items.def_en: to become much more successful, faster, or greater in quantity than a competitor

items.def_zh: 使承担过多任务（或债务）；过度扩展，使延伸过长
items.def_en: to take on more work, debt, or responsibility than one can handle; to extend something too far
to be sold in greater quantities than something else

items.def_zh: 超出，越过（overshoot 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of overshoot; to have gone beyond a target, limit, or intended destination

groups.summary_en: A subject goes beyond another entity or standard in extent, speed, quantity, or competitive performance. Verbs range from general quantitative excess to domain-specific superiority such as commercial sales or physical range.
groups.summary_zh: 在数量、尺度、表现或商业效益上超过对比目标。

groups.name: Exclamations & Emotional Vocal Outcries · 欢呼与情态呼喊 (Whoop, Howl, Ooh)
groups.tip: 兴奋欢呼或高声大喊宣泄情绪

items.def_zh: 尖声插话，突然发声嚷嚷
items.def_en: to suddenly start speaking or shouting, often in a high-pitched or shrill voice

items.def_zh: 发出“哦”的惊叹声，发出赞叹声
items.def_en: To make a long 'ooh' sound to express wonder, pleasure, surprise, or admiration.
to shout or speak loudly to attract attention or express an emotional outcry
to shout approval, praise, or encouragement warmly and loudly
to give a loud, informal, full-throated shout or call
to make a sudden, loud sound or shout due to pain, fright, or strong emotion

items.def_zh: 高声欢呼，兴奋大叫；欢呼着说出
items.def_en: To shout loudly and excitedly with joy, triumph, or enthusiasm.

items.def_zh: 长嚎，狂吠；咆哮，大声哭喊；呼啸
items.def_en: To make a long, loud, mournful sound like a wolf or dog; to cry, shout, or laugh loudly.
to produce a prolonged, high-pitched vocal cry of grief, fear, or pain
to emit a deep, loud, roaring shout typical of extreme rage or distress

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on non-verbalized or interjectional outcries expressing intense emotional states like delight, surprise, mockery, or physical anguish.
groups.summary_zh: 指表达惊叹、欢呼狂喜、痛楚或起哄等情绪的特异拟声呼喊。

groups.name: Exhilarate & Elate · 振奋与欢欣 (Uplift & Exhilarate)
groups.tip: 精神抖擞重新焕发活力

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make or become more cheerful, positive, and full of spirits
(+ sb) to become or make someone more lively, cheerful, or energetic
to give comfort, hope, or lighthearted happiness to someone

items.def_zh: （使）振作起来，（使）精神抖擞；竖起
items.def_en: (often 'perk up') To become or make someone more cheerful, lively, or energetic after feeling tired or sad.
to fill someone with renewed physical or mental energy and vitality

items.def_zh: 点燃热情，使斗志昂扬/极度兴奋
items.def_en: (+ sb) to fill someone with intense enthusiasm, excitement, or determination

items.def_zh: 使振奋，使极度兴奋，使高兴
items.def_en: (often passive) To make someone feel extremely happy, excited, and energized.

items.def_zh: 使兴高采烈，使欢欣鼓舞
items.def_en: (usually passive) To make someone feel extraordinarily proud, joyful, and excited.
to excite or elate someone to the point of losing self-control or critical awareness
to fill someone with intense pleasure, delight, or reverent joy

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe instilling positive energy, high spirits, or euphoric joy in someone. They range from a mild boost in alertness or cheerfulness to soaring, overwhelming excitement and pride.
groups.summary_zh: 使某人振奋精神、心情舒畅乃至陷入极度兴奋自豪。

groups.name: Express Clearly & Expound · 阐述与系统表达 (Articulate, Discourse, Expound)
groups.tip: 通过图表或言语清晰说明

items.def_en: (+ sth) to explain or present ideas, facts, or plans clearly and systematically
(+ sth) to state, arrange, or explain facts, arguments, or intentions clearly in speech or writing

items.def_zh: 用图解法表示；绘制……的图表
items.def_en: To represent, explain, or show the arrangement of something using a diagram.

items.def_zh: 为（图片、插图等）加文字说明或标题
items.def_en: To provide an illustration, photograph, or video with a title or explanatory caption.

items.def_zh: 详加说明，极其明白地阐述
items.def_en: (+ sth) to explain something in full, explicit, and painstaking detail
To speak or write authoritatively and at length about a particular subject.

items.def_zh: 清晰明确地表达；清晰发音；关节连接
items.def_en: 1. To express an idea or feeling clearly and effectively in words. 2. To pronounce words or sounds clearly. 3. To connect parts together with a joint.
to describe, outline, or represent something precisely in speech or diagrammatic detail
(+ on/upon) to explain a theory, belief, or concept thoroughly in systematic detail
to make something clear and easy to understand by careful explanation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote formulating ideas with precision, speaking or writing in structured detail, or illustrating concepts systematically.
groups.summary_zh: 清晰严密地阐明见解，或通过详述与图注进行系统说明。

groups.name: Extinguish & Put Out · 熄灭与扑灭 (Extinguish, Put out, Quench)
groups.tip: 扑灭火焰或压制火光

items.def_en: to make a fire, cigarette, or light stop burning or shining
to extinguish a small flame by blowing air onto it
(+ sth) to extinguish a flame or candle by covering it or pinching it
(+ sth) to extinguish a small fire by treading heavily upon it
(+ sth) to extinguish a flame or fire thoroughly by pouring water or liquid over it
1. To put out a fire, flame, or light so it stops burning. 2. To completely destroy or end a feeling, hope, or idea.

items.def_zh: 厚闷熄灭；隔绝空气闷灭
items.def_en: to extinguish a fire by covering it tightly to deprive it of oxygen

items.def_zh: 掐灭，熄灭（烛火等）；扼杀，消灭；用鼻子闻，吸入
items.def_en: 1. To extinguish a candle flame or light (often 'snuff out'). 2. To put an end to something suddenly. 3. To sniff or inhale something.
to extinguish a fire or flame, especially by pouring water or liquid over it
to extinguish a fire by throwing a large amount of liquid over it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing a fire, flame, or light source to cease burning or shining by depriving it of oxygen, cooling it, or using a physical barrier. They range from everyday phrasal verbs to formal or literary terms.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过隔绝氧气、降温或覆盖使火焰、烛光熄灭或扑灭。

groups.name: Fabricate & Craft Materially · 锻造与人工制造 (Forge, Mint, Synthesise)
groups.tip: 从无到有锻造与生产

items.def_en: to shape molten metal or other material by pouring it into a mold
to make up a substance or drug by combining two or more ingredients

items.def_zh: 匆匆敲定，粗略拼装制作出
items.def_en: (+ sth) to assemble or fabricate something roughly or hurriedly from material parts
(+ sth) to assemble or create a physical object by joining separate parts or pieces

items.def_zh: 粗制滥造，临时拼凑制作
items.def_en: (+ sth) to put together or fabricate something quickly and roughly from whatever materials are available

items.def_zh: 打制，锻造；缔造，开创；伪造，假冒
items.def_en: 1. To shape metal by heating it in a fire and beating it with a hammer. 2. To build or form something strong, such as an alliance, relationship, or agreement. 3. To make an illegal copy of something to deceive people.

items.def_zh: 铸造（硬币）；创造，发明（新词语等）
items.def_en: 1. To make coins from metal, especially officially for a government. 2. To invent or coin a new word or phrase.
to construct or manufacture an industrial product or structure from raw materials

items.def_zh: 重制，重新制作（remake 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of remake; to produce, make, or shape something again, often in a new or different way.
1. (chemistry / biology) To produce a substance by chemical or biological synthesis. 2. To combine various separate ideas, styles, or concepts into a unified whole.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe specialized, often technical or physical processes of fabricating, shaping, or compounding material items such as metal, currency, or chemicals.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过熔铸、压印、化学合成等专门工艺或人工技术制造实物。

groups.name: Fabricate & Forge · 仿造与伪造 (Counterfeit, Forge, Fake)
groups.tip: 仿照原作进行复刻或造假

items.def_en: (+ sth) Produce an unauthorized, illicit, or cheap copy of a design or product
To make a photographic or printed copy of a document using a photocopier.

items.def_zh: 捏造；伪造（故事、证据或借口）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Fabricate, invent, or concoct a false story, plan, or excuse

items.def_zh: 以假乱真地推销或冒充
items.def_en: (+ sth as sth) Falsely represent a fake or replica item as genuine
1. To make an exact copy of something in order to deceive people; forge. 2. To pretend to have a feeling, illness, etc.

items.def_zh: 复制，仿制；再现，重现；繁殖，生殖
items.def_en: 1. To make a copy of a text, picture, sound, etc. 2. To make something happen or exist again in the same way. 3. (of humans, animals, or plants) To produce young or offspring.

items.def_zh: 克隆，无性繁殖；复制，仿造
items.def_en: 1. (biology) To produce an exact genetic copy of an animal, plant, or gene. 2. To make an exact copy of a computer system, digital file, or product.

items.def_zh: 篡改，伪造（账目、记录或数据）
items.def_en: to alter records, reports, or accounts fraudulently so as to mislead

items.def_zh: 伪造，假冒（签名、画作或文件）
items.def_en: to fraudulently make or alter a document, signature, or work of art in order to deceive
to make an exact fraudulent imitation of something valuable, especially banknotes or official documents

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe producing a replica, imitation, or counterfeit version of an original object, document, or organism, often with intent to deceive or bypass authentic creation. The manner ranges from standard mechanical duplication (photocopy, reproduce) to fraudulent imitation (fake, forge, counterfeit).
groups.summary_zh: 仿制或伪造原件与真品，涵盖技术克隆及意在欺诈的假造。

groups.name: Face & Confront · 迎面正视与正面硬抗 (Brave, Confront, Beard)
groups.tip: 由勇敢直面升级为正面交锋

items.def_en: to accept and deal directly with a difficult situation or opponent

items.def_zh: 勇敢面对；正视（现实或困境）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Accept and confront an unpleasant truth, difficult situation, or consequence squarely

items.def_zh: 勇于面对；摆好架势迎战
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Face and deal resolutely with a challenger, threat, or hard reality
to resist or confront someone powerful courageously and refusing to yield
(+ sb/sth) Confront, challenge, or oppose an adversary or formidable problem directly

items.def_zh: 使竞争，使对抗，使相斗；在……上留下凹痕；去（果）核
items.def_en: 1. (+ against) To set someone or something in competition or conflict with another. 2. To make small marks or depressions on a surface. 3. To remove the stone or pit from fruit.

items.def_zh: 公然对抗，勇斗，当面顶撞
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To openly confront, oppose, or defy someone in a bold and fearless way.
1. To face and withstand a dangerous, difficult, or unpleasant situation with courage.

items.def_zh: 正视，勇敢面对；当面对质，对抗
items.def_en: 1. To face, meet, or deal with a difficult situation or problem directly. 2. To face someone with hostile or challenging intent, or confront them with evidence.
to openly resist or refuse to submit to an authority or formidable force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail an agent stepping directly into the path of an adversary, hazard, or unpleasant truth instead of flinching or retreating. Nuances range from stoic endurance ('brave') to assertive, unblinking opposition ('confront') and defiant, up-close audacity ('beard the lion').
groups.summary_zh: 指主动迎面正视、毫不避让地抗衡危险、敌手或严峻现实，强调勇气与正面交锋。

groups.name: Familiarize & Acquaint · 熟悉与了解 (Acquaint, Familiarize, Orient)
groups.tip: 从初次接触到全面掌握知晓

items.def_en: (+ sb on) to give someone essential practical information or instructions in advance
(+ sb on/about sth) Provide someone with key information or context to make them informed
(+ sb on sth) Give someone the details or background information necessary to understand a matter
(+ sb) Familiarize someone with the latest developments or necessary working knowledge

items.def_zh: 使适应；使熟悉（新环境或情况）
items.def_en: (+ oneself/sb to/towards) to direct or accustom someone to new surroundings or facts
(+ oneself/sb to) to make someone familiar with something through repeated exposure or habit

items.def_zh: 使知悉；使了解（与 with 连用）
items.def_en: (+ oneself/sb with) to make someone familiar with or aware of facts, conditions, or rules

items.def_zh: 使熟悉，使了解；使普及，使通俗化
items.def_en: To make someone or oneself familiar with or knowledgeable about something.
(+ sb of) to inform or notify someone about a development or state of affairs

items.def_zh: 使重新熟悉，使重新结识
items.def_en: To make someone or oneself familiar again with someone or something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote causing oneself or another person to gain knowledge, understanding, or habitual competence regarding a subject, environment, or process, typically followed by 'with'.
groups.summary_zh: 指使自己或他人知悉、习惯并掌握某项事物或环境。

groups.name: Fascination & Absolute Charm · 吸引与神魂颠倒 (Captivate, Fascinate, Enthrall)
groups.tip: 从产生兴趣到深深沉醉着迷

items.def_zh: 激起……的好奇心；引起极大兴趣
items.def_en: arouse the curiosity or interest of someone by being unusual or mysterious
(+ sb) Gain someone's affection, admiration, or favorable approval through charm or persuasion
delight greatly and attract through pleasing personality or appearance

items.def_zh: 使惊叹不已；使为之倾倒
items.def_en: (+ sb) Overwhelm someone with surprise, admiration, or delight

items.def_zh: 使神魂颠倒（尤指 sweep sb off their feet）
items.def_en: (+ sb off sb's feet) Completely captivate or infatuate someone, sweeping away resistance
To hold someone's complete interest, attention, and curiosity by being very interesting or delightful.
hold the complete attention of someone as if bound by a spell
To attract and hold the attention and affection of someone completely by being charming, beautiful, or delightful.
1. To hold someone's fascination and attention completely. 2. (archaic) To enslave.
cause someone to become motionless with horror, wonder, or astonishment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark an ascending scale of mental and emotional capture, from arousing intense intellectual curiosity and interest (fascinate), to holding total aesthetic or personal absorption (captivate, enthrall), to being completely struck or overwhelmed by infatuation (smite/smitten).
groups.summary_zh: 从引起强烈兴趣与好奇，到牢牢吸引全部心神，直至彻底坠入爱河。

groups.name: Fashion & Construct · 构筑与匠造 (Fashion, Carpenter, Fabricate)
groups.tip: 动手打造打磨自制物品

items.def_en: to put together roughly or quickly using whatever materials are at hand
(+ sth) Construct or assemble something rapidly or roughly from available materials
to assemble a complete whole by joining separate components carefully
(+ sth) Assemble, build, or synthesize parts into a coherent physical or conceptual whole
(+ sth) Erect, assemble, or construct something quickly or makeshift fashion using whatever is at hand

items.def_zh: 做木工活；打造，制作（木制品）；精巧地装配
items.def_en: To make, fit, or repair wooden structures and objects; to construct or assemble skillfully.

items.def_zh: 手工制作，打造，塑造（使成形）
items.def_en: To shape, make, or form something skillfully, especially with hands or simple tools.

items.def_zh: 重新制作，重造；翻拍（电影等）
items.def_en: To make something again in a different or improved way; to produce a new version of an existing film or song.
to construct or manufacture an industrial or structural product from raw parts
to shape metal by heating and hammering, or to build a durable relationship/result

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe skillful, deliberate shaping and manual construction of physical or figurative artifacts from raw components or pre-existing material, emphasizing craftsmanship, structural assembly, or adaptive rework.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过手工技艺或精巧工艺构筑、制作或改制物品。

groups.name: Fasten, Secure & Enclose Barriers · 关锁与门禁启闭 (Shut, Unlock, Latch)
groups.tip: 开合通道或施加锁闭

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Enclose or confine someone or something by closing doors, gates, or barriers

items.def_zh: 给……装大门；用闸门关住，关门限制……出入
items.def_en: To furnish or close off with a gate; to restrict or confine within gates.
To open the lock of a door, container, or device; to make something accessible or revealed.
to fasten a door or gate with a latch so it stays closed
(+ sth) Secure, fasten, or obstruct an entrance or window firmly with wooden or metal bars
(+ sth) Fasten boards over doors or windows to enclose, barricade, or secure an opening
To close an entrance, container, or opening so that passage is obstructed; to cease operations.
to secure all doors, gates, and windows of a building or room with locks
to secure an entrance or barrier firmly by placing a heavy bar across it
to fasten a door or window firmly with a sliding metal bar

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote manipulating doors, gates, and movable barriers to secure, fasten, or unfasten access to an enclosed space.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过门栓、锁具或门栏对通道与出入口进行闭合、上锁或开启。

groups.name: Fight & Clash · 纠缠交战与肢体扭打 (Skirmish, Scuffle, Grapple)
groups.tip: 不同规模的武力冲突

items.def_en: (+ sb) Engage in a short, messy, informal physical fight or scuffle

items.def_zh: 发生小冲突，进行小规模交火；发生小争吵
items.def_en: To engage in a minor, brief fight or dispute, especially between small military groups.
(+ with/over) to struggle or fight roughly and disorderly, especially to obtain possession of something
Engage in a heated physical fight or aggressive scuffle

items.def_zh: 摆好架势对打；对峙决斗
items.def_en: (+ with sb) Adopt a fighting stance or prepare to engage directly in a combat clash
to fight noisily and roughly in a public place
(+ with) to engage in a close-quarters fight or struggle without weapons by clutching and wrestling
To fight briefly and confusedly at close quarters; to shuffle feet noisily.

items.def_zh: （中世纪骑士）骑马持矛比武；激烈交锋，展开竞争
items.def_en: To fight on horseback with lances in a medieval tournament; to engage in a fierce competition or contest.

items.def_zh: （战斗机）进行近距空中缠斗；激烈争夺
items.def_en: (of fighter aircraft) To engage in close-range combat in the air; to engage in a fierce struggle.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote dynamic, specialized physical combat or chaotic clashes, emphasizing the physical manner of engagement such as tangled wrestling, brief border fighting, or rapid aerial dogfighting.
groups.summary_zh: 描述具体方式的肢体打斗、混乱扭打或小规模交火冲突。

groups.name: Flee & Depart Secretly · 仓促逃离与溜走 (Decamp, Hightail, Skedaddle)
groups.tip: 摆脱束缚或仓皇逃跑逃离

items.def_en: (+ with) to escape hurriedly, especially after doing something illegal
Leave or depart quietly, unobtrusively, and without drawing attention
Depart furtively and secretly, often to avoid detection or duty
Depart or evacuate a place rapidly, abruptly, or under pressure
(+ for/from) to suddenly and rapidly run away out of fear or an urge to escape
(+ with/from) to depart secretly and hide, typically to avoid arrest or prosecution, often taking money

items.def_zh: （尤指秘密或匆忙地）逃走，溜走；拔营，撤营
items.def_en: 1. (often + to/with) To leave a place suddenly and secretly, often to escape or with stolen goods. 2. To pack up and leave a camp.
to leave in a great hurry, frequently used in imperative commands

items.def_zh: 仓促逃走，飞快逃离（常用于hightail it）
items.def_en: ('hightail it') (informal) To run away or leave a place as quickly as possible.
(informal) To run away or leave quickly, especially in a hurry or panic.

groups.summary_en: Informal and literary verbs denoting rapid, sudden, or evasive departures to avoid detection, pursuit, or impending consequences, typically used intransitively.
groups.summary_zh: 指为躲避追踪、麻烦或职责而突然、仓促地逃离或溜走。

groups.name: Float, Suggest & Formalize Proposals · 试探、提议与郑重提出 (Suggest, Moot, Propose, Proposition)
groups.tip: 提出建设性建议或正式提案

items.def_en: (+ sth) Introduce a topic, matter, or proposal into conversation or consideration
(+ sth) Produce or suggest an idea, scheme, or proposal for consideration
to offer an idea, theory, or candidate for general consideration and evaluation
(+ sth) Offer or mention an idea or suggestion casually for discussion
to propose an idea, plan, or course of action; to imply or indicate something indirectly.

items.def_zh: 提出（计划或建议）供讨论；讨论
items.def_en: (often passive) (chiefly British) to suggest or bring up an idea or plan for consideration and discussion.
(chiefly BrE) to officially submit a motion, proposal, or topic for formal debate

items.def_zh: 提议，建议，提出（计划等）；求婚；打算
items.def_en: 1. To put forward a plan, idea, or offer for consideration. 2. (+ to) To ask someone to marry you.

items.def_zh: 向（某人）提议；向（某人）提出性要求
items.def_en: To make a suggestion or offer to someone, especially a business proposal or an invitation to have sex.
to present a formal written bid, resignation, or proposition formally to an authority

groups.summary_en: This frame spans speech acts that put an idea, course of action, or offer before an interlocutor for consideration—escalating from tentative hint or open brainstorming (moot, suggest) to formal institutional presentation (propose) and blunt, often improper personal solicitations (proposition).
groups.summary_zh: 从试探性推敲、委婉建议递进至正式提呈乃至直白利诱。

groups.name: Fly & Soar · 飞行与翱翔 (Airborne Motion)
groups.tip: 在空中振翅或滑翔

items.def_en: Make contact with the ground at the conclusion of flight
to stay in the air in one place, flapping wings or rotors rapidly
to fly smoothly through the air without power or engine noise
Fly downwards rapidly and smoothly through the air, often toward prey
Leave the ground and begin airborne flight

items.def_zh: 飞，飞翔；驾驶（飞机）；飞越；疾驰
items.def_en: 1. To move through the air using wings or an aircraft. 2. To operate an aircraft; to transport someone or something by aircraft.

items.def_zh: 飞翔，飞行；飞越；击中（人或鸟的）侧翼或翅膀
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To travel through the air using wings; to fly. 2. To wound a bird or person in the wing or arm.
to fly high in the air without moving wings much, carried by air currents
To fly directly over a particular place or territory in an aircraft.
to move rapidly downward through the air, especially to attack or land

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe self-propelled or winged movement through the air, ranging from basic transit aloft to effortless gliding, high climbing, and swooping.
groups.summary_zh: 描述在空中展翅飞行、翱翔滑翔或俯冲巡航的各种空中运动方式。

groups.name: Forage & Prey on Specific Fauna · 特类动植物捕猎与采集 (Prey, Fowl, Frog, Oyster)
groups.tip: 野外追捕并猎取动物

items.def_en: (+ sth) Consume or forage specific plants or animals as a primary food source
[I/T] to try to catch fish or seafood in a body of water using nets, lines, or traps
to hunt or catch frogs.
to search for and catch crabs as a livelihood or recreational activity
to gather, dredge, or fish for oysters.
(+ for) to dig for or gather edible clams from coastal sands or mudflats
to hunt, shoot, or catch wild birds.
(+ sb/sth) Track, pursue, and capture wild prey after targeted pursuit
(+ sb/sth) Hunt, capture, and feed upon another creature

items.def_zh: 捕食，猎食；侵害，欺凌；折磨，使苦恼
items.def_en: (prey on/upon) to hunt and eat another animal; to exploit, harm, or deceive vulnerable people.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized frame describe engaging in the targeted hunting, gathering, or predatory harvest of specific wild creatures or preying upon other living organisms in nature. They typically function intransitively, often derived denominally from the quarry itself.
groups.summary_zh: 针对特定物种开展捕猎、采集或本能捕食活动。

groups.name: Forbid & Prohibit · 严禁与法令取缔 (Ban, Prohibit, Outlaw)
groups.tip: 法令或规矩明文不许

items.def_en: to officially or legally prevent something from being done, read, or used
1. To officially forbid something by law, rule, or other authority; make something impossible.
to prohibit or forbid authoritatively, especially by an authoritative or ecclesiastical order
(+ sth) Impose strict measures or an outright ban to suppress an illegal or unwanted practice

items.def_zh: 明令排除；判定不可行/不允许
items.def_en: (+ sth) Exclude or formally disallow an action, candidate, or possibility
(+ sth) Take severe, decisive legal or institutional action against prohibited activities

items.def_zh: 禁止，不准（forbid 的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of forbid; to officially disallow or order not to do something.
To order someone not to do something, or to officially disallow something.
to make something totally illegal by passing a statute or governmental decree
to denounce or forbid a practice or organization formally as dangerous or unlawful

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent authoritative, legal, or institutional acts that decree an activity unlawful or inadmissible. 'Forbid' spans interpersonal and general injunctions, whereas 'prohibit' and 'ban' carry official and statutory gravity, and 'outlaw' formally places a practice outside legal protection.
groups.summary_zh: 依法律、权威或规章明令禁止某项行为或剥夺其合法地位。

groups.name: Fracture to Destruction · 裂碎至分子化粉碎 (Chip, Grind, Smash, Atomize)
groups.tip: 施加外力击碎碾压成微粒

items.def_zh: （使）掉碎片，（使）磕碰破损；凿，切削
items.def_en: To break a small piece off something by knocking or hitting it, or to be broken in this way.
to break or cause to break into small, thin, sharp pieces
(+ sth) Disintegrate or cause to fracture into distinct smaller fragments
(+ sth) Reduce something solid to small particles or fine powder by friction or crushing
to break violently into numerous tiny pieces upon impact
(+ sth) Break something violently into small pieces; destroy by shattering
To break violently into many pieces, or to cause something to do this; to hit or collide with great force.

items.def_zh: 磨碎，碾碎；摩擦，磨光；折磨
items.def_en: To break or crush something into small pieces or powder; to rub two hard surfaces together.
to reduce completely to fine dust or powder by crushing or beating

items.def_zh: 使粉碎成微粒；使雾化，使喷成雾状；使分裂，使瓦解
items.def_en: 1. To reduce something to tiny particles or spray; to turn a liquid into a fine mist. 2. To divide or break something into separate, isolated units.

groups.summary_en: This frame spans the physical reduction of brittle or solid structures into smaller fragments, powder, or ultimate constituents. It progresses in destructive intensity from small superficial fractures ('chip') to violent shattering ('smash'), crushing reduction ('grind'), down to absolute micro-level disintegration ('atomize').
groups.summary_zh: 由表层剥落、暴力破碎到研磨碾烂，直至彻底粉碎或化为微粒的破坏过程。

groups.name: Frame & Word Communication · 措辞与表达形式 (Phrase, Couch, Formulate)
groups.tip: 斟酌字句将思想转化为言辞

items.def_en: (+ adv./prep.) to express something in a specified manner or words
(+ sth) Communicate or express thoughts and messages clearly and effectively
(+ sth) Formulate or state something in clear, unambiguous, and explicit detail
to select and arrange words carefully to communicate a thought

items.def_zh: 用言语表达，措辞；划分乐句
items.def_en: 1. To express something in words, especially in a particular style. 2. (music) To divide or group musical notes into melodic units.

items.def_zh: 用……方式表达，以……措辞；低放（长矛等）；蹲伏
items.def_en: To express or state something in a specified style or manner of words.
(+ sth) Frame or present words, facts, or ideas attractively to disguise an unpleasant truth

items.def_zh: （以特定视角或方式）构思表达
items.def_en: to express or present an idea, statement, or question in a specific way

items.def_zh: 重新阐述，改换措辞表达；重构，改制
items.def_en: To express or state a plan, idea, or theory again in a different or clearer way.
1. To express thoughts, feelings, or opinions in words. 2. To utter sounds or sing with the voice.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on the deliberate selection, packaging, or stylistic styling of words to convey a specific sentiment or tone, ranging from neutral articulation to highly cautious or evasive phrasing.
groups.summary_zh: 强调刻意选择特定言辞、语气或结构来包装与阐述想法。

groups.name: Frolic & Prance · 欢蹦与雀跃 (Frolic, Gambol, Prance)
groups.tip: 欢快起舞或得意跳步

items.def_en: act in a comical, exaggeratedly silly, or high-spirited way
play in a boisterous, playful, or silly manner

items.def_zh: 欢跃，雀跃奔跳（尤指幼兽）
items.def_en: to jump or skip about happily and playfully, like a young animal
to play or move about in a happy, lively, and energetic way
engage in rough, energetic, and boisterous play
to skip or dance about in a lively or playful, exaggerated manner
1. To dance energetically to swing or rock and roll music. 2. (informal) to talk insincerely, tease, or deceive.

items.def_zh: 嬉闹，欢蹦乱跳；轻而易举地取胜（romp home/in）
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To play, run, or jump in a lively, boisterous way. 2. (romp home/in) to win a race or contest easily.

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步，欢跃；（马）昂首腾跃
items.def_en: 1. To walk or dance around with exaggerated, bouncy movements to attract attention. 2. (of a horse) to move with high, springing steps.

items.def_zh: 跳斯卡舞（随斯卡乐节奏狂乱摆动身体跳舞）
items.def_en: To dance energetically to ska or reggae music by bending the knees and swinging the arms.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lively, high-spirited, bouncing, or dance-like bodily movements expressing playfulness, arrogance, or rhythmic celebration.
groups.summary_zh: 以雀跃、跳跃或富有节奏的舞动姿态展现欢闹或得意。

groups.name: Gesture & Posture · 体态与神情 (Expressive Bodily Signals)
groups.tip: 故作姿态以虚张声势或表态

items.def_en: to purse or tighten one's lips together into wrinkles as an expressive facial gesture
to adopt an upright posture by raising one's spine and squaring shoulders
to lower and raise the head quickly as a sign of agreement or acknowledgment

items.def_zh: 耸肩（以表不知道、不在乎或无奈）；对……不予理睬（shrug off）
items.def_en: To raise and lower your shoulders to express doubt, indifference, or ignorance; ('shrug off') to dismiss something as unimportant.

items.raw_cluster: 示意与做手势 Gesture & Signal
items.def_en: 1. To close and open one eye quickly as a signal, greeting, or sign of shared secrecy. 2. To shine with an unsteady or flashing light; twinkle.
To bring your eyebrows together in anger, worry, or concentration; ('frown on/upon') to disapprove of something.
to smile in an unpleasant, smug, or self-satisfied manner

items.def_zh: 装模作样，故作姿态，摆姿态
items.def_en: (disapproving) To behave in an artificial or exaggerated way intended to impress, deceive, or gain advantage.

items.def_zh: 做鬼脸；因痛苦而龇牙咧嘴
items.def_en: to contort the face to express disgust, disapproval, or pain
to frown in an angry, bad-tempered, or menacing way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote voluntary or involuntary physical movements of the face, shoulders, or body used to project attitudes, emotions, or social signals.
groups.summary_zh: 利用面部神态、耸肩或摆姿势等肢体动作传达情绪或社会信号。

groups.name: Grapple & Clash · 搏斗与交锋 (Wrestle, Clash, Spar)
groups.tip: 言辞争吵到切磋性拳脚交锋

items.def_en: 1. To practice boxing with light punches without trying to hurt each other. 2. (+ with) To argue or disagree in a lively but usually harmless way.

items.def_zh: 小规模交火；发生小冲突
items.def_en: to fight briefly and irregularly on the fringes of a larger contest
to engage in a short, confused, relatively disordered physical fight
engage in a close, forceful confrontation or physical grapple
get involved in a physical fight, skirmish, or brawl
(+ sb/sth) engage in direct physical struggle or combat against an opponent

items.def_zh: 摔跤，角力；扭打，搏斗；努力解决，竭力对付
items.def_en: 1. To fight someone by holding them and trying to push or throw them to the ground. 2. (+ with) To struggle hard to deal with or solve a difficult problem.
(+ with/over) to struggle vigorously or wrestle roughly with someone

items.def_zh: 发生打斗，发生冲突；争执，发生分歧；（颜色、时间等）不协调，抵触
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To fight or argue violently with an opposing group or person. 2. (+ with) To disagree strongly, or to look bad together or occur at the same time.
(+ with) to engage in a close, forceful struggle or hand-to-hand fight

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote engaging in direct, forceful physical combat or competitive struggle against an opponent. They range from light, exploratory practice or skirmishing to intense, exhaustive physical locking of bodies.
groups.summary_zh: 强调双方直接的肢体搏击、对抗较量或激烈交锋。

groups.name: Grievance & Lamentation · 抱怨与哀叹 (Gripe, Moan, Lament)
groups.tip: 从日常口头抱怨到深沉悲鸣

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) complain continuously, spitefully, or petulantly about something
(+ sb/sth) complain in a feeble, irritable, or high-pitched manner
1. (+ about) To complain or grumble persistently and annoyingly. 2. To make a low, prolonged sound expressing pain, grief, or pleasure.
(+ about) to complain in an annoying, petulant, high-pitched tone
(+ about) to express persistent, irritating complaints about petty matters

items.def_zh: 哀叹，悲叹，对……表示惋惜或不满
items.def_en: To express deep sorrow, regret, or dissatisfaction over something.
utter a loud, mournful, or agonized vocalization of distress or grief
(+ over/for) To express deep regret, grief, or sorrow about something.
(+ for/over) to feel or show deep sorrow for a serious death or loss
to make a long, loud cry of pain, grief, or impassioned complaint

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify vocalizing dissatisfaction, distress, or grief, escalating from trivial, petulant griping to profound, sorrowful lamentation over loss or misfortune.
groups.summary_zh: 表达不满、委屈或痛苦，从琐屑发牢骚升格至沉痛哀叹悲挽。

groups.name: Groom & Spruce Up · 梳理修饰与精心打扮 (Preen, Primp, Groom)
groups.tip: 精细修整趾甲或打理羽毛

items.def_zh: 梳理清洗干净，收拾体面
items.def_en: (+ sb/oneself) wash, groom, and make oneself or someone presentable
(+ sb/oneself) improve one's personal appearance, neatness, or grooming
[T/I] Make oneself or someone else neat, smart, and presentable in dress and appearance
[T/I] Brush, clean, and make neat the coat, hair, or appearance of oneself or an animal
1. To trim, clean, and care for feet and toenails cosmetically.

items.def_zh: （鸟）用喙理（羽毛）；打扮，精心修饰；自鸣得意
items.def_en: 1. (of a bird) To clean and smooth its feathers with its beak. 2. To spend time making oneself look neat and attractive. 3. ('preen oneself') To feel proud or smug about oneself.

items.def_zh: 精心打扮，修饰（发型、容貌等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To spend time carefully arranging your hair, clothes, and makeup to look neat and attractive.
(+ sb/oneself) dress and groom oneself or another in a showy, meticulous way

items.def_zh: 打扮，精心修饰（尤指对着镜子）
items.def_en: [I/T] Spend time adorning oneself or fussing with clothing and cosmetics in front of a glass
Treat, trim, and polish the fingernails and skin of the hands cosmetically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the deliberate, meticulous cleaning, neatening, or adorning of oneself, someone else, or an animal. Nuances emphasize self-absorbed fussing before a mirror, dedicated cosmetic maintenance of specific bodily parts, or meticulous hygienic grooming.
groups.summary_zh: 指对自身容貌、毛发或身体部位进行细致梳理、修饰或精心修饰。

groups.name: Guide & Impart Instruction · 指导与训诫 (Mentor, Preach, Tutor)
groups.tip: 传道授业与悉心指导

items.def_zh: 辅导，训练（通过针对性练习提升表现）
items.def_en: [I/T] To train and give focused instruction to someone for an exam, performance, or sport

items.def_zh: 劝告，提供心理或专业咨询
items.def_en: [I/T] To give professional advice and guidance to someone resolving personal or social difficulties
(+ on/about) To deliver a didactic or moralizing lecture to someone in an intrusive way
(+ sb) train and instruct someone gradually into a new role or skill
(+ sb/sth) guide someone through a process or instruction step by step
(+ sth) authoritatively formulate and prescribe rules, principles, or moral guidance

items.def_zh: 指导，辅导（提供长期建议与培训）
items.def_en: To advise, guide, and train a younger or less experienced person over a period of time.
1. To deliver a sermon or religious address to an audience. 2. To earnestly advocate or urge a moral standard or belief.

items.def_zh: 教授，指导（系统传授技能或知识）
items.def_en: (+ in/on) To teach someone a subject or how to do something systematically

items.def_zh: 辅导，个别指导；当家庭教师
items.def_en: To teach or coach an individual student or small group.

groups.summary_en: An authority or experienced figure transmits specialized knowledge, moral doctrine, or practical skills to individuals or an audience, ranging from personal guidance to pedagogical drilling or dogmatic preaching.
groups.summary_zh: 师长或专业人士对受众进行个别指导、学业辅导或教义布道。

groups.name: Halt & Extinguish Flow · 压制流转与彻底终止 (Stagnate, Stanch, Deactivate, Kibosh)
groups.tip: 切断运转进程，直接戛然而止

items.def_en: to stop, check, or slow down the progress or spread of a development or disease

items.def_zh: 使停止运转，停用，使无效；解除（军事单位等）编制
items.def_en: To make something stop functioning or to deactivate a device, account, or chemical.

items.def_zh: 停滞，不发展；（水等）停止流动，变污浊
items.def_en: To stop developing, progressing, or flowing, and therefore become inactive or stale.
To stop the flow of liquid, especially blood, or to bring an end to something undesirable.
(+ sth) cut off, obstruct, or halt the supply, flow, or progress of something
(+ sb/sth) stop the flow, operation, or functioning of a system or activity completely
(+ sth) extinguish a fire, flow, or movement forcefully and entirely
to cause something to cease burning, existing, or functioning entirely
to suppress or extinguish something completely by forceful authority

items.def_zh: 使终止，破坏，废除（常用于 put the kibosh on）
items.def_en: (informal, usually in 'put the kibosh on') To put an end to something or prevent it from happening.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail stopping progress, flow, or system operations, varying dramatically in force and permanence. From inert cessation of movement ('stagnate') and sealing an active fluid leak ('stanch') to formal systematic de-energizing ('deactivate') and abrupt, decisive destruction of a plan ('put the kibosh on / kibosh').
groups.summary_zh: 阻遏流动、停顿进展乃至通过果断手段强行终结事物运转。

groups.name: Handcraft & Shape Artfully · 精制与塑形 (Handcraft, Confect, Mold)
groups.tip: 手工精心打造精致作品

items.def_en: (+ sth) assemble or handcraft an object by carefully joining separate parts
to carve an object bit by bit by cutting small slices from wood
To shape a material roughly in advance before final molding or finishing.
(+ sth) shape an artistic form or object by cutting away material manually
(+ sth) shape, flatten, or fashion metal or material through deliberate manual striking
to create an object by pouring hot liquid material into a hollow matrix
to give a particular shape or form to soft or molten substance using a mold
To make an object skillfully by hand rather than by machine.

items.def_zh: 配制，精制（甜食或药品）；虚构，编造
items.def_en: (formal) To prepare, make, or assemble something, especially sweet foods or an elaborate story.
to shape or carve clay, stone, or other material into artistic forms

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize the customized, artistic, or meticulous fashioning of physical materials into finished goods, ornamental pieces, or confections, contrasting industrial mass-production with manual finesse.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过双手或专用模具精工细作、调制或塑造成型的动作。

groups.name: Harden & Strengthen Material · 硬化与抗性加固 (Fortify, Toughen, Temper)
groups.tip: 增强结构坚固度与耐受力

items.def_en: (+ sth) strengthen or support a physical structure to prevent collapse or weakness
(+ sth) reinforce, thicken, or strengthen a material or physical framework
(+ sth) make a material, barrier, or structure substantially thicker or stronger

items.def_zh: 加固；用额外材料增强结构
items.def_en: to strengthen a physical structure or material by adding extra support or materials
to improve the hardness and elasticity of metal or glass by heating and cooling processes
[I/T] to make a substance rigid, tough, and resistant to wear or impact, or become so
to treat an item or surface so that water cannot penetrate it
to provide a building or defensive structure with defenses to withstand assault

items.def_zh: （使）变坚韧，（使）坚强；使（制度、法律等）更严厉
items.def_en: 1. To make something stronger or more resilient, or to become stronger. 2. To make rules, laws, or policies stricter or harsher.

items.def_zh: 对……进行防火处理，使防火
items.def_en: To treat a material, fabric, or building with substances so that it resists catching fire.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate physical, chemical, or structural modifications to an inanimate material, substance, or structure to make it resistant to damage, heat, stress, or attack. They differ according to the exact vulnerability addressed.
groups.summary_zh: 通过物理或化学加工提升物料、结构的坚固度、韧性或防护抗性。

groups.name: Heavy & Dragging Gait · 拖沓与沉重步行 (Shuffle, Lumber, Limp)
groups.tip: 拖着脚步懒散挪动

items.def_zh: 一瘸一拐地往前走；蹒跚而行
items.def_en: Walk forward with an awkward, uneven gait because of pain or an injured foot or leg

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地向前走；步履蹒跚地前行
items.def_en: Walk slowly with heavy, labored steps

items.def_zh: 拖着脚步走；缓步向前挪动
items.def_en: Walk slowly while dragging one's feet along the ground without lifting them fully

items.def_zh: 拖着脚走；洗（牌）；变换位置，挪动
items.def_en: 1. to walk by dragging one's feet along the ground without lifting them fully 2. to mix playing cards together in random order
to walk slowly and with heavy, deliberate steps over an extended duration

items.def_zh: 吃力地往前走；艰难跋涉
items.def_en: Continue walking slowly and with heavy effort, typically when tired or in harsh conditions

items.raw_cluster: 蹒跚与缓慢移动 Plod & Lumber
items.def_zh: 缓慢笨拙地移动；迫使承担（烦人责任等）
items.def_en: 1. to move in a slow, heavy, and awkward way 2. (informal) to burden someone with an unwanted duty or responsibility

items.def_zh: 一瘸一拐地走，跛行；艰难前行
items.def_en: to walk slowly and unevenly because of an injured leg or foot; proceed with difficulty
to walk awkwardly with a dragging, slow, and uncoordinated movement of the feet
to walk slowly and heavily with great effort, especially when exhausted or through difficult ground

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe walking with compromised mechanics, characterized by scraping feet, lumbering body mass, or uneven cadence caused by pain.
groups.summary_zh: 指因身体沉重、虚弱或受伤而表现出的拖脚慢行或沉重缓行步态。

groups.name: Help & Support · 帮助与支援 (Assist, Aid, Succor, Back)
groups.tip: 伸出援手共渡难关

items.def_en: to provide moral, financial, or political backing for a person or proposal

items.def_zh: 帮助，协助；改善，缓解；避免，忍住
items.def_en: 1. to make it easier or possible for someone to do something; assist 2. to improve or relieve a situation or condition 3. to prevent or avoid doing something
(+ in/with) to give help or support, typically in a professional or subordinate capacity
to provide necessary money, food, or material relief in time of need
to give immediate aid, comfort, or relief to someone in severe distress
(+ sb) Help someone, especially by giving them money or doing work for them
(+ sb) Support or encourage someone, especially in a confrontation or difficult situation
Join in and help with a job, task, or collective effort
(+ sb) Help someone get through a difficult period, usually by providing money or sustenance

items.def_zh: 帮助（某人）渡过难关（常与 over 连用）；随潮漂流，顺潮行驶
items.def_en: 1. (tide someone over) to help someone get through a difficult period, especially with money or food 2. to drift or float with the tide

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict providing resources, physical aid, or moral backing to relieve another's difficulty or enable them to achieve an objective. They range from ubiquitous assistance ('help', 'assist') to financial and emergency rescue ('tide over', 'succor').
groups.summary_zh: 指通过提供资源、行动或财物协助他人渡过难关或达成目标。

groups.name: Hesitate & Refuse · 畏葸停步与退缩不前 (Balk, Blench, Funk)
groups.tip: 临阵犹豫与本能畏缩后退

items.def_en: to express hesitation, doubt, or mild objection before acting
Retreat or show unwillingness to become involved or proceed with an undertaking
Hesitate or show reluctance to act or proceed
(+ from) to avoid doing something because you are nervous or frightened
(+ from) to show unwillingness to do something because it is frightening or unpleasant

items.def_zh: 畏缩不前；因顾虑而拒绝
items.def_en: (+ sth) Hesitate or refuse stubbornly to proceed with a course of action

items.def_zh: 畏避；回避（困难或危险的事）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Reluctantly hesitate or decline to do something because of fear, distaste, or lack of confidence

items.def_zh: 畏缩不前，犹豫推诿；阻止，挫败
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To hesitate and refuse to accept or do something difficult, unpleasant, or expensive. 2. To prevent someone from doing what they intended; thwart.
(+ at/from) To flinch, draw back, or turn pale suddenly from fear, pain, or shock.
(informal) to avoid doing something challenging or terrifying because of cowardice

groups.summary_en: An agent halts abruptly, winces inwardly, or obstinately refuses to proceed due to fear, moral qualms, or intimidation. Verbs emphasize moral hesitance, mental recoiling, or balking at an obstacle.
groups.summary_zh: 出于畏难、胆怯或道德顾忌而在关键节点止步不前、临阵退缩。

groups.name: Hesitate & Stammer · 犹疑吞吐与支吾 (Hesitate, Waver, Hem and Haw)
groups.tip: 言语支吾吞吐拿不定主意

items.def_en: (+ sth) hesitate, pause, and struggle awkwardly to find the right words
to hesitate extensively and avoid giving a direct answer through vague noises and pauses
(+ over/through) to make frequent speech errors or pauses while trying to speak

items.def_zh: 犹豫吞吐，支吾其词（常作 hem and haw）；（使牲口）向左转
items.def_en: To hesitate and speak unclearly, especially in the phrase 'hem and haw'.

items.def_zh: 结结巴巴地说；口吃吞吐
items.def_en: [I/T] to speak with involuntary pauses and rapid repetitions of syllables, often from nervousness
(+ sth) falter or hesitate in vocal delivery due to emotional stress or reluctance
(+ sth) utter words haltingly with involuntary pauses or repeated syllables
to lose strength or confidence in speaking, causing one's voice to hesitate or waver

items.def_zh: 犹豫不决，摇摆；摇晃，摇曳，颤抖
items.def_en: 1. To hesitate between choices or be unable to make a decision. 2. To flicker, tremble, or shake unsteadily.

items.def_zh: 说模棱两可的话；含糊推诿
items.def_en: to speak ambiguously or noncommittally in order to mislead or avoid commitment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe vocal hesitation, pausing, or faltering delivery in speech caused by indecision, nervousness, or evasion, often involving pauses, filler sounds, or repeated syllables.
groups.summary_zh: 指说话时因犹豫、紧张或推诿而吞吞吐吐、支吾停顿。

groups.name: Hoard & Stockpile · 囤积与储备 (Hoard, Stockpile, Stash)
groups.tip: 持续积攒聚集大量物资

items.def_en: (+ sth) Put something away in a container or storage space until needed
(+ sth) Accumulate or cause something to accumulate into a large quantity
to save or put away money or valuables for the future, often secretly
to store or hide money or goods in a secure place for future use
(+ sth) Store or hide something away in a safe, secluded place
Acquire and store a large quantity of something for future use
(+ away) to store something secretly and safely in a hidden place
to accumulate a large amount of wealth, resources, or items over time
1. To collect and store a large reserve of goods, supplies, or weapons for future use.
1. To collect and store large amounts of food, money, or items secretly, often beyond one's immediate needs.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate collecting, accumulating, and storing large quantities of supplies, valuables, or resources—often excessively, secretly, or in anticipation of future scarcity.
groups.summary_zh: 出于备荒或贪婪而大量聚敛、贮存物资或隐匿财物。

groups.name: Hold & Grasp · 抓握与持有 (Palm, Grip, Seize)
groups.tip: 从轻握掌持到用力握紧抓牢

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Keep one's hands firmly gripping or supporting something

items.def_zh: 将……藏于手心；偷偷拿走（或藏匿）；用手抚弄
items.def_en: 1. To conceal or hold something in the palm of the hand, especially in a sleight of hand or theft. 2. To touch, hold, or handle with the palm.
(+ sb/sth) Seize or take hold of someone or something quickly and firmly
(+ sth) Hold something firmly or tenaciously with the hands
(+ sb/sth) Take hold of and grip firmly onto someone or something
to take a firm, steady hold of something with the hand

items.def_zh: 抓住，夺取；没收，扣押；捉拿，逮捕
items.def_en: 1. To take hold of suddenly, forcefully, or violently; grab. 2. To take official possession of something by legal authority.

items.def_zh: 紧握，抓牢；吸引，强烈影响；控制
items.def_en: 1. To hold or grasp tightly and firmly. 2. To capture the interest or attention of someone intensely; to take a firm hold on emotionally.
[I/T] to grasp or hold someone or something tightly, often with anxiety, eagerness, or fear
to seize or grab something quickly, abruptly, or aggressively

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover manual contact and physical control over an object using the hands. They range in force and speed from stealthy handling ('palm') to steady, firm clutching ('grip') and sudden, forceful apprehension ('seize', 'snatch').
groups.summary_zh: 指用手操控、抓取或牢牢握持，从隐秘按抚递进至强力抓夺。

groups.name: Hope & Wish · 希望与期盼 (Long, Yearn, Aspire, Crave)
groups.tip: 对未来美好事物的心怀向往

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to have an intense, sustained desire for something distant or missing
to want something to happen and reasonably believe that it is possible

items.def_zh: 希望，想要，愿望；祝愿，祈愿
items.def_en: 1. to want something to happen or be true, even if it is unlikely 2. to express a hope or desire for someone's well-being or success
(+ sb/sth) Yearn intensely for or want something very much
(+ sth) Feel a persistent, strong craving or yearning for something
(+ sb/sth) Feel intensely sad while missing and wishing deeply for someone or something
(+ sth) Await a future event with anticipation and pleasure
to feel an overpowering, visceral appetite or desire for something
(+ to/to do) to direct one's hopes and ambitious efforts toward a noble goal
(+ for/to do) to feel an aching, poignant desire for something hard to attain

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on desire and anticipation for a specific future outcome or unfulfilled state. While 'hope' carries realistic expectation of fulfillment and 'wish' often leans toward hypotheticals or regrets, richer verbs encode yearning and aspiration.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对未来可能实现或难以触及之事的向往、期盼与渴求心理。

groups.name: Imagine & Envision · 想象与构想 (Conceive, Picture, Visualize)
groups.tip: 在脑中构想未来或画面

items.def_en: 1. To imagine or form a mental image of something. 2. To represent or show someone or something in a picture, painting, or description.
1. To imagine something that you would very much like to happen. 2. To experience images, thoughts, or emotions during sleep.
1. To form a mental picture or concept of something in your mind. 2. To believe or suppose that something is the case.

items.def_zh: 在脑海中浮现出，构想出
items.def_en: (+ sth) evoke or form a clear mental picture or sensory impression in the mind
(+ sth) conceive an inventive, elaborate, or unusual mental scenario or plan

items.def_zh: 在大脑中回忆起，勾勒出
items.def_en: (+ sth) summon an image or memory into conscious contemplation
(+ of) to form an idea, concept, or plan in the mind
1. To imagine or picture a future situation, plan, or possibility in your mind.

items.def_zh: 想象，设想；使显现，使形象化
items.def_en: 1. To form a clear mental picture of something. 2. To make something visible to the eye.
