to develop an abstract concept, model, or systemic mental formulation of something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote generating internal sensory imagery, anticipating future possibilities, or mentally contemplating scenarios not currently perceived through the senses.
groups.summary_zh: 在大脑中构建形象、在心理上预想未来情形或对未见之物形成具体意象。

groups.name: Imitate & Emulate · 模仿与效法 (Imitate, Emulate, Parody)
groups.tip: 以他人为榜样学习效法模仿

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) fashion one's behavior, style, or work in direct emulation of another
(+ sb/sth) mock or parody someone or something by exaggeratedly imitating them
(+ sb) mimic or caricature someone's voice, gestures, or mannerisms for amusement

items.def_zh: （滑稽、讽刺地）模仿；对……进行滑稽模仿
items.def_en: To copy the style of a person, writer, or piece of art in an exaggerated way to make people laugh.
to copy someone's speech, behavior, or style in an unoriginal or clumsy way

items.def_zh: （戏谑或惟妙惟肖地）摹仿，学样
items.def_en: to copy the way someone speaks, moves, or behaves, especially to entertain
1. To copy someone's speech, behavior, or style. 2. To copy something as a model.

items.def_zh: 用手势示意；通过哑剧动作表演；模拟动作
items.def_en: To use movements of your body and hands without speaking to tell a story or pretend to do something.

items.def_zh: 效仿，努力赶上；（计算机）仿真
items.def_en: 1. To try to do something as well as or better than someone else by imitating them. 2. (computing) to imitate the function of another system.

items.def_zh: 以讽刺画法夸张表现，滑稽地歪曲模仿
items.def_en: to represent someone in a way that emphasizes their distinctive traits comically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe copying the appearance, speech, behavior, or style of someone or something, either to learn from them, mock them, or reproduce their characteristics.
groups.summary_zh: 临摹、模仿或抄袭言行举止与风格，旨在学习、再现或讽刺。

groups.name: Impact & Violently Strike · 碰撞与冲击 (Collide, Cannon, Thud)
groups.tip: 物体猛烈相撞发生冲击

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ against/into) to strike lightly or accidentally against an obstacle

items.def_zh: 砰的一声撞击，沉重地撞击（或掉落）
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/against/onto) To hit or fall onto a surface with a dull, heavy sound.
(+ sth) collide violently with an entity or barrier, producing damage or loud noise
to crash forcefully into someone or something with relentless forward momentum
(+ sth) strike or collide with another object or body with immense, violent force
[I/T] (+ into/against) to strike or cause something to strike with great violence and noise

items.def_zh: （疾行中猛烈地）撞击，相撞；（台球中）击中两球得分
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/against) (chiefly British) To collide violently with something or someone, especially while moving fast and rebounding. 2. (billiards) To hit two balls in succession.

items.def_zh: 碰撞，互撞；（观点、利益等）冲突，抵触
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To crash violently into someone or something, or to crash into each other while moving. 2. (+ with) (of opinions, interests, or principles) To clash or come into direct opposition.
(+ sth) impact an obstacle or vehicle violently, causing destructive damage
[I/T] (+ into) to hit an obstacle violently, often causing severe damage or destruction

groups.summary_en: Objects or bodies move forcefully and impact another surface or entity, distinguished by the physical mechanics, momentum transfer, and sensory acoustic result of the strike.
groups.summary_zh: 物体或人带着动能猛烈撞击或反弹碰撞，伴随沉重声响或冲击力。

groups.name: Impair Integrity to Total Fracture · 损伤、打破与折断 (Damage, Break)
groups.tip: 受力破裂或使物体受损

items.def_en: to cause mild physical injury, damage, or negative consequence to an object or living thing
(+ sth) to separate or cause sth to separate into several smaller pieces or parts through force
(+ sth) to develop structural fractures or crash and severely damage a vehicle or structure

items.def_zh: 打破，弄碎，损坏；（使）破裂；违犯；中断，暂停
items.def_en: to separate into pieces, or cause something to do so; to damage or destroy something; to violate a rule or promise.
to harm, spoil, or break something so that it is less valuable or useful.

items.def_zh: 打破，弄碎，损坏（break的过去分词）
items.def_en: (past participle of break) to separate into pieces, damage, or cause to fail.

items.def_zh: 打破，弄碎，损坏（break的过去式）
items.def_en: (past tense of break) to separate into pieces, damage, or fracture.
(+ sth) to smash, damage, or severely fracture something by violent physical force
[I/T] to crack, break, or split a hard substance or bone so that cracks appear
[I/T] to break violently into numerous small, sharp pieces under sudden impact

groups.summary_en: This core physical-integrity frame spans verbs indicating loss of structural soundness, escalating from surface harm and functional impairment to clean separation, fracturing into pieces, and irreversible destruction. Note: non-standard lexical entries are aligned according to grammatical baseline.
groups.summary_zh: 从功能受损、物理裂损递增至彻底断裂或破碎。

groups.name: Impeded & Incoherent Utterance · 结巴含糊与语无伦次 (Stammer, Splutter, Gibber)
groups.tip: 口齿不清、结巴或语声沙哑

items.def_zh: 咕哝，嘟囔（声音低且口齿不清）
items.def_en: [I/T] to speak quietly and unclearly so that words cannot be understood easily
(+ sth) to say something suddenly and incoherently without thinking, especially when nervous

items.def_zh: 结结巴巴地说（重复词首音节）
items.def_en: [I/T] to speak with involuntary pauses and rapid repetitions of syllables
To speak with involuntary pauses, repeated sounds, or blocks, especially due to nervousness or embarrassment.

items.def_zh: 结结巴巴地说出；勉强吐出
items.def_en: (+ sth) to manage to utter or stammer words when flustered, hesitant, or angry

items.raw_cluster: 粗声与嘶哑 Speak Harshly & Rasp
items.def_zh: 粗声粗气地说；发出刺耳刺刮声；用粗锉刀锉
items.def_en: 1. To speak or utter something in a harsh, grating, raspy voice. 2. To make a harsh, scraping sound. 3. To scrape or smooth something with a rough file.

items.def_zh: 急促而语无伦次地说（伴有飞沫）；发出噼啪声，发出噗噗声
items.def_en: 1. To speak quickly, confusedly, and unclearly while spitting out small drops of saliva, especially when angry or surprised. 2. To make a series of short popping or spitting noises.

items.def_zh: 哽咽着说出；勉强挤出（话语）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to utter words with difficulty due to breathlessness or overwhelming emotion

items.def_zh: 胡言乱语，喋喋不休地胡扯
items.def_en: [I/T] to talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way

items.def_zh: 急促而胡言乱语，喋喋不休地胡扯
items.def_en: To speak rapidly and unintelligibly, especially through fear, shock, or madness.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate speech delivery impaired by physiological impediment, intense emotion, breathlessness, or panic, ranked by incoherence and vocal distortion.
groups.summary_zh: 依语流阻碍与混乱程度排列，表现受情绪、呼吸或心智失常影响的言语表达。

groups.name: Implement & Enforce · 实施与践行 (Implement, Execute, Enforce)
groups.tip: 将理论付诸实际行动

items.def_zh: 实践，践行，实行；练习，训练；从事（医务、法律等职业）
items.def_en: 1. To carry out, apply, or put into action a theory, belief, or custom. 2. To do an activity repeatedly to gain or improve a skill. 3. To work professionally as a doctor, lawyer, etc.

items.def_zh: 应用，运用，实施；适用；申请；涂抹；专心致力于
items.def_en: 1. To use or put something, such as a rule, method, or theory, into practical operation. 2. (+ to) To be relevant to or have an effect on someone or something. 3. (+ for) To make a formal request for something, such as a job. 4. To spread or rub a substance onto a surface. 5. ('apply oneself') To work hard and dedicate oneself to a task.
To put a plan, decision, policy, or agreement into effect.

items.def_zh: 执行，贯彻，实施；处死，处决；（计算机）运行
items.def_en: 1. To carry out, perform, or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. 2. To kill someone as a legal punishment. 3. (computing) To run a program or set of instructions.

items.def_zh: 强制执行，督促遵循（法律、规定）
items.def_en: to make people obey a rule, law, or decision, often through institutional authority or penalty

items.def_zh: 执行，落实（任务、指令或计划）
items.def_en: to perform, conduct, or complete an instruction, task, promise, or planned project
to continue an action or policy to its conclusion, completing what was planned
(+ sth) to cause a law, rule, or plan to begin operating or being applied
to take severe legal or authoritative measures against bad conduct or to strictly enforce a rule

items.def_zh: 颁布实施，通过（法律或改革政策）
items.def_en: (formal) to pass a law officially, or to put a specified policy or decree into legal force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to carrying out, enforcing, or putting into practical effect an abstract policy, legal regulation, plan, or established conviction. Nuances range from routine pragmatic habits (practice, apply) to authoritative executive actuation (implement, execute, enforce).
groups.summary_zh: 将规章、政策、决定或惯例付诸具体执行、落实与实践。

groups.name: Impoverish & Exhaust · 竭尽与使赤贫 (Deplete, Impoverish, Beggar)
groups.tip: 底气逐渐耗尽，实力大打折扣

items.def_en: (+ of) to gradually reduce or use up completely a supply of money, energy, or resources
to greatly reduce the amount of an essential resource, fund, or supply

items.def_zh: 逐渐消耗；蚕食（财富、资源）
items.def_en: to gradually deplete or reduce financial reserves, land, or resources over time
to use up entirely so that nothing remains, especially funds, reserves, or fertility

items.def_zh: 快速挥霍；迅速耗尽（资金）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to spend or deplete large amounts of money or resources very rapidly
(+ sb/sth) to completely deprive someone or an account of all money or supplies
to deplete someone or an entity of all financial means, rendering them legally or materially ruined

items.def_zh: 使破产，使沦为赤贫；使无法（相信或描述，如 beggar belief/description）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone extremely poor. 2. (beggar belief/description) To be too extreme, unusual, or shocking to be believed or described.

items.def_zh: 使贫穷，使赤贫；耗尽……的资源（或养分），削弱
items.def_en: To make someone or something extremely poor, or to make land, soil, or a system worse in quality.
to reduce an individual or class of people to absolute, degrading poverty

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the severe or total drainage of financial resources, land fertility, or material assets. They scale from progressively draining supplies (deplete) to reducing individuals, estates, or nations to utter insolvency and destitution (beggar).
groups.summary_zh: 使资财、地力或给养消耗殆尽并陷入彻底赤贫。

groups.name: Improve & Perfect · 改善与臻于至善 (Improve, Ameliorate, Perfect)
groups.tip: 由逐步改善直至趋于完美

items.def_en: (+ on sth) to improve or refresh one's existing knowledge, condition, or skill
to raise something to a higher standard or newer version
(+ sb/sth) to improve the appearance, efficiency, or operational standard of something
To make something better, or to become better.

items.def_zh: 更新，完善；使现代化；向……提供最新信息
items.def_en: 1. To make something more modern or suitable by adding the latest information or features. 2. To give someone the most recent news or facts.

items.def_zh: 改善，改良，缓解（不良状况）
items.def_en: (formal) To make a bad, unpleasant, or difficult situation better.
(+ sth) to refine, perfect, or add finishing touches to a performance, text, or skill

items.def_zh: 使完美，完善，使熟练精通
items.def_en: To make something completely free from faults, or to improve something until it is as good as it can be.
to improve something by making subtle, delicate adjustments to remove defects

items.def_zh: 磨砺；提升（技巧）至高水平
items.def_en: to refine or sharpen a skill or instrument over time to peak precision

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe a scalar gradient of positive change, advancing from simple updating and baseline improvement of flaws to formal rectification and the absolute pinnacle of flawless execution.
groups.summary_zh: 表示事物从初步改进、修正不良状态递进到极致完美程度。

groups.name: Industrial Production & Fabrication · 工业制造与产出 (Manufacture, Machine, Fabricate)
groups.tip: 工农业规模化产出物品

items.def_zh: 生产，制造；产出，产生；出示，提出；制作（影视等）
items.def_en: 1. To make, grow, or manufacture goods or materials. 2. To cause a reaction, result, or effect. 3. To show or present something.

items.def_zh: 用机器加工，用机床切削制造
items.def_en: 1. To cut, shape, or finish metal, wood, or other materials using a machine.
to make goods in large numbers, usually in a factory using machines
to manufacture goods in large quantities using standardized techniques and assembly lines

items.def_zh: 大量粗制滥造，流水线式大量产出
items.def_en: to produce large quantities of something rapidly and automatically, often with reduced quality
(+ sth) to manufacture or fabricate goods in specific quantities, usually using machinery
(+ sth) to manufacture or produce large amounts of items mechanically and routinely
(+ sth) to complete the industrial manufacture and release of a new product line

items.def_zh: 装配制造；加工制作（构件）
items.def_en: to construct or manufacture an industrial product or structure from standardized parts
1. To manufacture or grow more goods or food than customers want or can buy.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the industrial or systematic creation of physical goods, parts, or commodities using machinery, tools, and organized labor. Verbs range from general output generation (produce) to precise mechanical shaping (machine) and industrial fabrication (manufacture).
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖利用机器、车床或流水线规模化加工、成型与制造工业产品的全过程。

groups.name: Inscribe Typographic & Symbolic Markers · 符号标记与指示 (Mark, Asterisk, Check)
groups.tip: 签字署名或做记号以示确认

items.def_en: mark an item on a list with a checkmark (tick) to show verification
(+ off/out) mark with a cross to cancel or distinguish
(+ off) place a tick mark beside a listed item
(+ sth) to draw a line or symbolic cross through an item on a list to mark it as dealt with
(+ sth) to indicate boundaries or specific items by making typographic lines or marks
(+ sth) to put a check mark beside an item on a written list to verify or identify it

items.def_zh: 签字，署名；做手势，用手语示意；签约聘用
items.def_en: 1. To write your name on a document to show approval, agreement, or authorship. 2. To communicate using gestures or sign language. 3. To employ or be employed by signing a contract.

items.def_zh: 做记号于，标示；给……打分；标志着，纪念；留意
items.def_en: 1. To write, draw, or leave a symbol or line on something to identify or distinguish it. 2. To indicate, signify, or celebrate an important event. 3. (chiefly British) To grade or correct an exam or piece of work.
attach a label or marker to identify or classify

items.def_zh: 加星号标出，用星号注明
items.def_en: 1. To mark a word, item, or footnote with a star-shaped symbol (*).

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe affixing specific visual, typographical, or symbolic notations onto a surface or text to single out, annotate, or signify approval/identity. They differ according to the concrete shape or technical nature of the mark made.
groups.summary_zh: 指在文本或物体上添加特定符号、记号或星号以作标示。

groups.name: Inspect & Verify · 检查与复核 (Check, Inspect, Review)
groups.tip: 仔细查验以防出错

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to investigate, inspect, or verify the authenticity or status of sth
(+ sth) to examine or inspect something quickly to assess its general quality or validity

items.def_zh: 检查，核对，查验；制止，抑制；寄存，托运
items.def_en: 1. To examine something to determine its accuracy, quality, condition, or presence. 2. To stop, slow down, or prevent something undesirable from progressing. 3. (North American) To leave luggage, coats, etc., for temporary safekeeping.

items.def_zh: 复查，审查，审视；温习，复习；写评论；检阅
items.def_en: 1. To examine or assess something again carefully in order to verify it, make changes, or improve it. 2. To write a critical evaluation of a book, film, play, etc. 3. (chiefly US) To look over material again in study.
(+ sth) to examine or inspect the details of a document or process thoroughly

items.def_zh: 测试，检验，检测；考验；测验（某人）
items.def_en: 1. To examine or experiment on something to determine its quality, performance, or composition. 2. To give a test to someone to measure their knowledge or skill. 3. To severely strain or challenge patience, strength, or resolve.

items.def_zh: 审查，核查（背景或适任性）
items.def_en: Investigate someone or something thoroughly to check suitability, accuracy, or loyalty
Look at closely and systematically to assess condition, detect flaws, or ensure standards
[T/I] Verify the accuracy of information by comparing it with another independent source
Conduct an official, systematic examination and verification of accounts, records, or procedures

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cognitive actions aimed at examining, inspecting, or appraising an object, process, or document to establish accuracy, quality, or functional validity. Nuances vary from routine verification to systematic institutional scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指为确认无误、符合标准或处于完好状态而进行的检验、复查与审读。

groups.name: Joke & Jest · 玩笑与戏谑 (Joke, Jest, Quip, Banter)
groups.tip: 说话风趣打趣，以轻松玩笑幽默互动

items.def_zh: 装疯卖傻；插科打诨逗乐
items.def_en: to act silly or make wisecracks to amuse other people
to engage in playful, joking behavior or nonserious banter
to behave in a silly, joking, or unserious way with others
(+ with/about) to say funny things or speak not seriously
(+ with) to exchange playful, teasing, and witty remarks in good humor
To make a quick, clever, and amusing remark.
To say something as a joke rather than seriously; to tease or joke.
[I/T] to tease someone in a gentle, friendly, good-natured way
to make a quick, clever, and often sarcastic joke
[I/T] to laugh at someone and make playful or slightly annoying jokes about them

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate communicating in a humorous, teasing, or witty manner rather than in earnest, varying by whether the speech is a brief remark, playful back-and-forth, or light mockery.
groups.summary_zh: 指非严肃地插科打诨、幽默妙语、互相打趣或开玩笑戏谑。

groups.name: Know, Realize & Deeply Comprehend · 知晓、领会与透彻理解 (Know & Comprehend)
groups.tip: 从初步知晓到深入透彻理解

items.def_en: to understand or realize something after an initial period of confusion
(+ to sth) to begin to understand or realize a fact or secret that was not obvious

items.def_zh: 突然明白，恍然大悟；懂得，理解
items.def_en: (British English, informal) to suddenly understand or realize what is happening or being said
(+ sth) to succeed in solving, comprehending, or calculating something complex

items.def_zh: 知道，了解；认识，熟悉；确信
items.def_en: to have information in your mind; to be familiar with someone or something

items.def_zh: 理解，懂得（understand 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of understand; to have known or grasped the meaning of something
to achieve a clear, solid mental hold of a concept, fact, or situation

items.def_zh: 弄懂，理解（尤用于否定句）；测出（水的）深度
items.def_en: 1. to understand someone or something after thinking carefully (chiefly negative) 2. to measure the depth of water
to understand fully and deeply the nature, significance, or meaning of something
to see into and thoroughly decipher a profound mystery, complex truth, or motive

groups.summary_en: This intensity scale progresses from mere factual awareness and sudden colloquial realization to solid intellectual grasp and ultimately penetrating, exhaustive comprehension of profound or elusive truths.
groups.summary_zh: 从基本知晓、忽然领悟到全面理解、洞悉透彻的认知深度递进。

groups.name: Lavishly Decorate & Adorn · 盛装与华饰点缀 (Gild, Bedeck, Garland)
groups.tip: 镀金、挂花环等手法装点表面

items.def_zh: 给……镀金；给……敷上金色；粉饰，虚饰
items.def_en: 1. To cover something with a thin layer of gold or gold paint. 2. To make something look attractive, valuable, or better than it really is.

items.def_zh: 打扮得花枝招展；盛装打扮
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to dress someone in very fancy, attractive, or ornamental clothes
(+ sth) to furnish, accessorize, or ornament something in an elaborate or stylish manner

items.def_zh: 装饰，装点，打扮；给……装上甲板；击倒
items.def_en: 1. (+ out/with) To decorate someone or something, especially for a celebration or special occasion. 2. (informal) To hit someone so hard that they fall to the ground.
to make someone or something more attractive by adding ornaments
1. (+ with) To decorate or crown someone or something with wreaths or garlands of flowers and leaves.
to decorate an object or surface with beautiful artistic details
(+ sb/sth) to dress someone or decorate a space lavishly, often for a special event
to decorate an area with strings of flowers, lights, or ribbons hanging in curves
1. (+ with) To decorate a person or thing lavishly with decorations, flowers, jewels, or ribbons.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve enhancing physical surfaces, garments, or spaces with opulent ornaments, wreaths, or decorative layers, often imparting ceremonial splendor or artificial prestige.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用花环、金箔、彩饰等繁复华丽饰物精心装点或铺陈美化。

groups.name: Lay Waste & Demolish · 摧毁与夷平 (Raze, Demolish, Devastate)
groups.tip: 从物理损坏到彻底夷平

items.def_en: to deliberately dismantle or demolish a building or structure
(+ sth) to demolish, raze, or collapse a building or structure completely
(+ sth) to intentionally demolish or tear down a building or large structure

items.def_zh: 拆毁，拆除；摧毁，彻底驳倒
items.def_en: 1. To knock down or destroy a building completely. 2. To defeat an opponent or disprove an argument thoroughly.
to completely level or destroy a structure or landscape

items.def_zh: 使成废墟，荒废；使感到极度悲伤孤独
items.def_en: 1. (formal / literary) To devastate or lay waste to a place, leaving it empty and ruined. 2. To make someone feel utterly sad and lonely.
(+ sth) to destroy or demolish something completely by using explosives

items.def_zh: 严重破坏，彻底摧毁；使极为震惊悲痛
items.def_en: 1. To destroy or ruin something completely or cause severe damage to it. 2. To make someone feel extremely shocked, upset, or devastated.
to destroy something so completely that no trace or sign of it remains
to completely level a building, town, or settlement to the ground

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the complete physical destruction or catastrophic ruin of structures, areas, or systems. They range from orderly or mechanical demolition to wide-scale ruinous devastation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理撞击或浩劫将建筑物、城镇彻底夷平、摧毁或破坏殆尽。

groups.name: Legalize & License · 官方核准与法定确权 (Authorize, Patent, License)
groups.tip: 官方或法律赋予权利

items.def_zh: 取得……的专利权；授予……专利权
items.def_en: to obtain a government patent for an invention or process, or grant a patent on.

items.def_zh: 授予特许经营权；赋予公民权（尤指选举权）
items.def_en: 1. to grant a franchise to market goods or commercial services. 2. to grant the right to vote to.
to grant a formal charter establishing a city, company, or university

items.def_zh: 获得……的版权；保护……的著作权
items.def_en: to secure the exclusive legal copyright on a piece of written, artistic, or musical work.
to provide with official credentials or license signifying qualified professional status
(+ on sth) to give formal or statutory approval to sth
(+ sb/sth) to officially authorize and clear sb/sth through regulatory checks

items.def_zh: 在（护照等）上签注；为……签发签证
items.def_en: to endorse or issue an official visa on a passport or travel document.

items.def_zh: 批准，认可，准许；对……实施制裁
items.def_en: 1. to give official authorization or approval to. 2. to impose punitive sanctions against.
to register a name, phrase, or logo as an official trademark

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers formal governmental or commercial acts that confer exclusive legal monopoly, statutory permission, or official immigration/regulatory clearance to individuals, products, or entities.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及政府或权威机构通过法定程序授予特许权、知识产权排他权或准入资质。

groups.name: Linger & Loiter · 逗留与磨蹭 (Loiter, Dally, Tarry)
groups.tip: 拖延时间、停留逗留或停滞

items.def_en: to linger, wait, or spend time in a place without doing much
to linger idly or stand around in an area without obvious purpose
to remain in a place rather than leave, often waiting for something
(+ on/around) to stay in a place longer than necessary, typically out of reluctance to leave

items.def_zh: 闲逛；游荡；虚度时间逗留
items.def_en: to stand or wait around idly with no apparent purpose

items.def_zh: 磨蹭；延误；漫不经心地闲荡
items.def_en: (+ over) to act or move slowly, wasting time
(archaic or literary) To stay longer than intended, delay leaving, or linger.
1. To move slowly or take much longer than necessary to do something, especially by lingering or wasting time.
to hesitate to proceed or stay behind the main group out of reluctance

items.def_zh: 踌躇不前，止步不前；抗拒，不情愿做（jib at）
items.def_en: 1. (especially of an animal) To stop suddenly and refuse to go forward; (+ at) to be unwilling to do or accept something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict an agent staying in a place longer than necessary, moving reluctantly, or idling aimlessly rather than departing promptly.
groups.summary_zh: 指在某处过久逗留、步调拖沓磨蹭或不愿前行而迟滞耽搁的行为。

groups.name: Liquid Discharge: Trickle to Deluge · 细淌与奔涌 (Trickle, Cascade, Deluge)
groups.tip: 水量过满而向外漫溢

items.def_zh: 细细地流，滴流；使缓缓流淌；缓慢移动
items.def_en: 1. (+ down/into/out) When liquid, people, or money trickle, they flow slowly in a very thin stream or small numbers. 2. To make a liquid flow in a thin stream.
to trickle or fall out slowly in small, intermittent drops
Flow or run over the edge, margin, or boundary of a receptacle
to spurt or flow out suddenly and in large quantities
to flow, gush, or stream rapidly and abundantly from an opening
1. (+ with) When a container, river, or sink overflows, liquid spills over its edges; to be filled beyond capacity. 2. To be full of strong emotion.

items.def_zh: 如瀑布般倾泻，大量涌出
items.def_en: (+ down/over) When water, hair, or information cascades, it falls or flows rapidly downward in large quantities.
[I/T] Discharge or issue forcefully out in a concentrated stream or jet
[I/T] Flow out suddenly, rapidly, and in copious volume
Inundate or overwhelm completely with a massive rush of water

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame depict liquids (or granular substances) pouring, discharging, and overflowing. The manner varies from a tenuous, slow dribble through breached containers, to steep cascading, and finally explosive, overwhelming surges.
groups.summary_zh: 描述液体或流体从细流缓滴、外溢漫出到如瀑布般倾泻与奔涌的不同形态。

groups.name: Load & Store Bulk Cargo · 散装装载与入罐贮存 (Load, Bunker, Discharge)
groups.tip: 将物品装入容器或运输工具

items.def_zh: 装载，装上（货物或乘客）；装填（弹药等）；（使）担负；（计算机）加载
items.def_en: 1. To put a large quantity of things or people into a vehicle or container. 2. To put ammunition into a gun or film into a camera. 3. (computing) To copy data or a program into a computer's memory.

items.def_zh: 把……储存在储罐（或大容器）中；把（液体）注入容器；彻底失败，暴跌
items.def_en: 1. To store a liquid or substance in a tank or large container. 2. (informal) To fail completely or fall rapidly in value.
to place and seal grain or bulk materials into a silo for storage
(+ sth) to fill a vehicle, ship, or container fully with cargo or fuel
(+ sth) to remove bulk liquid or sludge from a tank, bilge, or vessel using a pump

items.def_zh: 妥善存放，把（货物或物品）码放收藏好
items.def_en: (+ sth) to pack or store cargo neatly and securely in its proper place

items.def_zh: 卸载（大宗货物/流体）；倒空
items.def_en: [I/T] to unload bulk cargo, liquids, or passengers from a ship or conveyance

items.def_zh: 给（船等）注油；装入燃料舱
items.def_en: [I/T] to load fuel oil or coal into a ship's bunkers or storage reservoirs

items.def_zh: 卸（货），从……卸下货物；脱手，倾销；摆脱（负担），倾诉
items.def_en: 1. To remove goods, cargo, or passengers from a vehicle, ship, or container. 2. To get rid of unwanted goods, assets, or responsibilities by selling or passing them on to someone else. 3. To remove ammunition from a weapon.
(+ away/in) to pack or store cargo securely in a specific compartment or hold

groups.summary_en: Cargo handlers or logistics operators fill vessels, holds, tanks, or bulk storage facilities with bulk liquid, fuel, or freight, or conversely pump/empty it out.
groups.summary_zh: 在大型储罐、船舱或货台进行大宗货品与燃料的装卸与贮存。

groups.name: Marginalize & Ostracize · 排斥与孤立 (Social Exclusion & Isolation)
groups.tip: 群体将边缘人物排挤孤立

items.def_en: to separate someone or something physically or socially from others
to cause someone to stop supporting you or to feel isolated from their environment

items.def_zh: 排挤，使边缘化，使处于次要地位
items.def_en: To treat a person, group, or viewpoint as insignificant and push them to the fringes of society or an organization.
(+ from) (often passive) To cause someone to become distant, unfriendly, or alienated from friends, family, or society.

items.def_zh: 使隔离，使隐居，使与外界隔绝
items.def_en: ('seclude oneself') To keep someone or oneself apart from other people in a quiet, isolated, or private place.
(+ sb) to deliberately exclude or marginalize someone through hostile or cold treatment
(+ sb) to exclude someone deliberately from social participation, intimacy, or belonging
to intentionally exclude someone from a society, community, or group
(+ sb) to expel or banish someone forcibly from a group, community, or society
to officially send someone away from a country or community as an authoritative punishment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate pushing an individual or group away from mainstream social participation, affection, or community standing. They range along an intensity continuum from pushing someone to social margins or withdrawing into privacy, through emotional alienation, up to total formal expulsion or banishment.
groups.summary_zh: 从社交圈或权力中心推开、疏远乃至彻底放逐孤立。

groups.name: Mastication & Auditory Chewing · 咀嚼与咬碎声响 (Masticate, Chomp, Cranch)
groups.tip: 牙齿用力磨碎食物的动作

items.def_en: (+ on) to chew steadily and audibly, often with pleasure
(+ sth) to crush and grind solid food thoroughly using one's teeth

items.def_zh: 大口咀嚼，用力咬（通常后接 on）
items.def_en: (+ on sth) to bite down noisily, forcefully, and repeatedly on food
(+ sth) to chew hard, crisp food with a loud crushing sound
to chew or bite on something vigorously, noisily, and repeatedly
to crush and chew crisp food noisily between the teeth

items.def_zh: 大声咀嚼，使劲地嚼，用力咬
items.def_en: To bite and chew food noisily and energetically.

items.def_zh: 嘎吱嘎吱地咬嚼；咬碎，嚼碎
items.def_en: To crush, grind, or chew noisily between the teeth.
To chew food thoroughly with the teeth before swallowing.
(+ on/at) to bite or chew persistently at something hard

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the mechanical crushing and chewing of solid food in the mouth, often marked by distinctive crunching or noisy gnawing sounds.
groups.summary_zh: 指口腔粉碎食物的咀嚼动作，多伴有咯吱、大口咀嚼等听觉质感。

groups.name: Match & Correspond in Accordance · 契合与对应 (Match, Fit, Correspond)
groups.tip: 两事互相吻合相称

items.def_en: (+ with) to be in complete agreement or harmony with a rule, principle, or fact

items.def_zh: 相匹配，相符合；与……相称；比得上，敌得过
items.def_en: 1. To be equal to, identical with, or suitable for something else. 2. To find something that corresponds to or goes well with another.

items.def_zh: 合适，合身；与……相契合，符合；安装
items.def_en: 1. To be of the right shape and size for someone or something. 2. To be suitable, compatible, or in agreement with something.

items.def_zh: 适合，适宜；与……相配，衬托；使适应
items.def_en: 1. To be convenient, appropriate, or acceptable for someone. 2. (of clothes, colors, or hairstyles) To make someone look attractive. 3. To be right for a particular purpose or situation.

items.def_zh: 相符，一致；相当，相对应；通信
items.def_en: 1. To match, be consistent, or be similar to something. 2. To communicate by exchanging letters, emails, or messages.

items.def_zh: 相吻合，相契合，保持一致
items.def_en: to correspond closely, agree, or be equal to something else
(+ with sth) to be suitable, harmonious, or consistent with other things
(+ with sth) to align or agree precisely with facts, expectations, or standards
(+ with) to match or agree closely with another set of records or facts
(+ to/with) to behave according to or match an established rule, pattern, or standard

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe two or more entities being congruent, compatible, or equivalent in dimension, pattern, requirements, or functional role.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物之间在尺寸、属性、模式或规范上相互一致、吻合或对应。

groups.name: Mathematical Computation & Re-computation · 数学运算与重算校核 (Compute, Tot, Recalculate)
groups.tip: 按公式数字精细核算

items.def_en: (+ sth) to calculate the total of two or more numbers or amounts

items.def_zh: 结算；清点并计算出总数
items.def_en: (+ sth) to calculate the final total of points, figures, or items
(+ sth) to add numbers together to find the total amount
(+ up) to calculate the total sum of multiple numbers or quantities
1. ('tot up') (chiefly British informal) To add numbers or amounts together to find the total sum. 2. ('tot up to') To amount to a total.

items.def_zh: 算错，误算；误判，估计错误
items.def_en: 1. To calculate a number or amount incorrectly. 2. To judge or estimate a situation or risk wrongly.
(+ sth) to calculate an amount, cost, or value mathematically

items.def_zh: 计算，估算；（计算机）处理，运算
items.def_en: 1. To calculate an amount or number mathematically, especially using a computer.
to arrange numbers, figures, or data into systematic columns or tables
1. To calculate a figure, cost, or amount again, especially to correct errors or update data.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this procedural frame describe executing arithmetic operations, aggregating sums, or running mathematical calculations again to correct errors or update quantitative figures.
groups.summary_zh: 指执行算术求和、公式运算或重新验算校正数值结果。

groups.name: Mechanical Fastening & Joining · 紧固与机械连接 (Fasten, Staple, Rivet)
groups.tip: 铆接或拉链加固物体

items.def_en: to fasten or hold together with a clip, clasp, or pin

items.def_zh: 用订书钉钉住，用订书机订上
items.def_en: To attach or fasten things together using staples.
(chiefly North American) To fasten or close something with a zipper.

items.def_zh: 用螺栓紧固；把……用螺栓固定在地上
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten something firmly to a floor or structure using heavy bolts
(+ sth) to hold or fasten something firmly in place using a mechanical clamp
(+ sth) to secure something firmly in place using straps, ties, or fasteners

items.def_zh: 用螺丝拧紧；把……用螺丝固定
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten something securely to a surface using screws
to fasten firmly to something with heavy threaded metal bolts
to secure a nail or rivet by flattening or bending the protruding point

items.def_zh: 用铆钉固定；牢牢吸引（注意力），使目不转睛
items.def_en: 1. To fasten metal plates or other parts together with rivets. 2. (often passive) To attract and hold someone's attention completely.

groups.summary_en: An agent secures, binds, or joins materials firmly together using specific mechanical closures, fasteners, or structural bindings.
groups.summary_zh: 借助五金或专门扣具将物体机械式连接并固定，防止分离。

groups.name: Mechanical Obstruction & Sealing · 封堵与填塞 (Plug, Dam, Block)
groups.tip: 填塞缝隙或阻断孔道与通道

items.def_zh: 填塞，衬垫；虚报，夸大（账目、文章等）；放轻脚步走
items.def_en: 1. To fill, cover, or protect something with soft material. 2. To add unnecessary or dishonest material to something to make it larger. 3. To walk with soft, quiet steps.
(+ up) to close or seal a receptacle aperture with a bung or stopper
(+ sth) to close an entrance, passage, or opening so that nothing can pass through
to block, restrict, or completely cut off the flow or access of something
(+ sth) to block an opening, hole, or pipe completely by inserting a stopper or material
(+ sth) to fill or close a hole or opening so that it is completely blocked

items.def_zh: 堵住，塞住；宣传，推销；射中
items.def_en: 1. To fill or block a hole or opening tightly with something. 2. (informal) To promote or advertise a product, book, or show publicly. 3. (informal) To shoot someone with a bullet.

items.def_zh: 筑坝拦住，阻拦；控制，抑制
items.def_en: To build a dam across a river or stream to stop or control the flow of water; to hold back or suppress something.
to make seams watertight or airtight by packing with filler or sealant
(+ sth) to stop or restrict the flow of water or liquid by building a barrier across it

groups.summary_en: An agent seals or obstructs an opening, cavity, or flow of material by inserting or imposing a physical barrier. The methods range from stuffing with soft material to building rigid impediments or inserting tightly fitted stoppers.
groups.summary_zh: 塞入填充物或筑起屏障以封死通道或截断流动，强调物理封堵手段。

groups.name: Medically Sedate & Numb · 麻醉与镇静 (Anesthetize, Sedate, Dope)
groups.tip: 医学手术中的用药镇静麻醉

items.def_en: to cause someone to lose consciousness or fall heavily asleep through a drug
to render unconscious or insensitive to pain by administering ether

items.def_zh: 对……施用麻醉药使其昏迷
items.def_en: (+ sb) to render someone unconscious before surgery using an anesthetic

items.def_zh: 使昏睡，麻醉使失去知觉
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to lose consciousness using drugs or anesthesia

items.def_zh: 用镇静药或毒品麻醉（某人）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to administer heavy sedatives, narcotics, or drugs to dull someone's senses
to give someone a drug to make them sleepy, confused, or unconscious
to give a patient or animal drugs to make them calm, sleepy, or unconscious.
to make someone unconscious or kill them with chloroform vapor.

items.def_zh: 给……施麻醉，使麻醉；使麻木，使失去知觉
items.def_en: 1. to give an anesthetic to a patient so they feel no pain during a medical procedure. 2. to make someone unable to feel normal emotions or sensations.
to make a person or animal calm or unconscious by administering a drug

groups.summary_en: Medical professionals or captors administer chemical substances to render a person or animal calm, unconscious, or insensible to pain. Verbs range from general clinical procedures ('anesthetize') to specific pharmacologic agents or colloquial administration ('dope', 'etherize').
groups.summary_zh: 通过施用药物使人或动物镇静、昏睡或失去知觉。

groups.name: Mock & Taunt · 嘲弄与挑衅 (Jeer, Gibe, Taunt)
groups.tip: 言语奚落并蓄意挑衅对方

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to tease or mock someone in a teasing or derisive manner
(+ at) to express derisive disbelief or scornful contempt
(+ sb/sth) to treat someone or something with derision, mocking vocal sounds, or scorn
(+ sb/sth) to talk about or mock someone or something with derisive contempt

items.def_zh: （轻蔑或愤怒地）哼鼻子，嗤之以鼻；喷鼻息；（通过鼻子）吸入（毒品）
items.def_en: 1. To force air loudly through your nose to express contempt, anger, or amusement; to say something while doing this. 2. (informal) To inhale a powdered drug through the nose.
[I/T] (+ at) to shout loud, rude, and mocking remarks at someone publicly
[I/T] (+ at) to utter taunting, sneering, or sarcastic remarks
(+ sb/sth) to laugh at or shout rude, insulting, derisive remarks at someone
to deliberately provoke or tease someone with persistent cruel remarks to make them angry
1. To mock, insult, or provoke someone intentionally with unkind words in order to make them angry.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally provoking, disparaging, or mocking someone to their face through derisive vocal sounds, insults, or insulting challenges. They typically take a personal direct object or take prepositions like 'at'.
groups.summary_zh: 当面发出嘲弄、嗤笑或挑衅性言语以激怒对方。

groups.name: Move & Translocate · 移动与行进 (Go, Come, Move)
groups.tip: 基础位移动词

items.def_zh: 去，走，行进；离开；运转，进行
items.def_en: 1. To move or travel from one place to another. 2. To depart or leave a place. 3. To operate, proceed, or progress.

items.def_zh: 来，来到；发生；达到（某种状态）
items.def_en: 1. To move toward, reach, or arrive at a place or person. 2. To occur or happen. 3. To reach a particular stage, position, or condition.

items.def_zh: 移动，搬移；行动，行进；搬家；感动
items.def_en: 1. To change position, or cause someone or something to change position. 2. To travel, advance, or proceed. 3. To change one's home or office. 4. To evoke strong emotion in someone.
[I/T] (+ through/by) to move past or across a location
[I/T] to make a journey or move across an expanse of distance
[I/T] (+ on/towards) to move forward in a purposeful or organized manner
(+ to/along) to move forward in a particular direction, often in a formal manner
to continue traveling forward or change one's position to keep going
(+ sb/sth) to travel past a place, landmark, or person
to depart or begin moving away in a particular direction

groups.summary_en: Core verbs denoting basic physical translation across space, fundamentally differentiated by deictic direction relative to the speaker, procedural travel, or general change of physical position.
groups.summary_zh: 空间位置的基本位移与行进，区别在于视点朝向、行进方式及概括性。

groups.name: Nurture & Tend · 抚育与照料 (Parent, Mother, Nurture)
groups.tip: 以父母之责养育照护

items.def_en: (+ to) to care for the physical needs or health of someone
(+ sb) to look after someone vulnerable and provide for their needs
(+ sb) to attend to the physical and emotional welfare or safety of someone
To raise, care for, or act as a parent to a child.

items.def_zh: 悉心照料，像母亲般呵护；生下，生育
items.def_en: 1. To treat or care for someone with affection, overprotectiveness, or maternal attention. 2. To give birth to or produce.

items.def_zh: 照料，伺候，照顾；主持圣事
items.def_en: (+ to) 1. To attend to the needs, comfort, or care of someone. 2. To perform the functions of a religious minister.
to bring up and care for children until they are fully grown
to bring up a child who is not one's own by birth
to feed and care for a young child or vulnerable person while they grow
(+ sb) to care for and educate a child until they are grown up

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify providing protective physical care, developmental upbringing, or emotional safeguarding to a child, dependent, or vulnerable charge, differentiated by parental manner and formal ministry.
groups.summary_zh: 指对子女或被照料者施以养育、母爱呵护或侍奉看顾。

groups.name: Observe & Surveil · 观察与监视 (Monitor, Stake Out, Wiretap)
groups.tip: 长期持续观察与系统监测

items.def_en: to observe and check the progress or quality of someone or something over a period of time
to follow someone closely and secretly in order to watch what they do
to keep a place or person under continuous surveillance, especially by police or detectives
(+ sb/sth) to secretly watch someone or their activities over an extended period
(+ sb/sth) to monitor or track the movements, activities, or status of someone continuously
(+ sb/sth) to observe someone or something continuously to maintain supervision or security
to secretly connect a listening device to someone's phone or communications line
To observe and identify wild birds in their natural environment as a hobby.
To keep someone, a building, or an area under close, continuous observation or surveillance.

items.def_zh: 监视，对……实施严密监视（surveil 的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of surveil: to keep under close and continuous surveillance.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote systematically watching or tracking individuals, wildlife, or targets over an extended period, ranging from recreational field observation to clandestine intelligence-gathering.
groups.summary_zh: 指对人员、野生动植物或目标进行系统性、长期的观察与暗中监视。

groups.name: Oppose & Repudiate · 规劝反对与坚决拒斥 (Deprecate, Rebuff, Disavow)
groups.tip: 表明异议、坚决拒绝或抵赖

items.def_en: to reject or refuse to consider a proposal, request, or applicant

items.def_zh: 轻蔑地拒绝或不理睬某人/某事
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to reject, dismiss, or refuse to listen to someone or their ideas in a curt or offhand manner

items.def_zh: 挡开，回避，回绝（批评、质问或不受欢迎的要求）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to successfully defend oneself against or ward off unwanted questions, requests, or criticisms
1. To express strong disapproval of something; to make something seem unimportant or of little value.

items.def_zh: 坚决抛弃，断然背弃（立场、关系或信仰）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to repudiate, abandon, or discard someone or something completely
1. To reject an offer, request, or friendly approach abruptly and unkindly.

items.def_zh: 否认，拒不承认，否认与……有关系
items.def_en: 1. To state publicly that you have no knowledge of, connection with, or responsibility for something.
to refuse or reject an offer, person, or suggestion with contempt or scorn
to declare that one no longer has any relationship with or responsibility for someone

items.def_zh: 断然否认或坚决割席绝交
items.def_en: to reject the authority or validity of something forcefully; to renounce an association

groups.summary_en: A speaker communicates rejection, mild disapproval, or explicit repudiation of a request, stance, or connection, ranging from gentle deprecation to snubbing refusal and public denial.
groups.summary_zh: 从委婉表态不赞成，升级至生硬回绝以及公开断绝关系。

groups.name: Order, Align & Configure · 整理、排列与布设 (Array, Align, Configure, Tidy)
groups.tip: 将杂乱物体理顺排齐、布置就位

items.def_en: [I/T] to form or arrange a series of people or objects into a straight continuous row
(+ sth) to arrange or display things systematically and attractively in a particular space
(+ sth) to arrange things into a structured order by categorizing or separating them
(+ sth) to make a place or collection of things neat, clean, and well arranged
(chiefly British) (often tidy up) to make a room or items neat by putting things in order.

items.def_zh: 部署，排列，整齐排布；打扮，盛装装扮
items.def_en: (often passive) to arrange things or people in an attractive, orderly, or impressive display or formation.

items.def_zh: 使排成一行，对齐；使一致；结盟
items.def_en: to place things in a straight line or in correct relative positions; to bring into agreement or close alignment.
to organize people, assets, or ideas into a deliberate, orderly formation for action
to arrange, set up, or configure the parts, structure, or settings of a system or device.
to collect, compare, and arrange texts or pages in strict, logical sequence

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe organizing components or physical entities into deliberate, structured geometric lines, coherent spatial patterns, or systematic functional configurations. Nuances differentiate between making an area clean/orderly, drawing elements into a straight linear axis, or setting up complex systemic parts.
groups.summary_zh: 按特定几何轴线、功能结构或整洁规律排布整理诸要素。

groups.name: Oust & Depose · 罢免与废黜
groups.tip: 剥夺权力赶出宝座

items.def_en: formally order or allow someone to leave high office or official employment
(+ sb) to forcibly or unceremoniously expel someone from an office, organisation, or position of authority
(+ sb) to defeat an incumbent politician or leadership in an election, thereby removing them from office
(+ sb) to dismiss or oust someone abruptly and forcibly from an institutional role
remove forcibly from power, especially through revolution or rebellion
drive out or expel someone from a position of power, office, or territory

items.def_zh: 废黜，免去……的职务；（法律）宣誓作证
items.def_en: 1. To remove a powerful leader, monarch, or official forcibly from office or power. 2. (law) To give sworn evidence or testimony under oath.
cause a government, regime, or autocrat to fall from power

items.def_zh: 罢免，剥夺……的席位（或权力）；使从马上（或座上）摔下
items.def_en: 1. To remove someone from a position of authority or political office, especially by defeating them in an election. 2. To cause someone to fall off a horse, bicycle, or seat.

items.def_zh: 废黜（君主）；剥夺（领袖或冠军的）统治地位
items.def_en: To remove a monarch from the throne, or to depose a prominent leader or champion from their top position.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly, politically, or legally removing someone from a position of sovereign, political, or institutional power. Nuances vary from legal dismissal and electoral removal to revolutionary toppling.
groups.summary_zh: 通过政治手段、法律程序或暴力强制剥夺当权者的统治或领导职务。

groups.name: Overstate & Exaggerate · 夸大与夸张 (Overstate, Overplay, Exaggerate)
groups.tip: 言过其实夸大其词，有意渲染夸张事实

items.def_en: to make a story or statement more interesting by adding fictitious details

items.def_zh: 渲染，刻意夸大……的重要性
items.def_en: (+ sth) to emphasize or exaggerate the value, importance, or drama of something
(+ sb/sth) to describe someone or something in a way that makes them sound better, more valuable, or more successful than they actually are
[I/T] to make something seem larger, better, worse, or more important than it really is

items.def_zh: 夸大（重要性），夸张；表演过火；过分利用
items.def_en: 1. To exaggerate the importance or significance of something. 2. To act a dramatic role with too much emotion or exaggeration.

items.def_zh: 夸大，把……渲染得过分严重
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make something seem much bigger, worse, or more important than it really is

items.def_zh: 过分渲染，大肆夸张（通常作 lay it on thick）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to exaggerate praise, flattery, or an excuse in an excessive, obvious way
to make a problem, difficulty, or danger seem far greater or more serious than it is

items.def_zh: 夸大，言过其实，过分强调
items.def_en: To state or describe something in terms that make it seem more important, serious, or extreme than it really is.
[I/T] to speak or write using extreme rhetorical exaggeration

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe portraying something as greater, more significant, or more dramatic than it actually is, ranging from slight embellishment to gross distortion.
groups.summary_zh: 描述言语中言过其实、夸大重要性或戏剧性渲染的程度递增行为。

groups.name: Paddle & Manually Propel Watercraft · 划桨与荡舟 (Row, Paddle, Canoe)
groups.tip: 乘船驾筏的水上运动

items.def_en: to propel a boat across water using oars mounted in rowlocks
to row or propel forward across water as if with oars (literary)
to move a rowing boat away from shore by rowing vigorously
to propel a small boat smoothly forward through the water with steady paddle strokes
1. To propel or steer a small boat with a paddle. 2. To walk or play barefoot in shallow water.

items.def_zh: 划独木舟，乘独木舟旅行；用独木舟运送
items.def_en: To travel in or paddle a canoe; to transport by canoe.

items.def_zh: 乘筏漂流，乘筏运送；扎成筏子
items.def_en: To travel or transport goods on a raft; to fasten together into a raft.
to propel a flat-bottomed boat by pushing against the riverbed with a long pole
To travel or paddle in a kayak.
to propel a boat with a single stern oar moved side to side, or using a pair of light oars

groups.summary_en: Propelling, navigating, or steering small non-motorized watercraft across water using handheld oars, paddles, or poles. Differentiated by vessel type, blade type, and whether the motion is recreation, transit, or sport.
groups.summary_zh: 使用桨板人工驱动或驾驭小型船艇划行水上

groups.name: Pare & Finely Trim · 切削修整与微切 (Pare, Manicure, Mince)
groups.tip: 动刀细致切削碎化或切薄

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove small or protruding pieces from something with quick, fine cuts using scissors or shears

items.def_zh: 修整切除，削掉多余边缘
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove unwanted outer edges, fat, or excess material by careful slicing or cutting
[I/T] to cut very thin layers, slivers, or fibers from the surface of an object
[I/T] to cut small bits off something using rapid, light strokes of scissors or shears

items.def_zh: 修整（指甲）；精细修剪，精心护理（草坪、庭院等）
items.def_en: To trim, clean, and polish fingernails neatly; to groom or trim lawns and gardens with meticulous care.
[I/T] to carve or shape wood by repetitively slicing small slivers off surface edges

items.def_zh: 削，削去（表皮、指甲等）；削减，缩减（开支、人员等）
items.def_en: 1. To cut away the thin outer skin or edge of something with a sharp knife. 2. (+ down/back) To gradually reduce the size, amount, or cost of something.
(+ sth) to gradually reduce the size, thickness, or outer edges of something by cutting or paring
(+ sth) to cut or carve fine pieces off something to shape it or progressively reduce its size

items.def_zh: 切碎，剁碎（肉或蔬菜）；装腔作势地迈碎步走；委婉含蓄地说
items.def_en: 1. To cut meat or other food into very small pieces. 2. To walk with short, quick, affected steps. 3. ('not mince words') To express thoughts directly without softening them.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express meticulous, controlled reductive cutting, trimming, or shaving of edges and layers to groom aesthetic form or achieve minute culinary particle sizes.
groups.summary_zh: 精细切削边缘外层、微切或修整外形以达工整。

groups.name: Partition & Segregate · 切分与隔断 (Partition, Chunk, Disconnect)
groups.tip: 切割成块并划分配额

items.def_en: (+ sth) to separate or block off a specific section or enclosure by enclosing it with ropes
(+ sth) to divide or hide a part of a room or space by placing a partition or screen in front of it
(+ sth) to divide a larger space or whole into separate, distinct functional sections

items.def_zh: 把……分成大块；把（信息、任务等）分段组块
items.def_en: To divide or break data, tasks, or materials into thick pieces or manageable chunks.
to divide something previously whole into smaller parcels, tracts, or organizational units

items.def_zh: 用警戒线隔开，封闭隔离
items.def_en: (+ sth) to separate and isolate an area using a physical boundary, tape, or line of guards

items.def_zh: 隔开，分割；把（国家等）分裂，划分
items.def_en: To divide a room, space, or country into separate parts, especially by walls or borders.

items.def_zh: 切断，断开（连接、电源或供应）；使分离，使脱节
items.def_en: To separate or unfasten something from a power supply, larger system, or another object.
to divide into completely discrete, mutually isolated sections or cognitive categories
to separate an area physically or organizationally from its surroundings using a barrier

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the spatial, infrastructural, or computational division of a continuous entity into distinct partitions, isolated blocks, or decoupled functional units.
groups.summary_zh: 将连续空间、结构或系统切分为独立块区或断开连接。

groups.name: Pay Out & Disburse · 支出与出纳支付 (Disburse, Pay out, Defray)
groups.tip: 机构官方拨付款项或过度支出

items.def_en: to distribute or pay a large sum of money from a fund, policy, or account
[I/T] (informal) (+ for) to reluctantly pay a large amount of money
(+ for sth) to spend or disburse an amount of money, usually unwillingly or under obligation
(+ sth) to surrender or pay out money, especially reluctantly after pressure
(+ sth) to spend or disburse a substantial sum of money on something
(+ sth) to pay money owed or cover an expenditure
1. To pay out money, especially from a public or official fund.

items.def_zh: 多付，多给报酬；付出过高代价
items.def_en: 1. To pay someone too much money, or pay more than the correct or reasonable amount for something.
1. To spend more money than is planned, budgeted, or affordable.
to provide money to pay for a particular cost or expense

groups.summary_en: Financial transaction scenario dealing with releasing, expending, or covering funds—often from institutional reserves, budgets, or dedicated accounts, as well as exceeding acceptable payment thresholds.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及机构拨款拨付、费用报销冲抵或超出预算限额的资金支出情境。

groups.name: Permeate & Filter Through · 渗透与漫溢 (Permeate, Percolate, Infiltrate)
groups.tip: 分子或液体在介质中蔓延

items.def_en: (+ into/through sth) to flow or spread extremely slowly through tiny openings, cracks, or pores
(+ into/through sth) to gradually pass, spread, or disperse through a medium, barrier, or population
(+ sth) to completely penetrate and saturate a porous material or fabric with liquid
(+ sth) to slowly seep, spread, or run into an adjacent area or material

items.def_zh: 使湿透、使浸透、使彻底充满
items.def_en: to fill or soak something so completely that no more can be absorbed
[I/T] (+ into/through) to pass gradually into a substance through small openings, or secretly enter an organization
(+ through/into) to trickle or pass slowly through fine pores or small crevices
To spread or diffuse through every part of something, especially of a liquid, gas, smell, or influence.

items.def_zh: 弥漫于、布满（光彩、情感等）
items.def_en: (+ with) to spread gradually through or over something with liquid, color, or emotional light

items.def_zh: 过滤，渗透；（思想、消息等）逐渐传开；滤煮（咖啡）
items.def_en: 1. (of a liquid) To filter or seep gradually through a porous surface or substance. 2. (of ideas, feelings, or news) To spread slowly through a group or community. 3. To brew coffee using a percolator.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe fluids, vapors, or figurative elements (such as ideas, moods, and qualities) gradually moving through pores, small spaces, or an entire substance/community until fully spread.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、气体或抽象观念透过孔隙、网络逐步穿透并散布全局。

groups.name: Persevere & Endure · 咬牙坚持与挺过 (Weather, Soldier on, Stick it out)
groups.tip: 顶住压力逆风死撑

items.def_en: to continue surviving, persevering, or refusing to quit during an ordeal or hostile situation
(+ sth) to continue supporting or doing something challenging until its complete conclusion
to continue doing something with grit and determination despite facing pain, fatigue, or difficulty

items.def_zh: 坚持到底；硬着头皮熬下去
items.def_en: to continue doing something difficult, unpleasant, or painful to the very end

items.def_zh: 坚持下去，硬挺下去，顽强坚持（常与 on 连用）；当兵，服兵役
items.def_en: 1. ('soldier on') To persevere and continue doing something despite difficulty, pain, or tiredness. 2. To serve as a soldier.

items.def_zh: 经受住，平安度过（难关、风暴等）；（使）风化，（受风雨侵蚀）褪色变质
items.def_en: 1. To endure, survive, or come through a difficult situation or storm safely. 2. To change in color, shape, or condition as a result of exposure to the elements.
to experience and bear continuing hardship, pain, or misfortune without giving in
to continue to resist or survive under attack or deprivation

items.def_zh: 安然挺过，平安度过（风波、危机）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to survive or manage to get through a dangerous, tumultuous, or difficult period unharmed
to endure a difficult, painful, or confrontational period with grim determination

groups.summary_en: An agent continues forward through adversity, exhaustion, or hostile conditions, showing fortitude and refusing to surrender. Verbs differ in whether the emphasis is on stoic continuation despite pain or surviving an acute storm of events.
groups.summary_zh: 面对逆境、疲劳或严酷打击仍咬牙坚持、经受考验而不倒。

groups.name: Personal Attendance & Domestic Service · 侍奉与随侍服务 (Attend, Valet, Wait on)
groups.tip: 到场出席参与其中

items.def_zh: 照料，服侍，照料……的起居需求
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to attend to the needs, comfort, or physical welfare of a person

items.def_zh: 照料伺候，满足……的个人需要
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to attend to the practical needs or personal requirements of someone

items.def_zh: 为……服务，服侍；任职，服役；端上，供应（饭菜）；起作用
items.def_en: 1. To perform duties or work for a person, organization, or country. 2. To provide food or drink to guests or customers. 3. (+ as) To be useful for a particular purpose or function.
to accompany and supervise an individual or group as a protective social attendant

items.def_zh: 代客泊车；伺候，照看（客人衣物等）；彻底清洗（汽车）
items.def_en: 1. To park cars for customers (as a valet). 2. To act as a personal attendant to someone, especially by caring for their clothes. 3. (chiefly British) To clean the inside and outside of a vehicle thoroughly.

items.def_zh: 奉承侍奉，奴颜婢膝地巴结伺候
items.def_en: (+ sb) to attend to someone with excessive, servile, or ingratiating attentiveness
(+ hand and foot) to act as an attendant to someone, providing food, drink, or personal care

items.def_zh: 出席，参加；照料，侍候；专心于，处理（attend to）
items.def_en: 1. To be present at an event, meeting, or ceremony, or regularly go to a school or church. 2. (+ to) To pay attention to, deal with, or care for someone or something.
to escort or attend someone gallantly or solicitously in public

items.def_zh: 照料；伺候（病弱或需要者）
items.def_en: to attend carefully to the personal, spiritual, or physical needs of someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe personal ministering, domestic attendance, or bespoke care provided to an individual, varying in formality, subservience, and the exact physical domain of personal service.
groups.summary_zh: 描述为他人提供个人照料、随侍或专业管家式服务的行为与方式。

groups.name: Physical Confinement & Seclusion · 禁闭与关押 (Cage, Closet, Confine)
groups.tip: 关入封闭狭小空间限制自由

items.def_zh: 把（人或牲畜）关入栏圈中
items.def_en: to put or keep animals or people in a small enclosed area
to put someone in a prison, cell, or locked room
to keep someone or something confined in a small or restricted space
to close doors or boundaries so as to prevent someone or something from leaving

items.def_zh: 把……幽闭/关押起来，使其与外界隔绝
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to confine a person or animal in an enclosed room or secluded space away from others

items.def_zh: 圈闭，关在围栏/狭小空间内
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to trap or confine a person or animal in an enclosed physical space

items.def_zh: 严密围困，把……禁闭在狭小空间内
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to restrict someone's movement by trapping them in a confined area with no way out
to put or confine someone or an animal in a cage.

items.def_zh: 把……关入密室（商谈）；把……藏在小房间中
items.def_en: (chiefly passive) to shut someone away in a private room for a confidential discussion or intense work.
(+ to) to keep someone within certain limits or enclose them in a room or prison

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on physically shutting a person or creature into a small, enclosed container or interior space, restricting their physical liberty. Registers vary from everyday literal confinement to literary or metaphorical seclusion.
groups.summary_zh: 将人或动物封闭在狭小实体空间或房间内限制其人身自由。

groups.name: Physical Evasion & Quick Dodging · 敏捷躲闪与闪避 (Dodge, Duck, Shy)
groups.tip: 迅速侧身避开障碍

items.def_en: to quickly lower your head or body to avoid being struck or seen
(+ from sb/sth) to make a sudden nervous movement away from something due to fright or sudden alarm
[I/T] to quickly lower the head or body to avoid being hit or seen

items.def_zh: （因畏惧或惊吓而）退缩，退避；（马）惊跳后退
items.def_en: 1. (+ away from) To avoid doing something because you feel nervous, reluctant, or fearful. 2. (of a horse) To jump suddenly aside in fright.
[I/T] to step quickly to one side to avoid an oncoming blow or obstacle
to make a quick, nervous movement of the face or body as an instinctive reaction to pain or fear
to make a sudden spring backward to avoid an immediate physical hazard or blow

items.def_zh: 猛转方向避开，急转闪开
items.def_en: (+ from sb/sth) to change direction abruptly and sharply to avoid colliding with an oncoming obstacle

items.def_zh: 闪避，躲开；故意回避，躲闪（问题、责任等）
items.def_en: 1. To move quickly aside to avoid hitting or being hit by something. 2. To evade a duty, responsibility, or question cleverly or dishonestly.
to change direction abruptly, especially while moving, in order to avoid a collision

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe sudden, instinctive, or agile physical movements used to evade an oncoming object, blow, or unexpected obstacle, or backing away out of sudden alarm.
groups.summary_zh: 以迅捷或条件反射式的肢体动作避开物理冲击或突然的威胁。

groups.name: Piercing High-Volume Screaming · 尖声呼喊与号叫 (Shrill, Bawl, Squall)
groups.tip: 大声叫唤直至刺耳凄厉嘶喊

items.def_en: to make a shrill, discordant, or wailing cry like that of a cat
(+ sth) to utter, sing, or scream something with forceful, unrestrained vocal volume
to shout loudly or make an unrestrained, piercing vocal sound from pain, fear, or excitement
to make a harsh, grating, and high-pitched scream or outcry

items.def_zh: 放声痛哭；大声叫嚷，怒吼
items.def_en: To shout, call out, or cry very loudly and noisily; to scold angrily.

items.def_zh: 尖声喊出；发出尖锐刺耳的声音
items.def_en: To make or utter with a loud, high-pitched, piercing sound or cry.

items.def_zh: 嚎啕大哭，凄厉尖叫；（风等）起飑，呼啸
items.def_en: To cry or scream loudly and harshly, especially of a baby or bird; to blow in sudden violent gusts.

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳尖叫，尖锐嘶喊
items.def_en: (+ sth) to produce a harsh, high-pitched scream or shout with high vocal intensity
(+ sth) to utter a shrill, piercing, high-volume cry or utterance
to utter a sudden, sharp, high-pitched, and piercing scream

groups.summary_en: This frame covers vociferous, piercing, or unrestrained shouting and crying characterized by sharp timbre and extreme acoustic intensity.
groups.summary_zh: 指高音调、刺耳或声嘶力竭的高分贝嘶喊与啼哭号叫。

groups.name: Pillage & Plunder · 掠夺与抢劫 (Plunder, Loot, Pillage)
groups.tip: 动用暴力强行掠夺财物

items.def_en: (+ sth) to steal and escape with valuable property or plundered goods
[T/I] to steal goods from shops or homes during a riot, war, or natural disaster
(+ sth) to seize, loot, and remove valuable goods or property by force
(+ sb/sth) to forcibly dispossess someone or a location of all possessions, clothing, or valuables
[T/I] to steal goods violently from a place or person, especially in wartime
[T/I] to rob a place using violence, especially during warfare
[I/T] to roam around in search of things to steal or people to attack
(archaic / literary) To plunder, rob, or carry away by force.
(literary) To steal valuables from a place or strip something of its riches or beauty.
To steal a car by forcing the driver out using violence or threats.

groups.summary_en: Actors forcibly seize valuable property or resources from people, settlements, or vehicles, typically during wartime, lawless disorder, or through violent assault. These verbs emphasize aggressive, unauthorized dispossession ranging from battlefield pillaging to armed vehicular hijacking.
groups.summary_zh: 强调战乱或无序状态下暴力洗劫财物、掠夺资源的强取行为。

groups.name: Placate & Pacify · 安抚与平息 (Placate, Pacify, Mollify)
groups.tip: 平息怒火化解焦躁不安

items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause an angry, agitated, or hostile person to become peaceful and composed

items.def_zh: 化解（争端），抚平（愤怒），息事宁人
items.def_en: (+ sth) to mitigate hostility, soothe ruffled feelings, or minimize the seriousness of a dispute

items.def_zh: 使冷静下来，消除敌意或激愤
items.def_en: (+ sb) to pacify someone's violent temper or hostile agitation

items.def_zh: 姑息，抚慰（通过妥协或满足要求平息怨怒）
items.def_en: to pacify or placate someone by acceding to their demands, often at the expense of principles

items.def_zh: 平息（怒气）；抚慰；平定（动乱）
items.def_en: to make someone calm and less angry, or to bring peace to an agitated or rebellious crowd
To make someone less angry or hostile, especially by doing or saying things to please them.

items.def_zh: 缓和，减轻，平息（痛苦、内疚、恐惧等）；使满足
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To make an unpleasant feeling, such as pain, guilt, or fear, less severe. 2. (formal) To satisfy a physical need or appetite.

items.def_zh: 平息，安抚，使平静；缓和，减轻
items.def_en: To make someone who is angry or upset feel calmer and less annoyed.

items.def_zh: 调和，安抚（怀有敌意或争执的各方）
items.def_en: to stop someone from being angry or discontented by showing goodwill and seeking agreement

items.def_zh: 使息怒，取悦，求得……的原谅（或好感）
items.def_en: (formal) To win the favor or calm the anger of a god, spirit, or powerful person by doing or saying something pleasing.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe neutralizing anger, hostility, resentment, or violent unrest by conceding demands, offering conciliatory words, or making amends. They emphasize subduing hostility and grievance rather than offering sympathetic grief counseling.
groups.summary_zh: 平息他人的怒气、敌意或不满情绪，使局势转为缓和顺从。

groups.name: Place & Settle · 安放与安置 (Secure & Specialized Placement)
groups.tip: 稳妥安置并固定在特定位置

items.def_zh: 将……安放/藏置于隐秘稳妥处
items.def_en: (+ sth) to put something away in a secure, snug, or sheltered place

items.def_zh: 把……塞入（舒适或稳妥的位置）；给……盖好被子
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to place or push something neatly and snugly into a safe or comfortable position, especially sheets around someone in bed
to set or balance sb/sth securely on a high or narrow edge
to settle or place sth comfortably and sheltered warmly inside or against sth

items.def_zh: 使安顿，安置（常作 ensconce oneself，安顿下来，舒适地坐下）
items.def_en: (usually ensconce oneself) To settle comfortably and securely in a place.

items.def_zh: 躲避；安顿隐蔽在安全之处
items.def_en: to hide or settle oneself in a secure, secluded place
to put sb/sth in a specific position, seat, or home, often comfortably or formally

items.def_zh: 安置，安放（大炮、设备等）；使就位
items.def_en: To put something, especially a heavy weapon or piece of equipment, firmly into position.

items.def_zh: 掘壕固守；稳固防守阵地
items.def_en: to establish a secure, fortified, or entrenched defensive position
to establish sth firmly and securely so that change or removal is difficult

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express placing or settling a person or object into a sheltered, snug, strategic, or fortified resting position with stability and comfort.
groups.summary_zh: 以稳固、舒适、隐蔽或战略性的特定方式安置或固定人与物。

groups.name: Plan & Intend · 意图与规划 (Plan, Aim, Propose)
groups.tip: 心中抱有目标与蓝图

items.def_en: to decide on and arrange in advance a set of actions for achieving a specific outcome
(formal) To intend or resolve to do something; to have as an aim or plan.

items.def_zh: 安排，预定，将……列入时间表
items.def_en: To arrange or plan for an event or activity to happen at a particular time.
(+ to-inf / at) to have the clear objective, purpose, or intention of achieving something
to form an intention in one's mind (+ to-inf / -ing)

items.def_zh: 打算，计划，意图；打算使……成为（或用于）；意指
items.def_en: 1. To have something in mind as a plan or purpose; to plan to do something. 2. To design, designate, or mean something for a specific person, purpose, or use.
to formulate strategic plans or decisions deliberately in advance of future events

items.def_zh: 周密规划，详尽制定（计划/未来方向）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to plan, outline, or organize a detailed program of action for the future

items.def_zh: 立志打算，着手计划（做某事）
items.def_en: (+ do sth) to intend or consciously undertake a deliberate course of action with a specific aim
to consider something as a possible course of future action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express mental resolve, forward planning, or programmatic scheduling to bring about a deliberate future action.
groups.summary_zh: 指在心中拟定意图、设定目标或系统性排定未来行动步骤。

groups.name: Pledge & Swear Bindingly · 保证与发誓立誓 (Guarantee, Vow, Swear)
groups.tip: 立下誓约并提供担保承诺

items.def_zh: 担保，以信誉担保（真实性或人品）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to assert or guarantee the good character, accuracy, or reliability of someone or something
to make a serious, formal, and public promise to do or provide something

items.def_zh: 庄严承诺，立约使自己受约束
items.def_en: (+ sth) to commit oneself irrevocably to a solemn promise, duty, or oath
(+ sth) to state firmly or take an oath affirming the absolute truth of something

items.def_zh: 保证，担保；肯定，必然导致
items.def_en: 1. To make a formal promise that something will happen, be done, or meet a certain standard. 2. To make something certain to happen.
To make a serious, solemn promise or commitment to do something or that something is true.

items.def_zh: 发誓，起誓；诅咒，说脏话（swear 的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of swear; to make a solemn promise or oath. 2. Past participle of swear; to use offensive or profane language.

items.def_zh: 发誓，起誓；诅咒，说脏话（swear 的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of swear; to make a solemn promise or oath. 2. Past tense of swear; to use offensive or profane language.

items.def_zh: 宣誓保证，以死约定（誓言、婚约）
items.def_en: (archaic/formal) to give solemn pledge of fidelity or marry by solemn vow
to command or entreat someone earnestly and solemnly, as if under oath

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe making commitments of varying solemnity and binding force, moving from commercial or practical assurance to sacred oaths.
groups.summary_zh: 按庄严度与约束力递增，体现从常规担保到立下重誓的言语行为。

groups.name: Plunder & Raid · 掠夺与劫掠 (Predatory Incursions & Looting)
groups.tip: 突袭扫荡洗劫财物

items.def_en: to plunder and destroy a captured town or city in wartime
(+ sb/sth) to launch a sudden, predatory raid or surprise attack on an enemy or target settlement

items.def_zh: 席卷侵袭，毁灭性地横扫
items.def_en: (+ sth) to tear through a place causing massive devastation, pillage, or violence
(+ sth) to move rapidly across an area or territory while invading, looting, or destroying
[I/T] to steal goods from private homes or stores during a riot, war, or catastrophe
[I/T] to steal goods from a place or person, typically using force and in a time of war or civil disorder
(+ into) To make a brief, sudden raid into an enemy territory to plunder; to venture into an unfamiliar field.
To violently steal goods, plunder, and ransack property from a place during a war or conflict.
(literary) To roam around in search of things to steal or people to attack.
to violently strip a place of possessions, resources, or natural beauty

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame evoke the violent scenario of armed raiders or marauders penetrating territory or premises to seize property, sack settlements, and cause havoc. They differ between sudden swift incursions, roaming banditry, and widespread systematic sacking of towns during war.
groups.summary_zh: 武装突袭越界入室，大肆劫掠财物并破坏城镇。

groups.name: Position & Fit · 定位与安嵌 (Install, Emplace, Embed)
groups.tip: 将设备放置就位并完成装配

items.def_zh: 嵌合；把……安放到合适位置
items.def_en: (+ sth) to put or settle something securely into the correct space or position
(+ sth) to fit or slide easily into a designated narrow opening or space

items.def_zh: 使落座；使（零件）卡紧到位
items.def_en: to position a mechanical component firmly and accurately into its housing or socket

items.def_zh: 把（子弹）装入枪膛；把……关在房间内
items.def_en: 1. To load a round of ammunition into the chamber of a firearm. 2. (literary) To place or confine in a room or chamber.

items.def_zh: 放置，安放；存放，储存；使沉积
items.def_en: 1. To put or set down someone or something in a specific place. 2. To put money or valuables into a bank or safe place. 3. To leave a layer of a substance behind.

items.def_zh: 给……装上格栅；磨碎，擦成丝；发出刺耳的摩擦声；使人烦躁
items.def_en: 1. To furnish or fit with a grate or grates. 2. To shred food into small pieces by rubbing it against a grater. 3. To make an unpleasant scraping or rasping sound. 4. To annoy or irritate someone.
(+ sth) to fix or fasten something firmly and immovably into a particular place or position

items.def_zh: 安装，安设；安置；使正式就职
items.def_en: 1. To put a piece of equipment, system, or software into place and connect it so that it is ready for use. 2. To put someone into an official position or job with a formal ceremony.

items.def_zh: 把……安放在规定位置（尤指重型仪器或武器）
items.def_en: to put an instrument, weapon, or heavy structural element into a prepared position for use

items.def_zh: 嵌入，牢牢装入（深嵌在周围介质中）
items.def_en: to fix an object firmly and deeply in a surrounding solid mass

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe placing, fitting, inserting, or locking an object securely into an allocated compartment, frame, apparatus, or physical setting designed to receive it. Nuances involve precise mechanical containment (chamber), structural installation (install), or setting down in a designated depository (deposit).
groups.summary_zh: 将物品或设备安放、固定或装配至专用的槽位、结构与基座中。

groups.name: Position & Relocate · 定位与重置 (Position, Tee, Repot, Reseat)
groups.tip: 精准定位或调整摆放朝向

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange things in a straight row or into precise spatial alignment
(+ sth) to support something physically by placing an object under or against it to keep it in position
(+ sth) to adjust or place something so that it is straight, level, or at right angles

items.def_zh: 安置，放置；使处于特定位置
items.def_en: To put someone or something in a particular place or position.
to place or arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative position

items.def_zh: 搁在球座上；（tee up）准备好
items.def_en: (often + up) To place a ball on a tee in golf; to make preparations or set something up.
[I/T] to place or balance something precariously on a high or narrow surface

items.def_zh: 将（植物）换盆，移植到新盆中
items.def_en: To move a growing houseplant into a larger or different pot.

items.def_zh: 使重新就座；使复位，重新安装；给……换座底
items.def_en: 1. To provide new seats for, or seat someone in a new position. 2. To fit something back into its proper position.

items.def_zh: 使平衡；置于悬停待发位置
items.def_en: to balance or hold steady in readiness for a particular movement

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe manipulating an item into an exact spatial orientation, specialized fixture, or new container to serve an impending operational function. They emphasize precise geometric realignment, support, or transfer.
groups.summary_zh: 根据功能需要，将物品置于特定方位、承托架或重置至新容器中。

groups.name: Position & Settle · 放置与安放 (Put, Place, Set)
groups.tip: 将物体放在特定位置上

items.def_zh: 放置，安放；安置，任命；寄托
items.def_en: 1. To put something in a particular position or place; to assign a role, duty, or value to someone or something.

items.def_zh: 放，安放；使处于（某种状态）；表达，陈述
items.def_en: 1. To move something into a particular position or location; to cause someone or something to be in a certain state; to express in words.

items.def_zh: 放置，安放；设定，确定；摆放（餐具）；凝固；（日月）落山
items.def_en: 1. To put or place someone or something in a particular position; to establish or adjust a value, limit, or rule; 2. to become solid or firm; (of the sun or moon) to sink below the horizon.
To put someone or something in a particular calculated place or posture
[I/T] (+ against/on) To place or lean something so that it is supported
To put something down gently or carefully into a flat horizontal position

items.def_zh: 放下，放置（常较正式或指卸下重物）
items.def_en: To put or set down something, especially gently or carefully, in a formal or deliberate manner
(+ sth) to place something onto a flat surface or the floor
(+ sth) to place something flat on a surface with care
(+ sth) to place an object carefully on a surface or in an upright position

groups.summary_en: An agent moves an object to rest in a specific location or posture. Put is the most generic everyday verb, place implies conscious deliberation or care, and set implies positioning firmly into a designated, upright, or prepared state.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品置于特定位置，涵盖从随意放置到审慎安放。

groups.name: Possess & Retain · 拥有与留存保留 (Have, Own, Retain)
groups.tip: 掌握和占有某物

items.def_zh: 有，拥有；占有，持有；经历；吃，喝；使，让
items.def_en: 1. To own, hold, or possess something; 2. to experience or undergo; 3. to consume food or drink.

items.def_zh: 拥有，具有……的所有权；承认 (own up to)
items.def_en: 1. To possess or have legal ownership of something; 2. to admit or acknowledge something.

items.def_zh: 保有，保留；保存，保管；保持；遵守
items.def_en: 1. To retain possession of; to continue to have or hold; 2. to remain in a particular state or condition.
to maintain possession, custody, or control of property, title, or position

items.def_zh: 保留，保有；保存，保管；保持（keep 的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of keep: to have retained possession of, held, or maintained.
to continue to have, keep, or hold onto something rather than losing or relinquishing it
to have or own something tangible, or to be endowed with a quality (formal)

items.def_zh: 保留；保住（所有权或控制权）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to keep possession of something and refuse to give or sell it to others
(+ sth) to reserve a portion of something rather than giving it away or using it all

items.def_zh: 继续保留；留着（物品或财产）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to retain possession of something instead of parting with it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entering or remaining in a state of holding legal ownership, physical custody, or non-relinquishment of an entity, ranging from basic possession to formal custody and retention.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖对财物、权利或属性的事实持有、法定所有与持续保留。

groups.name: Press & Compress · 挤压与压缩 (Physical Compression)
groups.tip: 施力挤压使物体体积变小

items.def_en: (+ sth) to apply downward physical force to flatten or compact an object
[I/T] to make or become level, smooth, or flat by applying downward pressure
(+ sth) to crush or compress something forcefully into a smaller or flatter shape
(+ sth) to press two or more parts or objects tightly against each other
1. To press something firmly from opposite sides, often to extract liquid or change its shape. 2. To force one's way into a tight space.
To press something firmly together so that it becomes dense, solid, and tightly packed.
to crush or squeeze something with force, making it flat or soft
[I/T] to make or become narrower or tighter, especially by encircling pressure
to press or squeeze something with such force that it breaks or loses its natural shape
1. To press or squeeze something into a smaller space. 2. To reduce data or text in size or duration.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve applying inward physical force to an object or substance to reduce its volume, increase its density, or expel liquid. They range from gentle manual flattening to heavy mechanical compaction.
groups.summary_zh: 向内施力以缩小体积、增加密度或压出液体。

groups.name: Protect from Attack or Harm · 防御与护卫 (Defend, Guard, Shield)
groups.tip: 抵御外敌并守护安危

items.def_en: (+ from/against) to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or attack

items.def_zh: 守护，保卫；看守；警惕，防范
items.def_en: 1. To protect a person, place, or object from attack or danger. 2. To watch over prisoners to prevent escape. 3. (+ against) To take precautions to prevent something bad.
1. To protect someone or something against attack, harm, or danger. 2. To speak or write in support of someone or something against criticism.
