To protect someone or something from danger, harm, or unpleasant experiences.

items.def_zh: 使入病房, 守护, 保卫
items.def_en: watch over or shield from danger or harm; protect
to prevent someone or something unpleasant or hostile from coming near or harming you
(+ sb/sth) to defend or support someone or something that is being criticized or attacked
(+ sb/sth) to defend yourself against an attack or hostile approach by pushing the attacker away or resisting them
(+ sb/sth) to guard and protect someone or something to ensure they remain safe from harm
(+ against) to protect rights, security, or welfare with formal measures

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve acting to prevent an entity from being attacked, invaded, damaged, or injured by taking defensive postures or providing protective cover.
groups.summary_zh: 抵御外来侵犯，或通过遮挡、站岗等方式提供人身与安全防护。

groups.name: Protrude & Stick Out · 突出与伸出 (Protrude, Jut, Cantilever)
groups.tip: 表面向外凸出或显露出来

items.def_en: to protrude or emerge slightly through an opening or past a surface
to project or be physically raised from an adjacent background or surface
(+ of/from) to extend outward past the surface or edge of something
1. (+ from/into) To stick out beyond an edge or surface; to project outward.

items.def_zh: （建筑等）以悬臂伸出，用悬臂梁支撑
items.def_en: 1. (architecture / engineering) To project outward like a cantilever, or to support a structure using cantilevers.
to extend sharply outward beyond the main body or edge of something
(+ from) to stick out beyond an edge or surface
(+ with) to swell or protrude outward in a rounded shape

items.def_zh: 悬垂于…之上；向外伸出悬挂
items.def_en: [I/T] to project outward over something below
1. (+ out/into/over) To project or extend outward beyond the main line or body of something.

groups.summary_en: A structure, physical body, or architectural element extends outward or upward beyond an adjacent boundary or flat surface, either naturally or by cantilevered engineering.
groups.summary_zh: 物体或建筑构件向外、向上突出或挑出原有表面或边界。

groups.name: Publish & Release · 公布与发行 (Publish, Issue, Post)
groups.tip: 对外公布消息或公开发表

items.def_en: To display or publish information publicly, especially on a noticeboard or online; to send by mail.

items.def_zh: 发布，颁布；发行；配发；流出
items.def_en: To officially publish, produce, or announce something for the public; to distribute or flow out.

items.def_zh: 公开发售或公开发布（电影、产品、声明）
items.def_en: to make a film, record, software, or news available for public consumption

items.def_zh: 出版，发行；公开发表，公布
items.def_en: To prepare and produce a book, magazine, or document for sale or public distribution; to make information widely known.

items.def_zh: 发布消息或出版出版物
items.def_en: to produce or broadcast something for public notice
(+ sth) to make a new publication, product, or official policy available to the public for the first time

items.def_zh: 分发；分发寄出（通知或材料）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to distribute copies of a document, announcement, or newsletter to many recipients
(+ sth) to publish or release a book, magazine, or recorded piece of work to the public
[I/T] to pass from person to person or disseminate a document widely

items.def_zh: 正式颁布法令或公开宣布
items.def_en: to make a law, decree, or new principle publicly and officially known

groups.summary_en: An author, institution, or administrator puts text, announcements, or creative content into the public sphere through digital, print, or formal channels.
groups.summary_zh: 个人或官方机构借网络、书刊或公告将信息向公众发布。

groups.name: Pursue & Shadow · 追踪与尾随 (Follow, Track, Dog)
groups.tip: 紧跟或追随在后

items.def_zh: 跟随，追随；遵循，服从；理解，领会
items.def_en: 1. to travel or move behind someone or something 2. to obey rules or follow instructions 3. to understand or keep up with
to follow someone closely and continually; to cause problems for someone over a long period
to follow the trail, movements, or progress of someone or something
to follow behind someone by tracking clues, footprints, or scents

items.def_zh: 隐秘尾随，如影随形地跟着
items.def_en: to follow someone very closely, keeping watch without being detected
to follow someone closely and secretly in order to watch their movements
(+ sb/sth) to chase or pursue someone in order to catch them
(+ sb/sth) to follow clues or footprints until a target is located
(+ sb) to follow closely behind someone wherever they go

items.def_zh: 紧追不舍，不断纠缠追逐
items.def_en: to pursue someone relentlessly and persistently without giving them rest

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe maintaining surveillance or physical pursuit of an entity along a path, differing by persistence, visibility, and legal/hostile intent.
groups.summary_zh: 描述沿路径追随、暗中盯梢或持续追捕某人或某物，语域与敌意程度不同。

groups.name: Rebel & Defy · 抗拒、叛乱与背叛 (Defy, Riot, Defect)
groups.tip: 街头骚乱升级为武装暴动

items.def_en: [I/T] to fight back against or oppose something or someone actively
(+ sb/sth) to resist or confront a powerful opponent or bully with courage and defiance
to openly disregard a law, rule, or convention with contempt
to act collectively against an oppressive government or authority by taking up resistance

items.def_zh: 背叛；反目成仇；倒戈抵抗
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to stop being friendly or loyal to someone and start opposing or defying them
(+ against) to rise in opposition or take up arms against an established ruler or authority
1. To take part in a violent and uncontrolled public disturbance.

items.def_zh: 背叛，叛逃，变节（投奔敌对阵营）
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/to) To leave your own country, political party, or organization in order to join an opposing one.

items.def_zh: 违抗，反抗，藐视；使无法（相信、解释等）
items.def_en: 1. To refuse openly to obey a person, rule, or law. 2. To be impossible to explain, describe, or believe.
to refuse openly to obey the orders of officers in military or maritime service

groups.summary_en: Agents actively challenge authority, rising from insolent defiance to violent public insurrection or total treasonous abandonment.
groups.summary_zh: 对抗权威，从藐视抗命上升至街头暴动与叛逃倒戈。

groups.name: Rend & Cleave · 撕裂与劈开 (Rend, Rive, Crosscut)
groups.tip: 用力劈开木石断绝连接

items.def_en: (+ sth) to tear something completely into small shreds or fragments
[I/T] to pull or sever apart quickly and forcefully with rough edges

items.def_zh: 横切，横截（木材）；（电影中）交叉剪辑
items.def_en: 1. To saw or cut wood across the grain. 2. (in film editing) To alternate between two or more different scenes.
(+ sth) to tear or split something violently into pieces or separate parts
(+ sth) to pull or rend something into pieces using severe, violent force
[I/T] to split or sever something sharply along a natural line or grain

items.def_zh: 撕裂，撕碎，猛力劈开；使心碎
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To tear or split something apart violently. 2. To cause deep sorrow or grief to someone.

items.def_zh: 撕裂，分裂，劈开（rive的过去分词）
items.def_en: (literary) Past participle of rive: violently split, torn apart, or divided.
(literary) To tear or split something apart violently; to divide into pieces or factions.
to break or split apart violently into pieces; sever cleanly

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the violent splitting, fracturing, or tearing apart of solid material along or across grain lines. They distinguish mechanical transverse cutting from archaic, highly dramatic or violent fracturing and wrenching apart.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重沿纹理或横向实施剧烈、深度的劈裂、撕开或切断。

groups.name: Renovate & Modernize · 改造与翻新 (Redo, Retrofit, Redevelop)
groups.tip: 在旧基础上进行更新重塑

items.def_en: (+ sth) to renovate, redecorate, or put something into a state of good repair
1. To redecorate, renovate, or remodel a room or building; to do something again.

items.def_zh: 翻新，修缮（房屋或建筑物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to repair, redecorate, or modernize an old building, room, or vehicle
(+ sth) to structurally, visually, or functionally overhaul and improve something

items.def_zh: 翻新，修葺（使建筑等恢复良好状态）
items.def_en: To restore a room or building to a good state of repair
To give new and improved form, structure, or appearance to something

items.def_zh: 整修，重新装饰（改善外观或功能）
items.def_en: To redecorate and revamp a building or item to improve its appearance and utility

items.def_zh: 翻新，对……进行技术改造，加装新部件
items.def_en: 1. To install newer parts, equipment, or features into an older building, vehicle, or machine.

items.def_zh: 重新开发，改造，重建（旧区或建筑）
items.def_en: 1. To rebuild, modernize, or develop an urban area, building, or land for a new purpose.
To thoroughly examine and repair an entire machine, system, or organization

groups.summary_en: An agent modifies, upgrades, or structurally overhauls existing buildings, systems, or areas to improve functionality, conform to new standards, or give them a modern form.
groups.summary_zh: 对既有建筑、设施或区域进行改造、升级与更新。

groups.name: Reorient & Route Around · 换向与环行 (Pronate, Reorient, Circumnavigate)
groups.tip: 围绕轴线旋转、转动或环绕

items.def_en: (+ sth) to travel along a curved path around an obstruction or perimeter
(+ sth) to direct movement or travel around an obstacle or perimeter
(+ sb/sth) to change bodily orientation or bearing to face the opposite direction
[I/T] (+ on/around) To turn or balance on a central point or pin

items.def_zh: 旋后（使手掌或足底向上或向外翻转）
items.def_en: [I/T] To turn or rotate the hand, forearm, or foot so that the palm or sole faces upward or outward

items.def_zh: 旋前，前旋（使手掌朝下或足内翻）
items.def_en: (anatomy) To turn the forearm so the palm faces downward or backward, or to roll the foot inward during movement.
[I/T] To go around the edge or periphery of an area rather than through it
To go past or around an obstacle or town using an alternate route

items.def_zh: 重新调整方向，重新定位；使重新适应
items.def_en: To change the direction, orientation, focus, or purpose of something or someone.
To sail, fly, or travel completely around something, especially the earth or an island.

groups.summary_en: An entity adjusts its anatomical or spatial orientation, pivots relative to bearings, or navigates completely around a perimeter or globe.
groups.summary_zh: 调整解剖学或空间朝向、方位重定向，或绕周界环行。

groups.name: Resonate with Metallic or Ringing Sound · 震响与清脆鸣响 (Jangle, Twang, Knell)
groups.tip: 弦震或钟鸣产生的特殊声

items.def_en: to ring harmoniously or strike to signal time, as a clock or set of bells
to make a clear, musical, ringing sound like small bells or a clock

items.def_zh: 发出呼呼声，发出嗡嗡声
items.def_en: To make a continuous, low, rapid buzzing or humming sound.
to sound loudly and resonantly, especially of bells or chimes
to emit a loud, clear, resonant metallic or bell-like sound that carries through an area
to sound a large bell slowly and regularly, typically for a funeral or disaster

items.def_zh: （使）发出叮当刺耳声；激怒，使烦躁
items.def_en: 1. To make, or cause to make, an unpleasant, ringing metallic sound. 2. To make someone feel nervous, anxious, or irritated.

items.def_zh: 鸣丧钟；敲响（缓慢低沉的钟声）；预示灭亡
items.def_en: To ring slowly and solemnly, especially for a funeral; to sound as an omen of death or disaster.

items.def_zh: （使）发出拨弦声，（使）发出嘣的震颤声；带鼻音讲话
items.def_en: 1. To make, or cause something to make, a sharp vibrating metallic or string-like sound. 2. To speak with a strong nasal sound.

items.def_zh: 叮当响；发出高亢金属声
items.def_en: to make a loud, resonant metallic sound like that of hard metal hitting metal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the emission of resonant, plucking, clashing, or solemn acoustic vibrations, typical of bells, metallic objects, or vibrating cords.
groups.summary_zh: 发出琴弦拨动声、金属碰撞的刺耳脆响或沉重钟鸣声。

groups.name: Restrain & Fetter · 束缚与禁锢 (Fetter, Shackle, Trammel)
groups.tip: 具象化锁链缰绳捆绑与限制自由

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to surround closely and restrict freedom of movement, action, or growth
(+ sb/sth) to restrict someone's freedom of movement, development, or choice through obligations or constraints
to limit or restrict someone's freedom or ability to develop freely

items.def_zh: 给（马）套上辔头；控制，约束；（因受冒犯而）动怒，昂首表示不悦（bridle at）
items.def_en: 1. To put a bridle on a horse; to control or restrain something. 2. (+ at) to show sudden anger or resentment.
(+ sb/sth) to fasten securely with chains or restrain tightly so as to prevent movement
to fasten or confine someone or something securely with a metal chain

items.def_zh: 给……戴上手铐（或脚镣）；束缚，阻碍
items.def_en: 1. To fasten someone's hands or feet with shackles. 2. To severely restrict someone's freedom or prevent them from acting freely.

items.def_zh: 以契约束缚（做学徒或仆役）
items.def_en: (historical) To bind someone by a signed contract to work for another person as an apprentice or servant.
1. To restrict someone's movement by chaining their feet. 2. To restrict someone's freedom, choice, or development.
to put handcuffs on someone, or severely restrict their freedom to act

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe restricting a person's liberty, action, or development through physical bonds, legal contracts, or figurative constraints.
groups.summary_zh: 通过实体枷锁、契约或抽象障碍剥夺自由并限制行动。

groups.name: Retreat & Fall Back · 撤退与后撤 (Retreat, Withdraw, Fall back)
groups.tip: 脱离交战主动向后撤离

items.def_en: to move away from an enemy, danger, or difficult situation
to retreat or move back to a safer or secondary defensive position
[I/T] to withdraw troops or forces from a forward position, or to move backward
[I/T] (+ of) to evacuate or completely withdraw forces, personnel, or support from an area
to retreat backwards slowly away from a person, threat, or dangerous situation
to retreat from an active confrontation, dangerous encounter, or position
to move back or withdraw from a position or engagement gradually

items.def_zh: 撤退，撤离，离开；撤回，撤销；取款
items.def_en: 1. To pull back, retreat, or move away from an area or conflict. 2. To take back, remove, or retract something. 3. To take money out of a bank account.

items.def_zh: 撤回，撤退；退出；提（款）（withdraw的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of withdraw; to move back or away from a place or situation, remove, or take money out.

items.def_zh: 撤回，撤退；退出；提（款）（withdraw的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of withdraw; to move back or away from a place or situation, remove, or take money out.

groups.summary_en: An agent deliberately moves backward or departs from an active area of engagement, danger, or social participation. 'Withdraw' serves as the formal baseline, whereas 'retreat' conveys forced movement under threat.
groups.summary_zh: 指从危险前线、战场或特定场所主动或被迫向后撤离离开。

groups.name: Reveal & Uncover · 揭露与展露 (Disclose, Reveal, Unveil)
groups.tip: 展现公开隐藏的事物

items.def_en: to make known something that was previously secret or unknown
to uncover harmful secrets, dishonest acts, or scandalous behavior
(+ sth) to make qualities, hidden details, or obscured facts visible or clearly noticed
(+ sth) to disclose a secret, true identity, or confidential information carelessly or unintentionally
(+ sth) to reveal or disclose a piece of confidential information or news
To make secret, new, or private information known publicly; to reveal.

items.def_zh: 公布，推出；揭幕，揭开面纱
items.def_en: To show or introduce a new plan, product, or system to the public for the first time; to remove a cover or veil from something.
1. (formal) To show something clearly through signs or actions. 2. (often 'manifest itself') To appear or become evident.
to give away private or secret information to others
to reveal the true character or identity of someone or something hidden

groups.summary_en: Agents make previously hidden, confidential, or obscure information, facts, or objects visible and known to the public. Differences lie primarily in formality, ceremony, and whether tangible items or abstract secrets are revealed.
groups.summary_zh: 将隐藏、保密的信息或遮蔽的实物公布于众或显露出来。

groups.name: Roll & Wheel Around · 翻滚与转向 (Turn, Roll, Round)
groups.tip: 绕轴或向不同方向转

items.def_en: to move forward smoothly on wheels or by continuous rolling rotation
(+ sb/sth) to turn over completely onto one's side, back, or face by rotational movement

items.def_zh: 绕过，拐过；使成圆形；（使）变圆；四舍五入
items.def_en: 1. To go or pass around a corner, curve, or obstacle. 2. To make something round or become round. 3. (math) To round up or down to the nearest whole number or unit.
to pivot or turn around suddenly and sharply in a curving arc

items.def_zh: 旋转，转动；转弯，转向；转变，变成
items.def_en: 1. To move in a circular motion around an axis, or cause something to do so. 2. To change direction or orientation. 3. To change state or condition.

items.def_zh: 翻滚，滚动；使滚动；卷起；摇摆
items.def_en: 1. To move by turning over and over on an axis or along a surface, or cause to do so. 2. To curl or wrap into a tube or ball shape.
[I/T] To turn around quickly or fly in wide sweeping circles
To change direction suddenly or deviate from a straight course
[I/T] To change direction abruptly, especially in order to avoid an obstacle
To perform a rolling movement turning heel over head

groups.summary_en: An entity changes bodily facing, curves along an arc, or translates forward across a surface by continuous rolling rotation.
groups.summary_zh: 自身翻滚、绕弯转向或沿表面转动前行。

groups.name: Rule & Dominate · 统治与控制 (Govern, Control, Monopolize)
groups.tip: 国家治理与强权统辖

items.def_en: To control or maintain the rate or operation of a system by rules
(+ sth) to be in formal control of or exercise dominant authority over an organization, state, or proceeding
(+ sb/sth) to exercise sovereign authority, dominion, or administrative control over people or a country

items.def_zh: 统治，统辖，控制；操纵；抑制
items.def_en: To exercise authoritative power or dominance over an area or group; to manage, direct, or restrain something.
1. To conduct the policy and affairs of a state or organization. 2. To control or directly influence something.
(+ sb) to act in an arrogant and domineering manner toward someone

items.def_zh: 统治，治理；裁定，判定；支配
items.def_en: 1. To exercise authority or control over a country, people, or group. 2. To make an authoritative or legal decision.
[I/T] To exert a commanding, preeminent, or overbearing influence over others
To have or take exclusive control over a trade, market, conversation, or activity so that others cannot share.
To bring completely under domination or control, especially by military conquest

groups.summary_en: Actors exercise institutional power, regulatory direction, or overwhelming hegemony over subjects, states, or markets, escalating from standard administration to absolute subjugation.
groups.summary_zh: 行使治理、支配或垄断性权力，由制度监管升级至绝对主宰。

groups.name: Rumble & Resonate · 轰鸣与共振 (Rumble, Drone, Thunder)
groups.tip: 低沉震颤激起空气共鸣

items.def_zh: 发嗡嗡声；发出低沉轻微的哼鸣
items.def_en: to make a low, steady, continuous sound like that of a bee or electrical transformer
to emit a continuous, monotonous, low-frequency buzzing or humming sound
to make a steady, resonant, low-pitched mechanical vibration or acoustic hum

items.def_zh: 发出嗡嗡声，作轰鸣声；忙乱，充满喧闹声；按蜂鸣器呼叫
items.def_en: 1. To make a continuous low humming or vibrating sound like a bee or machinery. 2. To be filled with excitement, activity, or continuous chatter. 3. To signal or call someone with a buzzer.

items.def_zh: 发出低沉的嗡嗡声，轰鸣；单调低沉地讲，喋喋不休
items.def_en: 1. To make a continuous low, dull humming or vibrating sound. 2. (+ on) To speak for a long time in a monotonous, boring voice.

items.def_zh: 发出隆隆声，发轰鸣声；缓缓低沉地移动
items.def_en: To make a continuous, deep, low rolling sound like thunder or heavy vehicles.
to produce a deep, loud, resonant reverberating sound that travels widely

items.def_zh: 发出低沉有力的隆隆声；巨响
items.def_en: to emit a deep, hollow, resonant and prolonged sound

items.def_zh: 轰隆作响；打雷；雷鸣般呼喊，怒斥
items.def_en: 1. To make a loud, deep rumbling sound like thunder. 2. (impersonal) To produce thunder during a storm. 3. To speak, shout, or move with great noise and force.
to echo back or resonate repeatedly through a physical space or medium

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe producing or reverberating with a continuous, low-pitched, vibratory sound. They vary along the auditory spectrum from monotonous low-frequency hums and mechanical buzzing to earth-shaking, reverberating low-frequency thunder.
groups.summary_zh: 发出或伴随低沉、连续且具振动感的轰鸣声或嗡嗡声。

groups.name: Rupture & Explode · 爆裂与爆炸 (Burst, Rupture, Explode, Blast)
groups.tip: 压力骤增引发猛烈爆炸破裂

items.def_zh: 发出砰声爆裂；啪地爆开
items.def_en: [I/T] to make a light explosive sound, or to burst with a sharp popping noise
[I/T] to break apart or burst open under internal pressure or physical stress
[I/T] to break violently into many small pieces through explosive force or sharp impact
(+ sth) to explode violently or be destroyed by an explosive concussive detonation
to detonate, burst, or explode suddenly with great force

items.def_zh: （使）爆炸，（使）破裂；猛冲，突然出现；突然发作
items.def_en: 1. To break open or apart suddenly and violently, especially from internal pressure. 2. To move or enter somewhere suddenly and with great force.
[I/T] to burst violently and noisily into pieces as a result of chemical reaction or pressure
(+ sth) to shatter or violently disintegrate into pieces by explosive detonation

items.def_zh: 炸毁，爆破；发出尖锐强音，轰鸣；猛烈抨击
items.def_en: 1. To blow up or destroy something with explosives. 2. To make a loud, harsh sound or play music very loudly. 3. To criticize someone or something severely.
[I/T] to trigger or undergo a sudden, extremely violent supersonic shockwave explosion

groups.summary_en: This frame captures violent mechanical or explosive disintegration, progressing from internal pressure breaking open a container or skin to high-energy concussive detonations that shatter surroundings.
groups.summary_zh: 从内部压力胀破、开裂递进到剧烈爆炸与强力爆破摧毁。

groups.name: Sail & Steam · 航行与游弋
groups.tip: 驾船或依动力在水面行驶

items.def_zh: （轮船等）靠蒸汽动力航行，驶过；蒸（食物）；冒热气
items.def_en: 1. To move or travel across water by means of steam power. 2. To cook food using steam. 3. To give off steam.
To travel on water in a boat or ship, or control and direct a boat across water.
travel smoothly at an unhurried speed by boat or ship, often for pleasure
to depart or begin a sea voyage across open water

items.def_zh: 开足马力前行，全速航行
items.def_en: to travel forward steadily and continuously under engine power across waterways
to leave a port, harbor, or coastal shore and head out to sea
go on a long journey, especially by sea or into unfamiliar waters
direct, steer, or travel through a stretch of water along a planned course

items.def_zh: 乘汽船航行；以蒸汽机车行进
items.def_en: (dated) To travel or move by means of a steamship.
(+ between/along) travel regularly over a route, water body, or commercial line

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe large motorized or wind-powered marine vessels traveling over the sea, waterways, or coastal waters, often evoking steady commercial, naval, or passenger passage.
groups.summary_zh: 轮船、帆船等中大型水面船只在江海水域平稳航行、游弋或穿梭。

groups.name: Sap Strength & Undermine · 削弱与损耗 (Weaken, Undermine, Emasculate)
groups.tip: 力量减弱走向衰落

items.def_en: (+ at sth) to gradually diminish, weaken, or undermine an entity's strength, authority, or stability
[I/T] to gradually destroy or diminish power, confidence, or value over time
(+ at sth) to gradually destroy, erode, or undermine the integrity or substance of something
(+ sb/sth) to gradually weaken someone's physical strength, resistance, or structural firmness through sustained pressure
To become less strong, powerful, or determined, or to make someone or something less strong.

items.def_zh: 逐渐削弱，暗中破坏；从根基处破坏
items.def_en: To gradually weaken or damage someone's authority, confidence, or a system.

items.def_zh: 消耗，暗中削弱（精力/力量）
items.def_en: to slowly exhaust or deplete someone's strength, vitality, or resolve
to severely impair the strength, health, or functioning of an entity

items.def_zh: 削弱……的力量（或效力）；使丧失男子气概；阉割
items.def_en: (formal) To make a system, law, or idea less effective or powerful; to deprive a man of his male role or identity.

items.def_zh: 使极度衰弱，使软弱无力
items.def_en: to make someone or something extremely weak, frail, or devoid of energy

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe reducing the physical strength, structural integrity, authority, or effectiveness of something, ranging from gradual erosion to total psychological or systemic evisceration.
groups.summary_zh: 指力量、根基、权威或效能的减弱、暗中侵蚀乃至彻底废除。

groups.name: Satisfy & Gratify · 满足与取悦 (Content, Please, Satisfy)
groups.tip: 迎合心意并使人感到满足高兴

items.raw_cluster: 取悦与使满足 Please & Gratify
items.def_zh: 使满意，取悦，使高兴；（用于礼貌请求）请；愿意，喜欢
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel happy, satisfied, or content. 2. To choose or wish to do something. 3. Used as a polite word when asking for something.
1. To make someone feel happy, satisfied, or willing to accept a situation.
to be acceptable, convenient, or pleasing to someone

items.def_zh: 使满意，使高兴；满足，符合（需求、条件）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel pleased by giving them what they want or need. 2. To fulfill or meet a need, condition, or requirement.
(+ sb/sth) to provide the things that a particular person or situation needs or wants, often in order to satisfy or please them

items.def_zh: 迎合，纵容（不良嗜好或低级趣味）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to do or say what someone wants in order to please them, especially when it is unreasonable or wrong
(+ sb) to be very nice or flatter someone so that they will do what you want or be pleased with you

items.def_zh: 姑息，平息，满足（要求/胃口）
items.def_en: to satisfy a hunger or pacify an adversary by agreeing to their demands
to give pleasure or satisfaction to a person by fulfilling a desire or ambition
to make an angry or hostile person feel less dissatisfied or hostile by concessions

groups.summary_en: A stimulus, person, or outcome meets the desires, expectations, or emotional needs of an experiencer. Verbs vary from bringing adequate peace of mind without demand for more (content) to active delight and appeasement (please, gratify) and meeting stringent formal requirements (satisfy).
groups.summary_zh: 达到心理期望、使人心满意足或迎合取悦。

groups.name: Scold & Rebuke · 训斥与斥责 (Express Sharp Disapproval)
groups.tip: 由责怪批评上升为严厉训斥

items.def_en: (+ for/about) to speak to someone in mild disapproval, gently scolding them for minor errors
(+ sb) Severely reprimand or scold someone in authority
(+ sb) Speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong
To speak angrily and critically to someone, especially a child, because they have done something wrong.
(+ for) to express sharp, official, or authoritative disapproval of someone's behavior
(+ sb) Reprimand someone harshly and loudly
(+ sb) Attack someone verbally with great force and anger
To speak angrily or critically to someone because they have done something wrong or unacceptable; to reprimand.
(+ for) to criticize or scold someone angrily, harshly, and at length
(+ for) to reprimand or criticize someone severely and publicly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing sharp, direct disapproval or anger toward someone for their misconduct, ranging from domestic fault-finding to formal, authoritative censure.
groups.summary_zh: 因过错或不当言行而对当事人进行严厉责备、训诫或谴责。

groups.name: Seasonal Sheltering & Temporary Habitation · 栖居与越冬 (Winter, Camp, Cohabit)
groups.tip: 同居栖息共同生活度日

items.def_en: (+ in/at) Spend the winter in a specified place or sheltered sanctuary
Sleep outdoors in a tent or temporary shelter, especially for recreation or necessity
(Of animals) Retreat into a lair or den to seek protection during cold months
to go to sleep in a temporary, makeshift, or shared bed or place
(+ with sb) to start living together in the same dwelling, often without being formally married
to hide or stay sheltered in a secure, secluded, or hidden place for an extended period
Spend the winter in a dormant, inactive state resembling deep sleep

items.def_zh: 同居，共同生活；（动植物）共栖，共同存活
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) (formal) To live together in a sexual relationship without being legally married. 2. (biology) To exist or live together in the same habitat.
1. (biology) To spend or survive the winter season in a specific place or condition; to keep plants or animals alive through the winter.
1. (military / mountaineering) To camp temporarily outdoors in the open without tents or with minimal shelter.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe living, dwelling, or making temporary encampments under specific environmental conditions, seasonal shifts, or domestic arrangements. They range from organisms surviving cold seasons to humans setting up temporary quarters outdoors or co-residing.
groups.summary_zh: 指在特定季节、极端环境或临时条件下栖居、扎营越冬或同住。

groups.name: Seat & Lodge · 安放与入位 (Seat, Lay, Hole)
groups.tip: 将物体或人置于特定位置

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to place or become comfortably, stably, and firmly positioned in a seat, recess, or resting spot
(+ sb/sth) to draw or push the edges of something securely into a narrow space, recess, or fold

items.def_zh: 使就座，安排……坐下；安置，使安放于特定位置；容纳……坐下
items.def_en: 1. To lead or show someone to a seat, or assign a place to sit. 2. To fit or position something securely in a specified place. 3. To have enough seats for a certain number of people.
1. To put someone or something down carefully or in a flat position. 2. (of a bird or insect) to produce an egg.

items.def_zh: 放置，平放（lay 的过去式和过去分词）；铺设；产（卵）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of lay; to have put something down flat or carefully.

items.def_zh: 使安卧；半隐半现地置于
items.def_en: [I/T] to place or settle comfortably, snugly, or securely within a recess
(+ sth) to pack, squeeze, or seat an object tightly into a narrow opening or cavity

items.def_zh: （高尔夫球中）击（球）入洞；进洞；在……上打洞
items.def_en: 1. (golf) To hit a ball into a hole. 2. to make a hole in something, especially a ship.
[I/T] to fix, force, or deposit firmly into a position or receptacle
to fix firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass

groups.summary_en: These verbs designate placing an object or person into a stable, recessed, or designated resting recess, surface, or cavity. They emphasize positioning something horizontally or seating it securely into its designated resting base or enclosure.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将物体横放、深置或安顿至凹槽、底座与承重位置。

groups.name: Seep & Exude Slowly · 渗漏与滴流 (Ooze, Seep, Trickle)
groups.tip: 液体缓慢渗出或滴落过程

items.def_zh: 滴下，流淌；流口水；（球类）运球，带球
items.def_en: 1. When liquid or saliva dribbles, it flows slowly in thin drops or a small trickle. 2. (sports) To move a ball forward with repeated short kicks, bounces, or touches.
to flow or leak out very slowly through small cracks or porous material
to emerge or flow out slowly in a thin stream, intermittent drops, or small amounts
to flow slowly in a very thin, continuous or broken stream
1. (+ out/from/with) When a thick liquid oozes, it flows out slowly through small openings. 2. To show or express a particular quality or emotion strongly.
(+ into/through/out) When water, oil, or gas seeps, it flows slowly through small cracks or porous materials.
to filter gradually through a porous surface, membrane, or granular medium

items.def_zh: 缓缓渗出；淌出（浓稠液体）
items.def_en: to discharge or escape slowly and sluggishly from an opening, wound, or surface
(+ through/into) to seep or spread into an adjacent surface, as dye, ink, or sap
to discharge moisture, resin, or smell slowly and steadily through pores or cuts

groups.summary_en: A liquid moves through a porous barrier, crack, or wound in small, slow, or viscous amounts rather than a rapid gush. Verbs contrast thick sluggish discharge (ooze), capillary absorption through pores (seep), and intermittent thin dripping (trickle, dribble).
groups.summary_zh: 微量液体经孔隙或狭缝缓慢渗析或细细滴淌。

groups.name: Shape & Inscribe Rigid Material · 雕刻与塑形 (Carve, Sculpt, Chisel)
groups.tip: 雕琢打磨使原材料成型

items.def_en: (+ away/down) to carve wood into an object by repeatedly cutting small slices off it
(+ on/with) to cut words or designs into a hard surface such as metal, glass, or stone
(+ sth) to shape an artistic figure, hollow, or dimensional form by cutting into hard material
(+ sth) to cut, carve, or hollow out a shape, cavity, or relief from stone or wood with a chisel
(+ sth) to carve or shave thin slices away from wood or rigid material to reduce its size or form a shape
To carve, sculpt, or engrave words or designs into a hard surface.

items.def_zh: 雕刻，雕琢；把（熟肉等）切成薄片
items.def_en: 1. To cut wood, stone, or another hard material into a specific shape or pattern. 2. To slice cooked meat into pieces.
To carve, cast, or shape a material into a three-dimensional work of art.

items.def_zh: 塑形，浇铸；塑造（性格等）；发霉
items.def_en: 1. To shape a soft substance into a particular form by pouring or pressing it into a container. 2. To strongly influence the development or character of someone. 3. To decay and become covered with mould.
(+ out/into) to cut or shape stone, wood, or metal with a chisel

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cutting away hard materials like stone or wood, or shaping malleable materials into dimensional figures or artistic forms.
groups.summary_zh: 通过切割、凿刻坚硬材质或模塑可塑材料来塑造立体形象。

groups.name: Shed & Molt · 蜕皮与生物脱落 (Shed, Molt, Desquamate)
groups.tip: 表皮或组织脱落与蜕变

items.def_en: to come off in flakes, scales, or thin layers from an outer skin or surface
(+ off) to slough off or discard skin, horn, or cuticle naturally
to naturally drop or cast off hair, fur, skin, or leaves as part of a biological cycle
[I/T] of sunburned or diseased skin, to separate and flake off in thin strips
(US spelling of moult) When an animal or bird molts, it sheds old feathers, skin, hair, or a shell so new ones can grow.
(+ sth) to shed or molt a naturally discarded outer covering, such as a skin, shell, or cuticle
(+ sth) to shed, cast off, or peel away dead biological tissue, outer skin, or scales
[I/T] (often + off) to drop off or cause dead tissue or outer skin to be shed

items.def_zh: 去除（角质）；片状脱落，剥落
items.def_en: To shed dead skin or bark in thin layers, or to remove dead skin cells using a cosmetic scrub.
(British English spelling of molt) When an animal or bird moults, it sheds old feathers, skin, hair, or a shell.

groups.summary_en: An animal, human, or skin surface periodically casts off outer biological layers such as skin, feathers, shells, or cuticle dead cells naturally or through scrubbed peeling.
groups.summary_zh: 动物或生物表皮自然脱去旧毛羽、外皮或蜕落角质细胞。

groups.name: Shine & Glow · 发光照耀与温润生辉 (Shine, Glow, Radiate)
groups.tip: 持久而温暖地发出光泽

items.def_zh: 发光，发出微光；容光焕发，喜形于色
items.def_en: 1. To produce a dull, steady light, especially without flames. 2. To look healthy, warm, or happy with color in your face.

items.def_zh: 透出柔和或反射的微光
items.def_en: to shine with a gentle, smooth, or reflected brightness
to shine brightly, warmly, and continuously downwards onto a place or person
to send a clear, steady, luminous ray of light through a translucent opening or medium
1. To produce or reflect light; be bright. 2. To point light in a particular direction.
[I/T] to emit rays of light or heat in all directions

items.def_zh: 发光，照耀（shine的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of shine; to give off or reflect bright light.

items.def_zh: 烈日暴晒；强光炙烤照射
items.def_en: to shine with intense heat and powerful, unyielding brightness from above
to transmit or cast a bright, focused ray of light
to shine with a very bright, intense, and hot light

groups.summary_en: An emitter gives off a steady, warm, or broad beam of continuous light, distinguishing sustained luminescence from brief flickering bursts.
groups.summary_zh: 持续散发稳定、温热或普照的明亮光辉。

groups.name: Skim, Glide & Surf across Surfaces · 滑行与冲浪 (Taxi, Surf, Skim)
groups.tip: 顺势在表面平稳移动

items.def_en: to move forward smoothly on a surface through existing momentum without applying active force
(+ sth) to move smoothly, effortlessly, and quietly over a flat surface or across water
1. (of an aircraft) To move slowly along the ground before taking off or after landing. 2. (informal) To travel in a taxi.
to move smoothly, quietly, and continuously along a surface without noticeable effort
(+ sth) to pass or move quickly and lightly across the surface of water or ground, barely touching it
1. To ride toward the shore on ocean waves using a surfboard. 2. To spend time browsing different websites or TV channels.
to move quickly and lightly just above or along the surface of water or land
to ride incoming waves while lying prone on a specialized short foam board

items.def_zh: 进行冲浪板运动，用冲浪板冲浪
items.def_en: To ride ocean waves standing or lying on a surfboard.
to skim across a surface of water, or uncontrollably slide across a wet road on a film of water

groups.summary_en: An agent, vessel, or aircraft moves smoothly across a surface—such as water, runway tarmac, or waves—utilizing hydrodynamic or aerodynamic lift without fully taking flight or sinking. Verbs contrast ground navigation of aircraft (taxi) with hydroplaning over waves (surf, skim).
groups.summary_zh: 顺着地表或波浪表面顺滑滑行而不脱离支撑。

groups.name: Spill & Splatter · 倾倒、飞溅与泼洒 (Spill, Slop, Splatter)
groups.tip: 液体倾泻奔涌而出

items.def_en: move around noisily and splash within a container or on a surface
1. To flow, run, or fall over the edge of a container accidentally, or to cause a liquid to do this. 2. To pour or move out in large numbers.

items.def_zh: （使）溢出，（使）泼洒（spill的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly British) Past tense and past participle of spill: to flow or cause to flow over the edge of a container.
1. To spill or splash over the edge of a container carelessly, or to cause liquid to do so.
pour or splash out of a container in an uncontrolled manner
flow or slosh over the rim or edge of a container
to hit or cover something in large drops or messy patches with a wet, splashing sound
to move around noisily in a container, or cause a liquid to splash clumsily over the edge

items.def_zh: 大雨倾盆（尤与 down 连用）；用桶提（舀）水
items.def_en: 1. (informal, especially 'bucket down') To rain very heavily and in large amounts. 2. To carry, pour, or scoop something in a bucket.
(of rain) to pour down heavily and rapidly against a surface

groups.summary_en: A liquid moves or is made to move out of its container or path in an uncontrolled, messy, or torrential manner, varying from accidental overflow to vigorous sloshing or pouring in sheets.
groups.summary_zh: 液体失控地漫出、颠簸泼洒或如桶倾般倾泻落下。

groups.name: Spin & Rotate · 旋转与转动 (Rotate, Spin, Whirl)
groups.tip: 极速旋转眼花缭乱

items.def_en: (+ sth) rotate lightly and rapidly, like in a dance
[I/T] to turn around a fixed central point or axis in a continuous, controlled manner
[I/T] to move in a circular orbit around a central point, or turn on an axis
(+ sb/sth) turn or cause to turn rapidly around a central axis
1. To turn around and around quickly, or make something do this. 2. To twist fibers into thread.

items.def_zh: （使）飞旋，疾转；急转（身）；（头脑）发晕
items.def_en: To turn or spin around very quickly, or cause something to do so.
To turn round and round quickly and lightly, or make something do so.
rotate or spin around very quickly, often creating dizziness

items.def_zh: （使）快速旋转（spin 的过去式和过去分词）；纺（纱）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of spin; to have turned around rapidly, or twisted fibers into thread.

items.def_zh: 飞速回旋；作螺旋形晃转
items.def_en: to turn around quickly in circles or spirals, often with unsteady motion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe circular motion around an axis or center point, ranging from steady mechanical rotation to rapid, dizzying, or violent spinning.
groups.summary_zh: 描述绕轴心或中心旋转，从平稳转动到急遽飞旋。

groups.name: Sprout & Germinate · 萌芽与初生生长 (Germinate, Sprout, Shoot)
groups.tip: 植物破土抽芽并生出分蘖

items.def_en: (+ sth) produce or develop new shoots, buds, or leaves
emerge and begin growing upward quickly as a shoot or seedling
[I/T] to develop roots and establish biological anchorage for growth
to produce or develop vegetative buds or nascent flowers

items.def_zh: （树桩或植物）萌发新枝，分蘖；排便
items.def_en: 1. (botany) When a plant or stump stools, it sends up new shoots from the base or roots. 2. (medical) To pass solid bodily waste from the bowels.
1. When plants or seeds sprout, they begin to grow and produce new shoots or buds. 2. To appear or develop suddenly and in large numbers.

items.def_zh: 发芽，萌芽；（想法等）开始酝酿
items.def_en: When a seed or plant germinates, it begins to grow; when an idea germinates, it starts to develop.

items.def_zh: 拔节长高；迅速长出幼茎
items.def_en: grow rapidly taller from a shoot or stem
(often + up) to grow rapidly upwards from the ground or a plant stem

items.def_zh: 萌发新芽；迅速抽芽生长
items.def_en: to begin to grow buds or young leaves; to rapidly develop and expand

groups.summary_en: A seed, spore, or botanical organism initiates growth and produces preliminary vegetative parts such as buds, roots, or shoots. Often used intransitively, or transitively when causing seeds to put out shoots.
groups.summary_zh: 种子或植物打破休眠萌发生长，抽芽生根或迅速冒出幼苗。

groups.name: Strike with Rod or Strap · 抽打与鞭笞 (Whip, Lash, Flog)
groups.tip: 用皮鞭或长物猛烈抽击

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) strike suddenly and violently towards someone with or as with a whip
(+ sth) swing or strike violently using a flexible lash or strap
to hit a person or animal repeatedly with a whip or strap
to punish someone by striking them with a slender cane
(+ sb) attack someone forcefully with severe physical blows or strokes

items.def_zh: 抽打，鞭打；猛烈冲击；严厉指责；捆绑
items.def_en: 1. To hit someone or something violently with a whip, strap, or rope. 2. To beat or strike forcefully against something (like wind or rain). 3. To tie or fasten securely with a cord or rope.
To flog or whip someone with a bundle of birch twigs as a formal physical punishment.

items.def_zh: 鞭打，痛打；彻底击败；剧烈扭动，翻腾
items.def_en: 1. To hit or beat a person or animal repeatedly with a stick or whip. 2. To decisively defeat an opponent. 3. To flail or move limbs violently and wildly.
to beat someone harshly as a formal or severe physical punishment
to whip severely using a multi-thonged lash; inflict painful punishment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail striking a person or animal forcefully with an implement such as a whip, birch rod, or belt, distinguished by the physical instrument, repetition, and severity of punishment.
groups.summary_zh: 用鞭子、藤条或棍棒反复猛烈抽打、鞭笞或实施体罚。

groups.name: Suggest Indirectly & Convey · 暗示与体现 (Imply, Insinuate, Bespeak)
groups.tip: 言在此而意在彼，含蓄传递深层内涵

items.def_en: to suggest that something is true without saying it directly
[I/T] (+ at) to suggest something indirectly or provide a subtle clue
(+ sth) to suggest or refer to something indirectly
(+ sth/sb) to mention someone or something in an indirect or casual way
(+ sth) to suggest that something is true, likely, or exists
to state or make known subtly, delicately, or indirectly

items.def_zh: 显示，表明（bespeak 的过去式和过去分词）；预订
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of bespeak; to have shown, signaled, or suggested something.

items.def_zh: 暗指，暗示（不快或不光彩的事）；讨好，巴结（insinuate oneself into）
items.def_en: 1. To suggest something bad or unpleasant in an indirect way. 2. (insinuate oneself into) to gain favor or acceptance by subtle manipulation.
(of a word or idea) To suggest a feeling or meaning in addition to its literal meaning.
1. (formal) To suggest or be a clear sign of something. 2. (formal/archaic) to order or reserve something in advance.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe conveying an idea, attitude, or quality indirectly rather than stating it plainly, ranging from subtle insinuation to formal evidence inherent in someone's actions.
groups.summary_zh: 非直接明说地表达想法或流露特征，含含蓄暗示或显露迹象。

groups.name: Take Action on a Matter · 处理与应对事务 (Deal with, Handle, Address)
groups.tip: 动手处理推进事宜

items.def_zh: 处理，应付，解决（deal with）；做买卖，经营；发牌；给予（打击）
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To take action to solve a problem or handle a situation. 2. (+ in/with) To buy and sell goods or do business. 3. To distribute playing cards to players. 4. To deliver or administer (a blow, shock, or punishment).
(formal/business) To take official action on, process, or execute a request, plan, or matter.
to give attention to and begin to deal with an issue, problem, or query
to manage, deal with, or be responsible for handling a situation or task
to deal with business, practical tasks, or someone's specific needs
to attend to or make certain that a required task is carried out
(+ sb/sth) to take suitable action in order to solve a problem or complete a task
(+ sth) to deal with, organize, or take necessary measures regarding a situation
(+ sth) to organize, resolve, or successfully handle a problem or matter

items.def_zh: 处理，应付；做生意；发牌（deal 的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of deal; took action to solve a problem, did business, or distributed cards.

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting taking decisive administrative, managerial, or practical measures to resolve a problem, request, or situation.
groups.summary_zh: 针对问题、请求或既定事务采取行动予以处理或解决。

groups.name: Theft & Burglary · 偷盗与侵入行窃 (Steal, Burgle, Rob)
groups.tip: 从暗偷到明火执仗

items.def_en: [I/T] to steal things of little value, typically in small quantities repeatedly
(+ sth) to take or steal something, often casually or without permission
[I/T] to take another person's property without permission or legal right and without intention of returning it
to secretly take something of minor value in a casual or sneaky manner
(+ sth) to steal something and hurry away with it
to enter a building illegally and by force, especially in order to steal
1. (chiefly British) To enter a building illegally in order to steal property from it.
1. (chiefly North American) To enter a building illegally in order to steal property from it.
(+ sb/sth) to rob someone or a place using violence or threats with a weapon
(+ of) to take property unlawfully from a person or place by force or threat of force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the illicit, non-consensual taking of another party's property, scaling in intensity from stealthy theft without force to trespassing break-ins and violent confrontation.
groups.summary_zh: 指非法侵占他人财产，从隐秘盗窃递增至破门入室行窃乃至暴力抢夺。

groups.name: Thermal Liquid Cooking · 沸水烹煮与热油煎炸 (Boil, Bubble, Fry)
groups.tip: 厨房烹饪与受热油炸场景

items.def_en: 1. To cook food in hot oil or fat. 2. (informal) To burn or be burned by excessive heat or sunlight.

items.def_zh: 起泡，沸腾冒泡；（情感）翻腾，洋溢
items.def_en: 1. To produce or emit bubbles, especially when heated or boiling. 2. To be full of a particular feeling or quality.

items.def_zh: 煮沸，烧开；（液体）沸腾；暴怒，怒火中烧
items.def_en: 1. To heat a liquid until it bubbles and turns to gas, or to cook food in boiling water. 2. To be very angry.
to cook food quickly in a small amount of hot oil or fat
to boil and spill out over the edges of a pot or container
(+ sth) to reduce a cooking liquid or food by continuous heating and boiling
(+ sth) to cook or heat food in a pan using hot fat or oil
[I/T] to cook gently in liquid kept just below or barely at the boiling point

items.def_zh: 水煮；汆（在微沸温水中煮）
items.def_en: to cook food gently in simmering water or another liquid
to bubble and churn violently under intense heat

groups.summary_en: Food or liquids are subjected to direct high heat, cooking through bubbling liquids, rapid boiling, or sizzling oil in a pan or pot.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用沸水翻滚或热油煎炸等液态高热介质进行熟化加热的烹饪场景。

groups.name: Threaten & Intimidate · 威吓与慑服
groups.tip: 仗势欺人恐吓弱小者

items.def_en: to state one's intention to take hostile action against someone in retribution
(+ sb) to use threats, intimidation, or pressure to force someone to comply
(+ sb) to bully, intimidate, or give rude orders to someone

items.def_zh: 严密监视威逼；凌驾威吓
items.def_en: (+ sb) to stand close to someone in an intimidating way to force them to act
to intimidate someone with aggressive, bullying language or domineering facial expressions

items.def_zh: 恐吓，威胁，欺侮；横行霸道
items.def_en: To frighten, hurt, or threaten a smaller or weaker person, or force someone into doing something by using intimidation.
To frighten or subdue someone into doing what one wants, especially through threats or a show of power.
To frighten or threaten someone, usually in order to persuade them to do what you want.
to subdue or restrain someone by inspiring overwhelming respect or fear
to severely frighten someone over time using systematic threats, violence, or brutality

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe using force, threats, or domineering demeanor to frighten someone into submission or compliance. They scale upward from persistent verbal/physical bullying to paralyzing psychological intimidation that breaks another's spirit.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过恐吓、威胁或强势举动压制他人，迫使其屈服或胆怯。

groups.name: Throw & Loft · 投掷与高抛 (Lob, Pitch, Hurl)
groups.tip: 大力击球凌空高飞

items.def_en: [I/T] to throw something lightly, casually, or easily with an underarm motion
to throw something in a casual, careless, or offhand manner

items.def_zh: 高抛，把（球）击成高弧线；投掷
items.def_en: To throw, hit, or kick a ball high into the air in a slow, curved arc.
(+ sth) to throw or fling something away forcefully
(+ sth) to toss or throw something casually or discard it by throwing

items.def_zh: 投掷，抛，（棒球中）投球；搭（帐篷），扎（营）；竭力推销；向前倾跌；颠簸
items.def_en: 1. To throw or toss something, especially a ball in baseball; 2. to set up a tent or camp; 3. to promote an idea or product.
(+ sth) to throw something outwards with sudden violence or force

items.def_zh: 把（球）高高击向空中；将（画作）挂得过高
items.def_en: (especially in sports) To hit, kick, or throw a ball high into the air.

items.def_zh: 猛投，用力掷；厉声说出，大声叫骂（侮辱等）
items.def_en: To throw something with great force or violence; to utter insults or accusations vehemently.
to throw something violently, recklessly, or with significant force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey throwing an object through the air with a particular trajectory, speed, or targeted mechanical delivery (e.g., high gentle arcs vs. forceful aggressive heaves).
groups.summary_zh: 指依据特定的抛物线、速度或姿态将物体掷出或打向空中。

groups.name: Trim & Shave · 修剪与刮削 (Surface Material Removal)
groups.tip: 刀具修削刮去多余

items.def_en: to make neat or tidy by clipping, cutting away irregular parts
to peel or cut away the outer skin or edges of an object with a knife
(carpentry / engineering) To cut away a sharp right-angled edge of wood, stone, or metal to make a sloping bevel.
(+ sth) to trim, pare, or prune plants and bushes to reduce their size
(+ sth) to cut away outer edges or surfaces gradually with a blade
(+ sth) to remove a thin surface layer or hair by shaving or paring
to cut off hair or thin slivers of material from a surface with a razor or plane
To shave, cut, or slice closely with a razor.

items.def_zh: 割（草、谷物等）；大量杀死，撂倒（mow down）
items.def_en: 1. To cut down grass or crops using a machine or scythe. 2. ('mow down') To kill or knock down people in large numbers.
to cut wool or fleece from an animal, or clip off roughly with large shears

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate shaving, cutting back, or paring away outer surface layers, edges, or foliage using edged tools or blades to smooth or shorten them.
groups.summary_zh: 使用刀片或工具剃除、削平、修短表面材料、草木或边缘。

groups.name: Undo Fasteners & Open Wrapping · 解开与旋开 (Unfasten, Untie, Unzip)
groups.tip: 解开扣子、螺丝等束缚

items.def_en: (+ sth) to unfasten and remove a piece of clothing or accessory
to unfasten a buckle or an item secured with a buckle
to open something fastened with a zipper
to undo a knot, string, ribbon, or shoe lace, or free something secured by a knot
To remove the paper, cloth, or other covering from a parcel, gift, or food item.

items.def_zh: 旋开，拧开，旋松（螺丝或瓶盖等）
items.def_en: To loosen or remove something (such as a screw, lid, or bulb) by twisting or turning it.
To undo the buttons of an item of clothing.
to undo or open something that is fixed closed, such as a belt, latch, or buckle
(+ sth) to strip or rip away outer wrapping, packaging, or binding
(+ sth) to tear open a parcel, envelope, or wrapped package forcefully

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physically releasing, loosening, or reversing a mechanical fastening, wrapping, or interlocking mechanism to open an item or free a bound object.
groups.summary_zh: 指解开纽扣、旋开螺丝或拆除包裹等逆向物理拆卸、松脱行为。

groups.name: Urge to Incite · 催促、煽动与鼓动 (Urge, Agitate, Incite)
groups.tip: 呼喝吆喝以催赶驱动前行

items.def_en: (+ on) to encourage or stimulate someone to act or achieve something

items.def_zh: （吆喝着）催马前进，赶牲口；催促，鼓动（常作 gee up）
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'gee up') To urge a horse to move faster or turn in a particular direction; to encourage someone to put more effort into something.

items.def_zh: 怂恿；挑唆（做蠢事或险事）
items.def_en: to encourage someone to do something foolish or risky

items.def_zh: 鼓动，煽动；使焦虑，使不安；搅动，摇动
items.def_en: 1. (+ for/against) To argue strongly and campaign publicly for or against political or social change. 2. To make someone feel anxious, nervous, or upset. 3. To stir or shake a liquid briskly.
(+ sth) to deliberately provoke, instigate, or foment trouble or agitation
(+ sb/sth) to deliberately excite or provoke strong emotions, agitation, or collective action
1. (+ to/to do) To encourage or stir up people to act in a violent, unlawful, or aggressive way.
to intentionally bring about or provoke a specific negative action or event
to instigate or foster rebellion, discord, or violent unrest
(+ sb/sth) to provoke or urge people aggressively into conflict or violence against a target

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve an instigator communicating passionately to impel people to action, scaling in intensity from cheerful spurring and persuasion to public agitation and inflammatory incitement to violence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过言论驱使他人采取行动，从催促鼓劲升级至政治动员与暴力煽动。

groups.name: Violent Attack & Aggression · 突袭、重创与反击 (Assail, Blindside, Maul)
groups.tip: 以多种方式发起猛攻

items.def_en: to suddenly attack an enemy or rival from a concealed position
(+ sb/sth) to attack someone suddenly and ferociously
to attack someone suddenly and violently, often as a group
(+ sb/sth) to attack someone with severe physical violence or ferocious aggression
(+ sb) to attack someone suddenly and aggressively without warning
To attack an enemy or competitor in response to an attack by them.

items.def_zh: 从防备较弱的一侧袭击；使措手不及，使遭受突如其来的打击
items.def_en: To attack or hit someone unexpectedly from a direction where they cannot see, or surprise someone with an unforeseen difficulty.

items.def_zh: 猛烈攻击，袭击；质问，抨击；困扰
items.def_en: 1. To attack someone violently or physically. 2. To criticize strongly or be troubled persistently by something.
to attack violently and cause severe wounds, or criticize mercilessly

items.def_zh: 撕咬伤，抓伤；粗暴对待；严厉抨击
items.def_en: 1. (of an animal or person) To wound or tear someone severely by scratching, biting, or rough handling. 2. To criticize or treat someone or something severely.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe aggressive physical assaults or fierce metaphorical offensives characterized by sudden ambush, crippling damage, or retaliatory strikes against an opponent.
groups.summary_zh: 指以突袭、猛烈痛击或反攻的方式实施肉体打击或舆论围攻。

groups.name: Voyage & Itinerate · 游历与远行 (Travel, Tour, Journey)
groups.tip: 长途漫游与出行

items.def_en: 1. To make a journey, typically over a distance or to different places. 2. To move or journey along a route.

items.def_zh: 周游，游历，观光；巡回演出（或比赛）
items.def_en: To make a tour of a place or area, often for sightseeing, performance, or campaigning.
To undertake a journey or travel somewhere, especially over a long distance.
to begin a journey or expedition towards a distant destination
to depart and begin travelling towards a specific destination or trip
(+ sth) to travel across or briefly visit places as part of a longer itinerary
To make a long, arduous journey, typically on foot across difficult terrain
To go on a long journey, typically by sea or into unknown regions
[I/T] To travel unsystematically over a wide area without a fixed itinerary
To visit places of interest as a tourist

groups.summary_en: A person makes a journey between distant places, whether for recreation, broad exploration, sightseeing itineraries, or purposeful relocation across vast expanses.
groups.summary_zh: 长途旅行、巡回游览或跋涉探索异地。

groups.name: Wangle & Swindle · 巧取与诈骗 (Finagle, Wangle, Bamboozle)
groups.tip: 耍手腕巧妙诱骗他人获利

items.def_en: (+ sb into sth/doing sth) Persuade sb to do sth or give sth up by deceit or trickery
(+ sb out of sth) Trick or cheat sb in order to deprive them of money or possessions
Fool or cheat someone, often by baffling them with misleading talk or complex pretexts
Deceive or trick someone deliberately into believing something false or acting foolishly

items.def_zh: 骗取，耍手腕弄到；欺骗，耍手段
items.def_en: 1. (+ out of) (North American informal) To obtain or arrange something through clever, devious, or dishonest methods.

items.def_zh: 设法弄到，用计谋获得；耍花招搞定
items.def_en: 1. (+ out of) (informal) To obtain something desired through clever persuasion, manipulation, or trickery.
(+ sb) Cheat sb by charging too much money or stealing from them
Swindle or defraud someone out of money or property through a calculated, dishonest scheme
Cheat or cheat out of what is due, especially by dodging payments or swindling
1. (North American humorous slang) To trick, cheat, or hoax someone.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe obtaining something or manipulating people through devious maneuvering, clever trickery, cajolery, or outright deception. Nuances span colloquial clever schematics to folksy, colorful conning.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过耍弄手段、花言巧语或弄虚作假来设法获取利益或愚弄他人。

groups.name: Worry & Fret · 担忧与焦虑不安 (Fret, Perturb, Agitate)
groups.tip: 内心发愁焦虑而烦躁难安

items.def_en: [I/T] to feel or cause to feel anxious or troubled about actual or potential problems

items.def_zh: 发愁，烦躁，焦虑不安；侵蚀，磨损
items.def_en: 1. To worry constantly and be unhappy or anxious about something; 2. to wear away or erode.
(+ sth) Worry constantly or become visibly agitated over something

items.def_zh: （为小事）瞎操心，大惊小怪，烦恼；瞎忙
items.def_en: To worry excessively or pay too much anxious attention to small or unimportant details.

items.def_zh: 使焦虑，使心烦意乱，使不安；扰乱
items.def_en: (formal) To make someone feel worried, anxious, or unsettled.

items.def_zh: 使不安，使忧虑，使心神不定
items.def_en: (formal) To make someone feel worried, anxious, or uneasy.

items.def_zh: 折磨；让（某人）内心焦虑不安
items.def_en: (+ sb) Cause sb persistent mental distress, anxiety, or guilt over time

items.def_zh: 对……过分担忧；对……念念不忘
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Worry or think about sth incessantly to an unhealthy degree

items.def_zh: 使心烦意乱，使严重焦虑
items.def_en: to make someone intensely nervous, troubled, or mentally stirred up

items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使失去镇定自信
items.def_en: to deprive someone of courage, resolve, or composure through anxiety

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame articulate internal mental distress or anxiety, spanning from petty outward fussing and continuous brooding to profound internal agitation and deep disquiet.
groups.summary_zh: 表达由内心的挂虑、烦乱逐渐升级至深层心绪不宁与极度焦虑。

groups.name: Wrap & Enfold · 紧密包覆与护裹 (Cocoon, Jacket, Cere)
groups.tip: 如作茧或套外衣般层层裹覆

items.def_zh: 替（某人）掖好被子；把……塞入裹紧
items.def_en: (+ sb) Make sb comfortable in bed by snugly folding sheets or blankets around them
(+ sb/sth) Cover or enfold sth completely in paper, cloth, or warm garments
1. To cover or enclose something with a protective casing or jacket.
(+ sb/sth) Wrap sb or oneself tightly and warmly in clothing or blankets

items.def_zh: 紧紧包裹；庇护，使免受外界影响
items.def_en: 1. (+ in/from) To wrap or surround someone completely in warm, protective layers, or shield them from harsh realities.

items.def_zh: 裹厚保暖或裹住以消声
items.def_en: (+ in/up) to wrap or swathe someone or something warmly or to deaden sound
1. (archaic) To wrap a dead body in waxed burial cloth.
to wrap someone (especially a baby) tightly in cloth or blankets

items.def_zh: 温柔或密实地拥抱覆裹
items.def_en: to surround, cover, or wrap someone or something completely
(+ in/with) to encase or cover something in a protective layer

groups.summary_en: An entity covers or winds material snugly around an object, forming an intimate, protective, or sealing layer reminiscent of biological skins, casings, or swaddling cloths.
groups.summary_zh: 以护套、丝茧或包膜紧密服帖地覆裹以防损或隔绝。

groups.name: Wrinkle & Puckering · 起皱与褶皱 (Crease, Wrinkle, Crumple)
groups.tip: 揉搓受压形成细密褶皱

items.def_en: (+ sth) Form or cause to form thin, shallow wrinkles or ridges
To form small lines or folds in skin, fabric, or paper; to cause something to have wrinkles.
To make or develop folds, lines, or wrinkles in cloth, paper, or skin.
to draw together into small folds or ridges, especially lips or stitching
(especially of paper or fabric) To pucker, wrinkle, or contract unevenly into folds.

items.def_zh: 使弄皱；弄乱（衣物或毛发）
items.def_en: to make something such as cloth or hair untidy and full of creases
to form fine, delicate creases or lines on skin, foil, or paper
(+ sth) Become full of lines or wrinkles, or cause fabric or skin to do so

items.def_zh: （使嘴唇或织物）噘起；收拢起皱
items.def_en: (+ sth) Contract into small folds or ridges, especially the lips
to crush into irregular creases, or to collapse into folds

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe pliable surfaces—such as fabric, skin, or paper—forming unintentional lines, ridges, or furrowed puckers under pressure, dampness, or facial movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指织物、纸张或皮肤等柔性表面受挤压或收缩而起皱、起纹。

groups.name: Abandon & Relinquish · 放弃与抛弃 (Renounce Claims, Duties, or Bonds)
groups.tip: 彻底抛弃誓约或遗弃亲朋

items.def_zh: 自愿放弃（权利、索赔要求）
items.def_en: to officially and voluntarily give up a legal right, claim, or entitlement

items.def_zh: 交出，被迫放弃（权力、职位、财产）
items.def_en: to unwillingly or formally give up control, possession, or a right to someone else

items.def_zh: 放弃（权利、所有权或职责）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Renounce or surrender a claim, right, responsibility, or possession
to leave behind someone or something completely and with no intention of returning
(+ sth) Formally give up a legal right or property by signing a document
(+ sb/sth) Deliberately reject, forsake, or refuse to help someone or an obligation

items.def_zh: 断绝关系，公开放弃（名位、信念）
items.def_en: to state publicly that you no longer have a connection with, believe in, or claim something

items.def_zh: 抛弃，遗弃，彻底放弃（forsake的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of forsake; abandoned, deserted, or renounced.

items.def_zh: 遗弃，抛弃；断念，彻底放弃
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) To abandon someone who depends on you, or give up a habit, belief, or claim.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote letting go of possessions, claims, familial loyalties, or solemn responsibilities. They scale in moral and emotional gravity from formal relinquishment to deliberate, cold-hearted betrayal and total desertion.
groups.summary_zh: 按情感决绝度与责任背弃程度，放弃权利、职责或遗弃至亲。

groups.name: Abandon Relationships · 遗弃与背弃 (Abandon, Desert, Forsake)
groups.tip: 背弃职责或狠心舍弃

items.def_en: (+ sth) Deliberately abandon a difficult relationship or responsibility instead of dealing with it

items.def_zh: 甩下；突然背弃（伴侣或家庭）
items.def_en: to suddenly leave a partner, spouse, or family, ending the relationship

items.def_zh: 抛弃；遗弃（不再需要的人）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Discard or abandon someone completely because they are no longer wanted
(+ sb) Suddenly abandon a partner, spouse, or family in an irresponsible way

items.def_zh: 抛弃；遗弃（依附者或家庭）
items.def_en: to leave a person, dependent, or post permanently without intending to return
1. To abandon someone or leave someone without help or support. 2. To leave an armed force or post without permission.
to leave someone isolated and trapped without means of escape
to renounce or leave entirely someone or something one has a duty toward

items.def_zh: 抛弃（情人），（尤指婚礼前）甩掉
items.def_en: To suddenly end a romantic relationship with a lover or fiancé(e), especially unfeelingly or right before marriage.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe leaving a dependent, spouse, partner, or committed cause behind, abrogating moral or relational duty, ranging from abrupt romantic rejection to outright permanent abandonment.
groups.summary_zh: 指背弃职责或感情承诺，彻底遗弃依附者、伴侣或原有的责任。

groups.name: Abolish & Annul Laws · 废止与撤销制度 (Abrogate, Repeal, Annul)
groups.tip: 正式废除法律或撤销制度

items.def_zh: 裁定（法律、制度等）无效；废止
items.def_en: (+ sth) Rule that a law, regulation, or statute is illegal or unconstitutional and no longer in force
(+ sth) Put an end to or formally abolish an established practice, rule, or system

items.def_zh: 废止，从法典中删除（法律等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Formally remove a law or provision from the statute books
(of a legislative body) to officially rescind or withdraw an existing law by an act of legislature
to formally put an end to an institution, practice, or legal system
to make a law, contract, or official decision void by executive or legal authority
to declare officially that a statute, decree, or marriage is legally invalid from the beginning

items.def_zh: 废除，撤销（法律、条约或协议）
items.def_en: (formal) to officially end or cancel a law, treaty, right, or formal agreement

items.def_zh: 终止……的国教地位；废除，取消（某机构的法定地位）
items.def_en: 1. to end the official or legal status of a national church 2. to deprive an organization of its established public position

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to legislative, constitutional, or institutional authorities formally revoking, abolishing, or taking off the books established statutes, treaties, or state institutions.
groups.summary_zh: 官方权力机构依职权正式废止、废除法律、条约或制度。

groups.name: Acceleration & Velocity Increase · 加速与提速 (Quicken, Accelerate, Floor it)
groups.tip: 运动速度逐步提升

items.def_en: Increase in speed, pace, or intensity
[I/T] to make pace, gait, or movement faster, or become faster
Begin to move faster and faster
[I/T] to move faster or cause a vehicle or motion to increase its speed

items.def_zh: （使发动机）加速运转；（使）加速，活跃起来（常与 up 连用）
items.def_en: 1. To make an engine run quickly, or to run quickly. 2. (rev up) To become or cause something to become more active, lively, or faster.
1. To start to go faster, or make a vehicle go faster. 2. To happen or make something happen faster or earlier than expected.
(+ sth) Make an engine run much faster by pressing the accelerator, or accelerate rapidly
(informal) to depress the accelerator pedal firmly to make a vehicle travel much faster
(informal) to push an automobile's accelerator pedal flat to the floor to accelerate at maximum power

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale describe physical increase in the rate of motion, engine operation, or vehicular travel, progressing from slight incremental pacing to maximum engine throttle.
groups.summary_zh: 机动车或物体运行速度逐步提升乃至轰踩油门极速飞驰的动作梯度。

groups.name: Achieve & Attain Goals · 达标与斩获 (Achieve, Attain, Reach)
groups.tip: 达到目标赢得成果

items.def_zh: 达到（协议、水平、目标阶段）
items.def_en: To get to a particular point, level, or stage over time

items.def_zh: 赢得，获取（重大胜利、成功）
items.def_en: [I/T] To gain or achieve a major success, victory, or advantage

items.def_zh: （经努力）实现，达到，完成；取得成功
items.def_en: To succeed in reaching a particular goal, status, or result, especially by effort or skill.
To succeed in achieving something difficult or unexpected
To achieve or record a success, win, or high score

items.def_zh: 成功赢得；摘得（奖项或胜利）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Win a prize, award, or competition successfully
(+ sth) Achieve, record, or score a victory, success, or milestone

items.def_zh: 达到；累积达到（某数目或里程碑）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Reach or accumulate a specific benchmark, quantity, or distance
(formal) To succeed in reaching or achieving a particular goal, standard, or age.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers reaching desired outcomes, statuses, or benchmarks through sustained effort, ability, or progress. 'Achieve' focuses on earning results through deliberate labor, while 'attain' carries a higher register emphasizing lofty status, age milestones, or ambitious targets.
groups.summary_zh: 描述凭借努力、进步或历练，成功达到预期高度、地位或目标。

groups.name: Act & Execute · 执行与作为 (Act, Do, Perform)
groups.tip: 落到实处付诸行动

items.def_zh: 做，执行，实施；完成，处理；行动；（助动词）用于构成疑问、否定或强调
items.def_en: 1. To perform, execute, or carry out an action, task, or activity. 2. Used as an auxiliary verb to form questions, negatives, or to add emphasis.

items.def_zh: 行动，作为；扮演，表演；起作用，见效
items.def_en: 1. To take action or perform a function. 2. To perform a role in a play, film, etc.; to behave in a specified way.

items.def_zh: 执行，履行，实施；表演，演出；运转，表现
items.def_en: 1. To carry out, execute, or accomplish an action, task, or duty. 2. To entertain an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.
to carry out fully a legal instrument, order, plan, or official decision
to put into practice or complete a plan, order, or instruction
(+ with sth) Continue an action or duty until it is fully completed

items.def_zh: 付诸实施；贯彻实行（尤指艰难决定）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Complete a planned action or promise despite difficulties or opposition
(+ sth) Take action in accordance with instructions, advice, or official duty
to perform a task, duty, or responsibility that one is obligated to do

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate taking action, carrying out tasks, or executing duties and social responsibilities. 'Do' functions as the foundational everyday verb, 'act' underlines agency and taking initiative, while 'perform' and 'execute' emphasize structured delivery or official implementation.
groups.summary_zh: 指主体采取行动、履行职责或贯彻执行具体任务及法令。

groups.name: Adjust by Dial & Lever · 旋钮操纵与转控 (Crank, Dial, Maneuver)
groups.tip: 按键拨动以调控机械

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce the setting, intensity, or level of something by turning a dial or control
(+ to sth) to change from one mechanism, channel, or setting to another using a switch or lever
to turn a knob, dial, or control with a rotational hand movement

items.def_zh: 拨（电话号码）；（通过转盘或旋钮）调节
items.def_en: 1. To call a telephone number by pressing buttons or turning a disc; to adjust a control using a dial.
[I/T] (+ between) to switch a lever or setting between two alternating states

items.def_zh: 转动旋钮调高（音量、暖气等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to increase the level, volume, or setting of a mechanical or electrical control

items.def_zh: 用曲柄转动；调大（音量等，常与up连用）
items.def_en: 1. To turn a crank handle to start or operate a machine; (crank up) to increase the volume, level, or intensity of something.
to move or actuate something using a lever or lever-like handle

items.def_zh: 操纵，控制；使巧妙移动；耍花招，用策略调动
items.def_en: 1. To move, guide, or manipulate skillfully; to use clever tactics or deceit to achieve a goal.

groups.summary_en: An agent physically operates mechanical controls, dials, handles, or navigational mechanisms using specific rotational or guided manual force to adjust settings or direct movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过旋转旋钮、摇动手柄或技巧性拨动仪器以精准操纵机械或设备。

groups.name: Adjust to Environment · 适应与顺应 (Adapt, Acclimate, Adjust)
groups.tip: 逐步调整身心以融于新环境

items.def_en: to adapt or become used to a new situation or condition
1. (+ to) To change your behavior or ideas in order to suit a new condition or environment. 2. To modify something for a new use, purpose, or medium.

items.def_zh: 使水土服从；习惯新气候
items.def_en: to accustom or become accustomed to a new climate or environment
to make accustomed to something through prolonged or frequent exposure
to become familiar with and feel comfortable in a new environment, home, or job
(+ with sb/sth) to adapt visually or socially so as to look natural or unremarkable within surroundings
(+ with sb/sth) to feel accepted and live or work harmoniously in an environment
to adapt or fit oneself to someone or something

items.def_zh: 使适应，使服水土；适应新环境
items.def_en: (+ to) (chiefly North American) To adjust or adapt to a new climate, altitude, or unfamiliar environment.

groups.summary_en: An entity or organism alters its behavior, physiology, or habits to fit novel conditions or climatic environments. Verbs range from broad situational modification to strict environmental acclimatization.
groups.summary_zh: 个体或系统调整内部机能或行为模式以契合新环境与新条件。

groups.name: Adorn with Embedded Ornaments · 镶饰与缀缀 (Stud, Jewel, Bejewel)
groups.tip: 用饰物点缀外表以增添美感

items.def_zh: 镶嵌以，缀以（宝石或金属）
items.def_en: to mount, embed, or stud precious stones or decorative metals onto a surface

items.def_zh: 为……加饰边，为……加穗；沿着……的边缘形成边界
items.def_en: 1. To decorate something with a fringe or decorative border. 2. To form a border or edge along something.
to decorate or furnish an object or surface elaborately with ornamental pieces
(often passive) To decorate or mark a surface with many small ornaments, studs, or prominent objects.
To adorn or decorate something with jewels or precious stones.

items.def_zh: 缀满发光小饰物；点缀亮片
items.def_en: to cover or decorate glittering spangles, stars, or shiny ornaments across a surface

items.def_zh: 嵌花；将装饰物嵌入表面
items.def_en: (+ with) to set pieces of wood, metal, or stone flush into the surface of an object

items.def_zh: 缀满珠宝；用宝石华美镶嵌
items.def_en: to ornament or encrust lavishly with precious stones or jewels

items.def_zh: 在表面镶嵌/结上一层装饰物
items.def_en: (+ with) to cover a surface with a hard crust or dense embedded coating of jewels or decorative elements

groups.summary_en: A craftsman or decorator embellishes a surface, garment, or object by attaching, scattering, or embedding decorative borders, raised metal studs, or glittering gems across it.
groups.summary_zh: 在器物或织物表面镶嵌宝石、布满饰钮或边缘装饰流苏。

groups.name: Advertise & Promote · 宣传与推广
groups.tip: 商业营销炒作与公关推广

items.def_en: to actively encourage the sales, popularity, or public awareness of a product or event
to mention or recommend a product, book, or show publicly in an informal context
(+ sb/sth) to praise or promote something enthusiastically to generate positive public reception
(+ sth) to distribute and aggressively publicize commercial products or promotional material to the public

items.def_zh: 虚夸宣传；过度夸大推广
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to praise or advertise something with exaggerated, boastful puffery
(informal) To advertise or promote a product, person, or event extravagantly to create intense public excitement.
to praise or publicize something energetically, especially to persuade people of its merit
to make information about something widely known to the public

items.def_zh: 为……做广告，宣传（advertise 的变体）
items.def_en: A variant spelling of advertise; to promote or publish advertisements for something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe publicizing commercial goods, services, or events to capture audience attention, stimulate demand, and persuade buyers. They vary from conventional commercial paid promotion ('advertise') to high-pressure public relations or sensational puffery ('hype', 'plug', 'tout').
groups.summary_zh: 通过媒体宣传、造势或推介来吸引受众并促进销售。

groups.name: Advocate & Champion · 倡导支持与助力 (Espouse, Champion, Abet)
groups.tip: 从政见认同拥护到合谋协助服务

items.def_en: to give financial, material, or moral support to a person, plan, or campaign
to vigorously fight for, promote, or defend a cause, idea, or principle
to accept, support, or tolerate a particular practice or proposal
(+ sb/sth) to support, advocate, or publicly defend a person, right, or cause
(+ sb/sth) to state your support or advocacy publicly for someone or their cause
(+ sb/sth) to defend or champion someone or their principles when they are criticized

items.def_zh: 支持，拥护（观点、信条等）；嫁，娶
items.def_en: 1. To give support to a belief, cause, or way of life; (archaic) to marry.
1. (usually in 'aid and abet') To encourage, assist, or support someone in committing a crime or wrongdoing.

items.def_zh: 当球童，为高尔夫球手当球童
items.def_en: 1. To work as a caddy carrying a golfer's clubs and giving advice during a round.

groups.summary_en: Social and collaborative alignment where an agent endorses, champions, or actively facilitates another party's doctrines, enterprises, or illicit schemes.
groups.summary_zh: 指在思想、立场上拥护倡导，或在行动上作为同谋/助手给予协助支持。

groups.name: Agile & Sudden Rapid Motion · 飞奔与疾闪 (Dart, Zoom, Dash)
groups.tip: 极速移动呼啸而过

items.def_en: to move quickly with short, rapid steps like a small animal
to move swiftly, lightly, and somewhat erratically from place to place
to move abruptly, suddenly, and rapidly outwards from a concealed or stationary position
(+ into/out of) to run suddenly and rapidly over a short distance
(+ sb/sth) to move past someone or something with extremely high speed and suddenness
to leave or dash away suddenly and with great speed
(+ past/across) to move at tremendous speed leaving an impression of a streak

items.def_zh: 飞驰，极速移动；（镜头）变焦，急速拉近或推远
items.def_en: 1. To move or travel very fast, often with a loud humming noise. 2. (zoom in/out) To adjust a camera lens or digital view so a subject appears much closer or farther away.

items.def_zh: 飞奔，猛冲，疾驰；飞快地投向（目光等）
items.def_en: 1. To move suddenly and very quickly in a particular direction. 2. To cast a quick, sharp glance or look at someone.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame highlight sudden acceleration, lightness, or sharp changes of direction, contrasting rapid straight-line bursts with abrupt, evasive leaps.
groups.summary_zh: 强调步伐敏捷轻快、方向突然转换或骤然提速飞奔的运动方式。

groups.name: Agree & Concur · 意见一致与赞同 (Agree, Concur, Assent)
groups.tip: 表达赞成认同并达成一致

items.def_zh: 赞同，同意；意见一致；商定
items.def_en: 1. To have the same opinion as someone else. 2. To say yes to a suggestion, request, or proposal; to accept or arrange.
(+ with/on) to share the same views and agree fully with someone
(+ sb/sth) to agree with or accept a decision, opinion, or proposal
(+ sb) to align oneself with and support one person or party in a dispute
(+ sth) to accept and agree with someone's plan, opinion, or suggestion
(+ to) to agree with or support an opinion, belief, or theory
(formal) 1. To agree with someone or share an opinion. 2. To happen at the same time; coincide.
(+ to) to officially or formally express agreement with a plan, request, or proposal
(+ to) to agree to a demand, request, or proposal, especially after initial reluctance

groups.summary_en: Speakers express mutual consensus or align with another party's judgment, proposal, or conclusion. Verbs range from general conversational agreement ('agree') to formal, institutional, or deliberative harmony ('concur', 'assent', 'subscribe').
groups.summary_zh: 表达意见一致、赞成提议或在立场与结论上形成共识，涵盖日常赞同与正式决议。

groups.name: Allocate & Earmark · 划拨与指派 (Allot, Earmark, Apportion)
groups.tip: 把特定份额指派给各方

items.def_en: to formally set aside money for a specific official purpose through legislation or committee action
to give a specific task, role, or asset to someone
(+ sth) to reserve or earmark an amount of money, time, or supplies for a particular purpose

items.def_zh: 划拨出；分出（资金或份额）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to allocate or set aside a portion of resources or a budget specifically from a larger pool
(+ sth) to distribute, allocate, or hand out resources or tasks among people
to designate officially that an amount of money or resources should be used for a particular purpose
To give or assign a particular share of time, money, space, or tasks to someone or for a purpose.

items.def_zh: 指定……作特定用途，拨出（款项等）；在（牲畜）耳朵上打记号
items.def_en: 1. To designate or set aside funds, resources, or time for a specific purpose. 2. To mark the ear of an animal to identify ownership.
to divide resources, responsibilities, or blame among a group according to a calculated plan

groups.summary_en: An authoritative source sets aside or distributes money, resources, or duties for a designated recipient or specific purpose. Register ranges from official institutional designation to exact mathematical rationing.
groups.summary_zh: 机构或当局将资金、配额或资源按规定划拨、指派或专款专用。

groups.name: Amputate & Excise · 截肢与外科切除 (Amputate, Excise, Resect)
groups.tip: 外科手术割除特定组织

items.def_en: to remove a tumor, organ, or eyeball cleanly from its surrounding capsule or socket
(+ sth) to sever or surgically remove an anatomical limb or growth from the body
(+ sth) to surgically amputate or remove a diseased limb or body part
(+ sth) to surgically excise an organ, growth, or diseased tissue from the body
to surgically cut out an organ, tumor, or tissue sample from the body
To cut off an arm, leg, finger, or toe by surgical operation.
To cut off the foreskin of a male, typically for medical reasons or as a religious rite.
