to surgically excise and completely eradicate a diseased organ or pathological structure
to surgically remove a portion of an organ, bone, or other body structure

groups.summary_en: A medical professional surgically removes a diseased limb, organ, growth, or anatomical tissue from a living patient.
groups.summary_zh: 外科手术中切除病变肢体、组织、器官或增生物。

groups.name: Annotate & Expound Texts · 注释、阐发与诠释 (Annotate, Commentate, Paraphrase)
groups.tip: 解释原因由来说明事实真相

items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To explain the cause or reason of something, or give an explanation of what happened. 2. (+ for) To form or make up a specified proportion or amount.
(+ sth) to explain something in a very clear, explicit, and detailed manner
(+ sth) to add more details, explanation, or substance to a text or idea
to provide a brief explanatory note or definition for a difficult word or phrase in a text

items.def_zh: 意译，释义，用别的话改述
items.def_en: 1. To express the meaning of something written or spoken using different words, especially to make it easier to understand.
1. To add explanatory notes or comments to a book, text, or drawing.
[I/T] (+ on) to present and explain a theory, belief, or doctrine systematically and thoroughly
1. (+ on) To provide a spoken running commentary and analysis on a sports event or public occasion, especially for television or radio.

items.def_zh: 详尽剖析，阐释（理论、文本）
items.def_en: to explain, interpret, and unfold the meaning of a complex text or principle in detail

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this communicative frame denote analyzing, rewording, or providing explanatory critical commentary on written texts, events, or data to make their meaning transparent to an audience.
groups.summary_zh: 指对文本或事件进行意译、添加注释、解读分析或阐明原委。

groups.name: Anticipate & Await · 期待与预见 (Anticipate, Await, Foresee)
groups.tip: 预见可能情况并提早准备

items.def_en: to await an upcoming event with eager pleasure and anticipation
(+ sth) to await an expected outcome or decision before proceeding
to regard something as likely to happen
(+ sb/sth) to expect something to happen with high confidence and base plans on it

items.def_zh: 预备防范；为……做好心理准备
items.def_en: (+ sth) to prepare cognitively or physically for an impending, typically unpleasant event

items.def_zh: 预料，预期；期望，盼望；先于……行动
items.def_en: 1. To expect something to happen and prepare for it. 2. To look forward to something with pleasure.

items.def_zh: 等待，期待；将降临于，在等待着
items.def_en: 1. To wait for something or someone. 2. To be in store for or about to happen to someone.
to contemplate or visualize as a future possibility
to be aware of or realize beforehand that something will happen

groups.summary_en: An agent cognitively looks forward to a prospective future event, whether bracing for it practically, waiting with expectancy, or envisaging its unfolding.
groups.summary_zh: 对即将到来的事件保持心理期待、提前预想或准备。

groups.name: Apportion & Regulate Distribution · 配额与配给分发 (Ration, Dispense, Syndicate)
groups.tip: 按规则分发物资或配额

items.def_en: to distribute food, money, or supplies in strict, often begrudging or limited quantities
(+ sth) to divide something into shares or portions and distribute them
(+ sth) to carefully administer or give out measured amounts of something
(+ sth) to divide something into smaller parts or portions and allocate them to different recipients
to officially designate or set apart a specific share of resources for a defined purpose

items.def_zh: （通过辛迪加组织向多家媒体）联合分发，同时出售；组成辛迪加
items.def_en: To sell articles, television programmes, or photographs to many different newspapers or broadcasters simultaneously.

items.def_zh: 配给，定量供应；按配额分发
items.def_en: To limit the amount of food, fuel, or supplies each person is allowed to receive during a shortage.

items.def_zh: 分发，分配；配药；施予；（dispense with）省去，免除
items.def_en: 1. To distribute or give out supplies, medicine, or justice to people. 2. ('dispense with') To manage without or get rid of something.
to assign a fixed portion, quota, or share of something to a designated recipient

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve the systematic division and allocation of commodities, funds, or broadcast rights according to institutional quotas, mechanical controls, or contractual licensing.
groups.summary_zh: 依定量配额、特定机制或商业授权进行控制性分发与划拨。

groups.name: Argue & Dispute by Manner · 争吵与辩驳 (Quibble, Bicker, Debate)
groups.tip: 唇枪舌剑、为琐事吵闹或正式辩论

items.def_en: To argue with someone about petty or unimportant things.
to argue noisily about something that is not important

items.def_zh: 吹毛求疵，为微不足道的小事争辩；诡辩
items.def_en: To argue, complain, or make trivial objections about minor, unimportant details.
to engage in a quarrel or dispute and damage a relationship as a result
(+ sb) to engage in a minor, irritable argument, spat, or squabble with someone
1. To discuss or argue a subject in a formal manner. 2. To consider or ponder something carefully.
to argue with someone in a sharp but often friendly or testing manner
to discuss or argue about a disagreement openly and completely with someone to resolve it
[I/T] to argue against or formally question the truth or validity of a statement

groups.summary_en: Participants engage in verbal opposition, ranging from petty, irritable bickering over trifles to structured, formal forensic debate.
groups.summary_zh: 从为细枝末节琐碎争吵，到严肃、规范地展开辩论交锋。

groups.name: Arrange & Align · 排列与对齐 (Geometric Placement & Alignment)
groups.tip: 校准位置使其整齐排成行

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange objects in a straight row or ensure they are properly aligned
(+ sth) to align something so its edges, corners, or surfaces form right angles or sit evenly
[I/T] to place or arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative positions
[I/T] to arrange rectangular or polygonal shapes side-by-side across a surface without gaps

items.def_zh: 核对并按序排列（纸张等）
items.def_en: to assemble, sort, and order sheets or components in proper numerical or logical sequence

items.def_zh: 重新对齐，重新排列；重新调整（方向或关系）
items.def_en: To put things back into a straight line or correct position; to reorganize or adjust relationships, policies, or alliances.
(+ up) to bring an object, wheel, or frame into accurate alignment, flatness, or balance
(variant of align) To arrange elements into a straight line or into correct relative positioning.

items.def_zh: 以嵌花式铺砌，用几何形状无缝拼接
items.def_en: To cover a surface completely with repeated geometric shapes fitted closely together without gaps or overlaps.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve positioning objects, lines, or geometric patterns into orderly, straight, or precisely fitting configurations relative to an axis, grid, or neighboring elements. Nuances vary between linear alignment, fitting tiles seamlessly, or reorienting relative positions.
groups.summary_zh: 使物体沿轴线对齐、重整或拼嵌成几何无缝图形。

groups.name: Arrange in Line & Sequence · 排列与整齐成行 (Line, Space, Array)
groups.tip: 使多个物体沿线对齐成列

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to arrange people or items in a straight line, or to form a queue yourself
to line up or wait in a row behind one another
(+ sth) to arrange items or people with calculated, uniform intervals between them

items.def_zh: 沿……排列成行；排队，成行排列；给……加衬里
items.def_en: 1. To form a row or rows along the side or edge of something. 2. (usually 'line up') To stand or arrange in a row or line. 3. To cover the inside surface of something with a protective layer.
(+ out/apart) To arrange or place things at regular intervals or with a certain distance between them.

items.def_zh: 鱼贯而行，排成单列行进
items.def_en: (+ in/out/past) To march or walk in a single line one behind the other
[I/T] (+ up) To form or arrange people or vehicles into a sequential line

items.def_zh: 整齐排列，布阵（成有秩序的行列）
items.def_en: To place things or people in an orderly, impressive, or strategic arrangement
To arrange objects or seating in ascending rows or layers

groups.summary_en: This manner frame denotes arranging items, people, or intervals in straight lines, uniform files, or calculated spatial intervals. Gradations capture the strictness of geometric placement, from simple single-file lining to precision spacing and formal strategic arrays.
groups.summary_zh: 指按照直线、间距或队形将物体或人整齐排开、均匀分布或陈列。

groups.name: Assent & Comply · 赞同与应允 (Assent, Acquiesce, Consent)
groups.tip: 对他人提议表示赞许与首肯

items.def_en: (+ to) To give official or formal permission for something to happen
(+ sb/sth) to agree with or accept a decision, rule, or suggestion
(+ sb/sth) to finally agree to something that one previously resisted or opposed
(+ sth) to accept and support someone else's plan, views, or suggestions
(+ sb/sth) to suddenly cease all resistance and accept demands or pressure
(+ with) To express an opinion identical to another person's; agree formally
(+ to) To formally express agreement or approval regarding an opinion, proposal, or request.
(+ to) To agree to a demand, request, or proposal, especially after initial reluctance
(+ in/to) To accept, comply with, or agree to something reluctantly without protest.

groups.summary_en: An agent yields, agrees, or officially concedes to a proposal, decision, or demand made by another. Verbs contrast between active intellectual agreement ('assent'), passive non-resistance without enthusiasm ('acquiesce'), and formal grant of permission ('consent').
groups.summary_zh: 对他人提议或要求表示同意、顺从或准许，含被动默许与正式批准之别。

groups.name: Attach with Adhesive · 粘贴与黏附 (Paste, Stick, Gum)
groups.tip: 抹上胶水让物体牢贴不落

items.def_en: (+ sth) to attach posters, paper, or notices onto a surface with paste
(+ sth) to fasten or secure something to a surface using adhesive substance

items.def_zh: 用胶水粘合，涂胶于；使黏结，堵塞（与 up 连用）
items.def_en: 1. To stick or seal something together using gum or glue. 2. (gum up) To clog or make something sticky so that it cannot work properly.
(+ to) To stick firmly to a surface or substance (formal register)
(+ to) To hold on tightly to or adhere naturally to a contact surface
(+ sth) to firmly attach something onto a surface using glue

items.def_zh: 粘贴，黏附；刺，戳；伸出；卡住
items.def_en: 1. To attach or become fastened to something, especially with glue or a sticky substance. 2. To push something pointed into or through something; insert. 3. To become trapped or fixed in one position.

items.def_zh: 用浆糊（或胶水）粘贴，黏合；（计算机）粘贴
items.def_en: 1. To stick something to a surface using paste or glue. 2. (computing) To insert copied text, an image, or data into a document or file.
(+ to/together) To fasten or join firmly with glue or adhesive

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote joining or attaching surfaces together using a sticky, viscous, or adhesive substance, or remaining fixed onto a surface through natural adherence. They contrast by the type of adhesive medium, permanency, and physical application.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助黏稠介质或自身粘性将物体附着、固定在另一表面上。

groups.name: Audible High-Speed Motion · 呼啸疾掠 (Whiz, Whoosh, Zip)
groups.tip: 极速冲刺带风呼啸而过

items.def_en: (+ past/by) to speed rapidly with a light humming or hissing sound

items.def_zh: 飕飕掠过；作沙沙声甩动
items.def_en: [I/T] to move swiftly through the air with a soft hissing or rustling sound
to move past very rapidly while producing a rushing or whistling sound
to rush past swiftly with a loud displacement or gust of air
to travel past someone or somewhere extremely quickly with a sharp, swift rush of air
(+ past/through) to move rapidly producing a shrill whistling sound from air friction
(+ down/upon) to move rapidly downwards through the air with a rushing sound
To move very quickly with a rushing or hissing sound of air or water, or make something do this.

items.def_zh: 呼啸疾驰，嗖嗖地飞驰；飕飕作声
items.def_en: To move very quickly through the air or past someone, often with a buzzing or whistling sound.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate high-speed translation that generates a prominent rush of displaced air, humming friction, or distinctive aerodynamic sound.
groups.summary_zh: 特指伴随明显风声、破空声或气流呼啸的高速移动方式。

groups.name: Avow & Assert · 断言与主张 (Earnest Open Claim and Commitment)
groups.tip: 公开宣誓并坚定不移确证主张

items.def_zh: 公开表明；声称（信仰/态度）
items.def_en: to claim or declare a feeling, opinion, or faith openly, sometimes insincerely
(+ sth) State or declare an assertion or belief openly and publicly
State one's beliefs, convictions, or objections openly and without fear
(+ sb/sth) Assert and defend a belief, principle, or claim firmly when challenged
to state a fact or belief firmly and with positive confidence
to state positively or validate emphatically as true or valid
(+ that) to argue or assert earnestly in the course of an adversarial debate

items.def_zh: 重申，再次坚称；再次确立（权威等）
items.def_en: 1. To state a claim, belief, or fact firmly again, or re-establish one's control or authority.

items.def_zh: 公开承认，明确声明，坦承
items.def_en: 1. (+ that) (formal) To state, admit, or claim something openly and firmly in public.

groups.summary_en: A speaker declares a belief, identity, or commitment openly and resolutely in the face of skepticism, holding themselves personally accountable for the claim's integrity.
groups.summary_zh: 公开坚决地承认信念、身份或明确主张立场。

groups.name: Awe & Greatly Impress · 强烈打动与叹服 (Impress, Wow, Dazzle)
groups.tip: 直击心灵、留下深刻的情感印记

items.def_zh: 使惊叹，给……留下极深刻印象，轰动
items.def_en: (informal) To impress someone enormously; to delight or entertain an audience greatly.

items.def_zh: 给……留下深刻印象，使钦佩；使意识到，使铭记
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel admiration, respect, or deep emotional impact. 2. (+ on/upon) To emphasize firmly so that someone realizes the importance of something.

items.def_zh: 使极其震撼，使叹为观止
items.def_en: (+ obj) to amaze, surprise, or impress someone enormously
(+ sb) Astonish, dazzle, or greatly impress someone
(+ sb) Impress or captivate someone immensely with exceptional quality or beauty

items.def_zh: 完全吸引；强烈打动（通常作 sweep off one's feet）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Completely captivate or overwhelm someone with charm or admiration
to fill someone with deep admiration, respect, or reverential wonder
to greatly impress or overwhelm someone with brilliance, skill, or beauty
to hold someone's intense interest or admiration through charm or excellence

groups.summary_en: Denotes an agent, performance, or display creating a strong, deeply positive, and admiring emotional impact on an observer. Nuances range from dignified approval ('impress') to overwhelming, flashy sensory admiration ('dazzle', 'wow').
groups.summary_zh: 指凭借卓越表现或魅力令他人产生深刻印象、赞叹或叹服。

groups.name: Balance & Offset · 均等与抵消 (Balance, Offset, Counterbalance)
groups.tip: 力量相互抵消达到均等与平衡

items.def_en: [I/T] to put opposing forces, weights, or accounts in equal proportion or equilibrium
to act as an equal weight or power that holds another in exact balance
(+ sth) Become equal in amount, value, or influence, or make two opposing elements balance each other

items.def_zh: 使均等；使相等消除差距
items.def_en: (+ sth) Become equal or balanced, or make opposing amounts equal and level
(+ sth) Have an equal but opposite effect to something else, nullifying any net disparity
to compensate for or counteract something by having an equal and opposite effect
to render an opposing force, effect, or substance harmless and ineffective by equal counteraction

items.def_zh: （使）平衡，（使）均等；（比赛中）扳平比分
items.def_en: 1. to make things equal, balanced, or uniform across a group 2. (in sports) to score a goal or point that ties the match
to offset or balance the weight, power, or effect of something with an equal opposing force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve establishing numerical, financial, or mechanical equilibrium between opposing weights, forces, or liabilities so that net disparity is eliminated.
groups.summary_zh: 在力量、数值、收支或利弊之间实现对冲、平衡或抵消。

groups.name: Balance & Offset · 平衡与对冲
groups.tip: 拉平各方差距或相互抵消平衡

items.def_zh: 均分，使平均，平均分摊；平均为，平均达到；算出……的平均数
items.def_en: 1. To balance out or distribute evenly among several items or people. 2. To have as an average; amount to an average rate or number. 3. To calculate the numerical average of.

items.def_zh: 使平衡；以同等力量制衡
items.def_en: to bring into perfect equilibrium by applying an opposing weight or influence
(+ sth) Compensate for a deficit, loss, or shortcoming so as to restore balance
(+ sth) Result in an even average rate or balance over time
(+ with sb) Settle debts or differences so that balances are equalized
1. To balance, compensate for, or counteract something so that the overall effect is reduced or neutralized. 2. (printing) To print using the offset lithography process.
(+ for) to provide an offsetting balance against a deficit, loss, or defect

items.def_zh: 使对等，使平衡，使均等；（体育比赛中）扳平比分
items.def_en: 1. To make amounts, opportunities, or conditions equal, or to become equal. 2. (sports) To score a goal or point that levels the score with the opponent.
to exert an equal and opposite force or influence against something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe compensating for or counterbalancing one amount, influence, or disparity against another so as to achieve parity, equilibrium, or a fair midpoint. 'Offset' counters an effect with an opposing force, 'equalize' brings quantities into equality, and 'counterbalance' maintains stable equilibrium.
groups.summary_zh: 通过两相对照抵偿或调节比例，达到数值或效果的平衡对等。

groups.name: Bend & Angle Shapes · 弯曲与折折 (Bend, Crook, Fold)
groups.tip: 使纸张或软物对称对折

items.def_en: to bend a joint or muscle, or to bend slightly under stress without snapping
(+ sth) Curve or angle an object or limb backward from its straight position
(+ sth) Bend a part flat against another surface by folding

items.def_zh: 折叠，对折；抱拢，交叉（双臂）；（企业等）倒闭
items.def_en: 1. to bend a piece of paper, cloth, etc., so that one part lies flat on another. 2. to cross one's arms, or wrap something. 3. (informal) to close down or go out of business

items.def_zh: （使）弯曲，折弯；俯身，弯腰；屈服，服从
items.def_en: 1. to curve something straight, or become curved or folded. 2. to move the body or part of the body downwards and forwards. 3. to submit or yield to someone's wishes

items.def_zh: 使弯曲，弯成钩状（如手臂或手指）
items.def_en: to bend a finger, arm, or leg so that it forms a curved or hooked shape
to make lines or folds in cloth or paper by pressing or bending
(+ sb/sth) Bend sharply in half or bend the body sharply forward at the waist
to bend or warp severely out of shape under excessive heat, weight, or force

groups.summary_en: Manner verbs of physical shaping denoting altering an object or body part from a straight to a curved, sharply angled, or doubled-over position.
groups.summary_zh: 施加外力使物体或肢体由直变弯、折叠或成特定角度。

groups.name: Bend & Arc Smoothly · 弯曲与弧形折曲 (Curve, Arch, Bend)
groups.tip: 由平直变弯曲或拱起弧度

items.def_zh: 拱起成弧状；弯成拱形覆盖
items.def_en: (+ sth) Form a curved, graceful arch extending across or above something

items.def_zh: 沿弧形绕过；形成平滑曲线
items.def_en: (+ sth) Bend or sweep in a smooth continuous arc around something
Follow or form an elongated, smooth curving trajectory or line
to form a curve, or to bend or shape something into a curve
to force an object out of a straight line into a curve, or to naturally flex
to form an arch, or to curve something into an arch shape (such as one's back, eyebrows, or feet)
to bend a limb, joint, or pliable material temporarily without breaking
to bend into a curved shape under pressure, weight, or tension
1. to form into a curved or spiral shape, or cause hair, paper, etc. to do so. 2. (curl up) to sit or lie in a comfortable position with legs drawn up

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical objects, bodies, or trajectories forming a smooth, continuous curve or rounded deflection away from a straight line without buckling or tangling.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或身体呈现平滑连贯的弧形或弯度，无断折或扭结。

groups.name: Betray & Defect · 背叛与变节 (Betray, Defect, Sell out)
groups.tip: 倒戈叛变出卖信任

items.def_en: [I/T] to compromise one's principles or betray friends for personal gain
(+ sb) Betray someone's secrets or misdeeds to authorities
to deliberately deceive or betray an associate after pledging cooperation
(+ sb/sth) Defect to an opposing faction, nation, or ideological camp

items.def_zh: 反目背叛；掉头对付（同伴）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Suddenly attack, betray, or show hostility toward a former friend or ally
(+ from/to) to abandon one's country, party, or cause in favor of an opposing one

items.def_zh: 背叛，出卖；辜负；流露，暴露
items.def_en: 1. To be disloyal to someone who trusts you, or hand over your country or friends to an enemy. 2. To show or reveal feelings, thoughts, or information unintentionally.

items.def_zh: 背叛，叛变，脱离（信仰或组织）
items.def_en: (formal / dated) To abandon or renounce a religion, cause, or group, especially to become a traitor.
(formal) to renounce completely a religious, political, or ideological belief

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the violation of trust, sworn allegiance, or national loyalty. They scale in severity from surrendering comrades or transactional selling out to absolute geopolitical defection and high treason.
groups.summary_zh: 违背信任、背弃祖国或团体盟约，乃至变节叛国。

groups.name: Bind & Restrict Physically · 捆绑与束缚 (Tighten, Blinker, Shackle)
groups.tip: 戴眼罩限制视野与行动

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Tie up tightly with rope, cord, or bandages so mobility is restricted

items.def_zh: 按倒制服；压制使其动弹不得
items.def_en: (+ sb) Hold someone firmly against a surface so they cannot move freely

items.def_zh: （使）勒紧，绑紧，变紧；加强，收紧（管制等）
items.def_en: 1. To make something firmer, tighter, or more secure, or to become tighter. 2. To make rules, laws, or controls more strict.

items.def_zh: 严密捆绑（使四肢无法活动）
items.def_en: (+ up) to tie up tightly with rope, securing the wings or limbs to prevent movement

items.def_zh: 给（马）戴眼罩；限制……的眼界，使目光狭隘
items.def_en: To put blinkers on a horse; to narrow someone's outlook or prevent them from seeing the full picture.
(+ sb/sth) Tie up someone's arms and legs tightly to immobilize them completely
to fasten metal bands around someone's ankles or wrists to severely limit movement
to place metal shackles or handcuffs upon someone's wrists
to restrain with chains or manacles around the feet, totally immobilizing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote applying physical restraints, bindings, or narrowing apparatuses to an entity to curtail its freedom of movement, field of view, or flexibility. They range from merely constricting bands to completely immobilizing joints with heavy gear.
groups.summary_zh: 使用绳索、镣铐或装置勒紧并限制人或动物的躯体自由。

groups.name: Block & Congest Physical Flow · 堵塞与淤塞 (Clog, Bottleneck, Congest)
groups.tip: 交通狭窄造成移动拥堵

items.def_en: to crowd into a tight space, or wedge something so tightly that flow or movement ceases
to block, close up, or obstruct an opening or cavity (formal/technical)
(+ sth) Become blocked with an accumulation of matter, or cause fluid or traffic to stop flowing
(+ sth) Block a passage, machine, or channel completely through overcrowding or accumulation
(+ sth) Obstruct or restrict the passage, supply, or flow of something severely
(+ with/up) to fill a passage or system completely so that movement stops or slows dramatically
(often + up) To block or become blocked so that movement or flow is prevented or restricted.

items.def_zh: 造成阻塞，成为瓶颈；受阻
items.def_en: To slow down, delay, or block movement, traffic, or progress by causing a bottleneck.
(often passive) To overcrowd or block a road, passage, or bodily organ so that movement or flow is hindered.

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing the physical or infrastructural constriction of fluid, vehicular, or logistical passage caused by buildup, narrowing, or overwhelming volume.
groups.summary_zh: 指因杂物堆积、通道变窄或负荷过大导致物理或交通流动受阻。

groups.name: Blur & Obscure · 模糊与遮蔽 (Blur, Mist, Obscure)
groups.tip: 轮廓边界不清难以辨认

items.def_zh: 使蒙上阴影；使混浊/模糊
items.def_en: to make something less transparent, clear, or easy to understand
(+ sth) Become covered with mist, steam, or moisture so as to obscure vision
(+ sth) Become hazy, obscure, or indistinct in transparency or clarity

items.def_zh: 将…模糊处理；使轮廓模糊不清
items.def_en: (+ sth) Make an image or boundary indistinct and indistinctly defined
to make something difficult to see, hear, or understand by covering or clouding it
to cover a surface with condensed vapor or make a situation confusing and unclear

items.raw_cluster: 使模糊与遮蔽 Blur & Obscure
items.def_zh: （使）变模糊，（使）看不清；（使）界限不清
items.def_en: 1. To become, or make something become, unclear, indistinct, or hard to see and distinguish.

items.def_zh: （使）蒙上雾气，（使）视线模糊；下薄雾
items.def_en: 1. (often + over/up) To become, or make something become, covered with tiny drops of moisture so that vision or a surface is blurred.
to make or become less bright, clear, or distinct

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to optical, physical, or cognitive processes that make an image, shape, distinction, or meaning indistinct, hazy, or impossible to perceive clearly.
groups.summary_zh: 指由于薄雾、阻挡或混淆使轮廓、视线或认知变得模糊不清。

groups.name: Bodily Restraint & Physical Shackling · 械具拘禁与强力束缚 (Manacle, Straiten)
groups.tip: 戴上手铐限制人身自由

items.def_en: (+ sb) Confine someone securely in a prison cell or under physical restraint
(+ sb) Restrict someone's physical freedom by fastening them securely with ropes or straps
to fasten someone's hands together using a pair of metal rings joined by a chain

items.def_zh: 限制，束缚；使陷入困境，使贫困
items.def_en: To restrict someone's freedom or scope; to cause severe financial hardship or distress to.
(+ sb) Fasten or restrain someone securely to a fixed point using chains
to put physical metal shackles on someone's limbs to prevent movement
to bind the feet or body of a prisoner with heavy chains or shackles

items.def_zh: 给……戴上手铐（或镣铐）；束缚，限制
items.def_en: To fasten someone's hands or ankles with metal chains or handcuffs; to severely restrict freedom.
to restrain violently agitated persons by securing them in a strong canvas jacket

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physical constriction or immobilization of a person using mechanical restraints, chains, or confining garments, severely limiting their bodily mobility.
groups.summary_zh: 使用手铐、脚镣或紧身拘束衣等物理械具对人身体进行强制拘禁与活动限制。

groups.name: Bottle, Can & Package · 装瓶、装罐与封装
groups.tip: 把散装物料装入瓶罐封装

items.def_zh: 把（食物或饮料）装罐保存
items.def_en: to preserve fruit, vegetables, or drinks by sealing them in airtight metal cans
to put items into bags or pouches for retail packaging or storage

items.def_zh: 把……装瓶；抑制，压抑（感情，通常作 bottle up）
items.def_en: 1. To put liquid or other products into bottles. 2. (bottle up) To repress or conceal strong emotions.

items.def_zh: 包装，把……打包；把……组合包装销售
items.def_en: 1. To put something into a box, bag, or wrapping, especially for sale or transport. 2. To present or sell a set of things together as a unit.
(+ sth) Put liquid into bottles for preservation or sale
(+ sth) Put items or goods into boxes ready for storage, transport, or sale
(+ sth) Put goods or belongings into containers or parcels ready for dispatch

items.def_zh: 把（果酱、蜂蜜等）装入玻璃罐中
items.def_en: to put food or preserves into glass jars for storage or sale
chiefly BrE to preserve food by putting it into airtight tins

groups.summary_en: Refers to processing liquids or processed goods into retail-ready containers such as bottles, cans, or pre-measured sealed packets for distribution and sale.
groups.summary_zh: 将液体或加工商品分装入瓶、罐或预装包中以备销售。

groups.name: Broadcast & Transmit via Media · 广播与媒介传播 (Broadcast, Air, Stream)
groups.tip: 电台与电视信号的远距离播送

items.def_en: to broadcast a programme on television or radio

items.def_zh: 在线流媒体播放，网络直播
items.def_en: to transmit or receive continuous video or audio data over the internet

items.def_zh: 广播，播放（电视或电台节目）；散播，广而告之；播撒（种子）
items.def_en: 1. To transmit programmes or information by radio or television. 2. To tell a large number of people about something. 3. To scatter seeds widely over the ground.
to broadcast a program simultaneously across multiple channels or media

items.def_zh: 播送；发射（无线电或电视信号）
items.def_en: (+ sth) transmit a radio, television, or digital signal over a wide area
(+ sth) broadcast or issue a program, statement, or media message to the public
to receive a broadcast signal and transmit it onward to a broader audience
To broadcast an event, sports match, or programme on television.

items.def_zh: 通过电视播送，电视转播
items.def_en: To broadcast a programme or event on television.

groups.summary_en: Verbs referring to transmitting audio, video, or electronic signals to a public audience via radio, television, or digital networks.
groups.summary_zh: 通过无线电、电视或网络向公众播送音视频内容。

groups.name: Browse & Flip Through · 浏览与翻阅 (Scan, Thumb, Leaf through)
groups.tip: 随性浏览视线快速掠过

items.def_en: to turn the pages of a book, magazine, or document quickly, reading only fragments

items.def_zh: 浏览，翻阅；随意翻看（商品等）；（动物）吃草
items.def_en: 1. (+ through) To look casually through books, shops, or websites without searching for anything specific. 2. (zoology) (of animals) To feed on leaves, twigs, or other vegetation.
(+ sth) read, listen to, or examine short parts of a book or collection casually without reading the whole
to turn over pages or glance through items in rapid succession
to read or examine something very quickly and cursorily
(+ sth) examine or flip through written materials, documents, or a collection quickly

items.def_zh: 翻阅，随手翻看；竖起拇指要求搭车
items.def_en: 1. ('thumb through') To turn the pages of a book or magazine quickly and casually with your thumb. 2. ('thumb a ride/lift') To hitchhike by signaling with your thumb.

items.def_zh: 略读，浏览；掠过，擦过；撇去（浮沫等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/over) To read a text quickly to get the main idea. 2. To move lightly and quickly just above or over a surface. 3. To remove cream, scum, or fat from the surface of a liquid.
to look through a text rapidly to locate specific information or grasp key points

groups.summary_en: An agent inspects written, printed, or visual material rapidly and superficially without reading exhaustively, often turning pages casually or searching for specific items. Verbs vary in whether physical pages are manipulated (thumb, flip) or text is visually glanced over (skim, scan).
groups.summary_zh: 不作通读地快速扫视文本或翻阅书页。

groups.name: Bungle & Botch · 笨拙搞砸 (Bungle, Botch, Muff)
groups.tip: 笨手笨脚把事情彻底搞砸

items.def_zh: 手足无措地漏接；笨拙失误
items.def_en: [I/T] to handle something clumsily, especially dropping a ball or mismanaging an open opportunity
to fail to perform or speak smoothly, especially forgetting lines or miscueing a shot

items.def_zh: 弄糟，搞砸；错失（良机、接球等）
items.def_en: to mishandle, bungle, or ruin something through clumsiness, such as a catch, shot, or opportunity
(+ sth) Thoroughly ruin or botch something through incompetence or carelessness
(+ sth) Mismanage or bungle an operation, plan, or system completely
(+ sth) Spoil, botch, or handle an opportunity or task badly

items.def_zh: 搞砸，笨手笨脚地把…弄糟
items.def_en: to do something badly, clumsily, or carelessly, often ruining an attempt or task
[I/T] to mismanage or ruin a situation completely through stupidity or carelessness
to spoil something completely through poor workmanship, carelessness, or lack of skill

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe spoiling a task, chance, or project through incompetence, clumsiness, or poor coordination. 'Muff' emphasizes mishandling a fleeting opportunity or simple physical execution, whereas 'bungle' and 'botch' imply thoroughly mishandling a complex operation or repair.
groups.summary_zh: 指因愚笨、笨拙或失职而彻底弄糟任务或错失良机。

groups.name: Burn to Destruction · 焦灼与焚毁 (Singe, Ash, Incinerate)
groups.tip: 火焰灼烧最终化为灰烬

items.def_zh: 烧焦，烤焦（表面）；轻微烧灼
items.def_en: To burn something slightly, especially on the surface or edge.
[T/I] to damage a surface with heat, changing its color or texture without destroying it
[T/I] to burn something until it becomes black carbon throughout its surface or structure
(+ sth) Remove or destroy something completely through the action of heat or flames
(+ sth) Destroy the interior of a structure or machine completely by fire

items.def_zh: 使化为灰烬；弹（香烟等）灰
items.def_en: 1. To burn or reduce something to ashes. 2. To flick ash from a cigarette or cigar.
to burn a dead body completely to ashes in a furnace
(+ sth) Destroy or be destroyed completely by fire down to the ground
to burn waste or material completely until nothing remains but ash

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate destructive thermal destruction, progressing in severity from superficial singeing of outer edges to total consumption and reduction to ash.
groups.summary_zh: 热能毁灭性破坏程度的递增，从仅燎焦边缘表面到化为灰烬或彻底焚毁。

groups.name: Calm & Pacify · 平息与抚慰 (Soothe, Placate, Appease, Mollify)
groups.tip: 安抚躁动情绪以恢复内心的宁静

items.def_en: to make someone or something calm and peaceful, or to become calm
(+ sb) Make someone less angry, excited, or agitated, or become quiet and relaxed
(+ sb) Become or cause someone to become less excited, angry, or emotional
(+ sb/sth) Become or cause to become calmer, less noisy, or less agitated
to gently calm feelings of distress, pain, or irritation

items.def_zh: 姑息，平息（通让步满足要求）
items.def_en: to pacify or placate someone by acceding to their demands

items.def_zh: 抚慰，平息，安抚；平定，平息（叛乱等）
items.def_en: 1. to make an angry, upset, or agitated person become calm and quiet 2. to bring peace to a violent or rebellious region, often by force
to stop someone from feeling angry or hostile by making concessions
to appease the anger, hurt, or anxiety of someone through conciliatory words

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote acting upon an agitated, anxious, or angry individual or crowd to restore peace and emotional balance. Registers vary from affectionate physical soothing ('soothe') to formal concession and mediation ('pacify', 'mollify', 'appease').
groups.summary_zh: 抚平他人焦躁、怒气或恐慌情绪，使其恢复宁静与平和状态。

groups.name: Catch & Secure Quarry · 捕获与擒拿 (Bag, Catch, Snare)
groups.tip: 追逐并抓住逃窜目标

items.def_en: to catch fish or game in a net, or succeed in capturing a criminal
(+ sb/sth) Gather or herd fugitives, suspects, or animals together for capture
(+ sb/sth) Find and catch a fugitive, animal, or quarry after thorough searching

items.def_zh: 猎获，捕杀；抢占，占有；把……装袋
items.def_en: 1. To catch or kill an animal while hunting. 2. To succeed in getting or capturing something before others do.

items.def_zh: 捉住，抓到；接住（catch 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of catch: to capture, seize, or intercept.

items.def_zh: 用罗网捕捉，设陷阱逮住
items.def_en: to catch an animal or person using a trap, wire, or net
to collect or gather wild animals or people together and pen them in
(+ sb/sth) Pursue a target or wild animal relentlessly until captured or killed
to seize or arrest someone suspected of committing a crime

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the successful tracking, entrapping, or seizing of game, targets, or fugitives into one's grasp or custody. Nuances distinguish simple interception from netting, trapping, or claiming a prize.
groups.summary_zh: 通过追捕、陷阱或抓握将猎物或目标截获并收入囊中。

groups.name: Cause & Bring About Outcomes · 致使与实现结果 (Cause, Effect, Bring About)
groups.tip: 带来或引起某种结果变化

items.def_en: to make something happen, especially something bad, unpleasant, or unexpected
(formal) to bring about or achieve; to cause a change or result to happen
to generate or lead directly to a specific outcome, effect, or response
to make something happen, especially a meaningful change or historical turn
(+ sth) Cause something to happen, begin, or exist
(+ sth) Result in or act as the direct precursor causing a specific outcome
(+ sth) Cause an event, conflict, or reaction to start suddenly

items.def_zh: 造成，促成，引起（变化、灾祸等）；精工制作，锻造
items.def_en: (literary/archaic past tense and past participle of work) to cause or bring about something, especially a change, destruction, or havoc
to be the underlying condition that produces or generates a situation or feeling

groups.summary_en: Verbs signifying operating as an effective agent or underlying driver that produces a tangible result, transformation, or state of affairs.
groups.summary_zh: 作为施因者发挥作用，促成某种既定结果或重大改变。

groups.name: Chat, Babble & Schmooze · 闲聊、漫谈与套近乎 (Yarn, Waffle, Schmooze)
groups.tip: 讲故事侃大山，或社交套近乎

items.def_en: to converse informally about trivial, everyday topics
Talk in a friendly, informal, and continuous manner

items.def_zh: 讲长篇故事，闲扯，侃大山
items.def_en: (informal) To tell long, often exaggerated stories, or chat leisurely.

items.def_zh: 胡扯，瞎扯，喋喋不休；犹豫不决，摇摆不定
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/about) (chiefly British informal) To talk or write a lot without saying anything clear or important. 2. (chiefly North American informal) To be unable to make a clear decision; waver.
to talk continuously about trivial matters, especially with acquaintances

groups.summary_zh: 从多个备选项中做出取舍，涵盖口语随选至专业严谨的甄选。

groups.summary_zh: 指沿着弯曲、闭合环形或椭圆轨迹回绕行进或环绕某物运动。

groups.summary_zh: 使用水或洗涤剂冲洗织物、发丝或硬质表面。

groups.name: Clear & Take Away · 清理与移走 (Clear, Remove, Eliminate)
groups.tip: 清理障碍以恢复原位空旷

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express causing an obstruction, item, or unwanted presence to be taken away from a particular location or receptacle, rendering the space free, vacant, or unburdened.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人、物或阻碍移走，以使场地空出或恢复通畅、无碍。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame concern delivering clinical interventions, administering drugs, or admitting individuals to medical facilities to manage illness, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 指实施临床照料、开药用药或收治入院以进行医疗干预。

groups.name: Coat & Encrust Surfaces · 饰面覆盖与结壳覆层 (Veneer, Encrust, Overlay)

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mechanically or chemically applying a distinct outer crust, facing, or decorative layer onto a substrate, changing its texture, finish, or external appearance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在基底表面贴面、加盖覆层或硬壳沉积极以改变质感与外观。

(+ sth) compress paper, fabric, or other soft material tightly into a small ball
[T/I] to press something firmly together with your fingers or hand

items.def_zh: 捏，掐，拧；夹痛，挤压；（俚语）偷窃；逮捕
items.def_en: 1. To squeeze someone's skin or an object tightly between your thumb and finger. 2. To squeeze painfully or hurt by being too tight. 3. (informal) To steal; to arrest.

items.def_zh: 揉成一团，揉拢；用软物填塞
items.def_en: To roll, compress, or fold paper, cloth, or soft material into a tight ball or pad; to pad or stuff with soft material.
to press and stretch dough or muscles firmly and repeatedly with the hands

groups.summary_en: Agents apply localized compressive pressure to malleable, flexible, or soft material or body parts using fingers, hands, or tools. Actions range from therapeutic rubbing to compacting material into a tight mass.
groups.summary_zh: 用手或工具对柔软、可塑物体进行按压、挤捏或搓压变形。

groups.name: Confer & Bestow Formally · 恩赐与赠予 (Grant, Gift, Contribute)
groups.tip: 自愿出资捐献做贡献

items.def_en: (+ sth) officially pass control, custody, or possession of property or rights to another

items.def_zh: 正式过户；立约转让（财产）
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) legally transfer ownership of property, title, or funds to a recipient
1. To officially give, allow, or bestow something, such as money, permission, or a right. 2. To admit or accept that something is true.
1. To give something to someone as a gift or present. 2. (usually passive: be gifted with) To naturally endow someone with a special quality or talent.

items.def_zh: 捐助，捐献，贡献；促成，起作用；投稿
items.def_en: 1. To give money, goods, time, or assistance toward a common fund or cause. 2. (+ to) To be one of the causes of an event or situation. 3. To write articles or stories for a publication.
(+ to) To give money, goods, or services voluntarily to a cause or charity
(+ sth) formally transfer ownership of rights, property, or claims to another by signature
(+ on/upon) To confer an honor, gift, or right ceremoniously from a position of authority
(+ with) To provide an institution or person with a permanent fund or source of income

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate transferring ownership of property, rights, funds, or privileges to a recipient without receiving commercial payment in return. They typically emphasize formal authorization, donor generosity, or voluntary societal philanthropy.
groups.summary_zh: 指不求对价地正式让渡财产、权力或向公益团体捐赠捐助。

groups.name: Confuse & Bewilder · 迷惑与困惑 (Confuse, Mystify, Bewilder)
groups.tip: 认知不清陷入迷茫

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse someone or make them unable to think clearly
to cause someone confusion because something is hard to understand or explain
(+ sb + into doing sth) to thoroughly confuse or mystify someone, often to manipulate them

items.def_zh: 使困惑，弄糊涂；混淆，把……混同
items.def_en: 1. To make someone unable to think clearly or understand something. 2. To mistake one person or thing for another.
(often passive) To confuse or puzzle someone, especially as a result of drinking alcohol.
to completely bewilder or frustrate someone by being inexplicable
to thoroughly perplex or daze someone with a mass of conflicting information or complexity

items.raw_cluster: 使困惑与迷惑 Confuse & Mystify
items.def_zh: 使迷惑，使困惑不解；使神秘化
items.def_en: To confuse or puzzle someone completely, often because something is impossible to understand or explain.

items.def_zh: 使目瞪口呆；使思维迟钝麻木
items.def_en: to astonish or daze someone so intensely that they are unable to think or react clearly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cognitive disruption where someone's mental clarity is impaired, ranging from mild disorienting mix-ups to profound, insoluble bafflement.
groups.summary_zh: 描述认知受到干扰与困惑，从轻微混乱到深度迷惑。

groups.name: Contain & Entail Components · 包含与牵涉 (Contain, Include, Entail)
groups.tip: 整体内纳入各个要素

items.def_zh: 包含，包括；把……列入（或计算在内）
items.def_en: To contain something as a part of a larger whole, or to make someone or something part of a group, list, or calculation.

items.def_zh: 包含，需要；涉及，牵涉；使参与，使卷入
items.def_en: 1. To include or require something as an essential, necessary, or unavoidable part. 2. To affect or concern someone or something. 3. To cause someone to participate in an activity.

items.def_zh: 包含，容纳；抑制，控制（情绪或局势）
items.def_en: 1. To have something inside or comprise something as an element or part. 2. To control or restrain a feeling or an escalating situation.
to include something as part of a larger system, plan, or whole
to consist of or be made up of particular parts or members
(+ sth) to include or encompass a range of things or ideas
(+ sth) to entail or carry along as an inevitable consequence or accompaniment

items.def_zh: 包罗，囊括（范围广泛的事物）
items.def_en: to include a wide range of ideas, subjects, or areas completely
To involve or require something as a necessary or inevitable part or consequence.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express mereological or implicational containment, describing what a whole incorporates as a physical part, constituent member, or necessary logical consequence.
groups.summary_zh: 表示整体对局部的物理包容、构成包含或逻辑上的必然伴随。

groups.name: Contest & Squabble · 锦标比拼与琐事争执 (Tourney, Squabble)
groups.tip: 赛场竞技或口舌纷争

items.def_en: (+ sb) engage in an angry dispute or petty argument with someone
quarrel or disagree sharply with someone, ending friendly relations

items.def_zh: 坦诚摊牌；当面争辩了结争端
items.def_en: argue openly with someone to resolve a contentious grievance or quarrel

items.def_zh: 参加（比武）锦标赛，比武竞逐
items.def_en: 1. (historical) To participate or compete in a tournament, especially a medieval joust.
(+ about/over) to argue incessantly about petty and trivial matters
1. (+ over/about/with) To argue noisily over trivial, unimportant matters.
(+ over/about) to argue or dispute aggressively and at length

items.def_zh: 骑枪比武，言语交锋抗衡
items.def_en: (+ with) to engage in a formal chivalric combat or compete fiercely for power/prestige
(+ into/out of) to obtain an advantage or overcome a dispute through scheming

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe scenarios of rivalry and petty disputes, contrasting formal organized combat or competition with noisy, trivial bickering between parties.
groups.summary_zh: 参加竞技锦标赛比试，或就琐碎小事口角争吵。

groups.name: Continuous Fluid Outpouring · 涌流与喷溢 (Gush, Spout, Spew)
groups.tip: 液体或气体喷薄涌出之态

items.def_en: to discharge or emanate in an abundant, continuous stream
to rise to the surface and overflow copiously from within
(+ sth) burst forth or gush rapidly and forcefully from an aperture
flow out suddenly and in massive, overpowering quantities

items.def_zh: 喷出，涌出；滔滔不绝地说，高谈阔论
items.def_en: 1. To shoot or pour out forcefully in a stream. 2. (informal, disapproving) To speak lengthily and tediously about something.
(+ sth) expel large volumes of liquid, gas, or matter forcefully and continuously
1. To flow out or spit out in large quantities and with great force. 2. To vomit.

items.def_zh: 涌出，迸出；滔滔不绝地说，过分热情地赞扬
items.def_en: 1. To flow out suddenly and in large amounts in a rapid stream. 2. To express great enthusiasm or praise in an exaggerated way.
to violently erupt or eject large masses of smoke, fire, or fumes into the air

groups.summary_en: Large volumes of liquid, gas, or debris are discharged continuously or copiously from an opening or conduit. Nuances differ by whether the outflow is driven by an upward/pressurized orifice (spout), an overwhelming volume (gush), or an uncontrolled, often repulsive ejection (spew).
groups.summary_zh: 大量流体或杂物自孔口汹涌倾泻、喷出或狂涌，突出流态与流向。

groups.name: Copulate & Fornicate · 媾和与寻欢 (Screw, Fornicate, Wench)
groups.tip: 动物或人类的交配交媾行为

items.def_en: (slang) to have sexual intercourse with someone

items.def_zh: 与……性交；用螺钉固定，拧紧；欺骗，坑害
items.def_en: 1. (slang) To have sexual intercourse with someone. 2. To fasten or tighten something with screws. 3. (informal) To cheat or treat someone unfairly.
to have sexual intercourse with someone (common polite euphemism)

items.def_zh: （尤指偶然或随便地）发生性关系，亲热
items.def_en: (+ with sb) to engage in sexual activity or intercourse with someone, often casually

items.def_zh: 同居，搭伙过日子（常带贬义或非婚色彩）
items.def_en: (+ with sb) to live and have a sexual relationship with someone without being married

items.def_zh: 搞暧昧，发生不正当性关系；鬼混
items.def_en: (+ with sb) to engage in casual sexual activity or have an illicit affair
(archaic) To associate promiscuously with women or frequent prostitutes.
(+ with) to live together and have a sexual relationship without being married

items.def_zh: 私通，通奸，（男女非婚）性交
items.def_en: (formal or dated) To have sexual intercourse with someone to whom one is not married.

groups.summary_en: Human participants engage in sexual intercourse, differentiated by taboo registers, moral/archaic censure, or vulgar euphemism.
groups.summary_zh: 多指人类性交行为，区别在于粗俗用语、宗教道德谴责或古风寻欢。

groups.name: Corrode & Decay · 腐蚀与变质 (Corrode, Oxidize, Ret)
groups.tip: 化学作用导致质地瓦解

items.def_en: (+ at) to progressively consume or dissolve a substance by chemical degradation
(+ sth) to gradually become thinner, smoother, or eroded through friction, moisture, or chemical action
to decay slowly and completely through natural or bacterial action until disintegrated
(+ sth) to corrode completely or form holes as a result of rusting
[I/T] to undergo oxidation resulting in the formation of reddish-brown iron oxide
[I/T] to lose or cause to lose metallic luster through exposure to air or moisture
(chemistry) To combine with oxygen, or cause to combine with oxygen; to undergo or cause to undergo a reaction in which electrons are lost.

items.def_zh: 沤（麻等），沤制；使受潮腐解
items.def_en: To soak flax, hemp, or other plant stalks in water or expose them to moisture to loosen the fibers by rotting the outer tissue.
[I/T] to slowly wear away or destroy a metal, stone, or surface by chemical action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario cover natural, chemical, and biochemical processes where moisture, oxygen, acid, or bacterial soaking slowly break down material integrity. Registers range from industrial chemistry to agricultural soaking and elemental rust.
groups.summary_zh: 材料在化学反应、氧气或微生物浸泡作用下逐渐侵蚀、分解及变质。

groups.name: Course Deviation & Directional Shifting · 航向偏转与走向漂移 (Veer, Trend, Port)
groups.tip: 突然偏离既定航线

items.def_en: to move slowly and unintentionally away from a course or designated line

items.def_zh: （舵、船等）转向左舷，向左转舵；持（枪）
items.def_en: 1. (nautical) To turn or steer a ship or aircraft to the left or port side. 2. (military) To carry a weapon diagonally across the body.

items.def_zh: （朝某一方向）偏向，转向；显现……倾向；（在社交媒体上）流行
items.def_en: 1. To change direction or veer sharply in a particular course. 2. To show a general tendency or development. 3. To be currently popular on social media.
(of a ship, aircraft, or vehicle) to turn temporarily off course to the left or right
(+ sth) to change heading or orientation quickly toward another direction
to suddenly or noticeably turn away from an intended path, course, or direction
to change the course of a boat by turning its head into the wind so the sails shift
(+ from) to depart from an established course, standard, or path
to change direction smoothly or suddenly, especially of wind, a vehicle, or course

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe gradual or prescribed changes in direction, heading, or orientation, whether driven by mechanical navigation (nautical/aeronautical) or dynamic momentum.
groups.summary_zh: 交通工具或运动物体的偏转、航向调整或宏观走向的漂移。

groups.name: Court & Woo · 追求与求爱 (Court, Romance, Woo)
groups.tip: 男女恋爱关系中的倾心追求场景

items.def_zh: 追求，向……求爱；设法取悦，拉拢；招致
items.def_en: 1. To pursue a romantic relationship with someone, especially with a view to marriage. 2. To try to gain the favor or support of someone. 3. To invite or risk causing something unpleasant.
(archaic) to act as a suitor; court someone
to try to start a sexual or romantic relationship with someone

items.def_zh: 追求，向……求爱；讨好，拉拢；虚构
items.def_en: 1. To court someone or show romantic affection toward them. 2. To try to win the favor, business, or support of someone. 3. To invent or exaggerate stories.
(+ sb) to invite someone out on a date with romantic intent
(+ sb) to talk flirtatiously to someone with the aim of attracting them romantically
(+ sb) to demonstrate sexual or romantic interest in someone through forward words or actions
to seek the affection or favor of someone, especially with a view to marriage
to sing or play a song for someone in a romantic manner

groups.summary_en: A suitor makes romantic overtures to someone with the aim of winning affection, initiating a relationship, or securing marriage. Verbs range from romantic attentiveness to formal traditional wooing.
groups.summary_zh: 向心仪之人示好、献殷勤以博取芳心并结为伴侣的情感追求过程。

groups.name: Cover Surface with Sheet Material · 贴纸与薄层敷裹覆盖
groups.tip: 盖覆于表层以掩蔽或护底

items.def_zh: 用壁纸裱糊，用纸张遮盖
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cover a wall or damaged surface with wallpaper or paper sheeting
(+ sth) to fix paper, posters, or sheeting onto a wall or surface using adhesive
(+ sth) to fasten or hang wallpaper or notices onto a wall or flat surface
to put a layer of protective paper, foil, or fabric on the inner surface of an item

items.def_zh: 覆盖，遮盖；掩蔽，保护；包含，涉及
items.def_en: 1. To place something over or upon something else in order to protect, conceal, or decorate it. 2. To deal with, include, or provide for something.

items.def_zh: 给（墙壁等）贴壁纸；用纸包装，用纸覆盖
items.def_en: 1. To apply wallpaper to a wall or room. 2. To cover or wrap something with paper.
to apply decorative paper to the interior walls of a room
(+ with/in) to hang cloth or a covering loosely and casually over an object

items.def_zh: 用外皮或护套紧密包覆
items.def_en: to enclose a surface or structure tightly within a protective casing or skin

groups.summary_en: Denotes the physical action of spreading an exterior layer over a surface, particularly applying wallpaper, protective paper, or general sheeting over walls or furniture.
groups.summary_zh: 通过张贴墙纸、蒙纸或敷层等方式将物体表面彻底遮覆。

groups.name: Creative Art & Music Making · 艺术与音乐创作 (Compose, Improvise, Stylize)
groups.tip: 构思谱写作品或登台演绎

items.def_en: to write or arrange music for a film, play, or specific set of instruments
To write lyrics for a piece of music or song.
[I/T] to write or create a piece of music, poetry, or literature

items.def_zh: 演奏爵士乐；跳爵士舞；使生动活泼 (jazz up)
items.def_en: 1. To play music in the style of jazz. 2. ('jazz up') To make something more lively, interesting, or colorful.

items.def_zh: （在音乐或艺术上）对……即兴发挥
items.def_en: (+ sth) to play or produce an artistic or musical improvisation based on an existing theme or idea
to improvise music casually alongside other musicians or a recording
[I/T] to create or perform music, poetry, or drama spontaneously without preparation

items.def_zh: 将……改编为剧本；戏剧化表现
items.def_en: to adapt a novel, event, or story into a theatrical or broadcast drama

items.def_zh: 把……改编成小说（或戏剧、电影），使虚构化
items.def_en: To write a novel, play, or film based on real events or people with invented details.

groups.summary_en: An artist, writer, or musician crafts creative material or adapts subject matter into a particular expressive or musical style. Typical constructions include writing words for music, improvising on an instrument, or reshaping reality into art.
groups.summary_zh: 艺术家或创作者创作艺术品、谱写词曲或对现实进行艺术化风格加工。

groups.name: Creep & Advance Slowly · 挪动与缓行 (Inch, Edge, Sidle)
groups.tip: 一点一滴艰难挪移

items.def_zh: 缓慢移动，艰难挪动；使缓慢挪动
items.def_en: To move very slowly or carefully in a particular direction, or make something do this.
(+ around/past) to walk softly on one's toes to proceed quietly and unobtrusively
(+ on sb/sth) to approach someone or something slowly, silently, and imperceptibly

items.def_zh: 悄悄挪开，蹑手蹑脚退开
items.def_en: to move slowly, quietly, and cautiously away from someone or something
to move ahead very slowly, gradually, and by tiny degrees

items.def_zh: 缓缓移动，徐徐挪动；给……镶边；微弱胜过
items.def_en: 1. To move slowly and carefully in a specified direction, or make something move this way. 2. To give a border or edge to something.

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚移动，悄然蠕动前进
items.def_en: (+ along/up) to move slowly, quietly, and carefully, usually to avoid notice
(+ up to/toward) to walk or move in a secretive, timid, or sideways manner
[I/T] (+ into/through) to move with difficulty through a narrow space by writhing or creeping

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify moving forward, sideways, or through a tight space in tiny, cautious, or imperceptible increments. The motion is deliberate, often guarded or furtive, emphasizing fractional displacement.
groups.summary_zh: 极其缓慢、谨慎或隐秘地逐步挪动移位。

groups.name: Crowd & Huddle · 拥挤与簇拥 (Mass, Huddle, Cluster)
groups.tip: 由散到齐合聚一处

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ around/together) to gather or arrange closely in a small, compact group
[I/T] (+ against/into) to settle snugly and closely against one another

items.def_zh: 团团围住，蜂拥聚在周围
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to gather closely together around a person, object, or focal point in large numbers

items.def_zh: 蜷缩挤作一团，簇拥在一起
items.def_en: to press closely together in a tight, compact group for warmth or security
To gather or bring together into a large mass, crowd, or group.
[I/T] (+ into/around) to pack closely together in large numbers into a tight space

items.def_zh: 挤作一团，拥挤；蜷缩；把……聚集在一起；碰头密谈
items.def_en: 1. (+ together) To crowd or cause to crowd closely together in a small group. 2. (+ up) To curl one's body closely up for warmth or comfort. 3. To gather privately to discuss something.
(+ sth) to enter and fill a space tightly and in very large numbers
[I/T] to fill or press into a place in a dense, bustling mass

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict people or entities packing tightly together in a constrained physical arrangement. Nuances contrast sprawling bulk buildup with crouched or protective spatial compression.
groups.summary_zh: 以挤压、紧抱或密集堆叠的方式簇拥挤拢在一起。

groups.name: Crumble & Splinter · 碎裂与崩解 (Crumb, Splinter, Flake)
groups.tip: 外力撞击，由裂缝至成碎末

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ off/away) to come off or shed in small, thin, flat pieces
break down into small crumbs or brittle particles
come off a surface in thin, dry layers or small flakes
[I/T] to break a small piece off the edge or surface of something hard
[I/T] to break or cause to break into small fragments or powder, especially through dryness or decay

items.def_zh: 弄碎，捏碎（面包等）；裹上面包屑；清理桌面面包屑
items.def_en: 1. to break something (especially bread or cake) into small fragments or crumbs. 2. to coat food with breadcrumbs before cooking. 3. to brush crumbs off a table.
(+ sth) break a small, hard fragment off the edge or surface of something, or break away in such a manner

items.def_zh: （使）裂成碎片，分裂成小块；（使组织等）分裂
items.def_en: 1. to break or cause something to break into thin, sharp pieces. 2. (of a group, political party, etc.) to split or divide into smaller, opposing factions.

items.def_zh: 碎裂裂开成尖碎片；脱落崩裂
items.def_en: break or split away from a larger mass in sharp, slender fragments

groups.summary_en: A brittle or dry substance breaks or sheds into tiny crumbs, fragments, or sharp slithers due to dryness, structural weakness, or mechanical stress. Scale progresses from minor flaking/crumbling to violent longitudinal splintering.
groups.summary_zh: 干燥脆性物体脱落碎屑，或受力迸裂成细小锐利的碎片。

groups.name: Cry & Weep · 哭泣与抽泣 (Cry, Weep, Sob)
groups.tip: 从无声默默垂泪到放声痛哭流涕

items.def_en: to make weak, low, broken crying sounds of hurt or fear

items.def_zh: 抽泣，啜泣；哭诉，抽抽搭搭地哭
items.def_en: 1. To cry and complain in a weak, whining, self-pitying way while sniffling.
to utter a loud, tearful, or anguished sound caused by grief, distress, or pain
to cry noisily while taking sudden, convulsive breaths

items.def_zh: 痛哭失声，情绪崩溃落泪
items.def_en: to lose control of one's emotions and begin weeping bitterly

items.def_zh: 潸然泪下，突然嚎啕大哭
items.def_en: to suddenly begin crying passionately or copiously

items.def_zh: 哭泣，流泪；（伤口等）渗出液体
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) To cry tears because of deep sadness, pain, or joy. 2. When a wound or sore weeps, liquid oozes slowly from it.
to cry very loudly and unrestrainedly, like an upset child
to utter long, high-pitched cries of pain, grief, or distress

groups.summary_en: An individual sheds tears and produces vocalizations in reaction to sadness, relief, pain, or overwhelm. Verbs describe specific physiological manners such as convulsive chest heaves, audible wailing, or whiny complaints.
groups.summary_zh: 因悲伤、委屈或痛苦而流泪抽噎，区分眼泪流淌的剧烈度、声响及情绪控制力。

groups.name: Cuddle & Nestle · 依偎与贴近 (Snuggle, Nestle, Nuzzle)
groups.tip: 亲昵舒适地紧挨靠拢依偎

items.def_en: (+ to sb) to sit or lie very close to someone in an affectionate, comfortable way
to settle comfortably, warmly, and snugly into a resting place

items.def_zh: 依偎，偎依（以取暖或示爱）
items.def_en: (+ to/against sb) to move into a warm, comfortable, and close position against someone
[I/T] to hold someone close in an affectionate way, or to lie close together comfortably

items.def_zh: 依偎，偎靠；半隐半现地坐落，依傍；抱，抱在怀里
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/against/in) To settle comfortably and warmly against someone or in a sheltered place. 2. (of a place or building) To be situated half-hidden or pleasantly sheltered.

items.def_zh: 依偎，蜷伏，紧挨；使依偎，紧抱入怀
items.def_en: (+ up/against/into) To settle or move into a warm, comfortable position, especially by curling up or pressing closely against someone.
[I/T] to touch, rub, or press gently with the nose or face against someone or something
to sit or lie in a comfortable position with your legs drawn up close to your body
to settle oneself deeply and cozily into a bed or warm wrapping

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe settling closely, comfortably, and affectionately against someone or into a cozy place. They differ in physical focal points, such as pressing with the nose/face versus curling up one's entire body.
groups.summary_zh: 指亲昵、舒适地紧挨他人或蜷入温暖处，侧重身体依偎或面部蹭抚。

groups.name: Cultivate & Discipline · 育人与培养 (School, Train, Educate)
groups.tip: 循循善诱言传身教

items.def_en: (+ sb) to care for and educate a child until they are fully grown

items.def_zh: 教育，训练，培养；成群游动
items.def_en: 1. To educate, train, or discipline someone in a particular skill or habit. 2. (of fish) To swim together in a school.

items.def_zh: 训练，培养；接受训练，锻炼；瞄准，对准
items.def_en: 1. To teach a person or animal a particular skill or behavior through sustained practice. 2. To prepare for a sport or job by practicing. 3. To aim or point something at an object.
To provide with knowledge, skills, or training through formal instruction or schooling.

items.def_zh: 培养，陶冶（品格、素养或才能）
items.def_en: To foster the growth, refinement, and development of a quality, skill, or person

items.def_zh: 悉心养育，培育（促进成长）
items.def_en: To care for and encourage the growth or development of someone or something

items.def_zh: 向……灌输；通过反复操练使掌握
items.def_en: (+ sth + into sb) to impart habits, facts, or discipline into someone through rigorous repetition
[I/T] (+ in) To instruct or train someone thoroughly by repeating an exercise or routine strictly

items.def_zh: 训导，管教（使守规矩、受纪律约束）
items.def_en: To train someone to obey rules or a code of behavior, often using punishment

groups.summary_en: An institutional or familial agent develops a person's intellect, character, or professional habits over an extended developmental timeframe, moving from routine conditioning to formal schooling and holistic cultivation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过体制化、长周期的教育、训练与规训塑造个体。

groups.name: Cultivate & Plant · 播种与栽种 (Plant, Sow, Seed)
groups.tip: 重新种植花木培育新生

items.def_en: to put a plant, tree, or seed into the ground so that it will grow
[I/T] to plant seeds in an area of ground

items.def_zh: 将（幼苗）移栽入户外露地
items.def_en: (+ sth) to plant seedlings or young plants into open soil outdoors to grow
(+ sth) to transplant young plants or flowers into an outdoor bed or garden plot

items.def_zh: 栽下，播种（花卉/蔬菜/庄稼）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place seeds, bulbs, or seedlings into the soil to grow
to move a growing plant from one place to another to grow it elsewhere
[I/T] to plant seeds in the ground, often by scattering them
To plant crops, trees, or flowers again in an area, or to dig up a plant and put it in a new place.
To sow seeds again on land or a lawn, especially where vegetation has been damaged.

groups.summary_en: A cultivator places seeds, seedlings, or plants into soil or an agricultural substrate to grow crops or restore vegetation. Verbs range from general planting to scattering seeds ('sow') or refreshing a depleted area ('replant', 'reseed').
groups.summary_zh: 在土壤或苗圃中播撒种子或栽植苗木以促其生长。

groups.name: Cultivate & Raise Crops · 耕作与栽培
groups.tip: 农耕园艺与动植物培育

items.def_en: nurture and raise crops, vegetables, or plants from seeds or shoots
breed or grow crops, plants, or livestock on an agricultural scale
To grow or cultivate cells, bacteria, or tissues in a specially prepared artificial medium.

items.def_zh: 耕作，务农；经营（农场），饲养，种植
items.def_en: 1. To grow crops or raise animals on land or in water, especially for commercial production. 2. To use a piece of land for agriculture.

items.def_zh: 从事园艺，照料花园；种植花木
items.def_en: To work in a garden, growing plants, flowers, or vegetables.

items.def_zh: 促使（作物或幼苗）快速生长
items.def_en: (+ sth) to encourage plants or crops to grow or mature more quickly
(+ sth) to plant a growing seedling or cutting into a pot with soil
raise and nurture plants or crops for human sustenance or commercial use
breed specimens of a plant naturally or artificially from the parent stock

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the broader biological and agricultural process of raising, managing, and nurturing plants, crops, or microorganisms from germination through harvest.
groups.summary_zh: 从播种到收获全程培植作物、果蔬或微生物的农艺生长管理活动。

groups.name: Cultivate & Sow · 耕作与播种 (Cultivate, Sow, Till)
groups.tip: 农耕播种与精心培植

items.def_en: [I/T] to place seeds, bulbs, or seedlings in the ground so that they will grow
to prepare and cultivate land for crops by plowing or harrowing
(+ sth) to bury growing crops, stubble, or plants into the soil by plowing
(+ sth) to dig up and invert soil with a spade or plow to prepare it for planting

items.def_zh: 全面播种（使成草地或覆盖物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to plant an area of land with grass or a crop to establish vegetative cover

items.def_zh: 耕作，耕耘；培育，培植；培养，建立（关系）
items.def_en: 1. To prepare and use land for growing crops, or to grow plants and crops. 2. To develop or improve an attitude, skill, or relationship deliberately.

items.def_zh: 播种，散播（种子）；散布，激起（怀疑、争端等）
items.def_en: 1. To plant seeds in or on the ground. 2. To introduce or spread feelings, ideas, or doubts that cause problems later.
[I/T] to turn up the earth with a plow before sowing seeds
to break up and level plowed ground using a harrow

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe agricultural preparation and planting, where a farmer or gardener prepares soil, deposits seeds, or tends growing crops. They range from breaking and turning earth to planting and nurturing.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及农事准备、整地翻土、播种与作物培植的全套农耕动作。

groups.name: Curse & Swear · 咒骂与爆粗 (Curse, Swear, Blaspheme)
groups.tip: 情绪失控时用脏话咒骂

items.def_en: to use rude or offensive language, especially because you are angry
(+ sb) to direct offensive, taboo, or profane words angrily at someone
[I/T] to use offensive words against someone or to wish evil upon them

items.def_zh: 咒骂，说粗话（fuck 的委婉说法，常与 off 连用）
items.def_en: (slang, euphemistic) to curse or swear, used as a substitute for 'fuck'
(informal, chiefly North American) to swear, curse, or use offensive language
(+ sb) to berate someone using explicit insults and foul language
(+ sb) to yell profanities at someone in an outburst of anger
[I/T] to speak disrespectfully about God or sacred things, often using religious oaths
to express extreme hatred or denounce someone with venomous curses

groups.summary_en: Speakers utter profane, taboo, or offensive words to vent intense anger, frustration, or hostility toward someone or something. Verbs range from mild colloquial profanity to explicit, venomous cursing.
groups.summary_zh: 通过使用亵渎性、禁忌或粗俗词语发泄愤怒与不满，由口语爆粗延伸至恶毒咒骂。

groups.name: Cut & Sever · 切割与截断 (Saw, Sever, Section)
groups.tip: 用刀刃等工具斩断分割

items.def_zh: 切片，分段；把……分成部分；依法强行送入精神病院
items.def_en: 1. To cut or divide something into sections, slices, or segments. 2. (British English, law) To commit someone compulsorily to a psychiatric hospital.
to cut, slice, or divide something precisely into two equal parts
(+ sth) pierce and divide an object completely using a sharp blade
(+ sth) slice or cut away an unwanted part, such as a branch, with a swift stroke
(+ sth) remove or sever a portion of an object by cutting through it with a saw
(+ through/off) to cut wood, metal, or stone using a back-and-forth serrated blade
(+ off) to chop or cut off branches, limbs, or protruding parts with a decisive stroke
(+ sth) sever a part or piece from something with a heavy, sharp blow
(+ from) to divide or cut completely through something, detaching one part from another

groups.summary_en: An agent separates physical material into distinct pieces or cuts completely through an object using a blade, saw, or specialized cutting implement.
groups.summary_zh: 利用锯子、刀刃或切割工具截断、锯断或切分实体。

groups.name: Daily Meals & Eating Regimens · 日常进餐与膳食习惯 (Dine, Feast, Sup)
groups.tip: 一日三餐早午餐进食用餐

items.def_en: To eat lunch, the midday meal.
To restrict one's intake of food or eat prescribed foods, especially to lose weight or for medical reasons.
eat the first meal of the day
to have a meal in a restaurant rather than at home

items.def_zh: 外出赴宴；在餐馆进晚餐
items.def_en: to eat an evening meal away from home, especially at a formal restaurant
(+ on/upon) eat large quantities of rich food with great enjoyment

items.def_zh: 吃晚饭（文雅或旧式用法）
items.def_en: eat supper, especially in a quiet or traditional context
eat dinner, especially in a formal or leisurely setting
To eat brunch, a meal eaten late in the morning as a combination of breakfast and lunch.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the routine act of eating specific daily meals (such as lunch or dinner) or adhering to a structured dietary regimen. They differ primarily by the specific meal referenced and the degree of social formality or nutritional restriction involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指按日常时段享用正餐或依特定膳食规则进食。

groups.name: Dart & Whisk · 飞掠与轻盈拂动 (Dart, Whisk, Flit)
groups.tip: 轻盈迅速地掠过移动

items.def_en: to make rapid, light, irregular fluttering movements

items.def_zh: 轻盈敏捷地四处飞掠或穿梭
items.def_en: move swiftly, lightly, and erratically from one place to another
[I/T] to move quickly and lightly over or close to a surface without touching it heavily

items.def_zh: 嗖地掠过，嗖地挥动；（使）发出嗖嗖声
items.def_en: 1. To move quickly through the air or water making a soft whistling or rushing sound, or to make something move in this way.

items.raw_cluster: 掠过与飞快移动 Dart & Flit
items.def_zh: 轻快掠过，轻捷移动；（轻快地）飞来飞去
items.def_en: 1. To move lightly and swiftly from one place or subject to another.

items.def_zh: 突然飞快地跑开或冲走
items.def_en: run or move away suddenly and rapidly

items.def_zh: 迅速轻巧地带走或移开
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) take or carry someone or something away very quickly and smoothly
[I/T] to move suddenly and rapidly in a particular direction
[T/I] to brush or sweep lightly and quickly, or move someone away abruptly

groups.summary_en: An entity moves rapidly, lightly, and suddenly from place to place, often making a light whishing sound or fluttering sweep.
groups.summary_zh: 轻捷快速地闪掠、穿梭或轻抚而过。

groups.name: Dash & Bolt · 飞奔与疾驰 (Dash, Bolt, Sprint)
groups.tip: 如箭离弦短促飞驰

items.def_en: to move hurriedly with short, rapid steps
leave a place very hurriedly

items.def_zh: 猝然疾驰逃窜；拔腿飞奔
items.def_en: suddenly rush away in a burst of speed, often out of fright or urgency
leave or run away at tremendous speed

items.def_zh: 脱缰疾走，突然夺路而逃
items.def_en: to run away suddenly and rapidly out of control or in panic

items.def_zh: 猛冲，急奔；猛击，猛掷；使（希望、梦想等）破灭
items.def_en: 1. To run or move somewhere very quickly. 2. To strike or throw something violently against a surface. 3. To destroy someone's hopes, dreams, or expectations.

items.def_zh: 飞奔，疾驰；在……上留条纹，布满条纹；裸奔
items.def_en: 1. To move very fast in a specified direction. 2. To mark with stripes or streaks.
to run at maximum possible speed for a short distance
(+ along/down) to move or run with reckless, violent speed

groups.summary_en: An agent suddenly bursts into rapid, high-intensity running across a distance, characterized by abrupt acceleration and rushing velocity.
groups.summary_zh: 突然发力、高速冲刺或迅猛奔跑。

groups.name: Dawdle & Delay · 拖延与磨蹭 (Piddle, Temporize, Stall)
groups.tip: 游手好闲虚度时间慢吞吞

items.def_en: waste time doing unimportant or trivial things instead of taking action
to waste time through aimless indecision or loitering

items.def_zh: 磨蹭，虚度光阴（piddle around/away）；撒尿
items.def_en: 1. (informal) to waste time on trivial matters; dawdle (often followed by around or away). 2. (informal or euphemistic) to urinate.

items.def_zh: 故意拖长；拖延（时间或进程）
items.def_en: (+ sth) prolong an event, process, or discussion unnecessarily
to deliberately delay taking action so as to gain time to think or prepare

items.def_zh: 设法拖延以争取（时间等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) deliberately delay taking action in order to gain an advantage or more time
[I/T] to intentionally delay or play for time in order to gain an advantage
to habitually or intentionally delay doing something that should be done

items.def_zh: 拖延时间以待时机，搪塞；顺应潮流，妥协
items.def_en: (formal) to delay making a decision or taking action in order to gain time.

groups.summary_en: A person deliberately or carelessly avoids action or postpones a definitive outcome through time-wasting, trifles, or diplomatic stalling maneuvers. Nuances range from petty foot-dragging to calculated strategic delay in negotiation.
groups.summary_zh: 无所事事地瞎磨蹭，或为争取时间而策略性地拖延表态。

groups.name: Debilitate & Incapacitate · 虚弱与致残 (Weaken, Debilitate, Incapacitate)
groups.tip: 使力量或机能逐渐丧失

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become less strong, powerful, or effective physically or structurally
to make someone or something extremely weak, frail, and devoid of vitality

items.def_zh: 逐渐消耗，慢慢剥夺（力量或元气）
items.def_en: (+ sth) gradually drain or weaken someone's energy, strength, or resolve

items.def_zh: 逐渐削弱（体力、抵抗力或意志）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) gradually weaken someone's physical strength, endurance, or resistance

items.def_zh: 击倒；使（因伤病而）卧床不起
items.def_en: (+ sb) force someone to take to bed or incapacitate them through illness or injury
to damage someone's body or an organization so severely that normal function is destroyed

items.def_zh: 使虚弱，使衰弱；削弱（机构、经济等）
items.def_en: To make a person, body, or organization very weak and unable to function normally.

items.def_zh: 使丧失能力；使不能正常运转；剥夺……的合法资格
items.def_en: To deprive someone of the physical or mental ability or legal capacity to do something or function normally.

items.def_zh: 使瘫痪，使丧失行动能力
items.def_en: to cause a person or system to become completely unable to move or operate

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the progressive impairment of physical strength, health, or operational capability. They range from rendering someone moderately weak or fragile to completely neutralizing their ability to function, move, or fight back.
groups.summary_zh: 使身体机能或运作能力逐渐受损乃至完全瘫痪。

groups.name: Deceive & Dissemble · 欺瞒与掩饰伪装 (Dissemble, Dissimulate, Mask)
groups.tip: 掩饰真情故意隐瞒欺诈

items.def_en: to adopt an artificial manner of speech, demeanor, or posture to impress or mislead
to hide a feeling, smell, fact, or intention so that others do not notice it

items.def_zh: 掩盖，掩饰（真相、错误或真实情感）
items.def_en: (+ sth) conceal facts, bad actions, or true feelings behind an untruthful appearance

items.def_zh: 避重就轻地掩饰；掩饰带过
items.def_en: (+ sth) deliberately avoid dealing with unpleasant or dishonest truths by treating them lightly

items.def_zh: 掩饰，粉饰（分歧、裂痕或缺陷）
items.def_en: (+ sth) hide or disguise flaws, disagreements, or deceit beneath a superficial show of unity
(+ in) to disguise, hide, or cover something unpleasant or secret
to pretend to have a particular feeling, condition, or illness

items.def_zh: 掩饰，掩盖（真实情感或意图）；假装
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To hide your true feelings, intentions, or motives behind a false appearance.

items.def_zh: 掩饰，隐瞒（真实感情或意图）；假装
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To hide your real feelings, thoughts, or intentions by pretending.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify dishonest communication achieved by hiding one's actual feelings, intentions, or character behind a false, deceptive exterior.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过掩盖真实意图、情绪或真相，戴上面具以混淆视听的欺瞒方式。

groups.name: Deceive & Dupe Informally · 戏弄与扯谎欺骗 (Fool, Dupe, Bullshit)
groups.tip: 把对方当傻子戏弄与耍弄

items.def_en: to deceive someone playfully or jokingly as a jest
(+ sb) tease someone by attempting to make them believe something untrue

items.def_zh: 误导，哄骗（使抱有虚假期望）
items.def_en: (+ sb) mislead someone into believing something false, especially about one's intentions

items.def_zh: 忽悠，假意敷衍吊人胃口
items.def_en: to deceive someone over time by giving false hope or insincere promises
(+ sb) successfully deceive or dupe someone into believing a falsehood

items.def_zh: 愚弄，欺骗；干傻事，开玩笑（fool around）
items.def_en: 1. To trick, deceive, or make a dupe of someone. 2. To behave in a silly or playful way.
1. (informal, taboo) To say things that are untrue or exaggerated in order to deceive, impress, or mislead someone.

items.def_zh: 欺骗，愚弄（使其上当受骗）
items.def_en: (+ into) to deceive someone easily into doing or believing something foolish
(+ into) to confuse and deceive someone deliberately, often through trickery

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe informally misleading, tricking, or feeding someone false narratives to make them believe an untruth, ranging from playful teasing to cynical fabrication.
groups.summary_zh: 非正式地愚弄、哄骗或胡扯以使人信以为真。

groups.name: Deceive & Swindle · 欺诈与诈取 (Swindle, Bilk, Gyp)
groups.tip: 通过不当手段骗取财物

items.def_en: (+ out of) to act dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage or take somebody's money
(+ into/out of) to trick somebody into doing something or giving away money after gaining their trust
(+ sb) cheat someone by charging them too much money or stealing from them
(+ sb + sth) trick someone into giving away money or possessions through deception
(+ sb + sth) obtain money or possessions dishonestly from someone by fraudulent means
(+ of) to unfairly obtain an exorbitant amount of money from somebody through trickery or overcharging
(+ out of) to cheat somebody out of money or property using fraudulent schemes
1. (+ out of) (informal, sometimes offensive) To cheat or swindle someone out of money or fair value.
1. (+ out of) To cheat someone out of money owed to them, or to avoid paying a bill.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cheating, tricking, or defrauding an individual or entity out of money, goods, or rights through deceitful schemes or bad-faith transactions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过虚假交易、花招或违约手段骗取他人钱财或应得之物。

groups.name: Declaim & Intone · 歌咏与诵念 (Chant, Intone, Recite)
groups.tip: 有节奏地诵念经文或诗歌

items.def_en: (+ sth) to declaim or intone words in a dull, flat, and monotonous voice
[I/T] Sing or hum in a soft, low, intimate, and soothing voice
(+ sth) to recite or declaim a long list, poem, or memorized piece of text quickly and easily

items.def_zh: 吟诵，念唱（经文等）；反复呼喊，齐声喊唱
items.def_en: 1. To sing or recite a religious prayer or liturgical text on a monotone or simple melody. 2. To repeat a word, phrase, or slogan rhythmically together with a crowd.
1. To sing cheerful Christmas carols or songs of joy, especially in groups outdoors.

items.def_zh: 背诵，朗诵；逐一列举，详述
items.def_en: 1. To say a poem, speech, or passage aloud from memory before an audience. 2. To list or describe a series of facts, complaints, or items one by one.
[T/I] Say or recite text with little rise and fall of the pitch of the voice, chant-like
[I/T] Chant or sing sacred liturgical text or scripture according to musical notations
[I/T] Utter words, rhetoric, or poetry aloud in an impassioned, formal, oratorical manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the vocal delivery of memorized, sacred, poetic, or ritual text using musical, rhythmic, or stylized cadence. Register moves from celebratory song-bursts to liturgical droning or formal rhetorical declamation.
groups.summary_zh: 指以抑扬顿挫的语调、唱诵或富有节奏感的声调背诵、念经或歌咏。

groups.name: Decommission & Invalidate · 退役与使作废 (Decommission, Nullify, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 法律条约宣布作废或器械退役

items.def_en: to permanently withdraw machinery, ships, or aircraft from active service

items.def_zh: 退役；解除戒备；撤出服役
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) withdraw from active service, operational readiness, or an official post
(+ sb/sth) officially revoke the accreditation, legal standing, or operational validity of someone or a document

items.def_zh: 逐步淘汰；逐步停用退役
items.def_en: (+ sth) gradually withdraw something from operational use over a period of time
to cancel the legal validity of a transaction, instrument, or contract
to make an argument, document, ticket, or legal agreement officially no longer valid

items.def_zh: 使无效，废弃，取消；使失去作用，使抵消
items.def_en: 1. to make an agreement, law, or result legally void and ineffective 2. to cause something to lose its value, effect, or power

items.def_zh: 使退役，停用（军舰、武器或核设施等）
items.def_en: to officially withdraw a ship, aircraft, nuclear power plant, or weapons system from active service

items.def_zh: 封存备用；封存（装备/工厂）
items.def_en: to take equipment, ships, or industrial facilities out of active operation while preserving them in storage

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize ending the operational lifecycle or functional validity of tangible assets, facilities, weapons, or legal documents, rendering them void or decommissioned.
groups.summary_zh: 使设施、装备退役停用，或使证件、文书失去效力。

groups.name: Deepen & Escalate · 加深与加剧 (Deepen, Intensify, Escalate)
groups.tip: 程度层层加深，矛盾冲突激化

items.def_en: [I/T] to make an emotion, tension, or quality become sharper, stronger, or more perceptible
become more intense, aggressive, or exciting
To become deeper, more serious, or more intense; to make something deeper or more intense.

items.def_zh: 突然加剧；（争端、暴乱）骤然爆发
items.def_en: suddenly intensify or become violent, especially of an argument, crisis, or disease
