(+ sth) increase the intensity, speed, or scope of an activity or effort
1. To become, or make something become, greater, worse, or more serious.
1. To become, or make something become, stronger, more serious, or more extreme.
to make a bad situation, problem, pain, or injury significantly worse and more severe
to sharply aggravate an already critical problem, conflict, or adverse condition

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate an increase in degree, severity, emotional depth, or destructive magnitude of an ongoing condition, dispute, or state.
groups.summary_zh: 指程度、矛盾、危机或情感在深度与烈度上的持续升级与加剧。

groups.name: Deeply Read & Pore Over · 凝神研读与细勘 (Pore, Scrutinize, Peruse)
groups.tip: 集中精力致力于特定方向

items.def_en: (+ sth) read a piece of writing carefully from start to finish to scrutinize or check details

items.raw_cluster: 专注与致力于 Focus & Specialize
items.def_zh: 专门从事，专攻，专门研究；使专门化
items.def_en: (British English: specialise; US: specialize) (+ in) to focus on a particular subject, skill, or line of work.
to read or examine something very carefully and thoroughly

items.def_zh: 梳理；彻底搜寻（文献或记录）
items.def_en: to search through a body of records or writing exhaustively for specific information

items.def_zh: 费劲且深入地研读（大量资料）
items.def_en: (+ sth) read laboriously and systematically through a large quantity of text or data

items.def_zh: 凝神研读；仔细端详审阅
items.def_en: (+ sth) examine, read, or study a text or map with intense, focused attention

items.def_zh: 费力通读；艰难地读完（大量枯燥资料）
items.def_en: to spend a lot of time and effort reading through dense, long, or difficult documents

items.def_zh: 仔细阅读，仔细研读，钻研；审视
items.def_en: ('pore over') to read or study a book, document, or map very carefully and intently.
to examine a text, document, or object with great care and critical attention

groups.summary_en: An agent directs intense, sustained cognitive focus toward texts, documents, records, or technical details, examining every word or figure meticulously. Verbs emphasize the physical and mental intensity of scrutinizing written materials.
groups.summary_zh: 聚精会神、一丝不苟地研读或细查文本与资料。

groups.name: Delay & Postpone · 推迟与拖延 (Postpone, Put off, Procrastinate)
groups.tip: 主观拖沓或客观延后日程

items.def_en: (+ sth) reschedule an event or deadline to a later date or time
to postpone doing something or holding an event, often out of aversion
to arrange for an event or action to happen at a later time than originally planned
(+ on sth) delay taking action or postpone doing something until a later time
(+ sth) postpone consideration or settlement of a matter until a future date

items.def_zh: 延期，推迟；耽搁，延误；拖延
items.def_en: 1. To postpone something or cause it to happen at a later time. 2. To slow down or make someone or something late; to procrastinate.
to officially withhold action or delay an event until a later date
To delay doing something that you ought to do, usually because you do not want to do it or find it boring.
to waste time through aimless indecision or slow action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rescheduling events to a later time or habitually deferring action due to reluctance or disorganization.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动推迟安排或因拖沓习性而迟迟不采取行动。

groups.name: Delegate & Devolve · 授权与下放 (Reassigning Authority & Governance)
groups.tip: 上级下放权力或委托外包

items.def_zh: 向下级传达/下放（权力、指令、任务）
items.def_en: (+ sth) transfer tasks, decisions, or authority down through a hierarchy

items.def_zh: 委派；把（权力/任务）委托给
items.def_en: [I/T] to entrust a task, responsibility, or authority to another person or subordinate
to appoint someone as a deputy or authorized representative to perform an official duty

items.def_zh: 外包；把（工作或职责）分派出去
items.def_en: (+ sth) subcontract or delegate work or responsibilities to an outside or lower party

items.def_zh: 移交；下放（权力、控制权或职责）
items.def_en: (+ sth) transfer authority, control, or official responsibility to someone else

items.def_zh: 外包，把（工作或业务）转包给外部公司
items.def_en: (+ to) To arrange for goods or services to be produced or provided by an outside supplier rather than within the organization.

items.def_zh: 下放（权力、职责等）；移交；退化
items.def_en: (+ to/upon) To transfer power, authority, or responsibility from a central organization or government to a local or lower level.

items.def_zh: 下放权力，使非集权化；分散（机构或职能）
items.def_en: To transfer authority, functions, or administrative power from a single central body to regional or local units.
[I/T] to hire an outside firm or individual to perform part of a larger contract or obligation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the institutional transfer of responsibilities, decision-making powers, operational tasks, or legal authority from a centralized entity to lower tiers or outside parties. They differ in whether power moves downward within an hierarchy, outwards geographically, or to external third-party contractors.
groups.summary_zh: 将职权、工作或管理权从中心机构下放或转包外派。

groups.name: Delve & Peruse · 探究与细读 (Peruse, Delve, Scrutinize)
groups.tip: 钻研深掘其内在奥秘

items.def_en: To read something again, especially in order to understand it better or appreciate it.

items.def_zh: 潜心探寻；深掘细查（档案、文献）
items.def_en: (+ sth) search deeply and persistently through books, archives, or facts
to read or examine something carefully and attentively

items.def_zh: 深挖，深入探究（背景、资料）
items.def_en: (+ sth) investigate or examine information deeply and thoroughly

items.def_zh: 深层剖析，向下深入钻研（数据、细节）
items.def_en: examine detailed data or records meticulously to reveal underlying facts
to study or read something with deep concentration and sustained focus

items.def_zh: 探究，钻研，深入查考；翻找，翻寻
items.def_en: 1. (delve into) To investigate, research, or examine something deeply and thoroughly. 2. (delve into/in) To reach into a container to search for something.

items.def_zh: 仔细推敲，仔细审视（字句或细节）
items.def_en: to examine a text, document, or object with extremely close and critical scrutiny
to examine deeply to fully understand an obscure meaning or profound subject

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe examining, reading, or researching texts and data with intense thoroughness and intellectual depth to uncover hidden or exact details.
groups.summary_zh: 指带着极高的专注度，深入探究、详尽审阅或反复研读文本与资料。

groups.name: Deprive & Divest · 剥夺与剥除 (Deprive, Divest, Strip)
groups.tip: 剥除财产或剥离权益

items.def_en: (+ of) to officially and forcefully take away an honor, rank, privilege, or property from someone
(+ of) to unfairly or violently deny someone something desirable, rightful, or beneficial

items.def_zh: 剥夺（亲人、希望等珍贵事物）
items.def_en: (+ of) to deprive someone cruelly or devastatingly of a loved one or intangible vital possession
(+ sb/sth of sth) deliberately take away property, rights, or an official title from someone
(+ sb of sth) unfairly or deceitfully prevent someone from getting or keeping something rightfully theirs
(+ sb of sth) unfairly deprive someone of something they ought to have had
(deprive someone/something of something) To take something away from someone, or prevent them from having or enjoying something important or necessary.

items.def_zh: 剥夺，夺去（权力、财产等）；使脱去（衣物）；变卖，出售（资产）
items.def_en: 1. (divest someone/something of something) To strip someone of power, rights, or possessions. 2. To strip someone of clothing. 3. To sell off an investment, business asset, or subsidiary.
(+ of) to oust or officially force someone out of possession of their land, home, or goods

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate dispossessing someone of rights, status, property, or privileges, typically following the syntactic pattern 'verb someone of something'. They differ primarily in register, ranging from common legal/moral denial (deprive) to formal organizational or judicial stripping (divest, strip).
groups.summary_zh: 依法律、权威或强力夺取某人的权利、身份或财产。

groups.name: Derail & Disrupt Balance · 扰乱平衡与搅扰 (Mess, Unbalance, Derail)
groups.tip: 打破既有秩序使事物陷入紊乱

items.def_en: (mess sth up) to disrupt or spoil a plan, arrangement, or balanced state
(+ sth) disrupt or cause disorder in a plan, mechanism, or smooth operation
(+ sth) bungle or throw an arrangement into confusion and disarray

items.def_zh: 打乱，使心烦意乱或失衡
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) upset the composure, timing, or normal functioning of someone or something

items.def_zh: 弄乱，搞砸；胡闹，瞎摆弄；聚餐
items.def_en: 1. (often mess up) To make something untidy or dirty; to spoil or ruin something. 2. (mess with / around) To handle carelessly or meddle. 3. To take meals together in a military mess.

items.def_zh: 使失去平衡；使心神错乱，扰乱
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone or something to lose physical balance or stability. 2. To upset someone's mental or emotional stability.
to disturb the composure or balance of someone, making them feel unsettled
to obstruct and throw a process, plan, or negotiation completely off its normal course
to throw a structure, system, or mental balance thoroughly out of joint

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe upsetting the physical equilibrium, established routine, or smoothly operating plan of someone or something, throwing it off-kilter.
groups.summary_zh: 打破原有的平衡、节律或稳定运作，使人或机制陷入紊乱失衡。

groups.name: Derive & Conclude Logically · 逻辑推导与得出结论 (Conclude, Derive, Infer)
groups.tip: 依逻辑前提出结论

items.def_en: [I/T] to understand or infer something from information received or observed

items.def_zh: 推断出，得出结论；（使）结束，终止；达成，缔结
items.def_en: 1. to decide or form an opinion after considering all the facts or information. 2. to bring something to an end, or to come to an end. 3. to arrange or agree on a formal agreement or deal

items.def_zh: 推导出，推断；源于，起源于；获得，取得
items.def_en: 1. to deduce or trace something from an underlying source, principle, or premise. 2. (derive from) to come or originate from something. 3. to obtain or get something from something else
(+ sth) arrive at a logical deduction or solution through mental effort and analysis
(+ sth) deduce or determine something mathematically or systematically from premises
(+ sth) deduce a complete truth or narrative by systematically connecting separate facts and clues
[I/T] (+ from) to reach an opinion or conclusion from evidence and indirect facts
[I/T] (+ from) to estimate or project trends into an unknown area based on existing facts
[I/T] to deduce something to be probable despite lack of certain confirmation

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes arriving at an understanding, truth, or logical deduction based on premises, evidence, or systematic calculation. Verbs range from general logical conclusions to step-by-step mathematical or formal derivation.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据前提、数据或事实进行逻辑演绎，推断出必然或合乎理据的结论。

groups.name: Designate & Denominate · 称呼与命名 (Call, Name, Term)
groups.tip: 指名道姓赋予特定称呼

items.def_zh: 称呼，给……命名；呼唤，召唤；打电话
items.def_en: 1. To give a specified name, title, or description to someone or something. 2. To speak in a loud voice to attract attention; to summon. 3. To telephone someone.

items.def_zh: 命名，称呼；提名，任命；列举
items.def_en: 1. To give a name to a person, place, or thing. 2. To nominate or appoint someone to a role or position. 3. To mention or identify by name.

items.def_zh: 把……称为，用特定的词语表达
items.def_en: 1. To give a particular name, title, or label to someone or something.
(+ as) to assign a characterization or classification to someone or something
to officially assign a specific name, status, or identity to something

items.def_zh: (+ sb/sth + as sth) 把……称作；把……命名为
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth + as sth) to mention or name someone or something by a particular term or descriptor
(+ sb/sth + after sb/sth) to give someone or something the same name as another person or thing
to give an informal, descriptive name, title, or nickname to someone or something
to name a person at baptism, or formally name an object such as a ship

groups.summary_en: A speaker or community applies an identifier, label, or specific descriptor to an entity, spanning common verbal identification to formal technical and ceremonial naming.
groups.summary_zh: 指称、给事物起名或以特定学术、正式术语界定称谓。

groups.name: Desire & Crave · 渴望与渴求 (Long, Covet, Yearn)
groups.tip: 苦苦思慕企求满足强烈心愿

items.def_zh: 热望、期盼（常带怅惘之情）
items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to want something very much, especially when it is distant or difficult to obtain
(+ sth) have a restless and impatient urge to experience or obtain something

items.def_zh: 向往、渴望（常指不切实际的念头）
items.def_en: (+ after/for) to possess a persistent, uneasy desire for something not readily attainable
(+ sb/sth) experience an intense, aching desire for someone or something unattainable

items.def_zh: 极度渴求、渴望（如饥似渴）
items.def_en: (+ for/after) to have a deep, gnawing spiritual or physical desire

items.def_zh: 热望、强烈渴求（食物、毒瘾或关注）
items.def_en: to feel an overpowering physical or psychological compulsion for something
To feel a strong, deep, and often wistful desire or longing for someone or something.

items.def_zh: 垂涎，贪图，渴望（尤指他人之物）
items.def_en: To want very much to have something, especially something that belongs to someone else.
(+ sb/sth) pursue or crave something with desperate, breathless eagerness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this intensity scale express longing or urgent desire for something, graduated from gentle yearning or wistful dreaming up to intense craving or illicit lusting for what belongs to another.
groups.summary_zh: 表示对某物、人或状态的渴望，程度由低到高逐级递增。

groups.name: Detain & Imprison · 羁押与监禁 (Detain, Remand, Incarcerate)
groups.tip: 司法机关扣押或关押限制

items.def_en: to put someone in a jail or correctional facility
to put someone in a police cell or prison and secure them there
(+ sb) send someone formally to prison or a secure mental institution
(+ sb) confine someone securely away from society in a prison, ward, or cell
(+ sb) keep someone in legal custody pending a future hearing or trial
1. To officially keep someone in custody or confinement, especially for questioning. 2. To delay someone or keep them from proceeding.

items.def_zh: 拘留；软禁（政治犯或交战国侨民）
items.def_en: to put someone in prison or a detention camp, typically during wartime or for political reasons, without a trial
(law) To send an accused person back into custody or release them on bail while awaiting trial or further court proceedings.
to put someone in prison or keep them confined under formal penal authority

groups.summary_en: Judicial or law-enforcement authorities legally deprive an individual of liberty, holding them in custody, on trial remand, or in formal penal confinement. Terms range from short-term procedural holding to formal, prolonged incarceration.
groups.summary_zh: 执法或司法机关依法剥夺人身自由，实施拘留、还押或监禁。

groups.name: Develop & Evolve · 生长与演变进化 (Develop, Grown, Industrialize)
groups.tip: 事物由小到大演进蜕变

items.def_en: develop into a fuller, broader, or more elaborate form over time
(+ sth) develop and mature gradually into a larger, more advanced state or role
(+ sth) undergo a developmental transition to become something qualitatively different or advanced

items.def_zh: 发展；进化；成长；开发；逐渐形成；患（病）
items.def_en: To grow, mature, or evolve over time; to create, expand, or acquire something gradually.

items.def_zh: 推进；向前演进取得进展
items.def_en: [I/T] to make progress or move to a higher stage of development
[I/T] to reach full physical, mental, or structural development
To develop large-scale industries and modern manufacturing in a country, region, or economy.

items.def_zh: 演化；渐进演变为高阶形式
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ into/from) to develop gradually into a more complex or better-adapted state
to begin to grow, sprout, or develop rapidly and luxuriantly

groups.summary_en: An entity or society advances over time from an embryonic or basic state to a sophisticated, mature, or technologically organized condition.
groups.summary_zh: 事物或社会系统历经自然滋长、演进及工业化进阶。

groups.name: Die & Perish · 死亡与消亡 (Die, Perish, Expire)
groups.tip: 从自然死亡到惨烈消亡

items.def_en: to breathe one's last breath and pass away
cease to live (used as a gentle or polite euphemism for dying)
die and depart from biological life
(formal or law) To die.
(+ to) to die from the effects of a disease, injury, or extreme hardship
(formal or law) To die before someone else.

items.def_zh: 死，死亡；凋谢；消亡，平息；渴望
items.def_en: 1. To stop living and become dead. 2. To fade away or disappear gradually; stop functioning.

items.def_zh: 丧生，猝死，毁灭；（橡胶、食物等）老化变质，腐烂
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) To die, especially in an accident, disaster, or harsh conditions. 2. (of materials or food) To decay, rot, or lose quality.
die suddenly and unexpectedly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the cessation of physical biological life, ranging from ordinary death to formal legal passing and violent, untimely destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指生命机能终止，涵盖中性去世、法言辞世直至暴烈遇难或消亡。

groups.name: Directed Strike & Deflective Impact · 偏转击打与定向击球 (Bat, Backhand, Shank)
groups.tip: 球棒打、反手击等不同打法

items.def_en: [I/T] to ward off or deflect an incoming blow, weapon, or thrust with a counter-movement

items.def_zh: （高尔夫中）用杆颈击（球），斜向击偏（球）；用自制尖刀刺伤
items.def_en: 1. (golf) To strike a ball with the heel of the club so that it flies sharply sideways. 2. (slang) To slash or stab someone with a makeshift knife.
(+ sth) strike and deflect a projectile or object away with a quick blow
(+ sth) deflect or parry an incoming blow or object using an implement or forearm
(+ sth) strike a delivered ball or projectile back in the direction it came

items.def_zh: 用球棒击球；击打，拍打；眨（眼）
items.def_en: 1. To hit a ball with a bat, or take a turn at batting in baseball or cricket. 2. To hit or strike something lightly and quickly with a hand or paw. 3. To open and close one's eyes quickly (especially in 'bat an eyelid').
to hit a target with a sharp, quick, sweeping blow using an open hand or flat implement

items.def_zh: 用反手击（球）；反手击打，掌掴
items.def_en: 1. (sports) To hit a ball with a backhand stroke. 2. To strike someone with the back of the hand.
to strike someone or something sharply with a flat surface, producing a loud cracking sound

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify physical strikes delivered to a projectile or object using an implement or hand technique, differentiated by biomechanical motion, intended deflection angle, or erratic execution.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用手、拍或工具施加的特殊姿势击打或偏转击球动作。

groups.name: Directives & Authoritative Demands · 命令与强制要求 (Require, Order, Command)
groups.tip: 上对下发号施令与强制要求

items.def_en: (+ to do) to command, instruct, or invite someone with personal authority

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 明确要求；正式呼吁
items.def_en: (+ sth) to publicly or authoritatively demand that something happen or be provided
1. To demand or order something authoritatively or by rule. 2. To need something for a particular purpose.
(+ to do / on) to instruct, urge, or prescribe authoritatively with moral or legal force

items.def_zh: (+ sth) 强制规定；正式下达（命令或规则）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to authoritatively state a mandatory rule, principle, or instruction to be obeyed

items.def_zh: 命令，指示；订购，点餐；组织，整理
items.def_en: 1. To give instructions to or direct somebody to do something with authority. 2. To request or purchase goods or services.

items.def_zh: 命令，指示；指挥，统率；博得，赢得；俯瞰
items.def_en: 1. To give an authoritative order to someone. 2. To have control or charge of; to deserve and receive respect or attention.
to make something compulsory by official, statutory, or judicial authority
to order or issue a legally binding decree with absolute, sovereign authority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express an agent exercising formal or institutional authority to obligate someone to perform an action, differing in peremptory force.
groups.summary_zh: 体现施令者凭借权威或规范强制要求下属履行的层层升级指令。

groups.name: Disappoint to Deject · 失望、沮丧与消沉 (Disappoint, Depress, Deject)
groups.tip: 期望落空并伴随情绪低落与无力感

items.def_en: to fail to support or help someone as they had hoped or expected
(+ sb) cause someone to lose their cheerfulness, feeling disappointed or depressed
1. To fail to satisfy the hopes, wishes, or expectations of someone.

items.raw_cluster: 使沮丧与使消沉 Depress & Deject
items.def_zh: 使沮丧，使消沉；使萧条；按压
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel sad, gloomy, or downhearted. 2. To reduce economic activity or trade. 3. To press something down.
to cause someone to lose determination, confidence, or enthusiasm
(+ sb) cause someone to feel dispirited, despondent, or dejected
(+ sb) burden someone emotionally, causing lingering sadness or depression

items.def_zh: 瓦解斗志；严重挫伤士气
items.def_en: to destroy someone's confidence, enthusiasm, or will to persevere
to make gloomy, dispirited, or downcast in spirit

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe external outcomes, events, or circumstances causing someone to experience sinking spirits, ranging from mild failure to meet expectations to deep, dispiriting melancholy.
groups.summary_zh: 描述外在变故使人情绪滑落，从期望落空到深层挫败与消沉。

groups.name: Discard as Rubbish · 弃置与作废 (Discard, Junk, Scrap)
groups.tip: 当作废品丢弃不要

items.def_zh: 报废；取消；把…作为废品扔掉
items.def_en: to cancel, abandon, or break up something as no longer useful or practical
(+ sth) to get rid of something that is no longer wanted or needed
(+ sth) to discard something useless or unwanted as trash
(+ sb/sth) to get rid of or abandon someone or something regarded as useless
to throw something away casually into the trash
(+ out/away) to casually throw something away as rubbish (informal)
to get rid of or abandon something or someone abruptly (informal)

items.def_zh: 丢弃，抛弃，把……当作废物扔掉；放弃（计划等）
items.def_en: (informal) to throw away or discard something old or worthless; to abandon a plan or idea.
to throw away or get rid of something that is no longer useful or wanted.

groups.summary_en: An agent deliberately rids themselves of an unwanted, damaged, or useless physical object, project, or concept by casting it away or writing it off as worthless. Verbs range from neutral standard usage ('discard') to pragmatic commercial or colloquial dismissal ('scrap', 'chuck', 'ditch').
groups.summary_zh: 将废旧、无用或不再需要的事物视作垃圾处理或作废。

groups.name: Disorganize & Jumble · 搅乱与搞混 (Muddle, Disarray, Jumble)
groups.tip: 搅浑打乱使毫无头绪

items.def_en: to mix things together in a confused, untidy way so their order is lost
(+ sth) to throw an arrangement, room, or schedule into untidy disarray
(+ sth) to jumble together or confuse the order or identity of things
(+ sth) to arrange things in a confused, disordered, or nonsensical manner
to mix up thoughts, signals, or the proper order of things so they become unintelligible
to throw someone's hair, clothes, or appearance into untidy disorder
1. To arrange things in a confused, disordered way, or confuse one thing with another. 2. To make someone confused and unable to think clearly.
(formal) To throw something into a state of disorder or confusion.
to throw an orderly system, arrangement, or mind into severe disorder

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe throwing a systematic arrangement, schedule, or mental clarity into a state of untidy disorder, confusion, or entangling disarray.
groups.summary_zh: 将原本有序的事物、条理或思维搅乱，使其陷入混杂与无序状态。

groups.name: Disorganize & Throw into Chaos · 扰乱秩序与致乱 (Disorganize, Disrupt, Derange)
groups.tip: 打乱正常秩序与心智

items.def_en: (+ sth) to severely disrupt or cause functional chaos in a plan or mechanical system
(+ sth) to throw an orderly plan or situation into complete disarray
to interrupt the normal progress, continuity, or operation of an activity or system
To disrupt the order, arrangement, or smooth functioning of a system, plan, or organization.

items.def_zh: 使杂乱无章，使陷入混乱
items.def_en: to throw into complete disorder, confusion, or lack of proper arrangement

items.def_zh: 弄得翻天覆地；使彻底大乱
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cause utter confusion, total disorder, or radical disruption in a system or life

items.raw_cluster: 扰乱与使狂乱 Disrupt & Derange
items.def_zh: 使精神错乱，使发狂；扰乱，弄乱
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To make someone unable to think or act normally, or make someone mentally ill. 2. To disturb the proper order or function of something.
to overturn or transform an established system or situation completely

items.def_zh: 使瘫痪，使陷入完全停滞
items.def_en: to cause a system, organization, or function to stop operating entirely

groups.summary_en: Pertains to shattering the structural order, operational schedule, or functional coherence of a system, plan, or organization. Verbs escalate from minor procedural disorder ('disorganize') to active interruption ('disrupt') and total functional derangement ('derange', 'wreak havoc').
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏既定组织、运作体系或秩序，从打乱条理升级为瓦解瘫痪。

groups.name: Disparage & Defame · 贬损与诋毁 (Disparage, Discredit, Vilify)
groups.tip: 打上不良标签并败坏对方名誉

items.def_en: to speak of someone or something in a derogatory or dismissive manner
to unfairly attack the character, importance, or reputation of someone
(+ sb) to criticize, belittle, or humiliate someone to make them feel insignificant
(+ sb/sth) to disparage or speak slightingly and unfavorably of someone or something
(+ sb) to aggressively undermine or attack a person's standing, reputation, or character

items.def_zh: 败坏……的名誉，使丧失信誉；使怀疑，证实……不可信
items.def_en: 1. To damage someone's reputation so that people no longer respect or trust them. 2. To cause an idea, opinion, or report to seem false or unreliable.

items.def_zh: 给……带来耻辱，使蒙受污名，污名化
items.def_en: To treat or label someone or something unfairly as shameful, disgraced, or worthy of severe disapproval.
to deliberately damage someone's good reputation by making false and malicious statements
to speak or write about someone in an extremely abusive or harshly disparaging manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe verbal or communicative acts aimed at damaging a person's reputation or credibility, escalating from sneering detraction to toxic public demonization.
groups.summary_zh: 通过言论由浅入深地攻击他人声誉、可信度或道德品行，从轻视非议直至恶毒污名化。

groups.name: Displacement & Ouster by Force · 移位与驱离 (Shoo, Dislodge, Displace)
groups.tip: 外力迫使其脱离原位

items.def_en: to make an animal or person go away by waving your hands or making a 'shoo' sound.
(+ sb) to forcefully or summarily eject someone from a room, institution, or position
to use leverage to force something out of a wedged position

items.def_zh: 迫使移位，迫使离开家园
items.def_en: to force something or someone out of its usual or proper position

items.def_zh: 强行移出，从固定位置挪动；驱逐，逐出
items.def_en: 1. to force or knock something out of its fixed position. 2. to force someone to leave a place or position of power.
(+ sb/sth) to compel people, animals, or rivals to depart by force or pressure
(+ sb) to compel someone to leave a post, office, or geographic location

items.def_zh: 驱逐，逐出（官职、职位或领土）
items.def_en: (+ from) to drive out or expel someone from a position of authority or place

items.def_zh: 使落马，颠覆并剥夺其席位
items.def_en: to cause to fall from a horse or saddle; to depose from political office

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote removing an entity from a fixed resting position, vantage point, or presence, varying in manner from trivial waving gestures to forceful mechanical unseating or political/military ouster.
groups.summary_zh: 通过挥赶、外力撞击或强力干预将人或物体自固定位置移开驱逐。

groups.name: Disseminate & Broadcast · 传播与散布 (Propagate, Disseminate, Circulate)
groups.tip: 将消息、言论或思想广泛散播

items.def_zh: 散布，大肆宣扬，谣传（常用于 noise abroad/about）
items.def_en: (chiefly passive, 'be noised abroad/about') To talk about or spread news, rumors, or information widely.
make something publicly known to a large audience
(+ sth) to issue, release, or publish information, statements, or news broadly
(+ sth) to distribute or share news or material from person to person
(+ sth) to transmit or distribute announcements, invitations, or messages widely
pass or be passed from person to person or place to place

items.def_zh: 传播，宣传（思想、理论或信息）；繁殖，增殖；（声、光等）传导，传播
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To spread an idea, belief, or information widely among many people. 2. (biology) To reproduce or breed plants or animals. 3. (physics) To move or transmit through a medium, as waves or light.
spread information, knowledge, or ideas widely to many people
promote or make widely known an idea, law, or cause

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the systematic distribution and broadcasting of information, doctrines, or news across a wide population.
groups.summary_zh: 广泛公开散播、宣传理念、学说或使消息四散流传。

groups.name: Dissent & Challenge Arguments · 持异议与抗辩质疑 (Dissent, Challenge, Dispute)
groups.tip: 持不同政见或公开发表反驳意见

items.def_en: to openly question the authority, accuracy, or rightness of something
to formally assert that a decision, statement, or result is wrong or invalid
[I/T] to question the truth, correctness, or legality of a statement or claim

items.def_zh: 大胆反对；公开发表异议
items.def_en: (+ against sth) to publicly voice strong disagreement or protest against an injustice or policy
(+ with sb/sth) to disagree strongly with and challenge a statement or stance
(+ sb) to reply insolently or challenge assertions defensively

items.def_zh: 持异议，不同意，提出反对意见
items.def_en: (+ from) To express strong disagreement with an official opinion, policy, or decision.

items.def_zh: 反驳，驳斥；证明……属虚假，驳倒
items.def_en: To prove that a statement, theory, or accusation is false or incorrect.
(+ at/to) to express quiet disagreement, doubts, or reluctance to accept a suggestion

groups.summary_en: A speaker or faction explicitly voices disagreement, questions the validity of an official stance, or presents reasoned objections against prevailing positions.
groups.summary_zh: 表达异议、对抗既定结论并就论点展开抗辩质疑。

groups.name: Distract & Plague · 干扰与困扰 (Disturb, Bother, Torment, Obsess)
groups.tip: 分神受扰乃至持续纠缠

items.def_en: to annoy, worry, or cause mild mental concern to someone

items.def_zh: 分散（注意力），使分心；使困扰，使心烦意乱
items.def_en: 1. to take someone's attention away from what they are doing or thinking about 2. to confuse, disturb, or agitate someone emotionally
(+ sb) to cause persistent, nagging worry or pain to someone

items.def_zh: 萦绕在心头，持续困扰；（鬼魂等）出没于，常去
items.def_en: 1. to cause repeated anxiety, guilt, or sadness to someone over a long period 2. (of a ghost) to appear repeatedly in a place
to preoccupy or fill the mind of someone continually to an abnormal degree

items.def_zh: 不断折磨，侵蚀（某人的心神或情绪）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to persistently distress or trouble someone over a long period
(+ sb/sth) to cause continuous anxiety, worry, or distress to someone's mind
to afflict persistently with trouble, doubts, or physical discomfort
to inflict severe, relentless mental or emotional anguish upon someone

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mental disturbances and cognitive disruption caused by unwanted thoughts, memories, or external stimuli. Intensity escalates from brief loss of focus ('distract') to recurrent unsettling thoughts ('haunt') and relentless mental suffering ('plague', 'torment').
groups.summary_zh: 思维受外界或心事干扰，从一时分心升至持续缠绕、痛苦折磨。

groups.name: Draft & Sketch · 起草与构拟 (Draft, Sketch, Outline)
groups.tip: 拟定草案草拟初步蓝图

items.def_zh: 起草，拟订；草绘，绘制；征召入伍；选拔
items.def_en: 1. To write the preliminary version of a document, speech, or plan. 2. To draw or design a preliminary sketch. 3. To recruit someone for compulsory military service or professional sports.
to give the main facts, points, or general structure of a project or document
[I/T] (+ out) to make a quick, rough drawing or outline of something without full details
to sketch, mark, or plan something out in rough, general form
to prepare and write out a formal document, contract, or plan
(+ sth) to produce a preliminary design, outline, or draft of something without detailing

items.def_zh: 简要勾画，概述（轮廓或计划）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to give a brief or general description or preliminary drawing of something
(+ sth) to plan or arrange the details of something thoroughly in advance
(chiefly British English spelling of draft) 1. To write a preliminary version of a document, contract, or plan. 2. To draw or sketch a plan or design.

groups.summary_en: Creators compose the preliminary, non-final version of a text, design, or visual work, advancing along the workflow from rough spatial/conceptual layout ('sketch', 'outline') to formulated working versions ('draft', 'block out').
groups.summary_zh: 制作文本、规划或艺术品的初期雏形，涵盖构想提纲、粗略勾勒直至写出初稿。

groups.name: Drain & Exhaust · 排空与耗尽 (Deplete, Drain, Exhaust)
groups.tip: 资源或液体逐渐流失直至枯竭

items.def_zh: 倒空，排空（容器中的物品或液体）
items.def_en: [I/T] to remove the contents of a container so that nothing is left inside

items.def_zh: 耗尽（电量或能量）；使减弱
items.def_en: to lose power or gradually deplete resources, or to cause something to do so

items.def_zh: 使排干，抽光；（液体）流尽，排空；耗尽，使精疲力竭
items.def_en: 1. To make liquid flow away from something, or to empty of liquid. 2. To completely use up someone's energy, time, or resources.

items.def_zh: 削弱，暗中逐渐消耗（精力、信心）
items.def_en: to gradually weaken or destroy someone's strength, vitality, or confidence

items.def_zh: 大量削减，消耗（资源、储备）
items.def_en: to reduce the amount or supply of something considerably
to completely exhaust physical or mental energy through prolonged overwork or stress
to consume the whole of an available resource until none remains
(+ sb/sth) to exhaust all the financial or material resources of someone or something

items.def_zh: 耗尽，用光；使筋疲力尽；详尽探讨
items.def_en: 1. To use up a supply of something completely. 2. To make someone extremely tired or weary. 3. To discuss or treat a subject thoroughly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive or total withdrawal of liquid, energy, or resources until nothing useful remains, arranged from gradual emptying to complete depletion.
groups.summary_zh: 指逐步抽空液体或消耗体力、精力与资源，直至完全见底或枯竭的过程。

groups.name: Drink & Sip · 慢品与啜饮方式 (Sip, Slurp, Savor)
groups.tip: 啜饮吸吮带有声响地喝

items.def_en: [I/T] to drink by taking just a small mouthful at a time

items.def_zh: 饮红葡萄酒（尤指波尔多红葡萄酒）
items.def_en: 1. (dated) To drink claret (red Bordeaux wine).
(+ sth) to swallow all of a liquid drink in continuous gulps
(+ sth) to swallow an alcoholic drink rapidly and effortlessly
[I/T] to draw liquid into the mouth by creating suction with the lips and tongue

items.def_zh: 出声地喝，咕嘟咕嘟地喝；出声地吃
items.def_en: 1. To drink or eat something noisily with a sucking sound.
(+ sth) to drink an alcoholic beverage quickly in one or a few gulps
to drink an alcoholic beverage heartily and with relish
[I/T] to drink deeply or in large gulps directly from a container

groups.summary_en: An agent consumes liquid orally according to specific acoustic manners, rates of intake, or sensory appreciation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过啜饮、出声吮吸或细细品尝来饮用液体。

groups.name: Dull & Attenuate · 钝化与减退 (Blunt, Shallow, Dull)
groups.tip: 程度变浅或威力减退

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce or moderate the level, intensity, or aggressiveness of something
To become or make less deep, intense, or profound.

items.def_zh: 变迟钝，削弱（感官或锋刃）
items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become less sharp, bright, severe, or keen
to play down or deliberately make something appear less serious, severe, or intense

items.def_zh: 抑制，平息，减弱（感情、兴奋等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce the strength, intensity, or enthusiasm of an emotion or situation

items.def_zh: 使缓和，削弱（语气、色彩或尖锐感）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make something less intense, forceful, harsh, or bright
1. To make a feeling, sound, or reaction weaker or less intense. 2. To make the point or edge of something less sharp.
[I/T] to make something weaker, thinner, or less effective in force or value
to make a sound, physical sensation, or feeling less intense or completely numb

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to reducing the sharpness, depth, intensity, or acute quality of physical edges, feelings, senses, or arguments. The agent or process blunts a tip or diminishes the vividness or profoundness of an effect.
groups.summary_zh: 使锋芒、深度、感觉或效果变得迟钝浅薄。

groups.name: Dynamic Leaping & Bouncing · 腾跃与跳跃 (Leap, Spring, Bounce)
groups.tip: 弹性蓄力腾空而起

items.def_en: to spring or rebound back quickly after striking a surface
to move abruptly into an erect or elevated position with a springing leap

items.def_zh: 上下急跳，欢跳；跳吉格舞
items.def_en: to move up and down with quick jerky motions; to dance a lively jig
to skip, hop, or leap about in a playful, lively manner
to jump or bound upward suddenly with energetic force
to move suddenly and rapidly upwards or forwards from a stationary position
to walk or run with long, energetic, and bouncing leaping steps
[I/T] to jump over something in a single movement, often using one's hands for support

items.def_zh: （随摇滚乐等）狂暴跳跃冲撞，跳莫什舞
items.def_en: (informal) to dance wildly and aggressively by jumping around and crashing into others at a rock concert

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture energetic, spring-like vertical or propulsion movements off the ground, varying by rhythm, kinetic energy, and bodily control.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱离地面发力弹跳、腾空跃起或狂躁跳跃的运动方式。

groups.name: Eat & Ingest · 吞咽与摄入 (Ingest, Imbibe, Swallow)
groups.tip: 体内摄取流质或固体食物

items.def_en: to eat, drink, or ingest edible matter (formal/scientific register)

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地咽下；大口吞下
items.def_en: (+ sth) to swallow food or drink greedily, hastily, or in large mouthfuls
(+ sth) to swallow food rapidly without properly chewing it
(+ sth) to manage to swallow something unpalatable with difficulty or reluctance
[I/T] to cause food, drink, or medicine to pass down the throat into the stomach
to take food, liquid, or other substance into the body by swallowing or absorbing it
[I/T] to swallow food or drink quickly and noisily in large mouthfuls

items.def_zh: 饮，喝（尤指酒）；吸收，汲取（知识、思想等）
items.def_en: 1. (formal or humorous) To drink something, especially alcohol. 2. To absorb or take in ideas, knowledge, or information.

items.def_zh: 咕嘟咕嘟大口喝；（液体倒出时）发出咕嘟声
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To drink something quickly and noisily in large gulps. 2. (of liquid) To pour or flow with a hollow gurgling sound.

groups.summary_en: An organism takes food, drink, or substances into the body by swallowing, absorbing, or drinking down liquids.
groups.summary_zh: 通过口腔或生理器官摄入营养、吞咽液体或食物。

groups.name: Edit & Elide · 删减与校订 (Emend, Elide, Expunge)
groups.tip: 对文本字句进行删节与校订

items.def_en: to edit, shorten, or alter a manuscript with an editor's corrections and deletions
(+ sth) to draw a line through written text or errors to remove or invalidate them
(+ sth) to delete or cancel words or sections from an authored draft or legal document
(+ sth) to remove a part, word, or passage from a written text, recording, or broadcast
(+ from) to cut out words, sentences, or paragraphs cleanly from a manuscript

items.def_zh: 隐去；涂黑屏蔽（敏感信息）
items.def_en: to obscure or remove confidential information from a published legal or official document
(+ from) to strike out, obliterate, or wipe clean specific text, names, or recorded entries
(formal) To correct or improve a text, especially a scholarly or literary work.

items.def_zh: 省略（元音、音节或词）；忽略，略去；合并
items.def_en: 1. To omit a sound or syllable when speaking. 2. (formal) To omit, leave out, or merge things together.

groups.summary_en: An editor, scholar, or speaker removes errors, redundant vowels/sounds, or objectionable passages from an authored text, speech, or manuscript.
groups.summary_zh: 在文本或语音中剔除错误、音节、赘句或敏感字句。

groups.name: Embrace & Caress · 拥抱与亲昵 (Enfold, Nuzzle, Cuddle)
groups.tip: 用鼻子蹭或爱抚紧拥

items.def_en: to lie, sit, or curl up closely and comfortably against another person or thing

items.def_zh: 蜷缩（身体以取暖或亲昵）
items.def_en: to draw one's body into a snug, rounded position close to someone or comfortable bedding
to settle into a warm, comfortable, and affectionate position close to someone
to hold someone close in an affectionate manner, often in bed or on a couch
(+ against/in) to settle down warmly, comfortably, and affectionately close to someone

items.def_zh: 依偎；紧贴着取暖或爱抚
items.def_en: (+ up/against) to move into a warm, comfortable position close to someone else
To rub or press gently against someone or something with the nose or face in an affectionate way.
(literary) To hold someone closely in one's arms; to surround, enclose, or cover completely.
to hold someone tightly in one's arms or embrace

groups.summary_en: An agent expresses tenderness, affection, or protective warmth through bodily contact such as wrapping arms around or rubbing gently against another person or animal. Nuances emphasize protective sheltering versus intimate physical snugness.
groups.summary_zh: 以环抱、偎依或轻蹭肢体表达温情、依恋或保护欲。

groups.name: Emotionally Uplifting & Inspiring · 鼓舞与振奋 (Buoy, Uplift, Galvanize)
groups.tip: 唤起精神力量重拾向上斗志

items.def_en: to fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something uplifting
to make someone feel more hopeful, cheerful, or confident
(+ sb) to elevate someone's emotional state, spirits, or optimism
to become or make someone feel significantly happier, more hopeful, and encouraged

items.def_zh: 激发……的极大热情，使斗志昂扬
items.def_en: (+ sb) to fill someone with intense enthusiasm, passion, or excitement
1. To make someone feel happier, more hopeful, or morally and spiritually inspired. 2. To raise or lift something physically.

items.def_zh: 鼓励，鼓舞（buoy up）；使浮起，使漂浮
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'buoy up') To make someone feel more cheerful, confident, or optimistic. 2. To keep someone or something afloat.
to make someone feel exceptionally happy, excited, and energetic

items.def_zh: 激励，激起行动；电镀（锌）；通电刺激
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To shock or excite someone into taking rapid, energetic action. 2. To coat iron or steel with a protective layer of zinc.

groups.summary_en: An external factor, speech, or sentiment elevates someone's spirits, instills hope, or suddenly electrifies people into purposeful enthusiasm and action.
groups.summary_zh: 指提振精神、化解消沉或通过激昂号召使人备受鼓舞振作。

groups.name: Empirically Measure & Quantify · 实测度量与量化测定 (Measure, Quantify, Triangulate)
groups.tip: 逐一清点或推导数据

items.def_zh: 测定出（速度、时间等数值）
items.def_en: (+ at sth) to register or record a specific time, speed, or quantitative measurement
(+ sth) to take a precise amount of something by measuring its volume, length, or mass

items.def_zh: 数数，清点，计算；算入，包括；重要，有价值
items.def_en: 1. To calculate the total number of people or things, or to recite numbers in order. 2. To include someone or something, or be considered as valid. 3. To be important or have value.

items.def_zh: 估量尺寸；评估大小规格
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to inspect or gauge the physical proportions, capacity, or dimensions of something

items.def_zh: 测量，度量；有……长（或宽、重等）；衡量，估量
items.def_en: 1. To determine the size, amount, degree, or length of something using a standard unit or instrument. 2. To have a particular size, dimension, or quantity. 3. To assess or evaluate the importance, effect, or value of something.
to measure the magnitude, amount, or physical dimensions of something using an instrument

items.def_zh: 量化，以数量表示，测定……的数量
items.def_en: 1. To measure or express the amount, size, or degree of something in numbers.

items.def_zh: 作三角测量；将……划分成三角形
items.def_en: 1. (surveying / navigation) To determine a location or distance by using trigonometry and measuring angles from known points. 2. To divide an area into triangles.
to mark units of measurement on an instrument or adjust it precisely against a standard

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cognitive frame involve applying physical standards, geometric methods, or quantitative frameworks to empirically ascertain the precise dimensions, coordinates, or magnitude of something.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助工具或几何方法测定物体的物理尺寸、空间方位或将其数值化。

groups.name: Enclose & Confine Animals · 围圈与圈禁 (Corral, Kennel, Coop up)
groups.tip: 将动物关入犬舍或围栏内

items.def_zh: 关入马厩，在马厩喂养（马匹）
items.def_en: To put or keep horses or livestock in a stable
(+ in/up) To shut or hold animals inside a pen or small enclosed space
To confine animals or fowl in a coop or tightly restricted space
(+ sb/animal) to enclose or confine an animal or group of animals within a fenced pen or bounded area

items.def_zh: 将（宠物、动物）关入牢笼或棚舍内锁好
items.def_en: (+ animal) to confine an animal securely inside a cage, kennel, or building and lock the door
(+ animals) to gather and capture livestock into a corral or tight enclosure
To confine or lock an animal inside a barred cage

items.def_zh: 关入犬舍，把（狗）养在狗窝里
items.def_en: To put, house, or keep a dog in a kennel.

items.def_zh: 把（牲畜）赶入畜栏；围捕，集中（人群或物品）
items.def_en: 1. To gather and confine livestock in a corral. 2. To collect, gather, or enclose a group of people or things.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this agricultural and domestic frame involve gathering, enclosing, and penning up livestock, pets, or working animals into designated pens, cages, or structures. Nuances reflect the specific type of enclosure and species involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指将牲畜、宠物等动物约束或聚拢在特定围栏、窝舍或笼舍中。

groups.name: Endure & Persist · 持续与维持 (Continue, Last, Persist)
groups.tip: 状态延续或持久保持

items.def_zh: 持续，维持；够用，经受得住
items.def_en: To continue to exist, happen, or remain functional for a period of time.
To keep existing, happening, or doing something without stopping, or to resume after an interruption.
to stay in the same place, condition, or state without changing
to continue to happen, exist, or operate without stopping
to persist or continue uninterrupted over an extended period

items.def_zh: 维持；坚持；维持足够时间
items.def_en: to last or remain usable, durable, or resilient against depletion or adverse pressure
to continue to exist across a long period, especially amid hardship

items.def_zh: 持续存在，维持；坚持不懈，执意
items.def_en: 1. To continue to exist or occur for a long time despite opposition or difficulty. 2. To stubbornly keep doing something.
to continue unchanged; to endure or remain lasting

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a state, process, or event remaining in existence over time, ranging from neutral uninterrupted progression (continue), span of durability (last), to stubborn continuation against obstacles (persist, endure).
groups.summary_zh: 某状态或过程在时间上不断延伸、持久存续或顶住阻碍坚持。

groups.name: Endure Severe Mental Anguish · 极度痛苦与煎熬 (Agonize, Anguish, Suffer)
groups.tip: 身心备受剧烈痛苦与煎熬

items.def_en: [I/T] to experience physical or severe mental pain, distress, or hardship

items.def_zh: 使心力交瘁；极度折磨（某人）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause severe and persistent mental anguish, guilt, or distress to someone

items.def_zh: 使极度悲痛；使备受煎熬
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause intense, wrenching emotional pain and anguish to someone

items.def_zh: （因极度悲痛或难过而）哽咽，情绪激动失语
items.def_en: to become overwhelmed with deep grief, sadness, or emotion so that one cannot speak easily

items.def_zh: 感到极度悲痛，伤心欲绝
items.def_en: (+ over/for) to feel intense, deep sorrow or distress, especially over a bereavement
[I/T] to express deep sorrow, regret, or mourning over an agonizing situation
to cause someone severe mental or physical suffering; or reflexively to afflict oneself with guilt or worry

items.def_zh: 感到极度痛苦，痛苦煎熬；使极度痛苦
items.def_en: To suffer extreme physical or mental pain, grief, or distress, or cause someone deep agony.

items.def_zh: 感到极度痛苦，苦苦思索，焦虑煎熬
items.def_en: (+ over/about) To spend a long time worrying intensely or suffering extreme anxiety over a difficult problem or decision.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote experiencing extreme, wrenching emotional pain or tortuous mental worry, often over a grave loss or an agonizing decision. While 'agonize' focuses on protracted internal struggle or obsessive worry, 'anguish' and 'grieve' highlight deep, visceral distress.
groups.summary_zh: 表达内心经历极度痛苦、精神折磨或揪心煎熬的心理状态。

groups.name: Entrust & Consign · 委托与托付
groups.tip: 将财物事务托付他人代管

items.def_en: (+ to) to place someone or something safely into another's care, trust, or keeping
(+ sth to sb) to transfer responsibility, care, or custody of someone or something to another party

items.def_zh: 签署转让；把……正式托付/交割
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) to legally consign or transfer ownership, rights, or care of something to another person
(+ sth to sb) to entrust or give something to another person to take charge of
(+ to) to formalize the delivery of someone or something into the hands or protection of another
To give someone the responsibility for doing something, or to put something valuable in their care.
(+ to) to entrust something valuable or precious to someone for safekeeping

items.def_zh: 委托托运，把……交付代销；使陷入，置于（不良境地）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To send or deliver goods to someone, especially for sale or custody. 2. (+ to) To put someone or something into an unpleasant place, condition, or situation.
(variant spelling of entrust) To make someone responsible for doing something or caring for something valuable.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe handing over a valuable possession, delicate duty, or person to someone else's care or authority, relying on their responsibility. 'Entrust' highlights mutual trust and responsibility, whereas 'consign' often implies surrendering custody or transferring to a final, sometimes undesirable state.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将要事、重物或责任交予他人保管、照管或处置。

groups.name: Enumerate & Assess Commercial Price · 计点数额与核定价格 (Count, Score, Price)
groups.tip: 数值清点得分与费用核算场景

items.def_zh: 数，清点；总计，共计；给……编号；把……归类为
items.def_en: 1. To count or determine the number of. 2. To amount to a particular number in total. 3. To give a number to each item in a series.

items.def_zh: 价钱为，需花费；使付出（代价），使失去；估算……的成本
items.def_en: 1. To have a specified price or need a specific amount of money to buy. 2. To cause someone to lose or sacrifice something. 3. To estimate the price or production cost of something.

items.def_zh: 给……定价，标价；询问……的价格
items.def_en: 1. To determine or mark the price of something for sale. 2. To find out or compare the price of something.
to assess and decide how much monetary worth an item or asset holds

items.def_zh: 得分，进球；记分，给……打分；为……谱曲；在……上刻划
items.def_en: 1. To win or gain points, goals, or runs in a game, sport, or test. 2. To keep a record of points in a match, or assign a grade to work. 3. To write or arrange music for instruments.
(+ sth) to add up figures, items, or scores to calculate the final total
(+ sth) to calculate the total number, cost, or score by enumerating each unit
(+ sth) to increase the retail price of goods above their original cost
[I/T] to calculate and record a running score, count, or total of items

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario frame center on enumerating individual units, tracking scored tallies, or calculating and fixing the monetary charge or value assigned to goods and services.
groups.summary_zh: 指盘点记录数额、记分以及估算和拟定商品或服务的收费价格。

groups.name: Equip & Outfit for Service · 装备与配备 (Equip, Outfit, Accoutre)
groups.tip: 为特定人员配备器械

items.def_en: to supply someone with all the specific clothes or equipment needed for an activity
(+ with) to supply a place or person with what is needed, especially fittings or equipment

items.def_zh: 配备；装置设备（房间、船只等）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth with sth) to supply a person, vehicle, or room with all the necessary equipment, fixtures, or fittings
(+ for sth) to put on specialized gear or prepare equipment in readiness for a task or operation

items.def_zh: 为……配备特种装备；穿戴整齐装备
items.def_en: (+ sb with sth) to dress or equip someone with specialized gear, clothes, or tools for a specific task
to provide someone or something with the necessary equipment, clothes, or supplies for a particular purpose

items.def_zh: 配备，装备；使具备（能力、素质等）
items.def_en: 1. to provide someone or something with the necessary tools, equipment, or items. 2. to prepare someone mentally or practically with needed skills or qualities

items.def_zh: 给……装配帆具或特种装备
items.def_en: (+ out/with) to fit a boat or piece of machinery with necessary sails or gear

items.def_zh: 给……穿戴特殊装备或佩饰
items.def_en: (+ in/with) to clothe or equip someone in a noticeable, military, or historical fashion

groups.summary_en: This frame covers providing a person, group, or vessel with specialized tools, gear, supplies, or uniforms necessary for a specific task, voyage, or occupation. Differences lie in whether the focus is on functional tools, comprehensive outfitting, or ceremonial gear.
groups.summary_zh: 指为特定任务、远征或职能配齐必要的装备、服饰或工具设施。

groups.name: Erotic Caressing & Making Out · 亲昵爱抚与接吻 (Pet, Neck, Smooch)
groups.tip: 通过接吻与抚弄表达亲昵

items.def_en: (+ to sb) to curl up closely and affectionately against another person for physical warmth or intimacy

items.def_zh: 抚弄，抚摩；（亲昵地）抚弄爱抚；宠爱
items.def_en: 1. to touch or stroke an animal or person gently and lovingly. 2. to kiss and touch someone intimately in a sexual way.
(+ with) to kiss and cuddle amorously in an affectionate, often public way
[I/T] (+ with) to kiss and hold someone affectionately or passionately
(+ with sb) to engage in casual sexual touching, petting, or kissing
to engage in passionate kissing, embracing, and sexual petting with someone
(informal) to kiss and caress passionately.
to stroke or touch someone in a loving, gentle, or sexually intimate manner

items.def_zh: 热烈接吻，搂抱接吻（英式俚语）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with) to kiss someone passionately for a prolonged period

groups.summary_en: Describes amorous, physical intimacy between romantic partners without intercourse. 'Pet' implies intimate stroking or fondling, 'neck' specifies prolonged passionate kissing and embracing around the neck, while additions cover casual or intense kissing and snuggling.
groups.summary_zh: 情侣间接吻、拥抱、抚摩等非交垢性肢体亲昵行为。

groups.name: Evacuation & Departure · 离开与腾出 (Exit, Vacate, Clear out)
groups.tip: 离开原处腾出空间或退场

items.def_en: (formal) to leave or abandon a place, tenancy, or property

items.def_zh: 离开，走出去，退出；（戏剧）退场
items.def_en: 1. to go out of or leave a place, building, or vehicle. 2. to leave the stage (used as a stage direction). 3. to stop using a computer program.
to leave a place completely and take one's belongings away

items.def_zh: 迁出；搬离（住所或办公地）
items.def_en: (+ of sth) to permanently stop living in or occupying a house, room, or building and remove one's belongings
to retreat rapidly or evacuate an area urgently when under danger or threat

items.def_zh: 撤出；撤离（人员、军队或驻地）
items.def_en: (+ of sth) to withdraw or evacuate people or military forces from an area or premise
[I/T] to leave or remove people from a dangerous place to a safer location

items.def_zh: 腾出，空出（房间、住所等）；辞去，离任（职位）
items.def_en: 1. to leave a building, room, or seat so that it becomes empty and available for someone else. 2. to leave a job or position so that it is vacant.
to leave suddenly or secretly, typically shifting location with one's possessions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario frame describe departing from, clearing out of, or relinquishing physical spaces, rooms, or properties. They range from neutral everyday exits to formal legal surrender of premises or urgent evacuation.
groups.summary_zh: 主动离开、腾退居所或因租约、安全原因撤离建筑物与场地。

groups.name: Evade & Circumvent · 规避与规拒 (Shun, Circumvent, Bypass)
groups.tip: 刻意回避人际或规避冲突

items.def_en: (+ sth) To successfully avoid dealing with a rule, restriction, or difficulty by finding an indirect way
(+ sb/sth) To deliberately avoid a person, place, or situation that could cause problems
to pass around the edge of something or avoid addressing a sensitive topic directly
to avoid an obstacle, standard channel, or bureaucratic procedure by taking an alternative route
to avoid dealing with an issue or question in an evasive manner
(+ sth) To avoid doing something you should do by using clever excuses or deceit

items.def_zh: 规避，巧妙避开（规则、限制等）；绕行
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To find a clever or indirect way around a rule, obstacle, or restriction. 2. To bypass or go around.
(formal) to deliberately avoid or abstain from something on principle or habit
1. To deliberately avoid someone or something out of dislike, fear, or moral disapproval.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express deliberately steering clear of social contact, rules, moral duties, or legal constraints through active avoidance, clever maneuvering, or social ostracism.
groups.summary_zh: 通过巧妙钻营或刻意回避，绕过法规约束、义务或社交对象。

groups.name: Evade Truth & Gloss Over · 遮掩软化与含糊其辞 (Sugarcoat, Equivocate)
groups.tip: 闪烁其词含糊推诿以规避正面回答

items.def_en: to treat an unpleasant fact or fault lightly or evasively to minimize attention to it
(+ sth) To make problems, disagreements, or mistakes seem less serious than they really are
(+ sth) To discuss a topic vaguely or obliquely instead of addressing the core issue directly

items.def_zh: 套话防卫，含糊其词防担责
items.def_en: to avoid giving a direct answer or committing oneself by using qualifying language
(+ sth) To hide or conceal unpleasant facts, mistakes, or illegal activities from public view

items.def_zh: 粉饰，美化（使更易接受）；给……裹上糖衣
items.def_en: 1. To make unpleasant news, facts, or criticism seem more appealing or acceptable than they really are. 2. To coat pills or food with sugar.

items.raw_cluster: 模棱两可与推诿 Prevaricate & Equivocate
items.def_zh: 含糊其辞，闪烁其词，支支吾吾
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To speak deliberately in an ambiguous or evasive way to avoid telling the full truth or committing oneself.
to deliberately conceal misconduct, defects, or scandals to make things appear acceptable
to avoid telling the truth by speaking evasively or shifting the subject

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize the rhetorical manner of avoiding the harsh or plain truth, either by softening unpalatable realities or speaking ambiguously to dodge commitment.
groups.summary_zh: 修饰粉饰不快现实，或含糊其辞以逃避真相。

groups.name: Examine & Audit · 审查与核查
groups.tip: 官方查对账目与明细数据

items.def_en: to test or examine people or things to verify suitability or weed out undesirables
(+ sth) To examine or inspect something carefully line by line or detail by detail
(+ sth) To inspect something thoroughly to make sure everything is correct or in good condition

items.def_zh: 浏览核对，仔细翻阅审查
items.def_en: (+ sth) To examine a collection of things or pages in a document to find information or check details

items.def_zh: 审计，查账；旁听（大学课程）
items.def_en: 1. To officially examine and verify the financial accounts or records of an organization. 2. (North American) To attend a university course without receiving academic credit.

items.def_zh: 对……进行人口普查（或官方统计调查）
items.def_en: To conduct an official census or systematic survey of a population or group.

items.def_zh: 审查，审核（资格、背景或材料）；（兽医）诊疗（动物）
items.def_en: 1. To examine someone's past background, qualifications, or a document carefully to check suitability and accuracy. 2. To examine or treat an animal medically.
to look at something carefully in order to check its condition or compliance with standards
to examine or inspect closely and thoroughly with a critical eye

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe systematically inspecting, evaluating, or counting records, qualifications, or individuals to ensure compliance, authenticity, or complete demographic data. 'Audit' focuses on financial/procedural verification, 'vet' on character/suitability assessment, and 'scrutinize' on rigorous line-by-line inspection.
groups.summary_zh: 系统性核实账目、资质、背景或数据，确保合规与准确。

groups.name: Excavate & Hollow Out · 挖掘与开凿 (Hollow, Trench, Scoop)
groups.tip: 掘土挖沟以开凿空间

items.def_en: (+ sth) To remove material from something with a curved movement or tool, leaving a hollow

items.def_zh: 舀出，挖空（凹形物体掏空）
items.def_en: (+ out) to hollow out a space or remove soft earth by or as if by using a scoop
(+ sth) To make a space inside something solid by removing material from the interior
[I/T] (+ through/into) to dig a passage through or under the ground or an obstacle
To dig or carve out the inside of something so that it becomes empty or hollow.
To dig a long, narrow channel or ditch in the ground, especially for defense or drainage.

items.def_zh: 凿出，挖空（形成凹槽或深坑）
items.def_en: (+ out) to make a deep hole or groove in a surface using a sharp tool or heavy force
(+ sth) To cut, carve, or dig a deep groove or hole into a surface with force

items.def_zh: 挖掘，发掘（系统性开挖成坑）
items.def_en: [I/T] to make a large hole or cavity in the ground systematically, especially for construction or archaeology

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the spatial carving, gouging, or digging out of earth, rock, or solid mass to create channels, depressions, or hollowed-out cavities. They emphasize shaping or removing material to form specific voids rather than merely collecting loose earth.
groups.summary_zh: 通过掘土、凿穴或开槽等方式在物体或地面挖出空腔。

groups.name: Execution & Kill by Specific Method · 定刑处决与特种处死 (Behead, Crucify, Smother)
groups.tip: 剥夺生命，涵盖行刑与屠戮

items.def_en: execute someone by suspending them by the neck with a rope
kill someone by depriving them of oxygen
(+ sb) to kill or asphyxiate someone by blocking or squeezing their windpipe

items.def_zh: 使窒息致死，闷死；闷熄（火）；扼杀，抑制；厚厚覆盖
items.def_en: 1. To kill someone by covering their face so they cannot breathe. 2. To extinguish a fire by cutting off air. 3. To suppress or stifle an emotion or action. 4. (+ with/in) To cover something thickly.
execute someone using a guillotine
execute or kill someone by a massive electric shock
(+ sb) to kill someone by hanging them by the neck with a rope
1. To execute or kill someone by cutting off their head.

items.def_zh: 将……钉在十字架上处死；严厉批评，严惩
items.def_en: 1. (historical) To execute someone by nailing or tying them to a wooden cross. 2. (informal) To criticize or punish someone severely.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specific physical methods used to kill or legally execute someone, distinguishing each act by the anatomical or mechanical means applied—such as cutting off the head, nailing to a cross, or cutting off air supply.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过特定器械、解剖部位或既定规程处死或处决受刑者。

groups.name: Extrajudicial Execution & Wholesale Slaughter · 灭绝性屠杀与私刑处决 (Lynch, Massacre)
groups.tip: 从个体杀戮到集体屠杀

items.def_en: to kill, destroy, or severely wipe out a large proportion of a population
(+ sb) to hang someone, especially as an act of extrajudicial execution or lynching

items.def_zh: 像宰杀牲畜般屠杀；滥杀
items.def_en: to kill people in large numbers in a cruel, violent, and unsparing manner
to kill violently, brutally, and indiscriminately, treating victims like livestock

items.def_zh: （用机枪等）成批扫射杀死，残酷大屠杀
items.def_en: (+ sb) to kill large numbers of people quickly and mercilessly, especially with gunfire

items.def_zh: 消灭，彻底摧毁，歼灭（群体或人口）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to completely destroy, kill, or eradicate a whole population or group
1. To kill a large number of people or animals in a cruel or violent way. 2. (informal) To defeat someone thoroughly in a game or contest.

items.def_zh: 处以私刑（通常指处死、绞死）
items.def_en: (of a mob) To put someone to death by violence, especially hanging, without legal authorization or trial.
to deliberately destroy a whole population or group of living beings utterly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the deliberate, violent killing of multiple people or targeted individuals without due process, escalating from unlawful collective execution to indiscriminate, industrial-scale extermination.
groups.summary_zh: 非法处决或针对特定人群的大规模残暴屠戮，具有极高的血腥与残酷程度。

groups.name: Fade Away & Cease to Exist · 消失与消散 (Evanesce, Dissipate, Vanish)
groups.tip: 如轻烟雾气般逐渐化为乌有

items.def_zh: 逐渐消失、变得微弱或模糊
items.def_en: (+ away) to lose strength, loudness, or visibility slowly until no longer perceptible

items.def_zh: （如雪融化般）悄然散去、逐渐消失
items.def_en: to disappear gradually or unobtrusively, like ice turning to water
to slowly disappear, become weaker, or cease to be visible or audible
to gradually become quieter or weaker until it stops existing altogether

items.def_zh: 逐渐减少直至消失，慢慢止歇
items.def_en: to gradually dwindle, weaken, or come to an end

items.def_zh: 突然或完全消失、不见踪影
items.def_en: to disappear suddenly, completely, or in a way that cannot be explained

items.def_zh: （使烟、雾、云气等）逐渐消散、散去
items.def_en: [I/T] to gradually disappear or scatter completely, or cause gas, vapor, or tension to do so

items.def_zh: （使）非物质化，（使）化为乌有，消失
items.def_en: To cease to have physical form, or to cause something to vanish into thin air.

items.def_zh: 逐渐消失，消散，化为乌有
items.def_en: To fade away or disappear gradually like mist, smoke, or a memory.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entities or phenomena gradually or completely disappearing from sight, physical form, or existence. 'Evanesce' and 'dematerialize' represent literary or science-focused registers, while verbs like 'dissipate' and 'vanish' capture everyday and physical dispersal.
groups.summary_zh: 描述实体或现象由显转隐、形体散失或彻底化为乌有的过程。

groups.name: Fail to Retain or Notice · 遗忘与疏漏 (Forget, Overlook, Omit)
groups.tip: 因疏忽而未注意到或遗失

items.def_en: to be forgotten or overlooked, especially temporarily
(+ sb/sth) to fail to include or inadvertently omit someone or something
(+ sb/sth) to ignore, overlook, or fail to notice or consider someone or something

items.def_zh: 心不在焉而不去注意，不予理睬
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to stop listening to, noticing, or paying attention to one's surroundings or what is being said

items.def_zh: 漏掉，遗漏；未注意到；错过；未击中；想念
items.def_en: 1. To fail to notice, hear, or include something. 2. To fail to hit, reach, or catch. 3. To feel sad because someone or something is absent.
to fail to notice, see, or consider something inadvertently
to leave out or exclude someone or something, either by mistake or intention
1. To fail to remember a fact, event, or name. 2. To leave something behind by mistake or omit to do something.

items.def_zh: 刻意忘掉，抛弃（旧习惯或旧观念）
items.def_en: To make a deliberate effort to forget or discard a habit, skill, or false belief.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote a cognitive lapse where an agent fails to recall stored information or inadvertently neglects to notice, include, or perform something.
groups.summary_zh: 指记忆失效未能忆起，或认知疏忽导致遗漏未办。

groups.name: Fatigue & Physical Depletion · 疲乏与劳累 (Weary, Fag, Fatigue)
groups.tip: 体力从微困走向精疲力竭

items.def_en: [I/T] to lose energy or cause someone to feel in need of rest

items.def_zh: 使极度疲劳；使心力交瘁
items.def_en: to cause severe physical or mental exhaustion through prolonged strain

items.def_zh: 使体力消耗殆尽，使虚弱疲惫
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to become weak, fatigued, or physically depleted from overwork
to exhaust someone's physical stamina completely

items.def_zh: 使疲惫不堪，使筋疲力尽
items.def_en: (+ sb) to thoroughly tire someone out or exhaust their energy

items.def_zh: （使）疲倦，（使）劳累；（使）厌烦，失去耐心
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) To make someone feel very tired, or to become tired. 2. (+ of) To lose patience or interest in something.
(+ sb) to exhaust oneself or someone completely through prolonged hard work and exertion

items.def_zh: 使人疲惫不堪；耗尽精力
items.def_en: to make someone thoroughly exhausted from prolonged work or exertion

items.def_zh: 使筋疲力竭（常作 fag out）；苦干，辛劳工作
items.def_en: 1. (British dated, often fag out) To exhaust someone with hard work, or to tire oneself out. 2. To work hard and tirelessly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale describe the progressive onset of bodily tiredness from physical labor or prolonged exertion, progressing from mild fatigue to grueling overwork.
groups.summary_zh: 描述由体力劳作或持久消耗引发的身体倦怠与劳损程度递增。

groups.name: Feast Sumptuously & Make Merry · 设宴享乐与畅饮 (Banquet, Feast, Spree)
groups.tip: 宴席聚餐与畅快大嚼大饮

items.def_en: to eat a lavish or excessive amount of food greedily and indulgently

items.def_zh: 大快朵颐，开怀痛饮美食
items.def_en: to begin eagerly eating a hearty or sumptuous meal

items.def_zh: 纵情享乐，狂欢畅饮，过奢华快乐的生活
items.def_en: to enjoy oneself extravagantly and festively without restraint

items.def_zh: 尽情享用盛宴，大吃大喝
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to eat large amounts of delicious food and drink with great pleasure in celebration

items.def_zh: 设宴款待；痛饮饱餐，参加宴会
items.def_en: 1. To feast or eat richly and luxuriously at a banquet. 2. To entertain someone with a lavish formal feast.
(+ on) to indulge in an excessive, uncontrolled spree of eating, drinking, or revelry
(informal) To indulge in an uncontrolled bout of drinking, partying, or spending.
to honor or entertain someone lavishly with public celebrations or a festive meal

items.def_zh: 以盛宴款待，用美食招待
items.def_en: (+ with) to entertain lavishly with choice food and drink

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate participating in or hosting lavish, abundant meals accompanied by celebratory merrymaking, drinking, or spending. 'Banquet' and 'feast' highlight the indulgence in magnificent food and drink, while 'spree' focuses on going on an extravagant celebratory binge.
groups.summary_zh: 指举办或参与盛大奢华的宴饮、饕餮大餐及放纵享乐活动。

groups.name: Fight & Scuffle · 打斗与肉搏 (Roughhouse, Tussle, Brawl)
groups.tip: 身体近距离扭打推搡与肉搏

items.def_zh: 摆出打斗架势，迎面交锋
items.def_en: to adopt a fighting stance or prepare to grapple or brawl with an opponent
to engage in a short, disorganized, and confused physical fight

items.def_zh: 胡闹扭打，嬉闹打斗；粗暴对待
items.def_en: (informal) To play or fight in a rough, boisterous, or noisy way; to handle someone roughly.

items.def_zh: 与假想敌作拳击训练；虚与委蛇，闪烁其词
items.def_en: 1. To practice boxing punches and footwork in the air against an imaginary opponent. 2. To avoid directly confronting an issue or opponent; fence.
to engage in a physical fight, scuffle, or boxing match
(+ with) to engage in a close, hand-to-hand fight or struggle without weapons
(+ with/over) To fight, wrestle, or scuffle closely; to engage in a vigorous struggle or contest.
(+ sb) to attack someone physically with great force and violence
to fight noisily and roughly in a public or crowded place

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict close physical confrontation, violent grappling, or boisterous physical combat between individuals. They contrast along lines of playful rowdiness ('roughhouse'), disorderly skirmishes ('tussle'), non-contact training ('shadowbox'), and chaotic, violent melee fighting ('brawl', 'grapple').
groups.summary_zh: 指近身肉搏、相互扭打拉扯或喧闹的打斗冲突。

groups.name: Fit Out & Furnish with Fixtures · 装设特定构件与马具装备
groups.tip: 板条组装拼合完整架构

items.def_zh: 装配，装备，为……提供固定装置
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to equip or furnish a structure, room, or mount with necessary fittings or equipment

items.def_zh: 装配齐备，给……装备构件或用具
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to supply or furnish someone or something with all the required gear or fittings
(+ sth) to put a saddle on a horse or other riding animal

items.def_zh: 给（墙壁或天花板）镶嵌护墙板
items.def_en: to fit or cover a wall, ceiling, or door with flat wooden or composite panels

items.def_zh: 给（马等）装上鞍；使承担，使承受（重担或债务等）
items.def_en: 1. To put a saddle on a horse or other animal. 2. (saddle someone with) To burden someone with an unwanted responsibility or debt.
To provide, fit, or construct something using slats (thin strips of wood, metal, etc.).
to fit walls or ceilings with thin strips of wood to support plaster

items.def_zh: 给（室内墙下半部）装设壁板
items.def_en: to line the lower part of interior walls with timber paneling
to put a bridle on a horse or other riding animal

groups.summary_en: Denotes outfitting an animal or physical structure with specific structural members, boards, or riding gear (e.g., placing slats on blinds/fences or fitting a mount with a saddle).
groups.summary_zh: 为结构安装板条部件，或为坐骑备鞍装配专业马具构件。

groups.name: Fixation & Addiction · 迷恋与沉溺成瘾 (Addict, Obsess)
groups.tip: 从放任爱好到深陷其中无法自拔

items.def_en: to dominate the thoughts and attention of someone to the exclusion of other things

items.def_zh: 被深深吸引，疯狂爱上/迷恋上
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to become strongly and infatuatedly attracted to someone or something
(+ on/upon) to develop an unhealthy, obsessive focus or attachment towards someone or something
(+ with) to inspire an intense, foolish, and unreasoning passion in someone

items.def_zh: 迷恋上，从……中获得极大快感沉溺其中
items.def_en: (+ sth) to find something intensely exciting or derive an obsessive thrill or pleasure from it
(+ sb on sth) to cause someone to become addicted to or compulsively preoccupied with something
1. To cause someone or oneself to become dependent on or devoted to a drug, substance, or activity.

items.def_zh: 使痴迷，使着迷；念念不忘，牵挂（obsess about/over）
items.def_en: 1. To occupy the mind of someone continually and excessively. 2. (+ about/over) To think or worry about something constantly.

items.def_zh: 束缚，奴役（使被恶习欲望所控）
items.def_en: (+ to) to cause someone to lose all autonomy and be completely dominated by a habit or desire

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express degrees of psychological and emotional fixation, moving from persistent preoccupation to complete compulsive, uncontrollable dependence.
groups.summary_zh: 从持续思绪萦绕到彻底形成强迫性依恋成瘾。

groups.name: Flatten & Level · 找平与压平 (Flatten, Level, Grade)
groups.tip: 使表面平整消除凹凸

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become even, horizontal, or smooth over a wider surface
(+ sth) to make a surface smooth and flat by removing wrinkles, bumps, or irregularities

items.def_zh: 使变平整，使成水平面；平稳
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a surface flat, smooth, and even, or to become flat
to level out a surface of land or earth with machinery to prepare for building or roadwork
(+ sth) to flatten or make something smooth and uniform using a roller or heavy cylinder

items.def_zh: （使）平整，（使）平坦；（使）相等，（使）平均
items.def_en: 1. to make a surface flat, smooth, or level 2. to make amounts, scores, or conditions equal or balanced

items.def_zh: 弄平，压平；夷平，彻底摧毁；使平等；瞄准，对准
items.def_en: 1. to make a surface flat, smooth, or horizontal 2. to destroy or knock down a building or structure completely 3. to aim a weapon or accusation directly at someone
[I/T] to make something flat or flatter by pressing, rolling, or hitting it
to level or compact a ground surface using a heavy roller

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mechanically reducing surface irregularities, humps, or slopes to make ground or physical planes uniform and horizontal. Actions range from gentle grading to heavy compression.
groups.summary_zh: 通过机械刮削或强力压制使地表或物体表面平整、均匀。

groups.name: Flirt & Entice · 挑逗与引诱 (Flirt, Lure, Coquet)
groups.tip: 轻佻言行挑逗吸引对方注意

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make romantic or sexual overtures to someone

items.def_zh: 调情，打情骂俏；不严肃地考虑，玩弄
items.def_en: 1. To behave playfully toward someone you are attracted to, without serious intentions. 2. (flirt with) To consider or toy with an idea or possibility briefly.

items.def_zh: 卖弄风情，虚情假意地挑逗
items.def_en: (+ with) to behave flirtatiously without sincere affection, often in a playful or teasing manner

items.def_zh: 吸引，诱使进入（圈套或行动）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to entice, lure, or entrap someone into a particular course of action or involvement

items.def_zh: 诱导，挑逗引诱（给人虚假期望）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to encourage someone to expect a romantic relationship or outcome, usually falsely or deceitfully
To persuade or tempt someone to go somewhere or do something by offering them something attractive.

items.def_zh: 诱使，引诱（通常伴有利益或吸引力）
items.def_en: to attract or tempt someone by offering pleasure, reward, or advantage

items.def_zh: 勾引，诱惑（使人误入歧途或发生关系）
items.def_en: to attract powerfully and lead someone into sexual activity or a disastrous course of action
(+ into) to persuade or entice someone to do something by deception or flattery

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe playfully teasing, alluring, or enticing someone, whether to attract romantic attention or tempt them toward a specific, often dangerous or undesirable, course of action. They range from playful romantic overtures to calculated entrapment.
groups.summary_zh: 以言行挑逗、吸引或诱惑他人产生好感或落入圈套。

groups.name: Float & Waft · 飘浮与升腾 (Float, Waft, Levitate)
groups.tip: 无重量感地升起浮空

items.def_zh: 飘浮，随气流/水流漫无目的地漂荡
items.def_en: to drift gently through the air or on water without a fixed course
to float or rise rapidly and lightly to the surface of a liquid

items.def_zh: 漂移，随风或水流缓缓冲走/飘荡
items.def_en: to be carried gently along by the natural motion of wind or water
to be carried along gently and aimlessly by currents of air or water
to move smoothly, quietly, and seemingly without effort through air
1. To float, move, or cause to move gently through the air or over water.
to remain suspended in one place in the air
to keep an object afloat or supported in a fluid medium
1. To rise and float in the air without physical support, especially by magic or special power, or to cause something to do this.

groups.summary_en: An entity is suspended in or carried gently through the air or on liquid, either drifting with air currents or suspended defying gravity.
groups.summary_zh: 物体在空气中轻盈漂移、受气流托运或悬空升腾。

groups.name: Fluster & Perturb · 慌乱与使心烦意乱 (Agitate or Destabilize Mental Composure)
groups.tip: 心绪大乱失常且坐立不安

items.raw_cluster: 使慌乱与骚动 Agitate & Fluster
items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使心烦意乱；慌张忙乱；（雪、尘等）纷飞
items.def_en: 1. To agitate, confuse, or fluster someone. 2. To move in an excited, hurried, or confused manner. 3. (of snow, wind, or dust) To swirl around in light gusts.
to make someone nervous, confused, and prone to mistakes
(+ sb) to disturb someone's mental calm or fluster them with sudden agitation

items.def_zh: 使震惊，使心烦意乱，打破心境安宁
items.def_en: (+ sb) to upset, agitate, or unsettle someone emotionally

items.def_zh: 使心慌意乱，打乱心绪，使慌乱
items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse, perturb, or disconcert someone so that they lose their concentration or composure

items.def_zh: 使仓皇失措，使窘迫不安
items.def_en: to disturb the composure of someone; make someone feel unsettled or confused
to make someone worried, anxious, or uneasy in mind

items.def_zh: 使气馁，使不知所措/丧失胆量
items.def_en: to make someone lose confidence, composure, or determination

items.raw_cluster: 扰乱与使不安 Perturb & Unhinge
items.def_zh: 使心神错乱，使精神失常；取下……的铰链
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To make someone mentally disordered, distraught, or emotionally unstable. 2. To remove a door, gate, or lid from its hinges.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on causing someone to lose emotional equilibrium, focus, or calm. While 'flurry' and 'fluster' imply hurried confusion and embarrassment, 'perturb' and 'unhinge' strike deeper into psychological stability, potentially causing total derangement.
groups.summary_zh: 指打乱人的心绪平静，使其神情慌乱甚至精神失常。

groups.name: Fly & Soar · 飞翔与振翅 (Fly, Soar, Flitter)
groups.tip: 在空中飞翔、翱翔或轻快振翅

items.def_en: to depart or escape through the air by flight
to leave the ground and begin to fly through the air
[I/T] to flap wings quickly and lightly without flying far

items.def_zh: 轻快振翅，飞来飞去，扇翅
items.def_en: 1. To fly or move quickly, lightly, and erratically from place to place.
to fly upwards high into the air smoothly and effortlessly
[I/T] (+ one's way) to travel on wings or fly swiftly toward a destination
to stay in the air in one place by flapping wings rapidly

items.def_zh: 乘水上飞机飞行（或旅行）
items.def_en: 1. To fly or travel in a seaplane.
to fly high in the air without moving wings or using power

groups.summary_en: A creature or vehicle navigates through the air via flapping wings, mechanical propulsion, or gliding effortlessly aloft.
groups.summary_zh: 鸟类或飞行器在空中振翅振荡、展翅翱翔或航行。

groups.name: Forceful Striking & Kicking · 重击与蹬踹 (Kick, Pound, Boot)
groups.tip: 用手足施加物理冲击力

items.def_en: To hit or drive something forcefully with the foot; to recoil.
to strike someone forcefully with the knee, typically in close combat
(+ sb) violently assault someone by delivering repeated punches or kicks
(+ sth) break or force open a door or structure by striking it violently with the foot
(+ sb) attack someone physically with forceful, aggressive blows

items.def_zh: 连续重击，猛打；捣碎，捣烂；心怦怦跳
items.def_en: To hit something repeatedly and heavily with a fist or heavy instrument; to crush or grind into smaller pieces.

items.def_zh: 猛踢，用力踢；启动（计算机）；踢开，解雇
items.def_en: 1. To kick someone or something forcefully. 2. To start up a computer system. 3. (informal) To dismiss or expel someone.
to strike repeatedly and violently with the fists or heavy repeated blows
(informal) to strike someone or something with immense physical force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail blunt, high-impact mechanical strikes delivered via feet, heavy blunt tools, or repetitive physical blows, categorized by impact trajectory, limb usage, and destructive intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过重拳、钝击或脚部蹬踹施加的强力机械性撞击。
