groups.name: Forgive & Pardon · 宽恕与赦免 (Absolve, Exonerate, Amnesty)
groups.tip: 从心灵原谅到官方赦免

items.def_en: to overlook or forgive a minor fault or social breach politely
(+ sth) Relinquish grievance, grudge, or bitter resentment against someone
to accept or tolerate morally wrong behavior without censure
(+ sb) Excuse, pardon, or refrain from punishing an offender
1. To stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense or mistake. 2. To officially cancel a debt or financial obligation.
1. (law) To officially forgive a person and release them from punishment for a crime. 2. To forgive someone for a fault, bad behavior, or impoliteness.
(+ from/of) to officially or sacramentally declare free from guilt, blame, or sin
(+ from) to officially clear someone from an accusation of wrongdoing after investigation
to grant an official sovereign pardon to a group of political or criminal offenders

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote ceasing to harbor resentment toward someone for an offense or officially releasing an offender from legal culpability and punishment, scaling from interpersonal forbearance to formal sovereign absolution.
groups.summary_zh: 指免除他人罪责或法律惩罚，由人际宽恕升至官方赦免。

groups.name: Form Coalition & Unify · 结盟与联合 (Ally, Federate, Gang up)
groups.tip: 缔结同盟携手应对外部挑战

items.def_en: (+ with/together) To unite in a pact, league, or mutual protective covenant
To join or unite with another person, group, or country for mutual support or a common purpose.

items.def_zh: 结伙，联合（常与 up 连用）；结伙对付（与 up on/against 连用）
items.def_en: (usually gang up) To unite or join together in a group, especially to oppose or intimidate someone.
(+ with) To join together to form a political or functional coalition
(+ on/against sb) form a group or alliance to oppose, intimidate, or attack someone
(+ with sb) join together with another person or group to work toward a common goal
unite as a group to achieve a shared objective or face a mutual adversary
To bring people, parties, or states into an alliance or confederacy
To join together to form a federation, or to cause states or organizations to unite in a federation.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover sovereign entities, factions, or individuals entering into mutual pacts, treaties, or coalitions to achieve collective strength or political consolidation. They vary from formal legal federations to informal, often adversarial banding together.
groups.summary_zh: 指国家、团体或个人通过协议缔结同盟或结成联合体。

groups.name: Formally Request & Solicit · 请求与呼吁 (Request, Appeal, Solicit)
groups.tip: 从客气礼貌请求到极力恳求

items.def_en: to state that one wants someone to give them something or do something
(+ sth) make an official or formal request for something such as leave, a transfer, or a pay raise
to ask for something politely or formally
(+ sb) make a formal or earnest request to a person or authority for assistance or a decision
(+ sth) publicly demand or appeal for a specific action, policy, or remedy

items.def_zh: 呼吁，恳求；上诉，申诉；有吸引力
items.def_en: 1. to make a serious, urgent, or formal request for help, money, or information 2. to ask a higher court to reconsider a legal decision 3. to be attractive or interesting to someone
to formally ask someone for money, information, or help
(+ object + to do) to formally urge or invite someone to take a particular action
to make a formal, written application to an authority or court

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote making a polite, formal, or public application for help, action, or a decision, without necessarily implying emotional abjection. They scale upward from standard polite inquiries to pressing institutional or public calls for action.
groups.summary_zh: 正式、礼貌或公开地提出申请、呼吁与请求。

groups.name: Formally Submit & Lodge Documents · 呈交与递交 (Submit, Lodge, Tender)
groups.tip: 向有关机构再次呈交审查材料

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to) to present a proposal, document, or form to an authority for consideration or judgment
(+ with/against) to make a formal statement of a complaint, objection, or claim to an official body
to deliver a document, assignment, or notice to a person in authority

items.def_zh: 正式提出，呈交（申请、索赔等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) submit an official claim, proposal, or application to an authority
(+ sth) deliver or mail completed documents, forms, or applications to an organization

items.def_zh: 交出，呈缴（作业、报告、证件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) give a completed document, assignment, or formal item to a teacher, employer, or official

items.def_zh: 正式提出，递交（辞呈、申请等）
items.def_en: to offer or present something formally, such as a resignation, bid, or payment
to submit something again, especially after making revisions or corrections

items.def_zh: 重新呈交，再次提交（resubmit 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of resubmit; to have submitted something again for review or approval.

groups.summary_en: An individual officially hands over, tenders, or deposits documents, proposals, or formal notices to an authority or designated recipient for approval or processing.
groups.summary_zh: 向当局或官方机构正式呈送、递交文件、方案或辞呈。

groups.name: Formulate & Conceptualize Idea · 构想与设想 (Conceive, Formulate, Envisage)
groups.tip: 深思熟虑酝酿想法

items.def_en: form an idea, concept, or mental image in one's mind
(+ sth) think of or formulate an idea, plan, solution, or hypothesis
(+ sth) invent or formulate an unusual, creative, or impractical idea or plan
(+ sth) use one's imagination or intellect to originate an idea, story, or plan

items.def_zh: 构想，设想，构思；认为；怀（胎），怀孕
items.def_en: 1. To form an idea, plan, or concept in your mind; (+ of) to imagine or envisage something. 2. To become pregnant with a child.
plan or invent a complex method, system, or mechanism from thought

items.def_zh: 构想，制订，规划；确切阐述，明确表达
items.def_en: 1. To invent, design, or develop a plan, policy, or theory carefully in detail. 2. To express an idea or opinion in a clear and precise way.
contemplate or visualize a desirable or realistic future possibility

items.def_zh: 使概念化，将……形成概念，构想
items.def_en: 1. To form a concept, idea, or mental model of something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the mental process of originating, visualizing, or systematically structuring ideas, theories, or forward-looking plans. They vary in whether they emphasize the initial spark of creation, abstract modeling, or concrete articulation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在头脑中酝酿设想、构建概念或系统性地拟定方案。

groups.name: Forward Motion & March · 前进与行进 (Advance, March)
groups.tip: 整齐或坚定地向前

items.def_en: (+ into/out of) to walk or march together in a crowd, group, or body
move forward rapidly and purposefully despite obstacles
continue moving forward determinedly, especially despite fatigue, difficulties, or resistance
advance toward an objective or enemy territory with momentum and intent

items.def_zh: 齐步走，行军；坚定地走，挺进；迫使……同行
items.def_en: 1. To walk with stiff, regular steps, especially like soldiers. 2. To walk somewhere quickly and with determination. 3. To force someone to walk somewhere with you.
(+ on/forward) to continue moving rapidly or determinedly toward a destination or objective

items.def_zh: 前进，进军；推进，促进；提前；提出（观点）
items.def_en: 1. To move forward towards someone or something, especially in a military attack. 2. To develop, progress, or cause something to progress. 3. To bring forward a date, or pay money beforehand.
(+ ahead/on) to move forward steadily and purposefully, often despite resistance or obstacles
(+ forward) to move forward suddenly and powerfully like a tidal wave

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify intentional forward directional movement toward a goal or enemy position. They differ by formation, pace, and purpose—from formal military steps (march) to strategic or progressive forward momentum (advance, surge).
groups.summary_zh: 步调一致或有既定目标地向前推进与行军。

groups.name: Fragmentation & Structural Rupture · 碎裂与断裂 (Fracture, Fragment, Shatter)
groups.tip: 受力碎裂成细小碎片

items.def_en: develop a network of cracks or cause a solid surface to fracture
to break or fall apart into small fragments or powder gradually
separate or cause a solid object to separate into smaller parts or fragments
break into pieces because of structural weakness, strain, or decay
1. To break or split into many small, separate pieces or disconnected parts.

items.def_zh: （使）破裂，（使）断裂，（使）骨折；（使关系等）分裂
items.def_en: 1. To break, crack, or split, especially of a bone, rock, or hard object. 2. (of a group, organization, or relationship) To split or break apart.

items.def_zh: 打碎，破碎；（化）把……分馏，分成各个组分
items.def_en: 1. (archaic) To break or split into fragments. 2. (chemistry) To separate a mixture into different components or fractions, especially by distillation.

items.def_zh: （使木头、骨骼等）裂成碎片/刺状断裂
items.def_en: to break or cause to break into thin, sharp, jagged pieces
to break suddenly and violently into many small pieces

groups.summary_en: This manner frame denotes solid physical objects rupturing under stress, breaking into pieces, or losing structural continuity without total vaporization. Verbs distinguish whether the break is a fissure/crack in hard matter (fracture), disintegration into numerous detached shards (fragment, shatter), or splitting into segments (fraction).
groups.summary_zh: 坚硬实体受外力发生破裂、裂开骨折或散裂为无数细小碎块的过程。

groups.name: Fret & Preoccupy · 担忧与挂虑 (Worry, Concern, Fret)
groups.tip: 因不确定性而引发的焦虑不安

items.def_zh: 使担忧，使挂念；涉及，与……有关
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel worried, anxious, or troubled. 2. To relate to, affect, or be about something.

items.def_zh: 使担忧，使发愁；担忧，发愁；撕咬
items.def_en: 1. To feel anxious or troubled about actual or potential problems, or cause someone to feel this way. 2. To repeatedly bite or shake something with the teeth.
to cause someone mental disquiet, grief, or persistent anxiety

items.def_zh: 使心烦，使担忧；打扰，打扰别人；操心，费事
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel worried, annoyed, or anxious. 2. To disturb, interrupt, or trouble someone. 3. To take the time or trouble to do something.
to interfere with someone's peace of mind, causing anxiety or unease
(+ sb/sth) worry constantly or brood anxiously about an ongoing or potential problem
(+ sb) cause continuous emotional distress or persistent, gnawing worry to someone

items.def_zh: 使人忧心忡忡，沉重压在心头
items.def_en: (+ sb) make someone feel anxious, burdened, or persistently troubled
(+ about/over) to be constantly anxious and agitated about something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to feeling or causing anxious mental unease about real or anticipated troubles, spanning introspective brooding (fret), gentle interpersonal unease (concern), and intrusive distress (trouble).
groups.summary_zh: 对实际或预期的负面事由产生心神不安、挂念或困扰。

groups.name: Frolic & Play · 嬉戏与戏闹 (Boisterous / Carefree Play)
groups.tip: 无拘无束地嬉闹打闹作乐

items.def_en: engage in playful, silly, or boisterous activity purely for amusement
spend time playing or behaving playfully without any serious intention
to run, jump, or skip playfully, typically used of animals or young children

items.def_zh: 嬉戏，闹着玩（常与 about 或 around 连用）
items.def_en: (informal, lark about/around) To behave in a silly, playful, or mischievous way.
to play and move about happily, quickly, and energetically
(dated) To play around noisily and mischievously for fun.
engage in rough, noisy, or energetic physical play
to play about roughly, boisterously, and energetically
to jump or dance around excitedly and exuberantly, often in an uninhibited manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict moving, running, or playing about in a carefree, spirited, or mischief-making manner, varying from energetic gamboling to rebellious prankish antics.
groups.summary_zh: 欢快跳跃、无拘无束地嬉戏或淘气打闹，体现嬉戏的方式与动感。

groups.name: Froth & Billow · 起泡与鼓胀 (Foam, Belly, Billow)
groups.tip: 体积向外鼓出膨大

items.def_en: swell outward or cause something to swell or billow with air or wind

items.def_zh: 起泡沫，泛起泡沫；（口角）吐白沫；大怒
items.def_en: 1. To produce or form a mass of small bubbles on the surface of a liquid. 2. To have foam come out of the mouth, or be extremely angry.
[I/T] to produce or gather a mass of small bubbles on a liquid surface
to give off bubbles of gas as a chemical liquid swells and fizzes
expand or billow outward under the force of wind or gas pressure
produce a frothy layer of bubbles that swells and spills over the rim of a container
1. (+ out) To swell out or cause something (such as a sail) to swell outward with air or pressure. 2. (informal) To crawl forward on one's belly.

items.def_zh: 鼓起，如波浪般翻腾涌起
items.def_en: to swell outward or rise in large rolling, wave-like masses of fabric or smoke

items.def_zh: 如气球般鼓胀，急剧膨胀
items.def_en: (+ out) to swell out or puff up rapidly in spherical fullness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame capture dynamic swelling characterized by bubbly effervescence or aerated curvature (like sails or curtains filling with wind). They foreground the specific physical texture of bubbling or curved out-pocketing.
groups.summary_zh: 特指如波涛泛起泡沫般膨胀，或如风帆、布料受气流充斥向外鼓起膨出。

groups.name: Fulfill & Discharge Obligations · 履行与践行 (Fulfill, Discharge, Honor)
groups.tip: 顺利达成预定目标与职责

items.def_zh: 信守，践行（诺言、协议或支票）
items.def_en: To respect and keep a commitment, contract, or promise

items.def_zh: 满足，符合（要求、条件、规定）
items.def_en: To meet the requirements, conditions, or standards demanded
To succeed in doing or completing something successfully.
(+ sth) fulfill an obligation, pledge, or expectation to the expected standard
(+ sth) remain faithful to and uphold a promise, agreement, or decision
(+ sth) successfully carry out a promise or repay a debt or obligation

items.def_zh: 履行，履行（职责、债务、法律义务）
items.def_en: To perform or satisfy a formal duty, responsibility, or legal debt

items.def_zh: 履行，完成（职责、承诺）；实现（愿望、目标）；满足（要求、条件）
items.def_en: To do or achieve what was promised, required, or expected; to satisfy or meet a condition or need.
To fulfill or carry out a pledge, promise, or obligation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe satisfying binding duties, promises, conditions, or expectations set by contracts, moral codes, or formal roles. While 'accomplish' stresses bringing a planned task to a successful close, 'fulfill' and related verbs specifically emphasize meeting pre-existing obligations or requirements.
groups.summary_zh: 强调按规定、誓约或责任要求，圆满履行义务、践约或满足条件。

groups.name: Fulfill & Discharge Obligations · 履行职责与义务 (Execute, Perform, Honor)
groups.tip: 按约定或职责付诸实行

items.def_en: to carry out a required task, ceremony, or official duty
to keep a promise or fulfill the terms of an agreement

items.def_zh: 执行，贯彻（法令、计划或职务）
items.def_en: to carry out fully or perform a formal order, contract, or legal duty

items.def_zh: 实施，执行（命令、调查或职责）
items.def_en: to execute or complete a specific task, instruction, or duty
(+ sth) complete or execute an action, duty, or commitment that one started or pledged to do

items.def_zh: 把……进行到底，坚持完成（任务、责任）
items.def_en: (+ sth) continue working on a duty, obligation, or undertaking until it is fully finished

items.def_zh: 遵照……行动，履行（指令、职责）
items.def_en: (+ sth) take direct action in accordance with instructions, duties, or advice

items.def_zh: 履行，执行（职责、诺言）；清偿（债务）；准许离开，释放，免职；排出，流出；放电
items.def_en: 1. To carry out or fulfill a duty, task, or obligation; to settle or pay off a debt. 2. To officially allow or order someone to leave a place (such as a hospital, prison, or military service). 3. To release or emit a liquid, gas, or electrical charge.

items.def_zh: 履行，实行（诺言、职责）；达到，实现（愿望、目标）；满足（要求、条件）
items.def_en: To carry out or do what is required, promised, or expected; to achieve or satisfy a desire, hope, or requirement.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an agent meeting, completing, or carrying out formal duties, promises, contracts, or civic responsibilities. While 'fulfil' focuses on satisfying expectations or pledges, 'discharge' and 'execute' carry formal or legal weight in executing sworn duties.
groups.summary_zh: 强调按约定、法律或职责要求践行承诺、完成既定任务或义务。

groups.name: Fund & Underwrite · 出资与承保 (Fund, Underwrite, Sponsor)
groups.tip: 提供融资支持并承担风险

items.def_en: to provide money for an event, activity, or project
to support an event or project financially, often in return for commercial publicity
(+ sb/sth) provide financial assistance or emergency capital to rescue an enterprise from collapse
(+ sth) supply a sum of money required to finance a business, project, or venture

items.def_zh: 向……提供启动资金（或入股支持）
items.def_en: (+ sb) supply someone with financial capital or resources to establish a venture
to pay part of the cost of something to keep the selling price low or ensure survival

items.def_zh: 为……再融资，重新筹资（以借新债还旧债）
items.def_en: to replace an existing loan or mortgage with a new one under different terms or interest rates

items.def_zh: 承保，为……投保；包销（证券）；资助，为……提供资金担保
items.def_en: 1. (finance) to accept financial responsibility for an insurance policy, bond issue, or loan. 2. to support a project financially by agreeing to cover losses.

items.def_zh: 全额出资包揽，提供财务后盾
items.def_en: to supply all the necessary funds for an ambitious or risky venture

groups.summary_en: Actors in this commercial/financial frame provide capital, assume liability, or guarantee financial backing for an enterprise, loan, debt, or venture.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及金融机构或个人为项目、贷款或风险提供资金供给、责任承保或担保支持。

groups.name: Gamble & Risk · 赌博与投机 (Wager, Gamble, Speculate, Stake)
groups.tip: 下注押宝承担未知风险

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on) to risk a sum of money against an outcome, such as the result of a race or match

items.def_zh: 下赌注，拿……冒险；资助；用桩支撑
items.def_en: 1. To risk money or something valuable on the result of an event, race, or competition. 2. To risk or jeopardize something important. 3. To support financially or with stakes.
1. To risk money on a game of chance or bet on the outcome of a race or event. 2. To take risks in the hope of achieving success or a favorable result.
(+ sth) Risk money or resources on the outcome of a contest or uncertain event

items.def_zh: 就……冒险投机；在……上赌一把
items.def_en: (+ sth) Take a major risk in the hope of gaining an advantage from a particular outcome
(+ sth on sth) Risk something valuable, such as money or reputation, on an uncertain result
to put something vital such as reputation or life at risk on a dangerous chance
(+ in/on) to engage in risky financial transactions in the hope of making huge profit from market fluctuations
[I/T] (+ on/that) to risk a specific amount of money or valuable on an uncertain outcome (more formal than bet)

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to wagering money, assets, or outcomes on uncertain events, spanning recreational gaming, calculated financial speculation, and existential risk-taking.
groups.summary_zh: 在不确定性情境下押上金钱、利益或命运进行博弈、投注与金融投机。

groups.name: Gather & Converge · 聚集与汇拢 (Flock, Converge, Congregate)
groups.tip: 从各方向成群涌向一点

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ around/to) to come together or bring people together for a concerted effort

items.def_zh: 向…汇合，从四面八方涌向
items.def_en: to move toward and meet at a common destination or focal point

items.def_zh: 蜂拥而至；成群结队走向
items.def_en: (+ sth) Move in large numbers toward a specific place or event
(+ sth) Gather and enter a confined space together in very large numbers
(+ sth) Move into a place quickly and in immense, dense crowds like insects

items.def_zh: 成群结队地去，蜂拥而至；聚集
items.def_en: (+ to/together) To go or gather together in large numbers.
(+ into/to) to move in large, dense, active multitudes
(+ on/upon) To move toward or meet at the same point from different directions; to become more similar.
to come together in large numbers into a crowd or group

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe multiple people, animals, or objects traveling from different directions toward a single focal point. They emphasize movement toward a shared location, ranging from organic gathering to focused geometric heading.
groups.summary_zh: 人或事物从各处朝单一目标汇聚、涌向特定地点。

groups.name: Gleam & Sparkle · 闪烁与闪耀 (Flicker, Shimmer, Glitter)
groups.tip: 光芒细碎跳跃忽明忽暗

items.def_en: To shine or burn with an unsteady, wavering light; to appear briefly or faintly.

items.def_zh: 闪烁，闪闪发光；（眼睛）闪亮，露出笑意
items.def_en: To shine with quick, small flashes of light; (of eyes) to shine with pleasure or amusement.

items.def_zh: 闪烁，微微发亮，泛起微光
items.def_en: To shine with a soft, slightly wavering or trembling light.
To shine with a sparkling or reflective light, especially from a wet or oily surface.
(+ sth) emit a radiant or intermittent stream of bright light
reflect light in sudden bright or brilliant gleams
To shine brightly with many small, quick flashes of reflected light.
to give out brief, sharp flashes of reflected light from a hard surface

items.def_zh: 闪耀，闪闪发光（明亮锐利）
items.def_en: to shine brightly with points of flashing light through refraction or reflection

groups.summary_en: A light source or reflective surface emits unstable, intermittent, or reflected luminescence. Distinctions turn on whether the optical effect is wavering and faint (flicker), soft on wet/smooth surfaces (shimmer, glisten), or sharp and brilliant (glitter, sparkle).
groups.summary_zh: 光源或反光面呈现微弱颤动、温润泛光或耀眼折射。

groups.name: Govern & Steer Operations · 掌控与督导 (Manage, Mismanage, Direct)
groups.tip: 协调运作或暗中操控

items.def_zh: 主持，实施（管理运作过程）
items.def_en: to organize and carry out a particular activity, inquiry, or operational procedure
(+ sth) Mishandle or mismanage an affair, operation, or plan so that it fails

items.def_zh: 挥霍尽；败光（资源或资金）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Wastefully or carelessly exhaust a supply of money, resources, or estate
(+ sth) Assume managerial control or administrative direction of an operation or organization
to supervise, govern, or control the operations, staff, or course of an organization

items.def_zh: 管理，掌管；设法做到，应付；控制，操纵
items.def_en: 1. To be in charge of or run a business, organization, or project. 2. To succeed in doing or dealing with something difficult. 3. To control or manipulate someone or something.
to manage and be responsible for the running of a business, institution, or legal affairs
To manage or handle a situation, organization, or resource badly or incompetently.

items.def_zh: 精心策划并调度，协调操办
items.def_en: to arrange, plan, and direct a complex situation or event to achieve a desired result

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to the systematic control, administration, and executive direction of resources, organizations, or affairs. The manner ranges from competent orchestration to neglectful blundering.
groups.summary_zh: 主导、调控与组织人力、事务或机构的日常运转。

groups.name: Govern, Regulate & Oversee · 治理、立法与监督 (Govern, Legislate, Oversee)
groups.tip: 行使公权力进行立法治理

items.def_en: [I/T] to conduct the policy, actions, and affairs of a state, organization, or people with authoritative direction
to control or maintain the rate or speed of a process or supervise by means of rules and regulations
(+ sb/sth) Exercise sovereign political authority or administrative dominion over a people or realm

items.def_zh: 主持；掌管（体制、委员会或时期）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Hold formal institutional authority over a meeting, system, or transformative era
(+ sb/sth) Enforce strict regulatory or police measures against illicit conduct or violators
to manage and be responsible for the running of a business, organization, or system of laws
1. To watch over and direct people, work, or activities to make sure they are done correctly and safely.
to watch over and manage an activity or workers, especially in an official supervisory role

items.def_zh: 制定法律，立法；通过立法规定（或实现）
items.def_en: 1. To make or pass laws. 2. To bring about, determine, or control something by passing laws.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote institutional actions that steer public affairs, establish statutory frameworks, enforce compliance, or exercise administrative oversight over organizations and citizens.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖立法立规、行政管理及合规监管等国家与社会治理行为。

groups.name: Graphic Delineation & Visual Rendering · 绘制与描图 (Sketch, Graph, Cartoon)
groups.tip: 勾勒线条绘制图画形象

items.def_en: (+ sth) Delineate and render a formal visual plan, diagram, or blueprint

items.def_zh: 标绘；在坐标/图纸上标示出
items.def_en: (+ sth) Mark coordinates, paths, or points systematically on a chart or map
(+ sth) Draw a rough or preliminary outline of a picture or diagram quickly

items.def_zh: 画素描，画速写，画草图；简述，概述
items.def_en: 1. To make a quick, rough drawing of someone or something without many details. 2. (often sketch out) To give a brief or general description of something.
To draw a cartoon of someone or something, or to work as a cartoonist.

items.def_zh: 用图表（或坐标图）表示，绘制图表
items.def_en: To plot or represent mathematical data, functions, or relationships on a graph or chart.
To mark coordinates or draw a curve on a graph or chart
To describe or portray the outline or exact form of something visually
To represent in an exaggerated or distorted graphic depiction for comic effect

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on rendering shapes, concepts, or datasets visually onto a two-dimensional surface using drawing implements. The actions range from freehand preliminary outlining and satirical caricature to mathematically plotting coordinate functions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过线条勾勒、图表绘制或讽刺漫画化等手段在平面上描绘。

groups.name: Grasp & Clasp Tightly · 握持与紧抱 (Hold, Grasp, Clutch, Clasp)
groups.tip: 伸手牢牢抓紧或握住

items.def_en: (+ to sth/sb) keep a firm grip on something or someone
(+ to sth/sb) grasp or hold something tightly for support or safety
(+ to sth/sb) take hold of or attach oneself firmly onto someone or something
to hold something very tightly and securely with the hand
to hold someone or something tightly in your hands or arms
(+ to sth/sb) hold on to something or someone with great effort or tenacity
1. To take a firm hold of someone or something with your hand. 2. To completely understand a fact or an idea.

items.def_zh: 抓紧，紧握；企图抓住（clutch at）
items.def_en: 1. To hold something tightly, usually because you are cold, frightened, or in pain. 2. (+ at) To try very hard to grab something.
(+ to) to hold on tightly to somebody or something, especially from fear or desperation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking hold of and maintaining a firm, tight, or anxious manual or bodily grip on an object or person.
groups.summary_zh: 用手或双臂牢固、紧密或因恐惧/保护欲而紧紧抓住并握持。

groups.name: Grieve & Mourn · 悲哀与悼念 (Sadden, Grieve, Mourn)
groups.tip: 内心极度悲痛并寄托哀思

items.def_zh: 憔悴消沉；因悲哀相思而衰弱
items.def_en: Become progressively weak and despondent through intense, prolonged grief or longing
(+ for/away) to become weak with intense, unfulfilled grief or longing

items.raw_cluster: 使悲伤与使忧伤 Sadden & Grieve
items.def_en: To make someone feel sad, unhappy, or sorrowful.
(+ sb/sth) Experience or express profound sorrow over the death or tragic loss of someone
(+ sb/sth) Show solemn, outward bereavement and grief over a departed person

items.def_zh: 感到极度悲痛，哀悼；使悲痛，使伤心
items.def_en: 1. (+ for/over) To feel deep sadness, especially because someone has died. 2. To make someone feel very sad.
[I/T] to express deep sorrow, regret, or grief for someone who died or for an unfortunate situation

items.def_zh: 哀悼，哀痛，悼念；感到痛惜
items.def_en: (+ for/over) To feel and express deep sorrow or grief, especially for someone who has died.
[I/T] to wail in high-pitched grief over a dead body, especially in traditional lamentation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express profound psychological sorrow or ritualized bereavement over a death, tragic loss, or misfortune. 'Sadden' represents general despondency, 'grieve' conveys acute internal anguish, while 'mourn' and 'lament' signify formal, outward expressions of bereavement.
groups.summary_zh: 指因死亡或巨大不幸而产生的深切哀伤与外在悼念悼唁。

groups.name: Grind & Pulverize · 研磨与粉碎 (Powder, Pulverize, Mill)
groups.tip: 施加外力碾压磨成细小粉末

items.def_zh: （使）成颗粒，（使）粉碎成粒状；使表面成粗粒状
items.def_en: 1. To form into grains, or reduce something into small grains or granules. 2. To give a granular surface or wood-grain finish to something.
to crush or grind a substance into powder using a pestle
(+ sth) Press or smash a substance until it is completely reduced to fragments or powder
(+ sth) Reduce solid matter to small particles or smooth its surface by friction
(+ sth) Beat a solid repeatedly with a pestle or blunt implement until pulverized
to crush grain or other solid material into flour or powder in a mill

items.def_zh: 研碎，磨成粉末；往……上撒粉，擦粉
items.def_en: 1. To crush or grind something into a fine powder, or become powder. 2. To apply powder to skin or sprinkle powder over something.

items.def_zh: 磨成细粉；研碎（专用于医药、科研等）
items.def_en: to grind or rub something to a very fine powder, especially in pharmacy or science
to crush, grind, or pound something into fine powder or dust

groups.summary_en: An agent mechanically reduces solid materials into fine particles, granules, or dust using friction, pressure, or machinery. Verbs distinguish between milling into coarse granules, pounding into impalpable dust, or pulverizing completely.
groups.summary_zh: 通过机械力将固体物质碾磨、粉碎成细粉或颗粒。

groups.name: Guarantee & Ensure · 担保与确保 (Make Certain or Underwrite an Outcome)
groups.tip: 提供保证以杜绝意外风险

items.def_en: to succeed in obtaining or making certain that an outcome or asset is safe
To make certain that something will happen or that something is safe and guaranteed.
to promise formally that certain conditions will be fulfilled, or that a product has quality
to tell someone something positively to dispel doubt; to make something certain
to officially attest to or guarantee that a fact, condition, or product is genuine
(+ sth) Deal with a matter so as to make absolutely certain that an action or outcome occurs
(+ sb/sth) Express certainty or personal guarantee concerning someone's integrity or accuracy

items.def_zh: 锁定；确保获得（利率、条件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Make an advantageous contractual term, rate, or outcome permanently secured

items.def_zh: 给……投保，承保；确保，保证（尤美，同 ensure）
items.def_en: 1. To buy or provide insurance for someone or something against loss, damage, or death. 2. (especially US) To make sure or certain that something happens.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on establishing certainty, securing contractual indemnity, or guaranteeing a condition or outcome, differentiated by legal formality and operational directness.
groups.summary_zh: 确认结果必然发生或承担担保责任，涉及法律保障、商业承保到一般保证。

groups.name: Halt Activity & Forbear · 终止与罢手 (Cheese, Desist, Cease)
groups.tip: 动作暂时打住或彻底终结消退

items.def_zh: （航海或指令用语）停止，取消行动
items.def_en: nautical/colloquial: to cancel or halt an order or immediate ongoing activity
(+ sth) stop doing something or discontinue an action

items.def_zh: 停止；住手（常用于祈使句）
items.def_en: (+ sth) stop doing or saying something irritating or disruptive
(+ sth) stop doing something, especially an annoying or tiring activity or work
(+ sth) stop doing an activity, job, or annoying behavior

items.def_zh: 停止，罢休（尤用于命令句 cheese it）；使恼怒（cheese off）
items.def_en: (slang, chiefly imperative) To stop doing something, run away, or be quiet (especially in 'cheese it').

items.def_zh: 停止，中断（长期、系统性活动或供应）
items.def_en: to stop doing, providing, or maintaining a regular practice or production

items.def_zh: 停止，打住，终止（尤指停止令人不快或非法的行为）
items.def_en: (formal) To stop doing something, especially an annoying or unlawful activity (often + from).

items.def_zh: 停止，终结（较为庄重的书面通用词）
items.def_en: (+ from/to inf) to come to an end or bring an ongoing state/action completely to an end

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cessation frame specify halting an ongoing action or annoying behavior. Register and intensity progress from informal/archaic imperatives to break off an annoying act (cheese, belay), through formal/legal commands to deliberately forbear (desist), to universal and categorical stoppage (cease, discontinue).
groups.summary_zh: 描述中止或放弃正在进行的特定行为，从口语警告停手递进到法律严正勒令罢手。

groups.name: Hammer & Slam · 敲击与重击 (High-Force Destructive or Forceful Impact)
groups.tip: 从用力敲打到猛烈撞击或摔砸

items.def_en: to strike something forcefully with a sharp, sounding blow

items.def_zh: 不停地敲打；重重连续敲击
items.def_en: (+ at sth) Strike something forcefully and repetitively with heavy, relentless blows

items.def_zh: 砰的一声重重放下；用力摔下
items.def_en: (+ sth) Put or throw something down onto a surface with tremendous violent force and noise

items.def_zh: 猛击，重摔；砰地关上；猛烈抨击
items.def_en: 1. To shut, hit, or put something down with great force and a loud noise. 2. (informal) To criticize severely.

items.def_zh: 锤打，敲打；反复击打；狠批
items.def_en: 1. To hit or beat repeatedly with or as if with a hammer.
to hit repeatedly with hard, injurious blows so as to damage or shatter
(+ sth) Inflict devastating forceful blows on an object until it is heavily damaged or destroyed
(+ into/against) to break violently into pieces by heavy impact, or strike with crushing violence
to hit someone or something repeatedly with a heavy club or blunt instrument

groups.summary_en: An agent exerts forceful, aggressive blows on a target using a heavy tool, body mass, or swift momentum. The frame extends from repetitive heavy bludgeoning to single violent closures.
groups.summary_zh: 以极大力量重击、锤击或猛烈闭合碰撞。

groups.name: Hand & Deliver by Manner · 递交与转送 (Hand, Forward, Deliver)
groups.tip: 亲手交付或递送物件

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to) to pick up or take something and give it into someone's hand

items.def_zh: 顺道送达；把……送到下车处
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Deliver someone or something to a destination while en route
(+ sth) Distribute items directly by hand to each individual in a group
(+ sth to sb) Transmit or deliver an item, message, or document onward to another recipient
To give or pass something to someone using your hands.
to pass responsibility or physical custody of something to someone else formally

items.def_zh: 转寄，转发；运送，转运；促进，推进
items.def_en: 1. To send a letter, package, or electronic message on to another address or person. 2. (formal) To help something to advance or make progress.

items.def_zh: 投递，递送；兑现，履行；发表（演说等）；接生
items.def_en: 1. To take goods, letters, or parcels to people's houses or places of work. 2. To achieve, produce, or fulfill what has been promised. 3. To give a speech, talk, or statement.
(+ to) to transport goods physically or carry a message from one person to another

groups.summary_en: An agent transfers an object or communication to a recipient, progressing from direct physical manual passing to onward transmission and formal arrival.
groups.summary_zh: 从亲手递交物品，到中转转寄，再到送达指定接收方手中。

groups.name: Hang & Suspend · 悬挂与吊起 (Hang, Suspend, Dangle)
groups.tip: 由上至下垂挂悬空物体

items.def_en: 1. To attach or be fastened to something from above so that the lower part is free; to suspend. 2. To kill someone, or die, by dropping with a rope around the neck.

items.def_zh: 悬挂，吊；暂停，中止；使停职（或停学）
items.def_en: 1. To hang something from a high place. 2. To officially stop something for a period of time. 3. To temporarily prevent someone from working or attending school.
to hang something high up by cords or wires
(+ sth) Suspend an item from a hook, peg, or hanger so it hangs freely
(+ sth) Fasten and suspend an object using an elevated hook or clasp
(+ sth) Hang loosely and sway freely from an overhead anchor point

items.def_zh: 悬挂，吊；垂挂（hang 的过去式和过去分词，绞刑除外）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of hang (used for suspending objects, not execution).
[I/T] to hang or swing loosely, or hold something so that it swings freely
to hang or suspend something loosely between two points or over the shoulder

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe attaching an object from above so that it is supported without direct support from below, swinging or resting freely in the air. 'Hang' is the general term, 'suspend' is more formal or technical, while verbs like 'dangle' emphasize loose, swaying pendant movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指自上方固定物体使其下垂、无托底地悬于空中。

groups.name: Harass & Provoke · 骚扰与挑衅刺激 (Bait, Harass, Taunt)
groups.tip: 反复纠缠侵犯令人不安

items.def_en: (+ sb) Provoke and urge someone persistently to act rashly or foolishly
(+ sb) Repeatedly harass, tease, or criticize someone unfairly

items.def_zh: 故意挑衅，激怒，逗弄；在……装诱饵
items.def_en: 1. To deliberately annoy, taunt, or provoke someone into reacting angrily. 2. To place bait on a hook or in a trap.
(+ into) to repeatedly bother or pester someone with questions or demands
to provoke or challenge someone with insulting, sarcastic, or contemptuous remarks
to interrupt a public speaker or performer with aggressive comments or abusive shouts
(+ at sb) Deliver an aggressive verbal attack or physical blow in angry retaliation to provocation

items.def_zh: 骚扰，侵扰；不断困扰，烦扰
items.def_en: 1. To annoy, worry, or trouble someone repeatedly through unpleasant or threatening behavior.
(+ into) to deliberately annoy or incite someone until they react emotionally or aggressively

groups.summary_en: An instigator deliberately pesters, mocks, or badgers a victim to annoy them, wear them down, or goad them into an angry or irrational reaction. 'Bait' focuses on enticing a furious counterstrike, while 'harass' emphasizes persistent distressing pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 故意持续滋扰、嘲弄或言语相激以激怒对方或造成精神折磨。

groups.name: Harm & Inflict · 加害与危及 (Endanger, Imperil, Inflict)
groups.tip: 造成危险伤害与破坏受损

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to cause damage, punishment, or destruction to afflict someone (formal/literary)

items.def_zh: 强加于；把（伤害/痛苦）施加给
items.def_en: (+ sth on sb/sth) Force someone to endure suffering, injury, or painful hardship
(+ sth upon sb/sth) Cause misfortune, peril, or adversity to affect someone or oneself
(+ sth on sb/sth) Inflict immense damage, havoc, or destructive vengeance directly on a target
1. To put someone or something in a situation where they could be harmed, damaged, or destroyed.

items.def_zh: 予以（打击），使遭受（痛苦、损害等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/upon) To force someone or something to experience something very unpleasant, such as pain, damage, or defeat.
to do something that could damage or destroy an enterprise, plan, or safety
to cause or inflict massive damage, destruction, or vengeance upon something
to put someone or something in a situation where they might be harmed, destroyed, or lost

groups.summary_en: An agent, policy, or hazard introduces peril or imposes physical damage, suffering, or hardship directly onto a target entity.
groups.summary_zh: 主干框架为对目标施加损害、创伤或使之陷入危险境地。

groups.name: Heave & Haul with Effort · 提举与重力拉拽 (Heave, Heft, Haul)
groups.tip: 费力拉起或用力收紧

items.def_en: (+ at) to pull something hard, quickly, or repeatedly
(+ sth) Lift a heavy load into the air using ropes, pulleys, or mechanical tackle
to pull or drag something very heavy with continuous hard effort
to raise or pull up something heavy, often using ropes or mechanical gear

items.def_zh: 举起（试重量）；用力举起，抬起
items.def_en: 1. To lift or hold something heavy, especially to test or estimate its weight. 2. To heave or lift up with effort.

items.def_zh: （用绳索）收起帆角；把……绕成线球
items.def_en: 1. (nautical) To haul up the lower corners of a sail to its yard using ropes. 2. (archaic) To roll or wind thread or yarn into a ball.
(+ sth) Pull something weighty upward using ropes, rigging, or sheer muscular force
(+ sth) Raise or haul a very heavy burden upward with tremendous physical effort

items.def_zh: 用力拉（或举、推、掷）；（沉重地）起伏；喘息，叹气
items.def_en: 1. To lift, haul, or pull something heavy with great physical effort. 2. To throw or fling something with effort. 3. To rise and fall rhythmically or breathlessly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote lifting, hoisting, or pulling substantial physical burdens with muscular exertion or nautical rigging, characterized by weight evaluation, strenuous effort, and mechanical leverage.
groups.summary_zh: 借助肌力或绳索装置竭力提举、掂量或拖拉沉重物体。

groups.name: Heavy-Handed Domination & Batter · 强权碾压与残酷摧残 (Batter, Steamroll, Trample)
groups.tip: 以绝对优势强行碾压折磨对手

items.def_en: to strike repeatedly with hard blows so as to damage, bruise, or weaken severely
[I/T] (+ on/over) to step heavily upon someone or ignore rights and feelings in a harsh, callous way
(+ sth) Subdue or repress opposition completely and forcibly

items.def_zh: 蛮横践踏；横暴无视（他人权利或意见）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Act without caring about or respecting the rights, wishes, or feelings of others

items.def_zh: 践踏，肆意摧残（权利、自由或感情）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Treat feelings, rights, or laws with cruel or arrogant disregard

items.def_zh: 强行推进，霸道碾压（反对意见）
items.def_en: to force people or plans forward arrogantly, brushing aside objections by brute weight

items.def_zh: 强行推进，暴力压制；以势不可当之势击败，彻底击溃
items.def_en: 1. (North American variant of steamroller) To force an idea, plan, or measure through ruthlessly without regard for opposition. 2. To defeat someone overwhelmingly and decisively.

items.def_zh: 使遭受重创；使陷入两难夹击；彻底击溃
items.def_en: To subject someone or something to two opposing forces, losses, or pressures at once; to defeat or damage severely.
to destroy opposition, rebellion, or spirits entirely by extreme and overwhelming force

groups.summary_en: A powerful entity systematically crushes opposition or subjects individuals to punishing, disorienting force, moving from severe physical battering to ruthless institutional steamrolling.
groups.summary_zh: 从持续重击摧残递进至以压倒性霸权残酷碾压与摆布。

groups.name: Heed & Overhear · 倾听、聆听与旁听 (Hearken, Eavesdrop, Overhear)
groups.tip: 侧耳留心捕捉听觉声音

items.def_en: (+ on) to secretly or intentionally listen to a conversation that does not involve you
(+ to sth) direct one's auditory attention attentively toward a broadcast or sound
(+ one's ears) listen intently and alertly to a faint or sudden sound
to pay careful attention to somebody's advice, warning, or instructions and act accordingly
1. (+ on) To secretly listen to someone else's private conversation without their knowledge.

items.def_zh: 倾听，留神听（多用于祈使句）；追溯，重提（与 back 连用）
items.def_en: 1. (old-fashioned, used in orders) To listen carefully and pay attention. 2. ('hark back to') To recall, return to, or resemble an earlier time or topic.
to hear what other people are saying without their knowing and often without intending to

items.def_zh: 倾听，留神听；追溯，回溯（与 back 连用）
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To listen attentively and pay attention. 2. ('harken back to') To recall or return to an earlier subject or time.

items.def_zh: 倾听，留心听（多用于古体或文学语言）
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To listen carefully and pay attention to what someone says.

groups.summary_en: An agent attentively directs their hearing toward a sound or speaker, ranging from archaic or poetic invocations to listen and heed, to covertly listening in on private conversations.
groups.summary_zh: 侧耳细听、听从教诲，或在暗中偷听他人交谈。

groups.name: Hinder & Impede · 阻碍牵制与掣肘羁绊 (Cumber, Hamper, Militate)
groups.tip: 拖泥带水给前行增加负担

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) impede the progress, development, or success of someone or something
(+ sb/sth) restrict someone's freedom of action or movement with commitments or obstacles
(+ sb/sth) burden or encumber someone or something so as to hinder smooth action or progress
to severely disrupt or hinder the movement, progress, or effective operation of someone
to weigh down someone or something with physical, legal, or financial burdens
1. (formal / literary) To weigh down, hinder, or burden someone or something.

items.def_zh: 阻碍，不利于，对……产生负面影响
items.def_en: 1. ('militate against') (formal) To be a powerful factor in preventing something from happening or succeeding.
(+ sb/sth) prevent someone or something from making progress or moving forward
to severely restrict freedom of decision, action, or governance like putting in chains

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe factors, burdens, or actions that actively restrict progress, weigh down operational capacity, or operate forcefully as a structural barrier against success.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过增加沉重负担、羁绊或外部不利条件阻碍行动进展、掣肘成事。

groups.name: Hinder & Obstruct Actions · 阻碍与妨害 (Inconvenience, Hinder, Obstruct)
groups.tip: 制造障碍妨碍行动顺利开展

items.def_en: to put an obstacle in the way of someone or something, stopping progress
(+ sb/sth) Delay or impede the progress or operation of someone or something
(+ sth) Obstruct access or passage through a route or opening entirely
(+ sb/sth) Prevent or hinder someone from moving, working, or progressing freely
to delay or slow down the development, growth, or progress of something
To cause trouble, difficulty, or discomfort to someone.
To make it difficult for someone to do something or for something to develop or progress.

items.def_zh: 阻塞，堵塞；阻碍，妨碍；遮挡（视线等）
items.def_en: 1. To block a road, passage, or entrance with obstacles. 2. To prevent or hinder the progress or accomplishment of something. 3. To block someone's view.
to weigh down or burden someone or something so that free movement or action is restricted

groups.summary_en: Verbs marking interpersonal, legal, or physical friction that slows someone down, imposes logistical difficulty, or bars their smooth path or operation.
groups.summary_zh: 指给他人制造麻烦、拖延进度或阻挡通路以妨害正常行动。

groups.name: Hoist & Lift Mechanically · 吊起与升起 (Lift, Hoist, Trice)
groups.tip: 拉绳滑轮将重物向上吊起

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ up) to pull or drag something heavy upwards with prolonged effort
(+ sb/sth) Pull or drag someone or something upward with considerable mechanical or physical effort
(+ sth) Lift or raise something heavy upward with effort
(+ sb/sth) Hoist or pull someone or something upwards using a winch mechanism
to raise or pull something up to a higher position, especially using ropes or mechanical gear
(+ up/out) to lift or haul something using a mechanical winch
(usually trice up) to haul up and lash or fasten something securely with a rope
to lift or raise something up into a higher position
to lift or move heavy goods using a crane

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify raising an object or weight upwards, frequently employing ropes, pulleys, tackles, or dedicated lifting mechanisms. They differ according to the mechanism used (slings, halyards, tackles) and the height reached.
groups.summary_zh: 指借由绳索、滑轮组或机械力量将重物、帆或物体向上吊起、提升。

groups.name: House & Shelter · 安置与庇护 (Providing Lodging & Quarters)
groups.tip: 为人员调配居所与容身之地

items.def_en: to provide residential accommodation, shelter, or storage space for sb/sth

items.def_zh: 安置，为……提供住处；驻扎；把……分成四等份
items.def_en: 1. To provide someone, especially military personnel, with accommodation. 2. (of troops) To stay in a particular place. 3. To cut or divide something into four equal parts.

items.def_zh: 把（马等）关在马厩中，为（马）提供马厩
items.def_en: To keep or put a horse or other animal in a stable.
to protect sb/sth from danger, bad weather, or attack by giving them safe cover
(+ sb) Provide someone with temporary food and lodging in one's home

items.def_zh: 收留；接纳（庇护者、孤儿等）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Allow someone without a home or in need of shelter to live in one's home
(+ sb) Quarter or lodge soldiers in a civilian house or community
to give secret refuge or shelter to someone wanted by the authorities
(+ on / with) to lodge soldiers temporarily in a private home or designated station

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote supplying living accommodations, quarters, or protective sanctuary for people, refugees, military personnel, or animals.
groups.summary_zh: 为人员、部队或动物提供住所、营房、避难处或安置设施。

groups.name: Humiliate & Degrade · 贬低与羞辱 (Belittle, Humiliate, Dehumanize)
groups.tip: 剥夺人格尊严乃至非人化侮辱

items.def_zh: 轻视，贬低（使人感觉无足轻重）
items.def_en: to dismiss someone or their efforts as unimportant or small

items.def_zh: 居高临下地对待；鄙视地对……说话
items.def_en: (+ sb) Speak to someone in a patronizing, condescending way as if they are inferior
to cause someone to lose respect or lower their perceived moral/social standing
(+ sb) Regard or treat someone as vastly inferior, worthless, or beneath oneself
(+ sb) Criticize, mock, or belittle someone in a way that deflates their self-esteem or dignity
to make someone feel deeply ashamed, foolish, or publicly disgraced
to treat someone with complete disrespect, lowering their moral condition or human dignity

items.def_zh: 使蒙羞，玷污……的名誉；拒绝承兑（支票、汇票等）
items.def_en: 1. to bring shame, disgrace, or loss of honor upon someone or something 2. to refuse or fail to pay an accepted check, bill, or promissory note

items.def_zh: 使失去人性，剥夺……的人性尊严，使非人化
items.def_en: to treat people so badly that they lose their human qualities, individuality, or dignity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote treating individuals or groups in ways that crush their dignity, pride, or human status, escalating from verbal deflation of worth to total deprivation of human identity.
groups.summary_zh: 由轻及重剥夺个人或群体的尊严与体面，直至剥离其作为人的基本属性。

groups.name: Humiliate & Disgrace · 羞辱与贬损 (Shame, Humiliate, Disgrace)
groups.tip: 践踏尊严，使其名誉扫地蒙羞

items.def_en: To cause someone to feel guilt, distress, or embarrassment by exposing a fault
(+ sb) Lower someone's pride, spirits, or standing severely

items.def_zh: 拉下水；贬损尊严与品格
items.def_en: (+ sb) Corrupt someone or cause their moral reputation or dignity to degenerate
To reduce the quality, value, or moral standing of someone or something

items.def_zh: 使名誉扫地；使垮台蒙羞
items.def_en: (+ sb) Cause an esteemed person or institution to fall from power or suffer public disgrace

items.def_zh: 使蒙羞，使丢脸，使失去体面
items.def_en: To bring shame, dishonor, or discredit upon someone or a group through bad behavior.
To make someone feel very ashamed, foolish, or humiliated, especially in front of others.
To treat someone with disrespect and make them lose their self-respect

items.def_zh: 使深感屈辱，使极为难堪
items.def_en: To cause someone to feel deeply ashamed, severely embarrassed, or wounded in pride

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express causing someone to experience acute shame, lowering their dignity, or stripping away their public honor. They escalate from causing personal embarrassment or loss of face to stripping a person or group of their moral standing and societal reputation.
groups.summary_zh: 剥夺尊严、名誉，使其承受强烈的羞耻与公众贬损。

groups.name: Hypothesize & Postulate · 理论假设与前提设定 (Posit, Predicate, Postulate)
groups.tip: 从初步假设到确立公理

items.def_en: [I/T] to put forward an unproven idea or tentative explanation to be tested

items.def_zh: 提出（假说、设想或理论依据）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Propose an idea, theory, or hypothesis for consideration or discussion

items.def_zh: 陈述，阐明（理论假设或命题）
items.def_en: (+ sth) State, propose, or outline a hypothesis, proposition, or theoretical framework clearly

items.def_zh: 以……为先决条件，预先假定
items.def_en: to require or take something as an implicit prerequisite or given truth
(+ sth) Formulate a theoretical premise or assumption grounded in a principle

items.def_zh: 假定，假设；提出（观点、理论）
items.def_en: to suggest or accept that something is true, especially as the basis for a theory or argument

items.def_zh: 使基于，使以…为前提；断定，断言
items.def_en: 1. (usually be predicated on/upon) to base an idea, action, or statement on a particular assumption or fact. 2. to state or assert that something has a particular quality or property
to suggest or assume the existence, fact, or truth of something as a basis for reasoning

items.def_zh: 使公理化，定为不证自明的公理
items.def_en: to reduce to or formulate into fundamental self-evident axioms

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve laying down a hypothesis, premise, or axiomatic assumption as the theoretical basis for an argument or theory. They differ along an intensity scale from tentative conjecture to fundamental structural axiom.
groups.summary_zh: 指设定理论假设、公理或将某命题作为论证前提，强度由初步推断递增至基石确立。

groups.name: Idealize & Fantasize · 理想化设想与空想 (Fantasize, Glamorize, Glamourize)
groups.tip: 赋予过分美好的想象滤镜

items.def_zh: （dream的过去式及过去分词）梦见；梦想，幻想
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly British) Past tense and past participle of dream: to experience thoughts or images while asleep, or to imagine something desired.
1. (+ about) To spend time thinking pleasant, imaginative thoughts about things you wish would happen while awake.
entertain daydreamy, extravagant, and impractical fantasies
(+ sth) unrealistically desire that an unpleasant reality simply cease to exist
1. To imagine or view something as a future possibility or desirable outcome.
(+ about) to indulge in elaborate daydreams about desirable but unlikely events

items.raw_cluster: 理想化与美化 Idealize & Romanticize
items.def_zh: 把……理想化，将……想象得十全十美
items.def_en: 1. To regard or represent someone or something as far better or more perfect than they really are.

items.raw_cluster: 理想化与美化 Idealize & Romanticize
items.def_zh: （使）浪漫化，把……想象得富有传奇色彩（或过于美妙）
items.def_en: 1. To talk or think about something in a way that makes it seem more exciting, heroic, or attractive than it really is.

items.def_zh: 将……美化，使显得光鲜迷人
items.def_en: to portray or think of something as more attractive and exciting than it really is

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote cognitive processes where someone projects exaggeratedly desirable, unrealistic, or romanticized scenarios rather than objectively projecting feasibility.
groups.summary_zh: 带有主观滤镜地空想或构想，将事物想象得比实际更完美、浪漫或脱离现实。

groups.name: Identify & Recognize · 识别与辨认 (Distinguish, Discern, Spot)
groups.tip: 辨明特征认出对象

items.def_en: to see, notice, or identify someone or something, often when they are hard to perceive

items.def_zh: 识别，认出，辨认；查明，确定；认同，感同身受
items.def_en: 1. To recognize someone or something and state or prove who or what they are. 2. To find or discover the identity or presence of something. 3. (+ with) To feel that you understand and share the feelings or experiences of someone.

items.def_zh: 认出，辨出；承认，认可；表彰，赏识
items.def_en: 1. To identify someone or something because you have seen, heard, or experienced them before. 2. To accept, acknowledge, or realize the existence or truth of something. 3. To officially acknowledge or praise someone for their achievements or service.
to recognize the difference between two people or things, or discern something with the senses
to recognize and select a specific person or thing from a group
(+ sb/sth) Discern or distinguish someone or something with difficulty through sensory input
(+ sb/sth) Identify or choose someone or something distinctively from a larger group
(+ sb/sth) Recognize the difference between two or more similar people or things
to perceive, recognize, or distinguish something with difficulty or keen intellect

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cognitively matching sensory input against previous familiarity to determine identity, class, or individual distinctiveness.
groups.summary_zh: 指调取既有认知经验对所见所闻进行辨析，确认其具体身份或类别属性。

groups.name: Imitate & Emulate · 模仿与效法 (Mimic, Ape, Emulate)
groups.tip: 照葫芦画瓢地模仿学样

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Mimic someone or something humorously or satirically to ridicule them
(+ sb) Mimic someone's voice, accent, or mannerisms for entertainment or humor
(+ sth) Represent or imitate actions, scenes, or characters through performance
to imitate somebody or something unkindly in order to make them look ridiculous
to deliberately copy the style of a person, artist, or work in an exaggerated, comic way
1. To copy the way someone speaks, moves, or behaves, especially to entertain or ridicule. 2. To resemble or imitate something closely.
1. To copy someone's behavior, style, or speech, especially clumsily or uncritically.
to copy the speech, gestures, or actions of somebody, often naturally or as a model
to try to equal or excel somebody, especially by admiring and copying their achievements

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote copying another person's speech, gestures, behavior, or style, differentiating between admiring emulation, literal copying, and mocking caricature.
groups.summary_zh: 指模仿、仿效或滑稽模仿他人的言谈举止或行为风格。

groups.name: Impart & Inculcate · 传授与灌输 (Instill, Inculcate, Impart)
groups.tip: 循序渐进地传授思想观点

items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) to give or impart knowledge, skills, or advice to the next person or generation
(+ into/with) fill or soak someone or something with a particular quality or spirit

items.def_zh: 传授，告知，传达；赋予，增添
items.def_en: (+ to) 1. to pass information, knowledge, or wisdom to others. 2. to give a particular quality or taste to something.

items.def_zh: 逐步灌输，传授（思想、原则等）；滴注
items.def_en: 1. (+ in/into) To gradually put a feeling, idea, or principle into someone's mind so that it becomes firmly established. 2. (medical) To put a liquid into something drop by drop.
(+ with) inspire or permeate someone with a feeling, value, or quality
(+ sb) to teach something to someone through rigorous, continuous repetition
(+ sth into sb) to instill an idea, principle, or fact in someone by constant repetition
(+ into) instruct someone in something by rigid, repetitive exercise or discipline
(+ in/into) instill an attitude, idea, or habit by persistent instruction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote passing knowledge, qualities, or principles to someone, ranging from generous sharing to deep, repetitive cognitive conditioning.
groups.summary_zh: 将知识、品质或信念传递、逐步灌输给他人并使其内化。

groups.name: Improvise & Cobble Together · 即兴创制与临时拼凑 (Improvise, Extemporize, Cobble)
groups.tip: 未加准备当场构思创造

items.def_en: to make or assemble something quickly and roughly from whatever parts are available
(+ sth) quickly find, gather, or prepare something, especially food or resources, at short notice
[I/T] to make up lines, words, or actions on the spot in a performance or speech
(+ sth) construct or assemble something roughly and hurriedly using whatever materials are available
(+ sth) make, assemble, or arrange something hastily without much care or planning
(+ sth) produce or prepare something very quickly, especially a meal or improvised solution
[I/T] to speak, perform, or compose music without any prior preparation or script

items.raw_cluster: 即兴创作与发挥 Improvise & Extemporize
items.def_zh: 即兴创作，即兴表演；临时凑合，临时做
items.def_en: 1. (variant spelling of improvise) To perform or create spontaneously without preparation, or make something from whatever is at hand.

items.def_zh: 临时拼凑应急装置，权宜搭建
items.def_en: to build or repair something in a makeshift way using whatever materials are accessible

groups.summary_en: A creator devises, performs, or constructs something spontaneously without prior preparation, often utilizing whatever rudimentary materials or ideas are at hand.
groups.summary_zh: 无事先准备、随手利用现有材料或灵感临时创制或拼凑。

groups.name: Incarcerate & Confine · 监禁与拘押 (Imprison, Incarcerate, Confine)
groups.tip: 剥夺人身自由强制关押

items.def_en: To put or confine someone in prison or jail.
(+ sb) to put someone in a prison, jail, or secure psychiatric facility
(+ sb) to confine someone securely in a place where they have little contact with others
(+ sb/sth) to confine a person or animal in a tight, restricted space
(+ to) to keep someone closed in a place, such as a cell or room, preventing departure
to officially keep someone in custody or prevent them from leaving
to put someone in prison, or keep someone in a place they cannot escape from

items.def_zh: 关押，监禁（法律正式用语）
items.def_en: (formal) to confine or imprison someone by legal or penal process

items.def_zh: 关押，把……关在狭小空间（pen 的过去式及过去分词，常作 pent up）
items.def_en: (archaic or literary, past tense and past participle of pen) To confine or shut up closely in a small space.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to detaining an individual or animal by judicial authority or physical restraint, restricting them to a prison, cell, or enclosed space. 'Jail' is direct and everyday, whereas 'incarcerate' is formal and judicial, and 'pent' (often archaic or participial as 'pent up') highlights close enclosure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过司法制裁或物理禁锢手段将人限制于牢狱或狭小封闭空间内。

groups.name: Indecisive Hesitation & Vacillation · 优柔寡断与摇摆不定 (Hesitate, Dither, Vacillate)
groups.tip: 摇摆不定迟迟难下决断

items.def_en: to intentionally delay doing or deciding something due to uncertainty
1. (+ about/over) To pause before doing or saying something because of uncertainty, doubt, or nervousness.

items.def_zh: 犹豫不决，畏首畏尾，回避决断；蹑手蹑脚地走
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'pussyfoot around') To act or speak with extreme hesitation or caution so as to avoid taking a firm stand or making a commitment. 2. To move quietly and stealthily.
to waver repeatedly between two choices or opinions without deciding
to hesitate and spend a long time deciding before making a choice or giving an answer
to become unsteady or show indecision between choices

items.def_zh: 犹豫不决，摇摆不定；发抖，慌乱
items.def_en: 1. (+ over/about) To hesitate, vacillate, and waste time because you cannot make up your mind.
(+ between) to waver repeatedly between different opinions or courses of action
to fail to act and waste time through continual indecision

groups.summary_en: An agent delays making a choice, changes their mind repeatedly, or engages in timid evasion due to uncertainty, conflicting feelings, or lack of resolve.
groups.summary_zh: 指因拿不定主意、畏缩或反复权衡而踌躇不前、摇摆推诿。

groups.name: Inflict Harm & Abuse · 苛待与虐待 (Wrong, Mistreat, Abuse)
groups.tip: 不公对待直至残暴虐待

items.def_en: (+ sb) to bully, intimidate, or mistreat someone unfairly
(+ sb) to treat someone with physical violence to intimidate or harm them
To treat someone unfairly or unjustly.
To treat a person or animal in a cruel, unfair, or bad way.
to treat a person or animal cruelly, roughly, or violently
(+ sb) to hurt someone severely by repeatedly hitting or kicking them
to treat someone with repeated cruelty, violence, or exploitation
to deliberately single someone out for cruel or unjust treatment
to treat someone with extreme savage violence and cruelty

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe subjecting a person or animal to unjust, cruel, or damaging behavior, scaling from moral injustice and neglectful mistreatment to violent, dehumanizing abuse.
groups.summary_zh: 按侵犯严重程度递增描述对人或动物的不公对待、虐待与摧残。

groups.name: Inflict Psychological Torment · 精神折磨与创伤 (Torment, Torture, Traumatize)
groups.tip: 从轻微刺痛升级为深重心理创伤

items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause progressive, continuous mental distress or torment to someone over time

items.def_zh: 使焦虑不安，使悲伤痛苦；使苦恼
items.def_en: To make someone feel very upset, sorrowful, or anxious; to cause emotional suffering to.
to cause great anguish, or to suffer extreme emotional turmoil
(+ sb) to severely disturb or damage someone psychologically or emotionally
(+ sb) to cause someone profound psychological anguish, emotional pain, or distress
to cause intense, deliberate mental or physical anguish
to cause severe, persistent physical or mental anguish to someone
to leave a permanent mark of emotional suffering on someone's psyche

items.def_zh: 使受精神创伤；使受外伤
items.def_en: To shock and upset someone severely, leading to lasting psychological or emotional damage; to cause physical injury to.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote causing severe mental suffering, distress, or lasting psychic injury to a person, escalating from persistent emotional agitation to debilitating, life-altering trauma.
groups.summary_zh: 指对他人心理或精神造成持久煎熬、痛苦折磨乃至深重创伤。

groups.name: Inform on & Betray an Associate · 告密与告发 (Inform, Rat out, Grass up)
groups.tip: 暗中揭发秘密或出卖同伴

items.def_en: to inform on an associate or expose someone's misdeeds to an authority figure
to inform on a criminal associate to the police
(+ sb) to betray and report someone to the police or authorities
(+ sb) to report someone's bad behavior or misdeed to an authority figure such as a teacher or parent

items.def_zh: 揭发；告密（违法犯罪行为）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to bring an associate's wrongdoing or illicit activities to light by informing the public or authorities
(informal, dated) to inform on or betray an accomplice or friend
[I/T] (+ on) to inform on someone, especially regarding minor or petty infractions
(+ on) to betray a secret or inform to the authorities under pressure

items.def_zh: 告密，打小报告；闲聊，说闲话
items.def_en: 1. (especially of a child) to report another person's wrongdoings to someone in authority. 2. to gossip or chatter idly.

groups.summary_en: A person secretly discloses incriminating information about an accomplice, peer, or group member to police, teachers, or rivals, violating solidarity.
groups.summary_zh: 背弃同伴向警方或权威秘密告密、出卖或揭发违规行为。

groups.name: Informal Bargaining & Huddling · 讨价还价与私下商谈 (Dicker, Haggle, Chaffer)
groups.tip: 双方商讨条件或讨价还价

items.def_en: (+ with) to hold an informal meeting or conference to discuss a problem or plan
(+ with/about) to bargain or haggle repeatedly, especially over petty merchandise

items.def_zh: 反复商议达成；艰难敲定
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reach an agreement or deal after protracted, vigorous discussion and bargaining

items.def_zh: 深入讨论解决；反复协商
items.def_en: (+ sth) to talk about a problem or disputed details extensively until a resolution is reached
(+ sth) to persuade someone through haggling to reduce a price
(+ over/about) to argue persistently over the cost of something or petty details before reaching an agreement

items.def_zh: 空谈，扯皮，漫长费时的交涉
items.def_en: (+ with) to talk idly, profusely, or engage in lengthy, time-wasting negotiations
1. (+ over/with) (North American informal) To bargain or haggle persistently over the price, terms, or conditions of a deal.
1. (+ with) (informal) To have a casual, private chat or discussion.

groups.summary_en: Parties engage in protracted, often petty or informal discussions over terms, prices, or minor details, ranging from street-market haggling to backroom confabs.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重非正式或琐碎细节的讨价还价、私下商谈与扯皮。

groups.name: Ingest Rapidly & Noisily · 狼吞虎咽与咯吱咀嚼 (Crunch, Scarf, Gobble)
groups.tip: 门齿臼齿咀嚼咬碎食物

items.def_en: [I/T] to munch or chew audibly and vigorously

items.def_zh: 咯吱咯吱地咬嚼；嘎吱作响；（大量）处理（数据）
items.def_en: 1. to bite, chew, or crush food noisily with the teeth. 2. (informal) to process large amounts of information or numbers.
(+ sth) swallow food hurriedly without chewing it properly
(+ sth) eat something rapidly, hungrily, and noisily
(+ sth) swallow food or drink greedily and noisily in large mouthfuls
(+ sth) eat food very quickly and greedily

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽，大口吞食（常与 down 或 up 连用）
items.def_en: (slang, chiefly North American) to eat or swallow food greedily and quickly (often with 'down' or 'up')
(+ down/up) to swallow food hurriedly and greedily in large chunks
(+ down) to eat ravenously and quickly like a hungry animal

groups.summary_en: An eater consumes solid or crunchy nourishment either by chewing audibly and crispily or by ravenously gulping down food with greedy speed.
groups.summary_zh: 发出清脆碎裂声用力咀嚼，或贪婪而飞快地吞咽食物。

groups.name: Inhabit & Dwell Continuously · 定居与长久栖息 (Inhabit, Populate, Reside)
groups.tip: 人口或生物栖息于某地

items.def_en: to live in, work in, or fill a building, area, or room
(+ sth) to inhabit a particular building, area, or habitat as one's continuous residence
to establish a permanent home and continuous, stable residence in a particular place
to continue residing or dwelling in a place after others have departed
(+ in/at) to have one's permanent home in a specified place

items.def_zh: 承租定居；作为房客居住
items.def_en: to occupy land or property as a tenant or resident
(+ in) to live or stay permanently in a particular place

items.def_zh: 居住于，栖息于；构成……的人口；（计算机）填充（数据等）
items.def_en: 1. To live in an area and form its population; to inhabit. 2. (computing) To fill data or information into a database, spreadsheet, or form.
To live or reside in a particular place, habitat, or region.

groups.summary_en: Living beings live in, occupy, or colonize a territory, building, or habitat as their established place of residence.
groups.summary_zh: 指人类或动植物在某一地理环境或空间中长期居住、栖息。

groups.name: Inquire & Interrogate · 打探与质问 (Quiz, Debrief, Interrogate)
groups.tip: 从一般询问升级至严密审讯

items.def_en: (+ sb) to question someone indirectly to discover their opinions or intentions
(+ for) to try persistently to elicit information or secrets from someone
(+ sb for sth) to question someone persistently or slyly to obtain secret or private information
(+ about/on) To question someone closely to get information or test their knowledge.

items.def_zh: 详细询问，向（刚完成任务者）盘问情况并听取汇报
items.def_en: To question someone thoroughly about a completed mission or task in order to obtain detailed information.
(+ sb about sth) to question someone aggressively and relentlessly to extract information
to subject someone to intense, unrelenting questioning and pressure
to question a witness closely and aggressively to test the veracity of their testimony
To question a person closely, aggressively, or formally, especially a suspect or prisoner.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe questioning a person to extract information, ranging from casual probing or structured testing to systematic, high-pressure interrogation. Intensity escalates from brief questioning ('quiz') to professional intelligence extraction ('debrief') and aggressive adversarial grilling ('interrogate', 'grill').
groups.summary_zh: 指通过提问获取信息，从简短测问递进至严密审讯质逼。

groups.name: Insert & Intersperse · 填入与插入 (Interpolate, Grout, Wedge, Stuff)
groups.tip: 插入内部或嵌进缝隙

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fold or press the edges of something into a neat, secure position or narrow opening
to fill a hole or gap tightly with suitable material
(+ in/into) to push or fold edges into a safe, neat, or hidden position
(+ sb/sth) to manage to insert or fit someone or something into a very confined gap or tight space
(+ into/between) to fix or force something tightly into a narrow space
(+ into) to force or squeeze a large amount into a tight space
to fill the gaps between tiles, bricks, or stones with grout

items.def_zh: 插入，添加（语句或内容）；（数学）内插
items.def_en: 1. to insert extra words, remarks, or material into a text or conversation 2. (mathematics) to calculate or estimate a value between two known values
(+ sth) to push or stuff a large amount of material into an already tight space

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or textual insertion into an existing matrix, text, or gap. Manner distinctions reflect whether material is squeezed into seams (grouting), wedged tightly (stuffing/plugging), or inserted into sequences (interpolating).
groups.summary_zh: 通过塞、嵌、填或穿插等具体手法将外物置入空隙或原有序列中。

groups.name: Insinuating & Creeping Motion · 蠕动与潜入 (Worm, Sneak, Insinuate)
groups.tip: 放低身段悄悄移动

items.def_en: to advance into a space very quietly and slowly to avoid being seen or heard
to enter a place quietly, deceitfully, and stealthily so as to avoid detection
to move slowly, carefully, or gradually in a particular direction

items.def_zh: 潜行，偷偷地走；私带，偷偷放；告密
items.def_en: 1. To move quietly and stealthily so as to avoid being seen or heard. 2. To take, bring, or put something secretly. 3. (British informal) To tell an authority figure about someone's bad behavior.

items.def_zh: 蠕行，爬行前进；钻营（worm one's way into）；给（动物）驱虫
items.def_en: 1. To move slowly forward by wriggling, crawling, or twisting the body. 2. ('worm one's way into/out of') To insinuate or maneuver oneself subtly. 3. To treat an animal to expel parasitic worms.

items.def_zh: 潜行，偷偷走（sneak的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly North American informal) Past tense and past participle of sneak; to move stealthily, or to smuggle something quietly.
to move along by twisting and turning the body through a narrow space
(+ sth) to move slowly, twisting and wriggling, into a tight or restricted space
(+ oneself into) to maneuver oneself gradually into a favorable or tight position

groups.summary_en: An agent advances gradually into a restricted, tight, or forbidden space, often using subtle wriggling motions or deceptive stealth to avoid notice.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过蠕动、钻营或极隐秘手段慢慢潜入或钻进狭小隐秘空间。

groups.name: Inspire & Motivate · 激励与鼓舞 (Inspiring Action & Confidence)
groups.tip: 给予他人前行动力与信心

items.def_en: 1. To give support, confidence, or hope to someone. 2. To stimulate, foster, or promote the development of something.
to fill someone with the urge, creative ambition, or conviction to achieve something

items.def_zh: 激励，激发；成为……的动机，促使
items.def_en: 1. To inspire or give someone enthusiasm and determination to do something. 2. To provide a reason or motive for an action.
(+ sb) to strongly motivate, encourage, or urge someone to keep going or do better
(+ sb) to fill someone with high energy, enthusiasm, or passionate motivation
(+ sb) to urge or encourage someone persistently to take bold or risky action
(+ on) to urge a person forward to greater exertion or immediate action
to give someone the courage or confidence to do something daring
to make someone feel more hopeful, cheerful, or confident

groups.summary_en: An influencer instills spirit, purpose, hope, or willpower into another person to prompt productive action or bolster emotional resilience.
groups.summary_zh: 通过言语或精神榜样赋予他人信心与行动驱动力，促使其克服困难奋发有为。

groups.name: Insult & Slander · 侮辱与诽谤 (Slander, Malign, Vilify)
groups.tip: 公然羞辱或恶意捏造抹黑

items.def_en: speak to or treat someone with intentional disrespect or scornful abuse
speak of someone or something in a slighting, depreciative way
(+ sb) to insult, humiliate, or belittle someone, especially publicly
(+ sb/sth) to disparage, criticize, or denigrate someone's reputation repeatedly
make damaging and defamatory false oral statements about someone
(formal, often passive) To insult or offend someone openly, deliberately, and to their face.
(formal) To speak or write about someone in an abusive and unfairly critical way so as to damage their reputation.
(formal) To say or write false, harmful, and unfair things about someone.
deliberately harm the good reputation of someone through libel or slander

groups.summary_en: An agent speaks ill of someone or directly attacks their honor, scaling from overt offensive disrespect to venomous public character assassination.
groups.summary_zh: 言语攻击、恶意中伤或损害他人名誉，程度由当面冒犯递增至恶毒诋毁。

groups.name: Integrate & Desegregate · 整合与融入 (Systemic Socio-Political Inclusivity)
groups.tip: 消除隔离并重新融入群体

items.def_en: (+ into) to include a constituent group or element as a functional part of a unified body
(+ into/with) to combine different ethnic or social factions into full, equal participation

items.def_zh: 使主流化；使融入正规体制
items.def_en: to place formerly isolated or special-needs individuals into conventional educational or social environments
to fit naturally into a community or environment without looking different
to feel or be accepted as a natural member of a social group or society
(+ sb) to integrate or include someone within an existing group, system, or organization
(+ into) to absorb a group into the prevailing culture, adopting its customs and attitudes
1. (+ into) To help someone return to normal society or a group, or to combine again into a unified whole.

items.def_zh: 废止种族隔离，实现融合
items.def_en: 1. To end the legal or social separation of different racial or religious groups in schools or public places.

groups.summary_en: Institutional authorities or communities incorporate previously segregated, marginalized, or excluded groups into the mainstream social, institutional, or educational fabric. Verbs contrast legal desegregation with interpersonal cultural adaptation.
groups.summary_zh: 在社会结构或体制中消除隔离、接纳吸收特定群体。

groups.name: Interfere & Meddle Deviously · 乱动与不正当篡改 (Monkey, Tamper, Meddle)
groups.tip: 动手操纵把玩或胡乱摆弄拆改

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fiddle with or alter a mechanism carelessly or without authorization
(+ sth) to tinker with or tamper with something without serious intent or qualification
(+ with) to make minor, often amateurish or experimental changes to something

items.def_zh: 胡乱摆弄，瞎捣弄；胡闹，瞎搞
items.def_en: (+ with/around) To play or tamper with something carelessly, foolishly, or without permission.
(+ sth) to meddle with or alter something inappropriately, causing problems
(+ with/in) to try to change or influence things that are not your responsibility or concern

items.def_zh: 熟练操作，摆弄；操纵，摆布（人或局势）；篡改（数据等）
items.def_en: 1. To control, move, or operate something skillfully with the hands. 2. To influence or control someone or something in a clever or dishonest way.
(+ with) to interfere with or damage something secretly, unauthorizedly, or illegally
to dishonestly alter, falsify, or adulterate something in order to deceive

groups.summary_en: An actor inappropriately, mischievously, or deceitfully meddles with a mechanism, document, or system without authority. The scale ranges from clumsy informal tinkering ('monkey with') to unauthorized illicit alteration ('tamper with') and calculated fraudulent manipulation ('manipulate').
groups.summary_zh: 擅自乱动、瞎摆弄或不正当地篡改机构或数据。

groups.name: Invert & Upend · 翻转与倒置 (Upend, Invert, Overturn)
groups.tip: 倒置底朝天或颠倒上下

items.def_en: (+ sth) to turn over quickly so that the opposite side is facing up
[I/T] To tilt or cause to lean over so that one end lifts up
(+ sth) to reverse the position of something so that the top becomes the bottom
(+ sth) to overturn or cause something to lose balance and fall upside down or on its side
[I/T] To turn completely over or upside down, especially by accident or force
To turn something upside down or reverse its normal position, order, or condition
(medicine / technical) To turn something, such as an organ or body part, inside out.
[I/T] To overturn or cause a boat or ship to flip over in the water

items.def_zh: （使）颠倒，（使）倒放；彻底颠覆，打乱
items.def_en: 1. To turn something upside down or set it on end. 2. To disrupt, overturn, or throw into disorder.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify physically turning an object upside down, inside out, or reversing its physical orientation. 'Evert' is a technical/anatomical term for turning outward or inside out, whereas 'upend' stresses setting or turning an object on its end or turning it top-to-bottom.
groups.summary_zh: 将物体颠倒放置、上下翻转或自内向外翻开。

groups.name: Involuntary Physical Startle · 生理退缩与畏缩 (Flinch, Recoil, Cringe)
groups.tip: 本能受惊畏惧而向后缩身

items.def_en: to make a slight grimace or momentary movement out of sudden pain or distress
to pull back one's body or hand instinctively away from an unpleasant stimulus or danger
to bend one's body down in fear or apprehension; cower
to move backwards reflexively out of fear, pain, or revulsion
to jerk or leap backward suddenly in surprise, shock, or alarm

items.def_zh: 畏缩，退缩；（枪炮等）后坐，反冲
items.def_en: 1. To move back suddenly in fear, shock, or disgust. 2. (of a gun) To kick backward rapidly upon being fired.
(+ at/from) To make a sudden, small movement backward in pain, fear, or shock, or avoid facing something unpleasant.
to draw back in fear or lose heart in the face of danger
to crouch down or shrink away in fear and helplessness

groups.summary_en: A person reacts physically and instinctively by pulling back or tensing up in response to sudden pain, disgust, shock, or physical threat. Verbs describe reflexive somatic defensive movements.
groups.summary_zh: 因剧痛、恐惧或恶心而产生的本能、突发性躯体后退或缩身反应。

groups.name: Isolate & Quarantine · 隔离与孤立 (Isolate, Quarantine, Segregate)
groups.tip: 制度性分立或疫情防疫隔离

items.def_en: to separate someone or something physically or socially from others
to stop people from getting into an area by surrounding it with a rope, police, or barrier
(+ sb/sth) isolate someone or something completely from access, contact, or outside communication
(+ sb) confine or isolate someone securely away from the general public
(+ sb) keep someone in confinement or seclusion away from other people
(+ sb/sth) separate or isolate a person, group, or area by enclosing it completely
1. To isolate a person, animal, or ship for a period of time to prevent the spread of infectious disease.

items.def_zh: 使免受隔绝；使隔绝影响
items.def_en: to protect someone or something from unpleasant experiences or external influences

items.def_zh: 隔离，使分开；对……实行种族隔离
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To separate one group of people or things from another, especially because of race, sex, or religion.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe separating people, groups, or entities from others according to institutional policies, disease prevention, or social division.
groups.summary_zh: 因防疫、社会区隔或制度政策而将人或群体分离孤立。
