groups.name: Jar & Agitate Mental Peace · 震扰心神与不适 (Disturb, Jar, Unsettle)
groups.tip: 打破内心平静，产生焦虑烦躁

items.raw_cluster: 扰乱与使不安 Disturb & Agitate
items.def_zh: 打扰，扰乱；使不安，使心烦意乱
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel worried, anxious, or upset. 2. To interrupt someone or break the peace and order of something.
(+ sb) to shock, distress, or disturb someone's mental calm significantly

items.def_zh: 激起（烦躁、不安等负面情绪）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to agitate or evoke turbulent, uneasy feelings within someone
(+ sb) to upset someone's composure or unsettle their peace of mind

items.def_zh: 刺激，使烦躁不适；震撼，颠簸；发出刺耳声
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To have an unpleasant, annoying, or harsh effect on someone's nerves, feelings, or senses. 2. To shake or jolt forcefully.
to make someone feel anxious, insecure, or troubled in mind
to stir up intense anxiety, nervous excitement, or emotional distress in someone
to upset the smoothness or composure of someone; discompose
to make someone worried, uneasy, or emotionally troubled

groups.summary_en: Depicts external sensory inputs, shocks, or sudden events breaking someone's mental peace, composure, or concentration. The effect ranges from an abrupt clash with sensibilities ('jar') to lingering inner unease ('unsettle', 'disquiet').
groups.summary_zh: 指外界声响、反差或冲击打破内心宁静，引起突兀不安或焦虑。

groups.name: Keep Company Disreputably · 厮混与依附 (Consort, Stooge)
groups.tip: 从日常社交结识到充当附庸傀儡

items.def_en: (+ with) (informal) to spend time together casually as close companions, often dubious

items.def_zh: （常指与不三不四的人）厮混在一起
items.def_en: (+ with sb) to spend time socially with disreputable or questionable company
(+ with sb) to spend time or socialize casually with undesirable companions

items.def_zh: 充当傀儡，充当走狗；当衬托人，充当配角
items.def_en: 1. (+ for) (informal) To act as a pawn or subordinate tool for someone else. 2. To serve as a comic foil or straight man in a theatrical act.
(+ sb) to associate or keep company regularly with a disreputable group

items.def_zh: 亲善来往；（与敌对或违规方）私交
items.def_en: (+ with) to associate in an improper, familiar way, especially with an enemy or underlings

items.def_zh: 厮混，结交（不良之徒）；符合，相称
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) (disapproving) To spend a lot of time keeping company with someone disapproved of. 2. (+ with) (formal) To agree or harmonize with something.
(+ with) to mix socially with people of higher social status in a familiar way
(+ with) to cooperate secretly or deceitfully with others for illicit ends

groups.summary_en: These intransitive verbs denote socializing or associating with undesirable, suspicious, or illicit individuals, often carrying disapproval or implying sycophantic subservience. 'Consort' carries formal legal/moral disapproval, while 'stooge' highlights acting as an underling or compliant puppet.
groups.summary_zh: 强调与不良分子厮混、沆瀣一气或充当谄媚帮凶。

groups.name: Kiss & Embrace by Manner · 亲吻与搂抱 (Kiss, Buss, Smooch)
groups.tip: 亲昵肢体接触表达爱意

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on) to kiss someone quickly and lightly, often on the cheek
to draw close to another person affectionately in an embrace
[I/T] (formal or humorous) to kiss
(old-fashioned or humorous) To kiss someone.
(informal) To kiss and cuddle someone intimately or affectionately.
(+ sb) to kiss and fondle someone passionately over a period of time
1. To touch someone or something with your lips as a sign of affection, greeting, or respect. 2. (literary) To touch lightly or gently.
(+ with) to engage in prolonged, passionate kissing and caressing
[I/T] (informal, chiefly British) to kiss someone passionately for a long time

groups.summary_en: Individuals touch lips or embrace affectionately, varying from casual peck-like kisses to prolonged romantic smooching or necking.
groups.summary_zh: 用嘴唇触碰或亲密搂抱，从随意的轻触到缠绵激情的拥吻。

groups.name: Labor & Toil · 劳作与苦干 (Labor, Toil, Busy)
groups.tip: 付出辛勤体力奔波劳碌

items.def_zh: 使忙于，忙着做（busy oneself with/in）
items.def_en: 1. (busy oneself) To occupy oneself with something; to keep busy doing something.

items.def_zh: 辛勤劳作，苦干；艰难前行；尽力争取
items.def_en: 1. To work hard, especially doing difficult physical work.
(+ away/at) to work extremely hard and continuously for long hours under arduous conditions

items.def_zh: 做苦工，像奴隶般辛苦劳作
items.def_en: to work extremely hard and continuously for little reward or relief
to persevere exhaustingly at a strenuous, monotonous task
to work relentlessly and laboriously over a prolonged period
(+ away/through) to work hard and steadily at a tiring, tedious, and grueling task

items.def_zh: 做苦工，做乏味繁重的工作
items.def_en: to perform menial, unpleasant, dull, or servile labor over extended periods
(+ away/for) to work exceedingly hard like a slave, often with little rest or reward

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expending continuous bodily or mental effort in difficult, exhausting work, ranging from remaining actively occupied to agonizing over-exertion.
groups.summary_zh: 指付出繁重体力或脑力进行的持续艰辛劳作，从操持忙碌到精疲力竭。

groups.name: Laborious Incremental Motion · 挪动与费力推进 (Budge, Chug, Inch)
groups.tip: 改变位置或挪动细微距离

items.def_en: [I/T] to move or advance slowly and gradually in a particular direction

items.def_zh: 缓慢移动，艰难地一步步挪动
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ along/towards) to move or cause to move very slowly and carefully in small stages

items.def_zh: 缓慢匀速前行，吃力运转
items.def_en: to make slow but steady progress, often like an engine working evenly

items.def_zh: 缓慢爬行，极其费力地挪动
items.def_en: to move forward at an excruciatingly slow, dragging pace

items.def_zh: 步履沉重地前行，艰难跋涉
items.def_en: to walk or advance slowly and heavily with great effort
to progress in tiny, reluctant increments against resistance

items.def_zh: 缓缓行进，蹑手蹑脚移动
items.def_en: to move slowly, quietly, or cautiously so as not to be noticed

items.def_zh: 微微移动；（使）挪动；（使）改变主意
items.def_en: 1. (usually in negative sentences) To move slightly, or to make something move slightly. 2. To change your opinion, or to persuade someone to change their mind.

items.def_zh: 咔嚓咔嚓地缓慢移动；发出咔嚓声；（一口气）咕嘟咕嘟喝下
items.def_en: 1. To move slowly while making a regular, muffled engine sound. 2. (informal) To drink all of a beverage quickly without pausing.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture difficult, slow, or begrudging motion, either in tiny increments against resistance (budge/inch) or as steady, rhythmic, mechanical chugging across distance.
groups.summary_zh: 在阻力下极其缓慢、吃力地微移或伴随轰鸣有节奏地缓慢行进。

groups.name: Lean & Tilt · 倾斜与倚靠 (Lean, Tilt, Slant)
groups.tip: 重心歪斜或向支撑物倾倒

items.def_en: to incline one's upper body backwards against a resting support
to bend or incline one's body sideways or downwards away from a vertical stance
(+ sth) to slope or cause to incline away from an upright position

items.def_zh: 倾斜，使成角度移动；调整……的角度；钓鱼；谋取
items.def_en: 1. To move, proceed, or lean at an angle; to place or turn something at an angle. 2. (+ for) To try to obtain something indirectly or fish with a hook and line.

items.def_zh: 倾斜；倚靠，靠在……上；使倾斜
items.def_en: 1. To slope or bend away from an upright position. 2. To rest against a wall or other support, or place something in this resting position.
[I/T] move or cause to move into a sloping position with one end higher than the other
[I/T] slope or lie in an oblique direction rather than straight vertical or horizontal

items.def_zh: 倾斜；倚靠（lean的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: (chiefly British English) Past tense and past participle of lean; to incline or rest against a support.
[I/T] overbalance or cause to tilt to the point of spilling or falling over

groups.summary_en: A body or physical object deviates from a strict vertical or horizontal orientation, or rests against a supporting surface for balance.
groups.summary_zh: 身体或物体偏离垂直/水平轴线发生倾侧，或倚靠在支撑面上。

groups.name: Learn & Master · 学习与掌握 (Skill Acquisition & Role Preparation)
groups.tip: 钻研领会新知并彻底掌握技能

items.def_en: to gain comprehensive, expert control, understanding, or proficiency in a subject or craft
(+ on) to refresh and improve one's previous knowledge or proficiency in a dormant skill
(+ on) to study a specific topic thoroughly and quickly in order to prepare
(+ sth) to acquire a skill or piece of knowledge through practice or observation
(+ on sth) to study a subject intensively in order to master it
(+ on sth) to learn a large amount of factual material quickly for immediate application
to make knowledge, rules, or values an inherent part of one's own subconscious behavior

items.def_zh: 充当（某角色的）替角；学习（某人的角色或工作）以备接替
items.def_en: To learn another actor's part in a play so as to be able to replace them if necessary; to study another's work to act as a substitute.
To learn something again, especially after forgetting it or after an injury.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe acquiring competence, internalized knowledge, or specific operational skills to the point of proficient execution or role mastery.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过练习、复习或跟班排练以获得专门技能或角色胜任力。

groups.name: Legal Prohibition & Rejection · 取缔与否决 (Veto, Outlaw, Ban)
groups.tip: 行使公权力否决或取缔非法

items.def_zh: 不予准许，宣布（某事物）无效
items.def_en: to refuse to allow something, typically by finding that it breaches legal or official rules
(+ on sth) to take strict official action to suppress, restrict, or prohibit an illegal activity

items.def_zh: 判决无效，推翻（法令、法规）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially reject, nullify, or veto a legal rule or statute as invalid
to decide or declare officially that something is not allowed

items.def_zh: 正式宣布……为非法，明令取缔
items.def_en: to prohibit or forbid something formally and officially by law
(+ sth) to suppress or eradicate an unwanted practice or activity completely using decisive authority

items.def_zh: 宣布……为非法，取缔；剥夺……的法律保护
items.def_en: 1. to make an activity, organization, or practice illegal by law. 2. (historical) to deprive someone of legal protection.

items.def_zh: 否决，行使否决权；拒绝批准
items.def_en: to use official authority to reject a bill, proposal, or decision, preventing it from taking effect.

items.def_zh: 撤销，废止（法律判决或裁决）
items.def_en: to officially reject or declare invalid, especially an official ruling or conviction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the exercise of institutional or executive power to reject a measure or permanently prohibit an activity by statute. They range from formal executive negation of a bill to total legal interdiction and criminalization.
groups.summary_zh: 运用宪法或法定行政权力正式否决法案或依法取缔违法活动。

groups.name: Leisurely Strolling & Ambling · 漫步与闲逛 (Saunter, Mosey, Amble)
groups.tip: 无特定目的悠闲漫步游荡

items.def_zh: 随处闲逛，漫无目的地踱步
items.def_en: to amble along without urgency or destination
to walk slowly and in a relaxed manner, enjoying the passage
(+ sth) to walk slowly and casually around an area without a definite purpose
1. (+ along/over/into) (informal) To walk or stroll in a slow, relaxed, and unhurried manner.
to walk in a leisurely way for pleasure or exercise
to walk slowly and without a clear direction, turning often
to walk at a slow, relaxed, and easy pace
1. (+ along/into/past) To walk in a slow, relaxed, confident, and unhurried way.

items.def_zh: 闲荡，闲逛；白吃白拿，乞讨（mooch off）
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) (chiefly British informal) To walk, stroll, or loiter around lazily with no clear purpose. 2. (+ off) (chiefly North American informal) To ask for and obtain something from someone without paying for it.

groups.summary_en: An agent walks in an unhurried, relaxed, or casual manner without urgency, often enjoying the surroundings or drifting without a strict destination.
groups.summary_zh: 指从容不迫、步调缓慢、漫无目的或轻松惬意的步行方式。

groups.name: Leverage Advantage · 借势获益与巧用 (Benefit, Capitalize, Exploit)
groups.tip: 从中获取利益与好处

items.def_zh: 得益，受益；有益于，使受益
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To get an advantage or benefit from something. 2. To be useful or helpful to someone.
(+ from/by) to gain an advantage or benefit from a situation
to utilize a situation or resource fully and strategically, often selfishly
(+ on) to take opportunist advantage of an event or situation for financial gain

items.def_zh: 利用，依仗（声誉或优势）获利
items.def_en: (+ sth) to exploit a reputation, connection, or advantage for personal benefit

items.def_zh: 利用（他人的弱点或特定局势）谋利
items.def_en: (+ sth) to exploit circumstances, fears, or weaknesses to gain an advantage
(+ sth) to use an existing achievement or advantageous position as a base for further success
to use something to maximum advantage to achieve a desired outcome

items.def_zh: 利用，从中牟利（capitalize on）；将……大写；使资本化
items.def_en: 1. (capitalize on) To take advantage of something; to turn something to your advantage. 2. To write or print a word using a capital letter. 3. To provide a company or business with capital.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actors turning circumstances, situations, or existing resources to their strategic advantage, ranging from passive reception of good to aggressive opportunistic leveraging.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用局势、机会或既有条件为自身谋取实质利益与优势。

groups.name: Limit & Restrict Scope · 限制与划定界限 (Limit, Circumscribe, Delimit)
groups.tip: 划定界限以防逾矩

items.def_en: To keep something within a particular amount, size, or level, or prevent it from increasing.
(+ to) to put a hard limit on the amount, size, or freedom of action permitted

items.def_zh: 限制，约束（自由或活动范围）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) restrict sb's freedom, movement, or range of choices
(+ sb/sth) enclose or restrict sb's actions within narrow operational boundaries

items.def_zh: 困住；严密限制（使其无回旋余地）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) prevent sb from acting freely by severely limiting their available options
to severely limit or force a course of action through strict external conditions
to reduce in extent or quantity, imposing a cutoff before natural completion

items.def_zh: 限制，约束（自由或权力）；在……周围画线
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To restrict someone's power, rights, or freedom within strict boundaries. 2. (geometry) To draw a line around a shape.

items.def_zh: 划定界限，界定，阐明……的范围
items.def_en: (formal) To determine, mark, or set the exact limits or boundaries of something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs concerning the establishment of finite legal, physical, or operational boundaries that prevent expansion beyond set parameters.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过划定界限、设立参数或制度规范来约束范围与规模。

groups.name: Lobby & Solicit · 游说与劝诱 (Lobby, Induce, Canvass)
groups.tip: 施加影响促使其赞同

items.def_zh: 做…的思想工作；试图说服
items.def_en: (+ sb) try continuously to influence or persuade sb to agree to sth
[I/T] (+ for) to systematically solicit votes, subscriptions, or opinions from people in a district
(+ into) to persuade someone to do something through persistent flattery or false promises

items.def_zh: 招揽；极力游说争取（支持或选票）
items.def_en: (+ sth) try energetically to solicit or obtain political support, votes, or business

items.def_zh: 向…施压；施加压力以说服
items.def_en: (+ sb) put heavy pressure on sb in order to influence or persuade them

items.def_zh: 劝诱，诱使；引起，导致；催产
items.def_en: 1. To persuade or influence someone to do something. 2. To cause something to happen or exist. 3. To make a woman start labor by giving her medicine.
To try to persuade a politician, government, or other official to support or oppose a change in the law.
[I/T] (+ for) to ask someone for money, help, votes, or political support in a direct, earnest manner
(+ into) to exert sustained political, social, or coercive pressure on someone to force compliance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict deliberate political or strategic efforts to influence legislators, voters, or decision-makers into supporting a policy or making a concession. They differ by mechanism: formal legislative pressure (lobby), offering incentives (induce), or systematic door-to-door solicitation (canvass).
groups.summary_zh: 施加政治压力或以利益诱导对决策者进行游说劝诱。

groups.name: Logistical Transfer & Material Relocation · 物资调运与转运 (Redeploy, Wheelbarrow, Transship)
groups.tip: 人员或货物的调派、搬运转移

items.def_zh: 用车辆运走（大量物资或物品）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) take or transport goods or materials away using a vehicle or heavy carrier

items.def_zh: 摆渡运输；往返运送（物资）到对岸
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) transport goods or people across water or a divide in repeated trips

items.def_zh: 拖运走；重载转运（物资或废物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) transport heavy loads or bulky materials away by vehicle
to pull or transport large quantities of heavy goods over distance by truck or rail
to transport people or goods by boat, aircraft, or vehicle regularly over a short route
(+ off/away) to transport something heavy or cumbersome in or on a cart or small vehicle
1. To transport materials or goods in a wheelbarrow.

items.def_zh: 重新调配，重新部署，转岗
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To move troops, employees, or resources to a different location or task.
to transfer cargo or passengers from one ship, train, or vehicle to another during transit

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail moving goods, equipment, or assets between distinct locations, vessels, or strategic positions using specialized transport methods or logistical coordination.
groups.summary_zh: 使用特定工具或通过后勤调度将人员、物资或设备从一处转运至另一处。

groups.name: Lowering Bodily Posture · 屈膝屈身姿势 (Squat, Crouch, Kneel)
groups.tip: 弯折膝盖蹲下或坐定

items.def_en: bend one's knees and lower the body close to the ground

items.def_zh: 趴下；俯下身子（紧贴地面）
items.def_en: lower one's body quickly to a crouching, kneeling, or prone posture
lower oneself slowly onto the knees or into a deeply sunken, resting posture
1. (+ down) To go down onto one or both knees on the ground, often in prayer or respect.
to bend the knees and bring the body close to the ground, often to hide or prepare to spring
to squat down low on one's heels, often to stay warm or seek shelter

items.def_zh: 蹲下，蹲坐；擅自占用（房屋或土地）
items.def_en: 1. To bend your knees and sit close to the ground balancing on your feet. 2. To live in an unoccupied building or on land without permission.

items.def_zh: 屈膝（尤指单膝跪地以示敬意）
items.def_en: to bend one knee briefly touching the ground, especially in worship or reverence
to lie or crawl on the ground face downwards, especially in abject fear or servility

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering one's center of gravity close to the ground by bending the knees, hips, or legs, differing in whether weight rests on the knees, the balls of the feet, or directly on the ground.
groups.summary_zh: 通过屈膝、弯腿降低身体重心或贴近地面的姿态动作。

groups.name: Lunge & Pounce · 猛冲与扑击 (Lunge, Pounce, Swoop)
groups.tip: 突然发力向前猛扑冲刺

items.def_en: (+ at/on/upon) to leap suddenly and quickly toward a person or target
plunge forward or downward abruptly toward a target

items.def_zh: 奋身扑向；猛冲向前探扑
items.def_en: (+ for/at) to lunge or plunge one's body forward and downward to seize or intercept
(+ down on/upon) to move rapidly downward through the air to attack or snatch something
(+ sb/sth) attack or leap forward aggressively at sb
fly or plunge swiftly downward through the air to attack or seize prey
[I/T] (+ at) to rush forward aggressively and forcefully at someone or something in attack
To make a sudden forward movement or attack towards someone or something.

items.def_zh: 猛扑，扑抓；急忙抓住（机会、错误等）
items.def_en: To jump quickly to catch or attack something; to seize eagerly upon a mistake or opportunity.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses sudden, explosive forward or downward bodily leaps targeted at an opponent, prey, or objective, graded from an extended forward thrust to sudden predatory airborne leaps.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体突然爆发性向前直刺、前冲扑跃或猛扑捕捉目标。

groups.name: Malfunction & Sabotage · 故障失灵与毁坏击沉 (Conk, Scupper, Peter Out)
groups.tip: 系统发生故障或计划遭毁

items.def_en: stop functioning properly due to a mechanical or technical fault
(informal) of an engine, machine, or appliance, to suddenly stop working
of a machine or body part, to break down, stop functioning, or fail completely

items.def_zh: （机器、器官等）坏掉，彻底停止运转
items.def_en: suddenly stop working or break down permanently

items.def_zh: （机器等）出故障，坏掉（常作 conk out）；击打（头部）
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often conk out) (of a machine or engine) To break down and stop working suddenly. 2. (informal) To hit someone on the head.
fail, malfunction, or quit working suddenly

items.def_zh: 彻底破坏，破坏（计划、协议）
items.def_en: to deliberately destroy, ruin, or bring about the failure of a policy, proposal, or plan

items.def_zh: 使（计划等）破产，挫败；使（船）沉没
items.def_en: 1. (British informal) to deliberately ruin, wreck, or prevent a plan or opportunity from succeeding. 2. to deliberately sink a ship, especially one's own.
to spoil or completely destroy a system, relationship, or design

groups.summary_en: Verbs describe mechanical systems or undertakings breaking down, suddenly quitting, or being deliberately ruined and thwarted. They range from an engine or machine abruptly dying to a plan being completely sunk or scuppered.
groups.summary_zh: 机械突发故障停摆，或计划、企图被彻底破坏扼杀。

groups.name: Manifest & Reveal · 显露与表露
groups.tip: 将隐蔽之物公开展现出来

items.def_zh: 显露，展示；表现出，流露；表明，证明；演示，说明
items.def_en: 1. To allow something to be seen, or become visible. 2. To reveal or make a feeling, quality, or attitude apparent. 3. To demonstrate, prove, or explain how to do something.

items.def_zh: 泄露，显露（真实情感或秘密）
items.def_en: (+ sth) inadvertently reveal or betray a concealed feeling, secret, or intention

items.def_zh: （品质、情感）明显流露，显现出来
items.def_en: become clearly visible or easily observable through one's actions or demeanor
be visible or detectable beneath an outward surface or pretense
to reveal an emotion, weakness, or intention unintentionally
to demonstrate or reveal a quality or feeling clearly through outward actions or signs

items.def_zh: 显露，展示；表明（show 的古旧拼写）
items.def_en: (archaic spelling of show) To allow to be seen, display, or demonstrate.

items.def_zh: 表现出，显露，流露（情感、品质等）
items.def_en: (formal) To show or reveal a particular feeling, quality, or attitude clearly.
to indicate or be a clear sign of a particular state, attribute, or character

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate making an internal feeling, mental trait, or invisible quality observable through visible behavior, actions, or outward signs. 'Show' is universal, 'manifest' signifies clear outward evidence, and 'evince' is a formal term for indicating the presence of a disposition or emotion.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过神情、举止或外在迹象流露并展现内在品质或情感。

groups.name: Mark or Discolor with Spots · 斑点与污迹标记 (Speckle, Smudge, Fleck)
groups.tip: 涂抹污渍使表面不洁

items.def_en: to mark or cover thoroughly with numerous small spots

items.def_zh: 使沾上墨水或污渍；弄脏
items.def_en: to mark or stain something with a spot of ink or liquid

items.def_zh: 弄脏，涂污，使模糊；（墨水、妆容等）被擦模糊
items.def_en: 1. To make a dirty mark or blur wet ink or makeup by rubbing it accidentally.

items.def_zh: 使布满斑点，弄上斑点；点缀
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) (often passive) To mark or cover a surface with many small spots or patches.

items.def_zh: 使布满斑点，使有斑驳；点缀
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) (usually passive) To mark or sprinkle a surface with small spots or patches of color.

items.def_zh: 涂抹掉，用墨水或污迹覆盖
items.def_en: (+ sth) to obscure or cover writing or a surface with ink or spots
(+ sth) to spread a greasy, dirty, or sticky substance messily across a surface

items.def_zh: 涂污，胡乱擦抹留下污渍
items.def_en: to spread an oily, greasy, or wet substance across a surface accidentally or messily
to cover with small drops or specks of liquid splashed onto a surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote marking, discoloring, or marring a surface by dispersing small spots, droplets, or smeared blemishes across it. They vary by whether the mark is a diffused smear (smudge) or discrete speck-like particles (speckle, fleck, dab).
groups.summary_zh: 指在物体表面留下斑点、污痕或细碎微粒以致外观受损或显现斑驳。

groups.name: Mastermind & Detail Plans · 统筹操盘与蓝图谋划
groups.tip: 运筹帷幄绘制行动蓝图

items.def_en: (+ sth) draw up the basic outline or structural blueprint of a plan

items.def_zh: 通盘考虑；缜密推敲（计划或后果）
items.def_en: (+ sth) carefully consider all aspects and potential consequences of a complex plan
(+ sth) devise or formulate the detailed particulars of a comprehensive scheme

items.def_zh: 详尽拟定并规划（策略或方案）
items.def_en: to plan the details of an operation or project very carefully and systematically

items.def_zh: 详细规划制定（未来进程或路线）
items.def_en: to map out a precise sequence of steps or a definitive plan of action

items.def_zh: 为……绘制蓝图；详细规划，制订计划
items.def_en: To draw up a detailed plan, design, or scheme for a project or course of action.

items.def_zh: 巧妙策划谋定（局面或结果）
items.def_en: to arrange for something complex to happen by clever and manipulative planning
To plan and direct an elaborate, complex, or secret project, campaign, or crime.

items.def_zh: 精心策划并统筹调度（行动或事态）
items.def_en: to organize or arrange a complex situation or sequence of actions secretly or meticulously

groups.summary_en: Focuses on high-level cognitive engineering where an architect designs intricate plans in granular detail, or orchestrates an entire complex campaign from behind the scenes.
groups.summary_zh: 以总设计师或幕后操盘手身份周密拟定实施蓝图并统领全局。

groups.name: Masticate & Bite · 撕咬与咀嚼 (Bite, Nibble, Gnash)
groups.tip: 牙齿咬碎与研磨食物

items.def_zh: 细咬，啃，小口咬；（对提议）表示微弱兴趣
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To eat something by taking very small, gentle bites. 2. (+ at) To show cautious or slight interest in an offer or idea.
(+ sth) bite and grind sth repeatedly between the teeth
[I/T] to crush food repeatedly with the teeth before swallowing
[I/T] to chew continuously, especially tobacco
(+ sth) pierce the surface of food or an object with the teeth
(+ sth) bite or chew persistently at sth with the front teeth

items.def_zh: 咬，撕咬；叮，蜇；咬住；产生不良影响，起作用
items.def_en: 1. To use teeth to cut into, pierce, or grip something. 2. To have a sharp, unpleasant, or serious effect.
[I/T] (+ on) to chew or bite noisily and vigorously
To grind or strike your teeth together, especially in extreme anger, frustration, or pain.

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe using teeth or jaws to grip, sever, or grind food or express aggression. Nuances range from delicate, tentative small pecks to sharp piercing cuts and grinding clenches of fury.
groups.summary_zh: 强调使用牙齿对物体进行的轻啄、咬穿、咀嚼或磨切动作。

groups.name: Mean & Signify · 意指与象征 (Convey Sense or Indicate)
groups.tip: 表示特定含意与象征深意

items.def_zh: 表示……的意思，意指；意图，打算；意味着
items.def_en: 1. To signify, denote, or express an idea or thing. 2. To have as an intention or purpose. 3. To have something as a necessary result or consequence.
to be a sign of something; show that something exists or is likely true
(+ sth) indicate or signify a particular meaning, consequence, or overall truth
(+ sth) mean or lead to a certain inevitable outcome, often a negative one
(+ sth) represent or denote a specific word, concept, or symbol
(+ sth) indicate that something is likely to be true or will happen

items.def_zh: 表示，标志（字面或直接含义）
items.def_en: to be a mark, symbol, or literal sign of something

items.def_zh: 表示，象征，意味；具有重要性，要紧
items.def_en: 1. To be a sign, symbol, or indication of something; to mean. 2. (formal) To be important, consequential, or of matter.
to suggest an idea, feeling, or association in addition to literal meaning

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on symbols, words, signs, or events conveying a particular sense, value, or implication. 'Mean' is the neutral default verb, whereas 'signify', 'denote', and 'portend' lean towards formal, semiotic, or omen-like indication.
groups.summary_zh: 指符号、语言或迹象传达特定含义、象征或暗示。

groups.name: Mechanical Easing & Tension Release · 机械减张与松弛解脱 (Loosen, Slacken)
groups.tip: 由紧绷状态转向松散

items.def_zh: 放松（肌肉、握力等机械张力）
items.def_en: [I/T] to make a physical hold, tension, or muscle strain less firm or tight

items.def_zh: 微调放松；缓释（机械紧力）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ off/up) to gently reduce tension, pressure, or tightness on an object
[I/T] to make something that has been tightened less firm or loose

items.def_zh: 放松；减小（张力、拉力或压力）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce tension, pressure, or physical tightness gradually
(+ sth) to loosen a rope, tether, or fastener so that it is less taut
(+ sth) to make a rope, tether, or garment looser or longer by releasing tension
1. To loosen or ease tension on something tight. 2. (often 'slack off') To work with less energy, care, or speed.
To make or become less tight, firm, or strict, or to relax.
[I/T] to make or become less tight, taut, or rigid (esp. ropes or cables)

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physical frame denote reducing the structural tightness, tautness, or rigidity of a tether, knot, fastener, or grip, causing it to become lax, free, or less taut.
groups.summary_zh: 减弱缆绳、扣件或握持的张力与紧度，使物体变得松弛或便于拆解。

groups.name: Mediate & Reconcile · 调解与斡旋 (Mediate, Arbitrate, Intercede)
groups.tip: 第三方介入化解分歧冲突

items.def_en: to intervene in a dispute or difficult situation in order to help solve it
(+ sth) to settle a quarrel, dispute, or broken relationship between people
(+ sth) to resolve differences, disputes, or difficulties through discussion

items.def_zh: 居中调解，斡旋；起媒介作用
items.def_en: to act as an intermediary or mediator between opposing parties to resolve a conflict

items.def_zh: 调解，斡旋；促成（协议、和平等）
items.def_en: 1. to intervene between people or parties in a dispute to help them reach an agreement 2. to bring about an agreement or settlement through mediation
(+ with/to) to restore friendly relations between estranged people or harmonise conflicting viewpoints
(+ with/between) to act as a formal link between groups to promote cooperation and resolve friction
(+ for/with) to intervene on behalf of another party to settle a dispute or obtain mercy
[I/T] (+ between/on) to officially judge and settle a dispute between two opposing parties as an appointed neutral judge

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a neutral third party stepping between disputing factions to facilitate negotiation, settle conflicts, or reconcile broken relations. They range from neutral diplomatic facilitation to legally binding resolution or personal plea-making.
groups.summary_zh: 第三方介入冲突各方之间进行斡旋、居中调解或劝和，以达成共识或和解。

groups.name: Melodic & Folk Vocalization · 吟唱与民歌欢唱 (Lilt, Yodel, Carol)
groups.tip: 欢快吟咏或用约德尔调高亢歌唱

items.def_en: to sing in accompaniment with another singer, recording, or group
To sing madrigals, especially unaccompanied secular part-songs from the Renaissance period.

items.def_zh: 轻快地哼唱；欢快地唱出；轻快地跳动
items.def_en: To speak or sing with a pleasant, gentle, rising-and-falling rhythm.
to hum or sing softly in a low, gentle, and soothing tone
(+ sth) to sing a song vigorously, loudly, and with great spirit
to sing joyful songs or carols, especially happily or house-to-house at Christmas
to sing or play an amorous piece of music specifically for someone
to sing or utter with a rapid, vibratory alternation between adjacent vocal pitches

items.def_zh: 用约德尔调歌唱（真假嗓音反复变换地唱）
items.def_en: To sing a tune while switching rapidly between a normal chest voice and a high falsetto voice.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures stylized, melodic, or traditional folk singing techniques, highlighting distinctive rhythms, vocal shifts, and festive performances.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有特定旋律律动、民俗技巧或欢庆性质的歌唱与吟咏方式。

groups.name: Melt & Coalesce · 熔聚与融合 (Fuse, Bead)
groups.tip: 熔融一体合二为一

items.def_en: to blend or coalesce into a single combined mass or stream, especially through melting or flowing

items.def_zh: （液体）聚集成珠，形成珠状；用珠子装饰
items.def_en: 1. (of liquid) To gather or condense into small, round drops on a surface. 2. To decorate or adorn something with beads.
(+ sth) to join permanently into a single mass through intense heat or chemical cohesion
(+ sth) to melt a metal or substance completely so that it forms a molten mass
to blend smoothly or merge distinct substances into a harmonious whole
to come together to form one larger mass or whole

items.def_zh: （使）熔合，（使）融合；（因保险丝熔断而）断电
items.def_en: 1. To join or blend together into a single whole, especially by melting. 2. To stop working, or make an electrical device stop working, because a fuse has melted.
to alloy with mercury, or combine physically into a unified body
to bond powdered material into a coherent mass by heating without melting

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe physical particles or separate elements combining into a single mass through heating, surface tension, or cohesive pressure. 'Bead' focuses on surface-tension droplet cohesion, whereas 'fuse' denotes joining permanently into a continuum under heat or metallurgical bonding.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过熔解、张力或热力凝聚使分离部分熔合为一体。

groups.name: Mental Disorientation & Perplexity · 困惑与迷惘 (Confuse, Perplex, Bewilder)
groups.tip: 思维混乱令人头昏脑胀

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse someone cognitively so they cannot think clearly or understand

items.def_zh: 使困惑；打乱（心神或思路）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse, perplex, or disorient someone unexpectedly
(+ sb) to confuse or perplex someone so that they make a mistake or become bewildered
to completely puzzle or defeat comprehension by being inscrutable or complex

items.def_zh: 使发昏，使茫然，使不知所措
items.def_en: (often passive) To make someone unable to think clearly, especially because of a shock, blow, or surprise.
To confuse and worry someone by being complicated or difficult to understand.
to utterly bewilder someone by being curious, inexplicable, or secretive

items.def_zh: 使迷惑，使不知所措，使昏头转向
items.def_en: (often passive) To confuse someone completely, especially by being complicated, unexpected, or chaotic.
to confuse the mind or senses of someone so they cannot think clearly

groups.summary_en: A situation or stimulus compromises an agent's cognitive clarity, rendering them unable to comprehend, reason, or react. The frame ranges from intellectual bafflement to overwhelming, dizzying disorientation.
groups.summary_zh: 使人陷入理解障碍、认知混乱或思维茫然，强调心智紊乱程度。

groups.name: Mention & Allude · 提及与引述 (Cite, Mention, Allude)
groups.tip: 口头顺带提及或特意指出

items.def_en: to introduce a subject or topic for discussion in conversation
(+ sth) to mention or refer to a fact or situation as evidence or an example
(+ sb/sth) to mention or speak about someone or something briefly or directly
(+ sth) to mention or discuss a subject briefly or indirectly

items.def_zh: 提及，指出；注意，留意；记录
items.def_en: 1. To mention or point out something. 2. To pay attention to or notice something. 3. To record or write down something.

items.def_zh: 谈及，提及；参考，查阅；转介，推荐
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To mention, talk about, or direct attention to someone or something. 2. (+ to) To consult or look at something for information. 3. (+ to) To send or direct someone to a person or place for help or advice.

items.def_zh: 引用，引证；附参考资料，提及
items.def_en: To mention, refer to, or cite sources or references in a work.
(+ to) to mention someone or something in a brief or indirect way
to mention something as proof, an example, or authority in academic discourse

groups.summary_en: Speakers or writers introduce a topic, text, or person into discourse briefly, directly or indirectly. The spectrum spans brief conversational mentions to formal academic citations and oblique allusions.
groups.summary_zh: 在言谈或文本中简略引出、援引或间接影射某人某事。

groups.name: Meter & Gauge Instruments · 仪表测度与计量 (Meter, Gauge, Calibrate)
groups.tip: 借助标尺衡量尺度

items.def_zh: 用仪器测出；测得（速度或时间）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to register or measure a specific speed, time, or rate using a timing or measuring instrument

items.def_zh: 用量规测定；依仪表校量
items.def_en: (+ sth) to determine dimensions, clearances, or levels against a standard gauge or dial
(+ sth) to measure a specific quantity of something using an instrument or container

items.def_zh: 按比例测量，按比例绘制；衡量，过秤称；攀登；刮去……的鳞片（或水垢）
items.def_en: 1. to measure, estimate, or draw according to a scale 2. to weigh something on a scale 3. to climb up or over a steep surface 4. to remove scales or incrustations from

items.def_zh: 用仪表计量，用仪器测量；按定量供给
items.def_en: 1. to measure or record the amount of something using an instrument or meter 2. to release or distribute something in measured amounts
to measure the speed, time, or mileage of a moving object using a stopwatch or instrument
to measure dimensions, pressure, or liquid volume accurately using a gauge or device
to determine or express the exact operational value or magnitude in numerical terms
to adjust or mark an instrument so that its measurements strictly match a standard

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote determining quantities, dimensions, or discharge rates using standardized instruments, scales, dials, or calibrated metering mechanisms.
groups.summary_zh: 使用仪表、仪器或标准刻度来定量测定与校准。

groups.name: Minor Joint & Extremity Trauma · 扭伤与末端挫伤 (Sprain, Stub, Tweak)
groups.tip: 踢撞脚趾或运动扭伤关节

items.def_en: to slightly pull, twist, or injure a joint, ligament, or muscle
to injure a muscle or tendon by overextending or overexerting it

items.def_zh: 碰伤，踢伤（脚趾）；掐灭（烟头）
items.def_en: 1. To hurt your toe by accidentally striking it against a hard object. 2. (stub out) To extinguish a cigarette by pressing the end against a surface.
To injure a joint such as your ankle or wrist by suddenly twisting it, causing swelling and pain without breaking bone.

items.def_zh: 拉伤；使（关节或韧带）扭伤错位
items.def_en: (+ sth) to injure a muscle, tendon, or extremity by wrenching or overstretching

items.def_zh: 使（关节等）脱臼；扭伤（肢体）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dislocate or slightly wrench a joint, bone, or muscle in the body
(+ sth) to wrench or sprain a joint or extremity by sudden turning or twisting
to injure a joint or limb through a sudden, violent twisting motion
to force a bone out of its normal position at a joint

groups.summary_en: Covers accidental physical injury to joints, tendons, toes, or fingers caused by sudden twisting, wrenching, or colliding with a blunt obstacle, falling short of bone fractures.
groups.summary_zh: 指关节、韧带或脚趾等因扭转、撞击而发生的非骨折性损伤。

groups.name: Misunderstand & Misjudge · 误解与误判 (Misinterpret, Misread, Misjudge)
groups.tip: 从读错细节到全盘误判

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to confuse one person or thing with another, or mistake the meaning of something
1. To misunderstand or misjudge a situation, person, or intention. 2. To read words, figures, or symbols incorrectly.
(+ sb/sth) to fail to understand or misinterpret a person, statement, or fact
To fail to understand someone or something correctly, especially words, intentions, or true meaning.

items.def_zh: 误解（misunderstand的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of misunderstand; to have failed to understand someone or something correctly.
To understand, explain, or translate something wrongly.
to interpret words, gestures, or actions in an unintended and often unfavorable way

items.def_zh: 看错；错误评判（人品或形势）
items.def_en: to form an incorrect or unfair opinion of a person's character or the scale of an event

items.def_zh: 算错；对局势做出错误推断或预估
items.def_en: to assess a situation or future risk incorrectly, leading to tactical or strategic error

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cognitive failure to correctly grasp, interpret, or evaluate meaning, intentions, or situations. They range from innocent cognitive lapses in comprehension to severe errors in appraisal and flawed strategic judgment.
groups.summary_zh: 未能正确理解、释读或评估信息与局势，程度由浅层误解递增至严重误判。

groups.name: Mitigate Pain or Severity · 缓解与减轻 (Alleviate, Soften)
groups.tip: 降低硬度或缓和剧烈冲突

items.def_en: to make pain, tension, or a burdensome situation less severe
(+ sth) to make something less forceful, harsh, painful, or severe

items.def_zh: 减轻（冲击、损失）；为……提供缓冲
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to protect someone or reduce the painful impact or severity of a blow or shock
(+ sth) to reduce the sharpness, pain, or severity of something (as in taking the edge off)
to remove or significantly reduce unpleasant feelings, discomfort, or pressure
(formal) to make the harmful effects of something bad, harsh, or serious less severe
1. To become less severe, harsh, or violent, or to make something so. 2. To become soft, or to make something soft.
1. (formal) To make pain, suffering, or a difficult problem less severe.
(formal) to soothe or make an unpleasant feeling, anxiety, or grief less intense

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote reducing the severity, harshness, or painful impact of a problem, blow, grief, or physical discomfort without necessarily curing it entirely. 'Soften' emphasizes damping physical impact or harsh tone, while 'alleviate' centers on making suffering, distress, or symptoms more bearable.
groups.summary_zh: 使疼痛、困境、严苛冲击等在程度上减轻或变得可承受。

groups.name: Mix into Disorder or Union · 混杂与合并 (Jumble, Recombine, Muddle)
groups.tip: 搅混掺杂混杂一团

items.def_en: (+ sth) to combine different substances, elements, or items into a single mixture
[I/T] (+ with) to mix or become mixed together while keeping some distinct identities

items.def_zh: 使混杂、把…弄得乱七八糟
items.def_en: (+ up) to mix things together in a confusing, untidy way

items.def_zh: 把……搞乱；杂乱地混在一起
items.def_en: (+ sth) to mix things together in a confused, disordered, or untidy way

items.def_zh: 使混乱；混杂（物品或次序）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to mix things up into confusion or disorder so their proper order is lost
to mix up elements, order, or signals so that they are disordered or unintelligible

items.def_zh: 大杂烩般拼凑（口语/变体作动词）
items.def_en: to blend disparate ingredients or objects together without plan or pattern

items.def_zh: 使混乱，混杂，杂乱地堆放
items.def_en: To mix things together in a confused, disordered, or untidy way.

items.def_zh: （使）再结合，（使）重新组合，（使）复合
items.def_en: To combine again or in a different way, especially of genetic material or chemical compounds.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe manipulating distinct components by physically scrambling them into confusion or bringing them together into a new combination. 'Jumble' emphasizes disorder and chaos, whereas combinations like 'recombine' and 'scramble' alter configuration.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过搅乱次序或整合要素，使事物混杂无序或重新结合。

groups.name: Modernize & Revitalize · 更新与改造 (Modernize, Revamp, Overhaul)
groups.tip: 重焕生机或技术现代升级

items.def_en: bring up to date by incorporating the latest features or standards
(+ sth) to improve or modernize the appearance or condition of something
restore something to a good or modern state of repair
give new and improved form, structure, or appearance to something
(+ sth) to repair, redecorate, and modernize an old building or item
(+ sth) to officially renovate, update, or completely alter the appearance or structure of something
thoroughly examine and make necessary structural repairs or modernizations
To make or become modern, adopting modern equipment, techniques, or concepts.

items.def_zh: 革新，赋能再兴；（使）再生，（使）重生
items.def_en: 1. To revive, reform, or revitalize an area, organization, or system. 2. (biology) To regrow or cause new tissue or organs to form.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe transforming outdated systems, physical assets, or communities by bringing them up to contemporary standards or revitalizing their inner vitality. They range from superficial contemporary styling to exhaustive structural renewal.
groups.summary_zh: 指对过时结构或系统进行现代化更新、全面检修或重塑生机。

groups.name: Moisten & Desiccate · 润燥与湿润控制 (Hydrate, Dampen, Dehydrate, Dry)
groups.tip: 增湿或除水的湿度调控

items.def_en: to increase the level of moisture in the air or a closed space
(+ sth) to become completely dry or make something lose all moisture or moisture content
(+ sth) to lose all water or moisture until parched or empty
(+ sth) to make a surface or material slightly moist or humid by adding water
to cause something to absorb water or moisture
to remove water completely from food or biological tissue
to make something slightly wet or moist
to add moisture to or increase the humidity of (the air or an environment)

items.def_zh: （彻底）去除水分，使脱水，使干燥；（使）枯竭
items.def_en: 1. to remove all the moisture from something, especially to dry and preserve it 2. to cause something to become dry, lifeless, or drained of vitality

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario denote altering the moisture content of an object, air, or biological tissue, encompassing adding moisture (humidifying, moistening) or removing moisture until parched (desiccating, dehydrating).
groups.summary_zh: 描述对环境或物质水分含量的调控，涵盖增湿湿润与脱水烘干两侧过程。

groups.name: Moral Decline & Degradation · 堕落与道德败坏 (Backslide, Debauch, Deprave)
groups.tip: 道德品行或状态滑坡倒退

items.def_en: (+ into) to pass gradually into an inferior, weaker, or less moral state
to abandon one's former moral standards, religious faith, or allegiance
to start behaving in an immoral, unlawful, or socially unacceptable way
(+ into) to decline in moral qualities, character, or standards from a former state
To relapse into bad habits, sin, or lower moral standards after having made improvements.
(+ sth) to gradually decline into an undesirable, depraved, or debased state of behavior
to cause someone to turn from honesty or purity to evil or immoral practices

items.def_zh: 使堕落，诱导……放荡；败坏，糟蹋
items.def_en: To corrupt someone morally, especially by leading them into excessive sensual pleasures or indulgence.
to make someone utterly wicked, morally perverted, or completely corrupt

groups.summary_en: A person lapses from moral rectitude into indulgence, or an external influence corrupts someone's ethics and purity. Verbs range from mild relapses in behavior to active, ruinous moral corruption.
groups.summary_zh: 主体在道德修养上倒退、滑坡，或受到外界引诱而败坏、沉沦。

groups.name: Mourn & Lament · 哀悼与哀泣 (Mourn, Lament, Bewail)
groups.tip: 以泪洗面与长吁短叹

items.def_en: (+ sth) to weep, mourn, or express sorrow regarding an unfortunate event or loss
[I/T] (+ for) to feel or show great sadness, especially because someone has died

items.def_zh: 深切悲伤，感到极度痛苦
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ for/over) to suffer deep mental anguish resulting from a grave loss
(+ sb/sth) to feel or express deep sadness and distress over someone's death or loss

items.def_zh: 因哀伤憔悴而死，郁郁寡欢
items.def_en: to become physically weak, waste away, or die from prolonged, intense sorrow or grief
[I/T] (+ over/for) to express sorrow, regret, or complaint aloud or publicly
1. (informal, disapproving) To cry noisily and uncontrollably while talking.
1. (literary) To express deep sorrow, grief, or regret over a loss or misfortune.

items.def_zh: 为死者号啕痛哭，作哀歌
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ over) to make a loud, high-pitched vocal cry of intense grief over a dead body

groups.summary_en: Someone expresses profound sorrow, grief, or regret over a death, personal tragedy, or irrevocable loss. Verbs vary from silent, dignified grieving to overt, vocal, or tearful desolation.
groups.summary_zh: 对死亡、灾祸或不可逆的丧失表达深切悲痛，从静默沉哀到放声嚎啕、痛切悼惜。

groups.name: Move Forward & Traverse · 推进与穿行 (Proceed, Troop, Transit)
groups.tip: 步步为营推进前行

items.def_zh: 鱼贯而出，排成纵队走出
items.def_en: to leave a room or enclosure walking one behind another in an orderly line

items.def_zh: 鱼贯而行，排成单行前进
items.def_en: (+ in/out/past) to walk in a single line or orderly queue in a specific direction

items.def_zh: 成群结队地走，列队行进
items.def_en: (+ adv./prep.) To walk or march somewhere together in a large group.
to continue moving forward forcefully along a route despite obstacles or difficulties
(+ sth) to make one's way forward through a crowd, obstacle, or difficult terrain
1. (formal) To move forward or travel in a particular direction. 2. To continue doing something that has already started.
To pass through or across an area; to transport people or goods.
to travel across, over, or through an expansive area, terrain, or obstacle
(+ ahead/forward/on) to advance steadily, determinedly, or with heavy momentum

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate collective or directional forward motion and passage along a route or across an area, differing by group cohesion, formality, and navigational passage.
groups.summary_zh: 指按既定方向或队形向前推进行进，或穿过特定区域与通道。

groups.name: Mundane Roaming & Prowling · 穿梭闲逛与游荡 (Public Social Drifting)
groups.tip: 无固定目标信步游荡漫步

items.def_en: (+ sth) to spend time in a place waiting or roaming casually without clear purpose

items.def_zh: 徘徊游荡，挤在一起乱走
items.def_en: to move around a particular area aimlessly or in a confused, unstructured crowd
(+ sth) to walk slowly around a place without any definite direction or hurry

items.def_zh: （人群等）四处游荡，兜圈子，乱转；碾磨，磨碎
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) (of a crowd) To move around in a confused or aimless mass. 2. To crush or grind grain, ore, etc. into powder or small pieces.

items.def_zh: 漫游，缓行闲逛；以舒适速度平稳行进；乘船巡游，巡航
items.def_en: 1. To travel or drive around slowly and aimlessly, especially for pleasure. 2. To travel at a steady, efficient speed. 3. To sail around many places on a holiday cruise.
[I/T] to travel unsystematically through an area or space
to stand or wait around idly in a public place without clear purpose

items.def_zh: 应酬穿梭；融于人群走动
items.def_en: to move around and talk to different people at a social gathering
[I/T] to move restlessly or stealthily through an area as if searching for something

groups.summary_en: People circulate or drift among others in public social areas, either swarming randomly in crowds or navigating spaces purposefully looking for encounters or amusement.
groups.summary_zh: 在公共空间或人群中漫无目的地走动、穿梭或寻觅社交接触。

groups.name: Muster & Impose Rigorous Order · 整编与排布 (Marshal, Regiment, Brigade)
groups.tip: 像军队般系统编制与调动

items.def_en: to form into disciplined military lines or orderly ranks

items.def_zh: 把……整编/规训成，迫使……遵守纪律
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to bring a group quickly into rigorous order, discipline, or specific formation
(+ sb/sth) to arrange troops, vehicles, or personnel into formal or orderly formation
To bring components or groups into precise systematic line or agreement

items.def_zh: 严密编组，严格管制；把……编成团
items.def_en: To organize and control people, their work, or their lives strictly and rigidly; to form people or troops into military regiments.
To organize people, soldiers, or units into brigades or working groups.

items.def_zh: 集结，统整，组织（人员、军队或论据）；引领，安排
items.def_en: 1. To gather and organize people, soldiers, ideas, or facts in a systematic way for a particular purpose. 2. To lead or guide someone somewhere.
To assemble or summon troops, workers, or strength for inspection or service
To assemble and coordinate resources or personnel ready for active deployment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organizing, structuring, or disciplining people, troops, or resources under strict, quasi-military coordination or systematic alignment. They emphasize disciplined grouping, logistical alignment, and regulatory control over constituent elements.
groups.summary_zh: 指仿照军事编制对人员、资源进行严格整编与统筹排布。

groups.name: Negotiate & Mediate · 协商排解与居中斡旋 (Negotiate, Mediate, Broker)
groups.tip: 磋商谈判以达成一致

items.def_en: [I/T] to confer with others in order to reach an agreement or formal treaty

items.def_zh: 通过协商解决，消除分歧
items.def_en: (+ sth) to resolve differences, disagreements, or difficult points through discussion

items.def_zh: 商定，艰难谈判达成（协议）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reach an agreement, deal, or settlement after strenuous and detailed negotiation

items.def_zh: 充分讨论协商，深入探讨达成一致
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discuss something extensively and in detail until a mutual agreement is reached

items.def_zh: 讨价还价；谈判，商讨条件
items.def_en: 1. (+ with/for/over) To discuss terms or negotiate the price of something in order to reach an agreement.

items.def_zh: 居中协调，斡旋（达成协议或交易）
items.def_en: 1. To negotiate and arrange an agreement, treaty, or deal between opposing parties.
[I/T] to act as an intermediary between two hostile parties to settle an argument or dispute
[I/T] to make a formal judgment or decision on a disputed matter in an official or legal capacity
[I/T] to make an official judgment in a dispute between two people or groups after hearing both sides

groups.summary_en: Parties or neutral intermediaries discuss terms, reconcile differences, and craft formal settlements, agreements, or commercial deals between opposing sides.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重通过正式谈判、居中调解或斡旋促成协议。

groups.name: Obliterate & Rub Out · 消除与抹去 (Efface, Erase, Expunge)
groups.tip: 用涂改液抹去擦除痕迹

items.def_en: to remove pencil marks or chalk by rubbing with an eraser

items.def_zh: 遮蔽、涂抹消除（字迹或痛苦记忆）
items.def_en: to obscure or cover completely with ink, or deliberately force an unpleasant memory from the mind

items.def_zh: 彻底消除，抹去（印记、记忆、记录）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to completely destroy, erase, or obliterate traces, records, or memories
(+ sth) to draw a line through an item on a list or record to eliminate it
(+ sth) to delete or cancel recorded words or clauses by drawing a line through them

items.def_zh: 擦除、抹掉（字迹、数据或记忆）
items.def_en: to remove marks, text, or recorded data by rubbing or electronically clearing

items.def_zh: 删去、彻底抹杀（记录、指控或名字）
items.def_en: (+ from) to strike out, obliterate, or completely wipe away a name, record, or memory

items.def_zh: 抹去，擦掉；消除（痕迹或记忆）；使不引人注目（efface oneself）
items.def_en: 1. To rub out or remove a mark, memory, or feeling completely. 2. ('efface oneself') To intentionally behave in a modest way so as not to attract attention.

items.def_zh: 用涂改液涂掉，涂白修正
items.def_en: To cover up a written or typed mistake using white correction fluid.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally rubbing out, blotting out, or completely eradicating recorded marks, writing, memories, or traces. They range from physical removal of ink or chalk to literary and legal elimination of records.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过刮拭、涂改或物理消除手段抹去字迹、印记、记忆或记录。

groups.name: Official Enrollment & Legal Registration · 登记与入册 (Register, Enroll, Matriculate)
groups.tip: 法务或学籍的正式注册立案

items.def_en: to record an official name, event, or item on an official list or record
to put one's name down to participate in an activity, course, or organization
to enter names onto an official roster or duty list

items.def_zh: 登记报到，办理登记手续
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to register one's arrival officially at a hotel, airport, clinic, or event

items.def_zh: 登记入册，载入系统记录
items.def_en: (+ sth) to enter official data, identity, or names into a register or electronic roll

items.def_zh: 把……记入名单，给……报名登记
items.def_en: (+ sb) to record someone's name onto an official list, roster, or membership sheet
1. To register a name, symbol, or design as a trademark to legally protect it.

items.def_zh: （使）登记，（使）注册，（使）入学，（使）入会
items.def_en: 1. (+ in/on/for) (chiefly US) To officially register yourself or someone else as a member of a course, school, or organization.

items.def_zh: 被大学录取入学；注册成为大学生
items.def_en: to officially enroll as a student at a college or university

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame covers entering a name, entity, course, or intellectual property into an official roll, directory, or state database to establish formal status. Verbs vary across institutional contexts such as universities (matriculate, enroll), statutory IP protection (trademark, copyright), or general public record-keeping (register).
groups.summary_zh: 按法定或组织程序将人名、组织或知识产权载入官方名册以确立合法资格。

groups.name: Official Investiture & Authority Delegation · 授职入职与下放职权 (Induct, Delegate, Invest)
groups.tip: 指定职务并授予权责

items.def_en: (+ with/in) to formally endow someone with rank, office, authority, or ceremonial power
to admit someone to public office by administering a formal oath
(+ sth) to officially surrender or transfer authority, control, or office to another person
(+ sth) to transfer an official task, administrative responsibility, or power to a deputy
(+ sb) to appoint or recruit someone formally into a specific official role or leadership position

items.def_zh: 分派，委派（任务、权力）；选派……为代表
items.def_en: 1. to give part of your work, duties, or authority to someone else. 2. to choose someone to represent a group.

items.def_zh: 使举行就职典礼，正式任命
items.def_en: to introduce someone into an official position with a formal opening ceremony

items.def_zh: 使正式就职，任命；使入门，接纳（为会员）
items.def_en: (+ into) to formally introduce someone into a new job, position, or organization through an official ceremony.
(+ sb to do sth) to appoint or authorize someone to act as a representative or deputy

groups.summary_en: Denotes the formal transfer of office, status, or administrative power. 'Induct' refers to formally admitting an appointee into a post, society, or hall of fame, whereas 'delegate' focuses on assigning specific authorities or responsibilities downstream.
groups.summary_zh: 通过既定程序授予职位、正式就任或下放法定权力责任。

groups.name: Officially Revoke & Nullify · 撤销与宣告无效 (Revoke, Annul, Repeal)
groups.tip: 官方推翻或废止既定决议

items.def_zh: 判决……无效，撤销废除（法规、判决）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to legally declare a law, regulation, or ruling invalid and null

items.def_zh: 撤销，宣布无效（裁决、决定）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially overrule, annul, or invalidate a previous legal decision or agreement
(+ sth) to formally declare something inadmissible, unacceptable, or legally invalid
to officially cancel or withdraw a law, statute, or legislative act

items.def_zh: 撤销，废除，取消（法令、执照、特权等）
items.def_en: To officially cancel the power or effect of a law, decision, license, or agreement so that it is no longer valid.

items.def_zh: 推翻，否决，撤销；比……更重要，优先于
items.def_en: 1. To use your authority to reject or cancel a decision, order, or rule made by someone else. 2. To be more important than something else.

items.def_zh: 撤销；废止（命令、协议或政策）
items.def_en: to officially end a law, policy, or agreement, making it null and void
to make something have no legal force or effect

items.def_zh: 宣告无效；废除（契约、婚姻等）
items.def_en: to state officially that something such as a contract, marriage, or law is no longer legally valid

groups.summary_en: An authority or governing body formally cancels, invalidates, or overrides a previously granted law, license, ruling, or legal agreement so that it is no longer legally binding. 'Revoke' cancels privileges or decrees, while 'annul' declares something legally void ab initio, and 'repeal' specifically abolishes statutes.
groups.summary_zh: 主管机关依法正式废除、取消或推翻法规、许可及决定。

groups.name: Operate Specific Wheeled Vehicles · 驾车与跨骑代步 (Automobile, Bicycle, Motorcycle)
groups.tip: 操纵载具或乘车出行

items.def_en: to ride a bicycle for transport or sport
to travel or tour comfortably in an automotive vehicle
to travel on a bicycle or motorbike
to leave a place driving a motor vehicle

items.def_zh: （驾驶车辆）驶出，出站，开上主路
items.def_en: to drive a vehicle away from the side of the road or out of a parking space into traffic
to depart travelling on a bicycle or motorbike
to ride or travel on a motorcycle.
to ride a bicycle.
(dated) to travel or ride in an automobile.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe travelling by actively operating specific mechanized or pedal-driven wheeled vehicles (cars, pushbikes, or motorbikes), usually derived denominally from the vehicle itself.
groups.summary_zh: 由车辆名词直接派生的动词，指骑自行车、开汽车或骑摩托车代步。

groups.name: Oscillate & Sway · 晃动与摆动 (Yaw, Jiggle, Flail)
groups.tip: 剧烈挥舞或失控晃荡

items.def_en: to move unsteadily from side to side, showing a lack of balance

items.def_zh: 起伏，呈波浪形摆动，波动
items.def_en: To move or rise and fall in a smooth, continuous wave-like motion.
To move or shake lightly and quickly from side to side or up and down, or to cause something to do this.

items.def_zh: （船只或飞机）偏航，左右偏荡摆动
items.def_en: (of a ship or aircraft) To swing or turn unsteadily from side to side off its straight course.
to sway unsteadily back and forth as if about to fall

items.def_zh: 胡乱挥动肢体，无规则地乱扑乱甩
items.def_en: to wave or swing one's arms or legs about wildly and uncontrollably

items.def_zh: 剧烈翻腾，四处乱晃乱扑
items.def_en: to move wildly, violently, or erratically from side to side or back and forth

items.def_zh: 胡乱摆动，猛烈挥舞（四肢）；用连枷打（谷物）
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To wave or swing wildly and uncontrollably, especially arms or legs. 2. To beat grain with a flail.
[I/T] to move or swing wildly, violently, or convulsively

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe bodies or limbs undergoing irregular, rhythmic, or uncontrolled swinging, wave-like, or swaying movements. They distinguish subtle vibrations and smooth ripples from wide navigation deviations and violent, uncontrolled thrashing.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或肢体呈现波浪起伏、轻微晃动或失控甩动摇摆。

groups.name: Oscillate & Sway · 晃动与摇摆 (Sway, Oscillate, Rock)
groups.tip: 上下轻浮或左右往复摇晃

items.def_en: to move quickly and rhythmically up and down, especially on the surface of liquid or along a pivot

items.def_zh: 前后有节奏地摇晃，摆动
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to sway rhythmically to and fro between two points or along an axis

items.def_zh: 上下浮动，晃动；行屈膝礼
items.def_en: To move up and down quickly or repeatedly, especially on the surface of water.
[I/T] to move slowly from side to side or backward and forward
[I/T] to move unsteadily from side to side with a lack of balance
[I/T] to move backward and forward or from side to side in a steady, rhythmic way

items.def_zh: 摇摆，摆动；挥舞；转动，突然转向
items.def_en: 1. To move or make something move back and forth or in an arc. 2. To turn or rotate suddenly. 3. To swing an arm or bat to hit something.

items.def_zh: 摇摆，摆动；挥舞；转向（swing 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of swing; to move back and forth in an arc, or to turn suddenly.
to move repeatedly from one position to another and back again with a steady rhythm

groups.summary_en: Entities move back and forth, side to side, or up and down along an axis or pivot point. Verbs denote rhythmic, suspended, floating, or pivoting movements varying in speed, amplitude, and fluid dynamics.
groups.summary_zh: 围绕支点或轴线所进行的往复、摇晃或上下起伏运动。

groups.name: Ostracize & Marginalize · 排斥与隔绝 (Marginalize, Redline, Exclude)
groups.tip: 划定界限将弱势群体边缘化

items.def_en: (+ from) to intentionally prevent someone from joining, participating in, or entering a group
(+ sb) to exclude someone deliberately from social participation, opportunities, or community life

items.def_zh: 将……列入黑名单，联合抵制
items.def_en: to put someone on a list of people viewed with suspicion or excluded from employment or commerce

items.raw_cluster: 排斥与边缘化 Exclude & Marginalize
items.def_zh: 使边缘化，排斥，使处于非主流地位
items.def_en: To treat a person, group, or concept as insignificant or peripheral, pushing them to the margins of society.

items.raw_cluster: 排斥与边缘化 Exclude & Marginalize
items.def_zh: （尤指对特定社区）划红线排斥，拒绝提供贷款（或保险）；画红线标记修改
items.def_en: 1. To refuse loans, insurance, or mortgages to people living in particular disadvantaged areas. 2. To mark edits or changes on a document with red lines.
(+ sb) to banish or reject someone definitively from a community, society, or home
(+ sb) to force someone out of a social group, organization, or market through cold and hostile isolation

items.def_zh: 使集中于贫民窟，隔离聚居
items.def_en: to confine, isolate, or restrict a particular group to an isolated area or inferior status

items.def_zh: 排挤，共同孤立（被社群放逐）
items.def_en: to deliberately exclude someone from a community, society, or social group

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to systematically banishing, isolating, or pushing individuals, communities, or groups out of mainstream economic, legal, or social recognition. Nuances range from cultural alienation to structural institutional bans.
groups.summary_zh: 在社会、经济或体制层面排挤、孤立或边缘化特定群体。

groups.name: Overhaul & Reconfigure Infrastructure · 改造重组与改建产线 (Retool, Rewire, Reconfigure)
groups.tip: 调整内部构造与设备配置

items.def_en: to reset, rearrange, or adapt the elements or settings of a system, facility, or device
(+ sth) to equip or reconstruct a room, building, or vessel with specialized equipment and fittings

items.def_zh: 把……完全拆开（以便彻底检修改建）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dismantle machinery, an engine, or a system down to its base components for overhaul

items.def_zh: 改换，转产，切换（系统或产线）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to alter or convert an industrial mechanism or operating setup to a new system or purpose
to thoroughly inspect, repair, and rebuild a machine or system to improve performance
to build or organize something again after damage or obsolescence
to repair and fit out a ship, factory, or building with new parts and equipment

items.def_zh: 给……重新布线，更换电线；重构，改造（思维模式、神经回路等）
items.def_en: 1. To replace the electrical wiring in a building, vehicle, or piece of equipment. 2. To reorganize or alter the pathways or functions of a brain or system.

items.def_zh: 重组，改组；给（工厂等）更换新设备
items.def_en: 1. To reorganize, update, or adapt an organization, system, or set of skills. 2. To equip a factory with new machinery and tools.

groups.summary_en: An organization or technical specialist restructures, adapts, or overhauls internal systems, manufacturing machinery, or physical wiring to adapt to new tasks. 'Retool' emphasizes adapting industrial machines and operational methods, while 'rewire' literally or metaphorically resets electrical or neural circuitry.
groups.summary_zh: 改换机床工具、重连线路或重新配置基础设施以革新技术。

groups.name: Overlay & Mulch Soil · 铺设保护层与覆盖覆土
groups.tip: 铺覆外层以掩盖真实面目

items.def_zh: 给（草坪或作物）施表土；施面肥
items.def_en: to apply fertilizer, compost, or sand uniformly over the surface of soil or turf
(+ sth) to cover a surface or soil completely with an outer protective layer

items.def_zh: 铺设（覆土、碎石、草皮等保护层）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place a covering layer of turf, gravel, mulch, or laminate upon a surface

items.def_zh: 摊平铺开（覆盖物、土壤等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to distribute a material like mulch or gravel evenly over an underlying area
(+ with/in) to cover a broad surface with a dense, unbroken layer of snow, leaves, or mulch

items.def_zh: 用碎石铺盖（道路或地表）
items.def_en: to spread loose stone or gravel across an expanse of earth or path

items.def_zh: 铺在……上面，在……上加饰层（或保护层）；在（图像或文本）上覆叠
items.def_en: (+ with) 1. To cover the surface of something with a layer of a different material. 2. To place a digital image, text, or pattern over another.

items.def_zh: 压膜；给…覆上塑料保护膜
items.def_en: to cover a flat surface with a thin protective layer of plastic or laminate
(gardening) To cover the ground or soil around plants with mulch to retain moisture and suppress weeds.

groups.summary_en: Involves applying a distinct protective, agricultural, or decorative layer onto an underlying surface or soil, such as spreading mulch on flowerbeds or overlaying laminates.
groups.summary_zh: 在底层或土壤表面铺设防护层、树皮草屑或装饰板覆面。

groups.name: Pacify & Suppress · 遏制与镇压 (Defuse, Quell, Crush, Stifle)
groups.tip: 从抚平缓和到强力压制

items.def_en: to prevent a violent situation or unrest from escalating or spreading
to forcibly put an end to an insurrection, rebellion, or protest

items.def_zh: 缓和，平息（紧张局势）；拆除（炸弹的）引信
items.def_en: 1. to make a tense, dangerous, or difficult situation calmer and less volatile 2. to remove the fuse from a bomb or explosive device
(+ on sb/sth) to take strict action to suppress, restrict, or stop something from developing
(+ on sb/sth) to take severe or coercive disciplinary measures to suppress illegal behavior, unrest, or dissent
to eliminate or extinguish rebellion or unrest decisively

items.def_zh: 平息，镇压（暴乱、叛乱）；平复，消除（恐惧、疑虑等）
items.def_en: 1. to stop or suppress a rebellion, violent protest, or disturbance by force 2. to calm or reduce strong unpleasant feelings such as fear or anger
(+ sth) to suppress or stop a rebellion, riot, or strike by using physical or military force
to defeat and destroy opposition or rebellion completely with severe violence

groups.summary_en: This frame traces the continuum of neutralizing conflict, civil unrest, or rebellion. The scale moves from nonviolent de-escalation ('defuse') through firm administrative suppression ('quell') to overwhelming coercive force ('crush', 'stamp out').
groups.summary_zh: 平息遏制冲突或动乱，从温和化解逐步升级至暴力镇压摧垮。

groups.name: Pack, Box & Crate · 装箱、装盒与打包运输
groups.tip: 将杂件物品码入箱匣收纳

items.def_en: 1. To put something into a box. 2. To fight someone in a boxing match.

items.def_zh: 收拾行李，打包；挤满，塞满
items.def_en: 1. To put things into suitcases, boxes, or bags for travel or storage. 2. To fill a space tightly or crowd together.
to collect one's belongings and pack them into cases or boxes
to pack articles into cartons for shipment or handling
(+ sth) to pack items securely into boxes for moving, storage, or transport
(+ sth) to pack goods into large wooden crates, especially for shipping or freight transit
(+ sth) to tie or wrap several items together securely into a compact bundle
(+ up) to tie or wrap several things together into a compact package

items.def_zh: 把…装入板条箱（以备装运）
items.def_en: to pack goods into large wooden crates for safe transport or shipping

groups.summary_en: Covers physical packing operations where items are arranged into cardboard boxes, cartons, or wooden crates for moving, storage, or freight transit.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品整理收纳进纸箱、板条箱或包裹以备搬迁与物流运输。

groups.name: Pave & Surface Thoroughfares · 铺设与构建道面 (Pave, Cobblestone, Surface)
groups.tip: 将零散部件拼搭回整体

items.def_en: to apply an outer protective layer of asphalt, tarmac, or concrete to a road
to cover a road or runway with tarmac or asphalt surfacing
to cover or construct a road using crushed stone or macadam

items.def_zh: 用混凝土、沥青等铺满道面
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cover an area of land or dirt completely with asphalt, concrete, or stone paving

items.def_zh: 铺设（路面、铁轨或地基材料）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place materials such as gravel, asphalt, or rails systematically along a ground route
to cover a path, road, or area with flat stones, bricks, or asphalt

items.def_zh: 重新组装，重新装配；重新聚集，重新召集
items.def_en: 1. to put the parts of a machine or object back together. 2. to come together again as a group, or bring people together again

items.def_zh: 用鹅卵石（或圆石）铺（路等）
items.def_en: to pave a street, courtyard, or road with rounded stones (cobblestones)

items.def_zh: 用横木铺设（林间泥泞路）
items.def_en: to build a rough road across swampy or marshy ground by laying logs side by side across it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in civil construction describing laying materials (timber, cobblestones, asphalt, gravel) to form or reassemble durable roadways and pathways.
groups.summary_zh: 使用石块、原木、碎石等材料铺设、硬化道面或重构路基。

groups.name: Penetrate & Intrude · 穿透与闯入 (Penetrate, Infiltrate, Intrude)
groups.tip: 破开表面刺入内部

items.def_en: (+ to sth) to push past an outer boundary, line, or crowd to gain unauthorized entry
[I/T] to gain access to an organization or secure area gradually and secretly
(+ on) to enter someone's land or property without permission
(+ into/on/upon) To enter a private situation, conversation, or place where you are not invited, wanted, or expected.
(+ on/upon) to gradually intrude upon another's space, rights, or territory
(+ to sth) to enter a building or secured space forcefully and without permission
(+ sth) to push or drive an object or body through an obstacle or barrier with sheer mechanical force
to break through a wall, barrier, or defense

items.def_zh: 刺入，穿透；渗入，打入；洞悉，看穿
items.def_en: 1. To force a way into or through something. 2. To enter and become established in an organization, group, or market. 3. To succeed in understanding something complicated or mysterious.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve entering, breaking through, or encroaching upon a physical space, barrier, or territory without authorization or through sheer physical ingress.
groups.summary_zh: 指强行穿透防线或障碍，或未经准许擅自侵入特定空间的动作。

groups.name: Perform & Enact · 扮演与戏剧重现 (Portray, Enact, Personify)
groups.tip: 在舞台或情景中搬演再现

items.def_en: to represent an incident, story, or emotion by actions, gestures, and words

items.def_zh: 戏剧性地演绎，重现（情节或事件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to enact or perform a dramatic scenario, scene, or event

items.def_zh: 过火地表演，夸张做作地演戏
items.def_en: (+ sth) to perform a role with exaggerated, melodramatic, or unnatural theatricality
to act the part of a character in a film, play, or television show
to act out a role, story, or play on a stage or in front of an audience
to pretend to be another person, either for entertainment or to deceive

items.def_zh: 进行角色扮演，扮演……角色
items.def_en: To act out a particular role or scenario in training, therapy, or entertainment.

items.def_zh: 演哑剧；用手势动作再现
items.def_en: To express a story, action, or meaning entirely through silent gestures and movements.

items.def_zh: 再现，重新演练（历史事件或罪案）
items.def_en: To perform or act out an event from the past again, as in a drama, battle reenactment, or police investigation.

groups.summary_en: An actor or participant adopts a role, mimics actions without speech, or systematically dramatizes a past event or fictional scenario for instruction, therapy, or entertainment.
groups.summary_zh: 表演者扮演指定角色，通过肢体默剧或情境复现来演绎情节。

groups.name: Permit & Authorize · 许可与批准 (Permit, Approve, Authorize, License)
groups.tip: 上级或官方正式认可与许可

items.def_en: To give official clearance or permission to proceed after review
1. To give official or legal permission to someone to do, use, or own something.

items.def_zh: 批准，通过，核准；赞成，同意
items.def_en: 1. To officially agree to or accept a plan, proposal, or request. 2. To think that someone or something is good, right, or acceptable.

items.def_zh: 允许，准许；使成为可能，容许
items.def_en: 1. To officially allow someone to do something or allow something to happen. 2. To make something possible.
(+ to) To give permission or express willingness for something to happen
1. To give official permission or legal authority for someone to do something or for something to happen.
(+ sth) to give official or formal approval to a plan, document, or proposal
To give official, authoritative permission or approval for an action

items.def_zh: 使合法化；使非刑事化；免除……的刑事处罚
items.def_en: To change the law so that an activity is no longer treated as a crime.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal/administrative frame denote granting formal permission, legal capacity, or regulatory sanction to an individual or an activity.
groups.summary_zh: 官方或具权机构给予正当性认可，正式授予行事许可或合法化。

groups.name: Physically Hold & Grasp · 握持与抓拿 (Hold, Grasp, Grip)
groups.tip: 用手掌握并保持稳定状态

items.def_zh: 握住，拿住，抱住；持有，容纳；保持；举行
items.def_en: 1. to carry, grasp, or support someone or something with your hands or arms. 2. to contain, maintain, or have in a particular position or state. 3. to organize or conduct an event

items.def_zh: 握住，拿住（hold 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of hold; to grasp, carry, or support with the hands or arms
[I/T] to hold something tightly and firmly with the hand
(+ to sb/sth) to grasp or maintain physical hold of something tightly with the hands
(+ to sb/sth) to hold something firmly or tightly with one's hands or arms
(+ on sb/sth) to grip or compress an object firmly using hands or an instrument so it cannot move
[I/T] to take a firm hold of somebody or something with the hand
[I/T] to hold something tightly, often in fear, anxiety, or pain
[I/T] to hold someone or something tightly in your hands or arms

groups.summary_en: This frame involves securing and keeping an object or person with the hand, arms, or fingers. Verbs range from baseline holding to tight clutches and firm gripping.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手、手指或双臂控制、执持物体或人，涵盖从自然持握到紧紧抓牢。

groups.name: Pierce & Penetrate · 穿透与刺入 (Skewer, Pierce, Ream)
groups.tip: 尖锐利物刺入内部

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pierce or push a pointed tip completely through an opening or barrier
(+ sth) to forcefully push a pointed object into something with a quick, sharp thrust
(+ sth) to push a sharp or pointed object firmly into a surface or material
[I/T] to make a hole in or through something using a sharp point

items.def_zh: 刺穿；用签子串起；严厉批评，嘲讽
items.def_en: 1. To push a sharp skewer or pin through food (such as meat or vegetables). 2. (informal) To criticize or mock someone sharply and thoroughly.

items.def_zh: 铰孔，扩孔；用榨汁器榨取（果汁）；严加斥责
items.def_en: 1. To enlarge, shape, or clear a hole using a rotating tool (reamer). 2. To squeeze juice from citrus fruit with a reamer. 3. (informal, chiefly US) To reprimand someone severely.
to thrust through with or as if with a spear
(literary) to pierce through with a sharp weapon so as to fix in place
to pierce through with a sharp stake or instrument right through the body

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate forcefully driving a pointed or sharp instrument entirely through or into an object, often impaling, boring, or widening the perforation.
groups.summary_zh: 指用尖锐或特定工具用力穿透、贯穿物体或扩大孔洞的动作。

groups.name: Play Sport & Score · 竞技与得分 (Eagle, Birdie, Cricket)
groups.tip: 参与体育运动并争取得分

items.def_en: [I/T] to deliver the ball in cricket or roll the ball in bowling

items.def_zh: （高尔夫球）打出低于标准杆两杆的成绩
items.def_en: (golf) To score an eagle by completing a hole in two strokes under par.
To play the sport of cricket.
to hit the first shot from the tee in a round or hole of golf

items.def_zh: （板球中）击中三柱门将（击球员）淘汰出局
items.def_en: (+ sb) to dismiss a batsman in cricket by knocking down the wicket with the ball
to finish playing a hole in golf by hitting the ball into the cup with a putter
to complete a golf hole in the standard number of strokes
[I/T] to shoot one stroke under par on a golf hole
[I/T] to shoot one stroke over par on a golf hole

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario frame represent playing specific sporting matches or achieving distinctive game-specific scores and plays (such as golf or team athletics).
groups.summary_zh: 指参与特定体育项目比赛，或在运动竞技中取得特定计分或动作。

groups.name: Plead & Beseech · 请求与哀求 (Urgent and Desperate Entreaty)
groups.tip: 从诚恳恳请加剧为声泪俱下哀求

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make an earnest or formal request to someone for aid, sympathy, or a decision
(+ for/to do) to ask someone earnestly or anxiously for something, showing vulnerability
(+ sb) to make an earnest, urgent, and emotional appeal to someone for help or mercy
(+ with/for) to make a passionate, emotional appeal to someone for mercy or assistance
(+ sth) to urgently and desperately plead or ask for help, mercy, or relief
(+ to do) to beg someone desperately and movingly to do or refrain from doing something
to ask someone for something in an anxious and earnest way; to beg desperately
to ask or beg someone earnestly and emotionally to do something
(+ for) to ask humbly and submissively, often in prayer or on bended knee

groups.summary_en: This frame captures speakers urgently imploring someone for help, mercy, or a concession, progressing in intensity from earnest appeals to emotional, desperate supplication.
groups.summary_zh: 出于紧迫需求或危局，向对方提出极度恳切的请求或哀告乞求。

groups.name: Plot & Conspire · 密谋与图谋 (Plot, Scheme, Conspire)
groups.tip: 暗中图谋行事手段

items.def_zh: 密谋，暗中策划；在地图（或图表）上标出；为（小说等）设计情节
items.def_en: 1. To secretly plan something harmful or illegal. 2. To mark or draw a route, position, or points on a map or chart. 3. To plan the storyline or series of events for a book or play.
To make clever, deceitful, and secret plans to achieve something, especially to gain an advantage.

items.def_zh: 密谋；捏造；谋划（阴谋诡计）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to invent or secretly concoct a plan, scheme, or story, typically deceitful or self-serving

items.def_zh: 结伙；联手对付（通常配合 on）
items.def_en: to join together in a group to oppose, bully, or conspire against someone
(+ sb) to conspire against someone by fabricating false evidence to make them appear guilty

items.def_zh: 耍阴谋，暗中策划（宫廷、政治斗争中）
items.def_en: (+ against/with) To make secret plans to harm someone or gain advantage

items.def_zh: 策划，密谋（常与 plot/scheme 连用）
items.def_en: (often + plot/plan) To devise or concoct a secret plan or deception

items.def_zh: 共谋，图谋（做非法或有害之事）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with/against/to do) To plan secretly with others to commit an unlawful act

items.def_zh: 串通，勾结（尤为欺诈或不正当目的）
items.def_en: (+ with/in) To cooperate secretly or unlawfully with others to deceive

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame details agents privately, craftily, and often illicitly concocting plans to bring about harmful, subversive, or self-serving ends. It typically collocates with clauses ('plot that/to do') or prepositions ('scheme/conspire against/with').
groups.summary_zh: 多指暗中策划狡黠、违规或图谋不轨的计划，多带贬义或神秘色彩。

groups.name: Poke & Pierce · 戳刺与穿透 (Mechanical Contact Ranging to Puncture)
groups.tip: 从轻戳微刺到尖锐物穿透刺入

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to poke or thrust roughly and repeatedly at someone or something with a pointed object
