1. (+ at/into) To push a finger, stick, or sharp object quickly into or against someone or something. 2. To emerge or cause to project out from an enclosure or opening.
[I/T] to push someone or something with a finger or a pointed object
(+ sth) to pierce or push a pointed tip through a surface or opening
(+ sth/sb) to push a pointed object into someone or something
to make a very small hole in something or cause mild pain with a sharp point

items.def_zh: 刺穿，穿透；（光、声等）穿过，刺破
items.def_en: 1. To cut or make a hole through something with a sharp, pointed object. 2. (of light, cold, or sound) To penetrate through darkness, silence, or barriers.
[I/T] to make a hole in something with a sharp object, often causing deflation
to pierce through with or as if with a pointed weapon; impale completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail pointed contact against an object or body, scaling in force from light prodding to puncturing and deep perforation. 'Poke' initiates superficial contact, whereas 'pierce', 'prick', and 'transfix' penetrate surfaces or impale tissue entirely.
groups.summary_zh: 指以尖物从表层轻微轻戳、刺破直至彻底贯穿。

groups.name: Portend & Herald Future Events · 预示与预兆 (Foreshadow, Portend, Presage)
groups.tip: 事情发生前显露征兆，预先提示未来

items.def_zh: 预示；表明（未来趋势或结果）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to suggest or make it likely that a particular situation or outcome will develop

items.def_zh: 预示……的到来；宣告新时期的开始
items.def_en: (+ sth) to be a sign that a new period, event, or change is beginning
to be a sign that something good or significant is about to happen or arrive
To act as a warning or sign of a future event, especially in a book or film.

items.def_zh: 预示，预兆（常用于 bode well/ill）
items.def_en: (usually 'bode well/ill') To be a good or bad sign of what will happen in the future.
(literary) To act as a sign or warning of something bad; to foreshadow or presage.
(+ well/ill) to be a sign, omen, or promise of a particularly good or bad outcome
(formal or literary) To be a sign or warning that something (especially something bad) is about to happen.
to be a sign or warning that something momentous or calamitous is likely to happen

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate that an event, circumstance, or omen serves as an advance sign of a future occurrence, often carrying fateful or ominous connotations.
groups.summary_zh: 事物作为征兆或预感，在事先显露出未来的势头或吉凶。

groups.name: Postpone & Put Off · 延后与推迟 (Postpone, Defer, Delay)
groups.tip: 推延时间延期办理

items.def_en: [I/T] to make something happen later than planned or cause someone to be late
to change an arrangement, task, or meeting to a later date or time

items.def_zh: 推迟，延期（时间表、会议等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reschedule an event or deadline to a later date or time
(+ sth) to postpone an action, discussion, or decision until a future occasion

items.def_zh: 延缓（议案等）至某时处理
items.def_en: (+ sth) to postpone formal discussion or consideration of a proposal until a later time
To delay an event, plan, or decision so that it takes place at a later time or date.
1. (formal) To delay or postpone an action, decision, or payment until a later time. 2. (defer to) To yield politely to someone's wishes or authority.
[I/T] to formally pause a trial, meeting, or parliamentary session until a specified later time
to alter the scheduled timetable of an appointment or debt repayment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify rescheduling an event, payment, or decision to a later time rather than proceeding as initially planned, whether by necessity or choice.
groups.summary_zh: 人为安排将原本计划的事件、决定或付款推迟到更晚时间。

groups.name: Prejudice Judgment & Incline Unfairly · 偏见与先入为主 (Bias, Prejudice, Color)
groups.tip: 由施加影响到成见偏袒

items.def_en: to influence or skew someone's opinion or attitude, often subtly or unconsciously

items.def_zh: 使偏向；对……带有倾向性倾斜
items.def_en: (+ sth) to present information or frame judgments in a biased way favoring a particular side
to present information from a particular angle so as to bias the audience

items.def_zh: 使预先倾向于，使对……产生偏好
items.def_en: (+ to/toward) to influence someone beforehand toward a particular judgment or state

items.def_zh: 不利于；使处于受偏见劣势
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to influence a judgment or decision unfavorably against someone or something

items.def_zh: 使有偏见，使偏心，使偏袒
items.def_en: To influence someone or something in an unfair way so that they favor one side.

items.def_zh: 使怀有偏见，使产生成见；对……不利，损害
items.def_en: 1. To influence someone so that they have an unfair, unreasonable opinion. 2. (formal/law) To harm or damage a right, claim, or legal case.
(+ sb/sth) to cause someone to feel hostility, distrust, or prejudice toward someone or something

items.def_zh: 毒化（思想或人际判断），使产生根深蒂固的敌意偏见
items.def_en: to corrupt or permanently bias someone's mind or attitude against someone or something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate influencing someone's judgment, perception, or decision unfairly before factual appraisal. Intensity escalates from subtle affective skewing (color, slant) to conscious partiality (bias), culminating in entrenched, damaging preconceptions that shut down fair consideration (prejudice, poison).
groups.summary_zh: 描述外力或先入为主观念破坏公平中立，使判断逐渐偏向某一侧乃至彻底扭曲。

groups.name: Prepare & Prime · 准备、筹备与预置 (Prepare, Ready, Prime)
groups.tip: 预先做好安排使其就绪

items.def_en: 1. To make someone or something prepared or ready for use or action.

items.def_zh: 准备，预备；调制，配制；使做好心理准备
items.def_en: 1. To make or get someone or something ready for a future event, task, or purpose. 2. To make or cook food, or produce a mixture or medicine.
(+ with/for) to supply with the necessary items or skills for a purpose

items.def_zh: 使准备好；为……作好准备；灌注起动
items.def_en: (+ for/with) to make something or someone ready for a particular situation, operation, or question

items.def_zh: 做好准备；准备就绪（常接 for/to do）
items.def_en: to prepare oneself or an organization for an impending activity, event, or task
(+ sb/sth) to provide someone or something with all the necessary equipment, clothing, or fittings for a specific purpose

items.def_zh: 为迎接（困难、冲击等）做好准备
items.def_en: (+ sth) to physically or mentally ready oneself for something unpleasant, difficult, or shocking

items.def_zh: 预先调整，预先训练（使其适应某种状态）；预先设定条件
items.def_en: 1. To train, condition, or prepare someone or something in advance to behave or react in a desired way.

items.def_zh: 准备好面对（困难或斗争）
items.def_en: (+ oneself for) to prepare oneself mentally or physically for conflict, challenge, or action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actions taken in advance to put a person, equipment, or system into a fit, suitable state to perform, endure, or undergo a future event.
groups.summary_zh: 指事先对人员、装备或系统进行调适或训练，使其进入待命适任状态。

groups.name: Pressurized Liquid Ejection · 喷射与射流 (Spray, Spurt, Jet)
groups.tip: 液体受挤压猛烈喷涌喷溅

items.def_en: (+ sth) to eject or be ejected in a thin, rapid stream through a narrow opening
to force liquid out through a narrow opening in a sudden, thin stream
to gush or stream out suddenly and under pressure in a fast, intermittent jet
To force liquid out in a stream of very small drops, or to cover something with a fine shower of liquid.
to gush or shoot out suddenly in a powerful, intermittent stream
(variant spelling of spurt) To shoot or gush out suddenly in a stream, or to force liquid out.
to burst or be expelled rapidly and forcefully from a nozzle, orifice, or opening
to discharge or be propelled outward with great suddenness and force

items.def_zh: 喷出，喷射；乘喷气式飞机旅行
items.def_en: 1. To shoot out or squirt in a rapid, forceful stream. 2. To travel somewhere by jet aircraft.

groups.summary_en: Liquids or fine particles are expelled forcibly under pressure in a directional stream, burst, or dispersed mist. The intensity ranges from diffuse misting to violent, high-velocity streams that burst out suddenly.
groups.summary_zh: 液体受压定向喷出或迸射，强度由弥散细雾递增至高压疾喷。

groups.name: Prevaricate & Equivocate · 含糊其辞与狡辩 (Prevaricate, Equivocate, Fudge)
groups.tip: 闪烁其词含糊推托事实

items.def_zh: 拐弯抹角，旁敲侧击而不切入正题
items.def_en: To discuss a matter without coming directly to the point, usually to avoid awkwardness

items.def_zh: 轻轻带过；回避关键细节
items.def_en: (+ sth) to mention or treat a difficult or embarrassing topic briefly and ambiguously to avoid dealing with it

items.def_zh: 含糊其词，拐弯抹角以避嫌
items.def_en: To avoid giving a direct answer, commitment, or firm opinion
[I/T] To deal with a situation or issue in an ambiguous, evasive, or half-hearted way

items.def_zh: 掩盖；粉饰敷衍（问题或错误）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to deliberately treat an unpleasant fact or problem superficially to hide its true significance

items.def_zh: 绕开（关键问题）；避而不谈
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discuss a subject in an evasive, roundabout way to avoid addressing the central point directly
To use ambiguous language conceal the truth or avoid committing oneself

items.def_zh: 支吾其词，闪烁其词，搪塞
items.def_en: (formal) to speak or act in an evasive way; to avoid giving a direct, truthful answer

items.def_zh: 含糊其词，敷衍搪塞；讨价还价
items.def_en: (formal) to act or speak insincerely, deceitfully, or evasively; to bargain or haggle

groups.summary_en: A speaker deliberately uses ambiguity, evasive statements, or shifting arguments to conceal the truth without uttering a direct, barefaced lie. The manner varies from misleading wording ('equivocate') and dodging direct answers ('prevaricate') to informal blurring ('fudge', 'hedging').
groups.summary_zh: 故意使用模棱两可、闪烁其词的话语回避真相、搪塞质问或拖延表态。

groups.name: Primary Harvest & Raw Material Curing · 原料初加工与熟化 (Process, Cure, Hay)
groups.tip: 物理或化学加工材料

items.def_zh: 加工，处理；审核，办理；（计算机）处理（数据）
items.def_en: 1. To perform a series of mechanical or chemical operations on something to change or preserve it. 2. To deal with documents, requests, or applications officially. 3. (computing) To perform operations on data.
to grind or crush grain, corn, or other raw crop seeds into flour or meal

items.def_zh: 腌制；熟化；晾制（烟草、肉类或木材）
items.def_en: [I/T] to preserve meat, fish, tobacco, or timber by drying, salting, or smoking

items.def_zh: 烘干；晾干（使谷物、木材、饲草等脱水脱水变干）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove moisture from raw agricultural crops, timber, or forage as part of curing or storage preparation

items.def_zh: 吊挂风干/腌熟（肉类、烟叶等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to suspend meat, tobacco, or game to allow it to cure, age, or dry properly
(+ sth) to cure and preserve food products such as fish or meat by prolonged exposure to smoke

items.def_zh: 割晒牧草，制干草；供给干草
items.def_en: To cut grass and cure it to make hay; to feed or supply with hay.
to compress and bind hay, straw, or cotton into tight, manageable bundles
[I/T] to separate grain from the husks and straw of a plant by beating or mechanical processing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the agricultural, culinary, or industrial initial handling and preserving of bulk natural commodities (crops, forage, timber, meat) to prepare them for storage or consumption.
groups.summary_zh: 对农作物、牧草、肉类等原材料进行脱水、腌制或熟化等初级加工处理。

groups.name: Proliferate & Disperse · 散播与蔓延 (Unchecked Organic or Destructive Propagation)
groups.tip: 向四周散落或漫延开来

items.def_en: to extend over a progressively wider physical area or group of people
to spread out gradually in all directions through a gas, liquid, or group
to spread outward in multiple directions from a central source or pathway
to expand over a larger area, population, or period
to distribute or spread information, seeds, or doctrine widely
1. (+ across/over/with) To scatter things untidily over a surface or area.

items.def_zh: （疾病、暴力等）突然爆发并蔓延
items.def_en: to suddenly erupt or spread with renewed violence, pain, or contagion
to reproduce rapidly and increase numbers exponentially

items.def_zh: （癌细胞等）转移；（恶性事物）蔓延，扩散
items.def_en: 1. (medicine) To spread from the primary site of disease to other parts of the body. 2. (figurative) To spread and grow uncontrollably.

groups.summary_en: An undesirable entity, disease, rumor, or chaotic element spreads progressively across an area or medium beyond containment. Verbs distinguish between systemic pathological propagation and pervasive outward dispersal.
groups.summary_zh: 恶性事物、疾病或细碎异物不受限地蔓延散播。

groups.name: Prop & Shore Up · 倚垫与支撑 (Support Structurally or Physically from Underneath/Behind)
groups.tip: 用支撑物支起或倚靠放置

items.def_en: (+ sth) to rest something or oneself in an inclined position against a solid surface for physical support
1. To rest your head or an object on something soft as if on a pillow.

items.def_zh: 用软垫垫住，给……垫上靠垫
items.def_en: to place something soft against or under something to support it and protect against shock
(+ sth) to support the weight of a structure or object from underneath so it does not collapse
(+ sb/sth) to physically support an object or body part underneath or from behind to prevent it from falling or sagging
1. (+ against/up) To lean an object against something or support it from underneath so it does not fall.

items.def_zh: 抵住，加固支撑（以防摇晃或受压）
items.def_en: to support or hold something firmly in position with a rigid reinforcement

items.def_zh: 从底部加固，支撑（地基或结构）
items.def_en: to place masonry, concrete, or steel beneath a foundation to give it firm support

items.def_zh: 用支柱撑住（摇摇欲坠之物）
items.def_en: to support a wall, building, or sagging structure with heavy timber or metal struts

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the physical manner of bracing or supporting an object or a person's body part with a wedge, pillar, cushion, or angled support to prevent collapse or promote comfort. 'Prop' covers angled mechanical or physical leaning, while 'pillow' specifically cushions softly.
groups.summary_zh: 使用斜撑、软垫或坚固支撑物将物体或身体垫起以防倒塌或提供倚靠。

groups.name: Proportion & Quantize Values · 量化与按比例分摊 (Quantize, Prorate, Apportion)
groups.tip: 校正量度、比例并依规调控

items.def_en: to measure or regulate the supply of a utility or resource using a meter

items.def_zh: 按份分配；分成小块分派
items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide something measurable into specific portions or shares and distribute them

items.def_zh: 按量给予；定量分派（惩罚、配额等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dispense or apportion measured amounts of punishment, rewards, or shares according to a rule
(+ sth) to distribute measured or rationed amounts of food, money, or resources carefully
to distribute shares or amounts of something for a specific purpose
to allow someone only a fixed, limited amount of a scarce commodity
to divide and allocate shares of resources, responsibilities, or costs according to a plan

items.def_zh: 使量子化；（信号处理中）量化
items.def_en: to restrict a variable quantity to a discrete set of specific values, especially in physics or digital signal processing

items.def_zh: 按比例分配，按比例摊派（费用、时间等）
items.def_en: to calculate, divide, or distribute something proportionally according to a specific rate or fraction of time

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mathematically dividing, converting, or adjusting measurable values—such as discrete energy/signal steps, fractional costs, or proportional shares—according to a strict quantitative schema.
groups.summary_zh: 按照数学比例、分段规则或使用量进行量化与分摊。

groups.name: Provoke & Harass · 挑衅与烦扰 (Goad, Pester, Badger)
groups.tip: 言语激惹对方或反复纠缠

items.def_en: (+ sb) persistently scold, criticize, or urge someone to do something
(+ sb) strongly encourage or urge someone to do something foolish or dangerous
(+ sb) repeatedly treat someone unkindly, unfairly, or critically

items.def_zh: 用言语刺激；冷嘲热讽惹恼
items.def_en: to intentionally annoy or irritate someone by persistent petty teasing or stinging remarks
to repeatedly and persistently ask someone questions or urge them to do something
To annoy someone by repeatedly asking them for something or bothering them.
to deliberately provoke, mock, or annoy someone to elicit an angry response
to pursue, harass, or pester someone relentlessly without giving them peace

items.def_zh: 招惹，激怒，唆使；驱赶（牲畜）
items.def_en: To deliberately provoke, annoy, or urge someone into doing something, especially by saying unkind things.

groups.summary_en: An agent persistently irritates, nags, or taunts another person, either to annoy them incessantly or deliberately stimulate an aggressive reaction or compliant action. Nuance spans relentless whining to sharp, painful baiting.
groups.summary_zh: 持续烦扰纠缠某人，或用尖刻言行激惹对方做出反应。

groups.name: Provoke to Fury · 激怒与使狂怒 (Madden, Enrage, Infuriate)
groups.tip: 怒火中烧达至歇斯底里狂怒

items.def_en: irritate and frustrate someone to the point of intense anger
(+ sb) make someone angry or irritated

items.def_zh: 怒发冲冠，（毛发）竖起；愤然作色
items.def_en: 1. (+ at/with) To react with sudden anger, indignation, or defensiveness. 2. (of hair or fur) To stand upright away from the skin.
(+ sb) thoroughly enrage or annoy someone
(+ sb) deliberately tease, irritate, or agitate someone to anger

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使狂怒 Enrage & Madden
items.def_en: To make someone extremely angry, irritated, or frantic.
make someone very indignant or furiously wrathful
make someone extremely angry and agitated

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使狂怒 Enrage & Infuriate
items.def_en: To make someone extremely angry or furious.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote inciting severe, uncontrolled wrath in another person or reacting with overt signs of indignation. They scale along an intensity continuum from showing bristling agitation to driving someone into irrational frenzy.
groups.summary_zh: 指将他人激惹至极度愤怒，或因愤怒而表现出应激反应。

groups.name: Publish & Promulgate Publicly · 公示与系列出版 (Placard, Clarion, Serialise)
groups.tip: 面向大众正式公布与传播

items.def_en: to display a notice, placard, or message publicly in a designated place
to transmit a program, or tell a piece of news widely to many people
(+ sth) to attach a notice, poster, or announcement in a public place where people can see it
(+ sth) to broadcast or proclaim information loudly or conspicuously to a wide audience
to announce officially and publicly a new law, decree, or doctrine

items.def_zh: 重新发表，再版，重新发行
items.def_en: To publish a book, article, report, or other text again or in a new form.

items.def_zh: 张贴公告于，张贴海报公布；举告示牌抗议
items.def_en: 1. To post notices or posters in, on, or around a place. 2. To announce, advertise, or protest against something by means of placards.

items.def_zh: 大声宣告，响亮地宣扬；吹响尖音喇叭
items.def_en: (literary) To proclaim, declare, or sound a call loudly and clearly.
(British English) To publish a book or broadcast a work in a succession of regular installments.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote distributing, exhibiting, broadcasting, or sequencing informational media to the public via printed, posted, or serialized formats.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过张贴、刊载、连载或大肆宣讲等媒介方式将信息公之于众。

groups.name: Quiet & Suppressed Laughter · 咯咯笑与暗笑 (Giggle, Chuckle, Titter)
groups.tip: 从抿嘴微笑到咯咯发笑的不同神态

items.def_en: to laugh quietly to oneself in a contented or amused manner
To laugh repeatedly in a quiet, high-pitched, nervous, or silly way.
To smile broadly so that your teeth show, expressing amusement, pleasure, or mischief.

items.def_zh: 轻声笑，咯咯笑；暗自发笑
items.def_en: To laugh quietly and softly to oneself, showing amusement or satisfaction.
to give a smothered or half-suppressed laugh, often at someone else's misfortune
to laugh quietly and disrespectfully, especially behind someone's back
to give a short, nervous, or quiet laugh, typically in an effort to suppress it
(+ sth) to suppress or hold back a sudden burst of quiet laughter or tears with effort
to laugh in a breathy, gleeful, and snorting way, combining a chuckle and a snort

groups.summary_en: Speakers describe quiet, light, or suppressed vocal expressions of amusement, ranging from low, private throat laughs to nervous, high-pitched vocalizations.
groups.summary_zh: 指轻声、克制或低音调的笑声，多带有私人愉悦或神经质特点。

groups.name: Raise & Elevate · 抬升与举起 (Move Upward in Space or Status)
groups.tip: 由低向高举起或昂首挺立

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to raise something in your hands so people can see it or support it high
(+ sb/sth) to raise someone or something to a higher physical position
to raise something to a higher position or level using physical effort
(+ sb/sth) to haul or raise something upward toward yourself

items.def_zh: （马等）用后腿直立；举起，昂起，抬起；抚养，养育，饲养
items.def_en: 1. (of a horse or animal) To stand or rise up on its hind legs. 2. To lift or raise upright, especially the head. 3. To care for and educate children until fully grown; to breed animals.

items.def_zh: 举起，抬高；提升，提拔（职位、地位等）；振奋（情绪）
items.def_en: 1. To raise or lift something to a higher physical position. 2. To promote someone to a higher rank, status, or position.
to raise upwards physically or to elevate morally, spiritually, or culturally

items.def_zh: 用机械/绳索吊起，用力举起
items.def_en: to raise or pull something up, often using ropes, pulleys, or considerable effort
[I/T] to lift or pull something heavy with great effort

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing an entity to move higher or ascending upward, differing by physical posture, mechanical force, or metaphorical altitude.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体或躯体推向更高垂直位置，包含自然竖起与机械/意象抬升。

groups.name: Raise with Effort or Mechanical Force · 举起与顶升 (Lift, Hoist, Jack)
groups.tip: 向上用力提升物体高度

items.def_zh: 用千斤顶托起（通常作 jack up）；抬高，大幅增加
items.def_en: ('jack up') to raise or lift something heavy using a jack; to raise prices or amounts sharply.

items.def_zh: 举起，抬起，升高；解除（限制）；（云、雾等）消散
items.def_en: 1. to raise someone or something to a higher position or level. 2. to remove a rule, tax, or restriction. 3. (of mist or clouds) to disperse.

items.def_zh: 吊起；升起（借助绳索、滑轮）
items.def_en: to raise or pull something heavy up into position, often using ropes or pulleys
(+ sth) to lift something very heavy with great bodily effort
(+ sth) to raise a heavy vehicle or structure off the ground using a jack
(+ sth) to haul or lift a heavy load upward using a mechanical winch
to lift or move heavy materials using a mechanical crane
[I/T] to lift or haul something very heavy with immense physical exertion

items.def_zh: 用绞车拉起；用摇把吊升
items.def_en: to haul, raise, or lower an object using a mechanical winch

groups.summary_en: An agent applies bodily force or specialized machinery to elevate a heavy object from a lower position to a higher one. Verbs intensify from basic upward effort ('lift'), to heavy hauling with ropes/pulleys ('hoist', 'heave'), to mechanical tool-assisted lifting ('jack', 'winch').
groups.summary_zh: 施加人力或借助机械工具将重物从低处顶起或抬升。

groups.name: Rate Acceleration & Multiplicative Surge · 倍增与增幅 (Quicken, Treble, Quadruple)
groups.tip: 数量成倍增加或强度规模放大

items.def_en: to increase in speed, rate, or intensity
to become, or make something, twice as great in size, amount, or value
(+ sth) to become much more active or productive, or to make something do so
(+ sb/sth) to move, happen, or cause something to happen much faster
to increase multiplicatively or intensify through sequential additions

items.def_zh: （使）加快，（使）加速；（使）变活跃，激起
items.def_en: To become quicker, faster, or more active, or to make something do so.
(chiefly British) To increase threefold, or to multiply an amount or number by three.
To increase fourfold, or to multiply an amount or number by four.
to increase or multiply by a factor of five

groups.summary_en: A quantity, speed, or measure expands by a steep mathematical factor or accelerates sharply in pace. Verbs indicate specific arithmetic multiplication or brisk temporal acceleration.
groups.summary_zh: 数量按倍数翻增或节奏显著提速，重在跨越式的增幅与加速。

groups.name: Rearrange & Reconfigure Structures · 调整配置与重组结构 (Rejig, Reconfigure, Isomerize)
groups.tip: 重整分子结构或业务编排

items.def_en: to rearrange elements or settings of a system, software, or organization into a new pattern
(+ sth) to make substantial structural changes to an organization or system to improve it
(+ sth) to alter the internal order or relative positions of things
(+ sth) to scramble or rearrange the existing order or arrangement of items
to fundamentally organize a company, system, or agreement in a different way

items.def_zh: 打乱重组，调整（职位、卡片）
items.def_en: to change the order or position of things or personnel within a group
to adjust components, resources, or policies into new or corrected positions relative to goals

items.def_zh: 重新调整，重组，重新规划
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To reorganize, rearrange, or alter something (such as a system, schedule, or workforce) to improve it.
1. (chemistry) To convert or be converted into an isomer, having the same molecular formula but different chemical structure.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the internal arrangement, molecular structure, or organizational setup of an existing system, ranging from pragmatic operational tweaks to technical transformations.
groups.summary_zh: 重新调整或改变现有系统、布局或分子的内部结构与组成方式。

groups.name: Recover & Convalesce · 康复与疗养 (Recover, Recuperate, Convalesce)
groups.tip: 患病或负伤后休养逐步复原

items.def_en: (+ from) to return to normal health, consciousness, or vigor after illness or injury
to make a sudden resurgence of strength or health after severe weakness or decline
[I/T] to undergo or provide physical therapy or medical conditioning after an illness or injury
to quickly recover one's health, energy, or spirits after illness or trauma
(+ sb) to become or make someone more lively, energetic, and healthy after fatigue or illness

items.def_zh: 渡过难关；（重病中）挺过来
items.def_en: (+ sth) to recover from a serious illness or injury, surviving against the odds
(of bones, wounds, or sick patients) to heal, knit together, or improve in health

items.def_zh: 康复，休养，恢复健康；恢复，挽回（损失等）
items.def_en: 1. to recover health, strength, or energy gradually after an illness, injury, or exhaustion 2. to recover or regain lost money or assets
to spend time resting and gradually recovering health and strength after an illness or medical operation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to bodily restoration toward health, strength, and vitality after disease, exhaustion, or surgical trauma through rest and medical care.
groups.summary_zh: 经过病痛、伤损或过度劳累后逐渐恢复健康与体力。

groups.name: Recover & Reclaim Lost Assets · 追回与收回损失 (Reclaim, Recoup, Recover)
groups.tip: 重新拿回失去的财产

items.def_en: to get back possession of something lost, stolen, or taken away
(+ sth) to recover possession of lost, stolen, or borrowed money or property
(+ sth) to successfully regain an asset, position, or right after hard effort or conflict

items.def_zh: 艰难追回；强行追回（款项）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to recover money or benefits that have already been paid out, often through strict measures
to find and bring back something from a place where it was left or held
to achieve or obtain something back that has been lost or taken

items.def_zh: 要求归还，收回；开垦，开拓（土地）；回收利用
items.def_en: 1. To get back something that was lost, taken, or given away. 2. To treat waste products or wasteland so they can be used again.

items.def_zh: 收回，追回（成本、损失等）；弥补，补偿
items.def_en: To get back money that you have spent, invested, or lost; to compensate for a loss.
to legally take back possession of goods or property because the buyer failed to pay for them

groups.summary_en: An entity regains possession, rights, or financial value that was previously lost, surrendered, confiscated, or spent. 'Reclaim' emphasizes demanding back rights or property by entitlement, 'recoup' emphasizes recovering monetary outlays or losses through subsequent gains, and 'recover' covers broad repossession.
groups.summary_zh: 依法要回所有权或通过运营弥补追回经济损失。

groups.name: Refurbish, Rejuvenate & Renew · 翻新、重赋生机与修复 (Revitalize, Restore, Refurbish)
groups.tip: 恢复原有生机活力或样貌

items.def_en: (+ sth) to repair, redecorate, and modernize an old building or item
(+ sth) to improve a surface or appearance by making minor repairs or painting over blemishes
(+ sb/sth) to make someone or something look cleaner, fresher, and more attractive

items.def_zh: 翻新；整修（建筑物或设备）
items.def_en: to clean up, redecorate, and restore a building or equipment to good condition
to impart new life, energy, or activity to an exhausted person, organization, or economy

items.def_zh: （加水等）使复原，使恢复原状；重组，重建
items.def_en: 1. To restore dried or condensed food or drink to its original liquid or solid form by adding water. 2. To reorganize, reconstruct, or re-establish an organization or system.

items.def_zh: 使恢复元气，给……注入新的活力，使复兴
items.def_en: To give new energy, strength, or vitality to someone or something.

items.def_zh: 修复；检修大修（使恢复良态）
items.def_en: to overhaul, repair, and put mechanical equipment back into working order

items.def_zh: 给……重漆面漆，整修（家具或地板等）表面
items.def_en: To restore the surface of wooden or metal furniture or floors by stripping the old finish and applying a new one.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote acts of bringing an exhausted organism, degraded material, or worn structure back to an intact, vigorous, or freshly finished state through targeted restoration or rejuvenation.
groups.summary_zh: 对劳损人身、降解物质或陈旧表面施加加工以恢复生机或新貌。

groups.name: Refute & Disprove Decisively · 否定与确凿驳倒 (Contradict, Gainsay, Confute, Disprove)
groups.tip: 断然否认并举证驳斥观点

items.def_en: to state the direct opposite of what someone has said, or imply their claim is wrong
to offer formal arguments, counter-evidence, or statements proving that an accusation is false
To deny, contradict, or dispute the truth of a statement.

items.def_zh: 彻底击碎；驳得体无完肤
items.def_en: (+ sth) to completely expose flaws in and disprove a claim or explanation

items.def_zh: 断然驳倒；击溃（论点或提案）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to decisively reject or demolish an argument, proposal, or theory

items.def_zh: 逐一拆解驳倒；严厉批驳
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dissect and dismantle an argument by exposing all its logical weaknesses
to show with definitive evidence or logic that a statement, theory, or belief is false
To prove an argument, claim, or person to be completely wrong or false.
to completely defeat, tear apart, and expose as utterly false an opponent's argument

groups.summary_en: A speaker denies or tears down an argument, progressing from simple verbal contradiction and gainsaying to rigorous, irrefutable factual disproof.
groups.summary_zh: 从口头否认违拗递进至以无可辩驳的证据彻底驳倒。

groups.name: Register & Archive Official Records · 归档与登记 (File, Accession, Archive)
groups.tip: 正式编目入库建档

items.def_zh: 归档，建档；正式提出（申请、诉讼等）；列队行进；用锉刀锉
items.def_en: 1. To place documents in an official archive or record, or submit an official application, lawsuit, or report. 2. To walk one behind another in a line. 3. To smooth or shape something with a file.
[I/T] to record names, details, or transactions officially in an authoritative ledger or database
to place or store official documents, records, or digital data in an archive
(+ sth) to systematically record official details, entries, or arrivals in a formal logbook
(+ sb) to enroll or formally register someone into an official list, organization, or activity
(+ sb/sth) to enter someone's name or official details onto a formal list or record
to systematically list and describe items (such as books, art, or records) in a registry

items.def_zh: （博物馆、图书馆等）正式登记入册，入藏编目
items.def_en: (formal) To formally record a book, artifact, or document as a new addition to an official collection.

items.def_zh: 立案登记，编入案卷摘要
items.def_en: to enter a brief summary or title of a document or court case on a list or official docket

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe formally recording, cataloging, or depositing documents, artifacts, or official data into an organized institutional repository or registry. 'File' applies broadly to office and legal records, whereas 'accession' is a specialized term for formally adding acquisitions to a museum or archival collection.
groups.summary_zh: 指将文档、资料或馆藏物品正式录入、归档或列入名册的行政行为。

groups.name: Reinforce & Entrench · 巩固与牢固确立 (Bolster, Consolidate, Entrench)
groups.tip: 底部发力加固，维持结构稳固

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make something stronger, larger, or more effective by adding resources or personnel
(+ sth) to gradually reinforce, increase, or consolidate strength, defenses, or confidence
(+ sth) to support or strengthen a weak or failing institution, wall, or position
to make a structure, belief, or position stronger by adding support or substance
[I/T] to strengthen a position of power, success, or control so that it becomes more stable

items.def_zh: 支持，支撑；增强，加强，巩固
items.def_en: To improve, strengthen, or support something such as confidence, an argument, or a structure.
to make a place or position stronger and better protected against attack or decay

items.def_zh: 使牢固确立，使根深蒂固；掘壕固守
items.def_en: 1. To establish something firmly so that change is very difficult or unlikely. 2. (military) To dig trenches to protect soldiers from enemy attack.
to provide strong reinforcement or support for an argument, system, or structure

groups.summary_en: An agent strengthens, stabilizes, or deeply establishes a position, defense, belief, or institutional power. Verbs progress in manner from buttressing from the outside ('bolster') to unifying and solidifying ('consolidate'), up to rooting something so firmly that change becomes almost impossible ('entrench', 'ingrain').
groups.summary_zh: 稳固充实基础或使权力地位深度根深蒂固。

groups.name: Relax & Destress · 放松与解压 (Release Nervous Tension and Mental Strain)
groups.tip: 卸下心理压力以重获舒展轻松

items.def_zh: （使）放松，（使）缓解；休息；放宽（规则）
items.def_en: 1. To become or make someone less tense, anxious, or tired. 2. To make rules or control less strict.

items.def_zh: 放松肌肉；消除拘谨紧张
items.def_en: [I/T] to become less rigid, tense, or formal in body or demeanor
(informal) to thoroughly relax and stop being stressed or angry
to gradually relax after a period of stress, excitement, or hard work
(+ sb) to become or make someone quiet and relaxed after intense stress or anger
to stop working and sit back to relax completely

items.def_zh: 放松，舒缓身心（尤其在劳累之后）
items.def_en: to stop worrying and begin to relax after a long period of work or anxiety
to calm down and relax from intensive mental pressure
1. To relax and reduce mental or physical tension and anxiety.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate letting go of physical tension, mental strain, or acute anxiety after strenuous effort or emotional pressure. 'Relax' is the neutral umbrella term, while 'destress' explicitly highlights ridding oneself of occupational or psychological stress.
groups.summary_zh: 缓解精神高压或身体紧张，由焦虑紧绷状态回归松弛平静。

groups.name: Relieve & Mitigate · 缓解与减轻 (Relieve, Moderate, Alleviate)
groups.tip: 减轻痛苦痛苦或缓和严重程度

items.def_en: [I/T] To reduce pain, worry, or tension, making something less difficult or harsh

items.def_zh: （使）缓和，减轻；节制；主持（讨论、会议等）
items.def_en: 1. To become less extreme, violent, or intense, or to make something so. 2. To act as a moderator or chairperson of a discussion or debate.
to gradually lessen in severity, pain, pressure, or intensity
to become less strong, severe, or intense (of pain, bad weather, or pressure)
(+ sth) to reduce the sharpness, unpleasantness, or intensity of a sensation or feeling

items.def_zh: 缓解，减轻（痛苦、压力等）；使宽慰；接替，换班
items.def_en: 1. To make pain, anxiety, or a difficult situation less severe. 2. To replace someone who is on duty.
To make something bad or harmful less severe, serious, or damaging
To make suffering, deficiency, or a problem less severe

items.def_zh: 平息，缓和（恐惧、饥饿、负罪感等）
items.def_en: To make an unpleasant feeling or unsatisfied appetite less intense

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lessening the severity, intensity, or unpleasantness of pain, suffering, harsh conditions, or extreme states. While 'relieve' focuses on providing direct comfort by removing or blunting an acute distress, 'moderate' and 'mitigate' emphasize tempering or lowering the degree of an extreme condition.
groups.summary_zh: 减轻痛苦、压力或负面状态的剧烈程度，使之缓解趋于温和。

groups.name: Relocate & Resettle · 迁居与安置 (Resettle, Relocate, Billet)
groups.tip: 移民重新落户确立合法居所

items.def_en: To assign lodging or accommodations to soldiers or personnel
to begin living in a new house or assigned residence
(+ sb) to provide someone with accommodation or quarters to stay in
(+ sb) to provide someone with the home, funds, or equipment needed to establish residence

items.def_zh: 迁移，重新安置（员工、家庭、居民）
items.def_en: [I/T] To move someone or oneself to a new place to live or work

items.def_zh: 宿营，向……派驻借宿（尤指军人）
items.def_en: (+ on/in/with) To lodge soldiers or evacuees in civilian or temporary quarters

items.def_zh: （使）定居，（在法律上）确定……为正式居住地
items.def_en: (formal, usually passive) To establish someone or oneself in a permanent legal residence.
To go and live in a new country or area, or to help people to do this.
To provide new, usually public or better housing for displaced people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this administrative/demographic frame denote the process of organizing, establishing, or assigning living quarters to people who are migrating, displaced, or serving in military roles. It emphasizes authoritative arrangement and legal residency rather than merely casual dwelling.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及官方或机构对流动、受灾或流离失所人群进行安置与落户。

groups.name: Remain Alive & Endure · 生存与存活 (Live, Survive, Subsist)
groups.tip: 生命延续与艰难求生

items.def_zh: 活着，生存；居住；度过（某种生活）
items.def_en: 1. To be alive or remain alive. 2. To have one's home in a particular place. 3. To spend or pass one's life in a particular way.

items.def_zh: 幸存，存活；熬过，经受住；比……活得长
items.def_en: 1. To continue to live or exist, especially after a dangerous event or hardship. 2. To live longer than someone else.
(+ on/with) to manage to live or cope with difficulty using limited means

items.def_zh: 渡过难关；自重病重伤中生还
items.def_en: [I/T] to recover from a serious illness or survive a life-threatening crisis

items.def_zh: 勉强维持生计，艰难度日
items.def_en: manage to survive or live on very little money or resources
manage to survive or continue with what is available, despite it not being ideal
continue to survive or hold out in difficult or dangerous conditions
to remain alive after the death of someone else or after something ceases

items.def_zh: 靠微薄资源勉强维持生存
items.def_en: (+ on) to manage to stay alive with minimal food or money

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the fundamental biological or economic state of maintaining life, ranging from ordinary existence to enduring extreme perils or scraping by on minimal resources.
groups.summary_zh: 表示维持生命或存活，涵盖日常存在、度过险境及勉强糊口。

groups.name: Remember & Recall · 记忆与回忆 (Remember, Retain, Recollect)
groups.tip: 信息存入脑海与重现

items.def_en: to retain in memory or spontaneously bring back into one's mind a fact, person, or event

items.def_zh: 回忆起，回想起；召回，收回
items.def_en: 1. To bring a fact, event, or situation back into one's mind; to remember. 2. To officially order someone to return, or ask for defective goods to be returned.

items.def_zh: 记住，保留（记忆中的信息）
items.def_en: to keep facts, figures, or information securely in one's mind over time
(+ on/at sth) think about or reflect on something that happened in the past
(+ to sth) actively direct one's thoughts to an earlier time or event
(+ sth) bring a fact or past experience back into conscious thought
To learn something so thoroughly that you can remember it exactly.
(+ about) to indulge in enjoyable recollection of past events

items.def_zh: 回想，忆起（通常需努力思索）
items.def_en: to bring something from the past back to mind, often with conscious mental effort

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame encompass committing facts to memory, holding information across time, and actively retrieving past experiences or stored knowledge back into conscious awareness.
groups.summary_zh: 指有意识地背诵记忆信息，或在脑海中重新调取并重温过去的经历与知识。

groups.name: Repair & Revamp · 修缮与改造 (Overhaul, Refit, Revamp)
groups.tip: 修复破损缺陷，令旧物焕发新生

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) make an area, building, or object look cleaner, neater, and more attractive

items.def_zh: 翻新，修缮，修整（旧房或旧物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) repair, paint, and modernize an old building, room, or vehicle
(+ sb/sth) supply or equip someone or something with all the necessary gear or modern fittings

items.def_zh: 全面翻修，改版，翻新；修补
items.def_en: To reorganize, repair, or redesign something thoroughly so as to improve its appearance or functioning.
alter the structure, style, or form of a building, room, or object
adapt or update equipment or facilities to meet current standards

items.def_zh: 整修，改装，翻新（船只、车辆或机器）
items.def_en: To repair, clean, and equip a ship, building, or machine with new parts or fittings.

items.def_zh: 检修，修复，翻新（机器、设备等）
items.def_en: To repair, clean, and replace worn parts in a used engine, appliance, or vehicle so that it operates like new.
take apart a machine or system thoroughly to inspect, repair, and restore it

groups.summary_en: Agents upgrade, overhaul, or modernize existing systems, ships, buildings, or mechanisms to restore functionality or enhance performance.
groups.summary_zh: 对设施、船只或机械进行全面翻新、检修与现代化改装升级。

groups.name: Repay & Settle Debt · 偿还与退款补偿 (Repay, Refund, Reimburse)
groups.tip: 退回款项或弥补欠款

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) return money that you borrowed from someone
(+ sth) finish paying all the money that you owe on a loan, mortgage, or debt
(+ with sb) pay someone the money that you owe them, settling an account
1. To give someone their money back, especially because they have returned goods or are dissatisfied with a service.
(+ for) to pay someone an appropriate sum of money to make up for loss, damage, or work done

items.def_zh: 偿还，付清（借款）；报答，回报
items.def_en: 1. To pay back money that you have borrowed. 2. (+ with/for) To do or give something good in return for a favor, help, or kindness.

items.def_zh: 报销，偿还（垫付的款项）；补偿，赔付
items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To pay back money to someone that they have spent on your behalf or lost through official business.
[I/T] to send money in payment for goods, services, or debt, typically by post or electronic transfer
(+ against/for) to compensate someone for loss or damage through a formal or legal agreement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this institutional and contractual financial frame denote returning money or equivalent value to a recipient, distinguishing between returning purchase costs (refund), settling borrowed debt (repay), and covering expenses fronted by an individual (reimburse).
groups.summary_zh: 商业与法律契约下返还款项，细分退还购货款、结清债务及报销垫付款。

groups.name: Repel & Expel · 击退与驱逐 (Repulse, Expel, Ward off)
groups.tip: 将敌对力量挡回驱除

items.def_en: to prevent someone or something unpleasant or hostile from affecting or approaching you
(+ sb/sth) forcefully repel an advancing enemy or attacker
to force an advancing enemy force to retreat through defensive violence
to defend oneself against an attacker or physical attack by thrusting them back

items.def_zh: 击退，奋力抵抗（袭击或感染）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) defend oneself against and successfully repel an attacker or illness
(+ sb/sth) prevent an enemy, attacker, or competitor from advancing or defeating you
to forcefully and authoritatively expel an unwanted or evil presence from a person or group

items.def_zh: 击退，打退；使厌恶，使反感；拒绝
items.def_en: 1. to drive back an attacking enemy by force. 2. to cause strong feelings of disgust or aversion. 3. to reject an offer or approach coldly.

items.def_zh: 驱除（恶魔、邪念），驱邪；消除（痛苦回忆等）
items.def_en: to drive out an evil spirit by prayers or religious rituals; to free oneself from an unpleasant memory or feeling

groups.summary_en: An agent forcefully drives an intruding, hostile, or malignant entity (enemy troops, supernatural spirits, attackers) away from a protected space or physical host.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用力量、法术或戒备将敌方、入侵者或恶灵从所据领地或寄宿体内击退排挤出去。

groups.name: Rescue & Deliver · 救援与解脱 (Rescue, Deliver, Extricate)
groups.tip: 解除束缚重获自由

items.def_zh: 释放，解放；使解脱，使摆脱
items.def_en: To release someone or something from custody, confinement, or restraint; to relieve of a burden or obligation.

items.def_zh: 拯救，挽救，救助；节省，节约；积攒，储蓄；保存（数据）
items.def_en: 1. To rescue or protect someone or something from danger, harm, or death. 2. To avoid spending or using up money, time, or energy. 3. (computing) To store computer data to a storage medium.

items.def_zh: 解救；拯救（免受苦难或邪恶）
items.def_en: (+ from) to save someone from evil, suffering, or captivity (often formal or literary)
to save someone or something from danger, harm, captivity, or death
to rescue someone or an organization from a serious financial or operational predicament

items.def_zh: 打捞出，救出（水中或险境中之人或物）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) pull someone or something out of water or another dangerous confined place

items.def_zh: 挖出，从废墟/积雪中营救出
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) rescue someone trapped under rubble, earth, or snow by excavating
(+ sb) assist someone in dealing with a difficult task or emergency situation
to free someone from a difficult, entangling, or trapped physical situation

groups.summary_en: An agent pulls someone or something out of imminent peril, harm, capture, or oppressive conditions to bring them to safety and liberty. Register varies from everyday safety interventions to dramatic physical liberation.
groups.summary_zh: 将处于险境、囚禁或痛苦状态中的人或事物解救并恢复安全自由。

groups.name: Resist & Withstand · 抵抗与坚守 (Endure or Hold Out Against Adverse Force)
groups.tip: 顶住冲击承受攻击不退缩

items.def_en: [I/T] to use force or willpower to fight back against someone or keep something from happening
maintain a firm, unyielding stance in the face of adversity or confrontation
remain firmly anchored or committed without giving way under external force
to continue to resist an enemy or endure difficult conditions without giving in
refuse to yield, retreat, or change one's position against heavy pressure or attack

items.def_zh: 勇敢抵抗，顶住（压力/对手）
items.def_en: to resist someone or something boldly and resolutely without fear
to come safely through a storm, difficult period, or severe trial

items.def_zh: 经受，承受，顶住（withstand的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of withstand; resisted or endured successfully.
To resist, endure, or hold out successfully against force, pressure, or hardship without giving way.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers enduring pressure, physical wear, or hostile assault without yielding or breaking, progressing from passive resilience to active, immovable resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 承受外部压力、击打或恶劣环境而不屈服，体现韧性到强硬坚守的强度递进。

groups.name: Rest & Idle · 休息与闲卧 (Laze, Repose, Lounge)
groups.tip: 卧床歇息静养恢复体能

items.def_en: (informal) relax completely, doing nothing mentally demanding like watching TV

items.def_zh: 闲逛，闲散度日，懒散地待着
items.def_en: spend time relaxing lazily and doing very little
spend time in an idle, unproductive, and relaxed way
relax completely instead of feeling anxious or expending physical energy
lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed, lazy, or indolent way
idle away time; spend time doing little or nothing productive
sit, stand, or move with a drooping, lazy posture

items.def_zh: 静卧，休息，长眠；寄托（信任、希望等）于
items.def_en: 1. to rest, sleep, or lie peaceful in a particular place. 2. ('repose in') to place trust, hope, or confidence in someone or something.

items.def_zh: 闲逛，闲散，懒散度日；消磨（时光）
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) to spend time relaxing and doing very little. 2. to spend time in a lazy way.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe being physically at rest, either reclining quietly to recover energy or lounging idly without purpose or ambition.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体静止放松、安歇小憩或无所事事地闲躺闲卧。

groups.name: Retaliate & Avenge · 报复与复仇 (Inflict Harm in Return for a Wrong)
groups.tip: 受到伤害后实施回击报复

items.def_zh: 替……报仇，报复；（为……）洗雪（仇恨）
items.def_en: To inflict punishment or injury in return for a wrong done to oneself or others; to avenge.
to retaliate against criticism, an attack, or an opponent
to attack someone who has harmed or attacked you
(+ sb) punish someone or take revenge on them for bad treatment or injury
(+ sb) retaliate against someone who has caused you harm or embarrassment
(+ with sb) inflict harm or take revenge on someone so that an injury is repaid equally
To punish or harm someone in return for an injury or wrong done to oneself or others.

items.def_zh: 反击，报复（以同等行动回敬）
items.def_en: (+ against/by) to make an attack or assault in return for a similar attack

items.def_zh: 以同样方式回应（恩怨等）
items.def_en: [I/T] to respond to an action or hostile gesture with a corresponding one

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on striking back against an aggressor or wrongdoer. Verbs range from broad defensive retaliation to personal, justice-seeking retribution.
groups.summary_zh: 针对侵害采取反击或施加惩戒，涵盖战术还击到道德或个人情感复仇。

groups.name: Retreat & Evacuate · 撤退与疏散 (Retreat, Evacuate, Withdraw)
groups.tip: 面临威胁向后退走

items.def_en: To move back or away from a place, danger, or an enemy; to change your mind or back down from a position.
to move back toward rear defenses, especially when forced by enemy pressure
[I/T] to withdraw troops, investments, or personnel entirely from a specific region or engagement
move backwards away from someone or something dangerous or aggressive

items.def_zh: 撤出，迅速离开（危险区域）
items.def_en: leave a room or area quickly, especially to avoid danger or conflict
(+ from sb/sth) move slowly backwards away from a hazard, person, or threat
[I/T] to move soldiers or personnel back away from a battlefield or forward position
1. To move people away from a dangerous place to safety, or to leave a building or area because of danger. 2. To empty the bowels or bladder.
to depart suddenly or break camp secretly or hurriedly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote coordinated backward or outward egress from a hazardous, contested, or compromised location. 'Retreat' focuses on military or defensive withdrawal away from a pressing foe, while 'evacuate' focuses on emptying an endangered populated area of non-combatants.
groups.summary_zh: 指从危险、战区或受灾区有计划地后撤离开或组织人员疏散。

groups.name: Retrieval & Resurfacing of Memories · 回忆与复现 (Recall, Recollect, Evoke)
groups.tip: 往事重现与心绪唤醒

items.def_en: (+ sth) cause a memory or past feeling to be recalled vividly

items.def_zh: 使忆起，召唤出（记忆或画面）
items.def_en: (+ sth) make one think of something; summon memories or images into the mind
(+ to sth) remember or mention something that happened in the past
(+ about) to indulge in pleasant, nostalgic memories of past events
(formal) To remember something, especially by making an effort to recall it.
to create or bring a vivid image, picture, or memory vividly to mind

items.def_zh: 唤起，引起（回忆、感情或意象）
items.def_en: To bring a feeling, memory, or image into the mind.

items.def_zh: 重温，在想象中再次体验
items.def_en: To experience something again, especially in your imagination.
to bring back into consciousness or active recall memories long forgotten

groups.summary_en: An agent deliberately retrieves past experiences from memory or is confronted by stimuli that bring vivid emotional impressions back to life. Verbs differentiate cognitive retrieval effort from sensory triggering and intense emotional re-experience.
groups.summary_zh: 有意识检索记忆或受外物触动而重现旧景，重在心理提取与再体验。

groups.name: Revel & Socialize · 游乐与聚会狂欢 (Play, Party, Revel)
groups.tip: 休闲放松社交娱乐

items.def_zh: 玩耍，嬉戏，玩乐；参加（体育运动或比赛）；演奏（乐器）；扮演（角色）
items.def_en: 1. To engage in activity for fun, relaxation, or enjoyment. 2. To participate in a sport or competitive game. 3. To perform music on an instrument or act a role in a drama.

items.def_zh: 尽情玩乐，参加聚会狂欢
items.def_en: To attend or participate in a party, celebrating and having fun, often by drinking, dancing, and socializing.
continue drinking, dancing, and enjoying boisterous celebration
go out drinking and celebrating boisterously in bars and clubs
enjoy oneself immensely through extravagant parties, dining, or festive activities
(+ with) to participate in friendly, leisurely social interaction with other people
(+ in) to take immense pleasure in a wild, noisy celebration or festival
to play and run about happily, playfully, and briskly
to drink alcohol freely and indulge in boisterous, noisy social merrymaking

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario describe individuals engaging in lively social entertainment, festivities, games, or boisterous celebratory gatherings. Registers vary from everyday children's games to unrestrained celebratory nightlife.
groups.summary_zh: 描述投身于游戏娱乐、社交派对或节日狂欢等社交娱乐场景。

groups.name: Revile & Blaspheme · 辱骂与亵渎 (Vituperate, Revile, Blaspheme)
groups.tip: 恶言相向并肆意辱骂攻讦他人

items.def_en: [I/T] to utter offensive or profane words expressing hatred or wishing evil upon someone
to scold or condemn someone angrily and at length
(+ sb/sth) to criticize someone or something suddenly and very angrily
(+ sb) to attack someone fiercely with words; to scold harshly
(+ sb) to criticize or verbally abuse someone in an extremely aggressive manner
[I/T] to utter bitter, highly abusive, and harshly critical language against someone
1. (formal) To criticize or abuse someone fiercely with angry, hateful language.
to treat a sacred entity, site, or belief with extreme disrespect or irreverence

items.def_zh: 亵渎神明，说亵渎的话；肆意侮辱
items.def_en: 1. To speak irreverently or disrespectfully about God or sacred things.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve extreme verbal condemnation, scurrilous vituperation, or speaking sacrilegiously against the sacred. They denote the most severe, hateful, and profane tiers of verbal transgression.
groups.summary_zh: 施以极其恶毒的咒骂、痛斥或针对神圣事物的亵渎。

groups.name: Ridicule & Lampoon · 讽刺与讥讽 (Satirize Through Parody and Caricature)
groups.tip: 运用辛辣手段讽刺与丑化

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to mock, ridicule, or tease someone or something in a lighthearted or satirical manner

items.def_zh: 滑稽模仿（某人的言行举止）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to mimic or impersonate someone in an exaggerated way to make people laugh
(+ sb/sth) to mock or parody someone or something by imitating them in an amusing way
to imitate the style of someone or something in an exaggerated way for comic effect

items.def_zh: 把……画成漫画讽刺；夸张讽刺地描述（或模仿）
items.def_en: To represent, draw, or imitate someone in an exaggerated or distorted way so as to make them appear ridiculous.

items.def_zh: 讽刺，嘲弄，以讽刺文章（或漫画等）嘲讽
items.def_en: To publicly criticize, mock, or ridicule someone or something using humorous satire.
to use irony, sarcasm, or humor to expose and criticize people's stupidity or vices
to mock an earnest subject or figure through comically grotesque or incongruous imitation
to expose someone to severe public ridicule, contempt, or censure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote mocking or attacking a person, policy, or institution through artistic, literary, or comedic exaggeration and parody.
groups.summary_zh: 通过艺术夸张、漫画或讽刺笔法揭露缺陷并予以公开戏谑嘲讽。

groups.name: Rob & Plunder · 抢劫与掠夺 (Deprive by Force or Stealth)
groups.tip: 以暴力手段劫掠他人财物

items.def_en: to take property unlawfully from a person or place by force or threat
(+ sb/sth) to steal something from someone, or to cheat them out of money
[I/T] to steal goods from a place during a war, riot, or natural disaster
(+ sb/sth) to rob a person, bank, or vehicle using a weapon or threat of violence
(+ sb/sth) to threaten someone with a gun in order to rob them
(slang) To steal valuable goods or large amounts of money in a daring robbery.
To steal goods or valuables violently from a place, especially during a war or civil disorder.
[I/T] to violently rob a place using force, especially during wartime

items.def_zh: 洗劫，翻箱倒柜彻底搜刮
items.def_en: to search thoroughly and violently through a place, causing destruction and theft

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the unlawful appropriation of property through intimidation, force, or sweeping devastation, escalating from organized thievery to wartime ravaging.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过武力威胁、突袭或战乱席卷夺取他人财物，强调暴力程度与破坏力递增。

groups.name: Rotate on an Axis or Pivot · 轴向旋转与回转 (Rotate, Swivel)
groups.tip: 围绕轴心自转或转动方向

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to rotate so as to face in the opposite direction, or cause something to do so
[I/T] to turn or balance on a central point or pin
To turn or spin around on a fixed central point or pivot, or to cause something to do so.
(+ sb/sth) to turn round very quickly on an axis or pivot point
to pivot or turn around suddenly to face another direction
1. To turn or cause to turn around a central point or axis. 2. To regularly change or take turns doing a job or task.
[I/T] to turn around a center or orbit around an external central point
[I/T] to turn round and round quickly and lightly
[I/T] to turn around rapidly on a central point or axis

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing movement around a central axis or pivot point, ranging from continuous mechanical rotation to turning one's head, body, or an apparatus horizontally.
groups.summary_zh: 指围绕中心轴或枢轴发生的水平转动、旋转或机械回转。

groups.name: Rough Physical Push & Crowd Shoving · 推挤与推搡 (Jostle, Shove, Manhandle)
groups.tip: 在人群中推推搡搡挤开

items.def_en: [I/T] to push past someone or force a way through a crowd using one's elbows
[I/T] to push, butt, or push against gently with the head or horns
(+ sth) to force one's way aggressively into a space or crowd using physical strength
(+ sb) to physically jostle someone or treat them aggressively and imperiously
(+ sb) to push or handle someone roughly and aggressively
[I/T] to push someone or something roughly and forcefully with one's hands
1. to push or bump roughly against someone, especially in a crowd. 2. to compete forcefully with other people for something

items.def_zh: 凭力气硬挤入或强行推搡
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ in/into/past) to force one's way using physical strength or aggressive pressure

items.raw_cluster: 粗暴对待与推搡 Manhandle & Shove
items.def_zh: 粗暴地推搡（或拉扯）；用人力搬运（重物）
items.def_en: 1. to push, drag, or handle someone roughly. 2. to move a heavy or awkward object using physical human strength

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe pushing, bumping, or handling someone roughly or aggressively, typically in a crowd or during physical restraint. They vary in force from accidental crowd bumping to aggressive physical manhandling.
groups.summary_zh: 指在人群中推挤或粗暴拉扯、推搡他人的动作，从轻微拥挤到粗暴控制不等。

groups.name: Rub & Scrape · 摩擦与刮蹭 (Rub, Scrape, Grate)
groups.tip: 表面接触产生摩擦或刮蹭痕迹

items.def_en: (+ sth) to rub a surface vigorously with a cloth, abrasive paper, or scraper to clean or smooth it
(+ sth) to remove something from a surface by friction, or to become removed by being rubbed
1. To rub a rough or sharp edge against a surface, often making a mark or sound. 2. To rub your skin with your nails to relieve an itch.

items.def_zh: 摩擦，揉，搓；涂抹；相互摩擦
items.def_en: To move your hand, a cloth, or an object back and forth over a surface while pressing against it.
to rub an object with a soft cloth or buffer to make it smooth and shiny
(+ sth) to remove an unwanted substance or layer from a surface by dragging a hard edge across it
[I/T] to rub food against a shredder, or to rub two hard surfaces together with a harsh noise
[I/T] to drag a sharp or hard edge firmly across a surface to clean, level, or damage it
[I/T] to rub hard with a stiff brush or cloth, especially with water and soap

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe drawing one object firmly against another's surface to clean, abrade, smooth, or relieve an itch. 'Rub' specifies continuous surface contact and friction, whereas 'scrape' applies a rigid edge to drag across or peel off a surface layer.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过硬质边缘刮除或平顺按揉在物体表面产生的机械摩擦。

groups.name: Rummage & Ransack · 翻找与搜寻 (Rummage, Ransack, Scour)
groups.tip: 翻箱倒柜彻底搜翻掠寻

items.def_en: (+ around/through) To search for something by turning things over in disorder
(+ for/in) To search widely or rummage around for food or provisions
(+ sth) to search through a pile or container by moving objects aside
(+ sth) to search untidily through a collection of things by moving items around
(+ sth) to search thoroughly and haphazardly through a container or area

items.def_zh: 翻寻，快速搜找（尤指偷窃）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ through) To search through something quickly and untidily, often with intent to steal
To search a place or area thoroughly and systematically in order to find something

items.def_zh: 翻找，搜寻，翻箱倒柜地找
items.def_en: (+ through/in/around) To search for something by moving things around carelessly and hurriedly.

items.def_zh: 洗劫，翻箱倒柜搜掠；彻底搜查
items.def_en: To search a place thoroughly and violently, causing damage and mess, especially to steal things.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe searching untidily or aggressively through an enclosed place, container, or belongings by moving things about carelessly or violently. 'Rummage' evokes disordered digging through items, whereas 'ransack' connotes destructive, predatory, or thoroughly disruptive searching.
groups.summary_zh: 杂乱地翻动容器或强行粗暴搜掠场所，以寻找特定物品。

groups.name: Schedule & Slate · 安排与排定 (Time Allocation & Formal Scheduling)
groups.tip: 规划日程并列入计划

items.def_en: to plan that an event or activity will happen at a particular time or date

items.def_zh: 将……排入日程表，列入议程
items.def_en: To enter or schedule something in a calendar or timetable.

items.def_zh: 为……安排时间（或位置）；放入狭槽（或狭缝）
items.def_en: 1. To assign a time, position, or slot for someone or something in a schedule. 2. To put something into a narrow opening or slot.
to make a provisional booking or tentative appointment with the possibility of changing it
(+ sb/sth) to schedule or arrange a definite appointment or time slot for someone

items.def_zh: 在日程表上划出（特定时间段）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reserve a specific period of time on a schedule so that nothing else can be planned
(+ sb/sth) to manage to find time in a busy schedule to see someone or do a task
(+ for / to do) to plan or schedule sth for a future time; designate sb for a post

items.def_zh: 指定，专门预留（时间或资金）
items.def_en: (+ for) to designate or set aside sth specifically for a definite intended purpose or time

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote assigning an event, task, or person to a specific time, date, or programmatic position in a calendar or organizational agenda.
groups.summary_zh: 在日程表、节目单或计划中排定时间段或次序。

groups.name: Score & Scribe Surfaces · 划刻与压印 (Scribe, Score, Indent)
groups.tip: 用锐器在表面刻出细划痕

items.def_zh: 划刻出；在表面刮出（标记或字迹）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make shallow marks, words, or designs onto a surface using a sharp instrument

items.def_zh: （用划线器等在表面）划线，刻痕；抄写
items.def_en: 1. (technical) To mark or scratch a guiding line on wood, metal, or stone using a pointed tool. 2. (formal or archaic) To write or transcribe.
(often passive) To mark or dot a surface with tiny spots.

items.def_zh: 压出凹痕；使边缘呈锯齿状；（段首）缩进
items.def_en: 1. To make a dent or impression in a surface or edge. 2. To start a line of text further from the margin than other lines.
(+ sth) to mark a surface with lines or grooves, especially to guide cutting or indicate removal
to cut a shallow notch, line, or groove into a surface with a sharp tool
to decorate metal surfaces by indenting lines with a hammer and punch
to cut lines or patterns into metal or glass using acid or a sharp point
to cut designs, letters, or lines into hard material using an etching tool

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe tracing sharp shallow reference marks, grooves, tiny specks, or depressions into flat surfaces without completely severing the substrate, typically for guiding, measuring, or indenting.
groups.summary_zh: 指在材质表面划出标线、压入印记或轻微刻痕的操作。

groups.name: Scout & Forage · 侦察与搜寻 (Scout, Reconnoiter, Forage)
groups.tip: 前哨探路搜集前方情报

items.def_en: (+ for) search an area systematically for valuable mineral deposits or opportunities
1. To explore an area in order to gather information about enemy positions or terrain. 2. To look searchingly for someone or something having specific qualities.
(+ sth) Explore an area or examine a situation to gather preliminary information
(+ sb/sth) Search thoroughly until a person, animal, or vital supply is found
(+ sth) Search persistently until hidden items or information are discovered
[I/T] physically explore or make cautious inquiries to test conditions or defenses

items.def_zh: 搜寻（食物、物资等）；搜寻粮草
items.def_en: (+ for) To search widely across an area for food or wild provisions.
search a place thoroughly and systematically in pursuit of something or someone
(military) To explore an area, usually in secret, to gather information about enemy forces or terrain.

groups.summary_en: Agents explore unfamiliar or hostile terrain to gather tactical intelligence, locate targets, or search for food and vital supplies.
groups.summary_zh: 在开阔或陌生区域展开探查，以搜集情报、侦测敌情或寻找补给。

groups.name: Scrub & Wash by Force · 强力洗涤与冲洗 (Scour, Syringe, Scrub)
groups.tip: 注水冲洗或深度冲涤干净

items.def_zh: 用拖把或海绵冲洗擦净
items.def_en: (+ sth) Clean a surface, especially a ship's deck or floor, using a swab or mop and plenty of water
(+ sth) Clean a large object or surface thoroughly by spraying or pouring water over it

items.def_zh: 用注射器冲洗（耳道、伤口等）；用注射器抽取（或注入）
items.def_en: To clean, wash, or flush out an ear, wound, or cavity using a syringe.

items.def_zh: 用拖把或棉签擦洗清洁
items.def_en: (+ down) to clean or wipe a floor, deck, or wound using a swab, mop, or pad
to wash out a wound, body opening, or tissue with a continuous stream of water or saline

items.def_zh: 用软管冲洗（车身、地面等）
items.def_en: to wash something thoroughly by directing a heavy stream of water from a hose
(+ sth) Clean a large surface thoroughly by rubbing hard with a stiff brush and water
[I/T] to rub a hard surface vigorously with a stiff brush or cloth, usually with water and soap

items.def_zh: 彻底擦洗，刷洗；冲刷，冲蚀；彻底搜查
items.def_en: 1. To clean or brighten the surface of something by rubbing it hard with an abrasive or brush. 2. To search an area thoroughly in order to find someone or something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote cleaning a surface or internal cavity through vigorous physical action or targeted liquid application, such as abrasive rubbing ('scour') or pressurized flushing with an instrument ('syringe').
groups.summary_zh: 特指运用器械冲洗或施加强力摩擦刮除污垢的深层清洁方式。

groups.name: Seal & Weatherproof · 密封与填塞封闭
groups.tip: 闭合开口并严密塞紧

items.def_en: (+ sth) Fill and make watertight or airtight seams and cracks using caulking compound
to fasten or close an aperture tightly so that air, liquid, or gas cannot enter or escape
(+ sth) Prevent access to or passage of fluids/air into an area or container by closing openings completely
(+ sth) Close an opening, container, or seam completely so that nothing can enter or escape
to secure or fit a joint with a resilient mechanical seal to prevent fluid leakage
to make a joint, seam, or crack watertight or airtight by filling it with a waterproof mastic
To close or seal a package, container, or seam tightly again after it has been opened.

items.def_zh: 为（门窗）安装密封防风条
items.def_en: To fit strips of rubber, foam, or metal around doors or windows to block drafts, cold air, or rain.

items.def_zh: 填塞（缝隙）以防漏，堵漏；（给马蹄铁）装防滑尖铁
items.def_en: 1. (variant of caulk) To fill the seams or joints of something with waterproof material to prevent leaking. 2. To provide a horseshoe with sharp cleats or points to prevent slipping.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe applying specific materials, gaskets, or compounds to seams, cracks, or openings to make an enclosure impervious to air, moisture, or drafts. Manner variations depend on the application medium, such as caulking compound, weatherstripping tape, or sealant.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用密封胶、填缝剂或绝缘条封闭缝隙以防渗水漏气。

groups.name: Secrete & Excrete · 分泌与排泄 (Salivate, Stale, Discharge)
groups.tip: 腺体分泌体液或排泄废物

items.def_en: (+ sth) Emit or produce a liquid, secretion, smell, or gas from inside
Flow slowly and steadily out of a gland, wound, or small opening
Flow or leak out slowly through small pores or cracks

items.def_zh: （马、牛等）排尿，撒尿；（使）变陈旧，（使）走味
items.def_en: 1. (of horses, cattle, etc.) To urinate. 2. To make or become stale or uninteresting.
to allow saliva to run continuously out of the mouth involuntarily
(of an organ or cell) to produce and release a functional liquid substance

items.def_zh: 分泌唾液，流口水；垂涎，极度渴望
items.def_en: 1. To produce saliva in the mouth. 2. (+ over) To show great eagerness or anticipation for something.
[I/T] to emit or release pus, fluid, or bodily matter from a wound or cavity
to separate and discharge waste matter from the bodily system

groups.summary_en: Biological organisms release fluid or waste products from internal glands or organs, either functional secretions (e.g. saliva) or waste excretions (e.g. urine in animals).
groups.summary_zh: 机体或腺体产生并排出机能性体液（唾液等）或生理代谢废弃物。

groups.name: Seize & Haul · 抓夺与强拉 (Grab, Seize, Snatch, Haul, Tow)
groups.tip: 徒手用力夺取或拉拽

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Take sudden and firm physical possession of someone or something with one's hands
(+ sb/sth) Pull a heavy load inside, or take a suspect into custody forcibly
to pull somebody or something along the ground with effort
To pull a vehicle, boat, or other object along behind another using a rope, chain, or towbar.
to take hold of something suddenly, roughly, or secretly
(+ sb/sth) Carry or drag someone or something away by force or with heavy physical effort

items.def_zh: 抓住，攫取；抓住（机会）；吸引
items.def_en: 1. To take hold of something or someone suddenly and roughly. 2. To quickly take an opportunity. 3. (informal) To get someone's attention.
to take hold of something suddenly and forcefully with the hands or take legal possession of it
to pull or carry something heavy with a continuous, strenuous effort

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly taking hold of an object or dragging/towing it along with physical effort, spanning fast tactical grabs to heavy-load pulls.
groups.summary_zh: 用力抓取、抢夺或以机械力/体力强行牵引拽拉。

groups.name: Separate & Detach · 分离与解扣 (Uncouple, Disconnect, Detach)
groups.tip: 解开连接使部件各自分离

items.def_en: Separate into pieces or become detached from a joined structure
(+ sth) Disengage or release something from a hook or fastening
[I/T] (+ from) to unfasten and separate one part or item from a larger structure
[I/T] to break the physical or operational contact or connection between two linked things

items.def_zh: 脱开，解开，拆开（连接的车厢、机械等）
items.def_en: To disconnect or separate two things that are joined together, such as railway carriages.
Become physically separated or detached from a larger joined object or assembly
1. To divide, disconnect, or stop being joined together. 2. To stand or act as a barrier between people or things. 3. (of a couple) To stop living together.
(+ from) to unhook or release an animal or vehicle from a hitch
[I/T] (+ from) to release an interlocking mechanical component from engagement with another

groups.summary_en: An agent mechanically disengages or undoes the physical linkage joining two bound objects (such as vehicles, machinery parts, or fastenings), setting them free of each other.
groups.summary_zh: 松解、解除物理联结机械装置，将相互钩合或扣接在一起的物体分离开来。

groups.name: Sewing & Stitching Craft · 针缝与补缀工艺 (Stitch, Sew, Hem)
groups.tip: 针线交织与衣物缝合

items.def_en: (+ sth) Close a tear, hole, or incision completely using a needle and thread
(+ sth) Join the edges of cloth or human flesh together with stitches

items.def_zh: 粗缝，用粗针脚临时缝合
items.def_en: (+ sth) Attach a piece of fabric temporarily with loose or quick stitches
1. To sew or join pieces of fabric together using a needle and thread. 2. To close a wound with stitches.
[I/T] to join or fasten pieces of fabric, leather, or material using needle and thread
[I/T] to repair a hole in knitted cloth by interweaving yarn with a needle
to turn under and sew the finished edge of a piece of cloth

items.def_zh: 缝制，缝补（sew 的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of sew; to join, fasten, or repair cloth using a needle and thread.

items.def_zh: 粗缝，用大针脚假缝定位
items.def_en: to tack or sew pieces of fabric together temporarily with loose, long stitches

groups.summary_en: An artisan or tailor manipulates needle and thread to join fabrics, create garments, or close seams in cloth or flesh. Verbs represent the foundational technical acts of sewing, edging, tacking, or stitching seams.
groups.summary_zh: 裁缝或手工艺人运用针线拼接织物、修补边沿或手工缝合破口。

groups.name: Shake & Tremble · 颤抖与剧颤 (Quiver, Tremble, Shudder)
groups.tip: 从轻微发抖到剧烈摇晃

items.def_en: (+ sth) Shake involuntarily and slightly because of cold, fear, or weakness
to shake involuntarily with quick, short movements as a result of fear, cold, or weakness

items.def_zh: 颤抖，发抖；微颤，轻微晃动
items.def_en: to shake, tremble, or vibrate with a slight, rapid motion, often because of strong emotion, cold, or physical force
(+ sth) Agitate or vibrate an object vigorously back and forth
(+ sth) Shake violently or convulse momentarily with horror, disgust, or cold

items.def_zh: 摇动，摇晃；颤抖，发抖；动摇
items.def_en: 1. to move quickly back and forth, up and down, or from side to side, or to cause something to do so. 2. to tremble because of cold, fear, or illness. 3. to make someone or something feel less confident or secure
to shake suddenly and briefly with a strong, deep convulsive movement from disgust or fear
to shake violently, especially of the ground or large structures under immense force
[I/T] to shake violently and uncontrollably with sudden, irregular spasmodic contractions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote involuntary or mechanical vibrating movements, ranging from fine, delicate twitching caused by cold or emotion to violent structural jolts. 'Quiver' occupies the low-intensity threshold of barely visible shaking, whereas 'convulse' reaches violent spasmodic agitation.
groups.summary_zh: 按物理或情绪震动幅度由微弱细颤到剧烈痉挛的级差排列。

groups.name: Shave, Pare & Bore · 削切与掘凿 (Spud, Tonsure, Gouge)
groups.tip: 下放钻头向地下开凿深孔

items.def_en: (+ sth) Trim or shave off outer layers or edges of something bit by bit
(+ sth) Cut, scoop, or force out a hollow or piece from a surface using a sharp or curved tool
(+ sth) Cut off a thin layer or unwanted material from a surface using a blade
(+ of/off) to cut wool or hair from an animal or person, or slice through heavy material with blades
(+ out) to make a deep groove, hole, or indentation in something using a sharp chisel or claw-like tool
(+ out) to widen, enlarge, or clear a drilled hole or bore using a rotary cutting tool

items.def_zh: 开钻（油气井）；用短铲除草，铲除
items.def_en: 1. (petroleum engineering) To start drilling an oil or gas well (often 'spud in'). 2. To dig or cut with a spud or spade.
(+ away/down) to trim off outer layers, skin, or edges using a small sharp blade

items.def_zh: 为……剃发，削发（尤指剃度入修会）
items.def_en: To shave the head or the crown of the head of someone entering the priesthood or a monastic order.

groups.summary_en: Specialized vocational, mechanical, or ritual acts involving chipping, boring, shearing, or stripping surface material from an object or head using dedicated tools.
groups.summary_zh: 使用专用工具进行剥凿、打孔或仪式性剃除毛发/表层材料。

groups.name: Shine & Glimmer · 闪烁与烁耀 (Glint, Luminesce, Scintillate)
groups.tip: 光芒忽明忽暗微弱闪烁

items.def_en: to burn or shine unsteadily or intermittently
to shine with a flickering light that alternates rapidly between bright and faint
to shine with a soft, slightly wavering, luminous light

items.def_zh: 闪闪发光，闪烁（微弱的光）
items.def_en: 1. To shine with small, bright flashes of light; (of eyes) to show an emotion briefly.
1. To emit light without producing much or any heat.
(+ sth) to produce a brief, tiny flash of reflected light off a polished or faceted surface
to shine continuously with bright, lively, jumping points of reflected light

items.def_zh: 晶莹璀璨地迸闪火星般光芒
items.def_en: to shine brightly with flashes of light scattered across many points

items.def_zh: 闪烁，闪耀；焕发才华，妙语连珠
items.def_en: 1. To shine brightly with quick flashes of light; to be brilliantly lively, clever, or witty.

groups.summary_en: A light source or reflective facet emits light marked by rapid flashes, intermittent glimmers, or chemical luminescence.
groups.summary_zh: 伴随微动、折射或发光体特质而起伏闪烁的瞬时微光。

groups.name: Shore Up & Structurally Reinforce · 支撑与物理加固 (Underpin, Shore up, Buttress)
groups.tip: 搭设脚手架稳固支撑结构

items.def_en: (+ up) to prevent something from falling by placing an object under or against it
(+ sth) to secure, stiffen, or reinforce a structure using tight stays, struts, or braces
(+ sb/sth) to support a structure, object, or wall by placing a physical prop or beam underneath or against it to stop it falling
to support a building, wall, or structure with props or wooden shores to prevent collapse
to strengthen, support, or make rigid with a firm brace or diagonal beam

items.def_zh: 为……搭建脚手架；（教育学）为（学习者）提供支架式指导
items.def_en: 1. To support a building or structure with scaffolding; (education) to provide structured guidance to learners.

items.def_zh: 支撑，加固（建筑物底层）；巩固，构成……的基础
items.def_en: 1. To support or form the foundation of a wall or building; to strengthen, support, or substantiate an argument or system.

items.def_zh: 给（船）装压舱物；用道渣铺垫（铁轨）
items.def_en: 1. To provide a ship with heavy material for stability; to lay crushed stone under railway tracks.
to support or strengthen a wall or building with an external architectural buttress

groups.summary_en: Physical engineering and manual stabilization verbs describing the addition of beams, props, heavy weights, or foundations to prevent a structure from sagging or collapsing.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过架设支架、底座、压载物或立柱从物理底层结构上进行加固支撑。

groups.name: Shorten & Condense · 缩减与压缩 (Shorten, Condense, Compress)
groups.tip: 删繁就简，缩减篇幅与体积

items.def_en: (+ sth) Reduce the length, volume, or size of something
(+ sth) Reduce the dimensions, size, or scope of something in proportion
(+ to) To shorten a word, phrase, or piece of writing by omitting letters, sounds, or parts.
(+ sth) Reduce a liquid or text to its essential, concentrated elements
[I/T] To press something into a smaller space or decrease its volume

items.def_zh: 使凝缩，压缩（文字或体积）
items.def_en: [I/T] To make something more compact, dense, or shorter in substance or words

items.def_zh: （使）放气，（使）瘪掉；打消（气焰），挫伤（信心）；紧缩（通货）
items.def_en: 1. To let air or gas out of something, or to become smaller by losing air or gas. 2. To make someone feel less confident or proud. 3. To reduce the level of economic activity or money supply.
To shorten a piece of writing or speech without losing its central sense
To shorten something by cutting off the top, end, or tail portion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail reducing the physical length, spatial volume, air pressure, or written length of something. 'Abbreviate' focuses specifically on shortening words or written accounts, while 'deflate' specifically reduces volume by removing trapped air or gas.
groups.summary_zh: 通过省略、排气或挤压，使长度、体积或篇幅缩减变小。

groups.name: Sift & Sieve · 筛滤与细致排查 (Sift, Sieve, Riddle)
groups.tip: 用细孔筛网过滤粗粒杂质

items.def_en: to pass substances through a coarse wire mesh or systematically check items to eliminate unsuitable ones
(+ sth) Examine a large amount of information, evidence, or matter carefully to find what is relevant
(+ sb/sth) Filter out or eliminate unwanted individuals, substances, or elements
(+ sth) Reduce a list or group of candidates or items by gradually eliminating the less suitable ones
(+ sb/sth) Remove or eliminate unwanted, inferior, or troublesome members or things from a group

items.def_zh: 用粗筛筛选（矿石、泥土等）
items.def_en: to pass gravel, soil, or coal through a coarse wire mesh or sieve to separate fragments

items.def_zh: 筛分，过滤；细查，详审；撒落
items.def_en: 1. To pass a powder or loose substance through a sieve to separate fine parts from lumps. 2. (+ through) To examine information or evidence thoroughly to isolate what is useful or true.
To pass a liquid, powder, or grain through a sieve to remove coarse particles.

items.def_zh: 扬谷扬去糠秕；去粗取精，筛选出
items.def_en: (+ out/down) to separate chaff from grain by air current, or narrow down a group to find the best elements

groups.summary_en: An agent separates finer particles from coarser matter using a mesh instrument, or figuratively examines large quantities of evidence or data to extract what is relevant. Verbs in this frame contrast physical mesh-straining with meticulous intellectual sorting.
groups.summary_zh: 用筛网分离颗粒物杂质，或引申为在海量材料中严密筛查出有用信息。

groups.name: Signal & Indicate · 示意与发信号 (Flag, Signal, Motion)
groups.tip: 用动作或暗号传达意图
