items.def_en: (+ sb) Direct someone by making a non-verbal gesture with hands or head
(+ sth) Signal to the driver of a vehicle to stop by waving one's hand or an object
(+ sb/sth) Motion to someone or a vehicle to proceed by moving one's hand

items.raw_cluster: 示意与发信号 Signal & Flag
items.def_zh: 示意，打信号（如挥手拦截车辆）；标出，标示；衰退，变弱
items.def_en: 1. to signal someone (such as a driver) to stop or pay attention, especially by waving a hand or flag. 2. to mark or draw attention to something for special handling. 3. to become tired, weaker, or less enthusiastic.
[I/T] (+ to/toward) to direct or signal someone with a movement of the hand, head, or body
[I/T] (+ at) to shine or flicker a light as a visual signal or warning
[I/T] to make a gesture with the hand, arm, or head to encourage someone to approach
to wave your hand or an object to signal a moving vehicle to halt
1. to make a movement, sound, or action to give a message or order to someone. 2. to indicate, express, or make known a feeling, intention, or change.

groups.summary_en: A person communicates a message, warning, or operational instruction using gestures, lights, visual markers, or formal indicators rather than full speech. Verbs vary by the channel employed, from waving down traffic to flashing optical codes.
groups.summary_zh: 通过手势、视听标志或信号装置传达警告、意图或指令。

groups.name: Simulate & Put On · 伪装与假冒 (Pretend, Sham, Feign)
groups.tip: 装模作样掩盖真相与伪装

items.def_en: (+ that/sb) Claim or pretend falsely that something is true or that someone is a certain way
(+ sth) Pretend to have a particular feeling, quality, or manner to impress or deceive
to artificially put on a style, mannerism, or attitude to impress or mislead
to invent, simulate, or imitate falsely to mislead others
(+ sb/sth as sb/sth) Falsely represent someone or something to be another entity through deception
To act as if something is true when it is not, especially in pretend play or to deceive.
To pretend to have or feel something in order to deceive others.
to simulate an illness, emotion, or state with intent to deceive
[I/T] to conceal one's true motives, beliefs, or feelings by false appearance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the deliberate adoption of an outward false appearance, emotion, or condition in order to deceive onlookers, distinguished by register and the degree of theatricality or deceit involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过神态、举止故意装出某种假象以蒙蔽他人。

groups.name: Slacken to Enfeeble · 放缓、衰竭与削弱 (Slacken, Wither, Enfeeble)
groups.tip: 力量或状态逐渐减弱消退

items.def_en: Become slower, less active, or less intense in effort or tension
[I/T] to lose strength or power, or cause someone or something to do so

items.def_zh: 放慢，减缓，减弱；（使）变松，松开
items.def_en: 1. (+ off/up) To become or make something slower, less active, or less intense. 2. To become looser, or make something loose.
Slowly lose strength, health, or vitality until near death or extinction

items.def_zh: 消除两极分化；（物理、生物）去极化，消除极化
items.def_en: 1. To reduce or eliminate sharp polarization or division between opposing groups. 2. (physics / biology) To remove or reduce electrical or magnetic polarization.
Gradually become physically weak and thin through illness or starvation
to severely impair the strength or vitality of someone or something
1. (formal) To make a person, body, or institution very weak, frail, or powerless.
[I/T] to waste away or decline in effectiveness due to lack of use or disease

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a loss of vigor, physical tension, vitality, or structural strength, progressing in intensity from mild slackening of pace/tension to debilitating physical or biological enfeeblement.
groups.summary_zh: 描述力量、紧张感或生理机能从放缓松弛逐步恶化到虚弱枯竭的过程。

groups.name: Slip Away & Evade · 逃遁与规避 (Elude, Bunk, Abscond)
groups.tip: 巧妙躲避追查与危险

items.def_en: to depart quietly and unnoticed without attracting attention
Depart quietly or secretly without attracting attention
Leave quickly or secretly, especially to avoid an awkward situation, obligation, or duty
Move away quietly and stealthily so as not to be seen or heard
Leave hurriedly, especially in order to escape capture or detection
to escape or avoid someone or something by ingenuity or cleverness

items.def_zh: 逃跑，溜走；逃学，旷工；搭铺，睡简易床
items.def_en: 1. To run away or escape hastily. 2. ('bunk off') (British informal) To stay away from school or work without permission. 3. ('bunk down') To sleep in a simple bed or bunk.

items.def_zh: 逃避，躲避；使避开；把……难倒，不为……所理解
items.def_en: 1. To manage to escape from or avoid being caught by someone through cleverness or quickness. 2. If a fact, name, or solution eludes you, you cannot remember or understand it.
to leave secretly and quietly, typically to escape custody or avoid arrest

groups.summary_en: A person quickly departs without permission or deftly slips away to avoid capture, duty, or confrontation. Verbs range from colloquial bolting to formal stealthy avoidance or absconding.
groups.summary_zh: 为躲避追捕、责任或抓获而秘密溜走或机警避开。

groups.name: Smooth & Align · 抹平与理顺 (Slick, Preen, Straighten)
groups.tip: 抚平褶皱理顺表面

items.def_en: to disentangle and straighten tangled hair or fleece using a comb
(+ sth) to flatten hair back against the head using oil, gel, or water
(+ sb/sth) to make someone or something look neater, cleaner, and more attractive
(+ sth) to push the loose edges of a garment neatly into a waistband or other piece of clothing

items.def_zh: 理顺，抹平（头发等，常与 back/down 连用）；使光滑
items.def_en: to make hair or a surface smooth, flat, and shiny, especially by applying oil, gel, or water
to bring unruly curls, cowlicks, or hair into a neat, manageable state

items.def_zh: 理顺，理齐，弄平整；弄直，变直；整顿，清理
items.def_en: 1. to make something straight, tidy, or aligned, or to become straight 2. to resolve or clear up a problem, confusion, or misunderstanding
[I/T] (of birds or people) to clean and arrange feathers or tidy one's appearance meticulously

items.def_zh: 用油或水把（头发）梳得服帖
items.def_en: to flatten and smooth down hair neatly using water, gel, or oil

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify deliberate grooming or tactile manipulation to align fibers, hair, plumage, or garments neatly into place, often using moisture, pomade, or careful brushing.
groups.summary_zh: 梳理毛发、羽毛或衣着，使其整齐顺滑、不杂乱。

groups.name: Smooth & Flatten · 抚平与熨平 (Smooth, Iron, Plane)
groups.tip: 压平凸起褶皱令表面光洁

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make or become level, flat, or free of uneven bumps
to eliminate wrinkles, folds, or bumps by pressing softly with the hands or an instrument

items.def_zh: 抚平，使平整，使光滑；消除（障碍），使顺利
items.def_en: 1. to make a surface flat, level, or smooth, especially by pressing or rubbing 2. to make a process or situation easier by removing difficulties
to make a surface, texture, or situation smoother, flatter, or more even
(+ sth) to remove creases from fabric or clothing by pressing with a hot iron
(+ sth) to make a wooden or painted surface completely smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper
[I/T] to remove creases from fabric by applying pressure with a heated iron
to shave thin layers off wood to make the surface level and silky
to polish or smooth wood or metal surfaces by rubbing with sandpaper

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote removing surface roughness, creases, or minor bumps to create a sleek, silky, or uniform texture, typically using gentle manual strokes, tools, or heat.
groups.summary_zh: 用手工抚摩、熨烫或细木工工具消除折皱与粗糙表面。

groups.name: Soil & Besmirch · 玷污与弄脏 (Blot, Tarnish, Befoul)
groups.tip: 沾染污渍油垢，损毁清白整洁

items.def_en: (+ sth) make something dirty or muddy
(+ sth) dirty or blur a surface with streaks or smudges
[T/I] Make or become dirty on the surface, especially with earth, mud, or excrement

items.def_zh: 弄脏，染上污渍；玷污（名誉等）；（用吸水纸）吸干；（blot out）遮蔽，抹去
items.def_en: 1. To spot, stain, or spatter something with liquid or ink; to tarnish someone's character or reputation. 2. To dry wet ink or liquid by pressing absorbent paper against it. 3. ('blot out') To obscure from sight or completely wipe from memory.
[T/I] Cause dirty marks or smears on a surface, obscuring clarity

items.def_zh: （使）失去光泽，变暗淡；玷污，损害（名誉）
items.def_en: 1. To lose brightness or shine through exposure to air or moisture, or cause metal to discolor. 2. To damage, spoil, or stain someone's good reputation.

items.def_zh: 弄脏，弄污；施肥于；（muck up）搞砸，弄乱；（muck out）清理（牲口棚）
items.def_en: 1. To make something dirty or muddy; to spread manure on soil. 2. ('muck up') (informal) To spoil, ruin, or make a mess of something. 3. ('muck out') To clean manure from a stable or animal enclosure.
Damage someone's good name, honor, or reputation; soil or tarnish integrity
Make foul, dirty, or filthy with offensive matter; defile morally

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover the physical dirtying, staining, or discoloring of a surface, alongside the figurative degradation of an individual's honor, reputation, or purity. Nuances scale from surface smudges to severe corrosive or reputational spoiling.
groups.summary_zh: 指弄脏、留下斑印或玷污使表面变暗，引申为损害声誉或纯洁性。

groups.name: Soothe & Console · 安抚与慰藉 (Comfort, Console, Soothe)
groups.tip: 平复痛苦焦虑，给予心理温存

items.def_en: To make someone feel calmer and less worried, unhappy, or upset; to console.
(+ sb) make someone feel more peaceful, tranquil, or less distressed
(+ sth) relieve or ease pain, worry, or tension through gentle care
To give comfort or sympathy to someone who is unhappy, disappointed, or grieving.

items.def_zh: 使放心，打消……的疑虑或恐惧
items.def_en: to say or do something that removes the doubts, fears, or anxieties of someone

items.def_zh: 抚慰，使平静；缓解（疼痛或焦虑）
items.def_en: to gently calm a person, their feelings, or to reduce bodily pain and irritation

items.def_zh: 抚慰，在忧伤中慰藉（文雅）
items.def_en: (formal/literary) to give comfort, consolation, or relief to someone in distress or disappointment

items.def_zh: 抚慰，平复（负罪感、受挫的自尊等）；涂药膏于
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To soothe or ease guilt, wounded pride, or hurt feelings. 2. (dated) To apply a healing ointment to a wound.

items.def_zh: 减轻，缓解，平息（担忧、恐惧或疑虑）
items.def_en: (formal) To calm or reduce fear, worry, suspicion, or pain.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on relieving another person's sorrow, grief, physical distress, or anxious apprehension through sympathy, warmth, and reassuring presence. Unlike political placating, these actions target pain and emotional woundedness rather than aggressive wrath.
groups.summary_zh: 缓解他人的悲伤、痛苦、创伤或忧惧，给予温情与抚慰。

groups.name: Speak & Articulate · 发声与语音吐字 (Utter, Aspirate, Mispronounce)
groups.tip: 开口发音与言辞表达

items.def_en: (+ sth) articulate distinct letter sounds or syllables one by one to form a word

items.def_zh: 发出某词或字母的标准读音
items.def_en: [I/T] to make the sound of a word or letter in a particular way
1. To make a sound with your voice; to say something.

items.def_zh: 送气发音，以送气音读出；抽吸（体液等）
items.def_en: 1. (phonetics) To pronounce a sound with an audible breath release. 2. (medicine) To draw fluid or gas out of a body cavity.
1. To pronounce a word or name incorrectly.
(+ sth) articulate or utter words abruptly or with difficulty

items.def_zh: 声带发声或将想法说出
items.def_en: [I/T] to utter sounds or words using the vocal cords

items.def_zh: 清晰连贯地表达音节或话语
items.def_en: [I/T] to pronounce distinct syllables clearly or express thoughts smoothly
[I/T] to pronounce words, syllables, or sounds distinctly and clearly

groups.summary_en: A speaker employs the vocal apparatus to form phonemes, release breath, or pronounce verbal tokens, emphasizing physical phonetic mechanics.
groups.summary_zh: 通过发音器官调控气流与音节，侧重语音与吐字机制。

groups.name: Speculate & Conecture · 猜想与推测 (Conjecture, Surmise, Presuppose)
groups.tip: 凭直觉或模糊线索猜测

items.def_en: 1. To estimate or form an opinion about something without having enough facts. 2. (informal) To think, suppose, or believe.
make a guess or conjecture despite lacking complete information
(+ sth) form an opinion or expectation based on conjecture
[T/I] to form an opinion or supposition about something without sufficient evidence
to put forward an explanation or hypothesis as a basis for argument
to suggest or accept something as a basic fact or truth for reasoning
[T/I] to put forward a tentative assumption in order to draw out and test its consequences
(formal) To guess or infer that something is true based on incomplete evidence.

items.def_zh: 预先假定，假定；以……为先决条件
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To assume or accept something as true before having proof. 2. (formal) To require something to exist or be true as a necessary prior condition.

groups.summary_en: Cognizers form beliefs or hypotheses based on incomplete evidence, underlying assumptions, or intuition. The verbs differ in register and epistemic grounding, from informal everyday guesses to formal, deductive premises.
groups.summary_zh: 基于不充分证据或先入为主的前提出发，形成假定或猜想。

groups.name: Speed & Greed in Eating · 贪婪大嚼与狼吞虎咽 (Overeat, Snarf)
groups.tip: 无节制地过量塞满食物

items.def_en: Eat food enthusiastically and heartily
(+ sth) Finish eating all the food quickly and completely
[I/T] (+ up/down) to eat hurriedly and noisily in large mouthfuls
(+ sth) Eat something very fast in big, eager bites
(+ sth) Eat food very quickly and greedily
to eat food extremely quickly and greedily without chewing properly
to eat something rapidly, voraciously, and greedily

items.raw_cluster: 暴食与过量饮食 Binge & Overeat
items.def_en: To eat more food than is healthy or than your body needs.
(informal) To eat or drink something quickly and greedily.

groups.summary_en: Scale measuring the speed and voracity with which food is consumed, moving from simple excessive intake to rapid, noisy, gluttonous gobbling.
groups.summary_zh: 体现从普通的进食过量升级到贪婪、疾速、狼吞虎咽地大嚼吞食。

groups.name: Spin & Orbit · 旋转与公转 (Orb, Wheel, Revolve)
groups.tip: 像轮子般打转回旋

items.def_en: (+ sth) travel or orbit in a circular path around a central body
move in a wide circle or curve through the air or space
[I/T] To move completely around something in a circular path

items.def_zh: 绕轨道运行；使成球形，成圆形
items.def_en: (poetic) To move in a circular orbit, or to encircle or form into a sphere.
1. To turn or move quickly in a circle or curve, as birds in flight or people pivoting. 2. To push or move something that has wheels.
[I/T] To move around a central celestial body or object in an elliptical or circular path
[I/T] To move in a circle around an axis or center point

items.def_zh: 旋转，转动；围绕……旋转；以……为中心
items.def_en: 1. To move in a circle or orbit around a central point or axis. 2. (+ around) To have someone or something as the main subject or focus.
To move rapidly in a circle or spiral around an axis

groups.summary_en: An entity executes circular, rotational, or orbital motion either around an external central body or in a wide circular trajectory.
groups.summary_zh: 围绕中心轴或天体进行环形旋转、公转或绕圈回旋。

groups.name: Split & Divide · 分裂与分割 (Split, Divide, Cleave)
groups.tip: 整体裂解分成多份

items.def_en: to move or cause things to move slightly apart, creating a space between them
to divide or fork cleanly into two separate branches or paths
(+ sth) to divide an area, asset, or entity into several smaller parts among different parties
(+ sb/sth) to divide or break something into smaller parts or distinct groups

items.def_zh: （使）分裂，（使）裂开；分开，分担；分享；断绝关系，分手
items.def_en: 1. To break, divide, or split into two or more parts. 2. To share or divide something between two or more people. 3. (informal) To end a relationship or leave.

items.def_zh: （使）分开，（使）分裂；分配，分摊；（使）产生分歧；除以
items.def_en: 1. To separate into two or more parts, or cause something to separate. 2. To share out or distribute. 3. To cause disagreement among people. 4. (mathematics) To calculate how many times one number contains another.
(+ sth) to separate or cause something to separate completely into pieces
(+ along/through) to split or sever something firmly and cleanly, often along a natural grain
to break violently apart or sever completely, especially an abstract bond or unified entity

groups.summary_en: An agent separates a unified physical whole, group, or continuum into two or more parts, or a whole naturally fractures along seams under stress.
groups.summary_zh: 沿纹理、外力或界限将整体破裂、切开或划分成若干部分。

groups.name: Spoil & Decompose · 变质与腐坏 (Spoil, Decay, Rot)
groups.tip: 事物受损毁坏或品质败坏

items.def_en: Become rotten, stale, or sour so as to be unfit for consumption
Decompose into basic organic constituents through natural chemical decay
Become stale or begin to decompose and spoil (chiefly British)

items.def_zh: 变质，腐败；损坏，破坏；宠坏，溺爱
items.def_en: 1. (of food) To become bad or unfit to eat; to cause to decay. 2. To ruin or diminish the quality, value, or pleasure of something. 3. To overindulge a child.
[I/T] to undergo gradual structural decomposition by natural biological or chemical causes

items.def_zh: 变质，腐败；损坏，破坏；宠坏（spoil的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of spoil; to become decayed, ruined, or overindulged.
Gradually decay and disintegrate completely through biological breakdown
[I/T] to decompose through bacterial or fungal action, turning soft, foul, and unusable
[I/T] to rot and decay with the production of a foul, repulsive odor

groups.summary_en: This intensity-graded frame traces organic matter losing freshness, decomposing, and deteriorating until ruined. Intensity progresses from functional unfitness or souring ('spoil') to structural bacterial breakdown ('decay') and total offensive putrefaction ('rot', 'putrefy').
groups.summary_zh: 按由轻至重梯度，描述有机物由失去鲜度变质到彻底腐烂崩解的过程。

groups.name: Sport & Game Plays · 竞技战术执行 (Score, Defend, Play Cards)
groups.tip: 体育场上博弈较量与争夺胜负

items.def_zh: 出王牌胜过；出将牌打败
items.def_en: To play a trump card on a trick, defeating other suits
To physically intercept and bring down an opponent carrying the ball

items.def_zh: （体育比赛中）贴身紧逼防守（某人）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to mark or defend closely against an opposing player in team sports

items.def_zh: 从后场组织倒脚推进（足球）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to pass the ball systematically forward starting from the defensive zone or goalkeeper

items.def_zh: 触杀（棒球中持球触碰跑垒员出局）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to touch a baserunner with the ball or the glove holding the ball to put them out in baseball
To complete a hole or golf course in the designated standard number of strokes

items.def_zh: （美式足球或橄榄球中）打全卫位置
items.def_en: 1. (sports) To play as a fullback in American football or rugby.

items.def_zh: （桥牌等纸牌游戏中）出王牌杀牌
items.def_en: 1. (card games) To trump, or play a trump card when unable to follow suit in bridge or whist.

items.def_zh: （高尔夫球中）打出超过标准杆一杆的成绩
items.def_en: 1. (golf) To score one stroke more than par on a hole.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this domain represent technical game actions and scoring events within regulated competitive sports and games. They specify sport-specific maneuvers such as playing cards of a trump suit, recording golf scores, or executing designated tactical roles.
groups.summary_zh: 指竞技体育或纸牌等规则博弈中执行的具体战术与技术动作。

groups.name: Sprout & Flourish · 植物萌发生长 (Sprout, Bloom, Flourish)
groups.tip: 从含苞绽放到枝繁叶茂

items.def_en: to begin to grow and produce new leaves, shoots, or buds
to begin to grow and push up from the soil or a seed
To produce, develop, or begin to open into buds.
to grow upwards very quickly and vigorously

items.def_zh: 开花；繁荣，成熟，达到盛期
items.def_en: 1. To produce blooms or blossom. 2. To reach full development or peak prosperity.
to produce flowers, especially on fruit trees, or to flourish vibrantly
(+ blossom/flower) to suddenly produce an abundance of flowers or blooms
to grow vigorously and healthily under optimal conditions
to grow exceptionally well and energetically in a favorable environment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the sequential biological progression of plant life, tracking the manner of growth from early emergence and budding to fully flowering and thriving vitality.
groups.summary_zh: 描述植物从萌芽、抽枝、开花到枝繁叶茂的各阶段生长方式。

groups.name: Squirm & Wriggle · 蠕动与辗转扭动 (Squirm, Wriggle, Writhe)
groups.tip: 局促不安地扭动身躯

items.def_en: to twist and fidget one's body restlessly or uncomfortably
to free oneself or escape from a confined space by twisting and writhing the body
[I/T] to turn or contort the body or a part of it into a different position
[I/T] to move with small, quick, irregular movements from side to side or up and down

items.def_zh: （因尴尬、紧张或疼痛而）扭动身体，蠕动；感到局促不安
items.def_en: To twist and wriggle the body from side to side because of discomfort, nervousness, or embarrassment.

items.def_zh: 扭动，蠕动；蠕动着穿过；巧妙避开，摆脱 (wriggle out of)
items.def_en: 1. To twist and turn the body with quick, small movements; 2. (wriggle out of) to cleverly avoid a duty or problem.

items.raw_cluster: 不安乱动与微动 Fidget & Squirm
items.def_zh: 坐立不安，烦躁地动来动去；摆弄，玩弄 (fidget with)
items.def_en: To make small, restless movements with the hands or feet, especially from nervousness, impatience, or boredom.

items.def_zh: 辗转折腾；剧烈抽动打滚
items.def_en: to move one's body wildly, violently, or convulsively from side to side

items.def_zh: （因剧痛或不适而）翻滚，扭动身躯；深感痛苦
items.def_en: To twist and turn the body violently, especially because of severe pain or discomfort.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict continuous serpentine, twisting, or restless bodily movements, distinguishing between nervous discomfort, snakelike locomotion, and agony-induced contortions.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因紧张、局促、滑动或剧痛而产生的身躯辗转扭动动作。

groups.name: Stab & Spear with Pointed Weapon · 刺扎与穿刺 (Stab, Spear, Transfix)
groups.tip: 用尖锐武器穿透与刺扎

items.def_en: (of an animal) To butt, stab, or pierce someone or something with a horn.
to force a sharp point into or through a surface
(+ sb) pierce someone through the body using a sword, spear, or blade
(+ sth into sth) push a pointed weapon forcibly into someone's body
To push a knife or other sharp, pointed object into someone or something.
To push a spear or other pointed object through something, or catch something with it.
to pierce or wound deeply with a horn or tusk
to pierce completely through a body with a sharp stake or point
to pierce through with a weapon so as to pin firmly in position

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting a direct, forceful thrusting attack with a pointed implement, weapon, or natural horn into an opponent's body, causing puncture wounds through penetration.
groups.summary_zh: 指用尖刺状武器或角刺入、戳穿肉体的攻击方式。

groups.name: Station & Billet · 安置与派驻 (Station, Billet, Quarter)
groups.tip: 安排入驻场所收治

items.def_en: To assign someone to a particular place or post; to position oneself or someone at a specific spot.

items.def_zh: 提供床铺（或宿处），收留就寝；固定于基座，把……栽入土中；与……发生性关系
items.def_en: 1. To provide someone with a bed or sleeping accommodation. 2. To place or fix firmly in a foundation or in the ground. 3. (informal) To have sexual intercourse with someone.

items.def_zh: 为……配备工作人员，在……任职
items.def_en: To provide an organization, facility, or event with workers or personnel; to serve as staff for.

items.def_zh: 为（驻军或人员）提供营房寄居
items.def_en: to provide housing or lodgings for military troops or attendants

items.def_zh: 安排外宿；分派到民居驻扎
items.def_en: (+ sb) assign military personnel to stay in private homes or scattered lodgings
(+ sb at sth) assign personnel or soldiers to a particular post or location

items.def_zh: 派兵驻守，防守（据点或要塞）
items.def_en: to assign a military garrison to defend a fortified place, town, or base
To admit or send someone to a hospital for medical treatment or observation.

items.def_zh: 安排宿营，向民居寄宿安排（军人）
items.def_en: to assign soldiers temporary civilian lodging or quarters, typically using 'on' or 'with'

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this institutional frame describe formally assigning, housing, accommodating, or deploying personnel (soldiers, healthcare patients, corporate staff) to specific physical quarters, duty posts, or custodial facilities. The nuances distinguish military post assignment (station, quarter, billet) from administrative staffing and institutional admissions (hospitalize).
groups.summary_zh: 指派、驻防或集中安置人员（军人、职员或病患）至指定营所与设施。

groups.name: Stealthy Skulking & Lurking · 潜伏与匿影潜行 (Skulk, Slink, Lurk)
groups.tip: 鬼鬼祟祟、无声无息地移动

items.def_zh: 溜走，潜行，鬼鬼祟祟地走；（动物）早产
items.def_en: 1. (+ away/off/around) To walk or move quietly and stealthily, especially out of fear, guilt, or shame. 2. (of livestock) To give birth to prematurely.
1. (+ up to/along/past) To walk or move slowly, shyly, or secretly, often sideways, trying not to attract attention.

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚潜行；鬼鬼祟祟走动
items.def_en: to move quietly and stealthily about, trying to avoid detection

items.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟潜伏；暗中窥视徘徊
items.def_en: to lurk or move covertly and suspiciously in an area

items.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟溜走；怯生生躲开
items.def_en: to leave a place quietly and stealthily, especially out of fear, guilt, or shame
to move about in a secretive, suspicious manner
to wait or move furtively in a hidden place, often with sinister intent

items.def_zh: 潜行，偷偷溜走，躲躲闪闪
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To move around or hide secretly in shadows, especially with sinister or cowardly intent.
[I/T] to move around stealthily and restlessly in search of prey or opportunity

groups.summary_en: An agent moves stealthily, sideways, or keeps out of sight, typically motivated by guilt, cowardice, fear, or sinister intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指因心虚、怯懦或心怀不轨而鬼鬼祟祟地潜行、躲闪或潜伏。

groups.name: Strand & Immobilize · 滞留与受困 (Maroon, Bog down, Strand)
groups.tip: 陷入泥沼难以拔出动弹

items.def_en: to cause a ship to run aground, or forbid aircraft/pilots from flying
(+ sb/sth) sink into mud and become unable to move, or become severely impeded
(+ sb/sth) sink deeply into wet or muddy ground so that progress stops
to leave someone in a helpless situation or place without transport, funds, or escape

items.def_zh: 使困于受阻处，使受困孤立；放逐（某人）到荒岛上
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive, 'be marooned') To leave someone trapped and isolated in an inaccessible or deserted place with no way to escape.

items.def_zh: 陷入泥沼，受阻停滞；使陷入泥沼，使停滞不前
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'bog down') To become stuck or cause something to become stuck in mud or wet ground; to become delayed and unable to make progress.

items.def_zh: 使陷于泥沼，使缠身受阻
items.def_en: to cause something to sink in deep mud, or entangle someone heavily in difficulties

items.def_zh: 陷入泥沼，受阻停滞（bog的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of bog; stuck in wet ground or stalled and unable to make progress ('bogged down').
to catch an entity or person in a confined space, snare, or inescapable circumstance

groups.summary_en: A traveler, vehicle, or project becomes physically trapped, stranded in a remote location, or hopelessly impeded by difficult terrain or adverse conditions. Verbs contrast physical sinking into soft mud/mire (bog, mire) with abandonment in desolate places (maroon, strand).
groups.summary_zh: 陷入泥沼难以脱身，或被遗弃偏远险境受困。

groups.name: Strategic Avoidance & Circumvention · 策略规避与避开 (Sidestep, Eschew, Circumvent)
groups.tip: 巧妙躲避正面锋芒

items.def_en: (+ from sth) to deliberately avoid doing or facing something through hesitation or nervousness

items.def_zh: 绕开（问题）；避重就轻地回避
items.def_en: (+ sth) to avoid dealing with or addressing an awkward issue or topic directly
to avoid discussing or dealing directly with a controversial topic or problem
to avoid dealing with a rule, process, or hierarchy by going around it

items.def_zh: 绕开；避开（某人或棘手问题）
items.def_en: (+ of sb/sth) to deliberately avoid or keep away from a person, hazard, or sensitive topic
to cleverly find a way around an obstacle, regulation, or difficulty
1. (formal) To deliberately avoid or abstain from something out of principle or caution.

items.def_zh: 横跨一步躲开；回避，巧妙避开（问题或责任）
items.def_en: 1. To step quickly to one side to avoid someone or something. 2. To cleverly evade or avoid dealing with a difficult question or problem.
to consistently and deliberately avoid a person, practice, or situation out of caution or distaste

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to deliberately shunning, bypassing, or avoiding an issue, duty, or practice through strategic calculation, policy, or principled restraint rather than rapid physical movement.
groups.summary_zh: 出于原则、策略或审慎考量，刻意回避、绕开某事或不良行为。

groups.name: Strategic Orchestration & Intricate Engineering · 策划运作与精密编排 (Choreograph, Contrive)
groups.tip: 运筹帷幄，预先构思蓝图

items.def_en: to skillfully and artfully bring about a complex or tricky event
(+ sth) to invent, concoct, or devise an elaborate plan, scheme, or story
(+ sth) to produce a creative idea, complex plan, or solution through thought

items.def_zh: 凭空构想出；策划出（奇想或复杂计划）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to invent or plan something that is very creative, unusual, or improbable

items.def_zh: 构想出；发明（精巧计划或装置）
items.def_en: to invent a plan, method, or system with careful thought and ingenuity
to plan and direct an elaborate undertaking, complex scheme, or conspiracy from behind the scenes

items.def_zh: 精心策划；密谋操纵（全局）
items.def_en: to arrange, plan, or coordinate the elements of an intricate situation to produce a desired effect

items.def_zh: 精心策划，细致安排；编排（舞蹈等动作）
items.def_en: 1. To plan and coordinate a complex event, situation, or operation carefully. 2. To design and arrange the steps and movements for a dance or performance.

items.def_zh: 谋划，巧妙策划；设法做到，巧计促成；发明，设计
items.def_en: 1. To cleverly plan, devise, or invent something. 2. To manage to do or bring about something despite difficulties.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe designing and pulling together complex schemes, maneuvers, or staged actions with elaborate precision, often to produce a calculated, prearranged outcome.
groups.summary_zh: 通过精巧策划与严密编排，推动复杂事件或预谋方案按预期执行。

groups.name: Strike & Hack with Bladed Weapon · 兵刃刺斩 (Bayonet, Tomahawk, Pike)
groups.tip: 冷兵器刺穿与劈砍伤

items.def_zh: （野猪、大象等）用长牙刺戳；用长牙掘
items.def_en: To stab, gore, or dig something with long tusks.
(+ sb/sth) cut or wound severely with violent blows from a bladed weapon
strike repeatedly and roughly with an axe, cleaver, or heavy blade
to strike or hack forcefully using a heavy butcher blade
to pierce or assault violently using a short stabbing blade
to thrust or pierce through with a long spear or pike
To stab or kill someone with a bayonet.
to strike, cut, or kill with a heavy curved cavalry sword

items.def_zh: 用（北美印第安）战斧砍杀
items.def_en: To strike, cut, or kill someone with a tomahawk.

groups.summary_en: Denominal combat verbs where the instrument itself defines the violent thrusting, gouging, or hacking attack inflicted on an enemy (e.g., using a fixed rifle-blade, thrown axe, or animal tusk).
groups.summary_zh: 指借由特定兵刃（刺刀、战斧）或獠牙施加的刺杀与劈击动作。

groups.name: Strip & Peel Surface · 剥壳与脱皮 (Decorticate, Hull, Pare)
groups.tip: 解调分离特定信号成分

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gradually remove the outer layer or skin of something using a sharp tool
(+ sth) to remove an outer skin, rind, or covering by pulling it away

items.def_zh: 给（谷物、果实）脱壳或去蒂
items.def_en: to remove the outer husk, pod, or calyx from grains, beans, or fruit
to remove the leafy husk of corn or open the shell of oysters and clams

items.def_zh: 剥去；剥下（外皮、壳或保护层）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove an outer layer, skin, bark, or covering from something
to strip or scrape the protective outer bark from a tree or log

items.def_zh: 剥去（树皮、外壳等）；剥除（器官或组织的）被膜（或皮质）
items.def_en: (botany, medicine) To remove the bark, husk, or outer cortex from a plant or body organ.
(telecommunications) To extract the original modulating information signal from a carrier wave.
to strip off the skin or hide of an animal or person completely and brutally

groups.summary_en: An agent strips, pares, or strips away the outer shell, bark, rind, or protective membrane from biological specimens, grains, or organs.
groups.summary_zh: 机械或人工剥除外皮、谷壳、树皮或组织外膜。

groups.name: Strip Husk & Detach Layer · 剥离与脱壳 (Husk, Shuck, Ablate)
groups.tip: 剥除果壳或外层表皮

items.def_en: to come off or cause to come off in small thin pieces or layers
to drop off or be scraped away in flakes or thin scales
to scrape off the tough outer plates or encrusted surface layer from something
To remove the dry outer covering from grains, nuts, or corn.

items.def_zh: 剥除；剥去（保护层或外壳）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to systematically peel off or remove an outer protective casing or covering
(+ off/away) to pull or peel off an outer covering, sheath, or layer by force

items.def_zh: 剥（玉米）苞叶；剥（牡蛎等）外壳；脱去（衣服）
items.def_en: To remove the outer shell or covering from oysters, corn, etc.; to take off clothes quickly.

items.def_zh: （使）烧蚀，（使）消融；（医学上）切除，消融
items.def_en: (specialist) To wear away or be worn away by heat, friction, or melting; to surgically remove body tissue.

items.def_zh: 脱落，剥落（层状外皮/角质）
items.def_en: [I/T] to cast off, shed, or peel away in thin layers, scales, or flakes

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on detaching a tough protective casing, shell, or outer surface layer, spanning agricultural manual extraction (corn, shellfish) to technical and medical layer erosion.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱除硬质外苞、甲壳外层，或技术/医学上剥离侵蚀表层。

groups.name: Stroll & Wander Aimlessly · 漫步与闲荡 (Unhurried Directionless Walking)
groups.tip: 无固定目的地闲逛

items.def_en: to spend time moving about in an unhurried, aimless way doing small casual tasks
to walk in a leisurely, relaxed manner
to walk around a place casually without any specific direction or purpose

items.def_zh: 闲逛，信步漫步；从容做琐事，消磨时间
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly BrE) To walk or move about slowly and aimlessly. 2. To spend time doing small, pleasant, or trivial tasks in a relaxed way.
to walk in a slow, relaxed, and leisurely manner

items.def_zh: 漫步，闲逛，游荡；走神，神游；迷失方向
items.def_en: 1. To walk or move around slowly and without a specific destination or purpose. 2. (of thoughts or attention) To lose focus or drift away.
to walk at a slow, gentle, and unhurried pace
to walk along with a confident, proud, or entirely unhurried air
to follow a winding and turning course without clear destination

groups.summary_en: An individual walks or moves about at an unhurried, leisurely pace without a fixed goal, often engaging in small, casual domestic or observational activities along the way.
groups.summary_zh: 步调从容无目的漫行，或在小范围内优哉游哉走走停停。

groups.name: Structural Analysis & Dissection · 剖析与解构 (Deconstruct, Dissect, Parse)
groups.tip: 层层解剖细部脉络

items.def_en: to analyze a multifaceted concept, quote, or phenomenon point by point to reveal underlying meanings

items.def_zh: 对（句子或代码）作语法分析，句法剖析；仔细推敲，深入剖析
items.def_en: To analyze a sentence or string of computer code into its grammatical parts; to examine or analyze something closely.

items.def_zh: 细分剖析；解构（结构或论点）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide a complex idea, argument, or structure into its component parts to analyze it

items.def_zh: 梳理出；剖析出（细节或深层含义）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to carefully extract, separate, or analyze complex details or meaning from a larger body of information
to examine or inspect closely and thoroughly with keen critical attention

items.def_zh: 解构，剖析，拆解（文本、理论或概念）
items.def_en: To analyze a text, artwork, or cultural theory carefully to reveal its underlying structure, contradictions, and hidden assumptions.

items.def_zh: 彻底剖析；严厉解构（论点或理论）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to rigorously dismantle and critically analyze the components or weaknesses of an argument or text
to examine and analyze minutely, laying bare each constituent part or systemic flaw

items.def_zh: 仔细剖析，深入分析；解剖（动植物尸体）
items.def_en: 1. To examine or analyze an argument, text, or failure in minute detail. 2. To cut open a dead body or plant to study its internal structure.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify rigorous, critical intellectual scrutiny wherein a complex argument, biological specimen, or linguistic string is decomposed into its fundamental structural components.
groups.summary_zh: 将复杂对象、文本或论点细致拆解为基底要素进行微观分析。

groups.name: Study & Learn · 学习与研习 (Educational Engagement & Knowledge Acquisition)
groups.tip: 探求新知并领悟掌握

items.def_zh: 学习，攻读；研读，审视，研究
items.def_en: 1. To spend time learning about a subject by reading, attending classes, etc. 2. To examine or consider something carefully.

items.def_zh: 学习，学到；得知，获悉；记住
items.def_en: 1. To gain knowledge of or skill in something through study, practice, or teaching. 2. To become aware of something by hearing, reading, or being told.
to examine, read, or study a text or document with close and sustained attention
(chiefly BrE) to study hard, especially by reading books when preparing for tests
(+ on sth) to study a subject intensively in order to learn quickly about it
(+ on sth) to study a subject quickly and intensely, especially immediately before an examination
(+ on sth) to study hard and thoroughly, usually for an upcoming test

items.def_zh: 突击死记硬背，临时抱佛脚
items.def_en: to prepare for an examination by studying intensively over a very short period
(+ into) to research or study a subject deeply and systematically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate deliberate intellectual engagement with academic materials or instruction to acquire facts, principles, and competencies across various learning settings.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过阅读、听课、探究或突击备考等方式吸收文化与专业知识。

groups.name: Subdue & Overpower · 压制与强行制服 (Restrain, Subdue, Overpower, Vanquish)
groups.tip: 以压倒性力量使其服从顺从

items.def_en: to use moderate physical or verbal force to prevent someone from moving, acting, or escalating
(+ down/against) to hold someone firmly against a surface so they cannot move
(+ sb) to prevent someone from moving or rising by keeping physical weight or force on them

items.def_zh: 按住；压制（使其无法动弹）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to physically press someone down against a surface so they cannot move
(+ sb) to overcome someone in a physical struggle and force them to the ground

items.def_zh: 制服，征服，压制；抑制，克制（感情）；减弱，降低（光线、声音等）
items.def_en: 1. To bring a person, crowd, or rebellion under control by force; defeat. 2. To suppress or control strong feelings. 3. To make something less intense or bright.

items.def_zh: 制服，击败，压倒；（情绪、气味等）使难以忍受，使不知所措
items.def_en: 1. To defeat or subdue someone by using superior physical strength, numbers, or force. 2. (of an emotion, smell, or heat) To have such a strong effect on someone that they cannot resist or think clearly.
to stop disorder, rebellion, or violent opposition decisively using forceful intervention
to defeat an opponent, enemy, or opposing force completely in a battle or competition

groups.summary_en: An agent exerts escalating physical force, authority, or superior prowess to overcome resistance and bring an opponent or rebellious group under control.
groups.summary_zh: 施加不断增强的力量以压制反抗并彻底制服对手。

groups.name: Subdued & Scornful Laughter · 窃笑与轻蔑嗤笑 (Snicker, Titter, Chortle)
groups.tip: 包含偷笑咯咯笑到嗤之以鼻的笑态

items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To laugh quietly in a nervous, foolish, or restrained manner.
to laugh quietly or inwardly to oneself for a prolonged period

items.def_zh: 一笑置之；用讥笑或不屑的态度对待
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dismiss or minimize an awkward situation or criticism by laughing dismissively
To laugh repeatedly in a light, silly, high-pitched, or nervous way
To laugh quietly or inwardly with suppressed satisfaction
To smile in an affected, smug, or offensively knowing way
1. (+ at) (chiefly North American) To laugh quietly and disrespectfully or slyly, especially at someone's misfortune.

items.def_zh: 咯咯地笑，欢笑，洋洋得意地笑
items.def_en: 1. (+ at/with) To laugh quietly and merrily with amusement or satisfaction.
(+ at) To laugh in a half-suppressed, disrespectful or unkind manner

groups.summary_en: This frame captures vocal expressions of amusement that are restrained, suppressed, self-satisfied, or mocking rather than open and hearty. Verbs vary by acoustic pitch, degree of malice or gloating, and social appropriateness.
groups.summary_zh: 指压抑、窃密或带有自鸣得意、嘲讽意味的笑。

groups.name: Subvert & Overthrow Regime · 颠覆与推翻政权 (Subvert, Overthrow, Topple)
groups.tip: 自下而上摧毁政权或系统

items.def_en: to weaken or ruin the foundation or authority of a system gradually or insidiously
to remove someone from a political position of authority or elected office
[I/T] to cause a leader or regime to lose power and fall

items.def_zh: 排挤出局；强行逐出权力中心
items.def_en: (+ sb) to force someone out of a position of authority or governmental power
(+ sb) to forcibly remove someone from political office or authority

items.def_zh: 推翻，打倒（政权或统治者）
items.def_en: to remove a leader, government, or institution from power, especially by using force

items.def_zh: 驱逐，强行推翻剥夺职位
items.def_en: to force someone out of a position of power, often decisively

items.def_zh: 颠覆，破坏，推翻（政权、体制或原则）
items.def_en: to undermine, destroy, or overthrow an established government, system, or belief

items.def_zh: 推翻；使（政府或领导人）垮台
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to cause a government, regime, or ruler to lose power or collapse

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the dismantling or forced removal of an established regime, government, or authority. They scale from covert, insidious undermining up to violent and absolute collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 指动摇、瓦解或以武力击垮既定政权与体制，由隐秘侵蚀递进至强制推翻。

groups.name: Summarize & Recap · 概括与重述 (Summarize, Recap, Recapitulate)
groups.tip: 扼要提炼并回顾核心要点

items.def_en: to give a description of the main facts, points, or structure of something without details
to state the main points of an argument, situation, or discussion succinctly
to make a condensed summary or synopsis of a book, play, or argument
(+ sth) to conclude or summarize the main points of a discussion, presentation, or text
(+ sth) to gather together and present a summary of facts, news, or arguments
(+ sth) to quickly repeat, read, or summarize the primary contents of something
to give a brief statement of the main points of something

items.def_zh: 概括，扼要重述；翻新（轮胎面）
items.def_en: 1. To briefly summarize or repeat the main points of something. 2. To put a new rubber tread on a worn tire.
To summarize and repeat the main points of a speech, argument, or text.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote stating the principal facts, points, or arguments of a preceding discussion or text in an abbreviated form, ranging from casual conversational summaries to formal scholarly synopses.
groups.summary_zh: 指将前述讨论、言论或文本的核心要点进行简明概括与重述。

groups.name: Supply & Replenish · 供给与补给 (Supply, Replenish, Provision)
groups.tip: 源源不断供应物资服务

items.def_en: supply a ship, army, or expedition with necessary food and equipment
add liquid or balance to something in order to make it completely full
to make or become completely full, especially of fuel, liquid, or commodities
(+ on sth) to accumulate a substantial supply of provisions or goods
(+ sb/sth) to provide someone or something with all the necessary supplies or equipment

items.def_zh: 不断提供，连续供给（食物、酒等）；不断向……发问；从事（行业）；定期往返于
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To keep offering or supplying someone with large amounts of food, drink, or questions. 2. To work steadily at a trade or profession. 3. To travel regularly along a route.
fill something up again after it has been used or depleted

items.def_zh: 给……补充燃料，加油；加燃料
items.def_en: To put fresh fuel into an aircraft, vehicle, or ship; to take on fresh supplies of fuel.

items.def_zh: 重新进货，补足，重新装满
items.def_en: (+ with) To fill a store, warehouse, or supply again with fresh goods.

groups.summary_en: An agent provides essential commodities, consumables, or fuels to keep a recipient, vessel, or store functional and well-stocked.
groups.summary_zh: 向特定对象、储藏地或工具补充供给物资、燃料与日常必需品。

groups.name: Support & Render Aid · 援助与扶助 (Aid, Assist, Succor)
groups.tip: 施以援手提供助益

items.def_en: [I/T] to make it easier or possible for someone to do something by offering services or resources
1. To help someone to do something or provide aid; to facilitate.
1. To provide help, support, or resources to someone; to facilitate.
(formal) to give immediate help or relief to someone who is suffering or in distress
(+ sb) to assist someone, especially by giving practical aid in a difficult situation
(+ sb) to unite together to help or support someone in a time of crisis or distress
to join in enthusiastically to offer help or practical assistance
to take over duties from someone, or to provide humanitarian assistance to people in distress

items.def_zh: 有助于，有益于；对……有帮助
items.def_en: 1. To be of use, help, or advantage to someone (especially in 'avail oneself of': to make use of).

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving practical, medical, financial, or direct relief to help someone achieve a goal, overcome distress, or meet an immediate need.
groups.summary_zh: 指为受困者或需要者提供切实的行动协助、物资资助或解困援助。

groups.name: Surge & Flow Forcefully · 涌流与奔涌 (Well, Course, Gush)
groups.tip: 液体或气流急速涌动

items.def_en: (of a liquid or emotion) To rise to the surface and flow out or prepare to overflow.
to flow rapidly and abundantly out of a container, channel, or wound

items.def_zh: 涌出；喷涌而起（液体或情绪）
items.def_en: to rise to the surface and start to flow outward copiously

items.def_zh: （液体）奔流，急速流动；（情绪）涌动；用猎犬追猎
items.def_en: 1. (of liquid, blood, or feelings) To move or flow quickly through or over something. 2. To hunt game with dogs using sight rather than scent.

items.def_zh: 流淌、汩汩涌流（如眼泪、鲜血）
items.def_en: (+ down/from) to flow quickly and continuously in a steady direction
to gush or shoot out forcefully in a sudden stream
(+ through/forward) to move forward suddenly and powerfully like a great wave
(+ out/from) to pour out suddenly and with great force in large quantities
[I/T] to shoot out in a sudden, sharp, forceful jet or burst

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner-of-motion frame depict liquids, blood, tears, or strong emotions rising up and traveling rapidly and copiously along a channel or from an outlet. Nuances range from rising smoothly ('well') to rushing freely ('course') and erupting under pressure ('gush').
groups.summary_zh: 描摹液体、血液或内心情感自深处涌起并在通道中奔流的动态。

groups.name: Surgical Cutting & Boring · 手术剖切与钻刺 (Vivisect, Trepan, Resect)
groups.tip: 活体解剖进行医学探查

items.def_zh: 切除；切下（病变组织或器官）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to surgically remove a part of the body, tumor, or diseased tissue by cutting
(+ sth) to excise or remove surrounding flesh or damaged tissue surgically
(+ sth) to puncture and cut open a boil, abscess, or swelling with a surgical instrument
to prick or cut open a boil, abscess, or blister with a lancet to drain fluid
to surgically cut out an organ, growth, or piece of tissue from the body
to surgically cut off a limb or digit by medical procedure

items.def_zh: 截除，部分切除（器官或结构）
items.def_en: to cut out or remove part of an organ or anatomical structure surgically

items.def_zh: 对（头骨）施环锯手术；诱骗，诈骗
items.def_en: 1. (surgery / historical) To cut or bore a circular hole into a person's skull using a cylindrical saw (trepan). 2. (archaic) To entrap, ensnare, or deceive someone.
(science / medicine) To perform surgical operations or experiments on a living animal for scientific inquiry.

groups.summary_en: Refers to specialized, highly invasive medical or experimental procedures where a practitioner cuts, bores into, or excises living bodily tissue or skull bone. These terms belong to clinical, surgical, or anatomical registers rather than general wounding.
groups.summary_zh: 指对活体组织或骨骼进行钻孔、解剖或切除的专门外科及实验手术。

groups.name: Surpass & Outdo in Specific Metric · 按特定维度超越 (Outpace, Outstrip, Outnumber)
groups.tip: 在数量、速度或权重上胜过他人

items.def_en: to overtake competitors and gain an advantage in a race, measure, or competition

items.def_zh: 拉大领先优势；甩开对手
items.def_en: to increase the distance or margin by which one is ahead of rivals

items.def_zh: 重于，大于（在价值或重要性上超过）
items.def_en: to be greater or more significant than something in weight, value, or importance

items.def_zh: 数量多于，在数量上超过
items.def_en: to be greater in number than someone or something
to perform significantly better or more efficiently than someone or something else

items.def_zh: 超过……的速度，比……跑得更快；发展快于
items.def_en: to move, grow, or develop faster than someone or something else

items.def_zh: 超过，胜过；跑过，甩在后面
items.def_en: to become faster, larger, or better than someone or something else; surpass

items.def_zh: 使相形见绌，表现远胜于
items.def_en: to be much better, more impressive, or more successful than someone else
to surpass someone or something so completely that they become unimportant

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exceeding a competitor or standard along a measurable, quantifiable dimension such as speed, growth rate, physical quantity, or performance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在速度、增长率、数量或性能等特定量化维度上超越或胜过对手。

groups.name: Surrender & Cave In · 认输与低头屈服 (Yield, Submit, Capitulate)
groups.tip: 从被迫退让到完全俯首听命

items.def_en: to cease fighting or arguing and accept defeat or an opponent's terms
(+ to) to give way to arguments, demands, or pressure
Withdraw a claim, demand, or fighting stance in the face of opposition
Yield or concede under persuasion, pressure, or stronger force

items.def_zh: 屈服，顺从，投降；提交，呈递；主张，建议
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To accept or yield to a superior force, authority, or will of another person. 2. To present a document, proposal, or plan for consideration or judgment. 3. (formal) To suggest or state an opinion formally.

items.def_zh: 屈服，认输（常作 knuckle under）；开始认真努力（常作 knuckle down）；用指节按压
items.def_en: 1. ('knuckle under') To yield, submit, or surrender to pressure or authority. 2. ('knuckle down') To begin working hard and seriously. 3. To press, rub, or strike with the knuckles.
(+ to) to suddenly collapse mentally and surrender completely under pressure
Submit to authority or pressure, acknowledging defeat
(+ to) to cease resisting an opponent or demand under negotiated or forced terms

groups.summary_en: Pressured or overwhelmed agents cease resisting, formally or helplessly giving in to the authority, demands, or superior power of an adversary.
groups.summary_zh: 指在强大压力、权威或武力下停止抵抗而低头顺从。

groups.name: Surreptitious Looking · 窥视与窥探 (Peek, Peep, Snoop)
groups.tip: 自缝隙暗中偷偷探看

items.def_en: Look quickly or slyly into an enclosed space or opening
(+ at/through/into) To look narrowly or curiously, often through an opening or with strained vision
1. (+ at/into/through) To look quickly and secretly, often through a narrow opening or when you should not. 2. To stick out slightly so as to be just visible.

items.def_zh: 窥看，偷看；隐约显现；（雏鸟等）唧唧叫
items.def_en: 1. (+ at/into/through) To look quickly and secretly at something, especially through a small hole or opening. 2. To appear slightly or briefly. 3. To make a weak high-pitched sound.
(+ sth) Inquire too closely or inquisitively into someone else's private affairs
Look around secretly in an attempt to uncover confidential or private information
1. (+ around/into) (informal, disapproving) To look around secretly in a private place or through someone's belongings to find out private information.
(+ on/upon) To observe secretively and persistently to gather covert information
(+ into) To inquire or look into someone's private affairs with excessive curiosity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe looking furtively, briefly, or inquisitively through an opening, around an obstacle, or into private matters without authorization. They range from quick, secretive glances to intrusive prying into others' personal affairs.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过缝隙、遮蔽物暗中窥看，或刺探他人隐秘隐私。

groups.name: Swell & Blister · 肿胀与起泡 (Blister, Bulge, Puff up)
groups.tip: 皮肤受烫起泡或局部隆起

items.def_en: [I/T] to become swollen, enlarged, or distended, typically around eyes or joints
Swell or bulge outwards rapidly in a rounded shape
Become abnormally swollen or distended in size
Become larger, rounder, or distended due to fluid accumulation, infection, or injury
[I/T] to enlarge abnormally in volume or size due to inflammation or fluid retention

items.def_zh: （使）起水疱，（使）起气泡；严厉抨击
items.def_en: 1. To develop blisters, or cause blisters or bubbles to form on skin, paint, or a surface. 2. To criticize someone severely.

items.def_zh: 膨胀，鼓起，凸出；装满，塞满
items.def_en: (+ with/out) To stick out in a round shape, or to swell noticeably because of fullness or pressure.
[I/T] to swell or make swollen with fluid or gas, producing an uncomfortable distension
[I/T] (medical/formal) to blister or cause the formation of cutaneous vesicles

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail anatomical or surface swelling, where skin or organic tissue distends, blisters with fluid, or bulges outwards under internal pressure or pathology. Nuances contrast fluid-filled blistering with mechanical protruding.
groups.summary_zh: 肉体表面或皮肉因充水、积气或充血而隆起、鼓出或起水泡。

groups.name: Swell & Expand · 膨胀与隆起 (Inflate, Bloat, Swollen)
groups.tip: 充气扩充使整体体积明显变大

items.def_zh: （使）隆起成脊，成垄状；在……上作垄
items.def_en: To form into raised ridges or mark with narrow raised bands; to rise in ridges.

items.def_zh: 像气球般鼓起；膨胀隆起
items.def_en: to swell or bulge outwards like a balloon filled with air
(+ sth) to fill with air or gas so as to expand or swell
[I/T] To swell or expand with air, fluid, or pride
[I/T] To become larger, rounder, or more bulging than normal

items.def_zh: （使）充气，（使）膨胀；抬高（物价等）；使自负
items.def_en: 1. To fill with gas or air, causing to swell or expand, or to expand in this way. 2. To increase the price or size of something artificially.
[I/T] To swell outwards under internal pressure
To swell or puff up with fluid, gas, or food, or cause to do so.

items.def_zh: 膨胀；扩张（尤指腹部、血管）
items.def_en: [I/T] To enlarge, swell, or stretch out from internal pressure

groups.summary_en: Surfaces, containers, or biological tissues distend, inflate with gas or fluid, or rise into visible ridges and protrusions.
groups.summary_zh: 腔体或表面因充气、充液或应力而外凸鼓胀、隆起。

groups.name: Swim & Float · 游泳与浮游 (Self-Propelled Aquatic Motion)
groups.tip: 划水漂游自如前行

items.def_en: Remain suspended and drift gently on or near the surface of water
to stay resting on the surface of a liquid without sinking
Swim or move casually through water using short, paddling strokes
(+ sth) Cross a body of water by swimming

items.def_zh: 游泳；游动，漂浮；（头脑）眩晕，旋转
items.def_en: 1. To move through water by moving limbs, fins, or tail. 2. To feel dizzy or seem to be spinning.
to move the feet or hands gently in shallow water
to swim with quick, shallow strokes like a dog
to keep the head above water while remaining upright by pumping the legs
to swim by extending arms forward and sweeping them back while froglike-kicking

groups.summary_en: An animate agent or buoyant body propels itself through or rests suspended on a liquid medium. While 'swim' denotes active, coordinated limb movement through water, verbs like 'tread' and 'dog-paddle' represent specialized physical maneuvers to stay afloat.
groups.summary_zh: 人在水中通过自身肢体协调发力进行游动或保持浮起的姿态动作。

groups.name: Switch & Toggle · 切换与调换 (Toggle, Transpose, Invert)
groups.tip: 在不同状态间快速切换

items.def_en: (+ between/with) to repeatedly shift back and forth from one state, role, or action to another
(+ sth) Exchange the mutual positions or orders of two or more items
Change from one system, mode, or method to another
(+ sth) Invert or reverse the places or relative positions of things
(+ with/for) to give something and receive something else in exchange, swapping relative places

items.def_zh: 切换（在两种状态或选项间转换）；用拴扣扣紧
items.def_en: 1. (computing) To switch between two different options, states, or settings. 2. To fasten with a toggle.
(+ into/for) to substitute one obligation, penalty, or formal arrangement for another
to turn upside down or reverse the regular order, position, or relationship of items

items.def_zh: 调换……的顺序（或位置）；（音乐）移调；（数学）移项
items.def_en: 1. To change the relative order or position of two or more things. 2. (music) To play or write music in a different key.

groups.summary_en: An agent switches an operating state between two alternative settings, or exchanges the mutual order, positions, or polarities of two elements.
groups.summary_zh: 在两种状态间来回切换，或置换两者的顺序与位置。

groups.name: Systematize & Categorize · 整理与归类 (Methodical Structuring and Permutation)
groups.tip: 按逻辑秩序梳理并排列系统化

items.def_en: (+ sth) Divide complex data or items into structured subcategories
(+ sth) Organize, separate, or classify items into systematic groups
(+ as/into) to assign items to specific groups in a formal taxonomy
(+ as/into) to place items systematically into designated classes based on shared features
(+ sb/sth) Assign someone or something to a rigid, predetermined category
to reduce complex data into a schematic outline, framework, or diagram

items.def_zh: 使系统化，使条理化，有系统地整理
items.def_en: 1. To organize ideas, rules, or information according to a clear, logical system.
1. (mathematics / formal) To arrange a set of items, letters, or numbers into different orders.
to arrange rules, laws, or structural principles into a formal, systematic code

groups.summary_en: A thinker or analyst arranges complex information, items, or concepts into coherent categorical hierarchies, formal systems, or calculated sequence combinations.
groups.summary_zh: 按理性逻辑、分类框架或数学排列梳理复杂要素。

groups.name: Take a Short Light Sleep · 打盹与小憩 (Doze, Snooze, Nap)
groups.tip: 白天闭目养神或短时间浅睡

items.def_en: to sleep lightly or briefly, especially during the daytime
to have a very short, light sleep of a few minutes
(informal) To sleep lightly for a short period of time, especially during the day.
(+ off) To sleep lightly or fitfully, especially unintentionally for a short time during the day.
Fall into a light, unintentional sleep for a brief period
Gradually and gently fall into a light sleep
Slip into light sleep, often suddenly or unintentionally
to fall asleep unintentionally, often with the head dropping forward
to be half asleep, languid, or in a lethargic, sleepy state

groups.summary_en: Describes entering a brief, light, and easily interrupted period of sleep, typically outside of one's regular nightly bed routine. Verbs vary from intentional daytime rest ('nap', 'snooze') to accidental, intermittent drifting into unconsciousness ('doze', 'nod off').
groups.summary_zh: 指在非正式就寝时间短暂、轻微地入睡或打瞌睡。

groups.name: Tap & Strike · 敲击与打击 (Percussive Surface Impact)
groups.tip: 轻微敲打发出清脆声响

items.def_en: (+ sth) Strike a surface lightly and rhythmically with fingers or a small tool
(+ on/at) to strike a door or hard surface repeatedly with the knuckles or an object
1. To hit someone or something quickly and lightly, often making a small noise.
(+ on/at) to strike a hard surface sharply and rapidly, producing a crisp knocking sound
(+ sth) Strike a surface repeatedly and forcefully, making a loud noise
(+ sth) Strike a door or surface repeatedly with heavy, forceful blows
(+ on/against) to hit heavily and repeatedly with heavy blows

items.def_zh: 猛击，重击；砰砰作响，发出巨响
items.def_en: 1. To hit something hard, making a loud noise. 2. To make a sudden loud noise.
to hit something hard with a blunt instrument or fist, producing a heavy dull sound

groups.summary_en: An agent strikes an object or surface with an implement or body part, spanning from light, rhythmic finger contact to loud, reverberating collisions. Verbs are differentiated by the force exerted and the auditory resonance produced.
groups.summary_zh: 从轻点轻叩到发出响亮撞击声的表面敲击动作。

groups.name: Teach & Instruct · 教授与训导 (Transmit Knowledge, Skills, or Directives)
groups.tip: 传授知识与指导技能规矩

items.def_zh: 执教，训练（专项技能或应试）
items.def_en: [I/T] to train or give specialized preparation to someone for a sport, performance, or exam

items.def_zh: 教，教导，教授；使懂得，使明白
items.def_en: 1. To give knowledge, skills, or instruction to someone, or show how to do something.

items.def_zh: 教，教导，教授（teach的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of teach; imparted knowledge or skill to someone.
(+ sth) Transmit knowledge, techniques, or traditions to a student or learner
(+ sb) Guide and teach someone systematically through a process or lesson step by step
(+ sth) Impart or instill knowledge or discipline into someone through constant repetition

items.def_zh: 指导，讲授（系统技能或规程）
items.def_en: to teach someone a practical skill or academic subject in a structured, formal way

items.def_zh: 个别辅导，当……的私人家教
items.def_en: [I/T] to give private instruction to a single student or small group

items.def_zh: 灌输（教条、特定思想意识）
items.def_en: to force someone to accept a set of political or religious beliefs uncritically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this educational communication frame denote conveying expertise, formal doctrine, practical techniques, or behavioral guidelines from teacher to learner. They range from natural pedagogical guidance ('teach') to regimented systematic coaching or ideological inculcation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过课堂传授、技术指导或思想灌输，使受众掌握技能与知识。

groups.name: Tease & Mock · 戏谑与嘲弄 (Tease, Rib, Mock)
groups.tip: 用滑稽言行开玩笑或戏谑调侃

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Tease or playfully ridicule someone in an amused manner

items.def_zh: 扮小丑，耍活宝，滑稽逗乐
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To behave in a silly, funny, or playful way to make people laugh.

items.def_zh: 逗弄，戏谑，取笑；给……装上肋状物
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To tease or make fun of someone in a good-natured way. 2. To strengthen or provide something with ribs.
to tease someone in a light-hearted, good-natured way
(+ sb/sth) Subject someone to mockery, laughter, or derisive jokes
(+ sb) Tease, mock, or harshly banter at someone's expense

items.def_zh: 讽刺，讥讽，借讽刺作品批评
items.def_en: To criticize or mock someone or something using satire, irony, or humor.
to provoke or challenge someone with cruel, insulting, or mocking remarks
(formal) to express contempt for or mock as foolish and completely worthless

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve communicating in a playful, ironic, or derisive manner to poke fun at, ridicule, or provoke someone. They vary from affectionate ribbing ('rib', 'tease') to dramatic buffoonery ('clown') and sharper cultural or personal ridicule ('mock', 'satirize').
groups.summary_zh: 指通过言语或戏谑举止开玩笑、揶揄或讽刺挖苦他人。

groups.name: Tease & Rib · 戏谑与调侃捉弄 (Lighthearted Jesting and Banter)
groups.tip: 带玩笑或挑衅性质的言语逗弄

items.def_en: [I/T] to deceive someone playfully as a joke
(+ sb/sth) to tease or ridicule someone or something in a playful or unkind way
(+ sb/sth) to tease or mock someone or something in a lighthearted or gentle way

items.def_zh: 故意调侃；故意惹怒/逗弄
items.def_en: (+ sb) to deliberately tease or play a prank on someone to provoke a reaction
(informal, chiefly British) To tease, fool, or play a joke on someone.
to joke with or tease someone in a friendly and good-natured way
1. (informal) To tease, taunt, or mock someone in a teasing or aggressive way. 2. To scold or criticize someone harshly.
[I/T] to laugh at someone and make jokes about them, either playfully or unkindly
to tease someone in a good-humored, bantering way

groups.summary_en: This frame covers playful, informal vocal teasing, banter, or mild torment directed at an individual without severe malice. British and colloquial verbs like 'rag', 'cod', 'rib', and 'chaff' capture affectionate raillery and light mocking.
groups.summary_zh: 指朋友或熟人之间善意的戏弄、取笑或玩笑式调侃。

groups.name: Test & Substantiate Validity · 检验与证实 (Test, Verify, Prove)
groups.tip: 用实据验证真实性

items.def_en: to examine something carefully to discover its quality, reliability, or truth

items.def_zh: 证明，证实；展现；事实证明是，结果是
items.def_en: 1. To show that something is true by providing facts or evidence. 2. to turn out to be in the end.

items.def_zh: 检验，试验；校对（文本）；对……进行防护处理
items.def_en: 1. To test or check something to verify its accuracy or quality; to read and correct printer's proofs. 2. To treat something to make it resistant to damage.
(+ on/with) To conduct scientific tests or try out new ideas to discover or verify something.

items.def_zh: 核实，查证（真伪或准确性）
items.def_en: to check and prove that something is true, accurate, or genuine
(+ sth) to test something experimentally to see how well it works or whether it is valid
(+ sth) to support or confirm the truth or accuracy of a claim, prediction, or theory
(+ sth) to investigate or examine something to confirm its truth, or to prove to be true and correct

items.def_zh: 用事实证实，确证（指控或观点）
items.def_en: to provide concrete evidence that proves something is true or valid

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe determining the truth, quality, or operational competence of a hypothesis, claim, or product through rigorous empirical testing or logical demonstration.
groups.summary_zh: 通过实证检验、试验或严密论据来确证真实性或有效性。

groups.name: Thread & String · 穿引与串联 (Thread, String, Bead)
groups.tip: 用线绳将细小物件串接成行

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten or tighten shoes or garments by drawing laces through eyelets
(+ sth) to join several items together sequentially on a string or cord
(+ sth) to pass a thread, cord, or flexible strip through a narrow hole or series of openings
to pass a thread, ribbon, or wire through the eye of a needle or narrow aperture
to string beads onto a cord or decorate by threading beads
to pass a thread or line through an aperture again

items.def_zh: （string 的过去式和过去分词）用线穿起；悬挂；给（乐器）装弦
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of string: to thread objects onto a string; to hang in a line; to fit strings onto an instrument.

items.def_zh: 用线串起；用线系，悬挂；给（乐器）上弦
items.def_en: 1. To thread a series of objects onto a cord, thread, or wire. 2. To hang or stretch something across or around an area in a line. 3. To put strings on a musical instrument or sports racket.
to draw a cord or lace through eyelets or openings to fasten something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to passing a fine filament, cord, or flexible medium through an opening or aperture, or sequentially arranging small perforated objects onto a line.
groups.summary_zh: 指将细线穿过孔眼，或把多件打孔物品顺次串在绳线上的动作。

groups.name: Threaten & Intimidate · 威胁与恫吓 (Intimidation / Coercive Menace)
groups.tip: 言语叫嚣到武力威慑恐吓

items.def_en: (+ sb) to bully, intimidate, or tell someone what to do in an aggressive and unfair manner
(+ sb/sth) to make someone or something go away by frightening or intimidating them
(+ sb) to defeat or intimidate someone by looking directly and forcefully into their eyes until they look away
to act in a threatening or dangerously hostile manner toward sb/sth

items.def_zh: 放空话威吓，叫嚣，咆哮；（风）呼啸，狂吹
items.def_en: 1. To speak aggressively or threateningly, often with little effect or without backing it up. 2. (of wind) To blow violently and noisily.

items.def_zh: 威胁，恐吓；危及；预示（凶兆或坏事）
items.def_en: 1. To state your intention to harm or punish someone. 2. To be likely to cause damage or harm to something.
to deliberately frighten sb into doing or not doing sth through overt pressure or threats
to frighten or bully sb into submission using angry words or a severe manner

items.def_zh: 暴力威胁，使处于恐惧中
items.def_en: to severely frighten and dominate sb through persistent threats, violence, or brutality

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote communicating an intent to inflict harm, punishment, or negative consequences, scaling from noisy bluster and verbal warnings up to overt terrorization and menacing coercion.
groups.summary_zh: 表达施加伤害或惩罚的企图，从虚张声势递进到公开威逼与恐吓。

groups.name: Thwart & Frustrate Progress · 挫败与阻挠 (Hamper, Thwart, Impede)
groups.tip: 设障阻挠行动或进程推进

items.def_en: to prevent a plan, effort, or desire from progressing or being fulfilled
to completely prevent something from happening or someone from achieving a goal
(+ sb/sth) to block someone's path, progress, or access to resources
(+ sb/sth) to prevent or hinder someone from doing something or impede an outcome
(+ sb/sth) to completely stop or thwart an ongoing activity, attack, or opposing initiative
to prevent someone from succeeding in an illicit, hostile, or intended action
To prevent someone or something from moving, working, or progressing easily.
To prevent someone from accomplishing a plan, ambition, or effort; to frustrate.
(formal) To delay, slow down, or prevent the progress or movement of someone or something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs indicating the successful interruption, obstruction, or derailment of an agent's plans, objectives, or strategic momentum through direct countermeasures or unfavorable constraints.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过外部干预、阻力或挫败手段使某人的计划或推进无法得逞。

groups.name: Till & Plow the Soil · 翻土与耕作
groups.tip: 翻耕土壤准备播种

items.def_en: prepare and cultivate land for crops by plowing or breaking up the soil
(+ sth) to break up and turn over soil thoroughly using a plow
(+ sth) to dig and invert soil in preparation for planting
break up and loosen soil around growing crops with an implement

items.def_zh: 耕（地），用犁翻地；费力穿过，艰难推进
items.def_en: 1. (US) To dig and turn over soil with a plow before planting seeds. 2. (plow through/into) To force a way forward through something with difficulty.
To dig, loosen soil, or weed ground using a hoe.

items.def_zh: 耕（地），犁田；费力穿过，艰难推进（plow 的英式拼写）
items.def_en: 1. (British English) To dig and turn over soil with a plough before sowing seeds. 2. (plough through/into) To force a way forward through something with difficulty.
draw a harrow over tilled land to break clods and pulverize the surface soil
make long narrow trenches in the earth with or as if with a plow

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physical and mechanical act of breaking, turning, loosening, or cutting through soil using agricultural tools (hoes, plows, tillers) to prepare land for seeding.
groups.summary_zh: 使用犁、锄等农具翻动、松动或切碎土壤以备播种的机械性耕作动作。

groups.name: Topple & Keel · 倾覆与倒地 (Keel, Topple, Tumble)
groups.tip: 失去支撑轰然倒塌或跌倒

items.def_en: to lose balance and drop to the ground from an upright position
to fall over suddenly or collapse, typically from illness, faintness, or exhaustion
(+ sth) to overturn or cause something to tilt and fall on its side
(+ sth) to become unsteady and collapse or fall over from a height or upright position
[I/T] to turn upside down or fall on one side

items.def_zh: （尤指因病痛或疲惫而）突然倒下，昏厥（常与 over 连用）；（船）倾覆
items.def_en: (usually keel over) To fall down suddenly, especially from illness, exhaustion, or shock; (of a boat) to capsize or turn upside down.

items.def_zh: （使）失去平衡倒下，倒塌；推翻，颠覆（政权或领导人）
items.def_en: 1. To become unsteady and fall down, or make something do this. 2. To remove a leader or government from power.
[I/T] to overturn or cause a boat to overturn completely in the water
to suddenly fall down or cave in as a result of structural failure or loss of strength

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physical dynamics frame depict losing balance or structural integrity and falling over, collapsing sideways, or being overturned, ranging from sudden fainting to catastrophic structural collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 失去重心或结构支撑发生倾斜、倒塌、翻倒或昏厥摔倒。

groups.name: Touch & Manipulate Manually · 触碰与手操摆弄 (Handle, Finger, Palpate)
groups.tip: 用手或工具进行摆弄掌控

items.def_en: [I/T] to touch something with your fingers in order to examine or experience its texture
[I/T] to put your hand or finger on something or someone

items.def_zh: 用手拿，触摸；操作，操纵；处理，应付
items.def_en: 1. To touch, hold, or move something with your hands. 2. To operate, control, or use a tool or machine. 3. To deal with, manage, or take charge of a situation, person, or task.

items.def_zh: 用手指触摸，拨弄；（向警方）告发，指认
items.def_en: 1. To touch, handle, or feel something with your fingers. 2. (informal) To identify or accuse someone, especially as a criminal.
(+ sth) to examine or test the surface, shape, or texture of something by touching it
(+ sth) to touch, handle, or fiddle with an object continuously with one's fingers
(+ sth) to move or fiddle with an object idly or absentmindedly in one's hands
(+ with) to touch, manipulate, or play with something restlessly with the hands
to examine a part of the body by pressing lightly with the fingers, usually in a medical context

groups.summary_en: An agent uses their hands, palms, or fingertips to touch, hold, examine, or physically manage an object. Verbs distinguish between general carrying/managing ('handle'), running fingertips over something casually or nervously ('finger'), and turning something over in the hands ('manipulate').
groups.summary_zh: 用手或手指触摸、摆弄、拿取或检验物体。

groups.name: Trace Back & Reverse Course · 折返与循迹原路返回 (Retrace, Backtrack, Double back)
groups.tip: 受阻后撤或循原路折返

items.def_en: to start traveling back to one's point of departure or previous location
to curve around and return along a circular path to the starting point
(+ to) to trace backward along a recorded path or previous line of motion
(+ sb/sth) to return in the direction one came from, or cause someone to do so
[I/T] to travel backwards or drive a vehicle backwards

items.def_zh: 原路折返；改变立场，反悔
items.def_en: 1. To go back along the same path one came; to reverse an earlier opinion, policy, or decision.
to turn and go back in the direction you have just come from
1. To move backward or decline to an earlier, worse state; (astronomy) to appear to move in a reverse direction.
1. To go back over the same path or route one has traveled; to recall or trace the history of something back to its origin.

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the precise spatial manner of reversing course, following the exact route one previously traveled, or moving in an opposite direction along a trajectory.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿原路折返、重循旧迹或逆向回到起点与前段路径的行动方式。

groups.name: Trade & Barter · 交易与交换 (Trade, Exchange, Barter)
groups.tip: 双方互通有无做买卖

items.def_zh: 做买卖，经商，从事交易；交换，互换
items.def_en: 1. To buy and sell goods or services. 2. To exchange something for something else.

items.def_zh: 交换，互换；兑换（货币）；交流
items.def_en: To give something to someone and receive something of equal value or type in return.
(+ in) to buy and sell goods or people illicitly or commercially
(+ sth) to give an old item as part of the payment when purchasing a new one
(+ sth) to exchange or give up one thing in return for gaining another
(+ sth) to replace one item with another equivalent item by mutual exchange
[I/T] (+ for/with) to give something to someone in exchange for something else, usually informally

items.def_zh: 从事金融活动；搞投机，从事欺骗性财务活动
items.def_en: To engage in financial operations, management, or financial wheeling and dealing (often implying trickery).
[I/T] (+ for/with) to exchange goods or services directly for other goods or services without using money

groups.summary_en: Parties mutually transfer goods, services, or currency under agreed commercial or reciprocal terms.
groups.summary_zh: 双方相互让渡商品、货币或服务以实现商业互换或对等交易。

groups.name: Trade & Transact · 贸易与交易 (Trade, Deal, Merchandise)
groups.tip: 市场买卖与商业往来

items.def_zh: 做生意，经营（尤指特种或违禁商品）
items.def_en: (+ in/with) to buy and sell specific commercial goods, art, securities, or illegal drugs
[I/T] (+ in/with) to buy, sell, or exchange commodities, securities, or services commercially

items.def_zh: 做非法买卖，贩卖（毒品、军火或人口等）；做贸易
items.def_en: To buy and sell goods illegally (such as drugs or weapons) or trade in human beings; to trade or do business.
(+ sth) to buy and sell a particular product or commodity as a business
(+ sth) to sell off unwanted goods or assets quickly, often at a reduced price
(+ sth) to sell all or part of an inventory, business, or assets cheaply or swiftly

items.def_zh: 经商，买卖商品；推销，促销
items.def_en: 1. To buy and sell goods commercially as a merchant. 2. To promote or market goods or services to encourage sales.
to try to sell small goods by going from house to house or travelling from place to place
[I/T] (+ for/with) to exchange goods or services directly without using money

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail commercial exchange, distribution, and commercial handling of goods and commodities across legitimate and illicit retail or international markets.
groups.summary_zh: 在正规商业零售或违禁跨境市场中进行商品买卖、分销及流转交易。

groups.name: Trade Embargo & Cultural Taboo · 禁运与禁忌 (Embargo, Taboo, Sanction)
groups.tip: 依据法令或习俗取缔封禁

items.def_en: to put a person, country, or organization on a list of those that are disapproved of or banned from certain dealings
(+ sb/sth) to deliberately exclude a party from commercial or social activities by joint refusal to deal

items.def_zh: 联合抵制（商业往来或活动）
items.def_en: to refuse to buy, use, or participate in something as a collective act of protest
(+ sth) to close off an area, port, or route to prevent access, movement, or trade
(+ sb/sth) to prevent someone or something from entering or participating in a market or society

items.def_zh: 对……施加经济或外交制裁
items.def_en: to impose official penalties or commercial restrictions on a state, entity, or individual
to forbid or ban a topic, word, or practice by social convention or religious custom.

items.def_zh: 对……实行禁运；禁止出版（或播发）
items.def_en: 1. to impose an official ban on trade or commercial activity with a particular country. 2. to officially ban the publication or broadcast of information before a specified date.

items.def_zh: 封锁（港口、边界或贸易通道）
items.def_en: to seal off an area or port by military or physical force to prevent the transit of goods and people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote instituting macro-level trade restrictions, state boycotts, or deep-seated cultural bans against dealing with an entity or discussing a topic. They scale from cultural or social avoidance to sweeping sovereign or multilateral commercial bans.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及宏观层面的贸易制裁、禁运或文化社会层面的禁忌与排斥。

groups.name: Transmit & Broadcast · 信息传输与播送 (Transmit, Broadcast, Telefax)
groups.tip: 借助通信媒介发送传输信息

items.def_en: [I/T] to send out radio or television signals to a wide public audience

items.def_zh: 定向发送（无线电波/光信号）
items.def_en: to direct or send a radio signal, television program, or light in a specific direction
(+ sth) to transmit or broadcast signals, electronic messages, or information

items.def_zh: 定向发送（无线电信号等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to transmit an electronic signal, radio waves, or broadcast data from a satellite or transmitter downward
(+ sb/sth) to connect a communication signal, phone call, or broadcast feed to another channel
to send an electronic signal, message, or program over a wire, radio, or data link
to receive a signal or message and pass it on to another recipient or transmission point

items.def_zh: 转播，转发，重新发送（信号或数据）
items.def_en: To broadcast, relay, or send a signal, transmission, or piece of data onward again.

items.def_zh: 传真发送，用传真机传送
items.def_en: (dated) To send or transmit a document by facsimile machine.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario cover the technical or technological sending and relaying of signals, documents, audiovisual data, or messages through electronic media or telecommunication channels.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用电子设备、网络或通信频段发送、转播及传真信号或数据。

groups.name: Trap & Enmesh · 缠困与陷入 (Entangle, Enmesh, Mire)
groups.tip: 陷入泥沼缠绊难以脱身

items.def_zh: 使陷于泥沼；使陷入停滞
items.def_en: [I/T] To prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress
(+ sb/sth) to involve or entangle someone in an unwanted, complex, or compromising situation
(+ sb/sth) to cause cords, threads, or people to become hopelessly knotted, trapped, or muddled
(+ sb) to persuade or trap someone into taking part in an activity or obligation

items.def_zh: 捕捉；诱捕，罗织陷阱陷害
items.def_en: To catch an animal in a trap, or catch someone by clever trickery
To cause something to become twisted together with or caught in something else

items.def_zh: 使陷入困境，缠困；使陷于泥潭
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To involve or tangle someone in a difficult, messy situation. 2. To cause to sink or become stuck in mud.
1. To lure or trick someone into a dangerous, compromising, or unlawful situation. 2. To catch an animal in a trap.

items.def_zh: 使落入网中；使陷入（困境）
items.def_en: To catch or involve someone or something in a net or complicated, compromising situation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe snaring or catching someone or something in a physical web, mud, or trap, or metaphorically trapping them in an inescapable, difficult, or compromising situation. 'Mire' highlights becoming physically or conceptually bogged down, whereas 'entrap' implies deliberate cunning.
groups.summary_zh: 使陷入淤泥、罗网或复杂的困境、纠纷中难以脱身。

groups.name: Travel in Groups or Specialized Transit · 结队旅行与专线通行 (Caravan, Tram)
groups.tip: 成群漫游与结队迁徙
