items.def_en: to travel regularly back and forth between two specific places using designated transit
(+ sth) to enter a vehicle, bus, or train together quickly and in an unorganized group
to travel together in a single shared motor vehicle, usually to and from work or school
to make a long, arduous journey, typically on foot or in an organized expedition
[I/T] to travel or transport people regularly back and forth between two places
to travel regularly between home and work or school using public transport or a car
[I/T] to travel together in a group of vehicles or ships for mutual security or convenience

items.def_zh: （乘野营车或大篷车）旅行，度假；结队前行
items.def_en: 1. To travel or take a holiday in a camper trailer or caravan. 2. To travel together in a group or convoy.

items.def_zh: 乘有轨电车出行；用矿车（或煤车）运载
items.def_en: 1. To travel by tram or streetcar. 2. To transport goods or minerals in a tram or cart.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe travelling in an organized convoy, group, or via specialized shared transit, moving together across distances or commuting along defined tracks.
groups.summary_zh: 指结伴成队迁徙旅行，或乘坐有轨电车等特定公共交通通行。

groups.name: Trigger & Spark Immediate Reaction · 引发与骤然诱发 (Trigger, Spark, Provoke)
groups.tip: 诱发事端或引起连锁反应

items.def_en: (formal) to cause something to happen, especially an emotion or an event
to cause a strong reaction, an event, or a process to happen suddenly or immediately

items.def_zh: 引发，触发，激起；发出火花
items.def_en: 1. to bring about or trigger a sudden reaction, dispute, or event. 2. to produce tiny sparks of fire or electricity
to suddenly ignite or precipitate a widespread violent conflict or dispute
(+ sth) to trigger or suddenly cause a series of events, an explosion, or an intense reaction
(+ sth) to suddenly provoke or trigger an acute dispute, riot, or violent event

items.def_zh: 引起；导致（不良反应或危机）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cause something unpleasant, sudden, or severe to happen or develop

items.def_zh: 激起，引发（强烈抗议/冲突）
items.def_en: to stimulate an immediate emotional outbreak, protest, or retaliatory action

items.def_zh: 引燃，激起（强烈情感/冲突）
items.def_en: to suddenly trigger explosive feelings, controversy, or open violence

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting serving as the direct catalyst or sudden spark that sets off an intense, rapid, or volatile event, crisis, or reaction.
groups.summary_zh: 作为直接导火索，骤然诱发或引爆剧烈反应、危机或情绪。

groups.name: Twist, Gnarl & Contort · 扭结与畸形弯曲 (Contort, Gnarl, Frizz)
groups.tip: 受力改变原有平直形态

items.def_en: (+ sth) to twist, bend, or roll into a tight curved or coiled shape
(+ sth) to twist sharply into tight, irregular bends or loops
to bend, warp, or collapse out of shape under intense heat, weight, or pressure
to become bent, twisted, or out of shape as a result of heat or moisture
to form a sharp, unintended curl, twist, or bend in a wire, rope, or hair
to bend or curve backward or in the opposite direction
(of hair) to become tightly curled or rough and unruly, or to make hair form into tiny tight curls

items.def_zh: 使扭曲，使多节；咆哮，龇牙低吼
items.def_en: (usually passive) to twist, knot, or distort something (such as wood, roots, or hands) into a rough, bent shape
to twist or bend severely out of the natural or normal shape

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote physical deformation involving severe twisting, crimping, knotting, or irregular bending backward or outward into an unnatural or tightly coiled state.
groups.summary_zh: 强调反向曲折、紧密起皱或扭曲结节等非平滑的畸态形变。

groups.name: Twist, Wind & Interlace Strands · 卷绕与缠绕 (Spool, Twine, Interweave)
groups.tip: 丝线交织盘旋卷绕

items.def_en: (+ sth) to interweave three or more strands of flexible material together into a single cord
(+ sth) to wind a line, wire, or cord around a spool or reel
(+ sth) to roll or twist a thread, string, or cable tightly around a core or into a ball
(+ around/round) To wrap a strand, cord, or tape around a center or object

items.def_zh: 缠绕在线轴上，把……绕上卷轴；（计算机）假脱机操作
items.def_en: 1. To wind thread, wire, or tape onto or off a spool or reel. 2. (computing) To transfer data to a temporary storage area for later processing or printing.
To weave three or more strands of flexible material diagonally together
To wind, coil, or twist around something or around each other; to make something by twisting strands together.

items.def_zh: （使）交织，（使）编织在一起（interweave 的过去分词）
items.def_en: (past participle of interweave) To weave, blend, or closely connect two or more things together.
(+ around/with) To twist or twine two or more elements closely together

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses manipulating flexible, thread-like materials by winding them around a core, twisting filaments together, or interlacing strands into a unified structure. Distinctions turn on whether the motion is circular coiling, spiral twining, or reciprocal braiding.
groups.summary_zh: 指将丝线或柔韧物料进行卷盘、绞扭缠绕或相互交错编结。

groups.name: Typecast & Pigeonhole · 归类归纳与刻板定型 (Lump, Bracket, Stereotype)
groups.tip: 按本质属性整理分门别类

items.def_en: (+ sth + as sth) to categorize or label something broadly as a particular kind of thing

items.def_zh: 把……归类，归为一组；把……放入括号内；用托架固定
items.def_en: 1. (+ together/with) To group people or things together as being similar or of the same class. 2. To enclose words or numbers in brackets.

items.def_zh: 把……归并到一起，混为一谈；结块，成团
items.def_en: 1. (+ together) To put different things or people together into the same group without distinction. 2. To form into lumps or clumps.
to place people or things systematically into particular groups based on shared qualities
(+ sb) to confine someone within a rigid, narrow conceptual or social category
(+ sb/sth) to categorize or group disparate people or things together without making proper distinctions

items.def_zh: 对……产生刻板印象，按成见归类；把……模式化
items.def_en: To form a fixed, oversimplified, and often unfair idea about a person, group, or thing.
to classify someone or something into a rigid, restrictive, or oversimplified category
to repeatedly assign an actor or person to a single stereotype or conventional role

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote cognitive sorting or collective categorization, particularly those biased or reductive judgments that group disparate entities under broad, unnuanced labels.
groups.summary_zh: 以宽泛、刻板或笼统方式将相异事物归入同一范畴。

groups.name: Unite & Ally · 联合与结盟 (Unite, Ally, Band together)
groups.tip: 携手合作结成联盟

items.def_en: 1. (+ up/with) To join together with someone or a group to work as a team. 2. (+ with) To combine or match one thing with another.
To join together, or join people or groups together, to form a single unit or act in agreement.
[I/T] (+ with) to join or combine formally with another party for mutual benefit
to form a group in order to take collective action or defend mutual interests
(+ with sb) to join together with another person or group to work toward a common purpose
to unite or combine efforts with someone else to achieve a shared objective
(+ with sb) to connect, meet, or form an alliance with another party or faction
(+ into) to come together to form one larger whole or political coalition
[I/T] to join together into a formal federation or political union

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote entities such as people, factions, or nations joining forces to pursue a shared goal or mutual defense. Nuances differ between formal pacts, collaborative teamwork, and spontaneous collective organizing.
groups.summary_zh: 个人、组织或国家为共同目标或防卫而联手合作、缔结联盟。

groups.name: Unlawful Deprivation of Goods · 盗窃与洗劫抢掠 (Pilfer to Plunder)
groups.tip: 从小偷小摸到暴力明抢

items.def_zh: 小偷小摸，偷窃（微量物品）
items.def_en: [I/T] to steal things of little value, especially in small quantities repeatedly
[I/T] to secretly take another person's property without permission or intention of returning it
(+ sth) to steal something and hurry away with it undetected or unstopped
(+ sb/sth) to steal property from someone or cheat them out of possessions
[I/T] to enter a building illegally in order to steal property
(+ sth) to steal all the money or goods from a place or person, leaving it completely bare
1. To take money or property from a person or place illegally, especially using violence or threats. 2. (+ of) To unfairly deprive someone of something desirable or rightful.
1. (+ through) To search quickly through something in order to steal or find items. 2. To steal something from a place; to plunder or loot.
[I/T] to steal goods from a place or person violently and openly, especially during wartime

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe unlawfully taking property from a person or place without permission. Intensity scales from petty, stealthy thievery to forceful confrontation and violent ransacking or stripping of goods.
groups.summary_zh: 按侵害强度递增：从小偷小摸、入室行窃到当面抢劫及洗劫掠夺。

groups.name: Unsteady & Tottering Gait · 摇晃与踉跄行进 (Stagger, Lurch, Hobble)
groups.tip: 失衡挣扎或踉跄慢行

items.def_zh: 步履踉跄，摇摇欲坠地走
items.def_en: to walk with shaky, hesitant, and unsteady steps, as though about to collapse
to make abrupt, uncontrolled, and swaying forward movements while walking
to walk or advance with unsteadiness, repeatedly tripping or faltering
to move in an unsteady, zigzag path due to drunkenness, injury, or vertigo
to walk or move unsteadily, almost falling, as if carrying a great weight or disoriented

items.def_zh: 挣扎，踉跄乱动；不知所措，陷入困境
items.def_en: to struggle awkwardly to move or stay upright, especially in water or mud; to experience great confusion or difficulty
to make a sudden, unsteady, or uncontrolled movement forward or sideways; stagger

items.def_zh: 跛行，蹒跚；束缚（马等的腿）；妨碍，阻碍
items.def_en: 1. to walk with difficulty, taking small or uneven steps because of injury or pain 2. to tie the legs of an animal together; hamper or restrict
to rock, sway, or move backwards uncontrollably from shock, dizziness, or a blow

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail locomotion impaired by shock, intoxication, disorientation, or physical injury, producing abrupt lateral swaying or unstable flailing.
groups.summary_zh: 指因眩晕、受创、醉酒或虚弱导致的重心失衡、左摇右晃的踉跄步态。

groups.name: Uphold & Defend Principle · 支持与维持裁决原则 (Uphold, Maintain, Sustain)
groups.tip: 坚定捍卫决议、法治与正义

items.def_en: to keep an established principle, position, or standard in existence
to stand by and protect a law, principle, or ruling against criticism or challenge

items.def_zh: 确认；认可（异议或主张）有效
items.def_en: to officially uphold, accept, or decide that a legal objection or claim is valid
(+ sth) to adhere to, affirm, or continue to defend a decision, promise, or legal principle
(+ sth) to publicly defend or advocate for a principle, right, or standard against opposition
(+ sth) to support and defend a contested cause, belief, or ruling
to formally state that a legal judgment or conviction will be upheld

items.def_zh: 维护，捍卫（原则、正义等）；维持，确认（原判、决定等）
items.def_en: 1. To defend or maintain a principle, law, or right against opposition. 2. (law) To officially agree with and confirm a previous decision or court ruling.

items.def_zh: 维护，捍卫；维持（原判）（uphold的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of uphold; to defend a principle or confirm a legal decision.

groups.summary_en: An authority, court, or institution formally defends, affirms, or sustains an established law, conviction, principle, or custom against legal challenge or erosion. 'Uphold' typically denotes affirming lower rulings or defending standards, while 'sustain' confirms formal objections or validity.
groups.summary_zh: 司法或权威机构依法维持原判、确立原则或辩护惯例。

groups.name: Upload & Transfer Data · 数据传输与转移 (Digital File and Stream Transmission)
groups.tip: 网络或物理途径传输

items.def_en: (+ sth) to transmit digital files or data across a network or communication channel to another party
(+ sth) to transmit digital data or files wirelessly from a satellite or remote source to a receiving device
(+ sth) to transmit software updates or electronic data automatically to client devices across a network
to transmit continuous audio or video data over the internet for immediate consumption
(+ to) to send commits, data, or update payloads proactively from a client to a remote repository
(+ to/from) to copy or transmit digital data from one system or storage medium to another
1. To copy or transfer data, files, or software from the internet or a central computer onto a local device.
1. To transfer data, files, or programs from a local computer or device to a central network or internet.
to move data from a primary processor or memory bank to secondary storage or an auxiliary server

groups.summary_en: An agent or automated client program moves digital files, packets, or streams between local storage, remote servers, or devices across a network protocol.
groups.summary_zh: 在本地与远端服务器或设备间传输数字文件与流数据。

groups.name: Utilize & Exploit · 善用与撬动利用 (Utilize, Leverage, Harness)
groups.tip: 发挥人或事物的功用

items.def_zh: 开辟，开发利用（潜能、资源）
items.def_en: draw upon a resource, fund, or supply of expertise for a specific purpose

items.def_zh: 调配，有效运用（资源、手段）
items.def_en: bring resources, arguments, or capabilities into effective action
(formal) To make practical and effective use of something.
take strategic advantage of an opportunity, asset, or condition
(+ sth) to make strategic use of an available supply of skills, resources, or knowledge

items.def_zh: 开发利用；汲取（潜能、市场）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to access and harness a useful resource, market, or reservoir of knowledge
(+ sth) to exploit a quality, reputation, or connection to gain maximum practical advantage

items.def_zh: 充分利用，借助……发挥最大效能；（金融）举债经营，以杠杆投资
items.def_en: 1. To use existing resources, influence, or technology to maximum strategic advantage. 2. (finance) To use borrowed money to finance an investment or transaction.
control and direct the power of natural resources, talents, or efforts

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote putting resources, skills, or assets to effective, strategic, or maximal practical use to accomplish a goal.
groups.summary_zh: 高效运用、战略性撬动或转化资源以达成既定目标。

groups.name: Vacation & Sojourn · 避暑与度假小住 (Summer, Winter, Holiday)
groups.tip: 休假放松与异地旅居

items.def_en: to spend the summer in a particular place, especially on holiday or vacation
to spend a weekend in a particular place, especially for leisure or holiday
(+ in/at) to spend the winter months in a particular resort or warmer climate
(+ in/at) to spend time away from home enjoying recreation or leisure (mainly British)
(+ in/at) to take a holiday or spend vacation time in a specific destination (mainly American)
(+ at/with) to stay for a brief period as a temporary resident or visitor
to leave home or work to spend time relaxing on holiday or vacation

items.def_zh: 躲起来消夏/小住；隐居度假
items.def_en: to stay temporarily in a secluded or quiet place to rest, retreat, or spend a season
to lodge or reside temporarily as a guest at a place for a night or short sojourn

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate residing temporarily in a leisurely locale for a season, holiday, or weekend to relax, characteristic of seasonal migration and recreational getaways.
groups.summary_zh: 前往某地度假、过周末或度过特定季节（避暑/避寒）。

groups.name: Vegetative Flourishing & Enrichment · 滋养与绽放 (Blossom, Fertilise, Flourish)
groups.tip: 如花朵般绽放生长繁荣

items.def_en: to produce and unfold fresh leaves, entering a lush green vegetative state
to grow, sprout, or develop rapidly out of the ground
[I/T] to begin to grow leaves, buds, or shoots
to grow taller or lengthen very rapidly in a brief period of botanical vigor
to produce flowers or achieve a healthy, vibrant appearance

items.def_zh: 开花；繁荣，兴旺，蓬勃发展
items.def_en: 1. To produce flowers. 2. To develop, flourish, or become more successful and attractive.
to supply with the nutrients necessary for growth and vitality

items.def_zh: 使受精，使受粉；施肥，使肥沃
items.def_en: 1. To cause an egg, animal, or plant to develop new life by joining with a male cell. 2. To add fertilizer to soil or plants to aid growth.
to begin to grow or develop rapidly and abundantly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail botanical growth and enrichment, encompassing both the external act of enriching soil/plants and the plant's own vibrant phase of flowering and flourishing.
groups.summary_zh: 植物开花绽放或施肥充养等滋生演进的具体方式。

groups.name: Verbally Abuse & Revile · 辱骂与谩骂 (Abuse, Revile, Vituperate)
groups.tip: 由言语侮辱升级为恶毒痛骂

items.def_en: to say or do something deliberately offensive and disrespectful to someone

items.def_zh: 辱骂，粗话痛骂；用俚语说
items.def_en: (British informal) To attack or insult someone using abusive, vulgar language.
to scold or condemn someone angrily and at length
(+ sb) to suddenly attack someone with angry insults or bitter invective
(+ sb) to attack someone verbally with harsh, aggressive, and abusive language
(+ sb) to scold, abuse, or criticize someone with fierce verbal ferocity
to criticize someone in a very angry and abusive manner, often publicly
(archaic) To revile, abuse, or speak slanderously and insultingly of someone.
to blame or insult someone violently using abusive, malicious language

groups.summary_en: Speakers direct harsh, derogatory, or scurrilous language toward a person to humiliate or defame them, escalating from informal street insult to bitter, sustained invective.
groups.summary_zh: 使用侮辱、粗鄙或恶毒言语攻击他人，多含贬损与泄愤色彩。

groups.name: Verify & Ascertain Truth · 查证与核实 (Verify, Ascertain, Authenticate)
groups.tip: 搜集真凭实据核验真伪

items.def_en: make sure that something is true, accurate, or justified through evidence
(+ sth) To investigate or verify the truth or accuracy of information, or (of facts) to be confirmed as true
(+ sb/sth) To support or confirm the truth of a claim, prediction, or evidence
(+ sb/sth) To find the exact origin, fact, or person after thorough and systematic searching
check or prove the validity or accuracy of a claim or document

items.def_zh: 查明，精确指出；准确确定（位置或时间）
items.def_en: 1. To find, identify, or explain the exact position, cause, or time of something.
1. (formal) To find out and verify the exact facts or truth about something through investigation.
confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding with evidence

items.def_zh: 证实……为真，证明……是真实的；（计算机）验证（身份）
items.def_en: 1. To prove officially that a document, signature, artwork, or identity is genuine.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe systematic investigative or analytical efforts to establish factual accuracy, provenance, or exact parameters. They differ by whether the goal is identifying a precise point, validating genuine origins, or resolving doubt with definitive proof.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过调查、比对或技术检验来确定事实真相与真实性。

groups.name: Violent Homicide · 暴力杀害与行凶 (Knife, Stone, Murder)
groups.tip: 施加致命伤剥夺生命

items.def_en: kill someone by squeezing their neck to stop breathing
(+ sb) To murder someone intentionally, especially in an informal or underworld context
(+ sb) To assassinate or deliberately kill a specific targeted person

items.def_zh: 用石头砸死，用石块处决；投石击打
items.def_en: To throw stones at someone, especially to kill or execute them as a punishment.
To stab or cut someone with a knife.
kill a person in a violent, deliberate manner (formal or literary)
(+ sb) To kill someone by striking them repeatedly with severe physical violence
1. To kill someone deliberately and unlawfully. 2. (informal) To spoil, ruin, or perform something very badly.
murder a prominent person by surprise attack, usually for political reasons

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the deliberate, illegal killing of human beings using targeted weapons, physical violence, or premeditated assault. They escalate in intensity and legal/moral severity from specific instrumental assaults to outright premeditated murder.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用特定武器行凶或蓄意非法夺取他人生命。

groups.name: Walk with Heavy or Bold Stride · 迈步与行走 (Clump, Swagger, Stride)
groups.tip: 不同姿态步幅的行走方式

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地走，蹒跚而行
items.def_en: to walk slowly and with heavy steps, usually because of tiredness or difficult terrain
To enter a room or area with deliberate, assertive, and heavy strides
To walk away with loud, heavy, and angry steps
To walk forward with long, vigorous, and purposeful steps
to walk with long, energetic, and purposeful steps
to walk in a proud, pompous way with head up and chest thrust forward

items.def_zh: 脚步沉重而笨拙地走；聚集，成团
items.def_en: 1. To walk with heavy, clumsy, noisy steps. 2. To form or gather into a dense mass or cluster.

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆地走，趾高气扬地走；吹嘘，妄自尊大
items.def_en: To walk or behave in a proud, arrogant, or excessively self-confident way.
to walk with forceful, loud, deliberate steps, often out of anger

groups.summary_en: Agents propel themselves on foot with distinctive physical cadence or attitude, contrasting heavy, noisy footfalls with confident, insolent, or decisive strides.
groups.summary_zh: 通过特定的步态、声响或姿态行走，体现沉重笨拙或傲慢果敢。

groups.name: Wash & Cleanse Body Parts · 冲洗与盥洗 (Gargle, Lave, Rinse)
groups.tip: 漱口洗脸涤荡身体部位

items.def_en: (+ sth) To wash the mouth or a body cavity thoroughly with clean water without soap
(+ sb) To clean a person's body gently using a wet sponge or cloth

items.def_zh: 用水冲洗（全身或身体部位）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To thoroughly clean all or part of the body by splashing or spraying water over it
(+ down) to wipe or wash the body gently using a damp sponge or cloth
[I/T] (+ out) to wash mouth, hands, or hair lightly with clean water without soap
To clean the throat and mouth with a liquid held in the back of the mouth while exhaling.

items.def_zh: 清洗，沐浴；（水）轻拍，流淌冲刷
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To wash or bathe something gently. 2. (of water) To wash or flow against a shore or surface.

items.def_zh: 沐浴，用水清洗（伤口或身体部位）
items.def_en: [I/T] to immerse the body in water to wash; or gently wash a body part or wound with liquid
[I/T] (+ out) to rinse or swirl liquid vigorously around the mouth or a container

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe specific bodily washing or rinsing actions, differing by the technique, targeted anatomical area, and liquid flow. 'Gargle' specifies oscillating liquid in the throat, 'rinse' clears with water alone, while 'lave' is a poetic, gentle bathing or splashing action.
groups.summary_zh: 按清洗方式与身体部位细分的盥洗动作：漱口、冲洗及沐洗等。

groups.name: Weeping & Tearful Lamentation · 呜咽与抽泣啼哭 (Pule, Blub, Weep)
groups.tip: 从低声啜泣到放声大哭

items.def_en: to make weak, quiet crying sounds expressive of fear, distress, or hurt
To cry plaintively, weakly, or fretfully, especially like a sick child or young bird.
(+ sth) To struggle to suppress tears or convulsive sobs with great difficulty
To emit a loud, tearful wail or vocal lamentation from grief or pain

items.def_zh: 哭泣，流泪（weep 的过去式及过去分词）；渗出
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of weep; to have cried or shed tears.

items.def_zh: 抽抽搭搭地哭，号啕大哭；哭着说出
items.def_en: To cry noisily and childishly.
To lose emotional control and begin weeping uncontrollably
to cry noisily with gasping, convulsive breaths
to utter a loud, prolonged, high-pitched cry of deep grief and lamentation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail shedding tears and emitting cries of sorrow, ranging from weak, childish whines to unrestrained, convulsive weeping.
groups.summary_zh: 指伴随落泪的悲泣体验，从细弱哀鸣、委屈抽噎到放声痛哭。

groups.name: Weight & Compress · 施压与压紧 (Exert Downward Load or Compact Mass)
groups.tip: 施加重量或外力压实

items.def_en: (+ down) to pack down firmly by a succession of light, tapping blows
(+ sth) To press loose earth, snow, or materials together into a dense, solid mass
(+ on sth) To exert continuous downward physical force to compress or compact something
(+ sth) To keep something firmly in place or compress it by placing heavy weights on top

items.def_zh: 在……上加重量；压住，压紧；使加权
items.def_en: To attach a weight to or place a heavy object on something to hold it down or make it heavier.
to press or squeeze something together so that it occupies less space
to squeeze or compress tightly around the circumference of an object

items.def_zh: 压紧，压实；撞击，冲击；对……产生影响
items.def_en: 1. To press or pack firmly together into a solid mass. 2. To hit with great force, or have a strong effect on something.
to exert heavy pressure on loose material to form a dense, firm mass

groups.summary_en: An agent applies persistent gravitational load or mechanical force to an object or volume to press, stabilize, or compact it into a denser solid state.
groups.summary_zh: 通过施加物理重负或机械挤压力使之压实或压牢。

groups.name: Whisper & Mutter · 低语与咕哝 (Whisper, Murmur, Mumble)
groups.tip: 刻意压低声音喃喃自语

items.def_en: utter words very quietly or gently, often as an intimate disclosure
[I/T] speak very softly using one's breath rather than throat sounds to maintain secrecy

items.def_zh: 低语，低声说；轻声私语；发连续柔和的声音
items.def_en: 1. To speak or say something very softly and quietly. 2. To make a continuous low, gentle sound.
Speak so quietly that almost no one can hear, typically to express annoyance
Speak in a continuous low whisper
mutter or complain persistently in a low, monotonous voice

items.def_zh: 咕哝，含糊其辞地说，喃喃自语
items.def_en: To speak or say something quietly and unclearly so that words are hard to understand.
(+ about/to) To speak quietly in a low, unclear voice, especially when complaining or annoyed.
[I/T] make a low, rough, involuntary sound expressing reluctant agreement or surly discontent

groups.summary_en: Speakers utter words in low, indistinct, or breathy tones, ranging from secretive or tender confidences to irritated and indecipherable complaints.
groups.summary_zh: 以低沉、含糊或窃窃私语的方式说话，常带有不满或隐秘色彩。

groups.name: Wield & Harness · 操控与驾驭 (Wield, Harness, Channel)
groups.tip: 掌控并发挥能量工具

items.def_en: (+ sth) To make active use of one's reserved abilities, power, or inner resources
apply or bring into play a right, authority, or influence
(+ sth) To exert and direct one's power, influence, or pressure to achieve a desired outcome

items.def_zh: 开发利用，驾驭（资源或潜能）
items.def_en: (+ sth) To harness, manage, and draw upon an available force, supply, or energy
direct energy, resources, or emotion toward a specific purpose

items.def_zh: 控制并利用（自然力、资源等）；给（马等）套上挽具
items.def_en: 1. To control and make effective use of a natural force, energy source, or skill. 2. To put a harness onto a horse or working animal.

items.def_zh: 行使，运用（权力、影响等）；挥舞，操作（武器或工具）
items.def_en: 1. To possess and exercise great political power, authority, or influence. 2. To hold and use a weapon or tool skillfully.
To use something—such as power, authority, funds, or medication—in the wrong way or for a dishonest purpose.
make full use of and derive benefit from a resource or opportunity

groups.summary_en: An agent actively controls, directs, or exploits tools, power, authority, or natural forces, ranging from skillful mastery to deliberate abuse.
groups.summary_zh: 主动掌握、驾驭或运用工具、权力及自然资源，涵盖善用与滥用。

groups.name: Work & Labor · 工作与劳作 (Toil, Labor, Drudge, Exert)
groups.tip: 辛勤工作与体力劳作

items.def_zh: 工作，劳作；运转，起作用；操作，经营；加工，塑造
items.def_en: 1. to exert physical or mental effort; do a job 2. to function, operate, or produce the desired effect 3. to shape, mold, or process a material

items.def_zh: 做零工，打杂；分包（工作）；利用公职营私舞弊
items.def_en: 1. to do casual or odd jobs; work as a jobber 2. (formal) to use a public office or position for private or corrupt gain
to do hard physical work or strive diligently under strain

items.def_zh: 做苦工，像奴隶般拼命干活
items.def_en: (+ away/over) to work excessively hard under oppressive or thankless conditions

items.def_zh: 拼命苦干，当牛做马般劳作
items.def_en: (+ at sth) To work extremely hard and continuously for a long period of time
(+ at sth) To labor persistently and laboriously at a difficult or monotonous task

items.def_zh: 辛勤劳作，不辞劳苦地干
items.def_en: To perform exhausting, arduous physical or mental labor over an extended period
(+ away/at) to work extremely hard and continuously over long periods

items.def_zh: 干苦工，做繁重单调的工作
items.def_en: to perform dull, hard, or menial labor

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote expending physical or mental effort to produce goods, perform tasks, or earn a livelihood. Registers range from everyday employment ('work', 'job') to strenuous, exhausting manual exertion ('labor', 'toil', 'drudge').
groups.summary_zh: 指从事体力或脑力劳动，涵盖从日常上班到极度艰辛劳役的语体与色彩。

groups.name: Wrap Closely & Encase · 密实包裹与贴身覆裹 (Envelop, Bard)
groups.tip: 层层裹紧或完全包覆

items.def_en: (+ sth) To cover an object completely and securely with paper, cloth, or protective material
(+ sb/sth) To enclose and fasten an object or body part securely with tight bands or cloth
(+ sb/sth) To wrap a baby or limb tightly and closely in cloth or blankets
(+ in/with) To cover, wrap, or surround someone or something completely.

items.def_zh: 用寿衣包裹；将…完全笼罩遮蔽
items.def_en: to wrap a body in a winding sheet, or envelop something completely from sight

items.def_zh: （烹饪前在瘦肉上）裹上一层肥肉（或培根）
items.def_en: (cooking) To cover or wrap lean meat with slices of bacon or fat before roasting to keep it moist.
(+ in/with) to wrap, bind, or swaddle someone or something thoroughly in folds of material

items.def_zh: （用布料）紧紧裹住（婴儿或伤处）
items.def_en: to wrap someone, especially a baby, tightly in cloths or blankets
to wrap up, surround, or encompass someone affectionately or closely

groups.summary_en: Focuses on completely surrounding or binding an object in a protective or culinary outer layer, such as shrouding a form entirely or strapping fat/bacon onto meat.
groups.summary_zh: 紧密贴合地裹住某物，或在烹饪中以肥肉片紧缚肉块以防干焦。

groups.name: Yield to Rules & Authority · 遵从与依从 (Obey, Comply)
groups.tip: 遵照指示或规则行事

items.def_en: to accept and act in accordance with a decision, law, or agreement

items.def_zh: 严守；坚持遵循（准则、规章）
items.def_en: to strictly observe or act in agreement with a principle, rule, or guideline

items.def_zh: 顺从，赞同并遵从（规矩或建议）
items.def_en: (+ sth) To accept, agree with, and conform one's actions to rules, plans, or decisions
(+ sb/sth) To give way to authoritative demands, legal pressure, or established rules

items.def_zh: 顺从，遵从（上级旨意或规定）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To submit to the authority, rule, or overwhelming judgment of others

items.def_zh: 遵从，顺从，服从（规则、法律或要求）
items.def_en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, rule, or requirement.
To do what you are told to do by a person, rule, or law.
(+ to/with) to behave according to established rules, social customs, or standards

items.def_zh: 遵从；服从（权威或他人意见）
items.def_en: (+ to) to yield respectfully to the opinion, wish, or judgment of another person

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe conforming one's actions to explicit commands, regulations, legal standards, or authoritative requests, ranging from direct submission to institutional adherence.
groups.summary_zh: 遵守规章制度、指令或权威要求，按标准行事或顺从他人指示。

groups.name: Abolish & Annul by Authority · 官方废止与撤销 (Repeal, Annul, Nullify)
groups.tip: 正式宣布旧法或契约作废

items.def_zh: 废除，取消（法律、惯例或制度）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Abolish or get rid of a legal rule, custom, or institution
(+ sth) Declare a law, statute, or regulation invalid by official judicial decision

items.def_zh: 宣布……无效，作废，废止；排泄，排出（大小便等）
items.def_en: 1. (law) To officially declare that a contract, document, or election is invalid and has no legal force. 2. (formal/medicine) To discharge or empty urine or feces from the body.
(law/politics) (of a government or parliament) To officially cancel or revoke a law so that it is no longer valid.
to formally put an end to an established system, practice, or institution
to make a law, agreement, or decision legally void and without binding force

items.def_zh: 宣布（婚姻、契约、法律等）无效，废除，取消
items.def_en: (law) To officially state that a marriage, contract, law, or decision is invalid and has no legal effect.
to officially end a legal agreement, treaty, or law through authoritative decree

groups.summary_en: Formal legal verbs meaning to formally abolish, declare non-binding, or eradicate a statute, treaty, custom, or established institution.
groups.summary_zh: 官方或法律层面正式废除法律、条约或制度，使其失去法律效力。

groups.name: Absolve & Acquit · 赦免与雪冤 (Absolve, Exonerate, Acquit)
groups.tip: 司法判决或良心上赦免罪责

items.def_en: (+ of) to prove that someone is innocent of a crime, mistake, or misconduct
(+ sb) Decide not to punish sb for an offense or give them a very light penalty
(let sb off the hook) Free sb from blame, guilt, obligation, or punishment
to officially allow someone who has been convicted of a crime to go free without legal punishment
(+ of) to officially decide and state in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a crime
to prove that someone is not guilty or that someone was right after doubts or accusations

items.def_zh: 赦免，免除（责任、罪过）；宣告……无罪
items.def_en: (formal) To state officially that someone is free from guilt, blame, or sin, or to release someone from a duty or obligation.

items.def_zh: 免除（责任）；宣布……无罪，证明……清白
items.def_en: (formal / law) To officially pronounce someone free from guilt, blame, or legal responsibility for a crime or mistake.

groups.summary_en: Legal or moral authorities relieve a person from guilt, accusation, or liability. Verbs distinguish between verdict-based legal discharge ('acquit'), comprehensive clearance from culpability ('exonerate'), and moral or spiritual forgiveness ('absolve', 'pardon').
groups.summary_zh: 官方或道德权威免除当事人的过错、指控或罪责，涉及法庭无罪判决与道德赦免。

groups.name: Absorb & Resorb · 吸收与再吸收 (Absorb, Resorb, Reabsorb)
groups.tip: 生物体再吸收摄入物质

items.def_en: To take in a liquid or other substance gradually from the surface or through pores/membranes
(+ sth) To take in liquid or moisture completely into porous material or organic tissue
(+ sth) To absorb moisture or nutrients readily and completely into the body or cells
(+ sth) To pull fluids, air, or essential nutrients inward into bodily tissues
To absorb food or nourishment into the body tissues after digestion
(Physiological/Botanical) To take in fluid or moisture into organic structures by absorption
(biology/medicine) to absorb something again, especially a fluid or substance back into tissues or the bloodstream

items.def_zh: 再吸收，重新吸收（骨质或组织）
items.def_en: (biology/medicine) to break down and absorb bone or tissue back into the body

groups.summary_en: Biological tissue, cells, or bodily substances take in fluids, nutrients, or broken-down organic material. 'Resorb' and 'reabsorb' specifically detail the physiological uptake of substances previously secreted or bone/tissue matrix degradation, whereas 'absorb' describes general uptake.
groups.summary_zh: 生物组织、细胞对液体、营养物质或自体降解产物的摄取与吸收。

groups.name: Accuse & Challenge Validity · 归咎与质疑 (Impute, Impugn, Asperse)
groups.tip: 将过错归咎于他人并加以指控

items.def_en: to accuse or incriminate someone by attributing guilt or criminal wrongdoing to them
to charge someone with a crime or expose them to an accusation
to attack someone's reputation or integrity with false or malicious charges

items.def_zh: 向（某人名誉）投以怀疑；归咎
items.def_en: (cast aspersion/doubt on sb/sth) Cause people to doubt the honesty, integrity, or character of sb
(+ sth on sb) Blame sb for a crime or mistake, especially unfairly
to formally call someone before a court to answer an indictment, or to publicly accuse them of a fault

items.def_zh: 归咎于，把……归罪于；把……归因于
items.def_en: (formal) ('impute something to') To claim that someone is responsible for a fault or crime; to attribute a quality or characteristic to someone.

items.def_zh: 指责，抨击，质疑（……的真实性或诚实性）
items.def_en: (formal) To challenge or attack the truth, honesty, or integrity of a motive, character, or statement.

groups.summary_en: A speaker formally attributes a fault, crime, or unworthy motive to someone, or challenges and attacks the integrity and credibility of their character or statements. Register is decidedly formal, rhetorical, and legalistic.
groups.summary_zh: 在言论中向某人归咎责任或质疑、诋毁其人品与诚信。

groups.name: Acknowledge & Confess · 承认与坦白 (Admit, Acknowledge, Confess)
groups.tip: 从勉强认可到主动供认罪错

items.def_en: to accept or admit that something exists or that a factual situation is true
(+ to) to admit that you have done something wrong, usually something minor (informal)

items.def_zh: 敞开心扉；坦率道出心事
items.def_en: (+ to sb) Speak honestly and openly about your feelings or secret experiences
(+ to sth/to doing sth) Admit that you have done something wrong, shameful, or embarrassing

items.def_zh: 承认，供认；准许进入；接收（入院等）
items.def_en: 1. To agree or acknowledge, often unwillingly, that something is true or that you have done something wrong. 2. To allow someone to enter a place or join an institution.
1. To admit, especially formally or to police, that you have done something bad, illegal, or embarrassing. 2. To tell God or a priest about your sins.
[I/T] to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true or that you have lost an argument
(+ with/about) to tell the full truth about something you have kept secret

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe acknowledging that something is true or that one is responsible for an error or wrongdoing, ranging from reluctant concessions to deep, contrite unburdening.
groups.summary_zh: 承认某事属实或承认自身过错，从勉强认可递进至痛切招供坦白。

groups.name: Administer & Direct Governance · 治理与统领管理 (Administer, Conduct, Captain)
groups.tip: 指引前行并主持日常运转

items.def_zh: 组织，实施，主持；指挥（乐团）；带领，引导；传导（热、电）
items.def_en: 1. to organize and perform a particular activity; to manage or direct. 2. to direct the performance of musicians or an orchestra. 3. to lead or guide someone somewhere. 4. to transmit heat, electricity, or sound.

items.def_zh: 统领，担任……的队长（或船长、机长）
items.def_en: to act as the leader or captain of a sports team, ship, or aircraft.
[I/T] to officially conduct the policy, actions, and affairs of a state or organization
(+ sth) to assume formal control, command, or administration of an organization or jurisdiction
(+ sth) to be in official charge of or lead a situation, organization, or period of governance

items.def_zh: 管理，掌管；执行，实施；给予，施用（药物等）
items.def_en: 1. to manage and organize the affairs of a business, government, or institution. 2. to implement or enforce a law, test, or justice. 3. to give or provide medicine, treatment, or aid to someone.
(+ over) to hold the position of authority in meetings or governance frameworks
to direct, pilot, or act as chief leader of an enterprise or organization

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate exercising formal executive direction, stewardship, or organizational command over public affairs, institutions, maritime crews, or projects.
groups.summary_zh: 指行使公职行政管理、统领机构组织或指挥团队项目。

groups.name: Admit & Re-admit · 准入与接纳 (Admit, Enroll, Matriculate)
groups.tip: 重新批准进入或再次接纳

items.def_zh: 准许进入，接纳入学/住院
items.def_en: to allow someone to enter an institution, school, or hospital as an official member or patient
(+ sb) to accept someone as an admitted member, student, or hospital patient
(+ sb/for sth) to officially enroll or admit someone into an organization, course, or institution
to restore someone to a previous official position, membership, or rank
[I/T] to officially register someone as a member or student in an institution

items.def_zh: 录取入学，准予注册入大学（正式语体）
items.def_en: [I/T] to formally admit or be admitted as a student into a university or college

items.def_zh: 重新准许进入，重新接纳（readmit 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of readmit: to allow someone to enter, join, or be admitted to a place or institution again.

items.def_zh: 重新接纳，准许…重新加入
items.def_en: to allow someone to enter a school, hospital, country, or organization again

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve granting an individual official membership, entrance, or re-entry into an institution, school, hospital, or organization.
groups.summary_zh: 指机构或组织在制度上批准某人进入、恢复学籍或接纳为正式成员。

groups.name: Advance & Exalt Status · 提拔与擢升 (Promote, Elevate, Aggrandize)
groups.tip: 提拔地位官职上升

items.def_en: [I/T] to help someone move forward in career or social status
(+ sb) to advance in rank, corporate hierarchy, or social standing
(+ sb) to elevate someone abruptly to a higher rank, position, or classification

items.def_zh: 提拔，晋升；促进，推进；推销，宣传
items.def_en: 1. to raise someone to a higher rank, position, or status. 2. to encourage the development or progress of something. 3. to advertise or publicize something to increase sales
(+ to) to raise someone to a higher or more important rank, dignity, or position
to elevate someone to the rank of nobility or endow with noble qualities
to raise someone to a very high level of power, status, or praise

items.def_zh: 提升…的地位（或权力、财富）；吹捧，夸大
items.def_en: 1. to increase the power, wealth, status, or importance of someone or something. 2. to praise or portray something as greater than it really is

groups.summary_en: This frame captures upward mobility in social, corporate, or political rank. Verbs scale from regular organizational promotion, to dignified spiritual/social elevation, culminating in excessive aggrandizement of power and prestige.
groups.summary_zh: 指在阶级、官阶或权力声望上向上提拔、擢升，乃至极度扩充势力地位。

groups.name: Affix & Append Linguistic Elements · 添加与附加 (Prefix, Suffix, Affix)
groups.tip: 在词干前后添加词缀成分

items.def_en: (+ to) to casually or arbitrarily attach an extra item or amendment to an existing text
to add an extra statement, postscript, or section immediately at the end of a text
(+ sth) to append or attach an extra word, clause, or detail to the end of a text or remark
(+ sth) to attach or affix text, a clause, or notes as an addition to a document

items.def_zh: 在……前添加（前缀、词冠等）；加前缀于
items.def_en: (+ to/with) To add a word, title, or letter at the beginning of another word or number.
(+ to) to attach a linguistic affix to a root, or physically attach an addition to a document
(+ to) (linguistics) To attach a group of letters to the end of a word to form a new word or inflection.
(+ to) (formal) To add a piece of writing, signature, or document to the end of an official text.

groups.summary_en: A writer, speaker, or legal drafter attaches an element—such as a morpheme, note, codicil, or supplementary clause—to a root word, base document, or text. Verbs differentiate by exact structural positioning (prefixing to the front, suffixing/appending to the tail).
groups.summary_zh: 在词基或文本首尾增添词缀、注释或附件。

groups.name: Affix & Fasten Lightly or Temporarily · 连接与固定 (Affix, Tack, Pin)
groups.tip: 将两物接合固定在一起

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten or attach something to another object with a clip
(+ sth) to attach or fasten a notice, picture, or cloth to a surface using pins

items.def_zh: 用平头钉钉上；粗略固定
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fix or attach something lightly or temporarily with small nails or tacks
to fasten items together or onto a backing with a mechanical clamp or clip
to fasten or attach one object to another using a thin pointed piece of metal

items.def_zh: 用平头钉（图钉）钉住；粗缝；额外附加上
items.def_en: 1. To fasten or attach something with small nails (tacks) or temporary stitches. 2. (tack on) To add something extra as an afterthought.
to secure sheets of paper or materials together using small metal wire staples
(formal) To stick, attach, or fasten one thing securely to another.

groups.summary_en: Handlers fasten, adhere, or anchor one item onto another surface, ranging from temporary, light pin-like attachment to formal physical bonding.
groups.summary_zh: 将一物附加、钉合或粘贴于另一物体表面，含轻度固定与胶黏。

groups.name: Aim & Direct · 对准与瞄准 (Aim, Square, Sight)
groups.tip: 调整朝向位置使其归正

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ at/toward) To direct a finger, object, or weapon in a specific direction

items.def_zh: 平端对准，把（武器）平举指向
items.def_en: (+ at) To bring a weapon or finger horizontally in direct aim at someone

items.def_zh: 对准，瞄准（枪炮、镜头、目光）
items.def_en: (+ on/at) To point or direct a weapon, camera, or light steadily at a target

items.def_zh: 调正，使对齐（成直角或平正）；使挺直（双肩）；使一致，与……相符；结清（账目）
items.def_en: 1. To adjust or align something so that it is level, straight, or at right angles. 2. To pull back and straighten one's shoulders. 3. To make things agree or fit together, or to be consistent with something. 4. To settle or clear a debt or bill.

items.def_zh: 瞄准，对准；力求，旨在；针对
items.def_en: 1. To point a weapon, camera, or hit directly at someone or something. 2. (+ to do / at) To intend or strive to achieve a particular goal. 3. (+ at) To direct a remark, product, or action toward a specific audience.
To aim a weapon or optical device using sights or visual cues
(+ sb/sth) to direct a sight, weapon, or instrument precisely onto a specific target
(+ sth) to align a sight, barrel, or implement straight towards a target

groups.summary_en: In this physical manipulation and spatial orientation frame, an agent points an implement, weapon, or body directly toward a target or makes perpendicular adjustments. While 'aim' is the dominant everyday verb for lining up sights or trajectory, specialized verbs denote mechanical or geometric squaring.
groups.summary_zh: 指将身体、工具、武器或视线精准指向特定目标或调整为垂直对正。

groups.name: Alter Trajectory & Channel Away · 偏转与改道 (Deflect, Divert, Reroute)
groups.tip: 受阻反弹或主动改变方向

items.def_zh: 使改走新路线，为……重新规划路径
items.def_en: to send vehicles, flights, or data by a completely different route
(+ sth) to deflect or turn aside an approaching blow, danger, or unwanted intrusion
(+ sb/sth) to intercept and force someone or something to change direction
(+ sb/sth) to defend against or push away an approaching attacker or object

items.def_zh: 使改道，转移（车流、水流或注意力）
items.def_en: (+ from/to) to turn aside traffic, water, attention, or a course from its established path

items.def_zh: （使）偏斜，（使）偏转；转移（注意力、批评等）
items.def_en: 1. To change direction after hitting something, or cause something to do this. 2. To divert or redirect attention, criticism, or blame.

items.def_zh: 使改道，使改变方向；转移（精力、资源等）；改寄（邮件）
items.def_en: 1. To send someone or something in a different direction or toward a new goal. 2. To arrange for mail or digital traffic to be sent to a new address.

items.def_zh: 使转变方向，将……转移到支线或无关分支上
items.def_en: to divert someone or something from the main track, plan, or subject onto a tangent

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this trajectory-altering frame express changing the heading, trajectory, or designated path of an approaching object, fluid, traffic, or resource. Deflect focuses on immediate angular ricochet upon collision or physical defense, divert emphasizes channeling a moving flow or attention off its original line, and redirect/reroute specify an administrative or deliberate systematic change of destination.
groups.summary_zh: 指改变运动中物体、流体或流向的既定路径，使其偏离原本航向或转向新终点。

groups.name: Ambush & Waylay by Manner · 伏击与阻截 (Waylay, Bushwhack, Ambush)
groups.tip: 埋伏在暗处出其不意发起袭击

items.def_en: to obstruct or seize someone or something moving from one place to another before they reach their destination
(+ sb) to conceal oneself in ambush to launch a surprise attack on an unsuspecting target
to lure or trick someone into a dangerous trap or compromising situation
(+ sb) to attack someone suddenly by leaping out or taking them entirely by surprise
to make a surprise attack on someone from a concealed position

items.def_zh: 埋伏袭击，拦截（waylay 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of waylay; to have waited in hiding to attack, intercept, or accost someone.

items.def_zh: 伏击，突袭；在丛林中开路
items.def_en: (especially North American) 1. To attack or ambush someone from a hidden place. 2. To cut one's way through thick woods or bush.

items.def_zh: 伏击，埋伏袭击；半路拦截（以便交谈或抢劫）
items.def_en: To stop, intercept, or attack someone unexpectedly from a hidden place.

groups.summary_en: Attackers lie in concealed waiting to surprise, intercept, or violently strike an unsuspecting traveler or military force.
groups.summary_zh: 潜伏在暗处出其不意地截击、袭击或拦截毫无防备的行者与敌军。

groups.name: Amorphous Amassing · 堆积与积聚 (Heap, Mound, Bank)
groups.tip: 集中堆放成堆或丘

items.def_en: to pile snow, earth, or coal into a high ridge or protective sloping mass
to draw earth or loose material up around plants into an elevated mound
to collect or accumulate loose items into an amorphous mass
(+ sth) to put things into a large, messy, or rounded mound
(+ sth) to arrange objects or allow items to accumulate in tall piles
(+ sth) to form loose earth, snow, or clouds into a steep ridge or mound

items.def_zh: 堆积，堆放；大量给予（赞扬、批评等）；装满
items.def_en: 1. To arrange things in a large, untidy pile. 2. (+ on/upon) To give someone a great deal of praise, criticism, etc. 3. (+ with) To fill something with a large amount of things.

items.def_zh: 堆成土堆（或土墩），堆积；筑堤防卫
items.def_en: (often mound up) To pile earth, snow, or other material into a rounded heap or bank.

groups.summary_en: An agent gathers or piles loose material into a rounded, voluminous, or sprawling mass without strict alignment. The verbs differ primarily in register, typical substances (earth, snow, dishes), and the contour of the resulting mass.
groups.summary_zh: 将松散物质大体堆聚成隆起的团块或土丘状，不强调整齐度。

groups.name: Anticipatory Projection & Mind's-Eye Imaging · 预见瞻望与意象具化 (Envision, Foresee)
groups.tip: 在脑海中描摹未来图景

items.def_en: to think about and plan for future events or prospective conditions
to imagine or expect beforehand that an event will happen and mentally prepare for it
(+ sth) to create a vivid mental picture or idea of something in one's mind
to predict or calculate future developments based on analysis or projective modeling
to imagine or form a mental picture of something that might happen or exist in the future
To know, realize, or predict beforehand that something will happen.

items.def_zh: 想象，设想（在脑海中勾勒画面）；使形象化，使显现
items.def_en: 1. (British English spelling of visualize) To form a mental image or picture of something. 2. To make something visible.
to have a presentiment of or act as a foreshadowing warning of an impending future event

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deliberately projecting oneself into future scenarios or mentally modeling prospective states of affairs, picturing upcoming events or possibilities with concrete clarity.
groups.summary_zh: 在脑海中对未来情境或可能性进行推演构想、心象具象化及预先察觉。

groups.name: Appreciate & Value · 赏识与珍视 (Appreciate, Value, Prize)
groups.tip: 认可价值并给予真诚赏识与感激

items.def_en: to consider someone or something to be important, useful, or of great worth

items.def_zh: 赞赏，欣赏，珍视；感激；理解，体谅；增值
items.def_en: 1. To recognize the good qualities or value of someone or something. 2. To be grateful for something. 3. To fully understand or realize a situation. 4. To increase in value over time.

items.def_zh: 珍视，高度重视；撬动，撬开
items.def_en: 1. To value or esteem someone or something highly. 2. (usually UK) To force open or move something using leverage (pry).
to hold someone or something dear and treat them with great care and devotion
(+ sth) to consider something to be very important, valuable, or significant
(+ sb) to admire, respect, and hold someone in high esteem
(+ sb/sth) to have a very favourable opinion of someone or something
to keep an idea, hope, or love deeply and tenderly in one's heart over time

groups.summary_en: Experiencers recognize the worth, qualities, or usefulness of an object, person, or relationship, varying from cognitive gratitude and evaluation ('appreciate', 'value') to treating something as an irreplaceable treasure ('prize', 'treasure', 'cherish').
groups.summary_zh: 感知并认可某人某物的价值与品质，从知晓感激延伸至格外看重与深情呵护珍视。

groups.name: Approach & Near · 接近与靠近 (Approach, Near, Close in)
groups.tip: 缩短空间距离

items.def_en: to come or go near to someone or something in distance or time

items.def_zh: 靠近，接近；着手处理；找…商量
items.def_en: 1. to come near or nearer to someone or something in distance, time, or quality. 2. to deal with a situation or problem. 3. to speak to someone about a matter or request
[I/T] to move forward towards someone or something in a purposeful manner
(+ on/around) to move steadily closer to surround or corner a target
to approach or come closer in space or time (formal or literary)

items.def_zh: 快速逼近，气势汹汹地逼近
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to approach someone or something rapidly, threateningly, or with great momentum

items.def_zh: 悄悄靠近，不知不觉临近
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to move slowly, stealthily, or imperceptibly closer to someone or something

items.def_zh: 汇聚靠近，从不同方向聚集接近
items.def_en: (+ on) to move toward the same point from different directions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate physical or temporal movement toward an entity or threshold, decreasing the distance separating them.
groups.summary_zh: 指在空间位置或时间跨度上朝着目标靠拢，持续缩短彼此距离。

groups.name: Arduously Journey on Foot · 跋涉与重步慢行 (Trek, Tramp)
groups.tip: 艰难费力或长途行进跋涉

items.def_zh: （赶着狗拉雪橇）在雪地上跋涉，赶狗拉雪橇；捣碎，捣烂
items.def_en: 1. To travel over snow with a dogsled, directing the dogs with voice commands. 2. To crush or mash food into a thick, soft mass.

items.def_zh: 长途徒步穿过；重步行经
items.def_en: (+ sth) to walk heavily and firmly across a wide area or difficult land

items.def_zh: 步履沉重地前行；缓慢跋涉
items.def_en: to walk slowly with heavy steps, especially because of tiredness or difficult ground
(+ across/through) to undertake a long, strenuous journey on foot

items.def_zh: （长途或艰难地）跋涉，重步行走；踩，践踏
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/across) To walk with heavy, steady steps over a long distance or across rough ground. 2. To step heavily on something; trample.

items.def_zh: 步履沉重地走；吃力前行
items.def_en: (+ through/along) to walk slowly with heavy steps because you are exhausted or carrying a burden

items.def_zh: 艰难跋涉通过；费力地走过
items.def_en: (+ sth) to walk slowly and with great effort through mud, snow, or harsh terrain

items.def_zh: 艰难跋涉；深一脚浅一脚地走
items.def_en: (+ through/along) to walk with heavy, slow steps, especially through mud or harsh terrain

groups.summary_en: This frame captures demanding, exhausting, or heavily paced overland travel on foot across rugged distances or harsh conditions. 'Tramp' emphasizes heavy, determined footsteps over long stretches, while 'mush' specifically denotes driving or traveling arduously with a dogsled across snow.
groups.summary_zh: 指在恶劣地形或长途路途中迈着沉重步伐、艰辛用力的徒步前行。

groups.name: Ascend & Elevate · 上升与抬升 (Rise, Ascend, Elevate)
groups.tip: 由低向高的运动

items.def_en: (informal) To raise or increase the amount, price, or level of something.
to lift or move something to a higher position, level, or rank

items.def_zh: 上升，升起；上涨，增加；站立，起立
items.def_en: 1. To move upwards or ascend. 2. To increase in amount, level, or value. 3. To stand up from a sitting or lying position.
to raise someone or something to a higher position or level using physical effort
to move vertically upwards from a lower to a higher position
(+ sb/sth) to elevate or raise something to a higher physical level
to raise someone or something to a higher physical, moral, or official position
to move upward or travel towards the top of something; formal equivalent of rise

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate vertical movement from a lower location or status to a higher one, either intransitively (ascending) or transitively (raising/lifting).
groups.summary_zh: 自下而上地垂直移动、升起，或施力将某物抬高。

groups.name: Ascend by Hand & Foot · 攀登与攀爬 (Scale, Clamber, Shin)
groups.tip: 手脚并用向上攀登

items.def_en: (+ sth) to move or climb up steep, rugged terrain hurriedly using both hands and feet
(+ sth) to climb quickly up a pole, tree, or vertical structure using one's arms and legs

items.def_zh: 攀登，登上；骑上；增加；发起，组织；安装，固定
items.def_en: 1. To climb up, ascend, or get onto a horse, bicycle, or platform; 2. to increase gradually in amount or intensity; 3. to organize or initiate an activity; to fix firmly in place.
1. (often shin up/down) To climb quickly up or down a pole, tree, or rope using one's arms and legs.
(+ up/over) to climb quickly but awkwardly with hands and feet over rough ground
1. To climb mountains as a sport or expedition.
(+ up/onto) to climb with difficulty and effort, typically using both hands and feet
to climb up or over a very steep or high surface such as a wall or cliff

groups.summary_en: Verbs specifying the physical manner of moving upward across steep, vertical, or rugged obstacles using hands, feet, specialized gear, or bodily grip.
groups.summary_zh: 强调手脚并用、攀援贴附或借助器械沿陡峭表面向上攀爬的动作方式。

groups.name: Ask & Inquire · 询问与打听 (Seeking Information or Answers)
groups.tip: 开口打听消息或提出疑问

items.def_zh: 询问，打听；请求，要求；邀请
items.def_en: 1. To put a question to someone in order to get information or an answer. 2. To request something or make a request of someone. 3. To invite someone somewhere.
(+ on/about) to ask someone a series of formal or probing questions to obtain detailed answers
to ask several people in order to get information, advice, or help
(+ sth) to seek official or systematic information about a matter
(+ sb/sth) to ask questions or examine facts to make sure someone or something is correct or safe
(+ whether/if) to ask a question, especially to clarify or express doubt about a fact
to ask someone for information; to investigate or look into something
to ask a suspect or prisoner systematic, rigorous questions closely and aggressively

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this communicative frame denote an agent posing questions to an interlocutor to obtain facts, clarification, or guidance, differing primarily by formal versus conversational register.
groups.summary_zh: 为获取信息、答复或指导而向对方提出疑问或进行询问打听。

groups.name: Assert Political Hegemony · 殖民与支配 (Dominate, Colonize)
groups.tip: 对群体施加绝对权力支配

items.def_zh: 统治，支配，控制；占主导地位
items.def_en: 1. To have control, power, or authority over someone or something. 2. To be the most prominent or important feature of something.
to reduce a country or people to the status of a dependent satellite or client
to subject another region, polity, or market to imperial or geopolitical hegemony

items.def_zh: 称霸；对…耀武扬威地统治
items.def_en: (+ sb) to act in a superior, domineering manner towards others; exercise autocratic sway over
(+ sb/sth) to exercise sovereign authority, power, or dominance over a territory or people
(+ sb/sth) to prevent a group or population from advancing or rebelling through oppressive control

items.def_zh: 在……开拓殖民地，使殖民地化；（生物）大量繁殖于，占领
items.def_en: 1. To send settlers to an area to establish political control over it. 2. (biology) (of plants or animals) To establish itself and spread in a new area.
to bring a territory, people, or group under complete political control by force

groups.summary_en: These transitive verbs denote asserting pervasive political, territorial, or structural control over a nation, community, or demographic group. 'Dominate' focuses on exercising overwhelming sway or mastery, while 'colonize' focuses on settling and establishing institutional hegemony over indigenous lands.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强权对领地、国家或族群实行制度性支配与统治。

groups.name: Asserting & Claiming Positions · 声明与立论 (Assert, Contend, Profess)
groups.tip: 明确宣告观点或立场

items.def_en: to state that something is the case, typically without providing definitive proof

items.def_zh: 坚持认为，固执己见地宣称
items.def_en: to assert consistently and persistently in the face of doubt or opposition
(+ sth) to state an opinion, argument, or proposition for consideration or debate
(+ sth) to firmly adhere to or maintain the truth of a claim or assertion despite challenges

items.def_zh: 断言，明确坚称；维护，坚持（权利或权威）
items.def_en: 1. To state clearly and firmly that something is true. 2. To behave in a way that expresses your rights, authority, or confidence.

items.def_zh: 坚决主张，声称；竞争，争夺；搏斗，应付
items.def_en: 1. To state or argue something strongly as an opinion or fact. 2. To compete against someone in order to gain something. 3. (+ with) To struggle or deal with difficulties.
to state something emphatically and positively as a confirmed truth

items.def_zh: 声称，自称（常指虚假地）；公开承认，表明（信仰或情感）
items.def_en: 1. To claim or assert something, especially falsely. 2. To openly state or declare a belief, feeling, or religion.

groups.summary_en: A speaker declares a proposition, personal stance, or controversial belief with conviction. Verbs distinguish between making emphatic factual claims (assert), maintaining an argument against opposition (contend), and openly avowing an inner conviction or identity (profess).
groups.summary_zh: 坚定阐述立场、论点或宣称某项事实/信仰，语体偏向书面与正规辨析。

groups.name: Assess & Evaluate · 评估与量化评价 (Assigning Comparative Quality or Ranking)
groups.tip: 考量品质并给出评级

items.def_en: (+ sth) to evaluate and mark someone or their performance based on criteria or numerical ranking
1. To estimate or assess the monetary worth, quality, or importance of something. 2. To regard something as important or valuable; cherish.
to evaluate an answer, performance, or asset by assigning numerical points
(+ sb/sth) to carefully examine and evaluate a person or situation before forming a judgement
(+ sth) to consider and assess the relative merits, qualities, or drawbacks of something

items.def_zh: 评估，评价，定级；值得，应得；被认为，被评价
items.def_en: 1. To assign a standard, value, or ranking to someone or something. 2. To be considered or have a certain ranking or value. 3. To deserve or warrant something.
to evaluate and classify according to predetermined quality levels or score bands
(+ among/as) to give someone or something a specific position in a graded hierarchy

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve judging an entity's standing, quality, or merit along a qualitative or numerical scale, ranging from subjective appreciation to calibrated grading.
groups.summary_zh: 依据一定标准或尺度对对象的优劣等级进行定级、打分或评价。

groups.name: Assign & Allocate · 分派与配给 (Assign, Allocate, Task)
groups.tip: 向上呈递任务或分配具体职责

items.def_en: (+ sth) to delegate or assign work or duties to external contractors or subordinates
(+ sth) to distribute or allocate tasks, penalties, or resources to individuals
[I/T] (+ to) to entrust a task, responsibility, or authority to a subordinate
(+ to/for) to officially distribute resources, funds, or tasks for a specific purpose
(+ to) to give a specific share of time, money, or work to someone as their due

items.def_zh: 派给……任务，向……指派工作；使辛劳，使劳累
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a specific task or responsibility. 2. To put a heavy strain on someone; burden.

items.def_zh: 分派，布置（任务）；指派，选派；分配；归因于
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a particular job, task, or responsibility. 2. To allocate or designate something for a specific purpose. 3. (+ to) To ascribe or attribute something to.
(+ among/between) to divide work, blame, or resources according to a measured plan

groups.summary_en: An authoritative figure or administrative system designates duties, roles, or portions of resources to particular individuals, groups, or objectives.
groups.summary_zh: 主管机关或管理者将特定职责、任务指令或资源配额分派给对应人员或用途。

groups.name: Assimilate & Internalize Information · 领悟与内化吸收 (Assimilate, Internalize)
groups.tip: 彻底吸收转化为自身知识

items.def_en: to take in and understand information, facts, or ideas comprehensively
(+ sth) to absorb facts, ideas, or impressions eagerly and easily into one's mind

items.def_zh: 领悟；消化吸收（知识或信息）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fully understand, absorb, and mentally assimilate information
to reflect upon and thoroughly master complex concepts over time

items.def_zh: 吸收，充分理解，内化（知识、思想）；（使）同化，融入
items.def_en: 1. to fully understand and absorb ideas or information. 2. to integrate or cause to integrate into a wider society or culture.

items.def_zh: 使内化，将……吸收为自身观念（或信仰）
items.def_en: to accept and absorb an idea, attitude, or belief so deeply that it becomes part of one's own character or thinking.

items.def_zh: 被完全理解；逐渐深入人心
items.def_en: to become completely understood and internalised over time, especially painful or profound news
to firmly establish habits, attitudes, or beliefs so deeply that they are hard to alter

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame scale in cognitive and psychological depth from initial conceptual integration of ideas into one's knowledge base to deeply embedding cultural values and morals into one's unconscious mindset.
groups.summary_zh: 指认知吸收深度的递进，从理解并吸收概念到思想观念的完全内化。

groups.name: Astonish & Stun · 错愕与惊愕 (Astonish, Stun, Daze)
groups.tip: 突发意外让人目瞪口呆、思维停滞

items.def_en: to shock or surprise someone by moving suddenly or making a sudden noise
(+ sb) to shock, surprise, or disconcert someone unexpectedly (usually passive)

items.def_zh: 使大为震撼；令…目瞪口呆
items.def_en: (+ sb) to overwhelm someone with immense surprise, shock, or admiration
(+ sb) to astound or strike someone with overwhelming amazement or disbelief

items.def_zh: 使震惊，使目瞪口呆；打晕，使昏迷
items.def_en: 1. To shock or surprise someone so much that they cannot react immediately. 2. To knock someone unconscious or senseless with a blow.

items.raw_cluster: 使震惊与惊讶 Surprise & Astonish
items.def_zh: 使十分惊讶，使大吃一惊
items.def_en: 1. To surprise or shock someone very greatly.
to astonish someone so severely that they are temporarily speechless

items.def_zh: 使目瞪口呆；使大吃一惊
items.def_en: to surprise or shock someone intensely so that they do not know what to say

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote striking someone with sudden disbelief, intellectual shock, or cognitive numbness due to something completely unexpected.
groups.summary_zh: 因完全出乎意料而使人震惊、发呆或暂时无法思考。

groups.name: Astound & Appal · 骇异与惊骇 (Astound, Appal, Horrify)
groups.tip: 惊骇万分令人难以置信

items.def_zh: 使毛骨悚然；令人骇然恐惧
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to feel uneasy, frightened, or horrified
to cause someone to feel extreme surprise, bewilderment, or disbelief
(+ sb) to become extremely agitated, terrified, or appalled, or cause someone to do so

items.def_zh: 使恶心骇然；使极其反感
items.def_en: (+ sb) to disgust or horrify someone deeply with something offensive or repulsive

items.def_zh: 使恐惧；使极度震惊愤慨
items.def_en: to shock and dishearten someone by being extremely bad, offensive, or gruesome
1. (US appall) To shock, horrify, or disgust someone deeply.
1. To shock or greatly amaze someone, leaving them stunned or bewildered.
to frighten or shock someone so intensely that they are unable to move or speak

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe overwhelming someone with profound shock combined with intense disbelief, dismay, moral outrage, or deep dread.
groups.summary_zh: 极大震惊并伴随强烈的难以置信、道德反感或骇怕。

groups.name: Attract & Captivate · 吸引与迷住 (Allure, Mesmerize, Captivate)
groups.tip: 散发魅力令人心神荡漾着迷

items.def_en: (+ sb) to attract someone powerful sensory attention and make them involved or captivated
(+ sb/sth) to attract crowds, interest, or attention on a large scale

items.def_zh: 迷住，吸引……的全部注意力
items.def_en: To attract and hold the interest and charm of someone intensely

items.def_zh: 深深迷住；使无法自拔地卷入
items.def_en: (+ sb) to irresistibly captivate or draw someone into a situation or emotional state
(literary) to powerfully attract, tempt, or charm someone
to hold someone's attention completely; to fascinate or entrance someone as if by hypnosis
To capture the fascinated attention of someone entirely, as if under a spell

items.def_zh: 用符咒般的力量迷住，使呆若木鸡
items.def_en: To hold the complete attention of someone as if by magic; entrance

groups.summary_en: A person, object, or phenomenon exerts powerful gravitational pull over someone's sensory or emotional attention. Progression scales from subtle seductive attraction ('allure') to captivating engagement ('captivate') up to total, hypnotic immobilization ('mesmerize', 'spellbind').
groups.summary_zh: 通过魅力、美感或神秘感完全抓住对方的注意力和情感，使其深陷其中。

groups.name: Attribute & Impute · 归因与归属 (Attribute, Ascribe, Impute)
groups.tip: 将事由归结于特定缘故

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) allocate or attribute a particular value, origin, or cause to something

items.def_zh: 把……归因于，归咎于；认为……具有（某种品质）
items.def_en: (attribute something to) To say or believe that something is the result of a particular thing; to consider someone to have a particular quality.
(+ sth to sth) explain the reason for something as being caused by a particular factor
(+ sth to sth) to explain something by assigning it to a particular cause or origin
(+ sth on sb) to assign the blame or responsibility for something bad onto someone
(+ sth to sth) to attribute the ultimate origin, cause, or source of something to a past event

items.def_zh: 把……归因于，归咎于；认为……属于
items.def_en: (formal) (ascribe something to) To consider that something is caused by a particular person or thing, or to believe that a work was created by someone.

items.def_zh: 归咎；把（恶行、不良动机等）归于
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) assign guilt, responsibility, or an undesirable motive to someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cognitive links where a quality, cause, origin, or authorship is assigned to a specific source or agent. The syntactic pattern typically features a direct object followed by the preposition 'to'.
groups.summary_zh: 将原因、结果、动机、品质或作品归咎或归功于特定主体。

groups.name: Authorize & Confer Rights · 授权与赋权 (Entitle, Privilege, Empower)
groups.tip: 给予法定资格或特殊特权

items.def_zh: 准许，颁发执照赋予资格
items.def_en: to give official or legal permission to someone to own, use, or do something

items.def_zh: 赋予……权利，使享有资格；给（书、文章等）定名
items.def_en: 1. To give someone the right or claim to have or do something. 2. To give a title to a book, poem, or other work.

items.raw_cluster: 优待与赋予特权 Privilege & Favor
items.def_zh: 给予……特权，赋予特殊待遇；特免
items.def_en: To give a special right, advantage, or immunity to someone or something.
(+ to do sth) to give official permission or legal approval for an action
(+ sb with sth) to formally grant or confer legal authority, power, or privileges upon someone
(+ sth in sb) to confer legal rights, property, or authoritative powers fully upon a person or body

items.def_zh: 授权，赋予自主权/法定权力
items.def_en: (+ to do sth) to give someone the official power, authority, or legal freedom to do something
to give someone the legal right to vote or official constitutional status

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with granting legal rights, institutional privileges, social exemptions, or authoritative capacities to individuals or groups. Verbs vary primarily by official status and the breadth of prerogative bestowed.
groups.summary_zh: 依照法律、规章或制度赋予当事人权利、特权或法定资格。

groups.name: Avian & Canine Vocalization · 鸟鸣与兽吠 (Twitter, Bay, Yelp)
groups.tip: 飞禽走兽的各种叫声拟音

items.def_zh: （鸟等）发出尖细的叫声；尖声鸣叫
items.def_en: Begin to sing or make a high-pitched chirping sound, especially like a bird

items.def_zh: （鸟）唧唧喳喳地叫；嘁嘁喳喳地讲，叽叽咕咕地说
items.def_en: 1. (of a bird) To make a succession of short, high-pitched sounds. 2. To talk rapidly and nervously in a high-pitched voice about unimportant things.
(of a small bird or insect) to make a short, sharp, high-pitched repetitive sound
(+ sth) Emit a sudden sharp barking cry or sound

items.def_zh: （尤指猎犬、狼）长嗥，引颈低吠；（人群）高声叫嚷
items.def_en: 1. (especially of large dogs or wolves) To bark or howl with deep, prolonged sounds. 2. (of a crowd) To shout loudly and continuously, often demanding something violently.
[I/T] (of a dog) to emit a sharp, explosive vocal sound

items.def_zh: 嗷叫；尖叫（因疼痛或兴奋）
items.def_en: (of a canine) to utter a short, sharp, high-pitched cry especially from pain or excitement
[I/T] (of a dog or wolf) to emit a long, loud, mournful cry

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specific acoustic sound emissions produced by animals (principally birds and hounds), categorized by pitch, rhythm, and acoustic intent (such as light twittering vs. deep howling hunts).
groups.summary_zh: 动物特有的发声行为，涵盖鸟类的清脆叽喳啼鸣到猎犬的深沉低嗥咆哮。

groups.name: Ballroom & Partner Dance · 舞步与交谊舞 (Waltz, Tango, Foxtrot)
groups.tip: 伴随旋律起舞摇摆

items.def_en: to perform a ballroom dance with alternating slow and quick steps
to dance the rumba, marked by rhythmic hip movements
to dance the lively Brazilian samba
to perform a fast, acrobatic swing dance to jazz music

items.def_zh: 迈步跳舞；步入舞池起舞
items.def_en: Go onto the dance floor and perform structured dance steps with a partner

items.def_zh: 旋转（舞伴）；（伴着舞步）旋转化圈
items.def_en: (+ sb) Rotate smoothly across the floor during a ballroom dance or waltz
To dance the tango.

items.def_zh: 跳华尔兹舞，与……跳华尔兹舞；轻快地走，昂首阔步；轻而易举地获得（成功）
items.def_en: 1. To dance a waltz, or dance a waltz with someone. 2. (+ in/into/through) (informal) To walk somewhere briskly and confidently, or accomplish something easily.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to performing specific structured social or ballroom partner dances, often characterized by particular rhythmic steps, glide movements, and hold positions.
groups.summary_zh: 指按照特定节拍、舞步或姿态跳交谊舞或特定舞种。

groups.name: Bat & Hit Baseball · 棒球击球动作 (Bunt, Homer, Slug)
groups.tip: 全垒打或短打碰撞球体

items.def_zh: （棒球中）短打，轻击；（用头或角）顶撞
items.def_en: 1. (in baseball) to hit a pitched ball lightly with the bat without swinging so that it rolls softly in the infield. 2. to push or butt with the head or horns.
(+ a bunt) to gently bat a pitched ball with deliberate touch so it rolls a short distance
to hit a baseball high into the air within the infield for an easy catch
[I/T] to hit a baseball hard and on a straight, low trajectory
to hit a ball with a sharp, sweeping blow
(in baseball) to hit a home run
[I/T] to strike a ball with great force and power

items.def_zh: 击出场外全垒打；强力击飞
items.def_en: (+ sth) to hit a baseball cleanly and powerfully beyond the outfield boundaries

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized sporting manipulation frame describe how a batter makes contact with a pitched baseball, varying by mechanics from an intentional soft deflection (bunting) to powerful driving strikes.
groups.summary_zh: 特指棒球击球中不同的击打手法与力量施加，涵盖短打触击与强力挥棒轰击。

groups.name: Be Full & Overflowing · 充满与丰足 (Abound, Teem, Swarm)
groups.tip: 数量极多或大量充斥

items.def_en: (+ sth) to be full of or intensely crowded with people, animals, or objects
to be so completely full of something that it cannot contain any more and overflows
(+ sth) to be extremely filled or overflowing with a feeling, energy, or objects
(+ with) to be filled or crowded with a moving mass of living things
(+ with) to be so full of something that it exceeds limits or margins

items.def_zh: 大量存在，充斥；盛产，富于
items.def_en: To exist in large numbers or amounts; (abound in/with) to be full of something.
(+ with) to be densely covered or packed with something prominent or threatening

items.def_zh: 充满，挤满，到处都是；（雨水）倾盆而下
items.def_en: 1. (teem with) To be full of or swarming with people, animals, or things. 2. (of rain) To fall heavily; pour.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict a place, environment, or domain existing in an exceptionally populated, densely occupied, or overwhelmingly plentiful state. They typically take prepositions such as 'with' or occur intransitively with locative subjects.
groups.summary_zh: 表示某场所或环境中某物大量存在、充盈流动或遍布。

groups.name: Befall & Happen Unto · 发生与降临 (Befall, Betide, Overtake)
groups.tip: 多指厄运或命运忽然降临

items.def_en: (formal/literary) to afflict or punish sb with hardship, plague, or calamity
(+ to) to take place affecting sb/sth as a passive recipient of an event
(+ sb) to unexpectedly affect, strike, or descend upon someone (of feelings, misfortune, or fate)
(+ sb) to descend upon or befall someone as a fate, duty, misfortune, or curse

items.def_zh: 突然降临到；灾难性袭向
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to arrive suddenly and overwhelm someone or something, often disastrously
(of an unpleasant feeling, event, or fate) to affect sb suddenly and unexpectedly
(literary) (especially of something unpleasant or unfortunate) To happen to someone or occur.
(literary or archaic) To happen to someone or come to pass.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this literary/elevated occurrence frame focus on unexpected, fateful, or adverse events descending upon a specific affected person or group. 'Befall' and archaic 'betide' explicitly construct an event or fate striking a recipient as object or indirect target.
groups.summary_zh: 强调（通常具决定性或灾难性的）命运与意外事件降临到某人身上。

groups.name: Beget & Sire Offspring · 繁衍与父系受孕 (Beget, Sire, Foal)
groups.tip: 由父系繁衍后代或血统传承

items.def_en: [I/T] to mate and produce offspring, or keep animals for reproduction
(+ sb/sth) Produce or give birth to young or offspring
Give birth to offspring, used especially of livestock animals
[I/T] (of fish, frogs, or mollusks) to release eggs, sperm, or young in large numbers

items.def_zh: （尤指雄性家畜）成为……的父亲；做父系配种
items.def_en: (especially of male horses or cattle) to become the male parent of animal offspring
(of a mare or female donkey) To give birth to a foal.
[I/T] to produce young or offspring through sexual reproduction

items.def_zh: （作为父亲）生下，繁衍（beget的过去式）；招致，引起
items.def_en: (archaic) Past tense of beget: to father a child, or to cause or produce something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this biological frame refer specifically to procreation and lineage generation, especially paternal generation in animals or archaic human genealogy, as well as delivering specific animal young.
groups.summary_zh: 专指雄性配种繁衍后代或特定动物产仔的生殖过程。

groups.name: Bend & Buckle Materially · 物理翘曲与起褶 (Warp, Kink, Buckle)
groups.tip: 受外力或环境致形状走样

items.def_en: (+ sth) Twist or bend out of a flat alignment into upward curves at the edges
to force an object out of a straight line into a curve or angle
to form into a spiral, curved, or upturned shape at the edges
to compress, pinch, or bend material into small regular folds or ridges

items.def_zh: 因受压而弯折变形；扭曲皱缩
items.def_en: Warp, bend, or collapse under excessive heat, pressure, or weight

items.def_zh: （使）弯曲，（使）翘曲；曲解，扭曲（心智等）
items.def_en: 1. To bend or twist out of shape, especially from the effects of heat or damp, or to cause something to do this. 2. To distort someone's mind or judgment.
to bend, collapse, or give way under compressive force or intense heat
To form, or cause something like a rope, hose, wire, or hair to form, a sharp twist or bend.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on linear or planar physical objects (wood, metal, wires, pipes) losing their straight, level alignment through heat, moisture, or compressive stress, developing curls, bends, or twists.
groups.summary_zh: 指木材、金属、管线等因受潮、受热或受压而发生弯折、翘曲或起褶。

groups.name: Bend & Flex · 弯曲与屈伸 (Flex, Bow, Stoop, Arch)
groups.tip: 关节屈伸或收缩肌肉活动

items.def_en: curve the upper body downwards or forwards toward the ground

items.def_zh: 弯腰，鞠躬；（使）弯曲，弯成弓形
items.def_en: 1. To bend one's head or body forward as a sign of respect, greeting, or submission. 2. To bend or curve under pressure.
[I/T] to curve the back or a bodily part into a graceful arc shape

items.def_zh: 弯曲（关节）；绷紧（肌肉）；（使）屈伸
items.def_en: To bend a joint or limb; to tighten or contract a muscle.
to bend the head and shoulders forwards and downwards
(+ sth) raise one's shoulders or round one's back posture defensively or compactly
to bend knees and body close to the ground, pulling limbs in
bend suddenly forward at the waist, typically from intense pain or laughter

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate curving, flexing, or lowering body parts, whether to stretch muscles, show reverence, or alter posture.
groups.summary_zh: 指弯曲躯体、屈伸肌肉或俯身行礼等身体姿态变换。

groups.name: Beset & Beleaguer · 困扰与逼压 (Beset, Beleaguer, Plaguer)
groups.tip: 四面包围苦苦相逼

items.def_en: to make repeated attacks on an enemy or harass someone continuously
(+ sb) join together in a group to attack, harass, or oppose someone
(+ sb/sth) gradually surround or approach nearer to threaten or distress someone
(+ sb/sth) exert relentless, overwhelming pressure or approach aggressively
to continually cause trouble, suffering, or distress to someone or something
to repeatedly pester or urge someone with questions or demands

items.def_zh: 围攻，包围；困扰，使苦恼；镶嵌
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive, 'be beset by/with') To trouble, surround, or harass someone or something persistently. 2. (archaic) To surround or attack from all sides.

items.def_zh: 围攻，包围；使困扰，使陷入困境
items.def_en: 1. (often passive, 'be beleaguered') To overwhelm or persistently harass someone with difficulties or criticism. 2. (military) To surround an enemy town or position with armed forces.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey being continuously harassed, overwhelmed, or surrounded by persistent difficulties, critics, or hostile forces, whether literally in combat or metaphorically in distress.
groups.summary_zh: 遭受多方持续围攻、逼压或被重重困难与问题缠绕。

groups.name: Besiege & Blockade · 围困与封锁 (Besiege, Blockade, Cordon)
groups.tip: 截断交通补给切断内外通道
