items.def_en: (formal/military) to surround a town or fortified place with military forces so as to besiege it
to isolate an area by forming a protective barrier of police, soldiers, or tape
to surround someone or something completely so that free movement is impossible
(+ sth) block all entrances and exits to prevent movement in or out of an area
(+ sb/sth) surround someone or something completely so that escape is impossible

items.def_zh: 切断（补给、退路或外界联系）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) isolate a place or force from supplies, reinforcements, or communication
1. To surround a port, city, or country with troops or ships to prevent people and goods from entering or leaving.

items.def_zh: 围攻，包围；围扰，蜂拥而至
items.def_en: 1. (military) To surround a town or fortress with armed forces to cut off supplies and force surrender. 2. To overwhelm or harass someone with persistent requests or questions.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this military and operational frame refer to encircling an enemy fortress, city, or coast with armed forces to seal off access, sever supply lines, and compel surrender.
groups.summary_zh: 用军事或警卫力量切断外部通道与补给以封锁围困目标地。

groups.name: Block & Seal · 机械卡阻与孔径密闭 (Chock, Plug, Occlude)
groups.tip: 密闭孔道阻隔不通

items.def_en: (+ up) to fill an opening or leak completely with a tightly fitted stopper or material
(+ sth) fill an aperture or channel tightly so that passage is hindered or stopped
(+ sth) become or cause to become wedged tightly and unable to move or flow
(+ sth) block a hole, pipe, or aperture tightly to stop fluid or passage
to push tightly into a confined space so as to prevent any further movement
to overcrowd, clog, or stop up a narrow channel or passage
1. (+ up) To block, wedge, or secure something (such as a wheel) with a chock to stop it from moving.

items.def_zh: 使闭塞，堵塞，阻隔；（上下齿）咬合
items.def_en: 1. (formal / medical) To block, close up, or obstruct an opening or passage; (of teeth) to meet or close together properly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail physical manipulation to restrict movement or halt fluid/light flow by jamming a wedge under an object or totally plugging and sealing an aperture or vessel.
groups.summary_zh: 指用楔子卡死机构以防滑动，或用物质完全塞住通道、孔道与管腔。

groups.name: Blow & Gust · 吹动与狂刮 (Blow, Gust, Whistle)
groups.tip: 气流呼呼吹送移动

items.def_en: [I/T] To pass or cause to pass gently through the air like a light breeze
(+ sth) knock something down by the force of moving air, or fall over from wind
1. (of wind or air) to move or be in motion. 2. to force air out through the mouth or into an instrument.
(Of wind) To move rapidly past an obstacle, producing a clear, high-pitched shrill noise
(+ sth) blow through an area or opening with a sustained, loud, high-pitched wail
(+ sth) blow violently and swiftly through a space or landscape
(Of wind) To blow in sudden, forceful, and brief rushes
(Of wind) To blow violently making a loud, mournful sound

groups.summary_en: Air or wind moves across a space, either as a steady current or in sudden, distinct kinematic patterns. Verbs capture different wind behaviors, from steady generic flow ('blow') to sudden violent surges ('gust') or high-pitched, howling passage ('whistle', 'howl').
groups.summary_zh: 气流或风在空间中的流动运动，体现为由平稳吹拂到突发阵风或呼啸狂风。

groups.name: Board Transportation · 登乘交通工具 (Board, Embark, Entrain)
groups.tip: 进入交通工具出发

items.def_zh: 上（船、飞机、火车等），登乘；寄宿，提供膳宿；用木板封盖
items.def_en: 1. To get on or into a ship, aircraft, train, or bus. 2. To live in a place and pay for accommodation and meals, or provide this. 3. (often board up) To cover something with wooden boards.

items.def_zh: 骑上，登上（马车、自行车等）
items.def_en: [I/T] to get up on a horse, bicycle, or elevated transport vehicle ready for travel
[I/T] (formal) to board an airplane, or cause passengers or troops to board an airplane
(+ sth) step onto or board a bus, train, plane, or ship
(+ sth) quickly or casually step onto a bus, train, or other vehicle

items.def_zh: 爬上，登入（大型交通工具）
items.def_en: (+ sth) board a ship, aircraft, train, or large vehicle by climbing steps
[I/T] (+ on/upon) to go aboard a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle to begin a journey; or put passengers aboard

items.def_zh: （使）登乘火车；（物理/流体中）挟带，夹带
items.def_en: 1. (dated) To board a train, or put passengers or troops onto a train. 2. (technical) To carry along or trap bubbles, drops, or particles in a moving fluid.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the act of getting onto or putting passengers/cargo into a vehicle, ship, aircraft, or train for travel. While 'board' is the universal everyday term, 'embark' often applies to ships/planes or suggests setting out on a voyage, and 'entrain' specifies boarding a train.
groups.summary_zh: 指旅客或货物登上轮船、飞机、火车等交通工具以启程出发。

groups.name: Bond & Fuse Materials · 熔接与层压 (Solder, Laminate, Weld)
groups.tip: 压制黏合成多层复合体

items.def_en: (+ sth) join or blend materials permanently into a single body using heat or chemical bonding
(+ sth) fuse separate pieces of metal or thermoplastic together by applying intense heat
(+ sth) unite two surfaces firmly by means of adhesive, pressure, or chemical treatment
to join or become combined by or as if by melting together
to join pieces of metal or plastic by heating them until they melt together
To join pieces of metal or electrical wires together with melted solder.
1. To cover paper or a flat surface with a protective layer of plastic. 2. To bond thin layers of material together to make a composite.
to solder with a relatively infusible and hard alloy such as brass

groups.summary_en: Someone permanently joins materials (metal, plastic, paper) using heat, adhesives, or pressure to create an integrated bond or composite structure. Verbs specify technical fabrication methods, contrasting surface coating, heat fusion, or brazing.
groups.summary_zh: 通过加热、压合或熔焊将不同材质牢固接合为一体的技术工艺框架。

groups.name: Breach Rules & Defy Authority · 违抗规章与犯禁 (Contravene, Flout, Transgress)
groups.tip: 公然无视规矩法律并加以触犯

items.def_en: to break or violate an agreement, law, contract, or code of conduct
(+ sth) Oppose, disobey, or breach an established rule, law, or principle

items.def_zh: 公开反抗；勇敢顶撞（权威）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Resist or openly defy a powerful person, authority, or bullying force
to openly refuse to obey or show respect for authority, laws, or conventions
[I/T] (+ on/upon) to act in a way that breaks a law, rule, or another person's rights

items.def_zh: 违反，触犯（法律、规则等）；与……相抵触
items.def_en: (formal) to do something that is forbidden by a law, rule, or treaty; conflict with

items.def_zh: 公然违抗，藐视，蔑视（法律、规则等）
items.def_en: to deliberately disobey a rule, law, or custom openly and without respect

items.def_zh: 违背，逾越（道德规范、界限等）；违反
items.def_en: (formal) to go beyond the limit of what is morally, socially, or legally acceptable; violate

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote infringing laws, limits, or social mores, ranging from technical non-compliance to brazen defiance and moral overstepping.
groups.summary_zh: 表示对法律、条令或伦理规范的违反，从技术性违规到公然蔑视抗拒。

groups.name: Brood & Sulk in Resentment · 郁结与生闷气 (Sulk, Mope, Stew)
groups.tip: 嘟嘴生闷气与暗自懊恼

items.def_zh: 无精打采地闲逛；郁闷消沉地走动
items.def_en: Move around aimlessly in an unhappy, listless, or resentful mood
to push one's lips forward in a petulant or sullen show of annoyance

items.raw_cluster: 愠怒与生闷气 Sulk & Pout
items.def_en: 1. To remain silent, bad-tempered, and distant because you are annoyed or disappointed.

items.def_zh: 闷闷不乐，消沉发呆；无所事事地闲逛
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To wander around feeling sad, gloomy, and sorry for yourself.

items.def_zh: （怨恨、烦恼）折磨，侵蚀（某人的内心）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Cause someone continuous inward anxiety, distress, or resentment over time
(+ over/on) to dwell unhappily on a subject that causes resentment or distress

items.raw_cluster: 使懊恼与使沮丧 Chagrin & Disappoint
items.def_zh: 使懊恼，使感到屈辱或失望
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive, 'be chagrined') To make someone feel annoyed, disappointed, and humiliated.

items.def_zh: 暗自发愁/气恼；内心煎熬
items.def_en: (+ over/in) to worry, fret, or seethe in quiet, agitated resentment over a prolonged period

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exhibiting silent, passive, or visible resentment, dejection, or annoyance instead of speaking openly. They range from withdrawn silence born of bad temper (sulk) and listless wandering in self-pity (mope) to inward emotional boiling (stew, brood).
groups.summary_zh: 因不满、委屈或受挫而保持沉默、阴沉抑郁地独处或暗中生闷气。

groups.name: Build & Erect · 搭建与构筑框架 (Erect, Rafter, Frame, Assemble)
groups.tip: 平地起高楼的建筑过程

items.def_en: to construct or put together the structural framing of a building or roof
(+ sth) construct or erect a building, fence, scaffolding, or upright structure
(+ sth) assemble and place structural components in their upright operational position
(+ sth) assemble structural or prefabricated framework elements to form a complete unit
to fit together the separate component parts of a structure
1. To build or construct a structure, building, or monument. 2. To raise something to a vertical position; to establish a system or idea.

items.def_zh: 用桁架构固，以构架支撑
items.def_en: to support or strengthen a roof or bridge with a framework of beams
(construction) To furnish or fit a roof with rafters.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to raising upright structures, assembling architectural frameworks, or fitting structural supports into place.
groups.summary_zh: 指竖立柱梁、搭建骨架及安装建筑结构构件。

groups.name: Burn & Overheat · 灼烧与过热 (Thermal Stress to Combustion)
groups.tip: 高温烈火炙烤，表皮碳化焦黑

items.def_en: (+ sth) Become hot or make something significantly hotter
[I/T] to burn superficially or slightly, especially so as to singe hair, feathers, or cloth
to burn or scorch the surface of something with sudden, intense heat

items.def_zh: （使）烧焦，（使）焦黑；炙烤；（使植物）枯焦
items.def_en: 1. To burn and discolor the surface of something with intense heat, or to become burned on the surface. 2. (of the sun or drought) To dry up or wither vegetation.
Become extremely hot or develop a high fever
[I/T] to partially burn or reduce to black carbon or charcoal

items.def_zh: （使）过热，变得过热；（使经济等）过热
items.def_en: 1. To become excessively hot, or make an engine, machine, or system too hot. 2. (economics) (of an economy) To expand at an unsustainably fast rate, or cause it to do so.
to burn something completely until reduced entirely to ashes

groups.summary_en: An object, surface, or organism absorbs excessive heat, moving from functional overheating and localized superficial singing/scorching to deep thermal destruction and charring.
groups.summary_zh: 物体受热温度过高，由热负荷超标演进到表面灼伤焦黑直至焚毁。

groups.name: Bury & Entomb · 安葬与埋葬 (Funerary Interring & Consignment)
groups.tip: 将逝者入棺或迁墓下葬

items.def_en: to place a dead body into a grave or the ground, often during a funeral
(formal/literary) to commit a body to the earth by burial
(+ sb) Bury a deceased person in a grave
(+ sb) Bury someone with solemn funeral rites
to formally deposit a corpse in a grave or tomb with funeral rites
To place a dead body into a coffin.
to place a dead body in a crypt, mausoleum, or solid tomb
To bury a dead body or remains in the ground again, especially in a different location.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the ritualistic or physical placement of a deceased human or animal corpse into a grave, coffin, tomb, or the earth.
groups.summary_zh: 将逝者遗体放入棺木、墓穴或地下安葬的殡葬行为与场景。

groups.name: Calibrate & Fine-Tune · 仪器校准与细微调整 (Calibrate, Tweak, Fine-tune)
groups.tip: 精细调校参数至合规状态

items.def_en: 1. To make small, fine adjustments to a machine, system, or plan to improve it. 2. To twist, pinch, or pull something with a sudden jerk.
(+ sth) calibrate a sensitive scale or measuring instrument to a precise baseline of zero

items.def_zh: 微调（飞行平衡、电路或设置）
items.def_en: to make minor adjustments to controls, sails, or balance mechanisms
(+ sth) adjust parameters or controls precisely to achieve optimal calibration or focus
(+ sth) adjust a mechanism, wheel, or instrument so that it aligns accurately and symmetrically
to make very small adjustments to a system or setting to achieve best performance

items.def_zh: 校准，标定；精确调节，仔细评估
items.def_en: 1. To check, mark, or adjust a measuring device so that it gives accurate readings. 2. To carefully assess or adapt something to a particular standard.
(+ in/out) to adjust an instrument or sight to read zero or align precisely on target

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to adjusting mechanisms, parameters, or sensitive measuring instruments to conform to a standard or achieve optimal operational accuracy. They span from informal minor tweaks to standardized scientific calibration.
groups.summary_zh: 针对仪器、系统或参数进行微小修正或标准标定，以达到精确状态。

groups.name: Capitalize & Provide Finance · 融资与注资 (Finance, Capitalize, Underwrite)
groups.tip: 注入资金支持项目

items.def_zh: 为……提供资金，出资；贷款购买
items.def_en: To provide the money needed to pay for something such as a project, business, or large purchase.
(+ sb/sth) rescue an enterprise or institution from financial collapse by injecting funds
(+ sth into sth) supply large amounts of investment capital or funding into an enterprise

items.def_zh: 对（财务/资本结构）进行资金支撑
items.def_en: (+ sth) strengthen a precarious balance sheet or venture by supplying financial backing
to pay part of the cost of something via public funds or organizational assistance
to provide a large permanent sum of money for a school, hospital, or chair

items.def_zh: 包销；承销；为…提供经济担保
items.def_en: to accept financial responsibility for a commercial project or issue of securities

items.def_zh: 为……提供资金；利用（capitalise on）；大写
items.def_en: 1. To supply a business with the necessary funds or capital. 2. (capitalise on) To use a situation to your own advantage. 3. To write or print in capital letters.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate institutional, corporate, or financial acts of providing capital, balance-sheet backing, or structural funding to establish or maintain a venture.
groups.summary_zh: 为企业、项目或交易提供资本金、资金安排或承销金融担保。

groups.name: Capture & Seize Power · 强占与篡夺 (Forcibly Take Control or Territory)
groups.tip: 武力夺取领土或控制权

items.def_en: to succeed in taking control of a place, city, or enemy position by military force
to take control of an area, power, or weapon suddenly by using physical force
(+ sth) Assume control of a territory, organization, or political power, often forcefully
(+ sth) Forcibly take power, authority, or control from someone after a struggle

items.def_zh: 攻占，夺回（失地等）；重新拿回；重拍；重考
items.def_en: 1. To take control of a place or position again by force. 2. To take an exam or photograph again.
1. (formal) To take someone's power, throne, or position illegally or by force.

items.def_zh: 费力夺取，强行攫取（控制权）
items.def_en: (+ from) to forcefully extract control, power, or authority away from someone against resistance

items.def_zh: 强征，霸占（设备、场所用于军事）
items.def_en: to officially take possession or control of something, especially for military or emergency use

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the forceful or unlawful taking of sovereign power, high office, or fortified positions. 'Usurp' stresses taking supreme authority wrongfully without legal right, whereas 'retake' focuses on recapturing territory or strongholds previously lost.
groups.summary_zh: 通过武力或非法手段夺取权力、王位或收复阵地地盘。

groups.name: Care & Minister to · 照料与看护 (Tend, Nurse, Minister)
groups.tip: 悉心护理与日常照料

items.def_en: to look after someone who is ill, very old, or young by attending to their needs
(+ sb/sth) take care of someone or something, attending to their health, comfort, or safety

items.def_zh: 照料，看护，照管；往往会，倾向于
items.def_en: 1. To care for or look after someone or something. 2. To regularly or frequently behave in a particular way or be likely to do something.
to take care of a child or dependent animal as a guardian for a period
(+ sb/sth) give delicate, sustained care to a sick person or weak entity to help them recover
(+ sb) provide attentive personal service to someone, especially an invalid or elderly person
(+ to) to tend to someone's physical, medical, or emotional needs with devotion

items.def_zh: 护理，看护，照料（病人或伤员）；给……喂奶，哺乳；悉心调养，怀抱（情绪或想法）
items.def_en: 1. To care for a sick or injured person. 2. To feed a baby with milk from the breast. 3. To hold or nurture a feeling, idea, or injury carefully.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve providing dedicated personal, medical, or maternal care to an invalid, sick person, or dependent living being over time.
groups.summary_zh: 针对患病、受伤或体弱者提供贴身看护、治疗与日常照料的关怀行为。

groups.name: Catch & Seize · 接拿与截捕 (Catch, Field, Intercept)
groups.tip: 在运动中拦截并接稳飞球

items.def_en: (+ sth) Make a sudden attempt to seize or take hold of a moving or static object

items.def_zh: 接球，防守（接防飞球）；巧妙应对（提问或批评）；派出（参赛队伍或候选人）
items.def_en: 1. To catch, intercept, or stop and throw the ball in sports like baseball or cricket. 2. To deal with or answer questions, criticisms, or telephone calls skillfully. 3. To put a sports team or candidate into a competition.
(+ sth) Seize or grab an airborne or moving object rapidly and abruptly

items.def_zh: 接住，拦截；抓住，捕获；赶上（车辆等）；染上（疾病）
items.def_en: 1. To stop and hold something moving through the air with your hands. 2. To capture an animal or person. 3. To reach in time to board a vehicle.

items.def_zh: 中途拦截，截击（飞行中的球或投掷物）
items.def_en: to catch or receive a ball or projectile before it reaches its destination
to catch suddenly or unexpectedly (informal)

items.def_zh: 拢住，兜住（四处乱滚或四散的物品）
items.def_en: to gather together or trap loose, moving objects with one's hands
to catch or seize something quickly, suddenly, and forcefully

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intercepting and taking hold of an airborne, rolling, or moving object, ranging from routine grasping in sports to aggressive snatching.
groups.summary_zh: 指在半空中或地面上出手截留、截获或抓住处于运动中的物体。

groups.name: Catch Fire & Blaze · 点燃与引燃 (Ignite, Flare, Blaze)
groups.tip: 引火生热点起火苗

items.def_en: [T/I] to start a fire by setting light to fuel, or to begin burning gently
begin to burn with flames
suddenly burn more brightly or intensely
suddenly ignite and start burning violently
to burn with a powerful, extremely bright, and hot flame

items.def_zh: （火焰）突然烧旺，闪亮；（愤怒、暴力等）爆发；（使）张开，（使）呈喇叭形展开
items.def_en: 1. (often + up) To burn suddenly with a bright, unsteady flame. 2. (often + up) (of anger, violence, or illness) To suddenly erupt or become worse. 3. To widen gradually at the bottom, or make something widen.

items.def_zh: 点燃，引发；着火，起火；激起，引发（冲突、热情等）
items.def_en: 1. To catch fire, or make something start to burn. 2. To trigger or arouse strong feelings, controversy, or enthusiasm.
[I/T] to catch fire and burn furiously in an extensive, destructive blaze

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the initiation and escalating physical intensity of combustion, from the first spark of catching fire to a sudden burst or roaring flame.
groups.summary_zh: 描述物体被引燃起火到突然迸发强光或剧烈燃烧的物理强度进程。

groups.name: Chatter & Ramble · 闲聊与信口漫谈 (Babble, Chatter, Ramble)
groups.tip: 信马由缰地随意漫谈杂扯

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休地唠叨，闲聊；（牙齿）打颤；（鸟或动物）鸣叫
items.def_en: 1. To talk quickly and continuously about unimportant things. 2. (of teeth) To knock together repeatedly from cold or fear.

items.def_zh: 漫谈，闲扯，语无伦次地说；漫步，漫游；（植物）蔓生
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/about) To talk or write for a long time in a confused, unfocused way. 2. (+ through/over) To walk for pleasure in the countryside.

items.def_zh: 胡扯，喋喋不休地说胡话
items.def_en: to talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way
to talk at length about unimportant things in an idle or childish manner

items.def_zh: 嗡嗡作声地长篇大论，单调啰唆
items.def_en: talk for a long time in a dull, monotonous, and boring voice
talk incessantly and boringly about trivial matters
talk at length in an aimless, confused, or disjointed manner

items.def_zh: 单调低沉地唠叨，冗长慢谈
items.def_en: (+ on) to speak continuously and monotonously in a boring tone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict informal, uncontrolled speech, distinguishing rapid, incessant trivial talk from disjointed, wandering, and excessively long-winded monologues.
groups.summary_zh: 指缺乏严谨结构、琐碎或漫无边际、信口开河的言语交谈方式。

groups.name: Chew Repetitively & Clamp Jaws · 咀嚼与咬磨 (Chew, Champ, Chomp)
groups.tip: 用牙齿反复嚼碎或撕咬食物

items.def_en: 1. to bite and grind food repeatedly with the teeth. 2. to think carefully about something (often with 'on' or 'over').

items.def_zh: 咀嚼，咬碎（医学生理用词）
items.def_en: [I/T] to chew food thoroughly with teeth to reduce it to pulp
continue chewing food or an object repetitively
(+ at sth) continuously bite or nibble at something hard

items.def_zh: 格格地咬，大声咀嚼；（马）咬嚼（嚼子）
items.def_en: to chew or bite noisily, vigorously, or impatiently
(+ on sth) bite down forcefully and noisily with the jaws
[I/T] (+ at/on) to bite or nibble at something hard persistently with the front teeth

items.def_zh: 格格地大口咀嚼，用力咬
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/at) to chew or bite with forceful, noisy jaw movements

groups.summary_en: An agent rhythmically grinds, masticates, or clamps teeth onto food or an object using continuous, forceful mandibular action.
groups.summary_zh: 上下颚持续用力开合，反复咀嚼、咬合或咀磨坚韧物件。

groups.name: Classify & Sort · 分类与分级 (Sort, Grade, Pigeonhole)
groups.tip: 按属性理清事物类别

items.def_en: (+ sth) separate things or people into distinct classes, groups, or categories based on specific criteria

items.def_zh: 整理，分类；拣选；交往，协调
items.def_en: 1. To arrange things in a particular order or divide them into categories. 2. To pick out or separate from others. 3. (archaic) To associate with or suit.

items.def_zh: 将……分级，按等级分类；给……评分，批改（作业、试卷）；给（路面）平整坡度
items.def_en: 1. To arrange, classify, or sort into grades or levels. 2. To give a grade or mark to a student's work. 3. To level a road or ground to a smooth slope.
(+ as/into) to assign items formally to a particular group or category based on shared characteristics
(+ as/into) to place people or things into specific conceptual groups
(+ sth) examine a large collection of items or information very carefully to find or categorize what is needed
(+ through) to examine information or objects meticulously to separate the useful from the unneeded
(+ as) to unfairly or rigidly classify someone or something into an overly restrictive category

groups.summary_en: An agent systematically evaluates a group of items or people and assigns them to distinct categories, ranks, or tiers based on quality, size, or specific criteria.
groups.summary_zh: 依品质、规格或特征将事物或人员系统性归类、分等或排序。

groups.name: Classify & Sort · 分类与归整 (Classify, Sort, Group, Size)
groups.tip: 按属性特征进行归并分组

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) gather or arrange people or objects into categories or sets based on shared characteristics

items.def_zh: 按大小排列（或分类）；给……上浆（或涂胶料）
items.def_en: 1. To sort, arrange, or grade according to size. 2. To treat or coat a surface with size or glue.
[I/T] (+ into/by) to arrange things systematically according to their type, class, or quality
to pass substances or candidates through a check or sieve to separate by suitability

items.def_zh: 将……降级；划分到较低等级
items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the rank, grade, or classification of something according to quality or size

items.def_zh: 把……分组，把……归类；（使）成群，聚合
items.def_en: 1. To classify or arrange people or things into groups. 2. To gather together or form a group.
to arrange or sort products according to their quality, size, or importance
(+ as/into) to categorize objects or data into formal taxonomical groups

groups.summary_en: An agent systematically evaluates, separates, and arranges objects or data into organized categories, batches, or graduated scales based on physical traits (such as size, shape, or type).
groups.summary_zh: 按照规格尺寸、品质或属性等特征，将杂乱物品或数据有序地归类、挑选分档。

groups.name: Cleanse & Cull · 剔除与剥离残渣 (Weed, Flesh, Cull)
groups.tip: 剥掉表层或剔除多余无用部分

items.def_en: to remove or eliminate inferior, unwanted, or harmful members from a group
1. (weed out) To remove unwanted or inferior people or things from a group. 2. To remove wild and unwanted plants from the ground or a garden.

items.def_zh: 刮除（生皮上的）肉；充实，丰富（常与 out 连用）
items.def_en: 1. To remove adhering meat and fat from the underside of a skin or hide. 2. (flesh something out) To add more details or information to something to make it fuller.
(+ away/down) to trim off an outer layer, skin, or excess surface material with a knife

items.def_zh: 剥除；剔除（残渣或无用部分）
items.def_en: (+ sth) separate and eliminate unwanted parts or impurities from an overall collection or substance
to pick out and eliminate weak, excess, or defective individuals from a population
[I/T] (+ off/away) to remove an unwanted surface substance or residue by drawing a hard edge across it
(+ sb/sth) find and completely eliminate unwanted, inferior, or harmful elements

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe manual, chemical, or selective processing to remove unwanted matter, residual flesh, impurities, or inferior elements from an organic substrate, collection, or hide.
groups.summary_zh: 从机体或群体中清理剔除残渣、赘肉或杂质。

groups.name: Climb Clumsily or Mount Up · 爬上与吃力登攀 (Clamber, Scramble, Mount)
groups.tip: 手脚并用攀爬或跨骑登上

items.def_en: to climb up onto a horse, bicycle, or elevated platform
(+ onto/to sth) climb up an incline, structure, or vehicle with difficulty, using hands and feet

items.def_zh: 手脚并用攀上；快速爬上
items.def_en: (+ sth) move quickly and with awkward effort up a steep slope or rough surface
(+ up/onto) to climb or move hurriedly or clumsily over rough ground using both hands and feet
To climb or move awkwardly and with difficulty, using your hands and feet.

items.def_zh: 重新登上，再骑上（马或自行车）；重新安装，重装（底座、展品等）
items.def_en: 1. To get back onto a horse, bicycle, or other mount after getting off. 2. To fix or attach something again onto a frame, base, or support.
(+ up) to climb quickly up a tree or pole using your arms and legs
to climb to the top of a high, steep wall, cliff, or obstacle

groups.summary_en: An agent moves upward or ascends onto an elevated object, surface, or mount, especially by using hands and feet or with physical exertion. 'Clamber' focuses on awkward, clumsy scrambling upward, whereas 'mount' denotes getting onto an animal, vehicle, or platform.
groups.summary_zh: 费力攀爬、手脚并用登上或跨骑上高处。

groups.name: Cling & Cuddle · 紧抱与依偎 (Cling, Cuddle, Snuggle)
groups.tip: 紧紧抓附依附不脱手

items.def_en: (+ to/with sb) hold someone close or lie snugly together for warmth or affection
(+ to/with sb) settle into a warm, comfortable position close to someone
1. (+ up) To hold someone or an animal closely and affectionately in your arms, or to curl up comfortably together.
[I/T] (+ against/into) to rest warmly and closely against someone or something
[I/T] (+ up/into) to settle into a warm, comfortable position close to someone or something
(+ to sb/sth) hold on tightly to someone or something for physical security or support

items.def_zh: 挤在一起；蜷缩缩成一团
items.def_en: to crowd close together, often for warmth or protection

items.def_zh: 紧紧抓住，抓牢；黏着，附着；依恋，坚持
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To hold onto someone or something very tightly, or to stick closely to a surface. 2. (+ to) To refuse to give up an old belief, hope, or habit.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe bodily postures of holding someone or something close out of affection, comfort, fear, or a desire for physical security.
groups.summary_zh: 出于依恋、寻求温暖或安全感而紧密贴近或拥抱。

groups.name: Clot & Congeal · 凝结与增稠 (Thicken, Coagulate, Clot)
groups.tip: 流体聚集成块，由稀变稠变硬

items.def_en: become more viscous or make a liquid denser and semi-solid
form into thick semi-solid clots
turn into or assume a jelly-like, congealed consistency
to form soft, solid lumps from a liquid, or cause blood, cream, etc. to thicken into lumps

items.def_zh: （使）变浓，（使）变稠，（使）变厚；（情节等）变得复杂
items.def_en: 1. to become thicker, denser, or heavier, or make something thicker. 2. to become more complex or intense.
to separate into curds or lumps, typically as milk turns sour or sauce breaks
to solidify or become viscous and jelly-like, especially on cooling
to change from a fluid into a thickened, curdlike mass, especially by chemical or heat action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe fluid substances (especially blood, milk, or culinary liquids) undergoing a colloidal transformation into a semi-solid or gelatinous consistency. They contrast along register and physiological vs. culinary contexts.
groups.summary_zh: 描述液体（尤指血液、胶体或乳液）聚集、稠化并形成半固态块状。

groups.name: Coax & Wheedle · 劝诱与哄劝 (Coax, Cajole, Wheedle)
groups.tip: 用甜言蜜语讨好哄劝或激发他人行动

items.def_en: (+ sb into doing sth) persuade someone gently or skillfully to do something
To persuade someone gently and patiently to do something; to manipulate something carefully into a desired position.
(+ sb) be exceptionally nice or flatter someone to persuade them to do what you want
to coax or entice someone with sweet talk, mild compliments, or subtle flattery
To persuade someone to do something by making promises or using flattery.
[I/T] (+ into/out of) to obtain something or persuade someone through continuous flattering words

items.def_zh: 激励，激起，促使迅速行动；镀锌
items.def_en: 1. To shock or stimulate someone into taking action. 2. To cover metal with a protective layer of zinc.
(+ into) to entice or lure someone cleverly into doing something via artful deception or charm

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe using gentle persistence, flattery, soothing tones, or artful blandishments to persuade someone to do something they are initially hesitant to do.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过甜言蜜语、奉承诱导或温和软磨硬泡来劝诱就范。

groups.name: Coerce & Constrain Action · 施压与强力迫使 (Pressure, Necessitate, Compel)
groups.tip: 施加外力强使服从

items.def_en: (+ sb) treat someone unfairly by making unreasonable demands on their time or service

items.raw_cluster: 使遭受与迫使 Subject & Expose
items.def_zh: 使遭受，使承受；使服从，使隶属
items.def_en: to make someone or something experience, suffer, or be affected by something unpleasant; bring under control
(+ into) to rush or coerce someone into doing something without fair consideration
(formal) to make something necessary or unavoidable; require
(+ sb) exert strong pressure or intimidation on someone to compel them to comply
To persuade or force someone to do something by making them feel anxious or obliged.
to make someone do something by using legal authority, irresistible power, or circumstance
(+ into) to force an unwilling person to do something by using threats or manipulation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate applying psychological, legal, circumstantial, or physical duress upon an agent to dictate or enforce their compliance.
groups.summary_zh: 通过心理、形势、法律或外力压制手段，促使或逼迫当事人屈服服从。

groups.name: Collide & Ram · 猛撞与冲击 (Bump, Ram, Butt)
groups.tip: 轻微磕碰颠簸的物理碰撞

items.def_zh: 碰撞，撞上；颠簸前行；碰伤
items.def_en: 1. to hit or knock against something accidentally, usually with light force. 2. to travel along in an uneven, bouncing way.
[I/T] to push, poke, or butt gently with the head or a tool
[I/T] to hit or push someone or something with the head or horns
(+ sth) collide violently and uncontrollably with a person, vehicle, or barrier
(+ sth) strike something suddenly and with immense momentum
[I/T] (+ into) to violently crash or drive forcefully into someone or something
1. to hit or drive into something with heavy force. 2. to push or force something into a place firmly.
(+ sth) crash into something with violent destructive force

groups.summary_en: A vehicle, person, or object strikes another forcibly. Verbs contrast light or incidental accidental bumping with deliberate, heavy, head-on battering designed to smash through obstacles.
groups.summary_zh: 以力撞击目标，从轻微磕碰过渡到故意猛冲撞击。

groups.name: Come or Bring to a Standstill · 停顿与停滞 (Halt, Stall, Arrest)
groups.tip: 运动中断戛然而止

items.def_en: to stop or bring to a standstill the progress, motion, or spread of something
(of a vehicle or moving person) to come to a halt
to slow down gradually and then stop completely due to friction or breakdown
cease moving forward or stop operating
(of an engine or machine) suddenly break down, stall, or stop working
(of a vehicle) slow down and come to a complete stop at a particular place
To stop moving or progressing, or to make someone or something stop.

items.def_zh: （使发动机等）熄火，抛锚；（使进程）停顿，拖延；拖延，支吾
items.def_en: 1. (of an engine or vehicle) To stop suddenly, or cause to stop suddenly. 2. To stop or cause a process to stop making progress. 3. To deliberately delay doing something or answering.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an agent bringing an ongoing motion, progress, or engine to a sudden or temporary stop, or a moving entity/process stopping of its own accord. While 'halt' denotes a decisive or formal stop, 'stall' emphasizes involuntary loss of momentum or intentional delay.
groups.summary_zh: 描述行进、行动或运转进程突然或暂时中断、停顿。

groups.name: Command & Marshal · 统率与节制 (Direct, General, Marshal)
groups.tip: 发号施令指引方向

items.def_en: to steer, lead, or direct an organization, project, or crew
be the person who makes the critical decisions and directs what should be done
(+ sth) take control or operational command of an organization, operation, or group

items.def_zh: 指挥，统率，指导；命令，指示；导演（戏剧、电影等）；指引（方向）
items.def_en: 1. To control, manage, or lead someone or something with authority. 2. To give an authoritative instruction or command to someone. 3. To be in charge of making a film, play, or show.
to gather together and organize people, troops, or resources in an orderly way for action

items.def_zh: 统率，指挥（军队等）；担任统帅
items.def_en: To act as a general; to command, lead, or direct military forces.
to act as the energetic front-line leader of a campaign, offensive, or initiative
to take control of resources, vehicles, or leadership authority arbitrarily for operational needs

groups.summary_en: A superior leader or military commander exercises high-level tactical oversight, marshaling personnel, resources, and movements toward a concerted strategic objective. Nuances span operational direction to grand battlefield generalship.
groups.summary_zh: 以统帅或指挥官身份全局调度兵力、部署资源并掌控行动全局。

groups.name: Compile & Catalogue · 编纂与编目 (Compile, Index, Tabulate)
groups.tip: 编年记载与编目建档

items.def_en: to make an index for a book or list of items, or enter something systematically into an index
(+ sth) prepare and write out a formal document, catalog, list, or plan
to make a complete, detailed list of goods, assets, or possessions
to produce a book, list, or report by assembling information gathered from many sources

items.def_zh: 将……载入编年史，按时间顺序详细记录
items.def_en: To record a series of events in writing in the order in which they happened.

items.def_zh: 将……编入目录，为……编制目录；系统记录，列举
items.def_en: To list, classify, and record items systematically in a catalogue.

items.def_zh: 将……编入目录，为……编制目录；系统记录，列举
items.def_en: To list, classify, and record items systematically in a catalog.
to arrange data or facts in tabular form or columns

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the systematic gathering, ordering, and listing of historical events, archival records, or inventory items into structured compendia or formal registries.
groups.summary_zh: 指将历史事件、档案或文献条目按序搜集、整理编排成册或建档编目。

groups.name: Condense & Recapitulate · 概括与提炼总结 (Summarize, Recapitulate, Sum up)
groups.tip: 归纳核心要点并做整体收尾

items.def_en: 1. To state or express the main points of something concisely (often used as 'sum up'). 2. To calculate the total of.
to state the main points or an overall evaluation concisely
(+ sth) be summarized or reduced to its essential, most fundamental point
(+ sth) give a concluding summary of the main points of a discussion or meeting
To give a brief summary or statement of the main points of something.
to state again briefly the principal points just made
to express the essential features of something in a very brief and pithy form
to repeat or summarize the main points in a formal discourse or lecture

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the act of distilling extensive spoken or written discourse into an abridged statement of main points, ranging from general speech to formal academic and legal registers.
groups.summary_zh: 将大量言语或文本提炼出核心要点，涵盖日常与严谨语域。

groups.name: Confer & Bestow · 赋予与授予 (Confer, Bestow, Endow, Vest)
groups.tip: 上级依制度赋予权利或资格

items.def_en: (+ with/in) to formally endow a person with authority, rights, or official ceremonial attire

items.def_zh: 归属于；赋予（权力、财产权益）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) confer legal authority, property rights, or powers upon a designated entity
(+ sb) formally induct someone into public office or confer official duties via an oath

items.def_zh: 授予，赋予（权力、财产等）；归属于
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'be vested in/with') To confer or give legal authority, rights, or property to someone. 2. To become legally owned or held by someone.
To grant a permanent, tenured academic or professional position to someone.
(+ on/upon) to grant a title, award, degree, or benefit formally as a high institutional body
(+ on/upon) to present an honour, gift, or right to someone as an act of generosity or esteem

items.def_zh: 赋予（才能/特权），捐赠设立
items.def_en: (+ with) to provide someone or an institution with a permanent source of income, quality, or asset

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the formal, ceremonial, or legal act of imparting rights, power, honors, privileges, or academic permanency onto an individual or entity.
groups.summary_zh: 依据法律、传统或权威机制，正式授予某人权力、荣誉、资产或永久任职资格。

groups.name: Confine & Imprison · 束缚与监禁 (Confine, Imprison, Incarcerate)
groups.tip: 缩限行动范围直至关押

items.def_en: to keep someone or something inside the limits of a particular activity, subject, or space

items.def_zh: 把……圈禁在狭小空间；束缚
items.def_en: (+ sb) confine or restrict someone within a tightly limited space
(+ sb) confine someone in a secluded place away from the outside world

items.def_zh: 关入笼中；严密封锁限制
items.def_en: to shut or enclose someone or an animal in a cage or cramped space

items.def_zh: 禁锢，限制（在狭小空间内）
items.def_en: 1. To confine or restrict someone to a small or narrow space.
(+ sb) confine someone securely in a prison, cell, or locked room
1. To put someone in prison, or to confine them and limit their freedom.

items.def_zh: 关押；监禁（法律正式称谓）
items.def_en: (formal) to put someone in prison or keep them in a place they cannot leave

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physically restricting a person's freedom of movement, escalating from confining someone to tight quarters up to formal penal incarceration.
groups.summary_zh: 剥夺行动自由，从限制在狭窄空间到正式入狱监禁。

groups.name: Continuous Fluid Motion · 流动与穿流 (Flow, Stream, Run)
groups.tip: 如水流般连续涌动

items.def_en: to move along with a continuous, smooth, quiet, and effortless motion
flow smoothly or overflow past a boundary or rim
(+ down/from) to flow in a steady liquid stream
enter or arrive continuously in large numbers or volumes like a flowing current
flow or stream continuously and rapidly out of an enclosure in large quantities
(+ through/down) to move without interruption along a defined trajectory, usually quickly

items.def_zh: 流动，涌动；畅流，连贯流动；飘扬，飘拂
items.def_en: To move steadily and continuously in one direction like water or another liquid; to move along smoothly and without interruption.

items.def_zh: 流，流动，涌；飘动，飘扬；流出（液体）；在线流式传输（音视频）
items.def_en: 1. To move or flow continuously and in large amounts, like a stream. 2. To wave or float outward freely in the wind. 3. To transmit or receive continuous audio or video data over the internet.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the steady, continuous, fluid-like movement of liquids, traffic, or crowds moving smoothly along a course or path.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、人流或车流沿特定通道或方向持续、平稳地漫流穿行。

groups.name: Convey & Carry by Specialized Means · 载运与运送 (Porter, Smuggle, Ferry)
groups.tip: 肩扛手提搬运货物

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) transport or carry someone or something away, especially in a vehicle or with effort

items.def_zh: 摆渡；渡运（人员或货物）穿过
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth across sth) transport people or cargo across a body of water or designated route
to convey passengers or goods regularly from one place to another across water or along a route
to convey goods or burdensome items in a vehicle or by hand over distances
(+ sth) carry something heavy, clumsy, or cumbersome from place to place
to pull or transport large quantities of heavy goods by truck, cart, or ship
To carry luggage, supplies, or heavy loads, especially as a porter.
To take, send, or bring goods or people secretly and illegally into or out of a place.

groups.summary_en: Agents transfer physical cargo or individuals using specific modes, channels, or physical roles, whether by manual conveyance, clandestine transit, or shuttling.
groups.summary_zh: 借助特定承运身份、交通工具或隐秘通道运送物资及人员。

groups.name: Convulse & Shimmy · 抽搐与抖动 (Involuntary or Rhythmic Oscillatory Movement)
groups.tip: 肌肉不由自主地剧烈痉挛抽动

items.def_en: to shake with a slight, rapid, tremulous movement
[I/T] to give a short, sudden, involuntary jerking movement

items.def_zh: 晃动，异常抖动，振颤；跳希米舞（摇摆臀部和肩膀）
items.def_en: To shake, vibrate, or wobble abnormally from side to side; to dance with smooth, shaking movements of the hips and shoulders.
(+ sb/sth) jar physically or cause to vibrate and jolt violently
to shake violently and momentarily, typically as a result of fear, cold, or disgust
become suddenly rigid, paralyzed, or painfully locked by muscle spasm
to experience sudden, involuntary, painful muscle contractions

items.def_zh: （使）抽搐，（使）痉挛；剧烈震颤，剧烈动荡
items.def_en: To shake violently with sudden, uncontrollable muscle spasms, or cause someone to do so; to undergo or cause violent agitation.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses involuntary, rapid, or uncontrolled bodily vibrations, scaling from subtle, rhythmic wobbles to violent, full-body physiological spasms.
groups.summary_zh: 身体出现的不自主或节律性震颤，涵盖从轻微摇颤到剧烈肌肉抽搐的强度谱系。

groups.name: Cool & Freeze · 降温与冷冻 (Cool, Chill, Refrigerate, Deep-freeze)
groups.tip: 降温结霜甚至冰封

items.def_en: to become less warm, or to make something less warm without reaching freezing
become lower in temperature, or cause something to lose heat
to make something thoroughly cold, usually in a refrigerator, but above freezing point
(+ sth) lower the temperature of food, drink, or an object significantly

items.def_zh: （使）结霜，（使）覆上霜；（在糕点上）涂糖霜
items.def_en: 1. to become covered with frost, or cover something with ice crystals. 2. to cover a cake or baked goods with icing.
to keep food, drinks, or medicine cold in a refrigerator to prevent spoiling
become completely covered with a layer of hard ice
to freeze food quickly at very low temperatures for long-term storage

groups.summary_en: This scale captures the lowering of temperature, progressing from gentle cooling to standard refrigeration and culminating in sub-zero freezing. Verbs vary primarily by target temperature and commercial/domestic intent.
groups.summary_zh: 按降温程度从温和凉化、冷藏保鲜递进至极端深度冷冻。

groups.name: Correct & Rectify · 纠错与扶正拨乱 (Correct, Rectify, Redress)
groups.tip: 纠正偏差恢复正常状态

items.def_zh: 纠正，纠偏；使扶直，使恢复正常（或平衡）；为……昭雪
items.def_en: 1. To correct a mistake, wrong, or unfair situation; make right. 2. To return or restore something to an upright or proper position.
1. To fix or remove errors, flaws, or mistakes from something. 2. To mark the errors in a student's work or a test.

items.def_zh: 解决；纠正偏差；理清错乱
items.def_en: (+ sth) resolve an error, misunderstanding, or confused and irregular situation

items.def_zh: 理顺；纠正解决（问题或失误）
items.def_en: (+ sth) rectify a problem, resolve a difficulty, or restore an irregular condition to order

items.def_zh: 纠正；拨乱反正；改正错误
items.def_en: (+ sth) correct a mistake, injustice, or malfunction so that proper order is restored
to make minor changes or improvements to text, law, or behavior to correct faults

items.def_zh: 纠正，矫正（错误或不良状况）
items.def_en: (formal) to put right an undesirable situation, mistake, or imbalance

items.def_zh: 纠正，平反，补偿（不公或损害）
items.def_en: (formal) to remedy or set right an unfair, undesirable, or unequal situation

groups.summary_en: An agent identifies an error, injustice, or physical misalignment and restores the situation to its proper, accurate, or upright state. Verbs range from routine marking of errors to formal moral redress or physically setting something upright.
groups.summary_zh: 发现偏差、错误或不公后，将其纠正、拨正或恢复到正确与公平状态。

groups.name: Corrupt & Degrade · 腐蚀与堕落 (Corrupt, Degrade, Deprave)
groups.tip: 内在品德变质从蚕食到堕落

items.def_en: to contaminate morally or impart an undesirable defect to character
to reduce the moral quality, value, or dignity of someone or something

items.def_zh: 拉下水，使（道德/地位）堕落
items.def_en: (+ sb) to lower someone's moral standards or social standing to an inferior level

items.def_zh: 引诱入歧途，使误入歧途
items.def_en: (+ sb) to encourage someone to do bad, immoral, or foolish things

items.def_zh: 使堕落，腐蚀；贿赂；破坏，损坏（数据等）
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone to become morally bad or dishonest, especially by offering bribes. 2. To damage, alter, or spoil something (such as computer data or a text).
to alter something from its original, rightful course or corrupt someone sexually or morally
(formal) To make someone morally bad or evil; to corrupt someone's character.
to corrupt someone morally through sensual indulgence and dissipation

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses moral and ethical decay, tracing how integrity, innocence, or character is systematically eroded. The scale progresses from taint and debasement to complete moral depravity and perversion.
groups.summary_zh: 道德伦理遭受浸染蚀退，直至走向极度堕落与败坏。

groups.name: Crash & Impact · 撞击与拍击 (Splat, Broadside, T-bone)
groups.tip: 猛烈冲击或高速相撞

items.def_zh: 发出啪嗒声地撞在……上，摔得稀烂；使发出吧嗒声撞击
items.def_en: (informal) to hit a surface with a wet, flat sound, or to cause something to land this way.
(+ sth/sb) collide with or hit another vehicle, object, or pedestrian
to strike a vehicle or object along the side with a glancing blow
(+ sth/sb) crash forcefully and violently into someone or something, often without slowing down
[I/T] (+ into/against) to crash or hit something with great impact and loud noise
to crash into the side of another vehicle at a right angle
(chiefly North American) to crash directly into the side of another vehicle.
(+ sth/sb) collide with an object or vehicle with tremendous, destructive force

groups.summary_en: Objects impact surfaces or other moving vehicles in specific geometric angles or explosive textures. Nuances emphasize specific impact modes such as a liquid/soft entity hitting flat with a splash, or a vehicle smashing perpendicular into the flank of another.
groups.summary_zh: 描述特定的撞击形态（如侧面拦腰猛撞、湿软物啪嗒撞碎）。

groups.name: Cross & Traverse Natural Obstacles · 跨越与穿行 (Pass, Ford)
groups.tip: 涉水越障从一侧到达另一侧

items.def_zh: 穿过，越过；传递；度过；通过（考试、法律等）
items.def_en: 1. To go across, through, or past someone or something. 2. To hand or transfer something to someone. 3. To spend time. 4. To succeed in a test or be officially approved.
[I/T] to go from one side of a road, river, or room to the other

items.def_zh: 涉过，涉水穿过（河流等浅水处）
items.def_en: 1. To cross a river or other shallow body of water on foot or in a vehicle.

items.def_zh: 抄近路穿过（田地、开阔地等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) pass through an area, field, or open space to take a shorter route
(+ sth) walk through shallow water, such as a stream or river, to reach the opposite bank
(+ sth) set off and journey directly across an expanse of terrain
(+ across/through) to walk through water, mud, or thick snow that impedes motion

items.def_zh: 横穿；横渡（宽阔陆地或水域）
items.def_en: to cross or travel across a wide or difficult area of land or water

groups.summary_en: This frame covers moving across, through, or over physical barriers, bodies of water, or stretches of land. 'Pass' is the general, neutral term for going across or through an area, whereas 'ford' specifically denotes wading across a shallow part of a river or stream on foot or horseback.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过、穿过或趟过河流、陆地或障碍物等自然空间。

groups.name: Cultivate & Condition Soil · 农田耕作与土壤改良 (Plow, Till, Harrow)
groups.tip: 翻耕破土以平整农田

items.def_en: to prepare land for growing crops by plowing or harrowing
(+ sth) break up and turn over compacted soil or land using a plow
(+ sth) dig and invert topsoil with a spade or implement to aerate and prepare it

items.def_zh: 碎土；使（结块土壤）破碎疏松
items.def_en: (+ sth) crush and aerate dense clods of earth to prepare a suitable seedbed
(agriculture) to break up and cultivate soil using a disc harrow

items.def_zh: 施石灰于（土壤等），用石灰处理；涂粘鸟胶于
items.def_en: (agriculture) to treat soil or water with lime to reduce acidity
to turn over earth with a heavy blade before planting
to draw an agricultural implement over plowed land to break clods and smooth the surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to mechanically working, aerating, or chemically treating agricultural soil to prepare it for planting or enhance fertility. They typically take soil, ground, or fields as direct objects.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过机械翻耕、平整或施加改良剂来处理农田土壤以备播种。

groups.name: Cure & Preserve with Condiments · 糖腌与盐渍 (Sugar, Salt, Cure)
groups.tip: 施加盐糖香料提升食物风味

items.def_zh: 在……中加糖，撒糖于；使甜蜜，粉饰
items.def_en: 1. to add sugar to something or coat something with sugar 2. to make something unpleasant seem more appealing or acceptable

items.def_zh: 给……加盐调味；（用盐）腌制；在……上撒盐
items.def_en: 1. to add salt to food to improve its flavor 2. to preserve food by treating it with salt 3. to spread salt on a surface such as a road
to preserve meat, fish, or other food by salting, smoking, or drying
to preserve fruit by cooking or coating it thoroughly in heavy sugar syrup

items.def_zh: 用盐腌制（肉类或鱼类）以长期保存
items.def_en: (+ sth) to preserve meat, fish, or vegetables by packing them in salt
(+ sth) to steep food items in brine or vinegar for long-term preservation
to preserve food in vinegar, brine, or a spiced acidic solution
to soak or preserve meat, fish, or vegetables in heavily salted water

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe treating ingredients with fundamental chemical preserving agents—chiefly sugar, salt, or smoke—to cure, preserve, dehydrate, or heavily sweeten/salinate them as part of preparation or storage.
groups.summary_zh: 用糖、盐等基质进行腌制、脱水保鲜或加味处理。

groups.name: Decide & Choose · 决定与决断 (Decide, Settle on, Opt)
groups.tip: 权衡利弊做出裁决

items.def_en: to make a choice or judgment about something after consideration

items.def_zh: 决定，下定决心；支配，决定；查明，测定
items.def_en: 1. to decide firmly or officially. 2. to control or influence something directly. 3. to discover or calculate facts about something.
to make a firm and formal decision to do something
to choose or agree upon something after consideration or discussion
(+ sth/sb) make a final choice among two or more possibilities after consideration
(+ sth) choose one particular option or course of action instead of other alternatives
(+ sth/sb) choose an option or candidate decisively, often after prolonged hesitation
to make a choice or decision from a range of possibilities

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the cognitive process of reaching a conclusion or selecting an alternative after deliberation. 'Determine' implies firm or authoritative conclusion, whereas 'opt' highlights picking one alternative among many.
groups.summary_zh: 指在权衡各种选项后做出明确决断或选定特定行动方案。

groups.name: Deem & Judge Status · 视作与判定 (Deem, Repute, Regard)
groups.tip: 对事物形成主观定性判断

items.def_en: to form an authoritative opinion or conclusion about the condition or status of something
To consider, judge, or regard in a specified way.
(+ sb/sth as ...) regard, evaluate, or consider someone or something as possessing a certain character or status

items.def_zh: 视为；认为……具有特定属性
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth as ...) judge, deem, or evaluate someone or something to be in a specified condition

items.def_zh: 算作；视为（符合资格或状态）
items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) be judged or deemed officially or functionally equivalent to a specified status
(chiefly passive) to consider or regard someone or something as being a specified thing

items.def_zh: 普遍认为，把……称为，普遍认定
items.def_en: (chiefly passive) To be generally considered or said to be something.
(+ to be / as) (formal/legal) to declare or judge officially through formal ruling

groups.summary_en: An evaluator, court, or public opinion holds, judges, or treats an entity as possessing a specified status, quality, or condition. Verbs vary primarily in official judicial weight versus widespread popular repute.
groups.summary_zh: 由评判者或公众舆论基于评估将某事物视作或判定为某种状态。

groups.name: Defend & Counter · 防御预备与反制对抗 (Counteract, Forearm, Neutralize)
groups.tip: 御敌于外并保护己方

items.def_en: to protect against physical attack, aggression, or danger
to successfully push away or defend oneself against an incoming blow or assault

items.def_zh: 避开；抵挡防范（攻击或厄运）
items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) protect oneself against or prevent an impending attack, danger, or evil effect
(+ sb/sth) successfully resist an advancing enemy, opponent, or attack to prevent them from breaking through
(+ sb/sth) repel an attacker or overcome an aggressive physical threat through vigorous defense
to render an opposing threat or hostile force completely harmless or ineffective
1. (usually passive) To prepare or equip someone in advance against an expected danger or difficulty.
1. To reduce or prevent the bad effect of something by acting against it.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on proactively taking defensive measures in anticipation of an attack or actively neutralizing the adverse force, effect, or hostility of an opponent.
groups.summary_zh: 指事前采取防范准备，或在遭受对抗、攻击时采取行动抵消其威胁。

groups.name: Deficit to Gradual Depletion · 匮乏与渐进消损 (Lack, Sap, Drain)
groups.tip: 存量不足乃至不断耗损衰竭

items.def_zh: 逐渐抽走；缓慢损耗（资源、压力）
items.def_en: (+ sth) gradually release, siphon off, or drain away a resource, fluid, or pressure over time

items.def_zh: 逐渐枯竭；渐渐减弱消散
items.def_en: gradually diminish in strength, substance, or volume until completely gone
1. To not have any or not have enough of something.
to gradually deprive someone or something of strength, money, or resources completely

items.def_zh: 逐渐削弱，耗尽（精力、元气、信心等）；挖地道破坏（城墙地基）
items.def_en: 1. To gradually weaken or drain away someone's strength, energy, or confidence. 2. To undermine the foundations of a fortification by digging underneath.
to reduce the amount, supply, or value of something substantially
gradually disappear or diminish completely, especially energy, confidence, or resources

items.def_zh: 榨取；大量抽耗（资金或资源）
items.def_en: to extort, drain, or severely exhaust financial or material resources over time

groups.summary_en: A subject experiences an absence or gradual loss of vital resources, strength, or substance. Intensity escalates from passive deficiency or absence of an asset (lack) to steady, insidious undermining (sap), heavy systematic emptying (drain), and total exhaustion of reserves (bleed).
groups.summary_zh: 指资源或能量由本身匮乏，进阶到被持续抽吸、渐进耗损乃至荡尽。

groups.name: Deform & Distort Shape or Truth · 扭曲形相与变形 (Distort, Deform, Contort)
groups.tip: 受力变形偏离原本形状

items.def_en: (+ sth) distort the physical form or structure of an object so it loses its natural shape
(+ sth) deliberately alter the intended meaning of words or facts to mislead
1. To pull or twist something out of its natural, normal, or original shape. 2. To report or represent information in an untrue or misleading way.
to give an abnormal, uneven, or ugly shape to something
To spoil or change the normal or natural shape of something, especially through pressure or stress.
to reproduce a message, sound, or report in a confused or distorted way
to twist or wrench out of normal shape, especially violently or grotesquely

items.def_zh: 严重损毁变形，割裂扯碎
items.def_en: to destroy the proper form of something by cutting, tearing, or crushing severely

groups.summary_en: Centers on significantly altering the natural shape, appearance, sound, or conceptual truth of something so that its proportional harmony is lost. Applies equally to physical forms, facial expressions, and abstract representations like facts or data.
groups.summary_zh: 指严重改变形貌、面容、声音或事实，使其失真或不成原样。

groups.name: Defrost & Melt · 解冻与消融 (Thaw, Defrost, Melt)
groups.tip: 受热冰雪消融，坚冰化为流水

items.def_en: to remove ice or frost mechanically or chemically from the surface of something

items.def_zh: （使）融化，（使）解冻；（使态度、关系等）缓和
items.def_en: 1. (of ice, snow, or frozen food) To melt or become liquid or soft again. 2. (of relations or attitudes) To become warmer, friendlier, or more relaxed.
dissolve or turn to liquid and disappear through melting, as snow or ice does under warmth
(+ sth) become unfrozen completely, or cause a frozen object or food item to return to room temperature
To remove ice or frost from a refrigerator, vehicle windshield, etc., or to thaw frozen food before cooking.

items.def_zh: 融化；将（金属、固态物）熔解成液体
items.def_en: (+ sth) heat a solid until it liquefies completely, or liquefy through intense heat
[I/T] to change or cause to change completely from a solid state to a liquid by heat
(formal/technical) to dissolve gradually and turn completely into liquid by absorbing moisture or heating

groups.summary_en: A frozen or solid substance transitions to a liquid, softened, or ice-free state through the application or absorption of heat. Verbs escalate from gentle surface de-icing to total phase change into liquid.
groups.summary_zh: 因受热由冻结或固态逐渐变软、除冰直至完全液化。

groups.name: Degrade & Debase · 贬值与品质劣化 (Cheapen, Taint, Debase)
groups.tip: 降低品质或使其价值贬损

items.def_en: to make something weaker or less effective by adding extraneous elements
to lower the taste, aesthetic, or intellectual standard of something
(+ sth) lower the level, intrinsic value, or moral standing of something

items.def_zh: 稀释；贬低削弱（质量、效力）
items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the quality, strength, purity, or effectiveness of something

items.def_zh: 贬低（人格、价值等），降低……的品格；使贬值，使降价
items.def_en: 1. to lower the moral value, respect, or quality of someone or something 2. to lower the price or cost of something

items.def_zh: 降低……的品质（或价值、道德）；使（硬币、货币）贬值
items.def_en: to reduce the quality, value, or moral character of someone or something; to lower the value of a currency
to corrupt or debase something by adding inferior, foreign, or improper materials

items.def_zh: 败坏，腐蚀（质地或纯洁性）
items.def_en: to spoil or taint the integrity, purity, or original state of something completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote lowering the intrinsic quality, moral purity, currency value, or artistic worth of something, scaling from vulgarization to fundamental corruption and debasement.
groups.summary_zh: 使事物的内在品质、纯度、格调或价值逐步劣化与降格。

groups.name: Deregulate & Liberalize · 放宽管制与解禁 (Deregulate, Liberalize, Unbridle)
groups.tip: 打破垄断束缚并放宽行政管制

items.def_zh: 解除管制；取消价格或行业限制
items.def_en: to free an economy, price, or product from government controls
to release from severe legal, administrative, or literal shackles

items.def_zh: 开放，解除（市场、贸易等）限制
items.def_en: (+ sth) remove barriers or regulations to make trade, an economy, or an industry accessible to all
(+ sth/sb) make restrictions, rules, or enforcement less severe or burdensome
to release someone or something from regulatory or contractual constraints

items.def_zh: 放开限制，解除束缚；除去……的马辔
items.def_en: 1. To free something from restraint, inhibition, or control. 2. To remove the bridle from a horse.

items.def_zh: 解除对……的管制，放宽对……的行政限制
items.def_en: To remove government controls, rules, or regulations from an industry, market, or activity.

items.raw_cluster: 放宽与自由化 Relax & Liberalize
items.def_en: To make laws, systems, or trade regulations less strict, allowing greater freedom.

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote dismantling government, economic, or behavioral restrictions to facilitate open, unhindered activity. They differ by domain: policy-level statutory rollback vs. removal of civil/trade barriers vs. literary release of wild impulses.
groups.summary_zh: 指废除制度束缚、放宽行业政策管制或解开行为限制。

groups.name: Design & Devise · 设计与构想 (Formulate Functional or Aesthetic Structures)
groups.tip: 构思构想外观或实现方案

items.def_en: 1. To plan and make drawings or models showing the look and function of something before it is built or made. 2. To intend or plan something for a particular purpose.
(+ into/from) to shape or design an object skillfully using specific materials or forms
(+ sth) plan or design the details of something carefully
(+ sth) arrange or plan the physical or visual design of something
(+ sth) outline or draw the rough structure or preliminary design of something
to plan or invent a complex system, procedure, or plan from existing principles
to draw up a detailed technical plan or architectural scheme for an artifact or project

items.def_zh: 使风格化，使程式化（按特定艺术样式设计）
items.def_en: To design, represent, or perform something according to a particular conventional or non-realistic artistic style.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on conceiving, planning, and patterning objects, systems, or visual forms before fabrication, balancing utilitarian structure with deliberate stylistic choices.
groups.summary_zh: 在制造前对物品、外观或系统进行统筹规划与艺术/功能性设计。

groups.name: Desperately Beg & Supplicate · 恳求与哀求 (Beg, Plead, Implore)
groups.tip: 从寻常请求到哀求乞求

items.def_en: (+ sb) make an earnest, serious, or urgent request to someone in authority
to ask someone earnestly or desperately for food, money, or a favor
to ask someone earnestly and anxiously to do something
(+ sth) plead desperately or vocally for help, mercy, or relief

items.def_zh: 恳求，乞求；（在法庭上）认罪或抗辩；为……辩护
items.def_en: 1. to ask for something in an earnest and emotional way; to beg 2. to state formally in court whether you are guilty or not guilty of a crime
to ask someone desperately and earnestly to do something; to beg
to ask urgently and fervently for something, typically expressing deep distress
to ask or beg for something humbly and earnestly, especially from a deity or superior

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe urgent, emotionally fraught, or desperate entreaties made to an authority or another person, typically marked by humility, vulnerability, or deep distress. They range from earnest legal or emotional pleading to abject, desperate supplication.
groups.summary_zh: 带有强烈情绪、卑微或绝望色彩的恳求与哀求。

groups.name: Despise & Disdain · 鄙视与蔑视 (Despise, Disdain, Scorn)
groups.tip: 居高临下瞧不起与冷笑鄙薄

items.def_en: to regard someone as socially, intellectually, or morally inferior
(+ sb/sth) regard someone or something as inferior, worthless, or contemptible
(+ sth/sb) reject or show overt disdain for something as being beneath one's dignity
to express a low opinion of someone or something; to belittle
To dislike and look down on someone or something with strong contempt.
1. (formal) To regard or treat someone or something with contempt as unworthy of respect. 2. To refuse or reject something because of feeling superior.

items.def_zh: 鄙视，轻蔑；不屑接受，摒弃
items.def_en: 1. To feel or show contempt and disdain for someone or something. 2. To reject or refuse something with contempt.

items.def_zh: 傲慢地摒弃；轻蔑地拒绝
items.def_en: to reject with contempt or disdain, especially an offer, person, or overture

groups.summary_en: Verbs signifying an attitude of extreme disregard, viewing a target as worthless, despicable, or far beneath one's dignity and standards.
groups.summary_zh: 表示将某人或某物视为无价值、低下或不值一顾的蔑视态度。

groups.name: Deter & Ward off · 威慑防范与阻止侵扰 (Deter, Dissuade, Ward off)
groups.tip: 预先防范或威慑以避灾害

items.def_zh: 挡住，防住，避开（危险、厄运）
items.def_en: to prevent someone or something bad from affecting, damaging, or reaching one
to scare away potential intruders or threats by displaying formidable force
(+ sb/sth) deter an intruder, attacker, or competitor by intimidating them
(+ sb/sth) resist or delay an impending attack, threat, or adversary
(+ sth) prevent an impending problem or attack from developing or arriving

items.def_zh: 威慑，吓住；阻止，使打消念头
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To make someone decide not to do something by making them realize the difficulties or bad consequences.

items.def_zh: 避开，延缓，推迟（坏事）；击穿，敲破
items.def_en: 1. ('stave off') To temporarily prevent or delay something bad from happening. 2. ('stave in') To break or smash something inward.
(+ from) to persuade someone not to take a particular harmful or unwise course of action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on preventing an impending harm, attack, or undesirable action, either by intimidating the actor with punitive consequences or by proactively deflecting the threat.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过惩罚威慑阻止不良企图，或主动筑起防线避开、延缓危险侵害。

groups.name: Deteriorate & Decay · 恶化与衰败 (Decline in Quality or Condition)
groups.tip: 局势日趋恶化更为严重

items.def_en: to gradually become less, worse, or lower in quality or strength
gradually deteriorate in quality, health, or overall condition
To become worse, or to make something become worse, more severe, or more difficult.
lose structural integrity, health, or functional order progressively
disintegrate or decay into pieces through age, wear, or neglect
[I/T] to be destroyed gradually by natural processes, or decline in health and vigor
To become progressively worse in quality, condition, or value over time.
(+ into) to pass into an inferior, weaker, or less desirable state

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses entities undergoing progressive loss of quality, strength, health, or structural integrity. 'Worsen' covers any general downward trend, whereas 'decay' and 'degenerate' signify advanced biological or moral breakdown.
groups.summary_zh: 描述事物质量、健康或状态逐步走低乃至崩坏。

groups.name: Develop & Evolve · 发展与演进 (Progress, Evolve, Mature)
groups.tip: 事物逐步向前迈进与深化拓展

items.def_en: [I/T] to grow or cause to grow into a more advanced, complete, or elaborate state
[I/T] to move forward in position, development, or technological maturity
To develop, advance, or improve gradually over time.

items.def_zh: 逐渐演变，逐步发展；（生物）进化
items.def_en: To develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complex form; to undergo biological evolution.
[I/T] to become fully developed or reach a sophisticated, stable state
(+ sth) gradually develop or mature into a larger, more advanced state

items.def_zh: 顺利成型；显现良好发展势头
items.def_en: develop or progress in a promising, structured, or mature manner
(+ sb/sth) help someone or something to develop, improve, or make progress

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entities advancing through natural, historical, or planned stages toward a more complex, advanced, or complete state. 'Progress' emphasizes forward linear motion or improvement, while 'evolve' highlights gradual adaptation and structural transformation over time.
groups.summary_zh: 描述事物按阶段向前推进、深化或逐步演化为更成熟高级形态的过程。

groups.name: Dirty & Stain · 弄脏与沾污 (Dirty, Smut, Soil, Befoul)
groups.tip: 沾染尘垢或留下顽固污迹

items.def_en: (+ sth) make something dirty, untidy, or soiled
to make something physically unclean, particularly with dirt, mud, or waste

items.def_zh: 弄脏，熏黑；（谷物等）感染黑穗病
items.def_en: To mark or stain something with soot or dirt; (of crops) to infect or become infected with smut disease.
(+ sth) cover or spoil something with dirt, mud, or grime
(+ sth) cover or dirty a surface with greasy, sticky, or smudged marks
To make something dirty or unclean.
to blacken or cover deeply with ingrained dirt or grime
to make something foul, filthy, or offensively impure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate transferring grime, soot, or pollution onto a clean surface, varying from mild smudging to heavy, vile contamination.
groups.summary_zh: 指使物体表面沾上灰尘、黑垢或遭受严重污损。

groups.name: Discuss & Deliberate Together · 商讨与研商 (Discuss, Confer, Deliberate)
groups.tip: 各抒己见共同探讨议题

items.def_en: To talk about something with other people in order to exchange opinions or reach a decision; to examine a topic in speech or writing.
(+ with) to discuss something with someone in order to seek their advice or consent

items.def_zh: 和谈；会谈（特指敌对双方）
items.def_en: (+ with) to hold formal discussions with an opponent or opposing side to discuss terms
(+ sth) to discuss a problem, plan, or situation thoroughly with someone

items.def_zh: 深入讨论以解决（分歧或细节）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discuss something in detail until an agreement, solution, or decision is reached

items.def_zh: 非正式地讨论或探讨（想法、计划）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discuss an idea, plan, or suggestion informally or casually
(+ on/about) to discuss something thoroughly and formally before taking a critical decision or verdict

items.def_zh: 商讨，协商；授予，赋予（奖项、学位、权利等）
items.def_en: 1. To discuss something with someone in order to exchange opinions or reach a decision. 2. To formally grant or give an honor, degree, title, or right to someone.

groups.summary_en: Two or more interlocutors exchange views, evaluate alternatives, and pool advice to reach a shared understanding, resolution, or verdict. Verbs distinguish informal conversation from formal consultation and institutional deliberation.
groups.summary_zh: 双方或多方交流意见、磋商权衡，以谋求共识或决议。

groups.name: Disembark from a Vehicle · 下车与离载具 (Disembark, Alight, Detrain)
groups.tip: 指乘客从交通工具上下车或着陆

items.def_en: [I/T] to exit a bus, curb, or carriage by taking a downward step
[I/T] to exit or cause passengers to leave a train
(+ sth) to leave a bus, train, aircraft, or large vehicle
(+ of sth) to leave or exit a car, taxi, or small enclosed vehicle
(+ from) to step down or get off a train, bus, or other transport (formal)
[I/T] to leave a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle after a journey
(especially NAmE) to get off an airplane after it has landed.

items.def_zh: 下船，下飞机，登陆；卸下（货物、乘客）；剥去（树皮）
items.def_en: 1. to leave or remove passengers or goods from a ship or aircraft; to disembark. 2. to strip the bark from a tree trunk.

groups.summary_en: Passengers or crew exit a conveyance (aircraft, ship, train, bus, or vehicle). Verbs vary primarily by the specific type of transport involved ('deplane' for planes, 'detrain' for trains, 'disembark' general/maritime, 'alight' formal public transit).
groups.summary_zh: 乘客或机组人员从船只、飞机、火车或车辆中走出离开。

groups.name: Disentangle & Strip Apart · 拆解与解构解脱 (Disengage, Disentangle, Cannibalize)
groups.tip: 解开机械联锁或脱离挂钩

items.def_en: (+ sth) to disentangle or separate tangled strands, items, or confused elements

items.def_zh: 解开；拆散（编织物或缠结）
items.def_en: [I/T] to undo or become undone from a tangled, woven, or knitted state
(+ sth) to completely dismantle or demolish a structure, engine, or assembly
to take a machine, apparatus, or structure to pieces systematically

items.def_zh: （使机械等）脱开，脱离啮合；使脱离，摆脱束缚；（军队）撤出战斗
items.def_en: 1. To separate or release a clutch, lock, or mechanism; to become detached. 2. To withdraw or free oneself or troops from a conflict or situation.

items.def_zh: 解开，理顺（缠结物）；使摆脱，脱离（纠葛）
items.def_en: To separate things that have become twisted or knotted together; to free oneself or someone from an entangled situation.
to dismantle a machine, vehicle, or structure completely down to its basic core

items.def_zh: 拆用（旧机器等）的零部件来修理其他机器；分流，蚕食（现有产品）的销量
items.def_en: 1. To take parts from one machine, vehicle, or device to repair another. 2. To reduce sales of an existing product by introducing a similar new one.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the deliberate decoupling, extraction, or salvage-dismantling of mechanical parts, interwoven threads, or linked systems to free them or repurpose their components.
groups.summary_zh: 解开缠结、脱开机械锁合或拆除部件以作挪用。

groups.name: Disguise & Cover Up · 伪装与粉饰 (Masquerade, Whitewash, Camouflage)
groups.tip: 戴上面具化装潜入，乔装假冒特定身份

items.def_en: deliberately avoid dealing with flaws, mistakes, or difficult issues
(+ sth) to take action to prevent illicit, embarrassing, or wrongful deeds from becoming known
conceal disagreements or defects superficially rather than resolving them
(+ sb/sth as sb/sth) to fraudulently represent someone or something as something genuine or superior
conceal someone's real character, intentions, or true nature with a false exterior

items.def_zh: 伪装，冒充，假扮（masquerade as）；参加化装舞会
items.def_en: 1. ('masquerade as') To pretend to be someone or something else in order to deceive people. 2. To attend or take part in a masquerade.

items.def_zh: 掩饰，粉饰（罪过、丑闻等）；粉刷（墙壁等）；（体育比赛中）完封，让对手一分未得
items.def_en: 1. To conceal or downplay mistakes, faults, or scandals in order to protect an image or reputation. 2. To paint a wall or surface with whitewash. 3. (sports) To defeat an opponent completely without allowing them to score.

items.def_zh: 隐瞒，掩饰真实情感/意图
items.def_en: disguise or conceal one's real motives, feelings, or beliefs through deception

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deceptive actions taken to mask true identity, faults, or illicit behavior behind a benign, respectable facade.
groups.summary_zh: 以虚假身份伪装、或粉饰遮盖罪责以掩人耳目。

groups.name: Dislike to Revulsion · 厌恶与反感反胃 (Dislike, Distaste, Disgust, Loathe)
groups.tip: 从轻微反感递进为生理级作呕排斥

items.def_en: To feel that you do not like someone or something.
(+ sb) to cause someone to feel intense distaste, disinterest, or disgust
(+ sb) to disgust or sicken someone severely with something repulsive
To cause someone to feel extreme dislike, revulsion, or strong disapproval.
to feel intense hatred, disgust, or complete unwillingness to endure something
to hate something very much, especially on strong moral grounds
to make someone feel physically sick, horrified, or deeply repelled
to cause someone to feel shock, disgust, and physical nausea

groups.summary_en: An experiencer harbors an aversion toward a stimulus, progressing in visceral intensity from mild disinclination to physical revulsion and outright detestation.
groups.summary_zh: 从轻微反感不快逐渐递增至极度恶心乃至深恶痛绝。

groups.name: Dismantle & Disjoint · 拆解与分脱 (Take Apart Component by Component)
groups.tip: 使关节或连接处脱开

items.def_en: (+ sth) to separate something composite into its simpler components or individual parts
to separate an object into the smaller parts from which it is made

items.def_zh: 拆线，拆散（缝线或错综结构）
items.def_en: to undo the stitches of needlework or carefully disentangle a complex construct
(+ sth) to separate an assembled mechanism or object into its constituent pieces

items.def_zh: 彻底拆卸（至裸架或基本零件）
items.def_en: to completely dismantle an engine or vehicle to clean, inspect, or repair it

items.def_zh: 拆除，拆卸（机械、结构或组织）
items.def_en: to take a machine or structure to pieces piece by piece

items.def_zh: 肢解，切断关节；使脱节，使脱臼
items.def_en: To take something apart at the joints; to disconnect, disrupt, or separate the components of something.
To take a machine, structure, or piece of equipment apart into its separate pieces.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote separating an assembled structure, mechanism, or articulated body into its individual constituents, ranging from orderly breakdown to structural articulation separation.
groups.summary_zh: 把组合结构、机械或带关节躯体逐步分拆卸解，侧重机械性或解剖性操作。

groups.name: Display & Exhibit · 陈列与展出
groups.tip: 摆出事物供人观看欣赏

items.def_zh: 以……为特色展出；重点展示
items.def_en: to make something a prominent or special attraction in an exhibition or presentation

items.def_zh: 陈列，展出；显露，表现；（屏幕上）显示
items.def_en: 1. To put something in a place where people can see it easily. 2. To show a particular feeling, quality, or skill clearly. 3. (of an electronic device) To show words, pictures, or data on a screen.

items.def_zh: 展出，陈列，展览；表现出，显露（品质、迹象等）
items.def_en: 1. To display something publicly in an exhibition, museum, or gallery. 2. (formal) To clearly show a particular quality, feeling, or symptom.
to display something proudly or ostentatiously so that it attracts widespread notice
to exhibit the best qualities or features of something prominently to an audience
(+ sth) to arrange or display things attractively for people to see or inspect

items.def_zh: 摆出；陈列（供人观赏或使用）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place items in an open or designated area so that they are visible and accessible
(+ sth) to display something proudly or conspicuously to attract admiration

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate placing physical items, artworks, or merchandise out in the open or in a gallery/store so that people can view or inspect them. 'Display' emphasizes attractive visual arrangement, whereas 'exhibit' denotes formal presentation in a public exhibition, museum, or fair.
groups.summary_zh: 指将展品、商品或艺术品有意识地陈列供公众观览。

groups.name: Dissemble & Misrepresent · 掩饰与隐瞒 (Feign, Belie, Fib)
groups.tip: 掩饰真实真相并编造假象

items.def_en: (+ that / sb to be sth) to falsely assert, imply, or pretend that something is the case
to behave insincerely or pretend to feel an emotion that is not genuine
to give a false or misleading account of the nature of something
(formal) To pretend to have a particular feeling, illness, or condition.

items.def_zh: 掩饰，掩盖；证明……不真实，与……不符
items.def_en: (formal) 1. To give a false impression of something; to disguise or contradict. 2. To show that something is false or incorrect.
(informal) To tell a small, harmless lie.
[I/T] to conceal one's true motives, thoughts, or feelings under a false appearance
[I/T] to hide one's real feelings, character, or intentions by pretense

groups.summary_en: An agent deliberately obscures the truth or presents a false impression, spanning petty untruths, pretended states, and external appearances that contradict internal reality.
groups.summary_zh: 故意隐匿真相或展现虚假表象，涵盖撒小谎、假装状态以及表里相悖。

groups.name: Dissipate Resources Recklessly · 挥霍与耗尽 (Waste, Squander, Fritter away)
groups.tip: 毫无节制肆意挥霍

items.def_en: to waste time, money, or effort gradually on trivial or useless things

items.def_zh: 白白浪费；糟蹋（机会、金钱）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fail to make good use of an asset, opportunity, or advantage; squander

items.def_zh: 浪费，挥霍，滥用；（使）消瘦，衰弱；破坏，使荒芜
items.def_en: 1. To use more of something than is necessary, or to use it carelessly or uselessly. 2. (often 'waste away') To gradually become thin and weak, especially from illness. 3. (slang) To kill or destroy.
(informal) to spend a large amount of money recklessly and quickly

items.def_zh: 快速挥霍耗尽（巨额钱财或资源）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to spend or use up large amounts of money or resources very quickly and carelessly
to foolishly scatter, exhaust, or waste away wealth, energy, or resources
To waste money, time, or opportunity in a foolish or careless manner.
(+ sth) to waste or squander money, time, or an opportunity completely and foolishly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the careless, irresponsible, or lavish expenditure of finite resources (money, time, talents) such that they are depleted without yield, scaling from mere unproductivity to ruinous dissipation.
groups.summary_zh: 按程度递增描述对金钱、时间等宝贵资源的浪费、挥霍直至耗尽。

groups.name: Divide & Segment · 分割与细分 (Subdivide, Partition, Polarize)
groups.tip: 按结构或界限细分切离

items.def_en: [I/T] to divide something into separate, well-defined sections or groups
To divide something into smaller parts or sections.
(+ sth) to separate or divide an area or whole into smaller distinct sections
(+ sth) to divide or separate into distinct smaller parts, groups, or segments
to divide a room, surface, or country into separate parts using walls or borders
to divide into separate distinct categories, compartments, or mental sections
(+ sth) to divide an area, company, or resource into smaller portions, often aggressively or unfairly
1. To divide people, opinions, or groups into two completely opposing extremes. 2. (physics) To cause light waves to oscillate in one direction.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote partitioning an existing whole into smaller constituent parts, categories, or ideological extremes, altering its internal structural cohesion.
groups.summary_zh: 将一个现有整体在结构、地域或观念层面上予以切割、隔断或极化细分。

groups.name: Drink Heavily & Make Merry · 痛饮狂欢 (Carouse, Wassail, Revel)
groups.tip: 开怀畅饮彻夜狂欢庆祝

items.def_en: [I/T] to drink intoxicating liquor habitually or repeatedly, often in a social setting
