to drink a large quantity of alcohol in a lively or unrestrained social setting
to enjoy oneself in an extravagant, boisterous, and unrestrained manner
(informal) to drink alcohol heavily, especially in the company of others
(+ in) to take part in noisy, lively festivities or indulge deeply in merrymaking
[I/T] (formal or humorous) to drink alcohol, especially in a convivial atmosphere
(literary) To drink alcohol and celebrate noisily and unrestrainedly with a group of people.

items.def_zh: 痛饮狂欢；行酒祝愿，为……干杯
items.def_en: (historical or literary) To drink plentifully and celebrate noisily, especially during festive winter gatherings.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe engaging in boisterous, noisy, and often drunken celebration or merrymaking, typically in social gatherings. 'Carouse' and 'wassail' carry literary or archaic overtones of lively, alcohol-fueled festivities.
groups.summary_zh: 指在社交聚会中开怀畅饮、纵酒喧闹与狂欢作乐的情景。

groups.name: Electoral Campaigning & Politicking · 竞选拉票与政治运作 (Campaign, Politick, Stump)
groups.tip: 参与政治竞选与权力角逐

items.def_zh: 参与竞选，从事竞选活动
items.def_en: (+ for/against) to run a series of planned activities to win an election
(+ sth) to campaign and compete as a candidate to win an elected public office

items.def_zh: 作为候选人竞选（议员等职位）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to compete as an official candidate in an election (chiefly British)

items.def_zh: 巡回演说拉票，在各地助选
items.def_en: [I/T] to travel around an area making political campaign speeches

items.def_zh: 游说拉票，挨门挨户走访拉选票
items.def_en: [I/T] to visit voters directly to solicit votes or determine political support

items.def_zh: 进行政治活动，拉选票；搞权术活动
items.def_en: (chiefly US) To engage in political activities, campaigns, or strategic maneuvering for advantage.

items.def_zh: 巡回造势，在乡镇穿梭竞选
items.def_en: [I/T] to travel rapidly through rural areas making brief political appearances

items.def_zh: （在各地作短暂停留）进行巡回竞选演说
items.def_en: (chiefly US politics) To travel rapidly through small towns making brief campaign appearances or speeches.

groups.summary_en: Candidates and political operatives engage in public and backroom activities to win votes, gain influence, or secure public office. Verbs range from formal broad-scale campaigning to grassroots whistle-stop touring and self-interested political maneuvering.
groups.summary_zh: 候选人或政客为争取选民支持、赢得公职而进行的竞选游说与政治运作。

groups.name: Emerge & Loom Obscurely · 显露与隐现 (Loom, Hulk, Silhouette)
groups.tip: 事物在视野中浮现或逼近

items.def_zh: 投影遮蔽；显出隐约暗影
items.def_en: cast a dark silhouette over, or appear faintly like a dark outline
(usually passive) To cast someone or something as a dark shape against a lighter background.
to appear or loom as a large, indistinct mass
to be easily noticeable or visually prominent against a surrounding background
(+ over/above) stand or rise to a conspicuous, imposing height

items.def_zh: 赫然耸现，隐隐显现；逼近
items.def_en: 1. (+ over/ahead) To appear as a large, often frightening or indistinct shape. 2. (of an unpleasant event) To seem likely to happen soon.

items.def_zh: 庞然耸立，巍然显现；笨重地移动
items.def_en: 1. (+ over) To loom or appear massive, heavy, and imposing. 2. To move in a heavy or clumsy manner.
cast a large, dark shadow over something, making it loom darkly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe large, shadowy, or threatening shapes becoming visible or standing out against a contrasting background. They emphasize visual manner—ranging from projecting a dark outline to towering menacingly through mist or darkness.
groups.summary_zh: 指庞大或阴暗的轮廓隐约显现、赫然耸立或背光勾勒。

groups.name: Empathize & Commiserate · 同情与体恤怜悯 (Pity, Sympathize, Commiserate)
groups.tip: 对他人不幸心生哀怜并感同身受

items.def_en: (+ sb) to feel sympathy and compassion for someone in a difficult or painful situation

items.def_zh: 为……深感悲痛；为……心如刀绞
items.def_en: (+ sb) to feel intense sorrow, empathy, or pity for someone suffering
To feel sorrow, sympathy, or compassion for someone in an unfortunate or suffering condition.
(formal or archaic) To feel deep pity or compassion for someone suffering misfortune.
1. (+ with) To feel or express compassion and sorrow for someone's suffering or misfortune. 2. (+ with) To agree with, support, or approve of an opinion or cause.
(+ with) to understand and directly experience the feelings and experiences of another
(+ with) to express deep sympathy or shared sorrow for someone's misfortune
(+ with) (formal) to express sympathy to someone who is grieving a loss

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express affective concern, shared suffering, or sorrow for another's distress, ranging from superior pity to egalitarian empathy and shared grief.
groups.summary_zh: 指对他人的苦难或不幸心怀关切，包括居高临下的怜悯与感同身受的共情。

groups.name: Emphasize & Accentuate · 强调与突显 (Stress, Highlight, Accentuate)
groups.tip: 特别突出重点以引起重视

items.def_zh: 强调，着重；重读；给……施加压力
items.def_en: 1. To emphasize or give special importance to a fact, point, or idea. 2. To place emphasis or stress on a word or syllable. 3. To subject something to mechanical or mental stress.
draw special attention to an important fact, issue, or detail
(+ sth) to make a particular quality, feature, or contrast more prominent or noticeable
(+ sth) to draw clear attention to something or make its importance evident
(+ sth) to emphasize or exaggerate the value or importance of something
give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing
make a feature, fact, or feeling more noticeable or prominent

items.def_zh: 过分强调，过分着重；使过度紧张，使承受过大压力
items.def_en: 1. To place too much emphasis on something. 2. To subject someone or something to excessive strain or stress.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on giving cognitive, verbal, or rhetorical prominence to a fact, point, or principle to ensure listeners recognize its critical importance. Verbs vary from standard communicational emphasis to excessive or disproportionate focus.
groups.summary_zh: 在言语或论述中着重强调某事实或观点，突出其重要性。

groups.name: Enact & Decree · 颁布法令与司法裁决 (Enact, Promulgate, Decree)
groups.tip: 立法机构颁布法令或政策

items.def_zh: 宣布，作出（正式判决或裁定）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to deliver or announce a formal legal verdict or judicial decision officially
(+ sth) to state officially and firmly that something must be done or obeyed as a rule or principle

items.def_zh: 颁布，制定（法律）；扮演，演出；发生，实行
items.def_en: 1. To make a proposal or bill into a law. 2. To perform a story, play, or role.

items.def_zh: 颁布，发布命令；判决，裁定
items.def_en: 1. To officially order, judge, or decide something by decree.

items.def_zh: 命定，以法律或权威规定
items.def_en: to order or decree officially by virtue of superior authority or fate

items.def_zh: 制定法律，通过立法规定
items.def_en: [I/T] to make or pass laws, especially concerning a particular issue

items.def_zh: 正式公布，颁布（法律、教义）
items.def_en: to formally proclaim or make known a law or decree to the public
[I/T] to make a formal judgment or decision about a legal problem or disputed matter

groups.summary_en: Authorities, legislative bodies, or sovereigns formally establish laws, issue official orders, or hand down binding judicial judgments upon a state or community.
groups.summary_zh: 立法机构或掌权者正式颁布法律、发布政令或裁决。

groups.name: Encircle & Wreathe · 环绕与缠圈 (Wreathe, Entwine, Enlace)
groups.tip: 线绳藤蔓互相缠绕交错

items.def_en: (+ sth) to curve or wind around something forming a loose circle or ring
To wind around or enfold closely, as with a band or ribbon
To form a circle around something; surround completely
(+ sth) to twist, coil, or wrap continuously around a central object
(+ sth) to fold or encircle closely around an object or body part
To adorn or encircle with or as if with a garland or wreath
(+ with/around) To twist or wind things closely together or around something else.

items.def_zh: 盘绕，环绕，笼罩；编成花环
items.def_en: (+ in/with) (literary, often passive) To encircle, surround, or cover something with or as if with a wreath (such as mist, smoke, or flowers).

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe winding, curling, or draping something around an object in a decorative, continuous, or enveloping loop or crown. 'Wreathe' centers on encircling or crowning like a garland, whereas 'entwine' denotes winding lovingly or decoratively around something.
groups.summary_zh: 如花环或藤蔓般围绕、环抱或紧贴盘绕于物体周围。

groups.name: Enclose & Belt · 环绕与带状包围 (Environ, Girdle, Gird)
groups.tip: 环形包夹周遭围拢

items.def_en: to encircle or surround something with a strip or continuous ring
(formal/literary) to encircle completely as if with a ring
(+ sth) to surround or enclose an area with a fence or boundary structure

items.def_zh: 严密包围；围住使无法脱身
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to surround someone or something tightly so that movement is restricted
(+ sth) to enclose or isolate an area with walls or barriers
1. (literary or archaic) To surround, encircle, or enclose completely.

items.def_zh: 围绕，环绕；用带状物束紧；环剥（树皮）
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To surround or encircle something like a belt. 2. To cut a ring of bark from around the trunk of a tree.
to encircle or secure with a belt or band; to enclose defensively

groups.summary_en: Physical objects, environmental features, or protective bands encircle a central area like a belt or perimeter wall. While 'environ' belongs to high-register geographic or environmental setting and 'girdle' evokes a circular band cinching or binding an area, related formal verbs denote structural, defensive, or anatomical belting.
groups.summary_zh: 指地貌、带状物或防护结构如腰带般紧密围绕或束缚某物。

groups.name: Engrave & Inscribe into Surfaces · 雕刻与铭刻 (Engrave, Inscribe, Etch)
groups.tip: 把文字或图案深刻表面

items.def_en: (+ sth) to create a shape, design, or inscription by cutting away a hard material
(+ sth) to cut, form, or inscribe deeply into stone, metal, or wood using a chisel
[I/T] to produce a shape or inscription by cutting away material from wood or stone
1. (+ on/with) To cut words, pictures, or patterns into a hard surface such as stone, metal, or wood. 2. (often passive) To impress deeply on the mind or memory.
1. to press or stamp a mark or design onto a surface. 2. to fix an idea, memory, or feeling firmly in someone's mind.

items.def_zh: 蚀刻，雕刻；深深印在，使铭记
items.def_en: 1. to cut lines or designs into metal, glass, or stone using acid or a sharp tool. 2. to make a strong, clear, or unforgettable impression on someone's mind.
to cut precisely into a hard surface with a sharp tool to form letters or designs
to carve or cut stone, wood, or metal into shapes using a chisel

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify cutting, biting with acid, or incising words, designs, or memories deeply into a hard medium so that the mark remains permanent and prominent.
groups.summary_zh: 指用刀刻、酸蚀等方式在坚硬表面或心底留下永久的印记或文字。

groups.name: Entertain & Amuse · 娱乐与愉悦 (Provide Enjoyment / Amusement)
groups.tip: 逗人开心并带来轻松快乐的心境

items.def_zh: 使欢乐，使娱乐；招待，款待；抱有，考虑（想法、希望等）
items.def_en: 1. To interest and amuse someone. 2. To invite people as guests and provide food and drink for them. 3. To consider or hold a thought, idea, or feeling in your mind.

items.def_zh: 使高兴，使愉悦；以……为乐，感到高兴
items.def_en: 1. To give someone great pleasure or satisfaction. 2. (delight in) To take great pleasure in doing something.
(+ sb) to make someone laugh suddenly and uncontrollably with amusement
(+ sb) to make someone feel happier, entertained, and more cheerful
to cause sb to laugh, smile, or feel pleasantly entertained
to pleasantly distract or entertain sb away from care or routine work

items.def_zh: 以吸引力取悦/消磨（时光）
items.def_en: to charm, delight, or enchant sb, often helping time pass pleasantly
(+ with) to entertain sb lavishly with stories, jokes, or fine food and drink

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing pleasurable diversion, laughter, or intellectual enjoyment to an audience or individual, ranging from general hospitality to evoking genuine mirth or charm.
groups.summary_zh: 提供消遣、引人发笑或取悦他人，强调营造欢愉与娱乐体验。

groups.name: Erosion & Destabilization · 动摇与瓦解 (Erode, Undermine, Destabilize)
groups.tip: 破坏平衡态势，使系统陷入混乱

items.def_en: To gradually diminish or cause something to diminish in size or integrity through friction, erosion, or prolonged stress
[I/T] to wear away or diminish the strength, power, or stability of something slowly over time
(+ sth) To gradually diminish, weaken, or undermine power, stability, or confidence in small increments
(+ sth) To gradually damage, erode, or weaken a physical structure or abstract foundation over time
to weaken or ruin a system, authority, or foundation gradually or insidiously from below

items.def_zh: 颠覆；暗中破坏（政权、原则）
items.def_en: to undermine the power and authority of an established system or institution from within

items.def_zh: 破坏……的稳定，动摇，使陷入混乱
items.def_en: To make a system, government, or economy unstable and likely to fail or collapse.

items.def_zh: 使脱轨；使严重失衡紊乱
items.def_en: to throw a system, operation, or person into total disorder and instability

groups.summary_en: This frame captures intentional or gradual actions that compromise the balance, structure, or security of a system, institution, or physical foundation, ranging from imperceptible wear to outright subversion.
groups.summary_zh: 通过逐渐侵蚀、暗中破坏或颠覆机制，使原本稳固的体系或结构陷入动荡与瓦解。

groups.name: Erupt & Gush Forwards · 喷射、倒出与倾泻 (Gush, Disgorge, Effuse)
groups.tip: 液体或物体大量涌出、喷出

items.def_en: To flow, rush, or emerge rapidly and abundantly from an enclosure or container
To gush or shoot forward suddenly and forcefully from an opening
(+ from/out) to flow out suddenly and in large volumes with considerable momentum
To eject, discharge, or expel contents violently or copiously outward
[I/T] to expel large quantities of something rapidly, violently, and often unpleasantly
[I/T] to send out or emerge in a rapid and vigorous stream, jet, or surge

items.def_zh: （大量）涌出，喷出，吐出；被迫交出（非法所得）
items.def_en: 1. To pour or discharge liquid, gas, or contents out quickly and in large quantities; (of a vehicle or building) to empty out people. 2. To surrender or give back money or goods obtained illegally.

items.def_zh: 涌出，流出，泻出；倾泻（情感等）
items.def_en: To pour out or flow out freely; to express emotions or thoughts with unrestrained enthusiasm.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the sudden, forceful, or copious expulsion of liquids, crowds, or interior contents outward from an enclosed space or receptacle.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重液体或内含物从封闭空间内突然、猛烈或大体量向外喷涌倒出。

groups.name: Establish & Codify · 确立与建制 (Institute, Institutionalize, Enact)
groups.tip: 设立机构推行成制

items.def_en: to set up an organization, system, or set of rules on a firm or permanent basis

items.def_zh: 建立，制定；实行，开创；提起（诉讼）
items.def_en: 1. to introduce, establish, or initiate a system, policy, or practice. 2. to start or initiate a legal proceeding.

items.def_zh: 引进，实施（新法律或制度）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to introduce and enact a new law, system, or administrative regulation
(+ sth) to include a formal provision, clause, or restriction expressly within a codified legal document
to make a proposal or bill into official law through a legislature

items.def_zh: 使处于牢固地位；牢固确立
items.def_en: to establish an attitude, habit, or position so firmly that change is very difficult

items.def_zh: 使制度化，使成惯例；把……送入收容机构（如疗养院、精神病院）
items.def_en: 1. to establish a practice, custom, or norm as an accepted and permanent part of an organization or society. 2. to place someone in a long-term care institution such as a hospital or psychiatric facility.

items.def_zh: 编纂（法典）；将…条理化/法典化
items.def_en: to arrange laws, rules, or principles into a systematic official code

groups.summary_en: Authorities, societies, or organizations formally set up, enact, or deeply embed laws, customs, or administrative practices into an enduring official structure. Verbs range from inaugurating a system to embedding it irrevocably into cultural or legal norms.
groups.summary_zh: 正式创立制度、颁布法律，或将其深度融入体制系统。

groups.name: Establish & Found Entities · 创立与设立组织 (Establish, Found, Institute)
groups.tip: 奠定根基确立组织制度

items.def_zh: 创立，创建，建立；把……建立在（某基础上）
items.def_en: 1. to establish an organization, institution, or city. 2. (be founded on/upon) to base something on a particular principle, idea, or fact

items.def_zh: 建立，设立，创办；确立，证实
items.def_en: 1. to start or set up an organization, company, or system on a firm basis. 2. to achieve widespread acceptance or recognition; to prove or ascertain

items.def_zh: 制定，设立，开创（制度/规程）
items.def_en: to introduce or officially establish an organization, system, rule, or inquiry
to legally register a business enterprise as an official corporate entity

items.def_zh: 创立，建立（企业、机构、组织）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to establish, found, or formally organize a company, institution, or system

items.def_zh: 开创；创办（商业或实体组织）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to begin, launch, and establish a new business venture or operational entity

items.def_zh: 正式设立，组建（委员会/法定机构）
items.def_en: to establish or set up an official body, tribunal, or authority in legal form

items.def_zh: 自力更生创办，白手起家；[计] 引导，自举
items.def_en: 1. to start or build a business or project using only one's own limited resources without external help. 2. (computing) to boot or load a program into a computer using a smaller initial program

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing the deliberate act of creating, formalizing, and placing an enduring organization, system, school, or corporate enterprise on a firm footing.
groups.summary_zh: 正式创立、设立并稳固推行组织、机构、制度或企业。

groups.name: Even Surface Coating · 涂覆、裹覆与抹匀 (Coat, Butter, Spread)
groups.tip: 将油脂或涂料均匀抹在表面

items.def_en: (+ sth) To apply an ointment, cream, or substance onto a surface and rub until it forms an even layer or absorbs
(+ sth) To apply a substance evenly and smoothly across an entire surface
[I/T] to apply a substance across a flat surface in an even, continuous layer

items.def_zh: 涂黄油于；讨好，奉承（butter up）
items.def_en: 1. To spread butter on something. 2. (in 'butter up') To flatter someone to gain an advantage.
(+ sth) To spread or coat a thick, generous layer of a substance over a surface

items.def_zh: 给……涂上一层，覆上；穿上外套
items.def_en: To cover the surface of something with a thin layer of a substance.
to cover with a thin, shiny liquid or culinary mixture that hardens smoothly
to apply a protective, glossy coat of resinous liquid over wood or metal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote providing a functional, culinary, or protective layer uniformly across a surface (e.g., buttering toast, coating metal or food uniformly).
groups.summary_zh: 指在物体表层均匀覆盖或涂抹一层功能性、保护性或食用性涂层。

groups.name: Exact Reproduction & Duplication · 复制与复印 (Duplicate, Replicate, Facsimile)
groups.tip: 精准再造或仿制原型

items.def_en: (+ sth) To print or duplicate multiple copies of a document using a machine
to reproduce written or typed documents using a stencil duplicator
to produce a photographic copy of printed matter using a photocopier

items.def_zh: 精准复制，摹仿；传真发送
items.def_en: To make an exact copy or reproduction of something; to transmit by fax.

items.def_zh: 大量生产，机械地粗制滥造出
items.def_en: (+ sth) To produce large quantities of identical items or copies quickly and mechanically
to make an exact genetic or functional biological/digital copy of an original

items.def_zh: 复制，仿制；重复（实验等以验证结果）；（使）自我复制
items.def_en: 1. To copy, reproduce, or repeat something precisely, such as an experiment or design. 2. (biology) To make an exact copy of itself.

items.def_zh: 复制，复印；重复，做同样的事
items.def_en: 1. To make an exact copy of something. 2. To do something again, especially unnecessarily.

groups.summary_en: An agent reproduces an original artifact, document, or scientific result to create an identical copy. Verbs emphasize precise physical cloning, documentary reproduction, or methodological repetition.
groups.summary_zh: 精准仿制原型、复制文献或重现实验结果，强调毫厘不爽的复制性。

groups.name: Examine & Scrutinize · 深入检查与细致审视 (Examine, Inspect, Scrutinize)
groups.tip: 仔细核查检验细枝末节

items.def_zh: 仔细检查，审查；体检；考核，考查
items.def_en: 1. To inspect closely in order to determine the condition or nature of something. 2. To test someone's knowledge, skill, or qualifications.
(+ sth) To examine or inspect something methodically or critically to assess its quality or detect errors
(+ sth) To scrutinize, inspect, or study something with intense and sustained focus
(+ sth) To examine details, documents, or objects carefully and systematically
to officially examine accounts, records, or procedures for accuracy
to investigate someone's past background or an item's fitness before approving
To look at something closely and critically to check its condition or detect errors.
to examine someone or something extremely thoroughly and critically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe visual or cognitive inspection where an agent systematically checks an object, document, or subject for flaws, truth, or details. Nuances differentiate general testing from rigorous, critical probing.
groups.summary_zh: 指为查找缺陷、核实真相或评估状况而系统性地观察与审查。

groups.name: Exceed Moderation & Overdo · 过度与过火 (Overdo, Overreach, Overindulge)
groups.tip: 行为举止或表述超出合理限度

items.def_en: (usually be/get carried away) To lose self-control or moderation due to excessive enthusiasm or excitement
[I/T] to have too much of something enjoyable, especially food, drink, or leisure
To act without restraint, moderation, or proportion in doing, saying, or spending

items.def_zh: 大吃大喝；过度暴饮暴食
items.def_en: To overindulge excessively in eating food beyond moderation

items.def_zh: 把……做得过分；夸大；使过度劳累；煮（烤）得过久
items.def_en: 1. To do something to an excessive degree, or exaggerate. 2. To cook food for too long.

items.def_zh: 自不量力，做过头而受挫
items.def_en: to defeat one's own purpose by attempting too much or overextending oneself

items.def_zh: 把……做得过火；夸大（overdo的过去分词）
items.def_en: To do something to an excessive degree, or exaggerate (past participle of overdo).
to demand too much physical, mental, or financial effort from someone or something

groups.summary_en: Agents carry an action, effort, or behavior beyond proper or safe limits, leading to exhaustion, failure, or excessive indulgence.
groups.summary_zh: 行为或努力超出适度界限，导致精力耗尽、弄巧成拙或过度放纵。

groups.name: Excite & Thrill · 激动与振奋 (Arousal & Exhilaration)
groups.tip: 由情绪雀跃递进为极致狂喜刺激

items.def_en: to cause strong feelings of enthusiasm, eagerness, or agitation
(+ sb) To make someone intensely excited, stimulated, or full of anticipation
(+ sb) To fill someone with high energy, enthusiasm, and exhilaration

items.def_zh: 热情称赞，兴奋地说；使充满热情，使极为激动
items.def_en: 1. (+ about/over) To express great excitement or enthusiasm about something. 2. To make someone feel full of enthusiasm and excitement.
(+ sb) To arouse intense enthusiasm, passion, or excitement in someone

items.def_zh: 使极为激动，使狂喜；感到兴奋，震颤
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone to feel a sudden wave of intense excitement, pleasure, or emotion. 2. To feel a sudden surge of excitement or pleasure.

items.def_zh: 使极度兴奋；使震撼激昂
items.def_en: to fill someone with sudden, intense, tingling shock and excitement

items.def_zh: 使狂喜陶醉；使欣喜若狂
items.def_en: to exhilarate someone emotionally beyond normal self-possession

groups.summary_en: An external stimulus or internal feeling triggers progressive states of high positive emotional arousal, nervous animation, electric joy, or breathless exhilaration.
groups.summary_zh: 刺激引发正向兴奋感与充沛活力，从热忱洋溢到极度激昂狂喜。

groups.name: Exert Sustained Effort · 竭力争取与奋斗 (Strive, Endeavor, Struggle)
groups.tip: 全力以赴克服困难达成目标

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to make strenuous or determined efforts in the face of difficulties or opposition
(+ for/to do) to work hard and persistently toward a difficult objective
(+ for/after/to do) to exert oneself to the utmost to reach or achieve something
(+ sth) To exert sustained, determined effort and struggle toward achieving an ambition or standard
To work or labour incessantly and arduously over a prolonged period
(+ at sth) To work persistently and doggedly at a difficult task without giving up
1. (+ for/against/to do) To make a great, determined effort to achieve something difficult.
1. (+ to do) (formal, British English spelling of endeavor) To make an earnest effort to achieve something.

groups.summary_en: An agent exerts persistent, principled effort against obstacles or long odds to attain an ambitious goal or uphold a standard. While 'strive' suggests continuous, aspirational exertion and 'endeavour' denotes formal or conscientious undertaking, related verbs highlight arduous struggle or laborious toil toward an objective.
groups.summary_zh: 指为实现目标或克服障碍而持续付出艰苦努力、奋力拼搏。

groups.name: Fall Behind in Progress · 滞后与脱节 (Lag, Straggle, Trail)
groups.tip: 行进速度缓慢掉在队尾

items.def_en: to stay behind or proceed slowly when others are moving forward
To move backward or gradually lose ground behind competitors or travelling companions
[I/T] to follow behind or be losing in a competition or procession

items.def_zh: 滞后，落后；给（水管、水箱等）加保温层
items.def_en: 1. (+ behind) To move, develop, or happen more slowly than others. 2. (chiefly British) To wrap pipes or water tanks with insulating material.

items.def_zh: 掉队，落后；散乱地蔓延（或移动）
items.def_en: (+ behind/along) To move slowly and fall behind others; to grow or spread untidily.
To fail to keep pace and fall to a position behind others in a line or competition
to fail to keep up with the pace, schedule, or progress of others
To move, progress, or develop more slowly than others, creating a noticeable gap

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving or progressing more slowly than others in a line, group, or competitive benchmark, scaling from a gradual gap in pace to disorganized, total dispersion behind.
groups.summary_zh: 按滞后与脱节程度递增描述在行进、竞争或进度上落于人后。

groups.name: Fall Ill & Suffer Ailment · 染病与受疾患困扰 (Sicken, Ail, Languish)
groups.tip: 身体染病并承受生理痛苦

items.def_en: (+ from) to experience physical illness, pain, or continuous debility
to suddenly or gradually become sick
(+ sth) To begin to suffer from a specific illness or ailment, typically not life-threatening
(+ sth) To become sick or contract an ailment that causes physical deterioration
(+ sth) To become severely incapacitated or die as a result of an illness or disease

items.def_zh: 生病，患病；使厌恶，使恶心，使作呕
items.def_en: 1. To become ill or start to develop a disease. 2. To make someone feel deeply disgusted, shocked, or physically ill.

items.def_zh: 患病，受病痛折磨；使困扰，使苦恼
items.def_en: 1. To suffer from illness, pain, or distress. 2. To cause trouble, affliction, or pain to someone.
to become weak, feeble, or deteriorate due to illness or prolonged distress

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe falling ill, deteriorating in physical vitality, or suffering prolonged chronic distress. They range from formal or literary descriptions of decline to standard medical onset.
groups.summary_zh: 描述患病、身体渐衰或长期受慢性疾患困扰的身体状态。

groups.name: Favor & Prefer · 偏爱与青睐 (Prefer, Favor, Fancy)
groups.tip: 在对比选择中表现出的特殊倾向

items.def_en: To like one thing, person, or option better than another.

items.def_zh: 偏爱，青睐；有利于；赞同，支持
items.def_en: 1. To treat with partiality or prefer one person or thing over another. 2. To approve of, support, or be advantageous to.
accord special importance, superiority, or structural priority to one thing over another
feel a casual or sudden attraction or liking toward someone or something
show an emerging or tentative preference for a particular view or candidate
(+ sb/sth) to choose or treat one person or thing differently from others, especially to show special favor
(+ sth) to choose one particular option rather than others after consideration

items.def_zh: 逐渐喜欢上；对…产生好感
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to start to like or appreciate someone or something more

groups.summary_en: A person evaluates alternatives and singles out one option, person, or taste with greater liking, partiality, or bias.
groups.summary_zh: 权衡不同选择时表现出主观倾向，更倾向于喜爱、支持某人某事。

groups.name: Find & Detect · 发现与察觉 (Discover, Detect, Spot)
groups.tip: 通过感官获知客观存在

items.def_zh: 找到，发现；发觉，感到；裁决
items.def_en: 1. To discover someone or something by searching or by chance. 2. To perceive, realize, or experience something. 3. (law) To make a legal judgment or verdict.
to see, notice, or identify sb/sth, especially sth that is hard to see
to become aware of, find, or uncover sth unexpected, hidden, or previously unknown
To notice, discover, or identify the presence or existence of something, especially something subtle.
(+ sb/sth) to recognize or distinguish someone or something among a group of things or people
(+ sb/sth) to manage to see, hear, or recognize someone or something with difficulty
(+ sth) to discover or uncover something after investigation or searching
to perceive, recognize, or distinguish sth with difficulty using sight or intellect

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this perception frame denote discovering the existence, presence, or identity of an object, anomaly, or clue. 'Find' serves as the broad, neutral outcome verb, whereas 'detect' emphasizes sensory perception, technical measurement, or noticing subtle, hidden signals.
groups.summary_zh: 通过感官观察、检验或搜寻察觉并确定隐蔽或既有事物的存在。

groups.name: Fine-Tune Physical & Visual Settings · 校零与微调间距 (Zero, Kern, Calibrate)
groups.tip: 精细调校参数或对齐位置

items.def_zh: 微调，精确校准（仪器、参数或机械）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make precise adjustments or calibrations to an instrument, setting, or mechanism
(+ sth) to adjust a measuring instrument or scale so that it reads zero at the baseline

items.def_zh: 将（仪器、仪表等）调零，归零；瞄准，校准（武器）
items.def_en: 1. to adjust an instrument or measuring device so that it reads zero 2. to aim or calibrate a weapon precisely at a target
to adjust components into correct spatial or mechanical orientation relative to one another
to adjust a balance or scale to deduct the weight of an empty container
to adjust the horizontal spacing between characters or letters in typography
to bring an object or wheel into exact alignment, level, or circular symmetry
to adjust a measuring instrument against an established standard

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe making precise, technical, micro-level adjustments to instruments, typography, or spatial machinery to establish baselines, alignment, or balanced proportionality.
groups.summary_zh: 对仪表、排版或机械参数进行技术性微调与校零。

groups.name: Flamboyant & Affective Walking · 昂首阔步与招摇走动 (Sashay, Flounce)
groups.tip: 招摇、大摇大摆或优雅地走动

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆走动；招摇过市
items.def_en: to walk about in a prominent or showy way to attract attention or show off

items.def_zh: 忿然走开；趾高气扬地离去
items.def_en: to walk away in a stiff, angry, or haughty manner

items.def_zh: 大模大样地走进来；轻率擅入
items.def_en: to enter a place boldly, casually, or presumptuously without permission or apprehension

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆地走；趾高气扬地走
items.def_en: to walk with a proud, erect, pompous, or arrogant gait
to walk or bounce about in an energetic, proud, or self-important manner

items.def_zh: 趾高气扬地大步走，怒气冲冲地阔步走
items.def_en: To walk or leave with exaggerated, angry, or impatient movements in order to draw attention to oneself.

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆地走，摇曳而行，招摇走动
items.def_en: To walk in an easy, confident, and noticeable way, often with an exaggerated swaying of the hips.

items.def_zh: 大模大样地走；步态傲慢
items.def_en: to walk in an aggressive, boastful, or excessively confident way

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting deliberate, stylized, or expressive walking meant to show off, assert confidence, or register dramatic emotional petulance.
groups.summary_zh: 以夸张、摇曳或带着强烈情绪的姿态昂首阔步、招摇走动。

groups.name: Flatter & Ingratiate · 奉承与逢迎 (Flatter, Fawn, Ingratiate)
groups.tip: 用甜言蜜语讨好他人

items.def_en: (informal) to be very nice or flatter someone because you want them to do something for you

items.def_zh: 对……说甜言蜜语，奉承；加蜜使变甜
items.def_en: 1. (often honey up to) To speak flatteringly or cajolingly to someone. 2. To sweeten with or as if with honey.
(+ sb) to try to become friendly or ingratiate oneself with someone for selfish reasons
(+ sb) to flatter or behave deferentially toward someone to win their support

items.def_zh: 奉承，阿谀，巴结；使感到荣幸；（衣服、发型等）使显得更好看
items.def_en: 1. To praise someone excessively or insincerely, especially to gain an advantage. 2. To make someone feel pleased, honored, or proud. 3. To make someone look more attractive than they usually do.
(+ oneself with) to make someone like you, especially deliberately and insincerely
(+ sb) to flatter or try to please someone in authority in order to gain an advantage
(+ on/over) to praise someone and be excessively polite to them to gain their favor

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe praising or behaving subserviently toward someone, typically in an insincere manner aimed at gaining favor, advantage, or approval.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过虚假夸赞、卑躬屈膝或刻意讨好他人以获取私利或好感。

groups.name: Flush & Wash Down · 冲洗与高压洗涤 (Hose down, Power-wash, Flush)
groups.tip: 用水管冲洗去除污物

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove residue or soap from a surface with clean running water
(+ sth) to clean a large surface thoroughly using a strong flow of water
to wash, spray, or water something using a flexible hose

items.def_zh: 撇去……的浮渣（或浮沫）；起浮沫，长浮渣
items.def_en: to remove scum or foam from the surface of a liquid, or to become covered with scum
(+ sth) to clean an enclosed space, container, or system by running a liquid through it
to wash or clean something thoroughly using a stream of water from a hose
to cleanse or clear out a space by causing a rapid flow of water through it
to clean surfaces using a mechanical sprayer that delivers high-pressure water

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote cleaning, dislodging, or clearing dirt and contaminants from surfaces using a pressurized or directed stream of liquid. They emphasize the dynamic fluid mechanism rather than generic wiping or scrubbing.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用定向水流或加压液体喷射来冲刷、清理表面污垢。

groups.name: Foam & Bubble · 发泡与起沫 (Effervesce, Froth, Lather)
groups.tip: 液体翻腾产生气泡泡沫

items.def_en: to produce hissing bubbles vigorously on the surface of a liquid
to produce or fill with a mass of small bubbles or froth
(+ sth) to produce a thick soap froth, or cover something with lather
to make a continuous hissing sound while producing small gas bubbles
To form or produce a mass of small soap bubbles; to spread lather on someone or something.
to produce or become covered with a dense layer of small bubbles
[I/T] to produce or cause to produce a thick mass of small bubbles on a liquid surface

items.def_zh: 起泡，冒气泡；活跃，兴高采烈
items.def_en: 1. To produce small bubbles of gas and make a hissing sound. 2. To show high spirits, enthusiasm, or liveliness.

groups.summary_en: This physical change-of-state frame specifies liquids generating, trapping, or discharging masses of gas bubbles or soapy foam. Manner varies by physical trigger: soapy agitation ('lather'), chemical gas release ('effervesce'), vigorous physical churning ('froth'), or agitated liquid eruption ('fizz').
groups.summary_zh: 指液体因化学反应、机械剧烈搅动或皂化作用而产生气泡或泡沫。

groups.name: Foot the Bill & Bankroll · 出资与全面包办 (Fund, Bankroll, Foot the Bill)
groups.tip: 出资赞助提供财力

items.def_en: to pay the costs of an event, athlete, or broadcast in return for publicity
(+ sth) to produce or pay money unwillingly under pressure
[I/T] (foot the bill for sth) to pay for something, especially when it is expensive or should be paid by others
(+ sth) to pay out a large sum of money, often reluctantly
(+ sth) to spend or pay a substantial amount of money, usually begrudgingly
To provide money for an event, project, organization, or activity.

items.def_zh: 资助；向…提供赌本/启动资金
items.def_en: to provide someone with money to start a venture or contest
(informal) To support a person, organization, or project by giving them large amounts of money.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize the specific manner of covering costs—from straightforward allocation of money to lavishly underwriting or begrudgingly paying the entire tab.
groups.summary_zh: 以特定方式买单、全面包办开支或全额资助某项开销。

groups.name: Forced Packing & Cramming · 硬塞与挤满 (Stuff, Jam, Cram)
groups.tip: 硬挤入狭小缝隙直至填满

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to force a large number of people or things into a limited space
(+ into/with) to force people or things into a space that is almost too small for them
(+ sb/sth) to push people or things forcefully into a small or tight enclosure
(+ sth) to force an object tightly into a narrow space so that it cannot move

items.def_zh: 硬塞，塞满；挤进；（使）卡住，使故障；干扰（广播信号）
items.def_en: 1. To push or wedge something forcefully into a tight space, or crowd into a space until full. 2. To become stuck or make a machine become stuck and unable to move. 3. To block or disrupt electronic communications or signals.

items.def_zh: 把……塞进，填塞；给（食物）填馅；吃撑，狼吞虎咽
items.def_en: 1. To push or force something tightly or carelessly into a space or container. 2. To fill the inside of food with a mixture before cooking. 3. (stuff oneself) To eat a very large amount of food.
(+ in/into) to fix or force something tightly into a narrow space so that it cannot move
(+ into/down) to force something into place with heavy, violent downward or inward thrusts

groups.summary_en: An agent forces items or people into a limited space beyond its easy capacity, using physical pressure. The intensity scales with the degree of force applied and whether the objects are compressed, wedged immovably, or tightly jammed.
groups.summary_zh: 用力施加压力，将人或物强行塞入、卡入或挤入狭小受限的空间中。

groups.name: Fortify Resolve · 严阵以待与心理武装 (Brace, Steel, Nerve)
groups.tip: 心理防线建立、咬紧牙关直面困难

items.def_en: to prepare oneself physically or mentally for an impending confrontation or exertion

items.def_zh: 做好心理准备；迎接（冲击/考验）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to prepare oneself mentally or physically for something difficult or unpleasant

items.def_zh: 使下定决心，使坚强（以面对困难，尤指 steel oneself）；钢化，给……包上钢
items.def_en: (steel oneself) To prepare yourself mentally to do something difficult or unpleasant.

items.def_zh: 鼓起勇气，使振作精神（尤指 nerve oneself）
items.def_en: (nerve oneself) To brace or encourage oneself to face something difficult or dangerous.
(+ oneself / for) to prepare oneself physically or mentally for an unpleasant shock or blow

items.def_zh: 硬起心肠；使变得冷酷坚强
items.def_en: (+ oneself / one's heart) to make oneself emotionally unyielding or insensitive to hardship or pity
to make oneself calm and determined before an ordeal or confrontation

items.def_zh: 咬紧牙关准备；严阵以待
items.def_en: (+ oneself / loins) to summon up resolution and inner strength to face a challenge

groups.summary_en: An agent deliberately steels their own mind, nerves, or body in order to withstand an impending shock, ordeal, or painful confrontation. These verbs typically take reflexive pronouns or nouns denoting courage/resolve as their direct objects.
groups.summary_zh: 主体主动调整或强化心理与神经，以应对即将到来的痛苦或冲击。

groups.name: Frighten & Spook · 惊吓与惊扰 (Frighten Suddenly or Unease)
groups.tip: 突遭惊吓令人毛骨悚然

items.def_en: to make someone feel worried, fearful, or suddenly anxious about danger
(+ sb/sth) to cause a person or animal to leave or stay away by frightening them

items.def_zh: 使毛骨悚然；令人害怕不安
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to feel uneasy, nervous, or frightened
(+ sb) to startle or unnerve someone with sudden fright or suspense
[I/T] to make someone feel frightened, worried, or anxious
[I/T] to make someone feel sudden fear or panic
To surprise or frighten someone suddenly, often causing a sudden physical reaction or flinch.

items.def_zh: 惊吓，使惊恐不安；受惊，惊慌
items.def_en: (informal) To frighten a person or animal suddenly so that they panic, or to become startled and afraid.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing a person or animal to experience sudden alarm, panic, or skittish apprehension. Register varies from everyday 'scare' to sudden 'startle' and the nervous skittishness implied by 'spook'.
groups.summary_zh: 指突发性使人或动物受惊、恐慌或神经高度紧绷。

groups.name: Garble & Obfuscate · 混乱失真与蓄意晦涩 (Garble, Obfuscate)
groups.tip: 故意混淆视听使事实晦涩难懂

items.def_zh: 使模糊，混淆（判断或真相）
items.def_en: to make an issue, fact, or judgment less clear, transparent, or objective

items.def_zh: 搅混；把（事实/情况）搞混乱
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make an issue, argument, or situation confusing and unclear
(+ sth) to cause an issue, meaning, or fact to become obscure or ambiguous
(+ sth) to confuse elements of a message or story so that it becomes garbled

items.def_zh: 伪造，篡改（使记录或陈述失实）
items.def_en: to alter information, accounts, or records deliberately so as to mislead

items.def_zh: 弄混，混淆（使思路或信息杂乱）
items.def_en: to confuse or jumble a message, issue, or arrangement so it becomes unclear

items.def_zh: 歪曲，曲解；混淆，使（信息、话语等）杂乱不清
items.def_en: 1. To confuse, distort, or scramble a message, text, or signal so that it becomes unclear or misleading.

items.def_zh: 故意混淆，使晦涩难懂，使困惑
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To deliberately make a message, issue, or fact obscure, confusing, and hard to understand.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe making messages, communications, or facts incomprehensible or distorted, whether through accidental transmission errors and confusion or deliberate intellectual muddying.
groups.summary_zh: 使讯息或事实扭曲失真、语焉不详或晦涩难懂。

groups.name: Generate Commercial Return · 取得收益与入账 (Earn, Gross, Net)
groups.tip: 凭付出辛劳赚取酬劳

items.def_en: (+ sth) to yield or produce a certain amount of income or profit
to produce or generate a financial return, dividend, or profit
(+ sth) to earn or attract a specified amount of money or revenue
to gain an amount of profit beyond all expenses and deductions

items.def_zh: 挣得，赚取；赢得，博得；应得
items.def_en: 1. To receive money as payment for work done. 2. To get something that you deserve through your efforts, qualities, or skills.
to earn or produce an amount as clear profit after all tax, costs, and expenses
To earn a particular total amount of money before taxes and other costs are deducted.
(+ sth) to earn or take in large amounts of money easily or quickly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe specific commercial or accounting manners of realizing monetary proceeds from labor, investment, or enterprise, distinguishing pre-expense totals, post-expense surpluses, and baseline earnings.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过劳动、经营或扣除成本等特定方式获取并核算财务收益。

groups.name: Guarantee & Assure · 保证与担保 (Assure, Warrant, Guarantee)
groups.tip: 打消对方疑虑并提供确定承诺

items.def_en: to promise formally that certain conditions will be met, often offering restitution if not

items.def_zh: 向……保证，使确信；确保，使确定发生；（英）给……投保（人寿险）
items.def_en: 1. To tell someone positively that something is true or will happen, so as to remove doubt. 2. To make something certain to happen. 3. (British English) To insure someone's life.

items.def_zh: 保证，担保；使有必要，证明……合理
items.def_en: 1. To guarantee or state with confidence that something is true, safe, or reliable. 2. To make a particular action or state seem necessary, reasonable, or justified.
to state officially and formally that something is true, accurate, or meeting standard specifications
to formally and solemnly promise to do, give, or uphold something
(+ sb/sth) assert or confirm with certainty the good character, truth, or reliability of someone or something
(+ sth) guarantee the quality, truth, or reliability of a product, claim, or promise
(+ sth) declare with complete confidence that something is reliable and effective

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on speech acts that commit the speaker to the truth, quality, or certainty of an outcome, relieving doubts or accepting formal liability.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过语言或法律文书做出确凿承诺，打消对方疑虑或对品质承担责任。

groups.name: Harsh & Low Animal Vocalizations · 动物粗粝啼鸣 (Croak, Caw, Squawk)
groups.tip: 喉头发声与沙哑低鸣的发音方式

items.def_en: (of pigs or large animals) to make a low, rough, throaty sound

items.def_zh: （羊等）咩咩叫；微弱地抱怨，抽抽搭搭地说
items.def_en: 1. To make the wavering cry of a sheep, goat, or calf. 2. (disapproving) To complain or speak in a weak, high, trembling voice.

items.raw_cluster: 动物叫声 Animal Sound & Cry
items.def_zh: （母鸡）咯咯叫；发出啧啧声（表示同情或不赞成）
items.def_en: 1. (of a hen) To make a short, low, characteristic sound. 2. (+ over/at) To make a clicking sound with the tongue to express disapproval, sympathy, or fussy concern.
(of wild geese or swans) to make a loud, resonant call in flight or warning

items.def_zh: （青蛙或乌鸦）呱呱叫；用沙哑的声音说话；（俚）死
items.def_en: 1. To make a deep, rough sound like a frog or crow; to speak with a low, hoarse voice. 2. (slang) To die.

items.def_zh: （鸟类）发出粗厉刺耳的叫声；大声抱怨，抗议
items.def_en: 1. (of a bird) To make a loud, harsh, shrill noise. 2. (informal) To complain noisily or indignantly.
(of a crow, rook, or raven) To make its loud, harsh, characteristic cry.
(of an owl, raptor, or bird) to emit a harsh, loud, piercing cry

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting low, grating, harsh, or throaty vocalizations characteristic of specific creatures such as corvids, amphibians, and barnyard fowl.
groups.summary_zh: 描述乌鸦、青蛙或家禽等发出粗粝、低沉或嘶哑鸣叫的声音特征。

groups.name: Heal Tissue & Cure Disease · 医治与使康复 (Cure, Heal, Remedy)
groups.tip: 疾病得到根治与创口愈合

items.def_en: (+ with/for) to give medical care or attention to an illness or injured person

items.def_zh: （使）愈合，（使）治愈；调解，平息（争吵、分歧）
items.def_en: 1. To become healthy again, or make an injury, wound, or sick person healthy. 2. To resolve or put an end to an unpleasant situation or disagreement.

items.def_zh: 治愈，治好；矫正，消除（问题）；腌制，加工处理（肉、鱼等）
items.def_en: 1. To make an ill person healthy again, or treat a disease successfully. 2. To solve a problem or put an end to bad behavior. 3. To preserve meat, fish, or other food by drying, salting, or smoking.
become covered with healthy new skin or scar tissue
become completely healthy and whole again, especially of a wound or injury
(+ sb/sth) give quick or temporary medical treatment to an injured person or wound
to treat, correct, or provide an effective counteractant for a disease or bodily defect
(+ from) to recover health, energy, or strength gradually after illness or injury

groups.summary_en: A medical practitioner, therapeutic intervention, or natural biological process restores a diseased organism or damaged tissue back to healthy functioning. 'Heal' centers on the organic closing of wounds and restoration of whole tissue, whereas 'cure' targets the eradication of a specific medical pathology, disease, or infection.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过医药干预或肌体自我修复使伤口愈合、消除疾病并恢复健康。

groups.name: Heat & Thermal Prep · 加热与升温 (Warm, Heat, Preheat)
groups.tip: 施加热量使温度升高

items.def_en: (+ sth) Become hot or make food, a liquid, or an enclosure hotter
[I/T] to heat food that has grown cold, or to gradually increase temperature

items.def_zh: （使）变暖，（使）温暖；加热（食物等，常与up连用）
items.def_en: 1. To become warm or warmer, or to make someone or something warm or warmer.
1. To heat an oven, pan, or appliance to a particular temperature before using it.
(+ sth) Heat a liquid until it boils vigorously
1. To make something hot or warm, or to become hot or warm.
to make food or a liquid hot again after it has cooled down
to heat a liquid (especially milk) until it is just below its boiling point

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe transferring thermal energy to bring an object, liquid, or enclosure from a lower temperature to a desired higher temperature.
groups.summary_zh: 指对物体、食物或空间进行加温，使其由凉变热或达到预设温度。

groups.name: Heel, Capsize & Invert · 倾斜与翻覆 (Heel, Capsize, Turtle)
groups.tip: 重心偏移或底朝天

items.def_zh: （船只因偏载或进水而）持续侧倾
items.def_en: of a ship: to lean steadily to one side, especially because of cargo shift or flooding

items.def_zh: （船只等）倾斜，倾侧；使倾斜；紧随，尾随
items.def_en: (especially of a boat or ship) To lean over or tilt to one side; to cause to lean over.
fall or cause something to tilt over onto its side or upside down

items.def_zh: （船只或车辆）翻覆，底朝天翻转；捕龟
items.def_en: (especially of a boat or vehicle) To turn completely upside down; capsize.
to capsize onto its side or back; of a person, to fall over suddenly
turn completely upside down or onto its side, especially of a boat or vehicle
capsize or invert so that the underside is facing upward
of a boat: to overturn completely in the water, or to cause one to do so

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this nautical and physical motion frame describe watercraft or upright bodies tilting progressively from upright trim to complete upside-down inversion. Nuances range from temporary lateral leaning caused by wind (heel, list) to dynamic flipping (capsize) and full 180-degree hull inversion (turtle, keel over).
groups.summary_zh: 描述船只或物体受风浪或外力发生侧倾乃至完全倒扣翻沉的动态过程。

groups.name: Hesitate & Scruple over Details · 疑义与据理力争 (Demur, Stickle, Scruple)
groups.tip: 为细枝末节据理力争僵持不下

items.def_zh: 犹豫，迟疑（因吃惊或疑虑而裹足不前）
items.def_en: (+ at) to hesitate or be reluctant to accept or do something because of scruples or difficulty
(+ sth) raise petty, unnecessary objections or quibbles over minor details

items.def_zh: 顾忌，起疑虑（通常用于否定句）
items.def_en: (+ to do sth) to hesitate to do something because one thinks it may be morally wrong

items.def_zh: 提出异议，抗辩，表示反对或迟疑
items.def_en: (+ at/to) to express disagreement, hesitation, or polite objection to something.

items.def_zh: 对……犹豫畏缩；对……表示异议
items.def_en: (+ sth) hesitate or refuse to proceed because of scruples, difficulty, or reluctance

items.def_zh: 因顾虑而犹豫；因良心不安而止步
items.def_en: (+ sth) hesitate to do something because of moral doubts or principled scruples
(+ about/over) to raise trivial or irritating objections to avoid addressing the main issue

items.def_zh: （为微不足道的细节）据理力争，吹毛求疵，固执己见
items.def_en: (+ for/about/over) to argue stubbornly or insist pedantically on minor points or rules.

groups.summary_en: Refers to raising objections or showing reluctance over ethical principles, rules, or minor terms rather than entering open conflict. 'Demur' signals polite, principled hesitation, while 'stickle' marks rigid, stubborn insistence on exact details.
groups.summary_zh: 出于原则或细则提出疑义、犹豫不决或固执坚持争端。

groups.name: High-Heat Cooking & Overheating · 顶热炙烤与火候过度 (Broil, Overcook, Scorch)
groups.tip: 明火烧烤或过度烹煮

items.def_en: [I/T] to ruin food completely by cooking it for too long or at too high a temperature
to cook food on a heavy flat hot surface or iron plate with high heat
(+ sth) be ruined or destroyed by excessive heat, or burn food completely

items.def_zh: （因过度受热）变干硬；烘干过度
items.def_en: (+ sth) lose all moisture and become hard through prolonged or excessive cooking heat
(+ sth) become or make the surface of food pleasantly dry and firm using high direct heat
[T/I] to burn the surface of food slightly or unintentionally by excessive direct heat

items.def_zh: （在烤架或烤箱上火下）烤，炙烤；（天气等）酷热，烘烤
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly NAmE) To cook food by direct heat under an oven element or over charcoal (equivalent to BrE 'grill'). 2. To make or become extremely hot under the sun or high heat.

items.def_zh: 把……煮得过久，过度烹饪；煮得过久
items.def_en: To cook food for too long so that it becomes dry, burnt, or spoiled.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame contrast aggressive direct overhead radiant cooking with cooking food too long or at excessive heat, leading to degradation of texture or burnt results.
groups.summary_zh: 采用上方强直射热源炙烤，或因加热失当、过火导致食物烧焦烹坏的情境。

groups.name: Impair & Debilitate · 阻碍损毁与致残瘫痪 (Queer, Cripple, Hamstring)
groups.tip: 从轻微受损到彻底致残

items.def_en: (informal, dated) to spoil or ruin a plan or someone's chances of success.
to severely restrict the efficiency, freedom of action, or operation of someone or something
slow down gradually until completely stopping or becoming incapacitated

items.def_zh: 使失去战斗力；使丧失功能
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) injure, damage, or impair someone or something so that they cannot function or participate
(+ sth) stop a machine, system, or organization from operating, often rendering it completely non-functional

items.def_zh: 严重破坏，削弱；使致残，使残疾
items.def_en: 1. to seriously damage an organization, economy, or system so it can no longer operate properly. 2. (dated, offensive) to injure someone so that they are permanently unable to walk or use their limbs properly.

items.def_zh: 使瘫痪；使完全停止运转
items.def_en: to cause a person, system, or organization to become completely unable to act or function

items.def_zh: 使无能力，使伤残丧失工作能力
items.def_en: to prevent someone or something from functioning normally, as by injury, illness, or damage

groups.summary_en: An agent, condition, or event impairs an operation, person, or organization so severely that it loses its operational capacity. Nuances scale from spoiling or compromising a process to utterly incapacitating or paralyzing functionality.
groups.summary_zh: 破坏运作或致残机体，使其丧失正常机能与行动力。

groups.name: Indirect Communication & Implication · 委婉暗示与示意 (Hint, Intimate)
groups.tip: 不直说而委婉隐晦暗示

items.def_en: to express or indicate indirectly without explicitly stating
To suggest or indicate something indirectly.
(+ sth) suggest or allude to something indirectly rather than stating it plainly
(+ sth) mention or allude to a subject briefly or indirectly in passing
(+ sth) intend or convey a subtle meaning indirectly; imply
1. To communicate or make something known indirectly; to hint. 2. To state or announce officially.
(+ to) to mention or refer to something in an indirect, passing manner

items.def_zh: 含沙射影；暗指（常含贬义）
items.def_en: to suggest or hint at something unpleasant in an indirect and unpleasant way

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing communicative acts where the speaker conveys meaning subtly, obliquely, or delicately rather than stating it plainly.
groups.summary_zh: 指不直接言明，而是通过微妙言辞、含蓄提示或眼神委婉传达意图。

groups.name: Induct & Invest Clergy/Rulers · 授职与就职 (Enthrone, Invest, Ordain)
groups.tip: 授予神职、王权或官方职务

items.def_zh: 正式授予（职位、权力或长袍）
items.def_en: (+ with) to formally confer a rank, office, or insignia of power upon someone
(+ sb) to officially induct someone into public office through a formal oath

items.def_zh: 授予圣职；封立（牧师、神父）
items.def_en: to officially confer holy orders on someone, appointing them as a priest, minister, or rabbi
to introduce someone into an official public position with a formal ceremony

items.def_zh: 使正式就任；吸收（入职/入会）
items.def_en: (+ into) to formally admit someone into a post, holy office, or organization
to dedicate someone formally and religiously to a divine service or to the office of bishop

items.def_zh: 授予（某人）神职；给……穿僧袍（或长袍）
items.def_en: 1. To invest someone with clerical office or priestly robes. 2. To clothe in a frock.

items.def_zh: 使登基，使即位；使就主教职；尊崇
items.def_en: To formally place a monarch or high-ranking religious leader on a throne in an official ceremony.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote ceremonial, institutional installations of religious or civic dignitaries into official office or holy orders. They involve formal rites such as dressing in vestments, seating upon a bishop's or monarch's chair, or conferring official powers.
groups.summary_zh: 通过庄严宗教或世俗仪式为神职人员、主教或统治者授予圣职与职权。

groups.name: Indulgent & Satiating Overconsumption · 纵欲暴食与饱胀进食 (Binge, Gorge)
groups.tip: 放任食欲毫无节制大吃大喝

items.def_en: (+ on sth) eat heartily, enthusiastically, and voraciously
(+ on sth) eat enough food until one is completely full
(+ on) to indulge in eating an extraordinarily large amount of food greedily

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽至撑饱；大吃特吃
items.def_en: (+ with sth) eat a very large amount of food until uncomfortably full
(+ oneself) to eat so much food that one feels completely, uncomfortably full

items.raw_cluster: 暴饮暴食与放纵 Binge & Indulge
items.def_zh: 大吃大喝，暴食；狂欢放纵
items.def_en: To indulge excessively in food, alcohol, or another activity in a short period.

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽，大吃大嚼；塞饱
items.def_en: To eat a large amount of food greedily and until completely full.
to feed or supply someone (especially oneself) with food to full excess

groups.summary_en: Scale measuring the degree of uncontrolled, excessive food consumption to full bodily repletion and gluttonous stuffing.
groups.summary_zh: 反映从无节制的放纵暴食到将胃填满、吃到撑胀的程度递增。

groups.name: Informal & Improvised Musical Performance · 随性即兴演奏 (Vamp, Busk, Jam)
groups.tip: 不拘一格的即兴表演与演奏

items.def_zh: 随意弹拨；漫不经心地试音奏乐
items.def_en: to improvise or play an instrument in a casual, aimless way

items.def_zh: 随性伴奏；跟着即兴演奏
items.def_en: to play music informally and spontaneously along with other musicians or a recording
(+ sth) to play an improvised musical variation or series of notes based on an existing theme
to play improvised music casually with other musicians

items.raw_cluster: 即兴创作与演奏 Improvise & Vamp
items.def_zh: 即兴伴奏，弹奏反复过渡乐节；拼凑，捏造（vamp up）；勾引（男子）
items.def_en: 1. (music) To improvise a simple, repeating musical accompaniment. 2. ('vamp up') To patch up, refurbish, or invent hastily. 3. (informal) To act flirtatiously or seductively toward someone.
[I/T] to sweep the fingers lightly across the strings of an instrument
1. To play music, sing, or perform in a public place in order to earn money from passersby.

items.def_zh: 轻快奏出（高音），轻柔鸣啭；引诱，哄骗
items.def_en: 1. To play or sing light, high-pitched, piping or warbling musical notes. 2. (dialect) To coax or wheedle.

groups.summary_en: Musicians play instruments or sing in an informal, improvised, or public street context, often repeating basic chord patterns, busking for tips, or casually noodling on an instrument.
groups.summary_zh: 指在街头卖艺、即兴伴奏或随意摆弄乐器的非正式演奏方式。

groups.name: Infraction Penalization & Criminalization · 处罚与定罪 (Ticket, Penalize, Criminalize)
groups.tip: 从明令禁止上升到定罪惩治

items.def_en: to summon someone to court or issue an official ticket for a minor infraction
to compel someone to pay an amount of money as an official punishment for breaking a law or rule

items.def_zh: 对……开违规罚单；为……购票（或售票）
items.def_en: 1. to issue an official notice of a traffic offense or other fine to someone. 2. to provide someone or something with a ticket.
to impose a penalty or sanction on someone for breaking a rule, law, or agreement
(+ sb) to punish or penalize someone severely for an infraction or offense
(+ sb/sth) to enforce laws or penalties rigorously against offenders or unlawful acts
[I/T] to conduct legal proceedings against someone in respect of a criminal charge

items.def_zh: 定……为违法行为，使定罪；把……当作罪犯对待
items.def_en: 1. to make an action or activity illegal by law. 2. to treat someone or a group as criminals.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to law enforcement and statutory measures applied to wrongful conduct, progressing from minor administrative citations to severe statutory penalization and the formal classification of acts as crimes.
groups.summary_zh: 针对违章或违法行为施加处罚，从行政罚款升级为刑事定罪。

groups.name: Infuse & Permeate · 灌注与渗透 (Thorough Fluidic Infiltration)
groups.tip: 液体或物质完全渗透灌注

items.def_en: (+ sth) to penetrate deeply into the substance of a material by liquid absorption
(+ sth) to slowly flow, spread, or diffuse throughout a porous medium
(+ with/into) to introduce or soak a quality or essence thoroughly into a medium
[I/T] to spread throughout and pervade every part of an area or material
(+ with) to saturate or inspire completely with a feeling, value, or quality
to spread over or through something with light, color, or moisture

items.def_zh: 相互渗透，互相贯通；穿透
items.def_en: (formal) To penetrate, permeate, or diffuse into each other; to spread through and blend together.

items.def_zh: 灌注（液体、血液于器官等）；充满，洒遍
items.def_en: 1. (medicine) To pass fluid, especially blood, through the vessels of an organ or tissue. 2. (literary) To suffuse or spread liquid, light, or color over something.

groups.summary_en: A fluid, gas, quality, or substance deeply spreads, diffuses, and saturates throughout every part of a matrix or medium. 'Perfuse' and 'interpenetrate' denote specialized and reciprocal diffusion respectively.
groups.summary_zh: 液体、气味或无形质感彻底扩散并浸润充满整个空间或结构内部。

groups.name: Ingest & Consume · 进食与吞咽 (Eat, Devour, Gobble)
groups.tip: 口咽摄入食物的动作

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/at) To take small, tentative bites of food slowly
(+ sth) consume all of the food that has been served or prepared
(+ on sth) eat food greedily or enthusiastically
(+ sth) start eating food enthusiastically and with gusto
1. To put food into your mouth, chew it, and swallow it. 2. (+ away/into) To destroy or wear away gradually.
To consume food very quickly and eagerly, chewing very little
[I/T] (+ up/down) To eat food hurriedly and noisily, swallowing large pieces
To eat all of something greedily, rapidly, and voraciously

groups.summary_en: An agent consumes solid food through the mouth by chewing and swallowing. Manners range from basic routine ingestion ('eat') to ravenous, aggressive consumption ('devour') or rapid, noisy gulping ('gobble', 'wolf down').
groups.summary_zh: 通过口腔咀嚼并吞下食物的动作，涵盖从常规进食到狼吞虎咽的粗鲁吃相。

groups.name: Inspect & Scrutinize · 检查与细审 (Examine, Inspect, Scrutinize)
groups.tip: 严密审视细究各个细节

items.def_en: to examine something to see if it is correct, safe, or satisfactory
(+ sb/sth) examine or inspect someone or something to ascertain accuracy, state, or safety
(+ sb/sth) inspect or examine someone or something quickly to assess condition or quality
to look at something carefully, especially to check that it is in good condition or complies with rules
(+ sth) examine, review, or inspect something in detail for errors or quality
to look at or consider a person or thing carefully and thoroughly in order to learn more about them
to look at, read, or study something with intense concentration over an extended time

items.def_zh: 仔细审查，细看，严密审视
items.def_en: To examine or inspect someone or something very closely and thoroughly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe visually or analytically examining something with increasing degrees of critical thoroughness, moving from routine inspection to rigorous, unrelenting scrutiny for defects or hidden details.
groups.summary_zh: 指对事物进行由浅入深的细致检查、审视或严密核验。

groups.name: Install & Invest · 任命与就职 (Ordain, Inaugurate, Install)
groups.tip: 官职委派与仪式性就职履新

items.def_en: (+ with/in) to formally endow someone with legal rights, power, or official insignia
(+ sb) to formally admit someone into public office through an official oath

items.def_zh: 开启，引进（新时代、新任期）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to mark the formal beginning of a new period, regime, or leadership
(+ as/in) to formally place someone in an official position or rank with an appropriate ceremony

items.def_zh: 授予圣职，任命为神职人员；注定，规定
items.def_en: 1. To officially appoint or consecrate someone as a priest or religious minister. 2. (formal) (of God, fate, or authority) To decide or decree something beforehand.

items.def_zh: 为……举行就职典礼，使正式就任；开创，使正式开始；为……举行落成（或开幕）典礼
items.def_en: 1. To introduce someone into an official position with a formal ceremony. 2. To officially begin or initiate something new or important.

items.def_zh: 授予圣职，任命；整顿，安排
items.def_en: (rare or archaic) To ordain someone to a religious office; to order or arrange.
(+ into) to formally introduce someone into a new position, office, or exclusive organization

groups.summary_en: An authority or institutional body formally confers an official office, sacred status, or public mandate onto a person through an established ceremony.
groups.summary_zh: 权威机构通过既定仪式正式授予当事人公职、圣职或法定权力。

groups.name: Intend & Resolve · 意图与决意 (Intend, Resolve, Mean)
groups.tip: 确立行动意图与内在意志

items.def_zh: 立志，决意；用意志力驱动；遗赠（财产）
items.def_en: 1. To intend, desire, or determine something by a deliberate exercise of willpower. 2. To try to make something happen simply by thinking about it. 3. To leave something to someone in a will.

items.def_zh: 想要，愿意（will 的过去式，表意愿或决心）；将，会（表假设或推测）；过去常常（表习惯）
items.def_en: 1. Used as the past form of 'will' to express intention, willingness, or determination. 2. Used to express conditional outcomes, polite requests, or past habits.
(formal) to have as an intentional aim or firmly planned resolution

items.def_zh: 打算，企图；意味着（mean 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of mean: intended, had in mind, or signified.
[I/T] to have in mind as a purpose, plan, or objective to be achieved
[I/T] to make a firm and formal decision to do something
(+ to do sth) to begin an undertaking with a clear intention or determined purpose
(+ doing sth) to plan or resolve firmly to achieve a particular result

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on a conscious mental purpose, purposefulness, or fixed determination to bring about a particular future outcome. They range from basic aim ('mean') to volitional force ('will') and formal, deliberate intent ('purpose', 'resolve').
groups.summary_zh: 指主体在内心形成特定目标、意图或达成某事的坚定决意。

groups.name: Interlink & Coalesce · 联结互通与汇聚结块 (Interconnect, Conglomerate)
groups.tip: 彼此相通，交织成更大网络

items.def_en: (+ with sb/sth) connect, join, or combine together to form an integrated system or alliance
(+ with sth) join, coordinate, or be closely interconnected with another system or entity
to join or become joined together by weaving or blending
join together with others to form a single united group or coalition
(formal) To gather, cluster, or combine distinct parts or organizations into a single coherent mass or entity.
To connect with one another, or to connect two or more things, so that they form an integrated system.
to come together to form one larger group, substance, or mass
to collect or form into a mass or group

groups.summary_en: Distinct elements, organizations, or networks link mutually or gather into a cohesive mass or cluster. Manner ranges from systematic mutual linkage to dense physical or corporate agglomeration.
groups.summary_zh: 多元实体相互贯通网络化，或凝聚聚拢成块的演化方式。

groups.name: Intertwine & Convolute · 盘绕与交织 (Intertwine, Convolute, Involve)
groups.tip: 互相盘绕缠结呈复杂曲折

items.def_en: (+ sth) encircle or coil repeatedly around a central core or object
(+ sth) twist, coil, or encircle tightly around something else
[I/T] To wind or turn things around each other into a spiral or complex shape
[I/T] To wind into rings, loops, or a spiral shape
[I/T] To wind or spiral around something, or twist two things together
(+ sth) coil or interweave two or more flexible strands around each other
(+ with) To twist or wind two or more things closely together, or to be closely connected.

items.def_zh: （使）卷绕，（使）盘旋缠绕；使复杂化
items.def_en: To twist, coil, or fold intricately together; to make something complex or difficult to follow.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize twisting elements together into an intricate, twisted, or convoluted physical or abstract configuration. 'Convolute' stresses extreme twisting or complicating until clarity is lost, while 'intertwine' focuses on mutual, reciprocally coiled physical or conceptual relationships.
groups.summary_zh: 相互盘绕扭结，形成极其复杂、盘错或晦涩的形态。

groups.name: Join & Bind Typographically/Physically · 焊接与连字符连接 (Weld, Hyphen, Splice)
groups.tip: 焊接或符号连接一体

items.def_en: (+ sth) to unite or connect two things together physically to form a continuous whole
(+ sth) to join the ends of two ropes, wires, or pieces of film together to form a single continuous piece
(+ sth) to join separate parts together to make a whole
[I/T] to join or become joined together firmly by or as if by melting

items.def_zh: 焊接，熔接；使结合成一体
items.def_en: 1. To join pieces of metal or plastic by heating them until they fuse. 2. To unite people, organizations, or ideas firmly into a single cohesive whole.
to join two pieces of rope, wire, or film by interweaving strands or overlapping ends

items.def_zh: 用连字符连接（单词或音节）
items.def_en: To join words or syllables together using a hyphen (-); hyphenate.
to connect two words or syllables with a hyphen

groups.summary_en: An agent fuses, unites, or connects two entities into a continuous whole, either physically via heat/pressure or symbolically/typographically using punctuation or specialized joints. Verbs emphasize the creation of an unbreakable or formal composite link.
groups.summary_zh: 通过焊接等物理方式或连字符等形式将两部分牢固熔接或连结成一个整体。

groups.name: Leer & Ogle · 窥看与不怀好意地注视 (Leer, Ogle, Gawk)
groups.tip: 带有欲念或失礼地盯看

items.def_zh: 上下打量；（带有性意味地）注视
items.def_en: (+ sb) to look at someone carefully, especially to evaluate their sexual attractiveness
(informal) to look closely, intently, or brazenly at someone
(+ at) to stare openly and rudely, often in a stupid, gaping, or unseemly manner

items.def_zh: 呆看；失礼地张大嘴巴注视
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to stare openly and rudely, often with open-mouthed curiosity

items.def_zh: 色迷迷地看，挑逗地凝视
items.def_en: to stare at someone with open and suggestive sexual desire

items.def_zh: 色迷迷地看，斜着眼不怀好意地看
items.def_en: to look or stare at someone in an unpleasant, malicious, or sexually suggestive way

items.def_zh: 斜眼看；不怀好意或色迷迷地注视
items.def_en: (+ sb) to look at someone in an unpleasant, malicious, or sexually suggestive way
(+ over/at) to gaze upon someone with malicious satisfaction or triumph

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe fixing one's gaze upon a person in a sexually suggestive, predatory, intrusive, or malicious manner. 'Ogle' leans toward overt sexual admiration/undressing with eyes, whereas 'leer' conveys malicious, lascivious, or sinister intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指带着挑逗、好色、侵犯性或邪恶的不良意图注视他人。

groups.name: Legal Substitution & Contractual Succession · 法律代位与契约承继 (Subrogate, Novate)
groups.tip: 订立新合同以替代旧债权

items.def_zh: 转让（合同权利、财产或利益）
items.def_en: (+ to) to legally transfer rights, claims, or property to another party

items.def_zh: 转移，转交（权利、责任或所有权）
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) to transfer a legal right, title, claim, or obligation to a successor

items.def_zh: 签署转让；通过签字转交（财产或权利）
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) to officially transfer the legal ownership of rights or property to another party by signing a document

items.def_zh: 移交；交出（控制权或法定责任）
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) to transfer formal responsibility, rights, or possession of something to another person

items.def_zh: 正式取代（既有法律、规则或条约）
items.def_en: to take the place of a previously valid law, contract, or provision, rendering it void

items.def_zh: 移交；转移给（继承人或下级）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/upon/to) to pass duties, liabilities, or powers from one legal body or holder to a successor

items.def_zh: （法律或保险中）代位求偿，替代
items.def_en: (law) To substitute one person or party in place of another with respect to a lawful claim, right, or demand.

items.def_zh: （通过订立新契约）更新，替代（合同或债务）
items.def_en: (law) To replace an existing legal contract or obligation with a new one.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame describe substituting one party, right, or obligation for another by operation of law or mutual contract, transferring liabilities, claims, or duties formally from an original holder to a successor.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法律规定或合同协议，将权利、债务或法律主体正式转移替代给另一方。

groups.name: Lengthen & Protract · 延长与展延 (Lengthen, Extend, Protract)
groups.tip: 拉长空间维度或延长持续时间

items.def_en: (+ sth) to extend the duration or spatial span of something
[I/T] to make something longer in physical span, reach, or duration
[I/T] to pull something to its full length or make a period of time cover more
To become longer in distance or time, or to make something longer.
(+ sth) to prolong something unnecessarily or make it continue longer than desirable
(+ sth) to make an event, speech, or process last much longer than necessary
[I/T] to make or become longer in physical shape, often through stretching
(formal) To prolong something or make a meeting, process, or event last longer than expected or necessary.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stretching physical dimensions or drawing out durations in time, ranging from neutral extension to wearisome prolongation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在空间长度或时间跨度上加以拉长或过度延展。

groups.name: Levy Taxes & Extra Charges · 征税与加收费用 (Tax, Surcharge, Levy)
groups.tip: 按规定额外加收税费附加费

items.def_en: to impose an obligatory financial charge on a citizen, goods, or transactions by an authority
to evaluate property in order to set a tax, or to impose a specific charge on someone

items.def_zh: 强行征收；额外加收（税款或费用）
items.def_en: (+ sth) impose an extra tax, fee, or penalty suddenly or unfairly

items.def_zh: 附加，额外计入（费用或税额）
items.def_en: (+ sth) add an extra charge or condition onto an existing bill or payment, often as an afterthought
to impose a tax, fee, or fine formally by legal authority
to fix or impose a duty on goods entering or leaving a country

items.def_zh: 对……收取额外费用，加收附加税
items.def_en: to charge an additional fee or tax on something over and above the regular price

items.def_zh: 缴纳什一税；向……征收什一税
items.def_en: to pay or collect one tenth of one's income or produce as a religious tax or offering

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to official, institutional, or customary acts of imposing obligatory fees, taxes, or additional surcharges on goods, transactions, or people. They vary by administrative mechanism, religious obligation, or supplemental commercial pricing.
groups.summary_zh: 依法或按惯例征收赋税、附加费与摊派款项。

groups.name: Live in Specific Lifestyle Manner · 以特定方式栖居生活 (Bachelor, Bach, Slum)
groups.tip: 生物在特定环境下栖息

items.def_zh: 临时露营；在简陋环境中暂居
items.def_en: live or sleep in makeshift conditions like in a tent or unfurnished room

items.def_zh: 隐居；窝在（某处生活或藏匿）
items.def_en: stay or reside in a secluded or hidden accommodation for an extended period
(+ with) live together without being married, or cohabit casually

items.def_zh: 过单身生活；独自料理生活
items.def_en: 1. (dated or informal) To live as an unmarried man, managing one's own housekeeping and cooking.

items.def_zh: （slum it）在简陋条件下度日；逛贫民窟，体验下层生活
items.def_en: 1. ('slum it') (informal) To live or spend time in conditions much poorer or less comfortable than you are used to. 2. To visit poor or disreputable areas out of curiosity.

items.def_zh: 过单身汉生活，独自操持家务
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly US / NZ) To live alone as a bachelor, doing one's own cooking and housekeeping.
live in squalid, messy, or uncomfortable conditions

items.def_zh: 过简陋生活，勉强将就居住
items.def_en: live temporarily without normal comforts and conveniences

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe residing or keeping house in a distinct, socially characterized manner—typically living unencumbered as an unmarried person, roughing it in rustic accommodations, or deliberately enduring substandard conditions below one's customary station.
groups.summary_zh: 指过着单身汉生活、简居独处或屈身栖居于低端环境。

groups.name: Locate & Determine Identity · 查明与确准定位 (Locate, Pinpoint, Identify)
groups.tip: 探明确切位置与情况

items.def_zh: 用检索表鉴定（动植物物种）；确定，查明
items.def_en: To identify an organism or object using a biological classification key.
to detect, locate, or identify someone or something visually or through observation

items.def_zh: 找出……的位置，查明；使坐落于，安置
items.def_en: 1. To discover the exact place or position of something. 2. To place, establish, or position something in a particular location.
(+ sb/sth) to search for someone or something until they are located
(+ sb/sth) to identify or distinguish one person or thing specifically from a larger group
to find something or someone by carefully following clues, trails, or investigation
(+ sb/sth) to direct one's attention or locate the exact position or identity of a target

items.def_zh: 精准确定，查明准确位置或原因
items.def_en: to discover, locate, or explain the exact position, nature, or reason of something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the cognitive and investigatory process of finding the exact spatial position, nature, or critical identity of an unknown target. Nuances differentiate general discovery of position from high-precision targeting.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过认知搜寻或分析手段，查明具体目标的位置、属性或关键特征。

groups.name: Locomotion on Belly or All Fours · 匍匐与爬行 (Crawl, Creep, Grovel)
groups.tip: 四肢着地贴地缓慢向前爬

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚爬行；悄无声息地贴地潜行
items.def_en: move along quietly and stealthily close to the ground

items.def_zh: 缓慢蠕动前行；艰难爬移
items.def_en: move forward extremely slowly and with painstaking caution
to move along extremely slowly, little by little

items.def_zh: 匍匐爬行；蹑手蹑脚地走，轻手轻脚地移动；逐渐蔓延
items.def_en: 1. To move slowly with the body close to the ground; to crawl. 2. To move quietly and carefully to avoid being noticed. 3. To develop, advance, or grow gradually.

items.def_zh: 爬行，匍匐前进；缓慢行进；巴结，谄媚
items.def_en: 1. To move forward on hands and knees or with the body dragging close to the ground. 2. To move forward extremely slowly. 3. (informal) To behave subserviently toward someone.

items.def_zh: 匍匐爬行，蹑手蹑脚地走（creep的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of creep; to have moved slowly and stealthily, close to the ground or without being noticed.

items.def_zh: 匍匐；趴倒（亦含卑躬屈膝）
items.def_en: to lie or crawl with the face downwards and body close to the earth

items.def_zh: 手足并用地攀爬或匍匐移走
items.def_en: to move hurriedly or awkwardly on hands and feet over rough terrain

groups.summary_en: An agent moves forward close to the ground on hands and knees, on the belly, or with exceptionally slow, stealthy strides to stay low and undetected.
groups.summary_zh: 指手膝着地、腹部贴地匍匐前进，或极其缓慢贴地移动的身姿。

groups.name: Logical Generalization & Deduction · 归纳与推演 (Generalize, Deduce, Induce)
groups.tip: 依循严谨逻辑层层推导

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ that/out) to formulate thoughts systematically using logical arguments
(+ sth) to solve a problem or arrive at an understanding through logical thinking
(+ sth) to deduce, calculate, or logically determine something by reasoning
to derive or infer a general law from particular facts or instances
(+ sth) to find a solution or conclusion through careful logical analysis and deduction

items.def_zh: 概括，归纳；以偏概全，泛泛而论；普及
items.def_en: 1. to form a general principle or conclusion from specific examples or evidence. 2. to make a general statement that is too broad, often oversimplifying
to form an opinion or reach a conclusion about something by reasoning logically from facts or evidence
[I/T] to deduce or reason using formal syllogistic logic

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on formal cognitive directional reasoning: bottom-up inductive generalization from particulars to universals, or top-down deductive reasoning from premises to specific instances.
groups.summary_zh: 指从个别到一般的归纳概括，或从普遍法则向下推演具体情况的思维方式。

groups.name: Lower Body to Ground · 跪屈与蹲伏 (Kneel, Crouch)
groups.tip: 降低重心的不同下蹲姿态

items.def_en: to lower one's body closer to the ground to avoid danger or remain hidden
(+ down) to sit on your heels or bend your knees low while remaining on the feet

items.raw_cluster: 姿势与身体动作 Posture & Gesture
items.def_en: 1. (+ down) To bend your knees and lower your body close to the ground, often in fear, hiding, or readiness to spring.

items.def_zh: 跪下，屈膝（kneel的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of kneel; rested on one or both knees.
to lower one's body quickly to the floor or ground, often for concealment or protection
to squat or crouch low to the ground with the knees bent
(+ up) to curl one's limbs close to the body for warmth, protection, or fear
to crouch down or shrink away in fear, pain, or shame

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering the human torso toward the ground by bending the knees or hips, often for concealment, defense, reverence, or physical work. 'Kneel' focuses on resting one's weight on the knees, while 'crouch' centers on bringing the chest and belly close to the ground while balancing on bent legs.
groups.summary_zh: 指弯曲膝盖或躯干以降低重心，采取跪坐、蹲踞或缩低身姿的体态。

groups.name: Manual Shaping & Curving · 捏塑与团聚 (Ball, Cup, Mold)
groups.tip: 揉揉捏捏将其塑造成团状

items.def_en: to bend hands, fingers, or a pliable surface into a curved, rounded configuration
(+ sth) to squeeze or crumple something into a spherical, globular mass
(+ sth) to curve or bend something into a curved or coiled shape
(+ sth) to shape a flexible material into a cylinder or ball by folding it repeatedly
To form or be formed into a tight, round shape or ball.

items.def_zh: （使双手）做成杯状，拱起手捧着；为……拔火罐
items.def_en: 1. To shape your hands into a curved cup-like shape, or hold something gently with your hands curved. 2. To apply a heated suction cup to the skin as a therapeutic treatment.
to shape something into a ball or cylinder by turning it between the palms or on a surface
to work a soft, pliable substance by hand into a definite shape
