groups.summary_en: An agent shapes a malleable material or their own body part (especially hands) into a curved, hollow, or globular form. Verbs in this frame detail the precise geometry and physical action of the hands.
groups.summary_zh: 用双手或模具将物体捏制成弧状、碗状或球体，或手部自身做出相应姿势。

groups.name: Mark & Pattern with Distinctive Signs · 刻印与覆纹 (Character, Checker, Inscribe)
groups.tip: 在表面压印或铭刻印记

items.def_zh: 划线标明；以特定记号标出
items.def_en: (+ sth) draw lines or place distinctive marks to distinguish a boundary or pattern
1. (archaic) To engrave, inscribe, or stamp symbols or marks on something. 2. (literary) To describe or characterize.
to decorate or mark a surface with a recurring design or sequence

items.def_zh: 使呈方格花纹，用方格图案装饰；使交替变化，使多元化
items.def_en: To mark, divide, or pattern a surface with alternating squares or colors.

items.def_zh: 冲压刻出；压印出（图案或形状）
items.def_en: (+ sth) produce a shape or mark on a surface using a heavy die or stamp
to impress a pattern, mark, or design forcefully onto a surface
1. (+ on/with) To write, carve, or engrave words or designs onto a surface. 2. To write a dedication in a book or on a gift.
to mark permanently with a hot iron, or indelibly fix an impression on something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to marking, patterning, or stamping a surface with distinctive figures, checkered squares, or written symbols, often metaphorically describing how traits or experiences leave an indelible signature on character or appearance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在表面印刻图案、方格或文字记号，亦比喻性格或特质的烙印。

groups.name: Marry & Wed · 婚恋与缔结 (Marry, Wed, Tie the Knot)
groups.tip: 结为夫妻或联姻结合

items.def_zh: 结婚；娶，嫁；为……主持婚礼；结合，使结合
items.def_en: 1. To become legally joined to someone as spouses, or take someone as a spouse. 2. To perform a marriage ceremony for two people. 3. To combine two qualities, concepts, or things.

items.def_zh: （与……）结婚，娶，嫁；结合，使紧密结合
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) To marry someone. 2. To combine two different ideas, qualities, or things closely.
(idiomatic/informal) to get married

items.def_zh: 成双结对；结为伴侣/夫妻
items.def_en: form a romantic or marital partnership together
(+ sb) find a spouse for someone, especially a son or daughter, and arrange the marriage
(formal/literary) to marry a person; to take someone as a spouse
To marry again after a previous marriage has ended in divorce or death.
(archaic or literary) To marry a woman, or take someone as a wife.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to entering into the legal, religious, or social contract of matrimony, or officiating at such a ceremony. They vary from standard neutral usage (marry) to literary/formal expressions (wed, espouse) and archaic terms (wive).
groups.summary_zh: 缔结法定或世俗婚姻契约，涵盖口语成婚与文雅联姻表达。

groups.name: Mass Collapse & Downward Giving Way · 塌陷与崩落 (Slump, Avalanche, Cave in)
groups.tip: 突然下垂沉重倒下

items.def_en: (of ground or buildings) to sink down to a lower level without sudden violent disintegration
to collapse inward or fall down toward the center because the support beneath has failed
of earth, snow, or rubble, to collapse and cascade downward along an incline

items.def_zh: 沉重地倒下，猛然跌落；（身子）瘫倒，颓然坐下；（价格、经济等）猛跌，骤降
items.def_en: 1. To sit, lean, or fall heavily and suddenly because you are tired, weak, or ill. 2. To decrease suddenly and by a large amount.
of a roof, ceiling, or geological mass, to collapse inward or fall down into an empty space below
of a physical structure or ground, to suddenly break, fracture, or collapse under excessive pressure or weight

items.def_zh: 崩塌，雪崩般坍落；大量涌至
items.def_en: 1. (of snow, rock, or earth) To slide down a mountainside in a sudden mass. 2. To arrive or occur suddenly in overwhelming numbers.
(of an iceberg or glacier mass) to split off, collapse, and drop away violently

groups.summary_en: A heavy mass, structure, or geological feature suddenly loses support and cascades downward or caves inward under its own weight. The verbs specify the physical dynamics, such as crumbling inward, sliding down a slope, or tumbling en masse.
groups.summary_zh: 重物、地表或建筑结构因失去支撑而在自重下向下坍塌或倾泻。

groups.name: Mate & Copulate by Manner · 交配与交媾 (Mate, Rut, Fuck)
groups.tip: 两性交合与生物本能

items.def_en: come together as a male and female pair for mating
(+ sb) engage in sexual intercourse with sb
(of a male animal) to climb onto a female animal to mate
(especially of animals) To engage in sex in order to produce young; to bring together to breed.

items.def_zh: （鹿等雄性哺乳动物）发情，交尾
items.def_en: (of male deer or other mammals) To enter a period of sexual excitement and activity; to mate.
(+ with) to engage in sexual intercourse, especially in a biological or formal sense
(taboo, slang) 1. To have sexual intercourse with someone. 2. To ruin, botch, or damage something.
[I/T] (British slang) to have sexual intercourse with someone

groups.summary_en: Organisms engage in sexual intercourse, spanning biological animal mating, seasonal rutting, and crude or vigorous human copulation.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖动物自然交配、发情期交媾及人类粗俗直接的性交行为。

groups.name: Military Armament & Disarmament · 军备配置与裁减 (Arm, Disarm, Demilitarize)
groups.tip: 国家或军队武装配备与解禁

items.def_en: to supply a person, group, or country with weapons for combat
equip oneself or one's group with weapons in preparation for conflict
relax from a state of military readiness or withdraw from active deployment
(+ arms/weapons) surrender one's weaponry and cease fighting
[I/T] to take weapons away from someone, or to reduce a nation's military arms
to adapt, convert, or exploit something for use as a weapon

items.raw_cluster: 解除武装与裁军 Disarm & Demilitarize
items.def_zh: 解除武装，使非军事化，废除军备
items.def_en: to remove armed forces, weapons, and military installations from an area or country
to supply an army or country with new weapons again, or equip oneself with weapons again

groups.summary_en: This frame covers state or institutional operations involving the acquisition, enhancement, reduction, or stripping of weaponry and military installations. The continuum ranges from arming/rearming troops to demilitarizing zones or disarming forces.
groups.summary_zh: 对军队、国家或特定区域进行装备配置、重整或裁撤武器。

groups.name: Mobilize & Muster Resources · 动员与召集 (Mobilize, Muster, Rally)
groups.tip: 广泛召集人员或调动战力

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ around/behind) to bring people together to support a common cause, leader, or effort
(+ sb) summon someone to serve in the armed forces or muster for a duty
(+ sb/sth) assemble or collect scattered people, animals, or resources together

items.def_zh: 极力争取；召集（支持、资源）
items.def_en: (+ sth) gather or muster support, enthusiasm, or business through vigorous effort

items.def_zh: 统筹调集，组织（人力/论据）
items.def_en: to systematically gather, arrange, and deploy resources, people, or evidence for action
[I/T] to formally summon people to assemble together for an official meeting or council

items.def_zh: 召集，集合（军队等）；鼓起，振作（勇气、支持等）
items.def_en: 1. To gather together troops for inspection or battle, or summon up courage, strength, or support.

items.def_zh: 动员，调动；组织（人员或资源以采取行动）
items.def_en: 1. To organize and prepare troops, citizens, or resources for urgent military or political action.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate assembling, organizing, and deploying military forces, collective populations, or personal inner resolve to confront a shared emergency or collective objective.
groups.summary_zh: 指为应对紧要关头而组织、召集并调动军队、群众资源或内在勇气。

groups.name: Moisten to Drench · 浸湿至湿透 (Sop, Douse, Soak, Saturate)
groups.tip: 液体浸透直至湿透

items.def_en: (+ sth) absorb liquid from a surface using an absorbent material like bread or a cloth
(+ sth) moisten a surface or material thoroughly by sprinkling or spraying liquid on it

items.def_zh: 浸湿，泡透；（用海绵、面包等）吸尽，蘸尽（液体）
items.def_en: 1. To dip or soak food into liquid. 2. (usually 'sop up') To absorb or soak up liquid with bread, a cloth, or a sponge.
[I/T] to make completely wet by keeping immersed or allowing liquid to penetrate thoroughly
(+ sth) wet an absorbent object or material completely through its entire thickness
to wet thoroughly, especially by pouring liquid copiously over the exterior

items.def_zh: 泼水于，浇透，浸透；熄灭（火、灯）
items.def_en: 1. To pour a large amount of liquid over someone or something; drench. 2. To extinguish a fire or turn off a light.
to fill or soak an item with liquid until no more can possibly be absorbed

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote saturating an absorbent object with liquid, arranged by the degree of wetness imparted—from absorbing liquid locally (sopping) to total, heavy saturation or thorough soaking.
groups.summary_zh: 表达吸附水分或倾注液体的湿润程度，从局部吸湿到全面彻底湿透。

groups.name: Move & Relocate · 迁移与搬迁 (Relocate, Migrate, Resettle)
groups.tip: 变更常驻地点位置

items.def_en: [I/T] to change one's home or place of work from one location to another
permanently leave one's home or current place of residence
start living in a new home or place of residence

items.def_zh: 收拾家当迁居；移居他处
items.def_en: leave the place where one has settled and relocate to a new home or area
to move a person, family, or community permanently to an entirely new environment
To move to a new place to live or operate, or to move someone or something to a new place.
1. (of animals or birds) To travel to a different region according to the seasons. 2. To move from one country or region to another to live or work.
[I/T] to establish, or assist people in establishing, a new permanent home in a different region or country

groups.summary_en: Agents change their permanent or habitual place of residence or base of operations, ranging from personal moving to large-scale ecological or demographic shifts.
groups.summary_zh: 主体从一地变更为另一地居住或运营，涉及个人搬迁与群体迁徙。

groups.name: Nag, Harass & Dun · 纠缠索要与苦苦逼逼 (Badger, Dun, Harangue)
groups.tip: 像獾般死缠烂打、反复纠缠骚扰

items.def_en: to annoy someone with frequent, trivial, or persistent requests
(+ sb/sth) contact someone repeatedly to demand payment, an answer, or pending work
(+ sb) constantly criticize, harass, or nag someone about their obligations
(+ sb) repeatedly pester, nag, or remind someone to do something
to trouble, torment, or exert persistent pressure on someone with unwanted demands

items.def_zh: 纠缠，死缠烂打；反复追问，逼迫
items.def_en: (+ into/about) To repeatedly harass, urge, or pester someone into doing or telling something.
to pursue, harass, or urge someone relentlessly for demands or information

items.def_zh: 催讨（债款），逼索；反复索求
items.def_en: 1. To persistently demand payment of a debt from someone.

groups.summary_en: A creditor, claimant, or irritated party relentlessly presses someone with repeated demands, questions, or payment reminders. Verbs advance in emotional friction and coercive pressure from annoying badgering to aggressive, persistent debt collection.
groups.summary_zh: 因要钱、要答案或施压而反复催逼、纠缠不休，直至逼索债务。

groups.name: Narrate with Nuance · 详述与克制表述 (Recount, Understate, Detail)
groups.tip: 一五一十详尽叙述事情经过

items.def_en: (+ sth) avoid discussing an unpleasant detail by mentioning it very briefly or superficially
(+ sth) minimize the significance, severity, or importance of something rhetorically

items.def_zh: 轻描淡写地叙述；低调陈述，保守陈述
items.def_en: To state or describe something in a restrained way, making it seem less important, serious, or large than it actually is.

items.def_zh: 详细阐述；条理清晰地说明
items.def_en: (+ sth) explain, narrate, or describe facts or details clearly and sequentially
to give a full, precise, and itemized account of facts or events

items.def_zh: 详述，叙述；重新清点，重计（选票等）
items.def_en: 1. To tell someone a detailed story or account of what happened. 2. To count something again, especially votes.
to make sth appear less important, severe, or significant than it really is
to state sth too strongly, exaggerating its importance, severity, or degree

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this communicative manner frame involve conveying a sequence of facts, incidents, or claims with a deliberate rhetorical posture. 'Recount' gives a faithful, ordered narrative of past events, whereas 'understate' rhetorically downplays importance, severity, or emotional scale.
groups.summary_zh: 以特定的叙事口吻或修辞倾向，对既往事件或数据进行详述或克制表述。

groups.name: Nerve Strain & Total Depletion · 耗竭与萎靡 (Frazzle, Enervate, Exhaust)
groups.tip: 身心精疲力竭磨损神经

items.def_en: (+ sb) gradually drain someone's energy, strength, or psychological resistance
to deplete someone entirely of vitality, strength, or emotional capacity
become completely exhausted and unable to function due to prolonged stress or overwork
collapse into sleep or lose consciousness due to overwhelming physical exhaustion
to use up all the mental or physical resources of someone completely

items.def_zh: 使精疲力竭，使焦躁不安；（使）磨损，（使）破烂
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often passive) To make someone completely exhausted or stressed, or to become exhausted. 2. To wear away or fray into shreds.

items.raw_cluster: 使虚弱与疲惫 Weaken & Exhaust
items.def_zh: 使衰弱，使无力，使精疲力竭
items.def_en: (formal) To make someone feel physically, mentally, or morally weak and drained of energy.

items.def_zh: 使极度虚弱；使无力倒地
items.def_en: to reduce someone to extreme physical weakness or incapacitation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale specify severe physical and nervous draining where an entity's energy reserves are completely wiped out, leading to collapse, fraying nerves, or prostration.
groups.summary_zh: 描述精神紧绷、气力被掏空至崩溃瓦解的重度耗竭梯度。

groups.name: Objectify & Depersonalize · 物化与客体化 (Objectify, Sexualize, Instrumentalize)
groups.tip: 剥夺主体性降格相待

items.def_en: (+ sb) to view someone as inferior, unworthy of respect, or lacking human worth
(+ sb) to dismiss someone entirely as insignificant, useless, or merely a disposable liability

items.def_zh: 迷恋化，盲目迷信化（把人物化为执念象征）
items.def_en: To regard with excessive, irrational, or purely sexualizing obsession

items.def_zh: 使性化，将……视为性对象；使具有性特征
items.def_en: To make someone or something sexual in character, quality, or appearance, or to view or treat someone purely in sexual terms.

items.def_zh: 商品化（使人沦为可买卖的货物）
items.def_en: To treat a human being, service, or concept as a raw tradeable commodity

items.def_zh: 工具化（将人视作达成目的之手段）
items.def_en: To treat a person or relationship merely as a useful means to an end

items.def_zh: 将……物化（降格相待）；使客观化，使具体化
items.def_en: 1. To treat a person as a mere object or sexual commodity without regard to their dignity or feelings. 2. To express something abstract in a concrete, objective form.
To deprive someone of human qualities, individuality, or basic dignity

groups.summary_en: This cognitive/manner frame captures treating human beings not as autonomous agents with feelings and dignity, but as inert commodities, tools, or physical instruments. Verbs progress in severity from viewing someone through a reductive physical lens to totally dehumanizing them as disposable items.
groups.summary_zh: 指在认知或态度上剥夺人的主体性与尊严，降格为工具、商品或客体。

groups.name: Obliterate & Eradicate · 彻底抹去与完全消灭 (Decimate, Annihilate, Obliterate)
groups.tip: 由表及里，彻底消灭不留痕迹

items.def_en: (+ sth) destroy, obscure, or remove something completely so that no sign of it remains
(+ sb/sth) find and eradicate someone or something destructive completely
(+ sth) eradicate or extinguish something unwanted or dangerous entirely
destroy or get rid of something completely, especially something bad or harmful

items.def_zh: 大批杀害，大量消灭；严重破坏；（历史）每十人杀一人
items.def_en: 1. To destroy or kill a large proportion of a population, army, or system. 2. (historical) To kill one in every ten of a group of soldiers as a punishment.
(+ sb/sth) destroy completely, leaving no survivors or traces
destroy something completely so that nothing remains or can be recognized

items.def_zh: 彻底消灭，毁灭；彻底击溃
items.def_en: 1. To destroy someone or something completely so that nothing remains. 2. To defeat an opponent or enemy decisively and completely.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote extreme degrees of destruction that wipe out entities, populations, or objects, ranging from heavy destruction (decimate) to total obliteration where literally no trace or living remnant remains.
groups.summary_zh: 按破坏程度由重创大部分递进至全歼、彻底抹杀、不留一丝痕迹。

groups.name: Omit & Neglect Duties · 疏忽与缺损不顾 (Neglect, Ignore, Shirk)
groups.tip: 从视而不见到疏于照管

items.def_en: to reject, dismiss, or ignore someone's advice, complaint, or approach casually
(+ sb/sth) ignore or disregard someone or something when attention or action is due
(+ sth) avoid fulfilling a duty, obligation, or piece of work through evasion
decrease one's effort or neglect one's required duties through laziness
to intentionally pay no attention to someone or something

items.def_zh: 不理会，低估，不全信；打折，减价
items.def_en: 1. to decide that something is not important or not likely to be true. 2. to reduce the price of something

items.def_zh: 疏忽，忽视，不顾；疏于照管；未能（做某事）
items.def_en: 1. To fail to give proper care, attention, or maintenance to someone or something. 2. (+ to do) To fail to do something because of carelessness or forgetfulness.
to avoid or evade dealing with a duty, responsibility, or work through laziness or evasion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark an escalating intensity of cognitive omission, progressing from passive disattention or deliberate refusal to attend, to culpable failure to care for or fulfill responsibilities.
groups.summary_zh: 体现从主观不予理会、价值折损到严重失职失于照管的递进。

groups.name: Orchestrate & Engineer · 精心策划与全盘部署 (Orchestrate, Engineer, Mastermind)
groups.tip: 统筹全局运筹帷幄规划

items.def_zh: 谋划；精心编造（计划或借口）
items.def_en: (+ sth) devise or orchestrate a complex plan, excuse, or plot, especially deceitfully
(+ sth) plan or coordinate the precise details of a project or scheme systematically
(+ sth) organize and engineer the logistical details or conditions for an operation
to arrange or bring about a complex situation through clever and calculated manipulation

items.def_zh: 使作好准备（以面对困难或冲击）；支撑，加固；使振作
items.def_en: 1. (brace oneself) To prepare mentally or physically for an impending shock, impact, or difficulty. 2. To support, steady, or reinforce a structure with a brace.
to plan and direct an elaborate or difficult operation from behind the scenes

items.def_zh: 精心策划，统筹安排；把……编成管弦乐曲
items.def_en: 1. To organize or coordinate a complex situation, plan, or campaign carefully to achieve a desired effect. 2. To arrange or score a piece of music for an orchestra.
to plan and coordinate the precise sequence of steps or events in an operation

groups.summary_en: A strategist or conspirator coordinates disparate elements, logistical assets, or people into a cohesive, calculated plan or prepares defenses against an expected challenge. Verbs range from coordinating complex maneuvers smoothly to tightly engineering covert schemes.
groups.summary_zh: 精心排布、统揽全局以策划实施复杂行动，或周密准备应对挑战。

groups.name: Peel & Shell Produce · 剥皮与去荚 (Peel, Hull, Pod)
groups.tip: 剥除外皮或去除外壳

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pull or remove a skin, rind, or outer layer away from produce
To remove the outer covering, shell, or stem from seeds, nuts, or fruit.

items.def_zh: 剥（豌豆、蚕豆等的）豆荚；（植物）结荚
items.def_en: 1. To remove peas or beans from their pods. 2. (of plants) To produce seed pods.
to cut away the thin skin or outer surface of a fruit or vegetable with a knife
(+ sth) to pull away or remove the outer skin, peel, or husk from produce
to strip or slip off the thin outer skin from fruits, vegetables, or nuts

items.def_zh: 剥去（坚果、豌豆等）的外壳/荚
items.def_en: to remove the protective outer hard covering or pod from nuts, peas, or crustaceans
1. To remove the skin or outer covering from a fruit or vegetable. 2. (of paint, skin, etc.) To come off in small pieces or strips.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe removing the natural outer skins, husks, or pods from fruits, vegetables, seeds, or legumes in culinary preparation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在烹饪或加工果蔬、豆类时，剥除其天然外皮、种皮或荚壳。

groups.name: Persist in Place or Condition · 停留与留置 (Stay, Remain, Linger)
groups.tip: 停在原位或守住原有状态

items.def_zh: 停留，逗留；保持，维持（某种状态）；暂住
items.def_en: 1. To continue to be in a particular place, state, or condition. 2. To live somewhere temporarily as a guest or visitor.

items.def_zh: 保持，仍然处于；逗留，留在原处；剩余，遗留
items.def_en: 1. To continue to be in the same state or condition. 2. To stay in the same place without moving away. 3. To still exist after other things have been used or dealt with.
to remain continuously in one physical place without moving or leaving
(+ somewhere) to linger or stay in a place without any definite purpose
to stay in a place or situation for a period of time rather than leaving

items.def_zh: 寄居，常住（文雅/古旧用语）
items.def_en: archaic/literary: to dwell, remain, or stay permanently in a location
to stay in a place longer than necessary, typically because of reluctance to leave
archaic: to delay leaving or linger in an area longer than intended

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this stative frame denote continuing to occupy a spatial position or maintain an unmodified state rather than moving or changing. Stay is the high-frequency default emphasizing voluntary physical non-departure; remain is more formal, emphasizing continuity across time or being left after others depart; linger and tarry add nuances of reluctant, prolonged, or aimless staying.
groups.summary_zh: 指留在某一物理场所未离开，或在外部环境推移下保持原有存续状态。

groups.name: Pester & Infuriate · 烦扰与激怒 (Hassle, Vex, Infuriate)
groups.tip: 琐事缠身令人心浮气躁

items.def_en: to cause someone mild annoyance, inconvenience, or disruption
to make someone moderately angry or impatient by repeated minor acts
(+ sb) to repeatedly bother, criticize, or harass someone unfairly
(informal) To annoy, bother, or harass someone persistently, especially by nagging or making demands.
(formal or literary) To cause someone to feel annoyed, frustrated, or worried, especially about trivial matters.
(+ sb) to deliberately annoy or irritate someone until they are upset or angry
(+ sb) to thoroughly infuriate or intensely annoy someone
to make someone extremely angry and outraged beyond patience

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve irritating or distressing someone, stepping up from persistent nuisance and badgering to profound vexation and outright fury.
groups.summary_zh: 从持续纠缠、添乱的烦扰到令人深感苦恼乃至暴怒的情感升级。

groups.name: Praise Aggressively & Boast Publicly · 吹捧与大肆宣扬 (Tout, Trumpet, Hype)
groups.tip: 像吹小号般大肆鼓吹宣扬

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to praise, promote, or boast about someone or something enthusiastically to increase their perceived value

items.def_zh: 吹捧，大肆宣扬；兜售，招徕（顾客）
items.def_en: 1. to praise or advertise something enthusiastically to persuade people of its merits. 2. to try to sell something in an aggressive or persistent way.
to boast about or praise something excessively, often in a self-congratulatory way
(+ sb/sth) to promote or publicize something aggressively with extravagant claims
(+ sb/sth) to praise someone or something excessively or exaggerate their importance or qualities
to advertise, publicize, or promote something aggressively using exaggerated claims

items.def_zh: 大肆鼓吹，宣扬；吹小号；（大象）吼叫
items.def_en: 1. to announce or praise something loudly and proudly. 2. to make a loud sound like that of a trumpet, especially as an elephant does.

items.def_zh: 大肆宣传，哗众取宠地吹捧
items.def_en: to praise or publicize extravagantly and noisily, often with shallow exaggeration

groups.summary_en: Speakers publicly promote, extol, or boast about the virtues, success, or advantages of someone or something, often with an aggressive, commercial, or boastful tone.
groups.summary_zh: 公开极力宣传、吹嘘或高调夸耀某人某物的价值或成就。

groups.name: Precipitate in Torrents · 倾泻与暴雨倾盆 (Pour, Sheet, Pelt)
groups.tip: 如暴雨幕布般倾泻流淌

items.def_zh: 倾泻，倾盆而下；倒，灌，注；大量涌入；倾诉
items.def_en: 1. To flow or cause to flow continuously in a stream. 2. To rain heavily and continuously. 3. To come or go in large numbers.

items.def_zh: 如瀑布般层叠倾泻，大量涌流
items.def_en: to pour, fall, or rush down rapidly in large quantities like a waterfall
(+ down) of rain: to fall exceedingly heavily and copiously

items.def_zh: 倾盆大雨；倒水般下大雨
items.def_en: to rain extremely hard and heavily
to rain heavily and rapidly with driving kinetic force
to rain heavily and relentlessly in massive volumes

items.def_zh: （如雨水般）大片倾泻，倾盆而下；覆盖，形成薄层
items.def_en: (of rain or water) To fall heavily or flow in large, wide sheets.
of rain: to fall heavily and strike surfaces with relentless force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this meteorological and fluid-motion frame denote liquid—overwhelmingly heavy rain—discharging in massive volumes or uninterrupted broad waves. The distinction lies in continuous streams (pour, stream) versus vast horizontal walls of water (sheet) or driving kinetic velocity (pelt, cascade).
groups.summary_zh: 描述大量雨水或液体以极大体量、连续面状或高速撞击的方式倾泻而下。

groups.name: Premiere & Debut · 首演与面世 (Premiere, Debut, Unveil)
groups.tip: 文艺作品首次公开展现

items.def_en: to start selling a new product or service publicly
to bring something into use or make it known for the first time

items.def_zh: 首演，首次公映；使……首映（或首演）
items.def_en: 1. To have a first public performance or showing, or to present a show or film for the first time.

items.def_zh: 首次亮相，初次登台；使……首次推出
items.def_en: 1. To perform or appear in public for the first time, or to introduce a product or show to the public for the first time.
to make a new product, service, or system available to the public in stages

items.def_zh: 推出（新产品、作品、唱片等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to launch or release a new product, publication, or creative work to the public

items.def_zh: （电影、书籍、产品等）上映，出版，发行
items.def_en: to be released, published, or made available to the public for the first time

items.def_zh: 公布，揭幕（新产品或计划）
items.def_en: to show or introduce a new product, work of art, or policy to the public for the first time

groups.summary_en: A creative production, performer, or product is presented or made accessible to the public for the very first time.
groups.summary_zh: 文艺作品、演员或产品首次向公众演出、亮相或发售。

groups.name: Present & Display Formally · 展示与呈现 (Present, Display, Exhibit)
groups.tip: 公开呈现与直观展示内容

items.def_en: (+ sth) to spread out or arrange things formally for inspection, assessment, or view
(+ sth) to exhibit or arrange something in a public place for people to look at
(+ sth) to arrange and display items formally so that they can be seen or inspected
to put something in a prominent place so that people may see it easily

items.def_zh: 展现，呈现；提出，提交；授予，赠予；引见，介绍
items.def_en: 1. To show, exhibit, or display something to an audience. 2. To introduce, submit, or offer a proposal, idea, or document for consideration. 3. To give something formally or ceremonially to someone.

items.def_zh: 展现，表现（某种形象或特质）；放映，投射（光影）；凸出，伸出；预测，推算
items.def_en: 1. To present or display oneself, a quality, or an image in a particular way to others. 2. To throw or display light, shadow, or an image onto a surface or screen. 3. To stick out or extend beyond an edge or surface. 4. To estimate or forecast a future trend or amount.
to show an item, artwork, or quality publicly in a gallery, court, or formal setting
to present someone or something in a way that highlights the best qualities

groups.summary_en: Presenters formally set forth, exhibit, or project an image, proposal, or display before an audience for inspection, assessment, or appreciation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在公众或受众面前正式呈现、陈列或投射展示。

groups.name: Provoke & Tease Coquettishly · 挑逗与逗引 (Coquet, Tantalize, Flirt)
groups.tip: 戏谑调情或吊人胃口

items.def_en: to entice or provoke someone sexually or playfully while keeping satisfaction just out of reach
to behave playfully as if attracted to someone, without serious intent
(+ with) to act playfully or flirtatiously without serious commitment

items.def_zh: 卖弄风情，调情；玩弄，挑逗
items.def_en: (+ with) (dated) To flirt playfully without serious romantic intentions.
(+ sb) mislead someone into believing that one is romantically or sexually interested in them
(+ sb/sth) toy with someone's feelings or affection without serious intention
To tease or torment someone by showing or promising something desirable that remains just out of reach.
to excite or stimulate someone in a mildly pleasurable or suggestive way

groups.summary_en: Someone playfully or seductively entices another by displaying something desirable while holding it out of reach, or flirts to excite desire without intent to commit. Actions range from subtle coquetry to frustrating allure.
groups.summary_zh: 通过展示诱人目标或以轻浮姿态示爱诱惑对方，吊人胃口或撩拨情愫。

groups.name: Public Mockery & Jeering · 戏谑与当众嘲弄 (Wisecrack, Catcall, Pillory)
groups.tip: 发嘘声或起哄喝倒彩戏弄当事人

items.def_en: (informal) To make a witty, sarcastic, or cheeky remark.
(+ sb/sth) mock or ridicule someone publicly
(+ sb) silence or drown out a speaker by shouting loudly or jeering
to provoke or challenge someone with insulting, sarcastic, or cruel remarks
to disrupt a public speaker with aggressive, mocking questions and insults
(+ at) to laugh at or shout rude, derisive remarks at someone publicly

items.def_zh: 吹口哨起哄，发嘘声喝倒彩
items.def_en: To make loud whistles, shouts, or rude sexual comments at someone in public or to a performer.

items.def_zh: 当众嘲弄，严厉抨击；处以颈手枷示众
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To criticize, ridicule, or humiliate someone publicly and harshly. 2. (historical) To punish someone by locking them in a pillory.

groups.summary_en: A speaker publicly mocks, derides, or humiliates a target, ranging from lighthearted quips and hostile heckling to severe public exposure and excoriation.
groups.summary_zh: 以言语当众讽刺、起哄嘲弄或公开谴责羞辱，方式由俏皮转为严苛。

groups.name: Pull & Drag · 拉引与拖拽 (Apply Tensile Force to Move an Object)
groups.tip: 持续施加拉力拽动重物前移

items.def_en: [I/T] to exert force upon something to move it towards oneself or the point of effort
[I/T] to pull something hard or suddenly, often in short, repeated jerks
(+ sb/sth) pull someone or something along a surface with tensile force

items.def_zh: 拉，拖，拽；吸引；提取，汲取；画，描绘；（与……）打成平手
items.def_en: 1. To pull or drag someone or something steadily. 2. To attract interest or attention. 3. To extract or obtain something from a source. 4. To produce a picture with a pen or pencil. 5. To finish a game or competition with equal scores.

items.def_zh: 拖，慢而费力地拉动（在地面磨擦）
items.def_en: [I/T] to pull something heavy along the ground with effort and friction
(+ sb/sth) pull or transport someone or something away with substantial effort

items.def_zh: 用力拖拉；运载（沉重之物）
items.def_en: [I/T] to pull or transport something very heavy with sustained, arduous exertion

items.def_zh: 强拉，拽，硬拖（尤指拽送法庭等）
items.def_en: (formal or archaic) To drag, haul, or force someone to go somewhere, especially into court.

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies exerting tensile force towards oneself or along a surface, escalating from smooth linear guidance to laborious, heavy hauling against resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 沿特定方向对物体施加拉力，从顺畅牵引逐渐升级为克服阻力的沉重拖拽。

groups.name: Punish & Penalize · 惩罚与制裁 (Punish, Penalize, Discipline)
groups.tip: 对违规行为进行纪律制裁

items.def_en: to punish someone officially within an organization or household in order to maintain order and obedience
1. To make someone suffer a penalty or hardship for a crime, fault, or wrongdoing. 2. To treat roughly or inflict severe damage upon.
(+ sb) severely punish or criticize someone for wrongdoing
(+ sb/sth) take strict disciplinary measures to stop or penalize illegal or illicit activity

items.def_zh: 惩罚，处罚；置于不利地位
items.def_en: 1. To punish someone for breaking a rule, regulation, or law. 2. To put someone at an unfair disadvantage.
to inflict punishment on someone, often accompanied by strong verbal reprimand

items.def_zh: （通过惩罚或挫折）使收敛，使悔悟；惩戒，惩罚
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To make someone feel humble, restrained, or sorry, especially through suffering or discipline. 2. (formal) To punish or correct someone in order to improve them.
to punish or severely rebuke someone publicly or formally

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to imposing a negative consequence, penalty, or corrective suffering upon a person or group for an offense, rule-breaking, or wrongdoing, differing in formal versus institutional registers.
groups.summary_zh: 对违法、违规或过错行为施加处分或制裁，体现由轻至重的制度约束。

groups.name: Purify & Chemically Refine · 提纯与净化 (Elute, Decarbonize, Purify)
groups.tip: 洗脱杂质提取纯净成分

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove or be removed as vapor through continuous heating
(+ sth) remove unwanted substances or impurities using a filter or separating process
[I/T] to make a liquid clear or pure by removing suspended solids or impurities
[I/T] (+ out/from) to extract or remove soluble constituents from a solid using a percolating liquid
[I/T] to purify a liquid by heating it into vapor and condensing it back to liquid

items.def_zh: 洗脱，淘洗（用溶剂从吸附材料中提取出分离物）
items.def_en: to extract or wash out an adsorbed substance from a chromatography column or absorbent using a solvent

items.def_zh: 除去…中的碳（或积碳）；使脱碳，使实现低碳化
items.def_en: 1. to remove carbon or carbon deposits from an engine, metal, or substance. 2. to reduce or eliminate carbon dioxide emissions from an economy, process, or industry
[I/T] to convert a solid directly to vapor upon heating and condense to pure form

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on chemical and metallurgical extraction, separation, or stripping processes aimed at removing contaminants, carbon, or specific solutes. Verbs describe specialized chemical isolation techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过特定的化学、冶金或萃取手段剥除杂质或提取目标成分以达到高纯度。

groups.name: Purify & Decontaminate · 净化、提纯与除杂 (Purify, Detoxify, Refine)
groups.tip: 清除杂质或毒素恢复纯净

items.def_en: (+ sth) clean the interior of something thoroughly, removing all impurities or contamination
(+ sth) completely remove, cleanse, or eliminate harmful, unwanted, or sinful elements
to remove impurities or unwanted elements from a substance, typically as part of an industrial process
[I/T] (+ of/from) to remove dirty or harmful substances from something
1. (chemistry / engineering) To remove dissolved, trapped, or adsorbed gas from a liquid, solid, or container.
to neutralize or remove chemical, biological, or radioactive contaminants from an area or object

items.def_zh: 解毒，排毒；净化，去除毒素
items.def_en: 1. To remove harmful or toxic substances from the body, or to cleanse a contaminated substance or environment.

items.def_zh: 净化心灵，使精神化，使超凡脱俗；赋予……精神意义
items.def_en: 1. To purify or elevate morally and spiritually; to give a religious or spiritual meaning and character to something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the removal of harmful contaminants, toxins, dissolved gases, or spiritual impurities from a body, chemical compound, or mind to restore it to an unpolluted state.
groups.summary_zh: 指清除毒素、杂质、气体或精神污垢，使物质或心灵恢复纯净状态。

groups.name: Pursue & Apprehend · 追捕与擒获 (Hunt, Capture, Apprehend)
groups.tip: 追踪捕猎并俘虏拘捕

items.def_en: to force a person or animal into a place from which they cannot escape

items.def_zh: 捕获，俘获；占领，夺取；准确表达
items.def_en: 1. To catch and imprison a person or animal by force or skill; take control of a place. 2. To accurately represent or record a mood, quality, or atmosphere.
1. To pursue and kill wild animals for food or sport. 2. To search determinedly for someone or something.
to find someone or something after a thorough or difficult search
(+ sb/sth) search relentlessly for and capture a fugitive, criminal, or quarry
(+ sb/sth) gather, corner, and capture suspects or animals systematically
to catch and arrest someone who has not obeyed the law
(informal) to catch someone doing something wrong or take someone into custody

groups.summary_en: An agent actively tracks, pursues, and forcibly secures control over a fugitive, prey, or enemy combatant. Verbs span the full operational arc from active tracking to taking into custody.
groups.summary_zh: 追踪并最终通过强制手段剥夺自由或羁押的完整追捕场景。

groups.name: Push & Propel · 推动与驱使 (Propel, Drive, Impel)
groups.tip: 施加推力使物体向前移动

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) propel someone or something mechanically or urgently forward
continue forward with determination or propel something forward energetically
to force a person, animal, or object to move forcefully in a specific direction

items.def_zh: 推进，驱动（物体向前移动）
items.def_en: to push, drive, or force someone or something forward or in a particular direction

items.def_zh: （尤指在未准备好时）仓促推入，迫使承担；用草叉叉起
items.def_en: 1. to thrust someone suddenly into a difficult role, situation, or position. 2. to lift or move something with a pitchfork
[I/T] to push someone or something roughly or forcefully
to force, urge, or drive someone to do something; to push or drive an object forward
[I/T] to push suddenly and with substantial force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting mechanical force or urgent internal compulsion that drives an object or agent forward through space or into swift action.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加机械推力或强烈驱策力，使物体或个体向前疾进或被迫采取行动。

groups.name: Push & Pull · 推拉与拽引 (Push, Pull, Tug)
groups.tip: 施加向内推或向外拉的机械力

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) exert tensile force to draw someone or something back toward oneself
(+ sb/sth) exert force to move someone or something away or resist backward
to hold onto someone or something and move them towards yourself or in a particular direction
1. to use physical pressure or force to move someone or something away or into a particular position. 2. to encourage or force someone to do something or work harder
[I/T] to pull something heavy along the ground with substantial effort
[I/T] to pull something hard, quickly, or repeatedly with short jerks
to pull or drag something very heavy using sustained, intense exertion
to pull, strain, or twist something away with a violent sudden movement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting directional physical force either away from oneself (pushing) or toward oneself (pulling), spanning smooth and jerky motions.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加向外推开或向内拉近的身体物理力，涵盖平缓移动与猛烈拉扯。

groups.name: Push & Shove · 推搡与冲撞 (Jostle, Shove, Thrust)
groups.tip: 发力猛推或向前猛刺

items.def_en: to push someone or something with a finger or pointed object
[T/I] to push roughly against someone, usually in a crowd
(+ sb) physically shove or bully someone into compliance
(+ sb/sth) push someone or something out of the way forcefully or rudely

items.def_zh: 用肘推搡，用肘挤着前行
items.def_en: To push or strike someone with your elbow, or force your way through a crowd using your elbows.
to push or strike with the head or horns; to push gently

items.def_zh: 猛推，推挤；乱塞，胡乱放置
items.def_en: 1. To push someone or something roughly and forcefully. 2. (informal) To put something somewhere carelessly or hurriedly.
1. To push someone or something suddenly and with great force. 2. To make a sudden forward stabbing movement with a weapon or body part.

groups.summary_en: Agents exert abrupt physical force with hands, elbows, or the body to displace someone or something forcibly. Nuances range from forceful, rude jostling in a crowd to violent, forward-directed thrusts.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用肢体施加突发性外力，以粗暴或强行的方式推挤推搡目标。

groups.name: Push Beyond Physical Limits · 劳累过度与身体透支 (Overwork, Overdrive, Exhaust)
groups.tip: 超负荷驱动身体直到精疲力竭

items.def_zh: 使负担过重；使过度耗损
items.def_en: to make excessive demands on someone's strength, energy, or faculties
(+ sb) cause someone to become weak, fatigued, or exhausted through overexertion
to exhaust someone completely through continuous hard work or exertion

items.def_zh: 精疲力竭，过度劳累致垮
items.def_en: (+ sb) become or make someone thoroughly exhausted from prolonged overwork and stress
to drain someone entirely of physical or mental energy

items.raw_cluster: 过度劳作与疲竭 Overwork & Exhaust
items.def_en: 1. To work too hard for too long, or force an employee or machine to work excessively.

items.raw_cluster: 过度劳作与疲竭 Overwork & Exhaust
items.def_zh: 驱使过度，使劳累过度；使（发动机等）超负荷运转
items.def_en: 1. To drive, work, or push a person, animal, or system excessively hard beyond safe limits.

items.def_zh: 使极度虚脱；使力竭倒地
items.def_en: to reduce someone to extreme physical weakness or utter collapse through fatigue

groups.summary_en: An agent drives oneself or another past sustainable limits of energy or endurance, leading to acute depletion or breakdown. Verbs range from working excessive hours (overwork) to driving past breaking points (overdrive) and draining reserves entirely (exhaust, overtire, wear out).
groups.summary_zh: 指强迫自己或他人工作过量，造成体力与精力严重耗尽乃至崩溃。

groups.name: Quantity Adequacy to Saturation · 充盈至超载 (Suffice, Sate, Overload)
groups.tip: 从刚好满足需求到过度负荷

items.def_en: to provide enough to meet a demand, standard, or requirement
To be enough or adequate for a purpose or need.
(+ sth) become completely full or make a container full to capacity
to supply someone with so much of something that they are completely full or bored
(+ sth) clog or completely fill a passage or space so movement is blocked

items.def_zh: 使超载，使负荷过多；使负担过重
items.def_en: To put too great a load, amount of work, or electrical current on someone or something.
to overwhelm someone or something with an enormous quantity of items
to supply something in excessive quantities that exceed demand

groups.summary_en: This scale captures the transition of quantity or capacity from merely adequate to heavily excessive. 'Suffice' represents the threshold of minimum adequacy, while 'overload' marks the hazardous or excessive extreme where capacity is completely exceeded.
groups.summary_zh: 描述数量从最低限度的‘足够’攀升至超出负荷的‘过载’。

groups.name: Quash & Extinguish Rumor/Rebellion · 扑灭与扼杀 (Quell, Stifle, Scotch)
groups.tip: 彻底扑灭苗头扼杀在摇篮中

items.def_zh: 防患于未然；扼杀在摇篮中
items.def_en: (nip sth in the bud) to put an end to a problem or bad behavior at an early stage before it grows
(+ sth) suppress, extinguish, or crush an uprising, rumor, or fire with force
(+ sth) decisively put a stop to an objection, rebellion, or talk

items.def_zh: 扼杀，彻底平息（谣言、计划等）
items.def_en: To decisively put an end to a rumor, fear, belief, or plan.

items.def_zh: 扼杀，压制；（使）窒息，（使）喘不上气
items.def_en: 1. To prevent something from happening, continuing, or developing; to suppress feelings or reactions. 2. To be unable to breathe freely, or prevent someone from breathing.
to extinguish or suppress a flame, sentiment, or initiative by depriving it of oxygen or room to develop
to stop violent behavior, protest, or deep feelings using force or definitive authority
to decisively use force to stop a rebellion, protest, or vigorously put an end to rumors

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly suppressing, decisively crushing, or choking off dissent, rebellion, rumors, or fledgling ideas before they spread or fully develop.
groups.summary_zh: 果断压制或扼杀异见、叛乱、谣言或势头，防其蔓延成势。

groups.name: Reinvigorate & Jumpstart · 赋能与重新激活 (Energize, Jumpstart, Vitalize)
groups.tip: 激发潜能注入充沛活力

items.def_zh: 赋予生命力；使活力充沛
items.def_en: to endow with life, vigor, or active vitality
(+ sb/sth) Make someone or something more lively, energetic, or interesting
(+ sb/sth) Make something more energetic, cheerful, or stimulating, or become more active
(+ sb/sth) Become or cause someone or something to become more cheerful, active, or revived
to restore energy, enthusiasm, or operational capability to

items.def_zh: 激励，使精力充沛；供给能量，通电
items.def_en: 1. To give someone or something renewed energy, enthusiasm, or vitality. 2. To supply a device or circuit with electricity or power.
to give new energy or strength to someone or something

items.def_zh: 给……以生机，促进；用跨接引线启动（汽车等）
items.def_en: 1. To give an immediate boost to a stalled activity, economy, or process. 2. To start the engine of a vehicle with a flat battery using jumper cables connected to another battery.

groups.summary_en: An agent or intervention imparts fresh vigor, dynamism, or sudden starting power into a flagging system, organization, process, or tired person.
groups.summary_zh: 指为停滞或疲态的系统、机构或机体注入新鲜活力与重启能量。

groups.name: Reiterate & Restate · 重申与反复陈述 (Reiterate, Iterate, Restate)
groups.tip: 为强调立场而再三重复声明

items.def_en: (+ sth) Repeat an idea, fact, or argument forcefully so that it cannot be misunderstood
(+ sth) Explain something very clearly, explicitly, and in detail so there is no ambiguity
(+ sth into sb) Teach or emphasize something to someone through persistent, forceful repetition
(+ that) (formal) To repeat a statement, opinion, or demand several times for emphasis and clarity.

items.def_zh: 再次重申，坚定确认（立场、原则或承诺）
items.def_en: to state again with strong conviction that something is definitely true or valid

items.def_zh: 重申，重新表述（用稍有不同的措辞再次讲明）
items.def_en: to state something again or in a different way, especially to make the meaning clearer
1. (formal) To repeat a statement or perform something again. 2. (computing) To repeat a process or series of steps in order to get closer to a desired result.

items.def_zh: 过分冗长地反复强调（令人厌烦地絮叨）
items.def_en: to explain, repeat, or insist on something repeatedly or excessively

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate repeating an assertion, argument, or directive, usually to eliminate ambiguity, provide emphatic clarity, or guide sequential computation.
groups.summary_zh: 指为强调要点、消除误解而重申或多次陈述同一观点。

groups.name: Relinquish Official Office · 辞官解任与辞职退职 (Resign, Step Down, Demit)
groups.tip: 主动卸任职位或放弃

items.def_en: 1. To leave a job, school, or organization permanently. 2. To stop doing something or give up a habit.
1. To voluntarily leave a job, office, or position. 2. (resign oneself to) To accept something undesirable as inevitable.
to withdraw voluntarily from an important position or role to let someone else take over
to formally resign from a leadership post, witness stand, or public contest
[I/T] to resign from or give up an office or position, especially in formal or academic contexts
to withdraw from a prestigious role, competition, or public position gracefully
(+ sth) to relinquish authority, duties, or a position of responsibility to someone else
[I/T] to renounce one's throne, supreme power, or major high-level responsibility formally

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote formally giving up an official post, governance position, employment, or royal office, varying from formal institutional notifications to voluntary departures.
groups.summary_zh: 正式放弃职位、公职、王位或领导权并离开岗位的行为。

groups.name: Repair & Mend · 修补与修整 (Patch, Darn, Cobble)
groups.tip: 弥补残缺修改瑕疵使其复原

items.def_zh: 修补，打补丁；拼凑；暂时解决
items.def_en: 1. To repair a hole, tear, or worn surface by sewing or gluing a patch over it. 2. (computing) To update or fix a program with a software patch.
To put a new sole on a shoe or boot.

items.def_zh: 修正，修订，改订；复习（功课）
items.def_en: 1. To re-examine and alter, improve, or correct a text, plan, or opinion. 2. (chiefly British English) To review notes or books in preparation for an exam.
repair something damaged quickly, temporarily, or haphazardly
(+ sth) quickly produce, assemble, or repair something using whatever parts or materials are available
(+ sth) join the broken or torn parts of an object back together
mend a hole in knitted or woven fabric by weaving yarn across it
repair shoes or rough footwear as a shoemaker

groups.summary_en: Craftsmen or owners fix damaged, torn, or worn items by affixing material, replacing specific parts, or tailoring structural components.
groups.summary_zh: 为磨损破损的衣物、鞋履或器物贴上补丁、换底或予以缝补修复。

groups.name: Repair & Restore · 修复与复原 (Repair, Restore, Recondition)
groups.tip: 修整破损使旧物重返原貌

items.def_zh: 修理，修补；补救，修复（关系、名誉等）；（formal）前往，去往（repair to）
items.def_en: 1. To mend or fix something broken, damaged, or torn. 2. To remedy or put right an unwelcome situation or damaged relationship. 3. (formal) (+ to) To go to a particular place.

items.def_zh: 修复，整修（建筑物、艺术品等）；恢复，使复原；归还
items.def_en: 1. To repair or renovate a building, work of art, or object to return it to its original condition. 2. To bring back a former condition, feeling, or state of affairs. 3. (formal) To return something lost or stolen to its owner.
(+ sth) Repair, renovate, or redecorate an old building, car, or other damaged item
(+ sth) Repair or mend something quickly, temporarily, or by fixing damaged spots
(+ sth) Repair, clean up, or restore something damaged or worn to sound condition
to restore a building, room, or structure to a good state of repair
to clean, decorate, and repair an old building or piece of equipment to look new
to repair and thoroughly overhaul an engine or machine so that it is in good working condition

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on returning a damaged, worn, or aging physical object, ecosystem, or condition back to sound working order or its pristine original state.
groups.summary_zh: 指使损坏、磨损或老化的物品、建筑或系统恢复到健全状态或初始原貌。

groups.name: Reproduce & Reenact · 翻版与重现 (Reenact, Recreate, Replay)
groups.tip: 照样复刻，再次呈现原貌

items.def_en: (+ sth) listen to or watch a sound or video recording that has just been made
(+ sth) perform the actions and dialogue of an event or story

items.def_zh: 重放，重演（录像、赛事或回忆）
items.def_en: to play a recording, sporting sequence, or scene again, or to experience an event anew in memory

items.def_zh: 复写，复印；使增多，使多样化
items.def_en: 1. (dated) To make multiple copies of a document. 2. To multiply or make manifold.

items.def_zh: 重现，再造（昔日场景或体验）
items.def_en: to reproduce or bring back the conditions, atmosphere, or appearance of a previous era or event

items.def_zh: 重演（角色）；重奏，重复（乐段、歌曲等）
items.def_en: (US variant of reprise) To repeat a song, musical passage, or performance, or replay a particular dramatic role.

items.def_zh: 重播，重映（节目、电影）；重新进行（比赛、选举等）
items.def_en: To broadcast a television programme or film again; to run a race, election, or test again.

items.def_zh: 重演，再现（历史事件或罪案现场）
items.def_en: to act out a past event, historical battle, or crime scene again in a formal or theatrical manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe reproducing, repeating, or performing again a prior event, artistic performance, broadcast, or document to capture or demonstrate its original form. They contrast mechanical multiple-copy creation with dramatic or chronological recreation and rerun.
groups.summary_zh: 以翻印、重播、重演等方式再次呈现先前的事件、作品或文稿。

groups.name: Respire & Emit Strained Breath · 呼气与喘鸣 (Exhale, Wheeze, Gasp)
groups.tip: 呼气与粗重喘息的声音

items.def_en: (+ sth) Expel air from the lungs; exhale
to breathe in short, rapid gasps from physical exertion
to breathe out air, smoke, or vapor from the lungs
Breathe hard and audibly with labored, rapid exhalations due to heavy exertion
to breathe quickly and loudly through the mouth, as after strenuous physical exercise

items.def_zh: 喘息，发出哮鸣声呼吸；喘息着说
items.def_en: to breathe with difficulty and with a whistling, rattling sound, especially due to a chest illness
(+ sth) Say something with great difficulty while struggling to breathe or panting

items.def_zh: 倒抽气，因窒息/惊恐而倒吸冷气
items.def_en: (+ for) to inhale suddenly and sharply with an open mouth, usually due to pain, shock, or lack of air

groups.summary_en: A person expels air or breathes with difficulty, producing audible, labored, or involuntary sounds due to physical exertion, obstruction, or distress.
groups.summary_zh: 排出体内气体，或因气道狭窄、疲劳而发出沉重粗重的喘息声。

groups.name: Respond & React · 反应与回应 (Respond, React, Rejoin)
groups.tip: 对外界言行给出及时的反应

items.def_zh: 回答，答复；做出反应，响应
items.def_en: 1. To say, write, or do something as an answer, reaction, or reply.
[I/T] to respond in opposition or defense to an argument or action

items.def_zh: 做出反应，回应；起化学反应；起不良反应
items.def_en: 1. To act or change in response to an event, situation, or stimulus. 2. (chemistry) To undergo a chemical change.
(+ at sb) Criticize, retaliate, or respond forcefully to an attack or accusation
(+ at sb) Respond or retaliate aggressively against an opponent or criticism
(+ sb) Reply impudently or defend oneself sharply against criticism
[I/T] to give a quick, witty, or sharp verbal response to a statement
[I/T] to answer a remark quickly, sharply, or aggressively

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this broad behavioral and communicational frame describe acting, moving, or communicating in direct consequence of an external stimulus, utterance, or event.
groups.summary_zh: 受到外界刺激、局势变化或话语影响后作出动作或言语反应。

groups.name: Restore Mechanical Function · 检修与修缮 (Repair, Overhaul, Mend)
groups.tip: 彻底检修或修补磨损部件

items.def_en: to carry out regular maintenance or repairs on an engine, vehicle, or appliance
to restore damaged, faulty, or worn machinery or objects to good working condition
to repair something quickly or temporarily, often roughly
(+ sth) repair, recondition, or improve the physical condition of a mechanism, room, or vehicle

items.def_zh: 调试，检修（发动机或机械）
items.def_en: (+ sth) adjust an engine or machine so that it runs smoothly and efficiently

items.def_zh: 彻底检修，大修；全面改革，彻底革新；赶上，超过
items.def_en: 1. To examine and repair a machine, engine, or system thoroughly. 2. To reform or restructure a system completely. 3. (chiefly British) To overtake someone in a race or contest.

items.def_zh: 修理，缝补；愈合，痊愈；改善
items.def_en: 1. To repair something that is broken, torn, or damaged. 2. (of a bone or wound) To heal or become sound again.
to overhaul and repair a machine or component so that it is in like-new working condition

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers inspecting, servicing, and fixing mechanical systems, tools, garments, or structures that are worn or broken. 'Mend' suits small, domestic, or fabric repairs; 'overhaul' denotes dismantling and extensively reconditioning complex machinery or systems.
groups.summary_zh: 针对损坏或磨损之机械、器具进行小修、补缀或全面大修。

groups.name: Restrict & Restrain · 节制与抑制 (Restrict, Restrain, Curb)
groups.tip: 压制冲动势头加以有效控制

items.def_en: to put a limit on the amount, size, or range of something
(+ sb/sth) Prevent someone or something from moving forward, developing, or acting freely
(+ sb/sth) Control or limit the size, cost, number, or freedom of something
to control or limit something that has developed too far or too fast
1. To control, limit, or restrain something harmful or unwanted, such as inflation or anger.

items.def_zh: 制止，管束；抑制，克制（情绪或行为）
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To stop someone from doing something physically, or to control a strong feeling or urge.
(+ on sb/sth) Take strict and firm legal or official measures to suppress or restrict an activity
to limit or restrict someone's freedom or scope of action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote checking, controlling, or holding back actions, impulses, or growth, progressing from mild checks to firm physical or formal control.
groups.summary_zh: 控管或压制动作、冲动及发展，从约束到强力遏止。

groups.name: Revere & Venerate · 崇敬与敬仰 (Reverence, Worship, Adoration)
groups.tip: 由赞叹钦佩升华为敬畏膜拜

items.def_en: to admire deeply because of abilities, qualities, or status
(+ sb) to admire and have a great deal of respect for someone
(+ sb/sth) to show deep reverence, submission, or worship toward someone or something
(often passive) To fill someone with deep respect, wonder, or admiration mixed with fear.
to feel deep respect, love, and awe for someone or something

items.def_zh: 把……当偶像崇拜，盲目敬仰
items.def_en: to admire and revere someone excessively or unreservedly
to deeply respect, honor, and revere someone or something, especially because of age, wisdom, or sacredness

items.def_zh: 崇拜，敬奉（神明或极度崇敬之人）
items.def_en: to show reverence and adoration for a deity or treat someone with supreme devotion

groups.summary_en: This frame captures feelings and acts of profound respect, awe, and veneration toward people, deities, or institutions viewed as sacred or morally elevated. Intensity scales from standard deep respect to profound spiritual or religious adoration.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对神圣、长者或崇高事物从敬重、敬畏到顶礼膜拜的情感梯度。

groups.name: Revise & Redact · 修订与改写 (Rework, Redact, Revise)
groups.tip: 校正文本，重新润色修改

items.def_zh: 润色；微调修改（文本或艺术作品）
items.def_en: (+ sth) make small revisions or improvements to a piece of writing or artwork

items.def_zh: 重写；在原稿上覆写修改
items.def_en: (+ sth) rewrite text or record over existing material to revise or replace it
[I/T] to examine and correct, update, or improve a text, book, or plan

items.def_zh: 涂黑遮盖（以隐去敏感文本）；涂抹审查
items.def_en: (+ sth) obscure or redact words in a document by covering them with black ink
to change the words of a formal document, law, or contract in order to correct or improve it

items.def_zh: 修改，修订；重做，重新加工
items.def_en: To revise, rewrite, or reshape a piece of writing, music, or material to improve it.

items.def_zh: 修订，编辑（尤指删去或遮盖敏感、机密信息）；起草，编写
items.def_en: To edit a text for publication, especially by removing or blacking out sensitive or confidential information.
[I/T] to write something again in a substantially altered form to improve clarity or style

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize modifying written texts, legal documents, or creative materials by editing, censoring, rewriting passages, or adapting structure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过删改、审查屏蔽或大幅重新构思，对文本、法案或作品进行改动修订。

groups.name: Revive & Rejuvenate · 复元与焕活 (Revive, Rejuvenate, Revitalize)
groups.tip: 重新焕发青春，复苏往日活力

items.def_zh: 使精神振作，使恢复精力
items.def_en: to give new strength or energy to someone who is tired or hot
(+ sb/sth) become more active, energetic, or cheerful, or cause someone to feel this way
[I/T] to become, or make someone become, conscious, healthy, or active again
quickly recover health, energy, or success after an illness or setback
(+ sb) restore someone to consciousness or revive someone from faintness

items.def_zh: 使恢复元气，使复苏，使重获新生
items.def_en: To give new life, energy, vitality, or success to something that has become weak or inactive.

items.def_zh: 使恢复活力，使焕发青春；使重获新生
items.def_en: To make someone look or feel younger and more energetic, or to make an organization or system more effective and lively again.
to give life, energy, and strength to someone or something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote restoring energy, physical vigor, freshness, or youthful capacity to an animate being, organization, or exhausted system.
groups.summary_zh: 指为疲惫或衰败的人、组织注入元气，使其恢复活力或年轻状态。

groups.name: Revoke & Invalidate Status · 吊销与裁定无效 (Revoke, Rescind, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 宣布资格取消或法律无效

items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially strip someone of a right, license, or legal privilege
(+ sb of sth) to officially take away someone's title, rank, authority, or status
to officially cancel or withdraw a license, permit, right, or legal privilege

items.def_zh: 取消……的资格；使不合格，使不适宜
items.def_en: to officially stop someone from participating in a competition or activity, or from holding a position, because they broke a rule or lack qualifications
to withdraw an offer, statement, or formal grant previously issued

items.def_zh: 使无效，使作废；证明……不成立
items.def_en: to officially make something legally invalid or no longer acceptable; to prove that an argument, idea, or result is incorrect

items.def_zh: 废除，撤销，取消（法律、合同或决议）
items.def_en: to officially cancel or revoke a law, contract, order, or decision so that it is no longer valid

items.def_zh: 撤销，判为无效（判决/裁定）
items.def_en: to officially reject or declare an earlier legal ruling or conviction void

groups.summary_en: Verbs specifying the cancellation, withdrawal, or nullification of granted privileges, legal statuses, licenses, or eligibility by an oversight body.
groups.summary_zh: 权威机构裁定取消资格、吊销执照或撤回已授予的特权。

groups.name: Ride & Cycle · 骑乘与轻便通行 (Bike, Cycle, Pedal)
groups.tip: 骑车开车陆地行驶

items.def_en: to ride a bicycle over a distance
[I/T] to travel on a bicycle or push/steer a wheeled vehicle along a path

items.def_zh: 驾车疾行，乘汽车旅行；用车运送；迅速移动
items.def_en: 1. To travel by car, especially at a steady speed. 2. To transport someone in a motor vehicle.
1. To travel or ride on a bicycle or motorcycle.

items.def_zh: 蹬车离去；骑自行车远去
items.def_en: depart or move off by riding a bicycle
leave a place riding on a bicycle
depart riding on a bicycle, horse, or motorcycle
[I/T] to propel a bicycle or vehicle forward by working the foot pedals

groups.summary_en: A person travels by operating or riding a light wheeled vehicle, primarily a bicycle or small motorized craft. 'Bike' and 'cycle' focus on pedal-powered transport, while informal uses like 'motor' convey traveling purposefully by automobile or power-assisted vehicle.
groups.summary_zh: 依靠骑行自行车或驾驶小型机动车辆进行个人出行与通行。

groups.name: Roar & Rant · 咆哮与狂怒斥责 (Roar, Rant, Bellow)
groups.tip: 大声叫嚷或咆哮宣泄情绪

items.def_en: [I/T] say something in a very loud voice, expressing strong emotion or getting attention

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休地怒骂；没完没了地咆哮抱怨
items.def_en: continue speaking at great length in a wild, impassioned, or angry manner
(+ sth) shout or deliver an angry statement with tremendous vocal power

items.def_zh: 以高声叫喊压制（阻止对方发言）
items.def_en: (+ sb) silence or drown out a speaker by shouting loudly
(+ at/about/against) To speak or shout loudly, angrily, and at length about something you dislike or disagree with.
(+ at/about) speak wildly, irrationally, or furiously, as if mad or delirious
[I/T] shout something in a very loud, deep, and angry voice

items.def_zh: 咆哮，大吼；呼啸，轰鸣；放声大笑
items.def_en: 1. To make a deep, very loud, continuous sound, or to shout something loudly in anger or excitement. 2. To move rapidly while making a loud, continuous noise.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail vociferous, emotionally charged vocal output delivered with fierce volume or wild, uncontrolled anger, ranging from sustained incoherent diatribes to explosive animalistic shouts.
groups.summary_zh: 因愤怒而狂暴失控地大吼、咆哮或口若悬河地狂躁斥责。

groups.name: Routine Transit & Long Expeditions · 远行与通勤 (Commute, Voyage, Trek)
groups.tip: 长途跋涉或乘船远航

items.def_en: to travel over an extended distance, usually over a considerable period
leave a place to begin a journey or commute
depart on a long, arduous walking journey or expedition
begin a long voyage, expedition, or regular journey
[I/T] to pass through or across a place on the way to somewhere else
to make a long, arduous journey, especially on foot over challenging terrain
To make a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

items.def_zh: 通勤，上下班往返；减刑；替代
items.def_en: 1. To travel regularly between one's home and place of work or study. 2. (law) To change a severe judicial punishment to a less severe one.

groups.summary_en: Travelers undertake journeys marked either by recurring daily transit between home and work or by extended, adventurous, or seafaring expeditions.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖日常往返通勤与距离漫长、充满探险性质的远征航行。

groups.name: Rub & Scuff · 磨损与擦伤 (Chafe, Scuff, Fray)
groups.tip: 反复磨蹭擦伤表面

items.def_en: (+ sth) become worn, unraveled, or shredded along the edges from rubbing
(+ sth) remove or erode the surface of something through continuous friction

items.def_zh: 磨损，擦伤（表面）；拖着脚走
items.def_en: To mark or scratch the surface of something by rubbing or dragging against it, or to drag your feet while walking.
(+ sth) gradually diminish or erode a surface through continuous rubbing
[I/T] to become worn or unraveled at the edge through continuous rubbing
to make sore or rub raw by prolonged friction against the skin

items.def_zh: （使）擦伤，（使）擦痛；（因受限制而）恼怒，焦躁
items.def_en: 1. To rub against skin or another surface and make it sore or worn, or to become sore by rubbing. 2. To feel annoyed or impatient because of a restriction or rule.
to scrape or wear away the surface layer of skin, rock, or material through harsh friction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict superficial wear, irritation, or marked blemishes caused by continuous repetitive friction against fabric, leather, or sensitive skin. 'Chafe' typically targets tender skin or tight bonds, while 'scuff' marks smooth, polished rigid surfaces like shoes or flooring.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因反复摩擦而在皮肤表面导致发红或在物件表面造成磨痕。

groups.name: Rupture & Shatter · 破裂炸裂与粉碎 (Crack, Rupture, Shatter)
groups.tip: 粉身碎骨般的剧烈破裂

items.def_en: [I/T] to break or cause to break, crack, or split cleanly or partially
(+ sth) fracture or split sharply on impact or under heavy force
[I/T] to break open or apart suddenly and violently, especially from internal pressure
(+ sth) split, crack, or fly open violently under pressure

items.def_zh: （使）粉碎，碎裂；破灭，摧毁（希望、信念等）
items.def_en: 1. to break suddenly into very small pieces, or to make something break in this way. 2. to completely destroy or ruin someone's hopes, peace, or beliefs.

items.def_zh: （使）破裂，爆裂；（使关系）破裂，断绝
items.def_en: 1. to burst or tear open, or to cause a pipe, tissue, or blood vessel to do so. 2. to disrupt or end a friendly relationship, connection, or agreement.
[I/T] to break or shatter suddenly into small, thin fragments or pieces
(+ sth) shatter or rupture completely into pieces from explosive internal or external force

groups.summary_en: An entity breaks apart under immense physical pressure, impact, or internal strain. Verbs graduate from a clean structural tear or split to catastrophic fragmentation into myriad airborne shards.
groups.summary_zh: 承受外力或内压发生破裂，乃至剧烈粉碎炸裂成碎片。

groups.name: Sanction & Confer Authority · 授权、赋权与认证 (Empower, Accredit, Legalize)
groups.tip: 赋予合法权力与行动资格

items.def_en: to formally delegate someone to perform an official task, rank, or artistic production
to give someone an official permit or legal certificate allowing them to practice or trade
to give official permission, approval, or formal sanction for an action or person
(+ sth) to give formal or official approval to a document, plan, or authority

items.def_zh: 将（权力、财产）授予；归属于
items.def_en: (+ sth in sb) to confer legal authority, power, or rights upon a person or body

items.def_zh: 授权，准许；使能够，提升……的自主权
items.def_en: to give someone the official authority or freedom to do something; to give someone more control over their life or situation.

items.def_zh: 官方认可，鉴定合格；委派，派遣（外交代表）；把……归于
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) to officially recognize an institution or person as meeting required standards. 2. to appoint someone as an official representative.
to make an activity or substance permitted by law.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this institutional frame denote an official authority, legal body, or institutional mechanism granting formal power, recognized status, statutory validity, or practical autonomy to an agent, institution, or practice. They differ primarily by the institutional sphere (legal statute, institutional accreditation, or personal delegation).
groups.summary_zh: 官方或权威机构授予法定权力、资质认证或赋予行动自主权。

groups.name: Saturate & Pervade · 充盈、弥漫与充血 (Suffuse, Pervade, Engorge)
groups.tip: 充满空间或向各处渗透

items.def_en: (+ sth) to flow or spread slowly into and pervade a space or substance

items.def_zh: 灌输；使充满（情感或品质）
items.def_en: (+ with) to thoroughly permeate or saturate with a feeling, quality, or value
to spread through and be perceptible in every part of a space or group
1. (+ with) (literary) (of color, light, or feeling) To spread gradually all over or through someone or something.
(+ sth) to penetrate completely through something, making it thoroughly wet
[I/T] to cause an organ or vessel to become abnormally full of blood or fluid, or to clog a conduit

items.def_zh: 使充血，使充盈；狼吞虎咽，大吃
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To cause an organ, tissue, or blood vessel to swell with blood or other fluid. 2. To eat or consume greedily.

items.def_zh: 使人口过剩，使数量过多
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To cause an area to have too many people or animals for the available resources to support.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate a substance, liquid, or quality spreading thoroughly through or swelling within an area or physiological vessel until it is fully permeated or congested.
groups.summary_zh: 指流体、光气或感觉彻底充盈、浸润或使器官血管充血膨胀的过程。

groups.name: Savor & Relish · 品味与享受 (Savor, Relish, Bask)
groups.tip: 细细品味并全然乐在其中

items.def_zh: 沉浸于，尽情沐浴于（赞美、温暖）
items.def_en: (+ in) to lie comfortably in warmth, or enjoy pleasant approval or admiration
(+ sth) gaze at or savor an experience or scene with deep sensory pleasure

items.def_zh: 尽情享受；沉浸于（阳光、氛围、赞誉等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) absorb, relish, and thoroughly enjoy a pleasant sensory or emotional atmosphere

items.def_zh: 陶醉于；沉浸在……的快感中
items.def_en: (+ sth) take extreme delight, pride, or relish in an experience or achievement
(+ in) to take great and self-indulgent pleasure in comfort or pleasure

items.def_zh: 尽情享受，品味，玩味；渴望
items.def_en: 1. To enjoy an experience, prospect, or food with great pleasure and anticipation.

items.def_zh: 品尝，细细品味，尽情享受；体会
items.def_en: 1. (US spelling of savour) To enjoy food, drink, or a pleasant experience slowly so as to appreciate every detail.
(+ in) to get great satisfaction and uninhibited delight from a situation

groups.summary_en: A person consciously pauses to fully experience, appreciate, and derive deep pleasure or psychological gratification from a sensory experience, victory, or moment. Verbs emphasize deliberate appreciation over casual liking.
groups.summary_zh: 专注于充分感受并咀嚼某种滋味、体验或成功带来的愉悦与心理满足感。

groups.name: Scatter & Sprinkle · 撒播与铺撒 (Disperse Fine or Loose Particles over a Surface)
groups.tip: 把草料散布铺洒一地

items.def_en: (+ over) to trickle or pour a thin stream of liquid over food lightly
(+ sth) to throw or drop loose things in many different directions over an area
(+ sth on sth) to sprinkle a powdery or granular substance over a surface by shaking a container
(+ with) to cover a surface lightly with a fine powder or sugar
1. (dated) To scatter or cover a floor or ground with straw or similar material.
1. (+ on/over/with) To scatter small drops of liquid or tiny pieces of powder or sugar lightly over a surface.
to throw or drop things in different directions so they cover an area irregularly
(+ with/over) to scatter things haphazardly over an area so as to cover it

groups.summary_en: An agent manually scatters, drops, or spreads loose substances, grains, or liquid drops loosely across a surface. Verbs vary by the fineness of the matter distributed and whether the action is light, deliberate, or decorative.
groups.summary_zh: 将松散细小碎屑、粉末或水滴分散撒在表面上。

groups.name: Scatter & Sprinkle · 撒落与喷洒 (Sprinkle, Scatter, Spritz)
groups.tip: 向表面扑撒粉末或细碎物

items.def_en: (+ sth on sth) to apply a liquid mist or fine spray onto a receiving surface
(+ sth on sth) to drop tiny drops of liquid or light particles gently over a surface
to cover lightly with a powdered substance such as flour or sugar
[I/T] to drop small drops or particles scatteringly over a surface
To powder or treat something, especially the skin, with talcum powder.
To spray a quick, fine mist of liquid onto someone or something.
[I/T] to throw or drop things in different directions so they fall over a wide area
to scatter things untidily over a surface or place

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe distributing fine powders, droplets, or particulate substances lightly over a receiving surface. 'Spritz' designates applying a fine liquid mist via a nozzle, while 'talc' specifically means dusting with talcum powder.
groups.summary_zh: 指将微细颗粒、粉末或细雾分散挥洒在目标受体表面。

groups.name: Scurry & Scuttle · 窜逃与小跑 (Scurry, Scuttle, Scamper)
groups.tip: 小步慌乱快速逃窜

items.def_zh: 急促小跑离开；仓皇溜走
items.def_en: depart hastily with brisk, short, hurried steps
to run with quick, light steps, especially in a playful or hurried way
move away suddenly and very rapidly in a sudden dash
flee quickly with rapid, agitated steps like a frightened small animal

items.def_zh: 碎步疾跑，仓促逃窜；凿沉（船只）；破坏，破坏（计划）
items.def_en: 1. To run with quick, hurried steps, like a crab or mouse. 2. To deliberately sink a ship by opening valves or making holes in its hull. 3. To deliberately spoil or ruin a plan or proposal.

items.def_zh: 碎步急跑，疾走；仓促奔跑
items.def_en: (+ away/along/around) To move quickly with short, rapid steps, especially in haste or fear.
to move lightly and quickly or hurriedly along a surface
to move suddenly and rapidly in a particular direction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict moving briskly with short, hurried, agitated steps, typical of rodents, insects, or startled individuals darting away in fear or urgency.
groups.summary_zh: 指带着惶恐或急迫心情，以碎步敏捷仓促逃窜或快跑的动作。

groups.name: Seize & Hold Hostage · 绑架与劫持 (Kidnap, Abduct)
groups.tip: 暴力劫持人质勒索或带走

items.def_en: 1. To take someone away illegally by force, usually in order to demand money for their release.
(+ sb) abduct or carry someone away illicitly by force or stealth
(+ sb) abduct or seize someone and take them away abruptly and swiftly
(+ sb) carry or transport someone away forcibly against their will
(informal) to suddenly and forcibly take someone away or kidnap them
1. To take someone away illegally by force or deception; to kidnap.

items.def_zh: 劫持（交通工具及其人员）
items.def_en: to seize control of a vehicle, aircraft, or its occupants by force in transit
to take arbitrary or military control of a vehicle or building by coercion

groups.summary_en: These transitive verbs describe taking a person away unlawfully and by force or deception. 'Kidnap' strongly collocates with ransom demands and illicit detention, while 'abduct' is the formal and legal term for unlawfully carrying someone off.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过暴力或欺骗手段非法掳走并扣押人员。

groups.name: Share Sorrow & Commiserate · 同情与体恤 (Empathize, Condole, Commiserate)
groups.tip: 感同身受分担他人苦痛

items.def_en: To feel genuine compassion or sympathy for someone enduring distress

items.def_zh: 向……表示同情慰问；主动关怀
items.def_en: (+ sb) offer sympathy, support, or condolences to someone experiencing grief
(+ with) To feel and express sadness, pity, or compassionate understanding for someone

items.def_zh: 有同感，产生共鸣，感同身受
items.def_en: (+ with) To understand and share the feelings, thoughts, or attitudes of another person.
(+ with) To express sympathy, sorrow, or shared grievances for someone's misfortune
(+ with) To express sympathy, sorrow, or condolences to someone experiencing grief or misfortune.
(+ sb) feel immense sorrow, sympathy, and emotional pain for another's distress
(+ sb) feel profound and intense grief or sympathy on behalf of someone suffering

groups.summary_en: An agent expresses heartfelt sorrow, shared distress, or emotional alignment with another person who is suffering. Nuances range from intellectual emotional resonance ('empathize') to formal verbal condolences ('condole') and mutual lamenting ('commiserate').
groups.summary_zh: 针对他人遭遇的痛苦、不幸表达感同身受的悲伤、体恤或慰问。

groups.name: Shave & Depilate · 剃刮与除毛修容 (Shave, Scrape, Shear)
groups.tip: 修剪毛发剃胡打理仪容

items.def_en: to cut small amounts off hair or beard to keep it neat without removing completely
(+ sth) remove hair completely from the skin using a razor

items.def_zh: 剃（须），刮（毛）；刨平，刮掉薄层；略微削减
items.def_en: 1. To cut hair from the face or body very close to the skin using a razor. 2. To cut or scrape thin slices from a surface. 3. To reduce something slightly.
(+ sth) remove stubble, hair, or a top surface layer using a firm scraping blade
(+ sth) cut hair, wool, or fleece completely away close to the skin
to remove hair, skin, or surface layers by drawing a hard edge firmly across
(archaic) Past participle of shave; to remove hair closely with a razor.
to cut the wool or hair completely off an animal or person using shears

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve removing hair, stubble, or thin outer surfaces from the body using a bladed or abrasive instrument. The frame emphasizes closeness to the skin, mechanical cutting, or smooth finishing.
groups.summary_zh: 使用刀片或机械工具紧贴表皮刮剃毛发或平整修容。

groups.name: Slander, Smear & Defame · 诋毁与诽谤 (Denigrate, Defame, Vilify)
groups.tip: 从言语贬低演进到公然抹黑

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Criticize someone or something unfairly and damage their reputation
to publish a false statement that is damaging to a person's reputation
to make a false and damaging spoken statement about someone
(+ sb/sth) Make damaging, insulting remarks that impugn someone's character or standing
to damage someone's reputation by making false accusations or malicious leaks
to unfairly criticize someone or something and suggest they have little value or importance; to defame
to damage the good reputation of someone by making false or malicious statements
to speak or write about someone in an abusively disparaging manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe making malicious, damaging, or disparaging statements about someone's reputation or character. They scale from belittling and unfair criticism to legally actionable false statements and virulent, public character assassination.
groups.summary_zh: 恶意贬低、破坏名誉乃至蓄意中伤诽谤。

groups.name: Slow & Outdoor Cooking · 慢炖与户外炙烤 (Stew, Barbecue, Simmer)
groups.tip: 火烤炭炙等烹饪手艺

items.def_en: to cook a large piece of meat slowly with vegetables in a covered pot
Boil gently until reduced in volume or cooked thoroughly
(+ sth) Reduce in liquid volume or cause food to reduce through gentle, prolonged cooking
(+ sth) Cook meat or vegetables slowly in liquid until very soft and tender
[I/T] to cook food on a metal grate directly over hot coals or open flames
To cook food on a barbecue, over an open fire or heated coals outdoors.

items.def_zh: 炖，焖，煨（用慢火水煮）；焦虑，生闷气
items.def_en: 1. To cook food slowly in liquid in a closed pot or pan. 2. (+ over/about) (informal) To worry, fret, or brood over something for a long time.
[I/T] to cook liquid gently just below the boiling point over an extended duration

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent extended cooking scenarios, specifically outdoor grilling over coals/smokers or prolonged slow liquid boiling in a pot.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及长时间低温炖煮或在炭火/烤架上烟熏炙烤的料理场景。

groups.name: Smell & Exude Odor · 散发恶臭 (Emit Foul Smells with Varying Intensity)
groups.tip: 臭气熏天令人掩鼻退避

items.def_en: (informal, chiefly BrE) to have an unpleasant or stale smell
(+ sth) Smell strongly and unpleasant of a particular substance
(informal) to smell very foul or offensively pungent
(+ sth) Fill an enclosed place with an extremely unpleasant, foul smell
(+ sth) Cause an entire room or area to smell very bad

items.def_zh: 散发恶臭，发臭；极糟，令人讨厌
items.def_en: 1. To have an extremely unpleasant smell. 2. (informal) To be very bad, unfair, or unpleasant.

items.def_zh: 散发强烈刺鼻臭味（常指酒气、汗臭或烟味）
items.def_en: (+ of) to emit an extremely strong, pervasive, and offensive odor

items.def_zh: 散发恶臭，发臭（stink的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of stink; smelled extremely bad.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this olfactory frame indicate emanating foul, pungent, or offensive airborne scents. They scale from faint or standard unpleasant odors to unbearable, suffocating emanations that overpower an entire vicinity.
groups.summary_zh: 按气味浓烈与难闻程度，散发从隐约异味到刺鼻恶臭。

groups.name: Sniff & Scent · 闻嗅与寻味感知 (Sniff, Snuff, Scent)
groups.tip: 耸起鼻子嗅探隐约气味

items.def_en: to perceive the odor of something using the olfactory sense

items.def_zh: 到处闻嗅；探头探脑地打探
items.def_en: (+ sth) Explore an area by sniffing scents, or pry inquisitively into affairs
(+ sth) Discover or detect something by smelling it, or figuratively track down through investigation

items.def_zh: 嗅出，闻到；发觉，察觉；使充满香味
items.def_en: 1. To smell or detect the presence of something by its odor. 2. To add a pleasant perfume or fragrance to something.

items.def_zh: 闻，嗅；抽鼻子；嗤之以鼻，轻蔑地对待
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To breathe air in noisily through the nose to smell something or clear the nasal passage. 2. ('sniff at') To show disapproval, contempt, or lack of interest.
to sniff noisily at something or inhale deeply to catch a trace scent
(+ sth) Detect or find something by scent or through shrewd enquiry
to probe or root around inquisitively while sniffing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve actively taking air in through the nose to identify an odor or detecting a quarry's airborne smell, ranging from quick audible inhalations to instinctual predatory detection.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过鼻子主动吸气以闻辨气味，或动物凭借气味感知追踪目标。

groups.name: Snub & Disdain · 冷落与轻慢 (Snub, Slight, Cold-shoulder)
groups.tip: 社交场上的当面冷落与漫不经心

items.def_en: to insult someone by treating them without proper respect or attention

items.def_zh: 轻慢，怠慢，轻浮对待（trifle with）；虚度（光阴）
items.def_en: (trifle with) to treat someone or something without seriousness or respect; to waste time frivolously
