(+ sb) Deliberately ignore someone or fail to attend a planned meeting with them
(+ sb) Rudely ignore, dismiss, or refuse to listen to someone
to intentionally ignore or be unfriendly toward someone
1. to insult someone deliberately by ignoring them or treating them with cold disrespect. 2. to extinguish a cigarette by pressing the end against something.
(+ sb) Make someone feel unwelcome and exclude them through hostile coldness or social silence
to reject an offer, approach, or gesture in an abrupt or ungracious manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe treating an interlocutor with deliberate coldness, disrespect, or dismissal of their social status. 'Snub' focuses on overt social rebuff, whereas 'trifle' focuses on treating someone or their feelings dismissively without proper seriousness.
groups.summary_zh: 指以冷淡、傲慢或敷衍的态度故意轻视、羞辱或排斥他人。

groups.name: Social Intercourse & Professional Interaction · 交往与对话 (Converse, Network, Commune)
groups.tip: 人际互动中沟通并拓展人脉

items.def_zh: 建立工作关系网，拓展人脉；把……连成网络
items.def_en: 1. to interact with others to exchange information and develop professional contacts. 2. to connect computers or systems together.

items.def_zh: 接洽，沟通协作（业务或跨领域交流）
items.def_en: (+ with) to communicate and coordinate closely with another person or group, especially in business
Make an effort to communicate or establish contact with someone, especially for help or business
(+ sb) Spend time interacting socially with people
(+ sb) Establish working communication and exchange information between groups or organizations
(+ upon/on) to speak or converse authoritatively or formally on a topic
(+ with) to engage in conversation with someone.
(+ with) to share deep, intimate feelings or thoughts with someone or nature without reserve

groups.summary_en: Encompasses purposeful social and communicative engagement. Verbs vary from standard verbal interaction ('converse') and career-oriented contact building ('network') to deep intellectual or spiritual sharing ('commune', 'interface').
groups.summary_zh: 强调人际对话交流、建立社交往来或专业联络的场景。

groups.name: Spatial Contiguity & Bordering · 毗连与接壤 (Border, Adjoin, Abut)
groups.tip: 空间界限相交相靠

items.def_zh: 与……接壤，毗邻；给……镶边；近似，接近 (border on)
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To be next to or share a boundary with a country, area, or property. 2. To form an edge along something. 3. (+ on) To come close to or be almost the same as something.
1. To be located next to or live near someone or something.
(+ sth) Share a boundary with a particular place or territory
(+ sth) Touch or meet something closely at its boundary or edge
(+ sth) Adjoin or lead directly into a neighboring space or area

items.def_zh: 位于……的侧翼；侧面与……相邻
items.def_en: to be situated at the side or along the edge of someone or something
to be next to and joined with a building, room, or plot of land

items.def_zh: 紧邻，邻接（尤指边界直接碰合）
items.def_en: (+ on/against) to touch along a border or have a common boundary with another property

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this spatial frame assert that two distinct geographical areas, parcels of real estate, or physical objects share a common perimeter or touch directly at the margin. They range from everyday geographical statements (border, neighbor) to formal, legal, and architectural descriptions (adjoin, abut, flank).
groups.summary_zh: 指地域、地产或实体在地理空间上互相相邻、边缘接壤或直接相触。

groups.name: Speak & Talk · 说话与交谈 (Verbal Utterance and Conversational Exchange)
groups.tip: 开口发声进行语言交流表达

items.def_zh: 说话，交谈；演说，发言；讲（某种语言）
items.def_en: 1. to say words, talk, or have a conversation with someone 2. to make a speech to an audience 3. to be able to communicate in a particular language
(+ with/to) to talk in a friendly, informal, and relaxed manner about non-serious matters

items.def_zh: 说话，交谈；讲（speak 的过去分词）
items.def_en: the past participle of speak
Speak more loudly, or state an opinion openly without hesitation
(+ sth) Discuss a problem or situation thoroughly with someone

items.def_zh: 公开表达意见；挺身表态
items.def_en: Publicly express one's views or objections candidly and firmly
(+ on/upon) to speak or write authoritatively and at length upon a scholarly subject
(+ with) to engage in a formal, thoughtful, or prolonged conversation with someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this baseline frame denote the vocal delivery of words or an interactive verbal exchange between individuals, spanning spontaneous chatter to formal addresses.
groups.summary_zh: 用声音说出言语，或与他人展开双向口头交流与谈话。

groups.name: Specialized Cavity Stuffing · 填膛与烹饪填塞 (Farce, Pouch, Stuff)
groups.tip: 打包入袋或装入容器

items.def_en: (+ with) to fill the inside of poultry, meat, or vegetables with seasoned breadcrumbs, herbs, etc.
(+ with) to fill or line a receptacle or garment with soft protective material
to plug or fill a cavity or bore with a soft compressible wad
(+ sth) Fill a space, receptacle, or cavity completely and tightly
(+ sth) Force a great deal of material or things into a confined space or cavity
(+ sth) Fill or line a hollow cavity or shape with soft padding material

items.def_zh: 装入小袋（或囊袋）中；（使）鼓起成袋状
items.def_en: 1. To put something into a small bag or pouch. 2. To bulge outward like a pouch, or cause something to do so.

items.def_zh: 在（肉、禽等）中塞入填料；填塞
items.def_en: (cooking, archaic) To stuff meat, poultry, or vegetables with a seasoned filling before cooking.

groups.summary_en: An agent fills an enclosed cavity or flexible container (such as meat, poultry, or a small receptacle) with a specific compound, mixture, or stuffing. Verbs differ by technical domain (culinary arts vs. storage) and register.
groups.summary_zh: 在食材内膛或囊袋状容器内填塞配料或充填物，具明确专业场景。

groups.name: Spot & Scar Surface · 斑驳与麻点污损 (Splotch, Pockmark)
groups.tip: 破坏表面留下瑕疵或污斑

items.def_en: (+ with) to mark or speckle a surface with tiny specks or dots of color

items.def_zh: 弄脏；在表面留下划痕斑点
items.def_en: (+ sth) to damage, dirty, or disfigure the surface of something with scratches, blemishes, or spots

items.def_zh: 使有斑驳花纹（如斑驳光影）
items.def_en: (+ with) to mark with rounded spots or patches of light and shade

items.def_zh: 磨损；擦破表面留下痕迹
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make marks, scrapes, or rough patches on the surface of an object by scraping or rubbing
to spot, stain, or disfigure with ink, paint, or a heavy blemish
1. (+ with) To mark or cover a surface with large, irregular spots or stains of color or liquid.

items.def_zh: 使留下麻子，在……上留下坑洼（或凹痕）
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To mark, scar, or pit a surface or skin with small hollow scars or craters.

items.def_zh: 使凹陷，使表面留下坑洼
items.def_en: (+ with) to mark or indent a surface with hollows, craters, or small depressions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe defacing, marking, or blemishing a surface through localized spots, irregular blotches, or pitted depressions.
groups.summary_zh: 在表面留下斑块、瘢痕、点状凹陷等局部瑕疵损害。

groups.name: Spurt & Gush · 喷射与涌出 (Spurt, Gush, Jet)
groups.tip: 液体受压大股喷涌而出

items.def_en: [I/T] to force a thin stream of liquid through a narrow opening
to flow or pour out suddenly in very large quantities
to surge out rapidly in very large quantities
to discharge or emerge suddenly and with great force
to flow or burst out suddenly in a rapid stream from a confined space
to spurt out in a rapid, forceful stream under high pressure

items.def_zh: 喷出，喷射，涌出；突然加速，冲刺
items.def_en: 1. When liquid or flame spurts, it shoots out suddenly in a strong stream. 2. To increase speed or effort suddenly.
1. When hot water, steam, or liquid geysers, it spouts forcefully upward into the air.

groups.summary_en: A liquid issues forth forcibly and rapidly from a narrow orifice or pressurized source. Verbs are differentiated by fluid volume, steadiness, and the kinetic violence of the discharge.
groups.summary_zh: 液体受压自孔道或源头猛烈、大量涌出，按喷射力度、流速及持续性排序。

groups.name: Stage & Present · 排演与搬上舞台 (Stage, Dramatize, Mount)
groups.tip: 筹办搬上舞台呈现演出

items.def_en: to manage and oversee the financial and managerial aspects of staging a play or film

items.def_zh: 上演，把……搬上舞台；举行，组织（活动、抗议等）
items.def_en: 1. To organize and present a play, show, or performance on stage. 2. To organize and carry out an event, protest, or action.
to organize, produce, and put on a play, exhibition, or performance
to produce and present a play, concert, or theatrical show

items.def_zh: 用动作把…表演出来；搬演
items.def_en: (+ sth) to perform a story, scene, or event using actions and dialogue
(+ for sth) to audition or compete for a role in a theatrical production or film
[I/T] to practice a play, piece of music, or dance for public performance

items.def_zh: 将……改编为戏剧（或影视剧）；夸张，把……戏剧化
items.def_en: 1. To adapt a story, novel, or real event into a play, film, or TV drama. 2. To make an event or situation seem much more exciting, dramatic, or serious than it really is.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the creative and logistical act of adapting, organizing, and physically producing a performance or text for a theatrical audience.
groups.summary_zh: 指将文本、剧本或事件编排制作并在舞台、荧幕上呈现给观众的演艺行为。

groups.name: Stand & Upright · 站立与起立 (Stand, Rise, Upright)
groups.tip: 双腿直立或由坐而起

items.def_en: to rise from a sitting, lying, or kneeling position to an upright stance
to rise from a sitting or lying position onto one's feet

items.def_zh: 站立，直立；立起；位于；经受，容忍
items.def_en: 1. To be on your feet in an upright position, or to rise to this position. 2. To be located or positioned in a particular place. 3. (usually in negative) To endure, withstand, or tolerate something unpleasant.

items.def_zh: （stand 的过去式和过去分词）站立，直立；位于；容忍
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of stand: to be in an upright position on one's feet; to be situated; to endure or tolerate.
to stand erect from a low or seated posture
to bring one's torso into an erect vertical posture
(formal) to stand up from a kneeling, sitting, or lying position
to restore or raise something to an erect vertical position

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote assuming, maintaining, or returning to a vertical, upright posture on one's feet from a recumbent or seated position.
groups.summary_zh: 指双脚着地维持垂直挺立状态，或从坐卧体位转为站立姿势。

groups.name: Start & Embark · 启程与开拔起动 (Embark, Restart, Commence)
groups.tip: 着手开展或登程出发

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to begin a journey or start an enterprise with a specific aim
to leave the ground or begin to become rapidly active and successful
to begin a journey or major expedition
to begin a journey, event, or sequence of actions

items.def_zh: 向新方向出发；独立开拓
items.def_en: to start moving purposefully in a specific direction or embark on an independent venture
[I/T] to begin or start an undertaking, ritual, or formal activity

items.def_zh: 着手，开始（常与 on/upon 连用）；上船（或飞机）
items.def_en: 1. (embark on/upon) To start a new project, venture, or course of action. 2. To board a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

items.def_zh: 重新开始；重新启动（设备、系统等）
items.def_en: To begin again, or to cause something such as a machine, system, or activity to start again after stopping.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the initiation of major journeys, ventures, or restarting an activity after an interruption.
groups.summary_zh: 指开启旅途、启动企业事业项目或中断后重新开动。

groups.name: Steer & Navigate Craft · 驾驭与操舵领航 (Conn, Steer, Helm)
groups.tip: 操控车辆船只或导航前行

items.def_zh: 引航；驾驶（航向精细操纵）
items.def_en: to steer or guide a ship or aircraft through hazardous waters or air routes
(+ from sth) to guide or direct the movement of a vessel or vehicle away from something
to reverse the engines of a vessel in order to back up or stop forward headway
[I/T] to guide or control the direction of a vessel, vehicle, or aircraft
[I/T] to direct and manage the charted course of a ship, aircraft, or vehicle
to steer a ship or boat by operating the helm or rudder

items.def_zh: 指挥操舵，掌舵（操纵船只或潜水艇的航向）
items.def_en: 1. (nautical) To direct the steering and navigation of a ship or submarine.

items.def_zh: 骑摩托车，乘摩托车旅行
items.def_en: 1. To ride or travel on a motorcycle.

groups.summary_en: An operator directly directs the course, speed, or steering of a vessel, vehicle, or craft. Technical maritime terms like 'conn' denote issuing tactical steering orders from the bridge, whereas broader navigation verbs encompass the physical handling of the helm.
groups.summary_zh: 在舰船或载具上操舵、下达航向指令并掌控行驶动态。

groups.name: Sting & Tingle · 刺痛与触感微刺 (Tickle, Prickle, Tingle)
groups.tip: 针扎微刺伴随酥麻之感

items.def_en: to experience an uncomfortable, irritating sensation on the skin prompting scratching

items.def_zh: 胳肢，挠痒；使发痒，使发轻微刺痒；逗乐，使高兴
items.def_en: 1. To touch someone lightly in a way that causes laughter or a tingling sensation. 2. To feel or cause a slight itching or tickling sensation. 3. (informal) To amuse or please someone.
(+ with) to experience a slight, prickly, stinging sensation caused by cold, emotion, or friction

items.def_zh: 感到刺痛（或微痛、发麻）；刺，扎；使感到刺痛
items.def_en: To feel or cause a tingling, stinging, or prickling sensation on the skin.
to feel intense heat or a stinging, burning sensation on the skin

items.def_zh: （皮疹、疼痛等）突然发作；阵发刺痛
items.def_en: to suddenly become inflamed, painful, or intensely irritated on the skin
to feel a sharp, clean, stinging wound pain, such as from an antiseptic or slap
to feel or cause a sharp, burning, localized pain on the skin or eyes

groups.summary_en: A localized skin area or bodily surface experiences or produces a faint, irritating, light, or prickling sensory stimulation.
groups.summary_zh: 身体表面因微弱刺激而产生发痒、微刺或阵阵麻痛感。

groups.name: Stovetop Oil & Pan Cooking · 煎炒与焖煸 (Sauté, Braise, Sear)
groups.tip: 运用烘炖等手法烹制食材

items.def_en: [I/T] to fry food in a shallow pan with a moderate layer of oil or fat
[I/T] to cook sliced food quickly in a small amount of very hot oil while tossing continuously
(+ sth) to cook or heat food in a pan using hot oil or fat
(+ sth) to simmer food or sauce in a pan so that its liquid evaporates and reduces
(+ sth) to quickly fry food in a little hot fat over high heat
to fry the surface of meat briefly at high heat to lock in juices and create color

items.def_zh: 焖，炖（先煎炒后加少量汤汁盖紧锅慢煮）
items.def_en: To fry food lightly in fat and then cook it slowly with liquid in a covered pan or pot.

items.def_zh: 嫩煎，短时间煸炒（在少量热油中快速翻炒）
items.def_en: To fry pieces of food quickly in a small amount of hot fat or oil.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize stovetop culinary techniques using hot fat, pans, and controlled moisture, moving from high-heat frying to combination slow-braising.
groups.summary_zh: 炉灶锅底油煎、快炒与先煎后慢火焖煮的常用专业烹调料理技法。

groups.name: Strangle & Throttle · 掐扼与窒息 (Strangle, Throttle, Choke)
groups.tip: 卡掐咽喉阻断呼吸致人窒息

items.def_en: [I/T] to make someone unable to breathe normally by squeezing the throat or blocking the windpipe
(+ sb) to cut off someone's air supply by squeezing or compressing their throat

items.def_zh: 掐晕；锁喉使其窒息昏迷
items.def_en: (+ sb) to render someone unconscious by constricting their neck and cutting off air or blood flow

items.def_zh: 掐死，勒死，使窒息；扼杀，抑制；节流，调节（引擎节气门）
items.def_en: 1. To choke or strangle someone by squeezing their throat tightly. 2. To suppress, choke back, or prevent the development of something. 3. To control the speed or flow of an engine with a throttle.
to kill or render unconscious by covering the face to cut off air supply
to cause someone to lose consciousness or die through deprivation of oxygen

items.def_zh: 扼死，勒死，掐死；压制，扼杀
items.def_en: 1. To kill or harm someone by squeezing their throat tightly so they cannot breathe. 2. To prevent something from growing, developing, or continuing.
to kill someone by strangling them with a wire, cord, or metal collar

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the hostile act of gripping, compressing, or blocking someone's throat or windpipe to obstruct breathing or blood flow. Intensity spans from brief windpipe obstruction to lethal, sustained strangulation.
groups.summary_zh: 用手、绳索或物体勒紧或卡阻喉部使之窒息。

groups.name: Strew & Litter · 散落与乱撒 (Scatter Objects Carelessly over a Flat Area)
groups.tip: 零散抛撒随意落在各处

items.def_en: to scatter seeds broadly over the ground by hand rather than planting in furrows
(+ sth) to leave objects lying untidily in various places
(+ sth) to drop or throw objects untidily all over an area
(+ sth) to disperse objects broadly over a flat surface
[I/T] to throw or drop a quantity of small things loosely in all directions over an area
1. (+ with/among) To scatter or place things at intervals among other things to add variety.

items.def_zh: 乱丢杂物于，使乱七八糟地布满
items.def_en: to leave things lying scattered around untidily on a surface

items.def_zh: 散播，撒满，遍布（strew的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of strew; scattered or covered untidily across a surface.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this spatial frame depict scattering or distributing physical things untidily, haphazardly, or at wide intervals across a floor or ground surface. 'Strew' covers broad loose dispersion, while 'intersperse' deliberately distributes elements amidst others.
groups.summary_zh: 杂乱、随意地将碎物抛撒、散落并布满于地面或表面。

groups.name: Stride & Clomp · 阔步与重步迈进 (Stride, Stalk, Clomp)
groups.tip: 大步流星重步踏地前行

items.def_en: to walk slowly and heavily with effort, as if exhausted
to walk into a room or place with firm, resolute, rhythmic steps
to depart by walking away with long, purposeful steps

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步，傲慢或愤怒地大步走
items.def_en: to walk with stiff, haughty, or menacing long strides

items.def_zh: 大步走，阔步行进（stride的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of stride; walked with long, purposeful steps.

items.def_zh: 脚步沉重地走，沉重地践踏
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/up/down) To walk with heavy, loud, clumsy steps.
to walk away with heavy, angry, deliberate footsteps
to walk with very heavy, deliberate, and loud steps to convey anger

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate deliberate walking styles marked either by long, purposeful, confident steps or heavy, noisy, lumbering footfalls against the ground.
groups.summary_zh: 指迈大步果断前行，或脚步沉重笨拙、发出巨响的行进步态。

groups.name: Strip of Vital Attribute · 剥夺特质与脱除生物机能 (Defoliate, Unsex, Desensitize)
groups.tip: 脱落附着物或剥除特质

items.def_zh: 使裸露，剥除植被或覆盖物
items.def_en: (+ of) to strip a landscape, tree, or surface of its covering, vegetation, or foliage
(+ sb/sth) to completely drain someone or something of vitality, resources, or essential strength

items.def_zh: 剥夺；脱除（特质、尊严或生机）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth of sth) to deprive someone or something of a vital property, attribute, or dignity
to strip a person of human attributes, individuality, or basic dignities
to deprive a male of sexual vitality or virility, or to weaken a system of its potency
To strip trees or bushes of their leaves, especially by using chemicals, or to shed leaves.

items.def_zh: 剥夺……的性别特质；阉割，剥夺……的性功能
items.def_en: 1. (archaic or literary) To deprive someone of the qualities, emotions, or roles considered characteristic of their sex. 2. To castrate or sterilize.
to surgically remove the testicles or reproductive organs, depriving an organism of sexual reproductive function

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the radical transformation of an organism, landscape, or identity by systematically stripping away essential natural attributes such as leaves, sexual identity, or vitality, often through artificial or destructive means.
groups.summary_zh: 剥夺生命体原生的自然机能、叶片或性别特质。

groups.name: Structural Failure & Inward Fall · 倒塌与塌陷 (Collapse, Cave in, Subside)
groups.tip: 结构失去支撑下陷或坍塌

items.def_en: of ground or a foundation: to sink downward to a lower level

items.def_zh: （结构、支撑物）断裂垮塌，支撑不住
items.def_en: of a structure or surface: to break, yield, or buckle suddenly under weight or force

items.def_zh: 塌陷，塌落；使凹陷；（向压力）屈服，让步 (cave in)
items.def_en: To collapse or cause to fall inwards (often cave in); to give in to pressure or demands.
of a roof, ceiling, or excavation: to collapse inward toward the center
to collapse or buckle completely under sudden weight, force, or pressure
to collapse inward or downward, especially of a roof, ceiling, or ground

items.def_zh: 倒塌，塌陷；崩溃，瓦解；（因病累）倒下；使倒塌；折叠
items.def_en: 1. To fall down suddenly due to loss of support; to completely fail or break down. 2. To cause something to fall down or fold up.

items.def_zh: （结构或人）受压瘫倒，严重变形压塌
items.def_en: to suddenly collapse inward or buckle under intense pressure or force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical structures, roofs, or ground surfaces giving way inward, downward, or completely under weight, pressure, or loss of support. The distinction lies in whether the failure is a downward buckling (cave in, subside) or a total catastrophic disintegration (collapse, crumple).
groups.summary_zh: 描述建筑物、地表或结构因承重或外力而向内下陷或轰然倒塌。

groups.name: Subsidize & Fund · 资助与赞助 (Finance, Fund, Underwrite)
groups.tip: 提供财力支持与补贴

items.def_en: to provide the money needed for a particular project, institution, or activity
to provide the capital, credit, or funds necessary to pay for something

items.def_zh: 赞助，资助；主办，发起；倡议（法案等）
items.def_en: to support an event, activity, or person by providing money or goods; officially organize or propose something

items.def_zh: 紧急注资救助；经济援助
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to provide financial aid to rescue an organization or individual from collapse
(+ sth) to supply or pay a sum of money required to support something
to pay part of the cost of something to keep prices low or encourage it to happen; give a subsidy to
to provide a large permanent sum of money for an institution, school, or scholarship
to accept financial responsibility for something, agreeing to pay any costs if it fails or loses money

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate providing monetary backing, institutional subsidies, or commercial underwriting to support an individual, project, arts event, or enterprise.
groups.summary_zh: 指提供资金、政府财政补贴或商业赞助以支持项目、活动或实体的运作。

groups.name: Supervise & Oversee · 监督与监管 (Oversee, Supervise, Monitor)
groups.tip: 居于上位严密督查与把控

items.def_en: to enforce regulations, standards, or agreements in an organization, industry, or group
to observe, record, and check the progress or quality of an activity over a period of time
[I/T] (formal) to take responsible managerial care and direction of an organization or enterprise
(+ sb/sth) to guard, protect, and closely supervise someone or something
(+ sb/sth) to monitor someone or something carefully and continuously
(+ sb/sth) to investigate or inspect someone to verify they are acting properly or performing duties
[I/T] to watch and direct someone or an activity to make sure that work is done correctly and safely
To watch and manage an operation, project, or workforce to ensure it is done properly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exercising administrative, operational, or regulatory authority by watching over workers, projects, or compliance to ensure standards are met. 'Oversee' emphasizes overarching managerial responsibility, while 'supervise' and 'police' involve closer, hands-on administrative scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 行使管理职能以监督人员、项目或法规执行，确保合规与正常运转。

groups.name: Suppress & Disenfranchise · 镇压与剥夺政治权利 (Quash, Subjugate, Disenfranchise)
groups.tip: 以强权平定骚乱并剥夺选民权利

items.def_en: to forcibly put an end to protests, rebellion, or dissenting speech
(+ sb/sth) to exert strict administrative or physical control to suppress an activity or group
(+ sb/sth) to take strong, severe measures to enforce laws or suppress opposition
1. To violently put down or suppress a rebellion, rumor, or opposition. 2. (law) To officially declare a court decision or legal procedure invalid.

items.def_zh: 剥夺……的选举权（或公民权）
items.def_en: To deprive someone of the right to vote or take away their civil liberties and representation.
to defeat and gain total political and military dominance over a population
(+ sth) to eradicate or suppress rebellion, crime, or dissent completely by forceful means
to destroy opposition or uprisings completely and ruthlessly by force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe state or institutional authorities forcibly crushing political dissent, rebellion, or fundamental civic rights, progressing from stripping legal privileges to absolute, violent subjugation.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或统治力量镇压反叛势力并剥夺民众政治权利或自由。

groups.name: Surface Coating & Cladding · 铺覆饰面与碎石 (Wallpaper, Gravel, Pave)
groups.tip: 在表面铺设贴附面层

items.def_en: to cover a wall or ceiling with flat panels of wood or decorative material
to surface a roadway with compacted layers of small broken stone and tar
(+ sth) to cover a natural or prepared ground surface completely with a hard paving layer
(+ sth) to coat or finish a surface entirely with a layer of gravel
(+ sth) to cover a wall surface with wallpaper

items.def_zh: 铺砌（用石块、沥青等铺设路面）
items.def_en: to cover an area of ground or road with concrete, stones, or bricks
To cover the walls of a room with decorative wallpaper.

items.def_zh: 铺碎石于，用沙砾铺设；使困惑，使为难
items.def_en: 1. To cover a path, driveway, or road with gravel. 2. (dated) To confuse or puzzle someone completely.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this finishing and infrastructure frame designate dressing structural surfaces—whether interior walls or outdoor walkways—with a uniform decorative or aggregate layer such as wallpaper or loose gravel.
groups.summary_zh: 指在墙面或路面上铺敷装饰壁纸、碎石或硬化面层。

groups.name: Surround & Hem In · 环绕与合围 (Encircle, Compass, Ring)
groups.tip: 从所有侧面包抄环绕

items.def_en: to form a circle around something or someone
to be positioned all around someone or something so as to enclose them
to surround someone or something closely so that they cannot move or escape freely
(+ sb/sth) to move nearer from surrounding positions so as to trap someone or something
(+ sb/sth) to surround someone or something completely so that movement or escape is impossible
(+ sb/sth) to surround an area or target with barriers, enclosing it on all sides

items.def_zh: 包围，环绕；达到，实现；图谋
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To surround or encircle completely. 2. (formal or archaic) To achieve or accomplish a purpose. 3. (archaic) To plot or scheme.
1. To surround someone or something completely in a circle.

groups.summary_en: Entities or topological features arrange themselves along the entire perimeter of a target, closing off boundaries or forming an unbroken perimeter. Verbs differ primarily in register and spatial nuance, from literary and archaic spatial bounding (compass) to geometric positioning (encircle) and defensive confinement (ring, hem in).
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或群落沿周边排列形成闭合圈，将其环绕或圈禁在内。

groups.name: Sway & Lose Balance Drunkenly · 摇晃与步履踉跄 (Reel, Stagger)
groups.tip: 步履不稳左右摇摆晃动

items.def_en: to move unsteadily from side to side showing poor physical equilibrium

items.def_zh: 摇摇欲坠地走；颤巍巍走动
items.def_en: to move with weak, unsteady, trembling steps as if about to fall
to step backward unsteadily and sway from shock, dizziness, or a blow

items.def_zh: 踉跄独行；摇摇晃晃前行
items.def_en: to walk forward with clumsy, unsteady, wobbling steps
to walk or move unsteadily in an irregular, zigzagging course like a drunkard

items.def_zh: 摇晃，踉跄，蹒跚；感到眩晕，发昏；卷，绕
items.def_en: 1. To stagger or move unsteadily as if about to fall, or to feel dizzy and overwhelmed. 2. To wind something onto a reel.

items.def_zh: 摇晃，蹒跚，踉跄；使震动，使大吃一惊；错开，交错安排
items.def_en: 1. To walk or move unsteadily as if about to fall. 2. To shock or astonish someone deeply. 3. To arrange things so they happen at different times.

items.def_zh: 猛然前倾颠簸；歪斜晃动
items.def_en: to make an abrupt, uncontrolled, and unsteady movement forward or sideways

groups.summary_en: This frame involves uncoordinated, swinging steps caused by dizziness, severe intoxication, physical blows, or intense shock. 'Stagger' highlights unsteadiness with sudden stumbling steps to keep from falling, while 'reel' accents spinning disorientation and swaying wildly backward or sideways.
groups.summary_zh: 指因眩晕、受击或醉酒而失去平衡，身体剧烈晃动、步履不稳。

groups.name: Swerve & Veer · 突然偏转与改变方向 (Change Direction Abruptly)
groups.tip: 行进中突然拐弯或偏离

items.def_en: [I/T] to turn or move smoothly or suddenly in a new direction
[I/T] to suddenly move or cause to move at an angle from a straight path

items.def_zh: 急转避让；突然偏转方向
items.def_en: to make a sudden, sharp directional shift away from someone or something
to turn aside abruptly and sharply, especially to avoid a collision
to change direction abruptly and turn away from an original path
(+ away/off) To suddenly change course or turn away sharply, especially in order to avoid an obstacle.
to change direction suddenly, especially when moving at speed

items.def_zh: 急转弯，突然转向；背离，偏离；使急转
items.def_en: To change direction abruptly, especially while moving fast to avoid hitting something; to cause a vehicle to turn aside.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a moving vehicle, person, or object abruptly deviating from a straight path, often to avoid an obstacle or under sudden external force. While 'veer' suggests a sharp shift in course, 'swerve' emphasizes an evasive, often jerky turn.
groups.summary_zh: 指移动物体或人突然变向或急转，多为躲避障碍。

groups.name: Swing & Sway · 摆动与波动 (Oscillate, Ripple, Sway)
groups.tip: 如涟漪般起伏泛起波纹

items.def_en: Move rhythmically and continuously from one side to the other
Move or pivot around a central point in a smooth, sweeping curve
[I/T] to move slowly from side to side or backward and forward, typically rooted at the base

items.def_zh: 起微波，起涟漪；如波浪般翻滚；（在…中）扩散，传开
items.def_en: 1. to move in small waves, or to cause the surface of something to do this. 2. to spread gradually through a person, group, or place like a wave
to move with a continuous smooth, wavelike motion
[I/T] to move back and forth or in an arc while suspended from an axis or pivot point
to rise and fall irregularly in number, level, or physical position

items.def_zh: 摆动，振荡；（在两种观点、情感之间）摇摆不定
items.def_en: 1. to move repeatedly from one position to another and back again at a regular speed. 2. to keep changing between two extreme opinions, moods, or states

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote continuous, wave-like, or back-and-forth physical motion around a pivot or across a surface. While 'oscillate' denotes periodic pendulum-like or electronic alternation, 'ripple' captures outward spreading surface undulations.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体绕定点往复摆动或沿表面呈波浪状起伏扩散。

groups.name: Systemic & Spatial Relocation · 移位与转置 (Translocate, Relocate, Reposition)
groups.tip: 改变空间位置或方向挪动

items.def_en: (chess) to make a special move shifting the king two squares toward a rook and placing that rook on the square the king has just crossed.
(+ sth) Move objects or personnel around to different positions or configurations
(+ sb/sth) Change position or relocate slightly to make space or reconfigure
[I/T] to move to a new place or establish something in a new location
to change the physical position or strategic orientation of something
to cause two or more things to change places with each other
to assign troops, resources, or workers to a new position or task

items.def_zh: 使移位，迁移（动植物等）；发生易位
items.def_en: (biology, ecology) to move or be moved from one place to another, especially of plants, animals, or genetic material.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent deliberate, systematic movement or positional exchange of objects, elements, or personnel from one place or configuration to another, often within a formal, scientific, or rule-governed system.
groups.summary_zh: 在规则系统、科学语境或组织内部进行有序的空间转置与重新定位。

groups.name: Tactical Assault & Direct Fire · 进攻与交火 (Enfilade, Counterstrike, Engage)
groups.tip: 战场上的主动突击与炮火交锋

items.def_en: to open fire on or begin fighting an enemy unit or aircraft
(+ sb/sth) to begin shooting heavily with firearms or artillery at a target
to return gunfire in response to an attack
(+ sb/sth) to adjust aim or projectile fire directly onto an enemy position
to attack an enemy position continuously with large guns or bombs
to attack ground targets repeatedly with machine-gun fire from low-flying aircraft
To launch an attack in response to an enemy's assault; retaliate with military force.

items.def_zh: （以纵射火力）射击，向……实施纵射
items.def_en: (military) To direct gunfire along the entire length of an enemy trench, line of troops, or position.

groups.summary_en: Combatants initiate or retaliate with coordinated military force or projectile fire targeting opposing positions, ranging from retaliatory strikes to sweeping gunfire angles.
groups.summary_zh: 作战双方发起战术突击、还击或火力扫射，侧重交战与射击动作。

groups.name: Tactical Deception & Swindling · 虚招与诈取 (Feint, Diddle, Outmaneuver)
groups.tip: 运用假动作或诡计蒙蔽对手

items.def_en: (+ sb + into sth/doing sth) Persuade or trick someone into doing something through deceit
(+ sb) Cheat someone financially by charging too much or swindling them

items.def_zh: 诱骗，欺蒙（以巧妙手段惑人）
items.def_en: (+ into) to charm, divert, or mislead someone strategically or deceitfully
1. (+ at) To make a deceptive movement or pretended attack to distract or mislead an opponent.
1. (+ out of) (informal) To cheat or swindle someone, especially out of money. 2. ('diddle around') To waste time doing silly or useless things.
(+ sb) Dishonestly arrange circumstances so that someone is framed or deceived
(+ out of/into) to trick someone into giving money or property by winning their confidence

items.def_zh: 欺诈，行骗（法律层面谋利）
items.def_en: (+ of) to illegally obtain money or property from someone through deliberate deception

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to misleading an adversary or counterparty through deceptive maneuvers, fraudulent tricks, or deliberate misdirection to gain an unfair advantage or swindle them.
groups.summary_zh: 通过战术佯攻或欺诈手段迷惑对手以谋取利益。

groups.name: Tailor & Condition to Specs · 驯化与定制调适 (Condition, Individualize, Tailor)
groups.tip: 按需调整以适应环境

items.def_en: (+ sth) Design, modify, or tailor something to suit a specific purpose or group
to adapt or make something specifically suited for a particular person or need
to modify something to suit a particular individual or task
(+ sth) Adapt or condition something precisely to meet individual requirements

items.def_zh: 训练，使适应，使习惯于；调节，改善（发质、皮肤或空气等的状态）
items.def_en: 1. to train or accustom a person or animal to behave or think in a particular way 2. to improve the condition of hair, skin, air, or other materials
to make someone or something accustomed to a particular condition through exposure

items.def_zh: 使个性化，使适应个别需要；赋予……个人特色
items.def_en: to modify or adapt something to suit the special needs or character of a particular individual
to adapt or become accustomed to a new climate or environment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote modifying, training, or customizing an organism, mind, product, or process so that it fits a distinct physiological state, individual recipient, or contextual requirement.
groups.summary_zh: 通过训练、驯化或定制使之适应特定个体或机能状态。

groups.name: Taint & Desecrate · 玷污与亵渎 (Sully, Defile, Desecrate)
groups.tip: 由纯洁被玷污升级到亵渎神圣

items.def_en: to contaminate or affect something slightly with an undesirable quality
to corrupt the moral purity or physical cleanliness of something
to damage the purity, integrity, or reputation of something previously clean
(+ sth) Spoil, corrupt, or make something dirty or impure
(+ sth) Degrade, sully, or bring disgrace to someone's name or reputation (as in dragging through the mud)

items.def_zh: 玷污，亵渎，糟蹋；（狭路中）以纵队前进
items.def_en: 1. To spoil, pollute, or treat something pure or sacred with great disrespect. 2. (of troops) To march in a narrow line or single file.
to treat something sacred with irreverence, disrespect, or abuse

items.def_zh: 亵渎，玷污，糟蹋（圣物或圣地）
items.def_en: To damage or treat a sacred place, grave, or holy object with deliberate disrespect.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures moral corruption and sacrilege, scaling from marring purity or reputation to outright physical or ritual desecration of sacred, inviolable sites or objects.
groups.summary_zh: 从玷污名誉洁白递进到严重污损、亵渎神圣场所与宗教圣物。

groups.name: Take into Custody · 缉捕与拘押 (Arrest, Collar, Detain)
groups.tip: 执法机关依法剥夺人身自由

items.def_zh: 逮捕，拘留；遏制，阻止；吸引（注意）
items.def_en: 1. To seize someone by legal authority and take them into custody. 2. To stop or slow down a process or development. 3. (formal) To attract and hold someone's attention.
(+ sb) Arrest someone or take them to a police station for questioning
(+ sb) Apprehend someone and take them into custody
(+ sb) Place someone in a prison, cell, or secure psychiatric facility

items.def_zh: 逮捕，捉拿；拦截（某人与之说话）
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To catch and arrest a suspect or criminal. 2. (informal) To stop someone and make them listen or talk to you.
to officially keep someone in custody or delay their departure for questioning
(formal) to catch and arrest a suspect or fugitive
(informal) to catch someone doing something wrong and seize them suddenly

groups.summary_en: This scenario describes law enforcement or legal authorities seizing a suspect and placing them in custody. 'Collar' is informal police slang for catching or apprehending a wrongdoer, whereas 'arrest' denotes the full legal act of taking someone into official custody under warrant or suspicion.
groups.summary_zh: 司法执法人员发现嫌疑人并依法抓扣、收押之刑事执法场景。

groups.name: Tear & Rip · 撕裂与扯碎 (Tear, Rip, Shred)
groups.tip: 用力扯破或撕成碎块

items.def_en: (+ sth) Tear paper, fabric, or other fibrous material into small pieces
(+ sth) Pull something flexible or fibrous into several ragged parts
1. To pull or be pulled apart or into pieces by force. 2. To run or move somewhere very quickly.
[I/T] to tear something quickly and suddenly with substantial force
(+ sth) Pull something violently into separate ragged pieces
to cut or tear something into thin, narrow strips or fine fragments
to cut or tear skin or flesh deeply and jaggedly
to tear something apart violently into pieces with raw emotional or physical fury

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail pulling something flexible, fibrous, or organic apart by force into separate ragged pieces. 'Tear' is the general verb of division, while 'rip' implies sudden violence and speed, and 'shred' entails reducing material to many thin strips.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强力将布帛、纸张或肌肉等纤维柔性组织暴力扯断或撕碎。

groups.name: Thermal Rekindling & Heating · 重新加热与复燃 (Reheat, Reignite, Rekindle)
groups.tip: 施加热量再次升温或点燃

items.def_en: [I/T] to heat food, an engine, or a space until it reaches a suitable temperature
[I/T] to light a flame, burner, or cigarette again after it has gone out
(+ sth) Make something warm or hot again, or become warm again
(+ sth) Ignite a flame, boiler, or furnace anew

items.def_zh: 突然复燃；猛烈燃烧起来
items.def_en: Suddenly burst into flame again after dying down
[I/T] to relight a dying fire, ember, or flame, or catch fire again
To heat food, liquid, or an object again until it is hot.

items.def_zh: （使）重新点燃；使再次燃起，重燃（情绪、冲突或希望）
items.def_en: To catch fire again or make something catch fire again; to revive strong feelings, debates, or conflicts.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on reviving warmth, fire, or heat in an object, substance, or flame that had cooled or gone out. Verbs typically denote either warming something back up or striking combustion anew.
groups.summary_zh: 使冷却的物体再次受热，或使熄灭的火焰与燃烧重新引燃。

groups.name: Thick & Lavish Application · 厚涂与重裹 (Slather, Daub, Rosin)
groups.tip: 厚厚涂抹油脂或树脂覆层

items.def_en: [I/T] to spread an oily, greasy, or sticky substance over an expanse
To rub or coat something (especially the bow of a stringed instrument) with rosin.
(+ sth + on/over sth) Spread a thick, wet layer of substance heavily over a surface
[I/T] to spread a thick, sticky substance crudely, heavily, or unevenly on a surface
(+ sth + on/onto sth) Smear or apply cosmetics, mud, or paste in a very thick layer
(+ sth + on/onto sth) Apply a thick, generous, viscous layer of substance to a surface
(+ on/with) to apply a thick layer of a paste-like substance over a wide area

items.def_zh: 厚厚地涂，大量涂抹；大量使用
items.def_en: To spread or apply something thickly or in very generous quantities.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to applying viscous materials, oils, or resins onto a surface in thick, heavy, or specialized layers (such as spreading paste thickly or rubbing rosin on bowstrings).
groups.summary_zh: 指在物体表面极其厚实、大面积或针对性地抹上膏体、树脂等粘稠介质。

groups.name: Tinker & Mend · 捣鼓与修理 (Tinker, Fettle, Mend)
groups.tip: 摆弄修补恢复正常功能

items.def_en: to cover a hole or repair a defect by fastening a piece of material over it
to touch, adjust, or tinker with something repeatedly, often aimlessly or while trying to fix it
(+ sth) Repair something temporarily or roughly with available materials
(+ sth) Make small experimental changes or improvised adjustments to a machine or device
(+ sth) Improve or repair a surface or object by making small additions or corrections
[I/T] to repair something that is broken, torn, or damaged so that it can be used again

items.def_zh: 修补，摆弄，瞎捣鼓（tinker with）；做补锅匠
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To make small, experimental adjustments or repairs to a machine, system, or plan. 2. (historical) To work as a traveling tinker mending metal household items.

items.def_zh: 修补，修理；（冶金/铸造）修整（铸件边缘），修炉
items.def_en: 1. (dialect) To mend, repair, or put something in good condition. 2. (engineering) To trim the rough edges from a metal casting or piece of pottery.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote hands-on physical fixing, patching, or adjusting of broken household items, tools, garments, or machinery, often involving improvised or artisanal skill.
groups.summary_zh: 指动手修整、补缀衣物器具，或摆弄调试机械部件以使其恢复正常运转。

groups.name: Tolerate & Endure · 承受与苦熬 (Bear, Stand, Endure)
groups.tip: 默默担待乃至长期熬过痛苦折磨

items.def_en: accept or endure someone or something unpleasant or annoying without complaining

items.def_zh: 容忍，忍受（不快的人或事）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to tolerate or accept an unpleasant person or situation without complaining

items.def_zh: 经受；忍受（常用于否定句或疑问句）
items.def_en: endure or tolerate an unpleasant situation or person without breaking down
to persevere or endure through adversity or severe pressure without giving up

items.def_zh: 忍耐到底，熬过（困难局面）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to continue doing something difficult, tedious, or unpleasant until the end

items.def_zh: 忍受，承受；承担，负起；带有，具有；生育，结出（果实）
items.def_en: 1. To accept, tolerate, or endure a painful, unpleasant, or difficult situation. 2. To carry or support a weight or responsibility. 3. To give birth to a child, or produce flowers or fruit.

items.def_zh: 坚持挺过，熬过（艰难境遇）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to endure a difficult, painful, or adverse situation with determination until it passes
[I/T] suffer something difficult, painful, or unpleasant patiently over a long period

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame scale from the basic cognitive capacity to tolerate pain, hardship, or discomfort up to long-term heroic perseverance under severe, agonizing distress without capitulating.
groups.summary_zh: 由基础耐受烦扰递进到在极端痛苦或漫长困境中坚忍硬撑。

groups.name: Transilluminate & Reevaluate · 透光照检与复查核验 (Candle, Reexamine, Reinspect)
groups.tip: 逐项核对查验排除瑕疵

items.def_en: to inspect or verify something a second time to ensure accuracy
to carry out a second or repeated inspection to ensure compliance or quality
to pass strong light through an organ, tissue, or egg to examine internal structures
(+ sb/sth) Examine something carefully to ensure accuracy, safety, or physical integrity
(+ sth) Inspect or examine something again to verify condition or detect faults
(+ sth) Examine the details of something carefully in a secondary round of review

items.def_zh: 透光检查（蛋的受精或新鲜程度）
items.def_en: To examine eggs for freshness or fertility by holding them up to a bright light.

items.def_zh: 重新检查，重新审查；重考；复讯（证人）
items.def_en: To examine, inspect, or question someone or something again.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to specialized forms of diagnostic verification, specifically checking internal integrity via backlighting/transillumination (candling) or conducting repeated, secondary rounds of rigorous inspection.
groups.summary_zh: 通过透光照检（如照蛋）或重复复审等专门方法进行的核验。

groups.name: Tread Heavily & Crush Underfoot · 踩踏与跺脚 (Stomp, Trample)
groups.tip: 重重踩压与踏步

items.def_en: [I/T] to put one's foot down on; step or walk on something
1. Past participle of tread; stepped or walked upon heavily or firmly.
(+ sb/sth) Bring the foot down heavily and forcefully on someone or something
(+ sth) Crush, flatten, or compress something underfoot by stepping on it heavily
[I/T] to bring the foot down heavily and forcefully on the ground, often out of anger
(+ sth) Flatten, crush, or destroy plants or objects by stepping roughly on them
1. (+ on/out/around) To walk with heavy, noisy steps, or stamp one's foot down forcefully in anger.
[I/T] (+ on/over) to step heavily and repeatedly on something so as to crush or damage it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe driving the foot hard into the ground or down upon an object or living thing, either in fury or to crush and ruin. 'Stomp' foregrounds forceful, loud downward footsteps, whereas 'trodden' (tread) conveys stepping heavily upon something, often flattening, degrading, or injuring it.
groups.summary_zh: 指用力跺地或将脚重重踩在物体或地面上，常伴随重击或踩碎。

groups.name: Trigger & Excite into Activity · 触发与激发活性 (Activate, Stimulate, Animate)
groups.tip: 触动开关使其开始运转工作

items.def_en: to cause an intensive functional process or reaction to begin
to ignite or provide the initial stimulus that sets something into motion
1. To cause something to start working, operate, or become active.
(+ sb/sth) to activate, excite, or stimulate someone or a system into vigorous activity
(+ sth) to arouse or stimulate dormant feelings, memories, or biological impulses

items.def_zh: 使有生气，激活；赋予生命；制作成动画
items.def_en: 1. To make someone or something lively, energetic, and full of spirit. 2. To give life to something. 3. To produce drawings or models as a moving film.

items.def_zh: 激发，促进，激励；刺激（机体或器官）
items.def_en: 1. To encourage something to grow, develop, or become more active. 2. To make an organ, organism, or part of the body function or react.
to awaken or stir someone/something from lethargy into active response

groups.summary_en: A stimulus triggers an otherwise dormant function, physiological mechanism, or cognitive process, bringing it into an active, responsive, or lively operational state.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过外界刺激触发生理机制、心智或系统功能，使其进入活跃状态。

groups.name: Trim & Crop · 修剪与截除 (Roach, Jag, Crop)
groups.tip: 剪短边缘使之整齐整洁

items.def_en: (+ sth) Remove an unwanted end or protrusion with a quick cut of scissors or shears
(+ sth) Cut back the edges or growth of foliage, hair, or material to make it neat
[I/T] to cut something with short, quick, light strokes of scissors
(+ sth) Cut or slice off a branch, appendage, or excess material sharply
to cut hair, plants, or edges short, neat, or to a specific uniform length

items.def_zh: 剪短（马鬃使其直立）；剪平（头发等）；使拱起
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly North American) To cut a horse's mane very short so that it stands bristling upright. 2. To arch or curve something upward.

items.def_zh: 剪（撕）成锯齿状，使产生缺口；刺，戳
items.def_en: To cut, slash, or tear uneven notches or sharp teeth into an edge.
to cut wool, hair, or surface material off closely using heavy shears or blades

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specific physical cutting actions aimed at trimming, leveling, notching, or shearing hair, mane, foliage, or materials to alter their outline or reduce length.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过修整、锯齿状剪切或剪截边缘，对毛发、植物或材质进行修齐或截短。

groups.name: Unfasten & Loosen Closures · 解开紧固与松解联结 (Unfasten, Untie, Loose)
groups.tip: 解除系紧状态并释放物体

items.def_zh: 解开，松开；释放，放开；发射（箭、子弹）
items.def_en: 1. To unfasten, untie, or loosen something. 2. To set free or release someone or something from restraint. 3. To shoot or fire a bullet, arrow, or missile.
[I/T] to unfasten a buckle on a belt, shoe, or harness
(+ sth) to make a tight binding, knot, or closure less tight or rigid
[I/T] to undo a knot, or free something that is held by a knot
[I/T] to undo the buttons of an article of clothing

items.def_zh: 解开，松开；撤销，破坏（undo的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of undo: unfastened, untied, opened, or reversed something.

items.def_zh: 解开……的钩子；从钩上取下
items.def_en: 1. To unfasten hooks on something, or to release or remove something from a hook.

items.def_zh: 解开，松开，打开（系紧或扣住之物）
items.def_en: 1. To undo, open, or loosen something that is fastened, tied, or buttoned.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physical frame denote undoing, releasing, or separating clasps, hooks, knots, and restraining mechanisms to open a garment, container, or tethered item.
groups.summary_zh: 指解开绳扣、挂钩等固定连接构件，使物体脱离束缚或开启。

groups.name: Unfasten & Undo · 解扣与解开 (Unfasten, Untie, Unzip)
groups.tip: 解脱绳结拉锁使敞开

items.def_en: [I/T] to release the buckle of a belt, strap, or harness

items.def_zh: 脱下；取下（通过解开扣合件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to unfasten and remove a garment, belt, or watch from the body
(+ sth) to make a tight knot, strap, or binding less firmly fastened

items.def_zh: 拉开（……的）拉链；解压缩（计算机文件）
items.def_en: 1. To open clothing, a bag, etc. by pulling the zipper open, or to become unfastened by a zipper. 2. (computing) To decompress a zipped file.

items.def_zh: 解开，松开（绳、结、捆绑之物等）
items.def_en: To undo or loosen a knot, cord, or something that is tied or bound.
[I/T] to unfasten the buttons of a garment
to disconnect or unfasten something by releasing hooks
[I/T] to open or release a fastener, clip, lock, or buckle holding something together

groups.summary_en: An agent undoes a fastener, knot, or mechanical closure to open a garment, container, or bound object. Verbs correspond directly to the specific mechanism being undone (knots, zips, buttons, buckles).
groups.summary_zh: 解开拉链、绳结、搭扣等紧固件以释放或打开物体。

groups.name: Unfurl & Spread Out · 展开与展平 (Unfurl, Splay, Outstretch)
groups.tip: 将折叠卷曲之物展平铺开

items.def_en: [I/T] to spread out or cause to spread out in the shape of an open fan
(+ sth) to unfold or cause sth folded to become flat and wide
(+ sth) to open and spread sth flat that has been rolled up, or to become flat in this way
(+ sth) to open out or arrange sth over a wider surface
[I/T] to open out something that has been rolled into a flat shape
to extend or stretch out limbs or flat material to full length

items.def_zh: 展开，解开，展平；开放，展现
items.def_en: To open out or unroll something that was folded, curled, or rolled up, such as a flag, sail, or umbrella; to become spread out.

items.def_zh: （使）张开，（使）张开成八字形，展开
items.def_en: (+ out/apart) To spread fingers, legs, or objects wide apart or outward at an angle.

groups.summary_en: Agents or objects open, unroll, or flare out from a folded, rolled, or compressed state into a fully extended and flattened posture.
groups.summary_zh: 指将卷起、折叠或聚拢的物体向外伸展并摊开展平。

groups.name: Unify & Fuse into Whole · 融合与熔合 (Meld, Amalgamate, Fuse)
groups.tip: 多物合为一体交融

items.def_en: [I/T] to combine components so that they function together as an integrated whole
(+ sth) to combine or merge distinct elements into a single harmonious whole
to join or merge together to form a unified entity
(+ sth) to join closely or firmly together into an organic whole
[I/T] to join together securely or permanently into a single entity, often as if melted
(+ with/into) To combine or blend smoothly together into a unified whole.
(+ with) To join or merge two or more organizations, businesses, or things into a single unit.
(+ into) to grow or come together from disparate parts into a single mass

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe two or more distinct entities, substances, or concepts combining organically or structurally to form a unified, indivisible whole, differentiated primarily by formality and technical register.
groups.summary_zh: 表示不同要素结合为一个不可分割的统一个体，重在融为一体。

groups.name: Utter Loudly & Raise a Racket · 呼喊与喧嚷 (Cry, Din, Clamor)
groups.tip: 因情绪激动扯开嗓子大叫

items.def_en: (+ sth) to speak or shout loudly so as to attract attention

items.def_zh: 叫喊，大声呼叫；哭泣，流泪
items.def_en: 1. to shout or utter a loud call, exclamation, or sound. 2. to shed tears because of pain, sadness, or joy.
[I/T] (+ at/to) to utter words or sounds with maximum vocal volume
to make a loud sound or utter words loudly because of pain, fear, or urgency
(+ sth) to say sth in a sudden and very loud voice

items.def_zh: 大声喧闹，喧嚷；反复叮嘱，絮叨灌输
items.def_en: 1. to make a loud, unpleasant, or confusing noise. 2. to instill or repeat something wearyingly into someone's head.

items.def_zh: 大声喧哗，大声吵闹要求
items.def_en: (+ for/against) to make a loud and persistent outcry or demand with confusion and noise
[I/T] to emit a deep, loud, roaring shout or sound, typically in anger or pain

groups.summary_en: People emit powerful vocal shouts, vocalizations, or collective ear-splitting noises that overpower ambient sound or demand immediate attention.
groups.summary_zh: 发出响亮叫喊，或持续制造震耳欲聋、嘈杂喧闹的声响。

groups.name: Vary & Approximate · 跨度与趋近 (Range, Approximate, Fluctuate)
groups.tip: 数值在一定区间波动并趋近目标

items.def_en: to increase or move gradually and incrementally toward a higher figure
(+ sth) to stay or fluctuate near a particular amount, level, or approximate value

items.def_zh: 稳定在某个水平；趋于平稳
items.def_en: to stop fluctuating and remain steady at a certain approximate level
to come near to a specific quantity, figure, or condition in degree or number

items.def_zh: （在一定范围内）变动，变化；漫游；排列
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/between) To vary between certain limits or along a numerical scale. 2. To wander or travel freely over an area.
To be almost equal to or very close to something in amount, quality, or nature.
to rise and fall irregularly in number, level, or price within limits
(+ between) to fluctuate continually between two fixed points, extremes, or values

groups.summary_en: This scalar frame governs expressions of numerical extent, variation across bounds, or estimation toward a target value. 'Range' details distribution between specified limits, while 'approximate' denotes approaching a value or standard closely without exact convergence.
groups.summary_zh: 表示数值在界限内跨越分布，或在量级与标准上逐步趋近估值。

groups.name: Violent Surge & Forceful Charge · 冲撞与猛冲 (Rush, Storm, Charge)
groups.tip: 快步猛冲疾驰而去

items.def_en: [I/T] to rush aggressively forward in an attack or headlong movement
(+ sth) to rush in a clumsy, rude, or forcefully forceful manner
to rush or charge inside an area in a furiously agitated, aggressive manner
(+ sth) to rush or charge aggressively and violently toward or into sth

items.def_zh: 气冲冲地疾走，猛冲；突袭，攻占
items.def_en: 1. To move or rush somewhere in an angry, aggressive manner. 2. To attack and capture a place by sudden, direct force.

items.def_zh: 猛冲，疾驰，奔跑；匆忙行事；催促，仓促处理
items.def_en: 1. To move, run, or go somewhere with great speed. 2. To do something hurriedly or force someone to act too quickly.

items.def_zh: 呼啸猛冲；高速不可阻挡地前冲
items.def_en: (+ down/through) to move at high speed without stopping for obstacles
[I/T] to surge in a wild, panicked headlong rush, especially as a crowd or herd

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving with forceful, aggressive momentum driven by urgency or rage, ranging from hurried rushing to explosive, tempestuous charges.
groups.summary_zh: 描述带有冲劲、怒气或紧迫性由快走升级为狂暴冲击的运动。

groups.name: Wake & Awaken from Sleep · 醒来与唤醒 (Wake & Awaken)
groups.tip: 从睡梦中醒来或催促醒来

items.def_zh: 醒来，唤醒（最常用标准词）
items.def_en: to stop sleeping or make someone stop sleeping; become conscious after sleep

items.def_zh: 醒来，叫醒（口语核心动词短语）
items.def_en: to cease sleeping or cause someone to cease sleeping, especially in everyday speech
(+ sb) To arouse someone from deep sleep, lethargy, or inactivity
To awaken or regain consciousness after fainting, anesthesia, or sleep

items.def_zh: （使）醒来，唤醒；唤起（记忆、情感等）；觉察，意识到
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) to wake up from sleep, or to make someone wake up 2. to stir up or arouse an emotion, interest, or memory
to wake someone up from deep sleep, unconsciousness, or lethargy

items.def_zh: （使）再度醒来；（使）再次唤醒，重新激起
items.def_en: to wake up again, or to make someone wake up again; to revive a feeling or memory
(formal or literary) to stop sleeping, or to wake someone from sleep

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe stirring from sleep or rousing someone from an unconscious state, used both literally for slumber and figuratively for alertness or spiritual revival. Nuances range from ordinary physical waking to elevated, literary, or poetic awakening.
groups.summary_zh: 从睡眠中苏醒或唤醒他人，涵盖日常睡眠苏醒至书面/诗意化的顿悟觉醒。

groups.name: Whip & Scourge · 鞭笞与严酷体罚 (Flog, Scourge, Welt)
groups.tip: 挥舞皮鞭惩戒抽打

items.def_en: (+ at sb) To strike out violently at someone with or as if with a whip
to strike repeatedly with a flexible lash or strap as a punishment
to strike someone forcefully with a whip, cord, or sudden blow
(+ sb) To physically assault someone with repeated, severe punitive blows
to beat someone as judicial or formal punishment using a bundle of birch twigs

items.def_zh: 鞭笞，严刑拷打；（英，非正式）兜售，变卖
items.def_en: 1. to beat someone severely with a whip or stick as a punishment. 2. (informal, chiefly BrE) to sell something quickly or cheaply.

items.def_zh: 鞭笞，鞭打；使受苦难，折磨，蹂躏
items.def_en: 1. to whip someone severely as a punishment. 2. to cause great pain, suffering, or devastation to a place or people.

items.def_zh: 鞭打，痛打（在皮肤上打出红肿条痕）；给……加贴边
items.def_en: 1. to beat heavily, leaving raised red marks on the skin. 2. to sew a reinforcing strip (welt) onto a shoe or garment.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify administering severe physical blows to an individual's body using a whip, lash, or rod, causing welt marks, deep lacerations, or intense punitive suffering.
groups.summary_zh: 指用皮鞭、棍杖等严酷抽打肉体并留下伤痕的肉刑或暴行。

groups.name: Whittle & Chisel · 削制与凿刻 (Whittle, Chisel, Sculpt)
groups.tip: 运刀切削，雕琢材料成型

items.def_en: (+ at sth / + sth) to cut small pieces off wood or other solid material using a knife; gradually reduce by trimming
(+ sth) to carve or shape an object down to size by shaving away outer layers

items.def_zh: 削（木头），雕削；削减，逐渐减少
items.def_en: 1. (+ down/away) To carve wood gradually by cutting off thin shavings; to reduce a number, list, or cost steadily.
to cut away the outer surface or edges of something with a sharp knife
(+ sth) to cut, carve, or hollow out wood or stone with a chisel to form a shape
(+ sth) to carve, scoop, or dig out the interior of a solid material to make it empty
1. To cut or carve wood or stone using a chisel. 2. (informal) To cheat or swindle someone out of money.
to make a deep hole or groove in a surface using a sharp or curved tool

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote shaping, trimming, or carving solid materials (especially wood or stone) by using sharp hand tools in specific manual cutting motions.
groups.summary_zh: 使用手持刀凿工具对木、石等硬质材料进行削切塑造。

groups.name: Winter & Casual Travel Modes · 雪橇与便车出行 (Sleigh, Snowmobile, Hitchhike)
groups.tip: 搭车或驾驶载具出行

items.def_en: To travel aimlessly and casually from place to place without fixed plans
To travel along a route by getting free rides in passing vehicles
to travel across ice or snow on a runner-mounted sled
to drive or travel with a dog sled across snow
to travel or transport someone or something in a sleigh over snow.

items.def_zh: 骑雪地摩托，乘雪上机动车旅行
items.def_en: to travel or ride on a snowmobile.
to travel by asking passing drivers for free rides in their vehicles.
to coast down a snow-covered slope on a long, flat wooden toboggan

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe traversing snowy winter terrain via specialized sliding or tracked vehicles, or securing opportunistic passage by soliciting lifts along public roadways.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用冬季特种载具在雪地前行，或在公路招手搭顺风车出行。

groups.name: Withhold & Hold Back · 扣留与拒给 (Withhold, Retain, Keep Back)
groups.tip: 拒不给出或留在自己手中

items.def_en: to keep possession of something rather than returning or surrendering it
(+ obj) to refuse to give or reveal something, keeping it in reserve or secret
(+ obj) to withhold information, payment, or goods instead of delivering them
(+ sb) To refuse to give expected information, money, or goods to someone who is entitled to it

items.def_zh: 搁置压下，扣押（文件等）不发
items.def_en: (+ sth) To deliberately delay dealing with, releasing, or surrendering documents, funds, or news

items.def_zh: 扣留，保留，拒绝给予；隐瞒；克制
items.def_en: (+ from) To refuse to give, grant, or disclose something that is due, requested, or expected.

items.def_zh: 扣留，保留，拒绝给予（withhold的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of withhold; to have deliberately held back, refused to grant, or retained.
to seize and hold property or goods by official or legal authority

groups.summary_en: Refers to intentionally declining to give, surrender, or transfer money, documents, or information that is due, expected, or claimed by someone else. The emphasis is on active non-disclosure or refusal to release rather than mere passive ownership.
groups.summary_zh: 指蓄意扣留、拒绝移交或压下应给付的金钱、证物或信息。

groups.name: Wrap in Flexible Bands · 缠裹与襁褓包扎 (Swaddle, Swathe, Bandage)
groups.tip: 用织物层层包扎裹紧

items.def_zh: 用襁褓包裹（婴儿）；裹紧，束缚
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To wrap a newborn baby tightly in cloth or a blanket. 2. To wrap or bind something securely.
(+ sth) to tie or wrap bandages securely around an injury or body part
(+ sb) to wrap someone warmly and snugly in layers of clothing or blankets
(+ sb/sth) to cover or swaddle someone or something thoroughly in warm or protective cloth
to wrap or wind a band, rope, or cloth tightly around someone or something
to bind or wrap an injured part of the body with a strip of protective cloth
(+ in/with) to wrap someone or something up warmly, thickly, or protectively
1. (+ in) To wrap or bind someone or something completely in cloth, bandages, or other material. 2. To envelop or surround completely.

groups.summary_en: An agent winds long, supple strips of fabric, bandages, or soft coverings around a body or object in continuous overlapping layers. Manner distinctions contrast immobilizing infants in snug cloths (swaddle) against enveloping broadly in long wraps or winding shrouds (swathe) and winding medical dressings (bandage).
groups.summary_zh: 指用布帛、绷带等柔性材料对肢体或物体进行层层包裹缠扎。

groups.name: Write & Craft Literary Works · 写作与文艺创作 (Compose, Pen, Author)
groups.tip: 构思创作文艺谱写作品

items.def_zh: 撰写，著述（书籍、报告或方案）
items.def_en: to write or be the original creator of a book, report, or official document

items.def_zh: 起草，拟定（文稿、诗文初稿）
items.def_en: to prepare a preliminary version of a piece of writing or speech

items.def_zh: 执笔写下；创作（文章、信件、诗词）
items.def_en: to write or compose a literary piece, letter, or article by hand or with care

items.def_zh: 创作，谱写（乐曲、诗歌、信件等）；组成，构成；使平静
items.def_en: 1. to write or produce a piece of music, poetry, or text. 2. to make up or form something. 3. to calm oneself or one's feelings.

items.def_zh: 写诗，作诗，用诗表达；使精通（常用于 be versed in）
items.def_en: 1. to write poetry or express something in metrical verse. 2. (usually passive: 'be versed in') to be skilled or knowledgeable in a subject.
(+ sth) to compose a full, structured piece of writing based on notes or ideas
(+ sth) to write or compose a letter, poem, or literary piece quickly and with little effort

items.def_zh: 创作出，产出（大量文章或作品）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to produce a quantity of written, musical, or artistic work steadily

groups.summary_en: Refers to producing written literary, poetic, or musical works with conscious artistry and deliberate craft. Verbs range from general formal composition ('compose', 'author') to poetic or stylistic crafting ('verse', 'pen').
groups.summary_zh: 强调带有技巧与文学修养地撰写诗文、乐曲或著作。

groups.name: Acoustic Resonance & Lingering Echo · 声响回荡与共鸣 (Resonate, Resound, Reiterate)
groups.tip: 回响振荡在耳畔久久不绝

items.def_en: [I/T] to send back or repeat sound by reflection of sound waves
to produce a loud, clear sound that carries across a distance
to resound or reverberate back from a distant surface or across a space
of a sound, to remain audible across a distance or continue to reverberate

items.def_zh: 共振，产生共鸣；引起反响
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To produce or be filled with a deep, full, vibrating sound. 2. (+ with) To evoke an emotional response or shared feeling.
1. (+ with/through) To fill a place with sound or echo loudly. 2. To be widely celebrated, praised, or proclaimed.
(of a loud noise) to be repeated several times as an echo throughout a space

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deep, vibrating sounds echoing through a space, filling an area with persistent reverberation, or evoking a deeply felt parallel in memory or meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 深沉的声音在空间中回荡、充满振鸣，或在精神层面引发共鸣。

groups.name: Acoustic Tones: Buzz, Hum & Whistle · 嗡鸣与清鸣 (Hum, Buzz, Flute)
groups.tip: 蜜蜂振翅般的持续嗡叫

items.def_zh: 发出低沉单调的嗡嗡声
items.def_en: to make a continuous low monotonous sound, like an engine or bee
to continuously make a low vibrating humming sound

items.def_zh: 发嗡嗡声；忙碌，活跃；哼唱（曲调）
items.def_en: 1. To make a low, continuous vibrating sound. 2. To be full of busy activity. 3. To sing a tune with your lips closed.

items.def_zh: 发笛音，以清脆悦耳的声音说或唱；吹长笛；在……上刻凹槽
items.def_en: 1. To speak, sing, or make a sound in a high, clear, musical voice. 2. To play on a flute. 3. To carve decorative vertical grooves into a surface.
to make a continuous low, rapid whirring sound like revolving machinery

items.def_zh: 持续发出低沉的嗡嗡声
items.def_en: to make a continuous, low, monotonous humming or buzzing sound
to make a continuous rapid vibrating sound like a flying bee

groups.summary_en: An object, creature, or sound source generates a sustained, resonant acoustic tone—ranging from low continuous vibrations to sweet, flute-like or high vibrational notes.
groups.summary_zh: 物体或发声源产生持续、共鸣的声响，涵盖低频振动嗡鸣至清亮如笛的音调。

groups.name: Adjoin & Abut · 毗连与切近相接 (Adjoin, Abut)
groups.tip: 地界或空间紧紧相靠相连

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to share a boundary with an adjacent territory or property
to be located immediately next to or adjacent to another entity
(+ sth) to lie along or share a physical boundary with something
(+ sth) to touch along a border or be next to something directly
to be placed or situated at the side or flank of something
1. (formal) To be next to or share a boundary or wall with a room, building, or piece of land.
1. (+ on/against) (formal) To touch or share a boundary or edge with another property, structure, or area.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate spatial relations where physical bodies, lands, or buildings share a boundary, border, or touch directly alongside one another.
groups.summary_zh: 土地、建筑物等彼此接壤、毗邻或紧密接触相切。

groups.name: Advise & Counsel · 劝诫与深谋指引 (Counsel, Rede, Admonish)
groups.tip: 由日常提议上升为专业指导

items.def_en: (+ sth/doing sth) to give serious, authoritative advice to avoid a specific action or hazard

items.def_zh: 建议，劝告；提供心理咨询（或专业指导）
items.def_en: To give advice or guidance to someone, especially on personal or professional matters.
to warn or counsel someone firmly about their duty, conduct, or future action
(archaic) To give advice or counsel to someone; to explain or interpret.
(+ sb/sth) to strongly counsel someone not to do something or to be careful of danger
(+ to/with) to instruct or urge someone with formal responsibility or authority
to strongly urge or encourage someone to do something through moral appeal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve serious, weighty, or authoritative advice given in formal, moral, or archaic contexts, guiding conduct or warning against error.
groups.summary_zh: 指庄重、具道德约束力或权威深思的劝戒与指导。

groups.name: Advise & Recommend · 建议与推荐 (Recommend, Advise, Suggest)
groups.tip: 出于好意提出主意或对策

items.def_en: to put forward an idea, plan, or piece of advice for consideration
1. To advise or suggest a particular course of action. 2. To praise someone or something as being suitable for a particular job or purpose.
[I/T] to formally put forward a course of action for discussion and adoption

items.def_zh: 建议，劝告；给……出主意；通知
items.def_en: 1. To give advice or a recommendation to someone about what they should do. 2. (formal) To give someone official information or notice.
to recommend or advise something strongly with persistent emphasis
(+ sth/sb) to suggest an idea, proposal, or candidate for consideration
(+ sth/doing sth) to recommend that someone should not pursue a specific course of action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate offering opinions, proposals, or endorsements about the best course of action to another person.
groups.summary_zh: 指为他人提出合理化建议、方案或推荐适当人选。

groups.name: Aid & Empower · 优待与赋能 (Advantage, Enable, Empower)
groups.tip: 给予资源帮助创造有利条件

items.def_zh: 有利于，使处于有利地位；使获益
items.def_en: to put someone in a better, more favorable, or more successful position
to make an action or process possible or easier by removing obstacles
(+ sb/sth) to strengthen or empower someone or an organization to improve their capacity

items.def_zh: 为……创造有利条件；使具备条件
items.def_en: (+ sb) to provide someone with the resources, position, or advantage needed to succeed

items.raw_cluster: 使能够与促成 Enable & Empower
items.def_zh: 使能够，使有能力；使成为可能；激活，启用
items.def_en: 1. to give someone the ability, authority, or means to do something. 2. to make something possible. 3. to activate or turn on a system or feature

items.def_zh: 给予特权；使居有利地位
items.def_en: to grant special rights, systemic advantages, or immunity to someone or something

items.def_zh: 赋权；赋予自主权或能力
items.def_en: to give someone the official authority, confidence, or legal power to do something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing individuals or groups with favorable conditions, authority, or practical capacity to succeed. While 'enable' provides necessary means or capability, 'empower' grants institutional autonomy, and 'advantage' places someone in a privileged competitive position.
groups.summary_zh: 指为他人提供有利条件、资格或实际权能以助其成功。

groups.name: Align & Parallel Position · 精准平行对齐与贴置 (Collimate, Appose, Align)
groups.tip: 精确定位并对齐轴线

items.def_en: (+ sth) to adjust items or parts so that they are in a straight line or precise parallel alignment
to place things side by side in close physical proximity
(+ sth) to make edges, corners, or surfaces precisely straight, parallel, or at right angles

items.def_zh: 排列整齐，使成一行/一条直线
items.def_en: to arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative positions
to bring an object, wheel, or frame into accurate alignment, shape, or level

items.def_zh: 使并列，把……放在近处；使贴合
items.def_en: To place something side by side or next to another, or bring two surfaces into contact.

items.def_zh: 校准，准直；使（光线、粒子束等）平行
items.def_en: 1. To make rays of light or particles travel strictly parallel to each other. 2. To align the optical axis of an instrument accurately.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the spatial manipulation of physical parts, optical beams, or biological surfaces to bring them into parallel pathways, exact contact, or geometric correspondence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过几何或机械调节，使表面平行贴合、光束平行准直或构件位置精确对称。

groups.name: Analyze & Deconstruct · 分解与剖析 (Analyze, Deconstruct, Dissect)
groups.tip: 审视细节探求根由

items.def_zh: 分析，剖析；分解（物质成分）
items.def_en: 1. To examine something methodically and in detail in order to explain or interpret it. 2. (chemistry) To separate a substance into its constituent parts to determine its composition.
(+ into) to separate complex information or figures into smaller, more comprehensible units

items.def_zh: 挑剔剖析；逐项细拆分析
items.def_en: (+ sth) to examine or criticize a text, argument, or plan thoroughly piece by piece
(+ sth) to separate a complex structure, argument, or theory into its constituent elements
to examine, criticize, or analyze something piece by piece with minute precision
to analyze a sentence, string of code, or message into its component parts to grasp the exact meaning
to break down a concept, narrative, or text into basic parts to expose underlying assumptions

groups.summary_en: An analyst breaks down a complex problem, text, or dataset into its constituent elements to understand its underlying structure, logic, or meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 将复杂事物、文本或系统拆解为构成要素以深入理解其结构与机理。

groups.name: Apologize & Beg Pardon · 致歉与乞宥
groups.tip: 表示歉意、乞求原谅与宽恕

items.def_en: To forgive someone for a fault or minor mistake, or to justify an action.
(+ to/for) To tell someone that you are sorry for having done something wrong or causing trouble.
stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense or mistake

items.def_zh: 推托；请求免予责任或活动
items.def_en: to ask to be excused from an obligation, arrangement, or promise with an apology
(+ sth) to compensate or atone for an offense, fault, or omission
forgive or excuse a person for a mistake, breach of manners, or fault
(+ for) make amends or reparation for a wrong, transgression, or error

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey expressions of regret, contrition, or admitting an error, as well as the immediate transactional plea to release oneself or another from fault or offense.
groups.summary_zh: 表达悔意、承认过失以及请求他人宽恕或原谅的言语交际行为。

groups.name: Appoint & Delegate · 委任与指派 (Appoint, Delegate, Reassign, Subcontract)
groups.tip: 组织人事任命与业务层层转包

items.def_en: to formally choose someone to hold a particular position or perform an official task
(+ sth) to delegate or transfer decisions, responsibilities, or authority to a subordinate
(+ sth) to delegate, subcontract, or assign tasks or work to an external party
(+ sth to sb) to officially transfer legal ownership, rights, or authority to someone else by signing a document
[I/T] (+ to) to entrust a task, responsibility, or authority to another person

items.def_zh: 重新指派，重调（工作、职位等）；重新分配
items.def_en: To give someone a different job, role, or location, or to assign a task or resource to someone else.
To pay an outside person or organization to do part of a larger job that you have agreed to do.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this administrative frame describe delegating responsibilities, redistributing roles, or allocating tasks and portions of work downward or to third parties.
groups.summary_zh: 指在组织架构内委派职务、下放权力或将部分业务分包转移。

groups.name: Aver & Proclaim · 断言与宣告 (Authoritative Public Declaration)
groups.tip: 郑重断言并向公众公开宣告

items.def_en: (+ sth) to proclaim or state something publicly and officially
to state clearly, officially, and emphatically for the public record
to express an idea or doctrine clearly and authoritatively
to announce officially and publicly in a formal or ceremonial manner
to make known an official law, decree, or doctrine publicly and officially
1. (+ that) (formal / law) To state or assert firmly and positively that something is the case.
1. (formal / archaic) To announce, proclaim, or make known publicly or solemnly.

groups.summary_en: An authority or institutional speaker announces a definitive truth or formal finding categorically and solemnly. Nuances range from sworn evidential assertions to ceremonial public proclamations.
groups.summary_zh: 以庄重、权威或官方口吻作出的定论性宣告与明断。

groups.name: Bid & Offer · 竞标与出价 (Bid, Outbid, Underbid)
groups.tip: 在交易竞价中出资竞争

items.def_en: (+ for sth / + sth) submit a formal tender, offer, or bid for a contract or item
[I/T] (+ on/for) to offer a price for something, especially at an auction
[I/T] to submit an updated or secondary bid in an auction

items.def_zh: 出价低于（竞争对手）；竞标开价过低；（桥牌）叫牌过低
items.def_en: 1. To offer to do work or supply goods for a lower price than a competitor. 2. (bridge) To bid less than one's hand of cards justifies.
(+ sth) raise the price of an item at an auction by offering successive higher amounts
To offer to pay a higher price than another bidder or competitor, especially at an auction.
[I/T] to make a bid higher than the value of something or higher than intended

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail offering specific monetary amounts in an auction, tender, or contract setting, differentiating by bidding higher, lower, or beating a competitor's price.
groups.summary_zh: 指在拍卖或招投标中提出报价，尤指高于或低于对手价格的竞价方式。

groups.name: Bid & Outbid · 报价与叫牌竞争 (Lowball, Outcall, Outbid)
groups.tip: 拍卖交易中估价出价与压价

items.def_en: bid higher than the true value of an asset or beyond one's hand strength
(+ sth) aggressively force the acceptable price or offer to a lower level in negotiations
(+ with sth) put forward an initial offer or contributing sum in a competitive arrangement
offer a higher price than another bidder at an auction or sale

items.def_zh: 虚报低价，报极低价；给……极低的报价
items.def_en: (informal) To offer an intentionally or deceptively low estimate, bid, or price to someone in a negotiation.

items.def_zh: （桥牌或纸牌游戏中）叫牌胜过，出价高过
items.def_en: (card games) To make a higher bid than another player.

items.def_zh: 出价低于竞争对手（或叫牌偏低）
items.def_en: submit a lower bid than a competitor, or bid lower than justified in bridge

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent strategic communication in negotiations, bridge, or auctions, specifically offering, undercutting, or overcalling terms and prices.
groups.summary_zh: 在谈判、拍卖或牌局中出价、压低要价或以高叫牌压制对手。

groups.name: Bleed & Hemorrhage · 出血与流血 (Bleed, Hemorrhage)
groups.tip: 普通渗血到大出血的加剧

items.def_en: to slowly seep out through small tears or a cut in tiny amounts
slowly ooze or flow out through vascular tissue or a dressing
to flow or pass slowly through a bandage, tissue, or wound

items.def_zh: 流血，出血；榨取（钱财）；（颜料等）渗开
items.def_en: 1. to lose blood from the body, or cause someone to lose blood. 2. to extort money from someone. 3. to spread or run into an adjacent area (of dye or ink).

items.def_zh: 大出血，严重失血；（资金、人员等）巨额流失
items.def_en: 1. to bleed heavily and dangerously from a ruptured blood vessel. 2. to lose a large amount of money, personnel, or resources rapidly.
die or lose consciousness as a result of catastrophic, uncontrolled blood loss

items.def_zh: 放血，因大量失血而休克或致死
items.def_en: [I/T] to drain or lose all or most blood, causing death or near-death

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote losing blood internally or externally from damaged vascular tissue, escalating from minor weeping to catastrophic, uncontrollable blood loss (often extended to rapid loss of money or resources).
groups.summary_zh: 描述身体组织创伤性流血或失血，从微量渗血递增至大量喷涌与失控大出血。

groups.name: Breathe & Respiring · 呼吸与叹纳 (Inhale, Exhale, Respire)
groups.tip: 维持生命的自主呼吸与呼气

items.def_en: To draw air into the lungs
To expel air from the lungs
To emit a long, audible breath expressing relief, fatigue, or sadness
To draw air or vapor into the lungs
(formal/technical) To engage in the physiological process of respiration
To breathe out air or vapor from the lungs

items.def_zh: 呼吸，呼出；轻声低语，吐露
items.def_en: 1. To take air into the lungs and expel it again. 2. To whisper or say something very softly.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the vital respiratory mechanics of drawing air into the lungs and expelling it, as well as modifying airflow into deep sighs or barely audible breaths.
groups.summary_zh: 指肺部吸入与排出气体的生理机制，以及伴随情绪的深呼吸与叹息。

groups.name: Bribe & Suborn · 贿赂与收买 (Grease, Bribe, Suborn)
groups.tip: 以金钱利益腐蚀公职或证人

items.def_zh: 打点，塞钱疏通（尤指grease sb's palm）
items.def_en: (informal, esp. 'grease someone's palm') to covertly give money to an official to facilitate smooth processing
to give illegal hush money or kickbacks to someone to ensure silence or secure compliance
(+ sb) settle matters with someone, often illicitly or through covert financial satisfaction
to pay someone off in order to stop them from causing trouble, revealing secrets, or prosecuting

items.def_zh: 用金钱私下打通；收买摆平
items.def_en: (+ sb) arrange or improperly pacify an official or witness through illicit inducement
To illegally give money or gifts to someone, especially in authority, to persuade them to do something for you.

items.def_zh: 收买，唆使（某人做违法之事，尤指作伪证）
items.def_en: (formal / law) To secretly bribe or persuade someone to commit an unlawful act, especially to commit perjury in court.
