groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote corruptly inducing someone to act dishonestly, breach duty, or commit perjury using money, illicit favors, or covert payments, differentiated by stealth, formality, and illicit purpose.
groups.summary_zh: 通过金钱利益或不正当好处拉拢腐蚀他人，以诱使其违背公职职责或作伪证。

groups.name: Butcher & Core Meat/Carcass · 剥皮与剔膛 (Skin, Bone, Core)
groups.tip: 除去外表层或剥离内里

items.def_en: to remove the bones from a piece of meat or fish to produce boneless cuts
1. To remove the skin from an animal or fruit. 2. To injure the skin on a part of your body by scraping it.

items.def_zh: 去（水果等）的果心，掏出……的核心
items.def_en: To remove the core or seeds from fruit such as apples.
To remove the bones from meat or fish before cooking.
to extract and remove all internal skeletal bones from meat or poultry
to remove the stomach and internal organs from an animal or fish before cooking
to formally or surgically disembowel a body or carcass by removing all entrails

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve butchering or deeply hollowing an animal carcass or firm food item by removing anatomical structural elements such as hides, bones, or central fibrous cores.
groups.summary_zh: 指屠宰或食材预处理中剥除毛皮、剔除骨骼或挖去中心硬芯/内脏。

groups.name: Capture & Stage Production · 录影与补拍制作 (Record, Film, Reshoot)
groups.tip: 提前录下声音图像备用

items.def_en: [I/T] record moving pictures using a video camera or motion-picture equipment
record audio or video on magnetic tape or digital media
(+ sth) record a track, audio line, or foundational take in a production studio
(+ sth) record new audiovisual material over an existing recorded tape or take
record a performance, scene, or event onto videotape or video media

items.def_zh: 预先录制，预先录音（或录像）
items.def_en: To record sound, television programs, or other material in advance before broadcasting or using it.

items.def_zh: 重拍，补拍（电影镜头或照片）
items.def_en: To film a scene or photograph something again, often to improve or correct it.

groups.summary_en: This operational domain captures technical actions in audio-visual and film production pipelines where performances or scenes are captured, prepared in advance, or recaptured due to technical or narrative necessity.
groups.summary_zh: 影视与音频制作中对画面或声音进行的录制、预先准备或重新拍摄。

groups.name: Castrate & Sterilize · 绝育与去势 (Neuter, Geld, Spay)
groups.tip: 切除生殖器官以绝育或驯服

items.def_en: To castrate a male domestic fowl to improve the quality of its flesh

items.def_zh: 为（动物）做绝育手术；使失去效力（或力量）
items.def_en: 1. To surgically remove the reproductive organs of an animal so that it cannot produce offspring. 2. To make something harmless or ineffective.
To render an animal or human permanently incapable of producing offspring

items.def_zh: 阉割，给……去势；使丧失力量（或效果），削弱
items.def_en: 1. To remove the testicles of a male animal or person. 2. To deprive something of its power, vigor, or effectiveness.

items.def_zh: 阉割，给（雄性动物，尤指公马）去势；剥夺……的活力
items.def_en: To castrate a male animal, especially a horse; to deprive something of vitality or strength.

items.def_zh: 切除（雌性动物的）卵巢，为（雌性动物）做绝育手术
items.def_en: To surgically remove the ovaries of a female animal so that it cannot produce young.
To deprive a male animal or human of male reproductive organs

groups.summary_en: Veterinary and biological agents surgically remove or disable reproductive organs in animals or humans to eliminate fertility or suppress sex drive.
groups.summary_zh: 通过外科手术切除或灭活生殖腺，使机体丧失生育能力。

groups.name: Casual Party Circulation & Mixing · 穿梭应酬与随性社交 (Mingle, Socialize, Hobnob)
groups.tip: 在宴会社交圈中走动攀谈

items.def_en: associate or converse freely with others in a social gathering
spend time socializing casually and familiarly with others

items.def_zh: 在社交场合走动应酬，交际；（使）混合，融合
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) to move around and chat with people socially at an event. 2. (+ with) to mix or combine together.

items.def_zh: 社交，交际，联谊；使适应社会生活，使社会化
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) to spend time enjoying oneself socially with other people. 2. to train someone to behave in ways that are acceptable in their society.
(+ with) to meet and spend time with famous or important people in social contexts

items.def_zh: 亲热交际，与（名流等）过从甚密
items.def_en: (+ with) to mix socially, especially with people of higher social status
[I/T] (+ with) to talk informally with others, especially to gain an advantage or make connections

groups.summary_en: Characterizes the manner in which people move freely among others at a gathering, making small talk and building cordial ties. 'Socialize' is standard behavioral integration, 'mingle' highlights moving smoothly from group to group, and 'hobnob' implies familiar association with elite or influential figures.
groups.summary_zh: 在社交场合中周旋走动、与各方搭话应酬的动态姿态。

groups.name: Catalyze & Precipitate · 催化与加速促成 (Catalyze, Precipitate, Spark)
groups.tip: 充当催化剂以加速转变

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cause something to happen or bring a major change into being
to ignite or cause the sudden beginning of a process or reaction
to cause a process, development, or rate of change to happen faster
1. (chemistry) To speed up a chemical reaction by acting as a catalyst. 2. To cause an important event or change to happen or start.
(+ sth) to precipitate a sudden chain of events, a series of actions, or a crisis

items.def_zh: 诱发，触发（剧烈动荡或冲突）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to suddenly precipitate a violent, rapid, or dramatic reaction

items.def_zh: 陡然引致，加速促成（突发事件）
items.def_en: to make an event or crisis happen suddenly, unexpectedly, or prematurely

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to agents, events, or substances that cause an action, transformation, or reaction to happen much more rapidly without themselves being depleted. 'Catalyze' stresses structural or chemical-like acceleration of change, whereas 'precipitate' focuses on abruptly bringing about an outcome.
groups.summary_zh: 充当催化剂或引线，加速、激发某重大事态或转变的发生。

groups.name: Cavil & Petty Faultfinding · 吹毛求疵与琐屑挑剔 (Niggle, Nitpick, Cavil)
groups.tip: 吹毛求疵抓住无关痛痒微瑕挑刺

items.def_zh: 吹毛求疵，挑剔细节；使烦恼，纠缠
items.def_en: 1. (+ over/about) to criticize or argue about small, unimportant details. 2. to cause slight, persistent worry or irritation to someone.
(+ sb) repeatedly criticize someone about petty or insignificant matters
(+ sth) focus attention obsessively on small flaws or minor errors
(+ at/about) to make unnecessary complaints or petty criticisms about negligible points

items.def_zh: 吹毛求疵，挑剔微小的毛病
items.def_en: (+ over/about) to look for and criticize small, unimportant mistakes in something.

items.def_zh: 为细枝末节争拗，搬弄琐碎规条
items.def_en: to quibble over petty details or use shady, trivial tricks in an argument
(+ at/about) to complain continually about trivial matters in an annoying way

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the irritating manner of finding fault in microscopic, irrelevant particulars while ignoring substantial merit. Verbs differ in whether they emphasize irritating fussiness ('niggle'), obsessive inspection ('nitpick'), or frivolous argumentative objections ('cavil').
groups.summary_zh: 关注挑剔微不足道的细节瑕疵，小题大做地挑刺争拗。

groups.name: Celebrate & Revel · 欣喜与狂欢 (Rejoice, Revel, Carouse)
groups.tip: 举杯欢庆沉浸在极度喜悦中

items.def_en: to mark a happy event or milestone with enjoyable public or social festivities
to enjoy oneself socially by drinking, laughing, and celebrating cheerfully
continue celebrating or reveling rowdily
spend time enjoying oneself extravagantly and enthusiastically
1. (+ at/over/in) To feel or show great happiness about something.

items.def_zh: 狂欢作乐，纵情庆祝；陶醉于，沉醉于（revel in）
items.def_en: 1. To celebrate, dance, or drink in a noisy, lively way. 2. ('revel in') To get great pleasure, satisfaction, or delight from something.
to drink alcohol heavily, party loudly, and revel in a rowdy, uncontrolled manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark an escalation from internal, elevated happiness to loud, hedonistic public merrymaking and abandoned, rowdy partying.
groups.summary_zh: 指由心怀极大欢悦逐步升级为喧闹、放纵乃至醉饮的狂欢庆贺。

groups.name: Chaff & Heckle · 讥嘲与起哄 (Twit, Heckle, Chaff)
groups.tip: 用言辞挖苦、嘲笑或起哄

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) tease or mock someone in a playful or slightly mocking way
to poke fun at someone in a friendly, informal manner
1. (dated or informal) To tease, mock, or playfully reproach someone about a fault or mistake.
to tease someone in a lighthearted, good-natured way
to deliberately annoy someone by persistent petty teasing or critical prodding
(+ sb) silence or drown out a speaker by shouting or heckling loudly

items.def_zh: 起哄，喝倒彩，打断（演讲者等）；梳理（麻等）
items.def_en: 1. To interrupt a public speaker or performer with loud, aggressive, or mocking comments. 2. To dress or comb flax or hemp.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe teasing someone either through mild, nagging reminders of faults, persistent lighthearted ribbing, or disruptive public interruptions during an address.
groups.summary_zh: 以戏弄揭短、揶揄取笑或公开起哄打断的方式促狭质难。

groups.name: Cheat & Exploit · 侵吞与剥削 (Short, Profiteer, Gouge)
groups.tip: 短斤少两不法克扣

items.def_en: to give less change than is due, or to treat someone unfairly by withholding full value

items.def_zh: 克扣，少给（钱物或找零）；使短路；（金融）卖空，做空
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To cheat someone by giving them less than the full amount of money, goods, or change owed. 2. To cause or undergo an electrical short circuit. 3. (finance) To sell a security or commodity short.
(+ sb) cheat someone by charging them too much money for something
to deprive someone of money or property by fraud, extortion, or exorbitant fees

items.def_zh: 敲诈；哄抬价格漫天要价
items.def_en: to overcharge someone grossly, especially in a monopoly or emergency situation
(disapproving) To make an unfair or excessive profit, especially by charging exorbitant prices during a shortage, crisis, or war.
to take property or money from someone by deliberate deception or illegal artifice

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote illicitly withholding what is owed, making unfair commercial gains, or extracting exorbitant sums from vulnerable parties during transactions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过少给应付款项、哄抬价格或不正当交易手段侵吞利益与剥削他人。

groups.name: Chisel, Flake & Hew Material · 凿削与刻裂削打 (Hewn, Knap, Striate)
groups.tip: 砍削石木原料以雕琢成器

items.def_en: [I/T] to cut or break small fragments off the edge or surface of hard material
to cut or press a long, narrow furrow into a surface

items.def_zh: 使有条纹，加条痕（或沟槽）
items.def_en: to mark a surface with fine stripes, grooves, or parallel lines.
(+ at sth) gradually break small pieces off a hard material by striking it

items.def_zh: 敲琢（打制燧石等石器）；敲碎
items.def_en: to shape flint or stone into tools or building blocks by striking off flakes.
(+ sth) carve, shape, or cut something out of stone or timber by heavy cutting strokes
to shape or chop heavy wood or stone by forceful blows of an ax or chisel

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote rough-shaping, fracturing, or grooving rigid raw materials (such as stone, flint, or timber) by blunt-force chipping, cleaving, or scoring with fine parallel furrows.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过击打、劈凿或削划使石材木料成形或形成条纹肌理。

groups.name: Claim & Assert · 声称与坚持 (Allege, Claim, Insist, Assert)
groups.tip: 从单方断言到法理定罪性声称

items.def_en: to state that something is true, typically without providing proof

items.def_zh: 坚持（说法/声明），忠于原主张
items.def_en: (+ sth) maintain the truth or validity of an assertion without wavering
to continue to argue or insist that something is true against skepticism or opposition

items.def_zh: （未提出充分证据而）声称，断言，指控
items.def_en: To state that someone has done something wrong or illegal, especially without having yet proved it.
(+ sth) assert emphatically or solemnly that something is true

items.def_zh: 坚持说，硬说；坚决要求，坚持主张
items.def_en: 1. To state firmly and clearly that something is true, especially when others disagree. 2. (+ on) To demand that something happen, refusing to accept any opposition.
to state a fact or belief firmly, positively, and forcefully

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote stating that something is true, ranging from making formal unproven accusations to forceful, unyielding declarations of personal belief or fact.
groups.summary_zh: 指陈述某事属实，从无实据的指称逐步升级至坚定强硬的断言。

groups.name: Compile & Index · 汇编与编目索引 (Compile, Index)
groups.tip: 收集汇总资料编排成册

items.def_en: 1. To create an alphabetical index for a book, document, or collection. 2. To list or record something in an index.

items.def_zh: 汇编；整理汇集（资料、清单等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) assemble or compile information, documents, or data into a unified list or document

items.def_zh: 拟定；起草编制（清单、文件或表格）
items.def_en: (+ sth) prepare and write out a systematic list, document, or plan
1. To collect information from various sources and arrange it into a book, list, or report. 2. (computing) To translate source code into machine code.
to list, classify, and systematically describe items in a catalog

items.def_zh: 核对整理，校勘（各源数据）
items.def_en: to collect, compare, and assemble information or pages in their proper order
to arrange information, figures, or data into systematic columns and rows

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organizing, structuring, and systematizing collected information, documents, or data into comprehensive reference formats or searchable catalogs.
groups.summary_zh: 搜集并系统化编排信息成册、清单或检索目录。

groups.name: Confiscate & Expropriate by Authority · 官方征用与没收 (Confiscate, Seize, Impound)
groups.tip: 权威机构依法或强行充公

items.def_en: to take possession of property, contraband, or assets by official warrant or legal force
to officially take private property away from someone as a penalty or legal measure
to take legal custody of an object or vehicle until a fine is paid or case resolved

items.def_zh: 征用（战时或紧急官方调配）
items.def_en: to formally demand and take over supplies, buildings, or vehicles for official or military use

items.def_zh: 征用，强占（车辆、建筑物等用于军事或官方用途）
items.def_en: to officially take possession or control of private property, vehicles, or buildings, especially for military or emergency use

items.def_zh: 剥夺（财产、土地等），强夺；逐出
items.def_en: (formal) to deprive someone of land, property, or possessions

items.def_zh: 征用，没收（私有财产供公用）
items.def_en: (of a government or authority) to officially take away private property or land for public use

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an authority, government, military, or legal entity seizing private property, land, or resources, either for public/state use or as a punitive forfeiture.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或司法机构依职权征调、强制接管或没收私人财产。

groups.name: Connect & Relate in Mind · 关联与联想 (Associate, Relate, Link)
groups.tip: 将不同事物联系在一起

items.def_en: (+ to/with) to make, see, or state a connection between two things

items.def_zh: 使联系，把……联系起来；与……有关，涉及；叙述，讲述；理解并产生共鸣
items.def_en: 1. To show or make a connection between two or more things; (relate to) to be connected with. 2. To tell or narrate a story or facts. 3. (relate to) To understand and feel sympathy for someone.

items.def_zh: 把……联系在一起，联想；结合，结交，交往
items.def_en: 1. To connect someone or something in one's mind with someone or something else. 2. (associate with) To spend time with someone or have a relationship with them.
(+ with) to realize or show that a relationship exists between people or things

items.def_zh: 将……与……在脑海中联系起来
items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) mentally associate or link one idea, person, or thing with another
(+ sth) perceive or establish a conceptual or logical connection between things

items.def_zh: 相互关联，显示互相关系
items.def_en: [I/T] to bring into or have a mutual or reciprocal relationship

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote an agent mentally drawing a bridge or seeing an inherent relationship between two concepts, entities, or occurrences. 'Relate' points to identifying a logical connection, whereas 'associate' often operates via perceptual or imaginative connection.
groups.summary_zh: 在心智或逻辑上将两个或多个对象联系、联想在一起。

groups.name: Constitute & Compose · 构成与组成 (Make up, Comprise, Form)
groups.tip: 由部分组装成整体

items.def_zh: 由……组成，由……构成；在于，存在于
items.def_en: 1. (consist of) To be composed or formed of. 2. (consist in) To have something as an essential feature or basis.
to be made up of particular parts, or to constitute a whole

items.def_zh: 组成，构成（常用于被动 be composed of）
items.def_en: (chiefly passive) to be formed from specific elements, substances, or members
to combine together to form an entire group, amount, or whole
(+ sth) be formed from or composed of specified parts or elements
(+ sth) combine together to form or constitute a whole

items.def_zh: 构成，组成；被视为，算作；设立，任命
items.def_en: 1. To combine to form a whole; to make up. 2. To be equivalent to or considered as something. 3. To establish or appoint officially.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express mereological relationships where parts form a unified whole or a whole is composed of individual elements. Syntactic framing dictates whether parts serve as the subject (make up, form, constitute) or the whole serves as the subject (consist of, comprise).
groups.summary_zh: 表达部分与整体的构成关系，涵盖由部分组成整体或整体包含部分。

groups.name: Continuous Inundation & Heavy Fire · 炮火轰击与密集袭击 (Bombard, Barrage, Shell)
groups.tip: 炮火密集倾泻连番猛烈轰击

items.def_en: to fire heavy explosive shells at a fortress, city, or position continuously
(+ sb) attack someone forcefully and relentlessly with blows or harsh criticism

items.def_zh: 如雨点般倾泻于；密集猛烈袭击
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) fall upon or strike a target in an overwhelming, continuous shower of blows, fire, or criticism

items.def_zh: 以密集炮火轰击；连珠炮似地攻击（质问、投诉等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To attack heavily with an overwhelming burst of artillery fire or missiles. 2. (+ with) To bombard someone with a continuous stream of questions, criticisms, or complaints.

items.def_zh: 炮击，轰炸；连番轰炸（提问、投诉等）；用粒子轰击
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To attack a place continuously with bombs, shells, or missiles. 2. (+ with) To direct a relentless flood of questions, criticisms, or information at someone. 3. (physics) To direct high-energy particles at a substance.
to strike repeatedly with fists, missiles, or heavy blows
to attack or strike with sudden, intense, and destructive force, like a blitzkrieg

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe subjecting a target to an overwhelming, continuous assault—originally of artillery or ordnance, and metaphorically of questions, criticisms, or demands.
groups.summary_zh: 对目标施加持续、密集、高烈度的炮火打击或大量言论冲击。

groups.name: Continuous Rapid Fire & Bombardment · 扫射与猛烈轰击 (Strafe, Fusillade, Pepper)
groups.tip: 远程弹药齐射与扫射

items.def_en: to hit repeatedly with a shower of bullets, shrapnel, or missiles
to sweep the whole length of a target or area with gunfire

items.def_zh: 齐射，群射，并发；（球类运动）截击，凌空抽射
items.def_en: 1. To discharge or shoot a barrage of bullets, arrows, or words simultaneously or in rapid succession. 2. (sports) To hit or kick a moving ball before it touches the ground.
(+ sb/sth) suddenly unleash a continuous burst of heavy gunfire at a target
(+ sb/sth with sth) discharge a rapid, sweeping barrage of gunfire or pellets across an area or target

items.def_zh: 连续齐射；以连发炮火轰击
items.def_en: to attack or bombard with a rapid, continuous discharge of firearms

items.def_zh: （低空飞行飞机）用机枪扫射，猛烈轰击
items.def_en: To attack ground targets repeatedly with machine-gun fire or bombs from low-flying aircraft.

groups.summary_en: Combatants discharge a dense, continuous barrage of gunfire or artillery at an area or target, emphasizing volume and sweeping coverage rather than singular aim.
groups.summary_zh: 指密集连续地扫射、齐射或以重火力压制特定区域。

groups.name: Convene & Rally · 召集与集结 (Assemble, Convene, Rally)
groups.tip: 召集众人集合或开会

items.def_zh: 召集，集结；（使）重整旗鼓；（使）恢复
items.def_en: 1. To bring people together, or come together, in order to support a common cause or effort. 2. To recover strength, health, or value after an illness, decline, or difficulty.

items.def_zh: 召集；召聚（人们开会或商议）
items.def_en: (+ sb) summon people to assemble in one place for a collective purpose or meeting
(+ sb/sth) gather together scattered people or things into a single group
[I/T] to bring people together or come together in one place as a coordinated body
to officially and authoritatively order sb to attend or gather for a formal meeting
To come together, or to bring people together, for a formal meeting or gathering.
[I/T] to organize and encourage people to act together to achieve a specific political or civic goal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this governance and collective action frame describe authorities or leaders calling individuals together for a common purpose. 'Convene' denotes an official institutional summoning of delegates or boards, whereas 'rally' emphasizes mobilizing people into concerted political, military, or emotional support.
groups.summary_zh: 指权威机构或领袖为特定事务、议程或共同行动将众人召集到一起。

groups.name: Cooperate & Jointly Work · 合作与协作 (Cooperate, Collaborate, Team up)
groups.tip: 各方齐心协力完成目标

items.def_en: (+ with) To enter into an organized working alliance with another party
(+ with) To join together with another person or group to achieve a common goal
To work harmoniously with others, especially in a time of crisis or difficulty
combine efforts, manpower, or resources with someone else to achieve a common goal
join in cooperatively with others to help accomplish a task
To work together with someone else to achieve a common goal; to comply or assist.
1. (+ with/on) To work jointly with others on a shared project or goal. 2. (+ with) To cooperate traitorously with an enemy.

groups.summary_en: Parties work together toward a shared objective, pooling labor, resources, or intellectual effort. While 'cooperate' often highlights compliance or willingness to help, 'collaborate' stresses deep joint production, and phrasal forms like 'team up' indicate casual or strategic partnership.
groups.summary_zh: 强调双方或多方共同作业、分工协作以达成目标的互动行为。

groups.name: Coordinate Collective Enterprise · 筹划与工会化 (Organize, Plan, Unionize)
groups.tip: 组建工会联合众人

items.def_zh: 组织，筹办；组建（工会）；整理，使有条理
items.def_en: 1. To plan, arrange, or coordinate an event, activity, or system. 2. To form or encourage workers to join a trade union or group. 3. To put things into an orderly structure.
To bring the diverse elements of a complex activity or organization into harmonious efficiency

items.def_zh: 建立；创设（组织、机构或体系）
items.def_en: (+ sth) establish or organize an institution, committee, collective, or operational body

items.def_zh: 招揽入会；登记加入组织
items.def_en: enlist workers or members into an organized association, union, or collective body
To arrange or manipulate the elements of a situation to achieve a desired maximum effect

items.def_zh: 使制度化；建立正式机构
items.def_en: To establish into a structured, permanent social or legal organization
To organize workers into a trade union, or to become a member of a trade union.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on initiating, systematizing, and structuring social, civic, or labor institutions into functional collectives. Verbs differ between overall strategic program arrangement and legally organizing workers into collective bargaining units.
groups.summary_zh: 指筹办社会活动、协调事务系统或组织工人建立工会联合体。

groups.name: Cough & Sneeze · 咳嗽与喷嚏 (Cough, Sneeze, Hack)
groups.tip: 气道受刺激引发的排异反应

items.def_en: [I/T] to clear phlegm noisily from the throat

items.def_zh: 咳，咳嗽；咳出；（发动机等）发出爆震声
items.def_en: 1. to force air suddenly out of the lungs with a sharp, noisy sound. 2. (of an engine or machine) to make a sudden harsh, sputtering sound.
(+ sth) expel phlegm, mucus, or an object from the throat or lungs by coughing
to cough repeatedly in a harsh, dry, painful way
1. To suddenly expel air noisily through your nose and mouth because of dust, allergies, or a cold.

items.def_zh: 大声干咳着咳出（粘液等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) cough up phlegm or secretions harshly and noisily
to cough with a loud, convulsive gasping sound characteristic of pertussis

groups.summary_en: An agent involuntarily or deliberately expels air abruptly from the respiratory tract (throat, lungs, or nasal passages) to clear irritants. Verbs differentiate by acoustic harshness, respiratory origin, and physical strain.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过喉咙或鼻腔猛烈呼出气流以清除异物，涵盖轻咳、打喷嚏及剧烈干咳等生理反射动作。

groups.name: Cross & Traverse · 穿越与横跨 (Traverse, Crisscross, Jaywalk)
groups.tip: 从一端横跨穿行到另一端

items.def_en: [I/T] to go from one side of a road, river, or area to the other
to extend across or cross an expanse or obstacle

items.def_zh: 跨越到另一边；横过（马路等）
items.def_en: cross a road, border, or boundary from one side to the other
(+ sth) travel across or traverse an expanse, town, or area on the way to somewhere else
(formal) to travel across or over a large expanse or rough terrain

items.def_zh: 往来穿梭于；交叉往来；构成交叉图案
items.def_en: To travel back and forth repeatedly across an area; to form a pattern of intersecting lines across something.

items.def_zh: 乱穿马路；违章横穿街道
items.def_en: (chiefly North American) To cross a street carelessly or illegally without using an official crossing or following traffic signals.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving across an expanse, surface, or thoroughfare from one side to another, ranging from general spatial traversal to illicit street crossing.
groups.summary_zh: 指从一侧移动至另一侧横越路面、空间或水陆界线的动作。

groups.name: Culinary & Chemical Softening · 浸透、发泡与软化 (Macerate, Souse, Steep)
groups.tip: 液体充分浸湿乃至泡软

items.def_en: (+ sth) remain immersed in liquid to soften or infuse, or penetrate deeply into a substance

items.def_zh: 浸泡；沏泡（以析出汁液/香味）
items.def_en: [I/T] to soak in liquid in order to extract flavors, colors, or active principles
[I/T] to immerse meat, fish, or other food in a seasoned liquid before cooking

items.def_zh: 使浸润在（液体中）；浸泡提取
items.def_en: (+ sth) soak solid ingredients in liquid for a prolonged period to extract flavor or soften tissue
to preserve or marinate food by steeping it in brine or vinegar

items.def_zh: 浸泡，浸透；腌制（浸入盐水或醋中）；使烂醉
items.def_en: To plunge into liquid, soak, or drench thoroughly; to steep food in vinegar or brine.
To soften or break down a substance, especially food, by soaking it in a liquid.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote steeping solids in liquid over an extended period to soften them, break down tissue, or infuse them with flavor or preservatives (especially in culinary or chemical processing).
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过长时间浸泡使固体组织软化、出汁、腌透或溶解萃取。

groups.name: Cut Joint & Groove · 开槽与榫接 (Mortise, Rabbet, Dado)
groups.tip: 用利刃截断或开槽加工

items.def_en: to cut a long, narrow channel into a surface
to cut a step-shaped recess along the edge of a piece of wood
to cut a rectangular groove across the face of a board to fit another piece
to cut away a right-angled edge or corner to make a symmetrical sloping edge
To cut across or divide something transversely.

items.def_zh: 在（木材等上）凿榫眼，开榫槽；用榫接合
items.def_en: To cut a hole or slot into a piece of wood or stone to receive a tenon.

items.def_zh: 在……边缘开槽口；用槽口嵌接
items.def_en: To cut a step-shaped groove along the edge of a board so that another piece fits into it.

groups.summary_en: Specialized woodworking and craftsmanship verbs denoting the precise cutting, channeling, or grooving of material to form structural joints or cross-sections. Unlike rough chopping, these actions require calculated, measured toolwork.
groups.summary_zh: 指木工或工艺中精确开槽、打榫或横切构件的动作。

groups.name: Dare & Endanger · 涉险与冒险 (Attempt, Risk, Venture)
groups.tip: 甘冒风险放手一搏

items.def_en: to make an effort to do something, especially something difficult

items.def_zh: 冒……的危险，冒险做；使……面临风险
items.def_en: to put something in a situation where it could be lost or damaged; to do something knowing that bad consequences may occur
[I/T] to proceed or take an initiative despite substantial hazard or uncertainty
[I/T] (+ on/with) to risk money or something vital on a result in the hope of gain

items.def_zh: 冒险踏入；涉足（危险未知的领域）
items.def_en: (+ sth) proceed boldly or cautiously into a dangerous, unfamiliar, or hostile place or field

items.def_zh: 冒险亮出（脖子去犯险等）
items.def_en: (+ one's neck) deliberately take a substantial risk that exposes oneself to danger or criticism
to put something valuable at risk of being lost or destroyed; to dare to offer

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on choosing to undertake an action or journey in the face of potential danger, uncertainty, or failure. 'Attempt' merely denotes trying, while 'risk' foregrounds exposing an asset or life to loss, and 'venture' emphasizes stepping cautiously or boldly into perilous territory.
groups.summary_zh: 面临不测或危险时主动尝试、涉足或押上风险。

groups.name: Decontaminate & Clear Obstructions · 净化与疏通 (Purge, Decontaminate, Unclog)
groups.tip: 疏通管路并清除污染源

items.def_zh: 清理；清除（堵塞物或污物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) remove unwanted debris, contaminants, or blockages from a conduit or space

items.def_zh: 用水冲洗排出（脏物、残留物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) purge toxins, impurities, or sediment from a pipe or system by forcing liquid through it

items.def_zh: 清除；清洗（管道/容器杂质）
items.def_en: to rid a container, system, or area of undesirable substances or impurities
to clear an obstruction from a pipe, passage, or route
to cleanse something with a chemical agent to destroy harmful bacteria or viruses
to remove a blockage from a pipe, drain, or passage so that flow resumes freely

items.def_zh: 净化，清除……的污染（毒气、辐射等）
items.def_en: to remove dangerous chemicals, radiation, or germs from a person, area, or equipment

groups.summary_en: This technical sanitation/maintenance frame focuses on removing pollutants, toxins, or physical blockages from systems, spaces, or conduits to restore them to an uncompromised, flowing state.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过专业手段清除管道堵塞或消除系统、环境中的有毒污染物。

groups.name: Demand & Appropriate by Power · 强取与征用 (Exact, Requisition, Commandeer)
groups.tip: 凭权力强行征调物资

items.def_en: (+ sth) take something without permission or authority
(+ sth) take legal or forcible possession of property or goods

items.def_zh: 依法没收；征用（私有财产）
items.def_en: take away private property officially for public use, usually by a state or authority

items.def_zh: 勒索，强求；强索，迫使付出（代价）
items.def_en: To demand and obtain something forcefully or strictly; to inflict punishment or make someone pay a heavy price.
(especially military or official) To officially demand and take possession of property, supplies, or vehicles for public or military use.
officially take possession or control of something, especially for military or emergency use
(+ sth from sb) obtain money, information, or agreement from someone by using force, threats, or abuse of power

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an authority, government, or powerful entity forcibly taking, demanding, or commandeering property, payments, or compliance by right of power rather than consensual transaction. They typically govern direct objects representing resources, supplies, penalties, or concessions.
groups.summary_zh: 凭权威或强权强行征集物资、索取代价或强制夺取资产。

groups.name: Demote & Relegate · 贬黜与降级 (Subordinate, Demote, Relegate)
groups.tip: 降低官衔地位或降为从属

items.def_en: leave an important official job or position to take a lower rank or resign
(+ to/from) to move someone to a lower rank, position, or tier of seniority within an organisation
to strip an officer or official of their rank or honors as an official punishment

items.def_zh: 使处于次要地位，使从属于
items.def_en: To treat someone or something as less important than someone or something else; to place in a subordinate position.
(+ sb) force someone to leave a place, group, or position of influence

items.def_zh: 使降级，贬黜；把……降到次要地位；（使运动队）降级
items.def_en: To move someone or something to a lower rank or less important position; (in sports) to downgrade a team to a lower division.
(+ to/from) to send someone away from a royal court, capital, or sphere of power as a severe political expulsion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe organizational or hierarchical downward movement, where an individual or role is stripped of authority, rank, or prestige, moving from subtle subjugation to humiliating formal exile.
groups.summary_zh: 在组织架构或层级体系中逐级压制、剥夺权柄、降职贬黜或流放边缘。

groups.name: Descent & Plummet · 跌落与直坠 (Fall, Drop, Plummet)
groups.tip: 因重力向下坠落

items.def_en: fall or allow oneself to fall to a lower level or to the ground

items.def_zh: 落下，掉落，跌倒；减少，下降；倒塌，沦陷
items.def_en: 1. to drop down from a higher level towards the ground 2. to decrease in number, amount, or intensity
to descend slowly and steadily downwards through air, water, or ground
to fall or let something fall downward; to decrease or make something decrease in level or amount
to fall or dive quickly and with great force from a high level
fall or drop steeply and rapidly from a great height
to fall very rapidly and perpendicularly from a great height

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote downward vertical motion through space, ranging from gentle gradual lowering to sheer, catastrophic freefall.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在重力或下行动力作用下由高处落向低处，按垂直坠落剧烈度递增。

groups.name: Devalue & Downgrade · 价值与评级降低 (Devalue, Depreciate, Downgrade)
groups.tip: 等级地位下滑或资产价值缩水

items.def_en: to reduce the recorded book value of an asset because it is now worth less than formerly calculated

items.def_zh: 减价；给…评低分或降低评级
items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the official price, value, or assessment score of something
(+ sth) reduce the nominal value, scope, or financial scale of an asset or plan
(+ to) to reduce the formal rating, creditworthiness, or status of an organization or asset
to officially reduce the value of a country's currency relative to other currencies

items.def_zh: 表现不佳，业绩未达预期；（投资、股票等）运作差于大盘
items.def_en: to perform less well than expected, or worse than other people, companies, or financial assets

items.def_zh: （资产、货币等）（使）贬值，跌价；轻视，贬低
items.def_en: 1. to decrease in value over time, or to reduce the official value of a currency 2. to treat or represent something as having little value; to belittle

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame belong to economics and evaluation contexts, describing the lowering of an asset's market price, currency exchange rate, credit rating, or operational efficiency.
groups.summary_zh: 在经济与评估语境下，资产、货币、信用评级或性能在数值与等级上的下调或缩水。

groups.name: Dip to Submerge · 浸蘸至浸没 (Dip, Submerge, Immerse)
groups.tip: 从浅沾轻蘸到彻底浸入液体中

items.def_en: (+ sth) briefly place something into a liquid and lift it out
1. To put something briefly into a liquid and take it out again, or to briefly go underwater. 2. To lower or drop briefly, or to decrease slightly in level or amount.
to dip an object briefly into a liquid before quickly taking it out again
[I/T] to thrust or push someone or something quickly and forcefully down into liquid

items.def_zh: 使浸没，使浸入；使沉浸于，使全神贯注于
items.def_en: 1. To put someone or something completely under the surface of a liquid. 2. To involve someone deeply in an activity, interest, or feeling.

items.def_zh: 猛然浸入；彻底没入（水中）
items.def_en: (+ sth) push or immerse an object deeply and forcefully beneath the surface of a liquid
[I/T] to cause something to be completely underneath the surface of a liquid

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express placing an object into a liquid, graded by the physical extent of covering—from brief, partial immersion (dipping) to completely submerging the entire entity beneath the surface.
groups.summary_zh: 体现物体进入液体的深度与程度，从短暂局部沾浸到完全深潜浸没。

groups.name: Direct & Steer · 驾驶与掌舵领航 (Steer, Navigate, Pilot)
groups.tip: 掌控方向指引路线

items.def_en: to direct the movement, course, or direction of someone or something
to operate the controls of an aircraft or direct a ship through a hazardous passage
(+ sth) pilot or direct the course of a vehicle or vessel through a tricky passage
(+ sb/sth) navigate and direct the physical passage of someone or a vehicle through an area

items.def_zh: 驾驶，掌舵，操纵方向；引导，带领
items.def_en: 1. To control the direction in which a vehicle, boat, or aircraft moves. 2. To guide someone or something in a particular direction or towards a goal.

items.def_zh: 导航，确定路线；驾驶，航行；应对，妥善处理
items.def_en: 1. To plan and direct the route of a ship, aircraft, or vehicle; to find your way through an area. 2. To deal successfully with a difficult or complex situation.
to steer or steer a boat, ship, or organization as its helmsman

groups.summary_en: An operator guides the course, direction, or passage of a vehicle, vessel, or journey through terrain, water, or airspace. 'Steer' emphasizes physical mechanical deflection of direction, 'navigate' focuses on plotting and tracking a passage, and 'pilot' emphasizes expert hands-on guidance through difficult routes.
groups.summary_zh: 操控交通工具的方向或规划路线以安全通行。

groups.name: Direct Physical Exchange · 换物与易货 (Swap, Barter, Trade off)
groups.tip: 物物互通不经货币

items.def_en: (+ sth) substitute or exchange one physical item directly for another

items.def_zh: 以旧折价换新；折价换置
items.def_en: (+ sth) give a used item in part-exchange toward the acquisition of another
to exchange one thing for another as a compromise or direct bargain

items.def_zh: 交换，调换，以物易物；替换
items.def_en: to give something to someone in exchange for something else, or exchange places.
(+ with/over) to haggle or barter in a petty manner over terms or items

items.def_zh: 以物易物，交易（古旧或方言）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with) to barter or exchange goods without money

items.def_zh: 以物易物，物物交换；拿……进行交换
items.def_en: to exchange goods or services directly for other goods or services without using money.

groups.summary_en: Denotes the bilateral exchange of commodities or possessions without currency. 'Swap' highlights a quick, informal, one-for-one substitution, whereas 'barter' stresses the transactional negotiation of goods or services based on mutual valuation.
groups.summary_zh: 以货物、劳务直接互换资产，侧重无货币流通的以物易物。

groups.name: Discharge by Administrative/Military Action · 军政革职与解雇 (Cashier, Invalid, Drum Out)
groups.tip: 令其退役免职或开除公职

items.def_en: (+ of) to officially take away someone's rank, titles, or authority as a penalty

items.def_zh: 因伤残（病）令……退役；因病遣送退役
items.def_en: To discharge or remove someone (especially a member of the armed forces) from active service because of injury or illness.
(+ of) to dismiss someone from a military force or organization in official disgrace
(+ sb) dismiss or expel someone forcibly from a post, military unit, or institution

items.def_zh: 开除；驱除出机关或军伍
items.def_en: (+ sb) dismiss someone dishonorably or force them to leave an organization

items.def_zh: （军队中）革职，开除军籍；丢弃，罢免
items.def_en: To dismiss an officer from the armed forces in disgrace; to dismiss someone from an official position or discard something.
to officially remove a priest or cleric from religious office because of wrongdoing

groups.summary_en: An institution, armed force, or governing body terminates an individual's commission or service under specific administrative, medical, or disciplinary terms. Verbs highlight dishonorable expulsion, court-martial strip, or medical release.
groups.summary_zh: 因违纪、判决或伤残等特定行政/军事程序革职、除名或退伍。

groups.name: Discolor & Tint · 变色与着色 (Tinge, Stain, Tan)
groups.tip: 色泽发生褪变或被人工染上颜色

items.def_en: (+ with sth) to turn yellow over time due to age, exposure, or smoke
To become purple in color, or to make something purple.
1. To become brown, or to make someone's skin brown, from exposure to the sun. 2. To convert animal hide into leather.
to impart a slight trace of color, shade, or hue to sth

items.def_zh: （使）表面烤成褐色；（阳光或热度使）晒黑或枯黄
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make or become brown, especially from exposure to heat, sunlight, or drying
[I/T] to change or cause sth to change color in an abnormal, spoiled, or faded way
[I/T] to become red or make sth red (through sun, blood rush, or dye)

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify altering an object's surface color, either through natural physiological/solar processes ('tan'), chemical/biological pigment changes ('purple'), or accidental discoloration. Distinctions turn on whether the hue shift is intentional, weather-driven, or an applied stain.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体表面因光照、化学反应或外物渗透而改变自身固有色泽。

groups.name: Disentangle & Separate Strands · 理顺与解结 (Untangle, Unravel, Disentangle)
groups.tip: 理顺解开打结缠线

items.def_en: (+ sth) to untangle or arrange tangled things into an orderly state
to undo stitches or woven threads carefully one by one
(+ sth) to separate tangled strands, fibers, or hairs carefully and patiently

items.def_zh: 解开，理顺（缠结之物）；澄清，理清（混乱局势）
items.def_en: To separate knotted or twisted threads, wires, or hair; to sort out and clarify a complicated situation or problem.

items.def_zh: 拆散，解开（织物等）；使纠缠，使混乱；（纤维或编织物）散开
items.def_en: 1. To separate something into loose threads; to untangle or become unraveled. 2. To tangle, complicate, or become confused.
(+ from) to separate things that have become knotted, twisted, or confused together
to free something from tangled, snarled knots or messy snarls

groups.summary_en: An agent separates snarled, knotted, or intertwined threads, cables, or figurative complications into orderly individual strands. Verbs differ in whether the manner is patient manual clearing, loosening, or pulling apart.
groups.summary_zh: 耐心地将缠绕打结的绳线、线团或混乱乱局逐步解开理顺。

groups.name: Dry-Heat Cooking · 烘焙与干烤 (Bake, Roast, Toast)
groups.tip: 用炉火或烤箱将生食材制熟

items.def_zh: （经烘烤等干热使其）变脆；烘脆
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make or become pleasantly crisp through dry baking or roasting
[T/I] to make bread or other food brown and crisp by exposing it to direct dry radiant heat
(+ sth) to finish cooking or thoroughly bake prepared raw dough or pastries

items.def_zh: 烘焙，烤制（面包、糕点等）；（使）受暴晒，烤热
items.def_en: 1. To cook food, especially bread, cakes, or pies, by dry heat in an oven. 2. To become or make something extremely warm or dry through intense heat.

items.def_zh: （在烤箱或明火上）烤，炙烤，烘焙（肉、豆等）；戏谑批评，公开嘲弄
items.def_en: 1. To cook meat, vegetables, or nuts using dry heat in an oven or over an open fire. 2. (informal) To criticize severely, or playfully tease and mock someone.
to roast grain, corn, or peas slightly by dry heat without adding fat
[T/I] to blacken or scorch the exterior surface of food with intense dry heat

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cooking food through enclosed dry heat (such as an oven or dry radiant heat), differentiated by food type and whether open air or browning is involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用烤箱内或干热辐射加热食物的烹饪方式，依食材结构与烘炙手法区分。

groups.name: Emit Light & Shed Glow · 照亮与发光 (Lighten, Brighten, Illuminate)
groups.tip: 驱散黑暗，使视野豁然开朗

items.def_zh: （使）变亮，照亮；（使）变轻，缓解，减轻
items.def_en: 1. To become brighter, or to make something brighter or lighter in color. 2. To become or make less heavy, serious, or anxious.

items.def_zh: （使）变亮，照亮；（使）快活起来，（使）充满希望
items.def_en: 1. To become brighter, or to make something brighter. 2. To become or make happier, more cheerful, or hopeful.
(of the sun or a light source) to shine brightly and intensely downward
[T/I] to make an area or object suddenly bright with light
to emit a bright, clear, and steady beam of light
to light up a place or subject with focused or artistic artificial light
to illuminate something intensely with beams of bright radiant light

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey rendering an area visibly clearer or casting light upon it, contrasting gradual lightening of color/darkness with active illumination and radiance.
groups.summary_zh: 通过投射光线消除黑暗、照亮空间或使表面变得通明光亮的形态动作。

groups.name: Enclose in Rigid Coverings · 套装与鞘封 (Sheathe, Incase, Envelop)
groups.tip: 外壳套入密实包裹

items.def_en: to enclose or contain a mechanism or component within a protective frame or housing
(+ sth) to put items into a rigid box or crate for protection or storage
(+ sth) to pack goods into large rigid wooden crates for safe transport
to cover or enclose an object with an outer protective jacket or casing
to enclose or cover something completely in a case, close-fitting mold, or hard layer

items.def_zh: 把……装入箱（或套、壳）内，包住
items.def_en: 1. (variant spelling of encase) To enclose or cover completely within a protective case or covering.

items.def_zh: 插入鞘中；覆盖，包裹（以起保护作用）
items.def_en: 1. To put a sword, knife, or other weapon into its sheath. 2. (+ in/with) To cover or encase something in a protective outer layer.

groups.summary_en: An agent fits an object snugly inside a dedicated protective cover, rigid housing, or tight sheath. The manner of action varies from inserting a blade or wire into a form-fitting sheath (sheathe) to packing firmly within a rigid frame or protective crate (incase/encase) or embedding tightly in a protective jacket.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体严密装入定制硬质护套、外壳或紧密保护层中。

groups.name: Encompass & Subsume · 包含与涵括 (Include, Comprise, Embrace)
groups.tip: 全面包罗并广泛囊括

items.def_en: to contain someone or something as part of a whole or group
(+ sth) to include or encompass a range of things or concepts within a scope

items.def_zh: 包含，涵盖；欣然接受；拥抱
items.def_en: 1. To include or contain something as a part. 2. To accept an idea, belief, or change eagerly. 3. To hold someone closely in your arms.
1. To consist of or be made up of. 2. To form or make up something.
to include a wide range of ideas, subjects, or items comprehensively
(+ sth into sth) to integrate or subsume an entity, unit, or concept into a larger whole

items.def_zh: 归入；把……纳入更高级别范畴
items.def_en: to incorporate a lesser rule, element, or idea into a broader, comprehensive category

groups.summary_en: A collective whole, concept, or domain includes constituent elements or broad categories within its scope. Intensity measures the comprehensiveness and scope of inclusion, progressing from basic constituent containment (comprise) to wide-ranging thematic incorporation (embrace, encompass) and all-inclusive totalization (subsume).
groups.summary_zh: 指整体、体系或范畴在广度与深度上容纳、包含各组成部分。

groups.name: Enhance & Infuse Taste · 增香与赋味 (Flavor, Infuse, Spice)
groups.tip: 加入调料以丰富风味与口感

items.def_en: to add salt, herbs, or spices to food to enhance its natural taste
to give a particular taste or flavor to food or drink
to steep herbs or flavorings in a liquid so that the flavor is absorbed
to flavor something by adding finely grated citrus peel
(+ sth) to make food or drink tastier or more pungent by adding zest or spices

items.def_zh: 加香料使（食物）更辛香可口
items.def_en: (+ sth) to add spices or seasonings to food or drink to make it more flavorful
to flavor something with aromatic, piquant spices

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify modifying the sensory profile of food or drink by imparting, infusing, or steeping aromatic and sapid qualities into it. Nuances depend on the specific aromatic medium (herbs, spices, spirits) and the culinary method of flavor transfer.
groups.summary_zh: 通过添加香料或浸泡调配食物饮品的风味与香气。

groups.name: Evaluate & Appraise · 专业核估与鉴定 (Technical Valuation and Compositional Testing)
groups.tip: 专业考量与定性定价

items.def_en: to inspect and assess the structural condition and value of real estate or land
(+ sth) To calculate, evaluate, or assign an estimated monetary value or cost to goods, jobs, or assets
(+ sb/sth) To inspect or investigate someone or something carefully to verify truth, authenticity, or standard

items.def_zh: 化验，分析（矿石或金属成分）；评定，鉴定；尝试
items.def_en: 1. To test or analyze a substance, especially metal or ore, to determine its purity or composition. 2. (formal) To assess, evaluate, or analyze someone or something.
to formally test and prove that an artwork, manuscript, or antique is genuine

items.def_zh: 评定，鉴定，估价；评价，考查
items.def_en: To assess the value, quality, nature, or performance of someone or something, especially officially.
to determine the concentration or purity of a dissolved substance using volumetric analysis

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame specifies professional or expert evaluation of tangible property, ores, or legal/financial assets to determine monetary worth, authenticity, or chemical composition.
groups.summary_zh: 由专业人士对贵金属、不动产或文物进行的化验分析、成色测试与估价。

groups.name: Exist & Subsist · 存在与生存 (State of Being / Foundational Existence)
groups.tip: 客观存在或处在某种状态

items.def_en: to have actual being or reality in the world
(+ in) to exist permanently as an essential constituent or characteristic attribute
To continue surviving or persisting over time, or to subsist using a specific means of support
To manage to subsist or live with just enough resources or money
to be the fundamental basis, cause, or deep structural root beneath sth

items.def_zh: 共存，同时存在；和平共处
items.def_en: To exist together at the same time or in the same place, especially peacefully despite differences.
(+ on) to manage to stay alive or continue to exist, often with minimal resources

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the continuous state of being, living, persisting, or serving as an ontological or structural basis for something else.
groups.summary_zh: 描述事物的客观存在、勉强维生或充当底层根基的状态与维系。

groups.name: Experience & Endure Process · 经受与经历 (Undergo, Experience)
groups.tip: 亲身体验或承受变化

items.def_en: to encounter or undergo a particular event, feeling, or change
to experience a difficult, unpleasant, or complex period or process

items.def_zh: 经历（艰难困苦）并活过来
items.def_en: (+ sth) To experience an ordeal, catastrophe, or historical hardship and survive it
(+ sth) To undergo or experience a particular transitional phase, state, or transformative process
to experience and bear pain, hardship, or prolonged stress without giving in

items.def_zh: 经历，经受，承受（变化、痛苦等）
items.def_en: 1. To experience or endure a difficult process, surgery, or significant change.

items.def_zh: 经历，经受（undergo 的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of undergo; to experience or endure a difficult process, surgery, or change.

groups.summary_en: These transitive verbs denote passing through an extended process, transformation, hardship, or medical procedure. 'Undergo' specifically implies submitting to or enduring a structured, often involuntary or taxing ordeal, whereas other members cover passing through transformative experiences.
groups.summary_zh: 指身心经受变化、手术、考验等往往不可避免的历程。

groups.name: Exult & Glory · 欢欣与扬扬得意 (Joy, Glory, Exult)
groups.tip: 因喜事而心花怒放并载歌载舞

items.def_en: 1. (literary) To feel or express great happiness or joy. 2. To give joy to; to make glad.

items.def_zh: 自豪，洋洋得意，为……自鸣得意（glory in）
items.def_en: 1. ('glory in') To take great pride, pleasure, or satisfaction in something.
to express or feel joyful exuberance and triumphant celebration
(+ sth) To take intense pride, triumph, or joyful elation in an achievement or victory

items.def_zh: 幸灾乐祸；扬扬得意地夸耀
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To gloat or express triumphant joy loudly over someone's defeat or one's own success

items.def_zh: 感到胜利的喜悦；欢庆胜利
items.def_en: (+ over) to rejoice or exult insolently or passionately over a success or conquered rival
(+ in/at) to show and feel great joy, happiness, or jubilation, especially because of a triumph

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote experiencing or manifesting triumphant spiritual or emotional elation, typically taking intense personal satisfaction in a great victory, blessing, or accomplishment.
groups.summary_zh: 指因胜利、成就或幸事而感到由衷的极大欢欣或洋洋自得。

groups.name: Facial & Vocal Mirth · 各种笑声 (Chuckle, Giggle, Snicker)
groups.tip: 从轻声咯咯笑到开怀大笑

items.def_en: Laugh lightly and repeatedly in a silly, nervous, or childish way
Laugh quietly or inwardly, often conveying private amusement or mild satisfaction
To make sounds and movements of the face expressing amusement, pleasure, or mockery; to say or utter while laughing.
Give a smothered, half-suppressed laugh, often showing disrespect, contempt, or malice
Laugh in a harsh, shrill, broken manner reminiscent of a hen
Suddenly and uncontrollably start laughing out loud
Laugh loudly, boisterously, and heartily, often in an uninhibited manner

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the varied acoustic and expressive ways humans voice mirth, amusement, or mockery, ranging from quiet suppressed snickers to helpless hysterical laughter.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖表达欢愉、打趣、窃笑或嘲讽的各种笑声与面部发笑方式。

groups.name: Facial Expressions of Smiling · 微笑与假笑神态 (Smile, Smirk, Simper)
groups.tip: 轻笑假笑与咧嘴大笑的神态

items.def_zh: 傻笑，做作地笑，假笑；做作地笑着说
items.def_en: To smile in a silly, self-conscious, or overly sweet and unnatural way.
(+ sb/sth) To direct a benevolent, warm, or favorable facial expression of smiling toward someone
To form one's features into an expression of pleasure, amusement, or kindness, with the corners of the mouth turned up.
To smile in a smug, self-satisfied, or unkind way.
(+ sb/sth) To make an affected, smug, or insolently amused facial expression at someone
(+ at) to curl the lip in a mocking, scornful, or contemptuous facial expression
(+ at/with) to smile radiantly and broadly, expressing deep happiness or pride

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe facial configurations of smiling without prominent loud vocalization, distinguishing genuine warmth from smug, condescending, or affected expressions.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重于无声或微声的面部笑态，细分真诚笑意与得逞、造作之态。

groups.name: Fail & Collapse · 受挫与瓦解 (Misfire, Stumble, Founder, Collapse)
groups.tip: 计划或状态受挫瓦解

items.def_en: to lose strength or momentum, or begin to fail in an enterprise
fail or cease to function effectively, especially negotiations or relationships
fail to happen or be completed successfully, especially of a plan, deal, or negotiation

items.def_zh: （计划、言行等）失败，未达到预期效果；（枪炮）哑火；（引擎）失火，不点火
items.def_en: 1. (of a plan, joke, or scheme) To fail to achieve the desired result or have the opposite effect. 2. (of a gun or engine) To fail to fire or ignite properly.
break down completely or disintegrate into failure

items.def_zh: （计划、事业等）失败，破产，崩溃；（船）沉没；（马等）绊倒
items.def_en: 1. (of a plan, project, or business) To fail completely or break down. 2. (of a ship) To fill with water and sink. 3. (of a horse) To stumble and fall.
to fail completely and suddenly, as an organization, system, or plan

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive breakdown of an enterprise, plan, or negotiation, from an initial hitch or failure to gain traction to complete structural ruin.
groups.summary_zh: 指计划、事业或谈判由局部失灵逐步演变为全面停滞乃至土崩瓦解。

groups.name: Feed & Nourish · 哺乳与哺育 (Breastfeed, Suckle, Nurse)
groups.tip: 母亲或母兽哺乳滋养幼崽

items.def_en: [I/T] to feed a baby with milk from the breast, or to drink milk from a mother's breast
to feed a baby using a feeding bottle rather than the breast
(+ sb/sth) to gradually cause a baby or young animal to stop drinking mother's milk and take other nourishment
to fasten onto the mother's nipple properly in order to feed
1. When a mother breastfeeds a baby, she feeds it milk directly from her breast.
(+ off/from) to cause a baby or young animal to stop feeding on its mother's milk

items.def_zh: 哺乳，给……喂奶；吃奶，吮吸母乳
items.def_en: 1. When a mother animal or woman suckles her young, she feeds them milk from her breast or udder; when young animals or babies suckle, they drink milk from the breast or udder.

groups.summary_en: A mother or caregiver gives milk or food to an infant, or the infant draws milk from the mother's breast. Verbs capture both the maternal provision and the dependent offspring's ingestion.
groups.summary_zh: 母亲或看护者喂哺婴儿乳汁，或幼崽吸吮母乳，覆盖哺乳、喂奶与抚育全过程。

groups.name: Fitted Coverings & Structural Sheltering · 盖覆与遮蔽 (Cowl, Thatch, Canopy)
groups.tip: 加盖或设棚以挡风遮雨

items.def_en: to cover or fit something with a protective hood or casing

items.def_zh: 用木板封闭；用木板遮挡
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cover windows, doors, or openings with wooden boards for protection or shelter
(+ sth) to fasten or secure a protective waterproof sheet over equipment or structures

items.def_zh: 为……加装顶篷；覆以天篷般遮盖
items.def_en: to cover or shelter something with or as if with a canopy
to cover or envelop so as to conceal or protect from exposure
To cover the roof of a building with dried straw, reeds, or palm leaves.

items.def_zh: 用罩遮盖，为……装上烟囱罩（或发动机罩）
items.def_en: To cover an engine, chimney, or head with a protective hood or cowl.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this construction and craft scenario describe installing specific structural coverings, hoods, or traditional roofing onto surfaces or equipment to protect them from weather or hazards.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过加装特定防护罩、顶棚或茅草屋顶等实施遮蔽与防护。

groups.name: Fork & Bifurcate · 分叉与分流 (Fork, Bifurcate, Diverge)
groups.tip: 物理或路径上的分离分叉

items.def_en: (+ from) to leave the main path, line, or highway to form a subsidiary route
to spread out from a single point into several directions like a fan
to separate or diverge from the main body, path, or route

items.def_zh: 分叉，分流；走岔路；用叉子叉起（或翻起）
items.def_en: 1. To divide into two separate parts or branches, as a road or river. 2. To lift, dig, or move something using a fork.
(+ from) to separate and go in different directions from the same starting point
(formal) To divide or split into two separate branches or forks.
[I/T] to divide or be divided into three separate branches or prongs

groups.summary_en: Entities such as roads, rivers, branches, or paths split from a single origin into two or more distinct branching directions without external manual intervention.
groups.summary_zh: 道路、河流、解剖脉管等事物从主线顺势分生出两条或多条岔流与分枝。

groups.name: Greet & Salute · 问候与致意 (Greet, Welcome, Salute)
groups.tip: 社交礼节与举杯祝愿

items.def_en: to greet someone who has arrived with pleasure and hospitality

items.def_zh: 挥手示意（某人）过来问候
items.def_en: (+ sb) greet someone by gesturing with one's hand to invite them to come closer
(+ sb) welcome and guide someone into a place or gathering
1. To welcome someone with friendly words or gestures upon meeting them. 2. (of sounds or sights) To be immediately noticed by someone upon entering a place.

items.def_zh: 高声呼唤致意，欢呼迎候
items.def_en: to call out to attract someone's attention or greet enthusiastically from a distance

items.def_zh: 为……举杯敬酒；烤，烘（面包等）
items.def_en: 1. To raise a glass and drink in honor of someone's health, happiness, or success. 2. To brown bread or other food by exposing it to heat.
to show formal respect by a standardized gesture or public ceremony

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe acknowledging or welcoming someone upon arrival or encounter, ranging from basic polite greetings to celebratory drinking and formal military or ceremonial salutes.
groups.summary_zh: 指在会面或特定仪式场合向他人致意、问候、欢迎或举杯庆祝。

groups.name: Harvest & Extract Yield · 采收与收获 (Harvest, Reap, Gather)
groups.tip: 在自然或田间采敛资源

items.def_en: (+ sth) collect and store a harvest or yield

items.def_zh: 采珍珠，捕珠；凝结成珠状
items.def_en: 1. To fish for or gather pearls from oysters in the ocean. 2. To form into or adorn with pearl-like drops.

items.def_zh: 拾落穗；捡拾剩余农作物
items.def_en: [I/T] to gather leftover grain or produce after the main crop has been harvested
(+ sth) harvest crops and gather them into storage

items.def_zh: 收割，收获；采集，采集资源
items.def_en: To gather a crop, natural resource, or organs for medical use.
[I/T] to cut down and gather a crop (especially grain) at maturity

items.def_zh: 打捞，拖网捞取（水底牡蛎或贝类等）
items.def_en: [I/T] to bring up shellfish, mud, or specimens from the seabed using a dredge

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the productive extraction and gathering of mature natural resources, crops, or marine commodities from their native environments for human consumption and trade.
groups.summary_zh: 指对成熟农作物、天然物产或水产的大规模采收与收割。

groups.name: Hinder & Impede · 妨碍与阻碍 (Hinder, Impede, Inhibit, Disadvantage)
groups.tip: 阻扰行动使进程停滞受阻

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) prevent someone or something from making progress or advancing
(+ sb/sth) obstruct or prevent the progress or success of someone or something
(+ sb/sth) cause someone or something to become stuck or slow down significantly in progress

items.def_zh: 使处于不利地位，妨碍，损害
items.def_en: (often passive) To put someone in an unfavorable position that reduces their chances of success.

items.def_zh: 阻碍，抑制，阻止；使拘束，使难为情
items.def_en: 1. To prevent something from growing or developing freely, or to slow down a process. 2. To make someone feel too self-conscious or nervous to act naturally.
to make it difficult for someone to do something or for something to develop
to delay or obstruct the progress or movement of something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to interfering with an entity's progress, competitive parity, or freedom of operation, making development or success more difficult.
groups.summary_zh: 指给某方设置障碍、削弱其竞争地位或制约其正常运作与进程。

groups.name: Hold Sovereign Office · 登位与君临 (Reign, Throne)
groups.tip: 手握大权掌管天下

items.def_en: to exercise ultimate political power and administrative control over a realm
to conduct the policy, actions, and affairs of a state

items.def_zh: 称霸，称王，称帝；居支配地位，主导
items.def_en: 1. To rule a country as a monarch. 2. To be the predominant feature, quality, or condition of a situation.

items.def_zh: 使登王位，拥立为君；登位，执政
items.def_en: 1. To place someone on a royal throne; to invest with sovereign power. 2. To sit on or occupy a throne as a ruler.
(+ sb/sth) rule as monarch over a country, realm, or people
(+ sth) exercise supreme authority, governance, or sovereign control over an era or realm
to formally install a monarch or high dignitary upon a ceremonial throne

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers the constitutional and ceremonial exercise of royal or sovereign power. 'Throne' refers to the investiture or seating of a monarch, while 'reign' emphasizes holding the sovereign title or tenure over a kingdom.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及君主即位、在位与行使国家元首名分之统治场景。

groups.name: Hunt by Method/Quarry · 凭特定方式/猎物狩猎 (Falcon, Rabbit, Ferret)
groups.tip: 如猎犬般疾速奔跑追逐

items.def_en: 1. To hunt rabbits. 2. (rabbit on) (British informal) To talk incessantly and tiresomely about trivial matters.
to hunt with ferrets, especially rabbits driven from burrows
to hunt, catch, or shoot wild birds

items.def_zh: 用雪貂驱出；搜寻出猎物
items.def_en: (+ sth) drive quarry out of a burrow or hiding place, especially using ferrets
to hunt game with a trained hawk or falcon
To hunt wild animals or birds using a trained falcon.
(+ sb/sth) search for and catch or kill quarry through persistent tracking

groups.summary_en: A hunter pursues game using specialized animal aides (hawks, ferrets, dogs) or specifically targets a characteristic quarry. Verbs are denominal and capture traditional, highly specific hunting disciplines.
groups.summary_zh: 借助特种动物（鹰隼、猎貂）或针对特定猎物进行的专门化狩猎动作。

groups.name: Identify by Marking Pigment · 涂染标记与色标 (Raddle, Ruddle, Brand)
groups.tip: 抹上红赭颜料涂染上色

items.def_en: (+ sth) mark lines or boundaries on a surface using chalk
(+ sth) indicate boundaries or distinct parts using lines or pigment markers
to rub, mark, or distinguish a surface or livestock by drawing with chalk

items.def_zh: 用红赭石在（羊等）身上打标
items.def_en: to mark sheep with ruddle or red chalk for ownership identification

items.def_zh: 用红赭石（红颜料）做标记；涂浓妆，涂胭脂；编织（树枝等）
items.def_en: 1. To mark sheep or other animals with red ochre dye. 2. To color or paint with heavy rouge or red powder.

items.def_zh: 用红土（红赭石）涂抹，用红土做标记
items.def_en: To mark sheep or color a surface with ruddle (red ochre).
to mark permanently with a hot iron or indelible dye as a proof of ownership

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rubbing or applying pigments, chalk, or marking dyes (especially red ocher on livestock or materials) to distinguish, identify, or claim ownership.
groups.summary_zh: 特指用赭石颜料、染剂在牲畜或原料表面涂划色块以作辨识标记。

groups.name: Imaginative Reverie & Whimsical Daydreaming · 遐想神游与脱实幻梦 (Fantasize, Fantasy)
groups.tip: 放飞思绪勾勒画面

items.def_en: gradually lose focus on surroundings and become absorbed in daydreaming
to indulge in a pleasant, wandering series of speculative thoughts while awake
become completely detached from one's surroundings while lost in internal thoughts
To indulge in fantasies or daydreams; to imagine pleasant or improbable things.

items.def_zh: 做浪漫不切实际的空想
items.def_en: (+ about) to entertain exaggerated, romantic, or visionary thoughts about something

items.def_zh: 幻想，做白日梦；把……想象为
items.def_en: To imagine pleasant, exciting, or impossible events that one wishes would happen.
[I/T] to experience sensations of apparent visions that are completely detached from real stimuli

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cognitive manner frame capture indulging in wishful, unrestrained, or detached mental daydreams and unrealistic visions, distinct from practical planning or purposeful visualization.
groups.summary_zh: 沉湎于脱离现实的虚构幻象、脱靶白日梦或非现实的情节脑补。

groups.name: Impudently Defy · 顶撞与无礼不逊 (Cheek, Sauce, Backchat)
groups.tip: 态度放肆或言语冒犯

items.def_en: (+ to) to reply impolitely or defiantly to an elder or superior

items.def_zh: 对……言语冒犯，对……放肆无礼；给……加调味汁
items.def_en: (informal) to speak or behave impudently or rudely toward someone
(+ to sb) reply rudely or insolently to a person in authority
(informal) to speak to someone rudely or impudently

items.def_zh: 向（上级或长辈）回嘴，顶撞
items.def_en: to answer an authority figure back insolently or argumentatively
to speak to someone in a disrespectful or cheeky manner
(+ at sb) respond quickly, sharply, and aggressively to someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate speaking impudently, insolently, or disrespectfully to an authority figure or elder. These verbs carry strong colloquial/British expressive flavor, profiling the subordinate's defiance via cheeky, ill-mannered retorts.
groups.summary_zh: 对长辈或上级出言不逊、顶嘴无礼或傲慢顶撞。

groups.name: Infringe Rules & Contractual Terms · 违抗与侵犯 (Breach, Infringe, Violate)
groups.tip: 撕毁协议条约与突破底线

items.def_zh: 违犯，撕毁（协议、规则）；突破，攻破
items.def_en: 1. To violate or break a law, agreement, rule, or contract. 2. To make a gap or opening in a wall, barrier, or defense.
(+ sb/sth) get into conflict with or violate a rule, law, or authority
(+ sth) come into conflict with or break a regulation or statute

items.def_zh: （体育运动中）犯规，对……犯规；弄脏，污染；缠住
items.def_en: 1. (sports) To commit an unfair or illegal act against an opposing player. 2. To make dirty or polluted.
[I/T] (+ on/upon) to break a law, rule, or agreement, or encroach upon someone's rights
to do something that violates an official law, treaty, or formal directive

items.def_zh: 公然蔑视，公然无视（规章）
items.def_en: to openly disregard an established rule, law, or custom with contempt

groups.summary_en: Actors disregard, break, or commit a technical or legal infraction against an established rule, contract, sports regulation, or boundary.
groups.summary_zh: 违背或触犯既定规则、协议、法定义务或体育竞赛规程。

groups.name: Interlace & Plait · 编织与交错缠结 (Braid, Wattle, Plait)
groups.tip: 经纬编结扎成篱笆

items.def_en: (+ sth) interlace distinct strands of fiber or hair into a single cohesive braid
(+ sth) weave strands of hair, straw, or fibers together into a braid

items.def_zh: 编成辫，编织（头发或绳索）
items.def_en: to interlace three or more strands of hair, straw, or fabric diagonally to form a single cord

items.def_zh: 编成辫，编结；（用饰带等）镶边
items.def_en: 1. To weave three or more strands of hair, thread, or straw together into a plait. 2. To trim or edge a garment with decorative cord or tape.
[I/T] to cross or weave parts or strands intimately over and under one another

items.def_zh: 用枝条编造（篱笆、墙壁等）；用板条编结
items.def_en: 1. To build fences, walls, or hurdles by weaving flexible twigs and branches together.
[I/T] to weave or blend two or more threads, elements, or strands closely together

groups.summary_en: An agent interlaces strands of hair, flexible twigs, ribbons, or fibers in a diagonal or interlaced pattern to create decorative bands, ropes, fences, or woven structures. Verbs emphasize distinct manual braiding, plaiting, and twig-hurdle techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 将头发、枝条或纤维股条多股交叉交错编结成绳带、篱笆或结构件。

groups.name: Laud & Exalt · 赞美与崇高颂扬 (Laud, Extol, Exalt)
groups.tip: 从口头称赞到公开正式表彰

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth as sth) to present someone or something as an admirable example to be praised
to praise someone or something very highly in speech or writing, often at a formal occasion
(+ sb/sth) to praise someone or something enthusiastically in words or poetry
(formal) To praise someone or something lavishly or publicly.

items.def_zh: 赞扬，高度赞美；提拔，提升（地位等）；使兴高采烈
items.def_en: (formal) 1. To praise someone or something highly. 2. To raise someone to a higher rank, position, or status.
to praise someone or something enthusiastically and at length, especially in speech or writing

items.def_zh: 尊崇，赞美（神或伟大品性）
items.def_en: to praise, glorify, or extol someone or God in a ceremonial or reverent manner

groups.summary_en: High-register verbs denoting elevated, literary, or ceremonial praise, escalating from lofty commendation of virtues ('laud', 'extol') to quasi-sacred glorification ('magnify', 'exalt').
groups.summary_zh: 高阶书面与典礼性颂扬，从高度歌颂功绩美德递增至近乎神化的崇高赞美与推崇。

groups.name: Legal Seizure & Forfeiture · 没收与依法征收 (Confiscate, Foreclose, Impound)
groups.tip: 依法律或权力强行没收

items.def_en: Take official possession of property, contraband, or assets by judicial or police authority
1. (+ from) To officially take private property away from someone as a punishment or for security reasons.

items.def_zh: （因违规或受罚而）失去，丧失，被没收
items.def_en: To lose property, money, a right, or a privilege as a penalty for breaking a rule or failing to meet an obligation.
Seize and take legal custody of vehicles, animals, or goods because of a violation of the law

items.def_zh: 取消（抵押品）赎回权，没收（抵押财产）；排除，阻止
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) (law / finance) To take legal possession of an owner's property when they fail to keep up their mortgage payments. 2. (formal) To rule out or prevent something from happening.
Take back ownership of property (e.g. car, house) when the buyer defaults on loan installments

items.def_zh: 征用，没收（国家征收私产）
items.def_en: (Of a state or authority) Take away privately owned property, typically for public use

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote legal or regulatory actions wherein property, rights, or collateral are seized, repossessed, or lost as a penalty for breach of contract, lawbreaking, or loan default.
groups.summary_zh: 指因违约、违法或逾期未还款，依司法或行政权力没收、扣押或剥夺财产权。

groups.name: Lose & Misplace · 遗失与错放 (Lose, Misplace, Mislay)
groups.tip: 因疏忽乱放而一时找不到

items.def_en: (+ sth) to accidentally leave an object somewhere when departing
(+ sb/sth) to fail to stay aware of the location or condition of something and thus lose it

items.def_zh: 随手乱放而一时找不到（常为暂时性的）
items.def_en: to put an item in an unremembered or incorrect place so that it cannot immediately be found

items.def_zh: 放错地方，错放遗失（mislay 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of mislay: to lose something temporarily because you forgot where you put it.
To lose something temporarily because you forgot where you put it.
to accidentally leave behind or lose something while travelling or moving

items.def_zh: 丢失，遗失（通常指不可复得或去向不明）
items.def_en: to be deprived of or cease to have something, especially by accident or carelessness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote unintentionally forfeiting possession of an item or forgetting where it was put. Nuances range from temporary, recoverable disorientation of an object to irreversible loss.
groups.summary_zh: 指无意中丢失物品或因放错位置而暂时找不到。

groups.name: Make Amends & Expiate · 赎罪与清偿过错 (Atone, Expiate, Compensate)
groups.tip: 付出代价来抵偿罪过或损失

items.def_en: (+ sth) to do something good to compensate for an injury, error, or moral failing
(+ sth) to experience punishment, suffering, or remorse for past wrongdoing
to remedy or set right an unfair situation or grievance by compensation
(+ for) to make amends or reparation for an offense, crime, or sin
(archaic) To pay the penalty for something; to atone for a wrong.
(+ for) To try too hard to make up for a fault, disadvantage, or mistake, often causing a new problem.
to extinguish the guilt of sin or wrongdoing by suffering or penance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking corrective action, enduring penance, or offering reparation to balance out a moral offense, sin, or past injury, ranging from ritualistic expiation to psychological over-adjustment.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过受罚、赔偿或补救行动以弥补过失、罪愆或失衡。

groups.name: Maritime Docking & Mooring · 靠岸与系泊 (Dock, Berth, Moor)
groups.tip: 轮船停靠指定泊位

items.def_en: of a boat: to be moored or secured to a quay, pontoon, or buoy with lines
of a boat or ship, to arrive and come alongside a dock or harbor
of a watercraft, to steer alongside a wharf, dock, or shore and halt

items.def_zh: 进港停泊，（使船只）靠码头
items.def_en: to bring a ship into a dock or to come into a harbor basin/quay

items.def_zh: 系泊，用缆绳或锚将（船）固定
items.def_en: to secure a ship or boat in place with ropes, chains, or an anchor
(of a ship) To tie up or dock at an assigned place; to guide a ship into a berth.

items.def_zh: 停靠码头；使（船）靠码头；在码头上装卸（货物）
items.def_en: (nautical) To moor a ship at a wharf, or unload cargo onto a wharf.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized nautical scenario govern bringing a vessel alongside a coastal structure and securing it in position. They delineate the specific destination fixture: dock (entering a slip or basin), berth (occupying an allocated quayside spot), wharf (bringing specifically alongside a cargo wharf), and moor/tie up (securing via cables to bitts or buoys).
groups.summary_zh: 航海专业场景：将船只驶入指定水域，靠泊码头并系缆固定。

groups.name: Mark & Panel · 标记、烙印与嵌板修饰 (Brand, Panel, Emblazon)
groups.tip: 在物体表面留下印记或装饰

items.def_en: (+ sth) to draw or place visible marks on a surface to define an area or indicate identity

items.def_zh: 用嵌板装饰；给……安装饰板
items.def_en: To cover, line, or decorate a wall, door, or surface with flat panels.
to impress a pattern, brand, or sign into or onto a surface with an instrument
to cut or carve designs, names, or identifying marks into a hard material
(+ sth) to imprint or engrave a mark permanently onto a surface using heat or branding

items.def_zh: 打烙印于；铭刻；加污名于，谴责
items.def_en: 1. To mark permanently with a branding iron to indicate ownership or identity. 2. To impress permanently on the mind or memory. 3. To label someone as bad or shameful.
to conspicuously inscribe, mark, or decorate a surface with a design, crest, or letters

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict physical surface modifications intended to identify ownership, decorate, or mark an object permanently using structural plates, burns, or prominent visual devices.
groups.summary_zh: 通过镶嵌护板、烧烙印记或压覆显著标识来标记、识别或装饰表面。

groups.name: Mason & Pave · 石砌与筑路拼修 (Cobble, Pinnacle, Pave, Mason)
groups.tip: 打地基立梁柱，搭建构造物

items.def_en: to pave a surface with flat stone slabs (flagstones)
to build, construct, or fortify with stonework or brickwork

items.def_zh: 以砖石/沥青全面铺砌覆盖
items.def_en: (+ sth) to completely cover an area of ground with paving stones, concrete, or asphalt

items.def_zh: 拼凑搭建；粗制滥造地铺砌拼合
items.def_en: (+ sth) to piece together or construct roughly from varied available stones or materials
to cover a surface such as a road or floor with flat stones, bricks, or asphalt

items.def_zh: 给……加顶塔；置于尖塔之上
items.def_en: (architecture / literary) To crown or furnish a building with pinnacles; to place on a high point.

items.def_zh: 铺鹅卵石于；草率拼凑，粗制（常与 together 连用）；修补（鞋等）
items.def_en: 1. To pave a road or surface with cobblestones. 2. (cobble together/up) To assemble or produce something quickly and roughly. 3. To mend or repair shoes.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specialized architectural crafts involving masonry, crowning with stone summits, or rough assembling with stone and mortar.
groups.summary_zh: 指砌石、铺筑路面或为建筑顶部装饰尖塔等石构工艺。

groups.name: Misunderstand & Misjudge · 误判与误认 (Cognitive Attribution Errors)
groups.tip: 认知出现偏差导致看错

items.def_en: 1. to wrongly identify someone or something as someone or something else 2. to misunderstand a situation, statement, or idea
(+ with/and) to mistake one person or thing for another due to lack of distinct perception
(+ sb/sth as sb/sth) mistakenly identify someone or something as someone or something else
(+ sb/sth with sb/sth) mistake one person or thing for another through confusion
to interpret a sign, social signal, or text inaccurately
to form an incorrect opinion about someone or make an inaccurate estimate of a situation, distance, or size
to deduce an incorrect meaning or intention from someone's words or actions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent cognitive errors where a thinker incorrectly identifies an entity as something else or miscalculates someone's character, intentions, or capacities.
groups.summary_zh: 对事物身份产生误认，或对人的性格、意图及局势作出错误的判断。

groups.name: Notch & Groove · 开槽与刻痕 (Notch, Groove, Indent)
groups.tip: 切出凹口留下刻痕

items.def_en: to cut a long, narrow aperture or groove into a surface

items.def_zh: 在……上刻凹痕（或缺口）；赢取，斩获
items.def_en: 1. To cut a V-shaped mark or groove into a surface. 2. ('notch up') (informal) To achieve or score a win, point, or record.

items.def_zh: 在……上开槽（或刻凹槽）；狂欢享受，随音乐尽兴
items.def_en: 1. To cut a long narrow channel or track into a surface. 2. (informal) To dance or enjoy rhythmic music deeply.
to make a notch, cut, or recess in the surface or edge of something
(+ sth) cut or scoop out the inside or surface of an object to create a cavity or channel
to make narrow grooves or deep tracks in a surface
(+ sth) cut or scrape a deep recess, groove, or indentation into a surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote cutting narrow recesses, v-shaped cuts, or functional hollow tracks into surfaces of materials to fit components or mark indicators.
groups.summary_zh: 在材料表面加工切出凹槽、缺口或轨迹。

groups.name: Order & Codify Practices · 规范与制度化 (Regularize, Ritualize, Codify)
groups.tip: 建立规则使之标准化

items.def_en: (+ sth) finalize, formalize, and make a protocol, contract, or procedure rigidly fixed
(+ sth) make informal arrangements or tentative practices definite, structured, and agreed upon
to make a practice, tradition, or convention an established and accepted part of an organization or culture

items.def_zh: 编纂（法典）；将…成文化/制度化
items.def_en: to arrange rules, laws, or practices systematically into an official written code
to give an informal arrangement, agreement, or practice official or legal status

items.def_zh: 使规范化，使合规；使合法化；整顿
items.def_en: To make an irregular situation, status, or system legal, official, or compliant with established rules.

items.def_zh: 使程式化，使仪式化，使成惯例
items.def_en: To make an activity, pattern of behavior, or procedure into a formal, regular ritual or routine.

groups.summary_en: An authority or collective culture brings an ad-hoc, informal, or chaotic practice into an orderly, rule-governed, or ceremonial system. Verbs vary by whether the standardization is legal, procedural, or sociocultural.
groups.summary_zh: 将随意无序的惯例纳入既定规则、法制或仪式体系中。

groups.name: Order Authoritatively & Impose Terms · 命令与权威发号 (Summon, Dictate, Decreed)
groups.tip: 发号施令具强制权威

items.def_en: (+ sb) officially or authoritatively summon someone to appear before a superior or panel

items.def_zh: 传唤，召唤；召集（会议）；鼓起，振作
items.def_en: 1. to officially order someone to come or be present, especially in court. 2. to gather or call forth courage, strength, or energy (often with 'up').
(+ to/from) to instruct or urge someone authoritatively with the weight of official responsibility

items.def_zh: 制定；命令规定（原则、规章）
items.def_en: (+ the law/rules) authoritatively prescribe rules, orders, or terms that others must obey
[I/T] to order or establish something with the force of sovereign or legal law

items.def_zh: 命令，支配，决定；口授，听写
items.def_en: 1. to state or order authoritatively; to determine or control. 2. to say words aloud for someone else to write down.
to command, decide, or establish something definitively by divine or absolute authority

groups.summary_en: An authority delivers an unchallengeable directive, commanding another person to appear or arbitrarily prescribing the exact rules and terms they must follow.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借绝对权威发号施令、强制传唤或独断硬性规定行为。

groups.name: Orderly Layering & Piling · 整齐堆放与成垛码放 (Stack, Rick, Tier)
groups.tip: 将物品一层层向上堆放聚集

items.def_en: (+ sth) to put things into an orderly heap or pile, or to accumulate into one
(+ sth) to arrange things neatly in an orderly, vertical pile, or to accumulate in this way
to lay or gather items one on top of another into a neat or orderly rise
