items.def_zh: 把（干草、谷物等）堆成垛；扭伤（颈、背等）
items.def_en: 1. To pile hay, straw, or corn into large stacks (ricks). 2. To twist or sprain a muscle or joint.

items.def_zh: （使）整齐地堆起，叠放；堆满；暗中对……做手脚
items.def_en: 1. To arrange things in an orderly pile, or be arranged in a pile. 2. To fill or cover something with stacks of objects.
to stack cut firewood into neat, measured cords
to arrange things in orderly, graded vertical ranks or successive levels

groups.summary_en: An agent arranges items systematically in neat, vertical, or interlocking layers to create a stable, organized pile or store. It contrasts with disordered heaping by emphasizing geometrical alignment or structural order.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品有规则、有层次地整齐码放成垛，强调排列的稳定性与条理性。

groups.name: Overlie & Impose Downward Pressure · 覆压、叠压与压覆于上
groups.tip: 平躺覆于上方形成沉积遮盖

items.def_zh: 躺在……上面，覆在……上面；压死（尤指压在婴儿身上使其窒息）
items.def_en: 1. (geology / formal) To lie directly on top of something else. 2. To lie on top of a young child or animal and suffocate it accidentally.
(+ on sb/sth) to exert heavy, pressing weight downward onto an object or surface
(+ on sb/sth) to exert continuous downward gravitational or physical force upon an underlying surface or body

items.def_zh: （以天然层或顶部结构）覆盖顶部
items.def_en: to form an upper layer or permanent top surface over an underlying geological deposit or structure

items.def_zh: 沉重地覆压使之受沉重负荷
items.def_en: to exert heavy downward physical force on something below it

items.def_zh: 以厚重层严密覆压导致窒息或压迫
items.def_en: to cover a surface or organism heavily so as to extinguish airflow or crush it
to compress and suppress growth by lying heavily across or tightly around something

groups.summary_en: Expresses a stative or gravitational condition where a heavier geological layer, object, or weight lies directly on top of and presses down upon a lower stratum or body.
groups.summary_zh: 呈层状紧压或重压于下方物体或地层之上，构成沉重覆压态势。

groups.name: Overreach & Transgress · 逾矩与越权 (Overstep, Overreach, Transgress)
groups.tip: 超越职权界限或打破规则

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to gradually intrude upon or take over another person's rights, territory, or time
(+ sth) to gradually intrude upon or overstep rights, boundaries, or proper limits
to behave inappropriately or transgress accepted rules, boundaries, or authority
[I/T] (+ on/upon) to limit, encroach upon, or violate someone's legal rights or rules

items.def_zh: 逾越，超出……的限度（如职权、规则等）
items.def_en: To go beyond acceptable or normal limits of behavior, rules, or authority (e.g., overstep the mark).

items.raw_cluster: 越权与过度扩展 Overreach & Exceed
items.def_zh: 越权，做力所不及的事而失败；过度伸张
items.def_en: (often overreach oneself) To fail by trying to achieve more than one is capable of or by exceeding one's legitimate authority.
[I/T] to go beyond the limit of what is morally, legally, or socially acceptable

groups.summary_en: Actors exceed proper limits of authority, jurisdiction, competence, or ethical boundaries, escalating from trespassing accepted social/legal bounds ('overstep', 'transgress') to disastrously overextending one's ambition or capabilities ('overreach').
groups.summary_zh: 行动者超越权力、职责或道德界限，由违背规矩界限递增至因野心过大招致挫败。

groups.name: Overrule & Strike Down · 否决与推翻 (Nix, Overrule, Veto)
groups.tip: 权威上诉驳回或一票否决动议

items.def_zh: 否决；坚决拒绝（建议或提案）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to decisively reject, veto, or defeat a proposal, plan, or argument
(informal) to reject, veto, or cancel a plan, proposal, or idea

items.def_zh: 判决无效；推翻（法律或决定）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially rule that a law, regulation, or decision is invalid or illegal
To exercise an official constitutional or procedural power to refuse consent to a proposal
To use superior authority to reject or cancel someone's decision, order, or objection

items.def_zh: 驳回，否决（决定或反对意见）；改变（下级裁决）
items.def_en: to use one's authority to reject, overturn, or disallow a decision, objection, or argument
To officially reject or declare a legal decision, subpoena, or indictment invalid

groups.summary_en: An authority figure or governing body invalidates, denies, or uses formal power to nullify a proposal, ruling, or planned course of action. Verbs range from colloquial outright refusals ('nix') to formal institutional nullification ('overrule', 'veto', 'override').
groups.summary_zh: 凭借权力或上级权威对决议、判决或提案予以否决、推翻或驳回。

groups.name: Overtake & Surpass · 超越与赶超 (Overtake, Outrun, Outstrip)
groups.tip: 在速度或位置上超车越过

items.def_zh: 拉开距离甩开；将…远远甩在后面
items.def_en: to run or travel much faster than competitors, leaving them far behind
(+ of sb/sth) to move in front of a competitor in a race, journey, or competition

items.def_zh: 甩开；逐渐拉开领先差距
items.def_en: (+ from sb/sth) to increase the distance between oneself and a pursuer or competitor

items.def_zh: 超车，赶上，超过；突然降临于
items.def_en: 1. To catch up with and pass someone or something moving in the same direction. 2. To become greater than someone or something in number, amount, or importance. 3. To happen to someone suddenly or unexpectedly.

items.def_zh: 跑得比……快，赶过；超过（能力、范围等）
items.def_en: 1. To run faster or further than someone or something else. 2. To develop, increase, or spread more quickly than something can keep up with.
to go, develop, or grow more quickly than another person, rate, or competitor

items.def_zh: 超越；胜过（速度或发展速度上远超）
items.def_en: to move faster than and leave someone or something behind, or to exceed substantially in growth

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving faster than another entity to catch up with and pass them, or exceeding another entity in rate, quantity, or competitive achievement. They range from physical road or track maneuvers to broader quantitative or figurative eclipse.
groups.summary_zh: 在物理移动或指标发展上追平并超过原本领先的对象。

groups.name: Pan & Sweep Visually · 扫视与镜头扫掠 (Sweep, Pan, Scan)
groups.tip: 视线平移或大范围席卷掠过

items.def_en: (+ for sb/sth) to look visually in various directions or sweep across an area
(+ sth) to turn one's eyes or head to sweep visually across an area

items.def_zh: 平移摄影机拍摄；扫视；淘金
items.def_en: To move a camera slowly from side to side or up and down to follow a subject or film a wide view; to scan an area slowly.
to look over all parts of something systematically or searchingly

items.def_zh: 扫视，掠过；席卷；打扫，扫除
items.def_en: 1. To move quickly and smoothly over or through an area, or to let your eyes scan across something. 2. To clean a surface using a broom or brush.
to pass across or scan over an entire area or surface thoroughly
(+ across/over) to sweep one's eyes, light, or gaze piercingly from side to side

groups.summary_en: Describes eyes, a searchlight, or a camera moving smoothly across a broad horizontal or continuous arc to take in a panoramic view or survey an area systematically.
groups.summary_zh: 指目光、镜头或光束横向连续掠过以巡视或摄入全景。

groups.name: Parturition & Bearing Young · 分娩与产仔 (Birth, Lamb, Calve)
groups.tip: 怀胎受孕到产下幼崽新生命

items.def_en: to assist in the birth of offspring or bring forth a baby
To give birth to a baby or young animal; to produce or bring something into existence.
[I/T] (of a female dog, wolf, etc.) to give birth to puppies
(of livestock or animals) to give birth to offspring

items.raw_cluster: 生产与繁殖 Give Birth & Breed
items.def_en: (of a female sheep) To give birth to lambs.
[I/T] (of a sow) to give birth to a litter of pigs
[I/T] to give birth to a calf

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physiological frame describe the act of giving birth, whether used transitively for humans/general animals or intransitively for species-specific delivery events.
groups.summary_zh: 特指母体经历阵痛生产下胎儿或特定母畜分娩产仔。

groups.name: Perceive & Discern · 感知与辨识 (Notice and Distinguish Stimuli)
groups.tip: 感官接收外界信号的觉察

items.def_zh: 察觉，发觉（细微或隐藏之物）
items.def_en: to discover or notice something, especially something not obvious or easy to see
[I/T] to see, hear, or recognize someone or something with effort or clarity
1. To become aware of, notice, or identify something through the physical senses or the mind. 2. To regard or interpret someone or something in a specific manner.
to see, hear, or understand something with difficulty
(+ sb/sth) to recognize or distinguish someone or something from a surrounding group or background
(+ sth) to notice, discern, or become aware of something subtle that others may miss
(formal) To see, hear, or recognize something with difficulty or through careful perception.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking in sensory information and mentally recognizing, differentiating, or interpreting it. 'Perceive' encompasses sensory and cognitive awareness, while 'discern' and 'detect' emphasize detecting subtle, faint, or distinct details.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过感官或认知识别、分辨出细微刺激或真相。

groups.name: Postal Dispatch & Franking · 邮寄与邮资核验 (Mail, Post, Dispatch)
groups.tip: 涉及信件盖戳与邮资凭证

items.def_zh: 投寄，邮寄（英式核心动词）
items.def_en: to send a letter, parcel, or document via the public postal system

items.def_zh: 转寄，转发（信件包裹至新地址）
items.def_en: to resend or redirect a letter or parcel to an updated or further address

items.def_zh: 邮寄，投递；发送（电子邮件）
items.def_en: To send a letter, parcel, or message using the postal system or email.

items.def_zh: 在（信件等上）盖邮戳免费寄送，盖免付邮资章
items.def_en: To stamp an official mark on a letter or parcel indicating that postage has been paid or that it is sent free.
(+ sth) to dispatch or mail a letter or package through the postal system
(+ sth) to send letters, packages, or materials to many people by mail

items.def_zh: 发送，寄发（包裹、公文等至目的地）
items.def_en: to send off a letter, package, or consignment to a destination with promptness or formality

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario relate to the formal transmission of physical letters and parcels through an organized postal or courier network, including stamping or marking official authorization on the envelope.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过邮政或投递系统寄送实体信件包裹及邮资处理。

groups.name: Praise & Hail · 称赞与盛赞 (Compliment, Commend, Hail)
groups.tip: 从赞许夸奖到高度盛赞

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to commend, compliment, or express verbal approval of someone or something
To praise or express admiration, approval, or respect for someone.
to express strong approval of an action, decision, or person
to formally praise someone or something, especially publicly or officially
(+ of sb/sth) to enthusiastically express high approval, admiration, or acclaim for someone or something

items.def_zh: 赞扬，称颂；欢呼；招呼（出租车或人）；下冰雹
items.def_en: 1. To praise or describe someone or something enthusiastically as being very good. 2. To wave or call out to catch the attention of a person or taxi. 3. (impersonal) To produce hailstones during a storm.
to praise or welcome someone or something publicly and enthusiastically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing verbal approval or acclaim toward someone's qualities, deeds, or creations, escalating from polite social praise ('compliment') to official recognition ('commend') and enthusiastic public acclaim ('hail', 'acclaim').
groups.summary_zh: 表达口头认可或赞赏，由日常客套夸奖递增至官方表彰与全社会热烈欢呼盛赞。

groups.name: Presage & Foreshadow · 预示与预兆 (Portend, Forebode, Herald)
groups.tip: 预先显现征兆昭示未来

items.def_en: To signal the approach, arrival, or onset of a major event or new era
(literary/archaic) to be an omen of; to foretell or portend something
To give a subtle suggestion or indication of something that will occur later
(+ well/ill) To be an omen of a particular future outcome
To act as an advance warning or harbinger of something evil or disastrous
To be a sign or warning that something typically bad will happen in the future

items.def_zh: 预示，预告（尤指不祥之事）
items.def_en: To serve as a sign or warning that something momentous or calamitous is likely to happen

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe events, signs, or conditions serving as warning indicators or portents of future occurrences, ranging from solemn warnings to ceremonial announcements.
groups.summary_zh: 描述作为征兆预示未来事件，侧重不祥预感或重大转折。

groups.name: Regret & Repent · 懊悔与悔改 (Sorrow and Contrition Over Past Acts)
groups.tip: 对往事深感悔恨并悔改过错

items.def_en: to feel sad, repentant, or disappointed over something done or omitted
(+ over/for sth) Be annoyed with oneself for doing something foolish or missing an opportunity
[I/T] to express passionate sorrow or regret for something
(formal or literary) To feel deep regret, sorrow, or remorse for something done or allowed to happen.
to express deep grief or disapproval about something
(+ over/about sth) Blame or criticize oneself excessively with lingering regret or guilt
(+ of) To feel sincere sorrow, regret, or remorse for past sins or wrongdoings and resolve to change.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the painful recognition and distress experienced concerning past actions, errors, or sins. They scale from personal dissatisfaction ('regret'), to bitter sorrow ('rue'), up to morally transformative remorse ('repent').
groups.summary_zh: 表达因自身错误或罪过所生的悲叹、痛悔与悔改。

groups.name: Renounce Under Oath · 誓弃与发誓放弃 (Forswear, Abjure, Recant)
groups.tip: 公开发誓放弃权利或信仰

items.def_zh: 正式放弃；公开放弃（声明、权利）
items.def_en: to state publicly that you no longer have a particular belief, claim, or connection
(+ sth) Formally admit that what one said was wrong or untrue and retract it

items.def_zh: 收回（先前的言论或主张）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Retreat from, retract, or formally qualify a previous statement, claim, or promise
to say formally that you are not responsible for or no longer support an association or act

items.def_zh: 撤回；公开放弃（原先信仰或供词）
items.def_en: [I/T] to state publicly that your past opinions, statements, or heresy were wrong

items.raw_cluster: 放弃与声明放弃 Renounce & Relinquish
items.def_zh: 公开发誓放弃，发誓戒除（信仰、观点、习惯等）
items.def_en: To solemnly and publicly renounce or give up a belief, claim, or course of action.

items.raw_cluster: 放弃与声明放弃 Renounce & Relinquish
items.def_zh: 发誓放弃，发誓戒绝；作伪证，发伪誓
items.def_en: 1. To make a serious decision or promise to give up something (such as a bad habit, belief, or activity). 2. (forswear oneself) To commit perjury or swear falsely.

groups.summary_en: A person formally, publically, and solemnly disavows, retracts, or promises under oath to give up a belief, allegiance, or illicit claim. Verbs range from general solemn renunciation to courtroom/doctrinal retraction.
groups.summary_zh: 庄严宣誓放弃、收回原有的信仰、效忠誓约或主张。

groups.name: Repatriate & Ecclesiastically Exclude · 遣返归国与绝罚出教 (Repatriate, Extradite, Excommunicate)
groups.tip: 驱逐出教门或引渡遣返出境

items.def_en: to formally remove a religious minister or priest from professional standing due to misconduct
to officially deprive a priest or clergyman of ecclesiastical status and authority
(+ sb) Forcefully expel or banish someone from a community, group, or religious body
(+ sb) Force someone to return to their country or territory of origin
to hand over a person accused or convicted of a crime to the jurisdiction of the foreign state where the crime was committed
1. To send someone (such as a refugee or prisoner of war) back to their own country.
1. To officially exclude someone from participation in the sacraments and services of a church.

groups.summary_en: Institutions process individuals out of their current legal or spiritual jurisdiction, either sending them back to their sovereign state of origin or casting them entirely out of the religious community. 'Repatriate' centers on return to one's native state, whereas 'excommunicate' cuts off communion and membership.
groups.summary_zh: 公权力将人遣送回母国，或宗教机构剥夺教籍彻底革除出教。

groups.name: Reset to Baseline & Normalize · 恢复基准与重置常规 (Reset, Normalize, Reboot)
groups.tip: 重归常态或标准状态

items.def_en: to regain or return to an internal state of chemical, physical, or systematic equilibrium
Return to a calm, stable, or normal state after a period of disturbance or excitement
Stop fluctuating, rising, or falling and stabilize at a steady normal baseline
to set an instrument, system, or setting back to zero or an initial default state
to become or make something firmly established and unlikely to fluctuate wildly

items.def_zh: 重新启动（计算机）；重新开创，使复兴
items.def_en: 1. (computing) To shut down and restart a computer system or device. 2. To revive and relaunch a film series, brand, or project.

items.raw_cluster: 恢复与正常化 Restore & Normalize
items.def_zh: （使）恢复正常，（使）正常化；（使）标准化
items.def_en: To return to a normal, usual, or standard condition, or to make something do this.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe returning a disturbed system, technical device, physiological state, or social relation to its baseline default, stable operating equilibrium, or accepted normal bounds.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统、机器、生理或关系自失常回归标准基准与常态运转。

groups.name: Restoring to Fullness · 补满与补充 (Refill, Replenish, Top up)
groups.tip: 往空缺处注满，使其不再匮乏

items.def_en: to add a small amount of liquid or fuel to an already partially full container to make it completely full

items.def_zh: 再注满，重新装满；续杯；再配（药）
items.def_en: To fill a container again after it has been emptied, or to replenish a medical prescription.
(+ with) to fill up a store, pantry, or inventory with fresh supplies after depletion
(+ sth) Make a depleted container completely full, or become completely full
(+ on sth) Buy or collect a large supply of resources, goods, or provisions to replenish stores
to restore electric charge or revitalize depleted physical strength and inner resources

items.def_zh: 补充，重新装满，补足（资源、能量等）
items.def_en: To restore a supply of something to its former level, or to fill something up again.

groups.summary_en: An agent fills a depleted container, resource, or reserve back to its original or necessary level. The verbs contrast along lines of physical containers (cups, tanks) versus abstract or collective assets (stocks, energy, depleted reserves).
groups.summary_zh: 将已经消耗或耗空的容器、库存及体能重新补足至充盈状态。

groups.name: Retard & Prolong · 延缓与拖长 (Retard, Prolong, Drag out)
groups.tip: 人为放缓节奏或延长历程时间

items.def_en: to prolong or extend the duration of an activity or discussion
to make an event, speech, or process continue for longer than is necessary or pleasant
(+ sb/sth) Delay the progress or movement of someone or something
to intentionally make something last as long as possible by working slowly
(+ sth) Cause an event, activity, or series of actions to last longer than necessary
To make an activity, state, or process last longer in time.
(formal) To slow down the development, progress, or growth of something; to delay.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote slowing down progress or causing a process, duration, or state of affairs to continue far longer than desirable.
groups.summary_zh: 强调阻碍进程、减缓发生速度或不必要地拖长时限。

groups.name: Retell & Narrate · 复述与转述 (Narrate, Relate, Retell)
groups.tip: 条理清晰重述往事，绘声绘色讲述故事

items.def_en: (+ sth) Read written notes or a recorded statement aloud to check accuracy or narrate events
[I/T] to tell a story or describe a series of events in speech or writing

items.def_zh: 复述，重述；重新讲述（故事等）
items.def_en: To tell a story or account again, often in a different way or form.

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地背诵，一气呵成地讲出
items.def_en: (+ sth) Recite or narrate a story, sequence of facts, or list rapidly and effortlessly from memory
(formal) to give a spoken or written report of an event, experience, or fact
to repeat a statement, opinion, or message in order to emphasize it

items.def_zh: 复述，重述（retell的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of retell; narrated or told again.

groups.summary_en: This storytelling frame centers on relating or repeating a narrative tale, personal story, or event sequence to an audience. 'Retell' explicitly emphasizes re-presenting an existing story from a new perspective or in another form, whereas 'narrate' and 'relate' describe continuous oral or written storytelling.
groups.summary_zh: 以口头或书面形式，将已有故事或经历按情节脉络重新讲述或转述。

groups.name: Reverential Kneeling & Prostrating · 屈膝下跪与跪拜 (Kneel, Prostrate, Kowtow)
groups.tip: 女子屈膝行屈膝礼致意

items.def_en: to fall or rest on the knees
(+ to) To bend the knees slightly with one foot behind the other as a formal gesture of respect, traditionally done by women and girls.

items.def_zh: 单膝下跪（行敬礼）；跪拜，屈从
items.def_en: 1. (+ before/to) To bend one knee to the ground briefly in worship or respect, especially in a church. 2. To show servile obedience or excessive deference to someone or something.
(+ before/to sb) Kneel or bend one's body deeply toward the ground to show reverent submission or worship
(+ before sb/sth) Drop to the ground or prostrate oneself before someone in reverence or supplication
(+ to) to kneel and touch the forehead to the ground in homage
to cast oneself face down on the ground in total submission or worship

groups.summary_en: Agents drop down onto one or both knees or cast their full body to the floor as an act of formal reverence, submission, penitence, or supplication.
groups.summary_zh: 指因敬意、服从或祈愿而弯膝下跪或全身伏地。

groups.name: Ride as Passenger or Mount · 骑乘与乘车搭行 (Ride)
groups.tip: 骑车或乘坐载具

items.def_zh: 骑（马、自行车等）；乘，坐（车辆等）；取决于
items.def_en: 1. to sit on and control the movements of a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle. 2. to travel in or on a vehicle. 3. (ride on) to depend or hang on something.
to share a car journey with others when travelling to work or school
(+ sth) board or mount a vehicle, bicycle, or transit system as a rider

items.def_zh: 坐上，登上（公交车、火车等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) board a train, bus, ship, or bicycle to ride as a passenger
travel as a passenger in a vehicle alongside another person
to travel regularly between home and work via vehicle, train, or bus
[I/T] to board or cause people to board a railway train for transit

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this core frame represent the foundational activity of travelling as a passenger in a vehicle, or being carried along while mounted on an animal, bicycle, or transit system.
groups.summary_zh: 指骑马、骑车或作为乘客乘坐公共交通及车辆的基本出行场景。

groups.name: Rope & Technical Descent · 绳索速降与控速垂落 (Abseil, Rappel, Belay)
groups.tip: 自上而下位移下落

items.def_zh: 沿绳垂降；下降到下方高度
items.def_en: descend deliberately to a lower level along a rope or vertical drop

items.def_zh: 下降，走下，垂落；降临，侵袭；世代相传；屈尊
items.def_en: 1. to move or go down from a higher position to a lower one. 2. (descend on/upon) to arrive suddenly or attack in large numbers. 3. to pass down by inheritance or descent. 4. to lower oneself to an inferior or unethical standard.

items.def_zh: 系牢；为…打保护（用保护绳控降）
items.def_en: to secure a climber or lower them steadily with a running rope through a friction device

items.def_zh: 用保护绳固定；从绳索保护点下降脱离
items.def_en: secure or control descent using a belay system on a rope
to make a descent down a cliff or drop using a rope

items.def_zh: 用绳索沿陡壁下滑；速降
items.def_en: [I/T] to descend a steep rock face or structure using a doubled rope and friction device
(chiefly BrE) to descend a steep cliff or vertical drop using a rope coiled around the body or attached to a harness.

groups.summary_en: A climber, caver, or tactical operator moves downward a vertical surface or drop using specialized equipment like ropes, harnesses, and friction devices. The verbs describe distinct techniques of controlled, vertical descent.
groups.summary_zh: 使用绳索与制动装备自陡崖或高空受控垂直下降。

groups.name: Sacralize & Dedicate · 祝圣与奉献 (Consecrate, Anoint, Hallow)
groups.tip: 举行宗教仪式祝圣为神圣

items.def_en: to invoke divine favor upon or pronounce holy

items.def_zh: 将…奉献给神明或神圣事业
items.def_en: (+ to) to solemnly set apart something for sacred or divine honor

items.def_zh: 授予圣职；立为神职人员
items.def_en: to officially invest someone with ministerial or priestly authority by sacred rite

items.def_zh: 用油涂抹，施涂油礼（以示祝圣）；指定，选定（为接班人等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To put oil or water on someone's head or body as part of a religious ceremony to make them holy. 2. To choose someone formally to do a particular important job or to become the successor.
1. (formal or literary) To make something holy, or to honor and respect something as sacred.

items.def_zh: 祝圣，奉献给神；献身于，致力（于）
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To officially state in a religious ceremony that a person, church, or object is holy and dedicated to God. 2. (+ to) (formal) To dedicate your life, time, or energy to a particular purpose.
to set apart as sacred, cleanse from sin, or impart religious sanction

groups.summary_en: Religious or solemn authorities set apart a person, object, or place as sacred through traditional sacramental rites, ritual oil, or dedication to divine service.
groups.summary_zh: 通过宗教仪式、涂油礼或神圣宣告将人、物或场所奉献为圣。

groups.name: Satisfy & Gratify Appetite · 饱享与止渴 (Extinguishing Physical Desires)
groups.tip: 满足渴求带来心理慰藉

items.def_zh: 一口喝干；大口饮尽以解渴
items.def_en: (+ sth) consume liquid rapidly to slake intense thirst
(+ sb/on sth) sate hunger fully by eating a large quantity of food
to satisfy one's thirst by drinking liquid; to extinguish longing
to satisfy an appetite or desire fully, sometimes to the point of dulling interest

items.raw_cluster: 满足与使满意 Satisfy & Content
items.def_zh: 充分满足（欲望或胃口）；使厌腻
items.def_en: To satisfy a desire, appetite, or need fully, often to the point of boredom or disgust.

items.def_zh: （因过多过甜而）使人生腻；使餍足反胃
items.def_en: to disgust or sicken someone with an excess of sweetness, richness, or gratification

items.def_zh: 解（渴）；满足（欲望、好奇心等）；（用生石灰加水）熟化
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To satisfy a thirst, desire, or curiosity. 2. (chemistry) To combine quicklime with water to produce slaked lime.

groups.summary_en: An agent fully quenches or overfills a visceral appetite, thirst, or desire. 'Slake' canonically attaches to thirst, whereas 'sate' and 'satiate' emphasize filling appetite to full or excessive capacity.
groups.summary_zh: 彻底消除并填满干渴、饥饿或生理欲望，强调需求完全得到平息。

groups.name: Sound & Blast Horn · 鸣响与鸣笛按角 (Toot, Honk, Blare)
groups.tip: 喇叭发出刺耳鸣响，发出急促警报声

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a short, relatively high-pitched sound with a vehicle horn

items.def_zh: （使）鸣笛，吹奏（喇叭等发出短促声响）
items.def_en: 1. To sound a car horn, whistle, or wind instrument, or to make a short, sharp sound.
Make a loud, clear acoustic signal using a whistle, horn, or bugle

items.def_zh: 按（汽车喇叭），按喇叭示意；（大雁等）鸣叫
items.def_en: 1. To sound a car horn, or to make a car horn sound. 2. (of a goose) To make a loud, harsh cry.
(+ sth) Produce a very loud, penetrating sound or signal from a horn, siren, or speaker
[I/T] to sound a horn, siren, or whistle loudly and forcefully
[I/T] to make a loud, harsh, penetrating sound with a horn, siren, or trumpet

groups.summary_en: A person produces an acoustic warning or signal by sounding a horn, whistle, or siren, ranging from brief courtesy taps ('toot', 'beep') to jarring, resonant acoustic assaults ('blare', 'blast').
groups.summary_zh: 通过喇叭或警笛发出短促或长鸣的鸣笛警示声响。

groups.name: Specialized Bodily or Technical Descent · 异常垂坠与悬绳下行 (Prolapse, Rappel, Abseil)
groups.tip: 垂直方向上的升起或下降

items.def_en: Descend, sag, or lower to a lower physiological or physical level
(medical) to drop or sink abnormal downwards; to undergo ptosis
to sink to a lower level or fall downward smoothly and steadily
Descend a steep cliff face or vertical surface using ropes (rappel)
1. (medicine) (of an internal organ or disc) To slip, fall, or sink forward or downward out of its normal anatomical position.
1. (+ down) (mountaineering, especially US; British: abseil) To descend a steep rock face or vertical surface by sliding down a rope.
(+ down) to descend a rock face or other near-vertical surface using a doubled rope

groups.summary_en: An entity descends or drops downward via a specific mechanical technique or pathological physiological displacement. Verbs contrast controlled mountaineering descents down cliffs using friction ropes (rappel, abseil) with involuntary medical downward displacement and sinking of internal organs (prolapse).
groups.summary_zh: 指依靠特定绳索技术垂直下行，或体内器官异常下垂滑出原位。

groups.name: Steep Vertical Descent · 坠落与直坠 (Chute, Plummet, Plunge)
groups.tip: 从高处笔直坠落或急剧下跌

items.def_en: to fall rapidly or move downward vertically

items.def_zh: 跳伞；从滑道滑下；（水等）顺斜槽流下
items.def_en: 1. To descend by parachute. 2. To slide down a chute, or convey something along a chute.
to drop downward steeply or plummet precipitously below a point
to fall or drop steeply and suddenly from a high position
to drop or plummet headfirst toward the ground at a steep angle
to fall through the air solely under the force of gravity without resistance or restraint

items.def_zh: 垂直落下，坠落；暴跌，骤降
items.def_en: To fall straight down very quickly from a high level, or to decrease rapidly and by a large amount.

groups.summary_en: An entity falls downwards through air or a steep channel with rapid acceleration and acute steepness. Verbs in this frame scale in intensity from controlled sliding descents to unstoppable, catastrophic vertical plunges.
groups.summary_zh: 物体沿极陡坡道或空中垂直下坠，强调下落的势头猛烈与速度极快。

groups.name: Strain & Constrict Facial/Body Parts · 伸长与紧缩局部 (Crane, Purse, Pucker)
groups.tip: 骨骼肌肉的伸展与拉长

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pull facial features tight or contract specific body parts
tilt or turn a body part (like the head or ear) attentively or inquisitively

items.def_zh: 伸长（脖子），探着身子看；（用起重机）起吊，搬运
items.def_en: 1. To stretch your neck forward or upward in order to see something better. 2. To lift or move heavy loads using a crane.
To press your lips together into a tight, rounded shape, especially to express disapproval, doubt, or deep concentration.
(+ sth) to twist or contract one's facial muscles tightly
tighten the muscles of the forehead or brow into deep lines
contract into wrinkles or folds, especially lips in anticipation of a kiss

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail deliberate muscular movements stretching outward (like the neck) or pinching/constricting together (like the lips).
groups.summary_zh: 伸长、探出身体局部（如脖子）或紧缩挤压特定器官（如嘴唇）。

groups.name: Surpass & Bypass by Leaping · 越级与越过 (Leapfrog, Overshoot)
groups.tip: 冲过终点或飞跃超越

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pass across or bypass an intermediate point by leaping
(+ sb/sth) to move beyond an intended point or rival rapidly and abruptly
[I/T] to leap over an obstacle, or suddenly achieve a much higher level or position
to go beyond a physical limit or established boundary

items.def_zh: 越过，跨越，跳过（阶段或对手）；玩跳背游戏
items.def_en: 1. To advance past competitors or intermediate stages to a higher rank or position rapidly. 2. To jump over someone's bent back in the game of leapfrog.

items.def_zh: 冲过，越过（目标或跑道）；超过（预算或限额）
items.def_en: 1. To go past a particular point, target, or runway unintentionally. 2. To exceed a planned limit, budget, or figure.

items.def_zh: 超越；拉开距离甩在身后
items.def_en: to move much faster than and leave someone or something behind

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving beyond a target, stage, or competitor by jumping over intermediary steps or traveling past an intended mark. 'Leapfrog' focuses on bypassing intermediate levels to jump ahead, whereas 'overshoot' emphasizes accidentally or deliberately carrying past a boundary or stopping point.
groups.summary_zh: 指越过中间层级抢先超越，或因冲力过猛而越过既定目标界限。

groups.name: Surpass & Outdo · 胜过与抢风头 (Outdo, Eclipse, Upstage)
groups.tip: 技高一筹或抢走他人风头

items.def_zh: 使黯然失色，抢去……的风头
items.def_en: to cause someone or their achievement to seem less important or successful because of one's own prominence
to be much more skilled, impressive, or attractive than someone else

items.def_zh: 抢……的风头，抢戏；在舞台后方抢戏
items.def_en: To steal attention or the spotlight away from someone else, especially a fellow performer or colleague.
(+ sb) Vastly outdo or outperform someone with effortless superiority
to win the greatest popularity, admiration, or attention in a performance or gathering

items.def_zh: 使相形见绌，遮蔽……的光芒
items.def_en: to make someone or something seem much less important, famous, or impressive by comparison
To do something better, more successfully, or to a greater degree than someone else.

groups.summary_en: Competitors or performers surpass rivals in performance or divert social attention away from them, ranging from straightforward superior execution ('outdo', 'outperform') to eclipsing them into insignificance ('eclipse') or stealing the limelight ('upstage').
groups.summary_zh: 在技能、表现或声势上超越竞争者，乃至夺取全场焦点使对方显得黯然失色。

groups.name: Systematic Ordering & Hierarchical Valuation · 权衡排序与定先决 (Prioritize, Rank)
groups.tip: 权衡轻重排列优先级

items.def_zh: 整理，按优先级或类别分类
items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange things in a systematic order or separate items according to priority, type, or importance
(+ sth) to examine a large collection of items or information systematically to isolate what is worthwhile or essential

items.def_zh: 挑选出，挑出给予特别重视
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to choose someone or something from a group for special attention, priority, or evaluation

items.def_zh: 优先处理，按重要性排列次序；优先考虑
items.def_en: To arrange or deal with items in order of importance, or to treat something as more important than other things.
to organize or classify items into strict gradations of rank or importance

items.def_zh: 置于优先地位；给予先期权
items.def_en: to accord superior rank or priority in processing or consideration over others

items.def_zh: （按轻重缓急）伤情分流；紧急分类定序
items.def_en: to assign degrees of urgency to wounds, crises, or tasks to determine the order of treatment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cognitive frame denote systematically weighing alternatives according to urgency, merit, or importance, arranging elements into a hierarchical sequence or designating what demands precedence.
groups.summary_zh: 根据重要性、紧迫性或价值，对各项任务或对象进行系统化权衡与排列先后。

groups.name: Take a Risk & Venture · 冒险一试与投机 (Venture, Hazard, Chance)
groups.tip: 下注博弈或冒险尝试

items.def_zh: 尝试，试图；试验，检验；审理，审判
items.def_en: 1. To make an effort or attempt to do something. 2. To test something to see how good, effective, or suitable it is. 3. (law) To examine and judge a person or case in a court of law.
(+ sb/sth) Take an uncertain risk on someone or something in hopes of gaining an advantage

items.def_zh: 赌博，下注；钻空子，操纵（规则等）；玩电子游戏
items.def_en: 1. To gamble or bet for money. 2. To manipulate or exploit the rules of a system unfairly for personal advantage ('game the system'). 3. To play video games.
to risk an action despite the uncertain outcome; take the chance of
[I/T] to dare to go somewhere or undertake an action involving risk
(+ sth + on sth) Risk something valuable, such as money or reputation, on the outcome of an uncertain event
to risk losing something or hazard an attempt/guess despite peril

groups.summary_en: Agents undertake uncertain, daring, or speculative actions, knowingly risking loss, failure, or danger for a potential gain.
groups.summary_zh: 指明知存在失败或受损风险仍大胆尝试或押注一搏。

groups.name: Take for Granted as True · 假定与前提预设 (Assume, Suppose, Presume)
groups.tip: 基于前设推断未知

items.def_zh: 假定，假设；料想，推测；应当，理应（be supposed to）
items.def_en: 1. To assume or believe something to be true without certain proof. 2. (be supposed to) To be expected or required to do something.

items.def_zh: 假定，假设；承担（责任、角色等）；呈现，显露（特征、面貌）
items.def_en: 1. To accept something as true without having proof. 2. To take on a responsibility, role, or control. 3. To take on a particular quality or appearance.
(+ sth) Accept something as true or certain without questioning or testing it
(+ sth) Base actions or beliefs on a particular unverified assumption or premise

items.def_zh: 推断，假定（基于合理概率或惯例默认）
items.def_en: to take something to be the case on the basis of probability or reasonable expectation

items.def_zh: 假定，设想（作为严谨论证或理论的前提）
items.def_en: to put forward or accept a statement as the factual basis for an argument or theory

items.def_zh: 公设，假定（在学术或系统推演中确立前提）
items.def_en: to suggest or assume the truth or existence of something as a necessary postulate

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this epistemic frame denote treating a proposition as true without immediate conclusive proof. They diverge cleanly in baseline justification: suppose introduces tentative or counterfactual hypothesizing, assume takes an unverified premise as a starting point without evidence, and presume accepts a condition based on reasonable probability or conventional default.
groups.summary_zh: 指在缺乏确凿凭证时将某事视为成立，按推测或默认概率推进认知。

groups.name: Targeted & Concealed Shooting · 隐蔽精准射杀 (Shoot Down, Pick Off)
groups.tip: 开火命中并使目标坠落

items.def_en: to take a casual or opportunistic shot at game or an enemy
to shoot targets carefully and individually from a distance

items.def_zh: 击落（鸟兽等使其倒地）；告发，向警方告密
items.def_en: 1. (hunting) To shoot down a bird or bring down an animal to the ground. 2. (British informal, 'grass on') To inform on someone to the police.

items.def_zh: 狙击，隐蔽射击；放冷箭，暗中抨击
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To shoot at someone from a hidden position, usually from a distance. 2. (+ at) To make covert, malicious criticisms or personal attacks.
(+ sb/sth) Knock down or kill a target with gunfire, especially from a distance
(+ sb/sth) Kill, wound, or neutralize a specific enemy target using precise fire
to fell or kill an opponent instantly with a single gunshot

groups.summary_en: Shooters fire accurately from a concealed position, vantage point, or blind side to knock down or kill specific targets one by one.
groups.summary_zh: 指自隐蔽处或远距离对特定目标进行精准射杀或击落。

groups.name: Technological Displacement & Obsolescence · 技术淘汰与迭代覆写 (Outmode, Overwrite)
groups.tip: 以新换旧并淘汰过时事物

items.def_en: to cause a product, tool, or practice to become outmoded and no longer useful
(+ sth) Gradually withdraw an older technology, product, or system from use
(+ sb/sth) Force an older technology, product, or competitor out of the market by newer alternatives
to supersede and take the place of an older system, technology, or standard

items.def_zh: （软件）弃用，宣布不再推荐使用
items.def_en: to declare a software feature or protocol out of date and slated for removal

items.def_zh: （计算机中）覆盖，重写（数据）；写得过长（或过于雕琢）
items.def_en: 1. (computing) To replace existing data with new data in the same storage location. 2. To write in a style that is excessively elaborate or ornate.
To cause something to become obsolete, old-fashioned, or no longer useful.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote rendering older systems, designs, or data irrelevant or non-functional by directly superseding them or writing over them with newer technological alternatives.
groups.summary_zh: 通过技术升级、迭代或数据覆盖，使旧有的方案、数据或系统被淘汰废弃。

groups.name: Toss Around & Traffic In · 随口散播与兜售 (Bandy, Monger, Peddle)
groups.tip: 四处散播言论或传闻，任意散布言辞

items.def_zh: 到处散播；口头频繁提及
items.def_en: (+ sth) Discuss, spread, or use names, ideas, or terms casually and frequently without care
(+ sth) Sell or peddle goods, ideas, or rumors opportunistically or quickly
mention or discuss names, words, or ideas casually without serious thought

items.def_zh: 散播，四处传布（言论、流言等）；（争执中）来回顶撞，互相对骂；往返抛接（球等）
items.def_en: 1. ('bandy about/around') To spread or discuss ideas, rumors, or names carelessly and widely. 2. ('bandy words') To exchange angry or contentious remarks with someone.

items.def_zh: 大肆宣扬，沿街叫卖般鼓吹
items.def_en: publicly offer, push, or advocate an idea or claim persistently
promote, spread, or sell an idea, story, or rumor widely and uncritically

items.def_zh: 散播，兜售，贩卖（恐惧、谣言等）
items.def_en: (usually in compounds or disapproving contexts) To spread or deal in something undesirable, such as fear, gossip, or warmongering.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey circulating remarks, rumors, or loaded terms carelessly, casually, or opportunistically as commodities.
groups.summary_zh: 轻率口传、随口翻炒或恶意兜售言论、谣言及是非。

groups.name: Transgress Moral & Legal Boundaries · 违背与犯罪 (Transgress, Violate, Sin)
groups.tip: 触犯戒律道德或法律

items.def_en: (+ against/on) to make an unfair intrusion on rights or commit a moral offense

items.def_zh: 越界；逾越（伦理道德界限）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Cross an established ethical, moral, or legal boundary
[I/T] to go beyond acceptable moral, ethical, or legal boundaries
(+ sth) Lapse morally and forfeit a state of righteousness or grace

items.def_zh: 犯戒，犯罪，违背道德原则
items.def_en: To commit a sin; violate a religious law or moral principle.

items.def_zh: 违反，违犯（法律、协议）；侵犯；亵渎
items.def_en: 1. To break or act against a law, rule, or agreement. 2. To infringe upon someone's rights or privacy; disrespect or desecrate something sacred.
to offend grossly against moral decency, human rights, or fundamental standards

groups.summary_en: Moral or legal agents cross boundary limits of ethics, natural laws, or divine commandments, escalating from personal moral failing to severe systemic crime or desecration.
groups.summary_zh: 越过道德、良知或法律戒律红线，程度由个体过失至恶劣罪行。

groups.name: Underscore & Reinforce · 划线与佐证强调 (Underscore, Underline, Accent)
groups.tip: 划重点以引起特别注意

items.def_en: emphasize or give distinctive prominence to a particular feature or statement
(+ sth) make something clearer, more noticeable, or more obvious

items.def_zh: 使显现，衬托出（特性或要点）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a particular quality, feature, or point more noticeable or prominent
(+ sb/sth) to support or confirm the truth or validity of an assertion, theory, or expectation

items.def_zh: 清晰凸显，格外引人注目
items.def_en: to be clearly prominent or conspicuous, reinforcing visibility or distinct importance
1. To emphasize or highlight the importance of something. 2. To draw a line underneath text.
1. To emphasize or show the importance of something clearly. 2. To draw a line under a word or phrase.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate reinforcing or drawing distinct attention to a truth, reality, or conclusion, often by serving as physical, visual, or contextual markers that validate or emphasize an underlying point.
groups.summary_zh: 通过划线突显或借由现实事实验证并加深强调某一论点。

groups.name: Undertake & Shoulder Responsibility · 承担与认领 (Undertake, Assume, Shoulder)
groups.tip: 挑起责任并着手去做

items.def_en: to take on a role, duty, or responsibility formally
to accept and deal with a heavy burden, responsibility, or blame
(take sth on) to agree to do a difficult piece of work, job, or responsibility

items.def_zh: 接任，着手处理（职责、工作等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to accept or begin a job, official duty, or substantial responsibility
(+ sth) to confront and assume responsibility for a difficult task or critical role
(+ sth) to agree or commit officially to take on an undertaking, role, or obligation
1. To accept a job, task, or responsibility and begin to do it. 2. (undertake to do something) To promise or agree to do something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe voluntarily or officially committing to perform a significant task, enterprise, role, or legal/ethical responsibility.
groups.summary_zh: 正式或自愿承担重大责任、义务、项目或执行某项任务。

groups.name: Uniformity & Standards Alignment · 统一标准与同质化 (Standardize, Homogenize, Systematize)
groups.tip: 推行统一标准以消除差异

items.def_zh: 解决，消除（分歧或不一致）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove differences, irregularities, or problems in order to achieve uniformity or agreement
(+ with sth) to align or bring sth into standard agreement with other things
to make things of the same type conform to an established standard or norm

items.def_zh: 使常规化；统一（标准或尺度）
items.def_en: to bring data, rules, or practices into conformity with a shared baseline or normal standard

items.raw_cluster: 统一与同质化 Standardize & Homogenize
items.def_zh: 使同质化，使均匀；使（牛奶等）均质化
items.def_en: To make different elements, cultures, or parts uniform and similar; to treat a liquid (such as milk) so that its fat is evenly distributed.
to arrange or organize procedures or components according to a comprehensive system

items.raw_cluster: 规范与制度化 Standardize & Institutionalize
items.def_en: To make or become professional in standards, training, organization, or status.

groups.summary_en: An agent modifies diverse elements, products, or working practices so that they conform to a uniform standard, quality benchmark, or identical characteristics. Verbs range from organizational leveling to technical standardization.
groups.summary_zh: 对不同要素进行标准化改造，消除差异并达成质量或形态统一。

groups.name: Unsteady & Abrupt Movement · 摇晃与震颤 (Wobble, Jolt)
groups.tip: 失去平衡左右来回晃荡

items.def_en: 1. To move or cause to move unsteadily from side to side. 2. To become weak, uncertain, or indecisive.
to move or stand in an unsteady way, swaying as if about to fall
(+ sth) to cause sth to tremble or move abruptly with sharp mechanical vibration
to shake violently and uncontrollably, as from an impact or intense cold/fear
1. To move or cause to move with a sudden, rough, and sharp jerk. 2. To shock or surprise someone into taking action or paying attention.
to make a sudden, unsteady, and abrupt movement ahead
[I/T] to shake or jolt violently due to a sudden physical impact

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing unsteady, oscillating, or abrupt movements, varying from precarious rhythmic unsteadiness to sudden, sharp mechanical shocks.
groups.summary_zh: 指缺乏平衡的摆动、摇晃，或受到突然剧烈撞击引起的震颤颠簸。

groups.name: Vaporize & Evaporate · 气化与消散消失 (Vaporize, Evaporate)
groups.tip: 由实体转化为气体消逝

items.def_en: to cause a substance to pass off as vapor, or to evaporate rapidly
(+ sth) to dissipate or disappear, or cause mist or liquid to clear, through heat
to slowly dissipate and disappear completely from view or existence

items.def_zh: （使）蒸发，（使）气化；（希望、热情等）消散，消失
items.def_en: 1. To change from a liquid into vapor or gas, or to cause this to happen. 2. To disappear or dissolve gradually.

items.def_zh: 驱散，消散（使烟云、能量散开）
items.def_en: to disappear gradually or cause cloud, vapor, or tension to scatter into nothing
1. To turn, or cause to turn, from a solid or liquid into vapor or gas. 2. To destroy something completely, as by extreme heat or an explosion.
to convert a solid substance directly into gas without passing through liquid phase

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical state changes from liquid or solid into gas/vapor, as well as the figurative disappearance, dissipation, or total annihilation of abstract entities.
groups.summary_zh: 由液/固态转化为气体，或具象/抽象化消散湮灭。

groups.name: Vibrate & Agitate · 震频与撼动 (Vibrate, Jar, Rattle)
groups.tip: 高频振动摇晃不止

items.def_en: to move loosely inside a container or room, repeatedly striking the sides with short sharp sounds
[I/T] to make a series of short, sharp knocking sounds while shaking loosely
To shake continuously with very small, rapid movements, or to cause something to do so.
to shake slightly and quickly, typically from cold or momentary dread
[I/T] to move unsteadily from side to side because of lack of balance
(+ sth) to move or cause sth to move rapidly back and forth with agitating motion
[I/T] to hit or shake something with a sudden, harsh, painful impact

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail the acoustic, mechanical, or impact-driven manner of oscillatory motion. 'Vibrate' emphasizes rapid high-frequency pulses, 'rattle' involves loose objects knocking with clattering sound, and 'jar' highlights a harsh, jarring shock.
groups.summary_zh: 着眼于机械高频震动、撞击震撼或伴随杂音的特定摇动方式。

groups.name: Wake & Awaken · 苏醒与唤醒 (Wake, Awake, Awaken)
groups.tip: 由睡梦中清醒或叫醒

items.def_en: [I/T] To stop sleeping and become conscious of one's surroundings
To emerge from sleep, or to cause someone to stop sleeping.
(formal or literary) To stop sleeping, or cause someone to stop sleeping; to awaken or rouse.
to regain consciousness after sleep or fainting
(+ sb) to awaken someone from sleep or a state of complete inactivity
[I/T] To arouse from sleep, or stimulate an emotion, memory, or faculty
[I/T] To bring out of state of sleep, unconsciousness, or inactivity by active effort

groups.summary_en: Living beings emerge from sleep, unconsciousness, or spiritual dormancy, progressing from simple physiological rousing to deep moral or intellectual awakening.
groups.summary_zh: 从睡眠或麻木昏睡中醒转，由生理醒来渐至意识觉醒。

groups.name: Walk Clumsily & Shufflingly · 笨拙拖步与蹒跚挪动 (Bumble, Shamble)
groups.tip: 脚步不稳摇晃拖沓的走姿

items.def_en: to walk with heavy, slow, shuffling steps
(+ along/away) to walk by dragging one's feet along the ground without lifting them fully

items.def_zh: 踉跄，摇晃慢行；笨手笨脚地做；含糊结巴地说
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/along) To move awkwardly, clumsily, or unsteadily. 2. To act or work in a confused, incompetent way. 3. To speak indistinctly or stammer.
1. (+ along/into) To walk slowly and awkwardly without lifting your feet properly, as if tired or weak.
to walk or move ahead clumsily, awkwardly, or unsteadily

items.def_zh: 磕磕绊绊地盲目走；跌跌撞撞
items.def_en: (+ into/around) to move clumsily or blindly as if unable to see or control oneself

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地走；笨拙前行
items.def_en: (+ along/on) to walk slowly and heavily without grace or agility

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail moving with awkward, clumsy, or slow dragging strides, typically showing physical lethargy, confusion, or lack of coordination. 'Shamble' specifically captures dragging the feet in an awkward, shuffling gait, while 'bumble' emphasizes clumsy, blundering movements through space.
groups.summary_zh: 指动作迟缓拖沓、拖着脚步或跌跌撞撞的笨拙走动姿态。

groups.name: Warn & Advise of Danger · 告诫与预警 (Warn, Caution, Admonish)
groups.tip: 预先提醒注意可能的危险

items.def_en: to inform someone in advance of a possible danger, problem, or unpleasant situation
(+ to) to warn someone of a potential problem, hazard, or new development so they are prepared
(+ sb) to give secret or advance warning to sb about impending danger or police action
(+ sb) to order or advise sb strongly to stay away or not get involved in danger
to warn or advise someone carefully about a danger, risk, or mistake
(+ against/to) to advise or urge someone earnestly, warning them firmly of an error or danger
to warn someone specifically before a dangerous or unwelcome event occurs

groups.summary_en: An authority or peer alerts someone in advance about impending danger, negative consequences, or unacceptable conduct, urging care or avoidance.
groups.summary_zh: 提前就潜在危险、不良后果或不当行为向当事人发出提醒与警示。

groups.name: Waste Away & Wither · 衰竭与消沉 (Wither, Languish, Collapse)
groups.tip: 体能衰竭垮掉或身心萎靡不振

items.def_en: to gradually lose physical strength, energy, or endurance

items.def_zh: 枯萎消沉；渐渐虚脱衰竭
items.def_en: to become progressively weak, enervated, or exhausted, losing physical vitality
to lose vigor, strength, or fresh vitality gradually
1. (informal, often crock up) To collapse or break down due to illness, fatigue, or injury. 2. (informal) To injure or incapacitate someone.

items.def_zh: 衰弱，憔悴；受煎熬，长期陷于困境
items.def_en: (+ in) 1. To grow weak, feeble, or listless. 2. To be forced to stay in an unpleasant situation or place for a long time.
to gradually become very thin, frail, and weak from illness or neglect
to suddenly fall down unconscious or utterly break down in health

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the progressive physical wasting, moral enervation, or sudden failure of bodily vitality, scaling from chronic debilitation and dispirited fading to total sudden physical breakdown.
groups.summary_zh: 按生命力丧失程度递增描述机体日渐衰弱、消沉乃至轰然垮掉。

groups.name: Weave & Braid · 编织与交错 (Weave, Braid, Plait)
groups.tip: 多股线缕穿插编成辫状

items.def_en: (+ sth) to interweave strands of hair or fiber together into plaits or braids
(+ sth) to introduce or incorporate threads or strands into an existing woven arrangement
[I/T] To form fabric or structure by interlacing threads or flexible strands at right angles
To interweave three or more strands of hair, ribbon, or wire together
1. (chiefly British) To weave three or more strands of hair, straw, or rope together into a braid. 2. To form material into pleats.
1. (+ with) To weave, cross, or blend threads, branches, or elements over and under each other.
[I/T] To weave or blend together tightly and complexly, whether physically or metaphorically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict interlacing flexible strands, threads, fibers, or hair into a cohesive fabric, rope, or patterned arrangement. 'Plait' and 'braid' center on overlapping three or more strands into a band, while 'weave' and 'interlace' cover broader crossing-over structures.
groups.summary_zh: 将线股、毛发或柔性材料交错穿插编织成网状或辫状。

groups.name: Wring & Twist · 拧绞与扭捏 (Wring, Twist)
groups.tip: 旋转拧转纤维挤绞出水分

items.def_en: to bend or turn something around forcibly with a rotating motion

items.def_zh: 拧，绞，拧干；扭，勒；勒索，强行取得
items.def_en: 1. To twist and squeeze something tightly to extract liquid from it. 2. To clasp and twist one's hands in distress. 3. To obtain something with difficulty or by force.
(+ sth) to remove or separate something by rotating and twisting it with force

items.def_zh: 把（衣物等）拧干，绞出（水分）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to squeeze and twist something wet forcefully with hands to extract liquid
to pull or twist something suddenly and violently with great force
to pull or twist something forcefully away from someone's grip

items.def_zh: 拧，绞，拧干（wring的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of wring; twisted tightly or squeezed liquid out.

groups.summary_en: An agent applies opposing torsional force to compress, twist, or extract liquid from a flexible material or body part. Intensity moves from rhythmic squeezing to forceful twisting that causes structural strain or pain.
groups.summary_zh: 双手施加反向扭力，通过绞拧挤出液体或致使部位受扭受压。

groups.name: Abandon & Desert · 抛弃与遗弃 (Desert, Forsake, Jettison)
groups.tip: 主动放弃权利或所有物

items.def_en: To discard or ignore someone or something because they are no longer useful or interesting
To get rid of or part company with someone or something quickly and without ceremony

items.def_zh: 放弃（权利、主张）；抛弃，遗弃
items.def_en: 1. To give up a claim, right, or belief completely. 2. To leave someone or something behind, often permanently or with no intention of returning.
To leave someone or a military post without permission and with no intention of returning
To abandon someone you have a moral duty to, or permanently give up a cherished way of life
To discard unwanted cargo from a craft, or get rid of plans and ideas abruptly

groups.summary_en: This frame captures completely turning one's back on dependents, possessions, or long-held commitments, leaving them behind to fend for themselves or discarding them entirely.
groups.summary_zh: 指彻底撇下、背弃或扔掉人、物或使命，使其自生自灭。

groups.name: Abolish & Annul · 废除与废黜 (Repeal, Annul, Overturn)
groups.tip: 彻底废除陈旧陋习或法令

items.def_en: To officially cause a statute or legislative act to lose its legal force by legislative action
To reverse, vacate, or override a prior judicial ruling, legal precedent, or official outcome
To officially declare an indictment, legal verdict, or subpoena legally invalid and set it aside

items.def_zh: 宣告无效（婚姻、合约、判决）
items.def_en: To declare a contract, marriage, law, or election officially null and void as if it never existed

items.def_zh: 废除，废止（法律、制度或习俗）
items.def_en: To officially end a law, system, practice, or institution.
To officially end, revoke, or evade an authoritative agreement, treaty, or formal duty

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this high-intensity institutional frame designate formally and permanently dismantling laws, long-standing practices, judicial decisions, or historic institutions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、法律或政府机构彻底推翻、废除法令与体制。

groups.name: Abrade & Roughen · 粗糙与打磨糙化 (Rough, Scuff, Coarsen, Chafe)
groups.tip: 表面经磨蚀变得糙硬不平

items.def_en: To intentionally or accidentally mark and scratch up a surface to reduce slickness

items.raw_cluster: 使粗糙与变粗 Rough & Coarsen
items.def_zh: 使粗糙，打毛；粗暴对待；草拟
items.def_en: 1. To make a surface uneven, coarse, or textured. 2. ('rough up') To treat someone violently.
To scrape, scratch, or roughen the surface of shoes, furniture, or floors through friction
To scrape or wear away the smooth surface or skin of something through rigorous friction
To cause a texture, skin, or fabric to become rough, hard, or harsh to the touch
To make something sore or wear its surface rough by repetitive friction and rubbing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate modifying the texture of a surface to make it coarse, uneven, or abrasive, whether intentionally (e.g., to prepare for adhesion) or through wear, friction, and elemental exposure.
groups.summary_zh: 通过摩擦、擦刮或物理加工使光滑表面变糙、起毛或出现划痕磨损。

groups.name: Abscond & Bolt · 潜逃与逃逸 (Abscond, Decamp, Skip)
groups.tip: 迅速逃离危险或避开抓捕

items.def_en: To make a rapid, evasive escape from a difficult or threatening predicament rather than face it

items.def_zh: 溜走；不告而别（逃避账单或责任）
items.def_en: (+ on) To leave hurriedly or secretly, especially to avoid paying a bill or fulfilling a duty

items.def_zh: 逃跑（尤指为赖债而潜逃）
items.def_en: (archaic) To run away secretly to avoid paying gambling or financial debts.
To leave a place suddenly, secretly, or unexpectedly, often to escape an unwelcome obligation
To suddenly dash away out of control or in panic to evade detention or danger
To escape secretly and hide, especially after stealing money or to evade the law

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe running away secretly, abruptly, or furtively, almost always to evade debt, prosecution, capture, or obligations. They convey illicit stealth, hurried flight, or breaking parole.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为逃避债务、惩罚或抓捕而秘密、仓促地潜逃。

groups.name: Absent & Avoid · 缺席与回避 (Withdraw, Stay Away, Skive)
groups.tip: 有意不参加或避开

items.def_en: (+ of) Leave abruptly or evade an obligation or engagement
(+ from) Not go to a place where you are expected or intended to be
Fail to attend a class, meeting, or scheduled duty intentionally
('absent oneself') To stay away from a place or event where you are expected to be.
Stay away from school or duties without permission
Avoid or neglect a duty, responsibility, or effort out of laziness or fear

groups.summary_en: Denotes deliberately or improperly avoiding a duty, gathering, or workplace, absenting oneself from an expected presence.
groups.summary_zh: 指擅自缺席本应参加的场合、逃避义务或故意不到场。

groups.name: Accelerate & Expedite · 促进与加速 (Expedite, Accelerate, Quicken)
groups.tip: 扫除流程障碍，加快运行节奏

items.def_en: Move or progress at a faster rate, or make something happen more rapidly
Cause an event or outcome to occur sooner than expected
Make or become faster, more active, or more alert
Increase the speed of a process, event, or vehicle; cause to happen sooner
(formal) to make a process, delivery, or action happen faster and more efficiently

items.def_zh: 促发；猛烈促成（危机或剧变）
items.def_en: Cause an undesirable event or crisis to happen suddenly, unexpectedly, or prematurely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate speeding up the progress, movement, or completion of an action, process, or legal transaction.
groups.summary_zh: 指人为干预或外力介入，使过程、审批或速度显著提速增效。

groups.name: Accompany & Escort · 陪伴与护送 (Convoy, Chaperone, Tag Along)
groups.tip: 陪同在旁或随行护送

items.def_en: (+ with) To accompany someone, especially without being explicitly invited or needed
to travel or go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to happen or exist at the same time as something
To politely guide, lead, or conduct someone to their proper seat or destination
To accompany someone socially to ensure proper behavior and welfare, usually a young person
To travel with someone in order to guide, protect, or supervise them
To accompany ships, vehicles, or travelers as an armed escort for safety

groups.summary_en: This frame covers traveling in company with another entity, spanning formal protective escorts, social guidance, and casual joint travel.
groups.summary_zh: 指与他人结伴同行，涵括礼节陪伴、保卫护送及跟随照管。

groups.name: Acquire Knowledge & Master · 研习与习得 (Acquire, Master, Absorb)
groups.tip: 从初学者到彻底掌握

items.def_en: Acquire a skill, language, or piece of knowledge casually without formal instruction

items.def_zh: 学习，研习；得知，获悉（learn 的英式过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: (chiefly British English) A past tense and past participle form of learn: to gain knowledge or skill through study, practice, or experience.
Gain knowledge, an ability, or a skill through continuous effort or experience
Take in and fully understand information, ideas, or complex facts
Attain a firm or comprehensive understanding of a concept or subject
Acquire complete knowledge of or proficiency in an art, subject, or technique

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the process of gaining knowledge, comprehension, or skill through cognitive exertion or experience. Verbs range from broad acquisition to effortless internal absorption and total command.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过认知努力或经历吸收知识与技能，涵盖从初步领会到精通掌握的程度。

groups.name: Adapt & Accommodate · 适应与顺应 (Adjust, Conform, Reconcile)
groups.tip: 调整自身以配合他人需求

items.def_en: To change your behavior, expectations, or ideas so as to fit a new situation or environment
To gradually modify behavior, structure, or methods to suit different conditions or purposes

items.def_zh: 顺从，赞同（他人意愿或计划）
items.def_en: To accept, agree with, or adapt to someone else's plan, idea, or suggestion without resistance

items.def_zh: 使顺应，使适应；迎合；容纳；向……提供便利
items.def_en: 1. To adjust, adapt, or change behavior to fit new conditions or satisfy needs. 2. To provide space, shelter, or lodging for someone.
(+ to/with) To behave according to the usual standards, rules, or expectations of a group
(reconcile oneself to) To accept an unpleasant situation or compromise that cannot be changed

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to modifying one's behavior, ideas, or policies to fit changing circumstances, rules, or the needs of others. They range from mutual compromise to unidirectional compliance.
groups.summary_zh: 调整自身行为或安排以符合外部变化或他人需求。

groups.name: Address & Confront · 处理与应对 (Address, Confront, Grapple with)
groups.tip: 直面并着手解决问题

items.def_en: To give attention to or deal with a matter or problem directly
To take vigorous action to reduce, stop, or defeat an undesirable problem

items.def_zh: 着手处理，应对（难题）；阻截，扑倒，抢断（对手）
items.def_en: 1. To make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem or situation. 2. (sports) To intercept, stop, or knock down an opposing player.
To face and deal with a difficult situation or opponent bravely or directly
To struggle hard to deal with or solve a difficult problem
To accept a difficult challenge, duty, or fight against an opponent

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking determined, head-on action to manage, solve, or confront difficult challenges, crises, or systemic problems.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动、果断地正视并设法化解棘手困难、危机或复杂问题。

groups.name: Address & Greet · 致辞与向……进言 (Salute, Pitch, Speak To)
groups.tip: 面对特定受众发表演讲致辞

items.def_zh: 向……演说，致辞；设法解决，处理；称呼
items.def_en: 1. To make a formal speech to a group of people. 2. To direct attention and effort toward dealing with a problem or issue.
(+ to) To present an idea, proposal, or speech aimed directly at persuading a target listener
To communicate directly with a gathering, or speak publicly addressing a designated body
To call out to attract someone's attention or greet them enthusiastically from a distance
To honor or formally greet an assembly or distinguished individual with respectful words
To approach and speak to someone boldly, abruptly, or aggressively

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict directing a formal utterance, greetings, or tailored message specifically toward a designated person, crowd, or assembly.
groups.summary_zh: 指正式面向特定受众开口发话、致词或进言阐述。

groups.name: Admit & Acknowledge · 承认与招认 (Acknowledge, Admit, Confess)
groups.tip: 从被动认错到正式坦承事实

items.def_en: To admit or confess to having done something wrong, especially something minor or mischievous

items.def_zh: 承认，供认（常指勉强或因证据确凿）
items.def_en: To agree, often reluctantly or under pressure, that something is true or that one has done something wrong

items.def_zh: 坦白认错，对过失承担责任
items.def_en: (+ to) To admit responsibility for an error, misconduct, or unpleasant fact

items.def_zh: 承认（属实）；告知收到；向……致谢
items.def_en: 1. To accept, admit, or recognize the truth or existence of something. 2. To confirm receipt of a letter or message. 3. To express gratitude for assistance or work done.
(+ about/with) To finally tell the whole truth about something previously concealed or lied about

items.def_zh: 坦白，供认（过错、罪行或秘密）
items.def_en: To admit formally or openly that one has committed a crime, sin, or embarrassing fault

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe explicitly accepting the truth, reality, or responsibility of a situation or fault, ranging from matter-of-fact recognition to guilt-driven confession.
groups.summary_zh: 从客观认可事实到主动招认过失或罪责的表态行为。

groups.name: Adopt & Embrace · 接纳与采纳 (Embrace, Espouse, Buy into)
groups.tip: 欣然接受建议或收养为家庭成员

items.def_en: To accept or support an idea, philosophy, or premise, agreeing to align with it
To accept or start using a proposed idea, method, challenge, or career path

items.def_zh: 采纳，采用；收养，领养；正式通过（动议、提案）
items.def_en: 1. To choose to take up or follow an idea, method, or policy. 2. To legally take another's child as one's own. 3. To formally accept or approve a proposal.
To absorb, integrate, and incorporate people, concepts, or customs into a larger group
To accept, support, or take up an idea, belief, or lifestyle readily and enthusiastically
To actively support, champion, or adhere to a cause, doctrine, or belief system

groups.summary_en: Focuses on welcoming, officially choosing, or enthusiastically taking up beliefs, policies, practices, or outsiders. 'Adopt' centers on institutional or conscious selection, while 'embrace' highlights emotional and enthusiastic acceptance.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动接纳外来者，或欣然采纳新的观念、制度与方针。

groups.name: Affirm & Assert · 断言与确认声明 (Assert, Maintain, Attest)
groups.tip: 坚定确切地陈述事实或立场

items.def_en: To keep stating strongly that something is true, despite opposition or doubt
To affirm or assert something positively, often guaranteeing its authenticity
To state a fact or belief firmly, positively, and with strong conviction

items.def_zh: 断言，坚定声明；证实，确认
items.def_en: To state clearly and firmly that something is true or valid.
To provide or act as clear proof that something exists or is true
To state or assert firmly and formally that something is indeed true

groups.summary_en: This frame covers communicative acts where a speaker solemnly, confidently, or legally states that a fact is undoubtedly true. 'Assert' emphasizes forceful confidence, 'affirm' suggests formal validation or confirmation, and 'attest' implies bearing witness or furnishing proof.
groups.summary_zh: 指正式、坚定且确凿地宣称、证实或陈述某事为真。

groups.name: Afford & Provide · 负担与提供 (Furnish, Yield, Supply)
groups.tip: 具备财力并供应所需

items.def_en: To make available or supply something that someone needs or desires.
To provide a sufficient amount of goods, materials, or energy for practical use.

items.def_zh: 买得起，担负得起；提供，给予
items.def_en: 1. To have enough money, time, or resources to be able to buy or do something. 2. (formal) To provide or supply something.
To produce, supply, or generate a result, profit, or natural resource.
To manage to find, supply, or produce money, resources, or an answer when required.
(+ with) To provide or supply someone with what is needed, useful, or necessary.

groups.summary_en: This frame spans two linked senses: possessing sufficient monetary or temporal resources to absorb an expenditure, and formally conferring or yielding a distinct benefit, opportunity, or protection to others.
groups.summary_zh: 指经济或时间上能承受支出，或引申为正式提供、赋予某种条件。

groups.name: Age & Obsolete · 老化与废弃 (Date, Superannuate, Outmode)
groups.tip: 年岁渐长过时陈旧终遭淘汰

items.def_en: Show signs of age or obsolescence, or reveal the specific past era when something was made
Gradually stop using, producing, or operating something obsolete in stages

items.def_zh: 因年老废弃；使退休淘汰
items.def_en: Retire someone with a pension or declare an old object or machine obsolete from long service
(formal) To make something obsolete, outmoded, or old-fashioned.
Cause something to become out of date or no longer fashionable or usable
Take the place of a person or thing previously in authority or use, making it obsolete

groups.summary_en: Addresses the process of rendering something old-fashioned, outdated, or superseded by new technology and modern standards.
groups.summary_zh: 指技术、制度或事物随时间推移或新事物诞生而过时、老化或被淘汰。

groups.name: Aggravate & Worsen · 加剧与恶化 (Exacerbate, Compound, Intensify)
groups.tip: 不良状况多重叠加而愈发严重

items.def_en: To make an existing illness, injury, or unpleasant situation worse
To become more serious, severe, or acute, especially of crises or conflicts
To become worse, or to make something worse than it was before

items.def_zh: 使加重，使恶化；混合，化合
items.def_en: 1. To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse. 2. To combine two or more parts or substances to form a whole.
To make or become significantly greater, more serious, or more intense

items.def_zh: 使恶化；加重（痛苦、危机等）
items.def_en: To make a bad situation, disease, or problem much worse or more severe

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe making an already difficult, painful, or negative situation substantially worse by adding new complications or increasing severity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过叠加问题或提升严重性，使既有的不良局面、痛苦或矛盾进一步恶化。

groups.name: Agree & Accede · 赞同与允诺 (Assent, Concur, Yield)
groups.tip: 从日常赞同到正式应允同意

items.def_en: (+ in/to) To accept or agree to something passively, without arguing or showing active enthusiasm
(+ to) To give permission for something to happen, or agree formally to do something
(+ with) To share someone's opinion or agree with an official decision
(+ to) To express formal or official agreement to a suggestion, proposal, or request

items.def_zh: 同意，应允；就任，登基；正式加入
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) (formal) To agree to a request, demand, or proposal. 2. (+ to) To take up a high office, title, or the throne. 3. (+ to) To formally become a member of an organization or sign a treaty.
(+ to) To reluctantly agree to a demand or request after initially refusing or resisting

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey formal or reluctant agreement to a request, proposal, or dominant opinion. Nuances range from dignified yielding to formal diplomatic consensus or passive acquiescence.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在经过考量、请求或压力后正式赞成、顺从或允诺他人主张。

groups.name: Alternative & Secondary Employment · 兼职与自主从业 (Freelance, Moonlight, Side-hustle)
groups.tip: 从事自由职业或夜间兼职

items.def_en: to work as a temporary employee, typically in an office setting

items.def_zh: 转包兼职；作为替工工作
items.def_en: (+ sth) to subcontract work or work as an outside substitute contractor
to do separate pieces of work or odd jobs for various employers

items.def_zh: 从事自由职业，做自由兼职
items.def_en: to work independently for various clients rather than being employed full-time by a single employer.

items.def_zh: 兼职，打第二份工（尤指夜间或瞒着雇主兼职）
items.def_en: (informal) to work at a second job, often at night and without the main employer's knowledge.
to undertake secondary work or a side business to earn extra income

groups.summary_en: Depicts working outside regular, single-employer full-time contracts. 'Freelance' denotes operating as an independent contractor for various clients, while 'moonlight' explicitly involves holding a secondary, often covert night or weekend job alongside a primary one.
groups.summary_zh: 脱离传统单一全职劳动关系的自由接单或秘密兼职副业。

groups.name: Ameliorate & Alleviate · 好转与纾解 (Ameliorate, Alleviate, Mitigate)
groups.tip: 由差变好或使境况有所改善

items.def_en: To make pain, tension, or hardship less severe or gradually decrease
To reduce the harshness, severity, or harmful effects of something
To make suffering, deficiency, or severe problems less intense or severe
To make a bad, unpleasant, or painful situation better and more tolerable
1. To make or become better; to improve.
To cause a failing situation, business, or economy to become successful and healthy again

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on transforming bad, distressing, or substandard conditions into more tolerable, humane, or positive states.
groups.summary_zh: 指改善恶劣现状、减轻痛苦困境或使情势好转。

groups.name: Anchor & Ground · 固定与扎根 (Ground, Anchor, Root)
groups.tip: 将底部固牢立定防止倾倒

items.def_en: To attach or secure one thing firmly to another so that it will not come loose

items.def_zh: 使稳固，牢固确立；使停飞；使搁浅；罚（孩子）不准出门
items.def_en: 1. To base something firmly on facts, principles, or solid ground. 2. To prevent an aircraft or pilot from flying. 3. To cause a boat or ship to run aground. 4. To punish a child by forbidding them to go out.
To fix something firmly in position so that it cannot move, or establish a firm psychological or moral basis
To tie a boat or vehicle securely with ropes or an anchor to the shore or ground
(+ in) To fix something firmly into a place, tradition, or origin so it develops deep ties
To fix an object or concept firmly and deeply into a surrounding mass or solid context

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe securing an entity firmly to a foundation, bedrock, or fixed physical substrate to prevent drift or displacement. Figuratively, they describe basing arguments, principles, or individuals deeply in concrete realities and cultural roots.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体或理念深植、固定于稳固基底以防漂移晃荡。

groups.name: Animal Bleats & Yelps · 羊啼与犬吠 (Baa, Bleat, Yelp)
groups.tip: 禽兽虫鸟发出的叫声鸣响

items.def_en: 1. When a sheep or lamb baas, it makes its characteristic bleating cry.
1. When a small dog or puppy yips, it lets out short, sharp, high-pitched barks.
to make the typical wavering cry of a sheep or goat
(+ sth) to utter a sudden, sharp, high-pitched cry of pain, distress, or excitement
to bark continuously with sharp, annoying, high-pitched snaps
to give a sudden, short, high-pitched cry of pain or alarm

groups.summary_en: Animals such as sheep, goats, or canines utter brief, species-typical cries communicating distress, demand, pain, or social calls. Verbs denote distinct timbres ranging from dull bleating to sharp, high-pitched yelping.
groups.summary_zh: 羊或犬科动物发出短促高亢的叫声，用于呼叫同伴、发出惊叫或表达伤痛。

groups.name: Announce & Proclaim · 宣告与公布 (Proclaim, Declare, Broadcast)
groups.tip: 从日常通知到庄严正式宣告

items.def_en: To make something known publicly and officially; to declare or broadcast information.
To announce something clearly, firmly, and publicly
To tell a piece of news to a lot of people; disseminate information widely
To state something officially, ceremonially, or with authority
To announce or signal that something important or good is about to happen
To state something officially, publicly, and emphatically, often with legal authority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the communicative act of transmitting official declarations, solemn statements, or important news openly and authoritatively to the public.
groups.summary_zh: 公开、权威且正式地向公众宣告或广播消息。

groups.name: Answer & Reply · 问答与答复 (Answer, Reply, Retort)
groups.tip: 对疑问作出应答与正式回复

items.def_zh: 回答，答复；响应，应对；符合，适应
items.def_en: 1. To say, write, or do something in return to a question, letter, or call. 2. To match, correspond to, or satisfy a need or description.

items.def_zh: 回答，答复；做出回应，反击
items.def_en: 1. To say, write, or do something as an answer to what someone has said, asked, or done.
[I/T] to send a written letter or message in answer to one received
(informal) to send a reply or communication back to an inquirer
(+ sb) to reply or answer, often impudently or argumentatively, to a speaker
to reply insolently or disrespectfully to someone in authority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this core question-and-answer dialogue frame center specifically on supplying a verbal or written statement to satisfy a question, letter, summons, or direct inquiry.
groups.summary_zh: 针对收到的提问、信函、传唤或呼叫给出直接回答或书面答复。

groups.name: Apply & Exert · 运用与施加 (Exert, Wield, Exercise)
groups.tip: 施加力量或运用能力

items.def_en: to bring a physical force, law, or rule into direct practical contact or use
to make use of one's rights, skills, discretion, or patience
to put resources, arguments, or capabilities into action effectively
to apply force, influence, or resources firmly to solve an issue or affect an outcome
to hold and use effectively power, influence, or authority

items.def_zh: 施加（影响、压力等），运用（力量）；竭力，努力
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/over) To use power, influence, or physical force to achieve an effect. 2. ('exert oneself') To make a strong physical or mental effort.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate bringing force, pressure, authority, or specialized capabilities to bear on someone or something to produce a desired outcome.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动施加压力、动用权力或发挥某种能力以达到目的。

groups.name: Apportion & Ration · 分发与配给 (Allot, Ration, Parcel)
groups.tip: 按份拆分发放到人

items.def_en: To divide food or resources into servings or shares and distribute them
(often 'portion out') To divide something into parts or servings and distribute them.
To assign a specific amount, share, or time to someone for a particular purpose
To divide and distribute parts of something among people according to a plan or proportion
To distribute or administer something, especially punishment, rewards, or harsh treatment
To limit the amount of a scarce commodity that someone is allowed to have

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on dividing a limited pool of resources, tasks, or provisions into measured, calculated shares among recipients. They highlight fairness, scarcity, or systematic allocation.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将有限资源、份额或定量配额精准、有计划地分给各个对象。

groups.name: Apprehend & Collar · 逮捕与擒获 (Apprehend, Collar, Nab)
groups.tip: 警方突然出击当场捉拿归案

items.def_en: To bring a suspect into a police station or court for questioning or custody
(informal) To arrest someone and take them to a police station
(informal) To arrest someone or raid a place for illegal activity
(informal) To capture or arrest someone, especially by surprising them or catching them red-handed
To catch and arrest someone who has committed a crime, especially after a search

items.def_zh: 捉拿，当场逮捕；一把抓取，夺得
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To catch and arrest a criminal, especially unexpectedly. 2. (informal) To take, grab, or get something quickly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to taking a suspect or criminal into custody by seizing them directly, ranging from colloquial catchphrases to formal law enforcement procedures.
groups.summary_zh: 指警方或执法力量依法或当场拘捕、擒获嫌疑人。

groups.name: Approve & Ratify · 批准与认可 (Ratify, Endorse, Sanction)
groups.tip: 官方立法确认并正式批准

items.def_en: To give official legal power or formal permission for someone to do something

items.def_zh: 不加审查地照批，走过场批准
items.def_en: To approve an official measure or decision routinely and mechanically without critical scrutiny
To give formal and final approval or confirmation to a project, expense, or decision
To give official, binding permission or formal legal approval for an action
To express public, authoritative approval and support for a proposal, candidate, or plan

items.def_zh: 正式批准，签署生效（条约、协议等）
items.def_en: To make an agreement, treaty, or amendment officially valid by signing or voting for it.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on formal acts of giving legal, legislative, or institutional authority and binding assent to treaties, agreements, or appointments.
groups.summary_zh: 强调机关或法权层面赋予公约、法案或提案法律效力。

groups.name: Arbitrate & Preside Competitions · 裁判与执法裁断 (Judge, Referee, Adjudicate)
groups.tip: 法官或裁判依法决断

items.def_zh: 裁判，裁决，评定；审理，判决；判断，评价
items.def_en: 1. To decide the result of a competition, contest, or show as a judge. 2. (law) To formally try a legal case or hear someone in a court of law. 3. To form an opinion or conclusion about someone or something.

items.def_zh: 当裁判，为……担任裁判；审阅，评审（学术论文等）
items.def_en: 1. To act as the official referee in a sports match to ensure the rules are obeyed. 2. (academic) To evaluate and review a scholarly article or book before publication.

items.def_zh: 为……当裁判，当裁判；仲裁，公断
items.def_en: 1. To act as the official judge enforcing the rules in sports such as baseball, tennis, or cricket; to arbitrate or decide a dispute.

items.def_zh: 担任裁判；主持赛事/仪式
items.def_en: (+ at/in) to act as an official in charge of a sports match or formal proceeding

items.def_zh: 判决，裁决，裁定；担任（赛事等的）评判
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/between) To act as a judge in a competition, dispute, or legal case and make a formal decision.
[I/T] to officially judge and settle a dispute between two dissenting parties
