groups.summary_en: Verbs in this institutional frame describe serving as an official arbiter, applying formal rules to evaluate contestants, oversee sporting matches, or deliver binding legal or administrative verdicts.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方裁决人员依规主持竞赛评判、体育执法或作出正式裁定。

groups.name: Archive & Record · 存档与记录 (Chronicle, Document, Log, Catalog)
groups.tip: 将历史资料收录建档保存

items.def_en: To record the details of an event or process formally in writing or media
To enter systematic facts, times, or events into an official record or register
To place or store historical records, documents, or electronic data in an archive.
To put documents or records into an orderly collection or storage system for later use
To record a series of events in a detailed, factual, and chronological way
To make a complete, classified, and descriptive list of items or materials

groups.summary_en: This scenario involves systematically preserving information, historical artifacts, or governance transactions for perpetuity and retrievability. Actions emphasize authenticity, structure, and formal documentation.
groups.summary_zh: 指按规范对历史数据、文件或事项进行系统建档、编目与长期保存。

groups.name: Arise & Emerge · 出现与产生 (Arise, Emerge, Crop up)
groups.tip: 问题或现象逐渐浮现

items.def_en: to become evident or visible after having been hidden or dormant
to become apparent, prominent, or known through inquiry or gradual revelation

items.def_zh: 出现，浮现；发生，产生；起身
items.def_en: 1. to begin to exist, emerge, or become noticeable. 2. to get up or stand up.
to appear, occur, or come to light unexpectedly or inconveniently
to arise, occur, or be brought into consideration unexpectedly or naturally
to appear, develop, or emerge suddenly and in noticeable numbers

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify intangible matters (problems, questions, opportunities, or disputes) coming into existence, coming to notice, or developing out of a preceding situation. 'Arose' is the simple past of arise.
groups.summary_zh: 特指抽象事物（如问题、机遇、争执等）产生、浮现或显露出来。

groups.name: Arm & Equip · 武装与配备 (Arm, Equip, Weaponize)
groups.tip: 配置武器设备充实战力

items.def_en: To supply someone or oneself with weapons or equipment needed for defense or attack
To provide someone or an organization with a complete set of clothes, armor, or specialized equipment
To provide a person, group, or vehicle with the necessary tools, machinery, or gear for a specific purpose
To supply a ship, vehicle, or facility with essential machinery, weapons, or supplies
To equip or adapt an area, civilian police force, or resource for military purposes

items.def_zh: 将…改造为武器；使武器化
items.def_en: 1. To adapt or develop something (such as a technology, chemical agent, or issue) into a weapon to attack or gain advantage.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying individuals, military units, or devices with weapons, tactical gear, or offensive capability. While 'equip' broadly covers necessary operational gear, 'arm' and 'weaponize' focus specifically on offensive or combative readiness.
groups.summary_zh: 指为人员或组织配备武器装备或使某物具备攻击性功能。

groups.name: Arrest & Apprehend · 拘捕与缉拿 (Apprehend, Arrest, Detain)
groups.tip: 执法人员缉拿控制犯罪嫌疑人

items.def_en: To seize someone by legal authority and take them into custody on suspicion of a crime
To catch a fleeing suspect or enemy through pursuit or force
(informal) To raid or catch someone in the act of committing a crime and arrest them
To take a suspect into custody for questioning or arrest
To keep someone in official custody, preventing them from leaving
1. (formal / law) To catch and arrest someone suspected of a crime. 2. (formal) To understand or perceive something.

groups.summary_en: This legal and policing frame denotes taking a suspect, offender, or fugitive into custody by lawful authority, depriving them of liberty for investigation or trial.
groups.summary_zh: 指执法机关依法抓捕、羁押或剥夺嫌疑人的人身自由。

groups.name: Ascend & Reach the Peak · 上升与攀达顶峰 (Rise, Ascend, Crest)
groups.tip: 由低处向高处升起或登顶

items.def_en: to climb up onto a higher surface, platform, or incline
1. to climb up, go up, or rise to a higher position. 2. to rise to a higher rank or position of authority.
to climb up a steep surface such as a rock face, mountain, or high wall

items.def_zh: 攀上……顶端；到达顶峰（或最高点）
items.def_en: to reach the top of a hill, mountain, or wave, or reach the highest level or point.
to reach the top of a mountain, cliff, or steep climb
[I/T] to successfully reach the peak of a high mountain

groups.summary_en: An entity moves upward along a gradient, slope, or vertical axis, culminating in reaching the absolute highest point. Verbs scale in intensity from gentle or standard upward progress ('ascend') to arduous clambering and finally topping the summit ('crest', 'crown').
groups.summary_zh: 沿着斜坡或高度向上攀登，直至到达顶峰或最高点。

groups.name: Ascend & Scale · 上升与攀登 (Ascend, Clamber, Scramble)
groups.tip: 沿坡度或垂直方向攀爬上升

items.def_en: To rise, move upward, or climb toward a higher point or level
To climb quickly up a pole, rope, or tree by grasping with arms and legs
To climb up or over a steep surface such as a wall or cliff
To move upward on a slope, steep surface, or vertical object using feet and usually hands; to go up gradually in altitude, amount, or level.
To climb hastily over rough, steep, or rocky ground using hands and feet
To climb or move with difficulty or awkwardness, using both hands and feet

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe upward physical movement, especially effortful negotiation of vertical or steep terrain using limbs or mechanical momentum. They range from formal upward progression to hurried, awkward scrambles.
groups.summary_zh: 强调借助肢体攀爬陡峭地形或向上移行的动作方式。

groups.name: Attest & Testify · 证实与作证 (Attest, Testify, Vouch, Witness)
groups.tip: 出具证据证实或立誓作证

items.def_en: To see an event personally, or formally sign a legal document to confirm its authenticity
(+ to) To serve as explicit evidence or testimony that proves a fact or state of affairs
To state emphatically or under oath that something is definitely true or accurate
(+ to) To make a formal statement of truth in court or provide clear proof of something
(formal) To confirm, show, or prove that something is true, genuine, or correct, often by giving evidence.
(+ for) To assert personal confidence in someone's integrity, character, or the truth of a claim

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing formal or direct evidence that confirms the truth, existence, or authenticity of something, typically grounded in personal knowledge or official authority.
groups.summary_zh: 基于个人见闻或权威出具证据，正式证实某事属实或有效。

groups.name: Attribute & Ascribe · 归因与归功 (Attribute, Ascribe, Impute)
groups.tip: 追溯缘由肯定功劳

items.def_zh: 归功于，把…归于；信任，相信；把（钱）存入账户
items.def_en: 1. to attribute something to someone or believe that they are responsible for an achievement 2. to believe or trust someone or something 3. to add an amount of money to someone's bank account
To say or believe that something is the result of a particular situation, event, or person's action
To consider that something is caused by something else, especially as a useful lesson or experience
To explain something by identifying a single main cause, such as luck or human failing
To consider that something is caused by a particular person, event, or condition
To claim that someone is guilty of an undesirable action or possesses a particular quality

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on identifying the source, cause, or authorship of an action, achievement, or condition. Nuances range from acknowledging laudable contributions to assigning blame or inferring causal links.
groups.summary_zh: 指将原因、功劳、作品归属于特定对象或渊源。

groups.name: Avoid & Steer Clear · 避开与远离 (Shun, Steer Clear, Bypass)
groups.tip: 位移以躲避碰触

items.def_en: To pass along the edge of something, or avoid dealing directly with a delicate subject
To go around a place, obstruction, or formal hurdle rather than going through it
(+ of) To keep entirely away from someone, something dangerous, or an awkward topic
To take proactive action to prevent an impending danger, injury, or misfortune from affecting you
1. To stay away from someone or keep out of the path of something. 2. To prevent something bad or undesirable from happening.
To persistently and deliberately avoid, reject, or keep away from someone or something

groups.summary_en: This frame covers staying away from people, objects, topics, or hazards deliberately to prevent contact, risk, or conflict. It highlights preventative spatial distancing or intentional social aversion.
groups.summary_zh: 主动保持空间或社交距离，防范风险、接触或冲突。

groups.name: Ban & Prohibit · 禁止与取缔 (Forbid, Outlaw, Disallow)
groups.tip: 严格划定红线遏制行动

items.def_en: To state clearly that someone is not allowed to do something

items.def_zh: 阻止；正式封阻（进入或参加）
items.def_en: (+ from) To officially prevent someone from entering a place, doing something, or participating
1. To forbid or prohibit something officially, or ban someone from doing something.
To formally, legally, or officially make an action or practice forbidden
To pass a law that renders an activity, group, or object completely illegal

items.def_zh: 正式下令禁止；截击禁运
items.def_en: To authoritatively or militarily forbid or intercept trade, movement, or prohibited activities

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal enactments of legal or institutional barriers that forbid certain actions, goods, or rights altogether, ranging from mild disallowance to statutory criminalization.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法规、条令或官方权威彻底取缔或全面禁止某种行为或事物。

groups.name: Bargain & Haggle · 讨价还价与磋商 (Bargain, Dicker, Chaffer)
groups.tip: 商讨交易价格并互不相让

items.def_en: To persuade a seller to reduce the price of an item
To compel a seller to accept a substantially lower price
To bargain or haggle back and forth in an argumentative or protracted way
(+ with/over) To negotiate the terms and conditions of a transaction or agreement
To argue back and forth, especially about the price of something or the terms of an agreement, in order to get a better deal.
(+ with/over) To engage in petty bargaining or dispute over minor terms

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe informal or contentious discussions over prices, terms, or conditions, typically involving back-and-forth concessions.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及在买卖或协议中反复交涉以压低价格或争取有利条件的动作。

groups.name: Beat It & Clear Out · 溜走与拔腿开溜 (Vamoose, Scram, Skedaddle)
groups.tip: 快速离去、溜走或撤离特定场景

items.def_en: to depart immediately, most often used as an imperative to get lost
to go away immediately, usually spoken angrily to disperse unwanted bystanders
to leave in a rush, especially in order to escape chase or punishment
to run away or retreat hurriedly and spontaneously
to leave a place immediately and quickly, frequently used as a blunt command
(informal) to depart or run away quickly

groups.summary_en: This informal and slang-rich motion frame describes leaving a place with extreme haste, abruptness, or evasiveness—often when ordered to disperse or when escaping detection. Verbs carry punchy, colloquial energy.
groups.summary_zh: 指匆忙、突然或逃避性地离开某地；多用于口语开溜或轰赶。

groups.name: Beget & Engender · 生育与滋生创造 (Beget, Engender, Sire)
groups.tip: 血脉延续，繁衍生息后代

items.def_en: To physically deliver offspring, or metaphorically produce a groundbreaking idea or movement
To produce or cause something new, prolific, or numerous to develop rapidly
To become the male parent of an animal or child
To cause, produce, or bring about a feeling, situation, or condition

items.def_zh: 生育，繁衍；引起，导致（beget的过去分词）
items.def_en: (archaic or formal) Past participle of beget: to father children; to bring into existence or cause.
To produce young or reproduce sexually through biological procreation

groups.summary_en: Encompasses generative acts bringing new life or abstract conditions into existence, ranging from paternal lineage and biological procreation to giving rise to complex systemic consequences.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖生物繁衍孕育生命，以及催生出抽象事件或后果的过程。

groups.name: Believe & Trust · 相信与信任 (Believe, Trust, Buy into)
groups.tip: 从主观相信到托付信任

items.def_en: 1. To accept something as true, genuine, or real. 2. (+ in) To have trust or confidence in someone or something.
To accept something as true or plausible despite initial doubt

items.def_zh: 轻信，盲目接受（谎言或借口）
items.def_en: To accept an improbable story, claim, or excuse without questioning it
To completely believe in or accept an idea, explanation, or philosophy, sometimes uncritically
To believe that someone is honest, dependable, or sincere and will not harm you
(+ in) To trust someone completely by sharing secret or intimate feelings and thoughts

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express epistemic commitment, accepting propositions as true, or placing personal reliance in someone's integrity. Differences span from intellectual assent to uncritical acceptance and deep faith.
groups.summary_zh: 表示认知上的确信、信任或轻信，涵盖从理性认同到全盘接纳。

groups.name: Bestow & Endow · 赠予与赋予 (Confer, Bestow, Grant)
groups.tip: 正式或慷慨地赋予资源

items.def_en: To officially give or allow someone something that they have asked for or deserve, such as permission, rights, or funds
To endow or present someone with a desirable attribute, talent, or material gift
(+ in/with) To confer legal power, authority, or rights officially upon someone

items.def_zh: 赋予，天生具有；资助，向……捐赠
items.def_en: 1. ('be endowed with') To naturally possess a good quality, talent, or feature. 2. To give a large sum of money to establish or provide an ongoing income for a school, hospital, or organization.
(+ upon/on) To officially grant an honor, degree, title, or right to someone
(+ upon/on) To present an honor, right, or gift to someone, emphasizing generosity or dignity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the formal, gracious, or providential transfer of intangible gifts, honors, privileges, or natural abilities, typically from a superior authority or nature itself to a recipient.
groups.summary_zh: 上位者、机构或大自然庄重赋予、赐予或授给某人荣誉、权利与天赋。

groups.name: Bid & Tender · 出价与投标 (Bid, Tender, Quote)
groups.tip: 拍卖或竞标中提议价格

items.def_en: To state the exact price at which one is willing to provide a product or service

items.def_zh: 出价，喊价；投标，竞标；努力争取
items.def_en: 1. To offer a particular price for something, especially at an auction or for a commercial contract. 2. (bid for/to do) To make an effort or attempt to achieve something.
(+ a bid/tender) To submit an official commercial proposal or bid for consideration
To make a formal written offer to supply goods or execute work at a specified rate
To submit an offer higher than another buyer in an auction or competitive sale
To submit a lower estimate or bid than a rival contractor in order to win business

groups.summary_en: This frame captures commercial interactions where parties submit formal, competitive price proposals or procurement offers to secure contracts, acquisitions, or auction lots. The communication is generally binding, structured, and comparative.
groups.summary_zh: 在拍卖、竞标或商业洽谈中正式提交报价或供标方案。

groups.name: Bleach & Whiten · 漂白与褪色 (Whiten, Decolor, Fade)
groups.tip: 化学漂白剥离表面色泽

items.def_en: To lose brightness, color, or vibrancy gradually, especially over time or from exposure to light
To remove the natural or artificial color from a chemical compound, liquid, or fabric
1. To make cloth, hair, or paper white or much lighter using chemicals or sunlight.
To make hair, fabric, or skin lighter or paler in tone
To make something white or lighter in color, or to become white

items.def_zh: 使发白；（因惊吓等）褪去血色
items.def_en: To strip of color, or to become pale, through shock, fear, or chemical/culinary treatment

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes where color is drained, chemically extracted, or naturally stripped away by sunlight and exposure, transforming surfaces into white, pale, or faded tones.
groups.summary_zh: 指经化学处理、日晒或氧化导致颜色褪去、泛白或变浅。

groups.name: Bless & Consecrate · 宗教祈福与圣仪 (Consecrate, Sanctify, Anoint)
groups.tip: 举行宗教仪式与祝福

items.def_zh: 为（产妇等）举行感恩礼拜，为……举行教会祝福仪式
items.def_en: To perform a special church service of thanksgiving and blessing for (especially a woman after childbirth).
To ask God or a divine power to protect, help, or favor someone or something
To perform a Christian ceremony welcoming someone into the church, typically using water
To smear or rub oil on someone as part of a religious ceremony to set them apart
To officially state in a religious ceremony that an object, place, or person is holy
To make something holy or free from sin through religious observance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate religious or ceremonial actions whereby individuals, places, or objects are blessed, cleansed, or made sacred according to spiritual traditions.
groups.summary_zh: 通过宗教仪式祈福、净化或使其神圣化。

groups.name: Blow & Gust · 吹拂与刮风 (Blow, Gust, Whistle)
groups.tip: 从微风轻拂到狂风大作

items.def_en: To pass by or subside without causing lasting damage; or to knock something over by wind force
To move along creating a current of air, or to be moved or carried along by the wind

items.def_zh: 吹，刮，被风吹走（blow 的过去分词）
items.def_en: (past participle of blow) To move creating an air current, or be moved or shaped by the wind.
To move violently or blow sharply with sudden, lash-like force
To blow with a loud, wailing, prolonged noise, typical of fierce storms
To blow in sudden, forceful, and brief rushes of wind

groups.summary_en: This frame covers natural atmospheric movements where currents of air sweep across spaces at varying intensities. It spans gentle drifting breezes to violent, howling gusts that drive loose objects before them.
groups.summary_zh: 指空气流动形成的风力吹拂或呼啸强风，涵盖微风到狂风掠过。

groups.name: Blunder & Slip Up · 犯低级错误与失态出丑 (Blunder, Slip up, Goof)
groups.tip: 认知偏差酿成严重差错

items.def_en: (British English, informal) To make a silly, embarrassing, or careless mistake.
(informal) To make a silly, careless, or clumsy blunder
To make a careless mistake or lapse in attention
To make a mistake, or cause someone to make an error or slip
(informal) To make a mess of something or make a serious error
To make a serious, clumsy, or thoughtless mistake

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey committing careless, clumsy, or noticeably embarrassing mistakes in action or speech, typically causing public mortification.
groups.summary_zh: 指因粗心或笨拙犯下低级、尴尬或愚蠢的差错，多带有出丑意味。

groups.name: Blush & Flush · 面红与泛红 (Blush, Flush, Crimson)
groups.tip: 面颊受刺激泛红发热

items.def_en: to become pink or red in the face because you are embarrassed
to become red or crimson in the face, typically from strong emotion
to suddenly become visibly red or heated in the face due to anger or embarrassment
to turn red in the face as a result of sudden embarrassment or emotion

items.def_zh: （脸）发红，使脸红；冲洗（抽水马桶、管道等）；奔流；惊飞
items.def_en: 1. (of a face) To become red because of embarrassment, anger, or heat. 2. To clean a toilet or pipe by sending a sudden rush of water through it. 3. To force a person or animal out of a hiding place.

items.def_zh: 脸红，发红；感到惭愧，羞愧
items.def_en: 1. To become red in the face because you are embarrassed, shy, or ashamed.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe facial or bodily skin becoming visibly red and hot, caused by internal emotional states (embarrassment, shame) or physical triggers (heat, exertion, fever).
groups.summary_zh: 因羞愧等情绪或发热、运动等生理原因使面部泛红发热。

groups.name: Border & Abut · 相邻与接壤 (Butt, Abut, Flank)
groups.tip: 端部碰接或彼此贴边

items.def_en: (+ on) To form or share an edge or perimeter line with another territory or object
1. (+ against/on/up to) To lie adjacent to or touch at an end or edge. 2. To hit or push with the head or horns.
To border physically or approach very closely to a particular condition, state, or limit
To be situated at the side or along both sides of someone or something
To be very close to, contiguous with, or joined directly to another room, building, or piece of land
(+ on/against) To touch or be immediately adjacent along a common boundary or surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this spatial frame denote physical contact, adjacency, or bordering along an edge, perimeter, or boundary line. Nuances separate direct end-to-end touching from running along a side or enclosing borders.
groups.summary_zh: 描述两处土地、建筑物或物体在边界处紧邻相接、贴靠或侧邻。

groups.name: Borrow & Rent · 借入与租用 (Borrow, Rent, Hire, Lease)
groups.tip: 自外部借调使用权

items.def_en: To pay for the temporary use of something, such as a car or suit, usually for a short period

items.def_zh: 租用，承租（按期支付租金）
items.def_en: To pay money for the temporary use of property, land, or equipment owned by someone else
To take or receive something from someone with the intention of returning it after a period of time.
To ask for or obtain something, such as food, money, or a ride, from someone without paying or intending to return it
To hold or use property, vehicles, or equipment under the formal terms of a contract or lease
To hire an aircraft, ship, or vehicle for private, designated use

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe obtaining temporary custody or use of property, money, or services with the obligation of returning it, contrasting gratuitous borrowing with fee-based renting or commercial leasing.
groups.summary_zh: 表示以归还为前提借入或付费租用财物与服务。

groups.name: Bounce & Ricochet · 碰撞反弹与偏斜 (Deflect, Carom, Glint Off)
groups.tip: 碰撞硬物受阻弹回

items.def_en: To strike a surface and immediately bound away in another direction.
To hit a surface obliquely and bounce aside without delivering a direct blow.
(+ off/into) To strike a surface and ricochet vigorously off it, typically in billiards or vehicles.
To spring or bounce back through the air after impacting a solid barrier.
To hit an obstacle and change trajectory or cause something moving to do so.

items.def_zh: （弹丸、石块等受阻）弹回，跳飞，反弹
items.def_en: (of a bullet, stone, or ball) To hit a hard surface at an angle and bounce away.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical objects striking a hard surface and deflecting away at an angle, often with preserved kinetic energy or erratic trajectory.
groups.summary_zh: 物体撞击硬物表面后沿倾斜轨迹弹开、偏转或反冲的物理运动。

groups.name: Brawl & Scuffle · 扭打与聚众斗殴 (Scuffle, Tussle, Scraps)
groups.tip: 街头混战或毫无规则的肉搏

items.def_en: To fight briefly and confusedly in a disorderly physical clash
To struggle or fight vigorously with someone, often over possession of something
To engage in a rough, informal fistfight or physical quarrel
To fight or quarrel noisily and violently, especially in a public place.
To seize and hold an opponent in a close, wrestling-style physical fight
To fight or come into violent confrontation with an opposing group

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict chaotic, rowdy, and often physical skirmishes between individuals or groups, typically involving close quarters and disorganized fighting. While 'brawl' highlights loud public violence, 'scuffle' and 'tussle' imply brief, messy grappling with lower lethality.
groups.summary_zh: 指吵闹、混乱且近距离的徒手打斗或扭扯混战。

groups.name: Breed & Reproduce · 繁衍与繁殖 (Breed, Propagate, Procreate, Multiply)
groups.tip: 生物世代相传与延续血脉

items.def_zh: 繁殖，繁衍；饲养；招致，酿成
items.def_en: 1. (of animals) To reproduce or mate and produce offspring. 2. To keep and rear animals or plants to produce new ones. 3. To cause or bring about a bad feeling, situation, or condition.
To produce offspring or new individuals of the same kind naturally
To release or deposit eggs in water, or to produce offspring in large quantities
To increase greatly in number through ongoing reproduction
To breed or multiply specimens of a plant or animal from parent stock
(formal) to produce children or offspring through sexual reproduction

groups.summary_en: Verbs covering biological reproduction and multiplication across animals, plants, and organisms, whether natural or artificially cultivated.
groups.summary_zh: 指生物通过交配、繁育或传代使族群数量倍增的过程。

groups.name: Bringing Down & Felling · 砍倒与推翻 (Fell, Cut Down, Topple)
groups.tip: 施加外力砍倒击倒立物

items.def_en: To cut through the base of a tree, post, or plant so that it falls down
To make something tall and upright lose balance and collapse
To fell a tree or obstacle using repeated, forceful ax blows
To knock flat to the ground, whether a standing structure or an opponent
To knock someone down onto the floor or ground with a punch or strike
to cut down a tree; to knock someone down with a heavy blow

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to bringing upright structures, trees, or persons crashing to the ground through chopping, striking, or forceful impact.
groups.summary_zh: 通过挥砍、重击或施加蛮力将直立人或树木摧折击倒于地。

groups.name: Broadcast & Beam · 广播与无线传输 (Broadcast, Transmit, Beam)
groups.tip: 通过电波卫星向大众播放信息

items.def_zh: 广播，播送（电视或广播节目）
items.def_en: Send out sound or television programs via radio waves or digital transmission for public reception

items.def_zh: 通过卫星播送，经人造卫星传输
items.def_en: To broadcast, transmit, or relay a television or radio signal via a satellite.

items.def_zh: 定向发送（无线电信号、电视节目）
items.def_en: Send radio or television signals or light in a particular direction using electronic equipment
Broadcast a program simultaneously across two or more different stations, networks, or media
Send out an electrical, radio, or television signal through the air or a communication channel
Receive television, radio, or electronic signals and broadcast them onward

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the electronic dissemination or relay of audiovisual signals, data, or programming across airwaves, satellites, or digital networks to widespread or remote receivers.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过无线电波、卫星或网络向外发射或转播音视频信号。

groups.name: Browse & Leaf · 翻阅与浏览 (Thumb, Skim, Peruse)
groups.tip: 随手翻书快速查看内容

items.def_en: Look through a book, store, or web pages casually without a specific goal
Turn over the pages of a book or magazine in rapid succession without reading every word
Turn pages of a publication quickly with one's thumb while browsing
Look quickly over text to locate specific information or grasp an overview
1. ('leaf through') To turn the pages of a book, magazine, or document quickly without reading carefully. 2. To produce leaves.
Read quickly through a piece of writing in order to pick out key points

groups.summary_en: Captures the act of casually turning pages or glancing across written materials and collections without engaging in methodical reading.
groups.summary_zh: 指随手翻转书页、扫视文本或漫不经心挑选阅览的动作。

groups.name: Budget & Allocate · 预算与规划 (Earmark, Allocate, Apportion)
groups.tip: 资金使用的事前规划

items.def_zh: 编制预算，把……编入预算；规划（开支、时间）
items.def_en: to plan the spending of money or use of time carefully; to allocate a specific sum for a purpose
To officially authorize the expenditure of public or corporate money for a specific cause
To reserve a particular portion of money, time, or goods for future use
To distribute resources or duties according to a systematic plan or quota
To set aside funds or resources for a specific, designated purpose
To divide and share out costs, tasks, or resources proportionately among different entities

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with calculating, designating, and distributing financial resources or time systematically for predetermined purposes.
groups.summary_zh: 指为特定用途审慎计划、分配和预留资金或时间资源。

groups.name: Build & Construct Framework · 搭建构架与构筑 (Erect, Assemble, Fabricate)
groups.tip: 搭建框架搭起骨干结构

items.def_en: To construct or understand a whole structure by joining individual parts together sequentially
To fit together the separate component parts of a machine, furniture, or skeleton structure

items.def_zh: 构筑，搭建骨架；制定，拟定；给……装框；陷害
items.def_en: 1. To construct the framework or skeleton of a building or structure. 2. To formulate or express something in words. 3. To put a border or frame around an object. 4. (informal) To falsely incriminate an innocent person.
To build, assemble, or raise a vertical structure or framework into position
To manufacture or shape structural elements from standardized components or raw materials
To furnish a building or conceptual framework with temporary raised staging or supportive platforms

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this construction frame focus on forming the structural skeleton, load-bearing architecture, or foundational outline of physical edifices and conceptual models.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过骨架安装、组件配合来构建建筑物或体系的承重与支撑结构。

groups.name: Bulge & Sag Outward · 突出与凸垂鼓出 (Pooch, Bulge, Bag)
groups.tip: 腹部或口袋向外鼓起

items.def_en: to extend prominently outward from the main body or surface
(of clothes or fabric) to hang loosely or bulge outwards in an unsightly way
(+ out) to bulge, protrude, or puff outward, or cause something to do so
(+ out) to swell or cause to swell out like a belly when filled with wind or air
to swell or protrude noticeably outward from an otherwise flat surface
to jut out or thrust forward from the surrounding boundary or area

groups.summary_en: Covers physical shapes, clothing, or flesh jutting outwards awkwardly, protruding from a contour, or drooping slackly into an unsightly hump or pouch.
groups.summary_zh: 指衣物、肉肚或轮廓向外难看地隆起、鼓出或松弛下垂外凸。

groups.name: Bungle & Botch · 笨拙搞砸与办糟 (Botch, Bungle, Mess up)
groups.tip: 粗心大意导致行动彻底搞砸

items.def_en: To handle a matter poorly or throw a plan into disarray through carelessness
To miss or handle clumsily a shot, line, or golden opportunity
1. (informal) To bungle, mess up, or make a clumsy error in doing or performing something.
To mismanage, ruin, or bungle an undertaking completely
To ruin or spoil something by clumsy, careless, or shoddy workmanship
To carry out a task clumsily, incompetently, and with disastrously poor results

groups.summary_en: Characterizes handling a task, job, or performance with utter clumsiness, incompetence, or incompetence that results in poor execution.
groups.summary_zh: 强调执行动作或处理事务笨拙拙劣，彻底弄糟任务。

groups.name: Burden & Encumber · 加负与拖累 (Weigh Down, Encumber, Saddle)
groups.tip: 施加重担或造成牵绊

items.def_zh: 给……加重担，使承受负担；烦扰，拖累
items.def_en: To weigh someone or something down with a heavy load, responsibility, or emotional worry.

items.def_zh: 压垮；使心事重重；沉重压迫
items.def_en: To make someone heavy, slow, or depressed by a physical load or severe worries
(+ with) To place an unwelcome responsibility, debt, or task on someone
To put too much weight or work on someone or something
To place an excessive load or financial charge on a person or system
To restrict someone's movement or actions by placing heavy loads or legal claims on them

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to imposing onerous duties, physical mass, debts, or emotional strain that severely hamper freedom of movement or function.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加沉重的物质、责任、债务或精神重负，使之不堪负重或行动受阻。

groups.name: Bury & Cremate · 殡葬与安葬 (Bury, Inter, Cremate)
groups.tip: 遗体火化或入土安葬仪式

items.def_en: To place a dead body into the ground or a tomb, typically accompanied by funeral rites
To bury a dead body with appropriate ceremony and solemn respect
To deposit a dead body into an earth grave or crypt during a formal burial service
1. To burn the body of a dead person to ashes, usually as part of a funeral service.
To dig up a corpse from the ground or tomb, typically for investigation or reburial
To place a deceased body inside a tomb, vault, or monument

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal and ritual actions taken to lay a deceased body to rest, whether by interment in the earth or tomb, or reduction to ashes by heat.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过火化、土葬等仪式对遗体进行最终安葬与处理。

groups.name: Bury & Entomb · 安葬与埋葬 (Inter, Inhume, Lay to Rest)
groups.tip: 装殓入棺长眠于墓穴之中

items.def_en: To place a dead body in the earth or a tomb, usually with funeral ceremonies
To bury someone with ceremony and respect
To deposit a dead body in the earth; bury
To bury a dead body formally in a grave or tomb

items.def_zh: 将……装殓入棺；把……装入小盒中
items.def_en: To place a dead body inside a coffin; to put or enclose something in a small chest or casket.
To place a dead body in a tomb, crypt, or monument

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to the formal or solemn act of placing a deceased person's body into a grave, vault, or coffin as part of funerary rites.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及将遗体安置入棺、墓穴或地下的安葬行为。

groups.name: Cache & Stash · 隐藏与储藏 (Stash, Hoard, Squirrel Away)
groups.tip: 藏匿储存于隐秘处

items.def_en: To hide or store a reserve of money or goods gradually in a safe place for future use
To store something neatly in a discreet, private, or out-of-the-way spot
To save or stow away money or assets secretly for future security

items.def_zh: 隐藏，储藏；（计算机）存入高速缓冲存储器
items.def_en: to hide or store supplies, weapons, or digital data in a secret or fast-access place
(+ away) To store or hide an item or money safely, secretly, or quickly
To collect and store large quantities of food, money, or goods beyond present needs

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail concealing valuables, ammunition, provisions, or data in secure, covert spots for future retrieval.
groups.summary_zh: 为防被盗或以备未来使用，将贵重物品或物资秘密隐匿、封存。

groups.name: Cackle & Guffaw · 刺耳尖笑与狂笑 (Guffaw, Shriek, Howl)
groups.tip: 发出各种神态与声调的笑声

items.def_zh: 突然哈哈大笑，捧腹大笑
items.def_en: To burst suddenly and uncontrollably into loud, hearty laughter
(+ with laughter) To laugh with deep, full-throated, resounding volume
(+ with laughter) To make a loud, sustained vocal sound expressing intense, helpless amusement
To laugh loudly and boisterously, often in an uninhibited or crude fashion
To emit a high-pitched, piercing sound of extreme amusement or delight

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳的笑声，咯咯地大笑；（母鸡）咯咯叫
items.def_en: To laugh loudly in a shrill, unpleasant way, or (of a bird) to make a harsh, noisy cry.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe vocal laughter that is unusually loud, harsh, shrill, or uninhibited, contrasting sharply with discreet giggles or quiet chuckles.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重发出响亮刺耳、放肆尖锐或不可抑制的大笑声。

groups.name: Call & Telephone · 致电与拨通 (Ring, Call Up, Dial)
groups.tip: 口头大声呼叫或拨打电话

items.def_en: To make telephone contact with someone
To make a telephone call to someone.

items.def_zh: 打电话（主要用于英式英语）
items.def_en: (especially British) To telephone someone
To dial someone's phone number and speak with them
To make a telephone call to someone
To select digits on a telephone to initiate a connection

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe initiating voice telecommunication or placing a contact request over fixed or mobile telephone infrastructure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过固定电话、移动设备或网络语音系统发起通话联络。

groups.name: Calm & Quiet · 平息与缓和 (Soothe, Hush, Muffle)
groups.tip: 安抚躁动让环境与心绪宁静

items.def_en: (informal) Become calmer and less agitated or angry after a period of excitement or rage
to make someone or something calm or less noisy, or to become calm or quiet.
Gently calm someone down, relieve their anxiety, or ease physical discomfort
Make someone or something become quiet, or suddenly stop speaking or making noise

items.def_zh: 压低，使（声音）变沉闷隔绝
items.def_en: Deaden or wrap something to make a sound less loud, distinct, or audible

items.def_zh: 制伏，压抑平息（骚动或情绪）
items.def_en: Bring a person, feeling, or noise under control by superior force or restrained authority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote diminishing acoustic noise, turbulent motion, or emotional agitation into a tranquil, quiet state. They describe actions ranging from hushing audible commotion to soothing ruffled feelings or stifling sounds.
groups.summary_zh: 使声音低落沉寂，或使烦躁骚动的情绪与场面平息下来。

groups.name: Camp & Bivouac · 扎营与露宿 (Pitch, Bivouac, Rough it)
groups.tip: 户外搭建帐篷过夜栖息

items.def_en: To set up a tent and live outdoors temporarily.
To set up tents and establish a campsite
To live for a short time in conditions that are not comfortable or lack modern amenities
To sleep outside in a tent or sleeping bag rather than inside a permanent building
To settle in a camp, especially of soldiers or travelers establishing tents

items.def_zh: 露宿，野营（通常指简陋无帐篷）
items.def_en: To stay in a temporary camp without tents or substantial shelter, especially outdoors overnight

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe setting up temporary shelter outdoors, sleeping in tents or under the open sky, ranging from comfortable recreational camping to improvised survival stays.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及在户外搭建帐篷、露营或无遮蔽露宿的动作。

groups.name: Campaign & Crusade · 倡导与奋战 (Campaign, Crusade, Champion, Agitate)
groups.tip: 为特定社会理想投身长期斗争

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To take part in a planned series of activities to achieve a social, political, or commercial goal
To try to persuade politicians or officials to support or defeat a specific law or policy

items.def_zh: 游说竞选，进行巡回演说
items.def_en: (+ for) To travel around an area making political campaign speeches before an election
To fight for, speak publicly in support of, or defend a cause, right, or principle

items.def_zh: 投身运动，奋力争取，长期奋战；参加十字军东征
items.def_en: To fight or campaign vigorously for a cause or against something regarded as an evil.
(+ for/against) To argue strongly and publicly in order to build support for political or social change

groups.summary_en: This frame covers engaging in energetic, organized public action to promote a cause, reform, or policy, spanning from formal political campaigning to fierce activist crusading.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为特定理念或社会变革积极奔走、游说与奋战。

groups.name: Campaign & Lobby · 竞选与游说 (Lobby, Canvass, Stump)
groups.tip: 政治竞选争取选票

items.def_zh: 参加竞选；发起运动，游说宣传
items.def_en: To conduct, organize, or take part in a series of planned activities to achieve a political, social, or commercial goal.
(+ for/against) To try to persuade politicians, officials, or leaders to support or defeat a proposed law
(+ for/against) To engage in a vigorous, impassioned concerted effort for social or political change
(+ for) To travel around giving political speeches to garner votes during an election campaign
(+ for/against) To campaign publically and energetically to stir up public support or protest
To travel through an area visiting residents to solicit votes, donations, or opinions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate organized efforts to influence public opinion, secure votes, or persuade government officials to adopt specific policies or elect particular candidates.
groups.summary_zh: 指为实现政治诉求、竞选公职或推动特定议案而展开的有组织游说与宣传。

groups.name: Capsize & Invert · 翻覆与倒置 (Overturn, Upend, Keel over)
groups.tip: 底朝天翻转倾覆倒置

items.def_en: Lose balance and fall over on its side, or cause an object to topple
Roll or rotate completely upside down onto its opposite surface
Turn over completely so that the top becomes the bottom, or cause to do so
Set or turn something upside down or on its end
Turn over on its side or completely upside down in water, or collapse suddenly
(of a boat) To turn upside down in the water, or to cause a boat to do this.

groups.summary_en: Covers severe upsets where vehicles, vessels, or tall objects lose stability, tip over, and end up upside down or on their side.
groups.summary_zh: 指船只、车辆或直立物因失去平衡而倾覆、翻底或底朝天颠倒。

groups.name: Cater & Pander · 迎合与供给 (Pander, Accommodate, Humor)
groups.tip: 顺应特定群体偏好与需求

items.def_zh: 迁就；迎合（某人的脾气或任性）
items.def_en: To agree with someone or comply with their wishes simply to keep them quiet or happy
To consider someone's special needs or desires and adapt one's behavior or plans to suit them
To direct one's efforts toward pleasing or winning the approval of a particular group

items.def_zh: 迎合，投合；承办宴席，提供饮食服务
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To try to satisfy the specific needs, tastes, or desires of a person or group. 2. (+ for) To provide food and drink service for a social event or party.
(+ to) To submit obsequiously or yield tamely to someone's demands or wishes

items.def_zh: 迎合；谄媚（尤指低级趣味）
items.def_en: (+ to) To do or say what someone wants in order to please them, usually in a way that is disgraceful or unreasonable

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on shaping one's actions, services, or goods to please a specific audience or satisfy niche demands. It ranges from helpful accommodation to ethically dubious, spineless indulgence.
groups.summary_zh: 指为迎合特定群体需求或低级趣味而迁就调整服务与言行。

groups.name: Censor & Suppress · 审查与删剪 (Redact, Bowdlerize, Expurgate)
groups.tip: 行使权力查禁敏感内容

items.def_en: To cover text or images with dark ink to prevent them from being read
To edit, alter, or censor text by deleting parts of it
To remove, obscure, or black out sensitive text or information before publication

items.def_zh: 审查并删剪（书刊、电影、信件等）；查禁
items.def_en: To examine books, films, or other materials officially and remove parts considered offensive, politically sensitive, or dangerous.

items.def_zh: 删减（以使之适宜大众）；净化删节
items.def_en: To censor a text by removing or altering passages considered vulgar or improper

items.def_zh: 删去（令人不快或不合体统的内容）
items.def_en: To remove matter thought objectionable or unsuitable from a book, play, or account

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the intervention by authorities to suppress, excise, or black out objectionable, sensitive, or politically undesirable portions of texts or media.
groups.summary_zh: 官方或管理者对出版物与资讯进行审查、删节或涂盖。

groups.name: Center & Align Medially · 居中对齐与定位 (Centre, Middle, Centralize)
groups.tip: 移至中间或特定位置

items.def_zh: 把……置于中间；（球类运动）传中，把（球）踢到中路
items.def_en: 1. To place or position something in the center or middle. 2. (sports) To kick or pass a ball into the middle of the field or pitch.

items.def_zh: 置于中心，居中；将……集中于，以……为中心
items.def_en: 1. To move to or place something at the center. 2. (+ on/around) To focus or concentrate primarily on a particular subject or point.
to distribute or balance items uniformly about a central point
(+ sth) to arrange things in a straight line or adjust them to match a central or uniform axis
(+ sth) to position or align an object squarely and evenly relative to a center or border
to bring into or place at the center of an area or system

groups.summary_en: Actors position, align, or balance an object or feature exactly along a central axis or midpoint relative to its surrounding frame or bounds.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体或构件置于正中轴线或对准中心位置。

groups.name: Certify & Legally Validate · 律法确认与公证 (Legitimize, Notarize, Validate)
groups.tip: 官方公证认可并正式授权生效

items.def_en: (+ sth) give official or legal approval to a document, decision, or plan
to make something officially acceptable, legally binding, or confirmed as correct

items.def_zh: 证明真实；给…作证（签署确认）
items.def_en: to state or sign officially that a legal document or record is genuine and valid
to prove or certify that an official document, seal, or artifact is genuine

items.def_zh: 使合法化；使合理化，使合乎道义
items.def_en: To make something legal, justifiable, or socially and morally acceptable.

items.def_zh: 公证，由公证人确认（文件等）
items.def_en: To have a legal document officially certified, attested, or stamped by a notary public.

groups.summary_en: A legally empowered official or authorized procedure confers legal validity, authentic status, or statutory approval on a document, act, or claim. Verbs range from general validation to specific notarial witnessing.
groups.summary_zh: 依照法律或法定程序对文书、行为等给予法律效力确认或公证认可。

groups.name: Champion & Root For · 热忱声援与摇旗呐喊 (Champion, Back, Cheer on)
groups.tip: 化身拉拉队员极力喝彩声援

items.def_en: Give essential moral, political, or practical support to a candidate, initiative, or stance
Urge a participant forward with shoutings of praise and encouragement
Express enthusiastic hope and active moral backing for the success of a person or team
Enthusiastically promote, speak in favor of, and advance the standing of someone or something

items.def_zh: 担任拉拉队员；极力声援，竭力支持
items.def_en: 1. To perform cheers to support a sports team, or to enthusiastically promote and champion a person or cause.

items.def_zh: 捍卫，竭力倡导，为…而斗争
items.def_en: Vigorously advocate, defend, or fight for a person, cause, or policy in public

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses vocal, enthusiastic, and partisan support for a person, cause, or faction, spanning spontaneous emotional cheering to relentless public promotion and advocacy.
groups.summary_zh: 指以高度热情、声势浩大地为某人或某事业声援、摇旗鼓劲。

groups.name: Chat & Converse · 闲聊与交谈 (Chat, Gossip, Chew the fat)
groups.tip: 闲聊漫谈或深入交换意见

items.def_en: To spend time chatting amiably about unimportant things
To engage in casual, trivial conversation about everyday topics

items.def_zh: 侃大山，长时间闲聊唠嗑
items.def_en: To chat socially and informally at considerable length
To talk in a friendly, informal, and relaxed manner.
To talk casually about other people's private lives and affairs
To talk at length in a foolish, inconsequential, or simple-minded way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe informal, relaxed verbal exchanges where speakers interact socially rather than engaging in rigid, goal-oriented debate. They range from light social talk to colloquial idioms meaning to shoot the breeze at length.
groups.summary_zh: 指随性、轻松的日常闲聊或唠嗑，不带正式谈判色彩。

groups.name: Chemical Breakdown & Hydrolysis · 分解与水解 (Hydrolyze, Decompose, Digest)
groups.tip: 通过水解等反应分解物质

items.def_en: To separate or decompose into simpler chemical compounds or constituent parts
To break down food, tissue, or organic material chemically or enzymatically into absorbable substances
To break down chemically into simpler, often lower-energy compounds through exposure to enzymes, heat, or light
To break down into simpler chemical constituents or decay through natural biological or chemical processes
To split a molecule reversibly into simpler constituents, ions, or atoms
1. (chemistry) To break down a chemical compound by reacting it with water, or to undergo such a reaction.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the breakdown of chemical substances or complex organic matter into simpler components through chemical, biological, or thermal processes. While 'hydrolyze' specifically denotes cleavage by reaction with water, others emphasize natural decay, enzymatic digestion, or thermal cracking.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及化合物或有机质通过水、热、酶等作用降解为简单成分的化学与生物分解。

groups.name: Chemical Modification & Refining · 化工提纯与衍生改性 (Refine, Reprocess, Derivatize)
groups.tip: 化学工艺或深层再加工

items.def_en: to divide a mixture into distinct fractions or components by distillation or crystallization

items.def_zh: 衍生化；使转变成衍生物
items.def_en: to chemically transform a compound into a derivative of similar chemical structure

items.def_zh: 精炼；提纯（油品、糖或化学物）
items.def_en: to remove impurities or unwanted elements from a crude substance by chemical or thermal means
to extract a pure chemical component by removing foreign or contaminating substances

items.def_zh: （用柠檬酸）处理，使成柠檬酸盐（或酯）
items.def_en: (chemistry) To treat or combine a substance with citric acid or a citrate.

items.def_zh: 再处理，回收加工（废料、核燃料等）
items.def_en: To process used materials or waste, especially nuclear fuel, so that they can be used again.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on advanced laboratory or chemical engineering operations where a chemical substance, biological extract, or nuclear material is chemically altered, purified, or recycled into another derivative or state.
groups.summary_zh: 指在化验或化工过程中对物质进行化学反应改性、精炼或循环再处理。

groups.name: Chirp & Tweet · 啼鸣与啁啾 (Tweet, Chirp, Warble)
groups.tip: 鸟类或昆虫清脆短促的发声

items.def_en: To make a weak, high-pitched chirping sound characteristic of young chicks

items.def_zh: （鸟）鸣叫，啼叫；在社交平台发推文
items.def_en: 1. (of a bird) To make a short, high-pitched chirp or sound. 2. To post a message or update on the social media platform X (formerly Twitter).
To make a series of lively, high-pitched chirping sounds
To make a short, sharp, high-pitched sound typical of small birds or crickets
To utter a rapid, vibrating succession of high-pitched musical notes
To sing with melodious, rolling, or trembling notes

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the high-pitched, short, or melodious vocalizations of small birds and insects. It contrasts sharp single notes with extended, musical trills and chirruping calls.
groups.summary_zh: 描述小鸟或昆虫发出的短促、清脆或婉转悦耳的啼鸣声。

groups.name: Choke & Suffocate · 噎呛与窒息 (Gasp, Suffocate, Asphyxiate)
groups.tip: 呼吸道受阻乃至濒临窒息

items.def_en: To choke, reach to vomit, or prevent someone from speaking by plugging their mouth
(+ for) To breathe in suddenly and loudly with your mouth open, especially because of shock or lack of air

items.def_zh: （使）窒息，噎住，呛住；阻塞，堵塞；抑制，掐住
items.def_en: 1. To be unable to breathe, or prevent someone from breathing, because the windpipe is blocked or constricted. 2. To fill or block a passage or space completely. 3. To suppress, stifle, or restrain an emotion or speech.
To die, suffer, or cause someone to die from being unable to breathe
To kill someone by squeezing their throat tightly so they cannot breathe
To kill or render unconscious by depriving of oxygen

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physiological respiratory distress, where air intake is cut off by internal airway obstruction, external strangulation, or an oxygen-deprived environment.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖因异物卡阻、外力压迫或缺氧造成的呼吸困难乃至窒息反应。

groups.name: Claim & Profess · 声称与断言 (Claim, Profess, Assert)
groups.tip: 声称其真或斩钉截铁地断言

items.def_en: To state that something is true, often without providing definite proof
(+ to) To lay claim to a particular quality, right, or title
To assert that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically without proof
To falsely present someone or something as being another person or thing

items.def_zh: 声称，自称（常含虚假或缺乏依据之意）；标榜
items.def_en: (+ to be/do) (formal) To claim or profess to be or do something, especially falsely or without proof.
To claim or declare a feeling, belief, or identity, sometimes insincerely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stating that something is true or asserting an identity or status, often carrying skepticism about whether the claim is genuine or backed by proof.
groups.summary_zh: 表示自称、断言或声称拥有某种身份或事实，常含真伪存疑意味。

groups.name: Clash & Conflict · 抵触与不和 (Clash, Jar, Conflict)
groups.tip: 观点针锋相对爆发激烈碰撞

items.def_en: (+ with) To clash or be contrary to other principles, beliefs, or claims
(+ with) To quarrel with someone and stop being on friendly terms
(+ with) To be in strong, sharp disagreement or incompatibility with something
(+ with/against) To be incongruous, unpleasantly discordant, or out of harmony
(+ with) To come into direct, irreconcilable opposition regarding aims or views

items.def_zh: 不和，意见不一致；不谐调
items.def_en: (formal) To disagree, clash, or be out of harmony with someone or something.

groups.summary_en: Describes ideas, principles, temperaments, or sounds colliding antagonistically or failing to harmonize. Key distinctions track whether the discord is an active abrasive dispute, jarring aesthetic dissonance, or irreconcilable inconsistency.
groups.summary_zh: 指观点、风格、性格或声音因不契合而产生冲突与龃龉。

groups.name: Claw & Lacerate · 抓挠与撕扯 (Claw, Tear, Gouge)
groups.tip: 利爪抓挠撕扯物体

items.def_en: To scratch or tear violently and repeatedly at a person or obstacle using fingernails or talons
To attack something physically or verbally with relentless, destructive energy
To pull something apart forcibly into pieces or cause deep ragged wounds with claws or force

items.def_zh: 用爪抓，撕扯；（用爪或手指）挖，抓取；费力夺回
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To scratch, tear, or dig at something with sharp claws or fingernails. 2. ('claw back') To gradually recover money, power, or an advantage.
To inflict deep, jagged cuts or tears on flesh using sharp claws, teeth, or jagged edges
To dig or force something out roughly, leaving a deep hollow groove or severe laceration

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe aggressive, frantic, or sharp-edged gouging, tearing, and scraping with pointed claws, talons, or fingernails.
groups.summary_zh: 用利爪或指甲撕扯、猛抓以造成破坏或奋力挣扎。

groups.name: Clog & Silt Up · 阻塞与淤塞 (Silt Up, Clog, Choke)
groups.tip: 泥沙淤积致通道堵塞

items.def_en: To clog, foul, or prevent the smooth operation of a mechanism or channel with a sticky substance

items.def_zh: （河口、港湾等）淤积；被淤泥堵塞
items.def_en: To become gradually filled and obstructed with fine silt and sediment, or cause a waterway to do so
To block or become blocked with an accumulation of solid material or dirt so that movement is restricted
To overcrowd or obstruct a conduit, passage, or route with an excessive volume of matter
1. (often 'silt up') To become blocked or filled with silt, or to cause a waterway or harbor to do so.
To fill a passage, pipe, or channel so full of matter that free circulation is completely stopped

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture the gradual or heavy accumulation of sediment, debris, or particulate matter that obstructs flow in pipes, drainage basins, harbors, and waterways.
groups.summary_zh: 泥沙、杂物等颗粒物质聚积沉淀，导致管道或河道水流通路受阻。

groups.name: Coerce & Blackmail · 勒索与要挟 (Blackmail, Bleed, Squeeze)
groups.tip: 捏住把柄进行言语要挟逼索钱财

items.def_en: To extort large amounts of money from someone continuously
To obtain money from someone by deceit, intimidation, or extortion
To put pressure on someone to force them into giving up money or favors
To demand money or favors from someone by threatening to reveal damaging secrets about them.
To compel someone to act through force, threats, or intimidation
To obtain something by using threats, force, or abuse of authority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate extorting money, property, or favors by exploiting sensitive leverage, exposing damaging secrets, or applying menacing emotional pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 通过揭发丑事、威胁隐秘利益或施加威吓手段强索金钱或特权。

groups.name: Coerce & Press-gang · 强迫与诱骗胁迫 (Coerce, Railroad, Dragoon)
groups.tip: 用欺骗或暴力胁迫他人顺从

items.def_zh: 仓促强迫，逼迫…匆忙行动
items.def_en: To force someone into doing something hastily or without giving them time to consider or protest

items.def_zh: 诱骗，胁迫（某人做某事）；拐骗（去当水手）
items.def_en: (informal) to force or trick someone into doing something they do not want to do, or into going somewhere
To force or compel someone into taking on a job or task against their will
To use physical force, intimidation, or aggressive pressure to make someone do something
To persuade someone forcefully to do something that they are unwilling to do, especially by using threats
To force or bully someone into doing something they do not wish to do

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe compelling someone into an unwanted task or position, often through trickery, overwhelming social pressure, or outright intimidation. While standard compulsion can be legal, these verbs highlight unfair tactics, manipulation, or browbeating.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过施压、诱骗或恃强凌弱迫使他人就范。

groups.name: Cognitive Awakening & Comprehension · 顿悟与领会 (Realize, Grasp, Fathom)
groups.tip: 顿悟明白其中道理

items.def_en: To begin to realize or understand what is happening or meant
To become slowly or suddenly clear to someone's mind

1. to understand or become aware of a fact or situation
2. to achieve something that you were hoping for
To fully understand the meaning, importance, or nature of something complicated
To mentally grasp the nature, significance, or underlying logic of something

items.def_zh: 洞悉；探明（复杂/费解之事）
items.def_en: To successfully understand something deep, puzzling, or mysterious after much reflection

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the mental arrival at conscious understanding, ranging from sudden realization to deep, analytical comprehension of complex facts.
groups.summary_zh: 描述思维意识的唤醒，从豁然顿悟到深层彻底理解复杂实情。

groups.name: Cognitive Blurring & Confusion · 概念混淆与合并 (Confuse, Blur, Muddle)
groups.tip: 将不同概念融为一体或混为一谈

items.def_en: Mistake one person, thing, or idea for another in the mind
Make boundaries, differences, or distinctions unclear and difficult to perceive
Consider or portray one thing as identical or equivalent to another
Mix different thoughts, facts, or things together in a disorganized or confused way
Confuse or mix up two or more things, concepts, or identities in one's mind

items.def_zh: 将（两个或多个不同事物）混淆，合并（为一体）
items.def_en: (formal) To combine two or more separate things, especially ideas, concepts, or texts, into one whole, often creating confusion.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the mental act of failing to distinguish between distinct entities, concepts, or categories, mistakenly treating or fusing them as one.
groups.summary_zh: 指在认知上未能分清不同实体或概念，将其混同、模糊或误作一体。

groups.name: Color & Dye Materials · 染色与涂饰 (Dye, Stain, Marble)
groups.tip: 涂刷或浸染赋予外观新色彩

items.def_en: [I/T] to treat wood, glass, or biological specimens with a penetrating pigment liquid
To change the color of something such as cloth or hair, especially by soaking it in a coloring liquid.

items.def_zh: 使呈现大理石花纹，给……上大理石斑纹
items.def_en: To stain, paint, or pattern paper, wood, or other material so that it looks like veined marble.
[I/T] to remove color from a fabric, hair, or pulp using chemicals or sunlight
(technical) to color a substance by adding pigment or natural coloration
to apply a slight or delicate coloration to hair, paper, or glass

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the color or surface appearance of a material (fabric, wood, paper, or hair) by impregnating it with pigments, coloring agents, or specialized decorative patterning. 'Dye' penetrates textiles or fibers fully, 'stain' alters surface tones, and 'marble' creates a swirling decorative vein pattern.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过浸润染料、上色或施加纹理改变材料表面颜色的工艺行为。

groups.name: Color & Imbue Tone · 染色与赋色 (Hue, Complexion, Tint)
groups.tip: 施加色调赋予特殊外观

items.def_en: To tint or color something with a particular shade or hue.

items.def_zh: 浅染，微染（给予微弱色调）
items.def_en: to apply a small amount of color to something, giving it a slight hue

items.def_zh: 着微色，使带有一点颜色
items.def_en: to impart a slight or faint trace of a color to an object or surface

items.def_zh: 赋予……色彩；赋予……某种特征或外观
items.def_en: To give a particular color, tint, appearance, or character to something.

items.def_zh: 染（用染料给布料、头发等彻底着色）
items.def_en: to change the color of something permanently using a chemical dye or liquid
to saturate or pervade an object deeply with a dye, stain, or color

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the visual appearance of an entity by imparting a specific color, shade, or natural pigmentation. They vary in depth of color change from subtle surface washes to deep, structural coloration.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过赋予颜色、色泽或天然色素来改变物体表面的视觉色调。

groups.name: Come into Sight or Existence · 显形与浮现 (Materialize, Reappear)
groups.tip: 从暗中或遮蔽处出现浮现

items.def_en: (+ from) to come out into view or become manifest after being hidden
to become visible or arrive at a place, especially when awaited or missing
to be found or suddenly appear after being lost, hidden, or absent
[I/T] to appear clearly or demonstrate one's presence in a tangible form
To appear or become visible again after being absent or hidden for a time.

items.def_zh: 突然显现，现形；实现，成为现实
items.def_en: 1. To appear suddenly and unexpectedly, especially as if from nowhere. 2. To become a reality; to actually happen.

groups.summary_en: Verbs expressing the transition from unseen or absent to perceivable reality, often suddenly, tangibly, or after a period of disappearance.
groups.summary_zh: 强调事物从不可见或缺席状态转变为清晰显形、具象化或重新出现。

groups.name: Compare & Liken · 比拟与类比 (Liken, Compare, Equate)
groups.tip: 找寻相似处作形象比照

items.def_en: (+ to/with) To examine or represent two entities as similar or of equivalent standing
To show or highlight a close resemblance or structural similarity to another thing
To make an explicit analogy or comparison between two things to clarify meaning
To demonstrate or establish a mutual relationship, correspondence, or systematic parallel
(+ with/to) To consider or declare two different things to be identical, equal, or mutually equivalent
1. (+ to) (formal) To compare one person or thing to another by highlighting similarities.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on cognitively or rhetorically establishing points of resemblance, similarity, or identity between two distinct entities or phenomena.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过类比或联想，指出人或事物之间的相似或等同之处。

groups.name: Complete & Finalize · 完成与收尾 (Wrap up, Wind up, Conclude)
groups.tip: 使事情正式落地收尾

items.def_en: To bring something to an end formally or reach an agreement officially
To complete or finish an event, task, or meeting successfully
To bring a business, speech, or process gradually to an end

items.def_zh: 为…画上圆满句号；使圆满收尾
items.def_en: To finish or complete something in a particularly satisfying or successful way

items.def_zh: 了结；处理完（悬而未决的事）
items.def_en: To settle the final details of something (often as 'tie up loose ends')

items.def_zh: 把……最后定下来，最终落实；完成
items.def_en: To make final arrangements for something or agree on the last details of a plan or agreement.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers actions aimed at concluding an undertaking, settling the last outstanding details, or bringing a project to a definitive close.
groups.summary_zh: 强调完成最后环节、敲定细节或彻底结束事务。

groups.name: Complicate & Entangle · 复杂化与纠缠 (Confound, Muddle, Cloud)
groups.tip: 问题节外生枝演变得更加棘手

items.def_en: To introduce irrelevant or confusing details to make a clear issue hard to understand

items.raw_cluster: 恶化与复杂化 Worsen & Complicate
items.def_zh: 使复杂化，使恶化，使棘手
items.def_en: To make something more difficult, complex, or problematic to deal with.
To bring into a disordered, confusing, or ambiguous state
To cause something to become complicated, jammed, or tangled in disorder
To mix up distinct elements or worsen complexity by defying clear analysis
To involve someone or something in a complicated, compromising, or intractable situation

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on introducing tangled layers, confusion, or conflicting elements into an issue, making understanding, resolution, or execution significantly harder.
groups.summary_zh: 使局面错综复杂、难以理清，增加解决问题的难度。

groups.name: Compromise & Concede · 妥协与让步 (Compromise, Concede, Bargain)
groups.tip: 协商中让步达成一致

items.def_en: To end a dispute or legal contest by reaching a mutual contractual agreement

items.def_zh: 妥协，让步；危及，损害（名誉、安全等）
items.def_en: 1. To reach an agreement in which each side gives up part of what it originally wanted. 2. To damage, weaken, or expose something to danger or suspicion.
To practice mutual accommodation by willing compromises between two sides
To compromise with someone by making concessions equal to those they offer
To negotiate the terms of an agreement, trading reciprocal concessions to find common ground
To reluctantly admit defeat or surrender a right, point, or territory in an argument

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mutual dispute resolution where conflicting parties give up contested ground or rights in order to reach consensus. It highlights tactical trade-offs, formal acknowledgments, and pragmatic agreements rather than mere emotional relenting.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过各退一步、放弃部分主张或诉求，以达成具有约束力的协议。

groups.name: Concentrate & Condense · 浓缩与冷凝 (Condense, Boil Down, Reduce)
groups.tip: 排去稀释成分聚集成高浓度

items.def_en: To simmer a sauce or liquid until it becomes thicker and more flavorful through evaporation
To reduce a liquid by prolonged boiling, or to summarize a complex issue into its fundamental point

items.def_zh: 浓缩，提纯；集中，全神贯注
items.def_en: 1. to reduce a liquid or solution to a denser, stronger form by removing water 2. to focus your attention, energy, or resources on one thing

items.def_zh: 使冷凝；浓缩；压缩（文章等）
items.def_en: To make a liquid or gas denser by cooling or removing water, or to shorten a text to its essentials
To thicken or congeal a liquid through evaporation or dehydration, especially in formal or medical contexts
To purify or concentrate a liquid by heating it to vapor and cooling it, or to extract essential meaning

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to removing liquid, water, or bulk from a substance to make it thicker, denser, or more potent. They often extend figuratively to distilling ideas, texts, or problems into their core elements.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过蒸发、滤除水分使液体浓缩增稠，亦引申为提炼概括核心信息。

groups.name: Concern & Care · 关心与介意 (Care, Mind, Bother)
groups.tip: 放不下、在心上挂念与介怀

items.def_zh: 在乎，介意，关心；照顾，关照（care for）；愿意，想要
items.def_en: 1. To be interested in or concerned about something. 2. (care for) To look after or provide for someone. 3. (care for / to do) To want or like to do something.

items.def_zh: 介意，在乎；注意，当心；照看，看护
items.def_en: 1. To be annoyed, worried, or bothered by something. 2. To be careful about; heed. 3. To take care of or watch over someone or something.
[I/T] to make an effort or to be annoyed/worried by something
(+ sb/sth) to feel concern, interest, or emotional investment regarding someone or something
(+ sb/sth) to pay excessive or nervous attention to someone or something
(+ about/over) to be continuously worried, anxious, or unhappy about something

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on an experiencer attaching subjective importance or negative feeling to a state of affairs. While 'care' reflects general emotional investment or concern, 'mind' is largely used in negative and interrogative contexts to denote objecting to or being troubled by something.
groups.summary_zh: 主观上对某事感到介意、挂怀或产生情感投入。

groups.name: Concoct & Hatch · 谋划与编造 (Cook up, Hatch, Devise)
groups.tip: 凭空捏造，虚构罗织剧情

items.def_en: To invent a method, system, or plan cleverly and thoughtfully
To invent or fabricate an excuse, story, or deceptive plan
To invent an idea, scheme, or fantasy that is unusual, fanciful, or impractical
To create or secretly devise a plot, conspiracy, or plan, usually harmful or clandestine

items.def_zh: 捏造，编造（借口、计划）；调制，配制
items.def_en: 1. To invent an excuse, story, or plan, especially to deceive someone. 2. To make a food or drink by mixing different ingredients together.
To invent false information or forge evidence in order to deceive people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe scheming, formulating intricate plans, or fabricating deceitful stories and excuses. They highlight clandestine craftiness or elaborate mental calculation.
groups.summary_zh: 指秘密策划方案或巧妙编造借口、阴谋，带有工于心计的意味。

groups.name: Condemn & Rail · 谴责与痛斥 (Fulminate, Denounce, Inveigh)
groups.tip: 从严厉谴责升级为激烈痛骂

items.def_en: (+ at/against) To suddenly attack someone verbally with harsh, aggressive criticism or abuse.
(+ against/at) To complain angrily and bitterly about someone or something.
To criticize someone or something strongly and publicly, often stating that they are evil, dishonest, or illegal.
(+ against) To speak or write with deep hostility and bitter criticism against something.
To punish, rebuke, or criticize someone extremely severely, often in public.
(+ against/at) To express intense, explosive anger and criticism publicly and forcefully.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses fierce verbal assault, indignant protest, and blistering public rebuke. While 'rail' stresses prolonged, exasperated complaining, 'denounce' delivers formal moral condemnation, and 'fulminate' captures explosive oratorical rage.
groups.summary_zh: 指满怀义愤或激烈怒火地公开发难、猛烈抨击与痛骂。

groups.name: Condescend & Patronize · 居高临下与优越屈尊 (Condescend, Patronize, Stoop)
groups.tip: 居高临下施恩或自显优越

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) consider oneself superior to someone or view them with patronizing disdain

items.def_zh: 以居高临下的口吻对……说话
items.def_en: (+ to) to speak condescendingly to someone as if they were simple or inferior
(+ to) to lower one's moral or social standards by doing something beneath oneself

items.def_zh: 屈尊，俯就；表现出优越感，居高临下
items.def_en: 1. (+ to do) To agree to do something while behaving as if you are superior and doing others a favor. 2. (+ to) To treat someone with an air of condescension or superiority.

items.def_zh: 居高临下地对待，自显优越；光顾，惠顾；资助，赞助
items.def_en: 1. (disapproving) To speak or behave toward someone in a way that suggests you think you are more intelligent or important than them. 2. (formal) To be a regular customer of a business, shop, or restaurant. 3. To act as a patron toward; support or sponsor.
(+ to do sth) to do something that one considers beneath one's dignity

groups.summary_en: Superiors behave towards others with an air of gracious superiority, treating them as inferiors while feigning benevolence, polite concession, or guidance.
groups.summary_zh: 指以居高临下的优越姿态对待他人或故作宽宏屈尊。

groups.name: Confine & Enclose · 限制与监禁 (Incarcerate, Hem In, Impound)
groups.tip: 限定活动范围与人身自由

items.def_en: To surround someone or something tightly so they have little room to move or act
To keep someone or an animal confined in an uncomfortably small or enclosed space
To enclose or confine someone closely within walls against their will

items.def_zh: 限制，使局限于；监禁，关押
items.def_en: (+ to) to keep someone or something restricted within a certain place, limit, or subject; to keep someone in an enclosed space
To officially keep someone in custody and prevent them from leaving
To put or hold someone inside a prison or correctional facility

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame define restricting a person, group, or topic strictly within physical perimeters or predefined conceptual scopes.
groups.summary_zh: 将人、物或议题严格限制、锁闭在固定的空间或范围之内。

groups.name: Confirm & Corroborate · 证实与确证 (Substantiate, Verify, Authenticate)
groups.tip: 提供证据互相印证与证实

items.def_en: To check and confirm whether an assertion, figure, or identity is accurate and genuine
To provide evidence or factual results supporting a theory, prediction, or claimant
To confirm that something is factually sound, logically legitimate, or legally valid
(formal) To provide evidence or information that supports and confirms a statement, theory, or finding.
To prove formally that an item, document, or statement is genuine rather than fake
To provide substantial evidence, documentation, or facts to prove the truth of a claim

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying independent proof, testimonial support, or empirical documentation to establish the factual truth of an assertion.
groups.summary_zh: 指提出有力凭据、事实或独立证据以印证并核实论断的真实性。

groups.name: Conserve & Economize · 节约与保护 (Conserve, Husband, Economize)
groups.tip: 妥善保留防止物品变质耗损

items.def_zh: 妥善节用；精打细算管理
items.def_en: Manage, cultivate, or use resources prudently and economically

items.def_zh: 精打细算撑起；使（钱财等）耐用
items.def_en: Make a quantity of food, money, or resources last longer by using it sparingly
Spend less money or use fewer supplies and resources than usual

items.def_zh: 保护，保存；节约，节省；使（能量等）守恒
items.def_en: 1. to protect something from harm, loss, or waste; to use something carefully to prevent depletion. 2. (physics) to keep a quantity constant during a physical process.
Limit the consumption or distribution of scarce goods, fuel, or food
Reduce the quantity, duration, or extent of something to conserve supplies

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on managing limited resources, energy, or natural assets prudently to prevent waste, depletion, or extinction.
groups.summary_zh: 指审慎节约、精打细算地使用有限资源，以防消耗竭尽或破坏。

groups.name: Constrain & Inhibit · 限制与约束 (Shackle, Hamstring, Tether)
groups.tip: 通过规则约束限制行动自由

items.def_en: To restrict someone's freedom of action or movement through obligations or conditions
To hamper, impede, or limit the proper development or freedom of something
1. (formal) To restrict or limit someone's freedom, choice, or actions. 2. (often passive, 'be constrained to') To compel or force someone to act in a certain way.
To severely prevent freedom of action or development, as if with chains

items.def_zh: 使受挫；切断…的活动能力
items.def_en: To severely handicap, impair, or limit the efficiency or effectiveness of someone or something
To restrict or confine someone's freedom or advancement

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on restricting someone's capacity for independent movement, choice, or operation, frequently through institutional, physical, or resource limitations.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过制度、环境或物理力量束缚主体的行动自由或发展能力。

groups.name: Consume & Deplete · 消耗与耗尽 (Consume, Deplete, Exhaust)
groups.tip: 从持续消耗到彻底耗竭

items.def_en: To use up or spend time, effort, or capital in completing a specific purpose
To finish completely the entire supply of an ingredient, fuel, or material

items.def_zh: 消耗，耗费；吃，喝；（情感）吞噬，困扰
items.def_en: 1. to use up resources, fuel, or time 2. (formal) to eat or drink something 3. (of a strong feeling) to take up all the attention and energy of someone
To cause a pool of funds, vitality, or energy to flow away steadily until exhausted
To severely reduce the supply, proportion, or natural stocks of something valuable
To completely use up a resource, reserve, or energy supply until nothing is left

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the graded reduction and ultimate running out of finite materials, fuel, funds, physical energy, or natural resources through ongoing use or expenditure.
groups.summary_zh: 指资源、燃料、精力或积蓄因持续使用而逐渐削减直至枯竭耗尽。

groups.name: Consummate & Crown · 圆满完成与圆房 (Consummate, Crown, Finalize)
groups.tip: 既指事业大功告成，又特指婚姻圆房

items.def_en: To complete or reward something successfully with a final triumphant touch or achievement
To make an agreement, bargain, or relationship definitive, official, and complete

items.def_zh: 实现；达到预定完满状态
items.def_en: To achieve a promise, hope, or complete developmental destiny
To succeed in obtaining, achieving, or decisively settling an agreement or deal

items.def_zh: 最终确定；完成最后手续
items.def_en: To finish the last details of a plan, legal contract, or business arrangement

items.def_zh: （同房）圆房，使（婚姻）完满；完成，圆满达成（交易等）
items.def_en: 1. To make a marriage or relationship legally complete by having sexual intercourse. 2. (formal) To bring a deal, arrangement, or plan to a successful conclusion.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses bringing an ongoing project, treaty, relationship, or marriage to ultimate, culminating perfection and legal or emotional fulfillment. In marital settings it explicitly denotes initial sexual union; in broader usage it marks the definitive crowning achievement.
groups.summary_zh: 指使事业、协议达到圆满极点，或经由圆房使婚姻生效。

groups.name: Contaminate & Taint · 污染与玷污 (Taint, Besmirch, Befoul)
groups.tip: 混入杂质，破坏纯洁与原本品质

items.def_en: 1. To spoil or affect something with a bad, corrupt, or poisonous quality; to damage someone's reputation.
To make someone's good reputation, achievement, or character lose its brilliance or respect
To damage the purity, beauty, or unimpeachable integrity of something precious
To cause harm to the good reputation, honor, or spotless image of someone or something
To make foul, filthy, or morally repulsive through direct physical dirt or gross misconduct
To spoil something sacred, holy, or pure with foulness, corruption, or utter disrespect

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on inflicting a lasting, damaging defect, infection, or moral stain on someone's reputation, food supplies, character, or innocence, turning what was once pure or credible into something corrupted.
groups.summary_zh: 指对名誉、品质或洁净事物造成不可逆的毒害、玷污与腐蚀。

groups.name: Contract & Bind · 契约与法律约束 (Contract, Article, Indenture, Bind)
groups.tip: 通过条文契约约束

items.def_zh: 以契约约束（学徒或实习生）
items.def_en: (formal) To bind someone by a contract, especially as an apprentice or trainee.

items.def_zh: 订立合同，缔结契约；（使）收缩，缩短；感染（疾病）
items.def_en: 1. To make a formal or legal agreement with someone. 2. To become smaller or narrower, or make something do this. 3. To catch or develop a serious disease.
(+ to/by) to legally or morally oblige someone to adhere to a duty, agreement, or term

items.def_zh: 令（某人）具结保证，依法约束
items.def_en: (+ sb) to place someone under legal or judicial obligation to perform an action or keep the peace

items.def_zh: 签约雇用；签约承担义务
items.def_en: (+ sb) to bind someone or oneself by contract to a specific period of service or duty

items.def_zh: 签学徒契约，以契约束缚
items.def_en: (+ to) to bind someone by a formal legal agreement to work for another for a fixed period

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame depict entering into, drafting, or imposing legally binding covenant obligations (often governing service, partnership, or trade) between parties.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过订立具有法律效力的合同或学徒契约，使双方受到义务约束。

groups.name: Contradict & Gainsay · 反驳与自相矛盾 (Deny, Gainsay, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 针锋相对地质疑与反驳论点

items.def_en: To state that an allegation, rumor, or statement is simply not true.
To question the validity or truth of a claim, fact, or conclusion.
To disagree strongly with a particular point and choose to argue against it.

items.def_zh: 反驳，驳斥；与……相抵触，与……矛盾
items.def_en: 1. To say that a statement or person is wrong by stating the opposite. 2. If two facts, reports, or claims contradict each other, they are so different that both cannot be true.
To give an impression of something that does not match reality, or contradict it.
To deny, dispute, or speak against a statement (usually in negative constructions).

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on stating the polar opposite of a proposition, pointing out internal inconsistency, or flatly denying the truth of what was just asserted.
groups.summary_zh: 直言否定前述断言、指出两相冲突或断然否认某事实的存在。

groups.name: Convene & Select Jurors · 遴选与召集 (Em風nel/Empanel, Swear In, Subpoena)
groups.tip: 依法选定并登记陪审团成员

items.def_zh: （法庭上）对（陪审员人选）提出异议
items.def_en: (law) To formally object to the inclusion of a prospective juror during selection

items.def_zh: 编入陪审团名单；选定陪审团
items.def_en: To select and list candidates to serve on a jury for a specific trial

items.def_zh: 使宣誓就职（或入列陪审）
items.def_en: To administer an official oath to someone before they assume duties as a juror or public official
To officially order a citizen to appear in court for jury service or legal examination

items.def_zh: 召集（专门小组或陪审团）
items.def_en: To call people together formally for an official inquest, panel, or legal session

items.def_zh: 选定（陪审团成员），将……列入陪审员名单
items.def_en: (law) To select and swear in a group of citizens to serve as a jury in a trial.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the formal legal procedures for conscripting, screening, selecting, and swearing in citizens to constitute a jury, panel, or investigative body.
groups.summary_zh: 法庭依法筛选、召集并宣誓组建陪审团或专门小组。

groups.name: Cope & Manage · 应对与周旋 (Grapple, Tackle, Contend)
groups.tip: 调动认知资源化解难题

items.def_zh: 勉强对付过去，勉强维生
items.def_en: Have just enough money, resources, or ability to survive or manage difficult conditions
(+ with) To deal successfully with a difficult situation or problem.

items.def_zh: 搏斗应付，应付吃紧的难题
items.def_en: (+ with) Have to deal with a persistent problem, hardship, or disadvantage
Come through a dangerous crisis or severe difficulty safely without being broken by it

items.def_zh: 果断着手处理，对付解决
items.def_en: Make a determined, energetic effort to deal with and solve a difficult issue or task

items.def_zh: 扭结抗争，竭力设法应对
items.def_en: (+ with) Try very hard to understand, deal with, or find solutions for a difficult problem

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the cognitive, emotional, and practical efforts expended to confront, handle, and overcome adversity, stress, or demanding tasks, varying from just barely surviving hardships to taking proactive problem-solving action.
groups.summary_zh: 表达直面困难、重负或挑战时，努力周旋、应对并设法处置。

groups.name: Corrode & Erode · 侵蚀与腐蚀 (Corrode, Erode, Wear Away)
groups.tip: 化学或风雨缓慢蚕食

items.def_en: Cause something to become gradually thinner, smoother, or weaker through friction or continuous contact
Damage or destroy a substance gradually by chemical action, rust, or steady destruction
Create small hollow marks or small depressions on a metal or stone surface through corrosive action
Become oxidized and coated with iron oxide when exposed to moisture and air
Gradually wear away soil, rock, or other materials through wind, water, or friction
1. to slowly destroy or damage a material by chemical action, rust, or acid; to be destroyed in this way. 2. to gradually weaken or undermine something.
