groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the gradual physical or chemical wearing down, decay, and disintegration of surfaces or structural materials over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过风化、摩擦或化学作用使物质表面与结构发生渐进式的剥落销蚀。

groups.name: Corrode & Tarnish · 氧化腐蚀与生锈 (Rust, Oxidize, Corrode)
groups.tip: 化学侵蚀或氧化生锈

items.def_en: to cause hollow marks or tiny corrosive cavities to form on a surface
(+ at) to gradually destroy or consume a surface or substance by chemical or mechanical action
1. to become coated with rust through exposure to moisture and air, or cause metal to do this 2. to lose quality, skill, or vitality through lack of use or practice
to lose or cause to lose lustre, especially through exposure to air or moisture
to undergo a chemical reaction combining with oxygen, producing a crust, film, or rust
to slowly damage or destroy a metal or material through chemical or electrochemical action

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses metals and material surfaces undergoing electrochemical breakdown, oxidization, tarnishing, or gradual destruction due to moisture, air, or acids.
groups.summary_zh: 指金属或材质表面因受空气、水分或化学试剂侵蚀而氧化、生锈或变暗。

groups.name: Cosign & Guarantee · 连带签署与担保 (Underwrite, Guarantee, Back)
groups.tip: 共同签名确认法律效力

items.def_en: To provide financial, moral, or institutional support to reinforce an undertaking
To legally promise to pay another party's debt or honor their obligations if they default
To pledge ongoing loyalty or guarantee the quality and promises made by an entity
To accept financial responsibility for commercial risk or guarantee purchase of unsold shares
(+ against) To promise legal protection or compensation against future damage, loss, or lawsuit

items.def_zh: 连带签署，共同担保（协议或贷款）
items.def_en: To sign a loan agreement or official document jointly with another party, accepting equal legal obligation.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entering into legal or financial compacts jointly or as a guarantor, formally assuming liability to repay a debt or execute a contract if another party defaults.
groups.summary_zh: 指在金融与法律合同中承担连带签署、背书担保或兜底清偿责任。

groups.name: Counter & Push Back · 应对抗辩与回击 (Push Back, Riposte, Fight Back)
groups.tip: 针对对方观点针锋相对地回击

items.def_en: To reply to someone with an opposing argument, or to take action in order to oppose or defend against something.
(+ against) To oppose, resist, or argue back against a plan or viewpoint.
To make a quick and witty or damaging reply countering an attack or claim.
(+ against) To defend yourself energetically against criticism, demands, or an adversary.
(+ at) To retaliate against critics or opponents through spoken or written attacks.
To ward off a question or challenge by answering evasively or cleverly turning it aside.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on tactical argumentation where a speaker parries an opponent's critique or move by delivering an immediate, offsetting counter-argument or defense.
groups.summary_zh: 在辩论或策略对抗中进行抗辩、化解攻势并组织反向制衡。

groups.name: Creative Synthesis & Combination · 合成与结合 (Amalgamate, Fuse, Blend)
groups.tip: 化学或逻辑上的要素拼合

items.def_en: Make or assemble something by combining distinct parts, ingredients, or chemicals
Assemble a coherent story, theory, or object by gathering separate fragments together
Mix different substances or qualities together smoothly and harmoniously
Join or blend diverse things together inextricably, often by melting or intense union

items.def_zh: （通过化学或生物过程）合成；综合，融合（思想、观点等）
items.def_en: 1. To produce a substance by chemical or biological combination. 2. To combine different ideas, facts, or styles to form a single integrated whole.
Combine multiple elements, organizations, or materials into a unified single whole

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on systematically bringing disparate substances, elements, or concepts together through a process of synthesis to yield a distinct new composite entity.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将异质元素、成分或理论系统结合或化合，产出全新统一体。

groups.name: Criticize & Condemn · 谴责与声讨 (Condemn, Denounce, Castigate)
groups.tip: 从批评升级为严厉谴责

items.def_zh: 谴责，痛斥；判刑，判处；宣告（建筑物）为危房
items.def_en: 1. To express very strong disapproval of someone or something, usually in public. 2. To sentence someone to a severe punishment. 3. To officially declare a building unfit for use.
(+ as) To declare publicly that someone or something is wicked, evil, or utterly wrong
To strongly and openly express condemnation of something considered unfair, harmful, or shameful
To express severe, formal official disapproval of someone's misconduct or failing
To criticize a person, performance, or policy harshly, vigorously, and mercilessly
(+ for) To reprimand and criticize someone extremely severely, often in a blistering public fashion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame articulate deep moral indignation, official censure, or severe castigation of wrongful, criminal, or heinous actions.
groups.summary_zh: 指因道德或法规严重逾矩而予以严厉抨击与公开定罪。

groups.name: Crouch & Squat · 蹲伏与蜷缩 (Squat, Cower, Cuddle)
groups.tip: 缩成一团蹲伏避寒避险

items.def_en: To draw one's arms and legs tightly close to the torso in a protective posture
To bend one's knees fully so the buttocks rest near or on the heels
To settle into a low crouching shelter or brace oneself to endure a difficult period
To lower the body stance by bending knees and spine, often to hide or prepare to leap

items.def_zh: 蹲下，蹲伏；隐蔽防御，按兵不动
items.def_en: 1. ('hunker down') To squat down low on one's heels. 2. ('hunker down') To settle into a sheltered place or prepare to endure a difficult period.
To cringe or crouch down in fear, terror, or subservience

groups.summary_en: This frame covers lowering the body close to the ground by bending knees and spine, whether to take cover, conceal oneself, rest on heels, or brace against harsh conditions. It contrasts utilitarian low stances with defensive or protective curling.
groups.summary_zh: 指屈膝弯腰、紧贴地面以隐蔽、避险或休整的低姿态动作。

groups.name: Crush & Mash to Pieces · 压碎与捣烂 (Crush, Mash, Squash)
groups.tip: 施加重压直至彻底成浆

items.def_en: To crush food or another soft substance until it becomes a uniform paste or pulp
To crush thoroughly into a pulpy, blended consistency
To press or squeeze something with a force that deforms, breaks, or destroys its structure
To crush or squeeze something flat, soft, or out of shape through sudden or heavy pressure
To crush or grind something, such as fruit, wood, or paper, into a soft, wet, shapeless mass.
To crush, grind, or beat something into fine powder, dust, or tiny fragments

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting forceful mechanical pressure on an object until its physical integrity collapses into a soft, flattened, or formless mass. They range from utilitarian kitchen preparation to violent destructive flattening.
groups.summary_zh: 通过施压使物体破裂、扁平化或化为烂泥浆状。

groups.name: Cunning Superiority & Evasion · 智胜与耍花招胜过 (Outsmart, Outfox)
groups.tip: 凭借心智机巧压制并胜过对手

items.def_zh: 巧妙避开，规避（规则或对手）
items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) to overcome or bypass a rule, obstacle, or person by clever or sly means

items.def_zh: 巧妙穿过，趁人不备越过
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to pass or evade an opponent or obstacle quietly and cunningly without detection
to get the better of someone by being cleverer or more astute
to overcome an opponent by using more skillful or tactically superior maneuvers

items.def_zh: 智胜，比……精明，以计谋击败
items.def_en: To defeat or gain an advantage over someone by being more clever or cunning than they are.

items.def_zh: 以计谋挫败，以机智胜过
items.def_en: To defeat or outsmart someone by using clever, cunning, or deceitful tactics.

groups.summary_en: Verbs where an agent defeats, bypasses, or gains an advantage over a rival through superior wit, cunning, sly calculation, or shrewdness.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借过人智谋、狡黠手段或计策在博弈中胜过、挫败对手。

groups.name: Customize & Tailor · 定制与个性化 (Tailor, Bespeak, Individualize)
groups.tip: 依特定需求进行专享改造

items.def_en: To make something specifically ordered and fitted to an individual customer
To adapt or make something especially suitable for a specific person, group, or purpose
To build or change something according to a customer's individual needs and preferences

items.raw_cluster: 定制与个性化 Customize & Personalize
items.def_zh: 使个性化，专为个人定制；在……上标明专有记号
items.def_en: To design, adapt, or mark something to suit a specific individual's tastes, needs, or identity.
To give something individual character or adapt it to a single person's needs
To order or arrange for something in advance according to custom specifications

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote modifying, designing, or adapting goods, services, or experiences to match individual specifications, personal tastes, or unique requirements.
groups.summary_zh: 依据个体特定偏好或要求专门定制与改造。

groups.name: Dampen & Moisten · 浸湿与微湿 (Humidify, Mist, Sponge)
groups.tip: 增加液体与水分浸润

items.def_en: To spray fine droplets of liquid onto something, or become covered with vapor
To spray a fine mist of liquid onto something briefly
To wipe or moisten a surface gently using a damp sponge
To make dry air or a room more moist by releasing fine vapor

items.def_zh: 弄湿，微湿；减弱，抑制（热情或声响）
items.def_en: 1. to make something slightly wet 2. to make feelings, especially excitement or enthusiasm, less strong

items.def_zh: 减弱，消减（与dampen同义的引申义）
items.def_en: To make a sound, feeling, or sensation much weaker or less intense

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies reducing dry brittleness by lightly coating with liquid or vapor, and readily extends metaphorically to suppressing, dulling, or abating vigor and enthusiasm.
groups.summary_zh: 指轻微打湿或加湿以减除干燥，亦常引申为抑制情绪、热情或减弱强度。

groups.name: Dare & Defy · 敢于与叫板 (Dare, Defy, Challenge)
groups.tip: 鼓起勇气对抗危险或权威

items.def_en: Invite someone to engage in a contest, test of strength, or proof of capability
1. To be brave enough to do something difficult or dangerous. 2. To challenge someone to do something risky or frightening.
Dare to do or say something that involves substantial risk or danger
Endure or confront unpleasant, hazardous, or stormy conditions courageously

items.def_zh: 迎战，勇斗（强敌/艰巨任务）
items.def_en: Fight, compete against, or tackle a formidable opponent or daunting task
Openly resist, refuse to obey, or challenge authority or expectations boldly

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses having the personal audacity to confront peril or authority, as well as actively challenging someone else to demonstrate courage.
groups.summary_zh: 表达敢于涉险反抗，或向他人下战书发起挑战。

groups.name: Debar & Disqualify · 禁止与剥夺资格 (Debar, Disqualify, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 依法阻绝或剥夺资格

items.def_en: To formally exclude someone from an activity, right, or premises
To officially forbid an action or thing by laws, rules, or orders
To make someone not qualified or legally entitled to have or do something
To decide that someone or something is completely impossible, unsuitable, or ineligible
To officially stop someone from participating, winning, or practicing a profession due to breaking a rule
1. (+ from) (formal) To officially ban or prevent someone from doing something, entering a place, or holding a privilege.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on formally or legally denying someone a privilege, office, right, or qualification through an authoritative decree or failure of prerequisites.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、法律或规则正式剥夺某人的资格、权利或准入许可。

groups.name: Debase & Prostitute · 出卖人格与自贬才智 (Prostitute, Sell Out, Debase)
groups.tip: 为图利益自贬身价出卖原则

items.def_zh: 贬低，使蒙羞（尤指 demean oneself）
items.def_en: to cause a severe loss in dignity or self-respect through unworthy behavior

items.def_zh: 出卖背叛（原则/同伴），同流合污
items.def_en: to abandon one's moral values, cause, or associates for financial gain or personal comfort
to turn from sound moral principles to dishonesty, depravity, or bribery

items.def_zh: 卖淫；出卖（原则、才能等）以牟利
items.def_en: 1. ('prostitute oneself') to engage in sexual activity for payment 2. to misuse or debase one's talents, skills, or principles for low motives or financial gain

items.def_zh: 侮辱，损害……的自尊与品格
items.def_en: to treat or use someone in a way that humiliates them and reduces their worth
to lower the moral character, dignity, or genuine quality of someone or oneself

groups.summary_en: Conveys trading away one's creative talents, core beliefs, dignity, or moral integrity for mercenary reward, expediency, or fame.
groups.summary_zh: 指为金钱或功利而出卖原则、自轻自贱或玷污才智尊严。

groups.name: Decide & Resolve · 决定与抉择 (Determine, Settle, Conclude)
groups.tip: 从做出抉择到坚定决意

items.def_en: (+ for / to) Make a choice from a range of available possibilities
Come to a definitive decision after hesitation or contemplation

items.def_zh: 决定，抉择；裁决，判决；解决
items.def_en: 1. To make a choice or judgment about something after considering the possibilities. 2. To settle, resolve, or officially judge a dispute or outcome.
Bring an uncertain dispute, choice, or matter to an agreed-upon conclusion
Firmly establish, calculate, or make up one's mind about an outcome or rule
Make a firm, solemn, and steadfast decision to do something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cognitive acts of coming to a conclusive judgment, selecting an option from competing alternatives, or firmly binding oneself to an intended course of action.
groups.summary_zh: 权衡抉择，对不同选项或悬而未决的事项形成确定意志或结论。

groups.name: Decipher & Read · 辨读与释意 (Decipher, Make out, Construe, Fathom)
groups.tip: 破解隐秘玄机与密码

items.def_zh: 读出；领会（深层意义/意图）
items.def_en: To understand the meaning of non-verbal cues, intentions, or difficult characters
To deduce or understand something from words, clues, or observed evidence
To manage to see, read, or hear something with difficulty because it is faint or unclear
To recognize and understand the true nature or hidden inner motives behind words or facades

items.def_zh: 破译（密码）；辨认出（难辨字迹等）；理解，解读
items.def_en: To succeed in reading, decoding, or understanding text that is difficult to read or information that is mysterious or obscure.
(+ as) To understand the meaning of a word, remark, or action in a particular way

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the perceptual and cognitive struggle to read barely legible handwriting, faded inscriptions, or cryptic expressions and understand their underlying meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 辨认模糊难辨的字迹，或领悟晦涩难懂的言辞与表情。

groups.name: Decipher & Unravel · 剖析与抽丝剥茧 (Unravel, Untangle, Tease out, Sift)
groups.tip: 抽丝剥茧理清疑团

items.def_en: (+ through) To examine a huge amount of clues, evidence, or details carefully to find what is relevant
To understand a story, crime, or mystery by assembling fragmented evidence bit by bit

items.def_zh: 费力梳理出；耐心抽取出
items.def_en: To manage to reveal or extract hidden facts, subtle meanings, or strands of truth through patient effort

items.def_zh: 解开，澄清（谜团、疑难等）；拆开（织物等）；崩溃，瓦解
items.def_en: 1. To solve, explain, or clarify a mystery or complicated puzzle. 2. To undo or separate knotted or woven threads. 3. To fall apart, break down, or fail (of a system, plan, or relationship).

items.def_zh: 解开；理清（混乱思绪或复杂关系）
items.def_en: To separate things that are twisted together; clarify and make sense of a complicated situation
(+ from) To separate one complicated idea, narrative, or problem from another to make it clearer

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights the step-by-step, tactile or analytical disentanglement of complex, interconnected threads of information, convoluted plots, or knotted dilemmas until the whole structure is revealed.
groups.summary_zh: 抽丝剥茧般理清错综复杂的线索、纠葛或深奥谜题。

groups.name: Declutter & Streamline · 清理杂物与规整空间 (Clear out, Tidy, Weed out)
groups.tip: 清除杂乱使环境井井有条

items.def_en: To remove mess or unnecessary things from a room or surface to make it tidier
To empty a place thoroughly by discarding or putting away unnecessary contents
To make a place neat by putting things in their proper places
To systematically remove unwanted or useless items or elements from a collection
To look through a group of things carefully in order to organize them or remove unwanted items

items.def_zh: 清理，使整洁，清除……的杂物
items.def_en: To remove unnecessary objects or clutter from a space to make it tidy.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe removing unnecessary, scattered, or messy items from a room, container, or workspace to restore order. While 'declutter' focuses on discarding excess possessions, 'clear out' implies thorough removal, and 'weed out' emphasizes sorting to eliminate the unwanted.
groups.summary_zh: 指清除多余或杂乱物品以恢复整洁、开阔与秩序。

groups.name: Decode & Decrypt · 解密与转换 (Decode, Decrypt, Demystify, Translate)
groups.tip: 将晦涩代码翻译明了

items.def_en: (+ into) To express specialized, technical, or symbolic communication in words that ordinary people understand

items.def_zh: 诠释；解读（含蓄或编码意义）
items.def_en: To explain or decide on the intended meaning of ambiguous signals, charts, or signs

items.def_zh: 破译，译码；理解（晦涩含义）
items.def_en: 1. To translate a coded message, secret signal, or electronic data into intelligible language. 2. To understand the hidden or complicated meaning of something.
To analyze strings of coded data, syntax, or complex speech into distinct structural components
To convert cryptographically encoded or encrypted data back into its original plain, unencrypted form
To make a complicated or esoteric subject easier to understand by removing mystery and jargon

groups.summary_en: This frame belongs to the formal/technical domain of converting encrypted ciphertexts, technical jargon, or encoded binary transmissions back into human-readable, intelligible communication.
groups.summary_zh: 将加密电文、生硬术语或机器信号还原为可读懂的信息。

groups.name: Decompress & Relieve · 缓解与释放 (Unwind, De-stress, Let up)
groups.tip: 释放压力使身心舒缓

items.def_en: To relax completely and stop worrying, often after a stressful situation
To reduce feelings of tension and mental or emotional pressure
To get rid of accumulated nervous energy, anger, or stress through vigorous activity
To release strong feelings, pressure, or frustration openly and forcefully
To relax and let go of stress after a period of work or nervous tension
1. To reduce air or water pressure gradually; (informal) to relax and relieve stress after hard work.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on discharging pent-up physical pressure or emotional stress, transitioning from intense strain or work into a state of relaxed recovery.
groups.summary_zh: 指卸除积聚的物理压力或神经紧绷，从高压忙碌转入松弛休整。

groups.name: Dedicate & Devote · 奉献与倾注 (Devote, Dedicate, Commit)
groups.tip: 全身心投入崇高事业或信仰

items.def_zh: 致力于，投入（资源或自身）
items.def_en: (+ oneself/resources to) to pledge or devote completely to a particular purpose or course of action

items.def_zh: 把（时间、精力等）全部倾注于
items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) to dedicate or surrender oneself, time, or resources completely to a specific pursuit
(+ sth to sb/sth) to dedicate or sacrifice one's time, resources, or efforts wholly for a particular person or cause

items.def_zh: 把……奉献给，致力于（尤指 dedicate oneself/time to）；将（作品等）题献给；为（建筑物等）举行落成典礼
items.def_en: 1. (dedicate yourself/something to) To give a lot of your time, effort, or life to a particular purpose or cause. 2. To address or offer a book, music, or artwork to someone as a tribute.
To give your time, effort, or love completely to a person, activity, or cause.
(+ to) to officially dedicate someone or something to a revered, solemn, or religious purpose

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving a significant portion of one's time, efforts, resources, or one's entire life exclusively to a cause, person, or serious pursuit.
groups.summary_zh: 指将自身时间、精力或心血全心全意倾注于某项事业、信仰或他人。

groups.name: Define & Interpret · 定义与阐释 (Construe, Frame, Conceptualize)
groups.tip: 重新界定概念并诠释内涵

items.def_en: To express something chosen carefully to emphasize a particular perspective or context
To express an idea or feeling fluently and clearly in words

items.def_zh: 重新界定，重新定义；改变……的性质或范围
items.def_en: To define again or differently; to change the nature, meaning, or boundaries of a concept, role, or standard.
To understand the meaning of a word, action, or remark in a particular way
To describe, explain, or mark the exact limits of something in detail
To form an idea or principle in your mind to understand a phenomenon

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses intellectual and communicative verbs used to delineate boundaries, establish the essence of concepts, or frame how phenomena are understood.
groups.summary_zh: 阐发事物本质、界定概念范围或从特定角度解读。

groups.name: Defy & Rebel · 违抗与叛逆 (Defy, Flout, Rebel)
groups.tip: 从消极不服从到公开挑衅违抗

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To violate a law, agreement, or established rule.
To confront and resist an intimidating person or oppressive command bravely.

items.def_zh: 违抗，不服从；违反（法规、命令）
items.def_en: To refuse to do what you are told, or to break a rule, law, or command.
To openly refuse to obey a law, order, or authority figure with boldness.
To intentionally break a rule, convention, or statute with blatant disrespect.
(+ against) To fight against an existing government, ruler, or system of authority.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers deliberate non-compliance, escalating from passive or direct disregard of orders to outright rebellion against institutional authority.
groups.summary_zh: 对规章、禁令或上级命令的不服从、公然蔑视乃至武装反叛。

groups.name: Degrade & Weaken · 损耗与效能削弱 (Impair, Debilitate, Compromise)
groups.tip: 机能受损结构遭破坏

items.def_en: to make or become less in intensity, quality, or functional capacity

items.def_zh: 削弱，损害（安全性或机能）
items.def_en: to cause the impairment or weakening of structural, bodily, or operational integrity
to weaken or damage something (such as health, vision, or an ability), causing it to function less effectively
to severely weaken the strength, vigour, or operational ability of someone or something
to spoil, reduce, or destroy the quality, efficiency, or legal force of something
to damage or weaken severely so that normal functioning is largely prevented

groups.summary_en: Focuses on damaging, weakening, or diminishing the normal functionality, strength, or structural integrity of faculties, materials, or operational systems.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重使身体机能、机械强度或运作系统受损、衰退或功能大打折扣。

groups.name: Delegate & Appoint · 授权与分派职务 (Depute, Delegate, Commission)
groups.tip: 授权指定代理人代表行事

items.def_en: To formally choose someone to carry out a specific task or produce a specific piece of work
To officially choose someone for a special position or assignment
To give official permission or legal authority to someone to do something
To entrust a task, duty, or power to another person, especially a subordinate
To give someone the official authority, legal power, or confidence to take action

items.def_zh: 委派，授权（某人）代理；把（权限等）委托给
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/to do) (formal) To appoint someone to act as a representative or perform a duty on one's behalf; to delegate a power or duty.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate transferring authority, duties, or representative roles from a superior or organization to an authorized agent. Nuances vary according to legal formality, specific task assignment, and institutional power.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或上级将权力、职责或代理任务正式委派或分派给他人。

groups.name: Demand & Insist · 索求与强令 (Demand, Exact, Claim)
groups.tip: 坚决要求或主张应得权利

items.def_en: To demand or require publicly that action be taken
To demand forcefully and refuse to accept any refusal or alternative
To assert or demand as a right that something belongs to you
1. To ask for something firmly, forcefully, and authoritatively. 2. To require or need something.
To demand and obtain something firmly or by using authority, threats, or force
To wrest or obtain money or favors by intimidation, violence, or abuse of authority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express assertive, peremptory, or coercive calls for compliance, payment, explanation, or rights. They differ in degree of institutional authority, pressure, and whether force or absolute entitlement is claimed.
groups.summary_zh: 表达强硬、不容置疑地要求提供、交出或顺从。

groups.name: Democratize & Liberalize · 民主化与均等开放 (Liberalize, Emancipate, Decontrol)
groups.tip: 革新制度使之趋向民主现代

items.def_en: To remove social, economic, or legal barriers and make something broadly available
To give someone the authority, confidence, or legal freedom to control their own destiny
To distribute government or administrative power away from a central authority to local levels
To make laws, economic systems, or political regimes less strict and more open

items.def_zh: 使民主化；使普及，使大众化
items.def_en: 1. To make a country or institution democratic. 2. To make something accessible to all people.
To free someone from legal, political, or social enslavement and restrictions

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses political and social restructuring to dismantle hierarchical monopolies, expand civic participation, and make power or access universal.
groups.summary_zh: 指推行民主改革、打破专制特权或使权利与资源普及至大众。

groups.name: Demote & Depose · 降职与罢免 (Downgrade, Relegate, Oust)
groups.tip: 官职降等直至彻底废黜下台

items.def_zh: 使降级；调低…的级别或重要性
items.def_en: To reduce someone or something to a lower rank, status, or level of importance

items.def_zh: 使降职；将…降到次要或较低位置
items.def_en: (+ to) To assign someone or something to a lower, less important, or less pleasant rank or position
1. (+ to) To move someone down to a lower position, rank, or grade, especially as a penalty.
To officially take away someone's rank, titles, honors, or privileges, often as a punishment
(+ from) To force someone out of a position of leadership, office, or power

items.def_zh: 废黜；罢免（君主或政权首脑）
items.def_en: To suddenly and officially remove a monarch or ruler from power, typically by political or military force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stripping someone of rank, office, or authority, ranging from formal administrative downgrades to forceful removals from power.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及削减职级、调低身份或强行解除权力与职位的行为。

groups.name: Dent & Indent · 凹陷与磕碰 (Dent, Dingle, Dimple)
groups.tip: 受冲撞在表面留下凹印

items.def_en: To make a small surface dent or nick in something, especially a motor vehicle
To make a small depression, notch, or groove in a surface or edge by pressing or striking
To make an indentation or cavity inside or upon the surface of something

items.def_zh: 使凹陷，使磕出凹痕；打击，削弱（信心、名誉等）
items.def_en: 1. To make a hollow mark or depression in a hard surface by striking it, or become marked in this way. 2. To damage, diminish, or weaken someone's confidence, pride, or finances.
To bend, warp, or collapse under the influence of heat, pressure, or impact
To make a deep, rough groove, hole, or depression in a surface by forceful scraping or cutting

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate damaging or altering a firm surface by impacting or pressing it so as to leave a hollow, crease, or indentation without completely perforating it. Typical objects include sheet metal, body panels, woodwork, or hard soil.
groups.summary_zh: 通过撞击、挤压使硬质表面受损产生凹痕或坑洼，未穿透。

groups.name: Deny & Repudiate · 否认与驳斥 (Deny, Disown, Repudiate)
groups.tip: 从口头否认到彻底拒不承认

items.def_zh: 收回（先前的言论或主张）
items.def_en: (+ sth) retreat from or retract an earlier statement, claim, or promise

items.def_zh: 否认，否定；拒绝给予，剥夺
items.def_en: 1. to state that something is not true; to refuse to admit. 2. to refuse to give or allow something to someone.

items.def_zh: 断绝关系，拒不承认（责任或所属）
items.def_en: To declare that one no longer has any connection with, ownership of, or responsibility for something

items.def_zh: 拒不承认，声明与……断绝关系
items.def_en: To deny any responsibility for, knowledge of, or association with an act or claim

items.def_zh: 否认，驳斥；拒绝承认；声明断绝关系；拒不履行（债务等）
items.def_en: (formal) to refuse to accept, acknowledge, or obey something; to deny the truth or validity of something
To forcefully deny a statement or demonstrate that an accusation is untrue

groups.summary_en: A speaker rejects an assertion, accusation, or responsibility. Intensity progresses from straightforward negation of factual truth ('deny') to complete, aggressive rejection of allegiance, obligation, or validity ('repudiate', 'disavow').
groups.summary_zh: 全盘否认指控、事实，或断然拒绝承认某种关系、责任与正当性。

groups.name: Deploy & Station · 调配与部署 (Station, Position, Marshal)
groups.tip: 军事或组织层面的力量配置

items.def_en: To send someone to a particular place to work, especially as a soldier, guard, or official.
To put someone or something carefully into a specific strategic or functional location.
To assign military personnel, police, or guards to a particular place or post for a period of duty.
1. To position troops or military equipment systematically over an area for battle. 2. To organize and use resources, skills, or arguments effectively.
To advance into a designated area to take control, intervene, or establish an active presence.
To gather together people, facts, or resources and organize them systematically for a common purpose.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the systematic positioning, distribution, and utilization of personnel, military forces, or organizational assets. 'Deploy' implies readiness for active combat or strategic execution, whereas 'station' and 'post' focus on assigned locations, and 'marshal' emphasizes assembling scattered resources.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人员、兵力或物资系统性地分派、布设至特定战术位置。

groups.name: Descend Rapidly & Swoop · 俯冲与猛扑 (Swoop, Dive, Pounce)
groups.tip: 自高处猛然俯冲扑击

items.def_en: To plunge downward steep and fast through the air

items.def_zh: 俯冲急下；机头向下猛冲
items.def_en: To drop nose-first vertically through the air toward the ground
1. (of a bird, plane, etc.) To fly or move rapidly downward through the air. 2. To make a sudden attack or raid.
(of a hawk or falcon) To dive headlong toward prey during flight
(+ on/upon) To leap or dive suddenly upon prey or an adversary to seize them
To fall or drop straight down at very high speed

groups.summary_en: This motion frame captures sudden, aggressive, or breathtaking airborne descents toward a target, typically by birds of prey, fighter aircraft, or predatory animals.
groups.summary_zh: 描述猛禽、战机或猎手自上而下凌空极速冲降并突袭扑击。

groups.name: Deserve & Merit · 应得与配得 (Merit, Warrant, Earn)
groups.tip: 凭功过理应承受对待

items.def_en: To be considered worthy of a particular kind of treatment or status

items.def_zh: 博得，赢得，招致（赞誉、惩罚等）
items.def_en: To get something that you deserve because of your work, qualities, or behavior

items.raw_cluster: 应得与配得上 Deserve & Merit
items.def_en: To earn something or be worthy of it because of your actions, qualities, or situation.

items.def_zh: 使有必要；值得（采取某种行动）
items.def_en: To make a particular action, reaction, or measure necessary, justified, or appropriate
To deserve what bad happens to you because of your previous foolish or hostile behavior
To be worthy of or deserve praise, attention, or punishment because of qualities or actions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe being entitled to, worthy of, or justly receiving a particular outcome, reaction, or reward based on actions or intrinsic qualities. While 'merit' and 'warrant' lean toward formal justification, 'earn' emphasizes effort and direct causation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示基于行为、资历或本质而应得、配得或理应受到某种对待与评价。

groups.name: Design & Devise · 规划设计与策划 (Conceive, Formulate, Mastermind)
groups.tip: 工程化设计与方案构想

items.def_en: 1. To design, build, or modify something using scientific or engineering methods. 2. To skillfully arrange or bring about a result, often secretly.
To invent an excuse, story, or ingenious scheme, often dishonestly
To plan or arrange an operational sequence or itinerary in complete detail

items.def_zh: 构想出；设计出（方案/装置）
items.def_en: To invent or plan a complex mechanism, system, or strategy with skill
To systematically develop a policy, concept, or elaborate strategy
To plan and direct the execution of an intricate project or scheme

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote strategically originating, structuring, and engineering complex systems, blueprints, plans, or outcomes through ingenuity.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用专业技术或谋略构想、策划并建构复杂系统或方案。

groups.name: Design & Devise · 赋予风格与定调 (Style, Brand, Tailor)
groups.tip: 设定基调设计整体布局

items.def_en: To design, shape, or decorate something according to an aesthetic fashion or motif

items.def_zh: 以……为主题，按特定主题设计
items.def_en: To design or decorate something according to a particular theme, motif, or style.

items.def_zh: 使导向；按某种格调定位
items.def_en: (+ towards/to) To design or align an experience or space around a core characteristic
(+ to/for) To adapt or design something specifically to suit distinct tastes or themes
To decorate, fit out, or garnish something elaborately in a specific thematic style

items.def_zh: 树立品牌形象；赋予品牌风格
items.def_en: To design an entity or product with distinctive marks, motifs, and identity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to shaping, styling, or adorning an environment, product, or presentation to conform to an aesthetic motif, identity, or demographic.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据特定的美学主题、风格或既定形象来设计装点事物。

groups.name: Designate Title & Style Nominally · 赐名与加封头衔 (Title, Style, Dub)
groups.tip: 赋予名称、称号或特定头衔

items.def_zh: 给……加标题，定题目；授予头衔
items.def_en: to give a title to a book, movie, work of art, or person

items.def_zh: 称呼，命名；设计，使具有某种风格
items.def_en: 1. to designate, name, or address someone or something by a particular title or term. 2. to design or fashion something in a particular way.
to give a specific title to a book, article, law, or piece of art
(+ sb/sth) give an entity or child the same name or honorific as someone or something else
(+ as/obj.) to bestow a name, honorary title, or nickname informally or ceremonially upon someone
to give a baby or vessel a name at a ceremony, or to name someone metaphorically

groups.summary_en: People or official bodies assign a distinctive formal honorific, book name, or descriptive epithet to an entity or dignitary.
groups.summary_zh: 为作品命名，或正式授予、以特定官方头衔/称号称呼某人。

groups.name: Detach & Sever · 分离与脱钩 (Uncouple, Disconnect, Sever)
groups.tip: 从整体上拆卸并剥离

items.def_zh: 拆下，分离，分开；使脱离，摆脱
items.def_en: 1. To separate or remove something from something larger that it is attached to. 2. (detach oneself) To distance oneself emotionally or mentally.
To unfasten, unplug, or break the connection between two joined objects or systems
To completely cut through an object or violently end a relationship/connection
To free something from a mechanism that holds or interlocks it, or to pull back from contact
To disconnect two things that are linked or hitched together, such as rail carriages
To release or open something that is fixed closed by a clasp, buckle, or clip

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail the deliberate physical unfastening, disengaging, or slicing apart of an object from another to which it was joined. They range from clicking something loose to permanently severing bonds.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将原本相连、系牢的事物解开脱离，或将其决绝切断。

groups.name: Deteriorate & Degrade · 恶化与衰败 (Decline, Decouple, Atrophy)
groups.tip: 品质降级每况愈下

items.def_en: To disintegrate, decompose chemically, or fail structurally
To rot or decompose through natural organic or societal processes
To undergo chemical breakdown and decay, especially organic material

items.def_zh: （使）降解，（使）变质退化；贬低，羞辱；使降职
items.def_en: 1. To deteriorate in quality, or break down chemically in the environment. 2. To treat someone with disrespect, causing them to lose dignity or self-respect.
To become progressively worse in quality, condition, or health
To decline to an inferior, immoral, or less evolved state

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail progressive structural, functional, or biological decay and the loss of inherent quality or integrity over time. They describe physical erosion, biological decomposition, or systemic rot.
groups.summary_zh: 事物质量、机能或结构随时间逐步衰退、破损或分解。

groups.name: Detox & Purify · 排毒与净化 (Cleanse, Purge, Flush out)
groups.tip: 清除体内毒素恢复生理洁净

items.def_en: To cleanse the body or an organ by drinking copious fluids to carry away toxins and impurities

items.def_zh: 通过出汗排出（毒素/感冒）
items.def_en: To get rid of a toxin, cold, or illness by sweating profusely through exercise, heat, or sauna
To purify or free bodily fluids or organic matter from impurities or impurities
To rid the body, skin, or an organ of dirt, toxins, or waste products, often through washing or special dietary regimens

items.def_zh: 通便；催吐清肠；清除（毒素）
items.def_en: To clear the digestive system thoroughly using laxatives or emetics, or to rid the body entirely of unwanted substances

items.def_zh: 排毒，接受戒毒（或戒酒）治疗
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To undergo medical treatment or follow a diet to rid the body of alcohol, drugs, or toxic substances.

groups.summary_en: Refers to ridding the physical body, organs, or an environment of toxic substances, impurities, or metabolic waste. While 'detox' often centers on abstaining from harmful substances or metabolic cleansing, verbs like 'purge' and 'flush out' emphasize aggressive evacuation or dilution.
groups.summary_zh: 指清除体内毒素、杂质或废物的生理净化过程。

groups.name: Devalue & Depreciate · 贬值与缩水 (Depreciate, Cheapen, Discount)
groups.tip: 等级地位下滑或资产价值缩水

items.def_en: To reduce the original price of goods, or to regard a statement as worth little credence.
To diminish gradually in price, value, magnitude, or support.
To officially reduce the recognized book value of an asset on a financial balance sheet.

items.def_zh: 使贬值，贬值；降低……的价值（或重要性）
items.def_en: 1. To reduce the official value of a currency in relation to other currencies, or to lose value in this way. 2. To diminish the worth, quality, or importance of something.
To decrease in financial value over time, or to reduce the recorded accounting value of an asset.
To reduce the price, monetary worth, or moral/artistic dignity of something.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the reduction in financial worth, purchasing power, market exchange value, or perceived significance. While 'devalue' specifically describes government-mandated currency reductions or intentional belittling, 'depreciate' covers spontaneous market wear or economic loss over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指货币、资产在市场或官方层面出现价值下跌或无形折旧。

groups.name: Devote & Dedicate · 奉献与投入 (Dedicate, Consecrate, Pedge)
groups.tip: 将时间与精力全身心投入

items.def_en: (+ to) To give all of one's time, energy, or efforts completely to a specific noble purpose
(+ to) To commit resources, time, or self-effort exclusively to a designated person or pursuit
To formally bind oneself or commit resources to support a cause or endeavor
(+ to) To surrender or dedicate one's entire time, thought, or activities to a focus
(+ to) To solemnly set apart or dedicate someone or something to a sacred or lofty end

items.def_zh: 再次投身于，重新献身于；为（修缮后的建筑等）重新举行落成典礼
items.def_en: (+ to) To devote yourself or something again to a cause or goal, or to dedicate a restored building or monument with a new ceremony.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on pledging time, energy, resources, or oneself wholeheartedly to a noble pursuit, cause, deity, or enterprise. It conveys profound loyalty, moral commitment, and sustained investment over an extended duration.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将全部心血、时间或信仰庄严且全身心地倾注于某项事业或崇高目标。

groups.name: Diagnose & Pinpoint Faults · 研判诊断与定性 (Pinpoint, Troubleshoot, Identify, Detect)
groups.tip: 根据体征症状作专业辨识

items.def_en: to recognize and correctly name the exact nature or cause of an anomaly or condition

items.def_zh: 分离出；准确定位（故障点）
items.def_en: to separate a single component, pathogen, or variable from others in order to examine it
to direct all analytical attention or focus toward a single specific problem or source
To identify the nature or cause of an illness, problem, or fault through examination and analysis.
to discover, describe, or locate the exact cause, spot, or problem with absolute precision
to analyze, trace, and rectify mechanical, software, or operational problems

groups.summary_en: Involves investigating symptoms, telemetry, or system failures to isolate the root pathological or mechanical cause. It operates strictly within diagnostic and investigative scenarios.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过全面排查与测定，精确定位疾病病原或系统故障根源。

groups.name: Differ & Diverge · 相异与分歧 (Differ, Vary, Diverge)
groups.tip: 性质或特征上有所差异

items.def_en: To be different from each other in size, amount, degree, or character across a range
1. (+ from) To be unlike or dissimilar in nature, quality, or character. 2. (+ with/over) To disagree in opinion.
(+ with) To fail to match or correspond when comparing two statements, facts, or data points
(+ with) To differ fundamentally in color, style, or opinion so as to create discord
(+ from) To differ noticeably or depart from what is usual, normal, or expected
(+ from) To become increasingly different in character, opinion, or course from an established path

groups.summary_en: This frame describes attributes, values, or entities displaying dissimilarities or deviating from a standard or each other. Nuances range from inherent taxonomic variety to active divergence or ideological disagreement.
groups.summary_zh: 描述性质、数值或特征彼此不同，或在发展与观点上产生分歧差异。

groups.name: Digest & Assimilate · 消化与吸收代谢 (Metabolize, Digest, Assimilate)
groups.tip: 食物在肠胃中分解与代谢

items.def_en: to take in nutrients or fluids into the bloodstream through bodily membranes
to reduce complex nutrients into simpler chemical components during metabolism
to break down food biologically in the stomach and intestines so nutrients can be absorbed
to produce biochemical compounds through metabolic activity in an organism
to absorb and integrate digested food substances into body tissues

items.def_zh: 代谢，新陈代谢（消化或转化物质）
items.def_en: (biology) To break down or change food, chemicals, or substances in the body by metabolism to produce energy or tissue.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe internal biochemical or physiological processes that break down ingested sustenance, absorb nutrients, and convert them into energy or tissue.
groups.summary_zh: 指体内将摄入的营养物进行生物分解、消化和吸收转化的生理过程。

groups.name: Dike & Embank · 筑堤与防护 (Embank, Levee, Dam)
groups.tip: 构筑堤坝阻挡洪涝灾害

items.def_en: (often + up) To build a barrier across a watercourse to stop, restrict, or direct its flow
To enclose, confine, or defend with a raised bank of earth or stone
To construct protective ridges or embankments along the banks of a river
To protect a shoreline against erosion by building a retaining wall or barrier
To enclose or isolate an area by erecting protective vertical structures around it
To protect low-lying land from flooding by constructing an embankment or dike, or to provide with drainage dikes.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve constructing earthworks, barriers, or walls to constrain, redirect, or hold back water and prevent coastal or riverine flooding.
groups.summary_zh: 指修建土堤、挡水墙或水坝以阻遏洪水并加固水岸。

groups.name: Directing Aim & Intent · 瞄准与针对 (Target, Aim, Direct)
groups.tip: 明确指向特定对象

items.def_en: To hold a weapon, camera, light, or gaze steadily focused on a target
to direct an action, criticism, advertising campaign, or weapon at a particular person, group, or goal
To point a weapon, comment, or action at someone, or to direct an endeavor toward an end
To direct all attention, fire, or efforts precisely toward one specific point
To direct accusations, criticism, or weapons directly and pointedly at someone

items.def_zh: 挑选出（以作批评或特别对待）
items.def_en: To choose one person or group from among others for distinctive, often critical, treatment

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on aiming projectiles, actions, remarks, or tailored strategies directly toward a specific recipient, objective, or audience.
groups.summary_zh: 将武器、批评、注意力或策略明确指向特定对象或预定目标。

groups.name: Disarm & Demilitarize · 缴械与去军事化 (Decommission, Demobilize, Neutralize)
groups.tip: 收缴武器消除武装军事力量

items.def_en: Render harmless or ineffective by stripping away aggressive power or lethal capability

items.def_zh: 解除戒备；撤出战斗岗位
items.def_en: Relax from a state of military readiness or withdraw from an active alert

items.raw_cluster: 缴械与解除武装 Disarm & Demilitarize
items.def_zh: 解除……的武装；放下武器，裁军；消除（敌意或戒心）
items.def_en: 1. To take weapons away from someone, or to give up weapons and reduce military forces. 2. To make someone feel less angry, suspicious, or critical.
Officially take weapons, ships, or nuclear plants out of active service
Remove all military forces, armaments, and operations from an area or border
Disband troops or release members of armed forces from military service

groups.summary_en: Encompasses actions where weapons, armaments, or military capacity are removed, surrendered, stripped down, or rendered completely inoperative.
groups.summary_zh: 指收缴武装、裁撤军队、销毁装备或消除军事防御设施的行动。

groups.name: Discard & Shed · 丢弃与摆脱 (Shed, Slough, Jettison)
groups.tip: 脱落甩掉或丢弃不需要之物

items.def_zh: 摆脱，去除；脱落，脱落（皮、叶等）；流（泪、血）
items.def_en: To get rid of or discard something unwanted; to lose leaves, skin, or hair naturally; to cause tears or blood to flow.
To cast off an outer layer of dead skin, or to rid oneself of a burdensome habit or feeling
To free oneself from constraints, burdens, or unwanted garments
To informally abandon or get rid of someone or something abruptly
To throw away or get rid of something that is no longer useful or needed
To drop cargo from an aircraft or ship to lighten load, or to abandon an idea, plan, or person

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe getting rid of, dropping, or discarding unwanted burdens, physical coverings, or excess baggage, either naturally or decisively.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动脱去、丢弃无用物或自然蜕落附着物。

groups.name: Disconnect & Sever · 断开与切断连接 (Disconnect, Uncouple, Sever)
groups.tip: 拔除插头或解除物理连接分离

items.def_en: To remove or separate a part from a larger structure or surface
To break the connection between two things or stop a machine's power supply
To divide or cut off cleanly and completely through force

items.def_zh: 拔掉……的插头，断开；拔去塞子，疏通
items.def_en: 1. To disconnect a piece of electrical equipment by taking its plug out of a socket. 2. To remove an obstruction or stopper from.
To free something from being trapped, fitted, or interlocked with another mechanism
To separate two things that are physically joined or linked together, such as railway cars

groups.summary_en: This frame covers interrupting physical, electrical, or logistical links between two entities. Verbs range from reversible disengagement like 'disconnect' and 'uncouple' to permanent and forceful separation like 'sever'.
groups.summary_zh: 指断开、拔除或切断物体之间的物理或电气连接。

groups.name: Discount & Liquidate · 降价抛售与清仓 (Remainder, Clear out, Mark down)
groups.tip: 降价清仓转让余货

items.def_en: To reduce the stated retail price of an article of merchandise

items.def_zh: 降价清仓出售（滞销图书）
items.def_en: (of a publisher) To sell remaining copies of an unsold or discontinued book at a heavily reduced price.
To sell remaining merchandise quickly and cheaply to empty shelves or storage

items.def_zh: 批发出售（存货）；转让尾货
items.def_en: To sell or buy goods wholesale in odd, surplus, or clearance lots
To deposit large quantities of unwanted or subsidized goods into a market at very low prices
To convert assets or excess inventory into cash rapidly, often under distress

groups.summary_en: This frame covers methods of divesting stock, inventory, or discontinued product lines at drastically reduced price points to recover working capital and make shelf space for fresh inventory.
groups.summary_zh: 对积压滞销品或断档货品进行大幅打折、清仓出清。

groups.name: Disentangle & Free from Peril · 解套与摆脱险境 (Disentangle, Dislodge, Wriggle Out)
groups.tip: 从困境或束缚中解救脱离

items.def_zh: 逐渐松开；慢慢挣脱出来
items.def_en: To free oneself or an object gradually through repeated small movements

items.def_zh: 扭动脱身；（引申）金蝉脱壳
items.def_en: (+ of) To physically twist and squirm out of a tight space or hold, or figuratively evade a tough obligation

items.def_zh: 撬脱；费力从受困处扳开
items.def_en: To force something out of a tight, jammed, or bound position using leverage

items.def_zh: 逐出；使脱离卡住的位置
items.def_en: To forcibly remove or dislocate someone or something from a jammed, stuck, or firmly fixed position
(+ from) (formal) To free or disentangle someone or something from a dangerous, difficult, or trapped position.
(+ from) To free someone or something from being tangled or caught in an intricate or constricting mess

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical or figurative extraction from an entangled, constricted, or dangerously confining situation. The core nuance involves overcoming friction, snags, or hazardous physical entrapment with deliberate effort.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过克服阻力、拆解缠绕或巧妙用力，从物理困境或纠葛中脱险。

groups.name: Disperse & Scatter · 散开与消散 (Disperse, Scatter, Dissipate)
groups.tip: 由聚集状态向四周散布

items.def_en: To leave a place, or for smoke/clouds to fade away
To separate suddenly and move off quickly in different directions
To move apart and go away in different directions, or to cause people or things to do this.
To disappear completely or dissolve, like moisture into the air

items.def_zh: （使烟雾、感觉等）逐渐消散，驱散
items.def_en: To gradually break up, fade away, or cause to disappear
To cease to exist as an organized group or cause a group to separate

groups.summary_en: This frame covers entities or crowds moving away from a central point in various directions until spread out or completely dissolved. It applies to physical crowds, clouds, smoke, and abstract tension.
groups.summary_zh: 表示群体或实体自中心向四面八方散去，或烟雾、情绪等逐渐消散隐去。

groups.name: Dispose & Discard · 废弃与处置 (Discard, Scrap, Dump)
groups.tip: 扔掉废品或处理闲置

items.def_en: To place something unwanted into the trash or part with it permanently
To discard or break up old equipment for metal, or abandon a plan as useless

items.def_zh: 处置，处理，扔掉（dispose of）；布置，安排；使倾向于
items.def_en: 1. (dispose of) To get rid of someone or something that you no longer want or need. 2. (formal) To arrange things in a particular position; to make someone inclined to a particular state or attitude.
To get rid of something that is no longer useful or wanted
To deposit or discard waste carelessly, or abruptly get rid of an unwelcome burden
To throw cargo or fuel off a ship or aircraft, or abandon ideas and burdens to lighten a load

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally getting rid of unwanted materials, possessions, or burdens. They range from systematic disposal to unceremonious shedding of clutter.
groups.summary_zh: 强调主动抛弃、清理或系统性处理掉多余无用的人事物。

groups.name: Distinguish & Differentiate · 辨析与细分 (Distinguish, Differentiate, Tell apart, Discern)
groups.tip: 辨明细微差异并区别对待

items.def_en: to perceive the visible or behavioral difference between two very similar entities
to recognize, show, or mark the difference between two or more people or things
to perceive or constitute the specific attributes that make someone or something unique
1. To recognize or see clear differences between things. 2. To treat someone unfairly because of their race, sex, or background.
to detect or comprehend with the senses or intellect something that is obscured or faint
to fix, establish, or mark the precise boundaries or limits separating two areas or domains

groups.summary_en: Denotes detecting subtle variances, borders, or identities between two or more sensory stimuli, ideas, or categories. It highlights analytical discernment and perceptual acuity.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用感知力或分析力在事物间辨析细微差别与边界。

groups.name: Distort & Misrepresent · 歪曲与曲解 (Distort, Misrepresent, Twist)
groups.tip: 歪曲篡改事实恶意曲解真相

items.def_en: To explain, understand, or represent something incorrectly, whether intentionally or not
To repeat someone's words incorrectly, thereby obscuring or changing the original meaning
To deliberately interpret someone's words or an event in a misleading or malicious way
To change facts, ideas, or circumstances so that they become misleading or untrue

items.def_zh: 歪曲，不如实叙述，不实报道
items.def_en: 1. To give a false or misleading account of facts, views, or someone's character.
To reproduce a message, text, or set of facts in a confused, altered, or inaccurate form

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to giving an inaccurate, selective, or deliberately biased account of facts, statements, or events. They range from rhetorical bending of someone's words to systemic, fraudulent mischaracterization.
groups.summary_zh: 指对事实、言论或真相进行歪曲、捏造或误导性陈述。

groups.name: Distort & Pervert · 败坏与曲解 (Pervert, Corrupt, Subvert)
groups.tip: 恶劣扭曲真相或本义

items.def_zh: 贬低；降低……的价值或品格
items.def_en: To reduce the quality, value, or moral standard of something
To cause someone or something to change from good, pure, or honest to dishonest, immoral, or bad
1. To distort the true meaning or proper course of something (such as justice); to corrupt or degrade morally.

items.def_zh: 使劣化；使变质；杂乱更改
items.def_en: To alter something so drastically that its true quality, integrity, or purity is debased

items.def_zh: 颠覆；暗中破坏（体制、正义等）
items.def_en: To undermine the power, authority, or moral foundation of an established system, institution, or truth
To destroy, impair, or corrupt the legal force, purity, or effectiveness of something

groups.summary_en: This frame covers corrupting, debasing, or violently diverting an abstract system, institution, or moral principle away from its rightful, natural, or intended course. It carries an intense moral or systemic condemnation.
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏、腐蚀或严重颠覆正义、制度及道德原则的本义。

groups.name: Distort & Skew · 扭曲与歪曲 (Skew, Distort, Bias)
groups.tip: 偏离原本常态，失真变形走样

items.def_en: To influence someone's opinion or perception in a subjective or prejudiced way
To influence results, a person, or an opinion unfairly in a particular direction
To alter a person's thinking, judgment, or morality so that it becomes perverse or unnatural
To change the facts, ideas, or representation of something so that they are misleading or false

items.def_zh: 曲解，使有偏向；偏斜，歪斜
items.def_en: 1. To cause results, opinions, or data to be inaccurate, biased, or distorted. 2. To turn or place at an angle; to slant.

items.def_zh: 有倾向性地陈述，偏向报道
items.def_en: To present information, an article, or a story in a biased way with a deliberate angle

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to introducing systematic error, asymmetry, or partiality into facts, data, perspectives, or representations so that the truth is misrepresented.
groups.summary_zh: 指因偏差或主观意图导致数据、事实或真相被歪曲篡改。

groups.name: Ditch & Abandon · 决绝抛弃与甩掉 (Chuck, Bin, Drop)
groups.tip: 狠心丢弃不再理会

items.def_zh: 终止接触；甩掉（伴侣/朋友）
items.def_en: To stop associating with someone or cease carrying out an ongoing scheme

items.def_zh: 摆脱，去除（累赘、员工、债务）
items.def_en: To rid oneself of unwanted weight, jobs, assets, or obligations efficiently
To throw something away into a waste receptacle or terminate a project entirely
To casually throw something away or abandon a partner, job, or plan

items.def_zh: 丢弃，抛弃，甩掉；使（飞机）水上迫降；在……开沟
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To get rid of or abandon someone or something you no longer want. 2. To make an emergency landing of an aircraft on water.
To intentionally reject, dismiss, or abandon someone or something without hesitation

groups.summary_en: This frame covers high-intensity, casual, or ruthless ways of severing ties or dumping unwanted objects, commitments, and people. It highlights haste, callousness, or sudden disregard.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重果断、仓促或无情地抛弃、扔掉或甩脱人事物。

groups.name: Diversify & Branch Out · 多样化与业务拓展 (Branch out, Vary, Expand)
groups.tip: 打破单一形态向多元方向分生

items.def_en: (+ into) To increase the range, scope, or operations of a business or portfolio
To introduce changes and differences into something to prevent monotony
(+ into) To start doing a new type of activity or business distinct from one's main work
To distribute risks, investments, or resources across several diverse areas

items.raw_cluster: 分化与多样化 Diversify & Vary
items.def_zh: （使）多样化，（使）多元化发展；（企业）扩大业务范围，从事多种经营
items.def_en: 1. To become more varied, or to make something more varied. 2. (+ into) (of a business or investor) To expand into new products, services, or markets.
To increase the variety, scope, or range of interests, activities, or choices

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses expanding range, form, or operations into new and distinct types, varieties, or market sectors to spread risk or enrich breadth.
groups.summary_zh: 指拓展范围、品种或业务领域，实现多态化以分散风险或增强生机。

groups.name: Divert & Shunt · 转移与分流 (Reroute, Deflect, Sidetrack)
groups.tip: 改变路线或分流改道

items.def_zh: 使转轨，使分流；推托，搁置
items.def_en: 1. To move a train or carriage onto a side track or from one track to another. 2. To push someone or something aside to a less important place or task.
To direct or guide money, resources, or energy along a particular course
To cause something or someone to change direction or turn away from a course

items.def_zh: 使偏斜；转移（批评、注意力）
items.def_en: To cause something to change direction after hitting it, or turn aside criticism or questions
To send traffic, funds, or goods along an alternative route
To distract someone from the main subject or purpose with irrelevant issues

groups.summary_en: This frame captures turning aside, redirecting, or pushing something or someone away from the primary trajectory or main priority into a secondary, alternate path.
groups.summary_zh: 指偏离主道或既定目标，将人、物或注意力转移、分流至旁支。

groups.name: Divide & Alienate · 分裂与瓦解 (Alienate, Estrange, Fragment)
groups.tip: 破坏原有团结使之分裂

items.def_en: To break or cause to break into small, distinct, and disconnected parts
To cause someone to become unfriendly, hostile, or indifferent
To divide or split into smaller, weaker, conflicting groups
To cause something to split into two completely opposing camps or opinions
To cause someone to stop being friendly, close, or affectionate with another
1. (formal) To cause people, groups, or factions to separate, divide, or cease to be united.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on breaking harmony, cohesion, or political solidarity, driving factions or individuals apart into discord.
groups.summary_zh: 指打破群体凝聚力或和谐，使之产生分歧、疏离乃至分裂瓦解。

groups.name: Divide & Segment · 分割与划分 (Partition, Subdivide, Compartmentalize)
groups.tip: 将整体切分成不同的独立部分

items.def_en: To separate a particular area or portion from the rest of a space
To divide something into smaller constituent parts or categories
To divide land or resources into separate smaller plots or shares
To divide, partition, or split something into separate parts, sections, or segments.
To divide a room, area, or country into separate parts with walls or borders
To divide into separate, distinct, and non-overlapping sections or mental categories

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe breaking down a continuous whole, market, or space into distinct, structured sections or categories. They emphasize deliberate organizational, structural, or analytical separation.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将整体、空间或市场系统性地划分、拆解为若干独立部分。

groups.name: Dominate & Boss Around · 专横与辖制 (Boss around, Bully, Tyrannize)
groups.tip: 专横跋扈地支配与控制他人

items.def_en: To continuously tell someone what to do in an officious, domineering manner
To behave in an arrogant, superior way toward others
To intimidate or bully someone into doing something using arrogant words or looks
To act without any care or respect for the feelings, rights, or wishes of others
(+ over) To rule, control, or treat subordinates with cruel and autocratic power

items.def_zh: 专横跋扈，称王称霸；盛气凌人地控制
items.def_en: (+ over) To behave in an arrogant, bossy way, attempting to control others arbitrarily.

groups.summary_en: This frame involves imposing one's will on others through overbearing attitudes, bullying, or autocratic control. Synonyms distinguish between casual browbeating, systematic tyranny, and petty micromanagement.
groups.summary_zh: 指态度专断、高高在上地管束、辖制或指使他人。

groups.name: Dominate & Control · 颐指气使与作威作福 (Boss, Dictate, Browbeat)
groups.tip: 以专断态度对他人呼来喝去

items.def_en: To continuously tell someone what to do in a domineering, arrogant, and irritating manner
To treat someone unfairly or contemptuously by giving them orders and exploiting their compliance
To act in a haughty, superior, and condescending way toward someone over whom one claims power

items.def_zh: 对……指手画脚，专横地发号施令
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To tell people what to do in an overbearing, domineering, or annoying way.
To lay down rules, terms, or orders with authoritative imperiousness, admitting no dissent
To intimidate or bully someone through harsh, overbearing words or looks into doing what one wants

groups.summary_en: This frame captures overbearing, petty, or tyrannical interpersonal control where one party relentlessly directs or bullies others. While 'boss around' focuses on obnoxious meddling and nagging commands, related verbs escalate into autocratic decreeing or coercive intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 指专横跋扈、发号施令或以高压姿态强行摆布他人。

groups.name: Dot & Pepper · 点缀与密集分布 (Disperse Marks or Entities as Accents Across an Expansive Backdrop)
groups.tip: 将细小物斑点状撒落或散布

items.def_zh: 使带有微小斑点，点缀斑点于
items.def_en: to mark a surface with tiny, minute spots or specks of color
1. (+ with) To scatter or be spread across an area like small points. 2. To mark with a small dot.
to mark or cover something with a pattern of very small spots or marks

items.def_zh: 布满，散布；大量击打；给……加胡椒粉
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To scatter or distribute things thickly across an area. 2. To hit repeatedly with small objects. 3. To season food with pepper.

items.def_zh: 镶嵌，密布于（如宝石或明显突起）
items.def_en: to cover or decorate a surface with many small, distinct, and prominent objects

items.def_zh: 使满缀闪亮物，缀满（繁星、亮片）
items.def_en: (literary) to cover or adorn with sparkling, glittering spangles or lights

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this visual-distribution frame capture how entities appear as dispersed distinct marks across an expansive surface or scenery. 'Dot' emphasizes tiny, isolated spots across a landscape, while 'pepper' indicates high-density distribution like burst pellets hitting a target surface.
groups.summary_zh: 以离散点状或高密斑驳状分布并点缀于广阔背景之上。

groups.name: Double & Pair · 倍增与成双 (Geminate, Double, Pair)
groups.tip: 成对形成或数量直接翻倍

items.def_en: To join two elements or entities together into a functioning pair
To multiply or increase by two; to make twice as great or many
(often + off/up) To join or arrange two things or individuals together as a set
To combine, link closely, or pair two complementary things together
To make an exact copy of something or repeat an action identically
To arrange, produce, or occur in pairs; to double a speech sound or letter.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on multiplying by two, arranging components into pairs, or creating identical dual counterparts across numerical, physical, and linguistic contexts.
groups.summary_zh: 表示数量翻倍、两两配对或形成双重对称的相叠变化。

groups.name: Downgrade & Demote · 降级与下调 (Demote, Depreciate, De-escalate)
groups.tip: 等级地位下滑或资产价值缩水

items.def_en: To reduce the price, grade, score, or assigned valuation of something.
To reduce the size, rate, tier, or extent of an operation or plan.
To reduce or cause to become less intense, severe, dangerous, or militarized.

items.def_zh: 使降级，贬低；降低……的重要性
items.def_en: To reduce someone or something to a lower rank, rating, status, or level of importance.
(+ to) To place someone or something into a lower, less powerful, or less important category.
To move someone to a lower rank, position, or tier of responsibility, often as a punishment.

groups.summary_en: This frame addresses reducing someone or something from an established rank, classification, security alert, or official credit rating to a lower one. 'Downgrade' often targets formal ratings and estimates, whereas 'demote' specifically lowers occupational hierarchy.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或系统性地将职位、资信评级或危险等级向下调动。

groups.name: Drain & Empty · 排空与清空 (Drain, Evacuate, Clear out)
groups.tip: 放干积水或倒空内部所盛物

items.def_en: To make a space empty by removing all unwanted or stored objects from inside it

items.def_zh: 排空，倒空；变空；流入（大海或河流）
items.def_en: 1. To remove everything from a container or space. 2. To become empty. 3. (of a river) To flow into a larger body of water.
To remove liquid completely from a container or space, or to become completely dry of liquid
To empty or discharge the contents of the bladder or bowels
To empty the contents of a container, organ, or vessel, especially by removing gas, air, or bodily waste
To completely strip or remove the internal contents, structure, or fittings of a building or room

groups.summary_en: Covers removing the entire contents from a container, vessel, room, or space. 'Empty' is generic, while 'drain' focuses on liquid runoff, 'evacuate' implies complete systematic removal or bodily excretion, and 'clear out' stresses physical decluttering.
groups.summary_zh: 指将容器、空间或系统内的液体、物品完全排出或腾空。

groups.name: Drape & Arrange · 垂挂与搭覆 (Swathe, Sling, Enfold)
groups.tip: 系于高处或自然垂落

items.def_en: To extend or open out cloth or a covering smoothly across a surface
To attach or place a garment or cloth so that it falls freely without touching the floor

items.def_zh: 披，搭；悬挂（布帘等），覆以褶帘
items.def_en: To hang or place cloth, clothing, or a body part loosely and gracefully over or around something.
To suspend or hang something loosely over a shoulder or support in a casual way
To cover or envelop someone or something completely so as to hide from view
To wrap, envelop, or drape someone or something in layers of cloth or bandages

groups.summary_en: This frame involves placing fabric, clothing, or limbs loosely, elegantly, or casually over a surface, furniture, or another body part, focusing on the graceful folds or relaxed posture created.
groups.summary_zh: 轻柔、自然或优雅地将织物或肢体搭披在某物上。

groups.name: Drift & Wander · 漂流与流徙 (Meander, Stray, Waft)
groups.tip: 在水面或空气中漂动

items.def_en: To float or live aimlessly without putting forward clear deliberate direction
To walk or move around casually with no fixed destination or route

items.def_zh: 漂流，漂移；漂泊，无目的地游荡
items.def_en: 1. To be carried along slowly and gently by currents of water or air. 2. (+ into/toward) To move, change, or live aimlessly from one situation or place to another.
To move away unintentionally from a group, path, or expected bounds
To follow a winding, turning course without an urgent or direct heading
To move or be carried lightly and smoothly through the air or over water

groups.summary_en: This frame captures unhurried, directionless movement driven by external currents, winds, or a lack of definite purpose. Agents or objects float along passively or wander off course.
groups.summary_zh: 指随风浪漂荡或漫无目的、随遇而安地缓步移动。

groups.name: Drink Copiously · 豪饮与嗜酒 (Quaff, Imbibe, Guzzle)
groups.tip: 贪杯嗜饮或大口痛快饮酒

items.def_en: To drink alcoholic beverages habitually or frequently, typically in small amounts over time.
(archaic) To drink alcoholic beverages frequently or excessively.
To drink alcohol or other liquids, especially in a formal, literary, or humorous context.
To quickly drink an alcoholic beverage down in one continuous gulp.
To drink an alcoholic or flavorful beverage heartily, enthusiastically, and in large gulps.
To drink or eat quickly, eagerly, and in large quantities in a greedy or noisy manner.

groups.summary_en: This frame describes consuming alcohol or liquids in copious amounts, with gusto, or with chronic abandon. While 'quaff' highlights energetic, hearty draughts and 'guzzle' stresses greedy, unrefined ingestion, 'imbibe' offers a formal or euphemistic alternative.
groups.summary_zh: 指大口吞咽、大量纵饮或长年贪杯酗酒的行为模式。

groups.name: Drip & Drizzle · 滴沥与微淌 (Trickle, Drip, Seep)
groups.tip: 液体点滴掉落或下细雨

items.def_zh: 下毛毛雨；淋撒，淋浇（液体）
items.def_en: 1. When it drizzles, fine, light rain falls steadily. 2. (+ over/with) To pour a thin stream of liquid gently over food.
To fall in small liquid drops, or let liquid fall in this manner
To flow or make liquid flow slowly in a very thin, gentle stream
To flow or leak slowly through small openings or porous material

items.def_zh: 稀疏溅落；洒上零星雨点
items.def_en: To scatter or fall in tiny, distinct droplets across a surface
To pass or cause liquid to pass slowly through fine pores or a filter

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey liquids moving or falling in tiny, fine quantities or thin streams rather than gushing torrents. They often depict delicate precipitation or slow culinary drizzling.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体以极细水流、微雨或水滴形式缓慢滴落或淌流。

groups.name: Drop with a Sound · 扑通落下与钝响掉落 (Plop, Plunk, Thud, Flump)
groups.tip: 脱离支撑垂直掉落

items.def_zh: 软塌塌地倒下，噗通躺下
items.def_en: fall, lie, or sit down heavily and awkwardly due to exhaustion or limpness

items.def_zh: 扑通落下；扑通扔下，沉重地放下
items.def_en: to fall or drop heavily into water or onto a soft surface with a short, hollow sound, or to drop something in this way
drop or deposit heavy objects abruptly and carelessly onto a surface
fall or drop heavily with a dull, soft thud onto a bed, sofa, or floor
fall or strike heavily against something with a low, dull acoustic impact
drop abruptly or heavily onto a surface with a hollow sound, or set down carelessly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe falling or deliberately dropping into liquid, soft bedding, or onto a surface with a distinct sound—such as a watery splash or a dull, heavy thud. They emphasize the auditory feedback and the ungraceful, relaxed physical impact.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或身体掉落入水或软垫上，并伴随特有扑通声或沉闷钝响的动作。

groups.name: Drug & Sedate · 麻醉与给药致昏 (Sedate, Anesthetize, Tranquilize)
groups.tip: 使用药物致人昏睡麻木

items.def_zh: 给……下药；使服麻醉药，麻醉
items.def_en: To give a drug to a person or animal, especially in order to make them sleepy or unconscious.

items.def_zh: 对…下药；使服兴奋剂或麻醉药
items.def_en: To give someone or an animal drugs to affect their performance or render them unconscious
To administer a drug to a patient or animal to reduce agitation and promote calm or sleep
To calm or subdue a person or dangerous animal using a pharmacological tranquilizer
To cause someone to become unconscious or deeply asleep through medicine or drugs
To give a chemical substance to induce insensibility to pain before surgery

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the administration of pharmaceuticals or chemical agents to deliberately calm, dull consciousness, induce sleep, or eliminate sensation. Clinical terms like 'anesthetize' contrast with clinical-yet-coercive terms like 'tranquilize' or 'knock out'.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用药物使其镇静、麻痹知觉或陷入昏睡。

groups.name: Early Type & Symbolic Foreshadowing · 原型映射与征兆预示 (Prefigure, Foreshadow, Presage)
groups.tip: 言语或征兆提前预示未来

items.def_en: To foreshadow faintly or sketch the partial outline of a future reality
To act as an early warning or symbolic sign of a future event in a narrative or history
(+ well/ill) To be an omen of a specific outcome in the future
To serve as a portent, omen, or forewarning of a future event (often unwelcome)
To be a sign or warning that something momentous, calamitous, or unpleasant is likely to happen
(formal) to be an early sign, model, or indication of something that will happen or exist later

groups.summary_en: This literary and symbolic frame focuses on early events, textual elements, or structural antecedents that represent, mirror, or ominous anticipate a subsequent climax, historical occurrence, or thematic realization.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重文艺隐喻、历史原型对后续发展、高潮或恶兆在象征或结构层面的映射与先兆预显。

groups.name: Eat Greedily & Devour · 狼吞虎咽与暴食 (Gobble, Devour, Scarf down)
groups.tip: 如狼似虎般快速吞食大嚼

items.def_en: To gulp or swallow food hurriedly without chewing properly

items.def_zh: 囫囵吞下；狼吞虎咽吃完
items.def_en: To eat something up very rapidly, voraciously, and eagerly
1. (often wolf down) To eat food quickly, greedily, and eagerly.
To eat up hungrily, voraciously, and greedily
(often gobble up/down) To swallow food quickly and noisily in large chunks
(+ on) To stuff oneself with huge quantities of food greedily until full

groups.summary_en: Highlights ingesting nourishment with extreme speed, animalistic hunger, rapacious greed, or a total disregard for social dining manners.
groups.summary_zh: 强调极度饥饿或贪食之下，以飞快、贪婪的动作将食物吞食一空。

groups.name: Echo & Sympathetic Resonance · 附和、呼应与顺从 (Resonate, Chime with, Second)
groups.tip: 机械重复或随声附和

items.def_zh: 附和插话；插嘴表示赞同
items.def_en: (+ with) To join in a conversation or discussion, typically to express agreement or echo a view
(+ with) To pretend to agree with someone or their assertions to keep peace or gain time

items.def_zh: 附议；赞同并支持（提案或观点）
items.def_en: To express formal agreement with a proposal, motion, or expressed sentiment made by another

items.def_zh: 附和，盲目重复；发出回声，产生回响
items.def_en: 1. To repeat or agree with someone else's opinions, words, or feelings. 2. To send back or reflect sound as an echo.
(+ with) To evoke an immediate feeling of shared sympathy, deep agreement, or thematic consistency
To repeatedly reverberate, mirror, or proclaim an already stated opinion or widespread sentiment

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on mirroring, amplifying, or harmonizing with another person's expressed view, sentiment, or ideology. Unlike mindless parroting, verbs here emphasize alignment, social consensus, sympathetic accord, or formal endorsement.
groups.summary_zh: 强调与他人的思想、言论或情绪产生呼应、表示赞同或顺从共鸣。

groups.name: Edit & Revise · 编辑与校订 (Revise, Proofread, Redact)
groups.tip: 修润文本删除修正错误

items.def_en: 1. To prepare text, film, or other material by correcting, modifying, or condensing it for publication or broadcasting.
To re-examine and alter written work to improve its content, style, or factual accuracy
To remove unwanted sentences, footage, or sections during the editorial process
To make formal, minor changes to a document, statement, or law to correct flaws
To edit text by blacking out or removing sensitive information prior to release
To read over printer proofs or written text carefully to detect and correct typographical errors

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on textual or media curation: refining, pruning, adjusting, and correcting raw drafted material to ensure accuracy, coherence, and publication quality.
groups.summary_zh: 指对原稿或音视频进行修改、校勘与删改裁剪，以达到发表与播出标准。

groups.name: Eject & Oust · 弹出与逐出 (Eject, Expel, Oust)
groups.tip: 强力向外弹射或驱赶

items.def_en: To force someone to leave a room, building, or competition due to misbehavior
To deliberately drive someone away from a community, group, or society
To officially force someone to leave a school, organization, or country
1. (+ from) To force someone to leave a place or organization. 2. To push something out suddenly and with force; to escape from an aircraft by ejector seat.
To legally force someone to leave the house, land, or building they are renting
To force someone out of a position of power or out of a place

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the forcible removal of an object mechanically from a machine, or the compulsory expulsion of an individual from a venue, position, or organization. Force, suddenness, or legal eviction are prominent.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过机械力弹出物体，或通过权威/暴力将人强行逐出场所或职务。

groups.name: Elect & Return to Office · 推选与选任 (Elect, Return, Reinstall)
groups.tip: 通过投票表决再次当选职务

items.def_en: (politics, esp. British) To elect a candidate as a representative to parliament or public office
To officially install an elected candidate into a legislative or representative body
To choose someone to hold a public office or leadership role through a formal vote
To choose a candidate or party to take office through winning an election
To officially designate someone to continue serving in a position for another term
To vote someone back into the same public office for another term.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe choosing public officials, leaders, or representatives by collective electoral mandate, as well as confirming or returning incumbents to office.
groups.summary_zh: 通过选举产生公职人员，或将其再次选入领导职位。

groups.name: Elevate & Ennoble · 抬高身价与赋尊 (Dignify, Ennoble, Exalt)
groups.tip: 抬高社会地位并赋予尊严

items.def_en: To describe or represent something as admirable or splendid, sometimes undeservedly

items.def_zh: 抬高……的身价，赋予……尊严；使显得庄严（或重要）
items.def_en: To make someone or something appear worthy, impressive, noble, or more important than they actually are.
To raise someone to a higher rank or status, or to praise them extravagantly

items.def_zh: 使神圣化；赋予神圣光环
items.def_en: To declare or set apart as sacred, thereby lending profound religious or historical dignity
To lend noble, honorable, or elevated moral quality to a person, act, or character
To increase the power, status, or perceived wealth of someone, often excessively

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the act of conferring honor, solemnity, nobility, or unearned gravitas onto an individual, title, or act. It ranges from sincere moral elevation to conferring a spurious, pretentious legitimacy upon trivial things.
groups.summary_zh: 指赋予某人或某事尊贵地位、光彩或冠冕堂皇的名目。

groups.name: Elude & Escape · 摆脱与脱逃 (Elude, Slip, Break Away)
groups.tip: 设法躲避追捕逃离险境

items.def_en: To get free from captivity, confinement, or a dangerous situation
To leave a place quietly or inconspicuously without being noticed by captors or attendees
(+ from) To free oneself abruptly by force from someone's grasp, control, or confinement
To escape from or evade a pursuer, tracker, or unwanted companion

items.def_zh: 逃脱，躲避（追捕）；规避，逃避（责任、问题等）
items.def_en: 1. To escape or avoid someone pursuing you. 2. To avoid dealing with, answering, or fulfilling a duty, tax, or question.
To escape or avoid detection or capture by someone through speed, guile, or clever tactics

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on successfully breaking free or getting away from pursuit, confinement, capture, or dangerous traps. It emphasizes dynamic movement, cunning stealth, or outmaneuvering an opponent.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过机敏身手或脱困行动，摆脱追捕、监禁或围困。

groups.name: Emancipate & Sever Shackles · 解除束缚与禁锢 (Unshackle, Emancipate, Manumit)
groups.tip: 松绑绳索还其行动自如

items.def_en: To loosen or unfasten the cords, knots, or ropes binding someone or something

items.def_zh: 解开，松绑；释放，使解脱（unbind的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of unbind; to untie, release, or free from fastenings, bonds, or restrictions.

items.def_zh: 使脱离奴役；使觉醒解脱
items.def_en: (literary) To liberate someone from a state of enslavement, subjugation, or mental servitude

items.def_zh: 除去……的枷锁；使摆脱束缚
items.def_en: To remove chains or fetters from someone, or to deliver someone from oppressive social or institutional constraints

items.def_zh: 解放（奴隶）；给予政治或法律平等权利
items.def_en: To liberate someone from social, legal, or political servitude and grant them full personal rights
(formal/historical) To release an enslaved person from slavery by legal decree

groups.summary_en: This sociopolitical and moral frame focuses on breaking, untying, or lifting figurative and systemic fetters, bondage, or social oppression. The terms highlight the transition from servitude, institutional subjugation, or heavy restrictions to autonomy.
groups.summary_zh: 特指斩断锁链、废除奴役或打破体制性束缚以赋予自由。

groups.name: Embarrass & Disconcert · 难堪与窘迫 (Mortify, Disconcert, Fluster)
groups.tip: 因失误或失态而感到窘迫不安

items.def_en: to cause someone to feel nervous, self-conscious, or ashamed.

items.def_zh: 使深感屈辱；使极度难堪
items.def_en: to cause someone to feel extremely humiliated, shameful, or acutely embarrassed

items.def_zh: 使张皇失措；使心神不宁
items.def_en: to disturb the composure or self-possession of someone by unexpected behavior or news
to make someone agitated, nervous, and confused by rushing them or catching them off guard
to make someone feel uneasy, awkward, or confused in a social or confrontational situation
to make someone feel self-conscious, shamefaced, or uneasy through an awareness of failure or faux pas

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inducing social unease, loss of poise, self-consciousness, or acute shame in another person.
groups.summary_zh: 指使人感到难堪、窘迫、自惭形秽或手足无措。

groups.name: Embezzle & Misappropriate · 盗用与侵吞 (Embezzle, Misappropriate, Siphon off)
groups.tip: 监守自盗非法侵吞公款
