items.def_en: To dishonestly or illegally remove money from an account, fund, or organization over time

items.def_zh: 暗中抽取（部分收益、佣金）
items.def_en: To steal small amounts of money or profits secretly from an employer or business transaction over a period of time
To misuse or embezzle funds held in trust or official custody

items.def_zh: 挪用，侵吞（公款或受托财产）
items.def_en: To dishonestly take money or property that you have been trusted to manage, and use it for your own purposes
To embezzle or steal public funds or property entrusted to one's official care
To steal money or property that has been placed in your trust or care, especially from an employer or organization.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to dishonestly taking or diverting money or property that has been entrusted to one's care, especially in an organizational, corporate, or fiduciary context. Nuances range from legal indictments of fraudulent conversion to stealthily siphoning off accounts over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指侵吞、盗用受托管理的公款或财产，多用于职务犯罪与财务欺诈语境。

groups.name: Embody & Materialize · 具象与成形 (Incarnate, Personify, Manifest)
groups.tip: 使抽象概念具象化落地

items.raw_cluster: 具象与赋予形体 Embody & Materialize
items.def_zh: 使具象化，体现，赋予形体
items.def_en: To give a physical form, concrete presence, or distinct shape to an abstract idea or concept.
Show an abstract quality, feeling, or symptom plainly by one's outward actions or appearance
Express, represent, or provide a tangible form to an abstract idea, principle, or quality

items.def_zh: 物化，成为现实，赫然出现
items.def_en: Become real or actual, or appear suddenly as if taking on physical form
Embody or represent a quality or concept in human or physical form
Be the perfect example of a quality, or depict a thing or abstraction as a living person

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote imparting physical reality, tangible substance, or representative human-like presence to abstract concepts, ideals, virtues, or thoughts.
groups.summary_zh: 赋予抽象观念、精神或构想以具体形态或实在载体。

groups.name: Embroider & Embellish · 刺绣与添油加醋 (Embroider, Adorn, Color)
groups.tip: 刺绣点缀或辞藻艺术润色

items.def_en: To influence, distort, or add exaggerated flavor or bias to an account or description
To present something in an unusually attractive or deceitfully favorable way
To add more details, substance, or vivid information to a basic plan or outline
To decorate a surface physically or embellish speech and writing with flowery details

items.def_zh: 在……上刺绣；对……添油加醋，对（故事等）润色渲染
items.def_en: 1. To decorate cloth with sewn patterns using thread. 2. To add fictional or exaggerated details to a story to make it more interesting.
To make something more attractive by adding decorative details, or to make a story more interesting by adding fictitious details

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to enhancing a surface with decorative needlework or figurative details, often shading into embellishing, exaggerating, or romanticizing a narrative to make it more compelling. Collocations include tales, stories, fabrics, and facts.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过刺绣装饰织物，或在叙述中添油加醋以增强吸引力。

groups.name: Emit & Radiate · 散发与辐射 (Emit, Radiate, Exude)
groups.tip: 向四周喷发或辐射光热

items.def_en: Release or produce heat, fumes, light, or an aroma into the surrounding air

items.def_zh: 定向照射，发射（光芒或电波）
items.def_en: Transmit light, heat, radio signals, or television programs in a focused direction

items.def_zh: 散发，发出（光、热、声音、气味等）；放射
items.def_en: To send out or produce light, heat, sound, gas, or a smell.
Send out rays or waves of light, heat, or energy from a central core
(+ from) Originate and spread out gently from a specific source, such as sounds or heat
Release gas, liquid, or an electrical charge forcefully into the immediate environment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or perceptual sources broadcasting light, heat, ionizing radiation, or sonic waves outward in all directions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调光源、热源或能量向四周发射或播散。

groups.name: Emit Pungent Odor · 散发恶臭与强烈气味 (Reek, Stink, Whiff)
groups.tip: 散发明显或极其刺鼻恶臭

items.def_zh: 散发气味；有（不好的）气味
items.def_en: To give off an odor, frequently an unpleasant one
To smell very bad or give off a foul odor

items.def_zh: 散发出难闻的气味；带有一股异味
items.def_en: To give off a distinct, usually unpleasant puff of smell
To give off an intensely strong and unpleasant smell
To emit a strong, extremely unpleasant odor

items.def_zh: 发臭，散发刺鼻气味；明显带有……气息
items.def_en: (+ of) To smell very strongly and unpleasantly of something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving off an intense, distinct, and usually offensive smell. They range from neutral mild whiffs to overwhelming, nauseating stenches that cling to surroundings.
groups.summary_zh: 描述散发出刺鼻、浓烈或令人不快的恶臭气味，程度由隐约飘散到极度难闻。

groups.name: Empathy & Consolation · 同情与慰藉 (Console, Sympathize, Solace)
groups.tip: 对他人不幸遭遇表达哀思与同情

items.def_en: Ease the sorrow or grief of someone, imparting a sense of relief and hope
Express formal sympathy and sorrow to someone who has suffered a bereavement
Comfort someone who is experiencing grief, disappointment, or distress
Give comfort or consolation in times of sadness, grief, or distress
Feel or express compassion, pity, or shared sadness for someone's misfortune
(+ with/over) To express sympathy or sadness for the misfortune, grief, or disappointment of someone.

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to communicating heartfelt empathy, sharing in another's sorrow, or actively providing emotional comfort and solace to someone who is grieving or distressed.
groups.summary_zh: 向身处逆境或悲痛者传达同理心、深切关怀或施以情感安抚。

groups.name: Emulsify & Homogenize · 乳化与混融 (Emulsify, Homogenize, Blend, Incorporate)
groups.tip: 乳化混合均匀调配

items.def_en: beat distinct liquid ingredients rapidly with a whisk to form a smooth single liquid
blend or combine one ingredient thoroughly into an existing mixture until fully absorbed
hold micro-droplets or fine particles evenly distributed throughout a liquid medium
mix different substances thoroughly together so that they lose their distinct identities
treat a mixture or liquid so that its disparate components become evenly dispersed and consistent
(chemistry / cooking) to mix two liquids that normally do not blend (such as oil and water) into a smooth, stable emulsion, or to become mixed in this way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this culinary and chemical frame describe bringing together immiscible liquids or heterogeneous substances into an evenly distributed, stable mixture or emulsion. The process requires mechanical shearing, whisking, or stabilizing agents.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助机械搅拌或乳化剂，使互不相溶的液体或异质材料充分融合为均质胶态。

groups.name: Encamp & Station Soldiers · 驻扎营地与划区驻扎 (Encamp, Bivouac, Station)
groups.tip: 为军队调遣安排民居宿营

items.def_en: Position military personnel, naval units, or equipment at a designated outpost
Station troops in a fortified position, fortress, or town to defend it
Provide soldiers with accommodation in dedicated military barracks

items.def_zh: 为（军队）安排宿营，使驻扎；把……划分为区
items.def_en: 1. To assign troops to temporary quarters or billets. 2. To divide a territory into administrative districts.
Settle in or establish a camp, especially of soldiers or nomadic travelers
Stay in a temporary open-air camp without tents or under minimal improvised shelter

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stationing armed forces in tactical field camps, dedicated winter garrisons, or designated geographical zones. Distinctions involve field bivouacking, tactical dispersal, and formal base deployment.
groups.summary_zh: 指部队在野外、营地或划分好的防区内扎营、驻防与驻宿扎下根基。

groups.name: Enchant & Cast Spells · 施法与蛊惑 (Witch, Bewitch, Enchant, Hex)
groups.tip: 借助魅力或巫术操纵心智

items.def_en: to cast a spell over someone; to enchant or bewitch someone through magic or charm
put under a magical spell, or delight profoundly with an almost supernatural allure
bring bad luck or an unfortunate outcome to someone or something by supernatural misfortune
charm, enchant, or influence someone deceitfully, often masking true intentions
cast an evil spell or curse upon someone, bringing bad luck or harm

items.def_zh: 施魔法蛊惑，迷得神魂颠倒
items.def_en: cast a spell on someone, or gain control over them through irresistible magical attraction

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on casting magical spells or curses on individuals, or exercising supernatural or seductive sway to bend another's will. The verbs range from folk-magic hexing to irresistible, otherworldly enchanting of romantic partners.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用巫术、符咒或超自然魅力对人施加影响、控制其心智或降下厄运。

groups.name: Enclose & Encircle · 环绕与包围 (Encircle, Hem In, Encompass)
groups.tip: 四面包夹团团围住

items.def_en: To form a ring or circle around someone or something
1. To be all around someone or something; to encircle on all sides.
To completely surround or enclose physically
To form a complete circle around someone or something
To encircle, surround, or bind around securely
To surround someone or something tightly, restricting their freedom of movement

groups.summary_en: This frame covers positioning or moving around an entity so as to enclose, hem in, or form a continuous boundary on all sides.
groups.summary_zh: 指在周围形成闭合边界，将目标全方位包围、围堵或环抱。

groups.name: Enclose & Fence · 围圈与阻隔 (Fence, Cordon, Enclose)
groups.tip: 设立栅栏圈出一片封闭区域

items.def_en: To separate an area from the space around it by placing ropes around it

items.def_zh: （用栅栏或篱笆）围住，圈起；击剑；搪塞，回避
items.def_en: 1. To enclose or surround an area of land with a fence. 2. To practice or compete in the sport of fencing. 3. To avoid answering a question directly; equivocate.
To close off an area to the public using ropes, tapes, or police lines to prevent access
To surround an area with bushes or trees, or figuratively to strictly confine someone's freedom
To enclose an area or structure using railings or railings-based barriers
To surround something on all sides with a wall, fence, or physical boundary

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe erecting physical barriers, railings, walls, or cordons to circumscribe a perimeter, restrict access, or protect an inner area. Contrasts center on the type of enclosure used (hedges, ropes, palisades) and whether the barrier is defensive, agricultural, or security-focused.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过架设栅栏、围墙或警戒线将区域围起以实施阻隔。

groups.name: Enclose & Shield · 包围与遮蔽 (Enclose, Envelop, Shroud)
groups.tip: 四周环绕封闭并包裹

items.def_en: (+ in/with) To cover something by folding paper, cloth, or other flexible material around it

items.def_zh: 包围，围住；随信（或包裹）附上
items.def_en: 1. To surround or shut in an area on all sides with a wall, fence, or other barrier. 2. To place something inside an envelope or package along with a letter.
(+ in) To conceal, hide, or cover something as if with a cloak
To wrap up, cover, or surround someone or something completely on all sides
(+ in) To cover, obscure, or veil something from clear sight, as with mist, cloth, or darkness
To cover or enclose something completely in a tight, protective case or hard shell

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on encasing, wrapping, or shutting something in on all sides with protective coverings, wrappings, fog, or screens, sheltering or shielding it from the elements or view.
groups.summary_zh: 全方位包裹、笼罩或遮蔽某物，以起到掩护、保护或密封作用。

groups.name: Enclose & Wall · 包围与围筑 (Wall, Fence, Cordon)
groups.tip: 砌筑墙壁圈定四周防守封闭

items.def_en: To enclose or confine an area or animals completely with a fence
To separate or enclose a section of space using metal or wooden railings
To obstruct completely a street, passage, or route to prevent traffic or movement
To seal an area or accident site with barricades, tapes, or guards to bar entry

items.def_zh: 用墙围住，筑墙围护；（筑墙）封堵
items.def_en: To surround, enclose, or defend an area with a wall; ('wall off/up') to seal or separate an opening or area with a wall.
To block an entrance, road, or room with improvised defensive barriers

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes erecting, deploying, or utilizing structural barriers such as walls, fences, or barricades to partition space, seal perimeters, or block off external access.
groups.summary_zh: 通过构筑实体墙体、栅栏或防线将空间封闭、隔绝或圈禁。

groups.name: Encode & Decipher · 编码与破译 (Encrypt, Decode, Scramble)
groups.tip: 把信息转为特定代码格式传递

items.def_en: To convert digital data from one specific encoding format directly into another
To alter electronic signals or broadcasts so they can only be received with a special decoder

items.def_zh: 编码，将……译成密码；（遗传）编码决定
items.def_en: 1. To convert information, a message, or data into a coded or digital format for security or transmission. 2. (genetics) To specify the genetic code for a protein or trait.
To convert plain data into cipher text to prevent unauthorized access
To translate a coded message, signal, or data back into plain, understandable form
To succeed in reading or understanding obscure, illegible, or coded text

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses technical and communicative operations that transform information into an obfuscated or secret format, or reverse that transformation to render the meaning accessible.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖将信息转化为加密、伪装形式或反向解析破译的通信密码场景。

groups.name: Endanger & Put at Risk · 危及与危害 (Endanger, Compromise, Put in jeopardy)
groups.tip: 使事物陷入险境与危机

items.def_en: To be likely to cause damage, harm, or ruin to an existing condition or plan
To expose security, integrity, or chances of success to discredit or severe risk
To expose vital assets or outcomes to unpredictable peril or total loss
To put someone or something in a situation where they might be harmed, destroyed, or injured
To put someone or something in serious danger of being harmed, damaged, or lost.
To place someone or something in grave, imminent danger of ruin or failure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actions or policies that expose plans, status, security, or lives to immediate vulnerability or potential failure. Frequent collocates include future, safety, career, peace, and security.
groups.summary_zh: 指使前途、安全、健康或系统陷入危险、脆弱或失败境地。

groups.name: Endure & Outlast · 存续与久经 (Outlive, Weather, Withstand, Persist)
groups.tip: 挺过苦难且比他人存活更久

items.def_en: To survive a severe storm, trouble, or difficult condition without serious harm
To continue firmly or obstinately to exist beyond the normal or expected duration
To live or remain in existence longer than another person, idea, or institution
To withstand and come safely through a dangerous crisis, storm, or hardship
To remain undamaged and unaffected by severe stress, force, or wear

items.def_zh: 比……存活更久，比……维持更长
items.def_en: To continue to exist, survive, or remain effective longer than someone or something else.

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote surpassing temporal limits or external destructive stresses, continuing to exist, function, or prevail long after rivals, hardships, or natural lifespans have expired.
groups.summary_zh: 强调跨越时间考验或抵御外部风雨侵蚀，比对手或苦难留存更久。

groups.name: Engender & Cause · 孕育与产生 (Beget, Spawn, Breed, Foster)
groups.tip: 催生出某种感受或状态

items.def_en: To produce, trigger, or cultivate negative conditions such as conflict, discontent, or crime
To encourage the development or growth of ideas, feelings, or relationships
To cause something abstract or collective to develop or happen
To generate or produce something in prolific quantities, often suddenly or disruptively

items.def_zh: 引起，产生，催生（某种感情、情况或关系）
items.def_en: (formal) To cause a particular feeling, situation, or condition to develop.
(formal) To give rise to or bring about a particular effect or condition

groups.summary_en: This frame covers causative acts whereby specific states, conditions, controversies, or deep emotions are brought into existence. Collocations often involve abstract outcomes like fear, hostility, prosperity, or change.
groups.summary_zh: 指催生、诱发或孕育出特定情感、社会状况或连锁后果。

groups.name: Enlist & Mobilize · 招募与动员 (Enlist, Mobilize, Conscript)
groups.tip: 应征入伍或争取支持参与

items.def_en: To select and order someone into mandatory military service
To bring people together to unite their efforts in support of a cause or military struggle
To commit oneself or register another to join an organization or the armed forces

items.def_zh: 应征入伍；招募；争取，谋求（支持或帮助）
items.def_en: 1. To join or recruit someone into the armed forces. 2. To ask for and obtain the help, support, or cooperation of someone.
To organize people or resources to be ready for active military service or coordinated civic action

items.def_zh: 强制征召；强行征召入伍
items.def_en: To legally compel someone to join the armed services by law

groups.summary_en: This frame covers signing up or securing personnel for military service or collaborative public action, spanning voluntary self-enlistment, rallying supporters, and state-mandated conscription.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖为军队服役或大型行动招募人手，兼含主动投军、动员盟友与强制征兵。

groups.name: Enmesh & Trap · 缠结与困陷 (Entangle, Snare, Embroil)
groups.tip: 被网罗陷阱死死缠住难脱

items.def_en: Involve someone or something inextricably in a messy situation or physical knots

items.def_zh: 使陷入泥潭；使深陷困境
items.def_en: Cause to become stuck in mud, or involve someone or something in a difficult, slow-moving situation
(often passive) To catch or entangle someone or something in a net, or involve them deeply in an unpleasant or complicated situation.
Involve someone deeply in an argument, conflict, or difficult situation
Catch someone or something in a snare or trap, or trick them into a difficult situation
Trick or deceive someone into committing a wrongful act or falling into a compromising position

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe catching, ensnaring, or deeply involving someone in an inescapable physical tangle or a distressing web of circumstances.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理网罗或复杂困境将人事物深深绊住、陷害或无法脱身。

groups.name: Enslave & Oppress · 奴役与压迫 (Enslave, Subjugate, Oppress)
groups.tip: 残酷压迫并彻底剥夺人身自由

items.def_en: To bring a person, group, or rebellious force under subjection using decisive force
To govern or treat people in an unjust, cruel, and profoundly restrictive manner
To rule over or mistreat someone with merciless, absolute, and despotic severity
(+ on/underfoot) To violate, crush, or disregard people's freedoms and basic rights roughly

items.def_zh: 奴役，使成为奴隶；束缚，使受控制
items.def_en: To make someone a slave, or to completely dominate and control someone's mind, life, or actions.
To defeat and place an entire people or nation under rigid, absolute control

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the systemic, coercive deprivation of freedom, autonomy, and human dignity. They describe subjecting a population or person to tyrannical dominance, extreme cruelty, servitude, or crushed spirit.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强力、专制或残酷手段剥夺人身自由，实施全面统治与压制。

groups.name: Enter & Ingress · 进入与迈入 (Enter, Ingress, Step into)
groups.tip: 由外部穿入内部

items.def_zh: 进入，迈入；参加，加入；输入，录入
items.def_en: 1. To come or go into a place. 2. To become a member or participant in an organization, competition, or activity. 3. To record or key in data.
to pass over a threshold or boundary into an interior
to move by taking steps into an enclosed room or distinct area
to enter a building or room toward the speaker
to enter or gain entry into an enclosed space or property
to enter a structure or room by walking

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote crossing a boundary, doorway, or threshold to move from outside to inside an enclosed space, territory, or condition.
groups.summary_zh: 指跨越边界或门槛，从外部穿行步入空间或境地内部。

groups.name: Enter & Log Data · 输入与录入 (Key in, Type in, Feed, Record)
groups.tip: 通过键盘设备向系统录入指令

items.def_en: to supply continuous information, raw data, or materials directly into a computer or device
to record, store, or preserve data digitally from an analog or direct input source
to make an official, systematic record of events, numbers, or activities into a registry
To put data, information, or instructions into a computer or system.
to type text or numerical data into a computer or digital device using a keypad or keyboard
to enter words or code into an application by striking keys on a keyboard

groups.summary_en: Pertains to feeding raw data, text, or instructions into a computing terminal, ledger, or system. The frame highlights the tactile act of keystroking or systematic digitization.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过键盘或接口将文本、数值及数据准确存入系统或文档。

groups.name: Entertain & Amuse · 娱乐与逗乐 (Divert, Regale, Cheer Up)
groups.tip: 提供消遣，博得愉快欢笑

items.def_en: To provide someone with amusement or enjoyment, especially through performances or hospitality
To make someone feel happier, brighter, and more cheerful after sadness or gloom

items.def_zh: 逗乐，使发笑；给……提供娱乐，消遣
items.def_en: 1. To make someone laugh or smile. 2. To keep someone pleasantly entertained so that they do not get bored.
To distract someone pleasantly from serious matters, fatigue, or boredom
To appeal to someone's sense of humor and make them smile or laugh
(+ with) To entertain or amuse someone delightfully, typically with stories, jokes, or generous food

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe capturing someone's attention in a pleasant, cheerful, or humorous way. They range from diverting boredom and providing structured spectacle to producing sudden smiles and laughter.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过幽默言行或娱乐节目引人发笑、驱散无聊并带来身心愉悦。

groups.name: Entice & Coax · 诱惑与以利相诱 (Entice, Lure, Cajole)
groups.tip: 利用利益或欲望诱导他人

items.def_en: (+ into/away) To persuade or attract someone to go somewhere or do something by offering a pleasant reward or bait
(+ into/away) To attract or persuade someone to do something by offering something pleasant or advantageous.
(+ into) To gently and persistently persuade someone to do something through kind words or patience
(+ into) To persuade someone to do something by using sustained flattery or gentle deception
(+ into/out of) To persuade or obtain something from someone by using flattering words or ingratiating charm
(+ into) To persuade someone to do something through clever, deceitful, or deceptive coaxing

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to persuading or attracting someone to go somewhere or perform an act by holding out appealing rewards, inducements, or sweet persuasion. It differs from neutral convincing by relying squarely on attractive bait.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过抛出利益、许诺诱人前景或甜言蜜语引诱劝服他人行动。

groups.name: Err & Deviate · 判断失误与偏差走偏 (Err, Stray, Lapse)
groups.tip: 认知偏颇酿成差错

items.def_zh: 犯错误，出差错；偏离正道
items.def_en: (formal) To make a mistake or be incorrect in judgment or action.
To make an accidental mistake in conduct, calculation, or judgment
(+ from) To diverge from an accepted standard, truth, or correct path
(+ into) To slip gradually into an inferior, erroneous, or immoral state
(+ from) To depart from established rules, expected facts, or orthodox beliefs
To assess a situation, figure, or probability incorrectly

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to falling into intellectual, moral, or procedural inaccuracy, emphasizing departure from truth, righteousness, or standard correctness.
groups.summary_zh: 指在判断、道德或行为准则上发生偏差、失误或偏离正道。

groups.name: Establish & Locate · 设立与进驻 (Base, Station, Anchor)
groups.tip: 建立机构并落定选址

items.def_zh: 将基地设于；定居扎根于
items.def_en: (+ in/at) To locate the operational centre, headquarters, or personnel of an organization in a place
To assign an organization's personnel or military unit to a designated post
To provide living accommodations and institutional operational lodgings in a venue
To establish the headquarters or main center of operations of an organization or business in a particular place.
To establish an office, business, or operational presence in a location
To firmly fix an enterprise or institution within a regional community or hub

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate placing or stationing the headquarters, central operations, or core physical footprint of an enterprise in a particular location.
groups.summary_zh: 指将企事业单位、指挥部或业务中枢设立并安顿于某特定地点。

groups.name: Evade & Shirk Duty · 逃避与推卸 (Dodge, Duck, Weasel Out)
groups.tip: 懒惰推卸责任或逃避义务

items.def_en: (+ of) To withdraw from a commitment, contract, or promised task before completion
To shift responsibility or blame for an obligation onto somebody else
To cleverly or dishonorably avoid an awkward duty, meeting, or difficult interview
To deliberately avoid dealing with a responsibility, obligation, question, or payment
To deliberately avoid doing work, a duty, or a responsibility that you should do.

items.def_zh: 耍滑头逃避（承诺或义务）
items.def_en: (+ of) To avoid doing something promised or required by acting dishonestly or making devious excuses

groups.summary_en: This frame involves deliberately avoiding duties, accountability, work, or difficult questions through excuses, subterfuge, or deceit. Unlike physical flight, this involves moral evasion of societal or professional obligations.
groups.summary_zh: 通过借口、推诿或欺骗手段逃避责任、工作或义务。

groups.name: Exacerbate & Aggravate · 恶化与加剧 (Intensify, Worsen, Inflame)
groups.tip: 火上浇油，事态朝更坏方向演变

items.def_en: To become or make something of lower quality, poorer condition, or greater severity
To make a problem or difficult situation worse by adding further complications to it
To increase rapidly in size, severity, intensity, or hostility
To make an injury, problem, or offense worse or more serious
To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse or more severe.
To provoke or intensify violent, angry, or painful feelings and situations

groups.summary_en: This frame covers actions or circumstances that deepen the severity, pain, bitterness, or volatility of an already negative situation. These verbs emphasize an escalation from bad to much worse.
groups.summary_zh: 使已有的不良状态、矛盾或伤痛变得更加严峻或激烈。

groups.name: Exacting Extraction & Overburden · 苛征与过度剥削 (Overburden, Fleece, Bleed dry)
groups.tip: 施加过重税负或过度压榨

items.def_en: To exploit a situation, system, or person dishonestly to extract the maximum possible money or advantage
(informal) To strip someone of money or property through excessive fees, overcharging, or fraud

items.def_zh: 哄抬价格以勒索；漫天要价
items.def_en: To overcharge customers unfairly, especially during an emergency or shortage
To weigh down an individual, system, or economy with excessive responsibilities, debts, or demands

items.def_zh: 向……征税过重；使负担过度，使劳累过度
items.def_en: 1. To demand too much tax from someone or something. 2. To put too great a demand on someone's physical strength, ability, or resources.
To deplete all the financial resources of a person, firm, or country through sustained extortion or expenses

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this economic and possessive frame describe subjecting people, organizations, or resources to excessive levies, extortionate financial demands, or ruinous extraction. The core sense ranges from burdensome official taxes to predatory swindling.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对财务或体能资源施以过重负荷、苛捐杂税或残酷抽吸剥削。

groups.name: Exceed Permitted or Welcome Presence · 逾期逗留与怠慢客套 (Overstay, Outstay, Trespass)
groups.tip: 逗留时间超出许可或预期期限

items.def_zh: 逗留过久令主人嫌弃，过分叨扰
items.def_en: fixed idiom: to stay somewhere as a guest longer than one's hosts desire

items.def_zh: 逾期滞留，超过签证合法期限停留
items.def_en: collocation: to remain illegally in a country past the authorized expiration date
remain in a place or social setting longer than is necessary, welcome, or customary
stay somewhere past the time when one is expected or welcomed to leave

items.def_zh: 停留超过（规定时间或期限）；逗留过久
items.def_en: To stay somewhere longer than an allowed or expected time (e.g. overstay one's visa/welcome).

items.def_zh: 逗留超过（时间限制或主人的容忍度）；比……逗留更久
items.def_en: To stay longer than permitted or welcome (especially in 'outstay one's welcome'); to stay longer than someone else.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this relational frame describe remaining in a location, host's residence, or legal jurisdiction beyond the time permitted by explicit visa allowances or implicit social welcome. Overstay focuses on legal/temporal threshold breaches (e.g., visas), outstay typically governs social hospitality (outstaying one's welcome), while tarry over/overhang involve improper prolongation.
groups.summary_zh: 指停留时间超出签证许可期限，或客人逗留过久耗尽主人好客热情的行为。

groups.name: Exclude & Banish · 排斥与驱逐放逐 (Exclude, Ostracize, Banish)
groups.tip: 从排除在外升级为逐出国境

items.def_en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place or participating in discussions
To officially prevent someone from going somewhere, taking part, or securing a right

items.def_zh: 排斥，排除在外；不包括，不予考虑
items.def_en: 1. To deliberately prevent someone or something from entering a place or taking part in an activity. 2. To leave out or decide not to consider something.
To intentionally refuse to speak to, associate with, or accept someone into a community or group
To force someone to live away from their native country, often for political reasons
To officially send someone away from a country or place of residence as a punishment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this intensity spectrum describe deliberate rejection, social cutoff, or physical banishment from a collective, community, or privilege, spanning quiet omission to permanent exile.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人蓄意排斥在外，直至施以社会孤立、放逐出境的强硬手段。

groups.name: Excrete & Defecate · 排便与排泄 (Defecate, Excrete, Shit)
groups.tip: 生理代谢物排放过程

items.def_zh: 拉屎，排便；拉屎弄脏；戏弄，胡扯
items.def_en: 1. (taboo slang) To pass feces from the bowels; defecate. 2. (slang) To tease, mock, or attempt to deceive someone.
to defecate (slang, mildly vulgar)

items.def_zh: 拉屎，便便（儿童语或非正式口语）
items.def_en: to defecate; used informally, especially by or to children
[I/T] to separate and discharge waste matter from the body or system

items.def_zh: 拉屎，排便（shit 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: (taboo slang) Past tense and past participle of shit: to defecate.

items.def_zh: 排便，大便（正式或医学语体）
items.def_en: to pass solid waste from the body through the bowels (formal/clinical)

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to expelling solid waste from the bowels, ranging across clinical/formal biological terms, neutral everyday phrasing, and vulgar slang.
groups.summary_zh: 指将体内固体废物排出体外的生理行为，涵盖医学术语、口语及粗俗俚语。

groups.name: Execute & Capital Punishment · 依法处决与处死 (Execute, Decapitate, Hang)
groups.tip: 斩首等不同方式的死刑处决

items.def_en: to kill someone by tying a rope around their neck and dropping them
to kill someone as a lawful punishment for a serious crime
(+ sb) To execute someone by hanging, whether judicially or extrajudicially

items.def_zh: 斩首，砍头；使（组织等）群龙无首
items.def_en: 1. To cut off the head of a person or animal, especially as an execution. 2. (figurative) To weaken or destroy an organization by removing its leaders.
to execute someone using a guillotine

items.def_zh: 以电刑处死；使触电致死（或重伤）
items.def_en: To kill or severely injure someone by passing a strong electric current through their body, especially as an execution method or by accident.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify carrying out a legal sentence of death on a person, distinguished primarily by the mechanical or physical method used (e.g., severance, electric current, suspension).
groups.summary_zh: 指依照法律判决处死罪犯，核心区分在于具体的行刑手段与方式。

groups.name: Execute & Capital Punishment · 处决与行刑 (Execute, Behead, Decapitate)
groups.tip: 执行死刑并将罪犯送上断头台

items.def_en: To kill someone by tying a rope around their neck and dropping them
To kill someone legally as a punishment for a serious crime
To execute someone officially as a capital penalty
To cut off someone's head as a method of execution
To cut off the head of a person or animal, especially officially or surgically

items.def_zh: 用断头台处决（斩首）；（用切纸机等）裁切；（议会中）限制辩论并强行表决
items.def_en: 1. To execute someone using a guillotine. 2. (British politics) To end debate on a parliamentary bill by a fixed time so a vote can be taken. 3. To cut paper or materials with a guillotine machine.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the lawful or official killing of a condemned person as capital punishment, ranging from general execution to specific lethal methods.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据官方判决对受刑人执行死刑，包含各类具体的行刑方式。

groups.name: Exemplify & Elucidate · 举例与阐释 (Exemplify, Illustrate, Demonstrate)
groups.tip: 用事实、证据或示范进行论证

items.def_en: (formal) To cite or mention something as an example.

items.def_zh: 示范，演示；证明，证实；游行示威
items.def_en: 1. To show, explain, or prove something clearly by giving proof or practical examples. 2. To take part in a public protest.

items.def_zh: （用例子、数据等）阐明，说明；给……加插图
items.def_en: 1. To explain or clarify something by using examples, diagrams, or pictures. 2. To provide pictures, drawings, or photographs for a book or article.
to make something clearer or easier to understand by giving more details or an explanation
to be a typical example of something, or to show something by giving an example
[I/T] to make something very clear by explaining it in formal or technical detail

groups.summary_en: A speaker or writer provides concrete instances, analogies, or evidence to clarify, substantiate, or make an abstract concept readily understandable.
groups.summary_zh: 通过列举实例、演示或图解来清晰阐明抽象概念或论点。

groups.name: Exercise & Exert · 行使与施加 (Exercise, Exert, Wield, Apply)
groups.tip: 实际动用权力或施加威压

items.def_en: put a rule, principle, or forceful measure into practical operation
1. to use or apply a right, power, or authority. 2. to do physical activities to stay healthy or train
cite or appeal to an authoritative clause, right, or legal power to authorize an action
hold and effectively use power, authority, or influence over others
bring power, force, or influential leverage effectively to bear upon something
direct influence, resources, or acute pressure decisively upon a target or situation

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on putting rights, authority, discretion, or physical and political power into active operation. The verbs emphasize either the legitimate execution of constitutional/legal powers or the forceful leverage of pressure and influence.
groups.summary_zh: 指合法行使权利、权限，或主动施加力量、权威与政治影响力。

groups.name: Exercise & Train · 体能训练与负重锻炼 (Work out, Pump, Bench-press)
groups.tip: 肢体主动发力锻炼体能

items.def_en: to engage in vigorous physical exercise routines to improve fitness
to lift a barbell or weights upwards while lying on a bench
to lift heavy weights as an intensive bodybuilding activity
to do gentle stretching or light exercises following an intensive workout

items.def_zh: 做引体向上；用下巴触碰
items.def_en: 1. ('chin oneself') To pull oneself up on a horizontal bar until the chin is level with or above the bar. 2. (informal) To hit someone on the chin.
to perform knee-bending strength exercises, often with a barbell across the shoulders

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to performing specific physical exercises, calisthenics, or strength routines to build fitness and muscular endurance.
groups.summary_zh: 指进行具体的器械力量训练、自体重健身或专项体能锻炼。

groups.name: Exhort & Admonish · 告诫与极力劝勉 (Urge, Admonish, Exhort)
groups.tip: 由诚意规劝上升为严肃告诫

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ of/against/to) to advise someone of danger or undesirable consequences before acting
(+ to/on) to encourage someone strongly and earnestly to take a particular action
To advise or urge someone seriously to do or not do something, or to scold someone firmly but gently.
(+ for) to express disapproval or administer a mild, principled rebuke to someone
To strongly encourage, advise, or urge someone to do something.
(+ to/from) to direct, command, or urge someone with authoritative moral or legal weight

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate speech acts where an agent strongly prompts the addressee to adopt a moral course of action or reproves misbehavior. They scale in urgency and moral authority from gentle cautioning (admonish) to impassioned, urgent appeals (exhort, beseech).
groups.summary_zh: 基于权威或道德紧迫感提出劝诫、告诫与极力敦促。

groups.name: Exonerate & Plead Excuse · 开脱与提供不在场证明 (Exonerate, Excuse, Absolve, Plead)
groups.tip: 提出不在场证据或理由，为自身开脱罪责

items.def_en: to offer an apology, explanation, or mitigating ground to release someone from an obligation or fault
to allow someone who has done wrong to go without severe reprimand or punishment
to declare oneself innocent or guilty in a court of law, or put forward an excuse in one's defense
to declare someone formally free from guilt, moral obligation, or punishment

items.def_zh: 为……提供不在场证明，为……辩解开脱
items.def_en: To provide an excuse or an alibi for someone to clear them of blame.
to officially absolve someone from blame, guilt, or criminal responsibility for a wrongdoing

groups.summary_en: Covers legal or forensic speech acts where an accused party produces proof, excuses, or defenses to shift blame, refute culpability, and clear their name of wrongdoing.
groups.summary_zh: 指在受指控时提供不在场证明或托词，以此免除刑责与罪咎。

groups.name: Expand & Dilate · 扩张与局部膨胀 (Expand, Dilate, Distend)
groups.tip: 向外延伸，体量或范围不断扩大

items.def_en: [I/T] to become or make larger in size, area, volume, or scope
[I/T] to expand or puff out beyond normal dimensions, typically due to pressure or inflammation
[I/T] to fill something with air or gas so that it swells up

items.def_zh: （使）扩大，（使）膨胀，（使）张大；详述，详加论述 (dilate on/upon)
items.def_en: 1. To become wider, larger, or more open, or make something do so; 2. (dilate on/upon) to speak or write at length about something.
To expand operations or influence on a worldwide scale, or cause something to do so.

items.def_zh: （使）膨胀，（使）肿胀，（因内压而）鼓起
items.def_en: To swell or expand outward due to internal pressure, or cause something to do so.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the outward growth, swelling, or stretching of a body part, volume, or systemic scale, contrasting internal physiological distension with systemic expansion.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体、器官或体系由内而外地膨胀、张开或扩展。

groups.name: Expand & Extend · 膨胀与延伸 (Expand, Extend, Stretch)
groups.tip: 体积或范围向外扩张

items.def_en: [I/T] to draw out or extend in length or surface area by tension
[I/T] to increase in breadth or lateral extent

items.def_zh: 延伸，伸展；延长，扩大；给予，提供
items.def_en: 1. To stretch out or reach in distance, space, or time; to make larger, longer, or broader. 2. To offer or give something formally (such as greetings, an invitation, or help).
1. To become or make larger in size, volume, scope, or extent. 2. (+ on/upon) To give more details about something.
[I/T] to lengthen out or become physically longer relative to original proportions
[I/T] to make or become wider, larger, or more open, especially an aperture or pupil

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame describe spatial enlargement or elongation. They differentiate between volumetric dilation in all directions (expanding) versus linear unrolling, stretching, or lengthening along an axis (extending).
groups.summary_zh: 物体或范围在空间维度上的径向膨胀扩大或单向拉长延伸。

groups.name: Expect & Anticipate · 期待与预料 (Anticipate, Await, Foresee)
groups.tip: 预想未来可能发生的情况

items.def_zh: 预料，预期；期待，指望；要求
items.def_en: 1. To think or believe that something will happen. 2. To wait for or anticipate someone or something. 3. To demand that someone do something.
To foresee an event and take proactive action or mentally prepare for its occurrence
To feel pleasure and positive excitement about an event that is going to happen
To wait for something with expectation, readiness, or longing
To form a mental picture of something as a desirable or probable future eventuality
To know or realize that something will happen before it occurs

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental projection regarding future events, ranging from neutral logical expectation to eager, proactive emotional readiness. Verbs differentiate between passive certainty and active preparation.
groups.summary_zh: 指对未来事件的心理预期、预先准备或殷切盼望。

groups.name: Expel & Deport · 驱逐与流放 (Exile, Banish, Deport)
groups.tip: 放逐异乡剥夺本国居住权

items.def_en: 1. To force someone to leave their country or home, often for political reasons.
to officially force someone to leave a country, school, or organization

items.def_zh: 剥夺法律保护权并放逐
items.def_en: to deprive someone of the protection of the law, historically placing them outside society
to legally expel a foreign national from a country back to their country of origin
to send someone away from a country or place as an official punishment, forbidding return

items.def_zh: 逐出本国，放逐；移居国外
items.def_en: 1. To force someone to leave their native country. 2. To live in or move to a foreign country.

groups.summary_en: An authority or state formally and forcibly removes an individual from their home country or community, legally barring them from return. While 'exile' and 'banish' historically emphasize punitive separation from homeland, 'deport' and 'expel' denote modern legal or sovereign ejection.
groups.summary_zh: 统治当局将某人强制逐出国土或社区并禁止其返回的惩处或主权行为。

groups.name: Explore & Investigate · 探索与探究 (Investigate, Probe, Delve into)
groups.tip: 深入未知领域探索实情

items.def_en: To carry out a systematic or formal inquiry to discover and examine the facts of an issue
To travel through an unfamiliar area to learn about it, or to examine something systematically and thoroughly.
To explore an area in advance in order to gather information about terrain, opponents, or resources
To investigate something thoroughly and meticulously by digging deeply into research or records
To examine or inquire into something deeply, closely, and often intrusively
To make a preliminary survey of an unfamiliar area to gain strategic or practical information

groups.summary_en: Refers to traveling through unknown territories or systematically scrutinizing an intellectual topic, problem, or mystery. 'Explore' balances geographical and conceptual journeying, while 'probe' and 'delve into' emphasize deep, intrusive inquiry.
groups.summary_zh: 指对未知区域进行实地勘查或对问题深入探寻求知。

groups.name: Express & Articulate Views · 表达与阐明观点 (Express, Voice, Opine)
groups.tip: 将内心情感或想法用言语说出

items.def_zh: 公开发表；宣泄（看法、不满）
items.def_en: to make opinions, complaints, or views known publicly to open discussion
(+ that) (formal or humorous) To state or express one's opinion about something.

items.def_zh: 表达，吐露（意见、感受等）；发浊音
items.def_en: 1. To express feelings, opinions, or doubts aloud. 2. (linguistics) To pronounce a sound with vibration of the vocal cords.
To show or communicate a feeling, opinion, or fact through words, looks, or actions.
to express an idea, thought, or feeling with great clarity and coherence

items.def_zh: 宣泄；吐露（怒气或强烈情绪）
items.def_en: to give forceful, unreserved public expression to a powerful emotion or grievance

groups.summary_en: Verbs of communicative delivery specifying how an agent puts thoughts, feelings, or formal stances into words, ranging from raw emotional venting to philosophical speculation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将内在看法、情感或观点通过言语清楚表述出来的方式。

groups.name: Express Approval & Commendation · 赞扬与嘉奖 (Praise, Commend, Extol)
groups.tip: 正式表扬嘉奖其功劳与表现

items.def_en: 1. to express admiration or approval of someone or something. 2. to worship or express honor and gratitude to God.
to praise enthusiastically and publicly as an outstanding success
[I/T] to express strong approval of an idea, policy, or action

items.def_zh: 赞扬，表彰；推荐；把……托付给
items.def_en: 1. (formal) to praise someone or something formally or publicly. 2. to recommend someone or something to others. 3. (formal) to entrust someone or something to someone's care.
(formal) to praise a person or their achievements highly, often publicly
(+ the virtues of) to praise enthusiastically and lavishly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate verbal expressions of warm approval, admiration, or official tribute directed at someone's merits or achievements. Registers span from everyday positive evaluation to formal or elevated laudation.
groups.summary_zh: 对某人的品格、功绩或表现表达由衷赞赏、表扬或官方嘉奖。

groups.name: Expropriate & Commandeer · 征用与占为己有 (Expropriate, Commandeer, Confiscate)
groups.tip: 私占或依公权强制征收

items.def_en: To eagerly or opportunistically take control of something, such as an advantage or pretext

items.def_zh: 私占，侵吞；征用；拨出（专款）
items.def_en: 1. To take something for one's own use, typically without permission. 2. To allocate or set aside money or assets for a special purpose.
To seize property or contraband using official authority, usually as a penalty
To take possession of private property or vehicles by force for military or emergency purposes
To legally take away private property or real estate for public use, often by state power

items.def_zh: 冒领；擅自霸占（权力/特权）
items.def_en: (+ to oneself) To claim or seize power, rights, or privileges without proper justification

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the unilateral, authoritative, or illicit seizure of property, funds, or assets for official or private use. Collocates often include funds, private land, vehicles, or emergency powers.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方强制征收或私人擅自侵占财产、资金及物资。

groups.name: Extort & Blackmail · 勒索与敲诈 (Extort, Blackmail, Bleed)
groups.tip: 用威胁手段强行索取财物

items.def_zh: 压榨；逼迫（交出钱财或信息）
items.def_en: To exert severe economic or psychological pressure on someone to extract funds or concessions
To extort money from someone through deceit, intimidation, or aggressive pressure
To extort or drain money continuously from someone until their resources are exhausted
To force someone to give money or do something by threatening to reveal damaging secrets or harm them
(+ from) To obtain money, information, or agreement from someone by using threats, force, or intimidation.
(+ from) To obtain something forcefully or through extreme effort despite stubborn resistance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote extracting money, concessions, or compliance through coercion, threats, or abuse of power. While legal terms emphasize illicit force, informal extensions capture relentless financial draining.
groups.summary_zh: 以威胁、胁迫或不当压力逼迫对方交出钱财或妥协，含法律指控与盘剥意味。

groups.name: Extract & Draw · 抽取与挤取 (Draw Fluid or Essence from a Source)
groups.tip: 利用负压或挤压榨出液体

items.def_zh: 开阀抽取（树汁、桶装酒）；开发
items.def_en: to pierce a container or source to draw liquid or resource from it

items.def_zh: （用虹吸管）抽出，转移（资金/液体）
items.def_en: (+ off/out) to convey liquid through a tube; to divert funds or resources covertly

items.def_zh: 吸，吮吸；抽取，吸取；〈非正〉糟糕，令人厌恶
items.def_en: 1. To pull liquid, air, or an object into the mouth or an enclosed space using suction. 2. (informal) To be very bad, unpleasant, or disappointing.

items.def_zh: 挤奶，挤（奶）；榨取，勒索（钱财、利益等）
items.def_en: 1. To draw milk from a cow, goat, or other female animal. 2. (informal) To exploit or extract money, advantage, or information from someone in an unfair or ruthless way.
[I/T] to cause liquid to run out completely; to deplete resources or energy
to press firmly together to force out liquid or extract something with effort

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe extracting liquid, nutrients, or intangible value from a container or living organism, varying by physical mechanism (suction, squeezing) or exploitative intent.
groups.summary_zh: 通过吮吸、挤压或抽引从源体获取液体或利益，侧重手法特征与榨取意味。

groups.name: Extract & Pry Loose · 撬开与撬出 (Prise, Pry, Winkle)
groups.tip: 费力从狭缝或壳中挑出

items.def_en: to force or ease something out of a tight space by using a wedge
to move or lift something heavy using a firm lever or tool
to use force or a tool with leverage to move, raise, or open something stuck

items.def_zh: （用针等从壳中）挑出；挑出，搜出，挖出（尤与 out 连用）
items.def_en: (chiefly British informal) ('winkle out') To extract or force someone or something out of a tight space, hiding place, or position with difficulty.

items.def_zh: 撬，撬开，撬动；费力套出（信息）
items.def_en: (chiefly British) To use force or a tool to lever or pry something open or away; to extract with difficulty.
to force open a locked window, door, or drawer using a small crowbar or tool

groups.summary_en: An agent applies leveraged force or painstaking probing to separate, dislodge, or extract an object from a tight, stuck, or confined space. Verbs vary by the tool, leverage, and physical effort required.
groups.summary_zh: 施加杠杆或细致撬动以从紧密夹缝或狭小空间中起出、撬开某物。

groups.name: Extract & Pull Out · 拔出与提炼 (Extract, Draw out, Pry)
groups.tip: 费力把嵌入之物抽出提取

items.def_en: To pull something gently or smoothly from inside a holder or container; to elicit hidden information
To remove something by pulling it firmly from where it is fixed or embedded

items.def_zh: 拔出，抽出；提取，提炼；索取，榨取
items.def_en: To remove, pull out, or draw out something with effort, skill, or force; to obtain a substance or information from something.
To use leverage to force something open or dislodge it from a tight space
To forcibly pull or extract something away from a tight grasp or difficult obstacle

items.def_zh: 解救；使摆脱（险境或纠缠）
items.def_en: To free or release someone or something from a tangled, trapped, or dangerous position with difficulty

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote removing or obtaining an embedded object or substance through deliberate force, mechanical effort, or specialized technique. They often contrast raw physical pulling with chemical or informational extraction.
groups.summary_zh: 强调借助外力、技巧或工序将嵌生物件、深层成分或隐秘信息拔出或提炼出来。

groups.name: Fabricate & Forge · 编造与伪造 (Concoct, Forge, Trump up)
groups.tip: 无中生有捏造谎言或假货

items.def_en: To invent an untrue story, excuse, or explanation rather than tell facts
To contrive or fabricate a dishonest explanation, excuse, or plot
To invent an elaborate story, excuse, or plan, often to deceive people
To deliberately invent false charges or complaints against someone
To make an illegal, fraudulent copy of a document, signature, or currency
1. To invent false information, evidence, or an excuse in order to deceive people. 2. (manufacturing) To construct or manufacture something from prepared components.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail deliberately inventing falsehoods, doctoring evidence, or counterfeiting documents and stories with the intention of misleading, deceiving, or framing others.
groups.summary_zh: 指蓄意捏造谎言、虚构借口或伪造物证以达到蒙骗、嫁祸目的的行为。

groups.name: Fabricate & Mass-Produce · 工业生产与制造 (Fabricate, Assemble, Turn Out)
groups.tip: 工业加工制造各类成品

items.def_en: 1. To make or produce goods on a large scale using machinery. 2. To invent, fabricate, or make up a false story, excuse, or evidence.
To produce standardized goods in large quantities, usually using machines on assembly lines
To produce something mechanically or industrially, especially in large amounts
To produce large quantities of something rapidly and automatically, often with poor quality
To make something by joining separate component parts together systematically
To make or construct a product or structure by assembling prepared components

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the systematic industrial processing, assembly, or mechanical fabrication of tangible goods or products on a significant scale.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过工业机械、装配线或加工系统规模化制造实体产品。

groups.name: Fade & Diminish · 消退与变淡 (Fade, Wane, Dwindle)
groups.tip: 光彩逐渐暗淡最终完全消失

items.def_en: 1. to lose brightness, color, or loudness gradually, or to cause something to do so 2. to slowly disappear or decline
To lose intensity of brightness or clarity, or cause visibility to decrease
To diminish in size, number, or strength gradually until little remains
To recede like the tide, gradually decaying in momentum, emotion, or life force
To decrease in vigor, power, brightness, or scale over an extended period
To gradually come to an end by steadily growing weaker, smaller, or slower

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail progressive diminution in perceptual strength, intensity, or distinctness—such as the gradual fading of colors, memory, sound, daylight, or passion over time.
groups.summary_zh: 强调光度、色彩、声音或情感强度随着时间推移逐步减弱暗淡。

groups.name: Fade & Perish · 消逝与消亡 (Disappear, Dissolve, Evaporate)
groups.tip: 从看不见到彻底灭绝消亡

items.def_en: To slowly become weaker, dimmer, or less distinct until completely gone
To cease to be visible or to pass out of sight entirely
To break down, melt, or disintegrate into nothingness

items.def_zh: 突然消失，不见；绝迹，消亡
items.def_en: to disappear suddenly or completely; to cease to exist
To vanish abruptly without leaving a trace, often said of emotions, hopes, or assets
To die, be destroyed, or cease to exist permanently through ruin or violence

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entities passing out of sight, existence, or memory, ranging from gradual natural fading to sudden, irreversible disappearance.
groups.summary_zh: 描述人、物或现象从视线或存在中逐渐消退直至彻底灭绝。

groups.name: Fail & Flunk · 考核落第与挂科不合格 (Fail, Pluck, Wash out)
groups.tip: 考试不及格或事业遭挫败

items.def_en: To not pass an exam, test, or course, or grade someone as having not met the standard
(informal, especially North American) To perform disastrously badly on a test or exam
(informal) To fail a rigorous training program or course and be disqualified
To barely succeed in passing a test or course, hovering just above failure
(+ of) To leave an educational institution or course before graduating, often following failure

items.def_zh: 考试不及格；给……打不及格；败北，失败
items.def_en: (informal, especially North American) To fail an exam, course, or test, or to give someone a failing grade.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on failing an academic examination, course, or assessment, or giving an examinee an unacceptable failing grade.
groups.summary_zh: 指在考试、学业或资格考核中不及格、被淘汰或给某人打不及格。

groups.name: Fail & Malfunction · 故障与罢工 (Conk Out, Break Down, Glitch)
groups.tip: 机器或系统运转失灵失败

items.def_en: Stop working properly due to a mechanical, electrical, or structural fault
Suddenly stop functioning or fail completely, especially of an engine or electrical appliance
Suffer a brief, minor, or temporary malfunction or irregularity in operation
Completely cease to operate or support load under continuous strain
Become locked, jammed, or unable to move due to friction, heat, or internal failure
(of a machine, system, or organ) To fail to function or work properly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the sudden or progressive operational breakdown, stalling, or failure of mechanical engines, electrical hardware, or automated systems.
groups.summary_zh: 指机器、系统或设备发生故障、停转或瘫痪。

groups.name: Faint & Regain Consciousness · 昏厥与苏醒 (Pass Out, Black Out, Come Round)
groups.tip: 短暂失去知觉后恢复

items.def_en: To recover consciousness or normal physical faculties after fainting or an accident
To regain consciousness after fainting or anesthesia
To fall down suddenly, especially in a faint or as a result of illness
To suddenly lose consciousness for a brief period, typically from exhaustion, heat, or intoxication

items.def_zh: 眼前发黑而晕厥；暂时性丧失记忆
items.def_en: To experience a sudden, temporary loss of vision, consciousness, or memory
To suddenly lose consciousness for a short time, usually falling to the ground.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe abruptly losing consciousness due to shock, illness, or trauma, as well as regaining normal awareness afterwards. They range from colloquial phrasal verbs for blacking out to clinical or gentle terms for coming round.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖因生理休克或虚弱突发性失去知觉，以及随后苏醒过来恢复意识的过程。

groups.name: Falsify & Doctor · 篡改与伪造 (Doctor, Cook, Fudge, Rig)
groups.tip: 暗中动手脚改变原貌

items.def_zh: 篡改，伪造；在（食物或饮料中）掺杂质，下毒；行医
items.def_en: 1. To alter or tamper with something, especially dishonestly in order to deceive. 2. To add something harmful or potent to food or drink.
To artificially manipulate or falsify financial accounts, figures, or records
To manipulate or alter a contest, election, price, or system dishonestly to ensure a specific outcome

items.def_zh: 搪塞掩饰，胡乱拼凑（数字）
items.def_en: To adjust or manipulate facts, figures, or explanations dishonesly or vaguely to avoid difficulties
To deliberately change records, accounts, or evidence in order to deceive others
To corrupt, debase, or make a food, drink, or drug impure by adding inferior or unauthorized substances

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on intentionally altering, falsifying, or manipulating documents, data, records, or substances to mislead, conceal fraud, or secure illegitimate gain. The acts involve deliberate deception and corruption of integrity.
groups.summary_zh: 特指出于欺骗、掩盖真相或舞弊目的，对账目、数据或原件进行暗中改动。

groups.name: Falsify & Forge · 虚构与伪造 (Falsify, Forge, Fabricate, Cook up)
groups.tip: 无中生有编造谎言与篡改数据

items.def_en: alter or tamper with a document, drink, or result dishonestly to alter its impression or effect
concoct or invent a false story, alibi, or excuse deceitfully
produce a fraudulent copy of a document, signature, or banknote with intent to defraud
invent false stories, evidence, or data deliberately in order to deceive
manipulate or adjust facts, figures, or issues dishonestly to avoid difficulties or provide false impressions
to alter, forge, or misrepresent records, documents, or data dishonestly in order to deceive people

groups.summary_en: This frame covers deliberate acts of altering, fabricating, or faking documents, official records, scientific results, or accounts to mislead others. These actions involve dishonest misrepresentation, intentional distortion, or counterfeit production.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过捏造、篡改文件或伪造事实来欺瞒他人的不诚实行为。

groups.name: Falter & Weaken · 动摇与衰退 (Falter, Waver, Flag)
groups.tip: 由坚定不移到动摇变衰弱

items.def_en: To move unsteadily from side to side, or show uncertainty of purpose
To become unsteady, uncertain, or lose confidence and strength

items.def_zh: 逐渐消失；逐渐衰退减弱
items.def_en: To gradually diminish until completely disappearing or becoming ineffective
To become tired, weaker, or less enthusiastic and effective

items.def_zh: 动摇，衰退，衰弱；结结巴巴地说；蹒跚，踉跄
items.def_en: 1. To lose strength, momentum, or confidence and begin to weaken or fail. 2. To speak hesitantly or walk unsteadily.
To decrease gradually in vigor, power, intensity, or extent

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe losing physical strength, conviction, operational momentum, or steady progress, showing imminent signs of breakdown.
groups.summary_zh: 指力量、信心、势头或身体状态动摇不稳，开始显出疲态或衰退迹象。

groups.name: Fan & Ventilate · 鼓风与扇动 (Fan, Stoke, Ventilate)
groups.tip: 搧动器具鼓起风力吹拂

items.def_en: To spread open or spread out across a wide area from a central point

items.def_zh: 扇（风），煽动（风力）；成扇形散开；（棒球中）三振（击球手）
items.def_en: 1. To blow air onto someone or something by waving a fan or other flat object. 2. (+ out) To spread out in the shape of an open fan. 3. (baseball) To strike out a batter.
To introduce air or gas into a material or liquid to oxygenate it
To cause fresh air to enter and circulate freely throughout a space
To encourage a fire to burn more fiercely by adding fuel or agitating air
To blow air onto a hearth or flame using a bellows device

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve actively directing a draft or stream of air toward something to cool it, aerate it, or stoke a combustion. They emphasize deliberate mechanical or manual movement to agitate air.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动扇动或吹气以鼓风、降温、通风或煽旺火苗。

groups.name: Fasten with Adhesive · 粘贴与粘附 (Glue, Paste, Stick, Affix)
groups.tip: 涂胶粘合使两物贴紧

items.def_en: To press and secure an adhesive edge or flap flatly against a backing surface
To attach or become attached to a surface by adhesive force or natural tackiness
To seal, join, or fasten something using sticky gum or cohesive syrup
To stick or fasten paper, pictures, or objects to a surface using adhesive paste or gum
To fasten, join, or attach something securely to an exterior surface, usually by adhesive means
1. To join or fasten things together using glue. 2. (often passive, 'be glued to') To fix your attention or eyes completely on something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate joining, affixing, or holding lightweight objects together using paste, gum, or adhesive film. The physical action is direct, practical, and everyday, with common metaphorical extensions related to immobility.
groups.summary_zh: 通过胶水、浆糊或粘附力将物体粘接或贴在另一物体表面上。

groups.name: Favor & Coddle · 溺爱与过度娇宠 (Coddle, Pamper, Mollicoddle)
groups.tip: 关怀过度如同筑起温室

items.def_zh: 把……当婴儿对待，过分娇惯
items.def_en: Treat someone like a small child by doing everything for them or shielding them excessively
Harm a child's character by consistently giving them everything they ask for without discipline

items.def_zh: 纵容娇宠，悉心犒劳服侍
items.def_en: Give someone special comfort, luxury, and attention, catering to all their desires

items.def_zh: 娇生惯养，细心呵护免受挫折
items.def_en: Treat someone with extreme indulgence, care, or protection, often to a harmful degree
To protect someone, especially a child, too much so that they do not learn to be independent.

items.def_zh: 百般呵护，过分溺爱娇纵
items.def_en: Overprotect and pamper someone so excessively that they fail to develop fortitude or independence

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict interpersonal overprotectiveness and excessive pampering, shielding an individual (usually a child or dependent) from life's ordinary harshness, thereby stifling their resilience and self-reliance.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重人际间过度看护、娇生惯养或溺爱包办，剥夺自立锻炼机会。

groups.name: Feint & Deceive · 佯攻与诱敌 (Feint, Fake out, Juke)
groups.tip: 做假动作诱骗敌人产生误判

items.def_en: To avoid someone or something by a sudden, quick physical evasion or sidestep
To mislead or outwit an opponent by feigning a move in one direction before taking another
To intentionally provoke or lure an adversary into making an ill-advised, exploitable move

items.def_zh: （在球类运动中）做假动作欺骗对手
items.def_en: (sports) to make a deceptive movement in football, rugby, etc., pretending to pass or kick the ball, in order to trick an opponent

items.def_zh: 虚晃避开；做假动作晃过
items.def_en: To make a quick deceptive move or sudden shift of direction to evade a defender
To make a deceptive or distracting movement intended to mislead an opponent in sports or combat

groups.summary_en: Covers deceptive tactical ploys, sham moves, or mock strikes designed to mislead an opponent in sports or combat about one's true intention or trajectory.
groups.summary_zh: 指在对抗或体育竞技中通过虚晃、假动作误导对手并诱使其失位。

groups.name: Fend & Deflect · 抵挡与招架 (Fend, Ward off, Parry)
groups.tip: 架起盾牌抵挡进攻推开攻击

items.def_en: To turn aside from a straight course, or divert someone's criticism or focus.
To temporarily avert or delay an imminent bad outcome or disaster.
To avert, repel, or protect oneself against danger, disease, or an unwanted approach.
To ward off a weapon or blow, or adroitly evade a difficult question or critique.
1. ('fend off') To defend against or push away an attack, blow, or unwanted question. 2. ('fend for oneself') To look after and provide for oneself without help.
To drive back an attacker, army, or offensive force by fighting.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the dynamic physical or verbal maneuver of blocking, redirecting, or pushing away an incoming attack, aggressive demand, or uncomfortable scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 采取防守姿态或机敏反应来抵挡、化解攻击或质问。

groups.name: Fester & Ulcerate · 溃烂与化脓 (Suppuration & Tissue Breakdown)
groups.tip: 伤口细菌感染并溃烂化脓

items.def_en: suddenly develop eruptions, rashes, or sores on the skin

items.def_zh: （伤口）化脓，溃烂；（怨恨、问题等）加剧，恶化
items.def_en: 1. (of a wound or sore) To become infected and produce pus. 2. (of bad feelings or problems) To become worse or more intense over time.
(of skin or tissue) To develop an ulcer, or cause an ulcer to develop.
to undergo the formation and discharge of pus
(+ at sth) progressively destroy or erode tissue, a surface, or emotional well-being
[I/T] to become affected with or cause localized death and decay of soft tissue

groups.summary_en: Tissue or wounds undergo progressive bacterial infection, leading to pus generation, open sores, or gangrene. Figuratively, negative feelings decay and generate toxicity over time.
groups.summary_zh: 创口或组织发生感染化脓、腐烂破坏，程度逐步加深至坏疽溃败。

groups.name: Fill & Occupy · 充满与填充 (Fill, Pack, Stuff)
groups.tip: 装满空间不再空虚

items.def_en: To push something quickly and forcefully into a small space or container
To put a large quantity of things or people tightly into a space

items.def_zh: 充满，填满；担任，充任；满足
items.def_en: 1. To make or become full; to occupy a space completely. 2. To take up a job or position and do it.
To fill or take up a particular space, area, or period of time
To become completely full, or make something completely full
To force a person, thing, or group into a space that is already nearly full

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to causing a container, space, or vacancy to become full by inserting contents or taking up the available room. They range from neutral containment to forceful crowding and physical saturation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示装满、填塞或占据可用空间的动作，涵盖中性填补到用力塞满。

groups.name: Finalize Deal & Settle · 敲定与落实协议 (Clinch, Finalize, Settle)
groups.tip: 锁定胜利或最终敲定合同协议

items.def_en: To successfully conclude a business negotiation or sale
To resolve a dispute or come to an official agreement on a matter
To formally confirm, conclude, or make definitive an agreement

items.def_zh: 顺利完成；圆满结束（交易）
items.def_en: To complete or conclude a deal, contract, or meeting successfully

items.def_zh: 敲定，最后达成（协议）；赢得（比赛）；（拳击中）扭住对手
items.def_en: 1. To succeed in settling, winning, or concluding an agreement or deal finally. 2. (boxing) To hold the opponent closely with one or both arms.
To agree on or complete the last details of an arrangement or plan

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe successfully concluding negotiations, securing a contract, or firmly cementing a business or diplomatic deal beyond dispute.
groups.summary_zh: 指经过谈判最终成功达成协议、敲定合同或确立交易方案，使之板上钉钉。

groups.name: Financial Ruin & Depletion · 破产与倾家荡产 (Bankrupt, Ruin, Impoverish)
groups.tip: 财力耗尽直至彻底崩溃

items.def_en: To gradually exhaust the money, supplies, or financial capacity of someone

items.def_zh: 掏空（某人财物）；使倾家荡产
items.def_en: To take, win, or consume all the money that someone possesses
To destroy someone financially or cause their business to fold
To make a person, region, or enterprise extremely poor
To cause someone or an institution to lose all their money, property, or status

items.raw_cluster: 破产与使破产 Ruin & Bankrupt
items.def_en: to make a person, business, or country go bankrupt or lose all their money

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail stripping an individual, business, or state of financial solvency, reducing them to insolvency or economic collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 指剥夺个人、机构或国家的财力资信，使其陷入破产绝境。

groups.name: Fit & Dovetail · 契合与吻合 (Dovetail, Interlock, Jibe)
groups.tip: 如榫卯般严丝合缝紧密咬合

items.def_en: (+ with) To be harmonious or suitable with a surrounding group, system, or plan
(+ with) To correspond exactly in nature, opinion, occurrence, or position
(+ with) To be in full accord, compatibility, or agreement with another set of facts
(+ with) To harmonize, coordinate smoothly, or fit together cleanly like gear teeth
To fit or join together closely so that each part interconnects securely with another

items.def_zh: （使）吻合，（使）严密契合；用鸠尾榫接合
items.def_en: (+ with/into) If two things dovetail, or if you dovetail them, they fit together neatly and harmoniously; to join pieces of wood with dovetail joints.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the seamless, precise, and harmonious integration of parts, ideas, schedules, or facts. The emphasis is on structural compatibility, logical alignment, or mutual reinforcement without friction or contradiction.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重在结构、逻辑或时间上天衣无缝地精密吻合、协调一致。

groups.name: Fit Mechanical Parts & Hardware · 装设蹄铁与机械传动齿
groups.tip: 为马钉蹄或给机器装齿轮

items.def_en: to fit a horse or beast of burden with horseshoes
to furnish an edge or gear with projecting teeth or notches

items.def_zh: 给（管道或轮盘）装配凸缘或法兰盘
items.def_en: to provide an object or wheel with a rim or projecting collar
To fit or nail a horseshoe onto the hoof of a horse.

items.def_zh: 给……装轮齿；（掷骰子时）作弊
items.def_en: 1. To fit a wheel or gear with teeth (cogs). 2. (archaic) To cheat, especially at dice.

items.def_zh: 给…安装防滑垫或系缆角柱
items.def_en: to secure or reinforce something with cleats or projecting brackets

groups.summary_en: Pertains to specialized mechanical assembly or protective shoeing, specifically mounting shoes on hooves or providing gears/teeth to industrial machinery.
groups.summary_zh: 为机械传动装置安装齿齿构件，或为牲畜钉装马蹄铁。

groups.name: Flatter & Ingratiate · 讨好与逢迎 (Curry Favor, Ingratiate, Brown-nose)
groups.tip: 说好话巴结讨好以获取利益

items.def_en: To make deliberate, focused efforts to win someone's favor, support, or friendship
(+ to) To insinuate oneself into someone's friendship or favor for self-serving reasons
To lavish excessive praise and kindness on someone prior to asking for a favor
To flatter or behave obsequiously toward superiors to secure advancement or approval

items.def_zh: 讨好，巴结（常用于 curry favour）；梳刷（马匹）；用咖喱烹调
items.def_en: 1. (in curry favour) To try to win someone's approval or praise through flattery. 2. To brush and clean the coat of a horse.
(+ oneself with) To deliberately bring oneself into another's favor through charm or flattery

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe calculated efforts to gain another person's goodwill, acceptance, or approval through intentional charm, compliance, or targeted flattery. They center on the strategic cultivation of liking rather than mere spontaneous praise.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重出于策略目的蓄意笼络、迎合他人，以博得好感与赏识。

groups.name: Flatter & Ingratiate · 谄媚与卑躬屈膝 (Fawn, Grovel, Truckle)
groups.tip: 奴颜婢膝谄媚奉承，摇尾乞怜讨好权贵

items.def_en: (+ to) To deliberately flatter or please someone in authority to gain favor
(+ to) To act sycophantically toward someone important to gain personal advantage
(+ to) To submit obsequiously or act subserviently to someone's wishes

items.def_zh: 谄媚，阿谀奉承；（狗等）摇尾乞怜
items.def_en: (+ on/over) To praise and be overly attentive to someone in a servile, flattering way to gain favor.
(+ to) To act in an excessively subservient or deferential manner toward authority
To behave in an excessively humble, demeaning way to gain forgiveness or favor

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses acts of obsequious, servile deference where an actor demeans themselves through excessive praise or servility to win favor from a superior. Verbs differ in posture, ranging from adoring sycophancy to complete self-abasement.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过过分夸赞或卑屈姿态讨好掌权者，带有鲜明的谄媚低贱色彩。

groups.name: Flatter & Tout · 吹捧与兜售 (Plug, Hype, Tout)
groups.tip: 充当托儿做托儿吹嘘，极力吆喝推销

items.def_en: To promote or mention a product, book, or service publicly to increase popularity
To describe something in a very positive or glowing light to make people admire it
To publicize or stimulate interest in something through extravagant, exaggerated claims
To lavishly praise a book, performance, or commodity beyond what is deserved
To praise or publicize something insistently to persuade others of its exceptional value

items.def_zh: 充当托儿，为……做托儿吹嘘（公开推销以蒙骗他人）
items.def_en: (+ for) (especially North American informal) To act as a decoy or publicly praise and promote something in which one has a hidden dishonest interest.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers communicative acts aimed at aggressively promoting, puffing up, or shilling for a product, idea, or individual. The intent ranges from commercially calculated touting to extravagant and often disingenuous public boosting.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重为谋求利益而对人、商品或观点进行大肆宣传、推销与吹嘘。

groups.name: Flesh Out & Swell · 饱满与填充鼓起 (Plump, Puff Up, Fill Out)
groups.tip: 体积或外表变大凸起

items.def_en: to become larger, rounder, or inflated with air, liquid, or padding
to become rounder and heavier in form, losing gauntness or thinness
to shake or pat soft materials like pillows or feathers so they become full and airy
to become larger or rounder than normal due to internal pressure, expansion, or accumulation
to swell or cause to swell abnormally with fluid or gas

items.def_zh: （使）鼓起，（使）丰满；重重放下；扑通倒下
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) to make something fuller, rounder, or softer by shaking or patting it, or to become fuller and rounded 2. to drop or put something down heavily or carelessly 3. (+ down) to sit or fall down suddenly and heavily

groups.summary_en: Pertains to soft objects, body parts, or fabrics becoming comfortably rounded, volumized, full, or puffed up through shaking, hydration, weight gain, or stuffing.
groups.summary_zh: 指靠抖松、充气、长肉或补水使物体或身体部位变得丰满、膨松或软乎。

groups.name: Flip & Toss · 翻动与抛掷 (Toss, Flick, Whisk)
groups.tip: 轻巧向上翻面或顺手抛掷

items.def_en: Turn something so that the side that was underneath is now facing upwards
Turn round and round rapidly, or cause a flat object to rotate and flip

items.def_zh: 轻抛，翻动；迅速翻转；轻击
items.def_en: 1. To turn over quickly, or to throw something with a quick, light movement so that it turns over in the air. 2. To flick or strike something lightly with a quick motion.
Throw lightly or casually, or gently turn food ingredients over to mix them
Move or propel something with a sudden, quick, light snap of the wrist or fingers
Throw or fling something with a deliberate, targeted forward motion

groups.summary_en: Expresses quick, light manipulative actions that cause an object to turn over, invert, or sail briefly into the air with a flicking wrist movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指用敏捷轻快的手部或手腕动作使物体在空中翻转或翻面。

groups.name: Float & Buoy · 漂浮与浮载 (Buoy, Bob, Suspend)
groups.tip: 浮在水面或空中随波逐流

items.def_en: To maintain buoyancy and remain on top of water without sinking
To move up and down quickly and lightly while resting on the surface of water

items.def_zh: 漂浮，浮动；提出（建议或计划）；（使公司股票）上市
items.def_en: 1. To stay or move on the surface of a liquid without sinking, or drift gently through the air. 2. To suggest an idea, plan, or question for consideration. 3. To issue shares of a company on the stock market.
To hold a substance or particle floating evenly throughout a fluid or gas
To stay suspended in one place in the air, neither rising nor falling
(often + up) To keep someone or something afloat on a liquid surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe being physically supported by the buoyancy of water or air without sinking. They contrast buoyant stillness, rhythmic surface bobbing, and suspension.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体因浮力作用停留在水面或空中不沉，或轻快晃荡。

groups.name: Forage & Harvest Wild Food · 野外采集与收获 (Forage, Gather, Glean)
groups.tip: 采收坚果农作物归仓

items.def_en: To search for and pick wild plants, berries, or mushrooms to use as food
To gather or look for edible nuts.
To go searching for and gathering wild berries

items.def_zh: 搜寻（食物等）；漫山遍野地觅食
items.def_en: (+ for) To search widely across an area for wild food or provisions
To collect leftover grain or produce from a field after the main harvest has been gathered

items.def_zh: 寻觅残羹剩饭；翻找可用之物
items.def_en: To search through discarded materials or wild areas for usable food or items

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to searching for and collecting wild, uncultivated, or residual food and natural resources from the land. While commercial harvesting focuses on cultivated crops, these terms emphasize roaming, scrounging, or gathering scattered natural bounty.
groups.summary_zh: 指在野外或田间寻觅、采摘与收集天然食物或残存作物的动作。

groups.name: Forage & Scavenge · 觅食与搜寻 (Forage, Rummage, Comb)
groups.tip: 在野外搜寻食物或腐肉残渣

items.def_en: (+ in/for) To dig into or search through a container or pile of objects by turning things over
(+ for) To search widely across an area for food or provisions
To find or discover something hidden or lost through persistent searching and digging
(+ for) To search an area or set of items extremely thoroughly in order to find something

items.def_zh: （在垃圾中）搜寻（有用物或食物）；以（腐肉等）为食；打扫
items.def_en: 1. To search through discarded waste, garbage, or carcasses for food or usable items. 2. (of an animal) To feed on carrion or decaying organic matter. 3. To clean or clear away.
(+ through) To search for something by moving things around in an untidy and hurried way

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on hunting, rummaging, or sifting through an environment or discarded materials to find food, resources, or salvageable items. It ranges from natural animal feeding behaviors to human sorting through refuse.
groups.summary_zh: 在环境或废弃物中到处搜检、探寻食物或有用物资。

groups.name: Forage & Wild Gathering · 野外采摘与捕捞 (Forage, Shrimp, Blackberry)
groups.tip: 野外搜寻鱼类或果实

items.def_en: to gather wild berries
to gather wild mushrooms in the countryside
To fish for or catch shrimp.
To go out picking or gathering wild blackberries.
to dig for or gather clams in tidal sands or mudflats

items.def_zh: 搜寻野味；采集野食（菌菇、野草等）
items.def_en: (+ for) to search widely in the wild for wild food supplies or provisions

groups.summary_en: This scenario denotes going into nature specifically to seek, gather, or catch particular wild edibles, berries, or small aquatic fauna through recreational or artisanal forays.
groups.summary_zh: 指前往野外采摘特定野果或徒手捕捞小型水产的野趣劳动。

groups.name: Force & Coerce · 强迫与胁迫 (Coerce, Compel, Intimidate, Press-gang)
groups.tip: 运用威胁逼迫对方服从命令

items.def_en: Frighten someone purposefully into doing or avoiding a particular course of action
Force someone to do something through overriding authority or inescapable circumstance
Force someone to act by threatening to reveal damaging or compromising secrets
Use physical force, bullying, or aggressive pressure to compel compliance
to force someone to do something by using threats or other unpleasant methods
Bully or intimidate someone with harsh words and arrogant manners into submission

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe overriding another party's will through intimidation, severe duress, threats, or institutional force to compel action.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助暴力、威胁、恐吓或严厉压力迫使对方屈从行事。

groups.name: Formal Assent & Approval · 同意与赞许 (Accede, Acquiesce, Sanction)
groups.tip: 从被动准许到主动赞同认可

items.def_en: (+ in/to) Accept something reluctantly but without protest; give passive assent
Give official or final approval to a document, plan, or decision
(+ to) To give permission or agree to do something, especially after consideration.
Declare public or official approval and support for an idea, policy, or candidate
(+ to) Agree to a demand, request, or proposal, especially after initial reluctance
Give official permission, authorization, or formal approval for an action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote granting permission, officially ratifying a proposal, or yielding agreement along an intensity gradient from passive concurrence to formal authoritative authorization.
groups.summary_zh: 从勉强默认到官方权威授权，表示给予许可、赞同或批准。

groups.name: Fortify & Reinforce · 防护与加固 (Sandbag, Shore Up, Buttress)
groups.tip: 堆垒掩体加固以抵御外力

items.def_en: To support a wall, building, or declining structure by placing wooden or metal props against or under it
To make a structure, material, or barrier stronger by adding extra materials or supports
To strengthen, prop, or secure a structure with rigid stays, beams, or supports against heavy strain
To reinforce or support a wall or building with a projecting structure of masonry or wood

items.def_zh: 用沙袋堆砌（防洪或加固）；用沙袋打击；故意隐瞒实力以欺骗
items.def_en: 1. To protect or fortify an area against flood water or attack with sandbags. 2. To hit someone with a sandbag. 3. (informal) To deliberately conceal one's true ability or strength to gain an advantage.
To support or strengthen a wall or building from below with masonry, concrete, or extra foundations

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physically reinforcing, barricading, or propping up structures and perimeters against collapse, natural disasters, or assault. They range from hasty emergency barricading to heavy structural engineering.
groups.summary_zh: 通过沙袋、支柱等物理手段应急加固或防护防线，抵御坍塌与外力冲击。

groups.name: Freeze & Solidify · 冰冻与冻结 (Freeze, Deep-freeze, Ices up)
groups.tip: 遇冷由液态转为冰晶冻块

items.def_zh: （使）结冰，（使）凝结；冷冻；（使）僵住；冻结（资产等）
items.def_en: 1. to turn into ice or become hard because of cold, or preserve food at very low temperatures. 2. to suddenly stop moving. 3. to officially stop or restrict movement or access to funds.
to become covered with a layer of ice
to preserve food by freezing it extremely rapidly at very low temperatures
