(+ sth) to become completely covered with an uninterrupted sheet of ice

items.def_zh: 冻结，因受冻而堵塞/卡死
items.def_en: (+ sth) to become completely obstructed, hardened, or inoperable due to sub-zero temperatures and ice formation
to become coated or covered with a layer of ice as water freezes on the surface

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the phase transition of liquids or moisture-laden materials turning into solid ice under sub-zero temperatures. 'Froze' is the irregular past tense of freeze, while additions expand the core lexical set of thermal ice-formation.
groups.summary_zh: 特指液体或含水物体因低温而降至冰点并转变成固态冰的过程。

groups.name: Frolic & Gambol · 嬉戏与雀跃 (Gambol, Romp, Prance, Rollick)
groups.tip: 欢天喜地地蹦跳撒欢玩耍

items.def_en: To run or jump about playfully, happily, and lightly, like a young animal
To move around with high, bouncy, exuberant steps, showing off joy or pride
To engage in boisterous, noisy, and rough physical play
To act, move, or frolic in a jovial, spirited, and carefree manner
(+ around/in) To play, jump, and run around in a lively, cheerful, carefree way.
(+ about/around) To play or run in a boisterous, energetic, and loud manner

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts lively, lighthearted physical play characterized by leaping, skipping, and exuberant physical abandon. It typically evokes young animals or carefree children moving joyously outdoors.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘人或动物欢快轻盈地蹦跳、嬉闹、打滚等充满活力的嬉戏动作。

groups.name: Frolic & Indulge · 放纵与享乐 (Frolic, Revel, Carouse)
groups.tip: 放任自流或无拘无束玩乐

items.def_en: Enjoy oneself without restraint in a lively, playful way, often in an idyllic setting
Play and run about happily, lightly, and energetically
Abandon usual inhibitions and behave in an unrestrained, wild manner
(+ in) Take immense delight in something, often celebrating in a lively and noisy way
(archaic or literary) To behave in a reckless, unrestrained, or playful way.
Drink plentiful amounts of alcohol and enjoy oneself in a noisy, lively way

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote unrestrained celebration, boisterous merrymaking, or giving free rein to sensory indulgences and physical delight without social inhibition.
groups.summary_zh: 指纵情嬉戏、寻欢作乐或毫无拘束地沉溺快活。

groups.name: Fuel & Stoke · 刺激与助长火势 (Fuel, Stoke, Fan)
groups.tip: 点燃苗头火上浇油促其剧增

items.def_en: To blow air onto a flame, or make a disagreement, jealousy, or unrest more heated
To supply material to keep a fire burning or nourish suspicion, fear, or resentment

items.def_zh: 加剧，激起，助长；给……提供燃料
items.def_en: 1. To make an argument, feeling, or situation worse, more intense, or more active. 2. To supply something with fuel.
To deliberately excite, provoke, or incite intense emotions or frenzy in a crowd
To add fuel to a fire, or incite and encourage strong emotional fires and rumors
To cause feelings of anger, passion, or excitement to become far more violent

groups.summary_en: Focuses on stoking, supplying combustible energy to, or exacerbating a preexisting fire, negative emotion, controversy, or volatile crisis to make it escalate intensely.
groups.summary_zh: 指为火焰、冲突或不良情绪注入动能，使事态进一步恶化或激化。

groups.name: Function & Operate · 运行与起效 (Function, Run, Tick)
groups.tip: 机制正常运转发挥作用

items.def_en: to operate properly and perform its intended task without failure
to operate continuously, as an engine, machine, or software program
(+ as) to perform a specific function, duty, or purpose adequately
To work or operate in a proper, expected, or natural way.
to begin to take effect or start functioning automatically
to function smoothly and steadily, like a clock or biological mechanism

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express that an apparatus, system, or physiological mechanism is working normally, performing its role, or generating its intended operational effect.
groups.summary_zh: 指机器、系统或人体机能正常运转并产生预期的功效。

groups.name: Fund & Finance · 资助与出资 (Fund, Finance, Back)
groups.tip: 投入本金期待回报

items.def_en: To support someone or a project with money, power, or authority
To provide money for a project, activity, or event
To provide the money needed to pay for something substantial or commercial

items.def_zh: 投资，投入（资金以求利）；投入（时间、精力等）；授予（权力等）
items.def_en: 1. To put money into bank accounts, shares, businesses, or property in order to obtain a profit. 2. (+ in) To spend time, effort, or energy on something to achieve an advantage. 3. (formal) To give power, rights, or authority to someone.

items.def_zh: 出资赞助，提供赌注/本钱
items.def_en: To provide someone with money or capital for an enterprise, business, or venture
(informal) To support a person, project, or organization by paying all or most of their expenses

groups.summary_en: Covers providing monetary capital or resources to support projects, ventures, or institutions in return for future returns, ownership, or public benefit.
groups.summary_zh: 指为项目、企业或活动投入资金以支持其运作或获取回报。

groups.name: Fundraise & Solicit · 募捐与筹款 (Fundraise, Solicit, Rally)
groups.tip: 为特定目的公开筹集资金

items.def_en: To quickly stimulate and collect financial backing, donations, or enthusiasm
To fund a project or venture by raising small amounts of money from a large number of people online

items.def_zh: 大力招揽；筹集（资金或赞助）
items.def_en: To try persistently to obtain funds, business, or backing through promotional efforts
To circulate a collection container to gather voluntary monetary contributions from a group
(+ for) To collect or raise money for a charity, organization, or political campaign.
(formal) To ask for money, donations, help, or votes from people or organizations

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to appealing for and gathering monetary contributions, philanthropic aid, or investment funds from donors, institutions, or the general public.
groups.summary_zh: 面向公众或机构发起号召，以募集善款、赞助或启动资金。

groups.name: Furnish & Surface-Trim · 蒙面装潢与金银丝点缀
groups.tip: 软装陈设装潢居所

items.def_zh: 重做（家具的）包布与软垫
items.def_en: to replace the padding, springs, and fabric cover of an upholstered seat
to adorn fabric or garments with small shiny metallic or plastic discs
to cover a surface thinly with gold leaf or gold-coloured pigment

items.def_zh: 为（沙发、椅子等）装上垫子和面料，装璜
items.def_en: To cover a chair or sofa with padding, springs, and fabric or leather.

items.def_zh: 用金属箔（或金属丝）装饰；使显得俗丽，虚饰
items.def_en: To decorate something with tinsel; to give something a cheap, glittering, or showy appearance.

items.def_zh: 结彩装饰；以花彩垂挂装饰
items.def_en: (+ with) to drape or adorn a place with hanging strings of flowers, ribbons, or lights

groups.summary_en: Applies surface decorative crafts, specifically upholstering seating furniture with padding and textile, or draping and trimming surfaces with glittery metallic strips.
groups.summary_zh: 为家具包衬软垫布料，或用金属金银丝等细料精心装缀表面。

groups.name: Garment Alteration & Seaming · 裁缝修边与改衣 (Hem, Take in, Alter)
groups.tip: 穿针引线缝边锁扣修补

items.def_en: To make changes to clothing so that it fits better
To make a garment narrower or tighter by resewing the seams
To make a garment looser or wider by releasing seam allowances
To fit or modify a garment precisely to an individual's specific body measurements
To make a garment or piece of fabric shorter by cutting or hemming
1. To fold over and sew down the edge of a piece of cloth or a garment. 2. (hem in) To surround or restrict someone or something closely.

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame covers specific tailoring actions performed on fabric and garments to adjust fit, shorten lengths, or finish raw borders.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦缝纫中卷边、改小、缩短等服装边沿剪裁与改样操作。

groups.name: Gather & Assemble · 聚集与搜集 (Assemble, Muster, Amass)
groups.tip: 将分散物品归拢一处

items.def_en: To bring things or people together from different places over a period of time

items.def_zh: 聚集，集合；收集，采集；逐渐获得；推断
items.def_en: 1. To come together, or bring people or things together in one place. 2. To collect several things, often from different places. 3. To conclude or understand from evidence or information.
To find and bring together scattered people, animals, or items into one location
To come together in a single place, or bring people or parts together into a cohesive group
To assemble troops or summon up internal strength, courage, or support for a specific effort
To gradually accumulate a large amount of money, information, or wealth

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bringing people, objects, or resources together into one group or repository, whether casually assembling or methodically amassing valuable assets.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人、物或资源召集、聚集或逐步搜集至一处。

groups.name: Gather & Condense · 凝聚与结聚 (Condense, Coalesce, Aggregate)
groups.tip: 微粒聚集成核与凝结

items.def_en: To collect into a single mass, sum, or cluster
To change or cause something to change from a gas or vapor into a liquid droplets on a surface
To come together to form one larger mass, system, or community
To form into crystals or take a definite, structured physical or conceptual shape
(specialist) To form a central nucleus, or cause material to gather, condense, or crystallize around a core.

items.def_zh: 凝结；凝固（成冻状或固体）
items.def_en: To become thick or solid, especially upon cooling, as blood or molten fat

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the process by which dispersed particles, vapors, or disparate elements draw together around a core or unite into a solid, cohesive mass. They often collocate with physical states like moisture, crystals, droplets, or abstract ideas converging into a whole.
groups.summary_zh: 描述分散颗粒、水汽或要素汇聚凝聚成核或团块的过程。

groups.name: Gather & Swarm · 聚集与簇拥 (Crowd, Swarm, Flock)
groups.tip: 群体如蜂群般汇聚

items.def_en: To wander around a specific area in a confused or disorderly mass
To gather together in large numbers or press closely together in a confined space
To gather or move together in large numbers, especially toward an attraction or event
To crowd around someone aggressively or excitedly in large numbers
To move or gather in a large, busy, and densely packed group like insects
To gather or move in a large, densely packed crowd; to fill a place completely.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe large numbers of people or animals moving together or congregating densely in a space, often overwhelming the surrounding area.
groups.summary_zh: 强调人群或动物密集聚集、涌入或蜂拥包围某处。

groups.name: Gaze & Peer · 凝视与端详 (Peer, Squint, Scrutinize)
groups.tip: 眯眼端详乃至久久凝望

items.def_en: To glance quickly or furtively, often through a narrow opening

items.def_zh: 端详，凝视；费力地看，细看
items.def_en: To look closely, carefully, or with difficulty at something, especially when trying to see clearly.
To look steadily and intently at something, especially in wonder, love, or deep thought
To look at something with eyes partly closed, typically in bright light or when trying to see clearly
To look at and study a text, map, or object with great care and concentration
To examine or inspect someone or something very closely and thoroughly

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on looking intently, narrowly, or with physical effort to discern detail despite poor vision or obstruction. Unlike open admiration, these verbs emphasize focus, visual strain, and close inspection.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因视线受阻、距离远或审视细节而费力细看、凝望。

groups.name: Gel & Coagulate · 凝结与定型 (Gel, Congeal, Coagulate)
groups.tip: 由液态凝结成固体或胶状

items.def_zh: 形成协调整体；达成一致
items.def_en: To start to work well as an organized, harmonious group or clear plan
To change from a liquid or soft state into a firm, solid form

items.def_zh: 凝结，胶化；（想法、计划等）成形；（团队）融洽合作
items.def_en: 1. (of a liquid) To thicken and become a jelly-like substance. 2. (of ideas, plans, or people) To take definite shape or work together smoothly and effectively.

items.def_zh: 胶化；（想法或关系）成型定局
items.def_en: To take definite form or begin to work well and cohesively together
To become thick, soft, or solid, especially when cooling from a liquid state
To change from a liquid to a thick, semi-solid state, especially of blood or milk

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote liquid, semi-fluid mixtures or abstract concepts (plans, teams, thoughts) thickening into a unified, cohesive, gelatinous mass or structured whole. Physical contexts contrast with figurative usage where unformed ideas crystallize and click together.
groups.summary_zh: 指流体凝成胶状，或抽象的想法、团队形成协同与默契。

groups.name: Gentrify & Regenerate · 旧区改造与升级 (Regenerate, Revamp, Redevelop)
groups.tip: 老城区中产阶级化更新改造

items.def_en: To raise something to a higher standard, newer specification, or better quality
To make a place or oneself look cleaner, tidier, and more fashionable
To overhaul, modernize, or restructure something completely to make it more appealing
To bring new life, economic vitality, and improvements to a declining urban area
To build new housing or commercial developments on land where old buildings stood

items.def_zh: 使（旧城区等）中产阶级化，改造升级
items.def_en: 1. To renovate and improve a poor urban area so that it conforms to middle-class taste, often displacing poorer residents.

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to municipal and social urban renewal, where neglected neighborhoods, properties, or infrastructure are modernized, remodeled, or upgraded, frequently altering their socioeconomic character.
groups.summary_zh: 指对衰败街区或物业进行翻新改造、重建升级及士绅化。

groups.name: Gesture & Signal · 体态与示意 (Beckon, Wave, Shrug)
groups.tip: 点头或肢体动作示意

items.def_en: To move your raised hand back and forth as a greeting, farewell, or directional signal

items.def_zh: 打手势示意（某人做某事）
items.def_en: To direct someone to move or perform an action by making a silent gesture
To move your hands, arms, or head to express an intention or accentuate meaning

items.def_zh: 点头示意，点头答应；打盹，打瞌睡
items.def_en: 1. To move your head down and up, especially to show agreement, greeting, or acknowledgement. 2. To let your head fall forward when sleepy; to fall asleep briefly.

items.def_zh: 耸肩（表示不解或漠不关心）
items.def_en: To raise and drop your shoulders to show indifference, doubt, or lack of knowledge
To signal someone with your hand or head urging them to approach or follow

groups.summary_en: Relates to physical body language, especially head, hand, or shoulder movements deployed deliberately to communicate consent, direction, dismissal, or attitude without speech.
groups.summary_zh: 通过点头、挥手、耸肩等肢体动作传递示意、认可或情感反应。

groups.name: Glide & Breeze · 悠然快步与滑行 (Coast, Sweep, Sail)
groups.tip: 轻盈顺畅毫无阻力地前行

items.def_zh: 顺势滑行；毫不费劲地前进
items.def_en: To move effortlessly, propelled only by inertia or gravity rather than exertion

items.def_zh: 昂然飘然而过；从容前行
items.def_en: To move quickly, smoothly, and confidently in a particular direction

items.def_zh: 轻快自信地走；轻易通过
items.def_en: 1. To walk or move in a casual, confident, and effortless manner. 2. (breeze through) To pass or succeed in something easily.
To move smoothly and quietly without noticeable effort or resistance

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆漫步；轻快昂首踱入
items.def_en: To walk somewhere casually, cheerfully, or presumptuously without obstacle
To move smoothly and with dignity or impressive momentum into a space

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict movement executed with apparent ease, lightness, confidence, and unhurried fluidity, often without detectable friction or strenuous effort.
groups.summary_zh: 指步伐轻快、毫不费力且自信舒展地滑行、漫步或顺遂前行。

groups.name: Glimmer & Shimmer · 微光闪烁与晃动 (Shimmer, Twinkle, Flicker)
groups.tip: 光源稳定或微弱地放光

items.def_zh: 明灭不定，忽隐忽现地闪烁
items.def_en: To burn or shine unsteadily with rapid variations in brightness, like a candle flame.
To shine with a gentle, smooth, but distinct light, especially through darkness.
To shine with rapid, dancing flashes of bright light, like distant stars.

items.def_zh: 闪烁微光，泛起粼粼波光
items.def_en: To shine with a soft, tremulous, or wavering light, like heat haze or water.

items.raw_cluster: 发光与照射 Shine & Emit Light
items.def_en: To shine with a faint, wavering, or unsteady light.
To produce a tiny, momentary flash of reflected light off a polished surface.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this perceptual frame signify faint, wavering, soft, or intermittently trembling illumination rather than a blinding continuous glare.
groups.summary_zh: 微弱、摇曳或断续闪烁的柔和光亮，常见于星辰、微火或水面反光。

groups.name: Glorify & Exalt · 崇奉与极度赞美 (Glorify, Exalt, Extol, Lionize)
groups.tip: 从口头表扬到高度推崇赞颂

items.def_en: To speak of someone or something with boundless enthusiasm and approval
1. To praise and worship God or someone highly. 2. To make something seem much better, more exciting, or more noble than it really is.
To treat someone as a celebrated hero or notable public figure with intense adulation

items.def_zh: 赞扬；赞美（多用于书面或正式表彰）
items.def_en: To express strong formal praise and approval of an achievement or quality
To praise someone or something very enthusiastically in speech or writing
To praise or honor someone highly, or raise them to a much higher status or rank

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey enthusiastic, reverent, or hyperbolic praise that elevates someone or something to heroic, divine, or celebrated status, sometimes crossing into romanticized myth-making.
groups.summary_zh: 将人、事或神性推崇到极高地位、极力颂扬甚至理想化的赞颂行为。

groups.name: Gossip & Circulate Hearsay · 传闻与谣传 (Rumor, Whisper, Murmur)
groups.tip: 未经证实的风声四处流传

items.def_en: (+ sth) distribute or circulate gossip, news, or unverified stories among many people
(chiefly passive, 'be rumored') To circulate unverified news, gossip, or reports about someone or something.

items.def_zh: 私下流传，窃窃私语般传闻
items.def_en: (often passive: be whispered) pass unverified rumors privately or quietly
(+ about) talk casually or maliciously about other people's private lives
(+ sth) freely dispense or spread gossip or disparaging rumors to others
(+ about/abroad) spread a report or rumor widely among people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize spreading unverified gossip, speculative tales, or backchannel allegations without official substantiation.
groups.summary_zh: 私下耳语、传闻议论未经核实的流言蜚语或道听途说。

groups.name: Gradual Wearing Away · 磨损与水土风蚀 (Erode, Weather, Abrade)
groups.tip: 风化水冲或摩擦损耗

items.def_en: to wear away or make raw by repeated rubbing or surface contact
to carry away or undermine earth or material by the surging action of water
to reduce in height, thickness, or substance through persistent rubbing or friction
to undergo or cause to undergo changes in appearance or structure due to natural atmospheric exposure
1. to gradually wear away or be worn away by wind, water, or other natural forces 2. to slowly reduce, weaken, or destroy something over time
to scrape or wear away the surface of something through friction or harsh contact

groups.summary_en: Denotes the slow, progressive mechanical or natural removal of surface matter (such as soil, rock, or fabric) via constant friction, weather exposure, or flow.
groups.summary_zh: 指受风雨冲刷、水流或摩擦长期作用，表面被缓慢剥蚀、磨平或刮损。

groups.name: Graduate & Degree · 毕业与授位 (Graduate, Matriculate, Qualify)
groups.tip: 完成学业并获颁正规学术学位

items.def_zh: 毕业；授予…学位，准予…毕业；分等级，标刻度
items.def_en: 1. To successfully complete an academic degree, course of study, or high school education. 2. To grant a degree or diploma to someone; to mark divisions or scale intervals on a measuring device.
To successfully pass necessary examinations or complete required courses to practice a profession

items.def_zh: 军校结业；结业受训完成
items.def_en: (UK) To complete a military or police training course and graduate into service

items.def_zh: 获得学位；参加毕业典礼
items.def_en: (formal, US) To receive an academic degree at a formal graduation ceremony
(+ on/upon) To officially grant or present a university degree, title, or academic honor

items.def_zh: 被大学录取入学；注册入学
items.def_en: To formally enroll or be admitted into a college, university, or academic study program

groups.summary_en: This frame covers milestones and formal institutional completions within the educational lifecycle, from finishing study requirements and receiving a credential to conferring degrees upon students.
groups.summary_zh: 指完成学业要求、取得学历证书或学术机构授予学位资格。

groups.name: Grapple & Wrestle · 缠斗与抱摔 (Wrestle, Scuffle, Tussle)
groups.tip: 近身肉搏徒手扭抓与角力

items.def_en: To fight briefly and chaotically in a disordered, confused crowd or pair
(+ with) To struggle or fight roughly, especially over the possession of something
To engage in direct, stubborn confrontation or conflict with an opponent
To fight someone by holding, locking, and trying to throw or force them to the ground
(+ with) To become involved in a physical or argumentative conflict with someone

items.def_zh: 扭打，搏斗；努力对付，竭力解决
items.def_en: 1. To wrestle or struggle closely with someone. 2. ('grapple with') To try hard to deal with or overcome a difficult problem or challenge.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on close-quarters physical combat and hand-to-hand engagement, characterized by seizing, holding, locking limbs, and struggling vigorously to overpower an opponent.
groups.summary_zh: 指近身肉搏、相互揪扯锁抱或费力搏斗以制服对手的对抗方式。

groups.name: Grasp & Internalize · 领悟与心领神会 (Fathom, Internalize, Grok)
groups.tip: 心领神会掌握精髓

items.def_en: (+ to) To suddenly comprehend or realize the truth of a situation
(slang or dated) To understand or grasp something clearly.
To succeed in comprehending a bizarre, counterintuitive, or complex concept
To penetrate to the underlying meaning or reason of something obscure or deep
To incorporate values, ideas, or knowledge so deeply that they become intuitive parts of oneself

items.def_zh: 心领神会，彻底通透理解
items.def_en: To understand intuitively, deeply, and completely through emotional or intellectual empathy

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the deep, informal, or profound cognitive leap whereby complex external concepts are fully comprehended and absorbed into one's intuitive understanding.
groups.summary_zh: 指对深奥事理彻底领会、透彻理解并转化为内心认知。

groups.name: Graze & Nibble · 漫食与零食 (Graze, Nibble, Peck)
groups.tip: 食草动物漫游啃食牧草

items.def_en: (+ on) to eat small amounts of food casually between regular meals

items.def_zh: 扒拉着吃；毫无胃口地吃
items.def_en: to eat only tiny morsels of food without enthusiasm or appetite
to eat tiny portions of a meal slowly, showing little interest
to feed on leaves and twigs, or sample small bites of food at leisure

1. When cattle, sheep, or other animals graze, they eat grass growing in a field, or to put livestock out to feed. 2. To scrape and break the surface of the skin slightly by rubbing against something rough.
to eat food by taking very small, gentle bites repeatedly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to eating casual, leisurely, or diminutive morsels throughout the day rather than sitting down for a complete, structured meal.
groups.summary_zh: 指零碎食用、漫不经心地小口进食或以吃零食代餐。

groups.name: Ground & Earth · 接地与深埋 (Ground, Embed, Anchor)
groups.tip: 引入地线或埋覆于泥土中

items.def_en: To connect an electrical device or wire to the physical earth to prevent electric shock or damage

items.def_zh: 把（电线）接地；用土把（植物）覆上
items.def_en: To connect an electrical circuit or device to the ground for safety; to cover the stems or roots of a plant with earth.
To establish something firmly in earth, soil, or deep foundations
To drive, dig, or bury a post, foundation, or shaft deeply into the earth or sea floor
To fasten something firmly to the ground or a rigid base so that it cannot move
To fix something firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass of soil, rock, or concrete

groups.summary_en: Concerns completing an electrical circuit to the physical earth for surge safety, or securing something firmly into the soil or structural foundation. 'Earth' (chiefly BrE) and 'ground' (chiefly AmE) are electrical synonyms, while 'embed' stresses deep physical insertion.
groups.summary_zh: 指电气接通大地以保安全，或将构件牢固埋入地下。

groups.name: Habituate & Familiarize · 习惯与使适应 (Condition, Acclimate, Inure)
groups.tip: 调整认知以融入新境

items.def_en: To progressively become accustomed to a situation, noise, or condition until it feels normal
To train or train someone's mind or body to react in a particular habitual way
('accustom oneself/someone to') To make oneself or someone familiar with a new situation, habit, or environment.
To make someone or oneself familiar with a condition or behavior through repeated exposure
To get used to a new climate, altitude, culture, or operational environment
(+ to) To make someone toughened to or less affected by hardship, pain, or unpleasantness through prolonged experience

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the psychological or physiological process of becoming used to conditions, stresses, or routines over time. Some verbs highlight voluntary acclimation, while others emphasize hardening against hardship.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过反复接触或训练，逐渐适应乃至对艰辛习以为常。

groups.name: Hairstyling & Personal Grooming · 梳妆修发与弄姿 (Coif, Pompadour, Groom)
groups.tip: 打理毛发仪容修饰外表

items.def_en: To arrange, cut, or shape hair into an attractive design
To apply scented wax or ointment to hair to sleek, hold, or shine it
To backcomb hair toward the roots to give it greater volume
To brush, clean, and make someone's hair or general appearance neat

items.def_zh: 打理（头发），做发型；给……戴头巾
items.def_en: To style, arrange, or dress someone's hair.
To spend time arranging one's hair, makeup, or clothes with painstaking care

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing meticulous personal care directed toward styling, trimming, and arranging hair or appearance to achieve a polished, elegant look.
groups.summary_zh: 集中于做发型、梳理发丝以及修整仪表的精细打理行为。

groups.name: Hang & Dangle · 悬挂与垂荡 (Swing, Suspend, Droop)
groups.tip: 悬空吊着随风摇曳晃动

items.def_en: To extend downward freely from an elevated point
To hang something up from a high support so that it is free on all sides
To move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side

items.def_zh: 悬垂，摇晃地悬挂；使悬垂；用…引诱
items.def_en: 1. To hang or swing loosely, or hold something so that it does. 2. To offer something attractive to tempt someone.
To bend or hang downwards limp from lack of strength, moisture, or support
To move back and forth or sideways while suspended or pivoted from a fixed point

groups.summary_en: This frame captures objects or appendages hanging unsupported from above and swinging loosely or swaying with motion. Figuratively, it extends to holding out enticing prospects to entice someone.
groups.summary_zh: 自上方悬空垂下，并可自由晃荡或摇摆。

groups.name: Harass & Molest · 骚扰与侵害 (Harass, Pester, Assault)
groups.tip: 侵扰挑衅甚至造成人身侵害

items.def_en: to repeatedly urge, ask, or bother someone until they give in
to annoy someone repeatedly with frequent requests, questions, or interruptions
to torment or intimidate someone with persistent annoyance, threats, or unwelcome attention
to pursue, harass, or urge someone relentlessly without giving them peace
1. To touch or abuse someone, especially a child, sexually. 2. (formal or dated) To annoy, assault, or interfere with someone in a harmful way.
to attack someone violently in a physical or sexual manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe subjecting someone to persistent annoyance, intrusive hostility, intimidation, or physical violation. Nuances range from unrelenting verbal irritation to criminal sexual assault.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖从持续言语纠缠、恶意恐吓到严重肢体侵犯与性骚扰的递进侵害。

groups.name: Harden & Solidify · 固化与坚硬 (Harden, Solidify, Petrify)
groups.tip: 质地变硬强化坚固度

items.def_zh: （使）变硬，（使）硬化；（使态度或人）变坚决，变冷酷
items.def_en: 1. To become firm, solid, or stiff, or to make something solid. 2. To become or make someone more tough, determined, or unsympathetic.

items.def_zh: 变硬；使生硬；增强坚定性
items.def_en: To become firm, rigid, or less flexible, or to strengthen resolve
To separate into curds and whey, or to coagulate into solid clumps
To become hard or firm, or to make an agreement or relationship more definite and robust
To become hard and stony through deposits of calcium, or to become inflexible and resistant to change
To change organic matter slowly into stone, or figuratively to make attitudes rigid and unchangeable

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on scalar transitions from soft, pliable, or fluid states to rigid, tough, and impenetrable conditions. It applies equally to physical materials curing into stone/metal and human attitudes becoming unyielding, callous, or unbending.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体由软变硬、凝固，或人的态度意志变得坚决冷酷。

groups.name: Hasten & Accelerate · 加速与疾行 (Hasten, Speed Up, Quicken)
groups.tip: 速度逐渐加快或促进行程

items.def_en: To move or act with speed, or cause someone to do so quickly
To move faster or make something happen at a faster rate
To move swiftly or do something too rapidly without deliberation
1. To make something happen sooner or more quickly. 2. To move or act swiftly.
To become quicker or make pace, pulse, or actions move faster
To start to move faster, or cause a process to occur more rapidly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe accelerating the pace of physical travel or causing events and transitions to occur far earlier than scheduled.
groups.summary_zh: 指加快自身的移动行进速度，或人为使某事件提前、快速推进发生。

groups.name: Haul & Drag · 拖拉与牵引 (Haul, Tow, Lug)
groups.tip: 用力牵拉拖拽物体向前移动

items.def_en: To drag or allow something to drag loosely along the ground behind someone or something
To take something or someone away awkwardly or forcefully, as if on a cart
To pull something heavy or reluctant along the ground with effort and friction
To pull a vehicle, boat, or equipment along behind another vehicle using a rope, chain, or towbar
To carry or drag something heavy and awkward with clumsy, tiresome effort
1. To pull or drag something heavy with continuous effort. 2. To transport goods or materials by truck, cart, or ship.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe pulling heavy, cumbersome objects across a surface or transporting large loads with sustained physical effort or mechanical power. Nuances differentiate surface friction, mechanical towing, and awkward burdens.
groups.summary_zh: 指克服地面摩擦或巨大阻力，费力拖曳重物或机械牵引大批物资。

groups.name: Heavy Drinking & Imbibing · 痛饮与酗酒 (Booze, Binge, Guzzle)
groups.tip: 从慢饮微醺到暴饮滥醉

items.def_en: To drink intoxicating liquor habitually or in small, repeated quantities
To drink an alcoholic drink down quickly in large gulps
To drink an alcoholic beverage heartily and with great enjoyment
(informal) To drink alcohol, especially in large quantities.
(+ on) To indulge in an unrestrained, excessive period of alcohol consumption
To drink liquor greedily, noisily, or in very large amounts

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe heavy, intemperate, or enthusiastic consumption of alcohol, often in social revelry or compulsive bouts.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重大肆饮酒、海量灌酒或沉溺杯中之物的豪饮与酗酒行为。

groups.name: Hesitate & Vacillate · 犹豫与摇摆 (Waver, Dither, Hesitate)
groups.tip: 举棋不定并在多方选择间摇摆

items.def_en: To pause before saying or doing something through reluctance, uncertainty, or doubt
To shift back and forth irregularly in stance, opinion, or sentiment
To spend time being chronically indecisive and failing to commit to an action
(+ between) To show indecisiveness, flicker in determination, or hesitate between two options
(+ over/about) To be anxiously indecisive and unable to settle on a course of action
1. (+ between) (formal) To waver or alternate between different opinions, actions, or choices without making up one's mind.

groups.summary_en: Details the cognitive and behavioral instability of someone constantly shifting between choices, lacking firm resolve, or delaying decisions.
groups.summary_zh: 描写心理游移不决、反复摇摆不定或迟疑拖延的态度。

groups.name: Hijack & Commandeer · 劫持与强征 (Commandeer, Usurp, Expropriate)
groups.tip: 强行扣押载具或征调物资

items.def_en: To gain control of a company, vehicle, agenda, or responsibility
To divert, absorb, or assimilate an idea or role for one's own purpose

items.def_zh: 劫持（飞机等交通工具）；强行控制，篡夺
items.def_en: 1. To seize control of an aircraft, ship, or vehicle illegally by force. 2. To take control of something, such as a meeting or discussion, and use it for one's own purpose.
To take someone's power, position, or authority without having the legal right
To officially or high-handedly take possession of private property for temporary use
(+ to oneself) To claim or take something, such as a right, without justification

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize taking illicit or high-handed control over vehicles, organizations, public discussions, or processes for one's own agenda.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强硬手腕或非法途径擅自夺取载具、平台议题或权力的支配控制。

groups.name: Hijack & Seize Control · 劫持与强夺 (Skyjack, Seize, Pirate)
groups.tip: 武力强占交通工具并扣留人质

items.def_en: To gain control of an enemy vehicle, position, or person by force
To seize a ship or cargo at sea by violence; to appropriate without authorization
To take possession of someone or something quickly, forcibly, or by legal power

items.def_zh: 劫持（飞机、车辆等）；强行夺取
items.def_en: (variant spelling of hijack) To illegally seize control of an aircraft, vehicle, or cargo by force.
To hijack an aircraft while in flight using force or intimidation
To seize a vehicle from its driver by using violence or coercion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express forcibly and illegally seizing transit vehicles, transit goods, or operational control by threat of armed violence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过武力威胁，非法抢夺交通载具、货物或控制权的强盗与劫持行为。

groups.name: Hit & Kick · 击打与踢触 (Punt, Boot, Loft)
groups.tip: 用力踢打碰撞物体

items.def_zh: 凌空踢（球）；撑（平底船）；赌博，碰运气
items.def_en: 1. (sports) To kick a ball after dropping it from one's hands before it hits the ground. 2. To propel a flat-bottomed boat with a pole. 3. (informal) To gamble or bet on something.
To strike or kick a ball upward so that it travels high into the air
To strike a ball abruptly using the end of the toes
To kick or strike a ball before it bounces on the ground
To kick an athletic ball forcefully and far downfield
(informal) To kick a football long and hard without precision

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate striking an airborne or descending athletic ball with foot, boot, or paddle to propel it high, deep, or evasively downfield, balancing kinetic force with trajectory control.
groups.summary_zh: 用脚掌、足尖或器具凌空起脚踢击或推挑球体。

groups.name: Hit & Tap · 轻触与推杆 (Putt, Tap in, Nudge)
groups.tip: 控制力度进行击打或触碰

items.def_en: To knock a ball easily into the hole or net from very close range
To hit a ball lightly and softly just over an obstacle or into a nearby target zone
To push a ball or object very gently so it rolls slowly forward
(in golf) To hit a golf ball gently across the green with a putter toward or into the hole.
To hit a sports ball with a smooth, deliberate, and controlled swing or motion
To propel an object forward with a quick, light movement of the wrist or club

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses controlled, short-distance, precision strokes intended to steer or roll a sports ball or token gently into a pocket, cup, or specific target mark, prioritizing finesse over brute power.
groups.summary_zh: 使用推杆或柔和力道对球施加短程精准轻推或轻拨。

groups.name: Hitch & Tether · 系扣与拴接 (Hitch, Tether, Lash, Mooring)
groups.tip: 用绳索等束缚或系住

items.def_en: To join or link two vehicles, mechanisms, or parts together using a hitch or coupling device

items.def_zh: 拴住，套住，拴紧；猛拉，提起；搭便车
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/up) To fasten or tie something to another object with a rope, knot, or hook. 2. To pull up clothing with a quick movement. 3. To hitchhike.
To secure or immobilize an object tightly to a surface or structure using ropes or cords
To fasten a boat, ship, or aircraft to the shore, dock, or sea floor with ropes or anchors
To tie an animal or object with a rope or chain to limit its range of movement
To bind or fasten securely to something else with multiple wraps of rope or cord

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on securing an animal, vehicle, or cargo to a post, hook, or transport frame using a quick knot, rope, or coupling. These actions highlight temporary, functional linkage or fastening rather than permanent fusion.
groups.summary_zh: 用钩子、绳索或扣眼将人畜或车辆挂接或拴紧。

groups.name: Hold & Cradle · 抱持与呵护 (Cradle, Nuzzle, Cuddle)
groups.tip: 用双臂或怀抱温柔护持

items.def_zh: 抱持，呵护；温柔抱在怀中
items.def_en: 1. To hold someone or something gently and lovingly in your arms, hands, or lap, protecting them.
To settle or move into a warm, comfortable position, often close to someone.
To touch or rub gently with the nose or face, showing affection.
To hold someone or something close in an affectionate, loving way.
To hold someone or something tightly in your hands or arms.
(formal or literary) To surround or hold someone tenderly in your arms.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe holding or pressing someone or something tenderly and protectively in one's arms, lap, or hands. They contrast warm intimacy with physical shelter and maternal-like tenderness.
groups.summary_zh: 体现温柔呵护、抱持或亲密依偎的肢体动作。

groups.name: Honor & Revere · 尊崇与敬重 (Honor, Revere, Venerate)
groups.tip: 表彰嘉奖赋予荣耀

items.def_en: (+ sb) have a great deal of respect, admiration, and reverence for someone
to treat someone as a celebrated hero or celebrity and give them vast public attention
(+ sb/sth) show excessive or profound reverence, submission, or respect toward someone or an ideal

items.def_zh: 尊敬，崇敬；给予表彰，授予荣誉；兑现，信守（诺言或支票）
items.def_en: 1. To show great respect and admiration for someone. 2. To reward or praise someone publicly. 3. To fulfill, keep, or accept (a promise, agreement, or check).
to feel deep respect, awe, or admiration for someone or something regarded as sacred or noble
to hold someone or something in profound, quasi-religious awe and esteem, often on historical or spiritual grounds

groups.summary_en: Actors show profound social or moral respect toward individuals, ideals, or traditions, ranging from formal dignification and badges of merit ('honor') to deep religious or ethical reverence ('revere', 'venerate').
groups.summary_zh: 展现深沉社会敬意与道德推崇，由正式授予殊荣递增至发自内心的敬畏与神圣崇奉。

groups.name: Host & Moderate · 主持与主办 (Host, Chair, Emcee)
groups.tip: 作为东道主组织并款待来宾

items.def_en: to organize and provide the space or facilities for an event; to act as host to guests or on a television or radio show.

items.def_zh: 主持（会议、委员会等）；担任……的主席
items.def_en: to act as the chairperson of a meeting, committee, or organization.
[I/T] to preside over a debate, panel, or discussion to ensure fairness and order
(+ sth) serve as the primary host, presenter, or public face of a broadcast show or event

items.def_zh: 主持（新闻节目、全场播报）
items.def_en: to act as the primary presenter of a television broadcast or live news show

items.def_zh: 担任司仪；主持（节目、典礼）
items.def_en: [I/T] to act as master of ceremonies at an entertainment event or formal ceremony

groups.summary_en: A designated person or organization serves as the master of ceremonies, provider of venue, or meeting leader for a public event, broadcast show, conference, or dinner party. Verbs distinguish running a panel ('chair'), welcoming guests ('host'), or introducing performers ('emcee').
groups.summary_zh: 主办大型活动、主持会议议程或引导宴会节目流程。

groups.name: Hound & Harass Relentlessly · 穷追与死缠烂打 (Hound, Badger, Harry, Harass)
groups.tip: 如猎犬般紧追不舍百般纠缠

items.def_zh: 紧盯不放；近身监视施压
items.def_en: To monitor, chase, or pressure someone uncomfortably close while they are trying to act
To repeatedly pester or bother someone with persistent questions or annoying requests
To urge, push, or tease someone persistently to get them to do something quickly
To torment someone continually through demands, attacks, or constant interruptions
To trouble, distress, or intimidate someone by ongoing intrusive behavior or repeated pressure
To pursue, harass, or disturb someone relentlessly without giving them peace.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate predatory, persistent tracking and pestering, where the agent pursues a victim without respite through constant demands, questions, or stalking.
groups.summary_zh: 像猎犬般死死咬住不放，持续不断地追踪、纠缠或施压骚扰。

groups.name: Hover & Drift · 悬停与盘旋 (Poise, Flit, Hang About)
groups.tip: 空中停滞与平稳盘旋

items.def_en: To be carried slowly along by a current of air or water without propulsion
To loiter or stay in a place with no apparent purpose, often lingering near others
To stay in a place longer than necessary because of hesitation or reluctance to leave

items.def_zh: （在空中）盘旋，悬停；徘徊，逗留；踌躇
items.def_en: 1. To stay in one place in the air, flying or floating. 2. To stay close to someone or something, often in an uncertain or waiting manner.

items.def_zh: 悬停保持平衡；蓄势待发
items.def_en: To balance or remain held steady in one suspended position
To move or fly around someone or something in an aerial circle

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe remaining stationary or gently oscillating in the air without touching down, or lingering closely nearby with quiet or hesitant attention.
groups.summary_zh: 在空中悬止盘旋，或在某处附近徘徊不去。

groups.name: Humanize & Civilize · 人性化与教化 (Civilize, Edify, Enlighten)
groups.tip: 提升文明素养与人性关怀

items.def_en: To give someone greater knowledge, spiritual understanding, and rational insight
To make something harsh, rigid, or institutional more gentle, warm, and approachable
To educate and refine a society or person away from harsh, uncultured, or brutal manners
To train people or animals to behave in a way that is acceptable in human society

items.def_zh: 使具人性，使更人道，改善（环境或制度以符合人的需求）
items.def_en: 1. To make something more pleasant, humane, or suitable for people.
To instruct and improve someone morally, spiritually, or intellectually

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify imparting compassionate, civilized, or culturally elevated qualities to institutions, environments, or raw human nature.
groups.summary_zh: 指使事物更具人性关怀，或使人及环境摆脱粗蛮、迈向开明教化。

groups.name: Humiliate & Abase · 贬低与屈辱 (Degrade, Mortify, Belittle)
groups.tip: 极力贬抑自尊使人蒙羞

items.def_en: To criticize, insult, or disparage someone in front of others to make them feel insignificant.
To make someone or their achievements seem unimportant, small, or worthless.
To make someone feel completely ashamed, stupid, or ridiculous, especially publicly.
To treat someone with such disrespect that they lose their dignity and pride.
To cause someone to feel extremely ashamed, embarrassed, or wounded in pride.
(usually 'abase oneself') To lower yourself or someone in dignity or status; to humble deeply.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers causing intense loss of pride, status, self-respect, or moral standing. 'Abase' and 'degrade' focus on knocking down rank and dignity, 'belittle' targets intellectual stature, and 'mortify' evokes acute psychological shame.
groups.summary_zh: 指打击尊严与地位，使其蒙羞受辱、自惭形秽或威严扫地。

groups.name: Humiliate & Demean · 贬抑与羞辱 (Abase, Degrade, Mortify)
groups.tip: 贬低身份使人难堪蒙羞

items.def_en: Criticize or mock someone, especially in front of other people, to make them feel small

items.def_zh: 使谦逊，贬抑；挫败，使蒙羞
items.def_en: To make someone feel less proud, important, or arrogant; to defeat soundly.
Cause someone a severe loss of dignity or respect
Make someone feel ashamed, foolish, or publicly disgraced
Cause someone profound embarrassment, shame, or chagrin
Behave in a way that belittles or degrades someone, especially oneself

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering someone's status, dignity, or pride, ranging from moderate deflation of arrogance to profound, soul-crushing public degradation.
groups.summary_zh: 描述挫伤他人傲气或肆意践踏其尊严的贬抑与屈辱行为。

groups.name: Humor & Indulge · 迁就与顺从 (Humor, Indulge, Mollycoddle)
groups.tip: 顺着对方性子予以迁就

items.def_en: To comply with someone's wishes or mood in order to keep them happy or pacified.
to allow someone to have or do whatever they want, often unwisely
to treat someone with excessive comfort, care, and attention
to make someone feel less angry or hostile by conceding to their demands
to treat someone with too much care, kindness, or protection
to give someone far too much attention and protection, treating them like a baby

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to accommodating someone's whims, unreasonable mood, or eccentricities gently to avoid upsetting them or keep the peace.
groups.summary_zh: 指为了顾全大局、避免争吵而迁就、包容或纵容对方的任性与情绪。

groups.name: Hustle & Rush · 奔忙与催促 (Hustle, Scurry, Bustle)
groups.tip: 脚步匆忙紧张快速移动

items.def_en: To proceed or prompt another to act rapidly because of pressing time constraints
To move, act, or cause someone to progress with headlong, reckless speed

items.def_zh: 催促，急速推搡前行；奔波，拼搏；推搡；兜售
items.def_en: 1. To hurry someone along, or to move quickly and energetically. 2. To push or shove someone roughly. 3. (informal, especially North American) To work aggressively to make money, or to sell something energetically.
To move about in an energetic, noisy, and conspicuously busy fashion
To move or act with urgent speed, or to accelerate the pace of an occurrence
To move quickly with light, short, hurried steps from agitation or urgency

groups.summary_en: This frame captures rapid, energetic, and pressured movement or action, often driven by urgent necessity, crowded environments, or purposeful drive. When used transitively, it highlights actively shoving or hurrying someone else forward.
groups.summary_zh: 指在紧迫氛围或压力之下匆忙、活跃地移动，或强行催促他人行进。

groups.name: Idealize & Glorify · 美化与理想化 (Glorify, Glamorize, Aggrandize)
groups.tip: 戴着浪漫滤镜对事物过度美化

items.def_en: Disguise or gloss over unpleasant facts in order to give a falsely attractive appearance

items.def_zh: 使有魅力；美化（负面事物）
items.def_en: Make something seem charming, exciting, or sophisticated, obscuring unpleasant truths
Regard or represent someone or something as perfect or better than in reality

items.def_zh: 粉饰；使（坏事）显得可接受
items.def_en: Make an unattractive, unpleasant, or painful reality seem more acceptable or mild

items.raw_cluster: 美化与理想化 Idealize & Glorify
items.def_zh: 使浪漫化，把……想象得过于美好；沉溺于幻想
items.def_en: To talk about or view something in an idealized, unrealistic way that makes it seem better or more appealing than it really is.
Praise or represent something as admirable, heroic, or grand, often undeservedly

groups.summary_en: Covers cognitive and rhetorical acts of depicting something in an excessively noble, beautiful, or romantic light while ignoring ugly realities.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过滤镜或夸张表述美化现实，使其显得远比实情更浪漫或崇高。

groups.name: Idle & Loaf · 游手好闲与怠惰 (Loaf, Laze, Slack)
groups.tip: 游手好闲打发时间消磨生命

items.def_en: (+ around/about) To lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed, lazy posture without working
(+ away) To spend time doing nothing of substance or importance

items.def_zh: 游手好闲，虚度光阴，闲荡
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To spend time idly without doing anything useful.
(+ around/away) To spend time in a relaxed, lazy, and unproductive manner
To spend time idly wandering or living without regular work
To reduce one's effort, work lazily, or avoid duties

groups.summary_en: Covers spending time lazily, avoiding productive effort, and wandering or lingering aimlessly without serious intent.
groups.summary_zh: 描述游手好闲、消磨时光、逃避工作或无所事事的状态。

groups.name: Immunize & Inoculate · 保护与免疫 (Immunize, Vaccinate, Inoculate)
groups.tip: 建立免疫屏障，免受侵害感染

items.def_en: Protect someone or something from danger, infectious exposure, criticism, or unpleasant realities
Protect someone or something from adverse outside impacts, shocks, or financial hardship
(informal) Inject a vaccine into someone with a hypodermic needle
Administer an antigenic substance to stimulate an individual's immune system against a pathogen

items.def_zh: 预防接种；给……灌输保护意识
items.def_en: Treat someone with a vaccine to produce immunity, or introduce a mild stimulus to protect against future shock
to protect a person or animal against a disease, especially by administering a vaccine

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses medical and biological interventions designed to stimulate disease resistance or metaphorically shield against external vulnerabilities.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过接种疫苗或生物学干涉，建立机体抗病保护机制或强化免责屏障。

groups.name: Imprison & Incarcerate · 关押与拘禁 (Jail, Confine, Lock Up)
groups.tip: 投入牢狱剥夺人身自由

items.def_en: Put someone in prison or jail as a lawful punishment
Put someone in a prison or psychiatric hospital and keep them locked inside

items.def_zh: 禁闭；将……限制在狭小空间中
items.def_en: Keep someone closed in a restricted space or prevent them from leaving
Keep someone in official custody, usually for questioning or before trial

items.def_zh: 把……关押入狱；（在罐中）焖炖
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To put someone in prison. 2. To stew meat (especially hare) slowly in a closed container or pot.
Put or confine someone in prison, typically for an extended legal sentence

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe depriving someone of their physical freedom by legal authority or force, placing them behind bars or inside a secure facility. They range from neutral administrative terms to colloquial idioms emphasizing confinement.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法律制裁或强制手段剥夺人身自由，实施拘禁或关押。

groups.name: Incline & Predispose · 诱导倾向与偏向 (Incline, Bias, Dispose)
groups.tip: 预先使人产生某种倾向

items.def_en: (+ to/towards) To feel a tendency or influence someone towards a particular belief, mood, or choice

items.def_zh: 使倾向于，使对…抱有某种态度
items.def_en: (+ to/towards) To make someone naturally inclined to think, feel, or act in a particular way
(+ to) To make someone or something inherently more likely to develop a particular condition, attitude, or behavior.
(+ against/towards) To unfairly influence someone's opinion or decision in favor of or against someone or something
To influence or change someone's opinions, feelings, or decisions

items.def_zh: 事先灌输，使做好准备倾向
items.def_en: (+ for/to) To prepare someone beforehand to act or think in a certain predetermined manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe instilling, fostering, or possessing a latent tendency, leaning, or vulnerability toward a specific attitude, action, or state. They range from neutral inclination to deliberate prejudicial biasing.
groups.summary_zh: 表示使人产生某种心理倾向、态度偏向或具备易受某种影响的体质。

groups.name: Incline & Stoop · 俯身与屈体 (Stoop, Bend, Crouch)
groups.tip: 身体向前下方躬身弯曲

items.def_en: To tilt one's torso over a barrier, surface, or space
To curve the upper body forward, downward, or sideways from an upright position
1. To bend the head and body forward and downward. 2. (stoop to) To lower one's moral standards to do something bad or dishonest.
To round or arch one's back and draw one's shoulders forward
To lower the head or body abruptly to avoid being hit or seen
To lower the body by bending the knees deeply and bowing forward

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame depict bodily posturing where the spine, neck, or knees bend forward and down, often to pick something up or avoid striking an obstacle.
groups.summary_zh: 指脊背、头颈或躯干向前下方弯曲、弓背低头等肢体姿态。

groups.name: Include & Contain · 包含与涵盖 (Feature, Contain, Comprise)
groups.tip: 以某项特征为主要包含

items.def_zh: 以……为主要特色，包含；起重要作用；由……主演
items.def_en: 1. To include someone or something as a prominent characteristic, part, or performer. 2. To have an important role or place in something.
To consist of, encompass, or be made up of particular constituent elements or items
To include a wide spectrum of ideas, elements, or regions within a scope
To draw targeted public attention to a specific element, event, or participant as a main feature
To express, include, or give tangible form to a quality, concept, or feature within a larger body
To display or exhibit prominently the best features, talents, or qualities of something

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes having components, members, or prominent highlights as internal elements of a wider work, entity, product, or roster.
groups.summary_zh: 客体作为组成部分、特色亮点被囊括或展现于整体之中。

groups.name: Incremental Stepped Adjustment · 阶梯式递进增减 (Ratchet, Crank, Step up)
groups.tip: 校正量度、比例并依规调控

items.def_zh: 大幅提升；开大（音量、强度）
items.def_en: To increase the level, volume, speed, or intensity of something mechanically or forcefully.
To increase something incrementally by distinct steps, especially efforts, security, or pace.

items.def_zh: 快速增多；扩大生产/活动
items.def_en: To build up or expand a rate, pace, production, or intensity progressively over time.
To deliberately increase the intensity, rhetorical force, or degree of something.
To raise or achieve an increase in degree, level, or score by a specific step.

items.def_zh: 逐步调高（或调低），阶段性调整
items.def_en: (usually 'ratchet up/down') To increase or decrease something repeatedly by small amounts in stages that cannot be easily undone.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on shifting a quantity, intensity, or pressure upward or downward in discrete, irreversible, or incremental steps, frequently associated with gears, policy levers, or escalations.
groups.summary_zh: 指像齿轮卡扣一样分阶段、一档一档地逐步提升或收紧。

groups.name: Incur & Invite · 招致与招惹 (Incur, Invite, Bring upon)
groups.tip: 行为导致招来不良后果

items.def_en: To behave in a way that is risky and likely to attract danger, disaster, or rejection
To act in a way that makes bad treatment, trouble, or criticism likely to happen to oneself
To draw hostility, suspicion, or unwanted attention toward oneself
To cause something unpleasant or disastrous to happen to oneself or one's group through foolishness or error
To allow debts, bills, or deficits to accumulate quickly through one's own spending

items.def_zh: 招致，惹来（不良后果）；蒙受，承担（费用、债务）
items.def_en: To bring upon oneself something unpleasant or unwanted as a result of one's own actions; to become liable to pay costs or debts.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe unintentionally or heedlessly bringing unpleasant consequences (debts, wrath, penalties, hostility) upon oneself through one's own conduct.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重因自身的行为、态度或过失，使自己蒙受债务、非议、惩罚等不利后果。

groups.name: Indulge & Pamper · 纵容与娇生惯养 (Pamper, Spoil, Mollycoddle)
groups.tip: 过度娇惯姑息甚至沉溺放任

items.def_en: To agree with or please someone simply to keep them calm or satisfied

items.def_zh: 悉心娇惯；悉心照料关爱
items.def_en: To treat someone with excessive comfort, care, luxury, and special attention

items.def_zh: 迎合；曲从（低级趣味或无理要求）
items.def_en: To please or gratify someone's unreasonable or debased wishes and demands
To damage someone's character, especially a child's, by constantly giving them whatever they wish

items.def_zh: 纵容，放任；沉溺于，纵情于
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To allow yourself or someone else to enjoy a pleasure, desire, or luxury freely.
To protect and pamper someone too much in an overprotective, smothering manner

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to treating someone or oneself with excessive leniency, constant gratification, or luxurious care, often to the point of ruining character or exceeding reasonable boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 过分放任、迁就欲望或悉心照料娇宠，常带有宠坏任性的色彩。

groups.name: Infest & Plague · 侵扰与肆虐 (Infest, Beset, Pester)
groups.tip: 害虫或祸害成灾蔓延滋生

items.def_en: Fill and occupy an area uncontrollably with destructive insects, rodents, or weeds
Continually cause worry, suffering, or hardship to a community or individual

items.def_zh: （害虫、老鼠等）大批出没于，成灾于，骚扰
items.def_en: (especially of insects, pests, or parasites) to inhabit or overrun a place in large, harmful numbers
Cause extensive, catastrophic damage and devastation to a place or group
Affect or trouble someone or something persistently from all sides
Annoy someone repeatedly with irritating requests or constant unwelcome presence

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on pests, diseases, troubles, or vermin persistently invading a place or distressing a population in large, damaging numbers.
groups.summary_zh: 指害虫、疫病或祸患大肆繁殖侵扰，造成长期的危害与折磨。

groups.name: Influence & Sway · 左右与施加影响 (Influence, Sway, Color)
groups.tip: 通过威望或说服力操纵局势

items.def_en: To influence someone's opinion or judgment so that they do not view things impartially
To direct or guide the direction of someone's thoughts, negotiations, or general behavior
To influence someone in a way that makes them likely to think, feel, or behave in a certain manner
to affect or change the way someone thinks, behaves, or develops, or the way something happens
To cause someone to have an unfair preference for or dislike of a particular point of view
To persuade someone to believe or do something, or to heavily bias their thinking or decision

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote acting upon people's minds, decisions, or institutional outcomes through persuasion, charisma, or power. While some convey neutral steering, others indicate subtle bias, gradual manipulation, or significant behavioral modification.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权力、说服或无形力量左右他人思想或决断。

groups.name: Inform & Betray · 告密与出卖 (Snitch, Inform, Squeal)
groups.tip: 告密倒戈背弃同伴

items.def_en: (+ on) To secretly inform on someone to an authority figure or parent
1. ('rat on/out') (informal) To betray friends, colleagues, or associates, or inform against them to authorities. 2. To hunt or kill rats.
(+ on/against) To officially report an associate's unlawful activities to the authorities
(+ on) (chiefly British) To report an associate's wrongdoing to the police
(+ on) To betray associates by giving incriminating information to the police
To betray a group, friend, or principle for personal financial or social gain

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict disloyalty manifested by turning informant or snitching on colleagues, comrades, or criminal associates to authorities.
groups.summary_zh: 强调背叛同伙或团体，向当局或外人告密出卖。

groups.name: Inform & Snitch · 告密与出卖 (Snitch, Squeal, Grass)
groups.tip: 向官方告发他人隐私暗中打小报告

items.def_en: (+ on) (informal British) To act as an informer or give incriminating information to the police
To betray someone by informing an authority figure about their wrongdoing
(+ on) To expose illegal or unethical wrongdoing within an organization to authorities or the public

items.def_zh: 告密，告发，打小报告；顺手牵羊，偷窃
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) (informal) To secretly inform someone in authority about someone else's wrongdoings. 2. (informal) To steal something small or of little value.
(+ on) To betray comrades or co-conspirators by revealing incriminating information to the police
(+ on) To report petty mischief or trivial secrets, especially between children

groups.summary_en: This frame covers betraying illicit secrets or associates to authority figures, typically in a clandestine, treacherous, or self-serving manner. Verbs range from colloquial schoolyard tattling to criminal gang betrayals.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中向当局或长辈告发同伙过失，出卖秘密信息。

groups.name: Infuse & Aerate · 浸润与充气 (Aerate, Oxygenate, Infuse)
groups.tip: 注入气泡或让液体充分浸透

items.def_en: To convert a substance into gas or charge a liquid with gaseous molecules
To steep or introduce a substance into liquid so as to transmit its properties or flavor

items.def_zh: 充入二氧化碳，使碳酸盐化
items.def_en: to dissolve carbon dioxide gas into a liquid to make it fizzy
To produce a hissing sound and small bubbles as dissolved gas escapes from liquid
To supply, treat, or enrich a fluid or blood with oxygen gas
To introduce air or gas into a liquid or soil to circulate oxygen or create lightness

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on forcing or diffusing a gas, flavor, or chemical agent into a liquid or substrate to alter its texture, effervescence, or composition.
groups.summary_zh: 指将气体、液体或活性成分充入或浸润到介质中，改变其性质或起泡。

groups.name: Infuse & Permeate · 浸透与赋予 (Imbue, Infuse, Permeate)
groups.tip: 灌输精神或浸润特质

items.def_zh: 布满；充盈（常指光、色或情绪）
items.def_en: To gradually spread across or through something, especially with light, color, or a soft emotion
To fill someone or something deeply with a particular quality, value, or feeling
To spread through every part of an object, place, or system until completely saturated
(formal) to fill someone or something deeply with a quality, feeling, or idea
To exist throughout every aspect or corner of something, such as an odor, belief, or mood
To fill something so completely that no more of a substance, moisture, or quality can be absorbed

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe saturating, deeply penetrating, or endowing a person, object, or medium with a pervasive quality, emotion, atmosphere, or idea. While physical liquids can permeate, these terms frequently operate in abstract and literary contexts.
groups.summary_zh: 表示将某种品质、情感、观念或气味深度浸透、灌注并充盈其中。

groups.name: Ingratiate & Flatter · 讨好逢迎与阿谀奉承 (Ingratiate, Flatter, Fawn)
groups.tip: 逢迎巴结他人以博取青睐与好感

items.def_en: To praise someone excessively or insincerely, usually in order to gain their favor or please them
(+ with) To deliberately seek to advance oneself by attentive praise or servile compliance
(+ to) (informal) To try to make someone in authority like you by flattering them or doing them favors
('ingratiate oneself with') To make deliberate efforts to gain someone's favor, praise, or approval, often insincerely.
(+ on/over) To display exaggerated affection, subservience, or flattery in order to curry favor
(+ to) To act in an abjectly humble, subservient, or desperate manner to win forgiveness or favor

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this interpersonal frame describe actively seeking the favor, goodwill, or patronage of a superior or target through obsequious behavior, calculated compliment, or subservient attentiveness.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过奉承迎合、曲意逢迎或巴结攀附来博取上位者欢心与好感。

groups.name: Initiate & Launch · 发起与倡导 (Kick off, Spearhead, Pioneer)
groups.tip: 主动启动新项目或社会倡议

items.def_en: To start an event, discussion, or series of activities
To start an organized activity, campaign, or commercial enterprise

items.def_zh: 发起，倡导，开始；接纳（新成员入会）；使初步了解
items.def_en: 1. To cause a process or action to begin; to launch. 2. To introduce someone to an organization or activity, often with a formal ceremony.
To be one of the first people to develop or implement a new idea, method, or field
To bring about or initiate an action, reform, or event through deliberate urging
To serve as the active leader of a campaign, initiative, or movement

groups.summary_en: Refers to intentionally starting, launching, or championing a formal process, movement, or campaign. Contrasts high-profile executive leadership with early trailblazing efforts.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动发起、带头推动或倡导某项进程、项目或行动。

groups.name: Injure & Maim · 创伤与严重致残 (Wound, Mutilate, Maim)
groups.tip: 轻微受伤到重伤致残的升级

items.def_en: To cause physical harm or impairment to someone's body

items.def_zh: （用武器等）使受伤，伤害；伤害（感情）
items.def_en: 1. To injure someone physically, especially with a weapon. 2. To hurt someone's feelings, reputation, or pride.
To make a long, deep cut in someone's flesh
To tear or deeply cut flesh or skin roughly

items.def_zh: 毁损肉体；严重割裂残害
items.def_en: To severely damage, disfigure, or cut off parts of a living body
To injure someone severely so that a part of their body is permanently damaged or lost

groups.summary_en: Denotes inflicting severe physical damage upon the body, typically involving cutting weapons, ballistics, or extreme trauma. Focuses on violent disruption of bodily integrity ranging from flesh wounds to permanent physical destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过武器或暴力外力对肉体造成严重切割伤、残害或不可逆损伤。

groups.name: Injure & Maim · 残害与伤折 (Maim, Kneecap, Mutilate)
groups.tip: 残害肢体致严重致残

items.def_zh: 使伤残；使丧失活动能力
items.def_en: To cause an illness or injury that renders someone unable to function physically as before
To injure a person or animal in a leg or foot so that walking becomes difficult or impossible
To injure someone physically so that they cannot walk properly or use their limbs freely

items.def_zh: 枪击（或打碎）…的膝盖骨（作为惩罚或警告）
items.def_en: 1. To shoot or deliberately injure someone in the knee as a punishment or warning.

items.def_zh: 切断；毁伤；严重残毁（肢体等）
items.def_en: To severely damage the body, especially by severing or tearing off an essential limb or part
To injure someone so severely that a part of their body is permanently damaged or unusable

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote causing severe, permanent, or debilitating physical damage to someone's body, typically through deliberate violence or brutal punitive strikes. They carry extremely high somatic impact.
groups.summary_zh: 指蓄意对身体造成严重骨折、肢体毁伤或永久性致残伤害。

groups.name: Inoculate & Immunize · 接种与免疫 (Vaccinate, Immunize, Jab)
groups.tip: 植入抗原刺激机体产生抗体

items.def_en: To provide acquired immune resistance against pathogens or transmissible disease
To give an additional dose of a vaccine to replenish and increase antibody levels
(informal) To give someone an injection or vaccination with a sharp hypodermic needle
To administer a vaccine to a person or animal to produce immunity against a specific disease

items.def_zh: 给……接种疫苗；灌输，灌输思想；（生物）接种（微生物）
items.def_en: To protect a person or animal against a disease by injecting a mild form of it; to introduce microorganisms into a culture medium; to instill an idea into someone's mind.
To make a person immune to an infectious disease, usually through vaccination

groups.summary_en: Encompasses the biomedical act of administering an antigenic agent to elicit an immune response against infectious disease. 'Inoculate' emphasizes introducing the biological agent, 'vaccinate' specifically uses a vaccine, and 'immunize' focuses on inducing resultant resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 指注射抗原或疫苗以使机体获得抵御感染的免疫力。

groups.name: Inquire & Investigate · 询问与打探 (Ask, Query, Probe)
groups.tip: 向人求证情况或正式打听信息

items.def_en: (+ about/for) To put a question to someone in order to elicit information or an answer
To question someone discreetly or cautiously in order to find out their views or intentions
(+ into) To search into closely, examine thoroughly, or question persistently to uncover hidden facts
To ask questions about something, especially to check its accuracy or express doubt
(+ into) To inquire inappropriately or intrusively into other people's private affairs
(+ about/into) (chiefly British) To ask for information or investigate something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve seeking information by putting questions to someone or conducting an investigation into an issue. They range from routine neutral questioning to intrusive prying or formal official investigation.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及向他人提问、探求信息或对问题展开调查的动词，涵盖日常询问至深入打探。

groups.name: Insolent Repartee & Backchat · 顶撞顶嘴与反唇相讥 (Sass, Back-talk, Retort)
groups.tip: 态度无礼地顶嘴与回敬

items.def_en: To answer someone rapidly with an incisive, witty, or indignant response
(+ to) To reply defiantly or insolently to someone in authority
To speak to someone with brazen disrespect and cheeky effrontery
To reply impudently or argumentatively to a superior or authority figure

items.raw_cluster: 顶撞与反驳 Retort & Talk Back
items.def_en: (informal, chiefly North American) to talk back rudely or cheekily to someone, especially an authority figure
(+ to/at) To speak impertinently, disrespectfully, or belligerently to someone

groups.summary_en: This frame covers responding to figures of authority or conversation partners with cheeky, impudent, or sharp verbal defiance. The focus is on conversational disrespect, sharpness, or quick insolent retorts.
groups.summary_zh: 指对长辈、上级或他人不逊地顶撞、回嘴或带刺地反唇相讥。

groups.name: Integration & Assimilation · 合并与融合 (Integrate, Merge, Absorb)
groups.tip: 吸纳归并融入成为一体

items.def_zh: 合并，融入；包含，吸收；将……组建为法人公司
items.def_en: 1. To include or blend something into a larger whole or system. 2. To form into a legally recognized company or corporation.
Combine two or more things effectively so that they become a single unified system
Take in and make something part of a larger group, organization, or body
Blend or incorporate a component gently and thoroughly into a larger structure
Combine or cause two or more things, companies, or streams to coalesce into a single unit
Absorb and integrate ideas, customs, or people into a prevailing system or culture

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote absorbing, blending, or assimilating separate elements into a cohesive unified whole or larger operational structure.
groups.summary_zh: 将独立的要素、组织或成分纳为一体，使之并入更大整体。

groups.name: Intercept & Cut Off · 拦截与阻截 (Intercept, Head off, Cut off)
groups.tip: 中途截断阻止前行

items.def_en: To get in front of someone or a group moving toward a destination in order to stop them or change their direction
To block the route or path of someone moving, preventing them from proceeding or escaping
To encounter and halt someone when they are exposed or mid-transit
(formal/military) To intercept and prevent enemy movement, contraband, or supply lines from reaching an objective

items.def_zh: 拦截，截住，阻截；截听，截获
items.def_en: To stop, catch, or seize someone or something moving from one place to another before they reach their destination
To lie in wait for and stop or ambush someone unexpectedly along their path

groups.summary_en: Focuses on stopping, catching, or redirecting someone or something that is moving toward a destination before they arrive, usually by crossing their path or preempting their course.
groups.summary_zh: 指在人、物或信号抵达目的地途中，跨前横切路径实施堵截、阻断或缴获。

groups.name: Interfere & Meddle · 干涉与瞎掺和 (Interfere, Pry, Butt in)
groups.tip: 没有资格却多管闲事插手

items.def_en: (+ around / on) Look around secretly in order to discover private information about others
(informal) Interrupt rudely or intrude uninvited into a conversation or private business

items.def_zh: 干涉，介入他人事务并造成妨碍
items.def_en: (+ with / in) Deliberately get involved in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, causing trouble

items.def_zh: 管闲事，干涉，干预；瞎弄，擅自乱动
items.def_en: (disapproving) to interfere in something that is not your concern, or touch things without permission.
(+ into) Inquire too inquisitively or nosily into other people's private lives

items.def_zh: 胡乱摆弄，非法篡改破坏
items.def_en: (+ with) Interfere with something secretly or improperly in order to alter, damage, or falsify it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe unwelcome, intrusive, and disruptive involvement in other people's affairs or private business. They carry a strong disapproving tone, often highlighting nosiness, presumption, or unauthorized tampering.
groups.summary_zh: 强调令人反感地插手、过问他人私事或擅自摆弄摆布。

groups.name: Interrogate & Grill · 质问与盘问 (Cross-examine, Third-degree, Pump)
groups.tip: 严词诘难与高压拷问

items.def_en: To question someone discreetly or cautiously in order to discover their opinions or intentions.
To ask someone a series of rapid, inquisitive questions to obtain information or test knowledge.
(+ for) To elicit confidential or private information from someone by persistent questioning.
1. (informal) To question someone intensely and relentlessly for a long period. 2. To cook food directly under or over intense heat on a metal frame.
To question a witness or opponent vigorously in detail to test the truth of their statements.
To ask someone thorough, searching questions in a formal, stern, or official setting.

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote aggressive, exhaustive, and relentless questioning aimed at breaking resistance and forcing out hidden truths. 'Grill' conveys colloquial heat and persistence, 'interrogate' formal custodial examination, and 'cross-examine' forensic scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有压迫性、审判性地连续盘根问底以撬开真情。

groups.name: Intimidate & Browbeat · 威吓与胁迫 (Browbeat, Bully, Cow)
groups.tip: 以强横言行恐吓胁迫他人

items.def_en: To use direct pressure, threats, or intimidation on someone to compel behavior
(+ into) To use superior strength, size, or authority to persecute or force someone to comply
(+ into) To frighten or overawe someone into subdued submission through menaces
To intentionally make someone fearful or timid, especially to make them act in a certain way
(+ into/through) To force someone or an initiative into submission by sheer aggressive momentum
(+ into) To intimidate or bully someone into doing something using harsh words or stern looks.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses communicative and behavioral acts aimed at frightening, overpowering, or coercing another person into compliance through harsh language, imposing posture, or continuous overbearing threats.
groups.summary_zh: 通过严词厉色、强梁霸道或恐吓威胁迫使他人屈服顺从。

groups.name: Intimidate & Hector · 恐吓与威逼 (Bully, Browbeat, Cow)
groups.tip: 盛气凌人地威吓并强迫他人

items.def_zh: 迫使…仓促屈服；强行推动
items.def_en: To force someone into doing something hastily without calm consideration
To use superior strength or influence to intimidate someone, typically to force them to do what one wants
To cause someone to submit or feel subdued through fear or intimidation

items.def_zh: 盛气凌人地威吓，威逼，欺凌
items.def_en: To talk to or treat someone in a loud, aggressive, bullying way to force them to do something.
To use coercive or aggressive physical or political tactics to force compliance
To intimidate or coerce someone into doing something using aggressive words or stern looks

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe using loud, aggressive, or domineering behavior to frighten, pressure, or coerce someone into compliance. Nuances range from persistent verbal harassment and browbeating to sheer psychological intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过言语恐吓、盛气凌人的态度施压或迫使他人顺从。

groups.name: Intravenous Delivery & Injection · 药物输注与静脉给药 (Inject, Transfuse, Infuse)
groups.tip: 针剂输入血管，医学输液与注入

items.def_en: to supply liquid nourishment or medicine slowly through an intravenous drip
(+ sth) inject an illegal narcotic directly into a vein
to force a fluid or medication into tissue or a vein using a syringe and needle
to introduce a fluid or drug into a vein at a slow, controlled rate over time

items.def_zh: 静脉注射（毒品）；快速注入，直接输送
items.def_en: 1. (slang) To inject an illegal drug directly into a major vein. 2. (informal) To take in or supply something directly and intensely.
1. (medicine) To transfer blood or blood products directly into a patient's vein. 2. To instill, permeate, or infuse an idea or quality into something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote administering liquids, blood products, or therapeutic/narcotic agents directly into the bloodstream or tissue via needles, catheters, or vascular lines.
groups.summary_zh: 通过针具、导管向血管或组织中输入液体、血液或药剂。

groups.name: Intuitive & Mystical Divination · 直觉感应与占卜推测 (Divine, Douse, Scry)
groups.tip: 凭直觉或迹象预判未来

items.def_en: To detect, perceive, or recognize something obscure through sharp insight
To penetrate and understand a profound mystery or another's obscure intentions

items.def_zh: 用探杆探测（水源或矿脉）
items.def_en: (also dowse) To search for underground water or minerals using a divining rod
To understand or foresee something instinctively without the intervention of conscious reasoning

items.def_zh: 占卜，卜算；凭直觉推测，料想
items.def_en: to discover or guess something by using intuition, perception, or alleged supernatural powers
To foretell the future or reveal secrets by gazing into a crystal, mirror, or pool of water

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies discerning hidden truths, future developments, or underground materials through deep intuition, non-rational perception, or supernatural and occult methods, distinguishing it from empirical, statistical forecasting.
groups.summary_zh: 强调依赖直觉洞察、通灵玄学、占卜或神秘感应来探测隐秘真相或窥测未来。

groups.name: Invade & Overrun · 侵占与席卷 (Overrun, Swarm, Inundate)
groups.tip: 大举入侵并快速席卷占领

items.def_en: Spread across an area quickly and powerfully, affecting everything in its path
Move or gather somewhere in large, dense, often disorienting numbers
Enter a country or area in large numbers by force to occupy it, or enter a place aggressively in crowds

items.def_zh: （军队）大举攻占，席卷；（害虫、杂草等）肆虐，泛滥；超过（限度、时间）
items.def_en: 1. to invade, spread over, or occupy a place rapidly and in large numbers. 2. to exceed an allotted limit, budget, or scheduled time.
Sweep over and completely cover or surround something so as to submerge or hide it

items.def_zh: 泛滥于；大批涌向并淹没
items.def_en: Overwhelm or flood a place with huge numbers of people, things, or requests

groups.summary_en: This frame covers forces, crowds, or phenomena spreading aggressively, rapidly, and in overwhelming numbers to engulf and control a space.
groups.summary_zh: 指大批人马、军队或事物以压倒之势迅速席卷、占据某地。

groups.name: Invert & Overturn · 逆转与颠倒 (Invert, Overturn, Upend)
groups.tip: 前后翻转或方向对换完全倒置

items.def_zh: 颠倒，彻底反转；倒退，倒车
items.def_en: 1. To change something completely to its opposite, or invert its order or position. 2. To drive or move backwards.
To turn over quickly into an opposite orientation, or suddenly reverse a stance
To put something upside down or in the opposite order, position, or arrangement
To completely transform a nature, state, or structure into a contrasting or alternative form
To turn upside down, or officially invalidate and reverse a legal decision or policy
To set or turn something completely upside down, disrupting established balance or order

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate rotating, flipping, or transforming an order, position, relationship, or ruling entirely into its opposite. The change may be physical (turning upside down) or systemic (overruling a decision).
groups.summary_zh: 使物理位置、既定顺序或裁定彻底转向对立面。

groups.name: Invert & Reverse · 颠倒与反转 (Overturn, Upend, Flip)
groups.tip: 上下颠倒或次序彻底反转

items.def_en: To turn over quickly into an upside-down or opposite side position

items.def_zh: 使内外彻底颠倒；搞得翻天覆地
items.def_en: To reverse an object so its interior surface faces outward, or disorganize utterly
To turn upside down or invalidate an established legal decision or balance of power
To turn something upside down, inside out, or reverse its normal order, position, or condition.
To switch two or more things into each other's respective position or order
To set or turn something completely upside down, or thoroughly overturn established order

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses spatial, structural, or logical transformations where items, positions, decisions, or sequences are flipped into an opposite or upside-down configuration.
groups.summary_zh: 指在空间位置、先后次序或既定方向上彻底翻转颠倒。

groups.name: Investigate & Probe · 深入探究与盘诘 (Probe, Delve, Pry, Sift)
groups.tip: 抽丝剥茧探寻隐秘深处

items.def_en: To question someone discreetly or indirectly to find out their views, intentions, or plans.

items.def_zh: 探究，调查；用探针探查，探寻
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To examine or investigate a complex, hidden, or suspicious situation thoroughly. 2. To physically examine an area, wound, or object by poking with a tool or hand.
(+ into) To search thoroughly and deeply for hidden information, reasons, or obscure details.
(+ into) To enquire too inquisitively or inappropriately into other people's private affairs.
(+ through) To examine evidence or large amounts of material very carefully to separate what is useful from what is not.
To discover hidden information or track down elusive facts by persistent searching.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe penetrating beneath the surface to uncover concealed, sensitive, or intricate facts. They emphasize intrusive questioning, deep digging, or painstaking sorting through murky details.
groups.summary_zh: 强调破除掩盖、深入盘查或层层剖析以揭示隐藏实情。

groups.name: Involve & Implicate · 牵连与卷入 (Entangle, Incriminate, Involve)
groups.tip: 卷入事件或暗示牵涉其中

items.def_en: (+ in) To draw someone into an affair, plot, or compromising situation
1. (+ in) To show, suggest, or prove that someone was involved in a crime, scandal, or wrong action. 2. To imply or convey indirectly.
(+ in/with) To ensnare or involve someone heavily in complex, compromising difficulties
To provide evidence indicating that someone is guilty of a crime or illicit act
(+ in) To involve someone in a messy, difficult, or compromising situation that is hard to escape
(+ in) To drag someone deeply into a bitter quarrel, conflict, or legal dispute

groups.summary_en: Covers showing, claiming, or drawing someone into complicity in wrongdoing, legal transgression, or an unwholesome affair.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人牵扯进犯罪、丑闻或不良事态中，证明其有牵连。

groups.name: Jam, Freeze & Block · 卡住与受阻 (Jam, Freeze, Wedge)
groups.tip: 受阻黏附无法动弹

items.def_en: To become tightly wedged or blocked so that motion or mechanical function is completely stopped

items.def_zh: （使）卡住，（使）动弹不得；（stick的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: Past and past participle of stick; to become trapped, jammed, or unable to move or progress further.
