To stick or fail to slide smoothly due to friction, misalignment, or warping
(+ into/between) To force something tightly into a narrow space so that it cannot easily move
(+ with) To obstruct a conduit or mechanism by filling it with thick, sticky, or compacted matter

items.def_zh: （机器、轴承）抱死；完全冻结卡死
items.def_en: To become totally immobile or unresponsive due to extreme cold, friction, or technical malfunction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote mechanical parts, vehicles, or physical objects becoming firmly caught, wedged, or immobile due to obstruction or friction. Frequent collocates include gears, paper, drawer, traffic, and mud.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重因机械故障、挤压或外力阻碍而动弹不得、卡死。

groups.name: Jeer & Heckle · 起哄与喝倒彩 (Heckle, Jeer, Boo)
groups.tip: 看台上起哄吵闹或喝倒彩干扰

items.def_en: To make a deep, mocking 'boo' sound to show strong disapproval of a speaker or performance

items.def_zh: 喝倒彩，起哄；大声喝彩，加油
items.def_en: 1. (British) To shout and jeer disapprovingly at a speaker or sports team. 2. (+ for) (Australian / New Zealand) To cheer and shout encouragement for a sports team.
To interrupt a public speaker or performer with persistent, hostile, or derisive remarks
(+ at) To laugh or shout rude, mocking, and insulting remarks at someone publicly

items.def_zh: 吹口哨起哄，发尖叫嘘声
items.def_en: To make whistle sounds, shrill shouts, or mocking cries to express disapproval or harass someone
To prevent someone from being heard by shouting loudly and drowning out their voice

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe shouting derisive, taunting, or hostile remarks to disrupt and discomfit a public speaker, performer, or sports rival.
groups.summary_zh: 在公众场合大声喧哗、起哄、喝倒彩以扰乱演讲者或比赛方。

groups.name: Join & Bind · 结合与连接 (Conjoin, Unite, Link)
groups.tip: 将独立部分拼合接合为一体

items.def_en: To join together with others to achieve something, or to bring different parts together into a whole
To make or form a connection between two or more people, things, or places
To fasten, connect, or unite two or more things or groups into one
To join together physically by melting, or to combine distinct qualities or elements seamlessly
1. (formal) To join, unite, or combine two things together.
To connect or be connected with each other closely or in an intricate network

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physical or conceptual act of bringing two or more separate entities together to form a single combined whole. They range from physical assembly to abstract merging of ideas, forces, or entities.
groups.summary_zh: 表示将两个或多个独立实体在物理或概念上联结成一体的动作。

groups.name: Join & Rejoin · 汇合与加入 (Join, Rejoin, Re-enter)
groups.tip: 脱离组织后重新加入归队

items.def_en: To become a member of an organization, group, or activity, or to accompany others
To enter a group, workforce, political arena, or territory again after leaving it

items.def_zh: 团结在……周围；向……汇聚支援
items.def_en: To come together in a group to support or defend a person, organization, or cause
(+ with) To connect or associate closely with an organization or party again
(+ with) To bring or come together again after a period of separation

items.def_zh: 重新加入，回到（某人处）；反驳，答辩
items.def_en: 1. To return to or become a member of a group, organization, or companion again after leaving. 2. (formal) To reply quickly and sharply to a remark.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate entering, becoming a member of, or returning to a social, political, or military collective or ongoing company after a period of absence or separation.
groups.summary_zh: 指重新回到群体中，或再度加入组织、阵营及同伴行列。

groups.name: Keynote & Deliver · 宣讲与主旨发言 (Deliver, Unveil, Headcharge)
groups.tip: 面向公众发表演说或作报告

items.def_en: To present or communicate a speech or talk to an assembled group of listeners
To present or pronounce a speech, lecture, or prepared statement formally in public
To appear as the chief speaker, star presenter, or main attraction at an event

items.def_zh: 正式公布；宣布推出（规划等）
items.def_en: To present a new plan, policy, or project officially to an audience for the first time

items.def_zh: 为……拉开序幕；作开幕致辞
items.def_en: To open or inaugurate a major meeting or conference with an introductory address
1. (chiefly US) To deliver the main, theme-setting speech at a conference or convention.

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights presenting flagship talks, headline speeches, or formal addresses setting the principal theme for an assembly, summit, or high-level organizational conference.
groups.summary_zh: 指在峰会或大会上作主旨报告、正式发表定调演讲。

groups.name: Land & Touch Down · 降落与着陆 (Alight, Touch Down, Perch)
groups.tip: 自空中接触地面

items.def_zh: 着陆，降落；（使）上岸；赢得，获得
items.def_en: 1. To bring an aircraft or ship down to earth or onto water, or to arrive on the ground after flying. 2. To come to shore or put passengers ashore from a boat. 3. (informal) To successfully get or achieve a prize, job, or deal.
To make contact with the ground at the end of a flight or descent

items.def_zh: 操纵降落；使（飞机等）着陆
items.def_en: To pilot and safely bring an aircraft down onto the ground or water
To land by parachuting into an ocean or body of water, said of spacecraft

items.def_zh: 栖息；停落在高处或狭窄边缘
items.def_en: (+ on) To alight and balance upon an elevated branch, bar, or narrow perch
(+ on/upon) To land softly and settle gently onto a surface after flying

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the final stage of descent where an airborne vessel, bird, or person makes controlled contact with and settles onto a surface.
groups.summary_zh: 描述飞行器、鸟类或人自空中下降并平稳接触地面的过程。

groups.name: Lard & Pepper · 穿插点缀与夹杂 (Lard, Pepper, Interlard)
groups.tip: 添彩点缀充实美化

items.def_en: To give zest, piquancy, or variety to writing or discourse by interspersing sharp or witty points
To sprinkle or scatter abundantly through a speech, text, or surface
To intersperse or embellish writing or speech copiously with foreign phrases or allusions
To scatter or set thickly across a surface or work with notable features or examples
To distribute light touches of specific words, humor, or ideas throughout a piece of work

items.def_zh: 在（话语或文章中）大量穿插，缀满；在（瘦肉）中夹入肥肉膘
items.def_en: 1. To embellish or fill speech or writing abundantly with particular words, quotations, or references. 2. (cooking) To insert strips of fat into lean meat before cooking.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on interspersing speech, prose, or texts heavily with specific elements like jargon, quotations, anecdotes, or foreign phrases, often to an excessive or pretentious degree.
groups.summary_zh: 指在文本或谈话中大量穿插、夹杂引用语、术语或噱头。

groups.name: Leach & Percolate · 浸出与渗滤 (Percolate, Filter, Bleed Out)
groups.tip: 液体缓缓透滤，析出溶解物质

items.def_en: To pass a liquid or light through a porous medium or screen to separate or diffuse it
to wash chemicals or minerals out of soil, stone, or waste by water percolating through, or to be washed away in this way
To flow or pass slowly through small pores, cracks, or interstices
To slowly lose or allow chemical substances or dyes to seep out into surrounding material
To filter or ooze gradually through a porous substance, or to pass liquid through grounds
To separate a soluble substance from an insoluble solid by washing or percolation

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote a fluid slowly moving through a porous medium, either washing soluble minerals and chemicals out or gradually dripping through a granular substrate.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体在多孔物质中缓慢渗透，溶解或带走化学成分及可溶物。

groups.name: Lecture & Harangue · 说教与高声长篇训话 (Harangue, Preach, Berate)
groups.tip: 滔滔不绝的说教与严肃训诫

items.def_en: (+ about/on) To criticize or admonish someone sternly, often in an annoying, condescending, or didactic way
(+ to/at) To give unwelcome moral advice in a tedious or self-righteous manner

items.def_zh: 立规矩，发号施令，严厉训话
items.def_en: To tell people what to do or not to do in a forceful, authoritarian, and uncompromising manner
(+ about/on) To express opinions in an authoritative, pompous, and dogmatic way
To scold or criticize someone angrily, vehemently, and at length

items.def_zh: 向……滔滔不绝地演讲，大声训斥
items.def_en: To speak to someone or an audience loudly, forcefully, and at length, often in an aggressive or lecturing manner.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses speaking to someone at great length in an aggressive, pompous, or moralizing manner. Verbs differ in whether the tone is self-righteously preachy, aggressively hostile, or scolding and patronizing.
groups.summary_zh: 指以居高临下、冗长或咄咄逼人的态度对他人进行说教、训诫或高声斥责。

groups.name: Lecture & Instruct · 授课与训诫 (Teach, Preach, Admonish)
groups.tip: 面向公众或学生正式陈述讲授

items.def_en: 1. To deliver an educational speech or talk to an audience or class. 2. To criticize or warn someone sternly about their behavior.
To deliver a religious sermon, or to give unwanted moral advice in a patronizing way
To systematically teach a subject, skill, or principle to learners
To criticize, scold, or lecture someone angrily and at length
To speak to someone gently or mildly in disapproval of their behavior

items.def_zh: 妄加道德评价；作大道理说教
items.def_en: To lecture or pass moral judgment on others' behavior in an irritatingly righteous way

groups.summary_en: This frame spans two related senses: delivering informative academic instruction to an audience, and reproving someone pedantically or moralistically like an instructor scolding a pupil.
groups.summary_zh: 兼指学术性的讲课授业与居高临下的说教训斥。

groups.name: Legal Liberation & Enfranchisement · 解除束缚与赋予民权 (Enfranchise, Manumit, Emancipate)
groups.tip: 打破枷锁赋予自由与公权

items.def_en: (+ sb) release someone from captivity, confinement, slavery, or legal subjugation
(+ sb) release someone from prison or legal custody

items.def_zh: 解放，使重获自由（社会学或政治语境）
items.def_en: to set someone free from oppression, foreign control, or confinement

items.def_zh: 解放（奴隶或受束缚群体），使其获得政治或法律自由
items.def_en: to set someone free from legal, social, or political restrictions and slavery

items.def_zh: 给予选举权；解放，释放（奴隶等）
items.def_en: 1. To give someone the legal right to vote in elections. 2. (historical) To set a slave free from bondage.
(historical / law) To formally set a slave free from bondage.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal and sociopolitical frame denote formally granting legal freedom, civil rights, or suffrage to subjugated persons or disenfranchised groups, transforming their constitutional and civic status.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法律或制度赋予奴隶、受压迫者自由权或公民投票权。

groups.name: Lend & Entrust Temporarily · 借出与出借 (Lend, Lease, Farm out)
groups.tip: 暂时提供财物与他人

items.def_en: To send work or responsibilities out to be done by external contractors or workers
To make services, tools, or vehicles available to someone else for a fee
To permit another party to use one's property in return for periodic payment
1. To give something to someone for a short time, expecting it to be returned; to provide money that must be repaid. 2. To impart or contribute a particular quality to something.
To lease part or all of a rented property or asset to a third party
To grant temporary possession and use of property or equipment in exchange for rent

groups.summary_en: Interpersonal and institutional acts of parting with money, equipment, or belongings for a designated time with the clear understanding that the item itself or equivalent value will return.
groups.summary_zh: 人际借出物品或有期租让，预设物归原主或等价偿还。

groups.name: Light & Daytime Rest · 小睡与打盹 (Nap, Doze, Snooze)
groups.tip: 生理性入睡与短暂小憩

items.def_en: To gradually and peacefully slip into sleep
To fall into a light sleep unintentionally while sitting upright
to sleep lightly or for a short period of time, especially during the day
To have a short, comfortable sleep, often voluntarily or by postponing waking up
To sleep lightly, intermittently, and fitfully, especially without intending to
To sleep peacefully or serenely, often used in literary contexts

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent brief, non-exhaustive periods of slumber, often taken during daylight hours or drifting in and out of consciousness.
groups.summary_zh: 特指白昼或片刻间的轻度小憩、浅睡或断断续续的入眠。

groups.name: List & Itemize · 列举与逐项详述 (Catalog, Detail, Itemize)
groups.tip: 逐条列出清单进行详细说明

items.def_en: To explain something in detail, clearly and step by step

items.def_zh: 逐条列出，分项列举；详细罗列
items.def_en: 1. To list each individual item, detail, or expense separately and specifically.

items.def_zh: 一口气列出；滔滔不绝地说出
items.def_en: To say or recite a rapid, effortless list of items from memory
To list or describe fully, thoroughly, and point by point
To make a systematic, comprehensive list of items or events
To name things separately, one by one, especially in formal argument

groups.summary_en: Refers to communicating information by breaking it down into discrete components or reciting them one by one. Verbs vary from systematic accounting and official documentation to exhaustive verbal recounting.
groups.summary_zh: 指将信息拆解为独立条目、逐一列举或详述的言语行为。

groups.name: Maneuver & Navigate · 操纵调动与精巧转运 (Maneuver, Steer, Pilot)
groups.tip: 巧妙把控方向与机动调度

items.def_zh: 引导，领航（使沿正确路径行进）
items.def_en: Direct the motion or position of an object or vehicle along a planned course
Move or guide something forward very slowly, carefully, and in tiny stages

items.def_zh: 驾驶，引航（飞机或船只穿越险境）
items.def_en: Carefully direct and steer an aircraft, ship, or vehicle through a difficult passage
Control the direction in which a vehicle, vessel, or aircraft moves
Plan and direct the course of a vehicle or find one's way safely through a difficult area

items.def_zh: 巧妙移动，操纵；调遣，调动；用计策划
items.def_en: 1. To move or turn skillfully or carefully, especially into or out of a tight space. 2. To guide, direct, or manipulate someone or something cleverly or deviously.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the conscious, skillful physical or tactical guiding of a vehicle, person, or object through tight spaces, complex trajectories, or challenging conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 指在狭窄或复杂环境中娴熟细致地操控方向、避开障碍调遣移动。

groups.name: Map & Chart · 规划蓝图与绘制路径 (Map, Chart, Plot)
groups.tip: 图解推演未来路径

items.def_en: To arrange or sketch the main parts or overall timeline of a plan without full details

items.def_zh: 规划，安排（常与out连用）；绘制……的地图；映射
items.def_en: 1. (often 'map out') To plan or arrange something in detail. 2. To make a map of an area or show the features of something. 3. (mathematics) To associate each element of a set with an element of another.
To plan in careful detail how something will happen or be done over a period of time

items.def_zh: 绘制；在坐标上标示；策划
items.def_en: To mark a path on a diagram or chart, or to calculate and devise a precise path forward
To plot a course on a map or to plan out a detailed future course of action
To describe, trace, or outline precisely the exact boundaries or steps of something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame entail charting, surveying, and graphically or conceptually laying out a sequence of future actions, spatial courses, or complex distributions in rigorous, systematic detail.
groups.summary_zh: 指绘制图表、测定路线或系统勾画出详尽行动计划。

groups.name: Marinate & Soak · 浸泡与腌制 (Macerate, Pickle, Cure)
groups.tip: 用调味汁浸泡入味

items.def_en: To preserve meat, fish, or other food by salting, smoking, or seasoning it
To steep meat, fish, or vegetables in a seasoned, often acidic sauce before cooking
To preserve and flavor food by immersing it in vinegar, brine, or a sour solution

items.def_zh: （将肉、鱼等）腌泡，浸泡于腌汁中
items.def_en: to soak meat, fish, or other food in a seasoned liquid before cooking, or to be soaked in this way
To plunge or steep food in vinegar, brine, or pickling marinade

items.def_zh: 浸软；（将水果用糖或酒）腌透
items.def_en: To soften fruit or food by steeping it in alcohol, sugar, or flavored liquid

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this culinary frame describe steeping food in a seasoned, acidic, or alcoholic liquid over an extended period to tenderize it, impart flavor, or preserve it.
groups.summary_zh: 指将食材长时间浸润在调味汁或酸性液体中以入味、软化或保鲜。

groups.name: Market & Promote · 营销与推销 (Promote, Tout, Hawk, Plug)
groups.tip: 推销商品促进买卖

items.def_en: to promote, advertise, and offer goods or services for sale to consumers
promote or sell goods aggressively through persistent persuasion
publicize a product, cause, or venture to increase sales or public awareness
mention or recommend a product, book, or show publicly, especially in media appearances
carry goods about for sale, offering them by shouting in streets or markets
attempt to sell or praise something energetically, often making exaggerated claims

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses commercial and promotional actions intended to bring goods, services, or public figures to market and persuade audiences to buy or support them. Verbs range from broad corporate positioning to aggressive, street-level hawking or casual celebrity plugging.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖将产品或服务推向市场、吸引买家并促成交易的商业宣传活动。

groups.name: Match & Accord · 吻合与一致 (Tally, Match, Correspond)
groups.tip: 数据或事实完全对应

items.def_en: (+ with) To agree or make something agree logically with an established fact or belief
(+ with/to) To match or be identical with something in detail, character, or quantity
To be verified as true, accurate, or consistent upon investigation
(+ with) To match up correctly or bring into exact agreement or compatibility
(+ with) To happen at the same time, or to be in total agreement or accord in nature

items.def_zh: 吻合，符合，相符；清点，计数，核算
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) If figures, accounts, or stories tally, they match or agree with each other. 2. (+ up) To count, calculate, or record a total score or quantity.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on accounts, figures, or testimonies agreeing with or confirming one another without discrepancy. Verbs convey a harmonious parallel between independent pieces of evidence or statements.
groups.summary_zh: 指数据、陈述或事实在核对中完全一致、无出入。

groups.name: Measure & Estimate · 估算与计量 (Gauge, Appraise, Assess)
groups.tip: 估量价值与规模大小

items.def_en: To form a judgment or calculation about the approximate value, size, or cost of something.
To calculate or judge the nature, value, price, or significance of an asset or problem
To make a reasoned judgment or measurement about a quantity, situation, or person's mood
To calculate or state an amount or value that is nearly but not completely exact
To estimate an amount, size, or distance visually without using instruments
To examine someone or something to evaluate their value, quality, or condition formally

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental or instrumental computations used to determine the magnitude, value, duration, or likelihood of something without precise definitive calculation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过经验、感官或初步数据对数量、价值或规模进行预估与测算。

groups.name: Mediate & Intercede · 调解与求情 (Intervene, Arbitrate, Plead)
groups.tip: 从中斡旋化解双方矛盾争端

items.def_en: To become involved in a conflict or difficult situation to help resolve it or prevent problems.
(+ with/for) To make an urgent, emotional, and humble request on behalf of someone.
To intentionally become involved in a difficult situation in order to improve it or prevent it from worsening.
To try to end a disagreement between two or more people or groups by acting as a neutral go-between.
To speak to someone in authority on behalf of another person to settle a dispute or ask for mercy.
To officially judge and settle a dispute between two opposing parties after hearing both sides.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe stepping into a conflict or crisis on behalf of another party or to reconcile opposing sides. While 'intercede' emphasizes pleading for mercy or favor, verbs like 'mediate' and 'arbitrate' focus on neutral dispute resolution, and 'intervene' denotes decisive involvement.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及介入纠纷调解或代人求情，强调居中撮合或施加影响。

groups.name: Meet & Encounter · 遭遇与邂逅 (Encounter, Run into, Come up against)
groups.tip: 偶遇或正面交锋遭遇

items.def_en: To encounter someone unexpectedly when going about your day
To discover or meet someone or something purely by chance

items.def_zh: 偶然碰见，邂逅；遭遇（困难）
items.def_en: To meet someone by chance, or experience unexpected difficulties
1. To experience or come up against something difficult, unpleasant, or dangerous. 2. To meet someone unexpectedly.

items.def_zh: 遭遇，面对（严重阻碍或反对）
items.def_en: To be faced with serious opposition, an adversary, or a formidable obstacle
To face an unpleasant or challenging situation, fact, or person directly

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on coming into contact with individuals or adverse situations, predominantly unexpectedly or without prior design. Key contrasts distinguish stumbling upon an old acquaintance from facing formidable obstacles or enemies.
groups.summary_zh: 指偶然邂逅某人，或在行进与办事中迎面遭遇困难、阻碍与对抗。

groups.name: Mellow & Soften · 缓和与熟化 (Soften, Subdue, Season)
groups.tip: 褪去青涩尖锐，变得温和醇厚

items.def_en: To mature or make someone or something experienced and fit over an extended period
To become or make less severe, harsh, or rigid in attitude, tone, or appearance
1. To become softer, richer, or calmer with age or experience.
To develop fully and acquire a richer, more rounded quality or flavor over time
To make something less extreme or harsh, usually by balancing it with another quality
To soften the tone, light, or intensity of something, making it calmer and less striking

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe individuals, substances, or flavors losing their harshness, sharpness, or aggression over time, becoming gentle, rich, and balanced through maturation or experience.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘性情、风味或事物随岁月历练褪去锋芒、趋于温和醇厚的熟化过程。

groups.name: Melt & Liquefy · 融化与液化 (Melt, Liquefy, Thaw, Deliquesce)
groups.tip: 受热相变由固转液

items.def_en: change from a solid, frozen state to a liquid state by absorbing heat
become liquid by absorbing moisture directly from the ambient atmosphere
incorporate solid particles into a liquid solute until an even liquid solution forms
join or liquefy components together using intense heat
pass from a frozen to a liquid or unfrozen state as the temperature rises
to become liquid, or to turn a solid or gas into a liquid by heating, pressure, or condensation

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses thermodynamic and physical phase transitions where solids or compressed gases convert into liquids through heat, pressure changes, or ambient exposure. It also extends metaphorically to softening of resolve or sentiment.
groups.summary_zh: 指固态物质或气体在受热、受压或受潮后转变为液相的相变过程。

groups.name: Mesmerize & Transfix · 蛊惑与催眠 (Hypnotize, Mesmerize, Entranced, Captivate)
groups.tip: 心神被牢牢摄取与迷住

items.def_en: attract and hold the interest and affection of someone completely through irresistible charm
hold the complete attention of someone as if by an irresistible hypnotic spell
fill someone with wonder and delight, putting them into an altered, dreamlike state
hold someone's rapt attention completely, as if under an enchanted trance
to put someone into a state of hypnosis; to fascinate or charm someone so completely that they cannot look away or think clearly
cause someone to become completely motionless with astonishment, awe, or horror

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote capturing a person's conscious attention so completely that they enter a trance-like, receptive, or frozen state. The effect can be clinical hypnosis or an irresistible psychological state induced by fascination, beauty, or charisma.
groups.summary_zh: 指以超常魅力或催眠手段使人完全着迷、注意力停滞如入迷宫的心理状态。

groups.name: Military Occupation & Conquest · 占领与据守 (Capture, Garrison, Take over)
groups.tip: 以武力占据领地或掌控要冲

items.def_en: To assume dominant control, command, or ownership over a physical area or organization

items.def_zh: （武力）占领；占用（空间或时间）；使忙碌
items.def_en: 1. To enter and take control of a country, town, or area by military force. 2. To fill, exist in, or use a space, area, or period of time. 3. To keep someone busy or occupied.
To station soldiers in a town or fort to defend and retain sovereign control of it
To gain control of an enemy town, outpost, or position by armed combat or tactical maneuver
To take hold of a strategic location or seat of power suddenly and aggressively
To incorporate a territory or province into an existing political state, usually by force

groups.summary_en: This frame covers martial or authoritative acts of seizing control of a territory, installation, or building and maintaining control over it. Frequent collocates include territory, capital, stronghold, and base.
groups.summary_zh: 指凭借武力或控制力夺取并驻守领土、要塞或设施。

groups.name: Misguide & Deceive · 误导与引向歧途 (Mislead, Deceive, Delude)
groups.tip: 从引向歧途到蓄意诓骗

items.def_en: To cause someone to make a mistake, form an erroneous judgment, or wander from moral conduct
To cause someone to believe something that is not true by giving false information or leaving out key facts

items.def_zh: 误导，错误引导；寄错，指错方向
items.def_en: 1. To guide, direct, or channel someone or something into the wrong course or target. 2. To put the wrong address on a letter or parcel.
To deceive or trick someone, often by disguise, pretense, or cunning manipulation
To deliberately make someone believe something false in order to gain an advantage
To deceive someone into holding an irrational, false, or foolish belief

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing someone to follow a false path, adopt incorrect assumptions, or succumb to deliberate deception. They range from diversionary steering to outright intentional falsehood.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人引向错误方向、传达虚假认知或进行蓄意欺骗与误导。

groups.name: Misinterpret & Misjudge · 误解与曲解 (Misinterpret, Distort, Misread)
groups.tip: 歪曲解读原意酿成偏差

items.def_en: To fail to understand someone or something correctly
To understand or explain the meaning of something incorrectly
To understand the intent or signs of a situation, person, or text incorrectly
To alter or misrepresent the true meaning of someone's words or actions unfairly
To interpret or understand words, actions, or motives incorrectly.
To change facts, ideas, or statements so that they give a false or misleading impression

groups.summary_en: This cognitive frame involves interpreting statements, actions, or evidence incorrectly, either through honest perceptual error or deliberate, tendentious distortion. Verbs highlight failure to grasp intent or the twisting of original meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖因误读、判断失误或刻意曲解而未能正确领会事实原意的动词。

groups.name: Mismanage & Botch · 笨拙处理与处置不当 (Mismanage, Botch, Bungle)
groups.tip: 操持应对日常治理

items.def_zh: 处理不当，管理不善；粗暴对待，乱翻乱搬
items.def_en: 1. To manage or deal with a situation, task, or responsibility clumsily, carelessly, or incompetently. 2. To handle something roughly or clumsily.
To handle something badly or make a serious mistake that ruins a plan
To handle a delicate problem or situation awkwardly or indecisively
To organize or manage an organization or affair badly or incompetently
To spoil something by doing it badly, clumsily, or carelessly
To carry out a task clumsily or incompetently, leading to embarrassing failure

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on handling a delicate situation, project, or task in an incompetent, clumsy, or negligent manner that creates chaos or failure.
groups.summary_zh: 指因无能、疏忽或笨拙而错误处置事务，导致局面恶化或搞砸。

groups.name: Mistreat & Torment · 虐待与苛待 (Maltreat, Mistreat, Abuse, Torment)
groups.tip: 残忍对待或给予身心摧残

items.def_en: treat someone or an animal cruelly or carelessly, causing unnecessary suffering
treat a person or animal badly, cruelly, or unfairly over time
inflict severe physical, verbal, or emotional harm on someone within one's care or custody
subject someone repeatedly to excruciating mental agony or persistent physical distress
(formal) to treat a person or animal cruelly, violently, or unkindly
treat with extreme, savage physical violence that dehumanizes the victim

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on inflicting cruel, physically violent, or psychological suffering upon persons or animals who are under one's power. It highlights the sustained, malevolent, and abusive nature of the conduct across interpersonal, domestic, and institutional contexts.
groups.summary_zh: 指对人或动物进行身体伤害、言语侮辱或精神折磨等残酷苛待行为。

groups.name: Moisten & Hydrate · 湿润与补水 (Moisten, Dampen, Wet)
groups.tip: 补充水分保持滋润状态

items.def_en: To cover, saturate, or touch something with water or other liquid
To increase the level of moisture or water vapor in air or an enclosure
1. To supply or absorb water to maintain adequate moisture in the body, skin, or other substances. 2. (chemistry) To combine chemically with water.
To moisten lightly with liquid without thoroughly soaking
To apply an oily or moist substance to reduce friction and dryness
To make something slightly wet, supple, or damp

groups.summary_en: Covers adding water, liquid, or moisture to skin, body tissues, or dry objects to prevent dehydration and soften them.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过补充水分或喷洒液体使物体、皮肤等保持润泽或湿润。

groups.name: Moisten & Soak · 浸润与浸泡 (Dampen, Wet, Bedew)
groups.tip: 水分沾染使其潮湿

items.def_en: To cover, saturate, or touch something with water or other liquid
To increase the level of moisture or water vapor in air or an enclosed space
To wet or sprinkle a surface lightly with drops of liquid or dew
To clean or moisten an area lightly using a wet sponge
To make something slightly wet or humid
to make something slightly wet, or to become slightly wet

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe applying a controlled or mild amount of liquid to a surface or substance to eliminate dryness without totally drenching it.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加适量液体使物体表面或内部微湿、解燥，但未达到湿透程度。

groups.name: Monopolize & Selfish Usurpation · 独占与自私侵吞 (Hog, Monopolize, Corner)
groups.tip: 贪婪独占不与他人分享

items.def_en: To acquire enough of a commodity or market share to control its commercial supply and price
To take possession of something, often without right or permission, for one's exclusive use
To selfishly hold on to or consume an item rather than sharing it with peers
To obtain exclusive possession or complete control of an asset, conversation, or market
(informal) to take or use more than your share of something selfishly so that others cannot use it
To seize and hold power, position, or rights wrongfully and forcefully

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote taking, holding, or consuming disproportionate control or ownership of shared resources, space, or opportunities out of self-interest. They highlight exclusive appropriation that denies fair access to others.
groups.summary_zh: 指自私或专横地侵占、独揽共享资源、空间或话语权，排斥他人分享。

groups.name: Mouth & Mutter · 口型发音与机械含糊言说 (Mutter, Lip, Murmur)
groups.tip: 从动嘴发声到组织语言表达

items.def_en: To shape words silently with the lips without phonating any audible sound.

items.def_zh: 说出，用言辞表达；用口型不出声地说；口是心非地说
items.def_en: 1. To express or utter words, especially pompously or insincerely. 2. To form words with the lips without making any sound.
To utter words indistinctly so that others struggle to understand them.
To speak in a low, unclear voice with near-closed lips, often in complaint.
To repeat words without understanding them or with no genuine personal thought.

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休，假大空地说出
items.def_en: To speak or utter opinions pompously, repetitively, and in great quantities.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail non-standard speech production—either articulating words silently with the lips, chanting insincere platitudes, or muttering indistinctly under breath.
groups.summary_zh: 无声对口型、敷衍假意言说，或闭唇低声嘟哝含混发音的言语形态。

groups.name: Move Gently & Inch Along · 轻移与挪动 (Edge, Inch, Nudge, Worm)
groups.tip: 谨慎缓慢地一点点向前挪

items.def_zh: 轻移，小心缓慢地挪动；减轻，缓和
items.def_en: 1. To move gently, carefully, and slowly into or out of a position. 2. To become less severe, or make something less difficult or painful.

items.def_zh: 侧身缓缓移动；逐步挪动
items.def_en: to move slowly and carefully, often sideways or by tiny degrees
to move or make something move very slowly and in very small increments
to push someone or something gently, gradually coaxing them into a specific position
to move oneself slowly and cautiously through a crowded or restricted gap
to move smoothly and quickly or wriggle with a slight swaying motion through a narrow space

groups.summary_en: Refers to moving oneself or an object gradually, carefully, and slowly in order to avoid damage, detection, or physical strain. These verbs emphasize cautious navigation through tight physical spaces or delicate situations.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以极其谨慎、微小且缓慢的动作轻挪入位或避开阻碍。

groups.name: Murmur & Coo · 呢喃与温声软语 (Whisper, Purr, Breathe)
groups.tip: 柔和轻声倾诉或甜蜜呢喃

items.def_en: To utter words very softly and with warmth into someone's ear
To speak very quietly, using breath rather than the vocal cords

items.raw_cluster: 轻声细语与呢喃 Murmur & Coo
items.def_zh: 轻柔低语，温柔地说；（鸽子等）咕咕叫
items.def_en: 1. To speak in a soft, gentle, and loving voice. 2. (of a dove or pigeon) To make a soft low murmur.
To say something in a soft, low, barely audible voice
To speak quietly and in a low voice that is difficult to hear clearly

items.def_zh: 娇声而言；猫般轻柔发声
items.def_en: To speak in a smooth, quiet, pleasantly seductive tone

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses vocalizations delivered in a hushed, gentle, affectionate, or soothing register, typically conveying intimacy, tenderness, or comforting reassurance.
groups.summary_zh: 指用极为轻柔、深情或娇嗔的低音细语，传达温存与安抚。

groups.name: Muzzle & Silence · 压制与封口 (Gag, Silence, Stifle)
groups.tip: 给言论戴上口套强行压制

items.def_en: To tell or signal someone to be quiet, often by saying 'shh'
To stop talking, making noise, or shouting, especially when ordered to do so

items.def_zh: 扼杀；压抑；阻止（言论或表达）
items.def_en: To suppress, quell, or smother an utterance, opinion, or impulse before it can fully form
To stop someone from expressing their views, criticisms, or opposition
To prevent someone from speaking freely or disseminating information, often via legal orders or force

items.def_zh: 钳制，剥夺…发表言论的自由；给（动物）戴口套
items.def_en: 1. To prevent a person, group, or the media from expressing opinions freely. 2. To put a muzzle over the nose and mouth of an animal.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe coercive interventions aimed at preventing speech, public dissent, whistleblowing, or free expression by force or political suppression.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重于运用权势、法律或暴力手段强行封堵言论、压制发声。

groups.name: Object & Protest · 反对与抗议 (Object, Dissent, Kick Against)
groups.tip: 从提出异议到公开抗议反对

items.def_en: (+ to) To state that you do not approve of or agree with a plan, decision, or situation.
To show anger, resistance, or defiance toward rules or constraints that limit you.
(+ against) To declare one's opposition or criticism openly and publicly.

items.def_zh: 持异议，公开表达不赞同
items.def_en: (+ from) To publicly disagree with an official opinion, decision, or doctrine.
To express passionate, vehement condemnation or objection to an injustice.

items.def_zh: 抗议，反对；坚决声明，力辩
items.def_en: 1. To express strong disagreement, disapproval, or objection, especially publicly. 2. (+ that) To state or declare something firmly and emphatically, especially when others doubt it.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote expressing strong, overt disapproval or resistance against decisions, rules, or authority, ranging from formal procedural opposition to vocal public resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对决定或权威的明确反对与抗议，从程序性异议到强烈声讨。

groups.name: Oblige & Behoove · 应当与道义责任 (Ought, Behoove, Incumb)
groups.tip: 基于道义或规则的要求

items.def_en: To be convenient, acceptable, or morally and socially fitting for someone

items.def_zh: 应该，应当（基于道义、职责或常理）
items.def_en: (modal verb, usually followed by 'to') Used to indicate duty, moral obligation, or what is advisable or expected.

items.def_zh: 归属于；落到……头上（指职责）
items.def_en: To fall as a duty, responsibility, or necessity upon someone
To bind legally or morally to a specified course of action
To be suitable or appropriate for a particular status, occasion, or role

items.def_zh: 对……而言有必要/理所应当
items.def_en: To be incumbent upon, fitting, or necessary as a duty or responsibility (used impersonally, e.g., 'it behooves someone to')

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express moral obligation, propriety, logical necessity, or normative expectation. They range from modal assertions of duty to impersonal, formal expressions denoting that an action is becoming or required of a person in a particular role.
groups.summary_zh: 表达道义义务、合宜性或社会与职务上的理所应当。

groups.name: Obscure & Mask · 遮蔽与隐匿 (Conceal, Veil, Shroud)
groups.tip: 遮掩秘密使其隐没不见

items.def_en: To disguise or hide a feeling, sound, smell, or fact behind another layer
To separate or shelter an area from public view using a screen or barrier
To prevent something from being seen, known, or discovered

items.def_zh: 遮掩，遮蔽；使模糊，使费解
items.def_en: to cover something or block it from view; to make something difficult to see, hear, or understand
To cover something with a layer or mask so as to hide it partly from view
(+ in) To cover or envelop something completely so that it cannot be seen or identified clearly

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on blocking lines of sight or cognitive perception through physical coverings, darkness, or deliberate obfuscation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过实体覆盖物、黑暗或迷局阻隔视线，使之模糊或难以辨识。

groups.name: Observe & Scrutinize · 观察与审视 (Observe, Watch, Scrutinize)
groups.tip: 集中精力长久持续注视

items.def_en: To watch someone or something carefully, ensuring safety or guarding against wrongdoing
To look at someone or something for a period of time, paying close attention to developments
To keep track of and observe the progress or quality of something systematically over time

items.def_zh: 观察，注视；注意到；遵守（规则、习俗等）；评论
items.def_en: 1. To watch someone or something carefully. 2. To notice or perceive something. 3. To obey a rule, law, or custom. 4. To make a formal remark or comment.
To look closely or intently at someone or something, often assessing them directly
To inspect, examine, or look at someone or something very closely and critically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey focused, sustained visual monitoring and perceptual tracking of an entity over time, either for scientific collection, vigilance, or analytical assessment.
groups.summary_zh: 指对目标进行持续、专注的视觉监测、审视或追踪。

groups.name: Occupy & Colonize · 侵占与殖民 (Colonize, Settle, Subjugate)
groups.tip: 强行占领并建立殖民

items.def_en: Establish a community or colony in a new area, often displacing original inhabitants
Take and maintain military control and presence in a foreign territory
Supply a territory or region with human inhabitants or settlers
Take control of an area or country and formally incorporate it into one's own territory
Bring a people or region completely under domination and political control by force

items.def_zh: 使殖民地化，开拓殖民地；（动植物）大批繁殖于，聚居于
items.def_en: to establish political control over an area and send settlers there; (of plants or animals) to populate a new habitat

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote settling, occupying, or establishing political and territorial control over foreign regions or indigenous populations.
groups.summary_zh: 指国家或群体在领土上定居、占领并建立外来政治控制统治。

groups.name: Offer & Tender · 给予与正式递交 (Tender, Proffer, Present)
groups.tip: 主动呈递或赋予他人

items.def_en: To formally give, submit, or hand over something to somebody at a ceremony or official encounter
(chiefly UK) To submit a motion, proposal, or document formally for discussion at a meeting
To offer or impart a gesture such as hospitality, an invitation, or formal sympathy
To submit an official document, letter of resignation, or piece of work to an authority

items.def_zh: 正式提出，呈递；投标；（法官等）裁定给予
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To offer or present something formally for acceptance. 2. (business) To make a formal offer to supply goods or do a job at a stated price.

items.def_zh: 提供；端上；提出（建议/辞呈）
items.def_en: To hold out something to someone for acceptance, or to put forward advice or explanations courteously

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this formal transaction frame involve offering, presenting, or proffering an asset, payment, bid, or resignation for someone else's formal evaluation or acceptance. They emphasize formal protocol, deference, or contractual procedures.
groups.summary_zh: 指按照正式程序或以庄重态度呈递、提出财物、辞呈或建议以供接纳。

groups.name: Official Scheduling & Allocation · 预定日程与指派敲定 (Slate, Timetable, Earmark)
groups.tip: 列入候选名单或既定日程

items.def_en: To arrange or plan that an event will take place at a particular designated time
To officially choose someone or something to hold a specific office or purpose
To make a tentative, provisional arrangement for a meeting or appointment
To plan and set the definitive time and schedule of an operation or project

items.def_zh: 预定，指定，把……列入计划；严厉批评
items.def_en: 1. (often passive, chiefly North American) to schedule, plan, or designate someone or something for a particular event or role. 2. (chiefly British) to criticize severely
(+ for) To designate or set aside funds, resources, or items for a specific predetermined purpose

groups.summary_en: This administrative frame denotes formally scheduling events, earmarking resources, or nominating candidates for future duties and roles. The verbs emphasize structured institutional planning, programmed arrangements, and prospective appointments.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重官方、行政或组织层面上对时间表、项目安排、资金用途或候选人的正式预订指派。

groups.name: Operate & Run · 运转与操纵 (Operate, Run, Pilot)
groups.tip: 操控机械并保持其正常运转

items.def_en: to operate, handle, or manipulate a tool, machine, or lever
to cause a machine to function or to manage the daily business of an organization

items.def_zh: 运转，运行；操作，操控；经营；动手术
items.def_en: 1. To work, function, or control a machine or system. 2. To manage or run a business or organization. 3. (+ on) To perform surgery.
to manage, control, or operate a machine or vehicle with skill

items.def_zh: 驾驶；操纵（飞行器或船只）
items.def_en: to operate the controls of an aircraft, vessel, or complex vehicle
to direct and steer the course of an aircraft, ship, or vehicular system

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on an agent actively controlling, directing, or driving the mechanisms of machinery, vehicles, equipment, or business organizations.
groups.summary_zh: 指主体主动操纵设备、驾驶交通工具或掌管企业业务运营。

groups.name: Optical & Metaphorical Reflection · 映照与映射 (Reflect, Mirror)
groups.tip: 镜面水面反射光线影像

items.def_zh: 映照，照出；反射（光、热或声音）；反映，显示；深思，反省
items.def_en: 1. To show the image of someone or something on a shiny surface. 2. To throw back light, heat, or sound from a surface. 3. To show, express, or be a sign of something. 4. To think deeply about something.
To show the reflection of someone or something; to reflect or resemble closely.
to repeat or closely resemble something else in appearance, quality, or sentiment
to reflect or throw back light, heat, or an image from a surface
(+ sth) reflect light, sound, or an image back from a surface
(+ sth) reflect light, heat, or an image from an optical surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting an optical surface throwing back an image or light, or metaphorically matching, reproducing, or echoing characteristics and realities faithfully.
groups.summary_zh: 指光线或镜面映射出物象，或比喻性地忠实折射、映现真实面貌。

groups.name: Optimize & Maximize · 优化与效能最大化 (Maximize, Rationalize, Streamline)
groups.tip: 优化升级调整至最佳

items.def_en: To inspect, adjust, and optimize an engine, machine, or operational procedure
To exploit an existing resource, asset, or advantage to maximum benefit
To increase something to the highest possible degree, value, or amount

items.def_zh: 优化，使达到最佳状态；充分利用
items.def_en: 1. To make something as good, effective, or efficient as possible.
To adapt a system to run with maximum efficiency and minimum waste
To make an organization, system, or process more effective by reorganizing it logically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe tuning processes, operations, or systems to achieve maximal operational efficiency, minimal waste, and optimal strategic outcome.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过系统化调整使效能、资源利用或产出达到最优或极致。

groups.name: Oral & Forced Ejection · 吐出与喷射 (Spew, Eject, Spurt)
groups.tip: 由口中吐出或向外强力喷溅

items.def_en: Expel mucus, blood, or foreign matter from the respiratory tract by coughing

items.def_zh: 吐出（唾沫、食物等）；喷出，喷射；下毛毛雨
items.def_en: 1. To force saliva, food, or liquid out of your mouth; to eject liquid or sparks forcefully. 2. (impersonal) To rain very lightly.
Force or throw something out violently, suddenly, or automatically
Eject the contents of the stomach involuntarily through the mouth
Expel large quantities of liquid, gas, or vomit rapidly and violently
Gush out in a sudden, forceful stream or burst through a narrow opening

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the rapid, forceful discharge of liquids, substances, or particles from the mouth, orifice, or containment vessel under pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 指从口中或孔口强力排挤、吐出、喷射或喷溅液体与杂物。

groups.name: Orate & Declaim · 演说与激昂高论 (Declaim, Pontificate, Harangue)
groups.tip: 正式登台发表演说或阐述

items.def_en: (+ on/about) To talk lengthily and opinionatedly about a topic to listeners

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地说；喷出空话
items.def_en: To speak a lot in an unthinking, tedious, or pretentious manner

items.def_zh: 发表演说，致辞；高谈阔论
items.def_en: 1. (formal or humorous) To make a formal, often pompous or lengthy public speech.
To speak rhetorically, eloquently, or pompously with dramatic passion

items.def_zh: 武断地说；自以为是地发表高见
items.def_en: To express opinions or deliver speeches in a pompous, dogmatic, or condescending way

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地训话；大声质问
items.def_en: To speak to someone loudly, aggressively, and at great length, often criticizing them

groups.summary_en: Verbs here portray rhetorical delivery characterized by elevated tone, bombastic theatricality, high formality, or self-important pontification before an audience.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有夸张、激昂、做作或自以为是腔调的高谈阔论。

groups.name: Order & Mandate · 命令与指示 (Require, Direct, Instruct)
groups.tip: 上级发布具有约束力的指令

items.def_en: To make something necessary according to an official rule, regulation, or law
To give an official order or instruction to a person or organization to take a specific action

items.def_zh: 强制命令，规定；授权，委托统治
items.def_en: 1. To officially order, demand, or require something by law or policy. 2. To give official authority or a legal mandate to someone to act.
To state officially that a particular rule, procedure, or action must be followed
To formally tell someone what they must do, often in an administrative or operational context
To officially instruct or urge someone with authority to perform a duty or refrain from an action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the exercise of institutional authority to dictate actions, set policies, or compel compliance. While 'mandate' emphasizes binding official requirements, related verbs range from direct supervisory instruction to legal compulsion.
groups.summary_zh: 通过制度或行政权力下达指令、规定行为或强制执行要求。

groups.name: Originate & Stem · 源自与发端 (Originate, Arise, Spring)
groups.tip: 溯源事物的根基发端

items.def_en: (+ from) To originate, grow, or burst forth rapidly from a root or cause
1. (+ from) To originate, develop, or have root in something. 2. To stop or restrict the flow, spread, or increase of something.
(+ from) To trace one's root, origin, or lineage back to a foundational source
(+ from/out of) To come into existence or develop as a result of something
(+ in/from) To have a specified beginning, creator, or geographical origin
(+ from) To issue, spread out, or originate from a central source or authority

groups.summary_en: Covers having an ultimate point of beginning, cause, or derivation from a particular condition, root, or source.
groups.summary_zh: 强调事物以某一事件、原因或环境为发端、根源或衍生源头。

groups.name: Outlive & Survive · 比…长寿与存活 (Outlive, Survive, Outlast)
groups.tip: 度过劫难且寿命超过他人

items.def_en: To continue to live despite extreme hardship, aging, or after the loss of loved ones
To live, endure, or remain functional longer than someone or something else
To last longer than another entity or to endure beyond a designated lifetime

items.def_zh: 渡过难关；（大病或重伤后）活过来
items.def_en: To survive a severe, life-threatening illness, injury, or critical ordeal
To continue to live or exist, especially after a dangerous event or after someone else has died

items.def_zh: 比…长寿；比…活得长，比…延续得久；度过（难关）而健在
items.def_en: 1. To live longer than another person; to remain alive or in existence after something has ceased.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe living longer than another individual or continuing to endure and persist beyond a critical disaster, traumatic event, or historical era.
groups.summary_zh: 指在寿命上长于他人，或在危险、创伤及灾难中存活幸免。

groups.name: Overcharge & Fleece · 多收与敲诈 (Rip off, Fleece, Gouge)
groups.tip: 提供服务后索要相应费用

items.def_en: To cheat someone by charging them far too much money for something
To give someone back less money than they are owed as change, or to treat them unfairly
To charge someone an unexpectedly large or unfair amount of money
To take a lot of money from someone by charging them too much or cheating them
To force someone to pay an unethically high or inflated price, especially in a crisis
1. To ask someone to pay too much money for goods or services.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe demanding an unfairly high price or swindling someone financially. They range from billing errors to predatory price gouging and outright extortion.
groups.summary_zh: 指漫天要价、索取过高费用或在交易中敲诈勒索顾客。

groups.name: Overdraw & Overspend · 透支与超支 (Overspend, Run Up, Exceed)
groups.tip: 支出超出限额或账户余额

items.def_en: To spend part of a fund or savings reserve that was not initially meant to be used
To spend more money than an opponent, competitor, or prior allocation
To spend more money than is budgeted, available, or prudent

items.def_zh: 透支（银行账户）；夸大，夸张
items.def_en: 1. (banking) To take more money out of a bank account than it contains. 2. To exaggerate or overstate something.

items.def_zh: 刷爆（信用卡）；达到信用上限
items.def_en: To reach the utmost spending limit on a credit card or line of credit
To allow debts, bills, or deficits to accumulate quickly to a high total

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate exhausting monetary reserves, spending beyond allocated budgets, or drawing more funds or resources than one actually possesses.
groups.summary_zh: 花费超过预算额度，或向账户和资源进行透支借贷。

groups.name: Overhang & Loom · 突出与悬压 (Protrude, Project, Impend)
groups.tip: 自高处悬空挂着或覆于上方

items.def_en: To extend outward or upward beyond an edge or line

items.def_zh: 悬垂于…之上，突出在…上方；逼近，笼罩
items.def_en: To stick out or hang over something below; (figurative) to loom or threaten ominously.
To be suspended above something; (figurative) to threaten or cause anxiety continually
To stick out or extend outward beyond the main surface or edge
To thrust or bulge forward and stick out from the surrounding surface
To appear as a large, shadowy, often menacing shape hanging or rising above

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict structures or geological features jutting forward or hanging out above an area below. Figuratively, they describe threats or solemn fates hovering menacingly overhead.
groups.summary_zh: 物体向外突出悬于上方，或危险与阴影沉重笼罩。

groups.name: Overreact & Lose Composure · 反应失度与过激 (Freak Out, Overblow, Go Ballistic)
groups.tip: 对外界刺激做出应答

items.headword: make a mountain out of a molehill
items.lemma: make a mountain out of a molehill
items.def_en: To treat a slight difficulty or minor incident as a serious disaster.

items.def_zh: 灾难化想象，往最坏处惊慌反应
items.def_en: To present or view an unfavorable event as being completely disastrous.
To suddenly lose one's temper and shout angrily at someone.
To become crazily excited, furious, or shocked beyond self-control.

items.def_zh: 吓坏，情绪失控大发雷霆
items.def_en: To become extremely agitated, frightened, or irrationally angry over a situation.
To react more strongly, angrily, or emotionally than a situation justifies.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures responding to events or news with disproportionate emotion, panic, or anger far beyond what the circumstances warrant.
groups.summary_zh: 情绪或言行反应过激，表现出远超实际事态的慌乱、愤怒或夸张态度。

groups.name: Overspread & Blanket · 蔓延覆盖与笼罩 (Blanket, Overspread, Suffuse)
groups.tip: 物质在表面大面积铺开与遮盖

items.def_en: To spread slowly, quietly, and imperceptibly across a landscape or person's face

items.def_zh: 厚厚铺满；像地毯般覆盖
items.def_en: To cover a ground or floor densely with an even layer of vegetation, snow, or petals

items.def_zh: 布满；充盈（指光线、色彩或液体）
items.def_en: To spread gradually through or over a surface, especially with light, color, or fluid
(literary) To spread over and cover a surface or area completely.

items.def_zh: 厚厚覆盖；如毯子般铺满
items.def_en: To cover completely with a thick, uniform layer of snow, fog, leaves, or silence
To sweep over and swallow up completely, as by water, flames, or catastrophe

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive, widespread extension of a layer (such as clouds, snow, color, or feelings) across a wide expanse, resulting in complete, even coverage.
groups.summary_zh: 指云彩、积雪或色彩在广阔表面上徐徐漫延并全面覆盖。

groups.name: Overwork & Burn Out · 耗损与劳累过度 (Overwork, Overstrain, Burn out, Run down)
groups.tip: 用力过度导致筋疲力尽

items.def_en: to cause someone's health, vitality, or immune resistance to deteriorate from fatigue
to exhaust someone thoroughly through sustained physical exertion
to become completely exhausted and ineffective as a result of long-term work stress
to subject a muscle, body part, or mental faculty to more tension or effort than is safe
to make excessive demands on someone's physical strength, cognitive capacity, or endurance

items.def_zh: 使用力过度，过度消耗（常用于反身代词）
items.def_en: (overexert oneself) To push oneself too hard physically or mentally, causing strain or exhaustion.

groups.summary_en: Centers on pushing the human body or nervous system past physiological boundaries, inducing acute physical injury, fatigue, or nervous breakdown through excess strain.
groups.summary_zh: 指过度透支身心机能以至引发疲竭、肌肉劳损或生理崩溃。

groups.name: Pamper & Spoil · 娇惯与纵容 (Indulge, Mollycoddle, Cosset)
groups.tip: 悉心溺爱或过度纵容娇惯

items.def_en: To allow someone to have or do whatever they want, especially without restraint
To harm someone's character, especially a child's, by excessive leniency or endless gifts
To care for and protect someone in an overindulgent and sheltering way
To indulge with every attention, comfort, and kindness, often excessively

items.def_zh: 娇惯，溺爱，过度呵护；用文火煮（蛋）
items.def_en: 1. To treat someone with excessive care and protect them too much. 2. (cooking) To cook eggs gently in water just below boiling.
To treat someone with excessive indulgence and overprotectiveness, making them soft

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on treating someone with exaggerated attentiveness, gentle shielding, or excessive leniency. The actions often carry a negative connotation of weakening self-reliance or ruining character through overprotection.
groups.summary_zh: 强调过度呵护、溺爱或百依百顺，常隐含削弱独立性或惯坏脾气之意。

groups.name: Pander & Cater · 迎合与阿谀 (Pander, Cater, Truckle)
groups.tip: 无底线逢迎迁就低俗需求

items.def_en: to provide what someone wants or needs, often catering to lower or vulgar tastes
to direct one's efforts at pleasing a particular group or exploiting their biases

items.def_zh: 迎合，曲从，讨好（低俗或不合理的要求）
items.def_en: ('pander to') (disapproving) To satisfy someone's unreasonable wishes, prejudices, or immoral desires in order to gain an advantage.
(+ to) to flatter or defer to someone in authority for personal advantage
(+ to) to submit obsequiously or yield servilely to someone else's demands
(+ to) to show excessive deference or subservience in order to gain favor

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe yielding to, gratifying, or exploiting the base desires, prejudices, or demands of others, often compromising personal integrity or higher standards in the process.
groups.summary_zh: 指为讨好他人或谋取利益而曲意迎合其低级趣味或无理要求。

groups.name: Parade & Strut · 游行与大摇大摆 (Strut, Swagger, Prance)
groups.tip: 高调走动引人注目

items.def_en: To walk with measured, rhythmic steps, often as part of an organized procession or protest

items.def_zh: 游行，招摇过市；炫耀，大肆展示
items.def_en: 1. To walk or march in a procession or stride around ostentatiously to be seen. 2. To display or flaunt something proudly in order to impress others.

items.def_zh: 腾跃；大摇大摆欢快地走
items.def_en: To walk with exaggerated, bouncy, or flamboyant movements to show off

items.def_zh: 轻盈招摇地走；摆动身体走
items.def_en: To walk with exaggerated hip movements or flamboyant grace to attract notice

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆走；高傲地踱步
items.def_en: To walk with a proud, stiff, and self-important gait intended to attract attention

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步；神气活现地走
items.def_en: To walk in a confident, boastful, or arrogantly aggressive manner

groups.summary_en: Covers ostentatious, proud, or ritualized walking intended to impress, show off status, or display oneself to onlookers.
groups.summary_zh: 指为引人注目或展现傲慢、自信而大摇大摆、昂首阔步地走动。

groups.name: Paraphrase & Reword · 转述与重述 (Rephrase, Restate, Recast)
groups.tip: 换用不同词句重新阐述

items.def_en: To express what someone else has said or written using different words, especially to simplify it
To say or write something again in different words to make it clearer
To express something again using different words to make it clearer or more appropriate.
To present or explain a concept or problem in a different way or from a new perspective
To formulate or present an argument, sentence, or structure in a completely new form
To state an opinion, fact, or argument again, often in a clearer or more emphatic way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate expressing an existing statement, idea, or text in different words to improve clarity, adjust tone, or ensure mutual understanding.
groups.summary_zh: 指用不同措辞对原意进行重新表达，以求更清晰、得体或明确。

groups.name: Pat & Stroke · 轻拍与抚摩 (Pet, Caress, Fondle)
groups.tip: 用手掌轻柔接触、拍打或抚摸

items.def_en: To touch or hit gently and repeatedly with the flat part of the hand.
To touch or stroke an animal or child in a friendly, gentle manner
To move the hand or fingers gently and repeatedly over a surface, skin, or fur
To press fingers or a palm against something and move it back and forth
To touch or stroke someone or something gently and lovingly
To touch or stroke someone or something lovingly, gently, or sexually

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote affectionate, comforting, or calming tactile gestures made with the open palm or fingers gliding across someone or an animal.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手掌或手指轻抚、爱抚或温和触碰以示温情与安慰。

groups.name: Pawn & Collateralize · 典当与抵押借贷 (Pawn, Mortgage, Pledge)
groups.tip: 以财物作担保质押借款

items.def_zh: 抵押（房产或土地）以获取贷款
items.def_en: to offer property or real estate as security to a lender for a loan
to leave something valuable with a creditor as a formal guarantee that a debt will be paid

items.def_zh: 签字放弃/质押（权利或财产）
items.def_en: (+ sth) give up ownership or claim to property or assets by signing a legal document

items.def_zh: 提供（资产）作为抵押/担保
items.def_en: (+ sth) provide property, valuables, or funds as collateral or security for a loan
To leave an object of value with a pawnbroker in exchange for borrowed money.
(informal) to pawn an item at a pawnshop to borrow quick money

groups.summary_en: This commercial domain involves a debtor transferring an asset, property deed, or personal possession to a lender as security for a loan, facing forfeiture if unpaid. 'Pawn' and 'hock' typically involve small physical valuables deposited at a shop, whereas 'mortgage' involves real estate.
groups.summary_zh: 以财物或不动产作为债务担保交付债权人以换取借款。

groups.name: Persist & Persevere · 坚持与隐忍 (Persevere, Persist, Endure)
groups.tip: 意志坚定百折不挠

items.def_en: To persevere and survive during a challenging, exhausting, or critical crisis

items.def_zh: 奋力推进；坚定继续走下去
items.def_en: To continue moving forward or working in a determined, focused way despite obstacles
(+ in/with) To continue firmly in an opinion or course of action in spite of difficulty, opposition, or failure

items.def_zh: 硬挺下去；迎难而上坚持
items.def_en: To continue doing something with fortitude even when conditions are painful, boring, or difficult
To undergo and suffer hardship, suffering, or misfortune patiently without yielding

items.def_zh: 坚持不懈，百折不挠，不屈不挠
items.def_en: (+ with/in) To continue trying to achieve something difficult despite obstacles, delays, or failure.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers maintaining an effort, course of action, or belief over a prolonged duration despite hardships, discouragement, pain, or outright opposition. Persist highlights unrelenting continuance (sometimes obstinate), while persevere accentuates moral grit and tenacity against odds.
groups.summary_zh: 指在困境、阻力或痛苦面前坚持不懈、隐忍挺住。

groups.name: Peruse & Pore Over · 审阅与精读 (Pore over, Scrutinize, Wade through)
groups.tip: 逐字逐句仔细审视阅读

items.def_en: To turn the pages of a book, document, or magazine quickly without reading completely
To spend a lot of time and effort reading something lengthy, boring, or difficult
To read or examine something carefully, thoroughly, and in detail.
To search through documents or text thoroughly in order to find specific information
To read or study something very carefully and attentively for a long period
To examine someone or something with tremendous care and thoroughness

groups.summary_en: This frame captures manner-of-reading verbs involving deep cognitive engagement, concentrated visual focus, and exhaustive textual examination.
groups.summary_zh: 高度专注、极为细致地阅读、审阅或研读文本。

groups.name: Phase & Stage · 分期推进与阶段实施 (Phase, Stage, Stagger)
groups.tip: 按项目节点分阶段逐步推行

items.def_en: To arrange, organize, and carry out a complex activity or project in distinct progressive steps
To carry out, introduce, or discontinue something in gradual, planned stages.
To introduce a new system, regulation, or process gradually in planned stages
To withdraw, stop, or discontinue something gradually over an extended period
To launch or make a new product, system, or policy officially available to successive groups
To arrange events, working hours, or procedures so they occur at alternating or intervals

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to executing, deploying, or withdrawing a project, service, or policy in deliberate, sequential intervals rather than all at once, managing disruption and resource pacing.
groups.summary_zh: 指按时间表或顺序分步骤、分批次推进或撤出项目。

groups.name: Pilfer & Petty Theft · 偷窃与小偷小摸 (Pilfer, Filch, Pinch)
groups.tip: 顺手牵羊秘密盗取商铺物品

items.def_en: To steal items inconspicuously from a person, pocket, or store
To take something without permission, especially something small or unimportant

items.def_zh: 在商店顺手牵羊，入店行窃
items.def_en: To steal goods from a shop or store while pretending to be a customer.
To repeatedly steal small amounts of money or things of little value
To steal something of modest value sneakily and casually
To take something dishone﻿stly, often involving a breach of trust or secrecy

groups.summary_en: This frame covers surreptitiously stealing small, inexpensive items or money over time, typically through sneakiness, light fingers, or opportunistic petty theft.
groups.summary_zh: 指悄悄顺走小额财物或零碎物品的偷窃与小摸小偷行为。

groups.name: Plan & Conspire · 谋划与预谋 (Plot, Scheme, Hatch)
groups.tip: 事先构思盘算甚至暗中蓄意图谋

items.def_en: To invent or concoct an excuse, story, or deceptive scheme in order to mislead people.
To make clever, devious, and often dishonest plans to gain an advantage or deceive others.
To create or devise a secret plan, conspiracy, or plot, typically one with bad intentions.
To make a secret, elaborate plan with others to do something illegal, harmful, or subversive.
(+ with/against) To secretly plan with other people to carry out an unlawful, harmful, or treasonous act.
To think about, plan, or intend an action—especially a crime—before committing it.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on deliberate cognitive preparation for future action, especially illicit, harmful, or secretive deeds. Unlike generic planning, 'premeditate' foregrounds legally actionable forethought, while 'plot' and 'conspire' stress deceitful coordination.
groups.summary_zh: 指为实现特定（多含恶意或非法）目的而事先策划与密谋。

groups.name: Plant & Embed · 植入与安插 (Embed, Insert, Lodge)
groups.tip: 深栽入土或安插紧扣内部

items.def_en: Fit smoothly and easily into a narrow opening or planned position
Place, fit, or thrust something carefully into another thing

items.def_zh: 种植，播种；牢固安置，植入；安插，暗中放置
items.def_en: 1. To put seeds, bulbs, or plants into the soil to grow. 2. To place or fix something firmly in a particular position.
Become firmly fixed or embed something firmly in a particular place
Fix an object firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass
Insert tissue, a device, or an idea deeply into a body or mind

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deliberately fixing, inserting, or anchoring an object firmly into a surrounding medium or strategic position, often secretly or permanently. While 'plant' suggests intentional placement or concealment, 'embed' and 'root' emphasize deep physical or conceptual entrenchment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将物体牢固置入、深嵌或隐蔽安插于介质中。

groups.name: Planting & Sowing · 播种与定植 (Plant, Sow, Bed out)
groups.tip: 用点播器打穴并播种苗株

items.def_en: Place a seed, bulb, or young plant in the ground so that it can grow
Plant a seedling or cutting into an individual container or pot

items.def_zh: 把（温室苗）移栽到花坛中
items.def_en: Transfer young garden plants from pots or frames into outdoor garden beds
Dig up a growing plant and plant it again in another place
Plant seeds in or on the ground by scattering or dropping them into furrows

items.def_zh: 用点播器打穴种植（种子或幼苗）
items.def_en: To make holes in the soil with a pointed tool (a dibble) for planting seeds, seedlings, or bulbs.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the physical actions of introducing seeds, bulbs, or young plants into the soil or potting medium to grow. Nuances range from broad surface broadcasting to delicate root-setting and protective planting.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及将种子、幼苗或球茎置入土壤或培育基中的种植操作。

groups.name: Play Truant & Slack · 逃课与旷工 (Bunk, Slack, Malinger)
groups.tip: 偷懒溜号逃避工作职责

items.def_en: To work with less energy, diligence, or seriousness than required, especially when unsupervised

items.def_zh: 旷工，偷懒溜号，逃避职责；削薄（皮革等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ off) (British informal) To avoid work, school, or duty by staying away or leaving early. 2. (leatherwork) To pare, shave, or slice off the surface of leather.
(British informal) To stay away from school or work without permission
To stay away from school or work without explanation or authorization
(informal) To deliberately skip or fail to attend an assigned class, shift, or appointment
To pretend to be sick or incapacitated in order to avoid duties or work

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to illicitly absenting oneself from work or school, wasting working hours, or feigning illness to shirk toil. They are predominantly informal or colloquial register.
groups.summary_zh: 旷工、旷课、摸鱼或装病以躲避日常工作与课业。

groups.name: Plow & Till · 耕作与翻整 (Plow, Till, Cultivate)
groups.tip: 用农具翻整碎土准备播种

items.def_en: Prepare and cultivate land for crops by plowing, harrowing, or hoeing
Dig deep into soil so that the lower layer is brought to the surface
Break up the soil around growing crops or prepare land for planting
Turn up earth with a plow before sowing seeds

items.def_zh: 用耙耕整（土地）；折磨，使极度痛苦
items.def_en: 1. To pull a harrow over ploughed land to break up clods of soil and level the surface. 2. To cause deep distress or mental anguish to someone.
Make long narrow trenches in the ground with a plow

groups.summary_en: Refers to agricultural ground-preparation tasks where soil is cut, turned, broken, and aerated to ready a seedbed for sowing.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过机械或农具深翻、耙碎、疏松土壤以备播种的农耕操作。

groups.name: Plummet & Nose-dive · 骤降与坠落 (Plummet, Tumble, Nose-dive)
groups.tip: 从高处急速垂直坠落

items.def_en: To fall sharply from a high point or decrease significantly in magnitude
To fall suddenly, clumsily, or roll head over heels down a slope

items.def_zh: 猛跌，骤降；纵身跃入，急坠
items.def_en: 1. To jump, dive, or fall suddenly and forcefully downward. 2. To drop steeply or rapidly in amount, value, or temperature.
To drop rapidly without control or resistance under the pull of gravity
To drop suddenly and steeply downward, or deteriorate abruptly in value
To fall or drop straight down at very high speed

groups.summary_en: Focuses on sudden, steep, and uncontrolled downward motion in physical space or rapid declines in metrics and rates. The frame emphasizes drastic loss of height, stability, or momentum.
groups.summary_zh: 强调速度极快、近乎垂直或完全失控的猛烈下坠与暴跌。

groups.name: Politicize & Weaponize · 政治化与工具化 (Inject Partisan Bias into Neutral Spheres)
groups.tip: 操纵公共议题并将其政治工具化

items.def_zh: 意识形态化，赋予意识形态色彩
items.def_en: to interpret, govern, or distort something according to a rigid political ideology

items.def_zh: 使党派化，使呈现党争偏见
items.def_en: to cause an issue or organization to take on narrow party bias

items.def_zh: 大肆渲染（以达到政治目的）
items.def_en: (+ sth) emphasize or exaggerate an issue deliberately for political or tactical advantage

items.def_zh: 借机利用（某事谋取政治私利）
items.def_en: (+ sth) exploit an event, controversy, or situation to gain unfair partisan or personal advantage

items.raw_cluster: 政治化与操纵 Politicize & Manipulate
items.def_zh: 使政治化，赋予……政治色彩；使关心政治
items.def_en: 1. To give a political tone or character to something, or make an issue politically controversial.

items.def_zh: 武器化，将……转为攻击政敌的手段
items.def_en: to exploit a neutral fact, law, or scandal as an offensive tool to attack political opponents

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe framing an otherwise neutral, scientific, cultural, or administrative topic into a partisan controversy to gain factional advantage. 'Politicize' makes an issue political, whereas related terms emphasize turning societal issues into ideological battlegrounds or weapons.
groups.summary_zh: 将原本中立的事物染上政党党派色彩，或转为政治斗争工具。

groups.name: Pollute & Adulterate · 污染与掺杂 (Adulterate, Contaminate, Pollute)
groups.tip: 掺入不良成分败坏纯度

items.def_en: To dilute a liquid food or drink with water, often to stretch quantities dishonestly

items.def_zh: 稀释；冲淡（使质量或浓度下降）
items.def_en: To make a liquid weaker or less concentrated by mixing it with water or another liquid

items.def_zh: 掺假；掺杂（违禁品或液体）
items.def_en: (informal) To mix an illicit drug or spirit with an inferior substance to increase volume
To make a substance or environment impure or poisonous by introducing dirt, chemicals, or bacteria
To introduce harmful, toxic, or filthy substances into water, air, or soil

items.def_zh: 在（饮食或物质中）掺假，使变质
items.def_en: 1. To make food, drink, or a substance less pure or of poorer quality by adding cheaper or inferior ingredients.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with degrading the purity, authenticity, or wholesome standard of consumable substances, raw materials, or physical supplies by introducing cheaper, foreign, or harmful components.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过掺入劣质、外来或不纯物质来劣化产品或原料的纯度。

groups.name: Popularize & Mainstream · 普及与推广 (Popularize, Broaden, Disseminate)
groups.tip: 推广先进理念与事物，使之在公众中普及

items.def_zh: 使成为主流，推广入主流
items.def_en: bring an idea, style, or method into widespread ordinary usage or acceptance
(formal) make technical or esoteric knowledge easy for ordinary people to understand
become popular or widely accepted and adopted by the public

items.def_zh: 使普及；使被大众理解接纳
items.def_en: (+ sth) communicate an idea or concept effectively so that it is widely understood and accepted

items.def_zh: 普及，推广；使通俗化，大众化
items.def_en: 1. To make something widely known, popular, or accepted by the general public. 2. To present a complex subject in an easily understandable and appealing form.

items.def_zh: 使大众化，让大众普及享有
items.def_en: make something accessible to everyone, not just an elite minority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe introducing an idea, product, or cultural practice to the general public to gain wide acceptance, comprehension, or adoption.
groups.summary_zh: 向广大公众推广普及知识、产品或风尚使其大众化。

groups.name: Possess & Own · 拥有与享有 (Possess, Own, Hold)
groups.tip: 享有所有权或实际占有

items.def_en: To have something as one's lawful property
To keep, retain, or have in one's possession or control, such as property, titles, or shares
To have at one's disposal or naturally deserve and receive something valuable (respect, resources)
To continue to hold, have, or keep possession of something rather than lose or surrender it

items.def_zh: 拥有，占有；具有（品质、能力）；支配，控制（心智）
items.def_en: 1. To have or own something; to have a particular quality or ability. 2. To completely control someone's mind, feelings, or actions
To have or contain a desirable feature, asset, or quality that is a source of pride

groups.summary_en: Denotes holding proprietary entitlement, custody, inherent attributes, or lawful dominance over goods, assets, characteristics, or rights, contrasting legal title with de facto holding.
groups.summary_zh: 指对财物拥有法定所有权或实际持有，亦可指生来具备某种特质与能力。

groups.name: Pour & Decant · 倾倒与分装 (Pour, Decant, Dispense, Dish out)
groups.tip: 倾斜容器倒出或滗出清液

items.def_en: To serve portions of food onto plates or into bowls from a communal pot
To cause a liquid or loose particulate to flow out of a container in a continuous stream
(+ out/into) To serve or transfer soup or liquid food using a deep, long-handled spoon
To pour liquid gently from one container into another, often without disturbing the sediment at the bottom.
(+ into) To pour liquid or small particles through a funnel or a narrow aperture
To provide, distribute, or measure out liquids, medicine, or rations systematically

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies transferring liquids or loose solids from one vessel into another or into individual servings, ranging from gentle careful pouring to routine serving.
groups.summary_zh: 细致或按份从一个容器向另一容器倾倒、分装液体或物品。

groups.name: Practice & Hone Skills · 操练与磨砺 (Rehearse, Drill, Hone)
groups.tip: 反复操练以熟能生巧

items.def_en: (+ on) Refresh one's existing knowledge or dormant skill through quick review
Improve, refine, or add final touches of elegance and proficiency to a skill

items.def_zh: 练习，操练；实践，实行；从事（医、法等职业）
items.def_en: 1. (British English) To do something repeatedly in order to become skilled at it. 2. To do something regularly as a habit, tradition, or principle. 3. To work as a doctor, lawyer, etc.
Practice a play, music, or speech thoroughly in preparation for public performance

items.def_zh: 反复操练，死记硬背训练
items.def_en: Train someone or practice intensely through repetitive, disciplined exercises
Refine, sharpen, or perfect a skill or talent over a sustained period

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the deliberate, repetitive execution of an activity to refine technique, build fluency, or prepare for performance. Distinctions center on structured discipline, artistic rehearsal, and technical refinement.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过刻意、重复性的动作或训练来提升技能熟练度、排练或打磨技巧。

groups.name: Praise & Commend · 赞美与褒奖 (Praise, Commend, Applaud)
groups.tip: 由口头称赞到竭力推崇歌颂

items.def_en: To express strong admiration, approval, or gratitude for someone or their qualities
To express strong approval of an idea, policy, or action
To praise someone or something enthusiastically and publicly, often as a major achievement
To officially praise someone, especially in public, for an achievement or notable conduct
To praise someone or something enthusiastically and at length
1. (+ as) (formal) To praise someone or something very enthusiastically.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express high vocal or written approval, highlighting merit, quality, or commendable actions. They range from standard expressions of admiration to formal organizational commendation.
groups.summary_zh: 对出色行为或优秀特质表达由衷赞许、极力赞赏或官方表彰。

groups.name: Prattle & Chitchat · 喋喋不休与闲聊 (Jaw, Prattle, Gab)
groups.tip: 轻松聊天或随性八卦

items.def_en: To converse casually about superficial social topics and day-to-day trivialities
(informal) To talk or chat at length; to lecture or scold someone tediously.
(informal) To talk continuously and enthusiastically, typically about matters of little importance
(informal, + on) To talk relentlessly, repetitively, and annoyingly about trivialities
(informal, + on/about) To talk aimlessly and casually for a long stretch of time
(+ on/about) To talk at length in a foolish, childish, or inconsequential way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this expressive frame depict informal, rapid, idle, or incessantly tedious chatter about trivial subjects, often lingering past listener interest.
groups.summary_zh: 指冗长、琐碎、喋喋不休或信口开河的非正式闲聊、碎嘴与神聊。

groups.name: Precipitate & Shower Down · 降落与倾泻 (Hail, Sleet, Pour)
groups.tip: 自天空高处顺势坠下

items.def_zh: 下雨；大量落下，大量倾泻
items.def_en: 1. (impersonal, 'it rains') To fall in drops from the clouds. 2. To fall, drop, or throw something down in large quantities.
To rain very heavily and rapidly without stopping
To fall hard and relentlessly against a surface in rapid succession

items.def_zh: 如下雨般纷纷落下；倾洒
items.def_en: To fall or descend in large amounts over a wide area
(impersonal, 'it hails') To fall from clouds in pellets of frozen rain
To rain lightly in very small, fine droplets

groups.summary_en: This frame covers meteorological precipitation falling from the sky as well as objects, blows, or words cascading down in intense, concentrated volumes.
groups.summary_zh: 指气象降水自空中落下，或比喻事物、打击如雨水般密集倾泻。

groups.name: Predict & Foretell · 预言与推断 (Forecast, Foresee, Project)
groups.tip: 对未来局势的发展作出预先判断

items.def_en: To estimate a future rate, amount, or state by calculating from existing trends
to say that an event or action will happen in the future, often as a result of knowledge, data, or experience
To estimate or calculate a future trend, event, or weather condition based on current data
To make a formal prediction about future developments based on current indicators
To be aware of or realize beforehand that something is going to happen

items.def_zh: 预言（多带宗教或灵性色彩）
items.def_en: To declare or state that something will happen, especially through supposed divine inspiration

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote making informed, intuitive, or formal declarations about what will happen in the future, contrasting scientific extrapolation with intuitive foresight.
groups.summary_zh: 基于分析、趋势或前瞻判断对未来事件进行推断与宣告。

groups.name: Preserve & Bottle · 储藏与防腐保鲜 (Preserve, Pickle, Tin)
groups.tip: 将物品妥善存放以备后用

items.def_zh: 把（食品等）装罐保存；解雇
items.def_en: 1. To preserve food or drink by sealing it in a can or tin. 2. (informal) To dismiss someone from a job.
To treat food or perishable material to keep it from decaying
To preserve meat, fish, or skins by smoking, salting, or drying them
To store and seal preserved food securely inside glass jars
To pack and seal food in airtight metal tins or cans for preservation
To preserve vegetables, fish, or meat in vinegar, brine, or pickling solutions

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on treating, cooking, or sealing perishable foodstuffs and biological materials using cans, jars, brine, or chemical methods to prevent spoilage.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过灌装、腌制或密闭工艺加工食品以长期保鲜防腐。

groups.name: Preserve & Maintain · 保存与保持 (Preserve, Maintain, Safeguard)
groups.tip: 悉心防范损坏维持长久留存

items.def_zh: 维护；保养（保持良好状态）
items.def_en: Keep a building, machine, or state of affairs in good working condition by regular care

items.def_zh: 保护，维护；保存，保留；腌制（食物）
items.def_en: 1. to keep something in its original state or in good condition; to prevent something from being damaged or destroyed. 2. to treat food to prevent it from decaying.
Keep someone or something going over an extended period; preserve viability
Maintain something at its current high level or keep property in sound condition
Protect something valuable or vulnerable from harm, threat, or exploitation
Store equipment, ships, or planes in good condition so that they can be reused later
