groups.summary_en: This frame centers on keeping artifacts, buildings, food, or pristine states in their original, undamaged condition and preventing decay.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过保养、维稳或防腐手段，将物品或原初状态完好保留下来。

groups.name: Pressurize & Compress · 增压与压缩 (Compress, Pressurize, Compact)
groups.tip: 施加压力减小体积

items.def_en: (+ on sth) apply downward force to compress something into a smaller space
[I/T] to make a gas or vapor denser, especially by cooling or compressing it into liquid
(+ sth) compress loose material into a compact, firm mass by pressing
to press something firmly together to make it solid and compact
to press or squeeze something so that it fits into a smaller space or becomes denser

items.def_zh: 使增压，维持（机舱、管道等内部）气压；对……施加压力，强迫
items.def_en: 1. To maintain or increase the internal air or fluid pressure in a sealed compartment or container. 2. To force or persuade someone to do something; put pressure on.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote applying physical force inward on a gas, liquid, or bulk material to reduce its volume, increase internal pressure, or consolidate it into a denser mass.
groups.summary_zh: 指对气体、液体或物料施压以减小体积、提升压强或压实密闭。

groups.name: Program & Code · 编程与代码构建 (Script, Configure, Compile)
groups.tip: 编写计算机程序与逻辑

items.def_zh: 为……编写程序；预先设定；安排
items.def_en: 1. To write a computer program, or set a device to operate in a particular way automatically. 2. To schedule or plan an event or series of events.
To write a short computer program or series of commands to automate routine tasks
To write computer code for software applications or systems
To fix data or program parameters directly into the source code rather than obtaining them dynamically
To convert high-level programming instructions into machine code for execution
To set up a computer system, application, or network for a particular purpose

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail writing, preparing, and structuring machine-readable instructions or setting up digital architectures to automate and control electronic devices.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过编写、配置计算机指令与脚本，使设备按预设逻辑自动化运行。

groups.name: Progress & Fare · 进展与境况 (Fare, Cope, Muddle through)
groups.tip: 事情推进或生活境况发展

items.def_en: to manage, cope, or make progress in life or work
to manage to live or survive with limited resources

items.def_zh: 胡乱应付过去；勉强挺过
items.def_en: to manage to succeed or reach the end despite lack of clear organization
(+ well/badly) To succeed, progress, or get along in a particular situation.
(+ with) to deal successfully with a difficult and stressful situation
to fare exceptionally well, becoming successful or flourishing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate experiencing a certain degree of success, struggle, or well-being when navigating a particular ordeal, journey, or life condition.
groups.summary_zh: 指在特定境遇或过程中进展、维持生计或艰难应对。

groups.name: Prompt & Spurn · 催促与促使行动 (Spur, Urge, Goad)
groups.tip: 言语推力由微弱提示转向力催

items.def_en: To push, remind, or nudge someone who is hesitant into moving or acting
To persistently urge or encourage someone to do something foolish or risky
To advise or strongly encourage someone to take a specified course of action

items.def_zh: 促使，推动；激励；（给演员等）提示，提词
items.def_en: 1. To encourage or cause someone to do something. 2. To help an actor or speaker remember the next words.
To encourage someone or provoke an immediate surge of action or enthusiasm
To intentionally provoke or annoy someone into doing something, often rashly

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on motivating, pressing, or prodding someone into taking immediate action or speaking, ranging from subtle reminders to intense psychological pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过言语提醒、激将或施压，催促其迅速采取行动。

groups.name: Proselytize & Convert · 传教劝导与极力规劝 (Proselytize, Convert, Exhort)
groups.tip: 竭力劝导乃至热心传教以改变观点

items.def_en: To succeed in persuading someone to support, agree with, or join you
(+ to) To strongly encourage, urge, or warn someone to do something with earnest moral conviction
(+ to) To persuade someone to change their religion, political loyalty, or core system of beliefs
(+ for/against) To make a concerted, determined, and public effort to achieve or promote a cause

items.def_zh: 劝诱改宗，力劝……改变信仰；极力宣扬
items.def_en: To attempt to convert someone to one's own religion, political beliefs, or opinions.
To preach a religious gospel zealously, or to passionately advocate a particular cause or practice

groups.summary_en: This frame involves intensely striving to persuade others to accept, adopt, or convert to a specific ideological, religious, or philosophical doctrine. Verbs reflect varying degrees of evangelizing fervor and urgency.
groups.summary_zh: 指带着强烈的宗教或意识形态信念，竭力劝导并促使他人皈依或皈心。

groups.name: Prospect & Probe · 勘探与搜寻 (Prospect, Probe, Survey)
groups.tip: 勘察地界寻找潜在资源

items.def_en: To inspect, measure, and record the physical features of a tract of land or geological site
To travel through an unfamiliar area to discover geographical features or mineral deposits

items.def_zh: 勘探，勘察（矿藏等）；探寻，寻找
items.def_en: (+ for) To search an area for valuable natural resources such as gold, minerals, or oil.
(+ for / out) To search an area to gather strategic information, locate resources, or identify talent
(informal, chiefly Aus/NZ) To search abandoned diggings, riverbeds, or clutter for gold, gems, or scraps
To examine, explore, or search deeply into an area, substance, or issue

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to conducting exploratory, systematic investigations of physical terrain or specialized domains to uncover hidden minerals, resources, or commercial opportunities.
groups.summary_zh: 为发掘矿产、商机或地下资源而展开的定向实地勘探与考察。

groups.name: Protest & Picket · 抗议与设立警戒线示威 (Protest, Picket, Demonstrate)
groups.tip: 罢工者举牌纠察表达诉求

items.def_en: To walk together through public streets in an organized group to show support or protest
To express strong public disagreement or disapproval of an idea or policy
To take part in a public march or gathering to make feelings about something known
To assemble publicly in a massive gathering to voice support or opposition
To stop working or leave a meeting suddenly as an act of industrial or political protest

items.def_zh: 在……设置纠察；在……外抗议（示威）；担任纠察
items.def_en: 1. To stand or march outside a factory, office, or building as a picket during a strike or protest to persuade others not to enter.

groups.summary_en: Encompasses organizing public acts of opposition, labor pickets, and collective demonstrations to challenge policies, employers, or institutions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过走上街头游行、设立纠察线或公开抗议以表达诉求。

groups.name: Publicize & Promote · 宣传与报道 (Feature, Splash, Hype)
groups.tip: 大肆宣扬与登报公布

items.def_en: To give special prominence or emphasis to someone or something in a newspaper, show, or film
To mention or promote a product, book, or film publicly during a broadcast

items.def_zh: 作为标题大肆报道，使成为头条新闻；给……加标题；担任（演出等的）主角
items.def_en: 1. To publicize, report, or feature prominently as a headline news item. 2. To provide with a headline. 3. To perform as the star or main act in an entertainment event.
To advertise or praise something extravagantly to make people excited about it
To display a news story, picture, or headline prominently across a page or screen
To announce or talk about something proudly and publicly so everyone notices

groups.summary_en: This communicative frame captures media practices of spotlighting, heavily reporting, and generating widespread public visibility or excitement for an item or personality.
groups.summary_zh: 媒体予以重点报道、大力宣传或大肆造势。

groups.name: Punish & Penalize · 惩治与教训 (Chasten, Discipline, Reprimand)
groups.tip: 通过体罚或严厉惩诫教训

items.def_en: To punish an individual in order to instill obedience, order, or self-control

items.def_zh: 处以罚则；使处不利境地
items.def_en: To impose a formal penalty or disadvantage on someone for breaking a rule
To inflict discipline or hardship upon someone in order to restrain or subdue them
(dialect or old-fashioned) To punish someone or teach them a harsh lesson; to teach.
To reprimand or punish an offender with considerable severity
To punish or severely rebuke someone for inappropriate conduct

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inflicting penalties, chastisement, or harsh correction on someone to correct behavior or deter future misconduct.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过施加痛苦、惩罚或严厉训诫以纠正不良行为的行为。

groups.name: Puzzle & Bewilder · 困惑与不解 (Puzzle, Baffle, Perplex)
groups.tip: 面对复杂情况百思不解

items.def_en: To think about something until you finally understand it or resolve the confusion surrounding it

items.def_zh: 使迷惑，使困惑；苦思，苦苦琢磨
items.def_en: 1. To baffle, bewilder, or cause someone to feel confused. 2. (+ over/about) To think hard and long about something in order to understand it.
To confuse and slightly worry someone because something is difficult to understand or solve
To cause someone to be completely unable to understand, explain, or solve a problem

items.def_zh: 使不知所措；使眼花缭乱
items.def_en: To confuse someone severely, especially by presenting too many conflicting choices, details, or changes
To make someone feel completely unable to explain an event or secret phenomenon

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental states and causes where an unexpected, contradictory, or complex situation renders someone unable to understand, solve, or explain something. Baffle implies total failure of understanding, while perplex highlights accompanying worry or indecision.
groups.summary_zh: 指因事情复杂、矛盾或怪异而令人费解、困惑或冥思苦想。

groups.name: Question & Challenge · 质问与质疑 (Query, Dispute, Call into question)
groups.tip: 带着怀疑质问并提出挑战

items.def_en: To ask about something, especially in order to check if it is correct or true.
To cause doubt or uncertainty to exist about whether something is true, useful, or reliable.

items.def_zh: 质疑，对……表示怀疑；讯问，审问
items.def_en: 1. To express doubts about the accuracy, honesty, or advisability of something. 2. To ask someone a series of questions formally or systematically.
To question the truth, legality, or authority of someone or something, demanding proof or change.
To disagree with something, especially an official finding or claim, and argue that it is wrong.

items.def_zh: 指责，攻击质疑（动机或名誉）
items.def_en: To attack something such as someone's character, motives, or honesty as false or untrustworthy.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on casting doubt on the validity, veracity, or authority of a claim, policy, or person. 'Question' and 'query' involve raising intellectual skepticism, while 'challenge' and 'dispute' directly contest legitimacy and demand defense.
groups.summary_zh: 对某事物的真实性、合理性或权威性提出怀疑与异议。

groups.name: Question & Interrogate · 讯问与审问 (Interrogate, Grill, Cross-examine)
groups.tip: 正式面谈或法理上的盘问

items.def_zh: 面试，面谈；采访；讯问，审问
items.def_en: 1. To ask someone formal questions to evaluate their suitability for a job or course. 2. To question someone to gather information for a news story or broadcast. 3. (of police) To formally question a suspect or witness.
(+ for) To ask someone persistent questions in order to extract confidential information
To question a witness closely in court to test or discredit previous testimony
To question someone discreetly to discover their opinions or future plans
To subject someone to intense, unrelenting questioning
To question a suspect or captive formally and persistently, often aggressively

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on systematically asking questions to obtain intelligence, assess qualifications, or elicit confessions under varying degrees of pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统性、正式或施压性地盘问、审讯以获取信息或查证事实。

groups.name: Queue & Line · 排队与成列 (Line up, Queue up, File)
groups.tip: 按顺序依次排列成行

items.def_en: To walk or march deliberately in a single line, one behind another
To form or stand in a single-file or orderly row while waiting for something
To join a line of people waiting to enter a venue, receive a service, or purchase goods
To form a long, extended line or succession with notable gaps between individuals
To take one's place in an orderly military or structured rank and line

items.def_zh: 排队，成列等候；使排列成行
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) (chiefly British) To line up or wait in a queue to do or get something. 2. To arrange into a queue or sequence.

groups.summary_en: Covers the social coordination of people or vehicles arranging themselves in a sequence while waiting or moving. 'Queue' and 'line up' denote waiting sequentially, while 'file' stresses advancing in an orderly single row.
groups.summary_zh: 指人或车辆有序排列成行，等待服务或顺次前行。

groups.name: Quibble & Cavil · 狡辩与吹毛求疵 (Quibble, Cavil, Split hairs)
groups.tip: 在细枝末节上诡辩胡搅

items.def_zh: 过分琐碎辨析；钻牛角尖
items.def_en: To dwell obsessively on minute, practically meaningless differences in argument
(+ about/over) To argue or complain about small, trivial, or unimportant matters
(+ at/about) To make petty, carping, or unnecessary objections
To focus hypercritically on tiny, inconsequential flaws or mistakes

items.def_zh: 说模棱两可的话；推诿含糊
items.def_en: To use ambiguous language intentionally in order to conceal the truth or avoid committing
1. (dated) To quibble, bicker, or argue over petty, insignificant, or dishonest legal points.

groups.summary_en: Captures raising petty, trivial objections or dodging true issues through pedantic distinctions, evasive arguments, or legalistic pretexts.
groups.summary_zh: 指在微末细节上挑刺、狡辩纠缠或避重就轻地争执辩解。

groups.name: Radiate & Beam · 射线放射与照射 (Beam, Radiate, Cast)
groups.tip: 放射出射线与光芒

items.def_en: To direct downward beams of light over a person or ground.
To pour or shine steadily and brightly through an opening or window.
To send light, shadows, or glances across an area or surface.

items.def_zh: 放射（光线），辐射出光线；照射
items.def_en: To send out or be sent out in the form of rays of light; to emit or shine rays.
To emit a steady shaft of brilliant light in a specific direction.

items.def_zh: 辐射，向四周发散出（光或热）
items.def_en: To send out rays or waves of light, heat, or energy in all directions.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on light or energy traveling outward in distinct, directional shafts, straight beams, or spreading rays from an illuminated center.
groups.summary_zh: 光线呈束状、放射状向外直线发散照射或在表面投射光影。

groups.name: Radiate & Emanate · 辐射与发散 (Emanate, Beam, Exude, Diffuse)
groups.tip: 由中心向四面八方放射散布

items.def_en: to send forth or throw light, shadow, or a glance in a particular direction
to spread out widely over a large area or through a substance
to issue, proceed, or flow out from a source into the surrounding space

items.def_zh: 照射；绽放流露（笑容或光芒）
items.def_en: to transmit light, radio signals, or a broad, radiant emotional expression

items.def_zh: 放射，散发；流露；辐射状发出
items.def_en: 1. To emit or send out heat, light, or other energy in rays or waves. 2. To show a particular quality or emotion strongly. 3. To spread out in all directions from a central point.

items.def_zh: 散发；充分显露（特质或情绪）
items.def_en: to clearly and abundantly display an aura, quality, or feeling, or slowly discharge liquid

groups.summary_en: Describes the propagation outward of energy, light, heat, or intangible personal qualities from a central source. These verbs emphasize waves or streams spreading into the surrounding environment.
groups.summary_zh: 指能量、光热或气质情感从中心源头向外散发与弥漫。

groups.name: Rake & Sweep · 耙拢与刮取 (Scrape up, Scavenge, Comb)
groups.tip: 将分散之物归拢聚集

items.def_en: To gather together loose leaves, soil, or debris using a rake
To earn or gather very large amounts of money easily or quickly
To manage to gather just enough money, resources, or people with considerable difficulty
To search a place thoroughly and systematically to find or gather something

items.def_zh: （用耙子）耙平，拢聚；扫视，快速浏览；大量赚取（与in连用）
items.def_en: 1. (+ up/together) To pull, gather, or smooth materials with a rake. 2. To sweep or search rapidly across an area. 3. (rake in) To earn or gather a large amount of money easily.
To search through discarded waste or wild areas to collect useful items or food

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize sweeping, scraping, or raking surfaces to extract, clear, or gather scattered items, often involving physical implements or sweeping searching motions.
groups.summary_zh: 指用工具或类似扫拂、刮梳的动作拢集散物或刮搜财物。

groups.name: Realize & Materialize · 实现与具象化 (Materialize, Fulfill, Bring to fruition)
groups.tip: 将设想转化为现实结果

items.def_en: To cause something to happen or be achieved
To bring about, accomplish, or put into effect

items.def_zh: 使取得成果；使完全实现
items.def_en: To cause a plan, project, or process to achieve successful and full realization
To make a dream, promise, hope, or prophecy become reality
To become real or actual, especially after being planned, hoped for, or imagined

items.def_zh: 使……成为现实，实现；使现实化
items.def_en: To make something real or bring it into concrete existence; to fulfill potential or plans.

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify translating concepts, ambitions, or potentials from an abstract, latent state into concrete, tangible reality.
groups.summary_zh: 将潜能、规划或设想转化为真实存在与现实成果。

groups.name: Rearrange & Shift Schedule · 调整日程与延期 (Postpone, Defer, Move)
groups.tip: 重新调整日程并统筹安排

items.def_en: Delay or postpone an arranged meeting or duty until a later time
Postpone or delay a deadline, start time, or planned event
Move an appointment, event, or deadline to an earlier date or time
Arrange for an event or action to take place at a later time than originally scheduled
Put off an action, decision, or payment to a future date deliberately

items.def_zh: 重新安排（日程、时间）；重新调整（还债计划等）
items.def_en: 1. To change the date, time, or schedule of an event or appointment. 2. To agree on a new plan for repaying a debt.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on altering the prearranged calendar time or sequencing of an event, appointment, or obligation. Nuances contrast delaying, advancing forward, and comprehensively reorganizing a timetable.
groups.summary_zh: 指更改既定活动、预约或义务的时间与进度安排，涵盖推迟、提前与重编日程。

groups.name: Reassert, Reiterate & Emphasize · 重申与强化强调 (Reiterate, Reaffirm, Belabor)
groups.tip: 再度提起以加深印象或强调

items.def_en: To state an idea, objective, or position a second time, usually using distinct terms for clarity
1. To say, state, or perform something again, especially for clarity or emphasis.

items.def_zh: 重申，反复讲（以引起重视）
items.def_en: To say something again or several times in order to make the meaning unmistakable

items.def_zh: 反复敲黑板强调；透彻灌输
items.def_en: To state a fact or point with forceful repetition so that listeners fully grasp or accept it

items.def_zh: 重申；再次确认（信念、承诺）
items.def_en: To formally state again that something is true, or declare renewed support for an allegiance or policy

items.def_zh: 过分强调；喋喋不休地谈论
items.def_en: To explain, discuss, or worry about an argument more than is necessary or polite

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this communicative frame describe affirming, asserting, or declaring a statement, stance, or point multiple times to ensure clarity, absolute certainty, or persistent emphasis. Nuances range from resolute diplomatic reaffirmation to tedious over-arguing.
groups.summary_zh: 旨在通过再次陈述或多次强调，使立场、观点或警告更加明确坚决。

groups.name: Rebut & Refute · 正式辩驳与论驳 (Refute, Repudiate, Confute)
groups.tip: 提供反证强力驳斥，严密推翻对方论点

items.def_zh: 将（论点）批驳得体无完肤
items.def_en: To systematically criticize and expose every fatal flaw in an argument.

items.def_zh: 破坏……的可信度，使不可信
items.def_en: To destroy confidence in or demonstrate the untruth of an assertion or witness.
To prove that an argument, statement, or accusation is entirely false using evidence.
To reject the authority or truth of a claim, accusation, or doctrine with solemn finality.

items.def_zh: 反驳，辩驳，驳斥（用证据或论据证明其错误）
items.def_en: To prove that a statement, accusation, or argument is false, using evidence or counterarguments.
To conclusively prove a person or their argument to be in error.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this formal rhetorical frame refer to presenting structured arguments, facts, or testimony to legally or intellectually overthrow an opponent's claims.
groups.summary_zh: 在正式辩论或司法中，举证反驳控诉、推翻对方论据的严谨论辩。

groups.name: Recharge & Replenish · 恢复精力与重蓄能量 (Replenish, Rest, Regain)
groups.tip: 注入充沛能量，重拾饱满活力

items.def_en: To gradually rest and relax after a period of intense exertion

items.def_zh: （使）恢复体力，重振旗鼓；给（电池）充电
items.def_en: 1. To regain physical energy, strength, or enthusiasm by resting. 2. To restore electrical energy to a rechargeable battery or device.
To restore a depleted supply, energy level, or bodily reserve to fullness
To pause, rest, and reorganize one's efforts or mental focus before continuing
To relax and stop feeling nervous or tired after hard work
To regain energy, strength, or good health after exhaustion or illness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to restoring depleted physical stamina, mental energy, or internal reserves through rest, nourishment, or quiet intervals.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过休息、补给或休整来恢复消耗的体能、精力或储备活力。

groups.name: Reconcile & Integrate Differences · 调和与折中 (Reconcile, Integrate, Align)
groups.tip: 消除分歧冲突使各部分和谐一致

items.def_en: (+ into/with) To merge separate parts or disparate components into an effective, coherent whole
To resolve minor disputes, inconsistencies, or friction through mutual adjustments

items.def_zh: 对齐；使成一线；使结盟/一致
items.def_en: (+ with) To arrange into correct relative position, or bring policies and objectives into line
(+ with) To find an acceptable way to balance two contrasting ideas, systems, or hostile parties

items.def_zh: 使协调，使一致；协调，相符；唱和声，用和声伴奏
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To combine, blend, or make different things fit together in an agreeable, pleasing, or consistent way. 2. (music) To sing or play musical notes that combine pleasingly.
(+ with/into) To fit together seamlessly and logically like interlocking joints

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on active diplomatic, organizational, or conceptual adjustment to eliminate conflicts and bring diverging elements into structural balance. Key collocates include standards, laws, policies, and conflicting accounts.
groups.summary_zh: 强调主动消除差异或分歧，使制度、观点或利益达成一致。

groups.name: Record & Inventory · 清点与盘查 (Itemize, Audit, Stocktake)
groups.tip: 逐项盘点登记成册归档

items.def_en: (+ of) To count and record supplies, or carefully assess an overall situation
To inspect and verify official financial records or operational inventories
To make a complete, detailed list or count of all the goods, property, or equipment in a place.
To list, describe, and classify items in an organized index or inventory
To calculate a cumulative total or verify counts item by item
To list all individual items or components in a systematic, detailed fashion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the systematic counting, itemizing, and verification of assets, goods, or resources in an establishment.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统化地逐项清点、核实与列出库存、资产及物资。

groups.name: Record & Log · 记载与日志记录 (Document, Chronicle, Minutes)
groups.tip: 把事实或数据登入日志存档

items.def_en: To record the details of an event or process in writing, photos, or other evidence
1. To make an official record of events, facts, or measurements in a logbook or database. 2. To cut down trees for wood.
To make an official written record of proceedings and decisions taken at a meeting
To write down a piece of information quickly on paper
To write down useful details so as not to forget them
To record a detailed, continuous series of historic or notable events

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entering sequential events, technical observations, or administrative transactions into chronological logs or permanent written records.
groups.summary_zh: 指按时间顺序将事件、数据或交涉事实载入正式日志与档案。

groups.name: Record & Register · 登记与建档 (Enrol, Enter, Matriculate)
groups.tip: 按章程登记造册留下凭证

items.def_en: To write or input vital data or a participant's name into a register or database

items.def_zh: 登记，注册；挂号；记录，显示
items.def_en: 1. To record someone's or something's name on an official list. 2. To send mail by paying an extra fee for tracking and security. 3. To show or indicate an amount or feeling.
(+ in/on) To formally enter someone into the official roll or membership of an institution
To register one's name formally for an activity, organization, or commitment
To register one's arrival formally at a hotel, airport desk, or appointment

items.def_zh: 录取入学；注册为大学生
items.def_en: To register formally as a student entering a university or degree course

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to officially recording names, identities, or vital data into an institutional ledger, roll, or database.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人名、文件或官方资格正式录入名册、档案或系统。

groups.name: Recover & Regain · 恢复与复原 (Recuperate, Rally, Bounce Back)
groups.tip: 重回先前的良好状态

items.def_zh: 康复，恢复（健康或常态）；重新获得，找回；挽回（损失）
items.def_en: 1. To return to a normal state of health, strength, or functioning. 2. To regain possession or control of something lost or stolen.
To revive or recover strength, confidence, or value after a decline
To quickly recover from adversity, illness, or a setback
To recover or bounce back after an economic slump, defeat, or illness
To obtain possession or use of an ability, condition, or position again after losing it
To recover from illness, exertion, or financial losses over time

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on returning to a baseline state of physical health, psychological balance, financial stability, or control after illness, shock, or loss. Verbs emphasize the restorative process or the resilience shown during an upturn.
groups.summary_zh: 从伤病、打击或劣势中重新恢复健康、力量或常态。

groups.name: Recruit & Headhunt · 人才招揽与聘录 (Recruit, Headhunt, Scout)
groups.tip: 征召吸纳新成员入队

items.def_en: To give someone a job in exchange for wages or salary

items.def_zh: 招募，吸收（新成员）；征募（新兵）
items.def_en: To enlist or enroll someone as a new member, employee, or soldier in an organization or the armed forces.
To search for talented individuals, especially in sports, entertainment, or specialized business roles
To actively seek out and approach an experienced person to persuade them to leave their current job for another
To integrate and train a newly hired employee or member into an organization
To persuade someone to leave an opponent's or competitor's organization to join one's own

groups.summary_en: Focuses on identifying, attracting, and onboarding fresh talent or members into companies, athletic programs, and professional organizations. Nuances range from standard hiring pipelines to aggressive talent-scouting.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦为企事业单位或团队物色、招募与吸收新成员，涵盖招聘与猎头挖角。

groups.name: Recuse & Withdraw · 回避与退出 (Recuse, Abstain, Stand Aside)
groups.tip: 因利益冲突主动申请回避

items.def_en: To temporarily or permanently leave an official role or step out of an inquiry to avoid conflict of interest

items.def_zh: 退职；退出席位；停止任职
items.def_en: To leave a position of authority, committee, or tribunal, especially temporarily
(+ from) To remove oneself from an official proceeding, contest, negotiation, or position
To declare someone officially ineligible to participate, judge, or vote in a proceeding due to bias or rule violations
(+ from) To formally choose not to vote or participate in a collective decision-making process

items.def_zh: （因利益冲突）主动申请回避，要求（法官等）回避
items.def_en: (recuse oneself) (law) To withdraw from a legal case or position of judgment due to a potential conflict of interest.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate an official, judge, or board member deliberately stepping away from an official duty, vote, or case due to a conflict of interest, bias, or procedural mandate. Nuances range from formal legal self-disqualification to diplomatic or voluntary abstention.
groups.summary_zh: 指因利益冲突或程序规范而主动退出、回避裁决或表决。

groups.name: Recycle & Repurpose · 回收与利用 (Recycle, Salvage, Reclaim)
groups.tip: 物品回收并重新利用

items.def_en: To adapt an object or material for use in a different way or for a new purpose

items.def_zh: 升级改造；增值改造利用
items.def_en: To reuse discarded objects or materials in such a way as to create a product of higher quality or value than the original

items.def_zh: 回收利用，再循环；重新使用（旧概念、材料等）
items.def_en: 1. To treat or process used materials such as paper, glass, or plastic so that they can be used again. 2. To use something again in a different form or context.

items.def_zh: 回收利用；开垦；重新获得
items.def_en: To treat waste products and materials so that they can be used again, or to restore land to cultivation

items.def_zh: 抢救；挽救；从废品中回收
items.def_en: To save goods, damaged machinery, or materials from being destroyed, lost, or wasted
To use something again rather than throwing it away

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes that collect discarded goods, scrap, or waste materials and convert them into reusable products or extract valuable components. Terms vary depending on whether the action involves mechanical reprocessing, creative adaptation, or rescue from destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指对废弃物、材料或残存部件进行回收、再生与再利用。

groups.name: Redesign & Overhaul · 重新设计与系统改造 (Redesign, Revamp, Re-engineer)
groups.tip: 重新构想与蓝图规划

items.def_en: To restructure or redesign an organization, technical system, or operation fundamentally
To rearrange the elements or settings of hardware, software, or an architectural design
To thoroughly examine and dismantle a machine or system in order to repair or radically alter it
To design a product, building, or system again in an altered or improved way.
To change, repair, or improve the appearance or structure of something to make it modern and appealing
To change the structural layout, shape, or design of a building, room, or organizational model

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses reimagining, restructuring, and rebuilding existing structures, systems, mechanisms, or products to correct flaws, optimize performance, or adapt to modern requirements.
groups.summary_zh: 指对现有产品、架构或机制进行革新改造与重新设计。

groups.name: Redound & Contribute · 促成与回报 (Redound, Conduce, Turn Out)
groups.tip: 行为或成就最终反作用于自身名誉

items.def_en: Help to cause, bring about, or increase the likelihood of a certain outcome

items.def_zh: 有助益于；导致（良好后果）
items.def_en: Help to produce or promote a particular result or condition, especially a desirable one

items.def_zh: 影响（某人的）评价与声誉
items.def_en: Bring credit or discredit to someone by being associated with their behavior or conduct
Be received by someone regularly or naturally over time as a direct benefit or advantage

items.def_zh: 转变为（对某人有利/不利）
items.def_en: Result in a specific advantage, profit, or loss for a person

items.def_zh: 对……产生重大影响；增加，使增加（尤指声誉、利益，redound to）
items.def_en: (redound to) (formal) to contribute greatly to someone's credit, honor, advantage, or disadvantage

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on actions or circumstances naturally turning out to, culminating in, or yielding distinct credit, advantage, or disadvantage to someone.
groups.summary_zh: 指行为、努力或客观事态最终促成并归结为某种荣誉、声望或利害结果。

groups.name: Reestablish & Reinstate · 重建与恢复 (Restore, Reconstitute, Reinstitute)
groups.tip: 重新建立体制或恢复秩序

items.def_en: To bring back a previous condition, practice, or relationship of order and peace
To introduce, establish, or initiate a policy, rule, or system again
To reconstruct or form again, especially diplomatic ties, trust, or a destroyed system
To restore someone or something to their former position, rank, or condition

items.def_zh: 重建，重新设立；恢复（秩序、关系等）
items.def_en: To set up, restore, or bring back an institution, system, relationship, or state of affairs that previously existed.
To build up or organize a body, committee, or nation again in a new or restored form

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this formal and institutional frame describe restoring treaties, public order, diplomatic ties, official posts, or legal frameworks that had been severed or abolished. They focus on legitimate authority and structural continuity.
groups.summary_zh: 在官方或制度层面恢复原有的秩序、关系或职务。

groups.name: Refine & Polish · 提炼与润色 (Polish, Hone, Fine-tune)
groups.tip: 去粗取精达到完美状态

items.def_en: To make improvements to a piece of work or skill until it is smooth and elegant
1. To make a substance pure by removing unwanted materials from it. 2. To improve a method, system, idea, etc. by making small changes.
To make a process or organization simpler and more efficient by removing unnecessary steps
To sharpen, develop, and perfect a skill, technique, or blade over time
To make very small adjustments to a system or plan to achieve optimal performance
To polish metal to a high sheen, or to polish and improve an image or reputation

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on elevating an already acceptable skill, object, or argument by removing subtle flaws, sharpening precision, and adding sophistication.
groups.summary_zh: 指对已有成果进行润色、打磨、去除瑕疵以达到更高纯度或水准。

groups.name: Refloat & Salvage · 起浮与脱浅 (Salvage, Unstick, Surface)
groups.tip: 受浮力作用在水面或空中漂起

items.def_en: To rise up to the surface of water after being completely submerged
To release a stranded ship or trapped object so it can move and float again
To rescue or recover a damaged or sunken ship and its cargo from water
To knock or force a vessel or object out of a position where it is stuck fast

items.def_zh: （使）再浮起，（使搁浅船只）起浮脱困
items.def_en: To float again, or release a stranded, sunken, or grounded vessel back into deep water so it floats.
To bring a sunken vessel or underwater wreckage back up to the surface

groups.summary_en: This nautical and mechanical frame concerns restoring buoyancy to grounded or sunken craft, raising heavy objects out of waterbeds, or returning submerged objects to a floating state.
groups.summary_zh: 指使搁浅、沉没的船舶重新浮起脱困，或从水底打捞复位。

groups.name: Refresh & Revitalize · 提神与更新 (Invigorate, Rejuvenate, Freshen Up)
groups.tip: 重获清新与精神活力

items.def_en: To wash, tidy oneself up, or take a short break in order to feel clean and alert
To make someone or something more lively, interesting, or spirited
To imbue something with new life, vigor, or dynamic energy
To make someone or something look or feel younger, fresher, or more lively

items.def_zh: 使精神饱满，使恢复活力；使显得新鲜；（风）增强
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel clean and refreshed, or make something fresh again. 2. (of the wind) To blow harder and cooler.
To give strength, vitality, or energy to someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe renewing sensory vigor, cleanliness, mental clarity, or aesthetic vibrancy. They convey shaking off lethargy, staleness, or fatigue to feel bright and energetic again.
groups.summary_zh: 消除疲惫与陈旧感，使精力、头脑或面貌焕然一新。

groups.name: Refute & Disprove · 证据证伪与驳倒 (Debunk, Invalidate, Explode)
groups.tip: 立论反驳证其不成立

items.def_zh: 彻底打破，彻底粉碎（迷信、谣言）
items.def_en: To decisively shatter and expose a myth or false belief as groundless.

items.def_zh: 击溃，彻底否决（论点、提议）
items.def_en: To defeat or destroy an argument, proposal, or theory by showing its flaws.
To prove that an argument, conclusion, or theory is erroneous and cannot stand.
To show that an idea, myth, or belief is false, pretentious, or exaggerated.
To prove by evidence or argument that an idea, claim, or theory is false.
To demonstrate that a scientific hypothesis or factual claim is untrue by test.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this epistemic frame denote decisively demonstrating the falsity or inaccuracy of an assertion, hypothesis, myth, or thesis through rigorous evidence and logic.
groups.summary_zh: 运用确凿证据或逻辑推演彻底推翻某假设、学说或虚假传言。

groups.name: Regard & Deem · 视作与看待 (Consider, Deem, View, Gauge)
groups.tip: 以某种眼光评定事物

items.def_en: (+ as) To think about, interpret, or evaluate someone or something from a particular perspective
To have a particular opinion about someone or something; hold the view that someone or something is a certain way
(+ as) To consider someone or something to be a particular thing, or to be considered valid under a rule
1. To think of, consider, or evaluate someone or something in a particular way. 2. (formal) To look closely or steadily at someone or something.
To judge or evaluate something in a particular way, especially formally or officially
(+ as) To regard or think about someone or something with a specific attitude or disposition

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote evaluating, framing, or holding an opinion about a person, action, or situation. Nuances range from formal institutional determinations ('deem') to subjective cognitive framing ('view as', 'count as').
groups.summary_zh: 在心智中对人或事物进行主观评判、定性或视作某种角色。

groups.name: Regulate & Control · 控制与规范 (Control, Govern, Oversee)
groups.tip: 依规章制度对系统加以约束

items.def_en: To enforce regulations, compliance, and order within a particular sector, trade, or group

items.def_zh: 控制，规范，管理；调节，校准
items.def_en: 1. To control or direct by a rule, principle, or law. 2. To adjust a mechanism or system to a desired speed, temperature, or level.
To supervise people or processes to ensure that tasks are executed legally and correctly
To bring something under tighter control, restraining unwanted freedom or excessive growth
To have the power to direct, restrain, or dictate the behavior, functioning, or course of something
To officially control and direct the public policy, actions, or affairs of an entity or state

groups.summary_en: Deals with exercising authority or operational parameters over systems, markets, institutions, or behaviors. 'Regulate' stresses formal rules and calibrated standards, 'govern' focuses on sovereign jurisdiction, and 'rein in' emphasizes curbing excess.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据规则、法律或机制来监督、引导与约束秩序。

groups.name: Regulate & Standardize · 规范与标准化 (Normalize, Homogenize, Codify)
groups.tip: 立规立矩统一步调

items.def_en: To control an activity or process by using official rules, laws, or guidelines

items.def_zh: 使标准化，使符合统一标准
items.def_en: To make things conform to a single standard or consistent quality, rule, or model.
To make a system, organization, or process simpler, more efficient, and consistent by eliminating redundant steps
To bring something to a standard, expected, or typical state, pattern, or baseline
To bring systems, rules, or standards into agreement so that they work well together without conflict

items.def_zh: 编纂；把…编成法典或规则
items.def_en: To arrange laws, principles, or rules into a systematic and formal written code

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bringing practices, components, or systems into alignment with a shared model, benchmark, or regulatory framework. It spans technical harmonization, legal codification, and systematic control.
groups.summary_zh: 消除差异与混乱，使制度、产品或流程符合统一标准或规范。

groups.name: Rehearse & Practice · 演练与排练 (Practice, Drill, Run Through)
groups.tip: 舞台演出前的反复练习

items.def_en: To perform an activity or skill repeatedly in order to acquire or maintain proficiency
To plan, produce, and organize a dramatic performance or simulated scenario
To train or rehearse rigorously through repetitive exercises and discipline
To practice a performance, speech, or sequence quickly from start to finish
To conduct a complete trial or rehearsal of a process before the real event

items.def_zh: 排练，排演；反复练习；详述，列举
items.def_en: 1. To practice a play, concert, speech, or piece of music before performing it in public. 2. To repeat or give a long account of something in detail.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve practicing performances, maneuvers, or spoken parts prior to an official event. They range from formal stage rehearsals to rigorous military and safety drills.
groups.summary_zh: 指在正式演出、发布或实战前预先排演、反复练习。

groups.name: Reinforce & Armor · 加固与强化 (Reinforce, Fortify, Stud)
groups.tip: 钉掌加厚增强结构韧性

items.def_zh: 镶嵌；用饰钉/防滑钉加固
items.def_en: To fit, reinforce, or cover a surface with metal studs or raised projections

items.def_zh: 装防滑齿；装防滑条加固
items.def_en: To strengthen or provide footwear or beams with cleats for grip and rigidity
To strengthen, improve, or give greater substance to something physical or organizational
To make a structure, material, or object stronger by adding more support or material
To reinforce or fasten the soles of shoes or boots with hobnails.
To make a structure or object stronger and better able to resist damage or wear

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote physically strengthening, lining, or armor-plating materials and garments with studs, plates, or extra layers to withstand heavy wear.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过钉铁掌、衬垫或加厚材料，对物件（尤其鞋履与结构）进行机械加固。

groups.name: Reinstate & Restore · 恢复原状与复官复职 (Restore, Reinstate, Re-establish)
groups.tip: 官复原职或恢复此前权利

items.def_en: To bring back an original condition, status, power, or constitutional right
To set up or validate a system, institution, or official relation again
(+ with) To endow someone again with power, legal authority, or rank
To introduce or use a former rule, law, practice, or standard again

items.def_zh: 使复职，使恢复原位；恢复（法律、制度等）
items.def_en: 1. To restore someone to their previous job, rank, or position. 2. To restore a law, rule, or custom that had been abolished.
To return someone to their former good reputation, privileges, or standing

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on returning a dismissed person to an official position or re-establishing a suspended policy, rank, privilege, or status to its former validity.
groups.summary_zh: 指使被免职者恢复原职原薪，或使失效、废除的规章制度重新生效。

groups.name: Rekindle & Reawaken · 重燃与唤醒 (Revive, Resurrect, Reignite)
groups.tip: 死灰复燃重燃生机

items.def_en: To cause something sudden, such as feelings, memories, or a dispute, to start
To restore to life, consciousness, or vigor, or make active again

items.def_zh: 重新激起，重燃（情感、希望或冲突）；重新点燃
items.def_en: To revive or bring back a feeling, relationship, interest, or fire that had died down.
To awaken or trigger memories, desires, or capabilities that had faded
To catch fire or cause strong feelings, debates, or conflicts to flare up anew
To bring back into use, notice, or activity a practice, belief, or concept that had long ceased

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses bringing dormant emotions, relationships, controversies, or intellectual interests back into active flame. Verbs carry strong metaphorical imagery of igniting embers or waking something from deep slumber.
groups.summary_zh: 重新点燃休眠的情感、兴趣、争议或昔日关系。

groups.name: Release & Emit Volatiles · 释放与脱气 (Outgas, Degas, Exude)
groups.tip: 物质从表面解吸并释放

items.def_zh: 释放出气体（尤指真空或受热时）
items.def_en: To release or give off a gas or vapor, especially from a solid or liquid under reduced pressure or heat

items.def_zh: 慢慢放掉，排泄（系统内的多余气体或压力）
items.def_en: To slowly and deliberately release excess gas, fluid, or pressure from a closed system
To remove dissolved or entrapped gas from a liquid, vacuum system, or solid material
To extract an adsorbed substance from a solid adsorbent by washing with a solvent
(of a gas) To escape or pass through a tiny hole into an area of lower pressure
(chemistry / physics) To release or remove an adsorbed substance from a surface, or to be released from a surface.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scientific and physical frame describe the release, expulsion, or removal of trapped, dissolved, or surface-bound gases, vapors, and chemical substances. Collocations typically center on materials, pressure changes, thermal reactions, and chemical extraction.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及材料科学或化学中排出、释放被吸附或溶解的气体与微小物质的过程。

groups.name: Relief & Printmaking Techniques · 雕版与压印印制 (Emboss, Stencil, Lithograph)
groups.tip: 借助模板与压力拓印图案

items.def_en: to print patterns or text onto paper or textiles using hand-carved wooden blocks
to force ink through a prepared screen of fine mesh onto a substrate

items.def_zh: 用模板（孔版）印制，用镂花模板绘制
items.def_en: to paint, draw, or print letters or designs on a surface using a stencil.
to engrave or print designs through incisions sunken below the surface

items.def_zh: 在……上压印浮雕（或凸纹），压花
items.def_en: to decorate a surface with a raised design, pattern, or lettering stamped into it.
to print pictures or text using the process of lithography.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe specialized printing and surface-decorating crafts—such as raising reliefs, masking cutouts, or transferring chemical impressions onto paper, metal, or fabric.
groups.summary_zh: 指浮雕、网版漏印、石版平印等特定版画与印制工艺加工。

groups.name: Relinquish Grip & Free Restraints · 撒手与松开扣件 (Let go, Unleash, Unclasp)
groups.tip: 解除外力束缚使其脱困自由

items.def_zh: 释放，放开；解除，免除；发布，发行
items.def_en: 1. To set free someone or something from confinement, control, or restraint. 2. To stop holding something and let it go. 3. To make information, a movie, or a product publicly available.
To cease holding something deliberately so that it falls or is left behind
(+ of) To stop holding, grasping, or gripping something or someone

items.def_zh: 松开（紧握的双臂、手）；解开（扣环）
items.def_en: To open or release a clasp, or to loosen a tight grip with hands or arms
To untie, unfasten, or set completely free from physical bonds

items.def_zh: 脱开，解脱（啮合或扣合的部件）
items.def_en: To release or detach a mechanical component from another connected part

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manual and physical control frame denote the deliberate cessation of grasping, holding, clutching, or mechanical fastening. They describe letting go of objects, slackening mechanical latches, or terminating direct physical grip.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动松开手部抓握、解除机械卡扣或停止物理束缚的动作。

groups.name: Remember & Recall · 回忆与想起 (Recall, Recollect, Reminisce)
groups.tip: 留存或重新唤醒记忆

items.def_en: (+ to) To direct one's thoughts back to past events or periods

items.def_zh: 记得，记起；记住，牢记；代向……致意
items.def_en: 1. To have a memory of a past person, event, or fact in your mind. 2. To not forget to do something. 3. (formal) To convey greetings from one person to another.
To bring a specific past fact, image, or circumstance back into the conscious mind
(+ about) To talk, think, or write about past experiences with fondness
To summon a memory back to mind, often with conscious mental effort
To bring vivid memories or impressions sharply into the conscious mind

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the cognitive act of bringing previously acquired knowledge, perceptions, or personal memories back into conscious thought.
groups.summary_zh: 指将过去的经历、事实或感知自记忆中提取至意识中的心理过程。

groups.name: Remodel, Revamp & Restructure · 重塑与再造 (Remodel, Revamp, Overhaul)
groups.tip: 重新铸型与结构改造

items.def_zh: 调整结构；重组（企业体制、债务等）
items.def_en: To alter the basic organizational, operational, or financial framework of an institution or plan

items.def_zh: 全面检修；彻底革新（体系、机制）
items.def_en: To thoroughly examine and make necessary structural repairs, adjustments, or systemic reforms
To modernize, improve, or reconstruct the outward form or features of something to make it more appealing

items.def_zh: 改造；重新塑造（房屋结构、组织模式）
items.def_en: To change the physical structure, layout, or design of an existing building, room, or conceptual system
To alter the overall character, trajectory, or physical shape of something substantially

items.def_zh: 重塑，改造；改写；重铸；重新选派（角色）
items.def_en: 1. To change, adapt, or reorganize something into a new form. 2. To melt metal again and pour it into a mold. 3. To assign a new actor or group of actors to a play, film, or role.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving a significantly new structure, appearance, or operating format to a system, policy, argument, or physical entity. They stress transforming pre-existing material or conceptual foundations into a refined or modern iteration.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对原有构架、方案或实物进行脱胎换骨式的修改、重构与翻新。

groups.name: Remorse & Contrition · 后悔与忏悔 (Repent, Rue, Atone)
groups.tip: 从内心惋惜遗憾升级为痛改前非

items.def_en: Feel intensely annoyed and frustrated with oneself for making an obvious mistake
To feel sadness, remorse, or disappointment over something that has happened or been done, especially a mistake.
Express passionate sorrow, deep regret, or mourning over an unfortunate event
Bitterly regret a past action, decision, or missed opportunity
Feel deep sorrow and contrition for one's sins or wrongdoing, resolving to reform
(+ for) Make amends or reparation for a serious fault, wrong, or sin

groups.summary_en: This spectrum tracks the inner pangs of guilt, remorse, and deep self-reproach, escalating from wistful regret over a mistake to moral contrition and penitent self-abasement.
groups.summary_zh: 刻画从对过失的惋惜遗憾，上升至触及灵魂的愧疚、痛悔与忏悔。

groups.name: Renounce & Abdicate · 放弃与退位 (Abdicate, Relinquish, Renounce)
groups.tip: 主动声明放弃权利或王位退位

items.def_en: Resign or withdraw formally from an important official post or leadership role
Withdraw from a contest, position, or command to let someone else take over

items.def_zh: 声明放弃（头衔、权利或信仰）
items.def_en: Formally state that one gives up any claim to a position, right, or belief

items.def_zh: 被迫放弃，交出（权力或控制）
items.def_en: Voluntarily cease to keep, claim, or maintain control over power or authority
Give up control, territory, or sovereign rights formally to another party

items.def_zh: 正式退位，放弃王位；放弃（职责、权力）
items.def_en: 1. To formally give up the throne or royal authority. 2. To fail to carry out or abandon an important duty or responsibility.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe formally surrendering a high office, sovereign power, or vital duty, either through constitutional procedure or an explicit disavowal of authority.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及正式放弃王位、职权或重要法定职责。

groups.name: Renounce & Disavow · 宣布放弃与弃绝 (Disavow, Repudiate, Abdicate)
groups.tip: 主动宣布放弃权利或职责

items.def_zh: 宣布放弃（权利、头衔等）；声明脱离关系，断绝
items.def_en: 1. To formally and publicly give up a claim, right, title, or position. 2. To state formally that one no longer believes in, follows, or supports something.
To willingly surrender ownership, control, or a legal claim to another party
To formally resign from high sovereign office, monarchy, or critical duty
To state publicly that you have no knowledge of or responsibility for something

items.def_zh: 驳斥；断绝关系；拒绝承认
items.def_en: To refuse decisively to accept, believe, or have any association with something
To state solemnly and publicly, often under oath, that you renounce a belief or cause

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate deliberate, public, and formal acts of giving up claims, doctrines, allegiances, or official sovereign roles.
groups.summary_zh: 指正式、公开地声明放弃权利、王位、信仰或否认干系。

groups.name: Renovate & Modernize · 修缮与翻新 (Refurbish, Revamp, Renovate)
groups.tip: 重新整修焕然一新

items.def_en: To make someone or something look neater, cleaner, or more attractive with minor improvements
To restore a building, room, or structure to good condition by repairing and remodeling
To change and improve the appearance, structure, or function of something thoroughly
To change the internal structure, layout, or decorative style of a room or building
To clean, repair, or redecorate a building, room, or piece of equipment to restore it to good condition.
To return a derelict building or neglected area to a usable, functional state

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses updating, upgrading, and aesthetically restoring properties, facilities, or machines to modern standards and pristine working condition.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重建筑、设备或空间的升级翻新、装潢改造与重焕新生。

groups.name: Repair & Restore · 修理与修复 (Repair, Mend, Patch up)
groups.tip: 修补损坏使其恢复功能

items.def_en: To perform routine maintenance or minor repairs on a vehicle, appliance, or machine

items.def_zh: 修理，修复；使固定；确定，安排
items.def_en: 1. To repair or mend something that is broken, damaged, or not working properly. 2. To fasten, attach, or place firmly. 3. To arrange, decide on, or set a time or date.
To restore something damaged, faulty, or worn to good condition or working order
To repair something roughly, temporarily, or by covering holes or damaged areas
To thoroughly examine and make extensive repairs or adjustments to a machine or system
To repair a tear, break, or injury, especially in cloth, simple items, or bones

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to returning damaged, broken, or malfunctioning objects or systems back to working order, ranging from quick everyday remedies to systematic mechanical overhauls.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖将受损或故障之物恢复正常运转的各类修理与修复行为。

groups.name: Repay & Reciprocate · 回报与酬谢 (Requite, Reciprocate, Reward)
groups.tip: 对善意或付出予以报答

items.def_en: To give someone something good because they have worked hard or achieved something significant
To give something to someone as an award or compensation for effort, loss, or injury
To pay back money that you have borrowed, or to do something pleasant for someone who has helped you
To share the same feelings as someone else, or to behave towards someone in the same way they have behaved towards you
To pay someone for work that they have done or services provided
(formal or literary) To give something in return for a favor, kindness, or love, or to retaliate for a wrong.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to giving something back in return for a favor, benefit, service, or even an injury. While requite carries an elevated, literary tone often linked to love or revenge, synonyms range from formal contractual reimbursement to mutual social reciprocation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示对善意、恩惠或行为予以回报、酬谢或报答。

groups.name: Repel & Expel · 击退与驱逐 (Repel, Rebough, Ward off)
groups.tip: 打退进攻并彻底逐出界外

items.def_en: To defend oneself against an assault, blow, or unwanted demand
To prevent someone or something harmful from approaching or affecting you

items.def_zh: 击退，驱逐；抵御，抗拒；使厌恶，使反感；（物理）排斥
items.def_en: 1. To drive back or force away an attacker or enemy. 2. To resist or ward off something. 3. To cause strong feelings of disgust or horror. 4. (physics) To push away another body by magnetic or electrostatic force.
To reject an offer, approach, or advance in an abrupt and ungracious manner
To force an advancing hostile force or intruder to retreat
To drive back an attacking army or forceful intrusion through effective resistance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame evoke active physical or tactical resistance to push oncoming hostile forces, pests, or unwanted advances away from a defended boundary, keeping adversaries at bay.
groups.summary_zh: 武力反抗或设防，将进攻者、侵入者或敌意冲锋强力驱退。

groups.name: Report & Relate · 汇报与陈述 (Report, Relate, Recount)
groups.tip: 向上级或公众汇报陈述情况

items.def_en: 1. To give a spoken or written account of an event, fact, or situation. 2. (+ to/for) To present oneself at a place as required.
To tell a story, incident, or detailed sequence of events to someone
To give someone essential information, facts, or instructions in a concise summary
(+ to/on) To return and present findings or progress to a superior or commissioning group
To narrate the facts or details of an experience or past event in chronological order

items.def_zh: 听取汇报；盘问任务执行情况
items.def_en: To question someone thoroughly about a completed mission or task to obtain vital information

groups.summary_en: This frame covers delivering an official, detailed, or structured account of events, facts, findings, or narratives to an authority figure, audience, or supervisor.
groups.summary_zh: 指按要求向上级、公众或受众叙述、通报事实与经过。

groups.name: Resemble & Mirror · 相似与类同 (Resemble, Echo, Take after)
groups.tip: 样貌相似或彼此相称

items.def_en: To look like or be similar to another person or thing in appearance, character, or qualities.
To look or behave like an older member of your family
To be extremely similar to something else in development, structure, or outcome
To be reminiscent of or duplicate the style, ideas, or qualities of another

items.def_zh: 模拟，模仿……的外貌或特征
items.def_en: To reproduce the appearance, behavior, or conditions of something

items.def_zh: 反映，极为相似，如实映射
items.def_en: To be very similar to or reflect the exact qualities, patterns, or trends of something else

groups.summary_en: This frame covers entities sharing observable features, characteristics, or behaviors with another. Gradations range from a casual superficial likeness to strong genealogical inheritance or evocative thematic reflection.
groups.summary_zh: 表示人或事物在外貌、性格或特质上的相似、相像或呼应。

groups.name: Reserve & Secure · 预订与锁定 (Secure, Hold, Slate)
groups.tip: 提前锁定服务或资源

items.def_en: to reserve accommodations, a place, a ticket, or services in advance; to officially record someone's name for an offense
To keep an item, ticket, or room temporarily reserved and unavailable to others

items.def_zh: 设法获得，锁定（席位或名额）
items.def_en: To successfully obtain or lock down a confirmed ticket, place, or booking after effort
To arrange or schedule a tentative appointment or booking subject to later confirmation
To designate a chunk of dates, rooms, or calendar time exclusively for a group or purpose
To schedule or plan that something will take place at a specific future date

groups.summary_en: This commercial transaction frame focuses on arranging, registering, and locking in places, services, accommodations, or schedules in advance.
groups.summary_zh: 提前预约、登记或排定席位、房间及日程安排。

groups.name: Resolve & Settle · 解决与平息 (Settle, Reconcile, Iron out, Smooth over)
groups.tip: 排除疑难化解矛盾

items.def_en: To reach a final agreement or decision on an argument, disagreement, or claim

items.def_zh: 解决，化解（争端或难题）；下定决心；决议
items.def_en: 1. To solve or find a satisfactory end to a problem, conflict, or dispute. 2. To make a firm decision to do something. 3. (formal) To make a formal decision or vote on a motion.

items.def_zh: 消除；解决（细节分歧/麻烦）
items.def_en: To remove problems, disagreements, or minor difficulties by mutual negotiation
To make problems, differences, or unpleasant incidents appear less serious to restore peace
To deal with a problem, claim, or piece of business completely and satisfactorily
To find an acceptable compromise between two opposing ideas, parties, or conflict situations

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes ending contention, dispute, conflict, or procedural friction to reach an agreeable consensus or equilibrium. It contrasts finding technical answers with managing human differences and negotiations.
groups.summary_zh: 平息争端或消除分歧，促成妥协、协议与和谐了结。

groups.name: Restrain & Constrain · 勒缰与约束 (Rein in, Curb, Check)
groups.tip: 勒住缰绳施加外部规约控制

items.def_en: To prevent someone or something from moving forward, expressing emotion, or progressing
To stop or slow down the growth, progress, or expansion of something unwelcome
To control or limit something undesirable, such as spending, inflation, or temper

items.def_zh: 勒马，勒住缰绳；控制，约束
items.def_en: 1. To stop or slow down a horse by pulling on its reins. 2. ('rein in') To control, limit, or restrain someone or something strictly.
To limit severely the freedom of action or development of someone or something
To restrain or bring under control as if using a bridle; to curb hostile impulses

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying control, bounds, or friction to prevent runaway growth, impulses, or expenditures. Many verbs derive from equestrian metaphors denoting deliberate suppression of kinetic momentum.
groups.summary_zh: 通过拉紧缰绳般的控制手段，压制冲动、支出或过热态势，防止失控。

groups.name: Restrict & Demarcate · 限制与限定 (Limit, Cap, Circumscribe)
groups.tip: 设立界限防止越界违规

items.def_en: To control or keep something to a specified maximum size, number, or degree
To set an upper limit on spending, prices, numbers, or payments
to limit the size, amount, or range of something, or control actions
To bring something under tighter control, cutting back excessive behavior or spending
To control, check, or limit something undesirable from spreading or escalating

items.def_zh: 划定界限；约束（权力或自由）
items.def_en: To draw a boundary around and strictly control or limit powers, rights, or possibilities

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to setting definitive bounds, caps, or operational scopes to prevent growth, access, or activity beyond a regulated baseline.
groups.summary_zh: 设定界限、额度或操作范围，以防止活动或数量超出规定标准。

groups.name: Restructure & Realign · 机构重组与全面整顿 (Reorganize, Restructure, Revamp)
groups.tip: 对机构或人员做系统重组

items.def_zh: 精简……的机构，使流程精练高效
items.def_en: to make an organization or process more efficient by stripping away redundant administrative layers
to overhaul or reconstruct the internal parts, layout, or organization of something to improve it
1. To change the structure, arrangement, or management of an organization or system to make it work more effectively.
(+ sth) rid an organization of inefficient, corrupt, or unwanted personnel in a restructuring

items.def_zh: 大刀阔斧重组，彻底整顿
items.def_en: (+ sth) radically reorganize or restructure an organization or department to improve effectiveness

items.def_zh: 重组，调整（组织/债务）结构
items.def_en: [I/T] to make fundamental changes to the operational, legal, or financial structure of an entity

groups.summary_en: An executive or administrative authority alters the structural hierarchy, workflows, or operational setup of a business, government, or system to resolve inefficiencies. Verbs range from internal reordering to root-and-branch corporate restructuring.
groups.summary_zh: 对机构、体制或企业业务框架进行重新规划、精简整顿与体系重构。

groups.name: Restructure Rhythm & Morphology · 重组质地与节律 (Granulate, Syncopate)
groups.tip: 调整节奏规律或物质形态

items.def_zh: 打碎；打乱（连贯结构或节奏）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Divide or separate something continuous into smaller fragments, grains, or disconnected units
to vary the tone, pitch, or frequency of a wave or rhythmic pattern
to reduce a solid substance into fine particles or powder

items.def_zh: （使）成颗粒状，（使）粉碎成细粒；（伤口）长出肉芽
items.def_en: 1. to form something into small grains or granules, or break down into small particles 2. to form new healthy tissue in a healing wound

items.def_zh: （音乐）改变……的节奏（使出现切分音）；（语言学）略去（词中的）字母或发音
items.def_en: 1. to change the normal rhythm of music by placing accents on normally unaccented beats 2. to shorten a word by omitting a sound or letter from the middle
to break up a liquid or system into minute droplets or isolated components

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the structural regularity, texture, or rhythmic distribution of a medium—breaking smooth continuities into grains, syncopated stresses, or fragmented units.
groups.summary_zh: 打破平滑连续性，重组物质颗粒质感或节奏重音。

groups.name: Resuscitate & Reanimate · 起死回生与强效复苏 (Resuscitate, Reanimate, Revive)
groups.tip: 从濒死状态中重获生机

items.def_en: To help someone regain consciousness after fainting or anesthesia
To revitalize or bring renewed energy and freshness to something dying or moribund
To bring back consciousness, health, or functioning to someone weak or fainting
To bring someone who is unconscious or nearly dead back to life or consciousness
To restore life, breath, or animated movement to something dead or lifeless

items.def_zh: 使复活，使苏醒；给……以新的生机，使重获活力
items.def_en: (formal) To bring back to life, consciousness, or vigor; revitalize.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on restoring life, heartbeat, or consciousness to someone clinically dead or unconscious, or breathing new kinetic vitality into something near death.
groups.summary_zh: 指促使濒死、昏迷者恢复心跳呼吸与知觉，或使奄奄一息之物重获生机。

groups.name: Retort & Snap Back · 尖锐反驳与回呛 (Snap, Come Back, Cl打击ap Back)
groups.tip: 机智敏捷反唇相讥，迅速回怼对方质难

items.def_en: (+ with) To reply promptly and cleverly to a criticism or query.
(+ at) To respond swiftly and sharply to insults or public criticism.
To answer someone back instantly with irritation or anger.

items.def_zh: （机智或愤怒地）反驳，反唇相讥，回嘴
items.def_en: To reply quickly and sharply to an accusation or criticism in an angry or witty manner.
To retaliate against hostile speech with an equally scathing spoken attack.
(+ at) To say something sharp, irritable, and hurtfully abrupt in response.

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the stylistic and emotional manner of replying—specifically making a fast, biting, sharp, or sarcastic counter-remark when provoked.
groups.summary_zh: 在被冒犯或挑衅时，以尖锐、机敏或恼怒的口吻迅速回嘴反唇相讥。

groups.name: Return & Revert · 返回与回溯 (Return, Revert, Backtrack)
groups.tip: 沿原路折返归来

items.def_zh: 返回，归来；归还，送回；回报
items.def_en: 1. To go or come back to a place, condition, or activity. 2. To give, put, or send something back to where it came from.
to return to a previous topic, plan, or physical point after wandering
to turn back sharply and retrace one's physical steps or route
(+ to) to go back to a previous state, condition, or habit
to retrace one's steps along a path, or retreat from a previous opinion
to return to a former, less developed, or worse state

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame highlight physical or metaphorical motion going backward to a previous location, earlier point in time, prior stage, or original state.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体重回原处，或事物、思路退回至先前的初始状态。

groups.name: Reveal & Disclose · 透露与揭示 (Disclose, Divulge, Unveil)
groups.tip: 使隐秘之事浮出水面为人所知

items.def_en: To betray or accidentally reveal a secret, intention, or true identity
To reveal a secret or piece of confidential information inadvertently
1. To make known something secret or previously unknown. 2. To show something that was hidden or not visible.

items.def_zh: 透露，公开（机密或未知信息）
items.def_en: To make secret or new information known publicly or officially
To remove a covering from something, or to show or introduce a new plan, product, or finding for the first time
To give away private, secret, or sensitive information, often when one should not

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to making hidden facts, secret plans, or concealed objects known or visible to others. They range from neutral factual disclosures to formal, public, or dramatic unveilings.
groups.summary_zh: 指将隐秘事实、机密信息或遮蔽之物公之于众或使其可见。

groups.name: Revel & Roister · 狂欢与作乐 (Revel, Carouse, Make merry)
groups.tip: 喧闹放纵喧哗寻欢作乐

items.def_en: To play, romp, and behave merrily in an energetic, lighthearted way
(+ in) To celebrate noisily, heartily, and take supreme delight in festivities
To go out and celebrate exuberantly and flamboyantly in public venues
To indulge without restraint in merrymaking, revelry, or drinking
To engage in boisterous, rowdy drinking bouts and uninhibited partying
1. (literary) To celebrate, drink, and make merry in a noisy, boisterous, or riotous manner.

groups.summary_en: Expresses boisterous, noisy, and uninhibited celebration, often involving excessive drinking, carousing, and high-spirited carnal revelry.
groups.summary_zh: 指纵情痛饮、大肆喧闹欢庆并享受放浪形骸的社交狂欢。

groups.name: Revive & Rally · 复苏与苏醒好转 (Rally, Recover, Come round)
groups.tip: 从垂死昏厥中重获生机

items.def_en: To recover strength, health, or spirits after a period of illness or weakness
To regain consciousness after fainting, sleeping, or being knocked out
To become conscious again after an accident, operation, or swoon
To become or make someone more cheerful, lively, or energetic
To recover quickly from a serious illness, defeat, or setback

items.def_zh: （使）复苏，（使）苏醒；（使）复兴，重新恢复；重新上演（剧目等）
items.def_en: 1. To become conscious, healthy, or active again, or cause someone to do so. 2. To bring back to life, use, or prominence; revitalize. 3. To produce a play or musical again after a period of absence.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a person or organism recovering physical vitality, rallying from exhaustion or illness, or returning to an active, conscious state.
groups.summary_zh: 指人或生物从昏迷、衰弱或病痛中恢复意识、精力与生机活力。

groups.name: Revoke & Cancel · 撤销与取消 (Call Off, Void, Rescind)
groups.tip: 宣布法令失效或取消前置决议

items.def_en: To decide that an planned event, gathering, strike, or operation will not happen
To decide that an organized event, agreement, or order will not happen or will no longer be valid; to offset or neutralize.
To abandon an intended initiative, proposal, or scheduled project entirely
To render a contract, document, or transaction legally ineffective or worthless
To formally cancel the validity of a license, authorization, rights, or a will
To officially withdraw, retract, or reverse an order, law, permit, or decision

groups.summary_en: This frame covers decisions by individuals, organizers, or authorities to nullify scheduled arrangements, transactions, or standing privileges before or during execution.
groups.summary_zh: 强调经由决定使预订、活动、协议或特权作废或不再生效。

groups.name: Reward & Compensate · 奖赏与报偿 (Reward, Compensate, Recompense)
groups.tip: 按付出给予回馈肯定

items.def_zh: 奖赏，报答，酬谢；使得到应有回报
items.def_en: To give something to someone because they have done good work, behaved well, or achieved success.
To give someone an equivalent return or reward for a service rendered or damage suffered
To yield beneficial results or lucrative returns for prior effort or endurance
(+ for) To pay money or provide a balancing benefit to balance effort, loss, or injury
(+ against/for) To compensate someone for incurred loss, damage, or legal liability
To pay someone for the labor, professional services, or work they have carried out

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on conferring money, goods, honors, or advantages upon someone in recognition of their positive effort, achievement, service, or sustained suffering. It spans institutional prizes, fair remuneration, and restorative restitution.
groups.summary_zh: 因良好的行为、功绩或损失付出，而给予他人相应的物质或荣誉报偿。

groups.name: Riffle & Flick · 翻动与轻拂 (Flick, Shuffle, Rustle)
groups.tip: 快速翻动书页或沙沙作响

items.def_en: Move papers or leaves so that they make dry, soft whispering crackling sounds
Turn over pages, photographs, or cards rapidly with quick, sharp strokes
Examine, touch, or verify a sequence of items or pages in rapid succession
Spread out cards, pages, or fingers into the curved shape of an open semicircular fan
Mix playing cards or loose sheets of paper together thoroughly by sliding them past each other

items.def_zh: 快速翻阅，翻动；洗（牌）；使起微波
items.def_en: 1. To turn over or flick through pages or cards quickly. 2. To shuffle playing cards by flicking the corners together. 3. To cause light waves or ripples on water.

groups.summary_en: Highlights the tactile, rhythmic mechanical manipulation of paper edges or cards, making a fluttering sound as pages or cards snap past.
groups.summary_zh: 指快速拨弄书页或纸牌边缘、发出沙沙声的轻快翻动动作。

groups.name: Roar & Snarl · 吼叫与咆哮 (Snarl, Growl, Bellow)
groups.tip: 愤怒时龇牙低吼，发出震慑性怒号

items.def_zh: 厉声厉气地说，恶狠狠地反唇相讥
items.def_en: To speak impatiently or irritably with sharp, sudden, cutting words
To shout orders or insults abruptly and sharply in an intimidating manner
To make a low, guttural, threatening sound, or utter words in an angry, rumbling tone
To utter a full, deep, loud, and prolonged cry from anger, excitement, or predatory instinct
To shout in a deep, booming, resonant voice, typically out of rage or pain

items.def_zh: （动物）龇牙低吼，咆哮；怒吼着说；缠结，使混乱
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To make a deep, rough, threatening sound while showing the teeth, or say something in this manner. 2. (+ up) To become twisted into an entangled mass, or complicate traffic.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate vocalizations made with hostility, guttural rasping, and bared teeth or raw volume. They denote intimidating, animalistic, or furious outbursts directed at an adversary.
groups.summary_zh: 指露出尖牙或充满敌意的低吼、怒号及凶猛咆哮。

groups.name: Roll & Bowl · 滚动与滚转 (Roll, Trundle, Tumble)
groups.tip: 球状物体翻滚前行

items.def_zh: 平稳快速行驶；轻快滚过
items.def_en: To move along smoothly, rapidly, and effortlessly on wheels
To move along a surface by revolving over and over on an axis
To roll or move along slowly, noisily, or heavily on wheels

items.def_zh: 滚球，使球滚动；掷球（板球或保龄球中）；快而稳地行驶
items.def_en: 1. To roll a ball smoothly along the ground in a game. 2. (cricket) To pitch or deliver the ball toward the batsman. 3. (+ along) To travel quickly and smoothly.
To revolve or turn rapidly on an axis or pivot while moving
To fall, turn over repeatedly, or roll end over end in an uncontrolled way

groups.summary_en: Covers moving by rotating repeatedly across a surface or propelling a rounded object onward along the ground.
groups.summary_zh: 描述物体自身翻滚旋转前进，或顺地滚送球体等圆物。

groups.name: Rot & Decompose · 腐烂与分解 (Compost, Decompose, Break Down)
groups.tip: 堆肥发酵降解，化腐朽为养分

items.def_en: to separate organic compounds into simpler substances or decay biologically
1. to convert organic waste, such as leaves and food scraps, into compost 2. to treat soil or plants by spreading compost over them
to be broken down harmlessly into natural products by microorganisms
to rot or decompose through the natural action of bacteria and fungi
to undergo or cause to undergo chemical breakdown through natural biological activity into simpler elements
to rot and decay with the emission of a foul, offensive odor

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the biochemical breakdown of organic matter through natural or managed biological processes into soil-enriching humus or simpler chemical substances.
groups.summary_zh: 指有机物在自然或人为调控下被微生物分解转化为肥料或基础养分。

groups.name: Rot & Decompose · 腐烂与分解 (Rot, Decay, Putrefy)
groups.tip: 有机物从变质逐步化作泥土

items.def_en: To become unfit for eating through age or warm conditions
To gradually degrade, break down, or spoil through organic and chemical processes
To undergo natural decomposition through the action of bacteria and fungi
to rot and break down naturally into simpler chemical elements or substances; to separate something into its component parts
To become infected and filled with pus, or rot and decay offensive to the senses
To rot and decay producing a foul and repulsive stench

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses biological and organic deterioration where dead matter breaks down into simpler chemical constituents through bacterial action and natural decay.
groups.summary_zh: 强调有机体因微生物作用而自然败坏、腐烂、解体或质变。

groups.name: Rote Mimicry & Unthinking Repetition · 机械复述与盲从传话 (Regurgitate, Ape, Chime in)
groups.tip: 像鹦鹉学舌般机械照搬复读

items.def_zh: 装模作样地说；口头上空洞念诵
items.def_en: To utter or say words, platitudes, or solemn promises insincerely or without real conviction

items.def_zh: 反复齐呼；机械式反复念诵
items.def_en: To shout or speak slogans, verses, or phrases repetitively in unison or in a monotone manner

items.def_zh: 机械地重复，盲目附和，学舌
items.def_en: 1. (disapproving) To repeat someone else's words or ideas mechanically without really understanding them.

items.def_zh: 老生常谈地搬出；重复俗套的说辞
items.def_en: (disapproving) To produce clichéd arguments, stock excuses, or familiar quotes routinely and predictably

items.def_zh: 拙劣模仿；生硬效仿（他人言行）
items.def_en: To imitate someone's speech mannerisms or gestures clumsily or without comprehension

items.def_zh: 照本宣科地复述；生搬硬套
items.def_en: (disapproving) To reproduce facts, phrases, or arguments mechanically without digesting or understanding them

groups.summary_en: This communication frame describes repeating or mimicking utterances, slogans, or dogma in a mindless, uncritical, or automated fashion. It highlights a lack of original understanding, critical evaluation, or genuine communicative intent.
groups.summary_zh: 强调不假思索、缺乏主见或机械式地照搬与重复他人的言论。

groups.name: Rumble & Boom · 轰鸣与隆隆声 (Resound, Roar, Peal)
groups.tip: 低沉而震耳欲聋的声音

items.def_en: To make a continuous low, heavy, resonant sound like thunder or heavy vehicles
To echo repeatedly and loudly, often causing slight physical vibration

items.raw_cluster: 发出轰鸣与作响 Rumble & Boom
items.def_zh: 发出低沉隆隆声，轰鸣；繁荣，激增
items.def_en: 1. To make a deep, loud, resonant sound. 2. To experience rapid economic growth or success.
To make a very loud, deep noise, or move with that kind of tremendous sound
To make a deep, prolonged, very loud sound, like an engine or a stormy sea
To sound out in a loud, echoing burst or ring with prolonged resonance

groups.summary_en: This frame comprises emitting continuous, deep, explosive, or resonant acoustic vibrations such as thunder, artillery, heavy machinery, or amplified sound.
groups.summary_zh: 指发出沉闷低回、震耳欲聋或持续回响的轰隆声。

groups.name: Run Organized Extortion · 有组织敲诈与非法勾当 (Racketeer, Swindle, Hustle)
groups.tip: 黑帮以暴力敲诈勒索钱财

items.def_en: To make an unfair, exorbitant profit through predatory or illicit circumstances
To intimidate and extort money from someone through underworld muscle
To use physical force, intimidation, or aggressive threats to compel compliance
To strip someone of money or property through fraudulent, predatory schemes
To wrest money or property through illicit and systematic intimidation

items.def_zh: 进行非法敛财，参与敲诈勒索
items.def_en: To make money through dishonest, fraudulent, or illegal business schemes such as extortion.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on engaging in structured, institutionalized, or organized crime schemes—such as protection rackets, predatory scams, or underworld financial coercion.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过有组织团伙、欺诈性生意网络或保护费机制长期实施非法敲诈牟利。

groups.name: Sacrifice & Forego · 牺牲与放弃 (Surrender, Relinquish, Forego)
groups.tip: 为大局舍弃个人利益

items.def_en: To cheerfully or deliberately abstain from having or enjoying something desirable
To abandon ownership, pursuit, or possession of something valuable
To lose or give up a privilege, asset, or right as a consequence of error, duty, or rule
To willingly surrender custody, a claim, right, or treasured possession to another
1. To give up something valued for the sake of other considerations or for someone else. 2. To offer something as a sacrifice to a deity.
(+ to) To give up a right, advantage, or resource under external pressure or duty

groups.summary_en: Encompasses voluntarily relinquishing valuable possessions, rights, advantages, or ethical standings for a higher purpose, duty, or obligation.
groups.summary_zh: 指为实现崇高目标或迫于义务，自愿让出或割舍重大利益。

groups.name: Sanctify & Elevate to Sainthood · 封圣与祝圣 (Canonize, Sanctify, Beatify)
groups.tip: 宗教层面的祝圣与尊奉

items.def_en: To officially declare someone to be a saint (canonize); to regard or treat someone as holy or a saint.
To officially declare a person, bread/wine, or building sacred to God

items.def_zh: 奉为神明般供奉，铭记并崇敬
items.def_en: To place a relic or revered figure in a shrine or regard with sacred veneration

items.def_zh: 使神圣化，祝圣；使正当化，认可
items.def_en: 1. To make something holy or officially bless it through a religious ceremony. 2. To give official or religious sanction to something, making it morally acceptable.

items.def_zh: 册封为圣人，追封为圣徒
items.def_en: To officially declare a dead person to be an authorized saint in the church

items.def_zh: 宣福，行宣福礼（封圣前奏）
items.def_en: (of the Pope) To officially announce that a deceased person is blessed, preliminary to canonization

groups.summary_en: This ecclesiastical and ritual frame concerns solemn religious authority declaring a deceased person a saint, elevating an object or status to sacred veneration, or rendering a person or place holy through sacrament and decree.
groups.summary_zh: 指宗教机构或权威通过庄严仪式将人册封为圣徒，或将事物祝圣使之神圣化。

groups.name: Satisfy & Gratify · 满足与取悦 (Satisfy, Please, Content)
groups.tip: 满足欲望与期许使其称心

items.def_en: To make someone feel happy, satisfied, or approving
To make someone feel happy and satisfied with what they have, often keeping expectations modest
To fulfill someone's needs, demands, or expectations, making them feel pleased or contented
To allow someone or oneself to enjoy the pleasure of something, often to excess

items.def_zh: 使满意，使高兴；满足（欲望、期许等）
items.def_en: To please or satisfy someone, or to indulge a craving, desire, or appetite.
To bring pleasure, relief, or deep satisfaction to someone's heart or mind

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving someone pleasure by fulfilling their desires, needs, or expectations. While 'gratify' often implies indulging an appetite, pride, or deep craving, synonyms range from basic fulfillment to soothing delight.
groups.summary_zh: 描述满足他人欲望、需求或虚荣心，带来愉悦与宽慰。

groups.name: Saturate & Permeate · 浸透与渗透 (Saturate, Permeate, Pervade)
groups.tip: 深层浸润直至彻底饱和

items.def_en: To thoroughly immerse or imbue an object or person with a quality or medium
To spread completely throughout every part of an object, space, or group

items.def_zh: 使浸透，使充满；使受孕，使怀孕
items.def_en: 1. to soak or fill something completely with a liquid, gas, or substance 2. to make a female pregnant
To spread through and be noticeable throughout every portion of something
