To spread gradually through, across, or over something with liquid, light, or color
To make something hold as much liquid, moisture, or solute as can possibly be absorbed

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a substance, liquid, or gas entering, diffusing through, and filling every pore, fiber, or corner of an object until total absorption or saturation is reached.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、气体或特性深度渗入多孔介质的每一细孔，达到彻底充塞饱和。

groups.name: Scan & Inspect · 扫视与审视 (Scan, Scrutinize, Skim)
groups.tip: 快速扫读细致检查各处

items.def_en: To look at or examine something quickly and briefly, often to form a preliminary impression
(+ through/over) To read or look through something quickly in order to identify the main points without reading every word

items.def_zh: 细看，审视；粗略翻阅，扫视；扫描（图像或数据）
items.def_en: 1. To look at something carefully and thoroughly in search of something. 2. To read or look over something quickly. 3. To pass an optical or electronic beam over something to capture data or an image.
(+ over/across) To move one's eyes or gaze quickly and smoothly across an area in search of something
To look at and read or study a book, map, or document with prolonged, focused attention
To examine someone or something very carefully and thoroughly, looking for details, errors, or hidden clues

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe directing one's gaze systematically over an area, text, or surface, ranging from rapid visual sweeps to rigorous, detail-oriented examination.
groups.summary_zh: 指有条理地注视或查阅，涵盖快速浏览与细致审视。

groups.name: Scar & Disfigure · 留下伤痕与损容 (Scar, Deface, Blemish)
groups.tip: 从局部伤痕到完全毁灭破损

items.def_en: To spoil the appearance or flaw the perfect surface or reputation of something

items.def_zh: 使留下伤痕；使心灵受创伤；结疤
items.def_en: 1. To leave a permanent physical mark on the skin or land. 2. To leave a lasting feeling of grief or emotional trauma in someone. 3. To form a scar.
To ruin or diminish the perfection, completeness, or attractiveness of something
To deliberately spoil the appearance of something, especially by writing on or cutting it
To spoil the attractive appearance of someone or something severely and often permanently
To inflict severe and lasting emotional shock or deep psychological pain upon someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe leaving lasting, visible, or psychological marks that mar the appearance, integrity, or emotional well-being of someone or something. They range from superficial blemishes to deep, permanent disfigurement.
groups.summary_zh: 描述在身体、景物或心灵上留下永久性伤痕、玷污或毁容。

groups.name: Scatter & Clutter · 散落与杂乱丢弃 (Litter, Clutter, Strew)
groups.tip: 随处抛掷散落成杂乱

items.def_en: To leave things in untidy places where they ought not to be
To throw or drop things in different directions so they cover an area

items.def_zh: 乱扔；到处散落，乱七八糟地堆满；（动物）产仔
items.def_en: 1. To leave rubbish or scattered items lying untidily around a place. 2. (of an animal) To give birth to a litter of young.
To make an area dirty, untidy, or disordered
To fill or cover a place with an untidy collection of things
To scatter things untidily over a surface or place

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on depositing items haphazardly or untidily across a surface or space, often creating disorder, untidiness, or obstruction.
groups.summary_zh: 表示将杂物、垃圾等凌乱散放或随意丢弃在某处，造成杂乱无章的景象。

groups.name: Scatter & Disperse · 分散与驱散 (Disperse, Dissipate, Disband)
groups.tip: 由聚到散四散奔逃

items.def_en: To run away quickly with light, hurried steps in different directions
1. To move or cause people or animals to suddenly move in different directions; disperse. 2. To throw or drop things in different directions over a wide area.
To spread out widely or drive a group of people or things away in various directions
To gradually disappear or cause smoke, mist, or feelings to vanish into thin air
To stop functioning as a formal group, committee, or military unit and separate
To scatter things messily untidily over a surface or area

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate crowds, objects, or clouds breaking up and moving outward in all directions, dissolving cohesion. They highlight random distribution or the complete breakup of a unified mass.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重聚集的人群、微粒或物体向四面八方散去，使其不再凝聚。

groups.name: Screen & Filter · 筛查与甄别 (Filter, Vet, Sift)
groups.tip: 通过检查过滤不良信息

items.def_zh: 甄别，筛查；审查；遮蔽，掩护
items.def_en: 1. To test, examine, or check people or things to find disease, faults, or suitability. 2. To protect, shelter, or hide behind a screen.
(often + out) To pass items through a selective process to keep desirable elements and reject others
To assign degrees of urgency to wounds, illnesses, or tasks to decide order of treatment
To eliminate inferior, unsuited, or unwanted members from a group
To examine someone or something to confirm truth, identity, or soundness
To investigate someone's background, past record, or suitability thoroughly before approval

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote systematically evaluating candidates, items, or signals through standardized tests or criteria to identify flaws, verify qualifications, or isolate acceptable targets.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过既定标准或测试对人员或事物进行系统性筛查、背景审查或甄别淘汰。

groups.name: Scroll & Browse · 滚屏与翻动 (Scroll, Swipe, Flick)
groups.tip: 屏幕或页面上下翻动

items.def_en: To turn the pages of a book, document, or publication quickly

items.def_zh: 滚屏，滚翻（屏幕内容）；（使）卷起
items.def_en: 1. (+ up/down/through) (computing) To move text, images, or webpage content across a screen. 2. To curl or cause to curl into the shape of a scroll.
To inspect text, goods, or online content casually without a fixed goal
(+ through) To turn pages quickly or perform short, fast scrolling gestures
(+ left/right/up) To move a finger across a touchscreen to change content or view pages
(+ through) To read or view text rapidly in order to grasp the main points

groups.summary_en: Covers digital interaction gestures and rapid mechanical scanning through digital pages, texts, feeds, or physical leaves.
groups.summary_zh: 指在屏幕或书页上滑动、翻动浏览以查看连续图文内容。

groups.name: Seam & Join · 接缝与缉缝 (Hem, Stitch, Overlock)
groups.tip: 针线压缝合拢衣物接缝

items.def_en: To sew over the edge of one or two pieces of cloth to reinforce and bind the seam
To join or decorate materials with needle and thread in continuous patterns

items.def_zh: 缝合，用接缝连接；使出现裂纹（或皱纹）
items.def_en: 1. To join two edges of cloth, leather, or metal together with a seam. 2. To mark with lines or wrinkles.
To stitch together layers of fabric with a soft padding in between
To fold back and sew down the edge of a piece of cloth to prevent fraying
To sew pieces of cloth together with long, loose temporary stitches before final sewing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this tailoring and textile frame pertain to uniting pieces of fabric, leather, or sheet metal along their edges with continuous stitch lines or structural joins.
groups.summary_zh: 裁缝与装配场景，指沿织物、皮革或金属边缘缝合拼接形成接缝。

groups.name: Search & Probe · 探寻与摸索 (Fumble, Grope, Scrabble)
groups.tip: 摸索探试以获知内情

items.def_zh: 摸索寻找，探听；捕鱼，钓鱼
items.def_en: 1. (+ for/in) To try to find something by feeling around; to try to get information, compliments, or attention indirectly. 2. To catch or try to catch fish.
To search clumsily or awkwardly for something using one's fingers in a pocket, bag, or dark space
To search thoroughly through a collection of things by turning them over and moving them aside
To feel about blindly, hesitantly, or uncertainly with one's hands in search of something
To scratch or grope around frantically and hurriedly with one's fingers to locate something
To search relentlessly until hidden items, elusive facts, or secrets are discovered

groups.summary_en: Refers to searching blindly, tactilely, or indirectly for an object or information without direct line of sight. 'Fish' highlights reaching into a receptacle or angling for an outcome, whereas 'grope' and 'fumble' emphasize uncoordinated or vision-impaired touch.
groups.summary_zh: 指在盲视或受限环境下凭触觉、试探摸索搜寻目标。

groups.name: Secure Custodial Release · 司法保释与暂释 (Parole, Remand, Spring)
groups.tip: 保释出狱或从束缚中解脱

items.def_zh: （非正式）捞人；助人越狱或迅速保释出狱
items.def_en: (informal) To help someone escape from jail or arrange for their sudden, successful release from custody

items.def_zh: 保释出狱；（引申）施以财务救援
items.def_en: To secure the release of an arrested suspect by providing financial security to the court

items.def_zh: 释放；撤案释放（羁押人员）
items.def_en: To give official permission to an inmate or suspect to leave custody because charges are dropped or completed

items.def_zh: 保释（某人）；（用容器）舀水（出船舱）
items.def_en: 1. ('bail out') To pay money to secure the temporary release of an accused person from custody before trial. 2. ('bail out') To empty water from a boat using a bucket or container.
To officially forgive a crime and release someone from legal penalties or confinement
To grant a prisoner early release from prison on the condition of good behavior under supervision

groups.summary_en: This legal and custodial frame covers securing the release of an incarcerated, detained, or arrested person, often conditioned upon financial guarantees, supervision, or covert intervention. Terms vary from formal statutory procedures to informal prison slang.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及通过保释金、假释等司法程序或外部干预使羁押人员重获自由。

groups.name: Seduce & Charm · 勾引与诱惑 (Seduce, Captivate, Bewitch)
groups.tip: 以甜言蜜语或魅力诱人入局

items.def_en: To please and attract someone by being pleasant, engaging, or courteous
1. To persuade someone to have sexual relations with you. 2. (+ into) To tempt or attract someone into doing something unwise or wrong.
To attract and hold someone's full attention or affection through exceptional charm or beauty
To powerfully attract or charm someone by an alluring appearance, charm, or offer
To fascinate, enchant, or captivate someone so strongly that they seem under a spell
To charm, enchant, or attract someone, sometimes in a deceptive or insidious way

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on enticing someone into romance, physical intimacy, or unwise compromises through powerful charisma, flattering blandishments, or sensual allure. Nuances stretch from passionate attraction to cynical manipulation.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重以魅力、甜言蜜语或感官诱惑促使他人动情或做出违背原则之事。

groups.name: Seize & Snatch · 夺取与抢夺 (Grab, Snatch, Wrest)
groups.tip: 伸手迅猛夺走物品

items.def_en: To steal or seize something swiftly and casually, often when no one is watching
To buy or obtain something eagerly and immediately as soon as it becomes available
To take hold of something suddenly, roughly, or eagerly with one's hand
To take hold of something suddenly and firmly, often using official authority or force

items.def_zh: 猛抢，一把夺过；抓紧时间做（如抢先获胜、抓紧休息）；绑架
items.def_en: 1. To take or grab something quickly, suddenly, or roughly. 2. To quickly seize a victory or opportunity, or get a brief period of rest. 3. (informal) To kidnap someone.
To forcibly pull or extract something from someone's grip or control with great effort

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to taking possession of an object or advantage abruptly, roughly, or by rapid opportunistic action. While some denote quick physical clutching, others emphasize forceful extraction or competitive usurpation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以猝不及防、粗暴或投机的方式迅速夺取物品或控制权。

groups.name: Sell & Auction · 抽奖式与竞价拍卖销售 (Raffle, Auction, Liquidate)
groups.tip: 通过公开竞价或摸彩出售

items.def_en: To group goods into lots for sale by auction
To sell something to the highest bidder at a public auction event
(+ to) To declare an item sold at auction by striking the gavel
To bargain or haggle back and forth publicly regarding prices in a sale

items.def_zh: 以抽奖方式送出或售出
items.def_en: To sell tickets to many buyers and distribute the item as a prize to the drawn winner

items.def_zh: 拿……抽奖出售，以摸彩方式卖出
items.def_en: (often 'raffle off') To offer an item as a prize in a raffle, selling numbered tickets to determine the winner.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers structured, public disposal mechanisms where goods are sold through competitive open bidding or randomized lot-drawing (raffles/lotteries), commonly seen in fund-raising, estate clearing, or clearance events.
groups.summary_zh: 通过公开竞拍或抽奖券机制转让、处置财物或奖品。

groups.name: Sell & Vend · 出售与倒手 (Resell, Flip, Offload)
groups.tip: 面向公众转卖或向外兜售

items.def_en: To transfer ownership or clear out an asset by sale or formal settlement

items.def_zh: 以旧折价换新；折价转让
items.def_en: To give a used product as partial payment when purchasing a replacement model

items.def_zh: 快买快卖；翻转倒卖（房产等）
items.def_en: To buy an asset, improve or hold it briefly, and quickly resell it for a quick profit
To sell something, often fast, cheap, or by persuasive touting

items.def_zh: 转售，倒手卖出，转手出售
items.def_en: To sell something that you previously purchased, especially for a profit.
To sell or dispose of surplus, unwanted, or risky goods or shares to another party

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail transferring previously purchased or held commodities, assets, or property to a downstream buyer, frequently driven by financial turnover, liquidation, secondary markets, or arbitrage.
groups.summary_zh: 转售、倒卖或处理已持有的商品、资产以回笼资金或获利。

groups.name: Send & Dispatch · 发送与派遣 (Dispatch, Route, Forward)
groups.tip: 寄送物品或派发人员

items.def_en: To distribute or post large quantities of invitations, circulars, or signals
To send commercial merchandise or cargo by postal service, freight, or sea
To re-send or redirect mail, emails, or packages to a subsequent recipient
To send something along a planned pathway or course

items.def_zh: 发送，寄出；派遣，打发；促使，使处于某种状态
items.def_en: 1. To arrange for something to be carried, delivered, or transmitted to a place. 2. To cause or order someone to go somewhere. 3. To cause someone or something to move or be in a particular state.
To send off someone or something promptly to a specific destination for a specific purpose

groups.summary_en: Involves causing goods, messages, or personnel to be transported or delivered to an intended destination. Highlights differences in promptness, routing, and formality.
groups.summary_zh: 安排人员、物品或信息送达或派往指定地点。

groups.name: Sensory Overwhelm & Impairment · 感觉剥夺与感官损害 (Deafen, Blind, Stun)
groups.tip: 震聋耳朵等造成感官功能受损

items.def_en: To deprive a part of the body of sensation or make someone unable to feel physical sensations
To make someone unable to think clearly or react properly due to shock, blow, or glare
To knock unconscious or semi-conscious, or overwhelm sensory faculties with shock or sound
To cause someone to lose their sight permanently, or temporarily through an intense flash of light
1. (often passive) To make someone unable to hear, either permanently or temporarily, due to an extremely loud noise.
To cause a person or body part to completely lose the ability to move or feel

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on verbs denoting the temporary or permanent disabling of bodily senses or cognitive faculties through intense physical stimuli. They emphasize sensory shock ranging from transient daze to lasting physical incapacity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强烈的外部刺激造成感官功能受损、麻木或暂时丧失知觉。

groups.name: Serve & Dole Out · 盛出与施舍式分发 (Dish out, Spoon, Dole out)
groups.tip: 盛饭布菜式逐一分派

items.def_en: To provide food or drink to someone at a meal or table

items.def_zh: 盛（饭菜），分发（食物）；（dish out）分发，分派（建议、惩罚等）
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'dish up / dish out') To serve or distribute food into dishes or onto plates. 2. ('dish out') To distribute or dispense something freely, such as advice, criticism, or punishment.
To distribute something, such as food or criticism, freely and often generously or indiscriminately
To distribute something, usually money, food, or assistance, in small measured amounts
To transfer food from a container to plates using a large spoon
To give things to each person in a group by hand

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the physical, everyday act of distributing food onto plates, or colloquially distributing criticism, information, or handouts broadly and sometimes haphazardly.
groups.summary_zh: 指将食物盛到盘中分发，或引申为施舍、随意大量分发（常含口语色彩）。

groups.name: Serve & Tend · 侍候与接待 (Wait on, Tend, Cater)
groups.tip: 担任侍应生端盘服务宾客

items.def_en: To serve food and drink to someone at a table, or attend to someone's personal needs
To care for or manage something attentive to customer needs, especially in 'tend bar'
To provide food and beverage services for events, or supply what is needed and wanted

items.def_zh: 当女侍应生，当女服务员
items.def_en: To work as a waitress serving food and drinks in a restaurant or café.
To prepare and serve alcoholic drinks behind a bar in an establishment
(+ to) To attend to someone's needs, health, comfort, or spiritual welfare

groups.summary_en: This frame covers attending to the physical needs of patrons or masters by serving food, drinks, or hospitality. Verbs emphasize institutional service or attentive personal pampering.
groups.summary_zh: 指在餐饮、旅宿或家庭环境中提供侍餐、照料与殷勤服务。

groups.name: Servile Subservience & Deference · 卑屈俯首与奴颜屈从 (Kowtow, Truckle, Grovel)
groups.tip: 面对强权卑躬屈膝并服从

items.def_en: (+ before/to) To cower servilely and fawn obsequiously upon a superior
(+ to) To show extreme reverence, subservience, or uncritical submission to a master
(+ to) To submit obsequiously and yield meekly to another's will
(+ to/before) To act in an obsequious or degrading manner to obtain forgiveness or favor

items.def_zh: 卑躬屈膝，唯命是从；磕头
items.def_en: (+ to) (disapproving) to show excessive deference or submission to someone in power; (historical) to kneel and touch the ground with the forehead in worship or submission
To behave sycophantically toward someone influential in hopes of personal advancement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe excessive, groveling, or humiliating subservience shown to a dominant person or power. They highlight extreme willingness to sacrifice self-respect or autonomy in order to curry favor or avoid punishment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调丧失自尊、讨好权贵的极度卑躬屈膝、盲从逢迎或奴隶式的屈服。

groups.name: Severing & Cleaving · 砍断与断绝 (Sever, Cleave, Sundering)
groups.tip: 彻底切断斩断使分离

items.def_en: To remove by cutting, or to completely interrupt access, supply lines, or personal contact
To chop or slice away a protruding part, branch, or limb with a single decisive stroke

items.def_zh: 切断，割断；断绝（联系、关系）
items.def_en: 1. To cut completely through something so it separates into two parts. 2. To break off or completely end a relationship, connection, or diplomatic tie.
To split or sever something cleanly and powerfully along a natural grain or plane with a heavy blade
To surgically cut off a limb or digit, or figuratively lop off an essential component
To forcefully tear or drive apart into separate pieces or divided factions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote forceful, complete separation of a physical object into distinct parts with an edged tool or overwhelming force, frequently extended to absolute, irreversible termination of relationships, ties, or communications.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以利刃或猛力彻底斩断实体，或决绝切断关系、纽带与联系。

groups.name: Shed & Cast Off · 蜕变与脱落 (Slough, Shed, Moult, Cast off)
groups.tip: 自然脱去死皮或旧层

items.def_en: come off in strips or flakes from a surface, or strip away an outer layer
lose or cast off hair, skin, leaves, or clothes naturally or intentionally
shed or remove the surface dead cells from skin in scales or flakes
shed feathers, hair, or an outer cuticle periodically to make way for new growth
rid oneself of something burdensome or shed an old protective layer
(often slough off) to shed dead skin or an outer layer naturally, or to get rid of something unwanted or unpleasant

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe natural, biological shedding or intentional detachment of an outer layer—such as reptile skin, animal coats, dead human tissue, or outgrown beliefs. They denote shedding a husk to emerge renewed.
groups.summary_zh: 指表皮、毛发等自然蜕落，或引申为摆脱多余沉重旧物之状态改变。

groups.name: Shelter & Hole Up · 隐蔽与据守 (Take Cover, Hole Up, Hunker Down)
groups.tip: 躲入地堡掩体以防遭受打击

items.def_en: To get behind or under a protective barrier to shield oneself from incoming danger
To stay hidden or secluded in a safe, concealed place over a prolonged period

items.def_zh: 蹲守潜伏；原地避险待命
items.def_en: To settle in a safe, sheltered place and prepare to wait out an ongoing danger or storm
To dig defensive trenches and fortify one's position to resist assault

items.def_zh: 躲入地堡（掩体）；使（球）击入沙坑
items.def_en: 1. ('bunker down') to take shelter in a safe, fortified place to protect oneself from an attack or disaster. 2. (golf) to hit a golf ball into a bunker

items.def_zh: 构筑壕沟据守；使固守防线
items.def_en: To establish oneself or troops firmly in defensive trenches or fortified positions

groups.summary_en: This frame involves seeking refuge or holing up in fortified, entrenched, or safe locations to withstand an external threat, storm, or attack.
groups.summary_zh: 躲入坚固、封闭或安全据点以躲避外部危险、攻击或灾难。

groups.name: Shiver & Tremble · 战栗与发抖 (Shiver, Tremble, Quiver)
groups.tip: 因寒冷恐惧产生的肢体抖动

items.def_en: (+ with/from) To shake slightly and uncontrollably because you are cold, frightened, or excited.
to shake with a slight, rapid, often delicate movement from emotion or tension
(+ sb) Cause someone to tremble or feel deeply shocked and agitated

items.def_zh: 颤抖，战栗，发抖；摇晃，晃动
items.def_en: (+ with/at) To shake slightly and uncontrollably because you are cold, frightened, or emotionally excited; to shake slightly (of the ground or leaves).

items.def_zh: （因恐惧、寒冷等）不寒而栗，战栗，发抖；（机器等）剧烈震颤
items.def_en: (+ at/with) To shake suddenly and violently because of fear, cold, or disgust; (of a vehicle or machine) to shake violently.
to shake violently or continuously, especially from sheer terror or overwhelming shock

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote involuntary, rapid, fine oscillatory movements of the body caused by cold, fear, weakness, excitement, or profound emotional shock. 'Shiver' is predominantly thermal, 'tremble' spans cold, terror, and physical frailty, while 'shudder' signals an intense, convulsive spasm.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体因寒冷、恐惧、虚弱或震骇而产生的不自主颤动。

groups.name: Shoulder & Bear · 承担与背负 (Shoulder, Bear, Assume)
groups.tip: 主动挑起重担或负责

items.def_en: To bravely endure, support, or carry a heavy burden, sorrow, cost, or responsibility
To take on a position, power, or responsibility formally and officially

items.def_zh: 担负，承担（责任、费用等）；用肩推挤
items.def_en: 1. To accept or take on responsibility, blame, or burden. 2. To push or move past someone using your shoulders.
To take in or pay for costs, losses, or shocks without letting them cause breakdown elsewhere
To accept a new challenge, heavy duty, or commitment of personal effort
To accept the blame or responsibility for something that goes wrong, especially when others are at fault

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey accepting, sustaining, or managing heavy obligations, psychological burdens, fiscal debts, or moral liability over time.
groups.summary_zh: 表示自愿接纳或不得不支撑起重任、罪责与经济压力。

groups.name: Shroud & Cloak · 笼罩与裹覆 (Shroud, Cloak, Enfold)
groups.tip: 覆于表面以遮蔽或保护

items.def_en: To cover someone or something securely in paper, cloth, or warm garments
To dress in or cover with a mantle, or to hide and conceal something intentionally

items.def_zh: 覆盖，罩住；（脸上）泛起红晕
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To cover or envelop a surface like a cloak. 2. (literary) (of a blush) To spread over the face.
To wrap, bind, or swaddle someone or something completely in bands of fabric or fog
To surround, wrap, or clasp closely within drapery, arms, or darkness
To cover, envelop, or obscure from view as if with a funerary cloth or dense mist

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict physically or metaphorically enveloping an object or person tightly within a covering, garment, or layer of fog/darkness, emphasizing enclosure, concealment, or solemn protection.
groups.summary_zh: 指像斗篷或帷幔般紧紧包裹、遮蔽或笼罩。

groups.name: Sideline & Marginalize · 边缘化与排挤 (Sideline, Marginalize, Shunt Aside)
groups.tip: 将对手冷落排挤到边缘地带

items.def_en: To take up so much space, attention, or resource that someone or something else is pushed aside
To push someone out of a position, job, or opportunity through aggressive competition
To move someone to a less prominent or unimportant post to avoid dealing with them directly

items.raw_cluster: 排挤与边缘化 Marginalize & Sideline
items.def_zh: 使边缘化，排挤；使退出比赛（因伤等）
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To prevent someone from participating in an activity or playing a major role; to marginalize. 2. To remove a player from a team or game, especially due to injury.
To treat a person, group, or concept as insignificant or peripheral to society or power
To deliberately prevent someone from being involved in a group by being cold or uncooperative

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses manipulative or political actions that diminish a person or group's influence by pushing them away from decision-making or public attention without formal dismissal.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过政治或组织手段将人排挤出核心决策圈、置于边缘位置。

groups.name: Sift & Winnow · 筛选与扬弃 (Sift, Cull, Riddle)
groups.tip: 迎风扬谷吹去糠秕留谷粒

items.def_en: To examine a collection of things carefully to organize them or remove unwanted items
(+ from) To divide distinct components or isolate one material from another
(often + through) To pass a substance through a sieve, or examine a mass of data closely to isolate essentials
To separate large pieces from fine earth, sand, or gravel using a coarse mesh riddle

items.def_zh: 扬去（谷糠），簸（谷）；筛选，甄别挑出
items.def_en: To blow air through grain to separate chaff from seeds, or to narrow down a group by removing less desirable elements.
To reduce population size by removing inferior animals, or select specific items from a pool

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses separating finer particles from coarse chaff physically, or figuratively refining a large volume of choices, evidence, or people to extract only the most valuable remnants.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理上的过筛除杂，或比喻性地细致剔除糟粕以保留精粹。

groups.name: Sign & Execute Agreements · 签署与订立 (Sign, Ink, Ratify, Enter Into)
groups.tip: 签署协议达成正式合约

items.def_en: To write one's name on a document or contract to make it official or legally binding

items.def_zh: 正式签署并生效（法律文件）
items.def_en: To complete all legal formalities required to make a contract or deed valid, especially by signing
To give official approval to an agreement, plan, or document by signing or formally agreeing
To formally bind oneself to a contract, agreement, or institutional partnership

items.def_zh: 正式签署（合同或协议）；给……涂墨水
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To sign a formal contract or agreement. 2. To apply ink to a surface or printing block.
To make a formal agreement, treaty, or amendment officially valid by giving government or organizational sanction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe formalizing legally binding pacts, commercial deals, or official documents by signature or procedural execution. They range from neutral administrative actions to journalistic idioms and high-level diplomatic ratification.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖签署、达成及核准具约束力契约或协议的动词与短语，兼具商务与外交色彩。

groups.name: Sign & Validate · 签署与草签 (Endorse, Countersign, Ink)
groups.tip: 在文件上署名或签署姓名首字母

items.def_en: To write one's name on a formal document to authenticate it or express agreement

items.def_zh: 草签，在……上签署姓名首字母
items.def_en: To mark, sign, or approve a document with the first letters of one's names.
To add a secondary signature to a document previously signed by another party to confirm authenticity
To give official written approval or final authorization to a plan or document
To sign the back of a check or legal paper, or formally give public approval to a policy
(informal/journalistic) To formally sign and execute a deal, contract, or treaty

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate adding signatures, marks, or initials to official instruments, contracts, or draft treaties to indicate review, formal consent, or legal validity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过在文件上草签、签署或批注来确认审阅并赋予正式效力。

groups.name: Silence & Hush · 制止作声与使安静 (Silence, Hush, Muzzle)
groups.tip: 发出嘘声示意安静以制止喧哗

items.def_en: To cause a person, crowd, or controversy to calm down and become quiet
To make someone quiet, calm, or cease making sounds, often gently

items.raw_cluster: 制止与使沉默 Silence & Hush
items.def_zh: （发嘘声）让……安静，使噤声；发出嘘声
items.def_en: To tell someone to be quiet, especially by saying 'shush' or making a similar sound.
To stop talking or become quieter, often in response to an order
To prevent someone from speaking, shouting, expressing opinions, or making noise
To prevent an individual or press from speaking or publishing freely

groups.summary_en: Addresses suppressing vocal noise, speech, or dissent. Stretches from gentle conversational soothing to institutional suppression, gagging, or political muzzling.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过发声规劝、安抚或强硬手段制止发声、压制异议使其安静。

groups.name: Simplify & Clarify · 简化与澄清 (Simplify, Distill, Clarify, Demystify)
groups.tip: 剔除繁复使其清晰明了

items.def_zh: 剔除冗余，剥离至最简形式
items.def_en: To remove all non-essential parts, features, or elaborations so that only the fundamental core remains

items.def_zh: 通俗化，降低门槛（常带贬义）
items.def_en: To simplify academic or intellectual material to an exaggerated degree so anyone can grasp it, often losing nuance
To make a statement, idea, or situation clearer and easier to understand by removing ambiguity
1. To make something easier to understand, use, or do by removing unnecessary complexity.
To extract the most essential points or core ideas from a vast amount of information

items.def_zh: 去神秘化，深入浅出地解释
items.def_en: To make a difficult or obscure subject clear, comprehensible, and easily understood by ordinary people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate rendering complex concepts, texts, or procedures intelligible and clear by stripping away jargon, redundant steps, and ambiguity. They operate mainly on intellectual, rhetorical, or administrative content.
groups.summary_zh: 去除多余修饰、繁杂细节或模糊隐晦，使内容清晰易懂、易于执行。

groups.name: Sit & Settle · 坐下与就座 (Sit, Seat, Perch)
groups.tip: 弯膝落座与安坐指定位置

items.def_zh: 靠坐下；舒适地靠着坐好
items.def_en: To relax and make yourself comfortable by leaning back in a deep chair

items.def_zh: 坐，就座；使就座；坐落于；担任（委员会、法庭等成员）
items.def_en: 1. To rest one's body with the weight supported by the buttocks rather than the feet. 2. To cause someone to sit down; seat. 3. To be located or situated. 4. To serve as a member of an official committee, council, or court.
To guide someone to a chair or provide official sitting accommodation for people

items.def_zh: 使安坐；使舒舒服服坐好
items.def_en: (ensconce oneself) To position oneself comfortably, safely, and securely in a chair or cozy corner
To sit down suddenly, heavily, and clumsily onto a seat
(+ on) To sit on the edge of something narrow or elevated, often precariously

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe assuming or placing someone in a seated posture with body weight supported by the buttocks and thighs. Distinctions turn on formal seating, informal dropping down, high precarious balance, or sinking comfortably into cushions.
groups.summary_zh: 指人就座、坐下，或让某人安置于坐席上。

groups.name: Skip & Bypass · 跳过与绕过 (Omit, Sidestep, Bypass)
groups.tip: 略过既定步骤或直接绕开

items.def_en: To ignore or disregard someone or something, especially in favor of another
To spend too little time, money, or effort on something essential, effectively cutting corners

items.def_zh: 略过，跳过；避开，缺席；蹦跳着走
items.def_en: 1. To pass over or omit an item, step, or stage, moving directly to the next. 2. (informal) To not attend an event, meeting, or class that you should attend. 3. To move forward with light, springy steps, hopping on each foot in turn.
To advance ahead out of proper turn or omit intervening stages in a sequence
To avoid or circumvent an obstacle, regulation, or official procedure by taking an alternative route
To avoid dealing directly with an issue, question, or obligation by subtle evasion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deliberately omitting, passing over, or navigating around an established step, rule, or obstacle. While 'skip' emphasizes leaving out an item in a sequence, 'bypass' and 'sidestep' highlight evading formal procedures or direct confrontations.
groups.summary_zh: 指有意跳过步骤、规避规则或绕开既定障碍的动作。

groups.name: Slashing & Lacerating · 刀割与砍削 (Slash, Gash, Slit)
groups.tip: 用利刃挥舞劈砍斩削切口

items.def_en: To cut smoothly or forcefully through something with a sharp edge
To cut or tear violently along an edge so that the interior is exposed

1. to cut or hit violently with a sweeping stroke of a knife, sword, or other sharp blade
2. to reduce prices, costs, or jobs drastically
To make a long, straight, narrow cut in something, often with a clean blade
To make a long, deep, violent cut into someone's flesh or a surface
To cut or tear skin or flesh roughly and deeply

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses making long, rapid, sweeping cuts into tissue or material with a sharp, swift edge, producing deep lacerations.
groups.summary_zh: 用锋利刀刃以挥掠之势划开、割破或造成深长裂口。

groups.name: Slay & Slaughter · 杀戮与处死 (Slay, Murder, Execute)
groups.tip: 剥夺生命的不同手段方式

items.def_en: (informal) To murder or eliminate someone purposefully, especially in criminal contexts

items.def_zh: 杀死，致死；终结，破坏；使痛苦不堪
items.def_en: 1. To cause the death of a person, animal, or plant. 2. To stop, destroy, or put an end to something.
To put someone to death lawfully as an official punishment for a capital crime
To kill someone or an animal in a violent, bloody, or archaic/heroic manner
To commit the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing another human being
To kill animals for meat, or kill large numbers of people cruelly and indiscriminately

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intentionally taking the life of a human being or animal. Semantic distinctions hinge on legal execution, brutal butchery, predatory hunting, or unlawful malice.
groups.summary_zh: 指有意剥夺人或动物生命的各种行为，包含处刑、谋害与屠杀。

groups.name: Slide & Slip · 滑行与滑倒 (Slide, Skid, Glide)
groups.tip: 表面失控滑移或打滑倒下

items.def_en: To move continuously, smoothly, and effortlessly through air or over ice

items.def_zh: 打滑，滑倒；悄悄溜走；滑落，下滑
items.def_en: 1. To slide accidentally and lose one's footing or balance. 2. To move quietly and stealthily without attracting attention. 3. To slide smoothly or cause something to glide smoothly into position.
To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact
(+ over/up) To catch one's foot and stumble, often leading to a slip or fall
To slide sideways or uncontrollably over a surface due to loss of traction
To move by sliding sinuously or unstable over a slick, uneven surface

groups.summary_en: Covers smooth continuous movement across a slick surface, or unintended loss of traction causing a sudden loss of balance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在光滑表面上无阻力移动，或因失去抓地力而失去平衡滑倒。

groups.name: Smell & Scent · 嗅探与闻气 (Sniff, Scent, Snuff)
groups.tip: 用鼻子感知空气中气味

items.def_en: To detect by sense of smell, or to sense something imminent intuitively
To draw air audibly up through the nose to detect a scent or clear mucus

items.def_zh: 闻到一缕气味；略微闻到
items.def_en: To catch a brief, faint smell of something, or to emit a puff of odor
To discover or detect something by smelling, or figuratively by shrewd searching

items.def_zh: 闻到，嗅出；散发气味，闻起来有……气味；闻，嗅
items.def_en: 1. To perceive the scent or odor of something using your nose. 2. To have or emit a particular odor, or to smell bad. 3. To sniff at something to discover its odor.

items.def_zh: 抽气嗅闻；用鼻子使劲吸
items.def_en: To inhale audibly through the nose to detect an odor

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the sensory perception of odors through the nose or the emission of a characteristic aroma. Verbs range from involuntary olfaction to active, deliberate sniffing and detecting traces.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖通过嗅觉器官感知气味或自身散发气味的动作与状态。

groups.name: Snag & Catch · 勾绊与卡住 (Snag, Catch, Tangled)
groups.tip: 被突起物挂住或受阻卡壳

items.def_en: To wedge tightly in an opening or mechanism so that motion is completely prevented
(+ on) To become hooked, trapped, or entangled unexpectedly on a protruding object
To fasten, fasten on, or catch onto something with or as if with a hook
To become tangled or caught with lines, ropes, or mechanisms, impeding free movement

items.def_zh: 勾绊，卡住；勾破；抓住，获取
items.def_en: 1. To catch, snag, or tear on a sharp or rough object. 2. (informal) To obtain, catch, or secure something quickly.
To cause something to become twisted, caught, and snared in wires, cords, or vegetation

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mechanical or physical entanglements where an object or garment gets caught on a projection, resulting in an abrupt halt, tear, or obstruction.
groups.summary_zh: 突起物挂住、勾扯或卡阻衣物及物体，导致受阻或撕破。

groups.name: Snake & Meander · 蜿蜒蛇行与盘曲延伸 (Snake, Wind, Meander, Serpentine)
groups.tip: 如蛇一般曲折蜿蜒向前

items.def_en: follow a curving, twisting line, course, or pathway through an area
pass carefully and sinuously through a narrow, crowded, or intricate space
follow a bent or winding route that repeatedly alters orientation
to move, twist, or wind in a sinuous manner like a snake
follow a winding, slow, or circuitous course without fixed urgency
move in or form concentric curved, spiral, or loop-like turns

groups.summary_en: This frame characterizes smooth, fluid, continuous curved motion across space, reminiscent of a snake's locomotion or a meandering river. The curves are sinuous and sweeping rather than sharp or angular.
groups.summary_zh: 指如流水或游蛇般平缓、连续弯曲蜿蜒推进或延伸的轨迹与姿态。

groups.name: Snatch & Swipe · 扒窃与偷摸 (Cop, Swipe, Nick)
groups.tip: 不正当秘密占有财物

items.def_en: To take something that belongs to someone else dishonestly or without asking permission
To steal something, especially from a shop or an unsuspecting person's pocket or bag
To steal an object, often quickly or impulsively
To steal something of little value, usually quickly and without being noticed
To steal something casually or opportunistically, especially an item of modest value
(slang) 1. To steal or take something unlawfully. 2. To catch or arrest someone.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers informal and colloquial acts of snatching, lifting, or sneaking away small items without authorization. It emphasizes casual, illicit, or opportunist appropriation rather than grand larceny.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重口语与俚语中的顺手牵羊、偷摸或顺走小物件。

groups.name: Sniff & Probe · 嗅探与搜搜 (Nose, Sniff, Pry)
groups.tip: 顺着气味蛛丝马迹打探

items.def_zh: 四处探头翻找，随意翻寻
items.def_en: To search through items or explore an area casually or meddlesomely

items.def_zh: 嗅，闻；打听，探听；（车辆、船只等）小心前移
items.def_en: 1. To smell or sniff something; to pry or investigate in a meddlesome way. 2. (of a vehicle or vessel) To move forward slowly and carefully.
To inhale audibly through the nose to identify or scrutinize an odor
To look around furtively trying to find out personal or confidential information
To inquire insolently or intrusively into other people's private matters
To search out tenacity and uncover hidden facts, secrets, or evasive individuals

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate sniffing physically or prying inquisitively into hidden spaces or personal secrets. They describe investigative scrutiny driven by keen olfactory instinct or intrusive curiosity.
groups.summary_zh: 用鼻闻探，或指带着好奇、窥探欲到处打听搜寻。

groups.name: Snigger & Smirk · 讥笑与暗笑 (Snicker, Smirk, Chortle)
groups.tip: 掩嘴暗笑或心怀不善地窃窃嗤笑

items.def_en: To laugh quietly to oneself in a restrained, amused way
(+ at) To laugh quietly or half-suppress a laugh, especially in a disrespectful or unkind manner

items.def_zh: 窃笑，暗笑（尤指不敬或幸灾乐祸地）
items.def_en: (chiefly British) To laugh quietly in an unkind, disrespectful, or covert way.
To laugh nervously, quietly, or covertly, often at something embarrassing or scandalous
To smile in an unpleasant, smug, or conceited way showing self-satisfaction
(+ at) To smile or speak in a mocking, scornful manner that reveals contempt

groups.summary_en: This frame captures quiet, covert, or stifled laughter typically tinged with malice, disrespect, superiority, or amusement at someone else's misfortune or embarrassment.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中、压抑或带有轻蔑嘲弄意味的窃笑与冷笑。

groups.name: Soak & Dunk · 浸湿与浸泡 (Dip, Immerse, Souse)
groups.tip: 没入水中彻底浸湿

items.def_en: To put something briefly into a liquid and take it out again immediately

items.def_zh: 泡一下，浸入（液体中）；（篮球中）扣篮
items.def_en: 1. to dip something, especially bread or a biscuit, briefly into a liquid before eating it 2. (basketball) to slam the ball directly down through the hoop
To plunge an object completely into a liquid bath
To plunge suddenly into liquid, or to douse heavily with water
To push or thrust something vigorously and suddenly into a liquid
To push or drop something entirely below the surface of water

groups.summary_en: This frame covers brief, deliberate, or physical actions of plunging an object momentarily into liquid—such as dipping food, submerging laundry, or plunging a person playfully.
groups.summary_zh: 指迅速、刻意地将物体短暂浸入或沉入液体中，如蘸食或短时间浸洗。

groups.name: Soften & Make Pliant · 软化与赋柔 (Mollify, Tenderize, Condition)
groups.tip: 使质地变柔顺便于弯折塑形

items.def_en: To make muscles or joints flexible and ready for action through gentle exercise

items.def_zh: 保养；调理（皮革或毛发）以保柔润
items.def_en: To treat leather, hair, or skin with a liquid or cream to make it soft and healthy
To make or become softer, less hard, or less stiff
To make something soft, pliant, and flexible.
To make meat tender and easy to chew by beating it or applying a substance
To press, squeeze, and work dough or clay with the hands to make it smooth and pliable

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on rendering physical materials or bodies softer, more pliable, and less rigid, often through treatment, mechanical kneading, or conditioning.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过揉捏、加工或涂敷使质地变软、富有韧性及顺应性。

groups.name: Solve & Crack · 攻关与破题 (Work out, Figure out, Crack, Unravel)
groups.tip: 从解答问题到彻底化解

items.def_en: To think about something until you finally understand it or find the right answer
To discover the answer to a complicated problem by thinking very hard about it over time

items.def_zh: 计算出；推导出解决办法
items.def_en: To find the answer to a mathematical problem, calculation, or logical puzzle by reasoning

items.def_zh: 解决（问题）；解答，破解（谜题、案件等）
items.def_en: To find an acceptable answer to, explanation for, or way of dealing with a problem, mystery, or puzzle.
To understand a complicated reason or deep mystery after thorough examination
To succeed in finding the solution to a difficult problem, code, or mystery, often after tough effort

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the intellectual exertion and breakthrough involved in conquering a puzzle, mathematical challenge, or mystery. The continuum spans methodical computation ('work out') to sudden cognitive triumph ('crack').
groups.summary_zh: 通过脑力探索、逻辑推导或顿悟攻克难题、谜局或算法。

groups.name: Solve & Troubleshoot · 调试与排障 (Debug, Diagnose, Trace, Fix)
groups.tip: 排查系统故障并逐一解决疑难

items.def_en: To eliminate bugs, glitches, or technical flaws through testing and adjustments
(+ to) To follow the history, steps, or source of a glitch back to its point of origin
To determine the exact nature or cause of a mechanical problem, software defect, or operational issue
To discover, explain, or locate the exact place or cause of an error or problem
To look for and remove errors, faults, or bugs from a computer software program or hardware system

items.def_zh: 排查并解决故障，排除疑难
items.def_en: To locate and solve technical faults or problems in machinery, computer systems, or organizations.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the methodical diagnostic process of isolating defects, bugs, or operational failures in machines, software, or workflow systems, then systematically correcting them.
groups.summary_zh: 对机械、程序或系统进行故障定位、查因与调试修复。

groups.name: Sound Brass & Horn Calls · 吹奏与号角鸣响 (Trumpet, Toot, Blare)
groups.tip: 通过吹奏号角等发出警报

items.def_en: To cause a horn, trumpet, or alarm to produce a signal or call
To play a tune on a pipe or flute, or produce a high-pitched whistling note

items.def_zh: 高声吹奏；发出大象般的吼声
items.def_en: To play loudly on a trumpet or brass instrument, or make a loud, ringing sound like that of an elephant
To make a short, sharp whistling or honking sound, especially on a horn, whistle, or pipe
To make a loud, harsh, piercing sound, typical of brass horns, sirens, or trumpets

items.def_zh: 吹军号，吹号；（麋鹿等）发出高亢号声
items.def_en: 1. To play a bugle or sound a signal with a bugle. 2. (of an elk or other animal) To make a loud, ringing trumpeting call.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to playing wind or brass instruments to produce clear, loud musical signals or animal calls that carry over long distances. They range from formal fanfare blasts to short, sharp piping notes.
groups.summary_zh: 指吹响号角或铜管乐器发出嘹亮信号，或模拟动物高亢鸣叫。

groups.name: Spatial Retreat & Receding · 空间后撤与退缩 (Withdraw, Retreat, Ebb)
groups.tip: 自前方向后撤离或渐远

items.def_en: Withdraw from enemy forces or dangerous ground to a place of safety
Move backward, especially as a strategic military maneuver to safer defensive lines
Move backwards slowly away from someone or something dangerous or frightening
Move back or away from a place, military situation, or confrontation

items.def_zh: 后退，退去；逐渐减弱，变得渺茫；（头发等）后移
items.def_en: To move back or away from a previous position; to become smaller, weaker, or less distinct.
(of water or qualities) Flow back out away from land; gradually decline or diminish

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physical backward motion in space, describing bodies, tides, or front lines pulling away, diminishing in prominence, or stepping back.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理空间上的向后移动、潮水消退、阵线撤出或景物渐行渐远。

groups.name: Specify & Itemize · 详细说明与指明 (Enumerate, Itemize, Detail)
groups.tip: 逐一具体列出各项细则要求

items.def_en: To explain the details of something in a very clear, deliberate, and unambiguous way
To describe, list, or explain something fully and point by point
To set down or list individual items or particulars one by one

items.raw_cluster: 详细说明与指明 Detail & Specify
items.def_zh: 明确说明，具体指定，详细列明
items.def_en: To state clearly, explicitly, and in detail as a condition, requirement, or fact.
To state clearly and firmly that something must be done or accepted as part of an agreement
To name things separately one after another, especially in a formal or exhaustive manner

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on identifying or describing components, requirements, or terms with rigorous clarity and precision. Verbs contrast in whether they highlight listing distinct elements one by one, breaking down particulars, or fixing unambiguous conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以清晰、具体的方式列出、详述或明确规定各项细节与要求。

groups.name: Splash & Spray · 飞溅与喷洒 (Splash, Spray, Spatter)
groups.tip: 液体受力喷射或四处飞溅

items.def_en: To scatter tiny drops of liquid or light particles gently over a surface
To scatter liquid in fine, dispersed droplets onto or across a surface

items.def_zh: 飞溅，溅起；泼洒，溅湿；在水中扑腾
items.def_en: 1. (of a liquid) To scatter and fall in drops; to cause liquid to scatter onto someone or something. 2. To move noisily through water making it fly about.
To scatter or fall in discrete drops or small, messy spots across a surface
To splash or move about liquid clumsily inside or over the rim of a container
To splash or scatter a thick liquid noisily and unevenly upon impact

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe liquids scattering, diffusing into droplets, or breaking against solid surfaces upon impact or through deliberate dispersal. They contrast fine airborne misting with heavy, messy sloshes.
groups.summary_zh: 指水滴或液体撞击散开、四处飞溅或均匀洒出。

groups.name: Spoil & Pamper · 溺爱与纵容 (Spoil, Pamper, Indulge)
groups.tip: 无底线纵容悉心娇惯伺候

items.def_en: To comply with someone's wishes or temper in order to keep them contented
To satisfy someone's specific, often selfish or low tastes, needs, or whims
To yield freely to someone's wishes, appetites, or whims without discipline
To gratify or indulge immoral, unreasonable, or distasteful demands
To harm someone's character by granting them everything they want

items.def_zh: 娇生惯养，精心照料；溺爱，纵容
items.def_en: To treat someone with extreme comfort, care, and luxury, often spoiling them.

groups.summary_en: Covers indulging someone's whims, showering them with luxuries, or giving in to demands to their moral or behavioral detriment.
groups.summary_zh: 通过物质奢侈或无底线百依百顺来娇惯放纵他人，致其任性妄为。

groups.name: Sponsor & Fund · 赞助与资助 (Sponsor, Underwrite, Bankroll)
groups.tip: 为特定活动提供资金支持

items.def_en: To provide money for an event, project, or organization from public or institutional reserves
To support a person, organization, or activity by providing money or other resources, often in exchange for commercial publicity
To pay part of the cost of something to keep selling prices down or keep an activity viable

items.def_zh: 承保；包办筹资，承诺兜底
items.def_en: To accept financial responsibility for an endeavor, guaranteeing to cover any losses or shortfalls
To support a person, project, or business venture financially, often supplying all the necessary funds

items.def_zh: 共同赞助；共同发起，联名提出
items.def_en: 1. To fund, organize, or support an event, project, or legislative bill jointly with another sponsor.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing financial backing, material resources, or formal organizational endorsement for an event, project, person, or bill. They vary from formal commercial patronage to colloquial, high-risk financial backing.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及为项目、活动或法案提供资金支持与官方赞助，涵盖正式出资与全额包揽。

groups.name: Sport & Play · 专项球类与休闲竞技 (Golf, Bowl, Skate)
groups.tip: 从事体育运动或休闲玩耍

items.def_en: to fight someone in the sport of boxing using gloved fists
to play the game of bowling or lawn bowls
To play the game of golf.
to travel in a boat powered by wind as a recreational activity or sport
to glide on ice skates or roller skates as a sport or pastime
to ride ocean waves standing or lying on a special board

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe participating in specific organized sports, recreational games, or athletic outdoor pastimes.
groups.summary_zh: 指参与特定规则的专项球类运动或休闲体育竞技项目。

groups.name: Spread & Broadcast Rumors · 散播与传扬 (Bruit, Circulate, Bandy)
groups.tip: 消息或流言在人群中传开

items.def_zh: 随口传播（谣言、名字等）；议论纷纷
items.def_en: To mention or discuss a word, rumor, or name casually and repeatedly
To pass or cause to pass from person to person or place to place
To spread information, knowledge, or ideas widely so as to inform many people
(usually 'bruit about/abroad') To spread a report, rumor, or piece of news widely.
To spread a rumor, story, or statement that is often false

items.def_zh: 大肆宣扬；到处讲（隐私或消息）
items.def_en: To tell a piece of news or private detail openly to many people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the deliberate or gossip-driven diffusion of news, rumors, or opinions across a community. They emphasize repetitive hearing, casual talk, or active gossiping.
groups.summary_zh: 描述四处散布、传播谣言、新闻或流言飞语，常带随意性或人际闲谈色彩。

groups.name: Sprint & Bolt · 飞奔与突窜 (Bolt, Dash, Dart)
groups.tip: 极速狂奔夺路而逃

items.def_en: To run or travel somewhere in a great hurry
To run quickly with quick, short, hurried steps
To move somewhere with reckless speed and haste
To run at full top speed over a short distance
To move suddenly and rapidly in a specific direction

items.def_zh: 飞奔，夺路而逃；拴住，锁上
items.def_en: 1. To suddenly run away very fast, especially out of fear or excitement. 2. To fasten a door or window with a bolt.

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe sudden, high-velocity running or flight, often triggered by surprise, panic, or sheer urgency.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因受惊、突发状况或急迫而突然爆发出极高速度飞奔逃窜。

groups.name: Spruce Up & Smarten · 修饰翻新与打扮装点 (Titivate, Freshen, Smarten up)
groups.tip: 打扮修饰使外表光鲜齐整

items.def_en: To make someone or something look cleaner, tidier, or more stylish
To wash oneself or apply quick cosmetic changes to a room to renew its neatness
To make minor decorative changes or grooming touches to improve appearance
To dress up or decorate something in an elaborate or showy way
To improve the appearance of something by making small alterations or corrections

items.def_zh: 收拾，整理；打扮，使光鲜整洁
items.def_en: (usually 'spruce up') To make oneself, a room, or an object cleaner, neater, or more attractive.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on giving a place, object, or person a quick cosmetic improvement to make them look neater, fresher, or more appealing. Unlike heavy renovation, verbs like 'spruce up' and 'freshen up' highlight lightweight grooming, minor repairs, or aesthetic touches.
groups.summary_zh: 指进行快速修饰、收拾或翻新，使人或环境焕然一新。

groups.name: Spy & Snoop · 刺探与窥视 (Snoop, Pry, Peep)
groups.tip: 鬼祟探头窥探他人隐私

items.def_en: To search around a place trying to uncover hidden information or secrets
(+ into/through) To look quickly and secretly at something, especially through a narrow opening
(+ on) To listen secretly to someone else's private conversation

items.def_zh: 刺探，窥察；暗中监视；窥见
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/into) To secretly collect information about someone or an enemy. 2. To catch sight of or suddenly see something.
(+ around/into) To look around secretly in order to find out private information about someone
(+ into) To try to find out personal details about other people's private lives in an intrusive way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe observing others covertly, intrusively, or surreptitiously to uncover private secrets or gather intelligence. They contrast between political or military espionage and nosy, interpersonal meddling.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重暗中监视他人、刺探隐私或搜集秘密情报的窥视行为。

groups.name: Stabilize & Steady · 稳固与平衡 (Stabilize, Steady, Balance)
groups.tip: 保持稳定不再动摇变化

items.def_en: To stop something from shaking, moving, or fluctuating wildly, or to become calm and balanced
To become calm, stable, and regular after a period of excitement, change, or turbulence
To become balanced, steady, and uniform, or to eliminate uneven fluctuations
To stop rising or falling and remain at a constant, stable rate or level
To bring into or reach an equilibrium where opposing forces or factors balance
To become steady, stable, or unchanging, or to make something do this.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes where fluctuating, volatile, or precarious systems, objects, or conditions settle down, reach equilibrium, or are made resilient against disruption. Unlike purely physical solidifying, the emphasis here is on calm constancy and dynamic balance.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统、局势或物体摆脱波动与不稳，趋于平衡与稳定。

groups.name: Stand in & Deputize · 替补与代职 (Stand in, Pinch-hit, Fill in)
groups.tip: 委派替补上场接替原有位置

items.def_en: (informal) (+ for) To act as a substitute, especially in sports or teaching.
(+ for) To take someone's place temporarily, especially at work or in a theatrical role
(+ for) To act as a substitute in an emergency or unexpected absence, originally in baseball
(+ for) To act as a deputy or authorized representative on behalf of a superior or colleague
To enter a situation and take over someone else's role, especially to help solve a problem
To learn another actor's role in order to be able to substitute for them if necessary

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on temporarily stepping in to perform another person's duties, such as in sports, theater, or employment. Verbs emphasize acting as a proxy or emergency understudy.
groups.summary_zh: 指在体育、工作或表演中临时顶替他人职责，充当替补或代理。

groups.name: Station & Deploy · 驻扎与设防 (Garrison, Station, Billet)
groups.tip: 派遣军队进驻要塞要地防守

items.def_en: To assign soldiers, police, or military assets to stay at a specific base or strategic area
To provide living accommodations and sleeping quarters for military personnel
To position military personnel, ships, or equipment systematically ready for tactical action

items.def_zh: 派兵驻守，守卫（要塞或城镇）
items.def_en: To put soldiers in a town, fort, or base to defend it.

items.def_zh: 为（士兵）安排民房借住；留宿
items.def_en: To provide civilian lodgings or temporary quarters for soldiers in a town or base
To set up camp and settle soldiers in temporary outdoor tents or shelters

groups.summary_en: This military frame involves assigning, lodging, or posting troops and defense units in a particular fortress, town, or strategic post for defense, occupation, or operational readiness.
groups.summary_zh: 指将军队派驻、安置于城塞、据点或城镇进行防守、屯驻或常态布控。

groups.name: Steal & Rob · 偷盗与抢劫 (Rob, Burgle, Swipe)
groups.tip: 暗中顺手牵羊小偷小摸

items.def_en: To steal something casually, quietly, or opportunistically
To steal something and escape with it successfully
To steal something directly, or to cheat someone out of money unfairly
1. To take something that belongs to someone else without permission. 2. To move quietly and secretly so as not to be seen or heard.
To enter a building illegally, usually without violence, in order to steal things
To take money or property illegally from a person or place, often using or threatening violence

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses unlawfully taking property from an individual, vehicle, or premises, ranging from stealthy theft to forceful, violent dispossession.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖非法窃取或暴力掠夺他人财物的行为，涉及偷盗与打劫。

groups.name: Steal & Thieve · 偷窃与盗取 (Thieve, Steal, Pilfer)
groups.tip: 暗中非法窃取他人所有

items.def_en: To take another person's property unlawfully and secretly without permission
To steal goods from a retail store while pretending to be an ordinary customer
(dated / literary) To steal things; to take another person's property secretly and dishonestly.

items.def_zh: 小偷小摸，偷窃（微量物品）
items.def_en: To steal things of relatively little value repeatedly or in small quantities
To steal something secretly, often when given access to it or while violating trust
To steal casually or surreptitiously, typically items of minor worth

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this core semantic frame describe taking property unlawfully and covertly without the owner's knowledge or consent. Nuances span from petty theft in workplaces to systemic shoplifting and dishonest appropriation.
groups.summary_zh: 统指不为人知地非法窃取他人财物的行为，涵盖小偷小摸与一般盗窃。

groups.name: Stipulate & Prescribe · 明文规定与硬性约定 (Prescribe, Mandate, Dictate)
groups.tip: 在法律合同中载明具体条款

items.def_en: To state formally and firmly what rule or principle must be observed
To officially order, require, or make obligatory by law or public policy
To lay down authoritatively a rule or course of action to be followed
To control, influence, or lay down binding conditions with supreme authority
To issue an official and inviolable order or proclamation having the force of law
(formal) To state clearly and firmly that something must be done, especially as a condition of an agreement or law.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal and administrative frame describe establishing authoritative, legally binding terms, prerequisites, or rules that parties must adhere to. While 'stipulate' sets contractual conditions, 'prescribe' lays down exact procedures, and 'mandate' enforces by legislative order.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法规、契约或指令明文规定并强制执行特定要求。

groups.name: Stipulate & Prescribe · 规定与约定 (Stipulate, Dictate, Lay down)
groups.tip: 条文法规中明确指令与条款

items.def_en: To state officially what must be done, especially rules, principles, or conditions
To explain or present facts, ideas, or conditions clearly and in detail, especially in writing

items.def_zh: 清楚说明；明文规定细节
items.def_en: To explain something in a very clear way with all details so that there is no misunderstanding

items.def_zh: 规定，指定；（医生）开（药，处方）
items.def_en: 1. To state officially what should be done; set down as a rule or guide. 2. (medical) To tell someone to take a particular medicine or treatment.
To tell someone what to do or decide what must happen with absolute authority
To state clearly and firmly that something must be done, or how it must be done, as part of an official agreement or law

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe officially setting out rules, terms, or conditions that others are required to follow. While 'prescribe' often carries normative or regulatory authority, related terms range from contractual agreements to unilateral requirements.
groups.summary_zh: 以权威或契约形式明确规定条款、行为准则或必要条件。

groups.name: Stonewall & Evasively Delay · 阻挠与拖延对谈 (Stonewall, Temporize, Evade)
groups.tip: 用言语推诿或筑起沟通障碍

items.def_en: To avoid giving a direct answer or firm commitment by choosing ambiguous or evasive language
To satisfy an inquirer or complainant temporarily with an excuse or evasion to avoid answering genuinely
To avoid answering a direct question or dealing with an issue by intentional distraction or cleverness
To speak or act evasively in an inquiry so as to conceal the truth without uttering direct falsehoods
To deliberately avoid making a decision or committing oneself in conversation in order to gain time

items.def_zh: 推诿拖延，阻挠拖延，拒绝配合
items.def_en: 1. To obstruct or delay a discussion, investigation, or political process by refusing to answer questions or give information.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail non-cooperative interpersonal or communicative tactics—such as evasiveness, refusal to answer questions, or strategic stalling—to stymie investigations and negotiations.
groups.summary_zh: 在问讯、谈判中通过沉默、搪塞或顾左右而言他来拖延阻挠对方。

groups.name: Stoop & Hunch · 弯腰与蜷缩 (Hunch, Stoop, Crouch, Slouch)
groups.tip: 弓背缩肩，身体向前弯曲姿态

items.def_en: Bend the head and top of the body forward and downward

items.def_zh: 弯腰弓背，耸起（双肩）；蜷缩
items.def_en: to bend your back and shoulders forward into a curved position, or cause them to bend forward

items.def_zh: 没精打采地下垂坐立，懒散含胸
items.def_en: Stand, sit, or walk with slumped, rounded shoulders and relaxed posture
Lower the body by bending knees close to the chest, often to hide or rest
Curl one's limbs close to the body, typically against cold or emotional distress
Shrink back and crouch down in fear or submission

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe postural adjustments where the spine curves forward or the torso compacts toward the ground, whether from fatigue, dejection, or concealment.
groups.summary_zh: 指脊柱弯曲、含胸驼背或蹲伏蜷缩的身体姿态。

groups.name: Strain & Overexert · 劳损与拉伤 (Overexert, Sprain, Tear)
groups.tip: 过度用力引发肌肉韧带拉伤

items.def_en: To injure a muscle or tendon by overstretching it during physical motion

items.def_zh: 拉伤，扭伤，使过度劳损；极力运用，尽力；拉紧；过滤
items.def_en: 1. To injure a muscle, ligament, or body part by stretching or overexerting it. 2. To make a great physical or mental effort; to push something to its limit. 3. To separate liquid from solid food using a sieve.
To injure a joint by suddenly and violently stretching or tearing its ligaments
(oneself) To make excessive demands on one's physical strength or stamina
To rupture fibers of a muscle, tendon, or ligament through sudden heavy load
To make demands on bodily strength, energy, or health that are far too great

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve pushing muscles, tendons, ligaments, or the bodily constitution beyond its safe threshold, provoking tears or physical injury.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体肌肉、韧带或精力过度用力、拉伸超过负荷，造成局部拉伤扭伤或损伤。

groups.name: Strangle & Choke · 扼杀与勒毙 (Scrag, Strangle, Throtte)
groups.tip: 卡扼住喉咙颈部致使窒息死亡

items.def_en: To impede or prevent breathing by blocking the airway or squeezing the throat from outside
To attack or kill someone by compressing their throat forcefully with one's hands

items.def_zh: 勒死，扼毙；粗暴地抓住颈部殴打
items.def_en: 1. To kill someone by choking, strangling, or hanging them. 2. To seize roughly by the neck or assault violently.
To kill someone by squeezing their neck tightly with hands, a rope, or a cord so they cannot breathe
To execute or kill someone using a wire, cord, or metal collar tightened around the neck
To cause someone to die or lose consciousness by cutting off their intake of air or oxygen

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail violent constriction of the throat, windpipe, or neck causing asphyxiation, ranging from bare-handed choking to garroting.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过掐扼咽喉、收紧环圈致人窒息或死亡的暴力动作。

groups.name: Strategic Retreat & Reversal · 后退与退让 (Retract, Backtrack, Renege)
groups.tip: 改变立场或向后撤退移动

items.def_en: Admit that one is wrong and withdraw a claim or demand in a dispute
Cease to oppose a challenge or withdraw a claim when faced with resistance
Formally withdraw a statement, accusation, or promise as untrue or unjustified
Reverse one's opinion, policy, or position, or return along the same path
(+ on) Fail to fulfill, dishonor, or go back on a promise, contract, or undertaking

items.def_zh: 变卦，改变（立场或决定）；后退；倒蹬自行车脚踏板
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To retreat from or modify a previous statement, opinion, or promise. 2. To move backward or pedal backward on a bicycle.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe figurative movement backward, specifically retreating from a previously held stance, commitment, promise, or argumentative position.
groups.summary_zh: 指在立场、言论、承诺或态度上的后退、食言、撤回或退缩让步。

groups.name: Stretch & Extend · 延伸与延展 (Sprawl, Elongate, Reach)
groups.tip: 向外伸展开来延展

items.def_en: To spread out over a wider area from a central focal point like an opened fan
(+ to/for) To extend continuously so as to touch, cover, or attain a distant boundary
To continue or stretch over a certain area, distance, or period without interruption

items.def_zh: 延伸，伸展，延绵；伸长（肢体）；拉长，撑大
items.def_en: 1. To spread over a large area, distance, or period of time. 2. To make your body or limbs straight and reach out; to pull or spread something wider or longer.
To spread out over a large geographical area in an untidy, irregular, or expansive manner
To become longer or make something longer in relation to its width

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify spatial or physical continuation, broadening, or spreading out across geographical terrain or expanding beyond ordinary boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 描述空间体量、地形或肢体朝外部或纵深持续展开与延伸。

groups.name: Strike & Dislodge Ball · 击球与驱位 (Croquet, Cannon, Dislodge)
groups.tip: 用球槌或器械敲击球体

items.def_zh: 撞碰反弹；使球连续相碰
items.def_en: To strike and bounce off another ball or surface, especially in billiards
To send a ball or object far away by striking it with substantial force
To strike a ball so that it rebounds successively off another ball or cushion
To knock a ball, piece, or obstacle out of its current resting place by physical strike
To leave an opponent unable to hit their designated target ball directly without curving or using a cushion

items.def_zh: （槌球戏中）贴击（击打己球以撞飞紧贴着的对方球）
items.def_en: (in croquet) To drive an opponent's ball away by striking one's own ball when placed in contact with it.

groups.summary_en: This specialized sports and gaming frame focuses on hitting one's own playing ball, puck, or piece directly against an opponent's ball to deflect, relocate, or propel it out of scoring position, characteristic of lawn and cue games.
groups.summary_zh: 在球类或桌游中用球击撞对手的球使其偏离或位移。

groups.name: Strike Heavily with Dull Sound · 重击与闷响 (Thump, Whack, Pound)
groups.tip: 沉重击打发出沉闷撞击声

items.def_en: To strike someone or something vigorously with a forceful blow

items.def_zh: 重重撞击；砰然沉闷作响
items.def_en: To hit something with a dull, heavy, non-resonant sound
To strike heavily and repeatedly with great force
To strike hard and violently, often causing damage or denting

items.def_zh: 重击，重打；砰然撞击；（心脏）怦怦直跳
items.def_en: 1. To hit someone or something heavily with a fist or blunt object, making a dull sound. 2. To beat strongly and quickly.
To hit someone or something extremely hard with a heavy blow

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate striking someone or something with heavy, blunt, forceful physical impact that produces a low, dull sound rather than a sharp crack.
groups.summary_zh: 表示用拳头或钝器大力击打，发出沉闷重响，强调打击力度与低沉声响。

groups.name: Strive & Endeavor · 努力与奋斗 (Strive, Struggle, Toil)
groups.tip: 从普通尝试升级为拼搏奋斗

items.def_en: To try very hard to achieve something despite formidable obstacles
To work hard and exert immense sustained energy to achieve a goal
To apply oneself with heavy mental or physical exertion
To make every possible effort and hold back nothing to achieve success
(+ for/to do) To try very hard to do or achieve something over time
(+ to do) (formal) To try very hard to do or achieve something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey directing sustained willpower, intense energy, and earnest determination toward accomplishing a lofty, challenging goal.
groups.summary_zh: 指为了达成艰巨目标或崇高使命，付出坚韧不拔的意志与全心全力的努力。

groups.name: Submerge & Drown · 浸没与淹没 (Submerge, Inundate, Engulf)
groups.tip: 没入水面之下直至被彻底溺毙

items.def_en: To plunge or dip somebody or something deeply into a liquid until covered

items.def_zh: （使）溺死，（使）淹死；淹没，浸没；压过，盖过（声音）
items.def_en: 1. to die by being submerged in water and unable to breathe, or to kill somebody in this way 2. to cover completely with water or liquid 3. (of a sound) to be loud enough to prevent another sound from being heard

items.def_zh: 淹没（船只等）；使进水下沉
items.def_en: To overwhelm or sink a boat or structure by filling it completely with water
To place or sink something entirely under the surface of water or another liquid
To sweep over and swallow something up completely, as deep water or floodwaters do
To flood or overwhelm an area completely with a surging volume of water

groups.summary_en: This frame covers completely plunging or submerging someone or something underwater, leading to biological suffocation, total engulfment, or overwhelming destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人或物完全没入水中导致窒息死亡，或水势彻底吞没掩盖目标。

groups.name: Substitute & Replace · 替代与替换 (Replace, Swap, Exchange)
groups.tip: 用新角色或事物取代原有位置

items.def_en: To take the place of something, or put a new thing or person in place of an old one
To give something to someone and receive something of equal value or type in return
To change from one thing to another, or substitute one item or method for another
1. (+ for) To use someone or something instead of another. 2. (+ for) To perform a role or task in place of someone else.
(+ for) To do someone's job or duties temporarily while they are away or unable to work
To give something and receive something else in exchange, or exchange one position for another

groups.summary_en: This frame covers putting someone or something in place of another, whether by permanent replacement or functional equivalence. Verbs distinguish between symmetrical swapping and unilateral succession.
groups.summary_zh: 表示用一人或一物取代另一人或物，涵盖对调、更替或功能替代。

groups.name: Sudden Forceful Pulling · 猛拉与拽扯 (Yank, Jerk, Wrench)
groups.tip: 施力拖拽或猛然一扯

items.def_en: (+ at/on) To pull something hard or with repeated small, sharp movements
To move or pull something with a sudden, sharp, quick movement
To seize or pull something quickly, roughly, and suddenly
To pull, strain, or twist something violently away from its position
(+ at/on) To pull someone or something with a sudden, forceful, sharp movement.
To tear or yank something away forcefully and roughly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe abruptly and forcefully pulling or hauling an object or body part with sharp, sudden physical effort. Nuances hinge on whether the action involves a violent twist, a twitchy spasmodic motion, or aggressive dragging.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以突然、剧烈、短促的爆发力猛拉或扯动某物。

groups.name: Suit & Befit · 相称与适宜 (Befit, Suit, Become)
groups.tip: 身份地位或场合恰好相称

items.def_zh: 适称，使显得得体（尤指衣饰或举止）
items.def_en: To enhance someone's appearance or look suitable and proper on them
To be convenient, acceptable, or aesthetically flattering to someone

items.def_zh: 理应，理当（是某人的义务或责任）
items.def_en: To be incumbent upon or right and proper for someone to do something
To be suitable, fitting, or appropriate for someone or something
To match, harmonize, or be in natural agreement with a particular plan, system, or environment
(formal) To be suitable, proper, or appropriate for someone's status, character, or situation.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses relations where an action, dress, or attribute matches the dignity, propriety, role, or practical requirements of a subject. Nuances range from formal decorum and aesthetic flattering to functional compatibility.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在身份、礼仪、美观或功能上相配、得体、适宜。

groups.name: Surface & Emerge · 浮现与冒出 (Emerge, Crop Up, Crop Out)
groups.tip: 从水底或隐处升出

items.def_en: To rise quickly or buoyantly to the surface of a liquid
To appear suddenly and unexpectedly from beneath, behind, or within something

items.def_zh: 浮出水面；露头，浮现；醒来
items.def_en: 1. to rise to the surface of water or the ground 2. to suddenly become visible, known, or available after being hidden
To appear or occur suddenly and unexpectedly, especially of problems or mentions
To come out of an enclosed, submerged, or concealed place into open view
To force a way through a physical surface or barrier into visibility

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses entities moving upwards from below a liquid or subterranean barrier into visibility, or issues, facts, and emotions unexpectedly reappearing or breaking into awareness.
groups.summary_zh: 指从水下或地底升至表面，或引申为隐匿之物突然显现或浮出水面。

groups.name: Surface Discoloration & Patching · 斑驳与杂色 (Mottle, Fleck, Dapple)
groups.tip: 表面形成杂色与斑驳印记

items.def_en: To cover a surface with many small dots, marks, or color variations
To mark or dot something with small spots, specks, or particles
(usually passive) to mark a surface with irregular spots or patches of different colors
To mark or shade a surface with rounded spots or patches of light and shadow
To spot, stain, or obscure a surface with dark liquid marks
To diversify the color or visual pattern of something with different tints and streaks

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes that mark surfaces with uneven patches, blots, or speckles of distinct colors or shades.
groups.summary_zh: 指在表面形成不规则色斑、点渍或明暗相杂的视觉肌理。

groups.name: Surpass & Outperform · 胜过与超越 (Surpass, Outdo, Eclipse)
groups.tip: 在绩效表现上彻底超越对手

items.def_en: To be more successful, creative, or effective than someone else
To exceed someone or something in quality, quantity, degree, or achievement
To achieve better results, productivity, or financial performance than someone or something else.
To become larger, faster, or greater in amount or degree than a rival or benchmark
To be much more impressive or successful than someone else in a shared setting
To become much more important, popular, or successful than another, making them insignificant

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate exceeding another entity in skill, performance, quality, speed, or market achievement.
groups.summary_zh: 指在能力、成果、业绩或表现上全面超越他人。

groups.name: Surrender & Yield · 屈从与屈服 (Give In, Yield, Capitulate, Cede)
groups.tip: 在重压或诱惑下放弃抵抗

items.def_en: (+ to) to give way to pressure, superiority, or strong influence
(+ to) to stop resisting an argument, demand, or temptation after a struggle
(+ to) to submit reluctantly to the authority or harsh demands of someone else
(+ to) to collapse mentally or politically and give in completely to immense pressure
(+ to) 1. to stop resisting a temptation, pressure, or disease and give in. 2. to die from an illness or injury.
(+ to) to surrender or cease resisting an opponent or demanding pressure completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote ceasing resistance against an overpowering force, temptation, sickness, or ultimatum and accepting defeat.
groups.summary_zh: 指不再抗拒外界压力、诱惑或疾病，妥协或彻底认输。

groups.name: Surround & Besiege · 包围与围困 (Mob, Besiege, Swarm)
groups.tip: 群体围拢或围困受压

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To move from disparate directions toward the same target to surround it
To drive someone into a tight spot where escape is impossible, preventing them from slipping away

items.def_zh: 蜂拥团团围住，大举包围
items.def_en: To crowd around someone or something in a large, noisy, and disorderly group.
(+ around/over) To move around or congregate closely over someone or somewhere in large, bustling numbers
To pursue relentlessly, harass, or crowd around someone without giving them rest

items.def_zh: 围困；成群包围（要求回应）
items.def_en: To crowd around someone aggressively with requests or surround a place with forces

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate swarming or pressing tightly around a person or place in a disorderly, frantic, or hostile mass, restricting movement or creating extreme overwhelming pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 群体喧闹无序或敌意聚集，蜂拥紧围目标以制造压迫感。

groups.name: Surround & Flank · 包围与侧翼围绕 (Flank, Border, Hem in)
groups.tip: 从四周或两侧分布环抱

items.def_en: To form an edge or boundary along the periphery of something
To accompany someone or something laterally or closely to offer protection, honor, or guidance
To lie along, travel along, or form the outer edge or border of an area
(often passive, 'be fringed with') To form a narrow border or surrounding margin along the edge of something

items.def_zh: 位于……的两侧（或侧翼），侧翼包围
items.def_en: (often passive, 'be flanked by') To be situated at the side or sides of someone or something.
To surround someone or something tightly from multiple sides, restricting lateral movement

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to spatial positioning along the lateral sides, margins, or boundaries of a person, parade, or landscape, often forming an escort or physical perimeter.
groups.summary_zh: 位于主体两侧或周边边界，形成翼侧护卫、衬托或围护。

groups.name: Survey & Probe · 探测与勘测 (Sound, Gauge, Fathom)
groups.tip: 测量深浅探寻未明深处

items.def_en: To measure the depth of water using a weighted line or sonar, or figuratively investigate someone's intentions
To examine and record the physical features, contours, or boundaries of an area of land
To elicit opinions or probe someone's intentions discreetly and indirectly
To measure an exact dimension or depth, or to make an informed judgment about a situation

items.def_zh: 探测，测量（水深等）；钻研，探究（奥秘等）；给……装管道设施
items.def_en: 1. To measure the depth of water, especially with a plumb line. 2. To probe or explore something thoroughly ('plumb the depths'). 3. To install plumbing pipes in a building.
To measure the depth of water, or to probe deeply enough to understand an elusive truth

groups.summary_en: Covers technical, dimensional, or figurative assessment of depth, extent, or underlying conditions. 'Plumb' entails measuring depth or penetrating hidden depths, 'sound' involves measuring water depth or checking attitudes, and 'gauge' evaluates dimension and intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指测量深度、勘查状况或试探性评估真实程度。

groups.name: Suture & Stitch · 伤口缝合与闭合 (Stitch, Close up, Resuture)
groups.tip: 穿针引线缝合创口或织物

items.def_en: To complete a surgical operation by bringing the incisions back together and sewing them
To tie off a blood vessel, duct, or surgical tissue tightly with a thread or wire
To stitch a wound or surgical opening together again after stitches have failed
To join the edges of a cut or wound together using a needle and surgical thread
To close surgical incisions or severed tissue using specialized medical staples
1. (surgery) To stitch up a deep wound or surgical cut using medical thread.

groups.summary_en: This clinical and trauma frame focuses on medically approximating wound margins or tissue layers using surgical needles, thread, or staples to promote sterile healing.
groups.summary_zh: 医学场景中利用针线、缝线或缝合钉对创口边缘进行严密缝合与闭合。

groups.name: Swallowing & Ingestion Manner · 吞咽与痛饮 (Gulp, Quaff, Chug)
groups.tip: 大口咕咚咽下食物或液体

items.def_zh: 吞下，咽下；吞没，耗尽；轻信；忍受，抑制
items.def_en: 1. To cause food, drink, or an object to move down the throat into the stomach. 2. To take in, engulf, or completely use up. 3. To accept or believe something uncritically; to suppress a feeling.
Quickly drink an alcoholic beverage by tilting the head backward
Drink or swallow something completely, usually in one single effort
Drink a beverage, especially an alcoholic one, heartily and in copious quantities
