Swallow food or drink quickly and greedily, often producing an audible sound
Drink an entire container of liquid without pausing or taking a breath

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the physiological and behavioral manners of ingesting liquids or food down the esophagus, highlighting contrasts in speed, greed, volume, and audible effort.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖吞咽液体或食物的不同方式，体现大口狼吞、豪饮或艰难吞服。

groups.name: Swim & Dive · 游泳与潜水 (Swim, Dive, Plunge)
groups.tip: 水面游弋或下潜水中

items.def_en: To propel oneself through water using limbs or fins
(+ into/beneath) To plunge headfirst into water or swim deep underwater using equipment
To keep oneself upright and floating in deep water by moving the legs and arms
(+ into) To jump, dive, or fall steeply and forcefully into water
To wade in shallow water or propel oneself with short splashing arm movements

items.def_zh: 浮潜，使用水下呼吸管游泳
items.def_en: To swim near the surface of the water while breathing through a tube called a snorkel.

groups.summary_en: Covers intentional human locomotion through or immersion beneath water, ranging from surface leisure to deep underwater exploration.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖人在水中推进或深潜水下的运动行为与技能动作。

groups.name: Symbolize & Represent · 象征与代表 (Signify, Stand For, Typify)
groups.tip: 作为意象或代表来指代事物

items.def_en: To be a sign, symbol, or picture of something; to designate an abstract quality or reality.
To represent a word, acronym, idea, belief, or principle as a recognized sign.
To represent a quality, idea, or feeling in a tangible, clear, or bodily form.
To be a sign of something; to convey an explicit or implicit meaning.
To represent or be a symbol of something, such as an idea or quality.
To be an archetype or characteristic example of a particular group, style, or quality.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate that an object, mark, or concept acts as a visible or cultural sign for another, often abstract meaning. 'Symbolize' focuses on allegorical or figurative representation, whereas 'signify' emphasizes linguistic meaning and 'embody' stresses tangible manifestation.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或符号作为代表、代号或具象化化身体现抽象内涵。

groups.name: Tackle & Wrest · 扑倒与扭倒 (Tackle, Grapple, Bring down)
groups.tip: 用身体扑倒并按倒压制

items.def_en: To cause someone running or charging to fall to the ground
To engage in a close fight or struggle without weapons, wrestling hand to hand
To press someone down against a surface so firmly that they cannot move
To force someone or an animal to the ground by physical grappling and wrestling
To seize and throw or force someone down to the ground

items.def_zh: （摔跤中抓住牛角并扭脖子）摔倒（牛）；扑倒
items.def_en: (North American rodeo) To wrestle a steer to the ground by gripping its horns and twisting its neck.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on forceful physical maneuvers to seize, grapple, and wrestle a person or animal to the ground through bodily leverage or violent impact.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过身体扭打、擒抱或猛扑将人或动物制服扑倒在地。

groups.name: Taint & Defile · 玷污与败坏 (Besmirch, Tarnish, Blemish)
groups.tip: 沾染污迹或损毁纯洁

items.def_en: To spoil or contaminate the moral quality, good name, or purity of something
To make someone or something seem less good, respected, or pure
1. (formal) To damage or spoil the purity, integrity, or reputation of someone or something; to defile or make dirty.
To spoil the flawless appearance, reputation, or perfection of something
To desecrate or ruin something considered holy, clean, or pure
To damage the reputation or clean name of someone in the opinion of others

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on marring, degrading, or corrupting the purity, moral standing, or spotless reputation of an entity.
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏人或事物的纯洁性、声誉或名节，予以玷污或损坏。

groups.name: Tame & Subdue · 驯化与制服 (Tame, Domesticate, Subdue)
groups.tip: 驯化野性或彻底压服反抗

items.def_zh: 严格控制；收紧缰绳；抑制
items.def_en: To control, restrain, or limit someone or something that has become too wild, powerful, or extravagant
To control or limit something unruly, unwanted, or harmful before it grows out of hand
1. To train a wild animal to be gentle and obedient to humans. 2. To bring a wild, dangerous, or powerful emotion or situation under control.
To bring wild animals or plants under human control and care, adapting them to live alongside humans
To train a wild horse or animal to accept a rider, harness, and human commands
To bring a person, feeling, or wild force under control, especially by using physical force or authority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe bringing wild animals, unruly forces, or rebellious impulses under control, domestication, or calm. While 'tame' and 'domesticate' focus on rendering something wild gentle and cooperative, 'subdue' and 'quell' emphasize overpowering resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 指将野生动物驯养顺服，或用控制力压制野性、混乱及叛逆力量。

groups.name: Tangle & Knot · 缠绕与纠结 (Snarl, Knot, Ravel)
groups.tip: 线缕交织难解或被绊住

items.def_en: Mix things together in an untidy, disorganized, or confused way
Fasten or tie together with a knot, or form tight, hard tangled lumps
Twist together untidily into a confused mass, or cause threads or objects to do so
Become entangled or clogged with something, particularly of ropes, cables, or mechanisms

items.def_zh: 使纠缠，缠住；使卷入，使陷入
items.def_en: To twist things together in an untidy mass, or to involve someone or something in a complicated or difficult situation.
Become tangled or intertwined in an unruly way, or cause ropes, hair, or traffic to jam

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the physical twisting, knotting, or snarling of strands, cords, or hair into a disordered mass, as well as light figurative confusion.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重线缆、毛发等物理股线的互相交织扭结成一团，或思维事务的紊乱化。

groups.name: Tap & Dab · 点触与轻蘸 (Dot, Blot, Pat down)
groups.tip: 短促轻微地触碰点按

items.def_en: To mark or apply something in tiny spots or drops across an area
To touch, wipe, or apply something gently and quickly with small strokes.
To press something down gently with repeated small, flat hand motions
To spread a thick, greasy, or wet substance softly over a surface
To dry or clean a surface by pressing an absorbent material lightly against it
To clean or apply medication to a surface using a small wad of absorbent cotton

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on light, precise, localized applications of a pad, cloth, or fingertip, either to absorb moisture or apply small amounts of paint, cosmetics, or medicine.
groups.summary_zh: 指用布块、棉片或指尖轻蘸、轻点、吸拭微量液体或粉膏。

groups.name: Tap & Drum · 击打与节律 (Tap, Pat, Thrum)
groups.tip: 有节奏地敲打发出声响

items.def_en: To strike a surface lightly and repeatedly, often creating a sharp, rhythmic sound

items.def_zh: 吧嗒吧嗒地响；轻快敲击
items.def_en: To make repeated, rapid, lightweight tapping sounds, like rain on a roof or tiny steps
To make a short, rapid double-tap sound on an object
To drum or tap continuously, creating a repetitive, dull humming percussion
To strike a hard surface smartly and sharply, making a loud knocking sound

items.def_zh: 有节奏地敲击，连续敲打；击鼓，打鼓
items.def_en: 1. To make a continuous rhythmic sound by repeatedly tapping on a surface. 2. To play a drum or drums.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe producing continuous, light, and rhythmic percussion against a surface using fingers, sticks, or small objects. The emphasis lies on auditory periodicity and tactile cadence rather than destructive impact.
groups.summary_zh: 手指或工具连续、有节奏地轻叩表面，发出周期性响声。

groups.name: Tap & Flick · 轻弹与微碰 (Snap, Flip, Twitch)
groups.tip: 手指或手腕轻弹敲击

items.def_en: To hit someone or something gently, often making a light clicking sound
1. To hit or move something with a quick, light movement of the finger, wrist, or hand. 2. (flick through) To turn pages quickly.
To remove dirt, ash, or insects with a fast sweeping stroke of the hand
To remove something by giving it a light, quick snap with the fingers
To turn or throw something with a quick, flicking motion of the fingers or wrist
To move or cause something to strike with a quick, sharp, cracking motion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe abrupt, light, spring-like movements of fingers or wrists to dislodge an object, switch a mechanism, or deliver a quick tactile snap.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过手指或手腕的轻巧、急促抽弹来击打、拨动或振落细物。

groups.name: Technological Upgrade & Automation · 工业机械化与技术革新 (Mechanize, Automate, Streamline)
groups.tip: 工业改造与现代化升级

items.def_en: To convert an apparatus, process, or system to operate primarily by self-regulating machinery
To make an organization or process simpler and more effective by employing better tools or methods
To adapt something to modern needs, methods, or conditions using contemporary technology
To equip, manage, or automate a process or system with computers
To develop industry on a wide scale in a country or region using mechanical systems
to change a process, factory, or activity so that the work is done by machines rather than by people or animals

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses transforming manual labor, traditional workflows, or physical processes through machinery, computing, and advanced engineering. It highlights the shift from human effort to automated or standardized mechanical production.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过引入机器设备、自动化程序或现代技术来革新传统人工与生产方式。

groups.name: Tether & Hobble · 羁绊与拴系 (Tether, Hobble, Shackle)
groups.tip: 用绳套笼头限制行动

items.def_en: To put a bridle and bit on a horse to control its direction

items.def_zh: 给……套上笼头（或缰绳）；用绳套拴住
items.def_en: To put a halter on an animal, especially a horse, in order to lead or tie it.
To fasten something or someone securely with ropes or straps to keep them stationary
To tie an animal with a rope or chain to a fixed post so that it cannot wander beyond a certain radius
To tie together two legs of an animal to prevent it from wandering or galloping away
To put metal restraints or chains around someone's wrists or ankles to prevent movement

groups.summary_en: This frame covers binding, tethering, or harnessing animals or individuals using ropes, straps, or chains to restrict their movement. Nuances highlight whether mobility is totally halted or merely restrained.
groups.summary_zh: 指用缰绳、套索或镣铐束缚人或牲畜，以限制其走动或逃逸。

groups.name: Threaten & Menace · 威胁与恐吓 (Intimidate, Terrorize, Browbeat)
groups.tip: 露出凶相或声称将造成危害

items.def_en: To state an intention to inflict harm, damage, or other hostile action on someone, especially to force compliance
To force someone into doing something by using threats, superior strength, or influence
To frighten or overawe someone, especially in order to make them do what one wants
To threaten someone or something with serious harm or danger.
To fill someone with extreme fear, often through violence or persistent threats
To intimidate someone into doing something with harsh, domineering words or looks

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing an intention to inflict injury, damage, or punishment, or behaving aggressively to instill fear and force compliance. Nuances span from explicit verbal warnings to pervasive psychological intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及以言语、举动或声势施加危险信号，迫使对方产生恐惧或屈服。

groups.name: Throw & Hurl · 抛掷与猛掷 (Throw, Hurl, Fling)
groups.tip: 发力将物体掷出抛飞

items.def_en: To throw something lightly, casually, or carelessly
To throw something with careful aim, or toss something forward vigorously
To throw something carelessly or with a lot of force and sudden movement

items.def_zh: 猛投，猛掷；猛甩，猛冲（fling的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of fling; threw forcefully or moved suddenly and vigorously.
To lift and throw something heavy with great physical effort
To throw something with a great amount of force, usually in anger or aggression

groups.summary_en: Denotes propelling an object through the air using one's arm or hand, varying from routine casting to violent, forceful heaving.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手臂或力量将某物猛烈、迅速地抛投向空中或远处。

groups.name: Tile, Shingle & Overlap · 叠覆与层叠交接 (Overlap, Shingle, Imbricate)
groups.tip: 层叠交错部分覆盖

items.def_zh: 重叠，交叠；（波浪等）轻拍，拍打；舔食
items.def_en: 1. To lie partly over something, or to fold over and cover something. 2. (of water or waves) To wash gently against something with a soft splashing sound. 3. (of an animal) To drink liquid with quick movements of the tongue.

items.def_zh: 使边缘渐薄交叠；削薄边缘接合
items.def_en: To taper or blend an edge smoothly so that successive layers overlap imperceptibly
To cover part of the edge or surface of another thing, or coincide partly in time or scope
To extend underneath an adjacent part or edge in an overlapping structure

items.def_zh: 用木瓦（或鱼鳞状物）叠盖
items.def_en: To lay overlapping rows of roof shingles, tiles, or similar materials
(formal/technical) To place or arrange scales, plates, or edges in an overlapping pattern like roof tiles

groups.summary_en: This spatial and physical frame concerns surfaces, margins, or boundaries extending partly over another so as to form a continuous, layered sequence. Typical contexts include building materials (tiles, scales), temporal intervals, and structural segments.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体边缘、结构或时间跨度部分覆盖于另一物之上以形成层叠。

groups.name: Toast & Crisp · 烘烤与酥脆 (Toast, Brown, Singe)
groups.tip: 烘烤加热至外表酥脆

items.def_en: To become crisp, or to make food crisp again by baking or frying
To cook food until its surface turns brown and slightly crisp
To make food brown and crisp by heating it on both sides
1. To become crisp or make something crisp, especially by heating. 2. To curl or form into small crisp ripples or folds.
To make dry and crisp by exposing to heat, especially grains or seeds
To burn or cause something to burn slightly until blackened and brittle

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve applying dry heat to food or surfaces so they develop a brittle, crisp exterior or browned finish.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过干热烘烤或煎炸使食物表层变得酥脆、焦黄或微焦干燥。

groups.name: Toil & Labor Gruelingly · 辛劳与苦役 (Toil, Slave, Grind, Slog)
groups.tip: 从事繁重体力苦工劳作

items.def_en: to perform taxing physical effort, often under tough or unyielding constraints

items.def_zh: 做苦工；干繁琐乏味的工作
items.def_en: to do menial, repetitive, and uninspiring hard labor for extended stretches

items.def_zh: 拼命做苦工；像奴隶般劳作
items.def_en: to work excessively long, punishing hours without adequate reward or rest
to work extremely hard and continuously on strenuous physical labor
to work hard over a prolonged period, typically at a dull, arduous, or difficult task
1. To work hard and painfully. 2. To undergo the labor and pain of childbirth.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on sustained, physically or mentally grinding manual effort under arduous conditions. It denotes exhausting labor that drains human reserves over time.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在沉重或恶劣条件下付出耗竭体力的长期艰苦劳作。

groups.name: Toil & Labor · 劳作与劳苦 (Toil, Slag Away, Grind)
groups.tip: 长期从事艰苦繁重体力劳动

items.def_en: (+ at) To keep working hard at a difficult task in an uncomplaining way
To work extraordinarily hard, producing bodily sweat from strenuous effort

items.def_zh: 像奴隶般苦干；拼命劳作
items.def_en: To work extremely hard like a slave for little pay, recognition, or rest
(+ away) To work or study with relentless, monotonous, exhausting continuity

items.def_zh: 苦干，辛勤劳作；艰难缓慢地行走，跋涉
items.def_en: 1. (+ away/at) To work very hard and continuously for a long time, especially doing physical labor. 2. (+ up/along) To move or walk with great difficulty and effort.
(+ away/at) To work hard over a long period, especially doing repetitive toil

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame highlight sustained, physically grinding, and exhausting exertion over extended periods under punishing conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在艰苦严苛的环境下，长时间从事筋疲力尽、单调消耗的体力繁难劳动。

groups.name: Toil & Strive · 勤勉与苦干 (Beaver away, Toil, Slog)
groups.tip: 如河狸般勤奋埋头苦干

items.def_en: (informal) (+ at) To keep working hard at a difficult or repetitive job without giving up

items.def_zh: 拼命干；当牛做马般劳作
items.def_en: (+ away / over) To work excessively hard for long hours like a slave

items.def_zh: 埋头苦干，辛勤工作（常与 away 连用）
items.def_en: ('beaver away') (informal) To work very hard and persistently at a task for a long time.
To work extremely hard and continuously for long periods, often with physical exhaustion
(+ away / through) To work hard over a long period on something tedious or demanding
To perform hard, menial, tedious, or distasteful labor persistently

groups.summary_en: This frame captures unglamorous, grueling, and sustained labor. Verbs highlight relentless exertion, dogged perseverance, and endurance against weariness or tedious tasks.
groups.summary_zh: 埋头苦干、坚韧不懈地从事繁重、枯燥或耗时的工作。

groups.name: Touch & Contact · 触摸与接触 (Graze, Caress, Brush, Feel)
groups.tip: 指尖接触产生触觉感知

items.def_en: To deliberately touch something with one's fingers or hands to discover its texture, shape, or state

1. To put your hand or another part of your body on someone or something; to come into physical contact with something. 2. To produce an emotional feeling, especially of sympathy or gratitude, in someone.
To touch someone or something very lightly in passing
To move your hand gently along the surface of something in a smooth repeated motion
To touch or scrape lightly against something while moving rapidly past it
To touch or stroke someone or something gently and affectionately

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses physical sensory contact between the body and another surface. The manner of contact ranges from deliberate tactile exploration (feeling, stroking) to momentary or superficial friction (brushing, grazing).
groups.summary_zh: 身体表面或手与物体发生物理接触，体验触觉或产生轻触。

groups.name: Tour & Sightsee · 游览与观光 (Tour, Sightsee, Explore)
groups.tip: 以观光旅游为目的的游历

items.def_en: To go to see a landmark, museum, or tourist destination for interest
To travel through or visit multiple historic or scenic sights in a region
To travel through an unfamiliar area to discover its attractions or landmarks
To visit and consciously appreciate the sights, exhibits, or features of a place
To walk around an attraction, building, or town to see what is there
To travel around visiting monuments, famous sites, and attractions as a tourist.

groups.summary_en: Covers traveling around places, monuments, and cultural attractions for recreation, leisure, and exploratory curiosity.
groups.summary_zh: 指为休闲、猎奇或学习而走访各地景点、名胜古迹的观光活动。

groups.name: Toy & Flirt With · 把玩与漫不经心对待 (Toy, Dally, Flirt with)
groups.tip: 漫不经心摆弄思索

items.def_en: To experiment casually with different ideas, methods, or devices to see how they function

items.def_zh: 漫不经心地考虑；摆弄，玩弄
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To consider an idea or plan casually or without deep seriousness. 2. (+ with) To fiddle with or handle something absentmindedly.
(+ with) To touch, manipulate, or adjust something aimlessly, nervously, or inexpertly
(+ with) To make small, exploratory alterations or superficial repairs to something without a systematic plan
(+ with) To treat a serious matter, plan, or person's emotions in an idle, playful, or noncommittal way

items.def_zh: 浅尝辄止地考虑，玩弄（想法/危险）
items.def_en: To entertain an idea or course of action superficially or tempt a risky outcome without firm commitment

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses treating concepts, proposals, or objects non-seriously, speculatively, or idly without deep engagement or steadfast resolve.
groups.summary_zh: 浅尝辄止地摆弄事物或漫不经心地推敲构想。

groups.name: Transfer & Alienate · 让渡与过户 (Convey, Assign, Cede)
groups.tip: 依法移转产权或身份

items.def_en: To transfer legal rights, benefits, or property officially to designated parties
(law) To transfer property, land, or ownership rights to another person.
To formally relinquish ownership or rights to someone by signing a document
To transfer ownership of real estate or property by formal legal deed
To transfer the legal title or ownership of property to another person
To yield or surrender territory, sovereignty, or rights to another party

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to formal or legal transfers of property, title, rights, or territory from one party to another.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据法律或契约正式转让财产所有权、权利或领地的行为。

groups.name: Transfer & Denationalize · 私有化与产权转让 (Deregulate, Outsource, Divest)
groups.tip: 将产权或权利移交他人

items.def_en: To transfer an industry or company from state control or ownership to private hands
To hand over work or responsibilities to someone outside the organization
To contract out public services or company operations to an external supplier
To get rid of an asset, subsidiary, or business investment by selling it
To sell a state-owned business, industry, or service to private individuals or companies.

items.def_zh: 使商业化；使转入市场化运营
items.def_en: To manage or organize an activity primarily to generate financial profit

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this economic and legal frame deal with releasing state, corporate, or public control by transferring ownership, assets, or operation into private or commercial hands.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及公有资产转为私有，或将控制权、资产剥离转让给商业机构。

groups.name: Transfer & Shift · 转移与位移 (Relocate, Displace, Reposition)
groups.tip: 改变位置微调挪移

items.def_zh: 挪动，移动；转变，转移；换挡
items.def_en: 1. To move slightly or change position, or move something from one position to another. 2. To change opinions, plans, or direction. 3. To change gears in a vehicle.
To change the position of objects or shift one's weight back and forth restlessly
To move even slightly, usually used in negative contexts or with effort
To move something into a different location, orientation, or stance
To force something or someone out of its usual or proper place
To move oneself or something else to a new place to live or work

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to moving an entity slightly or substantially from one position, place, or orientation to another. Nuances range from subtle realignments to formal physical transfers.
groups.summary_zh: 指位置、方向或重心的改变与微调，涵盖轻微移动及正式挪移。

groups.name: Translate & Interpret · 翻译与诠释 (Interpret, Transpose, Paraphrase)
groups.tip: 跨语言转化与深层含义解读

items.def_en: 1. To change speech or writing from one language into another. 2. To change or be changed into a different form, condition, or result.
(+ into) Express or translate words or concepts into another language or artistic medium
Translate orally what someone is saying in another language, or explain meaning
Express the meaning of written or spoken text using different words to make it clearer
Put thoughts, speech, or data into written form or a different transcription code
Change or alter thoroughly in form, substance, appearance, or symbolic meaning

groups.summary_en: Relates to converting meaning from one linguistic or symbolic system into another, whether written, spoken, or figurative.
groups.summary_zh: 指将口头或书面信息从一种语言转换为另一种语言，或进行深层诠释。

groups.name: Trap & Decoy · 设伏引诱与诱捕 (Decoy, Trap, Ensnare)
groups.tip: 用假象设下诱饵引诱目标落入圈套

items.def_en: (+ in/into) To catch someone or an animal in a trap, or place them into a dangerous situation they cannot escape
To persuade or trick someone into joining in an activity, chore, or project against their initial inclination
To lie in wait for and attack someone by surprise from a concealed position
(+ into) To lure or trick a person or animal into a trap or danger by using bait or a distraction.
To catch or trap someone or something in a snare or cunning trap from which escape is difficult

items.def_zh: 诱陷，使入圈套（特指诱人犯法）
items.def_en: To trick someone into a situation, often an unlawful act, so they can be apprehended or prosecuted

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame captures the act of drawing a person, animal, or enemy into an inescapable predicament, snare, or ambush through strategic deception or false pretense. It highlights the calculated mechanics of entrapment.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用诱饵、伪装或诡计将目标引诱并困入圈套或险境的行为。

groups.name: Treat with Contempt & Scorn · 轻蔑与不敬 (Despise, Scorn, Disdain, Flout)
groups.tip: 从失礼冒犯到从心底鄙视

items.def_en: to consider oneself distinctly superior in status, intelligence, or morality to another
To treat or speak to someone with a lack of respect or courtesy.
to look upon someone or something with proud aloofness as unworthy of one's notice
to feel a strong dislike accompanied by complete lack of respect for someone or something
to treat someone or something with utter contempt or reject them with derision

items.def_zh: 公然蔑视；无视（法规或传统）
items.def_en: to openly disregard and mock a rule, law, or convention without hiding one's disobedience

groups.summary_en: Captures expressing deep lack of respect, active defiance, or disdain toward a person, rule, or institution. It ranges from verbal insolence to outright refusal to recognize authority.
groups.summary_zh: 指对人、规则或权威公然流露蔑视、嗤之以鼻或肆意冒犯。

groups.name: Trigger & Activate · 触发启动与促动 (Actuate, Trigger, Motivate)
groups.tip: 触发启动并促使部件运转

items.def_en: To cause a device, system, or chain of events to function or happen suddenly
To provide someone with a strong reason, desire, or purpose for acting in a certain way
To encourage, cause, or induce someone to take immediate action or say something
To make a device, chemical process, or system start operating or become active
To cause a mechanical switch, alarm, explosive, or sequence of actions to go off

items.def_zh: 驱动，促使运转；激励，驱使
items.def_en: 1. (technical) To cause a machine, device, or mechanism to operate. 2. (formal) To motivate someone to act in a certain way.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on initiating an operational process or motivating behavior, operating both mechanically (setting a device in motion) and psychologically (prompting someone to act). The frame spans from physical trip mechanisms to inner psychological drivers.
groups.summary_zh: 指机械装置被触发运转，或内在动机、外界刺激促使某人采取行动。

groups.name: Trudge & Slog · 泥泞跋涉与艰难慢行 (Slush, Trudge, Slog, Wade)
groups.tip: 脚步沉重艰难地缓行

items.def_zh: 在雪泥（或泥浆）中跋涉；溅泼（泥浆等）
items.def_en: 1. To walk or trudge through melting snow, slush, or mud. 2. To splash liquid or slush around, or cover with slush.
(+ through) To make a wet sucking sound while walking through thick mud or wet ground
(+ through) To walk through relatively deep water, mud, or snow with effort as it impedes motion
(+ through/along) To walk slowly with heavy, laboured steps, especially through mud, deep snow, or when exhausted
(+ through/along) To walk with slow, heavy steps in a monotonous and unhurried way
(+ through) To walk or progress with strenuous, exhausting effort through rough ground or bad conditions

groups.summary_en: Describes walking through deep mud, snow, wet slush, or water where heavy resistance forces slow, clumsy, and exhausting steps. 'Slog' stresses punishing physical toll, whereas 'wade' involves moving through depth.
groups.summary_zh: 指在烂泥、积雪或泥水等阻力重重的湿泞地面艰难跋涉。

groups.name: Tunnel & Bore · 掘进与凿穿 (Bore, Burrow, Pierce)
groups.tip: 在土石障碍中钻探开辟通道

items.def_en: To systematically force or excavate a tunnel, shaft, or adit horizontally through solid earth
To dig deep into the earth to extract minerals or construct military subterranean saps
To make a deep, cylindrical hole or passage in something solid by hollow drilling or digging

items.def_zh: 开凿隧道，掘地道穿过；在……中挖掘
items.def_en: 1. To dig or burrow a tunnel through, under, or into something.
To remove the inside or core of an object or earth bank to create an empty cavity
To dig a hole or continuous passage into or under something, typically using claws, hands, or repetitive scraping

groups.summary_en: Pertains to excavating a continuous passage through earth, rock, or other solid obstacles. 'Tunnel' implies excavating a path underground, 'bore' focuses on drilling a cylindrical cavity, and 'burrow' denotes an animal-like digging inwards.
groups.summary_zh: 指穿透岩石、泥土或障碍物向深处钻凿或掘出通道。

groups.name: Underestimate & Belittle · 轻视与低估 (Underestimate, Undervalue, Belittle, Minimize)
groups.tip: 主观评估远低于实际

items.def_en: to treat or portray an issue, problem, or accomplishment as being insignificant
to fail to guess the true scale, strength, or difficulty of an adversary, task, or quantity
To fail to recognize the full importance, value, or ability of someone or something.
to rate the worth, importance, or contributions of someone or something below their true merit
to fail to give full credit to or estimate someone's true capability accurately
to make someone or their actions seem small, trivial, or unimportant

groups.summary_en: Centers on judging someone or something to be less capable, valuable, severe, or important than they actually are. It contrasts miscalculating capability with deliberately diminishing significance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在认知上低估其能力、价值或有意淡化其重要性与严重性。

groups.name: Underestimate & Undervalue · 低估与轻视 (Belittle, Underrate, Downplay)
groups.tip: 评价偏低并带有轻蔑不屑色彩

items.def_en: To guess an amount, difficulty, or capacity to be smaller or less than it actually is
To fail to recognize how good, powerful, or important someone or something really is
To deliberately make something seem less important, serious, or urgent than it is

items.def_zh: 低估……的价值（或重要性），轻视，看轻；对……估价过低
items.def_en: 1. To fail to appreciate the true worth, importance, or qualities of someone or something. 2. To rate or estimate the financial value of an asset too low.
To fail to present or appreciate someone or something with the praise and respect they deserve
To treat someone or their achievements as small, unimportant, or worthless

groups.summary_en: Encompasses cognitive assessments or communicative acts that minimize the actual worth, competence, or significance of someone or something. Nuances vary between flawed appraisal and dismissive contempt.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在认知或言论中低估、轻慢其价值或能力，具贬低色彩。

groups.name: Understate & Downplay · 轻描淡写与贬低 (Minimize, Soft-pedal, Gloss over)
groups.tip: 故意淡化严重性或压低评价

items.def_zh: 弱化处理；采取缓和调门
items.def_en: To treat or present a problem less firmly or with restrained emphasis

items.raw_cluster: 轻描淡写与贬低 Understate & Downplay
items.def_zh: 淡化……的重要性，轻描淡写；表演低调含蓄
items.def_en: 1. To make something seem less important, serious, or dramatic than it really is. 2. To act a role with understatement and restraint.
To reject or dismiss a serious concern, question, or criticism impatiently
To treat a mistake or unpleasant fact as negligible by mentioning it only briefly
To treat or describe something as being of very little importance or magnitude
To make something appear less important, serious, or urgent than it really is

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes deliberately minimizing the severity, importance, scale, or impact of an issue in discourse, often to soothe concern, deflect scrutiny, or avert blame.
groups.summary_zh: 指刻意淡化事态严重性、重要性或负面影响，避重就轻。

groups.name: Undo & Unfasten · 解开与松绑 (Untie, Loosen, Unravel)
groups.tip: 解开绳结松开扣件

items.def_en: To release someone or something from ropes, bonds, or fetters

items.def_zh: 解开，解松（纽扣、绳结等）；撤销，废止；破坏，毁掉
items.def_en: 1. To unfasten, untie, or loosen a button, knot, or package. 2. To cancel or reverse the effect of a previous action. 3. To ruin or destroy someone or something.
To make something less tight, firmly fixed, or compact

items.def_zh: 拆散，解开（织物、缠结的线绳）
items.def_en: To cause threads or fibers that are woven or tangled to come apart
To undo a knot, ribbon, or the string or laces fastening something

items.def_zh: 解开，打开（扣件、安全带等）
items.def_en: To open or loosen a buckle, latch, zip, or other fastening mechanism

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to releasing, opening, or loosening physical attachments such as knots, buttons, laces, or bindings. They range from simple mechanical release to untangling intricate fastenings.
groups.summary_zh: 解开、松开或解脱绳结、纽扣、包装等物理固定物。

groups.name: Unlawful Incursion & Encroachment · 非法侵入与蚕食越界 (Trespass, Encroach, Infringe)
groups.tip: 未经允许强行踏入私人领地

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To encroach upon or violate a legal right, covenant, or agreement

items.def_zh: 非法侵入，擅入（私人领地）；冒犯，侵害
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to enter someone's land or property without permission; to intrude on someone's rights or privacy

items.def_zh: 偷猎；越界非法捕捞/窃取
items.def_en: To trespass on another's property to take game or fish, or to illicitly appropriate resources
(+ on/into) To enter a place or situation where one is unwelcome or has no right to be
(+ on/upon) To intrude gradually and stealthily beyond acceptable or legal boundaries
(+ on/upon) To have an unwanted or detrimental effect on another person's rights or sphere

groups.summary_en: This legal and territorial frame covers entering someone's real property without authorization or gradually violating another person's rights, domains, or boundaries. Verbs range from explicit unauthorized entry to incremental overreach.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及未经许可进入私人领地，或对他人合法权益、边界进行非法侵占或蚕食。

groups.name: Unseal & Open · 解封与破启 (Unseal, Uncap, Pry open, Break open)
groups.tip: 拆除封条并打开容器

items.def_en: To open a sealed or locked container by applying physical force
To remove the protective cap or lid from a bottle, pen, or device
To force open a tight lid, sealed crate, or door using a lever or tool
To open a sealed envelope, package, or wrapper quickly and forcefully by tearing it
To remove an obstructive stopper, bung, or plug sealing an opening or pipe
To break the seal of a letter, container, or document to open it.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physically removing, cutting, or breaking an adhesive, wax, or mechanical seal that keeps a container, envelope, or entrance shut, permitting access to its contents.
groups.summary_zh: 破除密封胶、封泥或外层封闭结构，打开包装或信件。

groups.name: Untie & Unleash · 解开与爆发式释放 (Unleash, Unloose, Let loose, Vent)
groups.tip: 解开禁锢爆发释放而出

items.def_en: To free someone or something from physical restraint; release strong emotions or actions without restraint

items.def_zh: 触发；引起（连锁反应/爆发现象）
items.def_en: To cause an intense, violent, or sudden reaction, process, or series of events to start immediately
(+ on) To express a strong negative emotion, such as anger or frustration, openly and forcefully

items.def_zh: 释放，发泄，解除约束使爆发；解开（系绳、皮带）
items.def_en: 1. To release a powerful force, emotion, or effect suddenly and often destructively. 2. To remove a leash from a dog or animal.
To loosen, untie, or set free from a bond, leash, or confining grip
To free someone or something from chains, bonds, or severe limitations

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this dynamic frame describe removing physical or psychological restraints, allowing pent-up fury, wild power, weapons, or destructive forces to burst forth without inhibition.
groups.summary_zh: 挣脱束缚或解除拘禁，使积蓄的力量、情感或破坏力猛烈迸发。

groups.name: Urge & Exhort · 敦促与力劝 (Urge, Exhort, Press)
groups.tip: 由一般催促上升至恳切告诫

items.def_en: To encourage or push someone strongly to do something foolish or risky
To urge someone gently but seriously to do what is right
To try hard to persuade or compel someone to do something

items.def_zh: 敦促，催促；力劝，大力主张
items.def_en: To advise or try hard to persuade someone to do something.
To provoke or annoy someone into action by persistent prodding
To strongly encourage or urge someone to do something through earnest speech

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting moral, persuasive, or vocal force on someone to prompt immediate action or compliance, ranging from earnest advice to persistent badgering.
groups.summary_zh: 表示以热切的言辞、劝告或道义力量催促、力劝他人采取行动。

groups.name: Usurp & Arrogate · 侵占与僭取 (Arrogate, Usurp, Appropriate)
groups.tip: 擅自越权霸占不法利益

items.def_en: Take something, especially public money or land, for one's own use without permission
Officially take possession or control of something by force or authority, especially for military or emergency use

items.def_zh: 先发制人取得；抢先占有
items.def_en: Acquire or claim something before others can do so, preventing them from accessing it

items.def_zh: 篡夺；非法侵占（权力、王位）
items.def_en: Take a position of power, throne, or authority illegally or by force
Officially take away private property from its owner, often without fair compensation

items.def_zh: 妄取，僭取，擅自霸占（arrogate to oneself）
items.def_en: (formal) to claim, take, or seize power, authority, or rights for oneself without justification

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe seizing, claiming, or assuming rights, powers, or privileges without legitimate authority or legal justification.
groups.summary_zh: 指未经授权、非法或专横地侵占权力、特权或他人财产。

groups.name: Vaunt & Preen · 骄傲与炫示自夸 (Pride, Boast, Preen)
groups.tip: 内心自豪与言行张扬吹嘘的展现

items.def_en: ('pride oneself on') To feel very pleased and proud of a quality, skill, or achievement.
To speak with excessive pride or self-satisfaction about one's achievements or possessions

items.def_zh: 得意地嚷嚷；幸灾乐祸地夸口
items.def_en: (+ about/over) To express gleeful triumph or boast noisily over a rival's defeat
To talk ostentatiously and excessively about what one has done or owns

items.def_zh: 得意扬扬；顾影自怜；自鸣得意
items.def_en: To congratulate oneself or display obvious vanity and complacency about one's appearance or skill
(+ over) To show malicious or smug pleasure at one's own success or another person's misfortune

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey experiencing, displaying, or advertising excessive satisfaction in one's personal achievements, possessions, or qualities. While 'pride' highlights inner self-worth, 'boast' and 'brag' manifest as vocal swagger.
groups.summary_zh: 指为自身才干、功绩或外貌感到荣耀自得，并向他人夸示炫耀。

groups.name: Ventilate & Aerate · 通风与充气 (Air, Ventilate, Oxygenate)
groups.tip: 使空气流通或通入气体

items.def_zh: 开窗透气；彻底晾晒散味
items.def_en: [I/T] to expose a room or clothing thoroughly to fresh air so as to remove dampness or odors
(+ sth) to clear or freshen an enclosed space or filter by forcing fresh air through it

items.def_zh: 使通风，晾晒；公开表达，发表
items.def_en: 1. To expose a room, clothing, etc. to fresh air or heat so that it becomes dry or fresh. 2. To express your opinions or complaints publicly.

items.def_zh: 使室内或封闭空间通风；为患者进行机械通气
items.def_en: to cause fresh air to circulate freely through a room or building, or to provide medical respiration

items.def_zh: 使充气，通气；使暴露于空气中
items.def_en: To introduce air or gas into soil, water, or another substance to make it fresher, lighter, or richer in oxygen.

items.def_zh: 给（血液、水体等）充氧，使与氧气结合
items.def_en: to supply, treat, or enrich a substance (such as blood or water) with oxygen

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to introducing fresh air, oxygen, or gas into a space, liquid, or soil to freshen, dry, or sustain biological and chemical processes. Nuances range from passive airing to active mechanical ventilation and chemical oxygenation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通入新鲜空气、氧气或气体以通风、干燥或充氧。

groups.name: Verbal Enumeration & Recitation · 逐一列举与数说 (Enumerate, Recite, Reel off)
groups.tip: 逐条清点罗列细目，详尽说明各项细节

items.def_en: To recite or count off items or grievances in sequence, often checking them off mentally or on fingers
To give a full, precise, and itemized spoken or written account of something
To narrate a series of events, experiences, or facts in clear, sequential detail
1. (formal) To name or list items, reasons, or details one by one in order.

items.def_zh: 一气呵成地念出；滔滔不绝地背出
items.def_en: To recite a rapid, unbroken sequence of facts, names, or numbers effortlessly from memory

items.def_zh: 讲得一清二楚；逐一详明
items.def_en: To explain something point by point in full, unmistakable, step-by-step clarity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe verbally detailing, recounting, or ticking through a succession of reasons, grievances, points, or achievements one after another in spoken discourse or rhetorical presentation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在言谈或论述中一五一十、逐条道出事实、理由或论点。

groups.name: Vindicate & Defend Legitimacy · 辩护与证成 (Vindicate, Defend, Uphold, Champion)
groups.tip: 摆出合理论据为行为开脱辩明

items.def_en: to speak, write, or argue in support of someone or something against hostile criticism
To provide a good reason for something or prove that an action or belief is reasonable.
to support, defend, or fight for a person, right, or opinion being unfairly targeted
to confirm, support, or maintain a decision, principle, or stance as correct and sound
to clear someone of blame or prove an argument or action to have been fully warranted
to supply solid evidence or reasoning to demonstrate that a claim or argument is true

groups.summary_en: Focuses on arguing for the correctness, legitimacy, or validity of an action, stance, or person against accusation or criticism. It emphasizes rational and moral argumentation.
groups.summary_zh: 指提供法理、道义或事实依据，为某立场或行为正名辩白。

groups.name: Violate & Infringe · 侵犯与违犯 (Infringe, Violate, Encroach)
groups.tip: 越界侵蚀他人合法权益与法规

items.def_en: Invade someone's sphere of interest or hurt their feelings by overstepping boundaries
Gradually intrude upon or infringe on someone's property, rights, or personal time

items.def_zh: 侵犯（权利、隐私等，infringe on/upon）；违犯，触犯（法律、条约）
items.def_en: 1. (infringe on/upon) to limit, encroach on, or violate someone's legal rights, freedom, or privacy. 2. to break or violate a law, rule, or contract.
Go beyond the acceptable limits of a law, rule, or moral standard
Directly break or fail to respect a law, agreement, principle, or someone's privacy

items.def_zh: 撕毁；违反（契约、保密协议）
items.def_en: Fail to observe the terms of a legal agreement, contract, or code of conduct

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to breaching, undermining, or stepping over legal limits, constitutional rights, contracts, or boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 指逾越界限、破坏条约法例或侵蚀侵犯他人的正当权利与领地。

groups.name: Violent Shudder & Mechanical Vibration · 剧烈颠簸与机械震颤 (Judder, Shudder, Rattle)
groups.tip: 机械或物体剧烈颠簸与颤动

items.def_zh: 格格作响地振动；使嘎嘎作响
items.def_en: To make or cause to make a rapid succession of short, sharp knocking sounds while shaking
To move or cause to move continuously and rapidly back and forth
To rattle noisily and violently while moving or shaking
To shake violently and momentarily, typically from cold, horror, or mechanical strain
To shake or sway abnormally with a rhythmic rocking motion, especially of a vehicle's wheels or frame
(especially of a vehicle or machine) to shake and vibrate violently and noisily

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intense, jerky, or noisy physical vibration and shaking, typical of malfunctioning machinery, vehicles, or profound physical shock. They contrast sharply with gentle quivering by emphasizing mechanical violent oscillation or audible rattling.
groups.summary_zh: 描述机械失灵、车辆颠簸或机体遭受强烈冲击时的剧烈震颤与杂音抖动。

groups.name: Visit & Frequent · 探访与造访 (Haunt, Patronize, Drop by)
groups.tip: 往来特定场所探望

items.def_en: To visit a particular place often or regularly.
To make an informal, unannounced, or brief visit to a person or place
To visit a place briefly, often to run a quick errand or say hello
To pay a formal or deliberate short visit to someone at their home or office
To visit a particular place repeatedly and persistently, becoming a familiar presence there
To visit a restaurant, shop, or establishment regularly as a paying customer

groups.summary_en: Covers visiting physical locations or individuals, especially with repeated regularity or informality. 'Frequent' implies habitual visitation, 'patronize' highlights recurring customer presence, and 'drop by' captures brief informal visits.
groups.summary_zh: 指经常出入某处场所或非正式地上门拜访巡视。

groups.name: Visual Detection & Noticing · 察觉与发现 (Spot, Catch Sight Of, Detect)
groups.tip: 视线扫过捕捉特定目标

items.def_en: To suddenly see someone or something, often briefly or unexpectedly
To manage to see or identify something with difficulty
To see someone or something for a brief moment, often incompletely
To pick out or focus visual attention on one particular person or thing among many
To see, detect, or recognize someone or something, especially with difficulty or after careful searching.

items.def_zh: 看到；发现（远处的微小或隐蔽目标）
items.def_en: To manage to see something, especially after looking for a long time or at a great distance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe visually picking out, identifying, or noticing someone or something, especially when obscured, distant, or embedded in a crowded background.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在纷杂或隐蔽环境中敏锐地发现、认出或捕捉到目标。

groups.name: Vocal Sighs & Murmurs · 叹息与呻吟 (Sigh, Groan, Moan)
groups.tip: 以叹气呻吟声表达身心痛楚

items.def_en: Emit a long, audible breath expressing sadness, relief, tiredness, or longing
Make a series of low, feeble, fretful sounds expressive of fear, pain, or unhappiness

items.def_zh: 发出“啊”的声音（表示赞叹、欣喜或痛苦等）
items.def_en: To make a prolonged 'aah' sound, expressing pleasure, relief, admiration, or pain.
Make a prolonged, low sound expressing physical suffering, sexual pleasure, or discontent
Inhale suddenly and audibly with an open mouth, typically due to shock, pain, or breathlessness
Make a deep, inarticulate sound conveying pain, despair, or intense disapproval

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote involuntary or semi-voluntary non-verbal vocalizations that express physical sensations or deep emotional states such as relief, pleasure, sorrow, or physical discomfort.
groups.summary_zh: 表示因疼痛、解脱、愉悦或忧伤而发出的叹息、呻吟等非语言人声。

groups.name: Volunteer & Offer · 自愿奉献与主动提供 (Volunteer, Offer, Step Forward)
groups.tip: 主动提供帮助或服务

items.def_en: to state one's willingness to give assistance, take action, or present something

items.def_zh: 自愿做，主动提供；自愿服役
items.def_en: 1. to offer to do something without being forced or paid 2. to offer information, opinions, or assistance willingly 3. to enlist for military or social service willingly
to present oneself willingly to help, take on responsibility, or provide testimony

items.def_zh: 投入协作，自愿助一臂之力
items.def_en: to join enthusiastically with others to help accomplish a shared task

items.def_zh: 举手自荐，自愿接下任务
items.def_en: to signify that one is willing to volunteer for an assignment or duty

items.def_zh: 主动呈递，提出（建议/帮助）
items.def_en: to hold out or put forward something graciously for someone to accept

groups.summary_en: Involves spontaneously, willingly, and freely offering one's services, time, aid, or information without compulsion, command, or monetary demand.
groups.summary_zh: 指不求回报、无外界强迫下自告奋勇承担任务或主动提供帮助与信息。

groups.name: Vomit & Puke · 呕吐与反胃 (Vomit, Puke, Throw up)
groups.tip: 恶心反胃将胃内容物吐出

items.def_en: (informal British) To vomit or bring up one's stomach contents
To expel food and digestive fluids involuntarily through the mouth
To eject matter forcefully from the stomach through the mouth
(informal) To vomit or bring up contents from the stomach.
(informal) To vomit or disgorge the contents of one's stomach
To make strong, involuntary muscular spasms as if about to vomit

groups.summary_en: Verbs here designate the involuntary, forceful physical ejection of stomach contents through the mouth due to nausea, sickness, or intoxicants. The frame spans clinical terms to casual colloquial expressions.
groups.summary_zh: 指因恶心或疾病通过口腔剧烈排空胃中内容物。

groups.name: Vomit & Regurgitate · 呕吐与反胃 (Throw Up, Regurgitate, Spew)
groups.tip: 胃部食物倒流剧烈反胃

items.def_en: To bring swallowed food up again to the mouth
To eject matter from the stomach through the mouth; vomit
(informal) To vomit
To make the sound or movement of vomiting; retch
To discharge the contents of the stomach up through the mouth, especially because of illness.
To vomit copiously and forcefully

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the physiological act of forcefully expelling the contents of the stomach through the mouth, ranging from clinical and formal terms to vivid, everyday conversational idioms.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖将胃内容物经口剧烈排出的生理动作，包含日常口语与医学书面表达。

groups.name: Vote & Poll · 投票与表决 (Poll, Cast, Refer)
groups.tip: 政治选举中投出选票

items.def_en: To formally express a choice or opinion in an election, referendum, or meeting
To register a vote or ballot formally in an election
(parliamentary) To separate into distinct groups to register formal 'ayes' and 'noes' votes
To survey opinions systematically or to receive a specified number of votes in an election
To vote or ask people to vote secretly on an issue or candidate.
To solicit votes, subscriptions, or opinions directly from individuals across an electorate

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal procedures where participants register their preference, cast ballots, or poll a population to reach a collective political or civic decision.
groups.summary_zh: 公民或成员通过投递选票、民调等程序进行集体表决。

groups.name: Wait & Await · 等待与守候 (Await, Bide, Linger)
groups.tip: 静止期待后续的发生

items.def_en: To stay where one is or delay action until a particular time or event occurs.
To spend time waiting or wandering idly in an area without clear purpose
To wait for a short period, especially during an interruption or on telephone calls
To wait expectantly for someone or something, or to be in store for someone
To stay in a place longer than necessary, reluctant to depart
(one's time) To wait patiently for a favorable opportunity before taking decisive action

groups.summary_en: This frame covers remaining in a place or postponing an action until an anticipated person, time, or event arrives, ranging from neutral staying put to expectant or patient endurance.
groups.summary_zh: 指停留某处、推迟行动以期盼或守候人、事、时机到来。

groups.name: Waive & Forgo · 弃权与自愿放弃 (Forgo, Forfeit, Cede)
groups.tip: 自愿放弃索赔或特权

items.def_en: To officially surrender your legal rights, property, or title by signing a document

items.def_zh: 放弃（权利、要求等）；免除，不强求遵守
items.def_en: 1. To officially and voluntarily give up a legal right, claim, or rule, or decide not to insist on a requirement.
To lose the right to have or do something because you broke a rule, contract, or law
To formally give up possession of territory, authority, or rights to another country or entity
To decide not to have, do, or enjoy something pleasant or advantageous
To yield possession, control, or a right to someone else under pressure or obligation

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights voluntarily relinquishing an entitlement, privilege, claim, or requirement, usually in a formal, legal, or gracious concession.
groups.summary_zh: 指自愿、正式地放弃自身合法权益、索赔权或应得待遇。

groups.name: Warn & Alert · 告诫与示警 (Warn, Alert, Forewarn)
groups.tip: 从寻常提醒升级为拉响警报

items.def_en: (+ against/about) To advise someone to be careful or prudent to avoid a mistake or risk

items.def_zh: 预先走漏风声；向……通风报信
items.def_en: To provide confidential advance warning or confidential hints about impending events
(+ about/of) To tell someone in advance about impending danger, harm, or unpleasant consequences

items.def_zh: 向……报警，使警觉，使注意到
items.def_en: (+ to) To warn someone of a potential danger or problem, or make them aware of a fact.

items.def_zh: 预先警告，先发制人通报
items.def_en: To warn or notify someone in advance about a coming risk or eventuality
To cause sudden anxiety or make someone acutely aware of danger

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on alerting agents to imminent hazard, danger, or trouble so they can take protective or preventative measures. It scales from routine cautions to urgent, high-intensity emergency alarms.
groups.summary_zh: 指就潜在危险或突发危机向对方发出预警和告诫。

groups.name: Waterproof & Seal · 保护与加固 (Waterproof, Seal, Weatherize)
groups.tip: 筑起防线，抵御外界侵蚀损伤

items.def_en: Cover with a thin protective layer of plastic, metal, or wood joined by adhesive
Close an opening or cover a surface tightly with a protective coating to prevent fluid or air passage
Make a structure, surface, or material stronger by adding extra support or substance
to treat fabric, a surface, or an object so that water cannot penetrate it

items.def_zh: 使耐风雨；作抗候防护处理
items.def_en: Modify or treat a building or item to protect it from extreme weather or cold temperatures
Fill cracks, seams, or joints with a waterproof material to prevent leakage

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe applying physical barriers, chemical coatings, or treatments to surfaces to protect them from environmental elements.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过涂层、密封或结构改性，使物体具备防渗、防水及耐环境侵袭能力。

groups.name: Weave & Coil · 编织与卷绕 (Entwine, Braid, Wind)
groups.tip: 纺织缝缀紧密相连

items.def_en: To wrap something flexible repeatedly around an object or center point
To wind or arrange a flexible material into continuous circular or spiral loops
To weave three or more strands of hair, rope, or fabric over and under each other
To twist or wind two or more things closely around each other
To join three or more pieces of hair, straw, or ribbon by intertwining them diagonally
1. (+ with) To weave threads together, or blend two stories, themes, or elements closely together.

groups.summary_en: This frame describes physically interlacing, winding, or twisting multiple strands, fibers, or narrative elements so that they wrap around or pass through each other in an integrated structure.
groups.summary_zh: 将多股线材、纤维或抽象叙事元素相互交缠、盘绕成复合结构。

groups.name: Weave & Knit · 结网与织构 (Spin, Mesh, Enmesh)
groups.tip: 交织经纬结成网络结构

items.def_en: To draw out and twist natural fibers, or produce fine silk threads to form a web or cocoon
To fit closely together or intertwine like interlocking threads or net strands
To capture animals or obtain resources by casting or surrounding them with a net

items.def_zh: 结网，织网；使落入圈套，使缠入网中
items.def_en: 1. To construct or form a web; to trap or envelop in a web.
To catch or trap an animal or person using a snare, net, or cunning web of deception
To catch, entangle, or trap someone or something as if in a tight net or complex snare

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame evoke the specialized act of producing interconnected, delicate, lattice-like networks or webbings, often with the secondary sense of entrapping or binding tightly.
groups.summary_zh: 专指纺丝结网、形成多孔网格结构，常引申为使深陷罗网或重重包裹。

groups.name: Wet & Moisten · 浸湿与润湿 (Douse, Drench, Moisten)
groups.tip: 由表层微润到内外彻底濡湿

items.def_en: To scatter tiny drops of water or liquid over a surface
To make something slightly wet or less dry
To flow over or splash across something in a spreading sheet of water
to make something wet; to urinate in or on something accidentally
To pour a large amount of liquid over someone or something abruptly
To make someone or something completely and thoroughly wet

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the application of water or fluid to an object or surface, spanning the spectrum from slight dampening to pouring liquid generously over it.
groups.summary_zh: 指将液体洒在或涂在物体上使其变湿，程度可从微润延伸至彻底浇湿。

groups.name: Whirlpool & Vortex · 漩涡与回旋流动 (Swirl, Eddy, Vortex)
groups.tip: 绕轴打转或形成漩涡

items.def_en: To move in a circular direction against the main current of water or wind
To move quickly around and around in a circular or spiraling pattern
To open or churn in deep, engulfing swirling movements
To revolve rapidly around a center or axis in a wild circular motion
To spiral rapidly inward or outward in the manner of a powerful vortex
To swirl, spin, or move rapidly in a circular motion like a whirlpool.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize fluids, air, or loose material spiraling inward or outward in circular, turbulent motion resembling a vortex or maelstrom. While 'swirl' covers rapid rotational sweeps, 'eddy' suggests counter-current spiraling rings.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、气流或物质如漩涡般飞速盘旋流动。

groups.name: Wind & Meander · 蜿蜒与曲折穿行 (Wind, Snake, Meander)
groups.tip: 蜿蜒曲折缠绕前行

items.def_en: 1. To twist, wrap, or coil around something. 2. To follow a curving, bending, or twisting course.
To follow a winding, turning course with gentle curves, characteristic of rivers or leisurely paths
To bend, curve, or turn repeatedly while progressing forward or being shaped
To move or extend in long, sinuous bends and curves across an area
To arrange or wind into a series of concentric circles or tight loops
To move by turning frequently and dodging between obstacles or people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe following a circuitous, sinuous, or weaving route, or physically wrapping something around an axis in loops. Key distinctions hinge on whether the motion is fluid natural meandering, deliberate zigzagging, or physical coiling.
groups.summary_zh: 表示路径或轨迹的曲折蜿蜒，或物体本身的盘绕与缠裹。

groups.name: Witness & Observe · 目击与见证 (Eyewitness, Witness, Testify to)
groups.tip: 亲眼目睹事件发生的实况

items.def_en: To see something happen, especially a crime, accident, or significant event, with one's own eyes
To notice or watch an occurrence attentively, taking note of details as an onlooker
To watch an activity or incident taking place without taking part yourself
To provide evidence or personal confirmation of something based on what one has observed
(+ to) To declare or prove that something is genuine or true based on personal observation or evidence
To see an event, crime, or accident personally with one's own eyes.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on directly perceiving an event, crime, accident, or historical moment in person, thereby becoming an evidentiary observer. Nuances contrast being a formal bystander witness with bearing legal or moral testimony.
groups.summary_zh: 强调亲眼目睹特定事件、突发事故或历史瞬间，具备见证与作证意味。

groups.name: Witness & Testify · 见证与目击 (Witness, Behold, Attest)
groups.tip: 亲身在场见证事件发生

items.def_zh: 经历；亲眼看见（时代变迁等）
items.def_en: To be the setting or time of an event, or to observe an incident firsthand

items.def_zh: 目击，亲眼看见；见证（重大事件、变革等）；作证
items.def_en: 1. To see something happen, especially a crime, accident, or historical event. 2. To experience or be the time or setting of an event or change. 3. To give evidence or sign a document as an official witness.
To watch an activity or event taking place without participating directly
(+ to) To show, testify, or furnish evidence that something occurred or is authentic

items.def_zh: 目睹；看见（尤指非同寻常之物）
items.def_en: To gaze upon or perceive someone or something, often with awe, admiration, or surprise
(+ to) To declare, confirm, or provide evidence that something exists or is true from observation

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on being physically present to see an occurrence personally (often crimes, historical turning points, or natural phenomena), thereby possessing firsthand experiential knowledge that can substantiate testimony.
groups.summary_zh: 指亲临现场目睹事件发生，成为第一手历史或法律见证者。

groups.name: Work & Drudge · 劳作与苦役 (Drudge, Moil, Scullion)
groups.tip: 从事枯燥繁重乏味的苦工

items.def_en: To engage in routine, tedious domestic or farm maintenance tasks
(+ at) To perform repetitive, tedious work persistently without inspiration
(+ at) To continue doing monotonous, painstaking tasks with quiet persistence
To work hard in wet, dirty, or tedious conditions; to drudge endlessly
(+ away/along) To drudge along doing lowly, dirty, or dull work

items.def_zh: 做苦工，做繁重枯燥的工作
items.def_en: (+ away/at) To do hard, dull, and monotonous work for long periods.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize enduring thankless, subordinate, boring, and soul-crushing drudgery in humble or domestic settings.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重于从事枯燥低微、缺乏报酬与成就感的牛马式杂务劳碌与下等苦差事。

groups.name: Yield & Relent · 屈服与松口 (Relent, Succumb, Cede)
groups.tip: 协商中放弃坚持并放宽要求

items.def_en: (+ to) To finally agree to something after adamantly refusing, surrendering to insistence
(+ to) To cease resisting someone's relentless pressure, demands, or influence

items.def_zh: 变宽厚，松口妥协，让步；（恶劣天气或严酷态势）减弱，放缓
items.def_en: To finally agree to something you previously refused, or to become less severe, strict, or harsh.
(+ to) To suddenly collapse one's resistance and capitulate entirely under heavy pressure
(+ to) To lose the determination or physical ability to fight against a superior power
(+ to) To stop fighting or resisting and accept the opposing side's demands

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving way to mounting pressure, fatigue, or moral persuasion after an initial phase of strict resistance. The nuance highlights psychological softening, abandoning an intransigent stance, or eventually bowing to force.
groups.summary_zh: 强调原先态度强硬或坚决抵抗，最终在压力或劝说下心软松动、让步服软。

groups.name: Zigzag & Tack · 蜿蜒转折与交替折向 (Zigzag, Weave, Tack, Dogleg)
groups.tip: 呈Z字形曲折蛇形前行

items.def_en: change the course of a boat or travel diagonally back and forth across a direct heading
bend sharply at an angle resembling the hind leg of a dog
move across a region with intersecting paths going repeatedly in opposite directions
move quickly with abrupt direction changes to evade obstacles, pursuit, or blows

items.def_zh: 穿梭前行，忽左忽右移动
items.def_en: move along by frequently changing direction from side to side around obstacles or traffic
to move forward by making sharp, alternating turns to the left and right

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on sharp, angular changes of heading across a progression path, alternating sharply left and right rather than curving smoothly. It applies to runners dodging defenders, roads ascending precipitous slopes, or yachts tacking against the wind.
groups.summary_zh: 指以明显的锐角、交替折向或左右曲折前进的运动方式。

groups.name: Absolve & Shrive · 赦免与解罪 (Absolve, Forgive, Shrive)
groups.tip: 神职人员听取忏悔并赦罪

items.def_en: To stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense, flaw, or mistake
To forgive an offense or impolite action; or to grant remission of an ecclesiastical fault
To cancel or pardon a punishment, debt, or spiritual sin
(+ from/of) To officially free someone from guilt, sin, or legal and moral obligations

items.def_zh: 听取（某人）忏悔并赦免；忏悔
items.def_en: 1. (archaic / religion) When a priest shrives someone, he hears their confession and grants them absolution.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on spiritual or moral forgiveness, where a religious authority or aggrieved party formally remits guilt, clears sin after confession, or releases someone from a deep moral obligation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在宗教忏悔或道德伦理层面宽恕罪过、赦免灵魂或免除沉重负疚。

groups.name: Absorb & Imbibe · 吸收与汲取 (Absorb, Imbibe, Assimilate)
groups.tip: 将水分、知识或养分纳进内部

items.def_en: To be thoroughly absorbed into a porous material or fully comprehended by the mind
To absorb eagerly or savor with total attention, such as sights or atmosphere

items.def_zh: 吸收（液体、气体、养分等）；汲取（知识、信息）；吸引（全部注意力）
items.def_en: 1. To take in a liquid, gas, or other substance from the surrounding space. 2. To take in and understand information or ideas. 3. To engross someone's attention fully.
To take in and fully incorporate nutrients or information into an existing body or system
To take in or absorb liquid, moisture, or ideas into the system

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking in liquid, moisture, knowledge, or influence throughout a body's interior volume, drawing it in until it is completely assimilated.
groups.summary_zh: 将水分、养料或知识文化深入吸收进体内或心智内部。

groups.name: Abstain & Refrain · 戒绝与禁欲 (Abstain, Refrain, Forgo)
groups.tip: 克制欲望彻底戒除烟酒

items.def_en: (+ from) to stop oneself from doing or saying something one is tempted to do
(+ from) to deliberately choose not to indulge in something enjoyable, especially alcoholic drink or food
to willingly decide to go without something desirable or pleasurable
to completely abstain from drinking alcohol

items.def_zh: 宣布放弃，断绝（恶习或欲望）
items.def_en: to formally and publicly state that one will no longer engage in or indulge a habit or pleasure

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on voluntary, disciplined self-restraint and complete renunciation of bodily pleasures, intoxicating substances (especially alcohol), or sensory temptations due to moral, health, or ascetic commitments.
groups.summary_zh: 指本着意志或原则自律戒断酒瘾、不良嗜好或肉体欲望。

groups.name: Abstain & Starve · 绝食与斋戒 (Starve, Fast, Abstain)
groups.tip: 从忍受饥饿到极端挨饿禁食

items.def_en: To deliberately restrict food intake to lose weight or for health reasons
To abstain voluntarily from all or certain kinds of food or drink for a period
(+ of) To keep someone from having essential nourishment or sustenance
1. To suffer or die from lack of food, or to cause someone to suffer from hunger. 2. (+ of) To deprive someone or something of something essential.
To refuse to eat as a prolonged, organized protest

groups.summary_en: This frame covers deliberate or enforced cessation of eating, ranging from medical/spiritual fasting to political hunger strikes and fatal deprivations.
groups.summary_zh: 包含出于宗教、抗议自愿断食，或遭受残酷断粮折磨的行为。

groups.name: Academic Research & Systematic Study · 学术调研与系统研究 (Research, Study, Scrutinize)
groups.tip: 系统性深入探寻事实真相

items.def_en: To examine a subject, trend, or phenomenon systematically in detail to understand it thoroughly.
To study something thoroughly and systematically in order to discover new facts, test ideas, or find out the truth.
To look at or consider a concept, subject, or specimen carefully in order to understand its nature.
To examine the structural components or underlying patterns of data, text, or a phenomenon critically.
To examine someone or something very closely and critically, paying attention to every detail.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the rigorous, intellectual, and methodical exploration of topics or phenomena to generate new knowledge or test theories. Unlike criminal inquiries, the focus here is scholarly, empirical, and analytical.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重遵循学术或科学方法对课题进行严谨、系统的研讨与求证。

groups.name: Accommodate & Billet · 寄宿与留宿 (Lodge, Billet, Quarter)
groups.tip: 在旅店或借宿处留宿居住

items.def_en: To stay and receive regular meals at someone's house or school in return for payment
To provide housing or shelter for people, especially soldiers, in specified lodgings

items.def_zh: 借宿，寄宿；供……留宿；卡住，嵌于；正式提出（申诉等）
items.def_en: 1. To stay somewhere temporarily, especially paying for a room. 2. To provide someone with a place to sleep. 3. To become stuck firmly in a place. 4. To formally submit a complaint or claim.
To provide someone with a room or place to sleep and live
(+ at / with / on) To assign someone, typically military personnel, to lodge in a civilian house

groups.summary_en: This frame addresses providing or taking temporary domestic accommodation, rented rooms, or arranged quarters for individuals, travelers, or troops, usually under formal or contractual terms.
groups.summary_zh: 指为旅客、租客或军队提供或接受临时食宿安排及安置借住。

groups.name: Accost & Approach · 唐突搭讪与迎面拦阻 (Accost, Buttonhole, Waylay)
groups.tip: 主动上前纠缠搭话或冒昧质问

items.def_en: Approach someone directly and intentionally to initiate contact or start a dialogue
Detain someone in conversation, often unexpectedly and against their inclination

items.def_zh: 半路拦截（以便交谈或盘问）
items.def_en: Stop or interrupt someone on their way unexpectedly in order to speak with them

items.def_zh: 当面对质，迎面截住问难
items.def_en: Face up to or approach someone directly in a hostile, challenging, or assertive manner

items.def_zh: （冒昧、唐突或具挑衅性地）上前搭话，走过去质问
items.def_en: 1. To approach and speak to someone boldly, aggressively, or unexpectedly, often in a public place.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe confronting, approaching, or stopping another person unexpectedly and uninvitedly—often assertively, aggressively, or awkwardly—to initiate an unwanted conversation.
groups.summary_zh: 指突兀、主动甚至挑衅性地上前拦住对方攀谈搭话。

groups.name: Accrete & Build Up Gradually · 沉积与层积累聚 (Accrete, Accumulate, Agglomerate)
groups.tip: 微粒附着层层缓慢积聚

items.def_en: To become blocked or filled gradually with fine sand, mud, or sediment

items.def_zh: 积聚，逐渐增大；使积聚，使合生
items.def_en: To grow, accumulate, or form gradually by layers or particles sticking together over time.
To become covered with a thick, hard, or dried layer of a substance, or form into a crust
To change from a soft or liquid state into a solid or firm mass, typically as it cools
To collect or gather into a cluster, rounded mass, or dense ball

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses processes where matter, layers, or components attach gradually to a core over time, building into a dense, solid mass. It highlights incremental, physical accumulation rather than abstract piling.
groups.summary_zh: 物质通过逐层附着、沉积或团聚而缓慢凝结成块的渐进累积过程。

groups.name: Ache & Hurt · 隐痛与持续作痛 (Ache, Throb, Smart)
groups.tip: 身体部位隐隐作痛钝痛

items.def_en: To cause or feel continuous physical pain in a body part
To feel a sharp, stinging pain, like that of a graze or burn
To experience a sudden, brief, sharp spasm of localized pain

items.def_zh: 隐隐作痛，钝痛；渴望，想念（ache for/to）
items.def_en: 1. To feel a continuous, dull pain in a part of your body. 2. (+ for/to do) To want something or someone very deeply and painfully.
To feel pain in a series of regular, pulsating beats

groups.summary_en: Captures the continuous somatic experience of dull, radiating, or pulsing discomfort in tissues and limbs. Contrasts deep continuous aching with rhythmic throbbing or sharp stinging sensations.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体内部持续不断的钝痛、跳痛或隐隐作痛的感觉体验。

groups.name: Acquit & Exonerate · 判免与开脱 (Exonerate, Vindicate, Clear)
groups.tip: 法庭判决无罪还其清白名誉

items.def_en: (+ of) To prove or officially state that someone is innocent of a crime, debt, or wrongdoing
To choose not to punish someone, or to give them only a very light punishment
1. (+ of) (law) To officially decide and state in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a crime. 2. ('acquit oneself') To perform or behave in a specified way.
To prove that someone is innocent, right, or justified, especially after they have been criticized or doubted
(+ from/of) To officially clear someone from blame, accusation, or criminal responsibility

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the formal clearing of an individual from criminal charges, blame, or suspicion through a judicial ruling, investigative findings, or concrete evidence.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法庭裁判、官方调查或确凿事实消除刑事指控或免除嫌疑。

groups.name: Adapt & Accustom · 适应与习惯 (Inure, Acclimate, Habituate)
groups.tip: 久经磨砺而渐渐麻木与顺应

items.def_en: (+ to) To adapt or get used to a new climate, conditions, or environment
(+ to) To make someone accustomed to or psychologically tolerant of something
(+ to) To make someone less sensitive to pain, cold, hardship, or emotional distress
(+ to) To cause someone to experience something so often that they stop reacting emotionally

items.def_zh: 使习惯于，使适应（苦难、不快等）
items.def_en: (usually passive, 'be inured to') To accustom someone to accept something undesirable, painful, or difficult without suffering.

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns becoming accustomed to conditions, progressing from normal cognitive and physical adaptation to becoming hardened or desensitized to hardship and pain.
groups.summary_zh: 指逐渐适应新环境，或对苦难与不良刺激习以为常。

groups.name: Adorn & Caparison · 锦衣与华饰 (Deck Out, Bedizen, Caparison)
groups.tip: 从日常穿衣到华丽装饰

items.def_en: Cover or wrap someone or something loosely with ornate, flowing fabric

items.def_zh: 盛装打扮；修饰得漂漂亮亮
items.def_en: Dress someone or decorate something in a remarkably festive, showy, or colorful manner
Dress oneself or style someone in an unusually stylish, showy, or elaborate way
Dress up or decorate gaudily and tastelessly with vulgar ornaments

items.def_zh: 给（马）披上华丽鞍鞯；使穿华服
items.def_en: (literary or historical) To dress a horse in rich ornamental coverings, or to dress someone in splendid clothing.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lavishing elaborate decorations, opulent trappings, or gorgeous finery upon a person, horse, or carriage. They emphasize theatrical extravagance and rich visual appeal.
groups.summary_zh: 指为人物、坐骑施以华美锦饰或极具观赏性的华丽装扮。

groups.name: Advance & Extend Credit · 贷款与拆借 (Loan, Advance, Finance)
groups.tip: 暂时让渡资金或物品

items.def_en: To pay money to someone before the regular time or prior to completion of work
To lend money, an object, or an artwork to someone temporarily.
To provide the capital or credit needed for a purchase, enterprise, or project
To support financially by contributing public or institutional funds
To accept financial liability or guarantee funding for an enterprise or security

groups.summary_en: Formal financial transactions where money, securities, or capital assets are advanced temporarily under contractually defined interest terms and repayment schedules.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重金融机构或合同语境下的资金拆借、信贷与借出资本。

groups.name: Advocate & Champion · 提倡与力挺 (Champion, Espouse, Back)
groups.tip: 从倡导理念到挺身捍卫事业

items.def_en: To defend or support a person, right, or principle against criticism or opposition
To publicly recommend, support, or push for a particular cause, policy, or action.
To embrace and adopt a belief, cause, or theory as one's own

items.def_zh: 游说拉票；到处奔走宣传
items.def_en: To travel around campaigning or speaking publicly in favor of a candidate or cause
To vigorously support or defend a cause, idea, or group of people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe public commitment to promoting or defending a policy, cause, or belief, ranging from moderate verbal backing to zealous campaigning.
groups.summary_zh: 公开推荐、拥护或极力争取某项主张与权益。

groups.name: Affect & Alter · 影响与波及变化 (Affect, Impact, Infiltrate)
groups.tip: 产生作用导致改变

items.def_en: To produce an effect on someone or something, often across a broad scale or scope

items.def_zh: 影响；侵袭，感染；深深打动；假装，装出
items.def_en: 1. to produce a change or have an effect on someone or something 2. (of an illness) to attack or infect someone 3. to cause strong feelings of sadness or pity in someone 4. to pretend to have or feel something
To have a direct, noticeable, and often disruptive effect on an environment, system, or situation
To cause changes in the characteristics, condition, or course of something without replacing it entirely
To disturb the normal operating process or state of an activity or system by causing a sudden change

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on an event, condition, or substance producing tangible alterations or disturbances in the state or function of something. It covers mechanical, biological, and systemic disruption rather than purely psychological sway.
groups.summary_zh: 指外因直接对状态、机能或事物演变带来实质改变。

groups.name: Affiliate & Partner · 联合与挂靠 (Align, Associate, Team up)
groups.tip: 建立联盟或附属合作关系

items.def_en: (+ with) To connect or partner oneself or an organization with another group

items.def_zh: 使隶属，使并入；发生联系，建立从属关系
items.def_en: To link a person or organization closely with a larger group or network, or to become formally joined with it.
(+ with) To join together with another person or group to achieve a common purpose
(+ with) To bring an organization or faction into agreement or alliance with another
To unite separate organizations or states into a formal federation or governing alliance

groups.summary_en: This frame covers organizations or individuals connecting formally or semi-formally with larger bodies to share resources, gain institutional backing, or pursue shared interests.
groups.summary_zh: 指个人或机构通过挂靠、结盟或联合融入更大体系或组织。

groups.name: Afflict & Torment · 折磨与使受苦 (Afflict, Torment, Plague)
groups.tip: 疾痛或苦难长久煎熬折磨

items.def_en: To make someone feel burdened, exhausted, or oppressed by trouble or grief
To cause continual discomfort, hardship, or severe trouble to someone over a long period
1. (often passive, 'be afflicted with/by') To cause severe physical pain, chronic illness, or emotional distress to someone.
To cause someone severe and prolonged physical suffering or intense mental distress
(formal) To cause great suffering or devastation to a people or region

groups.summary_en: Relates to causing acute or long-term bodily misery, severe physical pain, chronic illness, or profound mental anguish.
groups.summary_zh: 指疾病、苦痛、灾祸对人的身心造成长期的剧烈折磨。

groups.name: Afforest & Plant Woodlands · 植树造林与绿化 (Reforest, Afforest, Revegetate)
groups.tip: 植树造林促进植被恢复

items.def_en: To make an area greener by planting trees, grass, and other vegetation

items.def_zh: 造林；在从未有森林的土地上植树
items.def_en: To establish a forest on land that has not previously been forested

items.def_zh: 恢复植被；使重新长出植物
items.def_en: To replant or restore natural vegetation on barren, disturbed, or damaged ground

items.def_zh: 将（区域）全部栽种植物；植满
items.def_en: To fill an area of ground completely with trees, shrubs, or crops
to replant trees on land where an existing forest has been destroyed, cut down, or burned

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the intentional cultivation and establishment of tree cover or vegetation on open or depleted land. They range from formal ecological terms like afforest to everyday acts of planting saplings.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及在荒地或受损土地上规模化植树绿化、恢复植被的动作。

groups.name: Afforest & Reforest · 植树造林与绿化 (Forest, Afforest, Reforest)
groups.tip: 播种移栽树木绿化造林

items.def_en: to plant trees and vegetation over land to improve appearance, biodiversity, or environmental health
to cover an area of land with growing trees and create a forest
to establish a brand new forest by planting tree saplings on previously barren or deforested land
to plant tracts of trees across an open expanse of landscape
to replant an area with trees where a forest has been lost to harvesting, fire, or clearing

groups.summary_en: This ecological and silvicultural frame covers planting large swathes of saplings to establish new woodlands, regenerate logged forest ecosystems, or revegetate degraded land on an environmental scale.
groups.summary_zh: 指在荒地或采伐区大规模种植林木，营造森林或恢复林被生态。

groups.name: Age & Senesce · 成熟与衰老 (Decline, Grey, Wither)
groups.tip: 岁月流逝带来的生理演变

items.def_zh: 变老，老化；使变老；使陈酿成熟
items.def_en: 1. To grow older or show signs of aging. 2. To allow food, wine, or cheese to mature over time.
To become old or cause hair to turn grey through advancing years
To gradually deteriorate in physical health, strength, or vigor due to advancing years
To become dry, shriveled, or physically frail and wasted from age
(biology) To deteriorate with age at a cellular or organismal level

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on biological aging, physical decline, and progressive wear over the lifespan of living organisms or perishable commodities.
groups.summary_zh: 指生物机体老化衰退、显露岁月痕迹的动词群。

groups.name: Age & Wither · 衰老与枯竭 (Grey, Wither, Waste away, Senesce)
groups.tip: 身体器官退化衰老凋零

items.def_en: to become grey or white-haired as a natural part of growing older
to gradually lose the hair on one's head
to develop small folds or lines in the skin as a consequence of aging
to become dry, shriveled, or diminished in strength and youthful vitality
to gradually become severely thin and weak through illness or extreme old age

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail visible physical senescence, including hair loss, greying, skin shrinkage, and the loss of youthful vigor or bodily substance.
groups.summary_zh: 指人或生物随岁月流逝出现头发脱落、花白、机体枯萎等肉体衰老与衰败现象。

groups.name: Agree & Concord · 和谐与一致 (Harmonize, Accord, Coincide)
groups.tip: 各方达成协定与和谐共处

items.def_en: (+ with) To correspond, harmonize, or be entirely consistent with something such as facts or rules
To arrange things so that they match, or to bring opinions into agreement with a specific stance
(+ with) To be identical in opinion, nature, or interest, matching another viewpoint perfectly
(+ with) (formal or archaic) To agree, harmonize, or be in accord with something.
To be suitable together, or to cause different parts, policies, or groups to work together agreeably

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on mutual compatibility, constitutional alignment, and absence of friction between ideas, treaties, or parties. Verbs describe states or actions of falling into peaceful structural agreement.
groups.summary_zh: 思想、条款或主体之间保持协调、相符与无分歧的契合状态。

groups.name: Agree & Settle · 协商与商定 (Concur, Clinch, Hash out)
groups.tip: 多方协商达成一致

items.def_zh: 商定，协同安排，协力策划
items.def_en: (formal) To plan, arrange, or settle something by mutual agreement or cooperation.
To discuss the terms of an agreement with other parties in order to reach a settlement

items.def_zh: 反复推敲商定；达成妥协
items.def_en: To reach agreement through detailed, persistent, and exhaustive discussion

items.def_zh: 消除（分歧）；解决（细节问题）
items.def_en: To resolve remaining differences or minor complications through discussion
To successfully conclude or settle an argument, deal, or negotiation decisively
