groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses collaborative deliberation, mutual adjustment, and formal settlement where multiple stakeholders hammer out policies or contractual agreements.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及多方经磋商、协调与磨合后达成统一意见或敲定协议的行为。

groups.name: Alternate & Cycle · 轮换与交替 (Alternate, Rotate, Cycle)
groups.tip: 按次序交替更迭或周期循环

items.def_en: To perform an action or hold a duty alternately with one or more other individuals
(+ through) To move periodically through a set sequence of conditions, phases, or modes
To occur or happen in turns, one after another; to switch repeatedly between two conditions, states, or actions.
To pass or take turns in a recurring regular order among different personnel or crops

items.def_zh: 摆动，摇摆，在两种观点间摇摆
items.def_en: (+ between) To swing repeatedly back and forth between distinct states, extremes, or opinions

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on things or people taking turns in regular sequence, recurring successively, or shifting back and forth between two or more contrasting states.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或人员按照周期、顺序反复更替、交替出现或轮流值替。

groups.name: Anatomical Traction & Pull · 向内牵引与内收 (Adduct, Contract, Retract)
groups.tip: 用力向自身方向拉拽或牵引

items.def_en: To bend a joint or limb through muscle contraction, decreasing the angle between bones
(anatomy) To move a limb or part away from the midline of the body
To draw or pull a body part or tissue back or inward
To make narrower or tighter by drawing surrounding muscles or walls inward
(anatomy) To move or pull a limb or other body part toward the median axis of the body.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized frame describe directed anatomical or biomechanical drawing movements, particularly drawing limbs, flaps, or tissues toward the center axis or pulling them back.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及生物解剖层面肌肉牵引、肢体向身体中轴靠拢或组织内缩。

groups.name: Animal Calls: Horses & Small Creatures · 动物鸣叫：马与小兽 (Whinny, Chitter, Neigh)
groups.tip: 鸟兽等动物发出的鸣叫嘶鸣

items.def_en: to make a soft, low, affectionate whinny
1. When a horse whinnies, it makes a soft, gentle, high-pitched neighing sound.

items.def_zh: （鸟或小动物）发出唧唧声，啾啾叫；牙齿打战
items.def_en: 1. When small birds, bats, or insects chitter, they make rapid, high-pitched twittering sounds. 2. (of teeth) To chatter with cold or fear.
to make a long, loud, high-pitched call typical of a horse
to force air violently and noisily through the nostrils in impatience or alarm

groups.summary_en: Animals, particularly horses and small creatures (like rodents or small birds), produce characteristic vocal sounds expressing excitement, greeting, agitation, or rapid communication.
groups.summary_zh: 马匹或啮齿类等小型动物发出特征性的嘶鸣或轻促啼声，表达惊恐或交流意图。

groups.name: Animate & Energize · 振奋与激活 (Ginger, Liven, Galvanize)
groups.tip: 注入活力使充满生机

items.def_en: To make someone or an occasion more energetic, cheerful, and engaging, or to become so
To regain energy, cheerfulness, or freshness after fatigue, or to cause this in someone else

items.def_zh: 使更有活力，鼓舞；给……加姜
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) (informal) To make something more lively, energetic, or exciting.
To give new life, health, vigor, or strength to an institution, community, or flagging effort
(+ into) To shock, stimulate, or energize someone suddenly into forceful action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve infusing vitality, enthusiasm, or fast-paced momentum into something dull, sluggish, or demoralized.
groups.summary_zh: 指为沉闷、迟缓的人或事注入活力、热情与动力。

groups.name: Annex & Seize Territory · 吞并与强占 (Annex, Usurp, Appropriate)
groups.tip: 强行占领领土或夺取主权

items.def_en: To take possession of territory or property for one's own use, typically without authority or permission
To enter and take military control of an area or country

items.def_zh: 吞并，兼并（领土等）；附加，附着
items.def_en: 1. To take possession of an area of land or a country, usually by force or without permission. 2. (formal) To attach or add something to a larger or more important thing.
To seize and hold power, position, or land by force or without legal right
To officially take away private property or land, often without adequate compensation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the unilateral, often unlawful or forcible appropriation of land, territory, or political sovereignty by a stronger state or entity. Nuances range from formal geopolitical annexation to brazen seizure.
groups.summary_zh: 强国或掌权者单方面武力吞并、占领或侵占领土与主权。

groups.name: Annotate & Gloss Texts · 文本注释与附注 (Annotate, Gloss, Marginalize)
groups.tip: 在学术文本中添加尾注说明

items.def_en: To provide notes directing the reader to related information in another part of the same book or document

items.def_zh: 为（难词或短语）作简注或训释
items.def_en: To supply an explanation, translation, or brief marginal definition for an obscure word or phrase
1. To add explanatory or source notes at the bottom of pages in a text; to document with footnotes.

items.def_zh: 给（文章、书籍等）加批注或注释
items.def_en: To add critical or explanatory notes and commentary to a text, diagram, or book

items.def_zh: 对（经典或文献）撰写评注或系统阐释
items.def_en: To write an extensive, scholarly, or theological commentary analyzing a text in depth

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to furnishing a written manuscript, document, or publication with explanatory notes, commentary, critical apparatus, or cross-references.
groups.summary_zh: 对文本添加解释性批注、词解或旁注以澄清义理与源流。

groups.name: Anoint & Consecrate · 敷油与圣化 (Anoint, Consecrate, Sanctify)
groups.tip: 宗教临终敷油仪式祝圣

items.def_en: to officially invest someone with ministerial or priestly authority in an established religious order
to smear or rub with holy oil or ointment as part of a religious rite or coronation
to officially declare a person, church, or bread and wine holy through solemn religious ceremony
to set apart or purify spiritually for holy or sacred purposes

items.def_zh: 给（临终者）行敷油礼，涂圣油
items.def_en: (archaic) to anoint someone with consecrated oil, especially when administering the last rites

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this sacred ritual frame describe the ceremonial application of oil, chrism, or blessings to sanctify a person, monarch, or religious vessel. They emphasize formal conferral of divine grace, ordination, or dedication to sacred office.
groups.summary_zh: 指在宗教或登基仪式中施以圣油、赐福，赋予神圣属性或官职。

groups.name: Antagonize & Alienate · 挑衅与树敌 (Antagonize, Alienate, Estrange)
groups.tip: 主动激怒对方挑起敌意冲突

items.def_en: To irritate, annoy, or provoke someone without necessarily intending to
To make someone extremely angry, agitated, or hostile through annoying actions
To provoke, annoy, or upset someone so that they become hostile or opposed to you
To make someone stop supporting you or make them feel isolated and hostile
To cause someone to stop being friendly, affectionate, or close with another person

groups.summary_en: This frame covers interpersonal actions that generate hostility, breach goodwill, or turn friends and allies into adversaries. The core mechanism is behavior so abrasive or oppositional that it provokes defensive anger or estrangement.
groups.summary_zh: 指因言行摩擦或对抗态度而激怒他人，致使关系破裂或树立对立面。

groups.name: Applaud & Acclaim · 鼓掌与击节喝彩 (Clap, Applaud, Acclaim)
groups.tip: 拍手叫好表达赞赏与欢迎

items.def_en: To clap your hands together to show appreciation for a performance

items.def_zh: 拍手，鼓掌；轻拍；啪地放上（或关上）
items.def_en: 1. To hit your hands together repeatedly to show approval, praise, or enjoyment. 2. To strike or slap lightly with an open hand. 3. To place, slam, or strike quickly and forcefully.
To hit the palms together repeatedly to show praise, agreement, or appreciation
To voice loud approval and excitement alongside or in place of applause
To praise enthusiastically and publicly as an outstanding achievement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rhythmic physical clapping or formal public commendation delivered to artists, speakers, or champions. Nuances contrast simple percussive hand-slapping with reverent, high-intensity ovations.
groups.summary_zh: 通过击掌或公开盛赞来表示赞赏、欢迎与嘉许。

groups.name: Appoint & Designate · 任命与指派 (Appoint, Assign, Commission)
groups.tip: 官方委任并指定特定角色

items.def_en: To publicly appoint or choose someone to occupy a specific post or role
To grant someone an official military rank, or to authoritatively empower someone to perform a service
To choose someone formally and officially for a position of responsibility or a job
To give someone a specific role, duty, position, or piece of work to undertake

items.def_zh: 指定，任命，委派；选定，标出；命名，称作
items.def_en: 1. To officially choose or appoint someone for a particular role, task, or position. 2. To indicate or specify something as having a particular purpose or name.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this official administrative frame refer to assigning a person to an office, role, title, or specialized responsibility through legitimate authority. Nuances vary between high-level political appointments, military commissions, and formal task allocations.
groups.summary_zh: 通过行政或法定权力选定某人担任官职或执行任务。

groups.name: Apprentice & Gain Experience · 实习与见习 (Apprentice, Article, Shadow)
groups.tip: 实习或演练以提升技能

items.def_en: (+ as) To undergo systematic instruction and practice to qualify for a particular profession

items.def_zh: 与…签见习契约（英式法律/会计）
items.def_en: (British) To bind a trainee by formal contract as an articled clerk in law or accountancy
To follow closely and observe an experienced professional to learn their job role
1. (+ at/with) (chiefly North American) To work as a student or trainee to gain practical professional experience. 2. To confine or detain someone, especially during wartime.
(+ to) To work for a skilled master or employer for a fixed period to learn a trade

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to working in a supervised, entry-level, or trainee capacity within an organization to acquire practical occupational skills. They contrast structured professional training with passive observational learning.
groups.summary_zh: 指以见习、学徒或跟岗方式进行职业实践以获取工作经验。

groups.name: Argue & Dispute · 争论与辩论 (Argue, Bicker, Quarrel)
groups.tip: 从口头争执到正式规则辩论

items.def_en: (+ about/over) To argue persistently and irritably about unimportant or petty details
(+ over/about) To argue noisily and childishly about trivial matters

items.def_zh: 争辩，争论；论证，提出理由
items.def_en: 1. To speak angrily to someone because you disagree. 2. To give reasons in support of or against an idea or action.
(+ with/about) To have an angry disagreement or dispute with someone over personal or specific matters
(+ with/about) To engage in a very loud, noisy, and angry argument

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses verbal disagreements, escalating from petty, trivial squabbling to aggressive, loud, or deeply hostile confrontations between individuals.
groups.summary_zh: 指双方因意见分歧展开言语交锋，从拌嘴吵架到激烈争吵。

groups.name: Arm & Equip · 武装与整备 (Arm, Fortify, Weaponize)
groups.tip: 配置军备准备战斗

items.def_en: To provide a person, group, or nation with weapons and military equipment
To fully equip someone or a unit with the necessary uniform, gear, or operational supplies
To strengthen a place against attack by constructing defensive barriers, walls, or military installations

items.def_zh: 使军事化，给…配置军队；使军国主义化
items.def_en: 1. To equip an area, institution, or border with military forces and weapons, or organize it on military lines.
To adapt or convert an object, substance, or capability into an offensive weapon

groups.summary_en: Encompasses supplying, upgrading, or outfitting troops, fortifications, or entities with martial capabilities, defensive armor, and offensive weaponry.
groups.summary_zh: 指为团体、边界或设施配备武备兵械，强化军事打击与防御能力。

groups.name: Armor & Plate · 防护与装甲 (Armor, Plate, Shield)
groups.tip: 加装铠甲外壳以抵御外击

items.def_en: To protect someone or something from physical impact, radiation, or harm by interposing a defensive barrier
To cover or overlay a vehicle, vessel, or structure with protective metal sheets or armor
To sheath or reinforce a warship, vehicle, or structure with heavy iron plates
1. To cover a vehicle, ship, or person with protective metal plating or armor.
To cover the exterior of a structure or surface with a protective or insulating outer layer

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote encasing military personnel, combat vehicles, or installations in protective metal, composite, or ballistic plating to repel kinetic, chemical, or explosive attacks.
groups.summary_zh: 为人体、车辆或设施加装装甲或防护层，以抵御枪弹和外力创伤。

groups.name: Armor & Protective Shielding · 着甲防护与厚重披装 (Barde, Armor, Sheathe)
groups.tip: 为人马战备披上重甲

items.def_en: To cover or overlay a structure with protective sheets of metal
To equip a person, vehicle, or vessel with protective metal plates or shields
To encase or cover something closely in a protective outer layer

items.def_zh: 为（战马）披挂鞍鞯/华丽马甲
items.def_en: To put rich ornamental coverings or protective trappings onto a horse

items.def_zh: 为（战马）披护甲；（烹饪时）用培根或肥肉片包裹（瘦肉）
items.def_en: 1. (historical) To equip a warhorse with protective armor (barding). 2. (cooking) To cover meat with bacon or fat before cooking.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve covering, fitting, or encasing an animal, vehicle, or structure with rigid armor plating or protective cladding to defend against physical assault or environmental impact.
groups.summary_zh: 指为战马、人员或机械加装防护装甲板、护套以防御打击。

groups.name: Arouse & Kindle · 激发与唤起 (Arouse, Evoke, Kindle)
groups.tip: 点燃情绪引发强烈心理反应

items.def_en: To provoke or stimulate someone's curiosity or interest sharply
To cause deep, often turbulent feelings, memories, or public controversies to awaken
To spark or awaken a warm, intense feeling, curiosity, or hope in someone
To bring a specific feeling, memory, or mental image clearly into someone's conscious mind

items.def_zh: 引起，唤起；激起（欲望或兴趣）；唤醒
items.def_en: 1. To provoke a strong feeling, reaction, or suspicion in someone. 2. To excite someone sexually, or wake someone from sleep.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate stirring up dormant feelings, passions, curiosity, or reactions in someone through evocative words, events, or sensory cues.
groups.summary_zh: 指激发并唤醒内心情感、兴趣、警觉或生理欲望。

groups.name: Arraign & Indict · 传讯过堂与正式指控 (Arraign, Indict, Impeach)
groups.tip: 法庭公开传讯提审并正式起诉

items.def_en: To record the formal charges against an arrested suspect in police records
(+ with) To state officially that someone may be guilty of a crime
To officially charge someone with a serious crime, usually through a grand jury
To formally charge a high public official with serious misconduct in office

items.def_zh: 提审，传讯并宣读控罪；指责，责难
items.def_en: 1. (law) To bring an accused person before a court to formally read criminal charges and receive their plea. 2. (formal) To criticize or accuse someone publicly.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers formal judicial actions where an accused person is summoned into court, presented with an official indictment, and called upon to enter a plea.
groups.summary_zh: 指司法程序中正式传唤被告到庭提审、宣读书状及答辩。

groups.name: Arrest Growth & Restrict · 阻碍发育与压制 (Stunt, Inhibit, Stifle)
groups.tip: 阻碍阻滞正常生长发育

items.def_en: To hold back or arrest the normal development, expression, or activity of something

items.def_zh: 阻碍…的正常生长发育，抑制…的成长
items.def_en: 1. To prevent a plant, person, or thing from growing, developing, or progressing normally.
To slow down the growth, development, or progress of something, or make it hard for a process to occur
To bring something such as growth, supply, or initiative to an abrupt end by constriction or stoppage
To prevent something from developing, functioning freely, or being expressed

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe arresting, checking, or preventing the natural growth, development, or creative flourishing of an organism, talent, or economy.
groups.summary_zh: 阻碍生理、智力、才能或经济的自然成长与发育。

groups.name: Articulate Notes · 吹奏运舌与断音 (Articulate, Slur, Double-tongue)
groups.tip: 口齿清晰准确地咬字发声

items.def_en: To use the fingers in a designated manner on the keys, stops, or holes of a musical instrument

items.def_zh: 用舌吹奏（管乐器），用舌音发声；舔；斥责
items.def_en: To articulate notes distinctly using the tongue while playing a wind instrument.
To play two or more successive musical notes smoothly and continuously without tongue interruptions
To play or sing distinct, detached successive notes cleanly without blurring
To articulate rapid passages on a brass or wind instrument using alternating movements of the tip and back of the tongue

groups.summary_en: Specifically denotes vocal tract or instrumental mechanics where wind/brass players separate, slur, or articulate musical notes using tongue actions.
groups.summary_zh: 指管乐演奏中通过运舌控制音符分合与吐字发音。

groups.name: Asphyxiate & Smother · 窒息与扼毙 (Smother, Throttle, Asphyxiate)
groups.tip: 缺氧无法呼吸致昏厥甚至死亡

items.def_en: Severely restrict, obstruct, or cut off the passage of air or flow of a vital supply
Attack or kill someone by compressing their throat tightly to cut off their breath
Kill someone by covering their nose and mouth so they are completely unable to breathe
Squeeze the neck of a person or animal tightly, typically causing fatal airway collapse
To kill, die, or become unconscious from being deprived of air or unable to breathe.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on extreme, often fatal deprivation of oxygen caused by external obstruction of the airway, toxic environments, or mechanical strangulation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因气道受阻、缺氧或外力压迫导致丧失呼吸乃至致死。

groups.name: Assemble & Convene · 召集与集会 (Convene, Assemble, Muster)
groups.tip: 召集众人重新召开会议

items.def_en: To come together in a single place as a group, or to bring people together
To arrange or summon an official meeting, panel, or assembly, or to meet together officially
To assemble soldiers or collective resources, especially for inspection or military action

items.def_zh: （使）重新集会，（使）重新召集，（使）复会
items.def_en: To gather together again, or to call a meeting or court back into session after a pause.
To call together an official, ecclesiastical, or legislative assembly by authority

groups.summary_en: This frame covers formal, institutional, or deliberative gatherings where participants are summoned or come together for meetings, governance, military muster, or civic rallies.
groups.summary_zh: 指依规程召集或聚集人员参加会议、议事、演训等正式集体活动。

groups.name: Assert & Claim · 断言与坚称 (Claim, Assert, Maintain)
groups.tip: 从主观声称到坚定断言事实

items.def_zh: 宣称，断言；要求，索取；索赔；认领
items.def_en: 1. To state or assert that something is true, often without giving proof. 2. To demand or take something as one's rightful property or right.
To express firmly and repeatedly that something is true despite opposition

items.def_zh: 声称（多指未经证实的指控）
items.def_en: To state without proof that someone has done something wrong or illegal
To state something firmly as a reasoned opinion in an argument
To state a fact or belief confidently, forcefully, and without hesitation

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on insisting that something is true, justified, or due, often in the face of doubt, dispute, or absence of incontrovertible proof.
groups.summary_zh: 指缺乏确凿证据或面临质疑时，坚称某事属实或主张权利。

groups.name: Assert & Declare · 陈述与声明 (State, Declare, Assert)
groups.tip: 正式陈述并对外郑重声明

items.def_en: 1. To express thoughts, facts, or opinions clearly and formally in speech or writing.
To announce something publicly, officially, or emphatically
To give a formal, official, or authoritative decision, opinion, or judgment
To state a fact or belief firmly, positively, and with confidence
To state publicly and firmly that something is true, or to formally reassert a commitment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate making a direct, definitive, and authoritative formulation of facts, positions, or beliefs in speech or writing.
groups.summary_zh: 正式、明确且郑重地陈述事实、观点或官方立场。

groups.name: Asset Liquidation & Disinvestment · 资产剥离与撤资 (Divest, Offload, Liquidate)
groups.tip: 撤回投资或剥离下属资产

items.def_en: Sell one's investment or business equity to convert the total value into physical cash
Convert assets or an entire business entity into cash, often to settle debts
(+ of) Rid oneself of business assets, shares, or investments, often for strategic reasons

items.def_zh: 转手抛售，摆脱（包袱/资产）
items.def_en: Dispose of unwanted financial assets, inventory, or liabilities by selling them off

items.def_zh: 撤资，缩减投资；剥离资产
items.def_en: (economics) To withdraw, reduce, or liquidate financial investments, assets, or capital from a business or fund.

groups.summary_en: Covers financial and corporate moves to deliberately withdraw capital, shed non-core holdings, sell off assets, or reduce investment positions.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及企业与金融领域，指主动撤出资本、剥离子公司或清算变现资产。

groups.name: Assist & Facilitate · 协助与促成 (Aid, Expedite, Foster)
groups.tip: 提供帮助让事情变容易

items.def_en: To advance the interests, progress, or success of an endeavor
To provide support, money, or resources that help someone complete a task
(+ for) To remove difficulties so that an event or transition can unfold without friction

items.def_zh: 促进，促成；使便利，使容易
items.def_en: To make an action, process, or task easier or more likely to happen.
To cause a process or action to progress more quickly by clearing obstacles

groups.summary_en: Verbs here describe lending momentum, lowering practical barriers, or providing resources so that an operation, transaction, or development runs smoothly to completion.
groups.summary_zh: 表示通过清理障碍、提供便利或给予协同，使事务或进程更容易推进。

groups.name: Atone & Make Amends · 赎罪与赔罪 (Make amends, Compensate, Redeem oneself)
groups.tip: 通过诚心忏悔弥补过错罪衍

items.def_en: Act so as to neutralize an error, omission, or disappointment
(+ for) Do something positive to repair harm done to someone or balance a past wrong
Do something that restores respect and offsets one's previous fault or failure
(+ for) To do something good to show you are sorry for having committed a sin, mistake, or bad act.
Perform self-imposed punishment as a manifestation of repentance for wrongdoing

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote taking moral, practical, or personal corrective action to demonstrate remorse and counterbalance past offenses.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动采取善行、弥补过失以消解道德负疚感或恶果。

groups.name: Atrophy & Wither · 萎缩与枯萎 (Wither, Shrivel, Waste away)
groups.tip: 器官或肌肉缺乏锻炼导致缩减

items.def_en: to gradually become very thin, frail, and weak because of serious illness or starvation
to become dry, shriveled, or dead due to lack of moisture, or cause plants/tissues to do so
to deteriorate physically, mentally, or functionally over time
(medical / formal) to waste away or weaken from lack of use, or cause a body part or ability to do so
to wrinkle and contract, especially as a result of loss of moisture or heat

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe organic tissue, physical strength, vitality, or cognitive faculties shrinking, desiccating, and wasting away due to disuse, aging, illness, or drought.
groups.summary_zh: 指机体组织、动植物或器官功能因缺水、疾病、废用或衰老而干瘪、退化与枯萎。

groups.name: Attend & Turn Out · 参与与出席 (Attend, Show Up, Turn Out)
groups.tip: 投身加入群体活动

items.def_en: To go to and be present at an event, meeting, class, or official ceremony
To arrive and make an appearance at an expected gathering or rendezvous
To go out to a public event, protest, election, or gathering in a substantial group
(+ on) To attend a meeting, lecture, or trial as an observer rather than a full participant

items.def_zh: 单独出席（聚会），不带伴侣参加活动
items.def_en: (informal, especially North American) To attend a dance, party, or social event unaccompanied by a date or partner.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physical presence and social participation at planned events, gatherings, or functions. The verbs contrast formal registration/presence with spontaneous or informal appearances.
groups.summary_zh: 参与社交集会、现场活动或特定场合的到场出席。

groups.name: Attenuate & Dampen · 衰减与削弱强度 (Attenuate, Dampen, Diminish, Weaken)
groups.tip: 风暴、强度或痛感趋于平息减弱

items.def_en: To make or become less strong, powerful, or effective
To make something less harmful, serious, painful, or severe
To make a liquid weaker by adding water, or make a quality, belief, or effect weaker and less forceful

items.def_zh: 抑制；减弱（振动、情绪、势头）
items.def_en: To make something such as a sound, vibration, feeling, or activity less strong or urgent
(formal) To reduce the force, intensity, effect, or thickness of something, or become weaker.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify diminishing the force, amplitude, electrical signal, or destructive virulence of something. The focus is on a reduction in physical intensity, energy, or impact rather than mere count.
groups.summary_zh: 指削弱信号、冲击力、病毒毒力或物理振荡能量。

groups.name: Auction & Bid · 竞价拍卖 (Bid, Knock down, Liquidate)
groups.tip: 拍卖等特定交易手段

items.def_en: Sell something quickly or cheaply, often in bulk or to clear stock
Offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold at an auction
(+ to) Declare sold to a bidder by striking a mallet at an auction
(often 'auction off') To sell something to the highest bidder at an auction.
Convert assets into cash by selling them, typically to settle debts

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on selling property or commodities through competitive bidding processes, public sales, and gavel disposals.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦于通过公开竞价、拍卖槌裁决等方式变卖资产或物品。

groups.name: Audition & Try Out · 试镜与选拔选拔 (Audition, Try out, Screen, Screen-test)
groups.tip: 通过试镜或测试检验能力

items.def_en: To examine applicants, candidates, or materials systematically to eliminate unsuitable choices
(+ for) To compete in a trial or sports/theatrical assessment to show capability for a team or cast
To record an actor on camera during a trial scene to judge photogenic suitability for a film
To thoroughly investigate a person's background, past records, and qualifications before hiring

items.def_zh: 试演，试唱，试音；对……进行面试（或试镜）
items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To perform a short piece of acting, singing, or playing to test your suitability for a role. 2. To test an actor, musician, or performer in an audition.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses participating in or running competitive performance trials and initial screening evaluations to select candidates for theatrical or specialized roles.
groups.summary_zh: 通过现场演艺展示、试听或初步摸底，考核并筛选适合特定角色的人选。

groups.name: Autograph & Inscribe · 签名与题献 (Inscribe, Dedicate, Pen)
groups.tip: 亲笔签名题词以示确认或留念

items.def_en: To write one's personal name on a photo, album, or merchandise as a memento
(+ to) To write or announce that an artistic creation or book is offered in tribute to someone
To compose or write a letter, note, or signature by hand with a pen
(of a famous person) To sign one's name on a book, photograph, or item for someone as a souvenir.
(+ with/to) To write, print, or engrave words or one's name informally on a gift, coin, or book

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on signing one's name or writing a personalized message on keepsakes, books, photographs, or memorabilia as a token of admiration or personal dedication.
groups.summary_zh: 指名人题名留念，或作者在书画、纪念品上题写亲笔赠言。

groups.name: Autopsy & Post-Mortem · 验尸与尸检 (Necropsy, Dissect, Examine)
groups.tip: 专业解剖深挖病理真相

items.def_zh: 尸体解剖；验尸（多用于动物）
items.def_en: Perform a post-mortem surgical examination on a body, especially of an animal
Dissect a cadaver in order to display and examine its anatomical parts
To perform a post-mortem medical examination on a dead body to determine the cause of death.
Cut open and anatomically separate tissues of a body or organ to study its structure
Dig up a buried human corpse from the ground, especially for forensic examination

groups.summary_en: Forensic medical verbs describing the systematic dissection and clinical examination of a corpse to ascertain the cause, manner, and timeline of death.
groups.summary_zh: 指法医或病理学家对尸体解剖检验以确定死因的专业检查。

groups.name: Avert & Prevent · 避开与化解 (Ward off, Stave off, Head off)
groups.tip: 及早察觉并扭转避开危机

items.def_zh: 抵挡，击退（危机、攻击或质问）
items.def_en: To protect oneself against an attack, criticism, or unwanted demand
To prevent something bad or dangerous from affecting you for a period of time
To prevent an attack, danger, or unwanted occurrence from affecting you
To take pre-emptive action to prevent something from happening or continuing

items.def_zh: 避开，防止（危机、灾难）；移开（视线）
items.def_en: 1. To prevent something unpleasant or dangerous from happening. 2. ('avert one's eyes/gaze') To turn your eyes away from something you do not want to see.

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote proactive or decisive intervention to deflect, postpone, or prevent an impending crisis, disaster, or undesirable situation.
groups.summary_zh: 指采取积极措施防患于未然，化解或推迟危机与灾祸。

groups.name: Avoid & Bypass · 避开与绕行 (Circumvent, Skirt, Detour)
groups.tip: 迂回绕过障碍或避开通道

items.def_zh: 避开，绕开（危险或麻烦人物）
items.def_en: To deliberately take action to avoid touching, meeting, or dealing with someone or something
To go around the outer edge of something, or avoid discussing a contentious topic directly

items.def_zh: 绕过，避开（道路或障碍物）；越过，略过（规则或程序）
items.def_en: 1. To go around a town, obstacle, or problem instead of passing through or directly confronting it. 2. To ignore or skip an official rule, process, or hierarchy.

items.def_zh: 规避，设法绕开（规则或障碍）
items.def_en: To avoid a difficulty, obstacle, or rule cleverly or by taking an alternate route
To take a longer or roundabout route in order to avoid an obstruction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey navigating around a physical obstacle, geographic congested area, or regulatory/bureaucratic hurdle rather than confronting it directly.
groups.summary_zh: 指绕过物理障碍或规避繁琐规则与问题而非直接穿行。

groups.name: Backfire & Recoil · 适得其反与招致恶果 (Backfire, Rebound, Recoil)
groups.tip: 手段反弹波及自身致落空

items.def_zh: （+ on/upon）反弹，对原主产生反作用
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to have an adverse retroactive effect upon the originator of an action
(+ on/upon) to spring back dynamically with detrimental repercussions to the doer

items.def_zh: 未达预期，失灵弄巧成拙
items.def_en: to fail to achieve the intended goal, effect, or impression

items.def_zh: （计划）弄巧成拙，当头引爆反噬
items.def_en: to fail catastrophically and cause sudden public embarrassment or disaster for its author

items.raw_cluster: 适得其反与落空 Fail & Backfire
items.def_zh: 产生事与愿违的不良后果；（引擎等）发生逆火
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) to have the opposite and adverse effect from what was originally intended 2. (of an engine or vehicle) to undergo a mistimed explosion in the cylinder or exhaust system

groups.summary_en: Focuses on strategic actions, schemes, or remarks producing an unintended, reverse, and heavily damaging effect upon the initiator.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重行动、计谋或言论产生反向冲击，彻底弄巧成拙并反噬自身。

groups.name: Badge & Accredit · 授徽与颁证 (Badge, Accredit, Emblazon)
groups.tip: 贴标签或佩戴徽章

items.def_en: To attest formally or endorse with a designated certificate or official mark of approval
To furnish or invest with insignia, badges, or symbolic markers of office

items.def_zh: 在……上佩戴徽章，为……打上标牌；标明
items.def_en: To mark, brand, or furnish someone or something with a badge or distinguishing mark.

items.def_zh: 官方认可；核准；认证资格
items.def_en: To officially recognize, license, or provide credentials confirming an authorized standard

items.def_zh: 将（纹章、标志）饰于；以图徽标明
items.def_en: (+ with) To display or inscribe an emblem, coat of arms, or motto conspicuously on a surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve marking, insignia-bearing, or validating someone or something with official credentials, insignia, emblems, or formal signs of rank, competence, or entitlement.
groups.summary_zh: 赋予勋章徽标、加盖资质标记或以图徽彰显身份与资格。

groups.name: Balance & Counteract · 制衡与对冲 (Offset, Counterbalance, Neutralize)
groups.tip: 施加配重使两端保持平衡

items.def_en: Balance one influence or cost against an opposing one so that an overall equilibrium is maintained
Stop something from having any effect by acting against it with an opposing measure or substance
(especially in 'redress the balance') Correct an imbalance, injustice, or disadvantage by applying compensatory action
Have an equal but opposite effect or weight against something, keeping it in balance

items.def_zh: 给……加上配重；平衡，抵消，抗衡
items.def_en: to balance or counteract something by providing an opposing weight or equal force.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on supplying an opposing weight, force, or influence to cancel out, neutralize, or equilibrate an existing inequality, disadvantage, or force. The tone is strategic, functional, or mechanical.
groups.summary_zh: 借助相反的重量、作用力或措施相抵消，实现收支或力量平衡。

groups.name: Balance & Equilibrate · 维持平衡与均衡 (Equilibrate, Poise, Steady)
groups.tip: 使两端重量或状态均等稳定

items.def_zh: 使平衡，保持平衡；权衡，斟酌；相抵
items.def_en: 1. To put something into a steady position so that it does not fall, or remain in such a position. 2. To compare or weigh two different things against each other.
To hold or brace something securely to stop it from shaking, swaying, or falling over
To bring two or more opposing forces, weights, or states into exact mutual balance
To return to or maintain a steady, horizontal, and balanced posture or state
To hold something or balance yourself in a stable, carefully controlled position ready for action

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses holding an object or body in a state of stable physical equilibrium so that it neither tilts, wobbles, nor falls, or adjusting opposing forces equally.
groups.summary_zh: 保持身体或物体稳定平衡，防止倾斜晃动或跌落。

groups.name: Balance & Poise · 稳固与平衡 (Equilibrate, Stabilize, Steady)
groups.tip: 保持均势或沉着平稳

items.def_en: Keep or put something in a steady position so that it does not fall or tilt
Hold or support something firmly to prevent it from shaking, swaying, or falling
Support something physically from underneath or against a side to prevent it from falling over
Make something firm, level, and unlikely to overturn, wobble, or change abruptly
1. to balance or hold something steadily in a particular position. 2. to be or put in a state of balance or readiness for action.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express holding, positioning, or maintaining a physical body or structure in delicate or steady equilibrium, avoiding tipping over, wobbling, or collapsing.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体或身躯稳置于特定姿态，保持重心平稳而不倾覆摇晃。

groups.name: Bandage & Dress · 包扎与敷裹 (Dress, Bind up, Swaddle)
groups.tip: 用绷带纱布缠裹保护伤口

items.def_en: To clean, treat, and apply a sterile dressing to a wound
To wrap cloth tightly around an injury to stop bleeding or support it

items.def_zh: 用胶带/绷带固定（关节或肌肉）
items.def_en: To bind an injured limb or joint firmly with adhesive tape or straps to provide support
(+ up) To wrap an injured body part with a strip of cloth to protect it.
To wrap or bind someone or something in several layers of cloth or bandages

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the medical or protective care of wounds and injuries through wrapping, covering, and applying therapeutic dressings. They range from formal clinical procedures to pragmatic field first-aid.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖对创口或患处进行包扎、敷药与护创的医疗处理动作。

groups.name: Banish & Expel · 驱逐与遣返 (Deport, Expel, Banish)
groups.tip: 强制遣送出境或驱逐离开

items.def_en: To force someone to live away from their native country, often for political reasons
To officially and permanently force someone to leave an organization, school, or country

items.def_zh: 驱逐出境，遣返；表现，举止
items.def_en: 1. To officially force a foreign national to leave a country. 2. (formal, 'deport oneself') To behave or conduct oneself in a particular manner.
To officially order someone to leave a territory or community permanently as an official punishment
To officially surrender an accused or convicted person to another jurisdiction where the crime was committed

groups.summary_en: This legal and political frame describes the sovereign act of forcing an alien, dissident, or convict out of a territory, country, or jurisdiction. Nuances vary from formal administrative repatriation ('deport') to legal exile ('banish', 'exile').
groups.summary_zh: 指国家或主权机构依法将外国人、异见人士或罪犯驱逐出境或流放海外。

groups.name: Banter & Tease · 逗趣与调侃 (Chaff, Jape, Trade barbs)
groups.tip: 带着轻松玩笑的语气打趣

items.def_en: To laugh at someone and make playful or slightly unkind remarks to them

items.raw_cluster: 戏弄与开玩笑 Tease & Joke
items.def_en: (+ with) To exchange humorous, playful, and friendly remarks with someone.
To tease someone good-naturedly in a lively exchange
To exchange sharp or witty remarks and teasing insults back and forth
(informal) (+ on) To tease or play jokes on someone persistently

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mutual verbal repartee, lighthearted mocking, and witty back-and-forth remarks shared in a playful or sociable atmosphere.
groups.summary_zh: 指双向诙谐交谈、互相打趣与幽默逗乐的动词群。

groups.name: Baptize & Name · 施洗与命名仪式 (Christen, Dub, Inaugurate)
groups.tip: 宗教洗礼仪式上洗礼并赋予姓名

items.def_zh: 接纳参加；施行入门仪式
items.def_en: To admit someone into a secret society, religious group, or organization with formal rites
To give someone or something a specific unofficial name, nickname, or title

items.def_zh: 为……施洗礼；给……命名；使经受考验
items.def_en: 1. To administer baptism to someone, often officially giving them a name. 2. To give a name to; to subject to an initiating ordeal.
To name someone at baptism, or to dedicate and name a ship or project formally
To officially dedicate or declare something to be sacred in a religious ceremony

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario denote official, sacramental, or honorific acts of naming, initiating, or conferring a designated identity upon an individual, vessel, or creation. While 'christen' carries strong ritual/naming baggage, 'dub' conveys conferring a moniker or title.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过仪式或正式行为赋予名字、称号或进行入门授礼。

groups.name: Bark & Snap · 咆哮与厉喝 (Snap, Bellow, Snarl)
groups.tip: 大声厉喝与如犬吠叫

items.def_en: To utter sharp, impatient, or irritable words abruptly

items.def_zh: 厉声喊叫，厉声下令；（狗等）吠叫；剥（树皮）
items.def_en: 1. (+ out/at) To shout words, orders, or insults in a harsh, angry voice. 2. (of a dog) To make a short, loud, sharp sound. 3. To scrape or strip the bark off a tree.
To issue a command or statement in a loud, harsh, military fashion
To emit a deep, loud roar in anger or pain

items.def_zh: 龇牙怒吠；恶狠狠地低吼
items.def_en: To speak in an aggressive, threatening, guttural tone

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on shouting rapid, harsh commands or criticisms in an aggressive, sharp, and intimidating manner, resembling the abrupt vocalization of a canine.
groups.summary_zh: 指像犬吠般短促、粗暴、凶狠地厉声下达命令、训斥或怒吼。

groups.name: Barricade & Blockade · 筑障与封堵 (Barricade, Blockade, Cordone)
groups.tip: 设路障彻底封锁通道

items.def_en: To enclose or isolate an area with barriers or police tape to prevent unauthorized people from entering
To block a road, passage, or sightline by placing physical impediments in the way
To close off all access to a building, crime scene, or region completely to ensure total control
To seal off a place, port, or territory with military forces or heavy barriers to prevent goods and people from entering

items.def_zh: 设路障阻挡，封锁；把…关在路障内
items.def_en: 1. To block a road, entrance, or building with a barrier or heavy objects. 2. (reflexive, 'barricade oneself in') To shut oneself securely inside a place behind barriers.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote establishing physical or militarized obstacles across thoroughfares, doors, or borders to forcefully deny ingress, fortify a stronghold, or bottle up an enemy.
groups.summary_zh: 通过重物或工事强行封锁道路、出入口或建筑，阻止通行或侵入。

groups.name: Bask & Savor · 沐浴享受与沉醉 (Bask, Revel, Savor)
groups.tip: 像晒太阳般舒适地沉醉于暖意中

items.def_zh: 晒太阳，取暖；沉浸在，尽情享受（赞誉、温暖等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To lie exposed to pleasant warmth, especially sunlight. 2. (+ in) To enjoy and revel in warmth, comfort, praise, or success.
To sit or lie in the warmth of the sun in order to relax and tan the skin
To enjoy an experience, feeling, or taste fully and unhurriedly
(+ in) To get great pleasure and satisfaction from an experience, sensation, or triumph
(+ in) To immerse oneself completely in a pleasurable state, luxury, or emotion

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns lounging passively in radiant heat or sunshine, or wallowing indulgently in adulation, triumph, and sensory pleasure.
groups.summary_zh: 指惬意享受阳光暖意，或尽情沉醉于赞美与喜悦中。

groups.name: Baste & Moisten · 浇汁与润湿 (Baste, Moisten, Drizzle)
groups.tip: 烹饪时反复刷油浇汁防干

items.def_en: To spread sauce, melted butter, or egg lightly over food using a pastry brush
To lift pan juices or sauce with a spoon and pour them repeatedly over cooking meat
To pour a liquid over food in a fine, light stream or delicate drops
To make something slightly wet or damp, often by adding small amounts of liquid
1. to pour melted fat or juices over meat while it is cooking to keep it moist 2. to sew pieces of fabric together with long, loose stitches temporarily

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail culinary and manual techniques of intermittently pouring, brushing, or spooning hot fats, marinades, or liquids over food during cooking to prevent it from drying out.
groups.summary_zh: 特指烹饪中在食材表面反复浇淋汤汁、油脂以保持湿润入味的行为。

groups.name: Bathe & Cleanse · 沐浴与清洁 (Bathe, Wash, Shower)
groups.tip: 用水洗澡沐浴以洗净身体

items.def_en: To wash one's body while standing under a spray of running water
1. (chiefly BrE) To wash someone (especially a child or baby) in a bath. 2. (chiefly BrE) To wash oneself in a bath.
To clean an entire person or large surface thoroughly using water and soap
To wash someone clean using a wet sponge or cloth without full immersion
To wash oneself or another person thoroughly in a bath of water

groups.summary_en: This frame covers personal hygiene activities centered on washing the human body, bathing in tubs, or taking showers to become completely cleansed.
groups.summary_zh: 指在澡盆或喷头下清洁全身的沐浴个人卫生行为。

groups.name: Bathe & Soak · 沐浴与浸洗 (Bathe, Wash, Soak)
groups.tip: 水流冲洗清洁体表污垢

items.def_en: (literary) To wash or bathe gently with water, especially a body part or wound.
To clean someone's body or oneself by wiping with a damp sponge or cloth.
To wash oneself under a spray of water falling from an overhead fixture.
To lie immersed in a bath or liquid for an extended time to soften, relax, or cleanse.

items.def_zh: 洗澡，沐浴；用水清洗（伤口）；游泳
items.def_en: 1. To wash yourself or someone else in a bath. 2. To gently wash or soothe a part of the body with liquid. 3. (chiefly British) To swim in the sea, a lake, or a river.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers personal grooming or therapeutic treatment involving immersing oneself or parts of the body in water or soothing liquids, focusing on cleansing, relaxation, or wound care.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及全身或身体局部浸泡于水中以进行清洁、舒缓或护理。

groups.name: Be Situated & Lie · 地理坐落与展布 (Lie, Sit, Nest, Sprawl)
groups.tip: 处于特定地理位置

items.def_zh: 坐落于；位于（高地或明显位置）
items.def_en: To be positioned or situated proudly in a particular setting or elevated position
To be located or situated in a particular place, position, or direction.

items.def_zh: 高耸坐落于；临高栖息于
items.def_en: To be balanced or positioned high up on the edge of a steep hill, cliff, or tall support

items.def_zh: 漫延铺展；不规则扩展坐落
items.def_en: To spread out or lie irregularly across an expansive area in an untidy or loose manner

items.def_zh: 依偎坐落于；掩映在……之间
items.def_en: To be located comfortably, securely, or snugly sheltered within hills, trees, or a valley

groups.summary_en: This frame captures stative geographic verbs describing how physical features, buildings, or territories are located or oriented across a landscape, highlighting their natural pose or vista.
groups.summary_zh: 描写建筑、城镇或地理地貌在特定地形中自然坐落、铺展的状态。

groups.name: Beat & Emulsify Ingredients · 打发与拌和乳化 (Cream, Whip, Beat)
groups.tip: 击打搅和使原料充分交融

items.def_zh: 搅打成奶油状；把（黄油和糖）搅成乳霜状
items.def_en: To mix or beat ingredients (such as butter and sugar) together until they form a smooth, soft, creamy mixture.

items.def_zh: 掺和；用搅拌机打碎混合
items.def_en: Mix various ingredients together thoroughly until they form a single uniform substance
Combine two unblendable liquids (such as oil and vinegar) into a stable, suspended mixture
Mix food vigorously with repeated strokes of a spoon, fork, or electric mixer until smooth
Beat cream, eggs, or batter rapidly with a whisk or mixer to introduce air and produce foam

groups.summary_en: This culinary frame focuses on vigorously beating fat, sugar, eggs, or cream together until the mixture changes physical consistency, incorporating air to become fluffy, uniform, and velvety.
groups.summary_zh: 用力搅拌油脂、糖或蛋液，使空气充入形成轻盈细腻的乳霜质地。

groups.name: Beat & Thrash Crops/Surfaces · 连打与摔打脱粒 (Thresh, Thrash, Flail)
groups.tip: 用力击打脱粒或捣毁

items.def_en: To separate particles or grains by repeatedly striking

items.def_zh: 用连枷打；乱挥；猛烈击打
items.def_en: To beat or swing something vigorously and erratically as with a flail

items.def_zh: 脱粒，打谷；猛烈挥动，抽打
items.def_en: To separate grain from the rest of the crop plant by beating it; to thrash or beat violently.
To strike someone or something repeatedly with hard, punishing blows
To beat repeatedly and violently with a stick or whip, or thrash grain

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on vigorously beating or whipping plants, fibers, or objects with continuous swinging strokes, whether historically to separate grain or metaphorically to flail violently.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过挥舞工具连续摔打、抽打农作物或物体以脱粒、分离或剧烈击打。

groups.name: Beckon & Summon by Gesture · 招引与示意召唤 (Beckon, Wave over, Flag down)
groups.tip: 挥手摆头以肢体语言示意，招引他人走近

items.def_en: to indicate with a tilt or nod of the head that someone should approach you
to signal to someone with a movement of the hand to come closer or join you

1. to move your hand or head to signal someone to approach or follow you
2. to appear appealing, inviting, or likely to happen
to signal to the driver of a moving vehicle to pull over and stop, usually by waving your arms
to order or gesture to someone to come to you, often using authority or a decisive signal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe using silent physical gestures—such as nodding, waving, or crooking a finger—to summon someone toward you or signal them to follow. They range from polite social summons to urgent hailing on the street.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过招手、颔首等肢体动作示意他人靠近、停步或跟随。

groups.name: Beef & Grumble · 抱怨与牢骚不满 (Beef, Grumble, Whine)
groups.tip: 牢骚满腹或低语咕哝

items.def_en: 1. (+ about) (informal) To complain persistently or grumble about something.
(+ about) Complain about something in a bad-tempered, muttering, or disgruntled way

items.def_zh: 哭诉抱怨；唧唧歪歪地发牢骚
items.def_en: (+ about) Complain in an annoying, petulant, or high-pitched tone without taking action
(informal, + about) Complain repeatedly and irritably, often about trivial matters
(informal, + about) Complain spitefully, unfairly, or maliciously behind someone's back

groups.summary_en: Focuses on expressing petty, persistent, irritable dissatisfaction or grievances. Distinct from formal complaints, this frame captures informal venting, muttering, whining, and griping.
groups.summary_zh: 指非正式口语中喋喋不休地发牢骚、碎碎念或抱怨琐事。

groups.name: Befit & Behoove · 适宜与理应 (Befit, Behoove, Beseem)
groups.tip: 符合身份理应履行的义务

items.def_en: To be appropriate to or look attractive on someone; befit their status
To be acceptable, convenient, or proper for someone or something
(archaic or formal) To be suitable, fit, or becoming for
To be suitable, appropriate, or proper for someone or a particular situation
('it behooves someone to do') (formal) To be right, proper, or necessary for someone to do something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express that an action, manner, or quality is morally incumbent, appropriate, or fitting given a person's standing, role, or station.
groups.summary_zh: 指与身份、地位相相称，或某人理当履行的适宜职责。

groups.name: Befriend & Take In · 结交并关照 (Adopt, Champion, Patronize)
groups.tip: 主动结交盟友并给予扶持

items.def_en: To begin to like someone and behave in a friendlier, more welcoming manner toward them
1. To become friendly with someone and help or support them, especially when they are lonely or new.

items.def_zh: 悉心庇护；认作门徒悉心关照
items.def_en: To take a newcomer or younger person into one's protective care and guidance
To support, defend, and publicly advocate for someone's interests or rights
To treat someone with intense affection, excessive care, and overprotective shelter

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on proactively extending warmth, sponsorship, or compassionate companionship to newcomers, vulnerable persons, or outsiders. It combines interpersonal bonding with protective or mentoring action.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动亲近、庇护或关照新来者及弱者，兼具交好与支持之意。

groups.name: Beget & Reproduce · 配种受精与生殖繁育 (Sire, Pollinate, Beget)
groups.tip: 雄性配种繁衍留下血统

items.def_zh: 成为（雄性亲本）繁育出；作为……的雄性父本
items.def_en: (especially of a male domestic animal, such as a stallion) To be the father of offspring.
to cause an egg, female animal, or plant to develop new life by introducing male cells
(of insects, wind, or humans) To carry pollen to a flower or plant so that it can produce seeds or fruit.
(formal/archaic) to father or produce offspring through sexual reproduction
to introduce semen into the reproductive tract of a female animal or person

groups.summary_en: Organisms, human parents, or breeders cause reproduction by contributing genetic material, fertilizing flowers, or conceiving offspring. Verbs specify male parentage (animals or humans), botanical fertilization, or direct genealogical procreation.
groups.summary_zh: 动植物或人类通过配种、授粉、传宗接代产生后代或促成繁衍。

groups.name: Behave & Carry Oneself · 举止与表现 (Behave, Conduct, Act)
groups.tip: 言谈举止的表现方式

items.def_en: To behave in a specified way, whether appropriately or inappropriately

items.def_zh: 举止端正，持身（尤指反身）
items.def_en: (bear oneself) To carry oneself or behave with a specific demeanor or posture

items.def_zh: 举止，为人处事（尤指反身）
items.def_en: (conduct oneself) To behave and direct one's actions in a specified, usually proper, manner

items.def_zh: 表现，举止；守规矩，表现规矩
items.def_en: To act in a particular way; to conduct oneself properly or politely.
To behave in an excited, unreasonable, or inappropriate manner

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses acting or handling oneself in social interactions, evaluated against standards of decorum, etiquette, or expected propriety.
groups.summary_zh: 指日常社会交往中符合规矩礼仪的言谈举止表现。

groups.name: Belch & Spew · 嗳气与喷吐 (Burp, Spew, Gush)
groups.tip: 打嗝反气喷发胃部气体

items.def_en: To pass gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth, or help a baby do so
To send out liquid or vapor forcibly in a stream, or emit profusely
(+ out/from) To flow out rapidly in a plentiful stream or burst

items.def_zh: 打嗝，嗳气；大量喷出，喷吐
items.def_en: 1. To let air or gas come noisily up from the stomach through the mouth; to burp. 2. (+ out/forth) To emit or discharge smoke, gas, or flames forcefully in large amounts.
(+ out) To expel large quantities of gas, liquid, or substance rapidly and forcibly

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the forceful, noisy expulsion of gas or liquids, either biologically from the digestive tract or metaphorically from chimneys, volcanoes, and pipes.
groups.summary_zh: 指胃部积气发出声响喷出，或烟雾、液体等剧烈喷涌倾泻。

groups.name: Bellow & Low · 鸣吼与哞叫 (Moo, Bellow, Bleat)
groups.tip: 发自喉咙的啼叫与粗暴吼叫

items.def_en: (of cattle) To make a deep, low moo sound.
To make the characteristic deep sound of a cow
To make the quavering cry of a sheep or goat, or complain weakly
To make a high-pitched, loud sound characteristic of a horse
To emit a deep, loud, roaring sound in anger or pain, like a bull

groups.summary_en: This frame characterizes the deep, resonant, or plaintive vocalizations made by cattle, sheep, and other livestock, or deep booming cries emitted by humans.
groups.summary_zh: 指牛羊等家畜发出的深沉长鸣或人类发出的低沉吼叫。

groups.name: Belong & Appertain · 归属与从属 (Belong, Appertain, Pertain)
groups.tip: 明确所有权或从属关系

items.def_zh: 属于，归…所有；是…的成员；应在…处，适合
items.def_en: 1. (belong to) to be the property of someone, or be a member of a group or organization 2. to be in the right or suitable place, position, or situation
(+ to) To be associated with or belong to someone or something as a condition, right, or liability
(+ to) To belong to or be an appropriate part of something, especially by law or tradition
(+ in) To exist as a natural, permanent, or inseparable quality, right, or element within something

items.def_zh: 从属于，属于（特定群体或权利）
items.def_en: (+ to) To belong to someone or something as an accompaniment, right, or legal possession

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate rightful ownership, inclusion within a specific category, or formal association with a larger entity or jurisdiction. Register contrasts sharply between everyday possession and high-register legal or institutional relations.
groups.summary_zh: 表物品归属、成员从属或法理上的附带与关联。

groups.name: Bend & Refract · 折射与偏折 (Refract, Deflect, Bend, Diffract)
groups.tip: 光线或路径发生弯曲折射

items.def_en: Alter the straight direction of travel of a light ray or wave path
Break up or bend light or sound waves as they pass around the edge of an obstacle
Cause something to change its course or direction from an intended path
Cause something moving to change direction after striking something or meeting a field
(physics) to make a ray of light, sound wave, etc. change direction when it enters water, glass, or air at an angle

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical waves, beams of light, or traveling trajectories changing direction upon encountering an interface, obstacle, or new medium.
groups.summary_zh: 指光线、波或运动轨迹在穿过介质或碰撞时发生偏折。

groups.name: Benefit & Profit · 获利与受益 (Benefit, Gain, Capitalize)
groups.tip: 从中获取利润或好处

items.def_en: (+ from) to receive an advantage, improvement, or assistance; or bring advantage to
to obtain a useful advantage, improvement, or financial advancement

items.def_zh: 获利，赚钱；得益，受益；有益于
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/by) to gain a financial benefit, advantage, or profit from an activity 2. to be of service, advantage, or benefit to someone
(+ on) to take exploit a situation or trend purely for immediate personal or financial gain
(+ on) to turn an event, circumstance, or mistake into an advantage or profit for oneself

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote reaping an advantage, financial gain, educational enrichment, or practical utility from an event, circumstance, investment, or opportunity.
groups.summary_zh: 指从某一行动、机会、投资或境遇中获取金钱收益、实际益处或优势。

groups.name: Bereave & Deprive of Kin · 丧亲与遗孀化 (Bereave, Widow, Deprive)
groups.tip: 至亲故去或所依之物被强制剥夺

items.def_zh: 遗下；身后留下（孤儿寡母等）
items.def_en: Leave behind a surviving spouse, children, or dependents upon dying
(+ of) Prevent someone from having, keeping, or enjoying something vital, such as love, family, or basic rights
(+ of) Cruelly or unjustly take away a cherished person, hope, or life experience from someone

items.def_zh: 使丧偶，使丧夫（或丧妻）；剥夺
items.def_en: (usually passive) To cause someone to become a widow or widower by the death of their spouse.

items.def_zh: 使丧失（亲人）；使痛失至亲
items.def_en: (usually passive) Deprive someone of a close relative or friend through their death

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe leaving someone utterly desolate or emotionally depleted through the death of a spouse or close relative. They frequently appear in the passive voice to convey profound, involuntary loss.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因配偶或至亲离世而痛失亲人、陷入孤苦境地。

groups.name: Berth & Dock · 停泊与靠岸 (Moor, Tie up, Drop anchor)
groups.tip: 载具抵达泊位停靠

items.def_en: Mooring a vessel firmly to a dock or post with ropes
Lower an anchor into the water to immobilize a ship in position

items.def_zh: （使船只）停靠码头，进港；对接（航天器）；扣减（工资等）
items.def_en: 1. (of a ship or spacecraft) To sail into or tie up at a dock; to join together in space. 2. To reduce or deduct an amount of money from someone's pay or benefits.
Fasten a boat or floating structure to the shore or sea bottom with cables or anchors
Bring a ship into its allocated resting place at a wharf or harbor quay

groups.summary_en: Relates to securing watercraft (or spacecraft) to a fixed shore structure, pier, or seabed. The frame emphasizes nautical protocols of arrival, tethering, and anchoring securely.
groups.summary_zh: 指船舶或航天器驶入停泊位并系缆缆绳或抛锚固定。

groups.name: Besmirch & Tarnish Reputation · 玷污与抹黑 (Besmirch, Tarnish, Blacken)
groups.tip: 编造恶言败坏他人名誉

items.def_en: To make someone's reputation, honor, or good record less respected or tarnished
To spread false and damaging stories about a person, especially in politics, to ruin their credibility
To damage the purity, integrity, or spotless reputation of someone or something
To say damaging things about someone to ruin their good character in the eyes of others
(formal) To damage or tarnish someone's good name, honor, or reputation.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame invoke metaphors of physical staining, soiling, or corroding to depict inflicting enduring dishonor, loss of luster, or disgrace upon someone's virtue, lineage, or public standing.
groups.summary_zh: 借用污损灰暗意象，指抹黑、玷污他人名节、清白或崇高荣誉。

groups.name: Bestow & Confer · 赐予与恩准 (Bestow, Confer, Accord)
groups.tip: 居高临下施恩授予特权或物

items.def_en: Grant or provide someone what is appropriate, due, or requested
(+ on/upon) Grant an official title, degree, benefit, or right
(formal or archaic) To give, grant, or reveal something to someone as a special favor or condescension.
(+ on/upon) Confer or present an honor, right, or gift upon someone formally

items.def_zh: (+ to do) 屈尊俯就，垂赐
items.def_en: (+ to do) Condescend to give, do, or grant something in a gracious yet proud manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the unilateral transfer of honors, boons, rights, or special favors from a superior authority to an inferior.
groups.summary_zh: 指居高临下地施予恩惠、头衔、特权或圣意恩典。

groups.name: Bias & Distort · 偏见与扭曲 (Jaundice, Warp, Prejudice, Color)
groups.tip: 戴着有色眼镜审视而导致误判

items.def_en: Influence or taint someone's opinion or memory in an unfair or subjective way

items.def_zh: 使产生偏见；损害（客观性）
items.def_en: Give an unfavorable or preconceived bias toward someone or something before the facts are known
Distort or cause an assessment, statistic, or perception to be biased or inaccurate

items.def_zh: 使怀偏见，使心怀嫉妒或愤世嫉俗；使患黄疸
items.def_en: (often passive) To distort one's attitude or view with prejudice, cynicism, or bitterness.
Cause someone's judgment, personality, or understanding to become distorted or abnormal

groups.summary_en: Focuses on internal biases, bitterness, or prior grievances corrupting an agent's perception, judgment, or evaluation. Verbs emphasize how the observer's mind is skewed rather than an external deception.
groups.summary_zh: 指个人偏见、嫉恨或不良经历扭曲客观判断与认知视角。

groups.name: Bicker & Feud · 口角与争执 (Quarrel, Bicker, Squabble)
groups.tip: 从口角争执激化为公开争端

items.def_en: (+ about/over) To argue peevishly and repeatedly about trivial or unimportant matters
(+ over/about) To engage in a noisy and petty quarrel, typically over something slight
(+ with) To have an angry disagreement with someone and consequently cease friendly relations
(+ with/about/over) To have an angry argument or serious disagreement with someone.
(+ with) To maintain a prolonged and bitter quarrel, mutual hostility, or dispute over an extended time

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate vocal, emotionally charged disagreements and interpersonal spats, frequently revolving around petty matters or longstanding personal grievances.
groups.summary_zh: 指人际间因琐事或旧怨发生的口角争吵、拌嘴或长期不和。

groups.name: Bill & Invoice · 开票与计费 (Invoice, Bill, Charge)
groups.tip: 商业交易中的开具账单与收费

items.def_en: To demand an amount of money as a price for a service or commodity
To send a statement of charges to someone for goods or services
To calculate or bill a cost or fee owed

items.def_zh: 开具发票（或发货清单）给……；开发票列出（货物或服务）
items.def_en: (+ for) To send an itemized bill to a customer detailing goods or services provided and requesting payment.

items.def_zh: 制表计费；把账单细目化
items.def_en: To arrange financial figures or charges systematically in a table or list

groups.summary_en: This commercial communication frame denotes issuing payment demands, itemizing fees, or debiting someone for goods or services delivered.
groups.summary_zh: 开具费用明细清单、发出账单或计收费用。

groups.name: Binding Legal Adjudication & Arbitration · 法律仲裁与终局裁决 (Arbitrate, Adjudicate, Judge)
groups.tip: 第三方斡旋调和或权威仲裁

items.def_en: To act as an impartial referee or final authority to enforce rules and resolve contested issues.
To officially judge and settle a dispute between two people or groups who cannot agree.
To hear and decide the legal merits of a contested case in a court of law.
(+ on/that) To make an official authoritative legal decision or declaration.
To make a formal, authoritative, and legally binding judgment on a disputed matter or claim.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the binding, authoritative intervention of an authorized tribunal, referee, or designated neutral party who possesses legal power to pronounce a definitive resolution on a conflict.
groups.summary_zh: 指具有法权或受托资格的第三方做出具有约束力的权威断案与终局裁决。

groups.name: Birdwatch & Spot · 观鸟与野外搜寻 (Bird, Birdwatch, Spot)
groups.tip: 户外追踪与观测目标

items.def_zh: 在野外发现；辨识出（特定目标物种）
items.def_en: To catch sight of and identify a particular elusive bird or animal in the wild

items.def_zh: 观鸟，户外追踪观察鸟类
items.def_en: To observe, track, and identify wild birds in their natural habitats as a hobby.
To manage to see or catch sight of a rare bird or wildlife specimen

items.def_zh: 实地侦察；寻觅探索（栖息地或观测点）
items.def_en: To search an area systematically in advance to locate birds, animals, or favorable vantage points
To practice the hobby of observing wild birds in their natural environment

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the hobby or scientific activity of locating, observing, listening to, and cataloging wild animal and bird species in their natural habitats.
groups.summary_zh: 指在自然生境中专门搜寻、辨识并观察野鸟或野生动物。

groups.name: Bite & Sting · 叮咬与蜇刺 (Sting, Bite, Prick)
groups.tip: 昆虫或动物咬刺机体

items.def_en: To make a tiny hole in skin with a sharp point, causing a brief prickling sensation
To bite or pinch someone quickly, lightly, or playfully
To cut or pierce skin with teeth, mandibles, or mouthparts

items.def_zh: （昆虫、植物等）蜇，刺；（使）感到刺痛；激怒，使痛苦
items.def_en: 1. (of an insect, plant, or animal) To prick or wound someone with a sharp organ, usually injecting poison. 2. To feel or cause a sharp, burning pain. 3. To upset, hurt, or provoke someone.
To introduce venom into a body through a sting or bite

groups.summary_en: Verbs concerning physical puncture of the flesh by insects, snakes, sharp thorns, or barbed apparatuses, often injecting venom or causing acute local pain.
groups.summary_zh: 指昆虫、刺物或毒腺扎入皮肉引起锐痛、红肿或注毒的动作。

groups.name: Blacklist & Ostracize · 抵制与排斥 (Blacklist, Ostracize, Blackball)
groups.tip: 集体抵制并列入失信黑名单

items.def_en: To deliberately treat someone coldly to force them out of a group or venture.
1. To put a person, organization, or country on a blacklist, refusing to employ, trade with, or deal with them.
To deliberately exclude someone from a group, community, or society.

items.def_zh: 投弃权/反对票否决，排挤
items.def_en: To vote secretly against admitting someone to an exclusive club or organization.
(formal) To officially bar or prevent someone from enjoying a right, office, or privilege.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote institutional or community-driven exclusion, where a person or entity is formally marked, systematically barred, or socially shunned to banish them from a circle or industry.
groups.summary_zh: 通过列入黑名单或群体排挤来剥夺资格与交往机会。

groups.name: Blare & Blast · 高鸣与喧闹 (Blare, Blast, Peal)
groups.tip: 喇叭高亢刺耳轰鸣作响

items.def_en: to produce a prolonged high-pitched shrieking sound, typical of sirens or strong wind

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳尖声；尖声吹响
items.def_en: to make a harsh, loud, grating sound reminiscent of a donkey or metallic horn
to sing, play, or produce loud music vigorously with immense force
to emit or play sound at an overwhelming, explosive volume

items.def_zh: 高声鸣叫，尖叫；大声播放
items.def_en: To make a very loud, unpleasant sound, or to cause a horn, siren, or radio to sound loudly.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures emission of extraordinarily loud, penetrating, and often jarring noise from horns, speakers, or musical instruments. It contrasts deafening acoustic power with intrusive harshness.
groups.summary_zh: 指喇叭、扩音器或仪器爆发出的刺耳轰鸣、巨响或长鸣。

groups.name: Blaze & Flame · 熊熊燃烧与喷薄 (Blaze, Flare, Smolder)
groups.tip: 烈火熊熊发出光芒

items.def_en: To burn slowly with dense smoke but without visible flame
To produce visible tongues of fire, or burn vigorously with active flames
To burn with a sudden, bright, unsteady flame, or burst abruptly into light

items.def_zh: 熊熊燃烧；闪耀，发光；怒视
items.def_en: 1. To burn brightly and fiercely with strong flames. 2. If light, color, or anger blazes, it shines with dazzling intensity.
To burn with destructive, uncontrolled ferocity over a wide area

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray the visual and thermal dynamics of active burning, differentiating between roaring high-intensity infernos, sudden luminous outbursts, and subdued, smokey smoldering.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘火焰的动态燃烧样态，如烈火猛烧、突发迸燃或无焰暗燃。

groups.name: Blemish & Mar Surface/Reputation · 玷污与致瑕 (Blemish, Mar, Taint, Sully)
groups.tip: 损害外观或功能完整

items.def_en: To spoil the appearance, quality, or harmony of something, rendering it imperfect
1. To spoil the appearance, perfection, or reputation of someone or something with a mark or flaw.
To contaminate or corrupt something morally or physically, spoiling its integrity
To damage the purity or integrity of someone's reputation, character, or pristine state
To cause damage or dishonor to someone's good name, honor, or reputation

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to spoiling the aesthetic perfection, purity, or pristine reputation of an entity by leaving an indelible physical mark, defect, or moral stain.
groups.summary_zh: 留下小斑痕或污点，损害事物外观完好或声誉清白。

groups.name: Blemish & Speckle · 雀斑与瑕疵斑痕 (Blemish, Speckle, Mottled)
groups.tip: 日光照射后皮肤长出浅褐雀斑

items.def_en: to mark or stain a surface with unsightly spots or ink stains
to become marked, or mark someone's skin, with small brownish spots, especially from exposure to the sun
to spoil the flawless appearance or perfection of something with a mark or fault
to mark a surface with many small dots or patches of color
to mark with spots, blotches, or streaks of different colors or shades

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing marking, spotting, or disfiguring skin or smooth surfaces with tiny pigmentations, scars, spots, or imperfections.
groups.summary_zh: 指皮肤或物体表面长出小雀斑、斑点或瑕疵。

groups.name: Blind & Obscure · 遮蔽与致盲 (Dazzle, Obscure, Shroud)
groups.tip: 阻隔光线剥夺视线能力

items.def_en: To prevent something from being seen or heard clearly by covering or blocking it
To blind temporarily by an excess of light
To extinguish all lights or cover all windows to prevent light from being seen

items.def_zh: 使失明；使目眩，使眩晕；蒙蔽，使失去判断力
items.def_en: 1. To make someone permanently or temporarily unable to see. 2. (of light) To dazzle someone so they cannot see clearly. 3. To make someone unable to understand or perceive things clearly.

items.def_zh: 掩饰，遮盖（如被浓雾或阴影笼罩）
items.def_en: To cover or hide something so that it cannot be clearly seen, like a shroud or thick mist

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe depriving someone of vision or rendering an object invisible, either by overpowering light, dense visual barriers, or deliberate concealment.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强光眩目或浓密遮蔽物使人失明或使物隐没。

groups.name: Blind Feeling & Tactile Exploration · 盲目摸索与探路 (Grope, Feel, Fumble)
groups.tip: 在黑暗中用手盲目摸索

items.def_en: Search widely and urgently in various directions using touch or sight
Move forward slowly and carefully by touching surfaces rather than seeing clearly

items.def_zh: 摸索，盲目触摸；乱摸（猥亵）
items.def_en: 1. To feel about blindly or hesitantly with the hands, as in the dark. 2. (informal) To touch someone sexually without their consent.
Move or climb hurriedly using both hands and feet over rough or unfamiliar ground
Touch or handle someone or something clumsily, roughly, or repeatedly

groups.summary_en: Focuses on feeling around blindly, hesitantly, or in darkness using the hands or feet to navigate or locate an object without visual guidance.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在黑暗或视线受阻时，用手或脚犹豫、盲目地探寻摸索。

groups.name: Blitz & Storm · 闪击与突袭强攻 (Blitz, Storm, Ambush)
groups.tip: 以闪电般极快速度发起猛扑

items.def_en: To descend or pounce upon a target suddenly in a surprise raid or assault
To attack an unsuspecting enemy unexpectedly from a concealed position
To attack and enter a fortified place with a sudden, violent, coordinated rush
To attack continuously with heavy artillery fire, missiles, or aerial bombs

items.def_zh: 以闪电战袭击，闪击；密集轰炸；突击攻克
items.def_en: 1. To attack with a sudden, overwhelming military assault or heavy bombardment. 2. (informal) To deal with or complete something with sudden, concentrated energy.

groups.summary_en: This military and tactical frame characterizes launching sudden, furious, and overwhelming offensive strikes against an enemy position before defenses can react. It emphasizes rapidity, shock value, and devastating force.
groups.summary_zh: 指采取出其不意、迅雷不及掩耳的密集火力或突袭攻克目标。

groups.name: Blob & Splotch · 斑污与块滴 (Splotch, Smear, Daub)
groups.tip: 溅落污物留下斑块弄脏

items.def_en: To mark, stain, or spot a surface with drops of ink, paint, or liquid

items.def_zh: 使留有斑迹，溅污；把……抹成团状
items.def_en: To mark or stain a surface with a thick drop of liquid or paint; to form into thick, shapeless drops.
To mark or cover a surface with irregular, messy patches of liquid or color
To spread a thick, greasy, or sticky substance over a surface carelessly
To apply paint, mud, or grease quickly, crudely, or thickly to a surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to applying or marking a surface with thick, viscous liquid or pigment, creating messy drops, patches, or smears.
groups.summary_zh: 用粘稠液体或涂料在表面涂抹、滴落出斑块或厚重污迹。

groups.name: Bloom & Blossom · 开花与繁盛 (Blossom, Flower, Thrive)
groups.tip: 生命由小变大繁衍兴旺

items.def_en: Produce blossoms or develop fully to reach an optimum state
Unfurl petals or blossoms into full display

items.def_zh: 开花；繁荣，兴旺，容光焕发
items.def_en: 1. When a plant blooms, it produces flowers. 2. To develop, flourish, or become healthy and successful.
Produce flowers, or develop into something healthy, promising, or beautiful
Begin to grow rapidly or flourish vigorously

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the emergence of floral buds and vegetative vitality, extending to periods of peak health, radiance, and thriving potential. 'Bloom' and 'blossom' share literal floral stages and figurative developmental flourish.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重植物绽放花朵，或事物进入旺盛繁荣阶段。

groups.name: Board & Glide · 滑行器械乘骑 (Skateboard, Rollerblade, Glide)
groups.tip: 踩滑板或操纵车辆行进

items.def_en: To glide smoothly over ice or hard ground wearing ice skates or roller skates
To move continuously, smoothly, and effortlessly along a polished or frozen surface
To ride or perform tricks on a skateboard.
To glide down snow-covered slopes while standing strapped onto a single wide board
To skate on flat pavement using boots fitted with a single central line of wheels

groups.summary_en: This recreational locomotion frame covers riding, steering, and performing maneuvers on wheeled boards, skates, or similar non-motorized gliders, focusing on body balance and surface cruising.
groups.summary_zh: 指脚踩滑板、滑轮鞋等滑行板械依靠重心与推蹬移动并展示技巧。

groups.name: Boat & Traverse Water · 航行与驾舟 (Sail, Ferry, Canoe)
groups.tip: 乘风破浪驾船出行

items.def_zh: 乘船航行，划船；用船运载
items.def_en: 1. to travel, sail, or row in a boat for pleasure or transport 2. to carry or transport people or goods in a boat
to travel in or drive a motorized boat across water
to transport passengers or goods across a body of water in a boat

items.def_zh: 划独木舟，乘独木舟旅行
items.def_en: to travel or recreate on water in a light, narrow canoe
to travel or paddle across rivers or coastal waters in a kayak

groups.summary_en: This frame covers traveling over water specifically by waterborne craft, highlighting waterborne transport, leisure outings on small vessels, or conveying passengers across riverine passages.
groups.summary_zh: 泛指乘船、驾舟或摆渡穿过水体水域。

groups.name: Bond with Adhesives · 强力粘合与封胶 (Epoxy, Resinate, Sealant-bond)
groups.tip: 用强力树脂胶水硬化粘结

items.def_en: To close, fasten, or bind joints tightly using a cohesive or adhesive substance to exclude air or moisture

items.def_zh: 涂树脂粘合，用树脂浸渍处理
items.def_en: To coat, reinforce, or join structural components together using hard synthetic or natural resin
To join different materials into an inseparable unit through chemical dissolution or thermal adhesion
To bond layers of material firmly together under heat, pressure, or adhesive coating
1. To glue or bond surfaces together using strong synthetic epoxy resin.

groups.summary_en: This technical frame centers on fixing, bonding, or embedding solid substrates using specialized chemical resins, thermo-curing compounds, or high-tensile glues. Focus is placed on structural and craft application.
groups.summary_zh: 利用专用树脂胶、密封剂或强效化学粘合剂牢固拼接两块基质。

groups.name: Boning & Meat Dressing · 去骨与剔肉 (Debone, Bone, Dress)
groups.tip: 沿骨剔除鱼肉或剥离表面

items.def_en: Remove the outer skin or hide from an animal or piece of meat
Take out the bones from raw meat or fish
Remove the entrails and internal organs from a fish or slaughtered animal

items.def_zh: 剔去（鱼、肉的）骨头，把……切成无骨肉片
items.def_en: To remove the bones from fish or meat.
Remove bones from meat, poultry, or fish before cooking

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this culinary manipulation frame describe removing the bones, skeleton, or unwanted carcass sections from fish or meat to prepare prime cuts. Fillet specifically prepares long boneless slabs, debone is the generic term, and gut strips viscera.
groups.summary_zh: 烹饪前从肉类或鱼身上去除骨头、骨架或内脏处理。

groups.name: Boo & Heckle · 起哄与喝倒彩 (Boo, Heckle, Howl down)
groups.tip: 现场发出嘘声与嘲笑表达不满

items.raw_cluster: 喝倒彩与嘘声 Jeer & Boo
items.def_zh: 向……喝倒彩，发嘘声；发出嘘声
items.def_en: To shout 'boo' at a performer, speaker, or team to show disapproval or contempt.

items.def_zh: 大声起哄抗议（尤指观众）
items.def_en: To shout continuous jeers or hostile remarks at a team or speaker
To provoke or challenge someone with insulting, contemptuous remarks
To interrupt a speaker or performer with aggressive, challenging, or derisive comments

items.def_zh: 狂吼压制，怒吼倒彩使闭嘴
items.def_en: To prevent someone from speaking by shouting or yelling loudly in protest

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture vocal, disruptive public contempt aimed at silencing or deriding speakers, athletes, or stage performers. The sounds range from full-throated communal boos to organized, aggressive taunts.
groups.summary_zh: 大声喧哗起哄或质问打断，迫使台上者退场或难堪。

groups.name: Boomerang & Retribution · 自食恶果与因果反噬 (Boomerang, Blow Back, Reap)
groups.tip: 行为如回旋镖般反弹发生

items.def_zh: 反咬一口，产生报复性恶果
items.def_en: to react aggressively against someone or produce subsequent unexpected harms

items.def_zh: 产生逆风回火，引火烧身
items.def_en: to cause negative and unintended blowback for the original instigators

items.def_zh: 回头困扰，自食过去留下的恶果
items.def_en: to return later in time as an unavoidable problem or karmic consequence for past actions

items.def_zh: 自食其果，种瓜得瓜种豆得豆
items.def_en: to inevitably endure the negative repercussions created by one's own previous choices
(+ on) to produce an unexpected and harmful recoil or negative result on the person who initiated the action

groups.summary_en: Highlights the inexorable return trajectory of hostile or underhanded acts, causing them to return like a missile and inflict retributive harm upon the perpetrator.
groups.summary_zh: 强调恶意行为如飞镖般必然折返，引发因果报应并自食其果。

groups.name: Bore & Weary · 厌烦与厌倦 (Bore, Weary, Jade)
groups.tip: 因冗长单调而产生的心理倦怠

items.def_en: (+ of) To lose patience or enthusiasm because something has continued for too long

items.raw_cluster: 使厌烦与厌倦 Bore & Tire
items.def_zh: 使厌烦，使无聊；钻（孔），凿（洞）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel weary, tired, or uninterested by being dull or repetitive. 2. To make a deep, round hole in a hard substance using a drill or tool.
To deaden someone's engagement or enthusiasm by being tedious and monotonous
To cause someone to lose energy, interest, or patience through relentless repetition or exertion
(+ on) To become uninteresting or boring to someone as a result of excess or familiarity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to causing mental fatigue, apathy, or restive impatience through lack of stimulation, monotony, or overexposure. Variations range from transient dullness to profound existential weariness.
groups.summary_zh: 因单调无聊、过度重复或缺乏刺激而产生精神倦怠与厌烦。

groups.name: Boundary Delimitation & Demarcation · 划界与勘界 (Demarcate, Delimit, Bound)
groups.tip: 划定界限以明确管辖范围

items.def_en: To form the outer edge or perimeter of a tract of land; to serve as its geographic boundary

items.def_zh: 打桩标出（界线）；声明所有权
items.def_en: To mark the physical boundaries of a piece of land with stakes, establishing an explicit claim
To describe, trace, or mark the precise borders, lines, or contours of an area or idea
To determine or mark the exact external limits, parameters, or scope of something

items.def_zh: 划定……的界线，划定界限；区分，界定
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To mark or establish the exact boundaries or limits between two areas or concepts.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on setting, measuring, or physically and conceptually marking exact perimeters, borders, or clear distinguishing thresholds between adjacent territories, jurisdictions, or abstract concepts.
groups.summary_zh: 在法律、领土或概念上精确勘定、界定外围边界与区分界限。

groups.name: Bow & Throw Oneself Down · 跪拜与仆伏 (Kneel, Genuflect, Kowtow, Bow Down)
groups.tip: 五体投地跪拜或伏倒致敬

items.def_en: (+ down) to go down on one or both knees in rest, prayer, or deference
to bend one knee to the ground briefly as a gesture of religious worship or respect
(+ to/before) to bend the head or entire upper body very low in worship, awe, or complete submission
(+ before) to drop quickly to one's knees or flat on the floor before a deity or monarch

items.def_zh: 俯伏，跪拜（prostrate oneself）；使竭力，使精疲力竭
items.def_en: 1. (prostrate oneself) to lie flat on the ground face downwards, especially in submission or worship. 2. to make someone completely weak, helpless, or exhausted.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to bodily postures of deep reverence, religious worship, or total physical subjugation by lowering or casting oneself flat.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过跪伏、磕头、下跪等肢体动作表达极度崇敬或顺服。

groups.name: Boycott & Protest · 抵制与抗议 (Boycott, Picket, Walk out)
groups.tip: 群体集体拒绝合作示威抗议

items.def_en: To take part in a public march or gathering to protest against or support something.
To stop working or leave a meeting suddenly as an act of protest.

items.def_zh: 抵制，拒绝购买（或合作、参与）
items.def_en: 1. To refuse to buy, use, or take part in something as a way of protesting or forcing a change.
To deliberately avoid or keep away from someone, a practice, or an organization.
To stand outside a workplace or venue to protest and discourage people from entering.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate collective or organized acts of dissent by deliberately refusing participation, patronage, or compliance to demand change or express condemnation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过拒绝消费、参与或工作来发起集体抗议与施压。

groups.name: Brake & Halt · 踩刹车与紧急制动 (Brake, Hit the Brakes, Pull Up)
groups.tip: 速度放缓甚至停下

items.def_en: To bring a vehicle to a stop, or to come to a stop
To stop or slow down a horse by pulling on the reins, or strictly limit someone's freedom or speed
To slow down or stop a vehicle by applying the brakes.
To slide sideways or forward without tires gripping the road while trying to stop
To apply brakes suddenly and with great force in an emergency
