groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the mechanical or physical action of applying brakes or counterforce to abruptly arrest or check the motion of a vehicle, bicycle, or moving body.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过施加制动装置或牵引力使车辆及行进物体减速驻停。

groups.name: Branch & Diverge · 分叉与分支 (Fork, Ramify, Radiate)
groups.tip: 如树枝或河流向多方向岔开

items.def_en: To separate from a main route, road, or stem and proceed in a different direction
To start to do an activity or kind of work that you have not done before

items.def_zh: 分叉，分支；长出枝条；（branch out）涉足新领域
items.def_en: 1. To divide into two or more parts, paths, or branches; (of a tree) to grow branches. 2. (branch out) To start a new activity or diversify into new areas.
To divide into two separate paths, rivers, or directions
To spread out or develop into a complex, tree-like network of branches or consequences

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or conceptual structures dividing from a central stem into multiple stems, paths, or offshoots. They highlight natural growth, architectural splitting, or expanding outward into secondary directions.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重由主干向外自然生长、分岔或展开出支线与侧翼。

groups.name: Brandish & Flourish · 挥舞与夸示 (Brandish, Flourish, Wave around)
groups.tip: 高举器械挥动示威

items.def_en: To move an object or weapon back and forth in the air conspicuously or recklessly

items.def_zh: 炫耀地挥舞；挥动（引人注意）
items.def_en: To wave something about in an exaggerated, bold, theatrical manner to attract admiration or notice
To hold and effectively handle a weapon or tool ready for imminent, deliberate use
To display or wave something ostentatiously in order to provoke envy or assert dominance
1. To wave a weapon, tool, or object around in an excited, threatening, or triumphant way.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey waving or flourishing a weapon, flag, badge, or document conspicuously in the air, usually to intimidate, triumph, or demand immediate public attention. 'Brandish' inherently implies a menacing weapon, whereas 'flourish' highlights dramatic, showy gestures.
groups.summary_zh: 指在空中耀武扬威或引人注目地挥舞武器、旗帜或物件。

groups.name: Breach & Default · 违约与违背 (Breach, Default, Infringe)
groups.tip: 违反契约未履行义务

items.def_en: (+ on) To fail to fulfill an obligation, especially to pay back a loan or debt on time.
To break a law, agreement, promise, or legal duty
(+ on/upon) To act so as to limit or break a legal right, law, or rule

items.def_zh: 拒付；不履行（票据或承诺）
items.def_en: To refuse or fail to accept or pay a financial obligation like a check or draft
To do something contrary to a law, official rule, or agreement

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on formally breaking legal agreements, financial covenants, or regulations. It ranges from contractual non-performance to failing to meet mandatory debt repayments.
groups.summary_zh: 指在法律、合同或金融上未履行义务或违反条款。

groups.name: Brew & Concoct · 酿造与调制 (Steep, Concoct, Distill)
groups.tip: 调配各种成分酿造成饮品

items.def_zh: 酿造（啤酒等）；冲泡（茶、咖啡）；酝酿（事件、风暴）
items.def_en: 1. To make beer or other alcoholic drinks. 2. To make tea or coffee by soaking leaves or beans in hot water. 3. (of trouble, a storm, etc.) To start to form and threaten to happen soon.
To soak dried leaves or herbs in hot water to extract their flavor or color
To undergo or cause a chemical change whereby sugar converts into alcohol
To make something unusual by combining different ingredients or liquids
To purify or produce an alcoholic spirit by heating a liquid until vaporized and condensed

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the artisanal or domestic process of preparing drinks, potions, or mixtures through fermentation, infusion, boiling, or blending.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过发酵、浸泡、蒸馏或混合等工艺制作饮品或混合物。

groups.name: Brief & Apprise · 概要通报与交代 (Brief, Apprise, Debrief)
groups.tip: 向上级或团队简要通报情况

items.def_zh: 向……简要通报，向……介绍情况
items.def_en: To give someone concise information or instructions about a situation, project, or task.
(+ on) To give someone essential details or background information that they missed
(informal; + on/to) To give someone information or advice about something not widely known

items.def_zh: 听取汇报，询问（任务执行情况）
items.def_en: To question someone thoroughly about a completed mission, trip, or task in order to obtain intelligence or feedback
(formal; + of) To inform or tell someone about recent events or a development

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify delivering targeted, essential information, background status, or instructions to prepare someone for an assignment or keep them updated.
groups.summary_zh: 指针对特定任务或局势提供要点汇报、背景交代或最新指示。

groups.name: Broach & Introduce · 试探引入与提及 (Bring up, Touch on, Moot)
groups.tip: 初次提出话题或顺带提及

items.def_zh: 简单涉及；轻描淡写提及
items.def_en: To mention a subject briefly or in passing without elaborating
To mention or introduce a subject into a conversation
To suggest an idea, plan, or topic for debate or consideration

items.def_zh: 提出，引入（敏感或困难的话题）；开启，给（桶等）开孔引流
items.def_en: 1. To bring up a sensitive or difficult topic for initial discussion. 2. To pierce a container or cask to draw liquid from it.
To dare to say or introduce something at the risk of criticism or doubt

groups.summary_en: Emphasizes initiating discussion on a delicate, awkward, or novel topic, often testing the waters before deeper debate.
groups.summary_zh: 首次触及或试探性地提出敏感、重要的话题。

groups.name: Broadcast & Air · 节目播送与播出 (Air, Stream, Webcast)
groups.tip: 通过媒介向大众传播

items.def_en: Broadcast a television or radio show, or be scheduled and transmitted on a network
Broadcast or receive continuous audio or video directly over the internet in real time
Send out sound, images, or programs on radio, television, or digital channels to the public
To make a digital audio recording and make it available on the internet for people to download or stream.
Transmit a live or pre-recorded performance, conference, or event via the World Wide Web

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the mass dissemination of recorded or live digital media content (audio, video, podcasts) to a widespread public audience across networks, airwaves, or online hosting platforms.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过电台、电视或互联网平台向大众播发流媒体或节目录像。

groups.name: Broadcast & Disseminate · 宣传与广泛传播 (Publicize, Broadcast, Trumpet)
groups.tip: 向外界公开宣布并广泛宣扬

items.def_en: To present or praise something publicly to encourage sales or interest
To encourage the public acceptance, appreciation, or purchase of something
To disseminate information widely by radio, television, or word of mouth

items.def_zh: 宣传，大肆宣扬；公布，向公众宣传
items.def_en: To make information about something widely known to the public through the media; to advertise.
To proclaim loudly and boastfully in public

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on making information broadly known to the public through commercial, promotional, or media channels, often highlighting persuasion or fanfare.
groups.summary_zh: 强调借助媒介工具广泛散布、宣扬或推销信息以引起公众关注。

groups.name: Broadcast & Transmit · 电波传信与呼叫 (Transmit, Beam, Dispatch)
groups.tip: 通过无线电向大众传播信息

items.def_zh: 接通（无线电或电话线路）
items.def_en: Connect someone to a radio frequency, telephone line, or communication link

items.def_zh: 用无线电发送（信息），用无线电通讯；用无线电向……发送信息
items.def_en: To send a message to someone or communicate with someone by radio.
Send a telegraphic message, instructions, or money electronically across distances
Send a radio or television signal, or laser/light ray, directly in a specific direction or to a satellite
Send out an electronic, electrical, or radio signal, broadcast, or message over a communications system

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail the technical transmission or sending of audio signals, shortwave messages, and electronic communiqués across long distances, typically via dedicated radio equipment, telegraphy, or tactical comms channels.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用无线电波、通信链路或仪器远距离向特定对象或公共网络发报。

groups.name: Browbeat & Bully into Submission · 威逼施压与蛮横慑服 (Buffalo, Browbeat, Bulldoze)
groups.tip: 以强权手段使对方屈服顺从

items.def_en: Overcome or disconcert an opponent through a bolder, more resolute, and unflinching gaze
(informal, chiefly North American) To intimidate, overpower, or bewilder someone into submission or confusion.
(+ into) Force or badger someone aggressively into an unwanted course of action

items.def_zh: 强行压服，横冲直撞强推
items.def_en: Coerce or steamroller someone aggressively into doing something without regard for objections
Bully or intimidate someone into obedience or silence with harsh, domineering words

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on overpowering, browbeating, or bamboozling someone into compliance through aggressive intimidation or bluffing.
groups.summary_zh: 依仗蛮横声势或虚张声势，强行吓服、压制或摆布他人。

groups.name: Bruise & Contuse · 挫伤与碰伤 (Bruise, Contuse, Batter)
groups.tip: 受外力击打产生青肿损伤

items.def_zh: （使）出现青肿，碰伤；伤害（感情、自尊）
items.def_en: 1. To develop a bruise, or cause a dark mark to appear on the skin or fruit by hitting it. 2. To hurt someone's feelings, confidence, or pride.
To injure an area of the body without breaking the skin, causing a medical contusion
To damage the surface of skin by roughly rubbing against a hard, coarse surface
To injure or scratch someone through physical collision or falls
To strike someone or something repeatedly with hard blows, causing extensive bruising

groups.summary_en: Centers on blunt-force impact that discolors, compresses, or damages tissue beneath the surface without severely breaking the skin. Also extends metaphorically to delicate egos, reputations, or fruit.
groups.summary_zh: 指钝力撞击皮下软组织造成的青肿、挫伤，亦引申指自尊或外壳受损。

groups.name: Budge with Ill Will · 吝惜付出与心存怨嫉 (Grudge, Begrudge, Envying)
groups.tip: 心怀怨怼暗暗积压不平之气

items.def_en: Be overly frugal or grudging with spending, resources, or allowances
Feel discontent or covetous resentment towards someone's advantages, success, or possessions
(+ on) Provide only an inadequate, grudgingly small amount of something

items.def_zh: 心怀怨恨；勉强给予，吝惜；嫉妒
items.def_en: To feel resentful or bitter about giving, allowing, or seeing someone enjoy something.
Reluctantly grant or resent paying something; envy another's possession of a perk

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame evoke the bitter feeling of parting with something unwillingly, or seeing another enjoy a boon with silent jealousy and resentment.
groups.summary_zh: 极不情愿地让渡利益，或对他人的所得与待遇心怀酸楚与妒恨。

groups.name: Buffet & Batter · 连番冲击与拍打 (Buffet, Batter, Pound)
groups.tip: 风浪或重拳连续反复击打

items.def_en: To hit heavily and repeatedly with great force
To strike hard, repeatedly, and violently, causing structural damage or injury
To hit violently with sudden, whip-like force, as waves or heavy rain against a surface

items.def_zh: 连番冲击，连续击打；搏斗
items.def_en: (often passive) To strike or hit repeatedly and forcefully, as by wind, waves, or misfortune.
To strike repeatedly with fists or a succession of heavy physical blows

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express repeated, violent striking or pummeling by external physical elements (such as winds, surf, or artillery) or metaphorically by adverse fortunes.
groups.summary_zh: 指受到风浪、炮火或逆境的连番猛烈冲击与拍打。

groups.name: Bulldoze & Force Through · 蛮横推挤与强攻 (Bull, Ram, Bulldoze)
groups.tip: 蛮力横冲直撞向前顶推

items.def_en: To move with irresistible momentum through an obstacle, crowd, or massive backlog of work
To push or force one's way aggressively or clumsily through an obstacle or crowd.

items.def_zh: 压倒；以势压人强行通过
items.def_en: To overwhelm competitors or force through an initiative by sheer weight of power or influence
To drive or crash heavily into something, or force an object or idea through with brutal impact
To force something through ruthlessly, flattening any resistance or obstacles in the way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey heavy-handed, blunt force pushing through physical barriers or driving proposals through opposition without regard for subtlety.
groups.summary_zh: 施加粗暴阻力强行推翻障碍，或强推提案通过。

groups.name: Bunch & Cluster · 聚集与聚拢 (Cluster, Clump, Gather)
groups.tip: 分散的人或物收拢成群扎堆

items.def_en: To draw together into one place, or to pull cloth into folds

items.def_zh: 聚集，扎堆；使成一束，使聚成一团；隆起，打褶
items.def_en: 1. To gather or form tightly into a group or cluster. 2. To form or pull fabric into tight folds.
To form into a small, tight group around a point, or to gather things closely
To crowd closely together, often for warmth, safety, or confidential discussion
To form or gather into a thick, compact, and irregular mass or cluster

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote people, things, or flexible materials drawing close together into dense groups, folds, or tight physical clusters.
groups.summary_zh: 指人、物或织物紧紧聚拢成团、成簇或形成皱褶。

groups.name: Bundle & Aggregate · 分批与组包 (Batch, Bundle, Cluster)
groups.tip: 按批次归纳整理成组

items.def_en: To bring people or things together so that they form an orderly cluster or collective unit
To treat or process different things or people as if they were all alike in a single undifferentiated group
To assemble or cause to assemble closely together into a tight pack or statistical cluster
To group multiple individual items, products, or transactions together to be sold or handled as a unit

items.def_zh: 分批，成批处理；将……归类编组
items.def_en: 1. (computing / manufacturing) To group items or data together into batches to be processed simultaneously.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this computational and operational frame refer to gathering discrete individual items, tasks, or transactions together into cohesive groups to be handled or processed in a single run.
groups.summary_zh: 指将零散任务、数据或物品打包组合，以便集中批量处理。

groups.name: Bundle & Bundle Together · 束绑与捆扎成捆 (Bundle, Sheaf, Truss)
groups.tip: 将零散之物扎成一捆

items.def_en: To collect and bind cut grain stalks or similar materials into a sheaf
To gather loose objects together and tie or wrap them into a neat package or bundle
To tie, wrap, or gather several things loosely or tightly into a bundle
To compress and bind large amounts of material such as hay, cotton, or paper tightly into a bale

items.def_zh: 把……捆成柴捆；用抽纱刺绣法缝合
items.def_en: 1. To bind twigs or sticks together into a bundle. 2. (textiles) To join fabric edges with decorative crisscross stitches.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to collecting loose sticks, stalks, twigs, or fabrics together and tying them into a compact, manageable bundle or decorative arrangement. They are tightly bound to agricultural, forestry, or crafting contexts.
groups.summary_zh: 把树枝、麦秆或零散物品收集并捆成结实的束或包。

groups.name: Burl & Pick Clean · 摘疵与剔杂 (Burl, De-knot, Pluck)
groups.tip: 挑拣剔除布料或表面的杂质

items.def_en: To remove small flaws, unwanted pieces, or debris from something using fingers or fine tools.
To remove unwanted bits, loose yarns, or knots by making swift, short cuts with shears.
To smooth the rough edges or remove raised irregularities left on metal or material after working.
To remove small knots, slubs, or loose impurities from woven cloth during textile finishing.
To pull off or detach small threads, feathers, or unwanted items with a quick, snapping motion.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers precise, delicate manual operations aimed at picking out small knots, slubs, loose threads, burrs, or foreign particles from textiles, raw fleece, or crafted surfaces.
groups.summary_zh: 指手工或工具精细摘除毛料、织物或原料上的疙瘩、毛刺及细小杂质。

groups.name: Burn & Scorch · 灼伤与晒伤 (Sunburn, Scorch, Scald)
groups.tip: 强日光照射导致皮肤发红刺痛

items.def_en: To swell and develop watery pockets beneath the outer layer of skin because of intense heat or sunburn
To burn the surface of skin, fabric, or foliage slightly without consuming it completely
1. To damage the skin or become damaged, red, and painful from too much exposure to the sun.

items.def_zh: 烫伤（由沸水或蒸汽引起）
items.def_en: To burn someone's flesh painful with boiling liquid, steam, or extremely hot vapor

items.def_zh: 轻微烧焦；烤焦（毛发边缘）
items.def_en: To burn slightly, particularly along hair, eyebrows, or edges, causing localized surface damage

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses tissue damage or surface searing caused by intense heat, radiation from the sun, caustic chemicals, or boiling liquids.
groups.summary_zh: 指人体肌肤或组织因日晒、高温或液体而受损灼痛。

groups.name: Burn to Destruction · 焚毁与烧尽 (Burn Down, Burn Out, Scorch)
groups.tip: 烈火吞噬燃烧化为灰烬

items.def_en: Stop burning because there is no more fuel left, or destroy the interior of something by fire.

items.def_zh: 燃烧；烧毁；灼伤（burn的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly British English) Simple past and past participle of burn: to be on fire, damage by heat, or consume by flame.
Burn the surface of something with heat or fire, causing discoloration or minor damage.
Destroy a building or structure completely by fire, or be destroyed in this manner.
Destroy the interior of a building or room completely by fire.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on fires that cause structural damage, raze buildings to the ground, or deplete fuel until fire extinguishes itself naturally. It emphasizes physical destruction and ruin caused by flame.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重火势对建筑或物体的物理毁坏，直至完全夷平或燃料耗尽。

groups.name: Burrow & Tunnel · 打洞与钻穴 (Tunnel, Mine, Hole up)
groups.tip: 向地底挖洞钻探藏身

items.def_en: To move incrementally and wriggle through narrow spaces or subterranean passages like an earthworm
To hide or take shelter inside a concealed hole, burrow, or isolated secure location
To dig subterranean pits and galleries beneath the surface to obtain minerals or undermine defenses
To dig or bore an underground passage through earth, rock, or other dense barriers
1. To dig a hole or tunnel in the ground, especially for shelter. 2. To press under or snuggle closely into something

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the manner in which animals or humans dig passageways or holes through solid earth, snow, or obstacles to shelter or navigate underground. 'Burrow' highlights snug, protective animal-style excavation, while 'tunnel' denotes boring an elongated subterranean pathway.
groups.summary_zh: 指动物或人通过泥土或障碍物打洞穿行、构筑掩体或钻营潜入。

groups.name: Burst Into Fiery Radiance · 烈焰闪烁与燃腾 (Flame, Flare, Blaze)
groups.tip: 如烈火般闪耀炽热光彩

items.def_en: Emit an intense steady light and heat without producing active tall flames.

items.def_zh: 突然窜起火苗；突然爆发
items.def_en: Burst suddenly into active flame, or suddenly recur or escalate.

items.def_zh: 闪耀，泛起火红色；燃烧，泛红
items.def_en: 1. To shine brightly like fire, gleam intensely, or turn bright red. 2. To burn with a flame.
Burn with a sudden, unsteady flame or burst into sudden intense light.
Burn with a bright, powerful, and intense flame or shine brilliantly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the sudden or intense visual emission of fire and brilliant light. They highlight vivid visual perception, sudden eruptions of bright light, or burning passionately.
groups.summary_zh: 描述火焰骤然燃腾、爆发出耀眼强光或火星四射的视觉特征。

groups.name: Bury & Conceal · 埋藏与隐匿 (Bury, Cache, Stash)
groups.tip: 将物体埋入地下掩盖起来

items.def_zh: 埋藏，掩盖，隐藏；埋葬，安葬
items.def_en: 1. To put something underground and cover it with earth, or conceal it from sight. 2. To place a dead body in a grave or tomb.
To put something in a private, safe, or hidden spot where it is unlikely to be seen
To store or hide away weapons, food, or valuables in a secret or underground place
To store something safely and secretly in a hidden location
To conceal an object skillfully in a secure hiding place

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to concealing objects underground or beneath layers of materials to keep them hidden from discovery, sight, or hostile interference. While 'cache' suggests systematic strategic storage, 'stash' implies rapid or secretive hiding.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物品置于地下或深层遮盖物下藏匿，使之脱离视线。

groups.name: Bury & Entomb · 掩埋与复葬 (Rebury, Resepulcher, Entomb)
groups.tip: 掘地埋入土中或重新安葬

items.def_en: To cover completely beneath a mass of loose material, earth, or fluid
To bury a deceased person's remains again in a new or consecrated grave
To bury someone or something again in the ground or in a tomb; (past tense and past participle of rebury).
To place remains back into a tomb or sealed subterranean resting place
To enclose or entomb someone or something within or as if within walls

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on depositing or returning corpses, artifacts, or substances into a grave or subterranean cavity, often following exhumation, structural collapse, or specialized physical transfer. It emphasizes the physical act of sealing or covering within earth or stone.
groups.summary_zh: 指将遗骸或重物重新埋葬、永久封存或落入地下掩盖。

groups.name: Bury & Inter · 埋葬与安葬 (Inter, Entomb, Inhume)
groups.tip: 丧葬仪式中入土为安

items.def_en: To place a deceased body into the earth; bury formally
To lay or inter a corpse in a sepulcher or stone tomb
To bury someone who has died, used especially as a polite or ceremonial euphemism
(formal) To place a dead body into a grave or tomb; bury.
To place a dead body in a tomb, sepulcher, or crypt, especially permanently

groups.summary_en: This formal and ritualistic frame relates to placing human remains into the ground, a tomb, or a sepulcher as part of funeral rites. Verbs like 'inter' and 'inhume' convey solemn, ceremonious mortuary disposal rather than mere physical concealment.
groups.summary_zh: 指正式且庄重地将逝者遗体或骨灰安葬于坟墓或墓穴中。

groups.name: Bury & Lay to Rest · 安葬与入土 (Inter, Bury, Inhume)
groups.tip: 将逝者遗体入土埋葬入墓

items.def_en: Deposit a dead body in the earth, a grave, or underneath ground cover
Bury someone formally and respectfully with customary funeral ceremonies
Bury a body in the earth, distinguished from cremation or sea dispersal
Place a dead corpse into a grave or tomb, typically with funeral rites

items.def_zh: 将……安葬于墓穴；埋葬，掩埋
items.def_en: To place a dead body in a tomb; to bury or trap someone or something completely under earth or debris.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the ritual or physical act of laying a deceased body or remains into the earth, a crypt, or a formal burial vault. Nuances differentiate ordinary ground burial, formal ritual interment, and total sepulchral enclosure.
groups.summary_zh: 指将逝者遗体入土、下葬于墓穴或置于陵墓的丧葬仪式与埋葬行为。

groups.name: Bypass & Skirt · 绕行与避开 (Skirt, Bypass, Circumvent)
groups.tip: 沿边缘绕过中心区

items.def_en: To travel along an indirect route around a physical obstruction or detour

items.def_zh: 绕过……的边缘，沿……边缘走；回避，绕开（难题）
items.def_en: 1. To go around the outer edge of something rather than through it. 2. To avoid talking about or dealing with a difficult subject directly.
To go around a place, obstacle, or established procedure instead of going through or following it
To avoid answering a difficult question or dealing directly with an unpleasant situation
To cleverly avoid a difficulty, law, or restriction by finding an indirect path around it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe travelling along the periphery of a physical obstacle, geographic region, or problem rather than crossing straight through it. By figurative extension, they denote evading sensitive issues, rules, or direct confrontations.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿外沿边缘绕行，或引申为规避敏感问题、规则及正面交锋。

groups.name: Calculate & Compute · 算计与推算 (Compute, Tally, Reckon)
groups.tip: 依公式数字精密计算

items.def_en: To calculate an amount or solve a numerical problem through effort
To calculate an answer or amount by using mathematics or specialized machinery
To calculate an amount, number, or cost roughly by reasoning or counting
To calculate, add up, or keep a continuous record of a total score or quantity

items.def_zh: 计算，做算术；把……译成密码
items.def_en: 1. (old-fashioned) To calculate or do arithmetic sums. 2. To encode a message into secret cipher writing.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses carrying out mathematical computations, determining numeric quantities by rules of arithmetic, or working out formal numerical solutions.
groups.summary_zh: 运用数学运算规则推导求出总和、数量或数值结果。

groups.name: Calculate & Deduce Mentally · 琢磨与推断 (Figure, Reckon, Deduce)
groups.tip: 心中揣摩并得出推断

items.def_zh: 料想，认为，认定；计算；出现，起重要作用
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To think, conclude, or decide that something is the case. 2. To calculate or work out an amount. 3. To be featured or play an important part in something.
Infer or deduce a conclusion based on clues, conversations, or observation
Find an answer, explanation, or result through deliberate mental calculation and reasoning
Form a considered opinion or conclude from judgment that something is likely true
Reach a necessary logical conclusion by systematically examining known principles or evidence

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on working something out cognitively—either informal estimation of likelihood or structured mental deduction from available facts.
groups.summary_zh: 根据既有线索或事实在脑中推想、揣摩或得出结论。

groups.name: Calculate & Reckon · 计算与推算 (Calculate, Compute, Reckon)
groups.tip: 通用计算推演运作

items.def_en: To calculate an amount, or to conclude something logically after consideration
1. To find a number or amount using mathematics. 2. To estimate or judge a future situation or probability.
To calculate the total cost, quantity, or solution to a problem
To calculate an amount, value, or answer, often using an automated or systematic process
To calculate roughly, estimate an amount, or form a considered judgment

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses working out numerical quantities, evaluating likelihoods, or mentally estimating outcomes through mathematical procedures or careful reasoning.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过数学演算、逻辑推导或估算得出具体数值与结果。

groups.name: Call & Phone · 电话与呼叫 (Phone, Ring, Dial)
groups.tip: 通过电话等媒介即时呼叫沟通

items.def_en: To communicate with someone by calling them on a telephone
(chiefly British) To call someone on the telephone
To call or speak to someone using a telephone.
To make a phone call to someone
To enter a phone number on a keypad to make a telephone call

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe reaching out or conversing specifically via telephone or voice call hardware, encompassing dialing, ringing, and holding spoken calls.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过电话或语音通讯工具拨号、呼叫并进行实时语音交谈。

groups.name: Camp & Bivouac · 扎营与驻扎 (Pitch camp, Bivouac, Settle)
groups.tip: 在某处扎营驻扎长期定居

items.def_zh: 使驻扎；为…提供临时住宿
items.def_en: Provide soldiers or workers with temporary lodging or living accommodations
Sleep outside in a tent or temporary shelter, especially for recreation
Set up tents and prepare temporary accommodation outdoors
(formal) To set up camp or settle in tents, or cause someone to do so.

items.def_zh: 露宿；野营（尤指军人无帐篷宿营）
items.def_en: Stay in a temporary camp without tents or proper cover, especially in military contexts

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe setting up temporary living quarters outdoors or in the field, ranging from pitching tents for recreation to stationing military troops overnight.
groups.summary_zh: 指在野外或临时地点搭帐篷、安营扎寨或露宿驻扎。

groups.name: Capitulate & Cave In · 彻底妥协与屈服 (Capitulate, Cave In, Succumb)
groups.tip: 认输受降举白旗

items.def_en: (+ to) To finally stop opposing something and agree to demands after resistance
(+ to) To accept someone else's authority or pressure and do what they dictate
(+ under) To collapse mentally or surrender to extreme pressure or opposition
(+ to) To stop opposing someone or something stronger and accept defeat
1. (+ to) (formal) To stop resisting an enemy or strong pressure and surrender, especially on agreed conditions.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on ceasing all resistance after sustained pressure or confrontation and accepting defeat or dictated terms.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在顽强抵抗或长期施压后最终妥协认输、不再反抗。

groups.name: Card & Tease Fibers · 梳理纤维与除杂 (Card, Comb, Scutch)
groups.tip: 用梳齿梳理纤维并剔除杂物

items.def_en: Shake or comb fibers or soft materials to make them light, airy, and loose

items.def_zh: 梳理（羊毛、棉花等纤维）；记于卡片上
items.def_en: To comb and clean raw wool, cotton, or other fibers using a wire-toothed brush before spinning.
Prepare textile fibers for spinning by aligning long fibers and eliminating short ones and impurities
Separate raw cotton fibers from seeds using a mechanical cotton gin
Separate the woody husk from flax, hemp, or cotton by beating with a wooden blade

groups.summary_en: Industrial and craft verbs denoting combing raw fleece, wool, cotton, or bast fibers with spiked cards to remove debris, separate strands, and ready them for spinning.
groups.summary_zh: 指在纺纱前使用毛刷或梳理机清洁生纤维并理顺杂质。

groups.name: Carry & Lug · 吃力搬运 (Cart, Haul, Tote, Schlepp)
groups.tip: 费力拖运沉重行李物品

items.def_en: To carry or haul something substantial around by hand or over one's shoulder
To convey or haul heavy, clumsy, or unwanted items from one place to another
To pull or transport something heavy or cumbersome slowly and with continuous effort

items.def_zh: 费劲拉扯，苦哈哈地搬运
items.def_en: To haul or drag oneself or a heavy load along awkwardly and reluctantly
To carry or drag something heavy with a lot of effort.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize the intense physical strain, awkwardness, and sustained effort involved in moving bulky, heavy objects over distance without mechanical aid.
groups.summary_zh: 着重搬运笨重、沉重或不规则物品时所耗费的体力与费力拖带感。

groups.name: Categorize & Pigeonhole · 分门别类 (Assort, Categorize, Pigeonhole)
groups.tip: 按属性归类分门别类

items.def_en: To put documents or records into a filing system under specific headings
To place people or things into particular classes or groups according to shared characteristics

items.def_zh: 把……分类，把……分门别类；相称，协调
items.def_en: 1. To classify, sort, or arrange things into categories. 2. (assort with) (archaic) To match or harmonize with.
To classify someone or something into a rigid, often oversimplified category
To divide into discrete, isolated sections, categories, or compartments

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to sorting, grouping, or labeling items according to characteristics, criteria, or predetermined categories, sometimes rigidly or schematically.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据性质、类别或固定框架对物品或概念进行归类与分档。

groups.name: Categorize & Pigeonhole · 归类与标签化 (Label, Stereotype, Brand)
groups.tip: 给物品或概念贴上标签符号

items.def_en: (+ as) To identify or describe someone publicly and permanently as bad, untrustworthy, or criminal

items.def_zh: 贴标签于，打上标记；归类，把……称为
items.def_en: 1. To attach a label to something. 2. (+ as) To describe or assign a category to someone or something, often unfairly.
To place people or things into specific classes or divisions according to shared attributes

items.def_zh: 把……不合理地归类；妄加分类
items.def_en: To classify someone or something rigidly into an oversimplified category or mental compartment
To repeatedly assign an actor or person only to one specific, predictable role or character type

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on classifying, characterizing, or assigning descriptive identities to people, behaviors, or things—frequently with an oversimplified, restrictive, or stigmatizing nuance.
groups.summary_zh: 将人或事物贴标签归类、定性描述，常带有片面化或刻板印象意味。

groups.name: Cause & Render · 致使与转化 (Make, Leave, Turn)
groups.tip: 引发变化使其陷入某种状态

items.def_en: to cause someone or something to be in a specified condition, state, or mood
(+ into) to cause someone or something to change into a completely different state, nature, or appearance

items.def_zh: 使处于（某种残留状态或结果）
items.def_en: to cause someone or something to remain in a particular state or condition as a result of an action

items.def_zh: 逼得，促使（陷入极端状态）
items.def_en: to force or propel someone into an extreme mental, emotional, or physical state

items.def_zh: 致使，使处于某种状态；给予，提供；翻译；表现
items.def_en: 1. to cause someone or something to be in a particular state or condition 2. to give, provide, or submit assistance, a service, or a verdict 3. to translate, depict, or perform something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing a person, object, or situation to pass into a particular state, condition, or status. While 'render' often implies an involuntary or debilitating result, others emphasize physical transformation, intentional causation, or resulting residual states.
groups.summary_zh: 表示使人或事物转入某种特定状态或境地。

groups.name: Cavalry & Blade Cleaving · 劈砍与剑击 (Saber, Cleave, Hack)
groups.tip: 挥动马刀或利刃砍削劈杀

items.def_zh: 用马刀劈砍，用军刀击杀
items.def_en: to strike, cut, or kill someone with a saber
To cut or chop roughly, violently, and repeatedly with a heavy blade
To strike or sever with an ax, sword, or other heavy cutting weapon
To kill or seriously incapacitate someone with a blow or weapon in combat
To split or sever something forcefully with a sharp, heavy bladed weapon

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe delivering sweeping, brutal strokes with heavy bladed instruments (swords, sabers, axes) to pierce armor, wound, or execute combatants.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用军刀、阔剑或重斧等兵刃进行凶猛砍劈与肉搏杀伤。

groups.name: Cavort & Frisk · 嬉戏欢蹦 (Frisk, Caper, Disport)
groups.tip: 欢快雀跃或轻快打闹玩乐

items.def_en: (literary) To enjoy oneself unrestrainedly, especially by sporting or leaping about
To skip, jump, or dance about in an energetic, playful, and carefree way
(of an animal or child) To skip or leap playfully and briskly
To make playful leaps or perform mischievous, amusing antics

items.def_zh: 欢跃，雀跃玩耍，打闹嬉戏
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To jump, dance, and play around in a lively, noisy, and uninhibited way.

groups.summary_en: Verbs here emphasize dynamic, sometimes flamboyant or illicit kinetic abandon—bounding, whirling, or cutting capers without restraint. The movement is visibly loud, uninhibited, and theatrical.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重动作幅度大、张扬放肆或略带喧闹的跳跃、翩跹与欢快移动。

groups.name: Celebrate & Commemorate · 庆祝与纪念 (Commemorate, Mark, Honor)
groups.tip: 以欢庆或庄严仪式缅怀重要节点

items.def_en: Celebrate or officially recognize an important anniversary, milestone, or turning point
1. To do something enjoyable to mark an important day or event. 2. To praise or honor someone or something publicly.
Show deep respect, admiration, or public appreciation for someone's accomplishments
Remember and pay respect to an important person or historical event by a special ceremony or tribute

items.def_zh: 大加赞美，盛情款待设宴庆祝
items.def_en: Praise, welcome, or celebrate someone lavishly and publicly with special entertainment or banquets

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to acknowledging significant dates, triumphs, or notable persons through formal ceremonies, festive gatherings, solemn remembrances, or public tributes.
groups.summary_zh: 指以欢庆聚会、仪式或庄重形式纪念盛事、重大功绩及先贤。

groups.name: Center & Focus · 聚焦与汇拢 (Focus, Converge, Cluster)
groups.tip: 将中心或焦点移向正中央

items.def_en: (+ around/round) to gather or arrange together in a close group around a central spot

items.def_zh: 居中，将……置于中央；（使）集中于，聚焦于
items.def_en: 1. to place or position something at or in the center. 2. (center on/around) to have something as the main subject or focus, or direct attention toward it.
(+ on) to direct attention, energy, or light directly onto a central point or objective
(+ on) to move from different directions towards an identical central meeting point
(+ on) to direct full attention or aim with high precision toward a particular target or center

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate placing an entity precisely at a focal midpoint, or concentrating attention, forces, and resources toward a single pivot.
groups.summary_zh: 指使物体居中，或将注意力、力量聚集汇合于一点。

groups.name: Centralize & Consolidate · 集权与统合 (Consolidate, Concentrate, Streamline)
groups.tip: 权力收拢中央并巩固统治

items.def_en: to bring together power, control, or resources into one focal place or authority
to combine multiple things into a single more effective whole, or solidify power
to bring separate parts, regions, or systems together into a single cohesive unit

items.def_zh: 实行中央集权；集中，把……集中管理
items.def_en: to bring the control, administration, or power of an organization or country under one single central authority
to acquire complete exclusive control of an entire enterprise, authority, or field

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bringing disparate authorities, powers, resources, or operational units under a single unified center or commanding body.
groups.summary_zh: 指收拢权力或整合资源，将控制权归并至单一中央机构。

groups.name: Certify & Attest Formally · 认证与确证 (Attest, Authenticate, Validate)
groups.tip: 出具证明确认真实性

items.def_zh: 发给证书确认，批准，证明
items.def_en: To provide someone or something with an official certificate, or to confirm and authorize officially.
To make something officially acceptable, legally binding, or confirmed as accurate
To officially recognize an educational, medical, or corporate institution as meeting standards
To declare or show formally that something is true, genuine, or correct
To prove officially that something is genuine, valid, or authentic

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the formal, legal, or institutional act of verifying, authenticating, or officially attesting that a qualification, document, or condition meets authorized standards.
groups.summary_zh: 由权威机构或正式程序核实其真伪、资历或合法有效性。

groups.name: Channel & Direct Flow · 导引与调拨 (Channel, Route, Direct)
groups.tip: 顺着渠道指引方向

items.def_zh: 用管道输送，传导（液体、数据等）
items.def_en: To convey liquid, gas, or electronic signals through a conduit or system to a destination
To send or direct people, goods, or communications along a specified path or course

items.def_zh: 引导，把…引向；输送，灌注；开凿水渠
items.def_en: to direct, guide, or focus money, energy, or resources toward a particular purpose or through a particular route
To guide the movement, progress, or behavior of someone or something in a desired direction

items.def_zh: 使改道，转移（资金、注意力、水流）
items.def_en: To cause something or someone to change direction or switch away from one path to another

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate steering tangible or intangible flows—such as water, resources, enthusiasm, or energy—along a chosen path toward a targeted destination.
groups.summary_zh: 将资金、精力、情感或水流疏导并定向输送至特定管道或用途。

groups.name: Chant & Intone · 吟诵与咏唱 (Intone, Chant, Recite)
groups.tip: 抑扬顿挫慢声吟哦与念诵

items.def_zh: 吟诵，用单调的声音念；使（身体或肌肉）结实；给……定色调
items.def_en: 1. (archaic or literary) To utter words in a rhythmic, monotonous, or chanting voice; intone. 2. To make muscles or the body firmer and stronger.
To chant or recite liturgical text according to musical accents
To repeat words or phrases rhythmically and often in unison, or to sing sacred prose
To say or chant words in a slow, solemn, and measured tone, especially in religious services
To speak or utter rhetorically with high emotion and theatrical cadence

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to vocalizing words in a measured, rhythmic, or monotonous pitch, characteristic of rituals, religious liturgy, or poetic recitation. They contrast normal conversational speech with ritualized, sing-song cadence.
groups.summary_zh: 以仪式化、单调或富有韵律的声调吟诵、咏唱祷词或诗歌。

groups.name: Chap & Desiccate · 皲裂与干裂 (Chap, Crack, Chafe)
groups.tip: 干燥或受力产生表面细纹

items.def_en: (of skin or lips) To become dry, cracked, and sore from cold or wind, or to cause this to happen.
(+ off/away) To shed small flat, dry pieces from cracked or peeling skin
To make or become sore, raw, or irritated by friction or dry weather
To make or become uneven, dry, and coarse in texture
To develop narrow breaks or fissures on the surface of skin or lips

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on superficial cracking, roughening, and soreness of human skin or lips due to harsh cold, wind, or dry conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 受风寒干燥等影响，皮肤或嘴唇粗糙开裂起皮。

groups.name: Chaperone & Oversee · 监护陪同与风纪监督 (Chaperone, Supervise, Mind)
groups.tip: 作为监护人陪同青年社交

items.def_en: Take care of or keep watch on a child, vulnerable person, or place for a temporary period
Care for, protect, and monitor someone or something closely to prevent harm or misbehavior
Take responsibility for the physical safety, welfare, or proper behavior of someone
Watch over and direct an activity or person to make sure work or behavior is done safely and correctly

items.def_zh: 伴护，监护（陪同青年社交）
items.def_en: 1. (variant spelling of chaperone) To accompany and supervise young people at a social gathering or in public to ensure proper behavior.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on accompanying minors, students, or unmarried individuals to social events or public outings specifically to supervise behavior, ensure propriety, and maintain safety.
groups.summary_zh: 特指出于监护责任、道德约束或行为风纪进行的随行监督。

groups.name: Char & Carbonize · 炭化与烧焦 (Char, Carbonize, Blacken)
groups.tip: 受热燃烧直至表面变黑焦化

items.def_en: Turn dark or black as a result of fire, scorching, or smoke exposure.

items.def_zh: 微焦，燎焦毛发或衣物边缘
items.def_en: Burn something very lightly, especially at the edges, tips, or surface fibers.
1. To burn or convert into charcoal. 2. To take on or supply with coal as fuel.
Partially burn an object so that its surface becomes blackened and converted to carbon.
Convert an organic substance into carbon or charcoal through heating.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on partial or superficial burning that converts organic material into charcoal, soot, or a blackened, brittle state without fully disintegrating into powdery ash.
groups.summary_zh: 指有机物质受热发生炭化，表层变黑干裂而非完全化作轻灰。

groups.name: Chase & Follow · 追逐与跟追 (Chase, Tail, Shadow)
groups.tip: 紧追不舍追踪猎捕

items.def_en: To follow someone closely and secretly wherever they go
To follow closely behind someone in order to observe their movements
To hunt or chase game with hounds using sight rather than scent
1. To run after or follow someone or something in order to catch them. 2. To drive away.
To search persistently for someone or something until they are tracked down and caught

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses rapidly following someone or something with the intent to catch, overtake, or monitor them, spanning casual pursuit to discreet surveillance.
groups.summary_zh: 指紧跟或追赶目标以期追上、抓捕或暗中监视。

groups.name: Cheat & Defraud · 欺诈与骗取 (Swindle, Fleece, Defraud)
groups.tip: 施用诡计手段骗取财物

items.def_en: To blatantly cheat someone by overcharging them or selling inferior goods
(informal, variant of gyp) To cheat, swindle, or defraud someone of something.
To deprive someone of a large sum of money through exorbitant charges or dishonest tactics
To illegally obtain money, rights, or property from someone through deliberate misrepresentation
To obtain money or assets from someone deceitfully through a fraudulent scheme

groups.summary_en: Centers on illicitly extracting money, property, or goods through fraudulent schemes, financial con-artistry, or overcharging.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过欺诈手段、暴利或骗局非法攫取他人钱财或财物。

groups.name: Cheer & Root · 欢呼与呐喊助威 (Cheer, Root, Egg on)
groups.tip: 用欢呼和热情鼓舞他人斗志

items.def_en: To enthusiastically support or hope for the success of a team or competitor

items.def_zh: 欢呼，喝彩；为……加油，鼓舞，使振奋
items.def_en: 1. To shout loudly to show approval, encouragement, or joy. 2. To encourage or give comfort and hope to someone.
To shout words of encouragement to an athlete or participant during an event
To bring people together or come together to revive energy, courage, or concerted effort

items.def_zh: 欢呼雀跃，发出兴奋喊叫
items.def_en: To utter a loud, unrestrained cry of joy, triumph, or excited encouragement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover loud vocal support, rallying cries, and spirited encouragement given to competitors, comrades, or loved ones during trials and contests.
groups.summary_zh: 高声呼喊为选手或同伴加油打气、提振士气。

groups.name: Chemical Coordination & Complexing · 螯合与化学络合 (Chelate, Ligand, Sequester)
groups.tip: 化学离子发生螯合配对

items.def_en: To form one or more coordinate covalent bonds with a central metal atom or ion
To combine with an atom, ion, or molecule to form a coordination complex
To chemically attach to or trap a substance, preventing it from remaining free or active
To bind a chemical substance or ion so that it cannot undergo its typical chemical reactions
1. (chemistry) To bind a metal ion firmly to an organic molecule to form a ring-like complex.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized chemical and biochemical frame specify the bonding of central metal ions or atoms to multi-dentate ligands or carrier molecules to form ring complexes. They highlight stabilization, binding, or sequestration of chemical species.
groups.summary_zh: 特指化学与生化过程中通过多齿配体将金属离子络合、锁定的反应行为。

groups.name: Cherish & Entertain Feelings · 怀有与深藏心底 (Nurse, Entertain, Cherish)
groups.tip: 内心深处存留特定念头

items.def_en: To give consideration to or keep an idea, hope, or feeling in the mind

items.def_zh: 心怀（怨恨、希望等），长期蓄抱
items.def_en: To keep a feeling, grudge, or ambition in one's mind for a long time
To encourage the development of an emotion, belief, or relationship internally

items.def_zh: 心怀，怀有（情感、疑虑或怨恨）；窝藏，庇护
items.def_en: 1. To keep a thought, feeling, or secret in one's mind for a long time. 2. To give shelter or refuge to someone.

items.def_zh: 珍怀，抱持（珍贵的希望、回忆）
items.def_en: To protect and care for someone lovingly, or hold a thought or hope dear in mind

groups.summary_en: Involves mentally holding, nurturing, and preserving specific emotions, doubts, grievances, or ideals over an extended period. Some verbs skew toward bitter grudges, others toward tender affection.
groups.summary_zh: 在内心长期保留、滋养并抱持某种强烈情感、怨恨或崇高理想。

groups.name: Childproof & Modify for Safety · 防护与改装 (Childproof, Babyproof, Tamper-proof)
groups.tip: 改造设施杜绝安全隐患

items.def_zh: 使对婴儿安全；防婴儿触碰改装
items.def_en: To adapt a living space, furniture, or equipment so that it poses no danger to infants
To design or modify a machine or process so that it cannot go wrong or be mishandled even by an incompetent user
To design or modify packaging, locks, or software so that unauthorized interference is prevented or immediately detectable

items.def_zh: 使安全；消除…的危险隐患
items.def_en: To inspect and adjust an area or mechanism to eliminate all hazardous points and safety risks

items.def_zh: 对…做儿童防护改装，使儿童无法打开或触碰
items.def_en: 1. To modify a room, container, or piece of equipment so that young children cannot injure themselves or open it.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe adapting environments, enclosures, or mechanisms to render them safe from accidental damage, unauthorized tampering, or injury by vulnerable occupants.
groups.summary_zh: 通过改造空间或加装保护装置，消除特定安全隐患以防意外伤害。

groups.name: Chopping & Hashing Food · 切碎与剁碎 (Hash, Mince, Chop)
groups.tip: 切碎剁细食材木料

items.def_en: To reduce food to small shreds or fine particles by rubbing it briskly against a rough, perforated surface
To cut something into smaller pieces with rapid, forceful downward strokes of a knife or axe
To cut, grate, or tear material into thin, narrow strips or rough scraps

items.def_zh: 切碎，剁碎；搞糟，弄乱；（hash out）深入讨论解决
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To chop meat, vegetables, or other food into small pieces. 2. (hash out) To discuss something thoroughly until an agreement or solution is reached.
To cut or chop roughly, forcefully, and unevenly with heavy blows

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe reducing food or other materials to small, irregular bits through repeated, brisk strokes of a knife, cleaver, or chopper. Unlike fine decorative dicing, these verbs focus on rapid breaking down, shredding, or mincing.
groups.summary_zh: 指用刀斧反复快切、乱刀剁碎或切成细碎肉菜的粗粝切割手法。

groups.name: Chorus & Chime · 齐声呼应 (Chorus, Echo, Chiming In)
groups.tip: 异口同声附和或共同发声

items.def_en: to interrupt or join a conversation, typically to express agreement or offer opinion
to repeat an utterance or sentiment emphatically across a crowd
to formally or verbally back a proposal, statement, or speaker
to repeat or agree closely with someone else's sentiments, words, or opinions
to say or sing something all together at the same time

groups.summary_en: This frame captures group coordination in spoken discourse, where multiple speakers utter phrases in unison, harmonize agreement, or interrupt collectively with matching sentiments.
groups.summary_zh: 多人异口同声发言、集体应和或协同发声表达赞同附和。

groups.name: Cinematographic Recording · 拍摄影片与录像 (Film, Shoot, Record)
groups.tip: 利用镜头影音记录景象

items.def_en: To store sounds or moving images electronically onto a storage medium

items.def_zh: 拍摄（电影等）；拍下；蒙上薄膜
items.def_en: 1. To record scenes, people, or events using a video camera or motion-picture film. 2. To cover or become covered with a thin layer of something.
To use a camera to record a video, movie, or particular scene
To record sounds or television footage on magnetic or digital tape
To record moving images and sound on magnetic tape or video format

groups.summary_en: This production frame focuses on capturing moving images, live events, or staged cinematic performances onto electronic media or celluloid. Nuances contrast comprehensive documentary taping, multi-camera television production, and cinematic on-location shooting.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用摄像机、胶片或数字化设备摄制动态影视画面的行为。

groups.name: Circulate & Diffuse · 流动与传布 (Flow, Disperse, Disseminate)
groups.tip: 流通循环往复不息

items.def_en: To move steadily and continuously in a stream or circuit

items.def_zh: 在人群或圈子中流传，巡回走动
items.def_en: To be passed around from person to person, as news, rumors, or drinks
1. To move continuously around a closed system or area, or cause something to do so. 2. To pass or spread from person to person.
To distribute or spread over a wide area, or break up in different directions

items.def_zh: 大面积散播，传播（信息、理论）
items.def_en: To distribute or spread information, knowledge, or ideas widely among people

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the spatial movement of fluids, objects, or information through a network, closed loop, or population. Contrasts physical closed-loop transport with public social dissemination.
groups.summary_zh: 描述液体在系统内循环流动，或消息、物品在人群与网络中传布流转。

groups.name: Cite & Quote Authority · 征引与引证 (Quote, Cite, Invoke)
groups.tip: 引用前人原话或权威文献做证据

items.def_en: 1. to repeat or copy words that someone else has said or written 2. to state the price of a job, service, or goods
To refer to a book, author, or legal case as an authority, source, or proof of an argument
To put forward or cite facts or evidence in support of an argument or theory
To turn to an author, source, or document for authoritative information or confirmation

items.def_zh: 援引，诉诸（法律、原则或权威）
items.def_en: To mention or use a law, principle, or authority to support an opinion or justify an action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to reproducing external texts or summoning precedents, authorities, and empirical evidence to substantiate an argument.
groups.summary_zh: 引用外部文本、学说、法条或权威人物以佐证论点。

groups.name: Cite & Quote · 引用与述及 (Cite, Quote, Reference, Invoke)
groups.tip: 学术文献引用与原文转述

items.def_en: Provide a reference to or mention a source, work, or authority
Repeat or reproduce the exact words spoken or written by someone else

items.def_zh: 引用，引证；传唤，传讯；嘉奖，表彰
items.def_en: 1. to mention or quote something as an example, proof, or authority 2. (law) to officially summon someone to appear in court 3. to praise someone publicly for their brave actions or meritorious work
Cite or present facts, reasons, or evidence to substantiate an argument
Mention or call upon a law, rule, or authority to support an argument or justify an action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe referring to authoritative texts, previous statements, precedents, or examples to support an argument or establish credibility.
groups.summary_zh: 指引用权威言论、文献、先例或事实以论证支撑观点。

groups.name: Civilize & Cultivate · 教化与开化 (Cultivate, Humanize, Refine)
groups.tip: 通过教育脱离野蛮状态

items.def_zh: 使社会化，教导社交准则
items.def_en: Train individuals to behave in ways that are accepted and valued by their society
Improve something by making small changes, removing coarse or uncouth elements
Refine and educate one's mind, tastes, or manners through deliberate training
To educate a person or society and bring them to a more developed cultural and social state.

items.def_zh: 赋予人性，使更富人情味
items.def_en: Make a system, culture, or person more civilized, gentle, or compassionate

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on elevating raw, unrefined, or barbaric behaviors into culturally advanced, polite, and law-governed social conduct.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过文化、礼俗与道德培育使之告别粗蛮、步入开化。

groups.name: Clean & Sanitize · 清洁与消杀 (Clean, Wipe, Sanitize)
groups.tip: 扫除污垢并彻底清理干净

items.def_en: To remove dirt, soap, or chemical residue by washing lightly with clean water.
To clean or dry a surface by moving a cloth, sponge, or hand firmly across it.

items.def_zh: 打扫，清洗，使干净；去内脏，收拾（鱼等）
items.def_en: 1. To remove dirt, grime, or unwanted marks from something. 2. To remove the entrails of fish or poultry before cooking.
To make thoroughly clean, pure, or free of blemishes, toxins, or moral guilt.
To make hygienic and safe by disinfecting to kill bacteria and pathogens.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this ubiquitous frame designate eliminating dirt, foreign substances, contamination, or debris from items, surfaces, or food prep items using a variety of basic mechanical or chemical techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 通过擦抹、冲淋或消毒等日常手法清除灰尘污垢及杂质。

groups.name: Clench & Grind Teeth · 咬紧牙关与磨牙 (Grit, Clench, Grind, Gnash)
groups.tip: 咬紧牙关或咬牙切齿

items.def_en: To rub the upper and lower teeth together with force, causing an abrasive grating noise

items.def_zh: 咬紧（牙关）；使发出摩擦嘎吱声；撒砂砾于
items.def_en: 1. ('grit one's teeth') To clench your teeth tightly together in determination, pain, or anger. 2. (chiefly British) To spread sand or grit on a road or path.
To press the teeth together very firmly, usually due to anger, stress, or resoluteness
To clamp one's jaws or teeth rigidly and immovably together in extreme shock or tension

items.def_zh: 咬牙切齿（表示极度愤恨）
items.def_en: (+ one's teeth) To strike or grind one's teeth together violently in wrath, anguish, or desperation

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on somatic manifestations of intense emotional tension, determination, pain, or aggression expressed by pressing the upper and lower teeth firmly together or frictionally sliding them back and forth.
groups.summary_zh: 因痛苦、愤怒、下定决心或入睡神经紧张而用力紧咬或相互摩擦牙齿。

groups.name: Clench & Grip · 握紧与咬紧 (Clamp, Clasp, Grit)
groups.tip: 攥紧拳头或咬紧牙关的紧绷用力

items.def_en: To fasten, grip, or hold something tightly in place or shut
To press one's teeth tightly together, especially when facing pain or difficulty
To grasp something firmly with one's hand or hold someone tightly in one's arms

items.def_zh: 紧握（拳头）；咬紧（牙关）；抓牢
items.def_en: To close one's hands, teeth, or jaw tightly, especially when angry, determined, or in pain; to grip firmly.
To become tighter and narrower, or to compress muscles or parts together

groups.summary_en: Focuses on locking hands, jaws, or gripping surfaces tightly together, often reflecting tension, defiance, bodily control, or physical grasp.
groups.summary_zh: 死死抓紧、紧握手拳或咬紧牙关以抗压。

groups.name: Click & Clatter · 喀哒与脆响 (Clatter, Clack, Snap)
groups.tip: 机械硬物敲击的清脆轻响

items.def_zh: 发出轻微的咔哒声；使发出咔哒声；点击；豁然开朗
items.def_en: 1. To make or cause to make a short, sharp clicking sound. 2. (computing) To press a mouse button. 3. (informal) To suddenly become clear or understood.
To make a short, sharp, dry sound, like two hard pieces of wood or plastic striking together
To make or cause to make a sudden, crisp cracking sound, often as something breaks or locks
To make a rapid succession of short, sharp knocking sounds while shaking
To make a continuous loud, rattling sound by hard objects knocking repeatedly against one another

groups.summary_en: This frame details the production of sharp, dry, percussive noises generated by hard objects impacting one another. Verbs contrast repetitive rattling versus solitary sharp breaks or snaps.
groups.summary_zh: 描述坚硬物体碰撞时发出的短促、清脆或连续撞击声响。

groups.name: Cling & Adhere · 附着与死死依附 (Cling, Cleave, Hang On)
groups.tip: 牢牢附着或紧抓不放

items.def_en: To become physically joined or adhered to a surface
(+ to) To hold tightly to something for support or balance
(+ to) To hold on tightly to somebody or something, or stick closely to a surface

items.def_zh: 紧抓，抓紧不放；附着，紧贴（cling的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of cling; held tightly to someone or something, or stuck closely.
(+ to) (literary) To stick firmly to something, or remain faithful and committed to someone

groups.summary_en: Pertains to holding tenaciously onto an object or surface, or adhering persistently physically or emotionally without letting go.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体表面粘附，或紧紧依附、固执抓住某物不放。

groups.name: Clog & Block · 肠阻与堵塞 (Clog, Obstruct, Bung up)
groups.tip: 消化道排泄受阻或肠胃板结

items.def_en: To cause the bowels to become constipated and hard to move
To block a bodily organ or pipe completely so normal flow is halted
To block a tube, pipe, or channel with an accumulation of thick or solid matter
To block a passage, pipe, or bodily tract so that nothing can get through

items.def_zh: 使便秘，使肠道受阻；使迟钝，抑制
items.def_en: To make someone unable to empty their bowels easily or regularly; (figurative) to slow down, restrict, or stifle.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or biological obstruction where passages, vessels, or digestive tracts become impeded or jammed, halting natural flow.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体通道、器官管道或排泄系统发生堵塞与滞留。

groups.name: Close & Shut · 关闭与封闭 (Slam, Seal, Snap shut)
groups.tip: 合上门窗或封堵住开口

items.def_zh: 关上，封闭；关闭，停止营业；结束
items.def_en: 1. To shut something, or to become shut so that an opening is covered. 2. To stop operating or doing business, or to end an activity.
Move a door, window, lid, or mouth into a closed position
Close an opening securely so that nothing can enter, escape, or leak through
Shut something violently and noisily

items.def_zh: 停止运转，关闭（机器或设施）
items.def_en: Cease business operations or turn off mechanical or computerized systems completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate physical acts that draw an opening to a halt or block access, moving doors, lids, covers, or apertures from an open to a secure or fastened state.
groups.summary_zh: 使门、窗、盖子或开口进入遮盖合拢或气密闭合的状态。

groups.name: Close & Shutter · 关停与破产 (Shutter, Mothball, Wind up)
groups.tip: 强行中止营业或封闭出口

items.def_en: To halt operations or use of equipment, plants, or plans while preserving them for future reactivation
To stop a machine, factory, or organization from operating, either temporarily or forever

items.def_zh: 关闭，关停（企业或店铺）；用百叶窗关闭（窗户）
items.def_en: 1. To close down a business, store, or service permanently or temporarily. 2. To close windows with shutters.
To permanently cease operating or trading as a business or facility
To bring a business or venture to a legal close by settling debts and liquidating assets

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate terminating or temporarily mothballing the commercial or institutional operations of a business, factory, or facility due to financial failure, regulatory action, or strategic cessation.
groups.summary_zh: 指因经营不善、亏损或行政指令而关闭、停运工厂设施或终结业务。

groups.name: Clothe & Attire · 穿衣与妆理 (Attire, Clothe, Array)
groups.tip: 穿戴衣物遮体装饰身体

items.def_en: Provide someone with garments to wear, or cover someone with clothing
Equip or dress someone in a distinctive, special, or elaborate outfit
(literary, usually passive) Dress someone in an impressive or ornate assortment of fine clothes
(literary or archaic) To clothe or dress someone in garments.
(usually passive) Clothe someone in formal, elegant, or ceremonial garments

groups.summary_en: This frame pertains to furnishing a person with garments or dressing them completely, often with an emphasis on modesty, formal provision, or ritualistic preparation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为他人或自己穿戴齐备衣物，兼具遮蔽与礼容整理色彩。

groups.name: Clothe & Uniform · 穿戴与着装 (Clothe, Habit, Vest)
groups.tip: 将衣裳穿戴于身，特指特色盛装

items.def_en: (formal/archaic, usually passive) Clothe someone in a religious habit or distinctive style of costume
Provide someone with a complete set of clothes or necessary working gear
(informal, often passive) Dress someone completely in specific or fancy garments for an occasion
Clothe someone, especially a cleric, in formal liturgical or ceremonial robes
(usually passive) To dress or clothe someone in distinctive or particular garments.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on clothing someone in attire indicative of a specific role, order, profession, or status. The emphasis lies on distinctive dress, habit, or institutional uniform.
groups.summary_zh: 指身穿或使穿戴具有特定身份、职务或制式特征的衣着。

groups.name: Cloud & Obscure · 蒙翳与模糊 (Cloud, Mist, Blur)
groups.tip: 雾气或阴云笼罩遮挡

items.def_zh: （使）起雾笼罩，（使）变模糊；使困惑
items.def_en: 1. To become covered with steam or condensation, or cause something to do so. 2. To make something unclear, confused, or indistinct.
Become covered with tiny droplets of condensation that obscure vision
Become obscured with hot condensation and vapor

items.def_zh: 使模糊；蒙上云翳；使迷乱
items.def_en: Make a transparent surface opaque, or impair sound judgment and understanding
Make the edges or features of an image indistinct and difficult to see clearly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the process where moisture, haze, or metaphorical confusion obscures optical transparency or mental lucidity. 'Fog' and 'mist' evoke surface condensation, while 'blur' and 'cloud' cover loss of clear vision or judgment.
groups.summary_zh: 指因水汽凝结或云翳遮蔽而变得模糊、不清。

groups.name: Cloud & Obscure · 遮蔽与混淆 (Cloud, Obscure, Shroud)
groups.tip: 如云雾罩顶遮挡视线与真相

items.def_zh: 起雾变模糊，使蒙上雾气
items.def_en: To become covered with condensation or steam so that transparency is lost

items.def_zh: 遮蔽，蒙上阴影；使变暗，使模糊；（情绪）使变阴沉
items.def_en: 1. To make something less clear, distinct, or transparent, like mist or clouds. 2. To make an issue, judgment, or feeling uncertain, gloomy, or confused. 3. To become overcast or filled with clouds.
To prevent something from being clearly seen, understood, or noticed
To envelop in fog, or to confuse and make a matter unclear
To cover, conceal, or envelop something completely in fog, darkness, or secrecy

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate impairing visual clarity, transparency, or intellectual comprehension by covering with mist, shadow, or confusing complexities.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过雾气、阴影或复杂因素使视线模糊、事实晦暗或判断受干扰。

groups.name: Clumsy Handling & Rummaging · 笨拙摸索与翻找 (Fumble, Rummage, Scrabble)
groups.tip: 盲目摸索笨拙乱翻

items.def_en: Search by feeling around awkwardly inside a bag, pocket, or dark space

items.raw_cluster: 摸索与笨拙处理 Fumble & Grope
items.def_zh: 笨拙地摸索，乱翻；笨拙地处理；漏球
items.def_en: To use the hands awkwardly while doing or looking for something; to mishandle a situation or drop a ball.
Rummage persistently through a space in search of an elusive item
Scratch or grope around frantically with one's fingers to find or hold something
Search untidily through a mass or container to find something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe awkward, uncoordinated hand movements while trying to find, grasp, or manipulate an object, often due to nervousness, haste, or clumsiness.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因慌乱、紧张或笨拙而手忙脚乱地摸索、翻找或摆弄物体。

groups.name: Clutter & Jumble · 弄乱与混杂堆放 (Clutter, Jumble, Litter)
groups.tip: 杂物堆积使空间杂乱

items.def_en: (+ with/into) To fill a space uncomfortably full of objects or people
To clog, tangle, or throw a space or mechanism into disorder
(+ with) To spread rubbish or scattered objects untidily across an area
(+ up/with) To fill a place or surface with an untidy collection of things.
(+ up) To mix things together in a confused, disordered way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate filling or covering a space with an untidy, disorganized heap of disparate items, obstructing neatness or utility.
groups.summary_zh: 杂物乱堆乱放占用空间，导致场面杂乱无章。

groups.name: Coach & Drill · 指导训练与带教 (Coach, Train, Drill, Mentor)
groups.tip: 教练指引提升技能

items.def_en: To teach a person or animal the skills and behaviors needed for an art, job, or sport
To train, instruct, or supervise someone in a sport, subject, or skill
To train someone by forcing them to practice exercises or techniques repeatedly
To act as a trusted, experienced guide and counselor to a younger or less experienced person
To teach someone individually or in a small group, especially in academic subjects

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve actively preparing someone for performances, matches, or specific tasks through targeted practice, feedback, and drills.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过针对性练习、带教示范与反复强化来传授技能。

groups.name: Coat & Glaze · 涂层与上釉 (Glaze, Enamel, Varnish)
groups.tip: 上釉或覆上一层涂层

items.def_en: To cover a surface thoroughly with a thin layer of liquid, powder, or protective film

items.def_zh: 给……上釉，涂糖汁；给……装玻璃；（目光等）变呆滞
items.def_en: 1. to cover pottery or food with a thin shiny coating 2. to fit glass into a window or frame 3. (of eyes) to become fixed and expressionless
To coat a metal, glass, or pottery surface with a glassy, opaque decorative substance baked on
To apply a clear liquid that dries into a hard, shiny protective coating onto wood or metal
To apply lacquer to a wooden or metal object to give it a durable, glossy finish

groups.summary_en: This frame covers applying a smooth, lustrous, or protective surface finish to ceramics, woodwork, food, or crafts. The focus is on producing a glossy, sealed, or vitreous protective exterior layer.
groups.summary_zh: 指在器具、食物或材料表面涂抹光亮、封闭或具保护性的釉料及罩光层。

groups.name: Codify & Enact · 编纂与建制 (Codify, Legislate, Institutionalize)
groups.tip: 成文化确立法律规范

items.def_en: To arrange according to an organized, clear system, rule, or plan
To establish something as an accepted, permanent convention, standard, or organization
to arrange laws, rules, or principles systematically into an official written code
To give official status, definite form, or recognized structure to an arrangement
To put a proposal or decree officially into law through a governing body

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organizing, writing down, or formally enacting customs, principles, or regulations into legally binding or institutionally recognized codes.
groups.summary_zh: 指将规则、惯例系统整理成法典，或在制度层面上确立实施。

groups.name: Collaborate & Partner · 结盟与联合 (Partner, Team Up, Ally)
groups.tip: 结成伙伴协同共事

items.def_en: (+ with) To join with another person or group in order to work together on an activity
To combine efforts, resources, or people with another party to accomplish a shared goal

items.def_zh: 与……结成伙伴，使合作；做伙伴
items.def_en: 1. To form a partnership with someone, or bring two people or organizations together to work as partners.
To join together in a formal agreement to support one another in politics, war, or mutual interests
(+ with / on) To work jointly with someone else on an intellectual, artistic, or professional project

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail cooperative alignments between individuals, commercial enterprises, or political entities. They emphasize coordinating resources, sharing mutual objectives, or pooling efforts toward a common endeavor.
groups.summary_zh: 指个人、企业或机构为实现共同利益或目标建立合作联手关系的动作。

groups.name: Collateralize & Back · 抵押与资产担保 (Collateralize, Securitize, Underwrite)
groups.tip: 用资产作为债务担保

items.def_en: To guarantee financial support or value for a currency, security, or loan.
To pool various types of contractual debt and sell them as consolidated financial instruments.
To accept financial liability for another entity's debt or issue of securities.
(law) To place a legal claim or lien on a property or asset as security for a debt.

items.def_zh: 用……作抵押，以资产担保（贷款）
items.def_en: 1. (finance) To secure a loan or obligation by pledging assets as collateral.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame operate in formal finance and lending, denoting the legal dedication or securitization of real assets to guarantee repayment or underwrite obligations.
groups.summary_zh: 在金融融资中以具体资产作担保或发行担保证券。

groups.name: Collocate & Cohere · 搭配与共现 (Co-occur, Pair with, Go together)
groups.tip: 语言学中词语的习惯性搭配

items.def_en: To exist, happen, or appear in combination alongside another element in discourse or data
To combine or join two linguistic elements or items so they work together harmoniously
To naturally match, harmonize, or frequently appear together as expected partners
To fit or link together neatly and seamlessly like interlocking pieces
(linguistics) (of words) To naturally and frequently appear together; to arrange words or things in relation to one another.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this linguistic and compositional frame denote how words or structural elements fit, co-occur naturally, or systematically combine to form idiomatic, semantically harmonious wholes.
groups.summary_zh: 指语言成分或结构元素之间自然共现、习惯搭配或契合衔接。

groups.name: Collude & Conspire · 串通与勾结 (Connive, Intrigue, Scheme)
groups.tip: 暗中密谋串通搞权力斗争

items.def_en: To make clever, devious plans to gain personal advantage, often at the expense of others
To engage in underhand machinations or secret political plotting
To make secret agreements or plans together with others to carry out an unlawful or harmful design
To cooperate secretly or unlawfully with someone in order to deceive or cheat others.
To cooperate secretly in an illegal or wrongful activity, or knowingly allow wrongdoing to proceed unchecked

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate covert cooperation among parties to commit illegal, unethical, or deceptive acts, often involving institutional misconduct, corporate price-fixing, or betrayal of trust.
groups.summary_zh: 多方暗中勾结以牟取不当利益或损害公众、他人权益。

groups.name: Come to an End by Time Limit · 期满与失效 (Expire, Lapse)
groups.tip: 效力或生命的到期终结

items.def_en: to reach the end of a valid period (e.g., of a visa, lease, or passport)
to come to a temporal end, disappear, or cease to have effect over time

items.def_zh: 期满，失效，终止；断气，死亡
items.def_en: 1. To come to an end and no longer be valid or effective. 2. (formal) To die or breathe one's last breath.
(formal) to come to an official end or reach its concluding point

items.def_zh: 期满失效，终止；陷入（某种状态）；背离（信仰、准则）
items.def_en: 1. To stop being valid or active, especially through failure to renew. 2. (+ into) To gradually pass or fall into a particular state or condition.

groups.summary_en: These intransitive verbs describe an official document, contract, entitlement, or validity reaching its temporal end and ceasing to be active. 'Expire' is the neutral standard term for passing a designated deadline, while 'lapse' emphasizes cessation through non-renewal, negligence, or passage of time.
groups.summary_zh: 指文件、合约或效力因期限届满或未续期而自然终止失效。

groups.name: Comfort & Soothe Distress · 安慰与释怀 (Console, Soothe, Comfort)
groups.tip: 抚平焦虑情绪并给予鼓励支持

items.def_en: Ease the sorrow or distress of someone by offering sympathetic presence and words
Comfort someone who is grievously disappointed, mourning, or heartbroken
(+ that/about) To say or do something that removes someone's doubts or fears and makes them feel calmer.
Gently calm someone's agitation, pain, or emotional distress
Make an unpleasant feeling, fear, or guilt less intense through appeasement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe verbal or behavioral intervention designed to relieve another person's anguish, fear, grief, or uncertainty. Variations depend on whether the intent is lifting sorrow, restoring calm, or resolving doubts.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过话语或行为抚慰他人的悲痛、焦虑或疑虑，使之恢复平静与信心。

groups.name: Command & Decree · 规定与敕令 (Decree, Ordain, Enact)
groups.tip: 权威主体发号施令或立下规定

items.def_en: To state clearly and definitively that something must be done as part of an official agreement or contract

items.def_zh: 必须，应当（用于法律、章程等强制性规定）；将要，会（与第一人称连用）；要不要，好吗（征求意见）
items.def_en: 1. (formal / law) Used to express a mandatory command, legal requirement, or official rule. 2. Used to express the simple future tense (primarily with 'I' and 'we'). 3. Used in questions to make an offer, request, or suggestion.
To pass a law or make a formal proposal officially into statute by sovereign or parliamentary process
To officially order, establish, or decide something by an authoritative edict or legal proclamation
To order, establish, or decree officially by virtue of superior law, religious authority, or fate

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the formal codification and proclamation of authoritative decrees, statutory duties, and legal obligations. It spans legislative enactment, sovereign decree, and the solemn establishment of binding rules.
groups.summary_zh: 以法定条文、主权裁决或庄严法令形式确立不可逾越的义务。

groups.name: Commemorate & Observe · 纪念与隆重仪式 (Observe, Remember, Mark)
groups.tip: 举行仪式感念历史人物事迹

items.def_en: To celebrate or officially recognize an important anniversary or turning point
To show deep public respect, gratitude, or tribute to someone's memory or sacrifice
To formally commemorate or keep a holiday, solemn occasion, or ritual tradition
To say or do something explicitly to express admiration, homage, and remembrance
1. To honor and preserve the memory of an important event or person with a ceremony, holiday, or monument.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on formal societal, ritual, or public remembrance of a historic milestone, fallen soldiers, or significant event through ceremonies, holidays, or official moments of silence.
groups.summary_zh: 通过官方礼仪、节日、默哀等公共仪式正式缅怀先驱或纪念历史事件。

groups.name: Comment & Remark · 评论与评述 (Comment, Remark, Observe, Opine)
groups.tip: 发表个人见解与批判性点评

items.def_zh: 发表评论，发表意见；评论，评述
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To express an opinion, judgment, or reaction about someone or something.
To make a thoughtful remark or draw attention to an obvious or noticed fact in conversation
(+ on/upon) To mention or say something as a brief, casual observation or opinion
(+ on) To actively join a discussion, debate, or argument by voicing one's view or perspective
To formally state one's personal view, philosophical judgment, or interpretation of a subject

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to expressing an explicit thought, reaction, or passing observation regarding an event, topic, or person without necessarily providing formal analysis.
groups.summary_zh: 就某事、某人或当前形势随口或明确地发表看法、评语与感言。

groups.name: Commercialize & Monetize · 商业化与营利性利用 (Commercialize, Monetize, Exploit)
groups.tip: 将公共资源推向商业化利用

items.def_en: To develop resources for profit, or to use someone or something selfishly for financial gain
To take opportunistic advantage of a situation or trend to secure financial profit

items.def_zh: 商品化推销；贩卖衍生品
items.def_en: To promote, brand, and sell products linked to popular media, names, or events
To utilize an asset, service, or audience to generate financial income

items.raw_cluster: 商业化与利用 Commercialize & Exploit
items.def_zh: 使商业化，使商品化；利用……营利
items.def_en: To organize, develop, or exploit something mainly for financial profit, often at the expense of its quality or character.

groups.summary_en: This institutional frame revolves around converting ideas, art, resources, or practices into money-making ventures, often trading intrinsic authenticity for financial return.
groups.summary_zh: 将事物转化为营利性商业产品，往往以牺牲纯粹性为代价变现。

groups.name: Commercialize Integrity · 沦落出卖与谋私弃义 (Whore, Pander, Pimp)
groups.tip: 堕落沉沦出卖尊严与底线

items.def_zh: 卖淫；出卖原则，同流合污
items.def_en: 1. to work or engage as a prostitute 2. (+ out) to compromise one's principles or integrity for monetary gain or personal advantage

items.def_zh: 充当皮条客，借……牟利敛财
items.def_en: to act as a pimp, or figuratively exploit and market someone or something dishonorably
(+ to) to gratify or indulge immoral, depraved, or vulgar tastes to win favour or profit
to exploit something primarily for economic gain at the expense of artistic or moral value
to lower the real value, esteem, or dignified perception of someone or something

groups.summary_en: Strongly pejorative frame describing the mercenary commodification of one's own or others' values, gifts, or reputation to satisfy low desires or earn dirty money.
groups.summary_zh: 强烈贬义，指为私利或满足恶俗而曲意迎合、廉价抛售品德才艺。

groups.name: Commit & Obligate · 承诺与承担 (Commit, Bind, Obligate)
groups.tip: 立誓表态承担责任

items.def_zh: 束缚，使受责任/承诺牵制
items.def_en: To restrict someone's freedom of action by imposing demanding commitments or obligations

items.def_zh: 承诺，使承担义务；投入，调拨（资源）；犯（错误、罪行）
items.def_en: 1. To bind or obligate oneself to a specific course of action or relationship. 2. To dedicate time, money, or resources to something. 3. To do something illegal, wrong, or foolish.

items.def_zh: 使受诺言约束，承担保证
items.def_en: To bind oneself by formal promise, contract, or pledge to do something

items.def_zh: 约束，使承担法律或道德义务
items.def_en: To place someone under an inescapable legal, contractual, or moral obligation

items.def_zh: 使有义务，迫使承担责任
items.def_en: To constrain someone legally or morally to carry out a specific duty or action

groups.summary_en: This frame captures formally or morally binding oneself or allocating resources to a designated course of action, policy, or duty.
groups.summary_zh: 主动承担义务或在政策、资源上使自身受约束。

groups.name: Commit & Perpetrate · 作恶与犯罪 (Commit, Inflict, Pull off)
groups.tip: 实施违背法纪的严重罪行

items.def_en: To do something illegal, harmful, or morally wrong, such as a crime or an error

items.def_zh: 成功实施（骗局、抢劫等难办之事）
items.def_en: To succeed in carrying out a difficult or audacious enterprise, often a crime, scam, or trick
To force someone to experience something very unpleasant, painful, or damaging
to commit a crime, violent act, or harmful deception
To cause great damage, destruction, or chaos, often as a direct result of violent actions

groups.summary_en: Refers to carrying out illicit, destructive, fraudulent, or morally reprehensible actions. Differentiates formal legal infractions from heinous crimes and audacious hoaxes.
groups.summary_zh: 指实施违法、有害或极具破坏性的罪行与不道德恶行。

groups.name: Commit Infidelity · 不忠与背叛 (Betray, Cheat, Two-time)
groups.tip: 伴侣不忠或亲密关系背叛

items.def_en: (+ on) To be sexually or romantically unfaithful to a partner or spouse
To deceive someone by carrying on a secret romantic relationship with another person simultaneously
To break faith with a partner by being disloyal or sexually unfaithful
To begin an unfaithful sexual or romantic liaison outside one's committed relationship

items.def_zh: 对（丈夫）不忠，使戴绿帽子
items.def_en: (dated or literary) To be sexually unfaithful to one's husband.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote violating relational or marital fidelity through romantic or sexual betrayal and deceit.
groups.summary_zh: 指在恋爱或婚姻关系中违背忠诚、出轨背叛伴侣。

groups.name: Commune & Bond · 亲近与交融 (Bond, Connect, Harmonize)
groups.tip: 心灵深度契合建立深厚羁绊

items.def_en: To feel a close affinity, emotional sympathy, or mutual understanding with someone
To be in or bring into agreement, concordance, and peaceful accord with another

items.def_zh: 建立紧密关系；产生感情联结
items.def_en: To develop a close, warm relationship or emotional connection with someone

items.def_zh: （与……）心灵交融，亲密交流，心神契合
items.def_en: (literary) To feel in close spiritual or emotional harmony with someone or something, especially nature.
To understand and share the feelings and psychological perspective of another person

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this interpersonal and reflective frame describe forging intimate emotional closeness, spiritual rapport, or mutual understanding with others or the natural world. They highlight shared energy, alignment of feelings, and deep relational ties.
groups.summary_zh: 指人与人或与自然之间建立深层的情感共鸣与心灵纽带。

groups.name: Compensate & Indemnify · 赔偿与补偿 (Reimburse, Compensate, Recoup)
groups.tip: 弥补损失或承担赔偿责任

items.def_en: Pay or reward someone for effort, damage, or trouble suffered
(+ for) Give someone money or equivalent recognition in balance for loss, injury, or suffering
Repay someone money they have already spent on legitimate organizational expenses
Regain an amount of money spent, lost, or advanced through later returns

items.def_zh: 赔偿，补偿；保障……免受损失（或法律责任）
items.def_en: (+ against/for) To compensate someone for damage or loss incurred, or to protect them against legal responsibility.
