groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on monetary or material restitution legally paid to make good an injury, financial deficit, or collateral damage.
groups.summary_zh: 指依法或按约支付款项，以填补财务亏损、伤害或法律责任。

groups.name: Compensate & Reimburse · 补偿与报销 (Recompense, Indemnify, Make up for)
groups.tip: 弥补损失或报销花费

items.def_en: to do or provide something that reduces or cancels out the bad effect of something
to give something to someone as an expression of gratitude or to cover loss or effort
1. (+ for) to provide something good to balance or reduce the bad effect of damage or loss. 2. to pay someone money in exchange for work or to make up for loss
to pay back money to someone that they have already spent for an official purpose
to promise to protect someone against financial loss or to pay money for damage sustained

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving money, goods, or services to someone to balance out loss, injury, or out-of-pocket expenses. They range from informal amends to formal legal and corporate restitutions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过支付金钱或提供对等物以抵消损失、伤害或垫付支出的补偿行为。

groups.name: Compile & Correlate · 校勘与汇编 (Collate, Compile, Cross-check)
groups.tip: 对照整理核对文献资料

items.def_en: To verify the accuracy of information by comparing it with multiple other sources

items.def_zh: 拼凑整理出（真相或全貌）
items.def_en: To assemble facts, evidence, or fragments to reconstruct a coherent picture of what happened
To assemble information, data, or texts collected from many different sources into a coherent list or book
To compare two sets of figures or accounts to ensure that they agree and show no discrepancy

items.def_zh: 核对，对照；整理，装订（页码）
items.def_en: 1. To collect, compare, and arrange pages, data, or texts in the correct logical order.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this informational and editorial frame deal with bringing together disparate records, sheets, or data points to verify their sequence, reconcile differences, and synthesize a coherent whole.
groups.summary_zh: 指汇集散乱文件或数据，核对次序与差异并整理成条理化的成果。

groups.name: Complement & Enhance · 补充与相配 (Supplement, Round out, Offset)
groups.tip: 相得益彰地弥补不足

items.def_en: to add something extra to something in order to improve it or make it more complete
to add final details, variety, or elements to make something balanced and thoroughly complete
to make something look attractive or distinctive by standing in contrast to it
to combine smoothly with another element to form a unified working whole
to add to something in a way that enhances, improves, or completes it

groups.summary_en: This frame covers verbs where one element fits with, adds to, or balances another so that the combination becomes harmonious, complete, or improved.
groups.summary_zh: 指两者相互补充、协调搭配或增补不足，使整体更趋完备或更具美感。

groups.name: Complete Destructive Burning · 焚化与化为灰烬 (Incinerate, Cremate, Reduce to Ashes)
groups.tip: 烈火延烧，最终化为灰烬

items.def_en: Be completely destroyed or consume something completely by fire or atmospheric heat.
Completely destroy or engulf something by fire.
Destroy a structure or object entirely by fire so that only ash remains.
Dispose of a dead body by burning it to ashes, typically after a funeral ceremony.
1. To burn waste or a corpse completely until it is reduced to ashes in an incinerator.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the complete, high-temperature destruction of matter or bodies, turning them entirely to ash. They typically involve official, ritualistic, or catastrophic annihilation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示通过高温彻底焚毁废弃物或尸首，使其化为灰烬的高强度破坏动作。

groups.name: Comport & Demean Oneself · 庄重自持与合轨 (Comport, Acquit, Demean)
groups.tip: 言行举止与特定身份相符

items.def_en: To agree, harmonize, or correspond precisely with a rule, code, or standard
1. ('comport oneself') (formal) To conduct or behave oneself in a specified manner. 2. ('comport with') To accord, agree, or be consistent with.

items.def_zh: 举止自持，端正仪态（反身）
items.def_en: (deport oneself) To behave or carry oneself in a formal, dignified manner
(demean oneself) (formal) To conduct or carry oneself with a particular demeanour
(acquit oneself) To perform or conduct oneself in a specified way, especially successfully under pressure

groups.summary_en: A formal frame dealing with deliberate bodily and moral self-presentation in high-stakes or dignified contexts, often matching personal dignity with social status.
groups.summary_zh: 指严肃庄重场合下的立身处世、举止言行及规矩自律。

groups.name: Compose Verse & Rhyme · 押韵与作诗 (Rhyme, Verse, Scan)
groups.tip: 构思谱写诗词韵律与篇章

items.def_en: To conform to a regular rhythm or metrical pattern in verse
To correspond in sound through identical or similar vowel phonemes
To turn a story or prose into poetry, or compose verses
1. (+ with) To have or end with the same sound as another word; make words rhyme. 2. To compose rhyming poetry.
To repeat the same consonant sound at the start of adjacent words

groups.summary_en: Focuses on poetic composition, phonological correspondence, and metric arrangement in linguistic art. Spans end-rhyme pairing, versification, and metrical structuring of poetic lines.
groups.summary_zh: 指诗歌创制、韵脚匹配及音步格律构建的文学语言行为。

groups.name: Compress & Abridge · 压缩与浓缩 (Compress, Compact, Digest)
groups.tip: 挤压体积或凝炼内容

items.def_en: (+ to) To reduce or summarize complex information to its essential core points
To shorten a book, speech, or text by omitting less central parts while retaining the core meaning
To pack or press small loose particles tightly together to form a solid mass
To press or squeeze something so that it takes up less space or occupies a smaller volume

items.def_zh: 压缩，精简；（使）冷凝，（使）凝结；浓缩
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To make a text, speech, or book shorter by removing less important details. 2. To change or cause a gas or vapor to change into a liquid.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses reducing the physical bulk or textual length of something into a denser, more economical form. Verbs contrast physical squeezing of matter with editorial pruning and summarizing of informational content.
groups.summary_zh: 通过物理受压或文字删减来缩减体积或篇幅以提升致密度。

groups.name: Concede & Yield · 承认与让步 (Concede, Grant, Yield)
groups.tip: 勉强认同或退让妥协

items.def_zh: 承认（某论点的合理性），同意
items.def_en: To accept or admit the truth of a point or fact in an argument, often preceding a counterargument
To give way to an argument, demand, or pressure by relinquishing a previously held stance
(+ to) To cease resisting and finally accept someone's terms, demands, or assertions
(+ from) To withdraw a claim, threat, or demand in the face of opposition or superior reasoning

items.def_zh: （勉强）承认；让步，认输；让与，割让
items.def_en: 1. To admit that something is true, valid, or proper, often unwillingly. 2. To acknowledge defeat in a contest or election. 3. To give up or surrender a right, point, or territory.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on reluctantly accepting the validity of an opponent's argument or admitting an unfavorable outcome, especially in debates, negotiations, or elections.
groups.summary_zh: 在辩论、谈判或竞选中不情愿地认可对方观点或承认败局。

groups.name: Conceive & Gestate · 孕育与怀胎 (Conceive, Carry, Nurture)
groups.tip: 胎儿在母体子宫中孕育生长

items.def_en: To be pregnant with an unborn baby or young inside the womb
To become pregnant with a child, or form an idea or plan in the mind
To care for and encourage the growth or development of someone or something
To develop slowly under favorable conditions, as eggs or nascent schemes

items.def_zh: 孕育，怀孕；（在心中）酝酿，孕育（想法、计划等）
items.def_en: 1. To carry a developing fetus in the womb during pregnancy. 2. (figurative) To develop an idea, plan, or system slowly in the mind.

groups.summary_en: Encompasses both the physiological process of becoming pregnant and bearing an embryo, and the figurative incubation of thoughts, creative projects, or plans over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指生理上的受孕怀胎，或隐喻新思想、计划在脑海中酝酿成形。

groups.name: Conciliate & Placate Disaffected Parties · 抚慰安抚与绥靖退让 (Conciliate, Placate, Appease, Mollify)
groups.tip: 抚慰情绪以促成各方和解

items.def_en: To prevent conflict by granting the urgent demands or concessions insisted upon by an aggressive opponent.
To make someone less angry, hostile, or aggrieved by performing a kind act or conceding a point.
To soften the temper or reduce the severity of someone's anger or anxiety.
To end disagreement or make someone less angry by being pleasant or by making concessions.
To win or regain the favor of an aggrieved person, authority, or deity by showing submission or offering amends.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on mitigating hostility, outrage, or indignation through psychological soothing, gracious concessions, or strategic appeasement, shifting the opposing party from angry defiance to calm cooperation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过示好、倾听让步或抚平敌意，缓和对方怒火与对立情绪。

groups.name: Conclude & Cut Off Debate · 终止议程与辩论 (Adjourn, Table, Prorogue)
groups.tip: 正式终止对话或让行动告终

items.def_zh: 搁置（美）/ 提请审议（英）
items.def_en: (US) To postpone indefinitely consideration of a legislative motion or proposal
1. (politics / parliamentary) To end a debate formally by calling for an immediate vote.
To pause or end a meeting or legal proceeding until a later scheduled time
(British parliamentary) To fix a strict time limit on debate for a bill, forcing an immediate vote
(formal) To discontinue a parliamentary session by royal or executive prerogative without dissolution

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal procedural actions used in deliberative assemblies, committees, or formal debates to curtail discussion, postpone motions, or dissolve sessions. They are characterized by strict parliamentary authority.
groups.summary_zh: 指在议会或正式会议中行使程序性权力中止辩论或休会。

groups.name: Condemn & Doom · 判决与注定落败 (Doom, Destine, Condemn)
groups.tip: 权威判决引向注定的厄运

items.def_en: (usually passive, + to/for) To intend or predeterminedly fix someone for a particular fate
(+ to) To officially state in a court of law what someone's punishment will be
(+ to) To declare someone guilty or force someone inevitably into an unpleasant condition

items.def_zh: 注定（失败、受苦、灭亡等）；判定，判决
items.def_en: (usually passive) To make someone or something certain to fail, suffer, or die.

items.def_zh: 使永远受折磨；彻底毁掉
items.def_en: To consign to eternal punishment, ruin, or inescapable disgrace

groups.summary_en: Involves consigning individuals or projects inevitably to ruin, suffering, failure, or death. Distinguishes fatalistic inevitability from judicial or formal moral condemnation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人、事物无可挽回地判决或注定推向失败、毁灭或苦难的境地。

groups.name: Condescend & Deign · 屈尊与俯就 (Condescend, Stoop, Vouchsafe)
groups.tip: 放下身段屈尊纡贵去行动

items.def_zh: 屈尊，俯就，放下面子（做某事）
items.def_en: (+ to do) (disapproving) to agree to do something that you consider beneath your dignity or social position.
(+ to do) to behave in a manner perceived as degrading to one's self-respect or status
(+ to do) to agree to do something beneath one's dignity or social position, often with conscious superiority
to give, reveal, or grant something graciously or condescendingly to someone viewed as inferior
(+ to) to lower one's moral standards or dignity far enough to perform an unworthy act

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering oneself socially or morally to perform an action deemed beneath one's rank, pride, or dignity, often patronizingly.
groups.summary_zh: 指自居尊贵而放下身段、纡尊降贵或屈就做下情之事。

groups.name: Confect & Candy · 糖渍与蜜制 (Candy, Crystallize, Glacé)
groups.tip: 在物体外表涂抹糖衣或防护层

items.def_en: To coat, dust, or preserve food with granulated sugar or sweet syrup

items.def_zh: 用糖煮，把……做成蜜饯；（表面）结晶为砂糖
items.def_en: to cook or coat fruit or food in sugar or sugar syrup, or to become encrusted with sugar
To soak fruit repeatedly in concentrated syrup so it becomes tender, translucent, and glossy

items.def_zh: 渍制（在糖浆或油脂中慢烹慢浸）
items.def_en: To cook and preserve food slowly immersed in rich syrup or fat over extended heat
To preserve fruit or edible blossoms by coating or impregnating them with crystalline sugar

groups.summary_en: This culinary preservation frame relates to steeping, boiling, or coating fruits, nuts, or edible flowers in dense sugar syrup until they absorb the sweet solution and become encrusted or preserved.
groups.summary_zh: 指用浓缩糖浆浸渍、熬制或在表面结晶包衣，制成果脯或糖果。

groups.name: Confer Nobility & Monarchy · 封爵与加冕 (Crown, Knight, Ennoble)
groups.tip: 授予王位勋衔与荣誉

items.def_zh: 为……加冕；使圆满，使达到顶峰
items.def_en: 1. To officially place a crown on someone's head in a royal ceremony, making them monarch. 2. To complete or make something perfect or successful.

items.def_zh: 封……为爵士，授以骑士爵位
items.def_en: To bestow knighthood upon someone in an official ceremony.
to confer knighthood upon someone by tapping their shoulders with a sword
to apply oil to someone in a religious ceremony as a divine sign of consecration to monarchy or high office
to confer a peerage or noble rank upon someone

groups.summary_en: This frame covers formal, ritualistic acts of bestowing royal status, a title of nobility, or knighthood upon an individual in a monarchical governance context. The verbs take the recipient person as the direct object.
groups.summary_zh: 君主制仪式中授予君权、爵位或骑士称号等贵族特权的行为。

groups.name: Confess & Absolve · 忏悔告解与赦罪 (Shrive, Absolve, Remit)
groups.tip: 宗教或道德上的宽恕与赦罪

items.def_en: To tell a priest all of one's sins in the sacrament of penance
To cancel or refrain from exacting a penalty or sin in an authoritative capacity
To state formally in a religious or legal setting that someone is free from guilt, blame, or sin

items.def_zh: 听取告解并给予赦免，忏悔（动词shrive的过去式）
items.def_en: (Archaic) Past tense of shrive; heard confession and granted absolution to.
To hear the confession of, impose penance on, and give absolution to a penitent

groups.summary_en: This religious and sacramental frame denotes hearing a penitent's confession, administering penance, and pronouncing divine release or forgiveness from sins.
groups.summary_zh: 专指宗教语境中听取信徒忏悔并授予赦罪、免除罪责。

groups.name: Confide & Disclose · 倾诉与吐露 (Unburden, Disclose, Pour out)
groups.tip: 向信任之人袒露心声秘密

items.def_en: (+ to) Speak candidly about one's intimate feelings or personal past
Make secret or hidden personal information known to another person
To share private thoughts, feelings, or secrets with someone because you trust them.

items.def_zh: 倾吐（心事）；卸下（心理负担）
items.def_en: (+ oneself/mind to) Relieve oneself of a burden by talking about one's troubles or secrets
Freely and copiously express thoughts, worries, or emotions to someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote revealing private vulnerabilities, intimate thoughts, or closely guarded secrets to someone trusted. They range from formal disclosures of concealed information to emotional outpourings of distress.
groups.summary_zh: 强调出于信任或宣泄需要，向人吐露私密心声、秘密或苦衷。

groups.name: Confine & Localize · 局限与圈定 (Localize, Contain, Circumscribe)
groups.tip: 限制在特定局部范围

items.def_en: To keep something harmful, such as a fire, virus, or hostile movement, within limits and prevent it from spreading
To surround someone or something closely so that movement or expansion is impossible
To restrict someone or something within designated borders, limits, or parameters

items.def_zh: 将…限制在局部；确定…的发生位置；使本土化
items.def_en: 1. To confine or restrict something, such as an infection or conflict, to a specific area. 2. To find the exact place or origin of something. 3. To adapt a product or service for a particular local market.
To draw a line around something or strictly limit its range, power, or operational scope

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict deliberate boundaries placed around a problem, disease, or influence to keep it within a narrow, defined spatial area.
groups.summary_zh: 将危害、疾病或活动圈定在局部狭小范围之内。

groups.name: Congratulate & Commend · 道贺与嘉许 (Congratulate, Felicitate, Applaud)
groups.tip: 对喜人成果表达赞许与贺意

items.def_en: To offer formal congratulations to someone on a happy occasion or achievement

items.def_zh: 轻拍后背表扬；赞赏鼓勵
items.def_en: To praise, acknowledge, or show warm appreciation to someone for doing a job well
To tell someone that you are pleased about their success, good luck, or happiness.
To express strong, public approval and admiration for someone's decision or action

items.def_zh: 表彰；赞许（上级或官方褒奖）
items.def_en: To officially praise someone for an exceptional deed, service, or standard of conduct

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on interpersonal communicative acts expressing personal delight, official recognition, or shared happiness toward someone regarding their notable achievement or good fortune.
groups.summary_zh: 针对他人取得的成就或吉事，向其当面表达喜悦祝贺与嘉许。

groups.name: Congregate & Swarm · 群聚与汇聚 (Congregate, Flop, Swarm)
groups.tip: 群体向某一处聚拢集合

items.def_en: (of fish) To swim together in a disciplined, coordinated group
To move or go together in large crowds to a specific destination
To move or gather in large numbers like insects, fish, or a crowd
1. (of fish) To gather and swim together in a large group. 2. (of water) To become shallower.
To gather together in large numbers in a particular location

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts animals or organisms assembling and moving collectively in large groups, shoals, flocks, or swarms across physical spaces.
groups.summary_zh: 指动物、水生生物或人群大量群聚、成群移动或扎堆活动。

groups.name: Conjecture & Infer on Gaps · 揣摩与凭据推测 (Conjecture, Surmise, Deduce)
groups.tip: 根据零星线索推理假设

items.def_en: To venture or dare to offer a guess despite knowing one may well be wrong
To form opinions about what might happen or what is true without firm knowledge
To form an opinion or conclusion based on incomplete evidence or guesswork.
To deduce or conclude something from implicit evidence and reasoning rather than explicit statements
To suppose that something is true without having certain confirming evidence

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forming conclusions or opinions when facts are incomplete, ranging from intuitive guesses to reasoned extrapolations.
groups.summary_zh: 在证据不足或存在盲区时，结合线索做出推断或揣度。

groups.name: Connect & Join · 连接与结合 (Link, Connect, Couple)
groups.tip: 将两端物体关联接通一体

items.def_zh: 连接，结合；关联，建立联系
items.def_en: 1. To connect, join, or fasten two or more things together physically. 2. To make or show a connection between two people, things, or ideas.
To fasten, unite, or bring two pieces together so they become one
(usually passive + with) To join, link, or combine two elements closely
(+ to/with) To join together two or more things physically or logically
To attach, connect, or plug electronic or mechanical components into a system

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physical or conceptual interconnection where two or more distinct entities are brought together, united, or interrelated into a functional whole.
groups.summary_zh: 指将两个或多个物理实体或抽象概念连接结合在一起。

groups.name: Conspire & Connive · 共谋与纵容 (Connive, Collude, Scheme)
groups.tip: 暗中串通策划或默许勾结

items.def_en: To pretend not to notice improper or illegal conduct, thereby implicitly allowing it
To make clever, underhanded secret plans, especially to deceive or gain advantage

items.def_zh: 共谋，暗中勾结；纵容，默许
items.def_en: 1. To secretly plot or conspire with someone to do something wrongful or illegal. 2. ('connive at') To ignore or turn a blind eye to wrongdoing.
(+ with/against) To secretly plan with other people to carry out an unlawful or harmful act
(+ with) To work together secretly with someone in order to achieve an illicit or deceitful purpose

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with covert, illicit cooperation or culpable inaction, in which parties secretly plan illegal deeds or turn a blind eye to wrongdoing, compromising moral or legal standards.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中串通策划不法行为，或明知违法犯罪而故意纵容、视而不见。

groups.name: Construe & Analyze Meaning · 解读与推定意图 (Take, Decipher, Read into)
groups.tip: 赋予深层含义与理解

items.def_en: (+ as/to be) To understand or interpret a remark, action, or person in a specified way

items.def_zh: 理解，领会，阐释；作句法分析
items.def_en: 1. (+ as) (formal) To understand or explain the meaning of words, actions, or events in a particular way. 2. (grammar) To analyze the syntax of a sentence.
To analyze text or behavior component by component to determine its structural or latent meaning
To attribute more meaning, intention, or significance to something than is warranted by the facts
To succeed in reading, decoding, or understanding something encoded, messy, or obscure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on inferring, parsing, or assigning a specific intention or semantic meaning to actions, texts, or ambiguous conduct. Nuances range from legal deduction to subjective projection.
groups.summary_zh: 从言行或文本中推论、剖析并赋予特定意图或含义。

groups.name: Contact & Reach · 联络与触达 (Reach, Get hold of, Ring)
groups.tip: 设法通过各种渠道取得联系

items.def_en: To successfully communicate with someone by phone, letter, or email
To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or sending a message.
To manage to find or contact someone, often after some effort
(+ with) To initiate contact or establish communication with another person
(+ to) To make an effort to communicate with someone for help, cooperation, or networking

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the act of initiating communication with an individual or party across distance via phone, messaging, or written correspondence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过电话、信息或书面形式主动联系或寻找某人。

groups.name: Contemptuous Rejection · 鄙弃与蔑绝 (Spurn, Scorn, Disdain)
groups.tip: 从单纯拒绝递进至傲慢唾弃摒绝

items.def_en: To dismiss or reject someone or their suggestions curtly and rudely
To refuse to do something because of feelings of superiority or contempt
To deliberately insult, ignore, or cold-shoulder an invitation, overture, or person
To reject a person, offer, or idea with disdain or contempt.
To refuse or reject something contemptuously as beneath one's dignity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this high-intensity frame describe refusing an advance, offer, proposal, or person with haughty disdain, contempt, or mockery. Nuances emphasize emotional revulsion, haughty rejection, or cold derision rather than polite denial.
groups.summary_zh: 强调带着傲慢、不屑、鄙夷或厌恶的强烈情绪断然拒绝。

groups.name: Contest & Dispute · 提出异议与抗辩 (Dispute, Contest, Challenge)
groups.tip: 围绕观点分歧展开激烈交锋

items.def_zh: 对……表示强烈反对；对……有异议
items.def_en: To disagree strongly with a specific opinion, claim, or action
To call into question the truth, validity, or legality of a view or assertion
To formally oppose, question, or assert defense against a decision, election, or statement
1. To question the truth, validity, or authority of something. 2. To argue or disagree strongly with someone about something.
To declare a statement or fact to be untrue; to oppose or speak against

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve actively challenging the truth, validity, fairness, or authority of a claim, result, or decision through formal opposition or sharp intellectual contention.
groups.summary_zh: 指对某项声明、裁决或权力的真实性、有效性提出质疑或抗辩。

groups.name: Convene & Deliberate · 集会与党团商议 (Convene, Confer, Assemble)
groups.tip: 党派骨干闭门集会商定策略

items.def_en: to gather together in one place as a unified body for a specific purpose
(+ with) to discuss something with someone in order to reach a decision or exchange ideas
to call together or gather for a formal meeting or assembly

items.def_zh: 召开党团会议，集会商讨策略
items.def_en: (chiefly US politics) to meet privately with members of a political party to choose candidates or decide on policy
to gather closely together in a private group to confer or plan tactics

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this political and governance frame depict gathering formal groups, party members, or committees to deliberate policy, negotiate strategy, or select leaders.
groups.summary_zh: 指政党代表或委员会正式聚集、协商策略与研拟方针。

groups.name: Converse & Speak Together · 交谈与对话 (Talk, Converse, Chat)
groups.tip: 双方或多人互动交流探讨

items.def_en: To say words in speech; to have a conversation or discuss a matter with someone.
(+ to/with) To articulate sounds and words, or hold dialogue with another person
(+ with/to) To talk in a friendly, relaxed, and informal manner
(+ on/upon) To speak authoritatively, formally, or at considerable length on a subject
(+ with) To engage in formal or extended spoken conversation with someone

groups.summary_en: This broad frame covers oral linguistic communication between two or more individuals exchanging thoughts, remarks, or updates interactively.
groups.summary_zh: 指两人及以上之间面对面或远程进行的口头言语交流、交谈与探讨。

groups.name: Convert & React · 化学转化与反应 (Acidify, Oxidize, Polymerize)
groups.tip: 化学处理促成质变转化

items.def_en: To make or become acidic by treating with an acid or increasing hydrogen ion concentration
(chemistry) To treat or combine a substance with nitric acid or introduce a nitro group into a chemical compound.
To combine with oxygen or lose electrons during a chemical reaction
To treat or combine a substance or water supply with chlorine
To treat an organic compound with hydrogen to introduce hydrogen atoms into the molecule

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized chemical domain describe treating substances to alter their molecular composition, bind functional groups, or induce specific chemical transformations.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过添加试剂、引入特定基团以改变物质分子结构的化学处理过程。

groups.name: Convey & Express · 表达与传达 (Express, Communicate, Impart, Put across)
groups.tip: 传递思想情感或意图

items.def_en: to show or tell what one feels or thinks using words, looks, or actions
to successfully share or exchange information, opinions, or ideas with someone
to explain an idea or message in a way that is clearly understood by others
1. to express or communicate a thought, feeling, or idea so that it is understood by others. 2. (formal) to transport or carry someone or something from one place to another
to communicate information, knowledge, or a distinctive quality to someone or something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify transmitting thoughts, meaning, emotional tone, or signals from one person to another across language, signs, or artistic media.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过语言、神态、媒介或作品将思想、感受、信息准确传递给受众。

groups.name: Convey & Transmit Info · 传达与沟通 (Communicate, Convey, Transmit)
groups.tip: 双方互通信息与思想

items.def_zh: 交流，沟通；传达，传递；传染
items.def_en: 1. To share or exchange information, ideas, or feelings. 2. To pass a message, emotion, or disease to another person.

items.def_zh: 播送，发送，传递（信号、信息）
items.def_en: To send or forward an electrical signal, message, or piece of data across a medium

items.def_zh: 传达，表达（思想、情感、含义）
items.def_en: To communicate or make an idea, feeling, or impression known and comprehensible to someone
To bestow, pass on, or disclose information, knowledge, or a specific quality to others
(+ with) To establish and maintain mutual communication to ensure close operational cooperation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to transmitting ideas, data, impressions, or emotional states across people or channels, ensuring understanding or connection.
groups.summary_zh: 指思想、消息、情感或信号在人际、媒介间的传达、传递与交互沟通。

groups.name: Convey & Transmit Signals · 传导与发信 (Transmit, Broadcast, Beam)
groups.tip: 中转信源并准确表达传达意图

items.def_en: To send out radio or television programs or signals over an area
To transmit a radio signal or light beam in a specific direction

items.def_zh: 通过线路传输（音频/数据）
items.def_en: (+ to/into) To send signals, sound, or data through cables or direct connections

items.def_zh: 传递，转达；传导（光、热、声音等）；播送，发送（信号）；传染（疾病）
items.def_en: 1. To send out electronic signals, messages, or broadcasts. 2. To pass information, beliefs, or disease from one person or thing to another. 3. To allow heat, light, or sound to pass through.
To send out rays of light, heat, or electromagnetic energy in all directions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe emission and propagation of electromagnetic signals, electronic data, light waves, or contagions through a medium or space.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理媒介或电磁波辐射发出信号、广播或散播病原。

groups.name: Convince & Sway · 说服与使信服 (Convince, Sway, Assure)
groups.tip: 通过摆事实讲道理令人信服

items.def_en: 1. To persuade someone to do something. 2. To make someone believe that something is true.
Free someone from doubt by supplying adequate evidence or satisfying explanations
Tell someone positively and confidently in order to dispel their lingering anxiety or doubt
Persuade someone who initially opposed you to support or agree with you
Influence someone's mind or opinion so that they change their allegiance or judgment

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights bringing someone into a state of firm intellectual or emotional belief, overcoming their doubts, skepticism, or reluctance through sound arguments or conclusive evidence.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重消除疑虑，以论据或事实使人在思想认知上完全信服。

groups.name: Convoy & Shield · 护航与编队保护 (Convoy, Flank, Screen)
groups.tip: 结队伴随保护安全通行

items.def_en: Protect or shield a main body of troops, warships, or transports by forming an outer defensive line
Protect someone or something from danger, harm, attack, or exposure by placing oneself in between

items.def_zh: 领航护送；集中护送指引
items.def_en: Guide or direct a group of people, ships, or vehicles carefully and protectively
Be positioned or move along the sides of someone or something, often for protection or support
1. To travel with and protect a group of ships, vehicles, or travelers on a journey.

groups.summary_en: Involves accompanying multiple vessels, vehicles, or transport groups with armed or specialized protection to repel hostile attacks or hazards along a dangerous transit.
groups.summary_zh: 专指为车队、船队或要员编队护航、警戒并阻挡侧翼威胁。

groups.name: Cool Down & Chill · 冷却与降温 (Cool, Chill, Refrigerate)
groups.tip: 通过降温使其变凉

items.def_en: To become cooler in temperature, or to calm down after anger or excitement

items.def_zh: （使）冷却，（使）降温；（使）冷静，（使）平息
items.def_en: 1. To become or make something lower in temperature. 2. To become or make someone calmer, less enthusiastic, or less angry.
To make something cold or cooler without freezing it, or to become cold
To keep food, drink, or medicine cold in a refrigerator to preserve it

items.def_zh: 淬火；迅速冷却（灼热物体）
items.def_en: To cool hot metal or material rapidly by plunging it into liquid

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering the physical temperature of an object or substance, or metaphorically calming down heightened emotion or activity. They range from natural thermal dissipation to artificial refrigeration.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体温度下降或使之变凉，亦引申指情绪或局势平息降温。

groups.name: Coordinate & Harmonize · 协调与调控 (Synchronize, Liaise, Orchestrate)
groups.tip: 协调各方以促进合作

items.def_en: 1. To organize different people, groups, or activities so that they work together efficiently and effectively.
(+ with) To fit together or harmonize smoothly like interlocking gear wheels
To plan and organize a complicated campaign or event smoothly and strategically
To cause distinct actions, events, or mechanisms to occur at the same time or rate
(+ with/between) To act as a bridge between groups to exchange information and align efforts

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing separate actors, operational processes, or schedules into alignment so they function smoothly as a unified whole. It ranges from basic inter-departmental communication to complex tactical synchronization.
groups.summary_zh: 指调解、沟通各方行动与资源，使其协调一致、顺畅运转。

groups.name: Cork & Suppress · 堵塞与压抑 (Plug, Bung, Bottle up)
groups.tip: 塞紧开口防止漏出

items.def_zh: 用软木塞封（瓶等）；抑制，克制（感情等）
items.def_en: 1. To close or seal a bottle tightly with a cork. 2. (cork up) To suppress or hold back strong feelings or emotions.
To block or close an opening completely by pressing something firmly into it
To close or seal a receptacle, cask, or opening tightly using a large stopper

items.def_zh: 隐忍不发，强行抑制（情绪）
items.def_en: To refuse to express feelings such as anger, sorrow, or anxiety, keeping them tightly repressed inside

items.def_zh: 强行咽下，忍住（泪水或言语）
items.def_en: To struggle hard to stop oneself from showing strong emotion, speaking, or weeping

groups.summary_en: This frame describes physically inserting a stopper or plug into an aperture to close it, extended metaphorically to containing or suppressing pent-up emotions.
groups.summary_zh: 指塞住孔道瓶口进行封口，亦引申指压抑抑制情绪或言语。

groups.name: Correct & Disabuse · 破除迷思与启蒙辟谣 (Disillusion, Undeceive, Set Straight)
groups.tip: 指出真相消除对方错误观念

items.def_zh: 纠正…的错误看法；跟…讲明真相
items.def_en: To correct someone's misunderstanding or mistaken impression by telling them the truth

items.def_zh: 使不受蒙蔽；为…澄清真相
items.def_en: To tell someone the truth and free them from an erroneous deception or assumption
To make a difficult or mysterious subject clear, accessible, and free of misconception

items.def_zh: 使省悟，消除……的错误观念
items.def_en: 1. ('disabuse someone of') (formal) To persuade someone that a belief or idea they hold is false or mistaken.
To free someone from an illusion or naive ideal, often causing disappointment

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes liberating someone from a false belief, cherished misconception, or persistent illusion through targeted factual correction or candid disclosure.
groups.summary_zh: 指点迷津，破除他人的错误认识、幻觉或成见以澄清事实真相。

groups.name: Correct & Rectify · 纠正与纠偏 (Amend, Remedy, Put Right)
groups.tip: 改正偏颇错漏，回归正轨与标准

items.def_en: To restore something to its proper upright position, order, or state of correctness
To make something right, accurate, or standard by removing errors or defects
To fix a mistake, breakdown, or problem so that normal function is restored
To alter a document, text, or statement slightly in order to correct or improve it
1. (formal) To correct a mistake, fault, or unfair situation.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to bringing an error, flaw, calculation mistake, or physical alignment back to a proper, accurate, or standard state through deliberate operational adjustments.
groups.summary_zh: 通过操作性调整纠正错误、改正偏差或使之恢复准确标准状态。

groups.name: Correlate & Relate · 关联与相关 (Connect, Link, Tie in)
groups.tip: 理清事物间的对应相关性

items.def_en: Make, suggest, or demonstrate a causal or thematic connection between two things
Connect someone or something in one's mind with another concept or condition
Join or see two ideas, events, or facts as having a direct relationship

items.def_zh: 使结合，与……保持一致/紧密联系
items.def_en: (+ with) Align closely, match, or link smoothly with another fact, plan, or piece of information
To have a mutual relationship or connection, or to show that two things are related to each other.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote establishing, demonstrating, or possessing a systematic statistical, cognitive, or causal relationship between two or more variables, observations, or facts.
groups.summary_zh: 表示变量、现象或认知概念之间存在逻辑或统计上的相互关联。

groups.name: Counteract & Balance · 抵消与中和 (Counteract, Counterbalance, Offset)
groups.tip: 力量正负相抵，化解原有作用

items.def_en: To balance one influence or cost against an opposing one so an equilibrium is kept.
To lessen the impact of a shock or maintain chemical stability against abrupt changes.
To act in opposition to something in order to reduce or eliminate its negative effect.
To balance or neutralize the weight or impact of something by exerting equal opposite force.

items.def_zh: 抵消，使中和；使失效，解除威胁
items.def_en: 1. (British English) To stop something from having any effect or causing damage; to counteract or neutralize.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate chemical or functional interaction where opposing forces, properties, or compounds act upon each other so that the net harmful or potent effect is cancelled out.
groups.summary_zh: 通过施加相反特性或力量以中和毒性、酸碱或不良效应。

groups.name: Counteract & Offset · 抗衡与抵消 (Counteract, Offset, Counterbalance)
groups.tip: 施加反向力量以求制衡抵消

items.def_en: To have an equal but opposite effect to something so that the final result is zero
To balance the effect of something with an equal, opposite quality or amount
To act against something in order to reduce its force or neutralize its bad effects
To act with equal power or importance against something else so neither dominates
1. (formal) To act against an opposing force or influence with equal strength so as to offset or counterbalance its effect.

groups.summary_en: Highlights exerting an opposing force, influence, or positive weight against another to neutralize or equalize its effect.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过施加反向作用力或同等权重来中和、平衡或抵消负面影响。

groups.name: Court & Solicit Favor · 拉拢与讨好 (Woo, Court, Solicit)
groups.tip: 主动示好以争取支持或选票

items.def_zh: 讨好，争取……的支持；献殷勤
items.def_en: To deliberately seek the favor, approval, or cooperation of someone, especially in public or political life

items.def_zh: 恳请，索求（选票、赞助、支持）
items.def_en: To formally ask for or try to obtain something from someone, such as votes, money, or help
To gently and persistently persuade someone to do something through patience and flattery
(+ with) To ingratiate oneself with an influential figure through flattery or servile behavior

items.def_zh: 争取……的支持，拉拢；求爱，追求
items.def_en: 1. To try to gain the support, votes, or custom of someone. 2. (literary or old-fashioned) To try to persuade someone to marry or enter into a relationship.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures intentional, flattering, or persistent actions designed to win over someone's political support, business partnership, or affection.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动示好、游说或迎合以争取选民、客户或关键人物支持与青睐。

groups.name: Covenant & Contract · 承诺与立约 (Covenant, Contract, Stipulate)
groups.tip: 契约或誓约情境下的庄严承诺

items.def_zh: 立约订立合同，以协议承诺
items.def_en: To enter into a formal, legally enforceable mutual agreement to perform specified duties
To form an explicit treaty, alliance, or formal agreement between parties

items.def_zh: 缔结（契约/条约），签署参与
items.def_en: To formally bind oneself by signing or engaging in a legal contract, agreement, or alliance
To enter into a solemn, formal, and legally binding agreement or contract.

items.def_zh: 在协议中明文规定，约定
items.def_en: To lay down or demand a specific condition as an essential requirement in an agreement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal and institutional frame denote establishing formal, legally enforceable pacts, charters, or solemn bilateral covenants.
groups.summary_zh: 订立正式契约、公约或具有法律约束力的双边协议。

groups.name: Cover with Blood · 染血与血渍 (Gore, Bloody, Besmear)
groups.tip: 染上污渍破坏洁净

items.def_zh: 玷污，使留下血印或污迹
items.def_en: To leave a persistent colored mark such as blood on clothing, skin, or fabric
To stain or smear with blood, especially to initiate hunting hounds or soldiers into combat

items.def_zh: 沾上血迹，用血弄脏；使流血，打伤
items.def_en: 1. To cover or stain something with blood. 2. To cause someone to bleed, especially by wounding them.
To thoroughly wet or drench something through with a liquid such as blood

items.def_zh: 刺伤，扎破（尤指被角顶伤流血）
items.def_en: To pierce or wound someone deeply with a horn or tusk, causing bloody injury

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify causing physical wounding or staining surfaces and bodies directly with blood, carrying strong visceral and violent overtones.
groups.summary_zh: 指伤及皮肉使之出血，或用鲜血浸透、染污人体与物件。

groups.name: Crack & Fracture · 开裂与断裂 (Crack, Fracture, Fissure)
groups.tip: 受力产生细微裂痕直至碎裂

items.def_zh: （使）破裂，（使）开裂；（使）发出爆裂声；破译
items.def_en:
1. to break without dividing into separate parts, or to cause a surface to show lines of fracture
2. to make a sharp, snapping sound
To break or cause something to break, crack, or split, especially a hard object or bone
To split or crack into long, deep, narrow openings, physically or metaphorically
To suddenly break with a sharp, cracking sound, especially under tension
To split or sever something cleanly and sharply, especially along a natural grain or line

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical materials or institutional structures splitting, developing surface fissures, or breaking without necessarily shattering entirely.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及物体或抽象关系在压力下开裂、断裂或出现缝隙的过程。

groups.name: Crash & Collide · 撞击与坠毁 (Crash, Collide, Smash)
groups.tip: 剧烈猛撞导致损毁

items.def_en: To collide forcefully with something while moving forward relentlessly with high momentum
to hit something violently and cause damage or noise; to lose control and collide with another object
(+ into) To violently hit, break into pieces, or shatter against a hard barrier
To deliberately or forcefully drive or push an object into something else
(+ with) To hit something or someone with serious impact while moving

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict high-energy, violent physical impacts involving vehicles, objects, or surfaces that result in severe force, noise, or wreckage.
groups.summary_zh: 表示物体或交通工具间发生的高速剧烈撞击、破坏及毁损。

groups.name: Crawl & Inching · 蜗行与慢爬 (Inched, Plod, Creep)
groups.tip: 像蜗牛般极其缓慢挪步

items.def_en: 1. To move along extremely slowly like a snail.
To move forward very slowly and carefully in tiny increments or short stages
To advance at an imperceptibly slow pace, often silently or close to the ground
To move along the ground on hands and knees, or advance at an exasperatingly slow speed

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地走；蹒跚而行
items.def_en: To walk slowly and heavily with prolonged effort, as if weighed down or exhausted

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forward motion characterized by extreme sluggishness, reluctant progress, or advancing infinitesimally like a snail. While 'inch' signifies microscopic linear progress, 'creep' conveys hushed slowness, and 'plod' stresses heavy, weary trudging.
groups.summary_zh: 指以极度缓慢、滞重或寸进的方式吃力前行或爬行。

groups.name: Craze & Web-crack · 龟裂与网裂 (Alligator, Craze, Check)
groups.tip: 受力或老化开裂，表面出现裂纹

items.def_en: To develop small surface cracks, especially in seasoned wood or dried coatings

items.def_zh: （釉面、塑料等）出现细碎网纹/龟裂
items.def_en: To produce a network of fine cracks on the surface of pottery, glaze, or plastic
To rub off or degrade unevenly in fine surface fragments

items.def_zh: （油漆、涂层等）龟裂，开裂成鳄皮状
items.def_en: (of paint, varnish, or asphalt) To crack into a rough pattern resembling alligator skin.
To form or show a network of wrinkles or cracks, as in photo film emulsions

groups.summary_en: Verbs here specialize in surfaces such as paint, ceramics, asphalt, or timber developing complex networks of fine surface cracks resembling mesh or scales.
groups.summary_zh: 油漆、陶瓷或沥青表面老化出现网状龟裂纹。

groups.name: Critique & Denounce · 痛斥与斥责 (Deplore, Lament, Rail)
groups.tip: 对恶劣行径深表痛惜与道德谴责

items.def_en: To complain angrily and bitterly, loudly protesting against perceived injustice or absurdity

items.def_zh: 严厉声讨，电闪雷鸣般指责
items.def_en: To issue a fiery and vehement protest or verbal attack against an authority or practice
To express deep sorrow, regret, or discontent publicly about an unfortunate situation

items.def_zh: 谴责，对……深表愤慨；痛惜，对……深感遗憾
items.def_en: To strongly disapprove of and criticize something morally unacceptable, or feel deep regret about something.
To criticize a person or institution with scathing, blistering, and unrelenting severity

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on expressing profound grievance, righteous aversion, and bitter disapproval toward regrettable conditions, policies, or injustices.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对不公或恶劣局势的深切痛惜、憎恶与严正痛斥。

groups.name: Critique & Review · 评论与审评 (Critique, Review, Appraise, Assess)
groups.tip: 对作品或观点进行审视评议

items.def_en: To write an evaluative article expressing an informed opinion about a book, film, exhibition, or play
To find every tiny defect, contradiction, or mistake in an argument, creative work, or theory
To evaluate and review a book, artwork, theory, or performance critically.
To analyze or criticize a text, statement, or performance minutely in order to expose its flaws or structure
To carefully evaluate the quality, condition, or importance of a person, performance, or work

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on detailed, professional, and analytical evaluation of creative works, performances, or policies, pointing out both virtues and defects.
groups.summary_zh: 对艺术、学术作品或方案进行审读分析，作出专业性评判与优劣剖析。

groups.name: Cross & Traverse · 横越与跨越 (Traverse, Span, Ford)
groups.tip: 穿过区域或界限

items.def_en: To take a shorter, direct route across an area instead of going around

items.def_zh: 跨越，横跨（桥梁、时间或空间）
items.def_en: To extend across, over, or from one side of something to the other

items.def_zh: 穿过，越过，横渡；交叉，使相交
items.def_en: 1. To go or travel across a space, boundary, or obstacle. 2. To place or move one thing across another.
To cross a shallow body of water by wading or riding through it

items.def_zh: 横穿，穿越（险阻或大片地域）
items.def_en: To travel across or through a large or difficult expanse of land or water

groups.summary_en: Covers passing from one side of a surface, obstacle, or geographical area to the other. Distinctions center on terrain difficulty, the medium crossed, and whether one journeys across or physically bridges the expanse.
groups.summary_zh: 表示自一端越过至另一端，侧重地形介质、涉水或物理跨越。

groups.name: Cross & Traverse · 穿过与跨越 (Cross, Span, Traverse)
groups.tip: 横穿与走过广阔区域

items.def_en: Go from one side of a road, river, border, or area to the other
Extend or stretch across an entire space, distance, or body of water from margin to margin
Travel or move across the surface or top of a boundary or tract of land
Successfully travel across or journey over a tract of water, air, or land
(formal) To travel, move, or extend across or through an area of land or water.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote traveling or extending across the breadth of a physical territory, watercourse, barrier, or span of terrain from one side to the other.
groups.summary_zh: 指由一侧移动到另一侧，横跨或穿过广袤地形与界限。

groups.name: Crouch in Fear · 蜷缩震慑与俯首惊伏 (Cower, Flinch, Truckle)
groups.tip: 因恐惧而本能地蜷缩躲避

items.def_en: To lower one's body close to the ground with bent limbs to avoid detection or violence
(+ from) To draw back or fail to endure unpleasant confrontations or duties
(+ to) To act subserviently and yield submissively to an overbearing superior
To yield to daunting forces and show weakness or terror instead of resistance
To crouch down or shrink back in fear or distress from someone or something threatening.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this set evoke emotional yielding to intimidation, accompanied by crouching low, drawing away, or failing to hold one's ground against overwhelming authority.
groups.summary_zh: 突显遭受恐吓或威压时，心理屈服并做出蜷伏、避让或不敢正视的反应。

groups.name: Crowd & Throng · 簇拥与挤满 (Throng, Cram, Mob)
groups.tip: 人潮涌入扎堆挤满

items.def_en: 1. To gather together in large numbers, or to fill a place completely. 2. To push or force someone closely in an uncomfortable way.
(+ into) To fill a venue, room, or vehicle so full that there is little or no space left
(+ into) To push or squeeze people or things tightly into a space that is barely large enough
To fill or crowd into a place in extremely large, closely packed numbers
To crowd around someone in an unruly, enthusiastic, or aggressive mass

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray high-density gatherings where spaces are tightly filled, individuals press closely against each other, or eager masses overwhelm a space or figure.
groups.summary_zh: 指极高密度的人群挤满空间、涌上前来或簇拥围困某人。

groups.name: Crush & Mash · 压瘪与压碎 (Crush, Flatten, Trample)
groups.tip: 挤压受重力碎扁成饼

items.def_zh: 压扁，压碎；挤入，塞进；平息，镇压
items.def_en: 1. To crush or press something flat or out of shape. 2. (+ into) To push or squeeze into a small or crowded space. 3. To suppress, silence, or put a stop to a rumor, protest, or rebellion.
To bring something completely down or compress it flat against a surface by heavy impact
To compress a soft, moist item out of shape, often producing a damp squelching sound
To compress something with great force so that it is broken, flattened, or damaged
(+ on/down) To step on heavily and repeatedly, crushing and damaging beneath the feet

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights forceful, destructive compression that deforms, breaks down, or flattens an object out of its original shape.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加破坏性重压使物体变形、压瘪或碎裂毁坏。

groups.name: Crush & Mash · 捣烂与化泥 (Crush, Muddle, Puree)
groups.tip: 施重压捣烂成泥状

items.def_en: To lightly press and crush herbs or fruit with a pestle to release juices and essential oils
To crush food roughly into smaller textured pieces with flat force
(+ up) To crush food into a soft, smooth mass, especially using a fork or masher.
To process cooked food into a smooth, thick liquid or cream using a sieve or blender
To crush something soft completely into a wet, uniform mass

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on reducing soft, edible solids into a pulp, paste, or puree by methodical pressing, crushing, or blending with utensils.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用工具将较软食材压碎捣烂成泥状或糊状。

groups.name: Crystallize & Take Shape · 结晶与具体成型 (Crystallize, Take Shape, Coalesce)
groups.tip: 由液态变为固态或规则晶体

items.def_en: To form into grains, small particles, or crystal-like pellets
To develop into a definite, recognizable, or organized form
To become firmer like a jelly, or of ideas or teams, to come together successfully
To come together to form one larger, unified group, substance, or coherent system

items.def_zh: （使）结晶；（使）（想法、计划等）成形，明确化
items.def_en: 1. To form or cause to form solid crystals. 2. (of ideas, plans, or opinions) To become or make clear, definite, and concrete.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict atoms or molecules organizing into clear crystalline structures, and prominently extend to nebulous ideas, thoughts, or plans resolving into crisp, tangible, well-defined forms.
groups.summary_zh: 指物质形成晶体，亦喻指模糊想法清晰化、成型定相。

groups.name: Culinary Cutting & Cubing · 切分与切块 (Dice, Cube, Julienne)
groups.tip: 用刀切丁与细细切片

items.def_en: To cut food into pieces of roughly uniform size before cooking

items.def_zh: 切成小方块，切丁；掷骰子；冒险（dice with）
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To cut food such as vegetables or meat into small neat cubes. 2. (dice with) To take great, dangerous risks with something.
To cut food into distinct, uniform square-sided blocks that are larger than diced pieces
To cut vegetables or other foods into thin, matchstick-like strips
To cut or chop food into extremely tiny, fine pieces

groups.summary_en: This frame covers precise culinary techniques of cutting solid food items into specific geometric shapes—especially uniform cubes, sticks, or wedges. It highlights geometric precision and kitchen preparation rather than rough hacking or slicing.
groups.summary_zh: 指烹饪中将食材精准切削成方块、条状或规则几何形状的操作。

groups.name: Curl & Frizzle · 卷曲与焦卷 (Crisp, Frizz, Kink)
groups.tip: 受力产生卷曲或褶皱弯折

items.def_en: To form a sharp twist, curl, or bend in hair, wire, or a line
To form small, thin folds, ridges, or tightly curled ripples
To form or cause hair to form tight, wiry curls or fuzzy tufts

items.def_zh: （使）卷曲，（使）起褶；（油煎时发滋滋声并）炸焦，炸卷
items.def_en: 1. To form or cause hair or fiber to form tight, crisp curls. 2. To fry food until it sizzles, curls up, and becomes crisp.
To curl up or become brittle and rigid through heat or drying

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes where hair, fibers, or materials shrink, crimp, or twist tightly, often under the effect of heat, humidity, or chemical treatment.
groups.summary_zh: 指毛发或材质受热或潮湿后形成紧密卷曲或焦卷状态。

groups.name: Curse & Damn · 咒骂与诅咒 (Execrate, Condemn, Imprecate)
groups.tip: 用恶毒言语发泄愤怒咒骂

items.def_zh: 咒骂，诅咒；判处……下地狱；严厉批评，指责
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To express anger or frustration by cursing someone or something. 2. (in religion) To condemn someone to eternal punishment in hell. 3. To condemn, ruin, or heavily criticize something.
To call upon a supernatural power to inflict harm, suffering, or disaster upon someone
To express complete disapproval of someone or declare them doomed to a severe spiritual or fatal punishment
To formally invoke evil, disaster, or divine curses against someone
To feel or express intense loathing for, or to utter fierce curses against someone or something

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on invoking supernatural, eternal, or absolute ruin upon a target, condemning them spiritually or expressing scathing, virulent denunciation.
groups.summary_zh: 施加毁灭性诅咒、宣告神圣绝罚或表达强烈的唾弃与谴责。

groups.name: Curse & Hex · 施咒与下蛊 (Hex, Curse, Bewitch, Bedevil)
groups.tip: 施展巫术下蛊，念咒招致灾祸与不幸

items.def_en: To utter wishful harm or use magic power to bring disaster, illness, or perpetual misfortune upon someone
To chant or perform magic rituals that bring a targeted person under magical control or harm
To put a magic curse or evil spell on someone or something.
To cast a magical spell over someone, or control their mind and emotions through enchantment
To torment, harass, or plague persistently as if driven by demonic or sinister forces

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses invoking supernatural malice, incantations, or dark magic to inflict misfortune, illness, or harm upon a targeted victim.
groups.summary_zh: 施用黑魔法、巫术或恶咒，使特定目标遭受灾祸、疾病或厄运。

groups.name: Curse & Malign · 咒骂与咒怨 (Revile, Denounce, Rail)
groups.tip: 污言秽语发泄咒怨

items.def_en: To strongly criticize or accuse someone publicly, branding their conduct as wicked or shameful
To speak or write about someone or something with immense hostility and biting bitterness
To protest, scold, or complain against someone or something using angry, impassioned language

items.def_zh: 咒骂，辱骂；诅咒；使遭殃，折磨
items.def_en: 1. To use offensive words or profanities in anger. 2. To express a wish that evil, harm, or misfortune happen to someone. 3. (often passive) To cause someone continuous hardship, pain, or suffering.
To criticize someone in an abusive, furiously insulting, or venomous manner

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on aggressive verbal assaults aimed at degrading or defaming others through venomous tirades, sustained verbal abuse, and bitter recrimination.
groups.summary_zh: 通过恶毒抨击、公开辱骂或尖刻责难来宣泄怨恨与诋毁他人。

groups.name: Curse & Swear · 咒骂与粗口 (Cuss, Blaspheme, Exclaim)
groups.tip: 气极败坏口出恶言甚至诅咒

items.def_en: To direct crude insults and profanities verbally toward an individual or target
To utter offensive, angry expletives or swear words in response to a mishap or irritation
(informal) To use vulgar, offensive, or swear words, especially in irritation
1. (+ at) To use offensive, vulgar, or obscene language. 2. To make a solemn, formal promise or declare that something is true under oath.
To speak irreverently or profanely about sacred things or use religious terms as vulgar oaths

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the spontaneous or habitual utterance of crude, taboo, or profane language to vent acute emotion, frustration, or pain, distinguished from ritualized invocations of supernatural harm.
groups.summary_zh: 使用粗鄙、忌讳或侮辱性字眼宣泄愤怒、挫折与剧烈情绪。

groups.name: Curve & Arc · 弯曲与拱起 (Arc, Curve, Arch, Bow)
groups.tip: 轨迹或形体呈弧形

items.def_en: Form a smooth continuous bend or follow a rounded path
Bend into a curved shape under pressure or along its length

items.def_zh: 呈弧形移动；形成弧形，拱起；（电）产生电弧
items.def_en: to move, curve, or form into the shape of an arch or a curved line; to produce an electric arc
Curve smoothly into the shape of an arch or bridge
Form an arched or domed roof or curve high over an open space

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict moving along a curved trajectory or assuming a stationary convex, semicircular, or bowed contour.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体沿弯曲轨迹运动，或自身形成弧形、弓形姿态。

groups.name: Cushion & Dampen · 缓冲与减震 (Buffer, Soften, Dampen)
groups.tip: 加设缓冲垫防撞击

items.def_en: To take in and dissipate the force of a collision, shock, or liquid without shattering
(+ against/from) To protect someone or something from the harmful impact of a force or sudden change

items.def_zh: 起缓冲作用，减轻……的震动（或影响）；加垫褥于
items.def_en: 1. (+ against/from) To soften the force of a physical blow, or protect someone from the harsh impact of a shock or loss.
To make a physical blow, fall, or harsh emotional outcome less severe or devastating
To lessen or diminish the physical force, vibration, or intensity of a blow or shock

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote softening or mitigating the mechanical force of an impact, or shielding people and systems from the jarring consequences of shocks or setbacks.
groups.summary_zh: 减轻物理冲击碰撞，或削弱负面打击与震荡的影响。

groups.name: Customize & Tailor · 定制与按需调整 (Tailor, Adapt, Personalize)
groups.tip: 调整定制以改进原貌

items.def_en: To alter something slightly so that it fits a new purpose, user, or situation

items.def_zh: 个性化设计，赋予个人特色
items.def_en: To design, alter, or mark something so that it reflects someone's personal taste
To furnish, modify, or equip a room, vehicle, or vessel with custom equipment
To adapt, modify, or design something so it precisely meets someone's requirements

items.def_zh: 定制，按需制作，根据个人需要调整
items.def_en: To modify or build something to suit the specific needs or preferences of an individual or customer.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail adapting, reshaping, or personalizing goods, software, or services to match the unique criteria, preferences, or specifications of a user.
groups.summary_zh: 指依特定用户或需求改动、调制产品设计与功能，使其量身契合。

groups.name: Cycle & Treadle · 踩踏踏板与骑车 (Pedal, Cycle, Treadle)
groups.tip: 脚踏踏板驱动车辆前行

items.def_en: To travel or commute using a bicycle or tricycle
To ride or push a wheeled vehicle such as a bicycle across a surface
To ride a bicycle as recreation, sport, or daily transport
To operate or drive a bicycle, boat, or machine by pushing pedals with your feet.

items.def_zh: 踩踏板（操作缝纫机等工具）
items.def_en: To operate an engine, sewing machine, or loom by working a foot-operated lever rhythmically

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail propelling a vehicle or machine through the rhythmic human exertion of pushing foot pedals, ranging from riding traditional bicycles to operating foot-driven pedal machinery.
groups.summary_zh: 指双脚交替踩踏板以驱动自行车、小艇或脚踏机械向前行进或运转。

groups.name: Dabble & Toy With · 涉足与浅尝 (Toy, Dip Into, Meddle)
groups.tip: 抱着玩票心态浅尝辄止地涉猎

items.def_en: 1. (+ in/with) To take a casual, superficial interest in an activity or subject without serious commitment. 2. To splash hands or feet gently in water.
To read, study, or take part in something briefly and selectively

items.def_zh: 随便玩玩，漫不经心地对待
items.def_en: To engage with an idea, skill, or enterprise casually without firm commitment
(+ with) To make amateurish or experimental adjustments without structured expertise
(+ in/with) To interfere inappropriately in matters where one has neither right nor expertise

groups.summary_en: Describes participating in a field, hobby, or domain superficially or casually without professional discipline, deep devotion, or serious intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指非专业、浅尝辄止地涉足某一领域、爱好或事务。

groups.name: Dam & Embank Waterways · 阻挡与筑堤 (Dyke, Dam, Levee)
groups.tip: 筑起堤坝阻拦水流物料

items.def_en: To build a barrier across a river or stream to hold back or direct the flow of water
To enclose, confine, or protect a river, road, or low-lying land with a bank of earth or stone
To construct an earthen embankment along the edge of a river or waterway to prevent flooding

items.def_zh: 筑护堤；在…周围设拦泥堤
items.def_en: To construct an embankment or retaining wall around an area to contain fluid or soil run-off
1. (chiefly British) To enclose, defend, or protect land with a dyke or embankment.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote building civil engineering barriers, dikes, levees, and weirs to retain, divert, or block bodies of water, controlling floods or reclaiming submerged land.
groups.summary_zh: 修建堤坝或挡水墙阻隔水流、控制水位或防洪排涝。

groups.name: Dance & Groove · 舞动与跳舞 (Disco, Dance, Groove, Boogie)
groups.tip: 伴随节拍翩翩起舞摆动

items.def_en: (informal) To dance energetically and rhythmically to pop, rock, or dance music
(informal) To dance or move rhythmically and enjoyably along with popular music
1. (informal, dated) To dance to disco music, especially at a nightclub.
To dance fast, energetic swing or rock-and-roll dances
To dance with rapid circular or swirling movements of the hips and body

groups.summary_en: Pertains to rhythmic bodily movement executed to musical beats, particularly informal, club, or party dancing. 'Groove' and 'boogie' evoke spontaneous, rhythmic, and joyful movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指随节奏舞动身躯，尤指在派对或夜店随现代流行乐起舞。

groups.name: Dart & Pop Out · 突进与窜出 (Pop Up, Dart, Burst Out)
groups.tip: 迅雷不及掩耳窜出

items.def_en: Emerge or become visible suddenly and unexpectedly from a hidden or enclosed space

items.raw_cluster: 突然移动与跳出 Pop & Dart
items.def_zh: 突然出现，迅速窜出；突然蹦出；发出砰声
items.def_en: 1. To move, appear, or come out suddenly and unexpectedly. 2. To make or cause to make a short, sharp explosive sound.
Move rapidly or leap upward or forward in a single, sudden energetic motion
Move suddenly, rapidly, and abruptly in a specific direction
Rush, spring, or break out suddenly and forcefully from confinement or an enclosure

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes sudden, abrupt emergence or brisk springing motions, where a person or object appears, shoots out, or darts forth without warning.
groups.summary_zh: 指冷不防、出其不意地快速窜出或突兀显现。

groups.name: Data Transmission · 双工传输与信道传送 (Duplex, Multiplex, Channel)
groups.tip: 通信设备双向传送信号，交换数据指令

items.def_en: To direct signals, data, or electronic impulses along a particular path
To send or receive continuous audio or video data over a network in real time
To transmit multiple signals or messages simultaneously over a single channel
To send data packets or communication streams along a specific network path

items.def_zh: 进行双工通信（或传输）；双面打印
items.def_en: 1. (telecommunications) To transmit signals or data in both directions simultaneously. 2. (computing) To print on both sides of a sheet of paper.

groups.summary_en: Technical verbs describing the transmission, encoding, or routing of telecommunication and computing signals through bi-directional or shared pathways.
groups.summary_zh: 指通信与计算领域中信号或数据的通道化传输与复用。

groups.name: Date & Time Assign · 标注日期与确定时限 (Predate, Backdate, Timestamp)
groups.tip: 标记或推迟文书事件的具体日期

items.def_en: To assign a date earlier than the actual date, or to precede in chronological time
To record the precise date and time at which a digital event or transaction occurs
To exist, happen, or occur at a time earlier than someone or something else
To give a document or agreement a date that is earlier than the date it was signed

items.raw_cluster: 确定日期与计时 Date & Time
items.def_zh: 填迟……的日期；晚于，在……之后发生
items.def_en: 1. To write a date on a document, check, or letter that is later than the actual date. 2. To occur or exist at a later date than something else.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to recording, altering, or establishing a chronological date or time reference on formal instruments, events, or artifacts.
groups.summary_zh: 在文件或记录上注明、回溯或调整所生效的日期与时间。

groups.name: Daze & Bewilder · 使眩晕与使发昏 (Daze, Stupefy, Disorient)
groups.tip: 头昏眼花导致意识陷入模糊

items.def_en: To confuse or muddle someone's mind or senses
To make someone feel unsteady, confused, and as if everything is spinning.
To stun or confuse someone so they cannot think clearly, especially by a blow or shock

items.def_zh: 使迷失方向；使产生困惑
items.def_en: To make someone lose their sense of direction, spatial awareness, or clear bearings

items.def_zh: 使神志不清；使目瞪口呆
items.def_en: To make someone unable to think or feel clearly, especially through drugs, alcohol, or shock

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inducing a state of mental confusion, vertigo, or sensory disorientation, either through physical blows, overwhelming sensory stimuli, or dizzying complexity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过击打、感官过载或强烈冲击令人头晕目眩、感知错乱或不知所措。

groups.name: Dazzle & Overwhelm with Light · 耀眼夺目与使目眩 (Blind, Glare, Overwhelm)
groups.tip: 强光刺眼令人目眩神迷

items.def_zh: 以气势或光芒压倒；震撼
items.def_en: To overcome someone completely by an overpowering brilliance, sensory display, or emotional force
To shine with a harsh, uncomfortably bright and dazzling light

items.def_zh: 使目眩，使眩晕；使倾倒，使惊叹
items.def_en: 1. (of strong light) To blind someone temporarily. 2. To impress or enchant someone greatly with brilliance, beauty, or talent.
To thoroughly impress, confuse, or blind someone with brilliant light, charm, or splendor
To deprive someone temporarily or permanently of sight, especially by shining an overpowering light into their eyes

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intense illumination that overpowers vision or, figuratively, stuns an observer through brilliant talent, beauty, or spectacle. Nuances range from temporary sensory impairment to awe-inspiring showmanship.
groups.summary_zh: 以强烈光芒刺目致眩，或以卓越华彩震撼人心。

groups.name: Deactivate & Inhibit · 抑制与失活 (Inactivate, Deactivate, Inhibit)
groups.tip: 钝化使其丧失反应活性

items.def_zh: 关闭停止运转，使中止活动
items.def_en: To bring a machine, biological pathway, or facility to a complete cessation of operations

items.def_zh: 抑制（反应、生长或酶活性）
items.def_en: To slow down, impede, or completely block a chemical reaction or biological activity
To render an acid, toxin, virus, or weapon ineffective by countervailing action

items.def_zh: 停用，解除激活（装置或系统）
items.def_en: To cause a technical mechanism, security system, or chemical agent to become inactive

items.raw_cluster: 使停止与抑制 Deactivate & Inhibit
items.def_zh: 使失活，灭活；使丧失反应活性
items.def_en: To make an enzyme, virus, chemical substance, or device inactive or nonfunctional.

groups.summary_en: This scientific and technical frame involves disabling the functional activity, catalytic capacity, or active state of enzymes, pathogens, devices, or chemical agents.
groups.summary_zh: 通过生化或物理机制使生物活性、反应或功能终止。

groups.name: Deaden & Dull · 迟钝化与麻痹感觉 (Deaden, Dull, Numb, Muffle)
groups.tip: 削弱力量或钝化外界感官

items.def_zh: 使迟钝；减缓（痛感、注意力）
items.def_en: To make a pain, feeling, or edge less sharp, clear, or acute
To make an emotion, sensation, or sharp response weaker or less sharp
To make a sound quieter or less distinct, especially by wrapping or covering the source

items.def_zh: 减弱，缓和（声音、痛感等）；使麻木，使迟钝
items.def_en: To make a sound, feeling, pain, or sensation weaker, less intense, or duller.
To make a part of the body or a feeling lose sensation or the ability to feel anything

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to impairing, numbing, or absorbing sensory perception, pain, or acoustic sharpness. They emphasize taking away sensitivity, sharpness, or resonance so an experience becomes faint or unresponsive.
groups.summary_zh: 指使感觉迟钝、止痛麻木或消除声响锋芒。

groups.name: Deadening & Numbing · 麻木与知觉丧失 (Numb, Deaden, Desensitize)
groups.tip: 肢体感知减弱乃至麻木

items.def_en: To diminish the sharp edge or acute responsiveness of a sensation, pain, or sense organ

items.def_zh: 使麻木，使失去知觉；使迟钝
items.def_en: To make a part of the body unable to feel physical sensations, or to make someone unable to feel emotion or think clearly.
To make someone or a body part less capable of feeling physical sensation or emotional reaction
To extinguish or severely reduce the intensity of pain, sound, or feeling in an area
To administer drugs to eliminate all physical sensation, rendering an area or person completely numb

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rendering sensory receptors or emotional capacities unresponsive, blocking all sensation, pain, or empathetic feeling.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理阻滞、药物或心理打击使局部感官或情感知觉完全丧失反应能力。

groups.name: Debit & Deduct · 扣除与扣划 (Deduct, Dock, Withhold)
groups.tip: 从账目中扣除相应金额

items.def_zh: 从…账户中扣除；记入…账下
items.def_en: To enter a debit or expense directly against an existing credit balance or departmental budget

items.def_zh: 扣减（工资、待遇）作为惩罚
items.def_en: To reduce an employee's wages or benefits, typically as a penalty for being late or underperforming
To take money out of a bank account; to charge a sum of money against an account.
To deliberately keep back an amount of money from salary before payment, notably for national taxes
To take away an amount or part from a total sum (such as taxes deducted from pay)

groups.summary_en: Covers removing a specified sum of money directly from a financial account, wages, or balance in settlement of fees, penalties, taxes, or payments owed. Contrasts discretionary deductions with automated banking ledger debits.
groups.summary_zh: 指自账户、薪酬或总账中直接扣减、扣划款项或税费。

groups.name: Debunk & Disprove Claims · 辟谣与戳穿假象 (Debunk, Discredit, Puncture)
groups.tip: 戳穿虚假迷思与谎言，公开揭示真相

items.def_en: Show a belief, myth, or scientific theory to be completely baseless and destroy general faith in it
Harm the good reputation of someone or prove that an idea, claim, or piece of evidence is unreliable or false
Prove a statement, charge, or theory to be completely wrong or false using methodical argument or clear evidence

items.def_zh: 戳破（谎言、幻想、膨胀的傲气）
items.def_en: Suddenly destroy or deflate an illusion, myth, inflated claim, or person's pride

items.def_zh: 揭穿，戳穿，驳斥（谬论或虚假谎言）
items.def_en: To prove that an idea, belief, or claim is false or exaggerated.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express dismantling false claims, superstitions, fraudulent theories, or inflated reputations through evidence and critical analysis. They focus on shattering falsehoods rather than merely presenting facts.
groups.summary_zh: 用事实与证据驳斥谣言、戳穿伪科学或假象，打破虚假认知。

groups.name: Deceive & Dupe · 蒙骗与愚弄 (Gull, Cozen, Con)
groups.tip: 利用诡计哄弄欺诈，诱使他人上当

items.def_en: To persuade someone to do something or give up money by means of a confidence trick

items.headword: pull the wool over someone's eyes
items.lemma: pull the wool over someone's eyes
items.def_en: To deceive someone by preventing them from discovering what is truly happening
To trick or deceive someone into believing or doing something foolish.

items.def_zh: 欺骗，使容易轻信者上当
items.def_en: To fool or cheat someone who is unusually trusting or naive
To win over, cheat, or deceive someone by subtle artifice or wheedling

groups.summary_en: Highlights the gullibility and vulnerability of the victim who is easily outwitted, taken advantage of, or made a fool of by an imposter.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重利用受害者单纯轻信而施加诱骗、愚弄及耍弄手段。

groups.name: Deceive & Mislead · 欺骗与蒙瞒 (Deceive, Mislead, Delude)
groups.tip: 用虚假手段误导并骗取利益

items.def_zh: 欺骗，诱骗；作弊；对（配偶）不忠
items.def_en: 1. To act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage. 2. To deprive someone of something by trickery or deceit.

items.def_zh: 误导，给虚假希望以欺骗
items.def_en: To encourage someone to believe something false, especially regarding intentions or affection
To cause someone to form a wrong impression or action by giving inaccurate information
To deliberately make someone believe something that is false for one's own advantage
To cause someone to accept a false belief, often self-servingly or unrealistically

groups.summary_en: Encompasses general breach of faith and systemic dishonesty, ranging from unfair advantage in rules to causing someone to harbor mistaken beliefs.
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏规则以谋私利，或故意掩盖真相以误导他人信念。

groups.name: Deceive & Trick · 欺诈与诱骗 (Hoodwink, Bamboozle, Beguile)
groups.tip: 设局弄虚作假、诱人上当

items.def_zh: 使上当，蒙骗（常用被动态）
items.def_en: To successfully fool or deceive someone into believing a falsehood
To deceive or cheat someone, especially by using clever or dishonest methods.
To charm, enchant, or attract someone, sometimes in order to mislead them
To confuse or mystify someone so thoroughly as to mislead or cheat them
To deceive someone completely through clever misdirection or a trick

groups.summary_en: Focuses on outsmarting, deluding, or cunningly manipulating another's perception to induce error or action through calculated ruses.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用巧计、圈套或言语诱惑蒙蔽他人判断并使其上当。

groups.name: Decelerate & Ease Up · 减速与缓行 (Decelerate, Slow Down, Ease Up)
groups.tip: 移动速度逐渐放慢

items.def_zh: 放慢速度；放松油门/努力
items.def_en: To reduce one's speed, pressure, or level of exertion gradually
To become slower, less intense, or less productive
To move or happen at a slower speed, or to cause something to do so
To reduce speed; to slow down, or cause a vehicle or process to slow down.

items.def_zh: 减油减速；调低功率缓速
items.def_en: To reduce the power or fuel flow to an engine to decrease speed

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate a continuous, measured rate of decreasing physical speed, cadence, or economic momentum over time, contrasting with sudden mechanical braking.
groups.summary_zh: 指运动速率或发展进程逐渐降低、放缓步伐。

groups.name: Decode & Decipher · 破译与理顺 (Decipher, Decrypt, Untangle)
groups.tip: 厘清混乱信息破译内涵

items.def_en: To translate a coded signal, message, or sequence into plain intelligible language

items.def_zh: 理清，厘清（混乱思绪或复杂局面）
items.def_en: To make an extremely tangled or confused set of facts, thoughts, or relationships clear

items.def_zh: 破译，理顺，恢复（混乱信息或信号等的）原貌
items.def_en: To put mixed-up letters, words, or electronic signals back into a clear, understandable order or decoded state.
To succeed in reading, decoding, or understanding something hard to read or obscure
To decode electronically encrypted data or ciphertexts back into plain readable text

groups.summary_en: Focuses on cognitive and analytical efforts to convert encoded, garbled, or disorganized data back into meaningful, orderly sense. It emphasizes penetrating chaos, obfuscation, or dense ciphers.
groups.summary_zh: 通过智力推演或技术手段破译乱码、密码，理顺混乱信息。

groups.name: Decode & Decrypt · 解码与破解 (Decrypt, Decode, Decipher)
groups.tip: 解开密码并读懂深层隐晦信息

items.def_en: To find the solution to a code, problem, or mystery, especially after difficult mental effort

items.def_zh: 解开；阐明（谜团、复杂问题）
items.def_en: To solve, explain, or uncover the details of something complicated or mysterious
To convert a coded message into intelligible language, or extract meaning from complex signals

items.def_zh: 辨认出；破译（难辨字迹或密码）
items.def_en: To succeed in reading or understanding something that is poorly written or difficult to understand
to decode or convert encrypted data or a secret code into readable plain text

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to interpreting, unravelling, and converting encrypted, obscure, or encoded signals and texts into intelligible meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 指将加密、模糊或晦涩的符号、代码与信息转译还原为可读内容。

groups.name: Deconstruct & Dissect · 分解与剖析 (Factor, Deconstruct, Dissect)
groups.tip: 化整为零剖析要件

items.def_en: To divide a total figure, process, or complex problem into smaller, more manageable parts

items.def_zh: 分解因式，把……化为因子；把……作为因素计入（factor in）
items.def_en: 1. (mathematics) To resolve a number or mathematical expression into its factors. 2. (factor in / into) To include a particular fact or situation when calculating or planning something.
To analyze a sentence, string of data, or argument into its component parts to reveal its grammatical or logical structure
To break down and critically analyze the underlying components, assumptions, or structure of an idea or work
To examine, analyze, or criticize something in minute detail, piece by piece

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cognitive frame involve breaking down complex mathematical structures, arguments, or texts into their fundamental constituent elements to understand their underlying architecture.
groups.summary_zh: 指将复杂数字、理论或文本拆解为底层构成要素以深入剖析机理。

groups.name: Decouple & Disentangle · 解耦与脱钩 (Decouple, Uncouple, Disengage)
groups.tip: 解开连接使其彼此脱离

items.def_en: To detach or unfasten something by releasing its hook or fastener
To break the connection, correlation, or dependency between two currencies, policies, or entities
To release or detach something from a state of interlocking connection, such as gears or clutches

items.def_zh: 使脱钩，使分离；（使）脱离连接
items.def_en: 1. To separate or disconnect two linked systems, economies, or objects so they operate independently.
To disconnect two things that are joined together, especially train cars or linked mechanical devices

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to disconnecting or unlinking interconnected components, systems, or mechanisms so they can operate independently. They frequently collocate with economies, systems, software modules, and physical couplings.
groups.summary_zh: 强调解除两系统或部件间的关联，使其各自独立运作。

groups.name: Deep Insight & Complete Grasp · 彻悟与透彻领会 (Fathom, Grasp, Internalize)
groups.tip: 从表面知晓到心领神会彻底弄懂

items.def_en: To understand the meaning or nature of something completely and firmly
To succeed in understanding something obscure, complex, or hidden
To understand a difficult problem or someone's motives fully after deep thought
To integrate knowledge, attitudes, or values so thoroughly that they become part of one's nature

items.def_zh: 领悟，心领神会，彻底理解
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To understand something intuitively, deeply, and completely.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express an exhaustive, intuitive, or penetrating comprehension that transcends superficial knowing to attain complete mastery.
groups.summary_zh: 表示超越表面了解，直达底层逻辑或全盘内化的深度领会与彻悟。

groups.name: Default & Back Out · 食言与毁约 (Renege, Weasel Out, Back Out)
groups.tip: 食言反悔或不履行契约

items.def_en: (+ of) To decide not to do something that you had previously agreed to do
(+ of) To evade an agreed responsibility or commitment through deceitful excuses
(+ on) To fail to fulfill a contract, legal obligation, or debt repayment
(+ on) To fail to fulfill an obligation or avoid paying a debt or bet
(+ on) To break a promise, agreement, or formal commitment.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures bad-faith evasions and withdrawals from pledges, bargains, or binding duties after prior agreement.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦达成共识后违背诺言、耍赖反悔或推脱协议的违约行为。

groups.name: Default & Renounce · 赖账与毁约 (Default, Renege, Back out)
groups.tip: 从失信赖账到恶意背叛

items.def_en: (+ of) To decide not to do something that you had previously agreed to do
To avoid doing something you should do by providing a poor excuse
('welsh on') (informal) To fail to pay a debt, fulfill an obligation, or keep a promise.
(+ on) To fail to fulfill a financial obligation, especially repayment of a loan
(+ on) To fail to keep a promise, agreement, or formal undertaking

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on failing to fulfill commitments, pay debts, or keep pledges, especially through evasive, dishonorable, or unilateral withdrawal.
groups.summary_zh: 指违背诺言、拒绝履行经济责任或背弃协议毁约。

groups.name: Defecate & Bowel Movement · 排便与排遗 (Crap, Defecate, Excrete)
groups.tip: 肠道蠕动排出大便废物

items.def_en: To pass feces from the bowels, used especially by or to children or casually
To discharge waste matter from the body by a normal bodily function
To discharge feces from the bowels through the anus
1. (informal, often taboo) To defecate; to have a bowel movement.
To pass waste from the bowels; vulgar and taboo in standard contexts

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physiological excretion of solid bowel waste, ranging from technical medical terms to highly informal and taboo slang.
groups.summary_zh: 表示排出固体排泄物生理活动，涵盖从医学术语到日常通俗及粗俗俚语。

groups.name: Define & Delimit · 界定与定义 (Define, Delimit, Delineate, Demarcate)
groups.tip: 划定概念范围并明确定义

items.def_zh: 界定；给……下定义；阐明，明确
items.def_en: 1. To establish the limits, nature, or character of something. 2. To state or explain the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.
To describe, trace, or portray outline edges and specifics with exact precision
To draw a line around something and restrict its scope or freedom tightly
To determine and mark the precise borders, limits, or scope of something
To set distinct boundaries separating one zone, category, or sphere from another

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this precise analytical frame describe establishing the exact boundaries, meaning, scope, or constituent properties of concepts, territories, and jurisdictions.
groups.summary_zh: 着重确立概念内涵、权限边界或实体轮廓，使其范围明晰而不含混。

groups.name: Dehumanize & Degrade · 剥夺人性与极度贬抑 (Dehumanize, Degrade, Brutalize)
groups.tip: 抹杀人性与道德败坏

items.def_en: To treat someone with such utter disrespect that they lose their dignity or self-respect
To treat someone merely as a tool or object without regard to their humanity or feelings
To lower someone's position, esteem, or pride through severe humiliation or subservience
