To treat someone with such sustained cruelty that they become numb or violent like a beast
1. (chiefly British) To deprive people of positive human qualities, rights, or dignity.

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes subjecting people to conditions or treatment that strips away their fundamental human qualities, agency, dignity, and rights, reducing them symbolically or functionally to beasts or objects.
groups.summary_zh: 极度贬低人的尊严，剥夺其作为人的基本权利与体面。

groups.name: Demand Performance & Recall · 喝彩返场与呼求 (Encore, Recall, Clamor)
groups.tip: 从礼貌请求升级为坚决要求

items.def_zh: 鼓掌喝彩（以示赞许或催促）
items.def_en: To show strong approval or urge further performance by repeatedly clapping hands
To bring a performer back onto the stage after a performance through sustained audience ovation
To summon a performer back to the stage by continuous applause or cheering

items.def_zh: 要求（演员）再演一次，要求重唱；为……喝彩加演
items.def_en: To call for a performer to repeat a song or give an extra performance at the end of a show.
To demand something loudly, insistently, and noisily as part of a collective crowd

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe audiences vocally or enthusiastically demanding an additional performance, an immediate reappearance, or an urgent public presentation from performers or speakers.
groups.summary_zh: 指观众或公众通过喝彩、掌声热切呼吁表演者返场或加演。

groups.name: Demobilize & Disarm · 复员与解散军备 (Stand Down, Decommission, De-escalate)
groups.tip: 战争结束后遣散复员军队

items.def_en: To officially order military troops or security personnel to relax alert or leave high-readiness duty
To formally discharge soldiers from military service, especially at the conclusion of a campaign
To take weapons away from troops or a group, or to reduce military weaponry drastically

items.def_zh: 正式退役，停止服役（军舰、武器设施）
items.def_en: To officially withdraw a military vessel, weapon system, or installation from operational service
(military) To release soldiers from military service, or convert armed forces from a war footing to peace.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the formal transition of military forces, personnel, or assets from combat readiness back to a peacetime status. They emphasize orderly drawdown, disarmament, and release from armed service.
groups.summary_zh: 军队或武装力量从战备状态转为和平状态，裁撤或复员。

groups.name: Demonetize & Strip Validity · 废止法定地位与去货币化 (Decertify, De-register, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 官方宣告法令或货币失效

items.def_en: To officially revoke the certified status, license, or recognition of an organization or product
To remove an individual, vehicle, or entity from an official government or administrative registry
To make a document, ticket, contract, or law officially and legally no longer valid

items.def_zh: 宣布无效，使丧失法律效力
items.def_en: To cause something to have no value or effect, or officially void a legal decree

items.def_zh: 废除（货币等的）法定地位，使停止流通；取消（视频等）营利资格
items.def_en: 1. To officially stop using a particular coin or banknote as legal money. 2. To prevent a content creator from earning money from their online material.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this regulatory frame describe stripping a financial instrument, license, credential, or content asset of its official legal standing or commercial earning privileges.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或平台剥夺资产、凭证或资格的法定效力与商业化权利。

groups.name: Demonize & Vilify · 妖魔化与极度丑化 (Demonize, Vilify, Slander, Malign)
groups.tip: 从轻视贬低上升到妖魔化抹黑

items.def_en: To tell damaging untruths or voice spiteful criticisms that harm a person's good reputation
To unjustifiably disparage, degrade, or diminish the significance and virtue of someone
To deliberately tarnish someone's public reputation by propagating scandalous falsehoods
To speak or write about someone in an extremely derogatory, malicious, and defamatory manner

items.def_zh: 妖魔化，将……描绘为凶恶者
items.def_en: To portray someone or something as wicked, threatening, or completely evil.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate intensely aggressive rhetorical attacks intended to brand targets as inherently evil, dangerous, or contemptible in the public eye.
groups.summary_zh: 通过舆论或言辞将目标刻画为邪恶、危险或下劣之人，极力败坏其人格声望。

groups.name: Denote & Stand For · 代表与表示 (Denote, Signify, Represent)
groups.tip: 符号或词语明确指代特定含义

items.def_en: To be a symbol or expression of a particular fact, concept, or quality
To represent or mean a particular word, idea, or concept as a symbol or abbreviation
(formal) To be a sign, mark, or symbol of something; to mean or represent a specific thing directly
To represent or stand for an abstract quality or idea as an emblem
To be a representative symbol or characteristic example of a category

groups.summary_en: This linguistic and semiotic frame describes serving as a direct formal sign, symbol, or literal definition of a concept. Denoting centers on literal representation and semantic reference, standing in contrast to connotative or emotional overtones.
groups.summary_zh: 指符号、代号或术语在字面意义或约定俗成上的直接指代与象征。

groups.name: Dental Hygiene & Interdental Care · 洁牙与口腔护理 (Brush, Gargle, Swish)
groups.tip: 用牙线剔牙等细致的身体洁护

items.def_en: To clean and polish the teeth with a toothbrush and dentifrice
To clear residual debris or mouthwash from the oral cavity with water
1. To clean between one's teeth using dental floss.
To move liquid rapidly back and forth inside the mouth to cleanse teeth and gums
To wash the throat and mouth with a liquid held in the back of the mouth and kept in motion by breathing out through it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intentional hygiene practices targeting the teeth, gums, and oral cavity to dislodge food particles, eliminate plaque, and freshen breath.
groups.summary_zh: 清洁牙缝、牙面及口腔黏膜以去除牙垢或食物残渣。

groups.name: Denude & Bare · 剥蚀与脱去覆盖 (Denude, Strip, Defoliate)
groups.tip: 剥去外层覆盖使其裸露

items.def_en: Uncover something completely so that its underlying structure or bare surface is exposed
(formal) (+ of) Strip someone or something of clothes, attributes, or possessions
Remove all coverings, vegetation, or contents from something until nothing remains

items.def_zh: 使裸露，剥去……的覆盖物；剥夺
items.def_en: (formal) To strip something of its covering, possessions, or assets, making it bare.
Cause the leaves of trees and growing plants to fall off, typically via chemicals or blight

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on thoroughly removing the protective covering, foliage, surface layer, or vital assets of a landscape, tree, or entity, rendering it utterly bare and exposed.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重彻底除去地表植被、表面遮盖层或资产，使其裸露。

groups.name: Deny & Veto · 否认与否决 (Disallow, Refute, Turn down)
groups.tip: 表达否定意见或行使否决权

items.def_zh: 否决，驳回；否定，证明……为假
items.def_en: (formal) To refuse to accept or approve; veto; to disprove or contradict.
To reject or refuse an offer, request, or formal proposal
To exercise an official right to forbid or reject a proposed law, plan, or action
To officially reject or refuse to acknowledge something as valid, legal, or permissible
To refuse to accept or acknowledge the truth, validity, or authority of something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on officially or formally refusing to accept, ratify, or affirm a claim, motion, or proposal. They range from legal disallowance and legislative vetoes to categorical refutations.
groups.summary_zh: 正式否认主张的真实性，或以权威驳回、否决提案与申请。

groups.name: Depart & Disperse · 离别与分离 (Part, Part Ways, Separate)
groups.tip: 彼此分开离开

items.def_zh: 分离，分别，分手；使分开，隔开；（使头发）分缝
items.def_en: 1. To leave someone or go away from each other; separate. 2. To separate people or things that are together.
To end a relationship, companionship, or professional association and go separate paths
To separate from a main route, party, or stream and take a different direction
To quickly move or cause to move apart in various directions
To move apart and go away in different directions, causing a crowd or group to break up

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or emotional separation between two or more parties who had been traveling or spending time together. They highlight the moment of parting and going separate ways.
groups.summary_zh: 强调相聚的人群或同伴各自离开、分道扬镳的物理或情感过程。

groups.name: Depose & Eject · 罢免与逐出权力 (Oust, Topple, Unseat)
groups.tip: 用强力将掌权者逐出职位

items.def_en: To defeat an incumbent in an election or formally remove an officeholder from their position
To force someone out of a room, seat of authority, or property, often with physical authority

items.def_zh: 驱逐，罢黜，剥夺（职位或权力）
items.def_en: To force someone out of a position of power, an office, or a piece of land.

items.def_zh: 废黜；罢免（君主或政权领导人）
items.def_en: To remove a monarch or political ruler abruptly and often forcefully from high office

items.def_zh: 推翻；颠覆（政权或统治者）
items.def_en: To cause a government, regime, or dictator to fall from power completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly removing an incumbent leader, executive, or faction from an elected office, government, or position of dominance. The actions range from institutional removal to sudden coups or regime overthrow.
groups.summary_zh: 指动用权力、投票或强制手段，将处于主导地位的领导人或对手赶下台。

groups.name: Deposit & Save Funds · 存汇与资金积蓄 (Deposit, Stash Away, Sock Away)
groups.tip: 把资金存入机构储备

items.def_zh: 把（钱）存入银行；在银行开户；（飞机等）倾斜转弯
items.def_en: 1. To deposit money in a bank, or have an account with a bank. 2. (of an aircraft) To tilt sideways when making a turn.
To put money or an asset into a bank account or financial fund
To steadily save a sum of money over time in a secure account
To reserve a designated portion of funds or income for a distinct future purpose
To save an amount of money regularly in order to keep it secure

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns placing money, capital, or negotiable instruments into financial institutions or dedicated savings reserves for safekeeping and investment growth.
groups.summary_zh: 指将资金存入银行或储蓄账户等金融场所妥善保管。

groups.name: Deride & Scorn · 鄙薄与讥刺 (Scoff, Ridicule, Mock)
groups.tip: 带着蔑视态度嘲弄，冷眼嗤笑对方短处

items.def_en: To tease or laugh at someone in a scornful or contemptuous manner, often by mimicking
To make fun of someone or something unkindly in an attempt to make them appear foolish
To feel or express extreme contempt and derision toward someone or something
(+ at) To speak about someone or something in a way that shows clear contempt and disbelief
(+ as) To treat or talk about someone or something with scorn or contempt as being ridiculous or worthless.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on formal or severe expression of contempt, portraying the target as ludicrous, worthless, or completely beneath serious regard.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以居高临下的轻蔑态度将对方视作荒诞可鄙而予以嘲笑驳斥。

groups.name: Desecrate & Profane · 亵渎与玷污 (Desecrate, Defile, Violate)
groups.tip: 冒犯神圣事物玷污信仰尊严

items.def_en: To treat a sacred place, tomb, or sanctum with contemptuous disregard or physical transgression
To make something sacred dirty, unholy, or corrupt through offensive acts
(formal) To treat something sacred, holy, or revered with irreverence or disrespect.
To damage, deface, or treat a sacred place, object, or concept with radical disrespect
To speak irreverently or contemptuously of God, holy figures, or sacred principles

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this moral and religious frame denote treating holy places, cherished artifacts, or deeply held principles with gross disrespect, contempt, or malicious violation. They vary from outright physical vandalism of shrines to moral debasement.
groups.summary_zh: 指对神圣事物、崇高信仰或遗址进行不敬侵犯与亵渎。

groups.name: Deserve & Merit · 值得与配得 (Deserve, Merit, Warrant, Earn)
groups.tip: 具备相称的价值与资格

items.def_zh: 配得上，值得（常用于否定）
items.def_en: To be considered worthy of receiving a specific rank, notice, or mention
To gain or incur something justifiable because of one's efforts, achievements, or behavior
To have earned something or to be entitled to a specific reward, punishment, or treatment based on one's conduct
To make a particular action, inquiry, or reaction necessary, reasonable, or justifiable
To deserve or be worthy of something such as attention, reward, or punishment.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote having a legitimate claim to a particular reaction, treatment, reward, or penalty due to innate qualities, actions, or severity.
groups.summary_zh: 指因行为、品质或严重程度而应受特定对待或裁决。

groups.name: Desiccate & Shrivel · 皱缩与干瘪 (Shrivel, Wizen, Shrink)
groups.tip: 失水枯瘪导致体积极缩

items.def_en: To gather or contract into small folds, wrinkles, or ridges
To form small, thin creases or wrinkles over a surface, often as moisture is lost
To become dry, shrunken, and wrinkled with age or dehydration, or to cause something to do so
(+ up) To become dry, smaller, and covered in wrinkles, or to make something do this.
To dry out thoroughly and drain completely of moisture or vital vitality

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical drying out, loss of moisture, and shrinking into a wrinkled, puckered state. They emphasize the physical texture and contorted reduction in volume of organic matter or skin.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因失去水分或生机而起皱、缩减及干瘪的外在物理形态变化。

groups.name: Despair & Lose Hope · 绝望与丧气 (Lose heart, Despond, Give up)
groups.tip: 彻底丧失信心，陷入无助心境

items.def_en: To stop believing that you can succeed and feel discouraged
(+ of) To completely stop expecting or believing that something positive will happen

items.def_zh: 绝望，放弃生还/成功的希望
items.def_en: To entirely cease to have or maintain any hope whatsoever

items.raw_cluster: 绝望与丧气 Despair & Lose Hope
items.def_en: 1. (+ of) To feel that there is no hope at all that a situation will improve.
To become extremely disheartened and abandon hope

groups.summary_en: This frame captures experiencing a complete cessation of hope, feeling helpless in the face of insurmountable adversity, or abandoning all expectation of improvement.
groups.summary_zh: 面对逆境彻底丧失希望、放弃期待或陷入极度沮丧。

groups.name: Destine & Fate · 注定与宿命 (Doom, Preordain, Foreordain)
groups.tip: 命中注定无法被更改

items.def_en: (chiefly passive) To predetermine or decree by fate, typically towards an unhappy end
To decide, decree, or fix an event beforehand by divine providence or cosmic authority
To determine an outcome in advance as if by inexorable fate
(chiefly passive) To make certain that someone or something will fail, die, or be destroyed
1. (chiefly passive) To predetermine or intend someone or something for a particular fate, purpose, or journey.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on outcomes fixed irrevocably beforehand by divine will, natural laws, or supernatural decree, often with grim or inescapable finality.
groups.summary_zh: 指由命运、神意或不可抗力预先判定无可更改的结局。

groups.name: Detach & Disassociate · 疏远与拉开距离 (Distance, Detach, Disengage)
groups.tip: 拉开心理或社交距离以示冷淡

items.def_zh: 超然物外；冷眼旁观；保持冷淡距离
items.def_en: (+ from) To keep oneself deliberately apart and uninvolved in social affairs or disputes
(+ from) To make yourself, or cause someone to be, emotionally, socially, or physically distant from someone or something.

items.def_zh: 使脱离；摆脱（情感依附或关联）
items.def_en: (+ from) To separate oneself emotionally, mentally, or socially from someone or something
(+ from) To free oneself from a connection, involvement, or confrontation

items.def_zh: 划清界限；声明脱离关系
items.def_en: (+ from) To formally or publicly declare that you are not connected with someone or something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deliberately creating emotional, social, or reputational separation between oneself and another entity. They emphasize purposeful non-involvement, stepping back, or disassociating from controversial matters.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重主动划清界限、拉开心理或社交距离以避免牵涉。

groups.name: Deter & Dissuade · 阻吓与打消念头 (Deter, Dishearten, Daunt)
groups.tip: 用言语劝诫或威慑阻止行动

items.def_en: Make someone dislike something or decide against proceeding with an endeavor

items.def_zh: 劝阻，打消……的念头；使灰心，使气馁；阻碍
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To persuade someone not to do something. 2. To make someone feel less confident, hopeful, or enthusiastic.
Cause someone to lose hope, confidence, or enthusiasm for carrying out a goal
(usually negative) Disturb, disconcert, or unnerve someone so as to stall their confidence
Make someone feel apprehensive or intimidated by the sheer difficulty of a task

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses dampening someone's confidence, enthusiasm, or will to proceed, discouraging them through negative reinforcement, intimidating obstacles, or sobering forecasts.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重以现实困难、消极态度或风险后果挫败其热情、制止行动。

groups.name: Detonate & Blast · 引爆与炸毁 (Trigger, Set off, Blast)
groups.tip: 雷管点火引爆轰鸣

items.def_en: To cause a detonator, bomb, or explosive reaction to go off
To cause a bomb, charge, or alarm to explode or activate suddenly
To destroy, shatter, or break open using explosives or heavy ordnance
To burn rapidly with intense heat and sparks without producing a true supersonic shockwave
1. To explode violently with a sudden loud noise, or to cause a bomb or explosive to do so.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the deliberate or mechanical ignition and destruction caused by explosive devices, charges, or weapons of war.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦人为引爆弹药、炸药并对目标造成毁灭性爆破破坏。

groups.name: Detour & Bypass · 绕道与绕过 (Detour, Bypass, Circumvent)
groups.tip: 避开障碍绕道迂回前行

items.def_en: To follow a curved or indirect path to pass an obstruction or barrier
To go along or around the outer edge of an obstacle, boundary, or difficult topic
To go around a town, obstacle, or problem to avoid delays, or to ignore an established rule
To find an ingenious or indirect way of avoiding an obstacle, rule, or restriction
To travel or take a longer, indirect route to avoid an obstacle or detour.

groups.summary_en: Encompasses physical travel around an obstacle, congestion, or restricted zone via an indirect route, as well as figurative sidestepping of rules, procedures, or bottlenecks.
groups.summary_zh: 指避开路障、拥堵或规则而采取间接路线绕行或迂回通过。

groups.name: Deviate & Stray · 偏离与走入歧途 (Diverge, Stray, Digress)
groups.tip: 脱离正常轨道或规定路线

items.def_en: Gradually lose focus or wander away from the central track or subject
(+ from) Move away aimlessly from a group, path, or acceptable moral standard
To depart or diverge from an established path, standard, rule, or expected course of action.
(+ from) Separate and go in a different direction; depart from an established course
(+ from) Depart temporarily from the main subject in speech or writing

groups.summary_en: This frame covers moving away from a correct physical route, an established standard, or a central topic. Nuances distinguish between wandering aimlessly away from a moral/spatial path and diverging conceptually from a fixed norm.
groups.summary_zh: 指离开既定路线、常规准则或主旨，包含物理迷路与抽象偏离。

groups.name: Deviate & Veer · 偏离与骤然转向 (Veer, Swerve, Sheer)
groups.tip: 中途改变方向偏离航向

items.def_en: Change course by turning into the wind, or alter one's policy or approach radically
(+ off/away) Turn suddenly away from a course or an obstacle

items.def_zh: 突然转向，偏离方向；改变（话题、态度）
items.def_en: To change direction or course suddenly; to shift suddenly in opinion or behavior.
Change direction abruptly, especially in order to avoid an obstacle or collision
(of a moving ship or aircraft) Twist or oscillate temporarily about its vertical axis

groups.summary_en: Captures sharp, abrupt, or unexpected directional changes while in motion. Verbs in this frame contrast sudden evasive turns with gradual shifts in direction, policy, or public sentiment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调行驶或运动中突然、急剧地改变方向或偏离既定路线。

groups.name: Diffuse & Pervade · 扩散与渗透弥漫 (Permeate, Pervade, Suffuse)
groups.tip: 由中心向外均匀渗透散开

items.def_en: To pass slowly and subtly through small pores or openings, diffusing gradually into a broader area

items.def_zh: 扩散，弥漫；传播，散播；缓解，平息（紧张气氛）
items.def_en: 1. To spread or diffuse widely through air, water, or space. 2. To spread ideas, information, or knowledge widely. 3. To make a tense situation calmer.
To spread gently all over or through a surface, especially with light, color, or deep emotion
To pass or diffuse through every part of a substance, space, or organization
To spread through every part of something and be noticeable in all aspects of it

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the passive or chemical dispersal of particles, gases, scents, light, or cultural influences into a surrounding medium until thoroughly intermingled, soft, or pervasive.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重气体、光线、气味或思想在介质中自发弥散、渗透并均匀分布。

groups.name: Digest & Assimilate · 消化与吸收 (Digest, Assimilate, Absorb)
groups.tip: 肠胃分解食物并吸收养分

items.def_en: To take in nutrients, moisture, or informational concepts and retain them
1. to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances the body can use 2. to fully understand and absorb new information
To absorb food into the bodily tissues, or to integrate complex ideas fully into the mind
To take food, liquid, or medical substances into the stomach through the mouth
To process food or chemical compounds biochemically into energy or tissue building blocks

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the breakdown of food into nutrient forms by the digestive system, alongside figurative extensions meaning to thoroughly internalize, absorb, and make sense of information or experiences.
groups.summary_zh: 指机体分解食物吸纳养分，或引申指心智对信息深度的吸收领悟。

groups.name: Digress & Stray · 离题与漫谈走调 (Digress, Stray, Wander)
groups.tip: 偏离核心主旨开始东拉西扯

items.def_en: to lose track of the thread of a discussion and begin addressing unrelated matters
to drift gradually away from the primary topic, argument, or set limit
to talk or write at great length in a confused, disordered, and unfocused way
to turn aside or deviate from the main subject in speech or writing
to depart noticeably from an established path, standard principle, or subject matter

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this discourse frame capture wandering away from the core topic or narrative line in spoken speech, debate, or writing. They contrast deliberate conversational detours with unintentional lapses in focus.
groups.summary_zh: 指在谈话、演讲或写作中偏离主要论题、主线而东拉西扯。

groups.name: Dilute & Water Down · 稀释与冲淡削弱 (Dilute, Water Down, Thin, Weaken)
groups.tip: 加入溶剂降浓以削弱效力

items.def_en: To make a liquid less dense or viscous by stirring in a thinning agent or solvent
1. To make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water or another solvent. 2. To weaken the strength, effect, or quality of something.

items.def_zh: 掺水稀释；变相削弱（法案、论点）
items.def_en: To make a liquid weaker by adding water, or make a proposal less forceful and more agreeable
To diminish the force, intensity, virulence, or thickness of something
To lower the quality or strength of food, drink, or substances by introducing inferior elements

groups.summary_en: This frame covers acts that reduce the concentration, potency, or impact of a physical mixture or an abstract entity (like an idea, law, or emotion) by intermixing thinner solvents or compromising elements.
groups.summary_zh: 通过添加溶剂降低液体浓度，或掺入妥协因素以削弱效力与烈度。

groups.name: Dim & Darken · 变暗与阴沉 (Darken, Dim, Cloud over)
groups.tip: 光彩逐渐消退，明亮转为昏沉

items.def_en: To become covered with clouds, or of a person's face, to suddenly look troubled or unhappy
To become less bright or clear, or to make something less bright
To become or make gloomy, dark, or solemn in atmosphere or hue

items.def_zh: （使）变暗，（使）变黑；（使情绪等）转为阴沉
items.def_en: To become dark or darker, or to make something dark or darker; to become or make gloomy.
To become black or very dark, or to make something black, as by smoke, fire, or storm clouds

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing a decrease in ambient light, brightness, or clarity, often extending metaphorically to solemn or gloomy moods and expressions.
groups.summary_zh: 描述光线减弱变暗，或引申指脸色、情绪变得阴沉凝重。

groups.name: Dim & Fade · 变暗与减弱 (Fade, Dull, Subdue)
groups.tip: 光线减退逐渐隐入昏暗

items.def_en: Make or become less bright, clear, keen, or sensitive

items.def_zh: （使）变暗淡，（使）变模糊；（使希望等）减弱
items.def_en: To become less bright, clear, or strong, or to make something do so.
Lose brightness, color, or sharpness gradually over time
Tone down the glare, brilliance, or intensity of light or sound

items.def_zh: 眼前发黑；熄灭所有灯光
items.def_en: Extinguish all illumination completely, or lose conscious vision temporarily

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses gradual reductions in sensory luminance, perceptual clarity, or intensity. 'Dim' focuses on declining light levels or fading vision, while 'fade' and 'dull' emphasize gradual loss of vividness and sharpness.
groups.summary_zh: 强调光线、亮度或知觉清晰度逐渐变弱、减退。

groups.name: Disallow & Invalidate · 裁定无效与不予许可 (Disallow, Reject, Overrule)
groups.tip: 官方依据条令严加禁止与驳回

items.def_en: to decide definitively that an option, proposal, or claim is unacceptable or impossible
to declare that a contract, document, or transaction has no legal force
to legally or logically prove that something is no longer binding, valid, or acceptable
to use higher authority to reject a decision, objection, or previous ruling

items.def_zh: 不予批准，驳回；判定……无效
items.def_en: to officially refuse to admit, permit, or recognize something, especially in sports or a legal court

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on procedural decisions in governance, courts, or competitive sports where an authority officially rules an action, claim, or score inadmissible or void. It emphasizes regulatory invalidation rather than moral condemnation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在比赛、法庭或行政程序中裁定某行为、进球或主张不合规而无效。

groups.name: Disappear & Vanish · 隐没与消失 (Disappear, Vanish, Evaporate)
groups.tip: 从视野中隐没至完全不见

items.def_zh: 渐次消退；渐渐远去消失
items.def_en: To become gradually weaker, fainter, or indistinct until totally lost to view or hearing
To disappear smoothly and inconspicuously into the surroundings until gone
to stop being visible; to cease to exist or be found
To disappear suddenly, completely, and without explanation
To turn to vapor or, metaphorically, to vanish entirely as if without a physical trace

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the total cessation of visibility or presence, where an entity passes out of sight, leaves no immediate trace, or ceases to exist, ranging from ordinary loss of sight to abrupt vanishing.
groups.summary_zh: 强调实体脱离视线、无影无踪或彻底失去存在迹象的过程与状态。

groups.name: Disapprove & Condemn · 反对与不赞同 (Frown on, Deprecate, Take Issue)
groups.tip: 表明不满立场并提出抗议

items.def_en: To view something with mild to moderate ethical disapproval or cultural disfavor
To strongly disagree with and dispute a specific claim, action, or assumption

items.raw_cluster: 反对与不赞同 Disapprove & Object
items.def_en: (+ of) To think that someone or something is bad, wrong, or morally unacceptable.
To express firm, reasoned disapproval of an action, policy, or attitude
To state forcefully that something is entirely wrong, wicked, or unacceptable

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate holding or manifesting a negative judgment, ethical aversion, or unfavorable opinion regarding someone's behavior, standards, or choices. Nuances differentiate internal moral censure from vocal, critical disparagement.
groups.summary_zh: 在道德或价值评判上对某人某事持否定、不赞同态度。

groups.name: Disband & Break Up · 组织解散与分道扬镳 (Dissolve, Scatter, Part Ways)
groups.tip: 组织解体并遣散旗下成员

items.def_en: To cease functioning as a unified group, partnership, or organization and separate
To separate quickly and move off in varied directions, ending a collective formation

items.def_zh: 解散（议会、机构、伙伴关系）
items.def_en: To officially terminate an assembly, committee, business partnership, or legal body
To break up a gathering or crowd, causing individuals to head in separate ways

items.def_zh: 解散，遣散（组织、军队、团体等）
items.def_en: (of an organized group, committee, or military unit) To break up and cease to exist, or cause to do so.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures groups, committees, musical bands, or units ceasing collective operation and going their separate ways. It highlights cessation of corporate identity rather than employer-employee terminations.
groups.summary_zh: 团队、社团、乐团或集会停止合作并正式解散。

groups.name: Discharge & Demob · 军役退伍与遣返 (Muster Out, Release, Invalided Out)
groups.tip: 军队遣散军人解甲归田

items.def_en: To officially free someone from obligatory armed service or contractual military duties
To leave military service or be officially discharged at the end of a conflict or tour
To formally discharge a member of the armed forces because of injury or serious illness
To formally grant an official release from service in the armed forces

items.def_zh: 使退役，遣散（军人，尤用于战后）
items.def_en: (British informal) To demobilize someone from military service, especially at the end of a war.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the administrative or personal milestone of an individual service member leaving the military, returning to civilian life after combat, enlistment, or medical unfitness. Often carries conversational or administrative war-exit flavor.
groups.summary_zh: 军人个人层面的正式退伍、除役或遣返民用生活。

groups.name: Discharge Urine · 排尿与撒尿 (Piss, Pee, Urinate)
groups.tip: 排出体内的尿液与代谢废物

items.def_en: To urinate; used strictly in medical or highly technical formal contexts
To pass urine, used especially in British English and by or with children
To pass liquid waste from the bladder out of the body
To pass urine from the body, in informal but ordinary speech

items.def_zh: 排尿，撒尿；惹恼（常与 off 连用）
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often considered vulgar) To discharge urine from the body. 2. ('piss off') To annoy or irritate someone intensely.

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the bodily act of discharging urine, differentiated across registers from clinical terminology to casual colloquialisms and vulgar profanity.
groups.summary_zh: 表示排尿的生理活动，区分临床正式、日常口语和粗俗口吻。

groups.name: Discourage & Demoralize · 沮丧与气馁 (Dampen, Daunt, Dishearten)
groups.tip: 受挫后热情熄灭、意气消沉

items.raw_cluster: 使沮丧与沮丧 Discourage & Chill
items.def_zh: 使沮丧，使泄气，使寒心；使变冷，冷冻
items.def_en: 1. To discourage, dishearten, or dampen enthusiasm. 2. To make or become cold without freezing.
To intimidate or subdue someone's courage by presenting daunting difficulties
To make feelings, spirits, or enthusiasm less strong and buoyant
To cause someone to lose hope, confidence, or motivation
To destroy the confidence, self-belief, or fighting discipline of a person or group

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actions or events that cool enthusiasm, diminish resolve, undermine confidence, or crush optimism.
groups.summary_zh: 指泼冷水使人热情冷却、信心受挫或意志消沉。

groups.name: Disgust & Repel · 厌恶与反感 (Disgust, Repel, Revolt)
groups.tip: 深恶痛绝引起生理排斥

items.def_en: To arouse a strong, visceral feeling of physical distaste or moral indignation in someone
To cause someone to lose interest or experience mild distaste and attraction towards someone or something
To cause someone intense shock and disgust that verges on physical sickness
To cause someone to feel intense aversion or an impulse to back away in distaste

items.def_zh: 使厌恶，使反感；使恶心，使作呕
items.def_en: To make someone feel disgusted, repelled, or sick to their stomach.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a visceral reaction of extreme distaste, physical revulsion, or moral sickness caused by something repulsive. Nuances contrast physical gagging and nausea with deep-seated aesthetic or ethical abhorrence.
groups.summary_zh: 引发本能的生理作呕感或强烈的道德与审美厌恶。

groups.name: Disinfect & Sanitize · 消毒与水质净化 (Disinfect, Sanitize, Chlorinate)
groups.tip: 物理化学手段，除去杂质病原

items.def_zh: 使无菌；消灭全部微生物
items.def_en: To make something completely clean by destroying all bacteria and other microorganisms on it
To clean something using chemicals in order to kill bacteria and pathogens

items.def_zh: 对……进行卫生消毒；使清洁卫生
items.def_en: To make something completely clean and free of bacteria, especially by using heat or chemicals

items.def_zh: 用氯消毒，给……加氯处理；使氯化
items.def_en: To treat or disinfect water or another substance with chlorine.

items.def_zh: 清除污染；消除毒害物质
items.def_en: To remove dangerous substances such as chemicals, poisons, or radiation from a place, object, or person

groups.summary_en: This frame covers deliberate chemical or thermal treatments applied to water, surfaces, or instruments to destroy harmful microorganisms and pathogens. It emphasizes hygiene, sanitation, and safety.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过化学药剂或物理手段进行消杀、消毒与灭菌处理。

groups.name: Disinherit & Expropriate · 剥夺继承权与没收 (Disinherit, Confiscate, Forfeit)
groups.tip: 剥夺继承权或合法权益

items.def_zh: 断绝继承权；断绝经济资助
items.def_en: Prevent someone from receiving an inheritance or financial support, typically out of anger
Officially take private property away by legal authority as a penalty or protective measure

items.def_zh: 断绝关系；否认有任何瓜葛
items.def_en: Refuse to acknowledge someone as one's child or family member, revoking all claims and rights
(formal) Take away private property for public use or state ownership, sometimes without consent
To legally prevent someone from inheriting your money or property.

groups.summary_en: This legal and familial governance frame encompasses officially barring a rightful beneficiary from an estate, or seizing private assets through judicial decree or authoritarian sanction.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及在法律或家族层面剥夺继承资格或强行没收财产。

groups.name: Dislocate & Luxate · 脱臼与骨骼错位 (Dislocate, Luxate, Put Out)
groups.tip: 关节或部件脱离原本位置

items.def_zh: 使（关节、骨头）脱臼或扭伤
items.def_en: To displace a joint or bone from its normal position through sudden physical strain
(formal or medical) To dislocate an anatomical joint completely
(medical) To undergo or cause partial dislocation of a joint without complete separation
(informal) To dislodge suddenly from its joint or socket, or to cause a joint to pop free

items.def_zh: 使脱臼，使关节移位；使混乱，扰乱
items.def_en: 1. To force a bone out of its normal position in a joint. 2. To disrupt or throw an established system, schedule, or organization into disorder.

groups.summary_en: This medical and anatomical frame describes forcing a bone or joint out of its normal anatomical socket or contiguous relation. Collocations almost exclusively focus on shoulders, hips, fingers, and spinal vertebrae.
groups.summary_zh: 指关节因外力或扭伤离开正常解剖位置而脱臼或错缝。

groups.name: Dislodge & Displace · 移位与强行挪离 (Displace, Dislodge, Uproot)
groups.tip: 迫使其离开原有位置

items.def_zh: 迫使离开原位（或家园）；取代，替代；排开（水）
items.def_en: 1. To force people or animals to leave their home or usual environment. 2. To take the place or position of someone or something; to move something from its usual place.
To move or cause something stuck or stubborn to move even slightly

items.def_zh: 将……连根拔起；迫使离开家园
items.def_en: To pull something out of the ground by its roots, or force someone to leave their secure lifelong home

items.def_zh: 逐出；用力移开（卡住之物）
items.def_en: To forcibly knock, pry, or remove something or someone from a fixed, stuck, or secure position
To dislodge someone from a saddle, vehicle seat, or settled physical stance

groups.summary_en: This frame covers moving an object, substance, or person out of a settled, fixed, or established position by physical force, pressure, or upheaval. It contrasts dislodging an impacted object with large-scale demographic displacement.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加外力将固着物挪开，或使人及群体被迫脱离原有安居位置。

groups.name: Dismantle & Deconstruct · 拆解与解构 (Dismantle, Disassemble, Take apart)
groups.tip: 逐一拆除结构使其崩解

items.def_en: To separate an object into the pieces from which it was made
To take a machine, piece of furniture, or mechanism apart into separate components
To dismantle an engine or vehicle down to its bare parts for repair or inspection

items.def_zh: 拆卸，拆开；逐步废除，取消
items.def_en: 1. To take a machine or structure apart into separate pieces. 2. To gradually end or dismantle a system, organization, or agreement.
To break down a complex system, theory, or structure into constituent elements to understand or expose it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify systematically taking an apparatus, physical structure, or institutional framework apart piece by piece, reversing its assembly.
groups.summary_zh: 指按部就班地将机械、结构或体系拆卸成各个组件或彻底解体。

groups.name: Dismember & Mutilate · 肢解与残害 (Dismember, Mutilate, Hack Apart)
groups.tip: 刀具割断，肢解形体结构

items.def_en: Methodically cut up a dead body, plant, or tissue to examine its anatomical structure
Chop violently and repeatedly so as to cut someone or something into separate pieces
Inflict severe, disfiguring damage on the body of someone or an animal

items.def_zh: 肢解，割断手足；分裂，瓜分（国家等）
items.def_en: To cut, tear, or pull off the limbs of a person or animal, or divide a country, territory, or organization into separate parts.
Violently rip or shred a body apart into separate limbs

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote violently tearing, cutting, or hacking a living body or carcass into pieces, or systematically dividing an entity limb by limb. They emphasize severe destructive force and bodily fragmentation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对肢体进行暴力撕扯、砍斫碎解或肢解分割的动作。

groups.name: Dismiss & Terminate · 解聘与革职 (Fire, Sack, Oust)
groups.tip: 解除任职或开除出局

items.def_en: To remove someone decisively from their job, often for unsatisfactory performance

items.def_zh: 免职，解雇，开除；对……不予理会，驳回；解散
items.def_en: 1. To remove someone from a job, position, or organization. 2. To decide that something is not important enough to consider. 3. To allow or tell people to leave.
To dismiss an employee from their post abruptly or harshly

items.def_zh: 终止（雇佣关系），解约解聘
items.def_en: To end an employee's contract or position formally and legally
To force someone out of a position of authority, responsibility, or office

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark the authoritative and permanent severance of an individual's employment or administrative post. Connotations range from polite contractual termination to punitive and unceremonious firing.
groups.summary_zh: 雇主或权威机构永久性解除某人职务、解雇或罢免。

groups.name: Disown & Disavow · 划清界限与断绝 (Disassociate, Disavow, Repudiate)
groups.tip: 明确断绝联系或划清界线

items.def_en: To behave in a way that shows you are not involved with or do not agree with someone or something

items.def_zh: 划清界限，声明脱离关系；使分离，使脱离联系
items.def_en: 1. (disassociate oneself from) To state clearly that you are not connected with or responsible for someone or something.

items.def_zh: 断绝（亲子等）关系；否认归属
items.def_en: To refuse to acknowledge or maintain a relationship with a family member or associate
To deny any responsibility or support for something previously said, done, or endorsed

items.def_zh: 断绝关系；驳斥并拒绝承认
items.def_en: To refuse to accept, acknowledge, or be associated with someone or something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe public or formal actions taken by individuals or organizations to cut ties, deny connection, or renounce responsibility for someone else's actions, statements, or beliefs.
groups.summary_zh: 指公开发声明或采取行动，断绝与某人或某事的牵连并否认责任。

groups.name: Disown & Repudiate · 断绝关系与拒不承认 (Repudiate, Renounce, Disavow)
groups.tip: 决绝宣布断绝亲情或师承关系

items.def_en: To get rid of or abandon someone or something completely and without remorse
To deny publicly any knowledge of, connection with, or responsibility for someone or something
To state formally and publicly that you will no longer have, support, or claim something

items.def_zh: 断绝关系，否认与……有关系；声明脱离
items.def_en: To decide that you no longer want to be associated with or responsible for someone or something.
To reject strongly and formally as having no authority, truth, or binding power

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve a formal, severe, or public refusal to accept, acknowledge, or maintain a relationship with a person, claim, or heritage. While 'disown' usually involves family or kin, 'repudiate' rejects validity, and 'disavow' denies association or responsibility.
groups.summary_zh: 指公开、坚决且决绝地断绝关系、推卸责任或拒不承认。

groups.name: Disparage & Slur · 贬损与蔑称 (Trash-talk, Put down, Diss)
groups.tip: 从轻浮取笑升级到公开言语羞辱挑衅

items.def_en: To demean, humiliate, or belittle someone in front of others
To use disparaging or insolent talk against an opponent to demoralize them
(informal) To speak disrespectfully to or criticize someone in an insulting or dismissive manner.
To represent something or someone as being of little value or worth
To criticize someone severely and unkindly, often behind their back

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses colloquial, hostile, or insolent verbal denigration meant to diminish someone's status, respect, or competence in an informal or aggressive context.
groups.summary_zh: 指在口语或冲突中用轻蔑、侮辱性言语贬损、驳斥他人。

groups.name: Dispatch & Send Forth · 派遣与发配 (Send off, Deploy, Detach)
groups.tip: 调派人马物资出发

items.def_zh: 委派或派选（人员去执行某项任务）
items.def_en: To assign a particular officer, soldier, or subordinate officially to execute a specific duty

items.def_zh: 部署或调派（军队、警力或资源）
items.def_en: To move troops, personnel, or equipment into position ready for immediate operational action
To send someone on a mission or transport an item by mail or courier to its recipient

items.def_zh: 派遣，调遣；发出（信件等）；迅速处理；杀死
items.def_en: 1. To send someone or something quickly to a particular destination for a specific purpose. 2. (formal) To deal with a task promptly; to kill a person or animal.

items.def_zh: 分遣或抽调（兵力或人员执行特别任务）
items.def_en: To send away a group of soldiers, ships, or workers from the main body for a special assignment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote sending agents, military units, vehicles, or urgent consignments purposefully and expeditiously to a designated location.
groups.summary_zh: 为特定任务或目的调遣人员、部队或车辆前往指定地点。

groups.name: Dispatch Electronic Documents · 传真与专递发件 (Fax, Wire, Telecopy)
groups.tip: 通过传真或电讯手段收发信函

items.def_en: To send a message, instruction, or funds electronically using a telegraphic network
To send a message by submarine telegraph cable or telegram
To transmit a facsimile of a document over a telephone or digital line
To send off a message, fax, or email quickly and abruptly
To send a document electronically using a fax machine.

groups.summary_en: Verbs referring to transmitting specific documents, records, or urgent telegraphic communications via dedicated telecommunication machines or services.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过专用电信设备或网络即时发送文档、电报或票据。

groups.name: Display & Flaunt · 显摆与炫耀 (Flaunt, Show off, Brandish)
groups.tip: 张扬显摆财富才华，招摇过市博眼球

items.def_en: To display abilities, possessions, or status conspicuously to elicit praise or attention
To display money, jewellery, or status symbols conspicuously to impress others
To exhibit or display something proudly and publicly so that everyone notices
1. To show off your wealth, beauty, or possessions proudly and openly so others admire or envy you.

items.def_zh: 炫耀性出示，挥舞（权柄或凭据）
items.def_en: To display or wave something aggressively or ostentatiously as a threat or show of power

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on ostentatious visual or verbal displays of wealth, assets, or power executed deliberately to provoke envy, admiration, or intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 刻意高调展示财富、特权或实力以引人注目、艳羡或施加威慑。

groups.name: Display & Flaunt · 炫耀与炫示 (Flaunt, Flash, Parade)
groups.tip: 从客观展示升级为刻意夸耀

items.def_zh: 得意地穿戴，炫耀，夸示；玩耍，嬉戏
items.def_en: 1. to wear or display something proudly or conspicuously. 2. (archaic) to play or amuse oneself.
to show something expensive, impressive, or eye-catching briefly and ostentatiously
to display something proudly or conspicuously before an audience so as to gain attention
to deliberately display something one has or can do in order to impress others
to display something ostentatiously, boldly, or insolently in order to provoke envy or admiration

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote conspicuously wearing, displaying, or calling attention to clothes, possessions, or achievements in order to attract admiration, envy, or status.
groups.summary_zh: 强调带着自豪、招摇或炫耀的意味展示服饰、财物或特质。

groups.name: Disqualify & Invalidate · 取消资格与使不合格 (Disqualify, Invalidate, Incapacitate)
groups.tip: 判定不符规范，剥夺参与资格

items.def_en: To officially decide that someone or something is ineligible or no longer considered
To officially declare someone ineligible to participate in a competition or hold an office

items.def_zh: 使不合格，使不相宜，剥夺……的资格
items.def_en: To make someone or something unsuitable, incapable, or unqualified for a specific purpose or role.
To deprive a contract, claim, or standing of official legal effectiveness or soundness
To render someone unable to function or legally unqualified due to injury or illness

groups.summary_en: Involves legally, procedurally, or physically stripping someone of their eligibility, legitimacy, or fitness to perform an official role or contest.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法律、规则或身心状态使人失去任职或比赛资格。

groups.name: Disrupt & Derail · 扰乱与破坏 (Derail, Upset, Discommode)
groups.tip: 从横加干预到打破秩序

items.def_en: to throw plans, arrangements, or an equilibrium into unexpected confusion or disorder
to interrupt or cause problems that prevent an event, system, or process from continuing normally.
to successfully oppose or block someone's efforts, plans, or ambitions from succeeding

items.def_zh: 使脱轨；阻碍破坏（计划/谈判）
items.def_en: to cause a plan, project, or negotiation to fail, veer off course, or collapse suddenly
to overturn or thoroughly destabilize an established system, assumption, or state of affairs

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe throwing a structured process, schedule, system, or organization into disorder or breakdown by active interference or sudden interference.
groups.summary_zh: 强调强行打断、阻挠或破坏既有秩序与进程，造成混乱或中断。

groups.name: Disrupt & Interrupt · 打扰与中断 (Disrupt, Intrude, Break up)
groups.tip: 中途插手干预直至进程被打断

items.def_en: To interrupt someone who is speaking or disrupt an ongoing discussion
To stop someone while they are speaking or break a connection prematurely
1. To say or do something that makes someone stop speaking or doing an activity. 2. To stop a continuous process or flow temporarily.
(+ on/upon) To enter or interrupt without invitation or permission, disturbing privacy or activity
To throw into disorder, radically break the continuity of, or stop a normal process

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe breaking the ongoing continuity of an action, process, or event, causing temporary delay, disorder, or termination.
groups.summary_zh: 指介入进行中的事务或状态，造成中断、紊乱或阻碍。

groups.name: Disseminate & Broadcast · 广泛传播与散播 (Disseminate, Diffuse, Propagate)
groups.tip: 如播撒种子般广泛散播信息

items.def_en: To tell a lot of people news or information, especially when it may not be true
To send or pass information, reports, or materials from person to person
To spread an idea, belief, or theory widely among many people
To spread information, customs, or influence widely into surrounding areas

items.def_zh: 传播，散播，分发（信息、知识等）
items.def_en: (formal) To spread information, knowledge, ideas, or news widely among many people.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers dispersing information, doctrines, findings, or seeds to a wide audience or across an expansive territory, often systematically.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统性、广泛地向公众散播信息、学说或观念。

groups.name: Dissipate & Disperse · 消散与驱散 (Dissipate, Disperse, Scatter)
groups.tip: 雾气或力量逐渐消散消失

items.def_en: To become bright and free of fog, clouds, or obstruction, or cause this clearance
To disperse and disappear as the sun warms the atmosphere (used especially of fog or mist)
To move or make people, particles, or animals move apart quickly in various directions
To cause a group, smoke, or cloud to scatter in different directions and clear

items.def_zh: （使烟、云、感情等）消散，消除；挥霍，浪费
items.def_en: 1. to gradually fade away, scatter, and disappear, or to cause something to do so 2. to waste time, energy, or money foolishly

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the manner of disappearance through breaking up, spreading thin, or scattering across a wide space (such as fog, clouds, crowds, or tension), leaving nothing concentrated.
groups.summary_zh: 着重指通过由聚变散、向外扩散稀释而使实体或气氛归于无形。

groups.name: Dissuade & Deter · 劝阻与设法打消 (Dissuade, Deter, Discourage)
groups.tip: 循循善诱给出建议，力劝打消原定念头

items.def_en: Convince someone through earnest discussion not to do something they planned
(+ from) To persuade someone not to do something.
(formal) Strongly urge someone against foolish conduct or towards duty
Tell someone explicitly to stay away from a person, place, or dangerous activity
(+ from) Prevent someone from doing something by making them fearful of the consequences

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on targeted interpersonal verbal communication intended to talk someone out of an intended action, course of conduct, or risky plan by offering reasons and warnings.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重以语言说理或指出不良后果，促使对方打消念头。

groups.name: Distract & Sidetrack · 分心与转移 (Distract, Deflect, Divert)
groups.tip: 偏移正题或将注意力强行引开

items.def_en: To take someone's attention away from what they are trying to do or focus on
To cause someone or something to change direction or turn their attention elsewhere
To redirect criticism, questions, or attention away from oneself to someone or something else

items.def_zh: 使分心，使偏离正题；转变话题
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To distract someone from their main topic, goal, or task onto something less important.
To make someone believe something false or behave improperly, leading them away from the right path

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve drawing a person's attention, thoughts, or momentum away from their central objective or focus. They emphasize cognitive interruption, avoidance, or derailment.
groups.summary_zh: 指引开注意力、打断核心思路或使目标与讨论偏离正轨。

groups.name: Diverge & Deviate · 分岔与偏离 (Deviate, Stray, Veer)
groups.tip: 由同一道路分道扬镳

items.def_en: To wander away from the correct place, route, or subject unintentionally

items.def_zh: 岔开，分叉；产生分歧，偏离
items.def_en: 1. (of roads, paths, lines, etc.) To separate and go in different directions; branch off. 2. (of opinions, trends, etc.) To differ, disagree, or develop in different directions.
(+ from) To act differently from standard practice, an original plan, or expectations
To depart from an established course, standard, rule, or acceptable behavior
To change direction or course suddenly and sharply

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express moving apart from a common physical course or departing from a standard, norm, or topic. They emphasize separation of trajectory, divergence of opinions, or drifting off track.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重路线的分离散开，或行动、观点偏离既定轨道与标准。

groups.name: Diverge & Dissent · 异议与意见分歧 (Dissent, Differ, Conflict)
groups.tip: 从意见不合升级为公开放抗

items.def_en: (+ with/from/on) To hold an unlike opinion or distinct view on a matter
(+ with/over) To enter into a serious dispute or breach in friendship due to an argument

items.def_zh: 不同意，持异议；不一致，不符；（食物等对身体）不适宜
items.def_en: 1. (+ with/on/about) To have a different opinion or fail to agree with someone. 2. To not match or correspond. 3. (+ with) (of food or climate) To cause someone slight physical discomfort.
(+ from) To refuse to agree with an official opinion, established dogma, or common consensus
(+ with/over) To hold beliefs, ideas, or interests that collide directly and incompatibly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing or sustaining divergence in perspective, belief, or reasoning. Contrasts delineate mild intellectual difference from formal legal or political defiance against a consensus.
groups.summary_zh: 对既有观点、主张或共识表达分歧、不一致或异议。

groups.name: Divert & Deflect · 偏转与转向 (Deflect, Siphon, Redirect)
groups.tip: 受阻或引导改变航向

items.def_en: Send traffic, resources, or communications via a different route
Gradually divert money or resources from one intended source into another

items.def_zh: 使转向，使改道；转移（注意力等）；娱乐
items.def_en: 1. To make someone or something change direction or follow a different route. 2. To redirect resources or attention for a different purpose. 3. (formal) To entertain or amuse someone.

items.def_zh: 偏斜；使转向；转移（视线/批评）
items.def_en: Cause an incoming projectile or accusation to bounce off and change direction

items.def_zh: 挡开（武器）；巧妙避开（质问）
items.def_en: Ward off an incoming blow or skillfully deflect a difficult question

groups.summary_en: Describes deliberately forcing an object, projectile, person, or resource to change its path or orientation. This includes physical ricochets and the intentional rerouting of traffic, rivers, attention, or funds.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动改变物体行进方向，或调转目光、话题、资源流向。

groups.name: Divert & Transform · 转向与内倾 (Internalize, Invert, Deflect)
groups.tip: 改变原有流向，转向内在或别处

items.def_zh: 使内向，使转向内在；使内弯，内陷
items.def_en: To turn one's thoughts, feelings, or interests inward; to fold or turn inward.
To reorient one's thoughts, affections, or edges toward the interior rather than external reality
To turn something inside out, upside down, or completely reverse its directional order
To cause something to alter its direct course or veer away toward a diverted track
To absorb and integrate thoughts, attitudes, or conflicts inward into one's psyche

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve reorienting momentum, mental energy, or structure away from an outward path into an inward, reversed, or redirected trajectory. They bridge psychological introspection with geometric turning inward.
groups.summary_zh: 指将注意力、能量、结构从外向引向内部倾斜、折返或转向逆位。

groups.name: Divination & Occult Foreseeing · 占卜与通灵预测 (Divine, Augur, Douse)
groups.tip: 借助占卜或异象提前窥见未来

items.def_zh: （用寻龙尺等）探寻水源或矿脉
items.def_en: To search for underground water or minerals using a handheld rod or pendulum
To discover hidden knowledge or future events by supernatural means or intuitive perception
To practice the art of foretelling the future without relying on empirical data
To predict or foresee an outcome by interpreting natural omens or signs

items.def_zh: （通过水晶球等）占卜预知未来，凝视窥探未来
items.def_en: to attempt to foresee the future or reveal distant events by gazing into a reflective object such as a crystal ball or mirror

groups.summary_en: This frame covers methods of gaining insight into the future or uncovering hidden truths via occult, intuitive, or ritualistic practices rather than rational analysis.
groups.summary_zh: 通过通灵、巫术或直觉超自然手段占卜未来或探查隐秘。

groups.name: Dodge & Duck · 躲避与低头 (Dodge, Evade, Weave)
groups.tip: 迅速闪身或低头避开撞击

items.def_en: To sneak away or extricate oneself discreetly from a commitment or gathering
To step laterally away from an approaching threat, blow, or obstacle

items.def_zh: 低头躲避，缩头避开；迅速躲避；浸入水中
items.def_en: 1. To lower your head or body quickly to avoid being seen or hit. 2. (informal) To avoid or dodge a duty, question, or responsibility. 3. To submerge or push briefly underwater.
To move quickly aside or out of the way to avoid a blow, missile, or encounter
To make rapid zig-zagging directional shifts with the upper body to evade blows

groups.summary_en: This frame captures rapid evasive bodily adjustments made to escape impending physical impacts, detection, or inconvenient duties. Verbs contrast swift lowering of the torso ('ducking') with lateral shifts ('dodging') and strategic maneuvers.
groups.summary_zh: 指迅速低头或侧身避开来袭物、视线或责任的敏捷闪避动作。

groups.name: Domineer & Patronize · 盛气凌人与作威作福 (Boss around, Bully, Trample)
groups.tip: 居高临下施加统辖

items.def_en: To continually tell someone what to do in an unpleasant and domineering way

items.def_zh: 称王称霸，作威作福；册封为贵族
items.def_en: 1. (lord it over) To act in a superior, arrogant, or domineering way toward someone. 2. To make someone a lord.

items.def_zh: 以恩赐态度对待，居高临下看人
items.def_en: To speak to or treat someone in a way that seems kind but clearly betrays a feeling of superiority
To treat someone in a domineering, harassing, or intimidating manner
To act without any care for someone else's feelings, rights, or opinions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey exercising authority in an arrogant, overbearing, or haughty manner, treating subordinates as inferiors and micromanaging them aggressively.
groups.summary_zh: 以高高在上、跋扈蛮横的姿态压制或差遣他人。

groups.name: Don & Wear · 穿戴与着身 (Don, Slip On, Throw On)
groups.tip: 把衣履护具穿戴于身躯上

items.def_en: Wear or display an item of clothing, jewelry, or haircut conspicuously and with pride
Put on a piece of clothing, armor, or an accessory, especially with some formality or purpose

items.def_zh: 穿，戴；蓄（发、须）（wear的过去分词）
items.def_en: (past participle of wear) To have clothing, jewellery, or an accessory on one's body.
Put on a garment or footwear quickly, easily, and without fuss
Put on clothes hastily and without worrying much about appearance

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the transitional and durative acts of placing clothes, shoes, or accessories onto the body. It ranges from deliberate dressing to quick, casual slipping on of apparel.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖把衣服、配饰穿戴上身以及穿著的状态。

groups.name: Donate & Philanthropic Giving · 捐赠与施予 (Donate, Bestow, Contribute)
groups.tip: 出于善意无偿奉献

items.def_en: (+ to) To give money, goods, or resources alongside others toward a common fund or cause

items.def_zh: 捐赠，捐献（财物、器官或血液）
items.def_en: 1. To give money, food, clothes, blood, or organs to help a person or organization.
To contribute a small amount of money or help toward a shared gift, fund, or endeavor
(+ on/upon) To present something valuable or honorable as a gift or conferment
To leave money or personal property to someone or an institution in a will

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate transferring funds, goods, blood, or resources to a charity, institution, or needy party without expecting compensation. The action is driven by altruism, civic duty, or institutional philanthropy.
groups.summary_zh: 向慈善机构、组织或弱者无偿赠与资金、物品或资源。

groups.name: Doubt & Disbelieve · 怀疑与否定不信 (Question, Discredit, Reject)
groups.tip: 从心存疑虑到彻底拒绝相信

items.def_en: To express doubt about the truth, correctness, or honesty of something

items.def_zh: 嘲弄并不信，对……嗤之以鼻
items.def_en: To speak about someone or something in a way that shows contemptuous disbelief
To dismiss or refuse to accept a premise, story, or belief as untrue

items.def_zh: 使不可置信，怀疑……的真实性
items.def_en: To cause an idea, statement, or claim to seem untrue, false, or unreliable
To refuse or be unable to believe that something is true, real, or accurate.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on cognitive refusal to accept claims, propositions, or asserted facts as true. Emphasizes an epistemological judgment of factual untruth rather than interpersonal suspicion.
groups.summary_zh: 着重于在认知与判断上拒绝相信某一陈述或事实的真实性。

groups.name: Downplay & Marginalize · 边缘化与淡化 (Marginalize, Sideline, Downplay)
groups.tip: 故意压低其重要性

items.def_zh: 使退居次要地位，淡化…的重要性；提供背景情况
items.def_en: To relegate something to a less prominent or important position; downplay the significance of.
To minimize the importance or value of something deliberately

items.def_zh: 靠边站，使退居次要地位
items.def_en: To remove someone or something from the center of activity or influence
To make something appear less important, severe, or noticeable than it really is

items.def_zh: 使边缘化，排挤至从属地位
items.def_en: To treat a person, group, or concept as insignificant or peripheral

groups.summary_en: Refers to strategic or cognitive actions that push an issue, party, or factor into a secondary, less visible status, deliberately diminishing its perceived importance or attention.
groups.summary_zh: 将事物置于次要地位、冷处理或边缘化，故意淡化其重要性。

groups.name: Downscale & Shrink · 缩小与精简规格 (Downscale, Scale Down, Compact)
groups.tip: 数量削减或规模由大变小

items.def_en: To make a system, organization, or design more efficient by eliminating redundant elements
To make something smaller in size, amount, or scope than originally planned
To press or squeeze something into a smaller space, or encode data into fewer bytes
To reduce the size, scale, or extent of an operation, image, or design

items.def_zh: 使缩小，使变小；（计算机）精简（代码以减小体积）
items.def_en: 1. To make smaller or reduce the size of something. 2. (computing) To remove redundant or unnecessary characters from source code to reduce file size.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on deliberately downsizing, compacting, or stripping down the scale, bulk, or technical footprint of an object, codebase, or model. It highlights reduction in scale, overhead, or redundancy.
groups.summary_zh: 指缩小尺寸规格、精简多余代码或压缩体积规模。

groups.name: Draft & Enlist · 征召与征募兵员 (Draft, Call up, Mobilize)
groups.tip: 国家战时强制征调公民服兵役

items.def_en: To officially order someone into mandatory military service, especially during an emergency
To summon someone for active military duty or reserve training
To assemble soldiers or sailors specifically for roll-call, inspection, or preparation for battle
To assemble and organize civilian and military troops into readiness for active war service
to officially and legally require someone to serve in the armed forces

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the mobilization of individuals into military or civilian defense service, ranging from compulsory government orders to targeted call-ups during wartime emergencies.
groups.summary_zh: 强调国家或军队依规召集、强制征派公民入伍服役。

groups.name: Drastically Cut & Terminate · 强行砍掉与废弃 (Scrap, Can, Nix)
groups.tip: 强行中断或彻底根除

items.def_en: (informal) To terminate, shelve permanently, or dismiss someone summarily
(informal) To abandon or discard something abruptly because it is no longer useful or desired
To discard or cancel a long-held plan, policy, or project as unusable or unviable
1. (informal) To suddenly cancel a project, cut funding, or dismiss employees.
(chiefly North American informal) To put an abrupt end to an idea, proposal, or proposal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the decisive, often ruthless cancellation or defunding of ongoing projects, jobs, or initiatives. They highlight abrupt managerial finality rather than natural phase-out.
groups.summary_zh: 指以果断甚至无情的方式突然取消项目、砍除预算或终止业务。

groups.name: Draw & Unsheathe · 抽拔与出鞘 (Unsheathe, Draw, Pull)
groups.tip: 拔刀出鞘或抽出利刃

items.def_en: To produce or brandish a weapon suddenly from one's clothing or holster.
To take out a weapon smoothly from its holster or scabbard ready for use.
To remove a handgun or firearm from its holster.
To draw or pull a sword, knife, or other weapon out of its sheath.
To draw or reveal a weapon or item with extreme swiftness and agility.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the swift manual extraction of a bladed weapon, tool, or weaponized object from its sheath, holster, or scabbard, often preparing for combat.
groups.summary_zh: 自刀鞘、枪套或皮夹中拔出利刃或武器备战。

groups.name: Draw, Paint & Depict · 绘制与刻画 (Paint, Draw, Sketch)
groups.tip: 用颜料画笔描绘出图像

items.def_en: To produce a picture or diagram by making lines and marks on paper with a pen or pencil
To make a quick, rough drawing of something without giving fine detail

items.def_zh: 画，绘画；涂漆于，给……刷油漆；描绘
items.def_en: 1. To produce a picture of something using paints. 2. To cover a surface with paint. 3. To describe or depict someone or something in a particular way.
To represent someone or something in a painting, drawing, sculpture, or piece of writing
To represent likeness or character in an artwork or to describe in a particular artistic way

groups.summary_en: This core artistic frame denotes the deliberate creation of visual representations or descriptive portraits by applying medium (pigment, ink, graphite) to a surface. Figuratively, it covers rendering people, events, or impressions through vivid words.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过颜料或笔墨在表面创制图像，或引申用生动语言描摹刻画。

groups.name: Drill & Pierce · 打孔与穿透 (Pierce, Perforate, Bore)
groups.tip: 用钻头或尖锥在表面穿透出孔

items.def_en: To make a round hole in or through something using a rotating tool
1. To make a hole in something using a drill or pointed tool. 2. To practice an activity repeatedly or instruct someone through rigorous training.
To make a hole in or through something with a sharp pointed object
To pierce a hole in something, especially causing air or fluid to escape
To make a line or pattern of small holes through a material

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mechanical or physical operations where a pointed or rotating tool makes a hole through, penetrates, or perforates a solid surface or material.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用尖锐或旋转工具在固体表面打孔、贯穿或刺穿。

groups.name: Drip & Trickle Drops · 滴落与沥落 (Trickle, Dribble, Weep)
groups.tip: 液体连续流淌或逐滴落下

items.def_en: 1. To fall or let liquid fall in small drops; to be wet enough for liquid to drop off.
To exude tiny drops of moisture, resin, or fluid very slowly from a surface or wound
To flow or leak slowly through small holes, pores, or minute fissures in small wet drops
To flow or make liquid fall in a thin, gentle, and often intermittent stream or series of drops
To fall or run in small drops or a thin, feeble, uncontrolled trickle

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the downward gravitational falling or oozing of liquid in discrete drops, beads, or feeble, interrupted streams.
groups.summary_zh: 液体成滴状或微细断续水流下落、滴沥或渗流。

groups.name: Drive Forward & Propel · 推进与驱动 (Propel, Drive, Thrust)
groups.tip: 施力驱动物体向前运动

items.def_en: To force someone or something into a particular direction or emotional state by applying constant pressure
To push something forward suddenly and violently into a specified position
1. To push or drive something forward or in a particular direction. 2. To force someone into a new situation or career.
To cast or propel something through the air with immense physical force
To launch or suddenly propel someone or something into a prominent situation or prominent status

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe generating strong kinetic or directional force that pushes an object forward or catapults someone into a new role or state.
groups.summary_zh: 施加强劲前行动力推动物体，或促使某人跃升至新状态。

groups.name: Droop & Loll · 萎蔫与耷拉 (Loll, Wilt, Flap)
groups.tip: 因重力萎靡向下耷拉

items.def_en: To dangle, droop, or extend loosely downward
To droop, become weak, or lose vigor and firmness
To become limp and bend toward the ground through lack of water or heat
To bend or hang downwards from weakness, tiredness, or lack of support; to decline or lose spirit.
To hang loosely, limp, or droop loosely down

groups.summary_en: Centers on biological, organic, or limp entities that hang down limply due to fatigue, dehydration, wilt, or loss of vital tone. It contrasts with structural sagging by highlighting limp flaccidity and lifelessness.
groups.summary_zh: 指生命体或柔软织物因疲倦、脱水或无力而无精打采地耷拉。

groups.name: Dry & Dehumidify · 干燥与除湿 (Desiccate, Dehydrate, Parch)
groups.tip: 抽取水分让环境变干燥

items.def_en: to become completely dry or remove all the liquid or moisture inside an object
to lose or extract water or moisture from food, the body, or a substance
to remove moisture from the air or a space.
to make something extremely dry, especially through exposure to intense heat or sun
to remove all moisture thoroughly from something, leaving it completely dry and preserved

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes that extract moisture or humidity from air, biological matter, or objects, turning damp environments or substances thoroughly arid.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理、化学或机械方式去除空气、物质或物体中的湿气与水分。

groups.name: Duel & Contend · 决斗与交锋 (Clash, Grapple, Spar)
groups.tip: 双人约定决斗或短兵相接

items.def_zh: 实战切磋；你来我往争吵
items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in practice fighting or trade verbal barbs without serious injury
(+ with) To engage in formal conflict, debate, or direct struggle with a rival
(+ with) To engage in close hand-to-hand combat or wrestle physically
(+ with) To engage in a short, violent fight or contentious confrontation
(+ with) To fight a formal combat against another person, or to contend intensely with a rival.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers engaged combat, head-to-head showdowns, and competitive sparring between two opposing individuals or factions.
groups.summary_zh: 指单挑对决、狭路相逢或直接对抗交锋的动词群。

groups.name: Duplicate & Replicate · 复制与复印 (Photocopy, Duplicate, Replicate)
groups.tip: 照样抄写克隆翻印原件

items.def_zh: 复制，复印；抄写；抄袭，模仿
items.def_en: 1. To make a duplicate or reproduction of something written, printed, or recorded. 2. To imitate or mimic someone's actions, style, or work.
To generate an identical technological or functional replica of something
To make an exact facsimile or reproduce the precise characteristics of an original
To make an exact matching copy or duplicate replica of an existing item or file
To produce a photographic paper reproduction of a document using a photocopier

groups.summary_en: Emphasizes producing exact facsimiles, carbon copies, or photographic reproductions of documents, files, or objects. Collocates include document, certificate, key, transcript, and disk.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重对原件、文件或物品制作高度一致的副本或复印件。

groups.name: Dynamite & Demolish · 爆破拆除与炸平 (Blast, Blow, Demolish)
groups.tip: 炸药爆破夷为平地

items.def_en: To clear or remove rock, earth, or masonry by repeated controlled explosions
To destroy a bridge, building, or obstacle completely using explosive charges
To deliberately knock down or blow apart a building or large structure
To strike and explode with a torpedo, or figuratively destroy a plan deliberately
1. To blow up, shatter, or destroy a rock, bridge, or structure using dynamite.

groups.summary_en: Refers to intentionally shattering, blowing apart, or razing physical structures, geological features, or obstacles using high explosives or dynamite.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重使用特定炸药定向爆破开路、摧毁建筑或粉碎岩体。

groups.name: Eavesdrop & Wiretap · 偷听与窃听 (Eavesdrop, Bug, Tap)
groups.tip: 私下越界窃听他人谈话

items.def_en: (+ on) Secretly eavesdrop on someone's telephone line or live conversation
Secretly connect a listening device to a telephone line to monitor calls
(+ on) Secretly listen to a conversation that one is not intended or invited to hear
Conceal a miniature listening device or microphone in a room or device to record conversations

items.def_zh: 搭线窃听，在……上装窃听器
items.def_en: To secretly connect a listening device to a telephone or communication line in order to listen to private conversations.

groups.summary_en: Centers on intentionally and surreptitiously intercepting or listening to private spoken conversations, whether through proximity and listening ears or electronic surveillance devices.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于隐秘动机，在旁偷听或利用电子设备窃听私人谈话。

groups.name: Ebb & Wane · 衰退与消退 (Wane, Dwindle, Peter out, Subside)
groups.tip: 如潮水般退去与减弱

items.def_en: to diminish gradually and come to an end in an unremarkable, sputtering way
to become calmer, quieter, or less fierce after an intense outburst
(often ebb away) to flow back toward the sea, as the tide; to gradually decrease, weaken, or decline
to become gradually weaker, less significant, or less prominent over time
to steadily shrink in size, amount, or strength until very little remains

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses gradual, progressive losses of strength, intensity, volume, or momentum, typically likened to tides, moon phases, or energy flows.
groups.summary_zh: 指强度、力量、激情或数量如潮水退落般逐渐减弱、凋零或减退至微弱状态。

groups.name: Eclipse & Outshine in Prominence · 掩盖与盖过风头 (Outshine, Eclipse, Overshadow)
groups.tip: 光芒盖过同类显得更出众

items.def_en: To win praise or attention away from someone else by preempting their achievements or speech
To cause someone or something to seem less important or successful because of one's presence
To deprive someone or something of significance, power, or prominence by greater achievement

items.def_zh: 使显得矮小；使相形见绌
items.def_en: To cause something to seem negligible or small in size or significance by comparison

items.def_zh: 胜过，比……更出色；使相形见绌；比……发光更亮
items.def_en: 1. To be much better, more impressive, or more successful than someone or something else. 2. To shine more brightly than.

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify surpassing someone or something so brilliantly that the lesser entity is obscured, diminished, or rendered completely insignificant by comparison.
groups.summary_zh: 以超群的光彩或卓越成就使他者黯然失色被遮蔽。

groups.name: Economize & Conserve · 节约与善用 (Economize, Conserve, Steward)
groups.tip: 精打细算勤俭持家

items.def_en: to consume a drink or conserve a resource slowly and carefully to make it last
to protect something from harm, destruction, or wasteful overuse
(+ on) to reduce expenses or use resources more carefully and avoid waste

items.def_zh: 精心照管，审慎管理（资源或财务）
items.def_en: to supervise, manage, or look after properties, finances, or natural resources responsibly

items.def_zh: 节约使用，勤俭管理（资源）
items.def_en: to manage and conserve resources, money, or energy carefully and economically

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on managing, conserving, and stretching limited resources, energy, or funds carefully and prudently to avoid waste. Unlike stingy withholding, it highlights thoughtful administration and sustainability.
groups.summary_zh: 强调审慎、精明地管理与调度物资、能源或金钱以杜绝浪费。

groups.name: Economize & Scrimp · 节约与省吃俭用 (Pinch, Pinch pennies, Economize)
groups.tip: 极力压缩开支精打细算

items.def_en: (+ on) to reduce expenses and use money or resources more carefully
to be extremely careful with every small amount of money one spends
to spend much less money and endure austerity because of financial hardship
(+ on) to spend very little money and live extremely frugally, often doing without necessities to save
to manage to live with just barely enough food or money to survive

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize an extreme, defensive frugality where an individual drastically curtails living expenses, endure privation, or cut everyday necessities to make ends meet or hoard savings.
groups.summary_zh: 强调节衣缩食、克扣日常开支以求省钱度日。

groups.name: Edge-Finishing & Stropping · 荡刀与精细开刃 (Strop, Hone, Whetting)
groups.tip: 在皮条上荡刀使其磨快锋利

items.def_zh: 微调修磨；给（刀刃）快速补磨
items.def_en: To give a knife or tool edge a brief, light sharpening or realignment to restore peak keenness

items.def_zh: 用磨刀棒给…正刃；在磨刀棒上修整
items.def_en: To realign the edge of a kitchen knife by drawing it along a butcher's honing steel
To sharpen a straight razor by stroking its blade along a leather strap.
To finish or polish a blade back or joint to extreme flatness and mirror smoothness using a fine abrasive paste
To remove the rough, ragged edge or tiny raised ridge left on a piece of metal after cutting or sharpening

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the meticulous, micro-level mechanical alignment or finishing of an already-formed cutting edge using straps, fine stones, or steels. Contrasts with bulk sharpening by emphasizing delicate edge realigning and deburring rather than heavy stock removal.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重在刃口成型后通过皮条、荡刀布等进行精细修整、去毛刺与微观校正。

groups.name: Edify & Enlighten · 启迪与教化 (Edify, Enlighten, Elevate)
groups.tip: 启迪心智并给予道德思想教化

items.def_en: To develop or improve a skill, quality, or person through sustained educational guidance
To make something clear and simple to understand, or to mentally enrich and enlighten someone
To give someone greater knowledge, understanding, or insight about a subject or truth
To elevate someone's moral, cultural, or spiritual feelings and bring inspiration

items.def_zh: 教化，启迪，启发（道德或心智）
items.def_en: (formal) To instruct, improve, or enlighten someone morally, intellectually, or spiritually

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this formal frame describe uplifting someone mentally, culturally, or morally through virtuous instruction and intellectual enrichment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在道德、心智或精神层面给予启迪教化与升华。

groups.name: Electoral District Manipulation · 选区划分与选举操纵 (Redistrict, Gerrymander, Stack)
groups.tip: 不公划分选区以操纵选举

items.def_en: Divide or organize an area into new political or legislative districts

items.def_zh: 密集塞入（使反对派集中于个别选区以削弱其席位）
items.def_en: Concentrate voters of one category into a single district to diminish their influence elsewhere

items.def_zh: 拆分拆散（把某一投票群体瓜分进多个选区）
items.def_en: Spread voters of an opposing party thinly across multiple districts to dilute their voting power

items.def_zh: 安排亲信把持，人为安插倾斜（委员会或选区结构）
items.def_en: Arrange a committee, district, or panel unfairly to guarantee a desired partisan advantage

items.def_zh: 不公正地划分选区（以利于某政党）
items.def_en: 1. To unfairly redraw the boundaries of voting districts to give one political party an advantage.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the administrative, structural, or boundary manipulations within electoral and institutional systems designed to systematically dilute or bolster specific voting blocs.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过重划边界或行政洗牌，系统性谋取选区或政治代表权优势。

groups.name: Electroplate & Coat Metal · 金属电镀与表面硬化 (Plate, Galvanize, Anodize)
groups.tip: 给物体外层镀膜或覆盖

items.def_en: To cover a metal object with a thin coating of precious or protective metal
1. To coat a metal or other object with a shiny protective layer of chromium.
To coat iron or steel with a protective layer of molten zinc to prevent rusting
To coat an object with a thin layer of metal by electrolytic deposition
To coat a metal (especially aluminum) with a protective or decorative oxide layer by an electrolytic process

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to applying a thin metallic layer or chemical finish onto a base material to guard against corrosion, enhance hardness, or provide a decorative finish. They center on industrial and metallurgical surface treatments.
groups.summary_zh: 指在金属表面施加化学或电镀保护层以防锈、硬化或装饰。

groups.name: Elevate & Ennoble · 册封、擢升与晋爵 (Elevate, Knight, Exalt)
groups.tip: 提升社会阶层或受封贵族

items.def_en: To promote someone to an ecclesiastical, administrative, or noble office of distinction
To confer the formal rank of knighthood upon a person as an official royal honor
To raise someone to a higher rank, superior social status, or more important post
To raise someone to a very high rank, position, or standard of dignity

items.def_zh: 封……为贵族，授予爵位；使高贵，使崇高
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a noble title, making them a member of the nobility. 2. To make someone or something finer, more noble, or more worthy of respect.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate raising someone to a superior aristocratic rank, high public office, or elevated moral and spiritual standing. They convey institutional authority, formal investiture, or profound honoring.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威赐予贵族爵位、大幅擢升社会地位，或使品格与声望极大升华。

groups.name: Elevate to Saintly or Supreme Status · 册封与神化 (Deify, Enshrine, Idolize)
groups.tip: 官方赞许并给以极高声誉

items.def_en: to treat someone as a celebrated person or public hero with widespread public praise
to place, preserve, or revere someone or something as sacred or inviolable, especially in cultural memory or law
to admire, revere, or love someone or something excessively or uncritically

items.def_zh: 封为圣徒；推崇，尊崇，奉为权威
items.def_en: 1. (religion) to officially declare a deceased person to be a saint. 2. to regard or accept someone or their work as authoritative, classic, or sacred.
to worship or treat someone or something as a god or supreme being

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe elevating someone or their achievements to sacred, unassailable, or revered historical status, whether formally in religion or metaphorically in cultural memory.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人或事物提升至神圣、崇高或不可动摇的殿堂地位。

groups.name: Elicit & Draw Out · 诱导与引出 (Elicit, Evoke, Extract)
groups.tip: 启发引导从而诱发反应

items.def_zh: 设法索取，强行引出（真相、认罪等）
items.def_en: To obtain information, money, or a confession from someone with difficulty or pressure

items.def_zh: 启发…开口，诱引出（信息或想法）
items.def_en: To skillfully encourage someone to speak freely or reveal information and feelings

items.def_zh: 唤起，引起（回忆、感情或共鸣）
items.def_en: To bring a feeling, memory, or image into someone's mind through suggestion or art

items.def_zh: 引出，探出（信息）；诱发，引起（反应）
items.def_en: (+ from) To manage to get information, facts, or a reaction from someone.

items.def_zh: 费力取得，硬逼出（口供或同意）
items.def_en: To obtain something such as a concession or facts with extreme difficulty or struggle

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve drawing out answers, latent emotions, confessions, or reactions from people through targeted questioning, skill, or evocative stimuli.
groups.summary_zh: 通过提问、刺激或技巧，从对方处探取信息或激发情绪反应。

groups.name: Elongation & Spatial Extension · 拉长与延展 (Elongate, Lengthen, Distend)
groups.tip: 两端向外拉伸，长度显著增加
