items.def_en: To make something last longer or to stretch out a malleable material
To pull something so that it becomes longer, wider, or tighter without breaking
To make or become longer in physical distance or duration
To make something longer, or to become longer and narrower.
To prolong or draw out something, especially in time or spatial extension

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes where physical dimensions or temporal durations are stretched out, making an entity longer, leaner, or prolonged. Nuances contrast geometrical elongation, temporal protraction, and flexible expansion under tension.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在几何形态、物理长度或时间跨度上使其伸展或变长。

groups.name: Email & Message · 邮件与电子通信 (Message, Text, Ping)
groups.tip: 现代邮件与即时通讯手段

items.def_en: To send an electronic text message to someone via an app, platform, or mobile device

items.def_zh: 给……发电子邮件；用电子邮件发送
items.def_en: To send an email message to someone, or to send something by email.
To send a written message directly to someone's mobile phone
To send a duplicate copy of an email to an additional recipient
To send a quick message or notification electronically to check availability or alert someone

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies modern digital text-based communication, capturing nuances from formal asynchronous correspondence to immediate, informal instant messaging.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用邮件、短信或即时通讯工具发送电子文字信息的行为。

groups.name: Embody & Represent · 体现与代表 (Personify, Incarnate, Manifest)
groups.tip: 具体化呈现某种精神或特征

items.def_en: To show or demonstrate an internal quality, state, or symptom plainly and noticeably

items.def_zh: 体现，代表（某种思想或品质）；包含，收录
items.def_en: 1. To represent or express an idea, quality, or principle in concrete or visible form. 2. (formal) To include or contain something as part of a larger whole.
To embody or represent a quality or spiritual concept in tangible human form
To be the perfect living example or physical incarnation of a quality, idea, or feeling
To be an exceptionally characteristic or quintessential example of a group or style

groups.summary_en: Centers on giving concrete, living, or visible form to abstract principles, virtues, or cultural identities. Contrasts bodily manifestation with formal political or symbolic representation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将抽象的概念、精神或特质具象化地呈现于人或物之上。

groups.name: Embrace & Clasp · 搂抱与紧拥 (Embrace, Clasp, Enfold)
groups.tip: 张开双臂紧搂入怀中相拥

items.def_en: To put your arms around someone as a sign of affection, greeting, or reconciliation
To hold someone firmly and closely with hands or arms against one's chest

items.def_zh: 怀抱，紧抱入怀；珍藏，藏于心头
items.def_en: (poetic/archaic) To hold closely to one's chest; to cherish or conceal in one's heart
(literary) To close one's arms tightly around someone to surround and comfort them
To clasp someone or something passionately against the breast

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey dignified, protective, or intense enclosing of another person within one's chest and arms. Often elevated or poetic, they highlight total physical enclosure or cherished harborage.
groups.summary_zh: 突出胸怀环拢的庄重姿态，表现将对方紧紧贴在胸口予以庇护或深情搂抱。

groups.name: Emigrate & Expatriate · 移出与去国 (Emigrate, Expatriate, Depart)
groups.tip: 离开原籍移居他乡

items.def_en: To leave one's region, community, or country to reside in another region

items.def_zh: 拔营启程；离开故土移居别处
items.def_en: To leave an established home, community, or country completely and move elsewhere

items.def_zh: 重新安置；迁移到外地/国
items.def_en: (+ to) To move permanently to a new place or country to live or establish business operations
To leave your own country permanently to settle and live in another.
To leave one's native country to live elsewhere, often for employment or prolonged residence

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the outward departure from one's homeland or country of origin to take up residence abroad, highlighting the point of origin and the act of relocating permanently elsewhere.
groups.summary_zh: 指自原籍国迁徙移出，强调离开本土并去往他国定居的过程。

groups.name: Emit & Emanate · 发散与散发 (Emanate, Radiate, Exude)
groups.tip: 气味光线或能量向外散发

items.def_en: to produce and send out gas, heat, light, or an odor into the surrounding air
to discharge or send forth light, sound, radiation, or gas
to send out rays or waves of heat, light, or unmistakable emotion in all directions
To come out or spread from a source, such as a feeling, smell, light, or sound.

items.def_zh: 流露，散发出（气质或气味）
items.def_en: to display an emotion or trait conspicuously, or to slowly seep out a liquid or odor

groups.summary_en: Denotes the outward transmission of intangible or volatile phenomena—such as odors, light, heat, or personal aura—spreading outward from an origin point.
groups.summary_zh: 强调气味、光热或特质从源头向外散发、流露或弥漫。

groups.name: Emote & Project Emotion · 显现情绪与流露 (Dramatize, Radiate, Gush)
groups.tip: 通过言行面容展现内在情绪体验

items.def_en: to become visibly unable to speak clearly due to being overwhelmed by strong emotion
to clearly show a particular feeling or quality in one's face or general demeanour

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地赞叹；过分热情地流露
items.def_en: to express praise, pleasure, or affection in an overly enthusiastic, effusive way

items.def_zh: 充分流露；四溢着（自信、魅力等）
items.def_en: to display a quality or emotion strongly and visibly in one's bearing

items.def_zh: 表达感情，流露情绪；（表演时）做作地表现情感
items.def_en: to express emotion openly and demonstratively, especially when acting on stage or screen

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate visibly portraying, exuding, or demonstratively expressing feeling, especially in theatrical performance or heightened expressive display.
groups.summary_zh: 指在外表、动作或舞台表演中公开、富有表现力地展现或流露情绪。

groups.name: Employ & Appoint · 任职与任用赋职 (Appoint, Install, Staff)
groups.tip: 招聘录用付酬使用

items.def_en: to provide an organization, project, or department with the necessary workforce
(formal) to employ someone or contract their services for a specific role
to assign someone formally to a specific public, political, or corporate office
to pay someone to work for you; to use a particular method, skill, or object for a purpose
to place someone formally in an official post or position through a ceremony

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this governance and institutional frame describe placing people in workforce roles, commissioning duties, and utilizing personnel and organizational resources.
groups.summary_zh: 指委派职务、配置人员及使人才在机构中担纲职责。

groups.name: Employ & Operate · 使用与操作 (Use, Employ, Wield)
groups.tip: 利用工具手段达成具体目的

items.def_zh: 使用，利用，运用；消耗，耗费
items.def_en: to employ a tool, method, or resource for a particular purpose; to consume or expend
to control the functioning of a machine, vehicle, or mechanical system
to hold, touch, or operate something skillfully with your hands
to make use of a particular method, technique, or instrument for a task

items.def_zh: 挥舞，操持（武器或工具）；行使
items.def_en: to hold and use a weapon or tool effectively with your hands; to exercise power

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the direct physical or instrumental handling and employment of tools, instruments, or methods to perform tasks or carry out functions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调直接操控、操纵工具或采取具体手段达成目的。

groups.name: Enact & Promulgate Law · 颁布与颁发法令 (Promulgate, Enact, Decree)
groups.tip: 官方郑重公开发表声明，颁布法定法令

items.def_zh: 正式颁发；下达（指令或声明）
items.def_en: To supply or produce something officially for public circulation or enforcement
To make a proposed law into official legislation

items.def_zh: 命令；裁定（尤指依法或以专制权力发布）
items.def_en: To order, establish, or decide something by official legal decree
To make or enact laws covering a specific area or jurisdiction

items.def_zh: 公布，颁布（法律、法令等）；宣扬，传播（信仰、教条）
items.def_en: 1. To officially announce and put into effect a new law, decree, or policy. 2. To spread or promote an idea or belief widely.

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the formal institutional process of putting laws, decrees, or official doctrines into public effect and widespread recognition.
groups.summary_zh: 专指立法机构或掌权者正式颁布施行法律、教义或法令。

groups.name: Encase & Liquidate into Money · 兑现与变现 (Cash, Redeem, Liquidate)
groups.tip: 把票据或资产变现

items.def_en: To exchange a check, bond, or money order for cash.

items.def_zh: 兑换现金，变现（筹码、证券）
items.def_en: To exchange securities, tokens, or policies for the monetary value they represent
To exchange a coupon, voucher, or share for money, goods, or equivalent value
To convert assets or securities into cash, often to settle debts or wind up a venture

items.def_zh: 实现货币化，靠……盈利变现
items.def_en: To convert an asset, activity, or online presence into regular income or legal tender

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe converting non-cash assets, financial instruments, vouchers, or claims into immediate paper money or readily usable funds.
groups.summary_zh: 指将支票、证券、凭证或非流动资产兑换、提现或变卖为现金。

groups.name: Encircle & Bind with Bands · 箍紧与环束 (Hoop, Band, Gird)
groups.tip: 铁箍绳索紧紧捆扎

items.def_en: 1. To bind, fasten, or encircle a barrel or object with metal or wooden hoops.
To encircle, bind, or reinforce an object with a flat strip or band of metal, plastic, or tape
To fasten, secure, or bind tightly together using a flexible strap or belt
To encircle, bind, or secure with a belt or band, or to surround structurally for support
To tie, bind, or fasten tightly so as to immobilize, reinforce, or hold securely in shape

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe securing, reinforcing, or enclosing an object by placing rigid or flexible bands, rings, or belts around its perimeter. They often carry technical or artisanal connotations relating to barrels, bales, or structural supports.
groups.summary_zh: 用金属圈、带子或箍环紧固或加固物体的外周。

groups.name: Enclose & Encase · 密闭与包裹封装 (Encase, Enclose, Sheathe)
groups.tip: 密闭封装入箱壳容器之中

items.def_en: To surround or hold inside a container, barrier, or boundary completely
To wrap up, cover, or surround something completely
To enclose something tightly inside or as if in a capsule

items.def_zh: 把……装入箱（或套）中；包住，完全围住
items.def_en: To enclose or cover something completely in a case, box, or protective layer.
To put a weapon or object into a protective case, covering, or sheath

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe placing an object inside a tight, fitted, or protective exterior covering, box, or sheath.
groups.summary_zh: 指用壳体、容器或保护套层完全包裹、容纳或密闭物体。

groups.name: Encode & Encrypt · 编码与加密 (Encode, Encrypt, Scramble)
groups.tip: 将明文转化成密码信息隐藏

items.def_en: To convert ordinary text into ciphertext using a cryptographic cipher
To modify a broadcast signal or transmission electronically so it cannot be received without a decoder
To convert information or instructions into a coded form
1. (computing) To convert electronic data or messages into a secret code to prevent unauthorized access.

items.def_zh: 用密码书写，将……译成密码；做算术，计算
items.def_en: 1. (variant of cipher) To encode a message into secret code. 2. (archaic) To calculate or do arithmetic.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to converting data, text, or signals into a cipher or secret format to ensure security, prevent unauthorized access, or facilitate machine transmission. 'Encrypt' emphasizes cryptographic security, whereas 'encode' generally applies to systemic data format conversion.
groups.summary_zh: 将信息、数据转化为密文或编码以防窃听或便于传输。

groups.name: Encounter & Live Through · 经历与亲历 (Undergo, Encounter, Taste)
groups.tip: 亲身感受并经历事情

items.def_en: 1. To undergo, live through, or feel something.
To experience a momentary or brief sensation of something, such as success, defeat, or freedom
To try or experience a small portion of an activity or lifestyle to see what it is like
To unexpectedly experience or be faced with a specific problem, condition, or situation

items.def_zh: 度过；亲身经历（艰难境况）
items.def_en: To survive and endure a traumatic, difficult, or momentous historical experience

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe actively meeting, feeling, or passing through significant life events, hardships, or perceptual phenomena. They express the cognitive and emotional imprint left by passing events.
groups.summary_zh: 指身历其境、亲身感受或遭遇某类生活变故与情感体验。

groups.name: Encourage & Spur · 鼓舞与激励 (Spur, Goad, Galvanize)
groups.tip: 鼓励鼓舞策马扬鞭

items.def_en: to poke, encourage, or remind a reluctant person to take action
to encourage or urge someone strongly to do something foolish or dangerous

items.def_zh: 激励，鼓舞，促使；用马刺策（马）加速
items.def_en: to encourage someone to do something, or to encourage something to happen faster or improve; to urge a horse forward with spurs
to persistently provoke or annoy someone into doing something
to shock or excite someone into taking immediate, vigorous action

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify injecting kinetic momentum, courage, or urgency into an agent to trigger decisive action. They contrast gentle verbal cheering with sharp, provokative jolts.
groups.summary_zh: 言辞鼓舞、利诱逼迫或强力震动以驱使他人迅速采取行动。

groups.name: Encroach & Poach · 侵蚀领地与非法截取 (Poach, Encroach, Usurp)
groups.tip: 越界非法侵占他人资源

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to actively violate or breach another party's legal privileges or space
(+ on) to enter someone's land, property, or affairs without permission

items.def_zh: 偷猎，非法捕猎；挖走（人员、客户等）；侵占；水煮，炖（蛋、鱼等）
items.def_en: 1. to hunt or fish illegally on someone else's land or water. 2. to persuade employees or clients to leave a rival organization. 3. to cook food gently in simmering liquid.
(+ on/upon) to advance gradually beyond acceptable limits into someone's territory or rights
to seize and hold power, position, or property illegally and by force

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes trespassing onto another's jurisdiction, property, or customer base to seize resources, wildlife, or personnel covertly, unlawfully, or gradually.
groups.summary_zh: 指未经许可侵入他人领地、领域，盗猎或截挖利益与人才。

groups.name: Endure & Weather Trials · 经受与经受折磨 (Weather, Sustain, Braved)
groups.tip: 饱经风霜遭受考验

items.def_en: To suffer, experience, or receive damage, an injury, or a severe setback

items.def_zh: 勇敢面对；经受（严酷环境）
items.def_en: To endure unpleasant, dangerous, or arduous conditions courageously
1. Past participle of undergo; to have experienced or been subjected to something.

items.def_zh: 平安经受；顶住（风暴、危机）
items.def_en: To come safely through a dangerous storm, financial crisis, or intense trial
To tolerate or endure an offensive, harrowing, or deeply unpleasant reality

groups.summary_en: Focusing on passive or stoic endurance, verbs in this frame denote being subjected to physical changes, severe tests, traumas, or damages without succumbing. They emphasize structural or personal fortitude.
groups.summary_zh: 指承受剧烈变化、创伤或危机而坚持下来，强调耐受与扛住考验。

groups.name: Endure Hardship & Agonize · 煎熬与受难 (Suffer, Languish, Agonize)
groups.tip: 承受生理或心理的磨难

items.def_en: To experience or be subjected to an unpleasant, painful, or demanding process
1. To experience physical or mental pain, illness, or severe hardship. 2. To experience or undergo something bad, unpleasant, or damaging.
To undergo and withstand lasting pain, hardship, or adversity without giving in

items.def_zh: 在困境中受煎熬；衰颓憔悴
items.def_en: (+ in) To be forced to remain in an unpleasant, neglected place and suffer continuous deterioration

items.def_zh: 备受精神折磨；极度焦虑苦恼
items.def_en: (+ over/about) To experience extreme physical pain or, more commonly, severe mental torment

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses enduring prolonged physical pain, intense mental anguish, or deep privation. Nuances vary between helpless decline, acute agony, and patient fortitude.
groups.summary_zh: 强调长期经受身心痛苦、煎熬或在困境中备受折磨。

groups.name: Enforce & Execute · 强制执行与恪遵 (Execute, Implement, Impose)
groups.tip: 从日常推行到强制执行法律政策

items.def_en: To put a plan, system, treaty, or policy into official operation and practical effect
(+ on) To enforce laws or regulations much more strictly to stamp out illicit behavior
To perform or carry out the requirements of a legal order, sentence, or administrative instruction
To officially force a rule, tax, punishment, or curfew to be accepted using governmental power

items.def_zh: 强制执行，贯彻（法律、规定）；强加，迫使
items.def_en: 1. To make sure that a law, rule, or system is obeyed. 2. To force something to happen or be accepted.

groups.summary_en: Refers to compelling compliance with laws, decrees, or mandates through authoritative mechanisms, state power, or sanctions, ensuring rules are actively applied rather than remaining dead letters.
groups.summary_zh: 依凭法定职权或惩戒机制强制落实法规、判决或规约，确保执行。

groups.name: Enforce & Impose · 强制与实施 (Reimpose, Enforce, Implement, Reinstate)
groups.tip: 再度强制执行法令规章

items.def_en: Put a formal plan, regulation, or policy into active practical effect
Make people obey a legal rule, law, or obligation through authority or punishment
Officially impose an administrative tax, tariff, fee, or legal fine
Restore a previous law, condition, practice, or authority to operational effect

items.def_zh: 重新实施，重新征收，再次强制推行
items.def_en: to bring back and enforce a law, tax, restriction, or penalty that had previously been lifted

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying authority, legal mandates, penalties, or restrictions, especially reinstating regulations to ensure societal compliance.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方动用职权推行法令、禁令或再度施行约束措施。

groups.name: Engage & Interlock · 啮合与咬合 (Mesh, Interlock, Cog)
groups.tip: 齿轮部件互相扣合

items.def_en: To fit together or cause mechanical parts to interlock so that motion is transmitted
To connect or adapt components smoothly to achieve a specific mechanical or functional relationship

items.def_zh: （齿轮等）啮合，相扣；紧密配合，吻合；用网捕
items.def_en: 1. (of gear teeth) To fit together and engage. 2. To fit together or work together smoothly and harmoniously. 3. To catch in a net.

items.def_zh: 相互交错咬合，连接锁定
items.def_en: To fit together firmly with parts that cross, overlap, or hook into one another
To fit together compactly and harmoniously like a carpenter's joint

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate mechanical parts, components, or abstract systems fitting together precisely so that motion or purpose is transmitted smoothly. Collocations typically involve gears, teeth, cogs, or integrated strategies.
groups.summary_zh: 强调齿轮或构件紧密嵌合，亦指计划体系环环相扣。

groups.name: Engulf & Submerge · 吞噬与淹没 (Engulf, Swallow up, Submerge)
groups.tip: 巨浪深渊，彻底吞饮没顶

items.def_en: To plunge, sink, or completely cover something under liquid or water
To completely cover, envelop, or cause something to vanish, as if consumed whole

items.def_zh: 吞没，淹没；（情绪等）席卷，彻底笼罩
items.def_en: (often passive) To surround and completely cover something, as by water or flames; to overwhelm or consume completely.
To flood an area with water so that everything is submerged
To completely destroy or devour something, especially by fire or catastrophic force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical forces—such as floodwaters, fire, or geological collapses—completely surrounding, burying, or consuming an object or person so it disappears. They are frequently used figuratively for overwhelming emotions or catastrophe.
groups.summary_zh: 指火势、洪水或灾变将事物全方位吞噬、淹没或完全埋没。

groups.name: Enjoin & Mandate · 严令与戒律传达 (Direct, Mandate, Decree)
groups.tip: 行使权威强制吩咐与下令

items.def_en: To instruct or tell someone to do something with formal authority
To lay down authoritatively as a rule, requirement, or course of action
To issue an authoritative, statutory, or official command to carry out an action
To order or establish something officially with legal or sovereign power

items.def_zh: 吩咐，命令，责成；（法律上）禁止，下禁令
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/to do) (formal) To instruct or strongly urge someone to do something. 2. (+ from) (law) To issue an official court order preventing or prohibiting someone from doing something.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal, authoritative, or legal directives instructing or obliging someone to perform an action or legally prohibiting them from doing so.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据权威、法律条令或高度职责严正命令、强制执行或司法禁令。

groups.name: Enjoy & Relish · 享受与玩味 (Relish, Savor, Bask)
groups.tip: 沉浸于美好体验并细细品味咀嚼

items.def_en: To lie in warmth, or to enjoy and derive immense gratification from praise, attention, or success

items.def_zh: 享受，喜爱；享有，拥有（有益之物）
items.def_en: 1. To take pleasure or delight in something. 2. To possess and benefit from something good or advantageous.
To take immense pleasure in an experience, prospect, or thought
To enjoy a food, aroma, moment, or feeling slowly and deliberately so as to appreciate it fully
To take fierce delight or satisfaction in a situation, state, or activity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this affective frame denote experiencing deep pleasure, appreciation, or satisfaction from an experience, sensation, or triumph. Nuances range from lingering over sensory tastes to actively reveling in personal recognition or comfort.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对愉悦体验、感官滋味或荣誉的尽情领略与回味。

groups.name: Enlighten & Illuminate · 启迪与开导 (Enlighten, Illuminate, Edify)
groups.tip: 传授知识并启迪开导他人心智

items.def_zh: 使大开眼界，让某人认清现实
items.def_en: Make someone realize an unexpected truth or discover facts previously hidden from them
To give someone greater knowledge, understanding, or insight about a subject or situation.
Instruct or improve someone morally, spiritually, or intellectually
Make something clear, lucid, and easy to understand intellectually

items.def_zh: 纠正，破除（某人的错误观念）
items.def_en: (+ of) Persuade someone that an idea or belief they hold is completely mistaken

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote conferring deep understanding, spiritual or intellectual clarity, and moral perspective, lifting someone out of ignorance or confusion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调解开困惑、点拨思维以启发心智与认知。

groups.name: Enshrine & Venerate · 供奉与铭记 (Enshrine, Commemorate, Venerate)
groups.tip: 载入史册入龛供奉与纪念

items.def_en: to recall and show respect for an event or person through a special act or monument

items.def_zh: 把……置于神龛中供奉；珍藏，铭记
items.def_en: (literary) to enclose in or as if in a shrine; to cherish or enshrine
to praise highly or raise someone or something to a very high level of honor
to preserve a right, tradition, or principle in a form that is respected and protected
to regard someone or something with deep respect, awe, or religious devotion

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on holding persons, ideals, relics, or memories in sacred or honored esteem, preserving them respectfully in texts, institutions, or ceremonial memory.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将圣物、英烈或信条虔敬供奉、载入法典或永久铭记。

groups.name: Entangle & Tangle · 纠缠与交织缠结 (Snarl, Enmesh, Intertwine)
groups.tip: 线缕杂乱交织无法解开

items.def_zh: 缠作一团；造成严重阻塞混乱
items.def_en: To twist or entangle into an intractable mess, or cause severe, tangled blockage
1. To twist threads, hair, or wires together into an untidy mass, or become involved in a complicated dispute.
To twist or twine together closely, whether physically or metaphorically

items.def_zh: 使缠住；使卷入复杂困境
items.def_en: To cause something to become caught in a snare, netting, or a complicated situation

items.def_zh: 落入网中；使陷入（网络、困境）
items.def_en: To catch or involve someone or something deeply in a net or complex web of trouble

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physical or figurative twisting and knotting together of threads, wires, limbs, or affairs, resulting in confusion, entrapment, or messy complication.
groups.summary_zh: 指线缆、毛发等互相盘绕死结，或比喻卷入复杂棘手的纷争陷阱。

groups.name: Enunciate & Formulate · 阐明与清晰陈述 (Articulate, State, Pronounce)
groups.tip: 字正腔圆咬字清晰地阐发观点

items.def_en: To make the distinct sounds of a word correctly, or to declare something authoritatively
To express an idea, thought, or policy fluently, coherently, and in distinct terms
To express an opinion, doctrine, or policy in a carefully prepared, precise, and systematic way

items.def_zh: 清晰阐明，明确表达；清晰发音
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To state an idea, principle, or belief clearly and definitely. 2. To pronounce words or sounds clearly and distinctly.
To formulate and state official rules, principles, or conditions firmly and clearly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize crystal-clear vocal diction or well-structured conceptual formulation. They contrast the physical clarity of phonation with the formal doctrinal exposition of policy or ideas.
groups.summary_zh: 口齿分明地发音，或系统清晰地陈述理论与主张。

groups.name: Envy & Covet · 嫉妒与觊觎 (Covet, Crave, Hanker After)
groups.tip: 从暗中羡慕嫉妒到生出非分觊觎

items.def_en: To have a persistent, lingering, and restless longing for something unattainable
To feel a powerful, urgent, and consuming desire for something
To wish you had someone else's qualities, possessions, or advantages; to feel envious of.
To yearn possessively to have something, especially something belonging to another person
To have an overwhelming, unbridled desire or greed to possess something

groups.summary_en: This frame spans the desire spectrum from wistfully wishing for another's advantages to hungrily coveting and striving to possess what rightfully belongs to someone else. The intensity scales from passive longing to grasping greed.
groups.summary_zh: 体现从羡慕他人物事逐步升级至贪婪觊觎、极度渴望占有的心理阶梯。

groups.name: Envy & Resent · 嫉妒与怨恨 (Resent, Grudge, Chafe at)
groups.tip: 心生嫉妒而暗怀怨尤

items.def_en: To feel irritated, impatient, or resentful because of constraints, unfairness, or rules
To feel bitter, indignant, or angry about something or someone regarded as unfair
To give or allow with reluctance, or feel ill will toward someone for possessing something
To express discontent, sorrow, or bitter regret about one's unfavorable situation relative to others

items.def_zh: 嫉妒，妒忌；对……心存不满，怨恨；勉强给，吝惜
items.def_en: 1. To feel unhappy or resentful that someone has something, or to envy someone their success. 2. To give or spend something unwillingly or reluctantly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express bitter, brooding displeasure directed at another person's advantage, privilege, or success, or giving something with persistent reluctance. The tone highlights bitter indignation and simmering grievance.
groups.summary_zh: 表现因他人拥有优势、成功或待遇而心生不满、耿耿于怀或勉强给予。

groups.name: Equivocate & Evade · 含糊其辞与规避 (Equivocate, Hedge, Pussyfoot)
groups.tip: 含糊其辞企图蒙混过关

items.def_en: To discuss a topic at length while deliberately avoiding the central point

items.def_zh: 含糊其辞，回避；篡改，捏造（以蒙混过关）
items.def_en: To avoid giving a clear statement, answer, or commitment; to adjust or manipulate figures or facts deceptively.
To avoid giving a direct answer or making a firm commitment by qualifying one's statements

items.def_zh: 说模棱两可的话；含糊其辞
items.def_en: To use ambiguous language intentionally to deceive or conceal the truth
To speak evasively or untruthfully in order to avoid an awkward truth

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intentionally using vague, ambiguous, or non-committal language to skirt a direct question, dodge accountability, or delay a hard decision.
groups.summary_zh: 故意运用模棱两可或留有余地的话语来回避正面回答或责任。

groups.name: Eradicate & Wipe Out · 灭绝与根除 (Annihilate, Obliterate, Wipe out)
groups.tip: 斩草除根无一幸免

items.def_en: Destroy or eliminate someone or something completely
To completely destroy or get rid of something harmful, such as a disease, poverty, or crime.

items.def_zh: 抹杀；使不留痕迹地消亡
items.def_en: Remove or destroy all traces of something completely
Destroy something utterly so that nothing of it remains
Destroy completely a group of people, pests, or living things

groups.summary_en: Verbs depicting the absolute obliteration or wiping off the map of diseases, social plagues, or enemy populations until no remnant survives.
groups.summary_zh: 指彻底摧毁、消灭有害事物或种群，使之一点不留。

groups.name: Err & Blunder · 犯错与失误 (Err, Slip up, Trip up)
groups.tip: 从轻微差错到愚蠢大错

items.def_en: To make a careless or minor error through inattention or forgetfulness
To make a mistake in judgment, understanding, or moral decision-making
To make an unwitting, clumsy misstep or misjudgment in speech or conduct

items.def_zh: 犯愚蠢的错误，搞砸；跌跌撞撞地走
items.def_en: 1. To make a serious, clumsy, or embarrassing mistake. 2. (+ into/along) To move awkwardly, clumsily, or blindly as if unable to see.
To judge or assess a situation, probability, or timing incorrectly

groups.summary_en: Focuses on lapses in judgment, oversight, or uncalculated decisions that result in grave, foolish, or embarrassing mistakes.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因疏忽、误判或笨拙而犯下明显错误或重大失策。

groups.name: Erupt & Burst Forth · 爆发与迸发 (Burst, Break Out, Flare up)
groups.tip: 能量或情感突然剧烈释放

items.def_en: (+ into/out) To emerge suddenly, spontaneously, and with great energy or emotion
To begin suddenly and violently, used of wars, fires, riots, or epidemics
To suddenly burn more intensely or suddenly erupt into conflict or anger
1. To burst out suddenly and violently, as in laughter, anger, or fighting. 2. When a volcano erupts, it suddenly throws out lava, ash, and gases.
To burst into suddenly and forcibly, or to increase abruptly and uncontrollably

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe sudden, violent emergences into active existence, spanning geopolitical conflicts, fiery natural phenomena, and abrupt collective emotional outpourings.
groups.summary_zh: 描述冲突、火势或强烈情绪突发性地爆发或喷涌而出。

groups.name: Escort & Accompany · 护送与礼仪陪同 (Escort, Accompany, Conduct)
groups.tip: 随行守护移动过程

items.def_en: (formal) Lead or guide someone through, around, or to a specific place
Show someone the right way or lead them through a route or unfamiliar setting
Go somewhere with someone as a companion, assistant, or escort
1. To go with someone or a vehicle in order to protect, guide, or guard them, or as a courtesy.
Guide or escort someone to a particular place, often politely and courteously

groups.summary_en: Describes traveling alongside someone to provide protection, security, authoritative guidance, or ceremonial respect. Contrasts casual walking with deliberate safeguarding or formal guidance.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重出于安保、护卫或礼节礼貌而护送、导引特定对象。

groups.name: Estrange & Divide · 离间与使反目 (Alienate, Estrange, Disaffect)
groups.tip: 感情渐行渐远导致隔阂疏离

items.def_zh: 在……之间挑拨离间；造成分裂
items.def_en: To act in a way that damages good relations and creates mistrust between two parties

items.def_zh: 使疏远，离间；使格格不入
items.def_en: (+ from) To make someone feel isolated, unfriendly, or detached from people, a group, or society.

items.def_zh: 使不忠；使产生反感与不满
items.def_en: To make someone discontented and disloyal toward an authority, leader, or organization
To cause someone to stop liking or supporting another and become hostile toward them

items.def_zh: 使疏远；使夫妻或亲友反目
items.def_en: (+ from) To cause someone to become unfriendly, hostile, or indifferent where intimacy once existed

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on driving a wedge between people or groups, dissolving mutual affection, loyalty, or trust. The consequence is deep emotional rift and enduring hostility.
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏亲密关系或忠诚，导致情感疏离、反目成仇。

groups.name: Eulogize & Commemorate · 颂扬与致颂词 (Eulogize, Panegyrize, Pay tribute)
groups.tip: 从日常赞扬表彰升华至致悼词歌功颂德

items.def_en: To remember and honor an important person or past event with a ceremony or specialized work
To preserve the memory of an honored person or momentous event, often in words or a monument
To express admiration, respect, or gratitude for someone's character or achievements formally
To speak or write a formal speech or text of elaborate and extravagant praise
1. (formal) To praise someone or something highly in a speech or piece of writing, especially at a funeral.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on eloquent, sustained, and highly formal tributes praising someone’s character or life work, most notably upon retirement, death, or momentous civic occasions.
groups.summary_zh: 在生离死别或重大典礼等正式场合，发表赞词对人一生或功绩进行颂扬。

groups.name: Excavate & Hollow Out · 开凿与疏浚 (Excavate, Scoop out, Gouge)
groups.tip: 清淤捞渣或大面积深挖

items.def_en: To hollow out an interior space or remove loose material by using a concave tool or cupped hands
To extract stone, slate, or other materials by cutting or blasting from a large open excavation

items.def_zh: 疏浚，清淤；捞取；翻出，重提（旧事）
items.def_en: 1. To clean out the bed of a harbor, river, or other area of water by scooping up mud and debris. 2. (usually 'dredge up') To bring up or recall unwelcome memories or facts
To make a deep hole or channel in the ground using earthmoving equipment, or uncover artifacts scientifically
To dig, scoop, or cut a deep groove, hole, or channel out of a solid surface with force or a sharp tool

groups.summary_en: This frame covers systematically removing soil, silt, rock, or internal substance using heavy machinery, vessels, or tools to deepen channels or reveal subterranean structures. 'Excavate' emphasizes archaeological or construction digging, whereas 'dredge' focuses on scooping silt from submerged beds.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用机械或工具对水体、地基或物体进行疏浚、开凿或挖空。

groups.name: Excavate & Unearth · 发掘与出土 (Excavate, Unearth, Exhume)
groups.tip: 深层发掘铲出地下之物

items.def_en: To remove something from the earth by breaking up and scooping soil
To dig carefully in the ground to uncover buried objects, ancient ruins, or fossils; to hollow out earth to make a hole or channel
To find something that was buried in the ground by digging it up
To remove a dead body from the ground, especially in order to examine it formally
To take something out of the ground or a grave where it was buried

groups.summary_en: This high-intensity physical frame denotes systematically removing earth to uncover buried ruins, artifacts, bones, or large subsurface spaces. It strongly collocates with archaeology, construction, and forensic disinterment.
groups.summary_zh: 指有目的、深层且系统性地清除土方，使地下文物、遗址或遗体出土。

groups.name: Excerpt & Anthologize · 节录与采辑 (Excerpt, Extract, Cull)
groups.tip: 从文章或讲话中节选摘录内容

items.def_en: To copy, take, or plagiarize a phrase or passage directly out of someone else's writing
To select and copy out a specific passage, sentence, or data point from a book or text
To select and include texts, poems, or stories in an anthology or collection
to take or select a short passage from a book, speech, film, piece of music, etc.
To pick out, select, or gather excerpts and facts from various sources

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on selecting, copying out, or compiling representative passages, chapters, or soundbites from a larger work.
groups.summary_zh: 从书籍、演讲或宏大作品中采选、摘取片段以供出版或引用。

groups.name: Excise & Extirpate · 切除与全剔 (Resect, Gouge, Cut Out)
groups.tip: 彻底切掉或手术剔除

items.def_zh: 切除，删掉（病变组织或段落）
items.def_en: To remove a piece of text or body tissue by cutting
To force or scoop something out deeply and violently with a blade or sharp tool
To cut out or surgically remove tissue or an organ; to completely remove a passage or part from a text.

items.def_zh: 手术切除（器官或组织一部分）
items.def_en: To surgically cut out part or all of an organ, bone, or tissue structure
To surgically cut off an arm, leg, finger, or toe

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on radical, thorough surgical, editorial, or physical resection where an entire offending structure, diseased tissue, or banned text is excised cleanly.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过手术或彻底剪除手段，将病灶、组织或文字段落彻底挖除割掉。

groups.name: Exclaim & Cry Out · 感叹与惊呼 (Blurt Out, Cry Out, Proclaim)
groups.tip: 高声呼喊并带有感叹情绪

items.def_zh: 脱口而出；不假思索地说出
items.def_en: To utter abruptly and impulsively without thinking
To make a sudden loud exclamation of pain, alarm, or surprise
To say something breathlessly while drawing in breath sharply from surprise
(literary/dated) To say something suddenly and passionately

items.def_zh: （因惊讶、激动或愤怒而）高声呼喊，惊呼，感叹
items.def_en: To cry out or speak suddenly and loudly because of surprise, strong emotion, or pain.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey spontaneous, vocalized reactions to sudden surprise, amazement, alarm, or overwhelming emotion, emphasizing the bursting nature of the utterance.
groups.summary_zh: 指因震惊、狂喜或突发刺激而情不自禁地脱口惊呼或抒发感叹。

groups.name: Exemplify & Epitomize · 体现与典范 (Exemplify, Distill, Mirror)
groups.tip: 作为典型化身并集中代表

items.def_en: To reflect or correspond closely to the qualities, moods, or patterns of something else
To serve as a perfect summary or representation of the essential character of something
To illustrate, explain, or stand as a prime example of a general rule or trend
To express or condense the essential qualities of something in a concise, compact form

items.def_zh: 成为……的典型（或缩影），集中体现；概括，摘要
items.def_en: 1. To be a perfect or typical example of something. 2. (formal) To give a summary or epitome of a piece of work.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on serving as the supreme, quintessential model or classic illustration of a broader phenomenon. Contrasts serving as an informative example with functioning as its ultimate paradigm.
groups.summary_zh: 指充当某一类事物最为典型、完美或浓缩的代表与例证。

groups.name: Exempt & Release · 豁免与免除 (Exempt, Excuse, Discharge)
groups.tip: 免除法定责任或特定义务

items.def_en: (+ from) To officially allow someone not to do something that is normally mandatory
To choose not to punish someone for an offense, or punish them very lightly

items.def_zh: 解除；准许离开(债务/职责)
items.def_en: To officially release someone from a legal duty, contract, debt, or institutional stay
To officially excuse someone or something from a duty, payment, or rule that others have to obey.
To formally state that a normal rule, fee, requirement, or right will not be enforced

groups.summary_en: This frame covers legal and administrative acts whereby an authority formally relieves an individual or organization from an otherwise mandatory obligation, penalty, liability, or tax.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或权威机构依法免除某人应履行的责任、税赋或惩罚。

groups.name: Exhume & Unearth · 发掘与掘出 (Exhume, Unearth, Dig up)
groups.tip: 掘开土壤取出掩埋之物

items.def_en: To remove something from under the ground by digging, or to uncover hidden information with effort
To bring a dead body back to life, or figuratively revive a forgotten practice, memory, or idea
To find or dig something out of the ground through excavation, or to discover long-hidden facts
To dig up a buried corpse from the ground, especially for medical or legal examination

items.def_zh: 掘出，发掘（尤指尸体）；使显露，揭露
items.def_en: (formal) To dig up something, especially a dead body, that has been buried; to bring back or uncover something hidden or forgotten

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to digging up buried corpses, hidden artifacts, or long-forgotten secrets out of the earth or obscurity. While 'exhume' is legally and medically specific to buried bodies, 'unearth' and 'dig up' extend freely to archaeology, evidence, and historical secrets.
groups.summary_zh: 指自地下或隐秘处掘出遗骸、文物或揭开被遗忘秘辛。

groups.name: Exonerate & Vindicate · 洗雪与昭雪 (Vindicate, Exonerate, Clear)
groups.tip: 据理力争洗刷污名证明正确

items.def_en: (+ of) To prove that someone is innocent of a crime, accusation, or misconduct
(+ of) To officially decide in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a specific charge

items.def_zh: 证实……正确，证明……无辜，辩白
items.def_en: To prove that someone or something is right, reasonable, or innocent after being blamed or questioned.
(+ of/from) To formally declare someone free from guilt, blame, or moral obligation
(+ from) To officially declare that someone is free from blame, fault, or legal responsibility

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe officially proving innocence, establishing truth, or releasing someone from sustained blame, suspicion, or false accusation through decisive evidence or subsequent events.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过确凿证据或事实证明清白、洗刷嫌疑或昭雪冤屈。

groups.name: Expatiate & Disclose At Length · 详述与长篇论述 (Expatiate, Dilate, Hold Forth)
groups.tip: 就特定主题作长篇论说

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To engage in a lengthy, formal discussion or exposition regarding a subject

items.def_zh: 大发议论；滔滔不绝地讲
items.def_en: (+ on) To express opinions lengthily and authoritatively, often to an assembled group
(+ on/upon) To speak or write at great length or in extensive detail about a topic
(+ on/upon) (formal) To speak or write at length and expand expansively upon a theme

items.def_zh: 长篇论述，详细述评；唱高音部
items.def_en: 1. ('descant on/upon') (formal) To talk or write at great length about a subject. 2. (music) To sing or play an ornamental melody above a basic theme.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this rhetorical frame signify speaking, pontificating, or writing at exhaustive length about a subject. They often carry connotations of formal disquisition, academic fullness, or self-indulgent verbosity.
groups.summary_zh: 指详尽、冗长或滔滔不绝地就某一话题阐发论述。

groups.name: Expend & Consume · 花费与消耗 (Spend, Exhaust, Deplete)
groups.tip: 用尽物力财力与时间

items.def_zh: 花费，耗费（金钱、时间、精力）
items.def_en: to pay out money or utilize time and energy on a specific activity or purchase
to completely use up supplies, funds, or reserves so that nothing remains
to exhaust the whole of a available supply of materials, energy, or money
to reduce the amount or supply of something valuable significantly

items.def_zh: 花费，耗费，消耗（时间、金钱、精力等）
items.def_en: to spend or use up resources, such as money, time, or energy, for a specific purpose

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate paying out funds or using up finite resources like time, energy, fuel, or patience toward an end until significantly diminished or depleted.
groups.summary_zh: 指为某项目的而支出金钱，或彻底消耗利用有限的时间、精力与资源。

groups.name: Expense & Disburse · 报销入账与资金拨付 (Expense, Write off, Disburse)
groups.tip: 清算账目付清款项

items.def_en: Record an item as an expenditure on a specific account or credit card
1. To charge or write off an amount as an expense, especially on an expense account or in financial accounts.

items.def_zh: 核销，作为坏账/开支勾销
items.def_en: Officially recognize and record an outlay, debt, or loss in accounts as unrecoverable expense
Repay an individual for money that they have spent on legitimate work-related expenses
Pay out money formally from an official fund or allocated account

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail formal financial transactions where outlays are officially debited, reimbursed via expense reports, or disbursed from institutional funds.
groups.summary_zh: 指按财务流程将支出记入账目、报销或自公款中拨付。

groups.name: Expiate & Purge · 赎罪与涤罪 (Expiate, Propitiate, Purge)
groups.tip: 通过受罚或补偿洗刷罪过

items.def_en: Free someone or a community from an unwanted moral taint, guilt, or defilement
Declare someone free from guilt, obligation, or the moral penalty of a sin
(formal) To accept punishment or make amends in order to atone for a sin or wrongdoing.
Win or regain the favor of a deity or authority by doing something that pleases them
Hear the confession of, assign penance to, and absolve a sinner

groups.summary_en: This formal and liturgical frame involves the mystical, ritual, or legally formal cleansing of guilt, spiritual pollution, or sacrilegious transgressions.
groups.summary_zh: 指在宗教、法理或神圣层面洗涤罪衍、消除业障与平息惩戒。

groups.name: Explain & Clarify · 解释与讲明 (Clarify, Elucidate, Spell Out)
groups.tip: 从普通说明到消除歧义澄清

items.def_en: To explain something in very clear, plain terms so that misunderstanding is impossible
To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.
To make something clear or easier to understand by removing ambiguity
To clarify or shed light on an obscure topic or difficult problem
To make a complex point or concept totally clear by explaining it in lucid detail

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey articulating facts, motives, or mechanisms to make something intelligible to another person. The semantic gradient moves from baseline communication to rigorous, transparent detailing.
groups.summary_zh: 通过叙述细节或原因使事物变得容易理解、清晰透彻。

groups.name: Explode & Blow Apart · 爆炸与剧变 (Blow up, Burst, Go off)
groups.tip: 能量瞬间集中迸发出巨大声浪

items.def_zh: 发爆裂声胀破；砰地爆开
items.def_en: To burst or cause to burst with a sharp, quick, explosive sound
To break open or apart suddenly and violently, typically from intense internal pressure
To shatter violently into pieces, or suddenly lose one's temper in a furious outburst
To suddenly discharge, trigger, or explode loudly

items.def_zh: 爆炸，爆裂；迸发，爆发；激增
items.def_en: 1. To burst or break apart violently with a loud noise, or to cause something to do so. 2. To react suddenly and intensely with emotion. 3. To increase suddenly and rapidly in number or extent.

groups.summary_en: Covers physical detonations, sudden ruptures under inner pressure, or sharp violent outbursts of temper and rapid exponential expansion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因内部压力或能量剧增而产生的猛烈炸裂、喷发或失控暴怒。

groups.name: Exploit & Capitalize · 利用与剥削榨取 (Exploit, Capitalize, Milk)
groups.tip: 从合理利用升级为榨取

items.def_en: To take advantage of an opportunity or situation for personal gain
To profit unfairly or opportunistically from a trend or misfortune
To take ruthless advantage of vulnerable, weak, or unsuspecting people
To extract as much money, benefit, or information as possible from someone ruthlessly
1. To treat someone unfairly by using their work or ideas to other's advantage. 2. To use something fully or effectively for one's benefit.

groups.summary_en: Describes using people, resources, or weaknesses to gain selfish advantage. Ranges from neutral strategic resource utilization to abusive predatory extraction of labor or wealth.
groups.summary_zh: 指为私利策略性利用资源，或以不公手段榨取、剥削他人价值。

groups.name: Expose & Uncover Wrongs · 揭露丑闻与曝光真相 (Expose, Uncover, Bring to Light)
groups.tip: 将隐情公开置于视线中

items.def_en: Cause concealed facts or crimes to become known clearly to everyone

items.def_zh: 揭露，揭发；暴露，显露；使面临（危险等）；（胶片）曝光
items.def_en: 1. To reveal the hidden or true nature of something, especially something dishonest or illegal. 2. To make something visible or leave it unprotected. 3. To subject photographic film to light.

items.def_zh: 挖掘出；揭开（掩盖的事实）
items.def_en: Discover or reveal secrets, fraud, or facts that have been deliberately covered up or concealed

items.def_zh: 彻底披露；赤裸裸地暴露
items.def_en: Completely reveal the hidden, vulnerable, or painful reality of a situation with nothing held back

items.def_zh: 彻底引爆并曝光（大丑闻）
items.def_en: Expose a conspiracy or major scandal so dramatically that it can no longer be hidden or denied

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on making hidden corruption, systemic wrongdoing, or suppressed factual realities open to public scrutiny. It ranges from neutral investigation to aggressive journalistic or investigative exposure.
groups.summary_zh: 将隐藏的不法勾当、丑闻或真相公之于众，接受舆论和法律监督。

groups.name: Expose & Unmask Deception · 揭穿与揭发伪善 (Unmask, Expose, Debunk)
groups.tip: 撕下伪装彻底曝光隐秘真相

items.def_zh: 驳斥，揭穿（虚假理论或迷信）
items.def_en: To show that a claim, belief, or theory is false, exaggerated, or pretentious
To make something hidden, private, or painful completely visible and understood
To discover and force hidden enemies, suspects, or secret information out into the open

items.def_zh: 揭露，揭发（丑闻、罪行或虚假）
items.def_en: To reveal the hidden truth about someone or something dishonorable, corrupt, or harmful

items.def_zh: 揭露，揭发（真实面目）；摘下面具
items.def_en: 1. To reveal the true identity, character, or nature of someone or something hidden or disguised. 2. To take off a mask from oneself or someone else.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe stripping away false appearances, fraud, or disguises to lay bare underlying corruption, hypocrisy, or malevolence. They convey a strong, adversarial, and definitive revelation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调剥去伪装或谎言，彻底暴露欺诈、虚伪或丑恶面目。

groups.name: Expose to Peril · 涉险与置身险境 (Hazard, Risk, Venture)
groups.tip: 使安全或利益陷入严重险境

items.def_en: To act in a way that exposes something valuable to damage, injury, or loss
To expose a valuable stake to hazard in a bold or unpredictable enterprise
(+ on) To risk a crucial possession, honor, or life itself on the outcome of an event
To expose one's life, fortune, or reputation to great danger or destructive loss
(literary) To expose someone or something to serious danger or risk.

groups.summary_en: A literary and elevated frame describing deliberate or reckless exposure of lives, honor, or fortunes to catastrophic outer dangers. Collocates include life, limb, fortune, and mortal peril.
groups.summary_zh: 偏文雅/书面语，指将生命、名誉或安危暴露于巨大凶险之中。

groups.name: Expound & Elaborate · 阐明与详加论述 (Elaborate, Explicate, Disquisition)
groups.tip: 系统剖析并详尽阐释观点主张

items.def_en: To add substance, illustrative details, or evidence to a bare outline or argument
To present or describe something in thorough, structured detail by adding further points

items.def_zh: 阐述，详细说明，系统阐明
items.def_en: To explain or present a theory, idea, or doctrine systematically and in comprehensive detail.
To formulate, explain, or state an idea, principle, or policy clearly and formally

items.def_zh: 细致解析，剖析（文本或原理）
items.def_en: To analyze and systematically reveal the meaning of a complex idea, literary piece, or argument

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate academic, philosophical, or formal discourse where doctrines, texts, or complex theories are articulated exhaustively. They differ from plain explanation by their scholarly depth and systematic rigor.
groups.summary_zh: 对理论、学说或文本进行全面、深入且系统性的阐述与推演。

groups.name: Extend & Flex · 伸展与屈曲 (Flex, Stretch, Overextend)
groups.tip: 肢体过度伸展或拉伸关节

items.def_en: To bend a joint or tighten a muscle to demonstrate strength or prepare for movement
To unbend a joint or make a bent limb completely flat or upright
To straighten a joint such as a knee or elbow completely until it becomes rigid
To stretch a limb or joint beyond its normal, safe limit, causing physical strain or injury
(medicine / sports) To stretch or straighten a joint forcefully beyond its normal range of motion.

groups.summary_en: Covers physical movements involving the bending, straightening, or extreme elongation of limbs and joints. Nuances range from healthy muscle engagement to forceful injury-inducing strain.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及肢体与关节的弯曲、延展或过度拉伸，涵盖正常运动与运动损伤。

groups.name: Extend & Span · 跨越与横亘 (Bridge, Cross, Traverse)
groups.tip: 空间或时间的跨越延伸

items.def_en: To extend over a specific spatial distance or interval of time
To build a passage across an expanse, or eliminate a divide or time difference between two items

items.def_zh: 横跨，跨越；持续，贯穿；用手掌量
items.def_en: 1. To extend across or over a period of time or a distance. 2. (of a bridge or structure) To cross over an area of water or land.
To pass or extend horizontally across or over a specified area or obstruction
To exist on or spread across both sides of a river, boundary line, or historical era

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on connecting two distinct endpoints in space or time, covering a continuous interval, physical divide, or thematic breadth.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重实体结构或时间范围在两点之间横跨、连接或完整覆盖。

groups.name: Externalize & Project · 显露与外化 (Manifest, Exteriorize, Project, Act out)
groups.tip: 将内心想法外化显露出来

items.def_en: to transfer an inward feeling or unacknowledged impulse onto someone or something else
to show an inward feeling, quality, or symptom clearly through outward signs
to bring an internal concept, sensation, or psychological state into external reality
(psychology / formal) to express or project internal feelings, thoughts, or conflicts outward into words, actions, or physical form

items.def_zh: 以行动宣泄内心冲突；把……表演出来
items.def_en: to express subconscious emotions or behavioral tensions through disruptive actions

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns projecting private psychological conflicts, unstated assumptions, or internal mental states into observable physical actions, symptoms, or objects.
groups.summary_zh: 指将内在的情感、心理冲突或观念转化为外在可见的言行、体征或具体形式。

groups.name: Extradite & Transfer Offender · 移交逃犯与引渡 (Extradite, Deport, Hand over)
groups.tip: 跨国司法合作引渡刑事嫌犯

items.def_en: To formally yield up or hand over a suspect or fugitive to the power or custody of another

items.def_zh: 移交，交出（在押犯人、控制权）
items.def_en: To pass responsibility or custody of a suspect or convict to another authority
To legally expel a foreigner or unwanted person from a country
(law) to officially hand over an accused or convicted person to another country or jurisdiction where the crime was committed
To send someone back to their own country of origin or citizenship

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover legal, sovereign procedures whereby an accused fugitive or prisoner is surrendered across jurisdictional boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 司法或国家主权机构将嫌疑人、罪犯合法引渡、遣返或移交给别国。

groups.name: Extrude & Expel · 挤出与喷注 (Squeeze out, Ooze out, Expel)
groups.tip: 施强大压力挤出孔模

items.def_en: To flow or leak out very slowly through small cracks, pores, or openings under slight pressure
To discharge slowly and steadily through pores or incisions as drops of moisture or resin
To force liquid or paste out of a flexible tube, fruit, or container by compressing it
To release or eject a liquid, gas, or stored substance outwards through an outlet

items.def_zh: 挤出，压出（通过模孔成形）；突出，伸出
items.def_en: To force, press, or push molten metal, plastic, or other material out through a shaped hole or die

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote forcing viscous liquids, plastics, paste, or bulk substances out through an orifice, nozzle, or opening under internal or compressive pressure. 'Extrude' is technically shaped by a die, while 'squeeze out' applies everyday physical force, and 'discharge' denotes fluid expulsion.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过加压使熔体、膏状物或流体自喷口或缝隙中被挤出、喷射。

groups.name: Exude & Seep · 渗出与溢流 (Exude, Seep, Ooze)
groups.tip: 液体自毛孔孔隙中缓缓渗出

items.def_en: To emit moisture through skin pores, or for moisture to condense and bead up on a cold surface.
To trickle or flow out very slowly through small openings or moist surfaces.
(+ into/through) To flow or pass slowly through a porous boundary, small crack, or cloth.
To produce and discharge a biological liquid or substance from an internal gland or cell.

items.def_zh: （使）渗出，流出；充分显露，流露出
items.def_en: 1. To release or ooze out slowly through pores or an opening, or to discharge liquid in this way. 2. To display a quality, feeling, or attitude strongly and openly.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses fluids or odors slowly issuing, trickling, or sweating forth through tiny pores, cracks, or tissue membranes, as well as radiating intangible traits like confidence or charm.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、气味或神态气质自孔隙或表层缓慢渗透、散溢出来。

groups.name: Eye Fluttering & Flashing · 眨眼与闪烁 (Blink, Wink, Flutter)
groups.tip: 眼睑快速开合眨眼动作

items.def_en: 1. To shut and open your eyes quickly. 2. To shine with a light that flashes intermittently on and off.
To open and close one's eyelashes flirtatiously or coquettishly
To close and open one eye quickly as a private signal, gesture of friendliness, or flirtation
To shine with an unsteady or wavering light, or to show a brief, fleeting expression in the eyes
To move one's eyelashes or eyelids up and down quickly and lightly

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses rapid involuntary or deliberate eyelid movements, as well as the metaphorical intermittent flashing of light sources.
groups.summary_zh: 指眼睑迅速开合的生理或示意动作，亦引申为光线的明灭闪烁。

groups.name: Face & Orient · 朝向与面对 (Face, Look, Overlook)
groups.tip: 身形正面对准特定方位

items.def_en: To have the front or face pointing in a specific direction or looking towards an object

items.def_zh: 面向，朝向；面对，对抗；领衔
items.def_en: 1. To face in a particular direction, or have the front facing towards something. 2. To lead or be the public face of an organization, band, or movement.
To have a view overlooking or opening directly onto a particular scene or location
To position or align something facing a particular point of the compass or direction
To provide a view of a place from above or have a vantage point facing it

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to spatial orientation and architectural alignment, where a person, building, or facade looks out in a specified physical direction. Verbs capture direct exposure, command of a view, or spatial alignment.
groups.summary_zh: 描述建筑或物体的朝向、方位布局，或视线正对某一景观方向。

groups.name: Fade & Grow Wan · 衰退与渐淡 (Wan, Wane, Fade away)
groups.tip: 色泽日渐浅淡，光芒黯然失色

items.def_zh: 逐渐枯竭；慢慢减弱直至停止
items.def_en: To gradually become smaller, weaker, or less active before ending completely
(archaic or literary) To grow pale, faint, or dim.
To slowly disappear, lose distinctness, or grow weaker until vanishing
To gradually become smaller in size, amount, or intensity
To decrease gradually in size, strength, power, or brilliance

groups.summary_en: Verbs marking gradual loss of radiance, vigor, or strength until a subject becomes faint, pale, or weak.
groups.summary_zh: 强调光泽、血色或生命力逐渐消减、微弱至趋于泯灭。

groups.name: Fail & Flounder · 成败与受挫 (Collapse, Flounder, Falter)
groups.tip: 行动结果成败分明

items.def_zh: 失败；未能做到；不合格；失灵，衰退
items.def_en: 1. To not succeed in doing something. 2. (+ to do) To not do what is expected or required. 3. To not pass a test or exam. 4. To stop working properly.
To fail suddenly and completely in negotiations, business, or organization
(of plans or deals) To come to nothing and fail to be completed
To lose strength, momentum, or resolve, showing early signs of breakdown

items.def_zh: 挣扎受挫；陷入混乱困顿
items.def_en: To experience great difficulties, confusion, and hesitation, risking complete failure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify falling short of an objective, breaking down under pressure, or struggling helplessly toward collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 指计划受挫、进程停滞或最终崩溃失败的动词群。

groups.name: Fail & Underperform · 受挫与表现不佳 (Underperform, Falter, Flounder)
groups.tip: 未达预期失利退败

items.def_zh: 表现不如预期；表现欠佳
items.def_en: To achieve lower financial yields or poorer practical results than predicted or required

items.def_zh: 表现未达预期，未充分发挥潜力；（学业、工作中）未达应有水平
items.def_en: To perform or achieve less well than expected, or fail to fulfill one's potential.
(+ of) To fail to achieve an intended target, expectation, or standard of performance
To lose strength, momentum, or effectiveness, showing signs of potential failure

items.def_zh: 挣扎；手忙脚乱陷入困境
items.def_en: To struggle clumsily and experience sustained difficulties in proceeding or succeeding

groups.summary_en: Describes performing below anticipated potential, falling short of baseline metrics, or stumbling during execution without outright catastrophe.
groups.summary_zh: 指表现未达预期、能力发挥不佳或在执行中受挫蹒跚。

groups.name: Fall Behind & Lag · 滞后与落后 (Lag Behind, Fall Behind, Drag Behind)
groups.tip: 跟在后方慢步拖延

items.def_en: to stay behind reluctantly or slowly when others have already moved on

items.def_zh: 落后于，滞后；尾随，跟踪；拖曳，拖在后面
items.def_en: 1. to lag or linger behind someone, or to be losing in a competition or match. 2. to follow or track someone or something. 3. to drag or be dragged along a surface.
to trail behind or stray from the main body while moving in an irregular or scattered fashion
to fail to keep pace with a group, competition, or expected schedule of progress
to move, progress, or develop more slowly than others in front

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture moving more slowly than peers, slipping into arrears, or failing to maintain the forward pace of a group or competitor.
groups.summary_zh: 指行进缓慢、落于人后或无法跟上既定步调。

groups.name: Falter & Stumble in Speech · 结巴与口吃 (Stutter, Stammer, Falter)
groups.tip: 因紧张舌头打结结结巴巴

items.def_en: To make mistakes or hesitate repeatedly while attempting to pronounce words or phrases

items.def_zh: 结巴地说，口吃；（机器）断断续续地运转
items.def_en: 1. To speak with involuntary pauses and repeated initial sounds because of a speech difficulty, nervousness, or shock. 2. To move or operate with unsteady, irregular sounds.
To speak in a hesitant, unsteady voice because of strong emotion or loss of confidence
To speak with difficulty, repeating sounds or pausing unexpectedly, often due to embarrassment or nerves

items.def_zh: 语无伦次地嘟囔；急迫结巴地说
items.def_en: To make rapid, indistinct spitting or choking sounds while speaking when angry, shocked, or confused

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses manner verbs characterizing disfluent speech marked by involuntary repetitions, prolonged syllables, or sudden blocks. The manner reflects physical speech impediments or acute psychological states like fear, embarrassment, or shock.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因言语障碍或紧张、震惊等心理因素导致的言语停顿或结巴。

groups.name: Farm & Graze · 农牧与经营 (Homestead, Graze, Raise)
groups.tip: 农田耕作与牧场经营劳作

items.def_en: Breed and bring up livestock or cultivate specific crops for commercial use

items.def_zh: 务农，耕作土地或饲养牲畜
items.def_en: Manage or work on land used for growing crops or keeping animals for food
To manage, operate, or work on a ranch (a large farm for raising livestock such as cattle or horses).
Put cattle, sheep, or horses out to feed on growing grass, or (of animals) eat field grass
Establish, settle, and cultivate a self-sufficient tract of agricultural land

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame encompass the sustained production and management of agrarian holdings, specifically tending pastures, breeding livestock, cultivating soil, and sustaining homesteads.
groups.summary_zh: 从事农牧耕作、放养牲口、经营田庄土地等农业生产活动。

groups.name: Fast & Diet · 节食与禁食 (Diet, Abstain, Slim)
groups.tip: 主动克制进食以养生

items.def_en: to abstain completely or partially from all or certain kinds of food or drink, especially for religious or medical purposes
to deliberately restrict one's intake of food in order to lose weight or for medical reasons
(+ on) to reduce the consumption of certain foods, calories, or substances
to suffer or die from lack of food, or deliberately deprive someone or oneself of nourishment
(+ from) to deliberately choose not to indulge in food, alcohol, or other bodily pleasures

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on voluntarily restricting or eliminating food and drink intake for religious, spiritual, medical, or weight-loss purposes.
groups.summary_zh: 指为宗教、养生或减重目的而主动禁食、节食或控制饮食进摄。

groups.name: Fatten & Fill Out · 催肥与丰满增重 (Plump, Flesh Out, Beef Up)
groups.tip: 喂食高营养促使牲畜长膘发福

items.def_en: To make something stronger, thicker, or more substantial in size or force
To become fatter, rounder, or more mature in bodily stature
To feed an animal or person deliberately to make them noticeably heavier
(often + up) To make something pleasantly soft, rounded, and full, or to become full
To make an animal or person fatter, or to become fatter, especially by eating a lot.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on making an animal or human heavier, rounder, and fleshier through feeding, or augmenting volume and substance metaphorically.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过喂食使人畜增重催肥，或引申为增加充实度。

groups.name: Fault & Blame · 归咎与挑剔 (Fault, Blame, Reproach)
groups.tip: 吹毛求疵挑毛病并归咎于人

items.def_en: To criticize someone or find a mistake, flaw, or imperfection in something
To criticize every detail of something or find all its small flaws
To hold someone responsible for a mistake, failure, or bad situation
To criticize someone especially for not being successful or not doing what was expected
To express strong, formal disapproval of someone's actions or failures

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on identifying errors, defects, or negligence in someone's conduct or performance. It spans from finding flaws in workmanship to holding a specific individual morally or practically culpable.
groups.summary_zh: 指在行为、做工中挑剔瑕疵，或将错误与过失归咎于当事人。

groups.name: Favor & Shield · 庇护与特殊优待 (Subsidize, Cushion, Shield)
groups.tip: 工会过度提供待遇保护

items.def_en: Make the harmful or painful effect of market shocks or setbacks less severe for someone

items.def_zh: 庇护，遮挡（外界压力与竞争）
items.def_en: Protect an organization or person from unpleasant scrutiny, competitive pressures, or harm
Give public or financial aid to an industry or entity to keep costs down and protect it from collapse

items.def_zh: 过度保护（工人或产业）；给……提供过分优厚待遇
items.def_en: To protect an industry, organization, or workers excessively with subsidies or easy conditions.
Provide emergency financial assistance to rescue a failing company, sector, or country from collapse

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on institutional, economic, or policy indulgence where specific sectors, unions, or organizations are shielded from competitive rigors through subsidies, restrictive rules, or unearned protective privileges.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过体制、补贴或壁垒过度保护、优待行业或组织以避开竞争。

groups.name: Fear & Dread · 害怕与恐惧 (Fear, Dread, Apprehend)
groups.tip: 面对危险时本能的惊惧与深层恐慌

items.def_zh: 害怕，恐惧，畏惧；担忧，忧虑；敬畏
items.def_en: 1. To be afraid of someone or something; to feel apprehension or anxiety about. 2. To revere or stand in awe of (God or a deity).
To shake or tremble violently with acute fear or panic

items.def_zh: 极度惧怕；畏惧（即将发生之事）
items.def_en: To anticipate with great apprehension, anxiety, or horror
To crouch down or shrink away in acute fear or intimidation
To fill someone with acute, overwhelming fear

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote experiential fear, ranging from rational anticipation of danger to visceral terror, chronic anxiety, or existential dread.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖对危险或未知的畏惧心理，从隐忧到极端惊恐。

groups.name: Fear & Quail · 畏惧与丧胆 (Quail, Tremble, Dread, Shrink)
groups.tip: 预感不祥心生胆怯而战栗

items.def_en: (+ from) To hesitate or hold back from doing something because of intense aversion or fear
To shake involuntarily as a direct physical effect of extreme fear or shock
To lose strength, confidence, or purpose and waver in the face of daunting adversity
(literary) (+ at/before) To feel or show great fear or apprehension; to shrink back or tremble in dread.
To anticipate future danger, pain, or ordeal with intense anxiety and aversion

groups.summary_en: Literary and affective verbs showing severe loss of courage, paralyzing dread, and internal faltering when faced with intimidation or dire threat.
groups.summary_zh: 多具书面语彩，突出面临威吓与凶险时丧失勇气、内心发怵与发抖震颤。

groups.name: Feature & Headline · 领衔与挂帅 (Headline, Showcase, Topline)
groups.tip: 领衔挂帅重点凸显

items.def_en: to play the principal role in a performance, cast, or presentation

items.def_zh: 领衔主演；担任主唱/头条
items.def_en: to appear as the main performer or attraction in a concert, festival, or theatrical show
to present someone or something in a way that highlights their best qualities, talents, or abilities
to be featured as the top-billed star or leading actor in a commercial production

items.def_zh: 主演，领衔主演；由……担任主角；给……标星号
items.def_en: 1. to play the main role in a film, play, or show, or to feature someone as the main performer. 2. to mark something with a star or asterisk.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate prominent casting or central positioning in entertainment, media, and public events where an individual or highlight serves as the primary attraction.
groups.summary_zh: 指在演出、电影或活动中担任主角、担纲领衔或作为重点推出。

groups.name: Feel & Sense · 感觉与体会 (Feel, Sense, Experience)
groups.tip: 主观感知与身心体会的词群

items.def_zh: 感觉到，体会到；触摸；以为，觉得
items.def_en: 1. To experience a physical sensation or emotion. 2. To touch something in order to examine it. 3. To believe or have an opinion.
To undergo or encounter a particular emotion, sensation, or situation directly
To notice or consciously record a feeling or impression in the mind, or make it apparent
To become conscious of an emotion, impression, or environmental fact through awareness
To pass through, suffer, or endure an arduous experience or physiological process

groups.summary_en: This fundamental frame covers receiving tactile sensations, experiencing emotional and physical states, or having internal intuitions about an occurrence.
groups.summary_zh: 指由感官接触引发躯体感觉、体验内在情感心境或产生直觉领会。

groups.name: Ferment & Brew · 发酵与暗中酝酿 (Brew, Smolder, Seethe)
groups.tip: 生物发酵引发内部躁动

items.def_en: To develop gradually beneath the surface, especially of an unpleasant crisis, storm, or conflict
1. To undergo or cause to undergo the chemical process of fermentation. 2. To cause or experience political or social unrest or excitement.
To become progressively worse, bitter, or more toxic over time through neglect
To be filled with intense, barely contained anger, agitation, or turbulent excitement
To exist in a suppressed state without clear outward manifestation, ready to break out

groups.summary_en: Covers organic chemical breakdown or metaphorical agitation where unrest, tension, or trouble develops beneath the surface before erupting.
groups.summary_zh: 指有机物化学发酵，或局势、情绪在暗中积累酝酿。

groups.name: Fetch & Retrieve · 取回与寻来 (Retrieve, Bring back, Collect)
groups.tip: 前往某处将物品带回

items.def_en: To go to a place and pick up an item or passenger waiting to be retrieved
To carry something with oneself on returning from another place
To go somewhere to collect an item from a store, office, or designated holding place
To find and bring something back from a location where it was stored, lost, or misplaced

items.def_zh: 取回，接来，去拿；售得（某一价钱）
items.def_en: 1. To go to a place, get someone or something, and bring them back. 2. To be sold for a particular price.

groups.summary_en: Describes the complete round-trip motion of going to a specific location, obtaining an object or individual, and bringing them back to the point of origin.
groups.summary_zh: 指前往某地寻找并取回、领回人或物品的双向过程。

groups.name: Feud & Quarrel · 宿怨与争斗 (Bicker, Clash, Spar)
groups.tip: 长期世仇结怨导致反复争斗

items.def_en: To argue about petty, unimportant matters in an irritable, persistent way
To engage in repeated, often sharp verbal exchanges or testing arguments with someone
To engage in a sharp, open conflict or direct confrontation over deeply incompatible views or interests
To carry on a prolonged, bitter, and mutual quarrel or hostility with someone.
To struggle persistently or engage in continuous hostility and conflict against a rival party

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on engaging in prolonged, bitter disputes or hostile rivalries between individuals, families, or groups. Nuances range from petty, persistent squabbling to intense, ideological warfare.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘长期对立、互相结怨或持续交锋，程度由零星口角至深仇大恨。

groups.name: Filibuster & Procedural Obstruct · 阻挠与妨碍议程 (Filibuster, Stall, Obstruct)
groups.tip: 利用程序或发言拖延阻挠

items.def_en: To intentionally delay an action, decision, or vote in order to gain time or exhaust opponents

items.def_zh: 以滔滔不绝的长篇发言使（法案）流产
items.def_en: To defeat or shelve a parliamentary bill by consuming debate time until the deadline expires
To deliberately impede or hinder the progress of a legislative bill, policy, or legal inquiry
To severely restrict the efficiency or power of a governing body or process by procedural sabotage

items.def_zh: （以冗长演说或议事程序）阻挠议案表决
items.def_en: 1. (politics) To delay or prevent a vote or decision in a legislature by making long speeches or using obstructive tactics.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exploiting parliamentary procedures, lengthy discourse, and bureaucratic rules to intentionally paralyze political votes, legislative sessions, or governmental actions.
groups.summary_zh: 利用冗长发言、程序漏洞或特权刻意阻碍议案表决与立法进程。

groups.name: Fill & Cram · 挤入与塞满 (Cram, Jam, Stuff)
groups.tip: 填塞入内直至严实拥挤

items.def_en: To enter or force oneself into an enclosed space together with many others
To push or force a lot of things or soft material tightly into a container or space
To fill a container, room, or space completely with objects or people
To push people or things into a space so tightly that movement becomes impossible

items.def_zh: 塞入，塞满，填满；（考前）突击死记硬背
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To push or force people or things into a small space until it is completely full. 2. (+ for) (informal) To study intensively in a short period of time, especially right before an examination.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on forceful physical compression where an agent forces people or matter into an already tight or restricted volume past comfortable capacity. Nuances range from forcing pliable material ('stuff') to jammed immobility ('pack', 'jam').
groups.summary_zh: 指用力将大量物品或人塞进狭小空间内使其极度拥挤或饱和。

groups.name: Fill & Overflow · 充溢与外溢 (Overflow, Teem, Swarm)
groups.tip: 从充盈满溢发展至过载泛滥

items.def_en: (+ with) To become so full of a liquid or emotion that it spills past the edges
(+ into) To exceed normal limits and spread beyond the original space or situation
(+ with) To contain large numbers of animals, people, or moving things
To flow over the edges or bounds of a container because it is too full
To be full to the brim with liquid, or to be full of a particular emotion or quality.

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts reaching full capacity or spilling past borders, whether referring to a liquid exceeding a vessel's rim or a state abundant with life and emotion.
groups.summary_zh: 指容量达极值进而满溢而出，或因事物充满而极为丰盛。

groups.name: Fill & Pervade · 弥漫与充斥 (Pervade, Permeate, Suffuse, Imbue)
groups.tip: 气味、情感无孔不入地渗透

items.def_en: Fill someone or something with a strong emotion or quality throughout
Spread through every part of an area, material, or system
Fill someone or something completely with a particular quality, value, or feeling
Gradually spread all over or through something, especially with light, color, or feeling
to spread through and be noticeable in every part of something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey qualities, smells, emotions, or influences diffusing deeply throughout every part of a space, mind, or physical medium.
groups.summary_zh: 指气味、氛围、情感或特质全面散布并充斥整个空间。

groups.name: Fill & Seal · 填缝与密封 (Caulk, Seal, Grout)
groups.tip: 用填料填满缝隙以防漏水

items.def_en: To fill the spaces between tiles, bricks, or stones with thin mortar or paste
To fill narrow cracks or seams, especially between logs in a cabin wall, with mud or sealant
To close an opening or joint securely so that gas, liquid, or dirt cannot enter or escape

items.def_zh: （用填缝料）填塞，封堵（接缝或裂隙以防水防漏）
items.def_en: To seal cracks, joints, or seams in a boat, building, or pipe with a waterproof substance to prevent leakage.
To close a crack, opening, or container completely so that nothing can get in or out

groups.summary_en: This construction and craftsmanship frame involves applying specialized, waterproof, or adhesive compound (mastic, silicone, mortar, or pitch) into narrow seams, joins, or gaps to make a structure airtight or impermeable to liquids.
groups.summary_zh: 指将防水胶泥或灰浆填入接缝裂纹中以实现密闭防水。

groups.name: Filter & Strain · 过滤与滤除 (Filter, Strain, Sift)
groups.tip: 借助滤网分离杂质与滤液

items.def_zh: 过滤，滤除；滤入，滤出；（消息等）走漏
items.def_en: 1. To pass liquid or gas through a device to remove impurities, or to remove something in this way. 2. To move gradually or in small numbers through something.
(+ off/out) To separate solids from a liquid by passing it through a perforated utensil or sieve
To remove undesirable particles, elements, or noise by passing through a selective filter
(+ through) To put fine dry material through a mesh screen to remove larger lumps or foreign matter
(+ through) To trickle or pass slowly through a porous substance or filter medium

groups.summary_en: Relates to passing a liquid, gas, or granular substance through a porous medium or mesh to isolate suspended solids, extract unwanted particles, or separate components.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助滤网或介质使流体或粉末通过，以分离杂质或固体颗粒。

groups.name: Filter Down & Narrow Down · 初选与入围 (Narrow Down, Screen, Weed Out)
groups.tip: 层层筛选圈定入围者

items.def_en: To check candidates or items systematically to ensure suitability

items.def_zh: 缩减范围，缩小（选择范围）
items.def_en: To reduce the number of possibilities, options, or candidates to a smaller selection
To eliminate unwanted, unqualified, or inferior members from a larger group
To remove unwanted items or individuals through a systematic selection process

items.def_zh: 将…列入候选名单，圈定入围
items.def_en: 1. To put someone or something on a shortlist of final contenders for a job, award, or competition.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this procedural scenario frame describe evaluating multiple applicants, candidates, or options to produce a reduced roster of prime contenders.
groups.summary_zh: 指在选拔或评审过程中淘汰不合格者，筛出最终候选名单。

groups.name: Fine Pricking & Pinpointing · 针刺与轻戳 (Jab, Poke, Pinprick)
groups.tip: 尖物扎破穿刺表面

items.def_en: Push a finger or pointed object into or through something

items.def_zh: 刺，扎，戳；使感到刺痛；竖起（耳朵）
items.def_en: 1. To make a very small hole in the surface of something with a sharp point, or to cause a sharp stinging pain. 2. (of an animal) To raise (its ears) to listen.
Push someone or something gently with a finger, stick, or pointed instrument
Push a pointed object into something so that it stays there
Poke or thrust abruptly with something pointed or blunt

groups.summary_en: This frame captures light, deliberate or accidental puncture of a surface with a fine, pointed object. While prick involves a tiny pinpoint entry, jab implies a sharp, rapid thrust and prod suggests gentle repetitive probing.
groups.summary_zh: 用尖细物体轻戳、扎出小孔或造成轻微刺痛。

groups.name: Fish for Specific Shellfish/Seafood · 捞捕特定水产 (Prawn, Crab, Clam)
groups.tip: 在自然水陆环境中捕获猎物

items.def_en: To fish for, catch, or harvest crabs
To catch or harvest small marine shrimp, especially with nets along shallow waters
To search for and dig up clams from mud flats or sand along the shore
1. To fish for or catch prawns.
To fish by pulling a large net along the seabed or through deep open water

groups.summary_en: This frame contains specialized maritime or coastal harvesting verbs that describe searching for, catching, or gathering specific marine organisms, especially shellfish and crustacea, from their natural habitats.
groups.summary_zh: 在水域或滩涂搜寻并捕捞特定海鲜水产（如虾蟹贝类）。

groups.name: Fissure & Split · 开裂与深裂 (Fissure, Cleave, Cleft)
groups.tip: 受力开裂形成裂隙

items.def_en: To divide or break lengthways into two or more parts

items.def_zh: （使）开裂，（使）形成裂隙；（使）产生分歧
items.def_en: To split or crack open into deep, narrow openings; (figurative) to divide or break apart.
To break or burst suddenly under pressure
To split or sever something along a natural line or grain
To tear something apart with violent force; split asunder

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights physical materials or social units cracking apart into deep, elongated crevices, divides, or structural ruptures.
groups.summary_zh: 岩体、地面或团体开裂出深窄缝隙或走向分裂。

groups.name: Flameless Low Burning · 闷烧与残燃 (Smolder, Glow, Simmer)
groups.tip: 无明火地内部闷烧

items.def_en: Continue to burn gently with reduced heat and minimal flame.
Emit vapor or gaseous exhaust while burning slowly without vigorous flames.
1. (US spelling of smoulder) To burn slowly with smoke but no flame. 2. To exist or develop in a hidden, suppressed state; to feel strong, lingering anger or passion.
Become increasingly rotten, or allow painful feelings to grow more intense in secret.
Be filled with intense but strictly unexpressed anger or agitation.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify slow, flameless combustion that produces smoke and latent heat, or metaphorically describe suppressed feelings of rage, resentment, or rebellion waiting to erupt.
groups.summary_zh: 指无明火、有烟有热的低速缓慢燃烧，多喻指隐忍未发的怒火或敌意。

groups.name: Flapping & Fluttering Motion · 拍动与飘拂 (Flap, Flutter, Wave)
groups.tip: 像鸟翅或旗帜上下拍打

items.def_en: To move freely back and forth or up and down, especially in the air or wind

items.def_zh: 拍打，振动；飘动，摆动；慌乱，焦虑
items.def_en: 1. To move or cause to move quickly up and down or back and forth, like wings or a flag. 2. (informal) To behave in an excited, nervous, or panicky way.
To move or make something move with quick, light, wavering movements

items.def_zh: 鼓胀翻滚；如波涛般翻腾
items.def_en: To swell out or bulge like a sail or cloth filled with air, moving in rolling waves
To wave or swing wildly and erratically, especially arms or limbs

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express rapid, oscillating back-and-forth or up-and-down movements of flexible objects, wings, sails, or fabrics caught in air currents. Nuances contrast light, delicate trembling movements with broad, forceful flapping or waving strokes.
groups.summary_zh: 指羽翼、旗帜或轻薄织物在空气中快速扇动、扑棱或飘摆。

groups.name: Flatten & Level · 压平与夷平 (Level, Even Out, Raze, Smooth Out)
groups.tip: 消除凹凸起伏，使表面平整
