items.def_en: to knock down or demolish buildings completely, or make an uneven surface flat and horizontal
to eliminate irregularities or bumps so that a surface becomes smooth and uniform
to press out wrinkles, ridges, or bumps on an object using one's hands or a tool

items.def_zh: （使）变平，展平，压平；击倒，彻底打败
items.def_en: 1. to make something level or flat, or to become flat. 2. to knock down, destroy, or completely defeat someone or something.
to completely destroy a building, town, or structure so nothing remains standing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve reducing contours, elevations, or standing structures to a flat, uniform surface, or demolishing objects to ground level.
groups.summary_zh: 指消除凹凸起伏使其平滑，或彻底夷平捣毁建筑物。

groups.name: Flatten & Smooth · 压平与碾光 (Glaze, Iron, Mangling)
groups.tip: 辊压机热压压平压光织物

items.def_en: To remove wrinkles from cloth by pressing with an iron
To make or become flat or flatter by pressing, rolling, or beating
To press clothes or laundry through heavy mechanical rollers to remove water or smooth wrinkles
To make a surface smooth and shiny by rubbing or pressing hard with a tool

items.def_zh: （用轧光机）压平，轧光（纸张、织物等）
items.def_en: To press cloth, paper, or other material between rollers to make it smooth, glossy, or flat.

groups.summary_en: This frame pertains to mechanical smoothing, rolling, or pressing operations aimed at eliminating creases, reducing thickness, or imparting a uniform glossy finish.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过滚轴、熨压或碾光去除褶皱并使表面平整光亮。

groups.name: Flay & Skin · 剥皮与严酷鞭笞 (Flay, Skin, Excoriate)
groups.tip: 从表面撕扯剥去外皮表层

items.def_en: Remove the skin from an animal, vegetable, or fruit
Shear the wool from sheep, or metaphorically strip someone of their money by deception
Whip someone severely with a lash, causing skin lacerations, or cause massive suffering
1. To strip the skin off an animal or person. 2. To criticize someone severely or harshly.
Tear or wear off the skin of someone, or express very strong, blistering disapproval of them

groups.summary_en: This high-intensity physical and metaphorical frame involves tearing or stripping away skin or hides from flesh, extended figuratively to savage, merciless public castigation.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理上的剥皮与抽打，或比喻极度严苛的公开痛斥。

groups.name: Fleeting & Remote Sighting · 远眺与微见 (Espy, Discern, Catch Sight Of)
groups.tip: 无意间敏锐瞥见并认出

items.def_en: To catch sight of something distant, indistinct, or difficult to make out
To identify or recognize someone or something within a crowded or obscure field of view
To see someone or something fleetingly or indistinctly
To perceive or recognize something faintly, indistinctly, or with visual effort
(literary or archaic) to catch sight of or notice something, especially something distant or partly hidden

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on catching sight of obscure, partially concealed, or distant objects, often demanding careful observation or happening unexpectedly.
groups.summary_zh: 指在远处、遮掩处或模糊视线中捕捉或辨识出隐蔽景象。

groups.name: Flicker & Waver · 摇曳与闪烁将熄 (Flicker, Gutter, Waver)
groups.tip: 微光忽明忽暗或随风摇摆不定

items.def_zh: 渐渐变弱而熄灭；逐渐断送
items.def_en: To diminish gradually until fading out or coming to a complete stop

items.def_zh: （烛光等）摇曳，闪烁不定；形成沟槽，流淌
items.def_en: 1. (of a flame or candle) To flicker and burn unsteadily, often on the verge of going out. 2. To form channels or grooves in a surface.
To shine with a light that is unsteady, varying rapidly in brightness
To shake, tremble, or become unsteadily bright and faint, as a flame in a draft

items.def_zh: 噼啪作响并闪烁；断续明灭
items.def_en: To burn with irregular spitting sounds and sudden spitting bursts of light before extinguishing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray luminous sources, especially candles or open flames, burning erratically, shuddering in drafts, and trembling on the verge of dying out. They convey delicate, unstable luminescence.
groups.summary_zh: 指火光或烛泪在微风中摇摇欲坠、明灭不定、濒临熄灭。

groups.name: Flit & Pass Swiftly · 飞掠与疾逝 (Fleet, Flit, Skim)
groups.tip: 轻快穿梭掠过转瞬即逝

items.def_en: To move quickly and lightly just above a surface
To make a sudden, quick, darting movement
To move or take someone or something somewhere very quickly and smoothly
To move quickly and lightly from one place or topic to another
(literary) To move swiftly or pass away quickly.

groups.summary_en: This literary/poetic frame denotes rapid, light, or evanescent passing, capturing fleeting motions through air, space, or transient time.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘如浮光掠影般轻盈、短暂且转瞬即逝的掠行与流逝。

groups.name: Flood & Engulf · 泛滥与覆没 (Flood, Inundate, Deluge)
groups.tip: 大水漫灌或巨量涌入完全吞没

items.def_en: To drive someone or animals away from a home or land through rising floodwaters.
To spill over the edges or boundaries because of an excessive volume of liquid.
1. To cover dry land with water, or become covered with water. 2. To arrive, fill, or enter in overwhelmingly large numbers or amounts.

items.def_zh: 以暴雨或洪流淹没；倾泻而下充斥
items.def_en: To cover completely with water or a heavy downpour, or to overwhelm with an enormous quantity of something.
To sweep over and completely envelop or swallow up something in water, flames, or devastation.

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the violent or overwhelming covering of land, spaces, or people by water, or an analogous sudden crush of objects and emotions. Verbs express high volume, rapid accumulation, and overpowering force.
groups.summary_zh: 指大量水体或事物迅猛倾泻、暴涨并彻底充斥或掩盖目标。

groups.name: Flood with Messages · 滥发与信息轰炸 (Bombard, Barrage, Inundate)
groups.tip: 批量发送或派遣传递

items.def_zh: 群发垃圾邮件，批量发送垃圾信息
items.def_en: To send unwanted or repetitive advertising or messages to a large number of people over the internet.

items.def_zh: 连珠炮般发来；密集倾泻
items.def_en: To direct an overwhelming outpouring of complaints, inquiries, or promotional communications at someone
(+ with) To attack or pester someone continuously with excessive messages, questions, or advertisements
To overwhelm someone with a sudden downpour of letters, phone calls, or digital notifications
(+ with) To overwhelm someone with a huge, unmanageable volume of requests or mail

groups.summary_en: Centers on overwhelming an audience or system by sending unsolicited, excessive, or repetitive messages. Highlights nuisance volume and aggressive communication channels.
groups.summary_zh: 指发送大量垃圾、不请自来或轰炸式的信息以压垮对方。

groups.name: Flourish & Prosper · 兴旺与茁壮成长 (Flourish, Prosper, Bloom)
groups.tip: 生命力蓬勃生长繁衍

items.def_en: To become healthy, radiant, or fully developed and prosperous

items.def_zh: 繁荣，茁壮生长，蓬勃发展
items.def_en: 1. To grow vigorously, stay healthy, and flourish or become very successful.
To grow luxuriantly, be healthy, and achieve sustained success or vigor
To develop in a highly successful way, especially financially or in status
To begin to grow, expand, or develop rapidly and luxuriantly

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to living organisms, businesses, or ecosystems growing robustly, developing vigorously, and achieving vigorous health and peak success.
groups.summary_zh: 描述生命有机体或实体展现旺盛生命力，茁壮发展与繁荣昌盛。

groups.name: Flourish & Prosper · 繁荣与蓬勃发展 (Thrive, Bloom, Blossom)
groups.tip: 生机勃勃或经济蓬勃发展

items.def_en: To produce blossoms, or metaphorically to achieve full beauty, health, or promise
To grow vigorously, be healthy, or do extremely well in a particular environment

items.def_zh: 繁荣，昌盛；蓬勃生长；挥舞
items.def_en: 1. When a business, plant, or civilization flourishes, it grows strongly and succeeds. 2. To wave something dramatically in the air.
To develop into something promising, rich, successful, or attractive
To begin to grow, expand, or develop rapidly and abundantly

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights vigorous, healthy growth, vibrant development, and visible vitality in organisms, communities, or systems. It emphasizes vibrant energy and blossoming potential beyond mere financial gain.
groups.summary_zh: 强调生命力旺盛、生机勃勃地健康生长或事业文化的大放异彩。

groups.name: Fluctuate & Vacillate · 震荡与摇摆不定 (Fluctuate, Oscillate, Vacillate, Yo-yo)
groups.tip: 如跷跷板般在两极波动

items.def_zh: （在两极间）摇摆不定，频繁波动；玩跷跷板
items.def_en: To repeatedly change between two conditions, moods, or states; to move up and down alternately.
To change continuously and irregularly from one level or value to another
(+ between) To swing continuously between differing opinions, feelings, or behaviors
(+ between) To waver indecisively between different choices or paths of action

items.def_zh: 剧烈反弹浮动，忽上忽下
items.def_en: To change erratically between high and low levels or conditions over a short time

groups.summary_en: This domain governs continuous, unstable shifting back and forth between two opposing positions, emotional states, price points, or levels.
groups.summary_zh: 指观点、情绪、政策或指标在两极状态间不断剧烈反弹与起伏摇摆。

groups.name: Fluctuate & Waver · 波动与摇摆 (Oscillate, Waver, Swing)
groups.tip: 状态或数值起伏不定

items.def_en: To repeatedly increase and decrease, or wax and wane, in rhythmic recurrence
1. (+ between/around) To rise and fall irregularly in amount, number, or strength.
(+ between) To lose strength or falter between alternate choices or positions
To change abruptly or dramatically from one state, opinion, or price level to another
(+ between) To swing continuously between conflicting beliefs, feelings, or courses of action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail irregular or rhythmic changes back and forth between states, levels, decisions, or prices.
groups.summary_zh: 指数值、状态、倾向或情绪在两个极端间反复震荡。

groups.name: Fluff & Plump Up · 拍松与蓬松化 (Fluff, Plump up, Tease)
groups.tip: 拍打调节使之蓬松

items.def_zh: 拍松（枕头、靠垫等），使丰满
items.def_en: To shake, pat, and reshape a cushion, pillow, or mattress so that it becomes soft, rounded, and full
To hold a cloth, rug, or sheet and shake it vigorously to remove dust, creases, and restore fullness

items.def_zh: 倒刮（头发使蓬松）；梳松（毛发）
items.def_en: To comb hair backwards towards the scalp or gently pull fibers apart to give them extra volume
To form hair or fibers into crisp, tight curls or a fluffy, frizzy halo

items.def_zh: 抖松，拍蓬松；念错，搞砸；变松散
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To shake, pat, or adjust a pillow, cushion, or feathers so they become soft and full. 2. (informal) To fail to perform or speak words correctly, especially in an acting performance.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve gently shaking, patting, beating, or teasing soft, fibrous, or feathery materials (such as pillows, duvets, or hair) to restore volume, airiness, and comfortable fullness.
groups.summary_zh: 指轻拍、揉松或抖动羽绒、枕垫或毛发，使其恢复蓬松丰盈感。

groups.name: Flutter & Flap · 扑翼与颤动 (Flap, Flit, Waver)
groups.tip: 轻快振翅或快速振动动作

items.def_zh: 扑翼，振翅；飘动，颤动；（心跳）悸动
items.def_en: 1. To move wings quickly and lightly, or to flap gently in the air. 2. (of a heart or stomach) To beat or move rapidly and irregularly due to anxiety or excitement.
To shake or vibrate with a slight, rapid motion
To move swiftly and lightly from one place to another
To move wings or another flat surface up and down or back and forth noisily or rhythmically
(of the heart) To beat rapidly, strongly, or irregularly, typically from excitement or exertion

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote quick, repeated, and often irregular back-and-forth or up-and-down motions, such as bird wings beating lightly, fabric trembling in the breeze, or nervous palpitations.
groups.summary_zh: 指翅膀轻快扇动、布料随风摆动或身体部位的微颤。

groups.name: Focus & Center · 调焦与重新聚焦 (Zero in, Center, Converge)
groups.tip: 收束散漫心神并重新聚焦核心

items.def_en: (+ on/around) To place or concentrate at a central point or main subject
(+ on) To direct all attention, effort, or aim toward a singular focal point
(+ on) To direct all focus, search, or thought precisely onto a specific target
(+ on) To come together from different directions to focus on a shared point

items.def_zh: 重新聚焦，调整关注点；重新对准焦距
items.def_en: To adjust attention, effort, or a lens again onto a central subject or priority.

groups.summary_en: Pertains to mentally or optically redirecting attention, energy, or lenses onto a specific point of interest. It highlights narrowing the cognitive aperture from a dispersed state to a single crisp target.
groups.summary_zh: 指将涣散的注意力、视线或重心调整收敛至核心焦点。

groups.name: Focus & Concentrate · 聚焦与专注 (Concentrate, Center, Zero in)
groups.tip: 将注意力和精力集中于一点

items.def_en: (+ on/around) To place something at the pivot of attention, discussion, or action

items.def_zh: 集中（注意力、精力等）；（使）聚焦，（使）调焦
items.def_en: 1. To direct your attention, effort, or interest towards a particular person, subject, or thing. 2. To adjust a lens or eye to see a clear image, or of an image to become clear.
(+ on) To direct all mental energy or attention toward a particular task or thought
(+ on) To direct all attention, effort, or aim specifically at a precise detail or problem
(+ on) To guide attention or movement steadily toward a single target or objective

groups.summary_en: This cognitive frame highlights directing mental acuity, visual attention, or organizational energy onto a single target while filtering out peripheral distractions.
groups.summary_zh: 指将注意力、思维或行动力量集中在特定核心目标或议题上。

groups.name: Follow & Ensue · 紧接与随之发生 (Follow, Result, Supervene)
groups.tip: 因某一事件而紧接着发生

items.def_en: (+ from/in) To happen or exist because of something that occurred previously
To happen or occur next in time, order, or as a consequence

items.def_zh: 意外发生；伴随发生而打断
items.def_en: To happen unexpectedly in a way that interrupts, alters, or complicates an existing situation

items.def_zh: 源自；作为…的自然结果产生
items.def_en: To arrive or develop as a natural, logical consequence of an event or policy

items.raw_cluster: 发生与随之而来 Follow & Ensue
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To happen immediately afterward or as a direct result of another event.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe events, consequences, or conditions that take place immediately after or as an inevitable outcome of a preceding incident. They range from neutral temporal succession to causal developments and unforeseen complications.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在某事之后紧接着发生、因果随之而来或作为意外情况插足发生。

groups.name: Fondle & Pet · 抚弄与亲昵抚摩 (Fondle, Pet, Dally)
groups.tip: 亲昵轻柔地抚摸身体或器官

items.def_en: Touch or stroke an animal or person gently and lovingly; or engage in affectionate kissing and touching
Touch or stroke someone or something gently and lovingly with the hands
1. To touch, stroke, or handle someone or something gently and affectionately, often in a sexual way.
(informal) Kiss, caress, and cuddle someone affectionately and playfully
Touch someone for sexual pleasure, especially crudely, clumsily, or without their consent

groups.summary_en: Denotes gentle, sensual, or sexually affectionate touching and stroking of another person or an animal. Nuances range from warm tender handling to erotic intimate contact.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有爱抚、亲昵或性意味地轻触、摩挲人或动物。

groups.name: Foot-Operate & Pedal · 踏板操控与脚力操作 (Pedal, Pump, Stomp)
groups.tip: 踩踏或手工操控机械运转

items.def_en: Depress a pedal or switch by pressing down firmly with the foot
Push down a foot pedal, lever, or button to activate a mechanism
Operate or propel a mechanism by pushing pedals with the feet
1. To operate a sewing machine, loom, or wheel by pressing a foot pedal up and down.
Operate a foot pedal or lever rhythmically by repeated up-and-down pressure

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physical manipulation driven by the feet, specifically pushing, pumping, or oscillating foot levers, pedals, and treadles to power or regulate mechanical machinery.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用双脚踩踏踏板或脚控装置来驱动、控制机械设备的动作。

groups.name: Forceful Tearing & Snapping · 强行撕扯与崩断 (Rip, Snap, Tear off)
groups.tip: 猛力扯烂织物或硬脆折断

items.def_en: Pull something apart or into pieces with rapid, deliberate force
Remove something forcefully and roughly from a surface or attachment
To tear or be torn violently, quickly, or forcefully.
Break suddenly and cleanly with a sharp, cracking sound under tension or pressure
Burst or break suddenly under internal or external physical pressure

groups.summary_en: Expresses sudden, high-force physical breakage where tensile integrity fails, causing materials like fabric, flesh, or bone to rupture or snap apart abruptly.
groups.summary_zh: 强调外力瞬间拉扯导致的撕裂、崩开或突发性折断脱离。

groups.name: Forcible Separation & Forcing Open · 强行撬开与扒开 (Pry, Prise, Force open)
groups.tip: 利用杠杆原理撬起硬物

items.def_en: Break open or gain entry to a lock, lid, or barrier through physical violence
Force and fix an aperture open by jamming an object into its seam
Force apart or expel by steady physical pressure and encroachment
1. To use force or a tool to lift, open, or separate something. 2. To inquire intrusively or meddle into someone's private affairs.
Force something open or away from a surface with an edged implement

groups.summary_en: Centered on separating stuck surfaces or opening tight containers/fixtures by wedging an implement into a crevice and applying levering force.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过插入楔子或工具利用杜杆力强行剥离、撬开卡紧或钉死的缝隙。

groups.name: Forge & Counterfeit · 伪造与仿造 (Counterfeit, Forge, Fake)
groups.tip: 弄虚作假，制造冒牌伪劣物

items.def_en: To make something falsely appear genuine or authentic
To make illegal, unauthorized copies of software, books, or media to sell
To illegally copy a document, signature, or work of art to deceive people

items.def_zh: 伪造，仿造；假装，假装具有
items.def_en: 1. To make an exact illegal copy of money, documents, or goods in order to deceive. 2. (formal) To feign or pretend to have a feeling or quality.
To change records or documents dishonestly in order to mislead people

groups.summary_en: This frame covers intentionally manufacturing deceptive duplicates of banknotes, legal signatures, art, or commercial goods with the fraudulent intent to deceive.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于欺诈目的故意伪造钱币、证件、签名或工艺品。

groups.name: Fork & Bifurcate · 叉开与分歧 (Bifurcate, Trifurcate, Diverge)
groups.tip: 主干分支向不同方向分叉

items.def_en: To divide or separate into two or more parts along a line
To move or extend in different directions from a common point
(formal or technical) To divide or fork into two or more branches, prongs, or parts.
To divide or cause to divide into two distinct branches or prongs
To split or sever something along a natural line of growth or grain

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate technical, precise, or formal dividing into specific prongs or dual branches (often anatomical, geological, or mathematical). They focus strictly on the geometric split of a single conduit or structure.
groups.summary_zh: 多用于书面或科技语境，精确表示一分为二（或多叉）的几何状分叉。

groups.name: Formal Inquiry & Crime Investigation · 官方立案调查与侦查 (Investigate, Inquire, Look into)
groups.tip: 讯问探查事件原委

items.def_en: To carry out a systematic or formal inquiry to discover the truth about a crime, accident, problem, etc.
To examine the facts and circumstances of a problem, complaint, or situation in order to determine what happened.
To carry out a deep, thorough, and often critical investigation into a suspected wrongdoing or controversy.
To visit an establishment or examine items officially to check that standards and regulations are met.
(+ into) To make a formal or detailed inquiry to establish the truth of a situation or event.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal, official, or legal procedures undertaken to uncover the facts behind an incident, crime, malpractice, or disaster. The purpose is accountability, fact-finding, and legal determination.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方、执法机关或委员会针对事故、案件或不端行为的立案侦办与调查。

groups.name: Formal Postponement & Deferral · 延期审议与推迟 (Table, Defer, Adjourn)
groups.tip: 延后审议暂缓处理

items.def_zh: 搁置，推迟审议（美式）；正式提出供讨论（英式）
items.def_en: 1. (North American) To postpone consideration of a bill, motion, or proposal. 2. (British) To present a proposal or bill for formal discussion.
To arrange for an event or action to take place at a date or time later than scheduled
To officially put off an action, decision, or payment to a later appointed time
To break off a meeting or legal trial with the explicit intention of resuming it later
To discontinue a parliamentary session without formally dissolving the assembly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote official procedural decisions to push back meetings, debates, or legal determinations to a scheduled later date.
groups.summary_zh: 按法定或正式程序推迟会议、审议或行动。

groups.name: Format & Layout · 排版编排与格式化 (Typeset, Structure, Arrange)
groups.tip: 对物理或文本版面规范排布

items.def_en: To organize elements of a text, program, or dataset according to a coherent framework

items.def_zh: 编排格式；格式化（磁盘等）
items.def_en: 1. To arrange the shape, size, or general layout of text or data. 2. (computing) To prepare a storage medium for reading and writing.
To assign page numbers or organize content into discrete sequential pages
To design or arrange how text, images, and white space appear across a surface
To arrange text and graphics into a visual layout for printing or digital display

groups.summary_en: This domain involves configuring the structural visual layout or computational schema of data, documents, or storage media. While 'typeset' focuses on typographic arrangement for print, 'paginate' controls page divisions, and 'structure' shapes hierarchical organization.
groups.summary_zh: 指对文本、媒体或数据进行版式编排、格式设定与结构规划。

groups.name: Fractionate & Clarify · 离心与分馏 (Centrifuge, Fractionate, Distill)
groups.tip: 用离心等物理手段提纯分离

items.def_en: To divide or separate a chemical mixture into its individual fractions or component parts
To cause a substance to be deposited or separated out in solid form from a solution

items.def_zh: 用离心机分离，对……进行离心分离
items.def_en: 1. (science) To spin a liquid mixture at very high speed in a machine to separate heavier particles from lighter liquids.
To purify a liquid by heating it into vapor and then condensing the vapor back into liquid
To gradually pour liquid from one container into another, especially without disturbing the sediment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this technical and chemical processing frame refer to separating mixed substances into distinct physical or chemical components based on density, boiling point, or particle size.
groups.summary_zh: 利用物理或化学原理（如离心、蒸馏）将混合物各组分纯化分离开来。

groups.name: Fray & Unravel · 磨损与起毛 (Fray, Tatter, Unravel)
groups.tip: 经年累月摩擦，边缘起毛破损

items.def_zh: （使）（织物、绳索等边缘）起毛，磨破；（神经、脾气等）变得紧张，急躁
items.def_en: 1. To become or cause to become unraveled or worn at the edge. 2. (of nerves, tempers, etc.) To become strained or irritated.
To become gradually thin, eroded, or damaged through friction or time
To undo or separate woven or knitted threads; figuratively, to fall apart
To tear, wear down, or cut into long, narrow strips
To make ragged or torn into shred-like pieces

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive mechanical disintegration of fabric edges, ropes, or materials through rubbing, commonly extended to strained patience or nerves.
groups.summary_zh: 边缘因摩擦散线起毛脱落，亦指神经脾气被磨损。

groups.name: Frolic & Cavort · 欢跃与嬉闹 (Frolic, Cavort, Caper)
groups.tip: 欢欣雀跃或欢快蹦跳打闹

items.def_en: to play and move around in a lively, cheerful, and light-hearted way
to play roughly, energetically, and boisterously

items.def_zh: 扮小丑滑稽动作，做滑稽蹦跳动作
items.def_en: (archaic) to perform silly, playful, or grotesque gestures and movements like a clown
to skip or dance around in a playful, energetic, or comedic manner
to jump or dance around excitedly and exuberantly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame depict vigorous, exuberant, playful jumping, dancing, and prancing around in high spirits or buffoonish glee.
groups.summary_zh: 指兴高采烈、滑稽或无拘无束地雀跃、蹦跳与打闹嬉戏。

groups.name: Fruit & Bear · 结果与产出 (Yield, Bear, Produce)
groups.tip: 植物成熟孕育果实的过程

items.def_en: Produce crops, flowers, or fruit as part of natural growth
To produce or bear fruit, or cause a plant to do so.
Produce or shed seeds after flowering
Produce or provide a natural product or crop as a result of cultivation
Become or make fruit or grain fully developed and ready to harvest

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the reproductive output of plants and natural organisms as they mature. The verbs contrast botanical yield ('fruit', 'bear') with agricultural and metaphorical productivity ('yield', 'crop').
groups.summary_zh: 指植物成熟后开花结果、结出果实或产出作物。

groups.name: Fuel & Tend Fire · 添柴与煽火 (Stoke, Feed, Tend)
groups.tip: 生火添柴助火势更旺

items.def_zh: 封火，压火（使火经久微燃）
items.def_en: To heap ashes or coal over a fire so that it continues to burn slowly for hours
To blow air onto a flame or fire to intensify combustion and make it burn fiercer
To supply fuel, wood, or combustible material continuously to an existing flame
To look after a fire by arranging logs, clearing embers, and ensuring steady burning

items.raw_cluster: 点燃与加燃料 Ignite & Fuel
items.def_zh: 给（炉火等）添加燃料；激起，煽动
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To add coal, wood, or other fuel to a fire or furnace and stir it so it burns brightly. 2. To encourage or stir up strong emotions or ideas.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the physical replenishment and mechanical maintenance of an active flame, hearth, or engine, often extending metaphorically to feeding passions or dissent.
groups.summary_zh: 向火堆、炉膛添加燃料、拨动火势，或比喻性地煽动情绪。

groups.name: Full & Scour Fabrics · 缩绒与精炼洗涤 (Full, Degrease, Bleach)
groups.tip: 纺织加工中的清洗与密实

items.def_zh: 漂洗缩绒（使毛织物等密实纯净）
items.def_en: To clean, scour, and thicken newly woven woolen cloth by moisture, heat, and beating.
To mat and press fibers together into a dense, solid fabric using moisture, heat, and pressure.
To remove grease, lanolin, or oil from wool, raw skins, machinery, or industrial materials.
To whiten textiles or raw pulps and strip impurities using chemical agents or sunlight.

items.def_zh: 精炼；脱杂洗净（原毛或织物）
items.def_en: To purify unworked wool or textiles by washing in hot, alkaline baths to eliminate grease and dirt.

groups.summary_en: This industrial and traditional craft frame relates to treating, scouring, and compacting raw fibers, cloth, or hides to purge natural oils, lanolin, dirt, and gum prior to finishing.
groups.summary_zh: 针对生纺织物或皮革进行缩绒、去脂与精炼，以清除天然杂质。

groups.name: Funnel & Siphon · 漏斗汇流与漏注 (Funnel, Siphon, Choke down)
groups.tip: 顺着通道漏斗式集中

items.def_zh: 堵住通道，将…限制在狭小空间
items.def_en: To trap or restrict vehicles, troops, or flow in a confined space so that movement is blocked

items.def_zh: 聚集，驱赶（人群向某处移动）
items.def_en: To move or make a group of people or animals move together in a compact body into a place

items.def_zh: （使）汇集，（使）通过狭窄通道；引导，转输；用漏斗注入
items.def_en: to move, pass, or direct something through a narrow space or channel; to channel funds, people, or resources toward a particular destination
To convey or divert liquid, money, or resources gradually away through a tube or covert channel

items.def_zh: 收缩，掐紧通道限制流速
items.def_en: To make narrower or tighter, restricting the free flow of fluid, traffic, or movement

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray moving substances, masses of people, or funds through narrow bottlenecks, tapering spaces, or covert channels.
groups.summary_zh: 使人流、物资或资金经由收窄的孔道、瓶颈汇聚或暗中抽取转移。

groups.name: Furlough & Lay Off · 临时停工与准假 (Lay Off, Stand Down, Suspend)
groups.tip: 暂时无薪休假或直接免职

items.def_zh: 暂时坐冷板凳，暂停上岗
items.def_en: To keep an employee or consultant inactive while waiting for a viable billable project
To officially bar someone from their job, office, or duties for a limited time, often pending inquiry

items.def_zh: 解雇，下岗（常因经营不善或裁员）
items.def_en: To terminate employment temporarily or permanently due to lack of available work
To temporarily cease operational duties or step aside from an active corporate post

items.def_zh: 准假，给予准假；使停薪休假，暂时解雇
items.def_en: 1. To give temporary leave of absence to an employee, soldier, or prisoner. 2. To temporarily lay off workers without pay, usually because of lack of funds or work.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on mandatory, temporary leaves of absence or workforce reductions driven by budget shortfalls or economic downturns, preserving or pausing the underlying employment link rather than outright termination.
groups.summary_zh: 因预算削减、危机或调查实施的临时停职、停工待命。

groups.name: Furnish with Projections · 装配倒刺与尖端 (Barb, Spike, Bristle)
groups.tip: 装上倒钩倒刺配件

items.def_en: To provide something with a sharp tip or tapered point
To furnish, pierce, or stud an object with sharp-pointed projections
To set or ornament a surface thickly with protruding metal studs or sharp bosses
to fit an arrow, hook, or wire with a sharp backward-pointing projection
To equip, line, or cause a surface to be densely furnished with stiff, spiky projections

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve arming, modifying, or retrofitting an object with sharp projections, hooks, or points to make it catch, snag, or inflict damage. They focus on functional edge modifications.
groups.summary_zh: 指为物体安装倒钩、尖刺或锐利凸起，以增强抓阻或杀伤能力。

groups.name: Gag & Silence · 封口与堵言 (Muzzle, Suppress, Silence)
groups.tip: 强行堵嘴剥夺发声权利

items.def_en: To tell or order someone to be quiet, usually by uttering the sound 'shh'
To suppress news or information about something discreditable to keep the public unaware
To suppress or extinguish speech, dissent, or opposition through power, intimidation, or censorship

items.def_zh: 塞住……的嘴；使噤声，压制言论；作呕，恶心
items.def_en: 1. to put a cloth or other object into or over someone's mouth to prevent them from speaking, or to suppress freedom of speech. 2. to choke or feel as if you are about to vomit.
To prevent a person or group, especially the press, from expressing opinions or publishing facts freely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly preventing speech, whether physically obstructing a mouth or using legal, institutional, or authoritative coercion to extinguish expression and leaks.
groups.summary_zh: 以物理外力或强权手段压制发声，实施禁言与灭音封口。

groups.name: Gain & Net · 净得与赚取 (Clear, Pocket, Gross)
groups.tip: 通过付出收获净收益

items.def_en: to earn an amount of money as pure profit after all expenses, costs, or taxes are deducted
to earn or obtain an amount of money as a net profit
to take or retain an amount of money, profit, or prize for oneself, sometimes illicitly
to earn an overall total amount of money before taxes, costs, and deductions are subtracted
to acquire or earn extremely large amounts of money easily or quickly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate earning or realizing an exact sum of money, revenue, or profit through business dealings, prize winning, or salary after expenses or deductions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过经商贸易、薪酬扣税或博彩比赛而最终实质性落袋、净赚或赚取金额。

groups.name: Gash & Slash · 割伤与斫出深口 (Gash, Slash, Lacerate)
groups.tip: 利刃划开皮肤造成极深的豁口

items.def_en: Tear or cut something open forcefully and abruptly
Cut someone or something with a violent, sweeping motion of a blade
Make a straight, deep, and deliberate cut into something narrow or thin, such as a throat or pouch
To make a long, deep cut in someone's skin or in a surface.
(formal) Tear or deeply cut human skin or flesh with a jagged edge

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify inflicting deep, jagged, or violent bodily incisions using blades, jagged edges, or glass, carrying high physical trauma and vivid visceral impact.
groups.summary_zh: 描述以锋利刃具或硬物猛烈割裂身体、造成较深伤口。

groups.name: Gather & Glean · 搜集与捡拾 (Scrape together, Cobble together, Muster)
groups.tip: 点滴搜集散落各处的资源

items.def_en: To reconstruct a full picture, narrative, or truth by gradually joining isolated facts

items.def_zh: 费力搜集（信息、知识等）；拾（落穗）
items.def_en: To gather information, facts, or news slowly and with difficulty from various sources; to collect leftover grain after harvesting.
To assemble or produce something quickly and roughly from whatever fragments are available
To collect or amass small amounts of money, support, or facts with great difficulty
To collect, assemble, or summon up troops, courage, or scattered evidence

groups.summary_en: This frame covers painstakingly gathering small amounts of information, resources, or support from diverse and often scarce sources. It highlights patient collation over effortless mass harvesting.
groups.summary_zh: 强调克服短缺困难，由琐碎、分散来源逐一收集或拼凑信息与资源。

groups.name: Gather & Steer · 驱赶与聚拢 (Herd, Round Up, Drive)
groups.tip: 驱策群体朝指定方向移动

items.def_en: To force a group of animals or people to move in a desired direction by shouting, chasing, or guiding
To locate, bring together, and enclose scattered people, cattle, or objects into one designated place
To carefully guide, escort, and watch over a group of people or animals along a path

items.def_zh: 赶在一起，驱赶（畜群或人群）；成群结队移动
items.def_en: 1. To make animals or people move together as a group. 2. To gather or move together in a herd.
To gather and confine cattle or people into an enclosed space or organized group

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote managing the movement of a collective group of animals or people, gathering them from scattered areas and directing them toward a specific location or enclosure. Actions range from gentle corralling to forceful driving.
groups.summary_zh: 指将四散的牲畜或人群聚拢、围集并驱赶引导至特定方向或场所。

groups.name: Gentle & Manual Laundering · 手洗与精细洗涤 (Hand-launder, Delicately wash, Hand-rinse)
groups.tip: 用手轻柔浸泡搓洗衣物

items.def_zh: 在肥皂水中轻轻漂晃（娇贵衣物）
items.def_en: To gently agitate delicate garments back and forth in soapy water without rubbing or wringing

items.def_zh: 手洗淘净（轻薄小件衣物）
items.def_en: To quickly wash and clear soap from a small garment by hand under running water
To wash, rinse, and press clothing exclusively by hand rather than using commercial or household machinery
1. To wash clothing or other delicate items by hand rather than in a washing machine.
To clean an article or fabric vigorously by rubbing hard with a brush, cloth, or one's knuckles

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict cleansing fabrics, garments, or delicate wares cautiously by manual agitation or non-machine care to avoid damage.
groups.summary_zh: 手工搓洗或轻柔洗涤织物，避免机器机械损伤。

groups.name: Gentle Prompting & Contact · 轻触与温和推动 (Nudge, Prod, Poke)
groups.tip: 向前推动或轻推提醒

items.def_zh: （用手肘等）轻推，轻触；推进，劝诱
items.def_en: 1. To push someone gently, usually with an elbow, to attract attention. 2. To gently encourage or persuade someone to take action.
To push a finger or sharp object quickly into someone or something to get their attention
To push or shake something slightly and briefly; often used figuratively to stimulate memory
To poke someone or something with a finger or pointed object, often to stimulate action
To strike or nudge someone gently or deliberately with one's elbow to alert them

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe touching or pushing someone lightly—often with an elbow, finger, or stick—either to draw attention or subtly urge them toward an action.
groups.summary_zh: 用手肘或指尖轻碰轻推以提醒或温和催促他人行动。

groups.name: Get & Access · 调取与获取 (Retrieve, Fetch, Query)
groups.tip: 调用和取回所需数据

items.def_zh: 在屏幕上调出（数据、网页或文件）
items.def_en: to find, display, or open an electronic file or record on a computer screen
to obtain, retrieve, or open information or files, especially on a computer
to locate and bring back information, files, or records from computer memory or storage
to seek out and return specific instructions, data, or files from storage
to search a database or index systematically to obtain specific answers or data

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe obtaining entry to, locating, and retrieving electronic files, databases, protected materials, or networked systems for operational use.
groups.summary_zh: 指进入系统、数据库或文件存储介质并调取、读取或提取所需信息与数据。

groups.name: Gird & Brace · 严阵以待与自我戒备 (Gird, Brace, Steel, Fortify)
groups.tip: 全副武装并做好面对挑战的准备

items.def_en: To prepare oneself or become prepared to do something demanding

items.def_zh: 增强（意志/体魄）；使有勇气坚守
items.def_en: To strengthen someone physically or mentally against danger, temptation, or hardship

items.def_zh: 下定决心；硬起心肠下狠劲
items.def_en: To fill oneself with courage or determination in order to face something unpleasant

items.def_zh: 使做好心理准备；准备抵御（冲击）
items.def_en: To prepare oneself physically or mentally for something unpleasant or difficult

items.def_zh: 准备（迎接挑战）；（用带子）束紧；围绕，环绕
items.def_en: 1. (especially 'gird oneself' or 'gird one's loins') To prepare oneself mentally or physically for a struggle or conflict. 2. (literary or archaic) To fasten around the waist with a belt or band; to encircle.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mentally, emotionally, or physically hardening and readying oneself for an impending ordeal, shock, or difficult confrontation. They convey active resolve, fortitude, and protective psychological posture.
groups.summary_zh: 指打起精神、做好心理或体魄防备以迎战艰难考验。

groups.name: Gloss Over & Whitewash · 掩饰过失与敷衍 (Gloss, Whitewash, Paper Over)
groups.tip: 粉饰搪塞，轻描淡写掩盖问题

items.def_zh: 掩饰，粉饰（后常接 over）；给……上光，给……涂光泽剂；加注释
items.def_en: 1. ('gloss over') To deliberately avoid talking about a problem, mistake, or embarrassing detail by treating it as unimportant. 2. To give a shiny, smooth surface to something. 3. To provide an explanation or translation for a word.
To make something difficult, unpleasant, or painful seem more acceptable or appealing than it is
To hide or gloss over difficulties or disagreements rather than resolving them fundamentally
To conceal an embarrassing problem or mistake in the hope that it will remain unnoticed
To conceal unpleasant facts, mistakes, or crimes by giving a false or misleadingly clean account

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe disguising defects, errors, or ethical failures by offering superficial explanations, soft-pedaling facts, or omitting inconvenient truths.
groups.summary_zh: 轻描淡写地粉饰缺点过错，或遮掩矛盾漏洞。

groups.name: Glower & Threaten with the Eyes · 怒视与沉下脸 (Scowl, Glower, Glare)
groups.tip: 沉着脸带着怒火瞪着对方

items.def_en: Furrow one's brow to convey disapproval, discontent, or serious concentration
Look sullen, dark, or threatening by casting one's brow into an angry grimace

items.def_zh: 怒视，怒目而视；皱眉，沉着脸
items.def_en: To look at someone or something with an angry, displeased, or threatening expression.

items.def_zh: 怒目而视，恶狠狠地盯视
items.def_en: (+ at) Stare at someone with a fierce, piercing expression of direct hostility or anger
(+ at) Look or stare at someone with sullen, brooding, or menacing displeasure

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote fixing someone with an intensely hostile, menacing, or angry facial expression, often involving furrowed brows and steady eye contact.
groups.summary_zh: 紧蹙双眉、带有敌意或威胁性地沉脸怒视他人。

groups.name: Gnaw & Nibble · 啃咬与咀嚼 (Gnaw, Nibble, Chew)
groups.tip: 像啮齿动物般持续啃磨硬物

items.def_en: To take small, gentle bites out of food repeatedly
To crush, grind, and masticate food in the mouth with the teeth

items.def_zh: 大声咀嚼；津津有味地吃
items.def_en: To chew food steadily and audibly with obvious relish
To chew or bite upon noisily or vigorously, as a horse champing at the bit
1. (+ at/on) To bite or chew repeatedly on something hard. 2. To cause persistent worry, pain, or discomfort.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses persistent or repetitive biting mechanics, ranging from small exploratory nibbles on food to wear-down gnawing that erodes hard substances or metaphorically eats away at peace of mind.
groups.summary_zh: 指反复啃切或咬碎坚硬物，引申指焦虑如啃噬般折磨心神。

groups.name: Goade & Prod Rashly · 怂恿与挑唆 (Egg On, Goad, Prod)
groups.tip: 暗中怂恿并激化对立冲突

items.def_en: Prick or deliberately annoy someone with teasing remarks until they take action.
Stimulate or urge someone into action when they are hesitant or reluctant.
Encourage or urge someone persistently to do something foolish or risky.
1. (egg someone on) To encourage or urge someone to do something risky, foolish, or wrong. 2. To pelt or throw eggs at someone or something.
Provoke or annoy someone continually until they react, often by doing something rash.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers interpersonal urging that pushes another person into doing something reckless, mischievous, dangerous, or foolish, often driven by peer pressure or malicious teasing.
groups.summary_zh: 指在人际交往中挑唆、怂恿他人从事冒险、鲁莽或愚蠢轻率之举。

groups.name: Golf Scoring Feats · 高尔夫击球得分 (Eagle, Bogey, Ace)
groups.tip: 竞技赛场打出小鸟球获胜

items.def_zh: 以低于标准杆两杆击球入洞
items.def_en: To complete a hole in two strokes under par
To hit a hole-in-one on a golf hole
To shoot the standard par score on a hole or course

items.def_zh: （高尔夫球中）以低于标准杆一杆击球入洞，打出小鸟球
items.def_en: (golf) to score a birdie on a hole by taking one stroke fewer than par

items.def_zh: 以高于标准杆一杆击球入洞
items.def_en: To take one stroke more than par on a hole

groups.summary_en: Specific scoring actions and hole completions in golf relative to the designated par. These verbs describe outperforming standard expectations through precision under pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 高尔夫运动中相对于标准杆的各类击球得分动作与结果。

groups.name: Gossip & Idle Talk · 闲聊与八卦琐事 (Dish, Tattle, Chatter)
groups.tip: 日常闲扯与打听传播闲话

items.def_en: (slang) (+ about/on) To share juicy secrets, rumors, or confidential gossip openly
1. (+ about) To talk informally about other people's private lives, actions, or rumors.
To talk quickly, incessantly, and casually about unimportant or trivial matters
To reveal someone else's secrets or petty misdeeds childishly to an authority figure
To criticize, defame, or speak spitefully and dismissively about someone behind their back

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe informal social communication centered on unverified rumors, trivial affairs, and other people's intimate lives. Nuances contrast playful chit-chat with malicious backbiting.
groups.summary_zh: 就他人私生活与未证实传闻进行的非正式闲谈或议论。

groups.name: Gradual Collapse & Decay · 瓦解与溃败 (Crumble, Disintegrate, Decay)
groups.tip: 土崩瓦解彻底分崩离析

items.def_en: To gradually wear away or deteriorate over time through steady friction or attrition
To break into pieces or fail completely because of structural weakness or internal stress
To decline gradually in health, prosperity, quality, or structural stability

items.def_zh: 崩解，瓦解；（使）粉碎，碎成细屑
items.def_en: 1. To collapse, break down, or fail gradually, such as a building, empire, or system. 2. To break or fall apart into small fragments or crumbs.
To break up completely into tiny pieces or cease functioning as a coherent whole

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the gradual, progressive deterioration and collapse of solids, organizations, or empires, crumbling into fragments through weakness or decay.
groups.summary_zh: 强调实体或组织体系因老化、脆弱而渐次碎裂、瓦解或名存实亡。

groups.name: Grant & Bestow · 给予与赠予 (Bestow, Confer, Accord)
groups.tip: 官方正式颁发荣誉奖项

items.def_en: (+ to) To grant or give someone particular status, treatment, or respect

items.def_zh: 授予，颁发；判定，裁定给予
items.def_en: 1. To give a prize, honor, or money to someone after an official decision or competition.
To formally or legally allow someone to have or do something, such as permission, rights, or funds
(+ on/upon) To officially grant a title, degree, benefit, or right to someone
(+ on/upon) To officially present an honor, right, or gift to someone as a mark of respect

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the formal, institutional, or honorific act of transferring a prize, privilege, or status to someone, often based on merit, authority, or ceremonial protocol.
groups.summary_zh: 基于法定裁决、权威或仪式给予奖项、荣誉或特权。

groups.name: Grant & Enfeoff · 封赐与封授 (Bestow, Invest, Deed)
groups.tip: 封建领主正式分封赐地

items.def_en: To formally confer a title, official power, rank, or property upon someone with ceremony
To convey or transfer real property, an estate, or title to another party by legal deed
To grant or bestow a title, award, degree, or benefit upon someone from an official position of authority
To present an honor, right, or gift upon someone as an official mark of favor or respect
(historical) to grant land or an estate to a vassal under the feudal system in exchange for pledged service.

groups.summary_en: This institutional frame encompasses formally or legally conveying title, sovereign lands, feudal estates, honors, or vested authorities to a subordinate recipient.
groups.summary_zh: 以君主或法律权威正式册封、赏赐领地、官职或特权。

groups.name: Grasp & Seize Physically · 抓握与强取 (Grasp, Seize, Snatch)
groups.tip: 伸手牢牢抓取或擒获

items.def_en: To grab onto or attach oneself firmly to someone or something
To take a firm hold of somebody or something with your hand
1. (formal / archaic) To seize or grasp physically. 2. (formal) To comprehend mentally.
To take hold of something suddenly and firmly with force
To take hold of something quickly, roughly, or secretly

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the physical act of closing fingers or an appendage firmly around an object, or taking hold of something suddenly or by force.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手掌或手指牢牢抓取、攥紧或强行攫取某物。

groups.name: Grave Risk & Existential Threat · 重创与严重危及 (Imperil, Threaten, Undermine)
groups.tip: 对安全或重大利益构成危险

items.def_en: To pose a formidable danger or forebode catastrophe toward public safety or political order
To weaken authority, stability, or confidence gradually and insidiously
To disrupt the steady functioning and security of a government or economic system

items.def_zh: 危及，使陷入险境，损害（jeopardize的英式拼写）
items.def_en: (British English) To put someone or something in serious danger of being harmed, damaged, or lost.
To expose institutions, lives, or state security to imminent and catastrophic hazard

groups.summary_en: Highlights actions that inflict severe or fatal risk upon vital governance, national stability, constitutional order, or alliances. Collocates include sovereignty, stability, regime, and peace talks.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重对政局、稳定或根本利益构成高强度威胁或重创。

groups.name: Gravitate & Incline · 趋向与靠拢 (Gravitate, Incline, Drift)
groups.tip: 受吸引力自然靠拢

items.def_en: (+ toward/to) To tend to support, favor, or choose a particular side, opinion, or preference

items.def_zh: 不知不觉漂移，缓缓靠拢
items.def_en: (+ toward/into) To move slowly and aimlessly, or be carried effortlessly toward a specific direction or group
(+ toward/to) To feel favorably disposed toward or lean toward a particular opinion or course of action

items.def_zh: 被吸引到，移向；受重力作用下沉
items.def_en: 1. (+ toward/to) To be naturally attracted to and move toward a person, place, or thing. 2. (physics) To move in response to gravitational pull.
(+ toward) To change direction or attitude, shifting progressively toward something new

groups.summary_en: Denotes physical or psychological movement naturally drawn toward an attractor, idea, or group. 'Gravitate' implies an irresistible or unconscious pull, whereas 'drift' suggests gradual, passive convergence.
groups.summary_zh: 指受到无形力量、兴趣或趋势驱使，自然或不自觉地向某处靠拢。

groups.name: Graze & Pasture · 放牧与吃草 (Graze, Browse, Pasture)
groups.tip: 牛羊在草场觅食吃草与放养

items.def_en: Send horses, cattle, or sheep out into a field or pasture to graze
Drive or manage a group of domesticated animals together to grazing grounds
Feed on high-growing vegetation such as leaves, twigs, and bark rather than ground grass
Feed on grass or growing plants, or put cattle or sheep out to feed on open pasture
To put animals in a field to graze, or to feed on growing grass.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses herbivores feeding on wild vegetation and herders turning livestock out to open grasslands or enclosed paddocks.
groups.summary_zh: 指食草动物啃食野草，或牧人放牧牲口。

groups.name: Grease & Lubricate · 润滑与抹油 (Grease, Lubricate, Oil)
groups.tip: 表面涂润滑脂防磨损

items.def_en: To apply mineral or plant oil to mechanical parts or tools to smooth their motion
To spread butter onto a slice of food or across the inside surface of a baking dish
to rub grease, oil, or fat onto a surface or machine part to make it run smoothly or prevent food from sticking
To apply an oily substance to machine joints or surfaces to reduce wear and friction
To coat with lard or insert strips of fat into lean meat to enhance richness

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying slippery substances such as oil, fat, or synthetic lubricants to machinery or cooking pans. The goal is to minimize mechanical friction, prevent sticking, or ensure smooth operation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在器械表面或容器内涂抹油脂，以降低摩擦或防止粘连结块。

groups.name: Grieve & Mourn · 悲伤与哀痛 (Sorrow, Grieve, Mourn)
groups.tip: 从心头感伤升级为丧亲般的沉痛哀悼

items.def_en: (literary) To feel or express deep sadness, grief, or sorrow.
To express deep sorrow, regret, or disappointment about a tragic event or loss

items.def_zh: 因悲伤而憔悴；消沉至衰弱
items.def_en: To become steadily weaker and thinner because of profound grief, unrequited love, or longing
To feel intense sorrow or distress, especially over the death of a loved one
To feel and exhibit deep sorrow for someone who has died, often following cultural mourning rituals

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote experiencing, enduring, or giving outward expression to deep emotional pain and acute distress over a profound loss or tragedy.
groups.summary_zh: 表示因遭受重大丧失或变故而内心深感悲痛、哀悼或流露悲戚。

groups.name: Grimace & Frown · 鬼脸与苦相 (Grimace, Wince, Scowl)
groups.tip: 痛苦或厌恶时扭曲面部做怪相

items.def_en: to furrow one's brows to register displeasure, confusion, or deep concentration
to make a slight, involuntary grimace caused by sudden pain, distress, or embarrassment

items.raw_cluster: 皱眉与做鬼脸 Frown & Grimace
items.def_en: To make an ugly expression with your face, typically because you are in pain, disgusted, or embarrassed.
to frown in an angry, sulky, or intensely displeased manner
to twist facial features out of their normal shape under agony or intense strain

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify involuntary or deliberate facial distortions reflecting negative emotional or physical states, contrasting sudden pain-induced spasms with deliberate brooding displeasure.
groups.summary_zh: 描摹因疼痛、反感或愤怒而引起的痛苦抽搐、皱眉或做鬼脸动作。

groups.name: Grip & Clasp · 握紧与紧抱 (Grip, Clasp, Clench)
groups.tip: 用手指手掌用力扣合紧握

items.def_en: To keep one's hands firmly attached to something to prevent falling or letting go
To hold something very tightly and firmly
1. To hold someone or something tightly with your fingers or arms. 2. To fasten or close something with or as if with a clasp.
To hold something tightly, usually because you are frightened, excited, or in pain
To close or hold parts of the body (such as fists or teeth) tightly together, especially in anger or determination

groups.summary_en: Describes holding an object or person tightly and securely with hands, fingers, or arms, emphasizing sustained pressure or an emotional embrace.
groups.summary_zh: 强调持续用力握紧、攥牢或紧紧抱住某人某物。

groups.name: Ground & Found · 奠定依据与确立基石 (Base, Ground, Found)
groups.tip: 立足于特定基础或前提

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to establish a claim, system, or organization based firmly on an underlying idea

items.def_zh: 以……为基础（或根据）；将（基地、总部等）设在
items.def_en: 1. to use an idea, fact, or situation as the foundation for something. 2. to locate headquarters or operations in a particular place.
(+ in) to base an argument, theory, or belief on sound facts or principles
(+ in) to fix or base something strongly within a particular context, reality, or principle
(+ on/upon) to base an action or belief on an underlying condition, idea, or assumption

groups.summary_en: This frame deals with establishing intellectual, logical, or evidentiary roots for theories, claims, and actions, rooting abstract ideas in solid evidence or principle.
groups.summary_zh: 指为理论、论点或行动确立坚实的事实依据与立论根基。

groups.name: Ground & Run Aground · 搁浅与触礁停滞 (Beach, Ground, Run Aground)
groups.tip: 船只冲滩停滞不前

items.def_en: Touch the seabed or riverbed in shallow water, preventing a boat or vessel from moving forward

items.def_zh: 使（船或海洋动物）搁浅，冲上岸；上岸
items.def_en: To bring or run a boat or marine creature onto a beach or shallow water; to run aground.

items.def_zh: 触礁进水沉没；失控沉没
items.def_en: Fill with water and sink, or break apart after striking ground or rocks at sea
Crash or come into shallow coastal water or onto rocks so that the hull is trapped
Leave a vessel, animal, or person trapped on a shore or reef without the means to move away

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers vessels or sea creatures coming onto coastal shallows, reefs, or mudbanks and becoming immobile. It highlights either accidental stranding due to hazards or deliberate intentional grounding.
groups.summary_zh: 船只或海洋生物触礁、冲上海滩或陷入浅滩而动弹不得。

groups.name: Grovel & Cringe · 卑躬屈膝与奴颜婢膝 (Crawl, Cringe, Kowtow, Truckle)
groups.tip: 卑躬屈膝地低头逢迎屈服

items.def_en: to behave in an obsequious or servile way, shrinking back in submissive fear
(+ to) to act obsequiously toward someone in power after falling out of favor

items.def_zh: 卑躬屈膝，摇尾乞怜；匍匐，趴着
items.def_en: 1. to behave with excessive humility or subservience in order to gain favor or forgiveness. 2. to crawl or lie face down on the ground.
(+ to) to act in an excessively subservient or obedient manner toward an authority
(+ to) to submit or yield tamely and servilely to another's demands or authority

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate abject self-abasement, servile fawning, or humiliating submission adopted to curry favor or beg for mercy.
groups.summary_zh: 指极度卑屈、阿谀奉承或毫无自尊地摇尾乞怜。

groups.name: Grow & Mature · 熟化与成熟 (Mature, Ripen, Mellow, Age)
groups.tip: 从生长发育逐渐走向完全成熟

items.def_en: To undergo storage over time to develop improved maturity, flavor, or texture
To soften in harshness and become rich, smooth, and gentle with age
To dry or treat material (like wood) or accustom a person until fully fit and experienced

items.def_zh: 发育成熟，长成；使成熟；到期
items.def_en: 1. To develop and reach full growth or maturity, or make something do this. 2. (finance) To become due for payment.
To develop to full fruitfulness or readiness for harvesting and eating

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this spectrum trace the progression of organisms, crops, wine, or minds toward peak development, ripeness, or mellow completion.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖动植物、心智或食品风味达到完熟、醇化及峰值状态的渐进转变。

groups.name: Grub & Root · 刨土与翻找 (Grub, Root, Rummage)
groups.tip: 翻刨泥土以寻物或行穿透

items.def_en: To search widely for food or supplies by scratching, rummaging, or scouring the ground
To dig or search untidily in the earth or among objects to find something
To find or discover something by searching thoroughly and persistently among hidden places
(+ around/in) To dig around in earth or a container using a snout or hands to search for something
To dig a hole or tunnel into the ground or under something to hide or nest

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this tactile frame describe messy, shallow, or foraging-style digging in earth, litter, or cluttered surfaces. The physical action is often hurried, unscientific, and driven by searching for food or buried miscellanea.
groups.summary_zh: 指在土层或乱堆中杂乱翻扒、挖掘，多出于觅食或翻寻杂物。

groups.name: Grunt & Mutter · 低哼与咕哝 (Mutter, Mumble, Chunter)
groups.tip: 喉部哼哧作响与小声抱怨

items.def_zh: 咕哝，哼哼；（尤指猪等动物）发出呼噜声
items.def_en: 1. To make a short, low, rough sound in the throat, or speak in an irritable or tired voice. 2. (of an animal, especially a pig) To make a short, low grunt.
To speak unclearly and quietly so that words are difficult to distinguish
To speak in a low voice that is difficult to hear, especially when complaining or angry
To complain about something in a low, quiet, and dissatisfied voice
To say something in a low, rough, and angry voice

groups.summary_en: Focuses on producing low, guttural, or indistinct vocalizations driven by reluctance, irritation, or physical effort. Contrasts quiet sulking with unintelligible, muffled complaining.
groups.summary_zh: 指因疲惫、烦躁或不情愿而从喉咙深处发出含混粗哑的哼声与咕哝。

groups.name: Guard & Beware · 提防与戒备 (Look out, Watch out, Steer clear)
groups.tip: 保持戒备以防隐患

items.def_en: To be vigilant and pay close attention to potential dangers around you
To be extremely careful and alert to dangerous people, events, or obstacles
To take active precautions in order to prevent an undesirable event or mistake
To deliberately avoid someone or something that seems dangerous or problematic
(usually imperative or infinitive) To be very careful or on guard against potential danger, harm, or difficulty.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate deliberate vigilance and mental or behavioral self-protection against hazards, deception, or detrimental situations.
groups.summary_zh: 保持高度警觉，在行动上严加提防或主动避开危险。

groups.name: Guide & Shepherd · 引领与护送 (Shepherd, Guide, Escort, Usher)
groups.tip: 在前带路或像牧羊般指引

items.def_en: Direct or show someone the way to go by accompanying them or giving directions
Accompany someone somewhere for protection, guidance, or courtesy
1. to guide, direct, or escort a person or group carefully and protectively 2. to tend, guard, or herd sheep or other livestock
Gather and organize people carefully to lead them along an orderly route
Show someone where to go politely by walking slightly ahead or showing the way

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote leading, escorting, or carefully navigating individuals or groups through an unfamiliar, crowded, or delicate passage with protective supervision.
groups.summary_zh: 指悉心护送、指引或调度人员穿行复杂或拥挤场合。

groups.name: Gurgle & Babble · 咯咯与轻响 (Babble, Lap, Trickle)
groups.tip: 喉部发出潺潺咕嘟如流水般细响

items.def_en: To splash gently against a shore, boat, or wall with an intermittent soft liquid sound
To laugh quietly to oneself or make a subdued throaty sound of mild amusement

items.def_zh: （婴儿或鸽子）发出柔和咕咕声
items.def_en: To make a soft, gentle, and contented throat sound characteristic of infants or doves
To make a low, gentle, murmuring sound like a shallow stream over pebbles or a cooing baby

items.def_zh: （尤指婴儿高兴时）发咯咯咕咕声；（水等）发出汩汩声，作潺潺声
items.def_en: 1. (of a person, especially a baby) To make a contented, bubbling sound in the throat. 2. (of a liquid) To flow or emit a hollow bubbling sound.

groups.summary_en: Covers gentle, bubbly, rhythmic sounds emitted either playfully by happy throats (e.g., infants) or by irregular liquid streams. Highlights wet, pleasant, low-level resonance.
groups.summary_zh: 指咽喉发出欢愉的咯咯声，或水流轻撞发出的清脆细碎响声。

groups.name: Gut & Eviscerate · 掏空与摧毁核心 (Eviscerate, Gut, Disembowel)
groups.tip: 取出内脏使其失去核心活力

items.def_zh: 剥离出；清空内部关键组件
items.def_en: To completely empty an interior or take away the key functioning components of an organization
To empty the interior of something, leaving only a shell or seriously weakening its core stability

items.def_zh: 取出内脏；彻底摧毁内部
items.def_en: To remove the internal organs of an animal, or destroy the inside of a building or organization completely

items.def_zh: 取出……的内脏；除去……的精华，重创
items.def_en: 1. To remove the internal organs of a body or carcass. 2. (formal) To deprive something of its essential force, strength, or meaning.
To cut open the stomach and remove the bowels or entrails of a person or animal

groups.summary_en: This domain encompasses actions that violently extract internal organs physically, or metaphorically strip an entity of its fundamental strength, provisions, or vital substance. Intensity peaks at utter existential destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理上开膛破肚取出内脏，或比喻义上彻底抽空某物的核心与元气。

groups.name: Hackle & Detangle · 梳理与解结 (Detangle, Unravel, Hackle)
groups.tip: 用梳齿清理并梳顺麻纤维

items.def_en: Untangle, straighten, or clean hair or fibers using a comb
Gently pull fibers apart or comb hair backward to separate strands and add volume
Free something from tangles, snarls, or knots
Undo or separate knotted, intertwined, or woven threads

items.def_zh: （用铁齿梳）梳理（麻等纤维）；乱砍
items.def_en: To comb raw flax or hemp fibers using a spiked tool (hackle) to separate and straighten them.

groups.summary_en: Verbs designating the mechanical separation, straightening, and disentangling of fibrous materials, threads, or matted hair using combs or toothed implements.
groups.summary_zh: 指用齿梳等工具将缠结的纤维、麻线或毛发梳直并解开杂结。

groups.name: Hail & Taxi · 乘出租车出行 (Cab, Hail, Hitch)
groups.tip: 搭乘各类交通工具出行

items.def_en: To signal to a moving driver to pull over and stop by waving one's hand
To travel to a destination by passenger taxi
To signal to a taxi or public vehicle from the street in order to catch it
(informal) To travel or go somewhere by taxi.
To travel by getting free rides in passing vehicles from strangers

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail traveling by hired or shared vehicle, specifically focusing on hailing, flagging down, or riding in taxis or informal rides.
groups.summary_zh: 指搭乘出租车、打车或叫车通行的行为。

groups.name: Hallucinate & Delude · 幻觉与妄想 (Delude, Daydream, Envision)
groups.tip: 感官失真产生的虚妄知觉

items.def_en: Form an inaccurate, distorted, or wrong sensory impression or understanding of reality

items.def_zh: 想象，在脑海中显现景象
items.def_en: Picture mentally something as a future possibility or conceptual reality
(often reflexive) Make someone believe something that is totally untrue, false, or unreal
(+ about) Indulge in vivid mental daydreams about unreal, desired, or impossible scenarios

items.def_zh: 产生幻觉，出现幻觉；在幻觉中看到（或听到、感到）
items.def_en: To see, hear, or feel things that are not really there, especially because of illness or drugs.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental distortions, sensory illusions, and self-deceptive fantasies where unreal impressions are perceived or embraced as actual reality, whether through fever, intoxication, or deep psychological self-delusion.
groups.summary_zh: 表现感知错乱、凭空产生虚幻感官经验或深陷不切实际的自我欺骗。

groups.name: Halt & Freeze · 停滞与僵住 (Freeze, Seize up, Petrify)
groups.tip: 骤然止步定格不动

items.def_zh: 呆住；（因惊吓等）僵住不动
items.def_en: Become suddenly motionless with fear, astonishment, or shock
To stop moving suddenly and become completely still, typically through fear or shock.

items.def_zh: （机械）卡住锁死；（肌肉）抽搐僵死
items.def_en: Suddenly stick or seize into an unmovable position without the ability to turn
(of machinery, muscles, or joints) Stop moving or functioning properly due to friction or jamming
(usually passive) Render someone completely motionless or paralyzed with horror or extreme fear

groups.summary_en: Denotes an immediate and involuntary cessation of movement, action, or mechanical operation, most frequently triggered by acute fear, shock, temperature drop, or severe friction.
groups.summary_zh: 因恐惧、震惊或机械故障而瞬间完全静止、僵滞无法动弹。

groups.name: Halt & Immobilize · 阻滞与固定 (Immobilize, Paralyze, Pin down)
groups.tip: 迫使物体停止移动或固定

items.def_en: To suddenly stop moving completely, often through fear or shock, or to order someone to halt all motion
To hold someone or something firmly so that they cannot move, or to suppress enemy movement with gunfire
To prevent an aircraft, ship, or person from moving or leaving a place

items.def_zh: 使不动，使固定；使瘫痪，使丧失机能
items.def_en: 1. To prevent someone, a limb, or an object from moving. 2. To make a vehicle, system, or organization unable to function normally.
To cause a person, animal, or part of the body to lose the ability to move, or to bring an activity or system to a complete halt

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to completely arresting physical motion or rendering an entity unable to act or move. Nuances range from mechanical restraint and medical fixation to systemic crippling.
groups.summary_zh: 使身体、物体或系统完全失去活动能力或行动自由。

groups.name: Ham & Grandstand · 刻意卖弄与做作表演 (Ham up, Grandstand, Play to the gallery)
groups.tip: 登台演出或浮夸做作

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步；卖弄做作地走动
items.def_en: to walk or move about with a proud, theatrical, or conceited air to draw attention

items.def_zh: 夸张地表演；做作地表现
items.def_en: to deliberately exaggerate one's performance, gestures, or emotions to entertain

items.def_zh: 迎合大众；迎合低级趣味
items.def_en: to behave in an exaggerated or sensational way solely to win cheap popularity from a crowd
(informal, often ham it up) to overact or exaggerate emotions in an artificial, theatrical way

items.def_zh: 哗众取宠；卖弄以讨好观众
items.def_en: to conduct oneself or speak theatrically in order to impress onlookers and gain approval

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on performers or speakers purposely exaggerating their actions, playing for laughs, or ostentatiously performing to pander to a crowd.
groups.summary_zh: 指演员或发言人故意夸大动作或表情，迎合受众以博取眼球或掌声。

groups.name: Happen by Chance · 偶然发生 (Befall, Transpire, Crop Up)
groups.tip: 机缘巧合偶然发生

items.def_en: To happen, develop, or come into being unexpectedly or naturally
To appear or occur suddenly and unexpectedly, especially an issue or topic

items.def_zh: 碰巧发生，偶然发生；冒险一试
items.def_en: 1. To happen by chance. 2. To take the risk of doing something.
(formal) To take place or occur, often gradually coming to light
(literary) (of something bad or unexpected) To happen to someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate events materializing serendipitously, unexpectedly, or without deliberate human orchestration. They contrast planned outcomes with accidental or coincidental occurrences.
groups.summary_zh: 指事件出乎意料、偶然发生或突如其来地降临与冒头。

groups.name: Harass & Haze · 欺凌与折磨 (Bully, Torment, Persecute)
groups.tip: 团体内对新人恶整与霸凌

items.def_en: To repeatedly treat someone unkindly or criticize them unfairly
To hurt, frighten, or compel someone weaker into doing something

items.def_zh: （恶作剧式）折磨，霸凌（新生或新成员）；（使）变朦胧
items.def_en: 1. (North American) To subject new members or recruits to humiliating, harsh, or abusive initiation tasks. 2. To become or make hazy.
To inflict severe physical or mental suffering on someone repeatedly
To treat someone cruelly and unfairly, especially because of their beliefs, race, or group status

groups.summary_en: Captures systematic intimidation, cruel initiation rituals, and coercive social torment directed at vulnerable or subordinate individuals.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过恃强凌弱、残酷虐待或苛待新人施行的人身与精神折磨。

groups.name: Harass & Hound · 追逼与催逼 (Chevy, Hound, Chivvy)
groups.tip: 在后追逼围堵捕获

items.def_en: To persistently attack, trouble, or harass someone with repeated demands
(+ into/along) To urge or badger someone repeatedly to do something or move faster
(+ into/with) To repeatedly ask, bother, or urge someone into doing something
To pursue relentlessly or harass someone persistently without letting them rest
(British dated) To chase, harass, or nag someone persistently.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on persistent chasing, badgering, or nagging someone to move them along, coerce them into action, or exhaust them through constant pursuit.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过不停追赶、催促或骚扰让人疲于奔命。

groups.name: Harbinger & Public Preannouncement · 昭示来临与隆重宣示 (Herald, Usher in, Proclaim)
groups.tip: 提前发出预兆或象征未来事件

items.def_en: To mark or cause the beginning of a new period, era, or epoch

items.def_zh: 预示……的来临；宣布，宣传；公开称赞
items.def_en: to be a sign that something important is about to happen; to announce or praise something publicly
To announce formally, publicly, or unmistakably that something noteworthy is occurring
To announce or celebrate an impending arrival or achievement loudly and proudly
To signal the immediate approach or dawn of a major event or seasonal change

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on serving as a momentous sign of incoming change, major historical shifts, or grand arrivals, as well as publicly championing or acclaiming that advent.
groups.summary_zh: 标志重大变革或历史纪元的到来，或对其来临进行隆重、显要的公开宣告与昭示。

groups.name: Harbor Bitterness & Resentment · 愤恨不平与深怀怨怼 (Resent, Chafe, Bristle)
groups.tip: 因不公而长期怀恨或心生不满

items.def_en: (+ from/under) Feel continuing psychological pain, indignation, or wounded pride
To feel bitter, angry, or aggrieved about something or someone, especially due to perceived unfairness.
(+ at) React with defensive irritation or anger when feeling provoked or slighted

items.def_zh: 强抑怒火，内心情绪翻腾
items.def_en: Contain intense, agitated anger and inward resentment that threatens to boil over
(+ at/under) Feel irritable, restless, or resentful under restrictions or annoying conditions

groups.summary_en: This frame captures deep-seated, persistent indignation felt toward an injury, unequal treatment, or an enforced condition perceived as deeply unfair.
groups.summary_zh: 对不公待遇或受制于人深感委屈、愤懑与怨恨难平。

groups.name: Harbour & Conceal · 窝藏与庇护 (Shield, Protect, Conceal)
groups.tip: 提供住所或掩护避难

items.def_en: To store or hide someone or something safely in a secret place

items.def_zh: 收留，接纳（投宿或避难者）
items.def_en: To allow someone to stay in your home when they need refuge or have nowhere else to go
To stay in a safe place so that the police or enemies cannot find you

items.def_zh: 庇护，遮蔽（免受惩罚或追查）
items.def_en: To protect someone from blame, punishment, or scrutiny by hiding or defending them

items.def_zh: 庇护，窝藏（罪犯）；心怀，怀有（情感或想法）；携带（细菌等）
items.def_en: 1. to give shelter, protection, or refuge to someone, especially a criminal. 2. to keep a thought, feeling, or grudge secretly in one's mind.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving illicit or protective refuge to fugitives, criminals, or forbidden entities, often involving secrecy and active concealment from authorities.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中向逃犯或危险人物提供庇护、藏匿以逃避追捕的非法或遮掩性保护。

groups.name: Harden & Desensitize · 结茧变硬与麻木 (Callous, Harden, Inure)
groups.tip: 质地变硬或生茧变钝

items.def_zh: 变硬；使（态度、心肠）坚硬冷酷
items.def_en: To become firmer or less flexible, or to make someone less sympathetic, sensitive, or emotional
to make or become hard and thick, like a callus, or to become hardened and unfeeling
To make someone less likely to feel shock or distress when exposed to upsetting things

items.def_zh: 使习惯于（痛苦或困难）；使适应
items.def_en: (+ to) To accustom someone to something unpleasant so that they no longer respond sensitively

items.def_zh: 使下定决心；使硬起心肠
items.def_en: (steel oneself) To mentally prepare oneself to be strong, unfeeling, or resolute before a difficult task

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on skin thickening through friction or, metaphorically, human feelings and sensibilities becoming progressively unfeeling, cold, and immune to suffering.
groups.summary_zh: 指表皮因磨损变硬增厚，或心理情感逐步麻木、对苦难无动于衷。

groups.name: Harden & Ossify · 骨化与僵化 (Ossify, Fossilize, Petrify)
groups.tip: 物理骨化变硬或思想僵化

items.def_en: To make or become rigid, strictly unbending, or unresponsive to external conditions
To harden by the deposition of calcium salts, or to become inflexible and unchanging
To change organic matter into a stony substance, or to render someone or something immobile and rigid
To become or cause to become a fossil, or to become fixed, rigid, and incapable of change

items.def_zh: 骨化，硬化；（思想、体制等）僵化
items.def_en:
1. to turn bone-hard, or convert tissue into bone
2. (disapproving) to become hardened, rigid, and conventional, opposing change

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe organic tissues turning into stone or bone, used predominantly in a pejorative sense for habits, attitudes, or systems growing inflexibly rigid and resistant to change.
groups.summary_zh: 描述机体变硬，或思想、体制变得顽固僵化、丧失适应力的过程。

groups.name: Harp & Dwell On · 絮叨与纠缠 (Harp, Dwell, Ramble)
groups.tip: 喋喋不休反复弹老调

items.def_en: To talk incessantly and tiresome about a specific topic
To talk or write at great length in an aimless, unstructured, and confused way
To think, speak, or write obsessively or at excessive length about something unpleasant

items.raw_cluster: 唠叨与反复诉说 Harp & Ramble
items.def_zh: 喋喋不休，反复唠叨（与on/upon连用）；弹竖琴
items.def_en: 1. (harp on/upon) To talk or complain repeatedly and tediously about the same subject. 2. To play the harp.
To argue, elaborate, or dwell upon a point excessively and tediously

groups.summary_en: This frame describes perseverative and tedious communication, specifically the habit of endlessly returning to, rehashing, or wandering around the same grievance or topic.
groups.summary_zh: 强调反反复复谈论同一琐事或旧怨，冗长啰嗦且令人生厌。

groups.name: Harvest & Gather · 采摘与收割 (Harvest, Glean, Garner)
groups.tip: 付出辛劳换取最终成果

items.def_en: To gather leftover grain after reaping, or collect information painstakingly in small amounts
To bring in and store harvested crops or collected items
To collect crops, fruit, or agricultural produce from fields or gardens
To collect or accumulate something valuable through sustained effort

items.def_zh: 收获，获得（成果或报应）；收割（庄稼）
items.def_en: 1. To receive good or bad results as the consequence of past actions. 2. To cut and collect a grain crop.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover the agricultural gathering of crops as well as the figurative accumulation or earning of rewards, consequences, and data over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指收割成熟作物，或引申为聚敛、收获回报与后果。

groups.name: Harvest & Pick · 采摘与采择 (Pick, Pluck, Forage)
groups.tip: 从植株上摘取采收果实农产

items.def_en: To pull or remove a fruit, flower, or berry from where it is growing using the hands
To steal fruit, especially apples or berries, from an orchard or garden (informal British)
1. To gather or look for wild berries. 2. (botany) To produce or yield berries.
To quickly pull or detach a single flower, leaf, or fruit with fingers
To search widely across the countryside or woods for wild edible plants and berries

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the hands-on manual extraction of wild foods, ripe fruits, flowers, or berries from plants, bushes, or the natural wild environment.
groups.summary_zh: 指亲手在植物或野外采摘果实、花卉或觅食野果。

groups.name: Hatch & Breed Young · 孵化与育幼 (Hatch, Brood, Foster)
groups.tip: 禽卵人工恒温孵化培育

items.def_en: Keep animals for the purpose of producing young in a controlled manner
Emerge from an egg, or cause young birds, insects, or fish to emerge
Release or deposit eggs in water, as fish, amphibians, or mollusks do
Sit on eggs to hatch them by body warmth, or hover protectively over young

items.def_zh: 孵化，恒温培育；（疾病）潜伏；（思想、计划等）酝酿
items.def_en: 1. (of birds or machines) To keep eggs warm so that they will hatch. 2. (of bacteria, viruses, or diseases) To develop slowly within a body before signs appear. 3. To develop an idea, plan, or business over time.

groups.summary_en: This biological frame captures the actions of birds, reptiles, and specialized devices keeping eggs warm, fostering development, and bringing offspring out of shells. Nuances distinguish physical sitting on clutches from embryonic emergence.
groups.summary_zh: 指鸟兽或人工设备抱窝供温促成胚胎发育并破壳，涵盖孵化、菢卵与育雏。

groups.name: Heave & Manhandle · 负重搬抬 (Manhandle, Hoist, Heave, Shoulder)
groups.tip: 负重转移或费力搬运

items.def_en: To lift a weighty burden onto one's shoulder and carry it forward
To raise or haul something heavy up to a higher position using ropes or sheer muscle

items.def_zh: 费力搬运，负重转移；使弓起
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To carry or lift something heavy with great effort. 2. To bend into a hump or curve.
To lift, drag, or throw something massive with a tremendous concerted effort
To move something cumbersome entirely using human physical strength, often roughly

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on exerting raw bodily force to lift, shoulder, or muscle unwieldy loads across distances, frequently implying back-straining labor or brute physical coercion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调凭借强悍蛮力拉起、硬抗或搬移极度沉重之物。

groups.name: Heavy Pulling & Dragging · 拖拽与死拉 (Drag, Haul, Lug)
groups.tip: 从轻拉到费力贴地拖曳

items.def_en: To pull something along loosely so that it drags across the ground behind

items.def_zh: 拖，拽，拉；缓慢费力地移动
items.def_en: 1. To pull someone or something along forcefully or with difficulty, usually along the ground. 2. To move slowly or with great effort; to pass tedious time.
To pull a vehicle, trailer, or boat along behind by means of a rope, cable, or chain
To pull or transport something exceptionally heavy with sustained, arduous physical effort
To carry or drag something heavy and awkward with strenuous difficulty

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes laborious, forceful pulling of heavy, resistive loads across a surface or ground against friction or inertia.
groups.summary_zh: 表示克服地面阻力、摩擦或重负，费力且吃力地拖拽或搬运沉重之物。

groups.name: Hedge & Insure Risk · 防范与对冲 (Hedge, Insure, Offset)
groups.tip: 采取平衡对策防范潜在风险

items.def_en: To protect someone or an investment from taxation, liability, or damaging market turbulence
To balance, counteract, or compensate for one liability, cost, or effect with an opposing one

items.def_zh: 防范，对冲（财务或潜在风险）；回避直接答复，含糊其词；用树篱围住
items.def_en: 1. (+ against) To protect oneself against financial loss or other risk by taking balanced counteractions. 2. To avoid giving a direct answer or committing oneself. 3. To enclose or surround an area with a hedge.
To contract for financial compensation against possible loss, or take active measures against a contingency
To protect someone or a balance sheet from the full adverse impact of an economic or unexpected shock

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mitigating exposure to financial, operational, or strategic risk by establishing counterbalancing positions, agreements, or reserves that absorb prospective shocks.
groups.summary_zh: 通过对冲操作、投保或建立备选方案来分散与化解潜在风险。

groups.name: Helm & Steer · 掌舵与统领全局 (Helm, Steer, Pilot)
groups.tip: 执掌大局掌舵与发号施令

items.def_en: To control the direction of a vehicle or guide the course and policy of an organization
To act as the captain or prominent leader of a team, vessel, or enterprise
To guide a project or ship carefully through a difficult process or initial trial period

items.def_zh: 掌舵，统领，掌管（组织、项目或影片等）
items.def_en: 1. To direct, lead, or manage an organization, project, ship, or film.
To serve as the active leader or driving force behind a campaign, attack, or initiative

groups.summary_en: Drawn originally from maritime navigation, these verbs characterize guiding, directing, and executing leadership over projects, organizations, or institutions through active strategic control and personal oversight.
groups.summary_zh: 源自航海隐喻，指对组织、项目或方向进行战略掌舵、主导与领航。

groups.name: Hesitate on Moral Grounds · 道德踌躇与疑虑 (Scruple, Balk, Demur)
groups.tip: 心存顾虑迟迟难决断

items.def_en: Lose momentum, confidence, or determination when faced with an ethical or arduous choice
Raise doubts or objections, or politely hesitate to agree with a proposed course
(+ at) Hesitate or be scrupled by an ethical issue or overwhelming doubt
(+ at) Hesitate or show reluctance to proceed with an action that feels wrong or difficult
(formal, chiefly negative) To hesitate or feel reluctant to do something because of moral doubts.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe pausing, hesitating, or refusing to act due to moral qualms, conscientious objections, or strong reluctance.
groups.summary_zh: 因道德良知或强烈顾忌而犹豫、踌躇或拒绝执行。

groups.name: Hibernate & Slumber · 冬眠与深睡 (Estivate, Torporize, Drowse)
groups.tip: 由日常睡眠延伸至动物冬眠休眠

items.def_en: Be half asleep, sluggish, or resting in a sleepy, non-alert condition
Sleep peacefully, deeply, and continuously, often quietly
1. (of animals) To spend the winter in a dormant state resembling deep sleep. 2. (informal) To stay indoors and remain inactive during the winter.
Spend or survive the winter in a designated place or state of reduced vitality
Spend a hot, dry summer period in a prolonged state of torpor or dormancy

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame delineate prolonged metabolic dormancy, deep biological winter sleep, or extreme states of inactivity and torpor observed in animals or dormant people.
groups.summary_zh: 进入休眠、极低代谢休整或长久深沉的昏睡状态。

groups.name: High-Pitched Scream · 尖叫与尖厉呼喊 (Screech, Shriek, Squawk)
groups.tip: 由大声呼叫升级为刺耳尖叫

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳尖鸣；大声抗议
items.def_en: To make a loud, harsh, discordant noise, or to complain loudly in a shrill tone
To utter a loud, sharp, high-pitched cry as an instinctive reaction to fear or pain

items.def_zh: 发出尖叫声，尖声喊出；发出刺耳声
items.def_en: To make a loud, high-pitched, unpleasant cry or sound, or to say something in such a voice.

items.def_zh: 尖叫；发出尖锐刺耳的声音
items.def_en: To make a short, very loud, high-pitched cry or sound when frightened or excited

items.def_zh: 发春猫般的刺耳尖嚎；怪叫
items.def_en: To make a shrill, howling, or wailing noise like that of cats fighting

groups.summary_en: Verbs conveying piercing, high-frequency vocal bursts or noises triggered by terror, shock, acute pain, or rage.
groups.summary_zh: 指因极度恐惧、疼痛或惊骇发出的刺耳高分贝尖叫与怪鸣。

groups.name: Hike & Trek · 徒步与远足 (Hike, Trek, Tramp)
groups.tip: 背包装备户外长途跋涉
