items.def_en: To take a long walk in the countryside or wilderness for pleasure or exercise
To make a long, arduous journey, typically on foot through wild or difficult terrain

items.def_zh: 背包装备徒步旅行，背负背囊远足
items.def_en: to travel or hike around carrying clothes and equipment in a backpack

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地长途步行；远足
items.def_en: To walk heavily or firmly over a long distance, often across rough country
To make one's way through thick woods, brush, or pathless wilderness

groups.summary_en: Covers long-distance travel on foot across natural or rural landscapes, ranging from leisure trail walking to arduous wilderness expeditions. While hiking implies marked paths, trekking and tramping convey rigorous, multi-day overland journeys.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及野外徒步、远足与背包旅行，侧重负重长途行走与穿越跋涉。

groups.name: Hinder & Handicap · 阻碍与妨碍 (Handicap, Impede, Encumber)
groups.tip: 施加不利条件削弱行动能力

items.def_en: To burden someone or something with a heavy weight or difficulty, hindering easy movement or success

items.def_zh: 阻碍，使处于不利地位；对…施加让步条件
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To put someone or something at a disadvantage that makes it harder to succeed. 2. To assign a handicap to a competitor in a contest.
To prevent the free movement, action, or progress of someone or something
To slow the progress of someone or something, or to make movement difficult by creating obstacles
To weigh down or burden someone or something so that freedom of movement or action is restricted

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on imposing disadvantages or burdens that make progress, movement, or success substantially harder without necessarily halting it outright.
groups.summary_zh: 施加不利条件或负担，使行动困难或难以成功。

groups.name: Hinge & Turn On · 取决于与以……为枢纽 (Hinge, Turn On, Pivot)
groups.tip: 关键所在依赖于某节点

items.def_en: to have something as the central, deciding factor or condition
to depend completely on a central point, argument, or development
to depend on or be based firmly upon a particular fact, assumption, or person

items.def_zh: 系于，取决于（成功或名誉等）
items.def_en: to depend heavily on the outcome of something, often involving high stakes

items.def_zh: 取决于，全视……而定（hinge on/upon）；装铰链于
items.def_en: 1. (hinge on/upon) to depend completely on something. 2. to attach a door, lid, or part using hinges.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers critical dependency where the ultimate outcome, success, or truth of an issue hangs entirely on a single pivotal condition, factor, or event.
groups.summary_zh: 指事态的发展、结果或结论完全以某关键支点为转移。

groups.name: Hint & Allude · 暗示与侧面提及 (Intimate, Touch On, Insinuate)
groups.tip: 言语含蓄迂回，暗中影射指涉

items.def_en: To mention or discuss a subject briefly or tangentially in passing

items.def_zh: (+ at) 暗示，透露细微迹象
items.def_en: (+ at) To say something that suggests what you think or want without saying it directly
To communicate or make something known subtly, indirectly, or quietly
(+ to) (formal) To mention or refer to someone or something indirectly.
To suggest something unpleasant or derogatory in an indirect, insidious way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate referring to someone, something, or a sensitive topic in an indirect, glancing, or veiled manner rather than stating it plainly.
groups.summary_zh: 指不指名道姓、避开直言，采用旁敲侧击、含蓄带过或隐晦的方式表达。

groups.name: Hire & Retain · 雇佣与出资招募 (Take on, Recruit, Retain)
groups.tip: 出资招纳人才填补职位空缺

items.def_zh: 雇佣，聘用；（短期）租用，租借
items.def_en: to employ someone to do a particular job for wages; to pay to use something for a short period of time

items.def_zh: 聘请（专业人员）；保留服务
items.def_en: to secure the future services of an expert, such as a lawyer, by paying a fee
to find and enroll suitable candidates to join a company, group, or armed force
to engage or employ new staff members
to commit someone to work or perform by signing a binding legal contract

groups.summary_en: This lexical frame centers on entering an employment agreement to pay someone for labor or retain services, especially through transactional hiring or contracts.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过支付报酬与合同约定招募劳动力或聘请外部专业服务。

groups.name: Hiss & Jeer · 嘘声与喝倒彩 (Hiss, Catcall, Raspberry)
groups.tip: 群体发出嘘声公开喝倒彩

items.def_en: To drive someone or an animal away by uttering a sharp sibilant sound
To make a derisive sputtering noise by sticking out the tongue between closed lips

items.def_zh: 发出嘘声喝倒彩；发出嘶嘶声；低声斥责
items.def_en: 1. To make a sharp sound of disapproval or boo at someone. 2. To make a long sharp sound like steam escaping or a snake. 3. To say something in a fierce, angry whisper.
To make loud, rude, and mocking remarks or sounds at someone

items.def_zh: 吹口哨起哄，发尖叫喝倒彩
items.def_en: To make a shrill whistle, shout, or derisive sound to show disapproval or mockery

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate hostile, sibilant, or mocking non-verbal sounds aimed at performers, politicians, or rivals to display bitter disapproval and contempt. They frequently feature sharp aerodynamic vocal gestures.
groups.summary_zh: 发出尖锐刺耳的嘘声或怪声以表达轻蔑、反感与倒彩。

groups.name: Hitchhike & Carry · 驮载与搭附 (Piggyback, Shuttle, Tote)
groups.tip: 跨骑或借助外力搭乘附载

items.def_en: To haul, carry, or transport a heavy or awkward burden on one's body or vehicle
To convey people, vehicles, or goods across water or between points as a regular service
To transport people or cargo frequently back and forth between two fixed destinations
To travel by soliciting free rides from passing motor vehicles alongside a road

items.def_zh: 背，骑在肩上；借助，搭乘（他人成果）
items.def_en: To ride or carry someone on one's back or shoulders; to use something that already exists to achieve a result.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses carrying a passenger on one's back, piggybacking onto another transport system, or hitching a ride along with an existing carrier. It captures physical carrying as well as metaphorical borrowing of infrastructure.
groups.summary_zh: 指背负人员、随带附载乘行，或借用已有载运系统搭便车附带前行。

groups.name: Hobnob & Mingle with Elites · 结交与逢迎权贵 (Hobnob, Rub Shoulders, Fraternize)
groups.tip: 与显贵攀附亲近把酒言欢

items.def_en: (informal; + with) To hang out as close friends or companions, often strategically

items.def_zh: 与…并肩结交，与名流过从
items.def_en: (+ with) To meet and spend social time with famous, powerful, or important people
(+ with) To spend time socially with people, especially when this is considered inappropriate or forbidden
(+ with) To associate habitually with someone, typically someone disreputable

items.def_zh: （与显贵或名人）亲切交往，过从甚密
items.def_en: (+ with) (informal) To spend time being friendly with someone, especially those who are rich, famous, or influential.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mixing socially or cultivating familiarity with prestigious, powerful, or influential circles, often with undertones of social climbing or impropriety.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重与地位高、有权势者周旋结交或过从甚密，常含奉迎之意。

groups.name: Hold Dear & Nurture · 珍爱与珍视 (Prize, Treasure, Foster)
groups.tip: 视若珍宝悉心呵护关爱

items.def_en: To value something extremely highly because it is rare, useful, or precious
To nurture, encourage, or hold dear a feeling, belief, or hope over time
To value, cherish, or care about someone or something with deep devotion
To keep an affectionate thought, secret hope, or deep feeling in mind

items.def_zh: 珍爱，珍视；怀抱（希望、想法等）
items.def_en: 1. To love, hold dear, and protect someone or something affectionately. 2. To keep a hope, belief, or memory fondly in one's mind.

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes regarding someone or an inward belief/memory with profound warmth, protective affection, and continual emotional devotion.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对人或珍视的信念、回忆怀抱深厚爱意与保护性珍视。

groups.name: Hone & Cultivate · 磨砺与精进 (Hone in, Perfect, Temper)
groups.tip: 反复切磋琢磨，技能更显精湛

items.def_en: To deliberately develop, sharpen, and improve a talent, habit, or area of competence over time

items.def_zh: 磨快，用磨刀石磨；磨砺，提升（技能）
items.def_en: 1. To sharpen a blade on a whetstone. 2. To refine or improve a skill, technique, or argument over time.
To practice and refine a skill or technique until it is completely free of faults
To develop a strong skill, alliance, or character through intense, demanding effort and discipline
To strengthen and toughen metal or personal character through strenuous hardship and testing

groups.summary_en: Pertains to developing expertise, discipline, or an acute instinct through protracted practice, disciplined rigor, and continuous refinement, evolving from working on a fine whetstone to honing one's professional craft.
groups.summary_zh: 强调经由长期修习、刻意训练与砥砺，使技艺或心智臻于精熟。

groups.name: Honor & Fete · 盛赞与款待 (Honor, Toast, Lionize)
groups.tip: 大张旗鼓地设宴庆祝赞颂

items.def_en: To show great respect and admiration for someone in a public ceremony or through an award
To drink to the health, success, or honor of someone, or to celebrate someone publicly

items.def_zh: 把……奉为名人，捧为重要人物
items.def_en: To treat someone as a celebrity or person of great public importance, showering them with social attention
To praise someone or their achievements highly and publicly

items.def_zh: 设宴庆祝，盛情款待；赞扬，颂扬
items.def_en: 1. To honor, praise, and entertain someone publicly with parties and celebrations.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on publicly celebrating and showing homage to individuals through elaborate ceremonies, official banquets, or public accolades. It highlights visible, socialized displays of esteem.
groups.summary_zh: 通过宴请、举杯或隆重仪式公开表达崇敬与盛大款待。

groups.name: Host & Moderate · 主持与引导 (Emcee, Host, Moderate)
groups.tip: 担任司仪主持活动与场面

items.def_en: To act as the host or presenter for an event, television show, or social gathering
To preside over a debate, panel, or discussion to ensure orderly participation and fairness
To act as the master of ceremonies or presenter for a variety show or performance
(+ over) To be in the position of authority or chairman at a formal meeting, court, or ceremony
To act as master of ceremonies for a show, event, or celebration.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on leading, presiding over, or coordinating formal events, public shows, discussions, or gatherings to ensure smooth execution.
groups.summary_zh: 指在活动、会议或仪式中担任主持人并把控全场。

groups.name: House-train & Condition · 训导与如厕习惯养成 (Housebreak, Train, Habituate)
groups.tip: 训练宠物养成良好居家习惯

items.def_en: To train a pet to accept and view an indoor crate as a safe resting shelter

items.def_zh: 训练养成习惯，建立条件反射
items.def_en: To train an animal or person to behave in a certain way through repeated stimulus
To teach a dog or other young animal not to relieve itself inside the house
To train a kitten or small animal to urinate and defecate exclusively in a litter box

items.def_zh: 训导（宠物）不在室内排便，养成居家卫生习惯
items.def_en: (North American) To train a pet dog or cat to urinate and defecate outdoors or in a litter box rather than inside the house.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on behavioral conditioning of domestic pets to adapt to household sanitary rules and human indoor living.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过行为纠正与习惯训导，使家宠遵守室内规矩和排泄准则。

groups.name: Hug & Cuddle · 拥抱与相拥依偎 (Hug, Cuddle, Snuggle)
groups.tip: 张开双臂搂抱或紧密依偎

items.def_zh: 紧抱，拥抱；搂抱；紧贴，挨着
items.def_en: To squeeze someone tightly in your arms, usually with fondness; to stay very close to something
To grip or hug someone firmly and closely with deep emotional intensity
To hold someone close in an affectionate, protective, and comfortable way for a prolonged period
(+ against/into) To press oneself gently and affectionately into a warm, snug position against another person
(+ up to/against) To settle or press into a warm, comfortable position close to someone else

groups.summary_en: This frame expresses physical warmth, affection, and comfort achieved by folding arms around someone or pressing closely against them, moving from brief greetings to sustained, cozy embraces.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于亲情、温存或安慰而展开的双臂环抱或亲昵贴靠，展现人际温度。

groups.name: Hurdle & Vault · 跃过与飞跨 (Hurdle, Vault, Clear, Leap)
groups.tip: 腾空而起越过前方障碍

items.def_en: To push oneself into the air and pass completely over an object on the ground
To jump high and across an intervening gap or barrier with sudden agility
To jump over an obstacle or bar without touching, clipping, or knocking it down

items.def_zh: 跨越（栏架、障碍）；克服（难关）
items.def_en: 1. To jump over a barrier or obstacle while running. 2. To successfully deal with or overcome a problem or difficulty.
(+ over) To leap over an obstacle using one's hands, arms, or a pole to push off

groups.summary_en: Focuses on leaping cleanly over an obstacle, fence, or barricade while maintaining running momentum or using hands/poles as props. 'Clear' emphasizes not touching the bar; 'vault' involves springing using an arm or lever.
groups.summary_zh: 指奔跑中跨跃障碍物，或借力腾跃翻过栅栏矮墙等。

groups.name: Identify & Flag · 附标与标识 (Tag, Flag, Tab)
groups.tip: 打上标签或符号以便辨识

items.def_en: To mark or signal something clearly so that it will receive notice, inspection, or action

items.def_zh: 给……加上标签，标明；尾随，紧跟
items.def_en: 1. To attach a label or tag to something to identify or describe it. 2. (+ along / after) To follow closely behind someone.
To furnish with a small protruding label or index marker for convenient identification
To set aside, reserve, or mark something distinctively for a dedicated future purpose

items.def_zh: 给（文件等）编签；摘要标记
items.def_en: To attach a brief informative summary label or tracking number to a document or package

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on attaching physical markers, digital markers, or visual indicators to objects, data, or files for tracking, indexing, identification, or highlighting for follow-up.
groups.summary_zh: 为物品、文件或数据附加标记、便签或元数据，以便检索追踪与提示。

groups.name: Idle & Stagnate · 闲置与停滞 (Stagnate, Stall, Sit)
groups.tip: 不运转或发展停滞不前

items.def_en: To remain unused, untouched, and neglected on a shelf or in storage for a long period
To come to an unintentional stop or cause a motor, process, or initiative to halt unexpectedly

items.def_zh: 闲置，不运转；（发动机）空转；虚度（光阴）
items.def_en: 1. (of an engine or machine) To run slowly while not engaged in gear or doing active work. 2. To spend time doing nothing productive. 3. ('idle away') To waste time in inactivity.
To stop developing, flowing, growing, or progressing, often deteriorating as a result

items.def_zh: 虚度光阴；无所事事过活
items.def_en: To live a totally passive, dull, and inactive life with little mental stimulation

groups.summary_en: This frame covers persons, machines, or processes remaining inactive, unproductive, or stalled over time. Nuances differentiate mechanical ticking without load from economic and personal decay.
groups.summary_zh: 缺乏运动、生产力或进展，处于停止运转或荒废状态。

groups.name: Illicit Forcing & Lock-Prying · 撬锁与破门 (Jimmy, Pick, Shimm)
groups.tip: 用撬棍等小工具强行撬锁开门

items.def_en: Bypass a spring latch or adjust alignment by inserting a very thin wedge or strip
Open a lock without its proper key by manipulating the internal tumblers with a thin tool
To force open a lock, window, or door using a crowbar or small tool.
Enter a locked building, vehicle, or room illegally by picking or smashing locks

items.def_zh: 用短撬棒撬开（英式写法）
items.def_en: Force open a window or door with a burglar's small pry bar

groups.summary_en: Applies to breaking into locks, windows, or doors using improvised flat tools, lockpicks, or wire implements, especially associated with illicit entry or lock manipulation.
groups.summary_zh: 特指使用细扁工具、铁丝等撬开门窗锁具或强行突破防盗装置。

groups.name: Illuminate & Brighten · 照亮与点亮 (Light, Illuminate, Brighten)
groups.tip: 引入光源照亮物体

items.def_en: 1. To provide light for something or make it brighter. 2. To start to burn or make something start burning.
To illuminate an entire place brightly, or become full of radiant light
To light something up or provide light for an area so it becomes visible
To make something lighter or more luminous, or to become visibly lighter
To illuminate something brightly with radiant beams or light rays

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying light to a dark space or object, varying from casting gentle ambient rays to flooding an entire area with brilliant luminescence.
groups.summary_zh: 向黑暗空间或物体提供光源，使其清晰、明亮或光芒四射。

groups.name: Imagine & Fancy · 想象与设想 (Fancy, Envision, Picture)
groups.tip: 在脑海中构筑虚构意象

items.def_en: To form a clear visual image of an event, person, or setting in the mind
To form a mental picture, concept, or idea of something not perceived through the senses

items.def_zh: 想象，设想；想要，倾慕；自以为
items.def_en: 1. To imagine or picture something in your mind. 2. (informal) To want to have or do something, or feel sexually attracted to someone.
To bring a vivid picture, memory, or idea vividly into conscious thought
To picture or visualize a future event or condition as a distinct mental possibility

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate mentally conceptualizing, visualizing, or daydreaming hypothetical scenes, possibilities, or personal preferences.
groups.summary_zh: 指在大脑中勾画画面、假想可能情景或产生主观倾向与设想。

groups.name: Immigrate & Resettle · 迁入与定居 (Immigrate, Settle, Resettle)
groups.tip: 长途跋涉迁往新地定居

items.def_en: (+ in/down) To establish a permanent home and start living stably in a new place or country
To establish oneself deeply and permanently as part of a new community or foreign land
To send a group of settlers to a territory and establish political and social control over it
To come to live permanently in a foreign country.

items.def_zh: 重新定居；安置（移民、难民）
items.def_en: (+ in) To move to a new country or community and establish a life there, often after displacement

groups.summary_en: Describes entering and establishing permanent residence in a new recipient nation or territory, emphasizing arrival, legal entry, and putting down roots in the destination.
groups.summary_zh: 强调迁入外国或异地并在目的地安家、扎根与定居。

groups.name: Immortalize & Commemorate · 铭记与流芳不朽 (Commemorate, Memorialize, Eternalize)
groups.tip: 隆重纪念以使名垂青史

items.def_zh: 使永世长存；使永垂不朽
items.def_en: To bestow unending life or everlasting public renown upon someone or something
To honor the memory of a historic person or event through a ceremony, statue, or building
To preserve a respected tradition, name, or historic achievement with deep veneration
To make someone or something famous forever through a book, painting, film, or monument.

items.def_zh: 使载入纪念碑；立碑铭记
items.def_en: To create a permanent tribute, plaque, or written account to remember a deceased figure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate acts of preserving persons, heroic deeds, or seminal events in perpetual collective memory via art, monuments, civic holidays, or high literature, conferring enduring glory or symbolic life across generations.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过纪念碑、文艺作品或典礼使人物或功绩万古流芳。

groups.name: Impeach & Indict · 弹劾与正式指控 (Impeach, Indict, Arraign)
groups.tip: 提出司法指控或议会发起弹劾

items.def_en: To officially charge someone with a crime in court and attempt to prove their guilt

items.def_zh: 弹劾；控告，检举；怀疑（名誉、动机等）
items.def_en: 1. (politics/law) To formally charge a senior public official with serious misconduct in office. 2. (formal) To question or challenge the integrity, validity, or motive of someone or something
To provide evidence indicating or proving that someone was involved in a crime
To bring a prisoner before a court of law to hear the formal charges and enter a plea

items.def_zh: 起诉；以大陪审团正式控告
items.def_en: To officially and legally charge someone with a serious crime, usually through an indictment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this high-intensity institutional frame denote formally charging officials or defendants with serious crimes or high misconduct in constitutional/judicial arenas.
groups.summary_zh: 特指在政治或司法体制内针对公职与重大罪行提起正式指控或弹劾。

groups.name: Imperil & Menace · 陷于危厄与威胁 (Endanger, Jeopardize, Menace)
groups.tip: 使人或处境陷入极大危险中

items.def_en: To present a clear and looming hazard to survival, peace, or continuity
To bring severe danger upon an entity, species, or valuable interest
To act as an ominous or impending source of destruction toward someone or something
To put a crucial outcome, safety, or enterprise into grave hazard of failure
(formal) To put someone or something in serious danger of being harmed, damaged, or destroyed.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on formal and consequential threats that actively bring critical entities into imminent jeopardy or existential harm. Frequent collocates include species, ecosystem, future, democracy, and lives.
groups.summary_zh: 正式语体，指对生态、体制、前途或生命造成紧迫危险。

groups.name: Impersonate & Masquerade · 冒充与扮演 (Pose, Masquerade, Feign)
groups.tip: 扮演冒充或刻意模仿

items.def_en: Pretend to be a specific person or professional in order to mislead others
Copy the way someone speaks, moves, or behaves, often to entertain or ridicule

items.def_zh: 假冒，冒充；扮演，模仿（娱乐表演）
items.def_en: To pretend to be another person by copying their voice, appearance, or behavior, either to deceive others or to entertain.
Falsely represent a person or thing to be something genuine or prestigious
(+ as) Pretend to be someone or something else, especially under a false appearance

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on assuming the identity, persona, or behavioral traits of someone else, typically with intent to deceive, fraud, or entertain. 'Impersonate' involves active mimicry of persona, whereas 'pose as' and 'masquerade' center on fraudulent disguise.
groups.summary_zh: 指故意假扮、冒充他人身份或声貌以行骗或表演。

groups.name: Implant & Transplant · 植入与移植 (Implant, Transplant, Graft)
groups.tip: 医学手术植入器官组织

items.def_en: (+ into) to place a device, tube, or instrument into a body cavity or organ
(+ in/into) to fix an object firmly and deeply inside surrounding bodily tissue or material

items.def_zh: 移植（器官、组织）；移栽（植物）；使迁移
items.def_en: 1. To surgically transfer an organ or tissue from one person or body part to another. 2. To dig up a plant and plant it in another place. 3. To move someone or something to a new environment.

items.def_zh: 植入，移入（组织或医疗装置）；灌输（思想、观念）
items.def_en: 1. To surgically insert an artificial device, tissue, or embryo into the body. 2. To fix an idea, attitude, or belief firmly in someone's mind.
(+ on/onto/into) to surgically attach living tissue to a damaged body part where it will grow

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote surgically embedding or transferring biological tissue, an organ, or an artificial device into a body to repair damage, restore function, or alter biology.
groups.summary_zh: 指将活体组织、器官或人工装置手术嵌入或移植至生物体内。

groups.name: Imply & Insinuate · 蕴涵、暗示与影射 (Insinuate, Entail, Connote)
groups.tip: 从含蓄提示到恶意夹枪带棒

items.def_en: 1. To suggest that something is true without saying it directly. 2. To involve something as a necessary consequence or condition.
To suggest an idea or feeling in addition to the primary or literal meaning
To be evidence of or suggest a particular quality, state, or circumstance
To involve something as a necessary part, result, or logical consequence

items.def_zh: 含沙射影；旁敲侧击（贬义）
items.def_en: To suggest something bad, dishonest, or embarrassing in a crafty and indirect manner

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses semantic entailment and intentional indirect communication, ranging from neutral logical consequence to loaded, sinister interpersonal insinuation.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖逻辑与语意上的必然后果与隐含意义，以及人际沟通中含沙射影的深意。

groups.name: Import & Introduce · 引进与输入 (Import, Bring in, Introduce)
groups.tip: 从外部引入技术或商品

items.def_en: Introduce a new law, product, or external specialist into an organization or country
Bring something such as a system, concept, or species into a place or context for the first time
Formally accept and put into practice an idea, method, or standard originating elsewhere

items.def_zh: 引进，输入；进口；导入（数据）
items.def_en: 1. to bring goods or services into a country from abroad to be sold 2. to introduce an idea, system, or custom from another place 3. (computing) to bring data or files into a program from another source
Transfer an institution, idea, or community from one environment to settle in another

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bringing goods, ideas, practices, or technologies into a new jurisdiction, culture, or organization from an external origin.
groups.summary_zh: 指自外部向某国度、领域或系统引进商品、理念或技术。

groups.name: Impose & Enforce · 强加与推行 (Impose, Inflict, Saddle, Clamp down)
groups.tip: 以权力强制推行与压制

items.def_zh: 使承担重任，使背负包袱
items.def_en: (+ with) Burden someone with an onerous responsibility, debt, or task
(+ on) Take firm authoritative measures to suppress or restrict an activity or group
Force someone abruptly to accept an unwelcome role, responsibility, or condition

items.def_zh: 把…强加于；强制推行，征收（税收、罚款等）；（尤指无礼地）打扰，麻烦
items.def_en: 1. to officially introduce a new law, rule, tax, or punishment 2. to force someone to accept something unwanted 3. (impose on/upon) to take unfair advantage of someone or bother them

items.def_zh: 使遭受，施加（痛苦或惩罚）
items.def_en: Cause someone to experience something unpleasant, painful, or damaging

groups.summary_en: Verbs here emphasize asserting heavy burdens, obligations, or rigid governance upon recipients who have little choice but to submit.
groups.summary_zh: 指居高临下施加重负、禁令或严苛义务，迫其承受。

groups.name: Impose & Foist · 强加与迫使 (Foist, Offload, Palm off, Force on)
groups.tip: 把不想要的人事物强加于人

items.def_zh: 以次充好转手，哄骗硬塞
items.def_en: (+ on/onto) Deceitfully persuade someone into accepting an inferior or unwanted item or task
Dispose of an unwanted object or unwanted duty by offloading it onto an unsuspecting party
Get rid of an unpleasant responsibility or unwanted person carelessly onto another
Get rid of an unwanted burden, asset, or task by transferring it to someone else

items.def_zh: 强加于，强迫接受；把…硬塞给
items.def_en: to force someone to accept or deal with something or someone unwanted or undesirable

groups.summary_en: This frame captures manipulative, evasive, or unfair acts of passing off unwanted responsibilities, deceitful ideas, or worthless items onto others.
groups.summary_zh: 指采用手段将不愿要的人、责任或劣货强行推卸给他人。

groups.name: Imprint & Frank · 盖印与邮戳 (Postmark, Frank, Cancel)
groups.tip: 在信件或物品上加盖邮戳标志

items.def_zh: 盖邮资免付印记；打印邮资戳
items.def_en: To stamp an official mark on a letter or parcel indicating postage is prepaid or waived
To mark a stamp, ticket, or voucher with a cancellation stamp to render it void for reuse
To stamp over an existing mark, text, or postage label with a fresh official imprint
To apply a postal transit or arrival mark onto the back of an envelope or postal piece
(usually passive) To stamp an official mark on a letter or package, showing the date and place of posting.

groups.summary_en: This frame pertains to applying official date stamps, postage cancellations, seals, or postal marks to mail, tickets, or documents to show processing, invalidate further use, or denote official authorization.
groups.summary_zh: 在信件或票证上加盖邮戳、注销章或免资印记以作凭证。

groups.name: Imprison & Lock Up · 监禁与羁押 (Incarcerate, Imprison, Detain)
groups.tip: 关入牢狱剥夺人身行动自由

items.def_en: To place someone in a jail or send them to serve a custodial sentence
To put someone in a secure place such as a prison or psychiatric hospital
To keep someone in official custody, typically for questioning or awaiting trial
To put someone in a prison or confine them closely as a legal punishment
(formal) To put or keep someone in prison or close confinement.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify depriving someone of freedom by placing them under legal custody or physical lock and key in a penitentiary, jail, or secure detention facility.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过司法或强制手段将某人关押在监狱或禁闭场所。

groups.name: Improvise & Riff · 即兴与发挥 (Ad-lib, Extemporize, Freewheel)
groups.tip: 围绕既有主题即兴借题发挥

items.def_en: To invent music, words, or actions spontaneously without prior preparation
To speak or perform without a script or notes, often humorously

items.def_zh: 随心所欲地发挥；不拘一格地表达
items.def_en: To act or speak freely and loosely without adhering strictly to rules or plans

items.def_zh: （就某一主题）即兴发挥，借题发挥；弹奏即兴重复乐句
items.def_en: (+ on) (informal) To speak, joke, or perform music in an improvisational or creative way, developing a theme or idea.
To compose, perform, or speak in public without any advance preparation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to speaking, performing, or thinking spontaneously without preparation or script, often elaborating dynamically on a theme.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱稿演讲、即兴演奏或无准备发挥，自由生发内容。

groups.name: Incapacitating & Disabling · 丧失功能与致残 (Cripple, Incapacitate, Paralyze)
groups.tip: 力量减弱直至丧失原有运作能力

items.def_en: Prevent something or someone from moving or being moved freely

items.def_zh: 使失去能力，使残废；使丧失功能，使无效
items.def_en: 1. To injure someone so that they are permanently unable to walk or use part of their body. 2. To stop a machine, device, or system from functioning properly.
Damage somebody so severely that they cannot walk properly, or ruin an operation completely

items.def_zh: 使无能力；使丧失活动力
items.def_en: Deprive someone of the physical or legal power, strength, or fitness to act
Cause a person or system to lose all motor function or cease normal operation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express causing severe impairment to an organism, machine, or organization such that it cannot function, move, or operate. Disable means turning off operational ability; cripple conveys catastrophic functional destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 使人致残或使系统、机械严重损坏并彻底丧失正常运转能力。

groups.name: Incinerate & Destroy by Fire · 纵火与焚毁 (Torch, Incinerate, Gut)
groups.tip: 引燃火苗至烈火焚烧

items.def_en: To destroy the interior and contents of a building by fire, leaving only exterior walls
1. (informal) To deliberately set fire to a building, vehicle, or property.
To burn a dead body to ashes, especially as part of a formal funeral ceremony
To destroy a building or structure completely by fire, or be so destroyed
To burn something completely until nothing remains except ash and bone

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on severe, destructive fire acts—either malicious arson or deliberate industrial cremation—that leave structures, vehicles, or refuse entirely gutted and reduced to ashes.
groups.summary_zh: 通过蓄意纵火或高温焚烧彻底摧毁房屋、车辆或残渣废料。

groups.name: Incite & Initiate Action · 唆使引发与策动 (Instigate, Incite, Provoke)
groups.tip: 在幕后唆使并引发事端

items.def_en: Trigger a sudden burst of activity, public debate, or violent conflict.
Cause a chain reaction of sudden events, protests, or emotional outbursts.
Cause an undesirable reaction or angry response deliberately through words or actions.
Encourage or prompt someone to commit violent, unlawful, or aggressive behavior.
1. (formal) To provoke or stir up trouble, rebellion, or bad behavior. 2. To initiate or cause an official action, investigation, or change to begin.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on being the prime mover behind an adverse action, formal inquiry, violent outburst, or dispute by urging participants or formally getting an initiative rolling.
groups.summary_zh: 指充当首要策划者或引爆点，发起调查、策划动乱或唆使做出激进行为。

groups.name: Incline & Tend · 倾向与偏好 (Incline, Tend, Lean, Gravitate)
groups.tip: 思维习惯性偏向某一方

items.def_en: (+ to/toward) To be likely to act, think, or develop in a specific direction

items.def_zh: （使）倾向于，（使）有意于；（使）倾斜，低头
items.def_en: 1. To tend to think or behave in a certain way, or to influence someone toward an opinion. 2. To slope, lean, or bend forward or downward.
(+ toward/to) To show a preference, sympathy, or disposition toward an opinion or policy

items.def_zh: 自然移向，受吸引而倾向
items.def_en: (+ to/toward) To be naturally drawn or attracted toward a particular person, place, or pursuit
(+ to/toward) To make someone liable or inclined to an attitude, action, or condition in advance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey having a natural predisposition, mental drift, or developing preference toward a belief, decision, or behavioral trait.
groups.summary_zh: 思想认知或行为上有偏向、倾向于特定选择。

groups.name: Include & Encompass · 包罗与囊括 (Comprise, Span, Incorporate)
groups.tip: 范围广泛地容纳覆盖

items.def_en: To include something as part of a larger whole or system
To include or contain particular parts, members, or aspects
To extend across a wide range of subjects, eras, or categories

items.def_zh: 包含，涵盖，囊括；包围，环绕
items.def_en: 1. To include a wide range of subjects, ideas, or elements. 2. (formal) To surround or encircle an area completely.
To include or absorb something into a broader, overarching category

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the conceptual act of containing, covering, or integrating diverse elements within a single comprehensive scope, category, or timeframe.
groups.summary_zh: 表示事物在范围、概念或时空上容纳、包含或统揽多重元素。

groups.name: Include & Subsume · 包含与归入 (Subsume, Encompass, Categorize)
groups.tip: 将细分子项纳进更宏观范畴内

items.def_en: (+ into/with) To merge various components together to form a harmonious, complete whole
To assign someone or something to a rigid, overly simplistic category or theoretical compartment
(+ into) To blend or combine one element into an existing unified system or structure
To take in, absorb, and fully integrate new concepts, populations, or information into a main body

items.def_zh: 将……归入，将……纳入（更广泛的范畴）
items.def_en: (formal) (often passive, 'be subsumed into/under') To include or incorporate something within a larger, more comprehensive category.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate theoretical, conceptual, or classification actions where individual items, sub-theories, or cases are absorbed under a broader umbrella or comprehensive category.
groups.summary_zh: 在逻辑、分类或理论层面将子项统摄、归并到更大架构中。

groups.name: Incriminate & Implicate · 牵连与使归罪 (Incriminate, Implicate, Inculpate)
groups.tip: 在法律或道义上指明其罪责

items.def_en: To falsely make someone seem guilty of a crime by fabricating evidence
To attach blame, responsibility, or guilt for something onto someone, often unfairly
To accuse, blame, or present evidence showing someone's involvement in a crime
To show or suggest that someone is involved in a crime or dishonest activity

items.def_zh: 使显示有罪，连累；控告，归罪于
items.def_en: To make someone seem guilty of a crime, wrongdoing, or illegal act, especially through evidence or testimony

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing evidence, testimony, or circumstantial proof that connects someone directly to a crime or misdeed. While incriminate emphasizes showing clear culpability, implicate often suggests entanglement in a wider conspiracy.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过证据或供词将某人与罪行关联，使其陷于有罪境地。

groups.name: Inculcate & Instill · 灌输与反复灌注 (Inculcate, Instill, Imbue)
groups.tip: 潜移默化反复告诫将思想灌输

items.def_zh: 逐渐灌输；潜移默化植入
items.def_en: To gradually but firmly cause someone to develop a feeling, attitude, or conviction over time

items.def_zh: 反复灌输；死板敲打进脑袋
items.def_en: To force someone to learn or memorize an idea or rule through relentless repetition
To firmly fix beliefs, habits, or attitudes so deeply that they are difficult to alter
(+ with) To fill someone or something thoroughly with a quality, value, or emotion
To fix an idea, belief, or moral principle firmly in someone's mind through frequent repetition or persistent teaching

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forceful, methodical, or deep-seated embedding of habits, tenets, or values into another person's psyche over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过反复灌输或长期渗透将思想理念深深植入心智。

groups.name: Indebted & Beholden · 感激与受惠负恩 (Obligate, Indebt, Owe)
groups.tip: 深感承蒙恩惠，背负感激之情

items.def_en: To express direct gratitude or appreciation to someone for something they have provided
To have a duty to repay someone or feel bound to give gratitude, loyalty, or money
To place someone under an enduring moral obligation of gratitude for a kindness or benefit received

items.def_zh: 使负有义务；使在道义上受拘束
items.def_en: To bind someone morally or legally to perform a specific action or show reciprocity

items.def_zh: 感激……的，对……负有恩情（常以 be beholden to 形式出现）
items.def_en: (used chiefly as passive/participial verb with 'to') To be obligated, indebted, or deeply grateful to someone for help received.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers recognizing a debt of profound gratitude, duty, or moral obligation to another party for critical assistance, patronage, or kindness.
groups.summary_zh: 指因承蒙恩泽、鼎力相助而心怀感激，或在道义与责任上产生负欠之情。

groups.name: Indefinite Postponement & Shelving · 搁置与暂缓执行 (Shelve, Mothball, Sideline)
groups.tip: 延长时间或暂缓处理

items.def_en: To delay or put an enterprise on hold until a more favorable occasion arises
To give an issue low priority so that it receives attention only after urgent matters are settled

items.def_zh: 靠边放；排除在主流之外
items.def_en: To remove an issue or person from active consideration or center-stage participation

items.def_zh: 搁置，延缓（计划等）；把……放在架子上；倾斜
items.def_en: 1. To postpone or abandon a plan or project indefinitely. 2. To place an object on a shelf. 3. To slope gradually.
To stop using or working on equipment or plans, preserving them for potential future revival

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on setting projects, legislation, or ideas aside indefinitely or putting them on ice rather than outright rejecting them.
groups.summary_zh: 将计划、动议或项目无限期搁置或封存暂缓推进。

groups.name: Indelible Marking & Etching · 刻印与铭留 (Etch, Inscribe, Imprint)
groups.tip: 在物体表面刻印或刺上标记图案

items.def_en: Write, engrave, or carve words or symbols formally onto a surface

items.def_zh: 在……上刺花纹（或文身）；连续有节奏地敲击
items.def_en: 1. To mark the skin with an indelible pattern or design by inserting pigment beneath the epidermis. 2. To tap or rap continuously and rhythmically.
Press a mark or design into something, or fix an impression deeply in mind
Cut a pattern or design into a hard surface with acid or a sharp tool
Mark skin or livestock permanently with a hot iron, or fix a reputation indelibly

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying permanent, indelible designs, text, or pigment onto skin, stone, or mental memory. Tattoo uses intradermal pigment, etch cuts with acid or tools, and imprint suggests lasting physical or cognitive impact.
groups.summary_zh: 在皮肤、物体表面或记忆深处刻下永久印记或图案。

groups.name: Indent & Pit · 凹陷与微小表面形变 (Indent, Pock, Dent, Corrugate)
groups.tip: 表面产生酒窝或凹痕

items.def_en: to form or cause to form small gentle waves or slight undulating depressions
to make a hollow impression in the surface of something by striking or pressing it

items.def_zh: （使）现出酒窝；（使）起凹痕，起微波
items.def_en: to produce small hollow depressions or dimples on a surface (such as cheeks or water), or to become marked by them

items.def_zh: 在表面留下凹痕；压出压印
items.def_en: to make a slight hollow, groove, or notch in a surface by pressing on it

items.def_zh: 使生痘痕；使布满麻点凹斑
items.def_en: to mark or disfigure a surface with small, pitted scars or hollow craters

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes that distort a surface by creating tiny depressions, dips, pits, or localized hollows across its contour.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体表面受到挤压或物理影响而产生细小凹陷、凹痕、波纹等形变。

groups.name: Indicate & Signal · 表明与显露 (Indicate, Signal, Bespeak)
groups.tip: 用手势或信号暗示提示事物

items.def_zh: 标明，指示；表明，显示；暗示
items.def_en: To point out or show something; to be a sign, signal, or suggestion of something
To be a sign of something or make clear a particular state or intention
To show or make clear that a particular event, change, or attitude is happening or likely

items.def_zh: 表明，表露出（品质或感觉）
items.def_en: To reveal the presence of a quality, feeling, or state through clear signs
To suggest or show signs of something through appearance or behavior

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing evidence, signs, or symptoms that something exists, is true, or is about to occur. Unlike direct verbal utterance, the transmission is achieved through cues, data, or observable markers.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过迹象、数据、征兆或行为侧面表明或暗示某种事实。

groups.name: Indict & Arraign · 控诉与起诉 (Indict, Charge, Arraign)
groups.tip: 从口头指责升级为正式起诉

items.def_en: (+ with) To state officially that someone is believed to be guilty of a crime
To officially charge someone with a crime and conduct legal proceedings against them in court

items.def_zh: 控告，起诉（尤指大陪审团正式指控）
items.def_en: (law) To officially accuse someone of a serious crime and charge them formally in court
To bring an accused person before a court to hear and answer a formal criminal charge
To formally charge a public official with high crimes or serious misconduct while in office

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame signify lodging an official criminal or civil charge against someone in a formal tribunal or court of law. The act moves the accusation from mere suspicion to binding judicial procedure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过司法或官方程序正式对嫌疑人提出刑事或严重罪名指控。

groups.name: Indoctrinate & Instill · 灌输与强加信仰 (Indoctrinate, Brainwash, Inculcate)
groups.tip: 反复灌输思想与系统性教育

items.def_zh: 逐渐灌输，潜移默化渗透
items.def_en: (+ in/into) Gradually and firmly establish an idea, virtue, or principle in someone's mind

items.def_zh: 谆谆教导，反复灌输（道德准则）
items.def_en: Instill an idea, attitude, or habit by persistent, repeated instruction

items.def_zh: 反复强行灌输，硬塞进脑子
items.def_en: Drive an idea or rule into someone's head through constant, forceful repetition

items.def_zh: 灌输，强行灌输（思想或信仰）；教导
items.def_en: To teach someone to accept a set of beliefs uncritically and without questioning.
Force someone to adopt radically different beliefs through coercive mental pressure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail the persistent, one-sided, or coercive implantation of rigid doctrines, dogma, and beliefs, preempting critical skepticism.
groups.summary_zh: 强调单向度、系统性地植入教条以消除怀疑精神。

groups.name: Indoctrinate & Subjugate · 灌输与思想控制 (Brainwash, Indoctrinate, Condition)
groups.tip: 从循循善诱到思想洗脑

items.def_zh: 反复灌输；强行念叨输入
items.def_en: To force information or lessons into someone's memory by endless, insistent repetition
To train or habituate someone systematically to behave or react in a predetermined way

items.def_zh: 重塑思维模式；彻底洗脑
items.def_en: To alter a person's core attitudes or ideological conditioning fundamentally and systematically
(+ with/in) To teach someone to accept a set of beliefs uncritically and reject opposing viewpoints
1. (+ into) To force someone to abandon their beliefs and accept new ones through intense psychological pressure and repetition.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe systematically forcing ideological dogmas upon someone through coercive, high-intensity mental conditioning or censorship.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过系统性压迫、灌输或心理控制强行重塑思维。

groups.name: Infect & Transmit · 感染与传染 (Infect, Contaminate, Transmit)
groups.tip: 病原体入侵或受到有害污染

items.def_en: To disperse widely or cause an infectious illness or attitude to reach more people
To transmit an infection, sickness, or habit to another individual

items.def_zh: 传染，使感染；使受不良影响
items.def_en: 1. To pass a disease or pathogen to a person, animal, or plant. 2. To affect someone with a particular feeling, idea, or harmful influence.
To pass an infectious disease, gene, or electrical/acoustic signal from one entity to another
To make a substance, environment, or person impure or poisonous by introducing harmful organisms or chemicals

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on passing biological pathogens, contaminants, or contagious behaviors/sentiments from a carrier to a host organism or medium.
groups.summary_zh: 指将病原体、污染物或极具扩散性的情绪传递并侵染宿主或媒介。

groups.name: Infiltrate & Permeate · 渗入与渗透 (Infiltrate, Penetrate, Pervade)
groups.tip: 神不知鬼不觉悄悄进入

items.def_en: To begin to enter or affect something gradually and imperceptibly, often with harmful results

items.def_zh: 巧妙钻营钻入；谄媚渗入
items.def_en: To gradually, insidiously, or deceitfully gain favor, trust, or an influential position inside a group
To spread through every part of an organization, culture, or substance so that the influence is everywhere
To enter or force a way into an organization, secure zone, or market against resistance
1. (+ into) To enter an organization, territory, or group secretly in order to spy on it or gain influence. 2. To pass slowly into or through something, as a liquid or gas does.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on covertly crossing physical or organizational barriers to gain access, or gradually spreading deeply throughout a structure or group.
groups.summary_zh: 指秘密潜入组织内部或物质逐步渗透扩散以实施控制。

groups.name: Inform & Clue In · 提示内情与通气 (Tip Off, Put Wise, Fill In)
groups.tip: 不点破直接给出微小线索

items.def_en: (+ on) To give someone essential information or details that they missed
(+ in / on) (informal) To give someone essential information or hints about something.
(+ of) To inform or make someone aware of an ongoing condition or development
(+ to) To give someone true information or advice that opens their eyes to reality
To warn or alert someone secretly about something likely to happen

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving someone inside information, confidential hints, or clarifying updates so they understand a hidden situation or know how to act.
groups.summary_zh: 指私下告知关键信息、提供内幕提示或补齐背景情况，使人明晰真相。

groups.name: Inform & Notify · 告知与通告 (Inform, Notify, Apprise)
groups.tip: 向对方正式告知通报最新情况

items.def_en: (+ of/about) To impart information or facts clearly to another person
(+ on) To give concise, necessary instructions or preparatory information to someone
(+ on) To provide someone with missing background facts, context, or recent details
(+ of/that) To officially give information or notice about something to someone
(+ of) (variant spelling of apprise) To inform or formally give notice to someone about something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe conveying formal, factual information, updates, or notifications to a party who needs to know. They differ in register from everyday informing to solemn legal or official notice.
groups.summary_zh: 指正式告知、通知某人关键事实或最新情况。

groups.name: Infuse & Fortify · 掺入与强化 (Fortify, Lace, Spike)
groups.tip: 将微量添加物掺入原液中

items.def_en: To secretly add alcohol, a drug, or a poison to someone's drink

items.def_zh: 掺入少量（酒精、毒物或药物）
items.def_en: (+ with) To add a small amount of a strong substance, alcohol, or drug to food or drink
To increase the nutritional or mineral value of food or drink by adding vitamins or minerals
To steep or introduce a quality, chemical, or flavor thoroughly into an existing medium
To add a small amount of fluoride to public drinking water or toothpaste to prevent tooth decay.

groups.summary_en: Denotes deliberately introducing a specific chemical, nutrient, flavoring, or foreign element into a bulk liquid or substrate to alter its properties.
groups.summary_zh: 向水体、食物或基质中有针对性地添加矿物、药剂或成分以改变效性。

groups.name: Infuse & Imbue · 注入与充盈 (Infuse, Imbue, Instill)
groups.tip: 浸泡萃取或思想浸润灌输

items.def_en: To bring renewed excitement, fresh vitality, or imagination into an otherwise flagging project
(+ into) To introduce a new quality, mood, or financial element suddenly to improve a situation
1. (+ with/into) To fill someone or something with a strong quality, emotion, or energy. 2. To soak tea leaves or herbs in hot liquid to extract flavor.
(+ in/into) To gradually put a feeling, virtue, or idea into someone's mind until it becomes part of them
(+ with) To fill someone or something completely with a specified quality, feeling, or conviction

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate imparting a pervasive quality, spirit, or feeling into an atmosphere, creative work, or person's demeanor.
groups.summary_zh: 指将某种特质、精神或情怀注入某物，使其完全充盈。

groups.name: Infuse & Saturate · 充注与注入渗透 (Infuse, Inject, Saturate)
groups.tip: 将气体或液体输送灌注到内部

items.def_en: To supply, treat, or enrich blood, water, or another substance with oxygen.
To introduce air or gas into a liquid or soil
(+ into) To introduce a fluid, gas, or new element directly into something
(+ into/with) To fill something or someone with a particular quality, fluid, or energy
(+ with) To cause something to absorb, hold, or be filled with the maximum amount of a substance

groups.summary_en: This frame involves permeating, enriching, or forcing a gas, fluid, or transformative quality into a body, liquid, or system to alter its composition or vigor.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过充入气体、液体或特质使受体渗透或富含该成分。

groups.name: Ingrain & Embed · 根植与植入 (Ingrain, Imbue, Inculcate)
groups.tip: 将观念与习惯深深扎根于心智中

items.def_en: To fix a practice, principle, or attitude firmly and securely inside a culture or psychological frame
To fix an idea, feeling, or doubt firmly in someone's mind so that it takes root and grows

items.def_zh: 谆谆教诲；灌输（美德、原则）
items.def_en: (+ in/into) To fix ideas, habits, or moral principles deeply in someone's mind through persistent instruction
(usually passive) To establish something so deeply that it cannot be easily removed or altered

items.def_zh: 使深深植根，使牢固确立
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive, 'be ingrained in') To fix a habit, belief, or attitude deeply in someone's mind so it is hard to change.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the deep, permanent embedding of values, traits, or habits into someone's consciousness through prolonged exposure, culture, or discipline.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过潜移默化或长期熏陶使观念、品性根深蒂固。

groups.name: Initiate & Blood · 启蒙与受炼 (Blood, Initiate, Indoctrinate)
groups.tip: 初入社群接受考验

items.def_zh: 使（新兵、猎犬等）初次经受实战或严酷考验
items.def_en: To give someone, such as a soldier or hunting dog, their first experience of combat or strenuous activity.
(+ into) To admit someone into a group, society, or discipline with formal rites or instruction
To train a novice or adjust someone gently to new, demanding duties
To subject someone to a severe introductory trial, especially in 'baptize by fire'

items.def_zh: 对新人整蛊折磨；霸凌初试
items.def_en: To subject a newcomer to humiliating, painful, or dangerous initiation tasks

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict inducting someone into a closed group, profession, or rigorous ordeal through a definitive, often demanding or traumatizing first experience.
groups.summary_zh: 让新人经受严苛初试或入会仪式，使其完成洗礼并融入群体。

groups.name: Injure & Ache · 身体致伤与刺痛 (Throb, Sting, Burn)
groups.tip: 局部剧烈刺痛与灼痛

items.def_en: To experience a sudden brief spasm of sharp physical discomfort or pang of distress

items.def_zh: 感到剧烈刺痛，灼痛；感到难过，感到屈辱
items.def_en: 1. To cause or feel a sharp, stinging, or burning pain. 2. (+ from/at) To feel upset, aggrieved, or wounded by a slight or defeat.
To cause or feel a sudden, sharp, pricking or burning localized pain
To produce a continuous, rhythmic, pulsing sensation of aching or pain
To produce a severe, heated, stinging sensation resembling fire or acid on flesh

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express localized sharp, piercing, or pulsating somatic pain, as well as the immediate emotional aftermath of wounded pride. While 'smart' denotes stinging sharp pain, its neighbors encompass throbbing, burning, or dull soreness.
groups.summary_zh: 指伤口或肌体产生剧烈刺痛、灼痛、搏动性抽痛的生理与心理感受。

groups.name: Inlay & Embed · 镶嵌与置入 (Inlay, Inset, Encrust)
groups.tip: 嵌入本体，精密契合固牢

items.def_en: To set or insert something into the surface of an object so that it lies flush
To decorate wood with mosaic-like inlays of contrasting woods or other materials
To fix an object firmly and deeply into a surrounding solid mass
1. (+ with) To decorate a surface by setting pieces of wood, metal, or stone flush into carved spaces.

items.def_zh: 以宝物镶饰；给……覆上一层硬壳
items.def_en: (+ with) To overlay or cover a surface richly with a decorative layer of gems or minerals

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to inserting contrasting decorative materials flush into cut-out recesses on a surface, or embedding stones, gems, and metals into a substrate. They convey precise craftsmanship and decorative integration.
groups.summary_zh: 指在表面开槽并将金属、玉石、木料等嵌入以起装饰作用。

groups.name: Innervate & Excite · 神经分布与冲动刺激 (Innervate, Stimulate, Fire)
groups.tip: 神经分布刺激肌体组织

items.def_en: to transmit a burst of electrical impulses along an axon or neuron
to initiate a specific neural response, muscular reflex, or physiological mechanism
to induce biological activity in a dormant nerve pathway, receptor, or sensory organ
to excite or activate an organ, nerve, or physiological process into functional activity

items.def_zh: 受神经支配，使分布神经；刺激
items.def_en: to supply a bodily organ or tissue with nerves, or stimulate it by nervous impulses

groups.summary_en: This physiological frame covers supplying biological tissues with nerve fibers or activating nerves and muscles through electrical and chemical impulses. Verbs contrast biological wiring with active neurological triggering.
groups.summary_zh: 指神经系统的结构分布，或通过电化学冲动激发组织器官活动。

groups.name: Inquire & Interrogate · 打探与质问 (Inquire, Question, Cross-examine)
groups.tip: 提出疑问并探求明确答案

items.def_en: To ask someone questions critically or express doubt about the truth of something
To question a witness or person aggressively to verify or undermine previous statements
To ask a question about something, especially in order to verify its accuracy or express doubt.
To seek information by asking questions in a formal or neutral manner
To ask someone questions thoroughly and aggressively, especially in an official setting

groups.summary_en: This frame covers seeking factual clarification, challenging assumptions, or expressing professional skepticism through direct questions.
groups.summary_zh: 指提出疑问、核实信息准确性或进行严肃质询与求证。

groups.name: Inquire & Interrogate · 打探与质问 (Sound out, Probe, Grill)
groups.tip: 深入探听内情与细致盘查追问

items.def_en: To question someone indirectly in order to find out their opinions or intentions
To survey or record the opinion or vote of people systematically
(informal) To ask someone persistent questions to extract information from them
To ask detailed and searching questions in order to discover hidden information

items.def_zh: 游说，拉票；打探民意，进行调查
items.def_en: To try to obtain political support, votes, or opinions from people by visiting them or asking detailed questions.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe systematic, inquisitive, or persistent efforts to elicit confidential information, survey public opinion, or examine someone's views thoroughly.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统性、探询性或带有倾向地探知他人意见或打探底细。

groups.name: Insert & Interpose · 插入与穿插 (Interpose, Sandwich, Interpolate)
groups.tip: 在缝隙或过程间穿插放入

items.def_en: To insert or include something quietly, discreetly, or smoothly

items.def_zh: 插入，穿插；作中场休息（或表演）
items.def_en: To insert an interval, pause, or short musical or theatrical piece between larger parts of an event.
To fit or insert someone or something tightly between two other things or events
To insert words, passages, or data into a text or sequence
To place something between two things, or interject a remark between other utterances

groups.summary_en: Pertains to positioning an object, interval, remark, or segment between parts of an ongoing sequence, text, or gap.
groups.summary_zh: 在连续体、间隙或环节中间嵌入穿插成分。

groups.name: Install & Mount Equipment · 安装与安放 (Fit, Mount, Set up)
groups.tip: 设置并稳妥固定部件

items.def_en: Fix or attach a component or appliance into its proper position
Attach an object firmly onto a backing, wall, stand, or other support

items.def_zh: 安装，装设；使就职，任命；安置，安顿
items.def_en: 1. To put equipment or software into position and connect it so that it is ready to use. 2. To officially put someone into an important job or position.
Assemble, connect, and prepare machinery, software, or equipment for immediate operation
Fit or install household equipment, appliances, or systems indoors

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve positioning, affixing, or connecting mechanical equipment, systems, or software so they become operational. Nuances range from physical mounting to systematic assembly and technical fitting.
groups.summary_zh: 指把设备、管件或软件置于适当位置并连接组装以供使用，涵盖固定与配装。

groups.name: Instruct & Direct · 指示与训令 (Instruct, Direct, Enjoin)
groups.tip: 从业务指导到强硬发号施令

items.def_zh: 向……作简明指示，简要通报
items.def_en: To give someone detailed instructions or essential information in preparation for a task
To give someone an official order or clear instruction to do something
1. To officially direct or command someone to do something. 2. To teach someone a subject, skill, or practical method
To tell someone authoritatively that they must do something
To instruct or urge someone authoritatively to perform a particular action

groups.summary_en: This frame covers giving authoritative, formal orders or structured guidance on how to carry out a specific task. Unlike blunt commanding, instructing often incorporates procedure, protocol, and explicit operational steps.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据权威或职责正式给出办事准则、步骤或下达指示性指令。

groups.name: Insulate & Shield · 隔绝与防护 (Shield, Cushion, Buffer)
groups.tip: 绝缘隔热以提供保护

items.def_en: to protect someone or something from danger, harm, criticism, or unpleasant exposure
to reduce the shock or harmful effect of something by acting as a protective barrier

items.def_zh: 缓冲；减弱…的震动或打击
items.def_en: to soften the physical or financial impact of something damaging

items.def_zh: 使隔热，使绝缘，使隔音；使免受不良影响，隔离
items.def_en: (+ against/from) to protect something with material that prevents heat, sound, or electricity from passing through; to protect someone from unpleasant experiences
to insulate a room or structure so that sound cannot pass through it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote surrounding or separating someone or something with a protective barrier against cold, sound, electricity, or harsh financial and external shocks.
groups.summary_zh: 指设立物理或抽象防护层，以抵御恶劣环境、冲击或外部影响。

groups.name: Insurge & Uprise · 反叛与起义 (Insurge, Rise, Take Up Arms)
groups.tip: 揭竿而起反抗既有统治

items.def_en: (+ against/in) To initiate collective active resistance or open rebellion against tyranny
(+ against) To fight against an established power structure or political system
(+ against) To mount an organized uprising aiming to displace those in control

items.def_zh: 起义，暴动，反叛；升起，上升
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To rise up in revolt or rebellion against authority. 2. (archaic) To ascend or move upward.
(+ against) To prepare for and enter into active armed insurrection against a foe or government

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on collective public or armed uprisings seeking to overthrow an oppressive regime or ruling force. These verbs emphasize the emergent mass mobilization and escalation into revolutionary upheaval.
groups.summary_zh: 群体性揭竿而起，发动武装叛乱或推翻现政权。

groups.name: Integrate & Merge · 融合与吸纳 (Assimilate, Synthesize, Blend)
groups.tip: 将分散要素融合为一个有机体

items.def_en: To include or embody something as an integral part of a larger plan, system, or organization
1. To combine two or more things to make them work together effectively, or to become part of a group or system.
(+ with/into) To mix together so thoroughly that the original boundaries disappear
To combine distinct ideas, substances, or components to form a coherent, complex whole
To absorb or be absorbed fully into the cultural traditions or life of a larger group

groups.summary_en: Verbs here describe fusing separate components, cultures, or data streams into an unbroken, harmonious, functioning single entity. They highlight structural alignment and complete systemic incorporation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将不同元素、系统或人群吸纳合并，使其合为一体顺畅运作。

groups.name: Interconnect & Interlock · 关联合并 (Intertwine, Mesh, Link together)
groups.tip: 事物之间彼此相互关联

items.def_en: Fit closely together or work together in harmony, like interlocking gear teeth
Be or become connected reciprocally with one another so that movement or data passes between them
Twist or weave closely together so that the components are difficult to separate
Fit or join together firmly in such a way that the parts motion or state is co-dependent
To be connected in such a way that each thing affects or depends on the other, or to make things relate to each other.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize reciprocal, mutual systems or components where elements do not merely refer to one another, but fit together, weave into one another, or depend co-functionally on each other.
groups.summary_zh: 描述要素之间双向咬合、交织或协同运作的深层互联状态。

groups.name: Interfere & Intervene · 干预与介入 (Intervene, Meddle, Intrigue)
groups.tip: 插手介入他人的事务

items.def_en: to interrupt a conversation or meddle bluntly in someone else's business without permission
to become actively involved in an ongoing dispute or crisis to help resolve it
1. (interfere in) to get involved in a situation without being invited or having the right to do so. 2. (interfere with) to prevent something from continuing or succeeding smoothly.
(+ in) to become involved in a difficult situation intentionally in order to influence, prevent, or resolve it
(+ in/with) to involve oneself in matters that are not one's concern without invitation or right

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights stepping into a situation, conflict, or private affairs, ranging from constructive and legitimate mediation to uninvited, unwelcome intrusion.
groups.summary_zh: 指介入他人事务或局势中，既包含正当调停，也包含盲目插手。

groups.name: Intermix & Mingle · 混杂与融合 (Intermix, Mingle, Interweave)
groups.tip: 多种成分均匀混为一体

items.def_en: To mix or cause to mix together without entirely losing distinct individual qualities.
To mix together closely or combine thoroughly, often used of groups, liquids, or intangible feelings.
(+ with) To mix or blend two or more substances, qualities, or groups together.
To blend or weave different elements closely and intricately together.

items.def_zh: 合并；混合（尤指资金或物质）
items.def_en: To mix together or combine, especially funds, assets, or chemical ingredients, into a common mass.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on combining different components, materials, or qualities so that they become thoroughly integrated or interspersed. Verbs emphasize mutual penetration, harmonizing, or diffuse spreading among elements.
groups.summary_zh: 描述各要素彼此穿插交错、完全混溶或交织成一体的状态变化。

groups.name: Internal Cavitation & Burrowing · 蜂窝化与侵蚀穿孔 (Tunnel, Hollow out, Excavate)
groups.tip: 穿刺使内部呈蜂窝状

items.def_en: Mark a surface with numerous small indentations, hollows, or craters
Remove the interior part of something so that only an empty space or shell remains
Dig or burrow a subterranean passageway through rock, earth, or substance
Make a hole or series of passages into or under something

items.def_zh: 使成蜂窝状，使布满孔洞（或通道）
items.def_en: (usually passive) To pierce or fill something with a network of holes, tunnels, or passages.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate structural decay or modification from within, forming an interconnected network of cavities, tunnels, or air pockets. Honeycomb denotes carving an intricate cell-like grid, whereas hollow out focuses on scooping out core mass.
groups.summary_zh: 指在内部穿凿或侵蚀，形成网状孔洞、管道或蜂窝状结构。

groups.name: Interpret & Elucidate · 阐释与破译说明 (Explicate, Unpack, Clarify)
groups.tip: 剖析内涵用言语明辨

items.def_en: To provide explanations or information that make a complicated problem easier to grasp

items.def_zh: 理解，阐释；口译；演绎（艺术作品）
items.def_en: 1. To explain or understand the meaning of something. 2. To translate spoken words from one language into another. 3. To perform a piece of music, a role, etc., in a way that conveys one's own understanding of it.
To make something obscure, confusing, or ambiguous clear and easily understandable
To examine, analyze, and explain the various elements of a complex idea, argument, or text
To analyze and explain a complex principle, literary text, or argument in exhaustive detail

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on explaining, translating, or unfolding the latent significance, symbolism, or mechanics of complex data, artwork, dreams, or foreign utterances for others.
groups.summary_zh: 对复杂数据、艺术意涵或隐晦言论进行剖析、翻译并加以说明。

groups.name: Interrupt & Interject · 打断与插话 (Chime in, Cut in, Butt in)
groups.tip: 半路插嘴打断他人的讲话

items.def_en: To join in or interrupt a conversation by offering remarks or agreement
To interrupt a discussion with a helpful or casual remark
To interrupt someone while they are speaking
To suddenly interrupt a conversation or speech by adding a remark.
(informal) To interrupt a conversation rudely without being invited

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate abrupt, momentary verbal intrusions into an ongoing dialogue to voice an opinion, clarify a point, or add a quick commentary.
groups.summary_zh: 指在他人说话或对话途中突然插话、搭话或插嘴发言。

groups.name: Interrupt & Punctuate · 打断与穿插 (Intersperse, Pepper, Punctuate)
groups.tip: 中途插话以打破原有节奏

items.def_en: (+ with) To enliven a speech or writing with humorous or striking remarks
(usually passive, + with) To scatter, decorate, or interrupt a narrative or surface with numerous instances
(+ with) To scatter or place things at intervals among other things

items.def_zh: 不时打断，间歇打扰；给……加标点
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To interrupt something repeatedly at intervals. 2. To add punctuation marks to a piece of writing.
(+ with) To hit or hit repeatedly with something; to distribute abundantly throughout

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on repeated occurrences, sounds, or events that regularly break the flow of a discourse or situation, rhythmically dividing or highlighting it.
groups.summary_zh: 指周期性或散布式地穿插、点缀于讲话或过程之中并形成打断。

groups.name: Intersect & Cross Paths · 相交与交汇 (Intersect, Converge, Cross)
groups.tip: 运动轨迹成十字相交

items.def_en: To pass or extend from one side of something to the other, or meet and form an X-shape
To move back and forth across an area or mark it with crossing lines in various directions
(+ on/at) To move toward or meet at a common focal point from different directions
(+ with) To cross or cut across each other at a point or line.
To divide or cut across something into two equal or distinct parts

groups.summary_en: This frame involves physical paths, geometric lines, or metaphorical journeys cutting across, overlapping, or meeting at a single spatial or conceptual junction.
groups.summary_zh: 指线条、道路或人生轨迹在空间或逻辑上的交叉、贯通与交汇。

groups.name: Intervene & Mediate · 介入与调解 (Mediate, Arbitrate, Step in)
groups.tip: 介入争端进行调停干涉

items.def_zh: 挺身介入，出手相助或制止
items.def_en: Become involved in an ongoing difficult situation, argument, or task to help resolve it

items.def_zh: 介入，干预，调涉；调解；阻碍，插手
items.def_en: 1. to deliberately become involved in a difficult situation in order to improve it or prevent it from getting worse. 2. to happen between two events or points in time.
Act as a neutral go-between to reconcile opposing sides and reach an agreement
(+ for / with) Intervene on behalf of another person, especially by pleading or negotiating for mercy or aid
Officially judge and settle a dispute between two conflicting parties

groups.summary_en: This frame covers constructive or deliberate involvement in disputes, crises, or diplomatic conflicts to resolve deadlocks, defuse tensions, or impose order. Unlike meddling, these actions are typically purposeful, authorized, or welcomed by at least one party.
groups.summary_zh: 指为化解矛盾、打破僵局或恢复秩序而主动介入调解。

groups.name: Intoxicate & Inebriate · 沉醉与陶醉 (Inebriate, Fuddle, Enrapture)
groups.tip: 酒精或药物带来的迷醉陶醉

items.def_en: To make someone slightly drunk or mellow

items.def_zh: 使醉，使陶醉；使欣喜若狂
items.def_en: 1. (formal) (of alcohol or drugs) To cause someone to lose control of their faculties; to make drunk. 2. (often passive) To excite or elate someone beyond self-control.
To make someone formally or medically drunk with alcoholic liquor
To confuse or stupefy someone thoroughly, typically with drink or excessive emotion
To fill someone with profound delight, reverence, or ecstatic wonder

groups.summary_en: This frame captures states of physical drunkenness caused by chemicals or metaphorical intoxication marked by overwhelming ecstasy and loss of composure.
groups.summary_zh: 指因酒精药物致醉，或受狂喜激情驱使而陶醉迷乱。

groups.name: Intoxicate & Inebriate · 醉酒与致醉 (Intoxicate, Befuddle, Tipsify)
groups.tip: 酒精催眠令人神志不清

items.def_en: To become less drunk or make someone return to a sober, lucid state
To cause someone to lose control of their faculties through alcohol or drugs

items.def_zh: 使大醉（常用被动态 sloshed）
items.def_en: To make someone heavily drunk (chiefly used colloquially in passive/participle form)

items.def_zh: 使醉，灌醉；使陶醉，使发狂
items.def_en: (formal) To make someone intoxicated or drunk; to fill someone with exhilaration or confusion.
To confuse or stupify someone's mind, typically with alcohol

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physiological and psychological states caused by alcohol or psychoactive substances, ranging from light euphoria to incapacitating stupor.
groups.summary_zh: 指酒精或麻醉物质导致头晕目眩、兴奋或醉倒的生理状态。

groups.name: Introduce & Preface · 开篇与前置说明 (Preface, Foreword, Preamble)
groups.tip: 通过写序引出全书正题

items.def_en: To provide an opening statement or initial presentation to orient an audience
To introduce a speech, document, or statement with an introductory explanation
(+ to) To serve as an introduction or preparation for the main topic
To start a book, performance, or speech with a particular remark or piece

items.def_zh: 为……作序；以……作为开场白（或前奏）
items.def_en: (+ with) To introduce a book, speech, or action with an opening statement or preliminary event.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this discourse-framing frame refer to providing introductory remarks, preambles, or background commentary that precede the main text or speech.
groups.summary_zh: 在正文、演说或行动之前作开篇介绍或铺垫说明。

groups.name: Introduce & Present · 介绍与引荐 (Present, Acquaint, Usher in)
groups.tip: 引荐新人或向公众展示展示

items.def_en: To formally introduce someone to another person or bring someone forward before an audience

items.def_zh: 介绍，引荐；引进，推行；提出（议案等）；作为……的开端
items.def_en: 1. To tell someone another person's name when they meet for the first time. 2. To bring something into use or existence for the first time. 3. To formally present a bill, idea, or proposal for discussion.
To introduce a proposal, argument, or candidate for formal consideration or attention
To mark or signal the beginning of a new period, reform, or momentous era
To make someone familiar with a person, fact, or situation through formal disclosure

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this interpersonal and ceremonial frame involve acquainting individuals with each other or formally bringing an audience into contact with a person, work, or new concept. They span basic social introductions to formal ceremonial presentations.
groups.summary_zh: 在社交或正式场合将某人、事物引荐介绍给他人认识。

groups.name: Intrude & Force Entry · 闯入与鲁莽侵入 (Barge, Burst, Muscle in)
groups.tip: 粗暴莽撞地冲入空间

items.def_en: To interrupt a conversation or meddle in someone else's affairs rudely without invitation
(+ on/upon/into) To enter a place or join an activity where one is not invited, wanted, or expected
To enter a room or building suddenly, loudly, and with great physical force
(+ on) To force one's way into an organization, enterprise, or conversation by aggressive pressure

items.def_zh: 闯入，猛冲，乱撞；用驳船运送
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/past/through) To move clumsily and forcefully, intruding rudely into a place or bumping into people. 2. To transport goods by barge.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures forceful, impolite, or clumsy bodily incursions into physical spaces or social situations without invitation. Nuances distinguish kinetic momentum from calculated social entitlement.
groups.summary_zh: 未获许可而粗暴、莽撞地闯入空间或介入他人谈话。

groups.name: Invigorate & Energize · 振奋与赋能 (Energize, Galvanize, Revitalize)
groups.tip: 为身体注入精力，精神大振

items.def_en: To make someone or something much more lively, spirited, colorful, or energetic
To supply someone or something with enthusiasm, physical energy, or operational drive
To imbue something languishing or depleted with new life, vigor, strength, or success
To shock or stimulate people into sudden, vigorous, purposeful excitement and rapid action

items.def_zh: 使精力充沛，使振奋；刺激，激励
items.def_en: 1. To give someone fresh energy, strength, and vitality; to stimulate or revitalize.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers imparting freshness, stamina, electrical dynamism, or biological vitality to a tired person, mind, or stagnant institution. 'Invigorate' evokes crisp physical rejuvenation, 'energize' conveys active operational power, and 'galvanize' indicates shocking into sudden motion.
groups.summary_zh: 指赋予活力、生机或精神力量，使疲乏或迟滞之物振奋重燃。

groups.name: Invite & Bid · 邀请与招引 (Summon, Bid, Ask over)
groups.tip: 礼貌邀人参加活动或上门

items.def_zh: 邀请，约请；招致，诱发；征求
items.def_en: 1. To politely or formally ask someone to come somewhere or do something. 2. To act in a way that makes something unpleasant likely to happen. 3. To solicit or request suggestions, questions, or applications.
To invite, summon, or order someone to attend or do something (literary or formal)
To invite someone to come to your home for a meal, drink, or social visit
To entertain someone as a guest in one's home
To officially or authoritatively demand someone's presence

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on requesting someone's presence, participation, or response, ranging from friendly social invitations to authoritative or ritualistic summons.
groups.summary_zh: 指请求或邀请某人出席、参与活动或前来作客。

groups.name: Invoke & Appeal to Authority · 援引与诉诸 (Invoke, Cite, Adduce)
groups.tip: 援引法条权威或呼吁求援

items.def_en: To refer to a book, article, law, or precedent as an authority or proof in an argument

items.def_zh: 退而诉诸，求助于（法律或权利）
items.def_en: To resort to an authority, statute, or reserve resource when other arguments or means have failed
To offer an example, reason, or piece of evidence as proof or justification in a formal argument
To formally appeal to or demand that someone or an authority take action or provide testimony

1. To cite a law, rule, or principle to justify an action or support an argument. 2. To appeal to a deity, spirit, or higher authority for help or protection. 3. To evoke or bring a feeling or image to mind.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to calling upon an established law, authoritative precedent, constitutional right, or supernatural entity to legitimize a course of action or justify a contentious stance.
groups.summary_zh: 指引用法律法规、权威先例或崇高力量为自身行为辩护或立论。

groups.name: Involuntary Muscle Jerks · 抽动与肌肉震颤 (Twitch, Spasm, Tic)
groups.tip: 肌肉局部的细微不受控抽搐

items.def_en: 1. To make a sudden, brief, involuntary movement, or cause a body part to do so. 2. To pull or jerk something with a quick, sharp movement.
To exhibit a recurrent, involuntary muscular contraction, typically of the face
To make rapid, light, irregular movements, such as a flickering eyelid or racing pulse
To shake or vibrate with a slight, rapid, and barely perceptible motion
To undergo a sudden, involuntary, and often painful contraction of a muscle or muscle group

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe sudden, brief, involuntary muscle contractions or small jerking movements. They range from tiny, repetitive eyelid flickers to sharp, localized bodily spasms.
groups.summary_zh: 描述身体局部肌肉微小、短暂且不由自主的抽搐、跳动或颤动。

groups.name: Involve & Entangle · 卷入与牵连 (Enmesh, Entangle, Implicate)
groups.tip: 深陷纷争或复杂事端之中

items.def_en: (+ in) To show or suggest that someone is involved in an illegal or morally reprehensible act
(+ in/with) To cause someone or something to become caught in a confusing or compromising difficulty

items.def_zh: 使卷入，使陷入（纷争或困境）；牵连
items.def_en: (+ in/with) (often passive) To involve someone deeply in an argument, conflict, or difficult situation.
(+ in) (usually passive) To involve someone deeply in a messy, intractable problem or controversy
(+ in) To entangle someone thoroughly in a complex net of troubles, conflicts, or deceit

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on drawing or ensnaring someone deeply into a complicated, compromising dispute, crime, or hostile situation from which extraction is difficult.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人深陷于纷争、丑闻或困境中，难以脱身。

groups.name: Irrigate & Cleanse · 冲洗与洁身 (Rinse, Flush, Syringe)
groups.tip: 用水流清洗清洁身体部位

items.def_en: Wash lightly with clean liquid, especially to remove soap, dirt, or debris from skin or mouth

items.def_zh: 灌洗，冲洗（尤指阴道等身体腔道）
items.def_en: To wash or flush a body cavity (especially the vagina) with a stream of water or a cleansing solution.
Cleanse or empty something by causing a strong surge of water or liquid to flow through it

items.def_zh: 用注射器冲洗（耳道/伤口等）
items.def_en: Cleanse or flush out an orifice (such as an ear) using a specialized syringe
Wash out a body cavity, organ, or wound with a controlled continuous stream of water or saline

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to washing, purging, or rinsing bodily cavities, passages, or skin surfaces with targeted streams of water or medicinal solutions to ensure cleanliness or medical hygiene.
groups.summary_zh: 用水流或药液对身体孔道、创口或表面进行定向冲洗洁治。

groups.name: Isolate & Sequester · 司法隔离与依法扣押 (Isolate, Quarantine, Impound)
groups.tip: 扣押财产或强行隔绝陪审团

items.def_en: to separate someone or something physically or socially from others
to enclose or seal off an area with a barrier or police tape to prevent access
to isolate a person, animal, or ship to prevent the spread of infectious disease
to seize and hold legal custody of property, documents, or vehicles by law

items.def_zh: 使隔绝，使隔离（陪审团等）；扣押，没收（财产）
items.def_en: (formal/law) to isolate a jury from outside influence during a trial; to legally seize property until a debt or dispute is settled

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to officially separating people or properties from outside contact, whether sequestering a jury, quarantining for public health, or impounding assets.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法律或官方行政手段将人员隔绝外界或扣押财产。

groups.name: Issue, Republish & Put Out · 重印与发行 (Reissue, Put out, Print)
groups.tip: 排版印刷与公开发行

items.def_en: To prepare and officially issue a book, journal, or piece of music for general sale
To produce and make available a publication, statement, or creative release to the public
To launch and publish a new product, literary title, or commercial run
To print a new supply of copies of a book, article, or photograph without making major changes.
To print and distribute a new edition or version of a book, recording, or document

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the commercial publishing workflow of manufacturing new runs, alternate editions, or fresh printings of existing literary or visual works. Collocates include edition, hardback, run, and serial.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重书籍、刊物等作品的重新发行、加印或换版出版。

groups.name: Itch & Tingle · 感官麻痒与刺痛 (Itch, Tingle, Prickle)
groups.tip: 表皮神经刺痛与微痒

items.def_zh: 起鸡皮疙瘩；感觉有虫爬般发痒
items.def_en: To experience an eerie, creep-like tingling sensation on your skin caused by disgust or chills
1. To have an uncomfortable feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch. 2. (+ for/to do) (informal) To feel a strong, impatient desire to do something.
To experience a slight stinging, prickling, or throbbing sensation on the skin or body part
To feel as though tiny sharp needles or pins are stinging the skin

items.def_zh: 刺痛；感到阵阵火辣灼痛
items.def_en: To produce a sharp, stinging superficial pain, as from a scrape, cut, or harsh liquid

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on mild to moderate superficial somatosensory sensations on the skin, such as prickling, tingling, or itching sensations that provoke an impulse to scratch.
groups.summary_zh: 指皮肤表层产生的轻微刺痒、蚁走感、发麻或引起搔抓冲动的躯体知觉。

groups.name: Jettison & Cast off · 抛弃与断然丢弃 (Jettison, Scrap, Ditch)
groups.tip: 抛下重物或弃置无用之物

items.def_en: Get rid of someone or something that you no longer want, need, or accept
Get rid of unwanted waste or possessions carelessly, or abruptly end a relationship with someone

items.def_zh: 报废；取消；把……当废物丢弃
items.def_en: Discard or abandon an idea, plan, or piece of machinery as useless or obsolete
(informal) Get rid of, abandon, or stop using someone or something that is no longer desired

items.def_zh: 抛弃，丢弃（重物以减负）；放弃（无用计划等）
items.def_en: 1. To throw goods, cargo, or fuel overboard from a ship or aircraft to make it lighter in an emergency. 2. To get rid of an unwanted idea, plan, or person.
