groups.summary_en: Pertains to abruptly shedding, discarding, or dropping objects, cargo, plans, or unwanted ties to lighten a load, eliminate burdens, or clear space rapidly.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为减负、断舍离或应对危机而断然抛弃物品或计划。

groups.name: Jinx & Bad-mouth · 致厄与招晦气 (Jinx, Hoodoo, Put the hex on, Blight)
groups.tip: 施加晦气让其遭殃

items.def_en: To bring persistent bad luck, misfortune, or jinxes to a sports team, individual, or project
To put a decisive stop to an activity or squelch someone's plans and good fortune entirely
To ruin, spoil, or severely damage the prospects, happiness, or health of something
To bring bad luck or misfortune to someone or something.
To deliberately or fatefully wreck a plan, opportunity, or chance of success

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to bringing bad luck, superstitious misfortune, or disastrous outcomes upon an endeavor or person, often by speaking prematurely or acting carelessly.
groups.summary_zh: 以乌鸦嘴、触霉头或迷信力量带来晦气，使计划或事物败坏遭殃。

groups.name: Joke & Tease · 开玩笑与调侃 (Joke, Jest, Kid)
groups.tip: 以轻松诙谐之语活跃气氛

items.def_en: To deceive playfully as a joke; tease or banter
To tell jokes or say something humorous rather than serious.
To exchange lighthearted, playful, and teasing remarks
To make a witty or sarcastic remark quickly
To speak in a playful, humorous, or teasing way

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify speaking in a playful, lighthearted, or teasing manner rather than in earnest, often to provoke laughter or defuse tension.
groups.summary_zh: 以戏谑、非严肃的方式言语，说笑或打趣调侃。

groups.name: Judge & Adjudicate · 裁决与依法认定 (Adjudge, Rule, Deem)
groups.tip: 基于规则与法律做出权威判定

items.def_en: To make an authoritative legal decision or declaration on a point of law
To consider, judge, or declare in an official or legal evaluation
To state an official decision, opinion, or judgment formally or publicly
To act as a judge or give an official judgment in a formal dispute
(formal / law) to declare, decide, or judge officially that someone or something is a certain way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe authoritative cognitive evaluations made by courts, arbitrators, or officials to determine legal status or culpability. They denote issuing a binding formal finding rather than pronouncing a punitive sentence.
groups.summary_zh: 指法官、仲裁者等权威依据事实和法律对性质或地位作出正式裁断。

groups.name: Judge & Convict · 审判与定罪 (Find guilty, Sentence, Adjudicate)
groups.tip: 法庭审理并依法判定有罪

items.def_en: To state officially in court that someone will receive a particular punishment

items.def_zh: 判决……有罪，定罪；证明……有错
items.def_en: To officially declare or find someone guilty of a criminal offense in a court of law.
To officially pronounce a harsh punishment or death penalty upon a convicted criminal
To reach a judicial verdict establishing that a defendant committed an offense
To pronounce judicially or rule formally that someone is guilty or liable

groups.summary_en: This legal frame focuses on formal judicial outcomes where an accused person is officially adjudicated, found guilty of a crime, and assigned legal penalty.
groups.summary_zh: 法庭经审判正式判定当事人有罪并施加刑罚。

groups.name: Jurisdictional Division & Districting · 划分管区与选区 (District, Redistrict, Gerrymander)
groups.tip: 按地域划分行政片区

items.def_en: 1. To divide an area or city into administrative, legislative, or school districts.
To divide an urban municipal territory into distinct electoral or administrative wards
To redraw the political, voting, or school boundary lines of an administrative region
To designate or divide an urban area into police or voting precincts

items.def_zh: 不正当划分（选区以谋求私利）
items.def_en: To redraw electoral district boundaries unfairly to give one political party an electoral advantage

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the legal and institutional partition of territorial entities into official districts for voting, schooling, policing, or civic governance, emphasizing borders defined by state authority.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或公权力依行政、司法、学区或选举需要划分管理辖区。

groups.name: Kibitz & Meddle · 插嘴与瞎出主意 (Butt in, Chime in, Meddle)
groups.tip: 从旁多嘴出谋或横加干预

items.def_en: To join into a conversation or debate, often suddenly with an agreement or opinion
To get involved in other people's affairs where one is not wanted or needed
To offer unwanted advice or critique to the person who is actually in charge

items.def_zh: 乱插嘴，瞎提建议；指点牌局
items.def_en: To look on and offer unwanted advice or commentary, especially during a game of cards.
To rudely interrupt a conversation or meddle in someone else's affairs

groups.summary_en: Depicts bystanders intruding into conversations, games, or affairs with unsolicited commentary, backseat advice, or meddlesome critiques.
groups.summary_zh: 旁观者胡乱插话、评头论足或多管闲事。

groups.name: Kick & Punt · 踢蹬与脚击 (Punt, Boot, Hack)
groups.tip: 凌空抽射或脚蹬反击

items.def_en: To kick roughly or indiscriminately at an opponent's shins or feet in sports
To drop a ball from the hands and kick it before it touches the ground

items.def_zh: 凌空踢球，反弹踢；做凌空飞踢
items.def_en: 1. (sports) To kick a ball just as it rebounds from the ground after being dropped from the hands. 2. (combat sports) To perform a dropkick on an opponent.
To kick something or someone hard and forcefully, often sending it a long distance
To kick a ball high and far with brute force, especially in soccer

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses forcefully striking or propelling an object or opponent using the foot or boot. It ranges from technical athletic maneuvers like dropkicking and punting to raw, forceful kicks directed at physical targets.
groups.summary_zh: 指用脚、靴子对球或目标物施加的各种击打与踢射动作。

groups.name: Kid & Rib · 戏弄与打趣 (Josh, Rib, Wind up)
groups.tip: 轻松开玩笑或善意逗弄戏谑

items.def_en: (UK informal) To tease someone by pretending something false is true
(informal) To say something not meant seriously, or tell playful lies to someone for amusement.
(informal) To tease or joke with someone playfully and amiably
(informal) To tease someone in an affectionate and good-natured way
(UK informal) To say things intentionally to mislead or tease someone as a joke

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to verbally teasing or feeding someone playful falsehoods for amusement without malicious intent, often testing their gullibility.
groups.summary_zh: 指善意逗弄、开玩笑或拿人寻开心的动词群。

groups.name: Kindle & Spark · 点燃与引燃 (Kindle, Ignite, Spark)
groups.tip: 引燃火种或点燃热情

items.def_en: To cause something to catch fire and begin to burn actively
To produce small electrical flashes, or cause a sudden sequence of events or feelings
1. To start a fire burning, or to arouse strong feelings, interest, or hope in someone.
To catch fire or make something start burning; to trigger a strong reaction
To ignite an explosive fuse, or precipitate a violent outburst or crisis

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the initial inception of ignition—starting a fire from a small spark, tinder, or match—as well as the figurative awakening of interest, hope, or romance.
groups.summary_zh: 引燃初始火花或微火，亦指激起、点燃某种强烈情感或灵感。

groups.name: Kiss & Caress · 亲吻与爱抚 (Make out, Canoodle, Neck)
groups.tip: 热烈亲吻拥吻肢体接触

items.def_en: (informal) To kiss, cuddle, and caress amorous partner intimately in a fond way
(informal) To kiss someone affectionately or engage in slow, romantic kissing
(informal) To engage in mutual kissing and sexual touching passionately
(informal) To kiss and fondle passionately, especially on the neck and mouth
(British informal) To kiss and caress someone passionately.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this intimate physical frame describe passionate or affectionate kissing, fondling, and amorous embraces. They encompass romantic caressing as well as colloquial and informal idioms for making out.
groups.summary_zh: 表达情侣间的深情亲吻、拥抱爱抚或激吻亲热。

groups.name: Kit & Outfit · 装备与整套装配 (Kit, Outfit, Rig, Equip)
groups.tip: 配齐所需器材与物资

items.def_en: (often kit out/up) to supply or equip someone or something with a complete set of clothes, tools, or gear
To provide someone or an organization with a complete set of equipment or clothing
To supply with the necessary items, tools, or skills for a specific purpose
To supply someone or something with all the necessary items or clothes
To fit someone out with specialized clothing, gear, or operational apparatus

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote supplying a person, team, or vehicle with a comprehensive set of gear, tools, or clothing necessary for an expedition, task, or sport. They focus on assembling a complete operational kit.
groups.summary_zh: 指为某人、队伍或车辆配齐执行特定任务所需的全套装备工具。

groups.name: Ladle & Bail · 舀取与舀水 (Ladle out, Bail out, Dip)
groups.tip: 用勺或长柄容器盛取液体

items.def_en: (+ into/out) to lower a ladle, cup, or bucket into a liquid to scoop some up
to ladle or portion freshly cooked food from pots into serving dishes ready for eating
to serve soup or liquid food from a pot into bowls using a ladle

items.def_zh: 用长柄勺舀取，盛出；大量分发
items.def_en: 1. (+ out/into) to serve, lift, or transfer liquid or food using a ladle 2. (+ out) to give out or distribute money, praise, or gifts generously
to remove unwanted water from a boat or container by scooping it out with a bucket or tin

groups.summary_en: This frame captures dipping deep-bowled vessels into liquids (such as soup, broth, water, or bilgewater) to scoop, transfer, or empty them. It contrasts measured culinary dispensing with rapid, repetitive manual bailing.
groups.summary_zh: 特指用长柄大勺或器具舀取汤汁流质，或舀出积水。

groups.name: Lampoon & Satirize · 戏拟与戏谑 (Lampoon, Caricature, Burlesque)
groups.tip: 恶意嘲弄与讽刺挖苦他人

items.def_en: To deliberately copy the style of someone or something in an exaggerated, comic way

items.def_zh: 嘲弄，戏弄，挖苦；用牵索固定
items.def_en: 1. To make fun of or ridicule someone. 2. To secure or steady something with a guy-rope.
To parody something through ludicrous, exaggerated, grotesque imitation

items.def_zh: 把…画成漫画嘲讽；夸张讽刺
items.def_en: To make a comically exaggerated or distorted representation of someone or their traits
To publicly criticize or make fun of someone using ridiculing satire

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses making fun of or parodying people, public figures, or customs, often through artistic caricature, comic impersonation, or theatrical spoofing.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过夸张模仿、讽刺画或滑稽戏来调侃并讽刺特定人物或事物。

groups.name: Land-Use Zoning & Spatial Partition · 土地规划与分区 (Zone, Parcel out, Section off)
groups.tip: 按照功能或属地分割规划

items.def_en: To separate an area or interior space into distinct enclosed parts with physical dividers or barriers

items.def_zh: 将……划为特定区域，分区规划；（zone out）走神，发呆
items.def_en: 1. To divide land or an area into zones designated for specific uses or purposes. 2. (zone out) (informal) To lose concentration or become unaware of one's surroundings.
To change the official zoning status or permitted land usage of a designated urban area
To divide an expansive property, estate, or resource into distinct portions and distribute them
To divide a room, structure, or territory into distinct separate sections by erecting walls or boundaries

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to partitioning continuous urban, rural, or interior space into bounded parcels designated for specific usages (residential, commercial, industrial) or controlled occupancy.
groups.summary_zh: 指依用途规划土地功能区，或在空间上拉设界线以划分特定使用区域。

groups.name: Launch & Propel · 发射与起航 (Launch, Propel, Blast off)
groups.tip: 用力推向空中或水面

items.def_en: to shoot a bullet, rocket, or projectile from a weapon or device

items.def_zh: 发射；使（船）下水；发起，开展；发行，投放（市场）
items.def_en: 1. To send a rocket, missile, or satellite into the air or into space. 2. To put a ship or boat into the water. 3. To start a major activity or introduce a new product to the market.
(of a rocket or spacecraft) to leave the launch pad with immense propulsion
to untie mooring lines and depart from shore or dock in a boat
to drive, push, or cause an object to move vigorously forward

groups.summary_en: Covers verbs for forcefully propelling a vessel, projectile, or craft into motion, whether sending a spacecraft into orbit, firing ordnance, or sending a boat into water.
groups.summary_zh: 指将飞行器、弹药或舰船强力送入空间、水域或轨道的动作。

groups.name: Lay & Bond Masonry · 砌筑与灰浆固定 (Mortar, Grout, Point, Brick)
groups.tip: 胶结粘牢物体部件

items.def_en: To finish, repair, or point-fill the mortar joints of a brick wall with fresh mortar
(+ in) To fix or set stones, bricks, or pipes firmly in an underlying wet layer of mortar or concrete
To coat an external masonry or brick wall with a protective, uniform layer of plaster or mortar

items.def_zh: 用灰浆砌合；用迫击炮轰击
items.def_en: 1. To join bricks or stones together using mortar. 2. To attack or bombard a target with mortar shells.
To fill the narrow spaces and crevices between tiles or masonry blocks with thin, hardening mortar

groups.summary_en: A specialized civil and trade construction frame dealing with joining bricks, stones, tiles, or blocks together using wet mineral binders such as mortar, grout, or cement slurry that dry into rock-hard joints.
groups.summary_zh: 指在建筑施工中用灰浆、填缝剂砌筑或填补石砖接缝的专门工艺。

groups.name: Leak & Spill Confidential Information · 泄露与走漏机密 (Leak, Spill, Blab)
groups.tip: 公开此前隐瞒或未知的信息

items.def_zh: 泄露，透露（机密信息）；（液体、气体等）渗漏，漏出
items.def_en: 1. To intentionally or accidentally disclose secret information to the public. 2. To let liquid or gas escape through a hole or crack.
(+ on) To report illegal, unethical, or wrongful activities within an organization to authorities or the public
To divulge a secret or reveal confidential plans prematurely or indiscreetly
To reveal confidential information or confess, especially under pressure or eagerly
To talk indiscreetly or tell secrets through carelessness or lack of restraint

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on unauthorized, accidental, or indiscreet disclosures of classified or private information. It highlights breaches of confidentiality, careless gossip, or calculated whistleblowing.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重未经授权、不慎或故意违规走漏秘密与内部消息。

groups.name: Lean & Recline · 倾倚与斜躺 (Recline, Lean back, Slouch, Lounge)
groups.tip: 身体倾斜依靠在支撑物上

items.def_en: To tilt one's torso backward against a supportive surface such as a chair back
To stand, sit, or lie down in a relaxed, comfortable, and lazy manner
To lean or lie back in a relaxed position; to adjust the back of a seat into a sloping position.

items.def_zh: 没精打采地坐/站，塌肩瘫靠
items.def_en: To sit, walk, or stand with a drooped head, rounded shoulders, and poor posture

items.def_zh: 伸开四肢躺卧，四仰八叉地躺
items.def_en: To sit, lie, or fall with arms and legs spread out awkwardly or carelessly

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on human posture where the torso slopes backward or sideward for relaxation, ease, or indolence, contrasting active leaning with passive repose.
groups.summary_zh: 身体向后倾倚或斜靠以求放松，或懒散躺靠。

groups.name: Leap & Bound · 纵跃与羚羊式跃跳 (Pronk, Leap, Bound, Cavort)
groups.tip: 四肢用力蹬地向上腾空跃起

items.def_en: (+ up/out) To leap, jump, or move suddenly, rapidly, and elastically from a stationary stance
(+ along/over) To run or advance with long, vigorous, springy steps and bounding leaps
To jump or dance around excitedly, playfully, and noisily

items.def_zh: 四脚弹跳，跃起（尤指羚羊等四肢僵直跳跃）
items.def_en: 1. (zoology) (of a quadruped, especially a springbok) To leap high into the air with an arched back and stiff legs.
(zoology) (of quadrupeds) To jump high straight into the air with all four legs held stiff and straight

groups.summary_en: Captures spring-like, buoyant four-legged or airborne jumping, where an animal or energetic person propels all feet off the ground in high, arching leaps. 'Bound' conveys long rhythmic strides; 'pronk' is specific to rigid-legged stotting.
groups.summary_zh: 指四足动物或活泼的人弹起腾空、四蹄腾空的高弹道腾跃。

groups.name: Legal Subpoena & Citation · 传唤与司法传讯 (Summons, Subpoena, Cite)
groups.tip: 官方传唤或正式组织开会

items.def_en: To officially give or deliver a legal document, such as a writ, to someone

items.def_zh: 传讯（某人）出庭；下达违章传票
items.def_en: To officially order somebody to appear before a court of law to face charges
To order someone to attend court as a witness by means of a formal legal writ
(law) To order someone to appear in a court of law with an official summons.

items.def_zh: 提审；提讯（被告核对罪名）
items.def_en: To bring an accused person before a court to hear and answer a formal criminal charge

groups.summary_en: Jurisprudential verbs describing formal orders backed by state coercion, directing a party or witness to appear before a court.
groups.summary_zh: 强调具有法定强制力、责令当事人或证人到庭受审的司法传票行为。

groups.name: Leverage & Implement · 务实利用与应用 (Utilize, Leverage, Harness)
groups.tip: 将工具或资源投入实际运作

items.def_zh: 调配，有效运用（资源或技能）
items.def_en: to bring resources, skills, or technologies into effective action
to use a situation, opportunity, or resource fully, sometimes selfishly or unfairly
to use an existing asset, influence, or opportunity to gain maximum advantage

items.def_zh: 驾驭，治理并利用（自然力等）
items.def_en: to control and utilize a natural or powerful resource to produce energy or achieve a goal
to make practical and effective use of something

groups.summary_en: This frame covers putting resources, skills, or opportunities to effective and purposeful work, often optimizing existing assets to achieve a tangible outcome.
groups.summary_zh: 强调调动或发挥人、物、技能的最大价值与效用。

groups.name: Leverage & Multiply Gains · 增值与倍增 (Parlay, Leverage, Compound)
groups.tip: 利用已有资本博取更大收益

items.def_en: To reinvest profits earned into the same business to foster growth and greater value
To increase gradually by generating earnings on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest
To use something that you already possess in order to achieve a much better result or greater advantage

items.def_zh: 使增值，利用……博取更大收益；连本带利地赌
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) (chiefly North American) To use an initial asset, success, or small advantage to gain something much greater. 2. To risk original money and its winnings on a subsequent bet.

items.def_zh: 利用浮盈加仓，滚雪球增资
items.def_en: To build up or multiply investments or gains progressively upon an original holding

groups.summary_en: Centers on exploiting an existing small stake, resource, or early success strategically to generate vastly greater profits, influence, or opportunities.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用初始资产、成果或微小优势实现指数级增值或倍增。

groups.name: Levy & Exact · 征税与强制课征 (Levy, Exact, Assess)
groups.tip: 公权力强制征收税款物资

items.def_en: To receive or assemble taxes, fees, or contributions from designated citizens or entities
To demand and obtain something such as taxes, dues, or penalties forcefully from someone
To officially order that a new tax, duty, or legal penalty must be established and obeyed
To calculate and officially assign the tax amount, rate, or value of a taxable asset

items.def_zh: 征收，课征（税款、罚款等）；征集（军队）
items.def_en: 1. to officially impose and collect a tax, fee, or fine 2. (historical) to recruit or assemble soldiers

groups.summary_en: This frame covers sovereign authorities establishing and compelling the collection of public revenues, penalties, and civic charges. It emphasizes the mandatory, legally enforced exaction of tariffs, duties, and fines from the public.
groups.summary_zh: 强调依法强行核定并征收税款、规费或罚款。

groups.name: Liaise & Coordinate · 联络与对接 (Coordinate, Network, Interface)
groups.tip: 在各方之间沟通充当联络人

items.def_zh: 结识人脉；建立业务联系
items.def_en: To meet and interact with people in business or professional fields to build useful connections
To organize people or departments so that they work together smoothly and effectively
(+ with) To interact, connect, and exchange information between departments or external systems
(+ with) To work joint-venture style with another party on a shared project or objective

items.def_zh: 联络，充当联络人，沟通协调
items.def_en: To work closely with another person or organization, acting as a link to share information and coordinate activities.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on organizational and professional bridge-building, where an actor actively shares intelligence, harmonizes workflows, and aligns multiple stakeholders.
groups.summary_zh: 指在组织或业务中充当纽带，负责各方的信息互通与协调对接。

groups.name: Liberate & Emancipate · 解放与独立 (Free, Enfranchise, Unshackle)
groups.tip: 摆脱殖民统治获得民族独立

items.def_en: To free someone or a population from literal shackles or severe socio-political constraints

items.def_zh: 解放，释放（受压迫国家或人民）
items.def_en: To free a country or people from foreign occupation, oppression, or strict control

items.def_zh: 解放，赋予人身自由/法定权利
items.def_en: To give someone legal, political, or social freedom, especially from slavery or institutional disenfranchisement

items.def_zh: 赋予选举权，给予政治自由
items.def_en: To grant political liberty, autonomy, or the legal right to vote to a disenfranchised group

items.def_zh: 使非殖民化，给予（殖民地）独立
items.def_en: To grant political independence to a colony or remove colonial control and influence from a country or institution.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers sovereign, legal, and sociopolitical acts of freeing peoples, territories, or enslaved groups from imperial domination or subjugation. The focus ranges from constitutional decolonization to collective liberation.
groups.summary_zh: 政治、法律或集体层面解除殖民统治、奴役或压迫。

groups.name: Lick & Lap · 舔舐与触碰 (Lap, Lap up, Taste)
groups.tip: 用舌头舔舐或用身体触碰

items.def_en: to put a tiny amount of food or drink on the tongue to sample its flavor
to lick up every drop of liquid, or metaphorically to enthusiastically accept praise or attention
to stroke, lick, or touch something deliberately with the tongue
to drink by scooping up liquid with rapid tongue movements, or of gentle waves to brush lightly against shore

items.def_zh: 舔，舔吃；轻拍，拂过；轻易击败
items.def_en: 1. to pass the tongue over the surface of something 2. (of flames, waves, etc.) to touch or lap lightly and repeatedly 3. (informal) to defeat or overcome someone easily

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying the tongue across a surface to ingest, groom, or sense, and metaphorically denotes liquids, flames, or waves gently touching and brushing against a boundary.
groups.summary_zh: 指用舌头舔拭、吸吮，或指波浪与火焰轻柔舔触表面。

groups.name: Lie & Recline · 躺卧与平卧 (Recline, Sprawl, Repose)
groups.tip: 身体横躺或仰卧休息

items.def_en: To place oneself in a flat, resting horizontal position on a bed or ground
To lie quietly at rest or peace in sleep, tranquility, or dignified stillness
To lean or lie back horizontally in a relaxed, comfortable resting posture

items.def_zh: 躺，平卧；位于；处于（某种状态）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of lie; to have rested in a flat, horizontal position, or to have remained in a particular state or location.
To lie or sit with one's limbs spread out awkwardly, casually, or carelessly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict resting horizontally on a supportive surface. They differentiate between relaxed reclining, untidy sprawling, and calm, stationary resting postures.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体平放、斜倚或展肢舒躺于平面的静息姿态。

groups.name: Lift & Hoist · 机械吊装与举升 (Hoist, Winch, Haul Up)
groups.tip: 用绳索或吊车起吊重物

items.def_en: To pull or drag something upward with continuous, heavy exertion
To raise something to a higher physical position or level
To raise or pull something up, especially by means of ropes, pulleys, or mechanical equipment.
To lift, raise, or pull something heavy with great muscular effort
To lift or pull something using a mechanical hauling apparatus with a cable or rope

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes raising or lifting heavy objects aloft, frequently with mechanical leverage, ropes, pulleys, or concerted muscular effort.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助器械、绳索或爆发力向上起吊或强行举起。

groups.name: Lift & Hoist · 起吊与绞拉 (Hoist, Haul up, Crane)
groups.tip: 用绞盘绳索机械发力吊起

items.def_en: To pull or drag something heavy upward using sustained force or gear
To move or lift something heavy using a crane or mechanical arm
To raise or pull something up, often with ropes, pulleys, or heavy effort
To lift, pull, or haul something using a mechanical winch.
To lift, raise, or throw something heavy with great effort

groups.summary_en: Specifies moving heavy loads vertically using mechanical aids, tackles, cables, or concentrated physical force.
groups.summary_zh: 借助滑轮、吊车或机械装置吊装拉升重物。

groups.name: Linger & Loiter · 逗留与徘徊 (Linger, Loiter, Tarry)
groups.tip: 迟迟不愿离开原地徘徊

items.def_en: To wait or spend time somewhere doing very little or without clear intent
To remain in a place for a period of time, especially after others have left

items.def_zh: 逗留，徘徊；（感觉、气息等）萦绕，消逝缓慢
items.def_en: 1. To stay somewhere longer than necessary because you are reluctant to leave. 2. (of a smell, feeling, illness, etc.) To take a long time to leave, disappear, or die.
To stand or wait around in a public place without any apparent purpose
(formal or literary) To stay longer than intended; to delay leaving a place

groups.summary_en: This frame captures staying in a place longer than strictly necessary, whether driven by reluctance to leave, aimless idling, or slow persistence of a trace or sensation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在某处过久逗留、漫无目的地闲荡或残存不去。

groups.name: Liquidate & Wind Up · 清算与结算 (Liquidate, Wind Up, Settle)
groups.tip: 清算资产以结清债务

items.def_en: To balance and pay off an account, claim, or balance owed in full.
To bring a company, transaction, or venture to an orderly legal close by resolving all debts.
To exchange investments, stocks, or redeemable tokens for cash value.
To officially and legally bring an organization, partnership, or enterprise to an end.

items.def_zh: 清算（公司等）；变卖（资产）清偿；消灭，处决
items.def_en: 1. To close down a business and sell off its assets to settle debts. 2. To convert assets into cash. 3. To kill or violently eliminate someone.

groups.summary_en: This legal and financial frame describes concluding business operations, converting inventory and assets into liquid currency, and settling outstanding accounts to dissolve an entity or debt structure.
groups.summary_zh: 通过变卖财产、核算款项来清偿债务并注销结清企业或账户。

groups.name: Listing & Cataloging · 罗列与登载 (List, Itemize, Catalog)
groups.tip: 逐条列举罗列清单要点

items.def_zh: 列出，罗列，列入清单；（使船等）倾斜
items.def_en: 1. To write or mention things one after another on a list. 2. (of a ship) To lean or tilt to one side, or cause it to do so.
To make a complete, detailed list of all goods, assets, or possessions held in stock
To record an item systematically in a complete, indexed register or directory
To list every individual item, charge, or expense separately with exact specifications
To arrange figures, survey results, or systematic items systematically in rows and columns

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to writing down, recording, or stating distinct items in an orderly written roll, inventory, or database for documentation, review, or commerce.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人、物或事项逐一登入名册、清单或数据库以供查考或记录。

groups.name: Litigate & Sue · 诉讼与对簿公堂 (Litigate, Sue, Prosecute, Indict)
groups.tip: 对簿公堂进行司法诉讼程序

items.def_en: To start a civil legal process against a person or entity in court to obtain financial damages or rights
To take a grievance or legal dispute before a judge or magistrate for official adjudication
To officially accuse someone of a criminal offense and pursue legal trial on behalf of the state
To formally charge a person with a severe felony through the ruling of a grand jury

items.def_zh: 提起诉讼，对簿公堂；诉讼解决
items.def_en: To take a dispute or claim to a court of law for legal resolution.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the formal domain of initiating legal action, bringing civil claims, or pressing criminal charges against an adversary through court proceedings.
groups.summary_zh: 通过司法途径向法院提起民事起诉、主张权益或对违法行为进行追诉。

groups.name: Load & Burden Down · 载重与使之不堪重负 (Laden, Burden, Encumber, Weigh down)
groups.tip: 承载过多沉重负荷

items.def_zh: 硬塞给……负担；使承受重担
items.def_en: To impose an unwelcome, onerous cargo, debt, or responsibility upon someone

items.def_zh: 装载，使负担（多用作过去分词形式）
items.def_en: (archaic) To load heavily with cargo or burdens; mainly used as a participial adjective meaning heavily loaded or weighed down.
To impede, restrict, or make free movement difficult by loading with luggage or burdens
To cause someone to bend, slow down, or become exhausted by imposing physical or mental heaviness
To load someone or something with a heavy physical weight or distressing responsibility

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame highlight loading cargo, weight, or figurative troubles to near or beyond maximum capacity, resulting in visible strain, sluggishness, or encumbrance.
groups.summary_zh: 指加载沉重货物或精神负担，使之沉重迟缓、不堪重压。

groups.name: Load & Replenish · 装填与重载 (Reload, Recharge, Replenish)
groups.tip: 将货物或弹药装填就位

items.def_en: To load with electrical energy, fresh ammunition, or vital supplies again

items.def_zh: 再装填（弹药）；重新装载（货物）；重新加载（网页或程序）
items.def_en: 1. To put bullets or cartridges into a firearm again. 2. To load goods or data again; refresh a computer page or program.
To fill a container or receptacle again after it has been emptied
To fill something up again with supplies, fuel, or liquid that has been used up

items.def_zh: 重整军备；重新装填武器
items.def_en: To equip an army, weapon, or oneself with weapons or ammunition once again

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying a chamber, container, or technical apparatus with an operational charge, ammunition, fuel, or cargo again after depletion. The focus is functional operational replenishment rather than haphazard filling.
groups.summary_zh: 指耗尽后重新装入弹药、能源、数据或货物以恢复可用状态。

groups.name: Loiter & Mope in Reverie · 闲荡与神伤恍惚 (Mope, Daydream, Laze)
groups.tip: 无所事事闲逛与神游发呆

items.def_zh: 闲逛，发呆，虚度（光阴）；（露出光屁股）搞恶作剧
items.def_en: 1. (often 'moon about/around') To spend time in an aimless, distracted, or daydreaming state. 2. (slang) To expose one's buttocks in public as a joke or insult.
To move aimlessly from place to place or thought to thought without purpose or clear direction
To indulge in pleasant, fanciful, but distracting thoughts while awake

items.def_zh: 郁郁寡欢地闲荡；垂头丧气
items.def_en: To wander about or spend time in a gloomy, depressed, and listless manner
(+ for/after) To yearn deeply and waste away emotionally with lingering grief or lovesickness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict passing time idly in an unfocused, wistful, or melancholy state of mind. They contrast idle romantic distraction with lethargic, dispirited wandering.
groups.summary_zh: 心不在焉、怅然若失地虚度光阴或陷入遐思。

groups.name: Lose & Forfeit · 失去与丧失 (Forfeit, Relinquish, Shed)
groups.tip: 因违规或疏忽而丧失

items.def_en: To give up or let go of something valuable or cherished, often with reluctance

items.def_zh: 丢失，遗失；丧失，失去；输掉
items.def_en: 1. To be unable to find something; to cease to have or retain something. 2. To fail to win a game, contest, or dispute.
To cast off, lose, or get rid of unwanted weight, staff, or attributes
To lose the right to a possession, advantage, or privilege as a consequence of wrongdoing
To involuntarily give up possession, control, or a right to another

groups.summary_en: Covers the outright, often permanent deprivation or surrender of possessions, attributes, resources, or rights. The intensity spans from involuntary deprivation to legal surrender or decisive structural elimination.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对物、权益或优势的彻底丧失、被剥夺或不得不放弃。

groups.name: Lubricate & Grease · 上油与润滑 (Lubricate, Grease, Anoint)
groups.tip: 涂油润滑以减少机件摩擦

items.def_en: To thoroughly apply lubricant or oil to machinery or equipment
To put or rub oil onto machine parts or a surface to make it smooth, lubricated, or functional.
To put thick oil or animal fat on a surface or mechanism
To apply a substance such as oil or grease to reduce friction and allow smooth movement
To smear or rub with oil, often as part of a formal or religious ceremony

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the physical application of slippery, oily, or fatty substances onto surfaces or mechanisms. Core distinctions depend on whether the intent is reducing mechanical friction, waterproofing, or ceremonial coating.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过涂抹油质物以减少机械摩擦或养护表面。

groups.name: Lurk & Skulk · 潜伏与窥伺 (Lurk, Skulk, Slink)
groups.tip: 暗中隐蔽鬼祟偷偷溜行

items.def_zh: 潜伏，埋伏；暗藏，潜存；（在网络社群中）潜水
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/in/behind) To wait or hide secretly in the shadows, especially with bad intentions, or remain hidden as a danger.
To stand or wait around in a public place without any clear purpose, often attracting suspicion
(+ off/away/around) To move quietly and stealthily, typically feeling guilty, ashamed, or fearful of detection

items.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟地潜行或潜伏
items.def_en: (+ around/about/behind) To hide or move around stealthily, often out of cowardice, shame, or sinister intention
(+ for) To conceal oneself and wait patiently in ambush to surprise, attack, or seize someone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote waiting, hiding, or moving covertly in shadows or out of view, typically driven by suspicious, malevolent, or cowardly motives.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中潜伏、窥伺或鬼祟隐匿，常带有不良或怯懦企图。

groups.name: Maim & Injure · 致残与重伤 (Mutilate, Cripple, Disfigure)
groups.tip: 造成肢体缺失或永久残疾的伤害

items.def_zh: 使伤残，使丧失活动机能
items.def_en: to injure someone so severely that they permanently lose normal physical or sensory function
to severely damage someone's legs or spine so that they cannot walk or move properly
to severely wound or injure someone, causing permanent loss or impairment of a limb or body part
to permanently spoil or ruin the physical appearance of someone's face or body

items.def_zh: 毁伤，残害（肢体或身体结构）
items.def_en: to severely damage, dismember, or violently tear away parts of someone's body

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on inflicting catastrophic, irreversible physical trauma on living bodies, specifically targeting limbs, bodily integrity, or permanent physical capability. Verbs range from complete physical incapacitation to permanent aesthetic desecration.
groups.summary_zh: 表示造成永久性伤残、肢体毁损或丧失行动机能。

groups.name: Maintain & Sustain · 保持与维持 (Preserve, Uphold, Keep Up)
groups.tip: 维持原有状态不退化

items.def_zh: 保持，维持；保养，维修；坚持，主张
items.def_en: 1. to make something continue at the same level or standard. 2. to keep a road, machine, or building in good condition by regular repair. 3. to state firmly that something is true.
To supply enough nourishment, energy, or support to keep something continuing over time
To continue to perform, supply, or sustain something at the same high level
To make something last longer than usual or expected
To defend, maintain, or support a legal decision, principle, or high standard

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing ongoing resources, care, or effort to prevent systems, standards, relations, or physical states from degrading or lapsing.
groups.summary_zh: 指持续投入精力、资源或维护措施，使状态、标准或实体长久维系不衰。

groups.name: Make Destitute & Abandon · 致孤与遗弃 (Orphan, Abandon, Cast Off)
groups.tip: 夺走基本权益致其孤立无援

items.def_en: Leave someone isolated and helpless in an inaccessible place or friendless situation
Leave someone to fend for themselves without guidance, family anchors, or social support
Leave a child, vulnerable person, or pet behind without support or intent to return
Leave someone you have a moral or legal obligation to support, especially a spouse or child

items.def_zh: 使成为孤儿；使丧失依靠
items.def_en: (usually passive) To cause a child to become an orphan by the death of their parents.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture the condition of rendering dependents solitary, vulnerable, or utterly without parental care or custodial protection through death, desertion, or callous severance.
groups.summary_zh: 指致使弱小者失去抚养监护人，陷入孤独无援的孤境。

groups.name: Make Metallic Tapping & Knocking · 金属敲击与爆震 (Pink, Ping, Patter)
groups.tip: 用硬物发出短促金属撞击声

items.def_en: To make a light, crisp, metallic or glass-like tapping sound

items.def_zh: （发动机）发生爆震；轻敲，发出叮当声；扎，刺
items.def_en: 1. (of an engine) To make a sharp metallic knocking sound due to improper combustion. 2. To pierce or prick lightly with a pointed weapon.

items.def_zh: 发出清脆的砰砰/当当声；发出轻微金属撞击声
items.def_en: To make a short, high-pitched metallic ringing sound
To make or cause to make a light ringing sound of metal or glass hitting
To make a regular thumping or rattling noise due to faulty combustion

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies generating repetitive, light, sharp, metallic tapping sounds, typified by engine misfires (knocking/pinking) or small hard objects rapidly hitting metal/glass.
groups.summary_zh: 指发动机爆震异响或小硬物快速击打硬物表面发出的轻微尖脆金属敲击声。

groups.name: Make Up & Touch Up · 梳妆打扮与上妆 (Powder, Paint, Touch up)
groups.tip: 涂抹脂粉与精心修饰仪容

items.def_en: Improve the appearance of makeup or an area by making small additions or adjustments
Apply fine cosmetic powder to the face or skin
(dated) To color the cheeks or lips with rouge.

items.def_zh: 梳妆打扮；把…打扮得漂漂亮亮
items.def_en: Dress someone or oneself attractively and apply makeup in an elaborate way
Apply makeup, color, or cosmetics heavily onto the face, lips, or nails

groups.summary_en: Verbs concerning the cosmetic enhancement of the face and body through cosmetics like powder, paint, blush, or quick touch-ups to improve personal appearance.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用粉底、彩妆等化妆品涂抹面容或修饰仪表容貌。

groups.name: Malinger & Feign Illness · 装病避役与偷懒欺瞒 (Malinger, Feign, Sham)
groups.tip: 装病装弱以逃避工作职责

items.def_en: To avoid work, school, or duty by slacking, slipping away, or making false excuses
To falsely claim, simulate, or display an illness or condition
To invent pretexts or feign incapacity to shirk assignment and idle on duty
To simulate or pretend to be affected by an illness, feeling, or state

items.def_zh: 装病（以逃避工作或职责）
items.def_en: To pretend to be ill or injured in order to avoid work, duty, or responsibility.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to dishonestly simulating illness, incapacity, or distress specifically to evade work, military duty, or unpleasant obligations. They highlight deliberate deception aimed at dodging responsibility.
groups.summary_zh: 指为逃避工作、责任或兵役而故意装病、假装伤残的欺瞒行为。

groups.name: Man & Crew · 配备人员 (Staff, Man, Outfit)
groups.tip: 为船舰或项目充实值守人手

items.def_en: To fill or furnish a place or administrative body with people
To supply a place, vehicle, or piece of equipment with personnel to operate it
To provide the personnel needed to run an organization, department, or office

items.def_zh: 为……配备船员（或机组人员）；充当船员（或工作人员）
items.def_en: 1. To provide a ship, aircraft, or vehicle with a crew. 2. To serve as a member of a crew.
To provide a team or expedition with necessary equipment, supplies, and staff

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with supplying, allocating, or assigning human personnel and specialized labor to operate an organization, facility, or craft.
groups.summary_zh: 指为机构、设施或载具调配、配置必要的工作人员。

groups.name: Manner of Speaking (Vocal Cadence) · 言谈腔调与语速 (Mumble, Slur, Twang)
groups.tip: 慢吞吞拖长声调发音的说话方式

items.def_en: To speak in a low voice that is not clear and is difficult for other people to hear

items.def_zh: 慢吞吞地说，拖长声调说
items.def_en: To speak slowly with vowel sounds drawn out longer than usual.
To speak with a sharp, resonant nasal quality or strong regional accent
To speak for a long time in a dull, monotonous, and unchanging tone
To speak indistinctly without pronouncing sounds clearly, often due to tiredness or alcohol

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize distinct acoustic manners, cadences, or impediments in vocal delivery, such as speaking draggingly, indistinctly, or with particular regional inflections.
groups.summary_zh: 指说话时独特的语速、发音拖沓度或含糊方式。

groups.name: Map, Survey & Plot · 地籍测绘与规划标绘 (Plat, Plot, Chart)
groups.tip: 画地界图或平面测绘图

items.def_en: To measure and examine the features of an area of land scientifically in order to prepare a map
To mark points or trace lines representing positions, courses, or measurements on a map or chart
To record or map the geographic features, coastline, or movement across an area on a chart
To produce a comprehensive map of a territory or outline a precise, detailed plan

items.def_zh: 绘制（土地分界图、地籍图）
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly US / surveying) To draw a detailed map or plan of a piece of land divided into building lots.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this technical surveying and cartographic frame involve measuring, delineating, and drafting precise plans, layouts, or boundaries of geographic land, parcels, or navigational courses according to mathematical or legal conventions.
groups.summary_zh: 指对土地、航线或疆界进行精密测绘、标绘并绘制地块图纸的行为。

groups.name: Mark & Record with Chalk · 用粉笔书写与记账 (Chalk, Slate, Chalk up)
groups.tip: 用粉笔或石膏在表面标记描摹

items.def_zh: 取得（成功、胜利）；将……归咎于
items.def_en: To achieve, record, or credit a success, score, or mistake to someone or something
To sketch or outline the details of a plan or project in a preliminary way
To schedule, plan, or designate someone or something for a particular event or role
To record, count, or calculate an ongoing score, amount, or points

items.def_zh: 用粉笔写，用粉笔画；记录
items.def_en: 1. To write, mark, or draw something with chalk. 2. ('chalk up') To achieve or record a success, score, or debt.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to writing, sketching, or tallying points and debts using chalk or an erasable board, often extending metaphorically to recording achievements or scheduling events.
groups.summary_zh: 指用粉笔或写字板进行书写、标记、记账或记录成绩的动作。

groups.name: Master & Dominate Skill · 精通与完全掌握 (Command, Excel at, Perfect)
groups.tip: 从理解领会到运用自如

items.def_en: To definitively understand, settle, or execute a complex technique or detail
To be exceptionally good or proficient at doing an activity
To learn or understand something thoroughly so that you can do it skillfully; to control or overcome an emotion or difficulty.

items.def_zh: 精通，娴熟掌握（语言、技能等）
items.def_en: To have a full, fluent, and powerful working mastery of a subject or language
To hone a skill, technique, or craft until it leaves no room for improvement

groups.summary_en: This frame spans the upper echelons of cognitive and practical competence, moving beyond mere understanding into effortless command, refined execution, and total expertise.
groups.summary_zh: 超越基础认知，达到对技艺或知识的彻底精通与自如掌控。

groups.name: Mat & Felt · 粘结与结成硬团 (Felt, Clump, Clog)
groups.tip: 线缕毛发互相盘绕缠结成团

items.def_en: To mat together wool, hair, or fibers into a dense, compacted non-woven fabric
To form into a compact, hard crust or solid mass, especially through drying or pressing
1. To tangle or twist together into a thick, messy, and compact mass.
To become tied or twisted into a tight, hard, inextricable lump or mass
To gather or compress into a thick, compacted group, lump, or messy knot

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail fibrous, filamentous, or hairy strands becoming pressed, compacted, and tightly felted together into a dense, solid, unyielding mass.
groups.summary_zh: 强调纤维、毛发或毛线紧密缠结、压实硬化成密不可分的板结团块。

groups.name: Match & Equal Benchmark · 达标与持平 (Par, Match, Equal)
groups.tip: 达到既定水准或预期目标

items.def_en: To be equal to another in quality, value, performance, or quantity
To achieve exactly the same level, score, or standard as another or as a benchmark
(+ to) To reach the required, expected, or satisfactory standard
To bring oneself or something to an equal score or status with a competitor
(in golf) To score the standard number of strokes on a hole.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on achieving a predetermined baseline, standard, or rival benchmark, whether matching a par score in golf or meeting an expected performance threshold in finance and skill.
groups.summary_zh: 指达到预设基准、标准，或在成绩、表现上与既定目标持平。

groups.name: Match & Fit · 契合与对应 (Correspond, Mirror, Align)
groups.tip: 平行对比或遥相呼应

items.def_en: (+ to/with) To match, be similar to, or have a direct equivalent in another system
(+ with) To agree with, match, or correspond correctly to a standard or counterpart
To reflect, simulate, or closely duplicate the features or behaviour of something else
1. To be similar to, correspond with, or equal something. 2. To run or extend in the same direction alongside something.
(+ with) To fit together smoothly, precisely, and harmoniously like interlocking joints

groups.summary_en: Verbs here highlight structural analogy, directional concurrence, or harmonious mirroring between distinct sets, systems, or historical trajectories.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重于事物在结构、形态、走势或特性上的对应、映射与高度呼应。

groups.name: Match & Fit · 相当与匹敌 (Match, Rival, Tie)
groups.tip: 程度相当或完全相等

items.def_en: (+ to) To be good enough or possess the qualities required to match an expected benchmark
To be equal to something else in quality, value, size, or strength
(+ with) To achieve the exact same score or position as a competitor

items.def_zh: 等于，相等；比得上，敌得过
items.def_en: 1. To be the same in quantity, size, number, value, or status as something else. 2. To match or be as good as someone or something else.
To be comparable or almost identical in outstanding excellence or power

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on equivalence in capability, quantity, or merit, indicating that one party measures up to another across a measurable dimension.
groups.summary_zh: 表明在数量、价值、水平或地位上与另一方旗鼓相当、达到均等。

groups.name: Matriculate & Enroll · 录取与注册入学 (Matriculate, Enroll, Register)
groups.tip: 正式录取入学或吸纳加入

items.def_en: To allow someone to enter an institution, especially a university or college, as a student
To record a person's name on an official institutional list to attend classes or a course of study
To commit formally to a structured course of training or study
To officially register or be registered as a member or student of a school, course, or program
(formal) To officially admit or be admitted as a student into a college or university.

groups.summary_en: Designates official academic and institutional accession, whereby an applicant is accepted, admitted, and recorded into formal registers at schools, colleges, or credentialed programs.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过审核正式被学术机构录取、缴费登记或办理学籍注册手续。

groups.name: Matter & Count · 关乎与重要 (Matter, Count, Signify)
groups.tip: 具备分量与重要性

items.def_en: To be important, significant, or of consequence.
(+ in) To be an important part of an ongoing process, plan, or calculation
To have importance, value, or influence on a situation
To exert powerful influence, authority, or credibility in decision-making
To have great importance or significance, especially regarding an outcome

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses stative verbs expressing significance, consequence, and meaningful weight within a given context. They denote whether something truly affects the outcome, is valued, or holds importance.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物具备分量、具有决定性意义或对全局产生不可忽视的实质影响。

groups.name: Measure Dimensions & Tolerance · 精密测径与规测 (Gauge, Micrometer, Metrize)
groups.tip: 借助仪器度量判定规格

items.def_en: To determine the exact physical dimensions of an object or sort items according to size specifications
To measure minute linear distances, thicknesses, or diameters using a micrometer screw gauge
To take full, detailed physical measurements of an object, room, or workpiece

items.def_zh: 用量规测定；精密测量（尺寸、间隙）
items.def_en: To measure the exact size, diameter, thickness, or capacity of an object using an instrument
to measure the thickness or diameter of something using calipers

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to utilizing specialized engineering or precision contact instruments to determine physical dimensions such as thickness, bore, or diameter.
groups.summary_zh: 使用量规、分厘卡等精细工量具测定工件的厚度、口径或公差。

groups.name: Mechanical Leverage & Shifting · 杠杆搬移与撬动 (Lever, Heave, Winkle)
groups.tip: 利用杠杆原理撬开或移动重物

items.def_zh: 挪动，撬动分毫（多用于否定）
items.def_en: Move even slightly under heavy pressure or effort (usually negative)
Pry or extract something stuck fast in an awkward or recessed space
To lift, move, or force something open using a lever or lever-like action.
Force, lever, or wedge something heavy using a metal crowbar
Lift, pull, or throw a heavy load with immense physical exertion

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the physical exertion and use of leverage mechanisms (bars, fulcrums, mechanical advantage) to heave, dislodge, or move heavy, stubborn items.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用杠杆原理、工具或极大臂力来撬离、挪动沉重或固定的物体。

groups.name: Mechanical Press & Typography · 印刷与上版 (Typeset, Stamp, Run off)
groups.tip: 油墨排版印刷复制图文

items.def_zh: 印刷；打印；用印刷体书写；铭刻
items.def_en: 1. To produce books, newspapers, or documents using ink and a printing press or printer. 2. To write words without joining the letters together.
(+ on/with) To imprint a character, mark, or seal onto an item by forceful pressing

items.def_zh: 印出，快速印刷（大量复本）
items.def_en: To quickly print or duplicate a specific batch of leaflets, proofs, or documents
(+ on/with) To stamp or press a mark, pattern, or text deeply onto a surface
To arrange text and typography in preparation for printing

groups.summary_en: Centers on the physical and mechanical act of transferring text, ink, or patterns onto paper or substrate using presses, plates, or printers. Typical collocates include newspaper, press, ink, page, and proof.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过机器、印版或墨水将文字图形物理印刷在纸张上。

groups.name: Meddle & Tamper · 乱动与瞎插手 (Tamper, Meddle, Tinker, Mess with)
groups.tip: 暗中乱动或不当乱碰

items.def_en: To touch, tamper with, or meddle with something inappropriately, risking damage or trouble
To handle or fool around with a delicate device or system heedlessly and without proper knowledge

items.def_zh: 暗中乱动，胡乱摆弄；篡改
items.def_en: 1. ('tamper with') To touch, alter, or interfere with something secretly and without permission, often causing damage.
(+ with) To make small, experimental, or amateurish changes to a machine, plan, or system
(+ in/with) To interfere in or pry into matters that are not one's concern or business

groups.summary_en: This frame covers unauthorized, unwanted, or inexpert physical and figurative interference. Agents disturb a delicate mechanism, system, or another person's private affairs without permission, often causing accidental damage or unwarranted friction.
groups.summary_zh: 指未经许可或盲目胡乱干预、触碰或调整系统、机械及他人私事。

groups.name: Mediate & Diplomatic Reconciliation · 穿梭斡旋与促成和解 (Reconcile, Mediate, Intercede)
groups.tip: 重修旧好恢复社会关系和谐

items.def_en: (+ with) To bring hostilities to an end and re-establish a condition of friendly relations.
To act as an impartial intermediary between disputing groups to help them reach an agreement.

items.def_zh: 使和解，使重归于好；使一致，调和；使顺从
items.def_en: 1. To restore friendly relations between people or groups who have disagreed. 2. To find a way in which two conflicting ideas, beliefs, or facts can both exist together.
To bring divergent viewpoints, interests, or principles into peaceful and consistent agreement.
(+ with/for) To intervene on behalf of another party to plead for mercy, relief, or a favorable compromise.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stepping in between alienated or warring sides to bridge differences, align opposing viewpoints, and restore amicable diplomatic, marital, or social relations.
groups.summary_zh: 指居间斡旋、弥合隔阂，使对立双方重修旧好或使矛盾观念达成一致。

groups.name: Medical Burning & Tissue Ablation · 灼烙与消融 (Cauterize, Sear, Lance)
groups.tip: 用烙铁烧烙止血治愈伤口

items.def_en: To remove unwanted skin growths or blemishes using acid, cryotherapy, or targeted heat

items.def_zh: 用柳叶刀刺破，切开（脓肿）
items.def_en: To cut open a boil, abscess, or infected swelling with a surgical instrument to release fluid
To burn or scorch skin or a wound with extreme heat to arrest bleeding or destroy tissue

items.def_zh: 烧灼，烙（伤口以止血或防感染）
items.def_en: 1. (medicine) To burn a wound or tissue with a heated instrument or chemical to stop bleeding or prevent infection.
To remove or destroy body tissue surgically, typically using lasers, heat, or radiofrequency

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe medical or surgical interventions involving extreme heat, chemicals, or incisions to seal wounds, stop hemorrhage, or remove diseased tissue.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及以高温、化学制剂或创口处置来止血或清除病变组织的操作。

groups.name: Medicate & Dose · 用药与服毒 (Dose, Medicate, Self-medicate)
groups.tip: 超量或规范服用药物场景

items.def_en: To administer a measured amount of medicine or drug to a person or animal
To choose and consume medications, alcohol, or illicit drugs to manage illness or stress without professional supervision
1. (+ on) To take an excessive and dangerous amount of a drug. 2. (+ on) (informal) To do, consume, or experience too much of something.
To treat someone or oneself with medical drugs or pharmaceutical substances
To give someone drugs in order to make them calm, sleepy, or unconscious

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on administering or consuming pharmacological substances or toxins. Verbs characterize intentional medical dosing, self-treatment, or drug overuse.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及摄入或给予药物、药剂，涵盖遵医嘱服药、自行用药及过量用药。

groups.name: Memorialize & Immortalize · 载入史册与缅怀 (Immortalize, Chronicle, Monument)
groups.tip: 举行仪式铭记过往人物与事件

items.def_en: To treat someone as a celebrated hero or public celebrity worthy of great homage
To record a detailed historical account of momentous events or lives over time
To confer endless fame upon a person or event through art, literature, or memory

items.def_zh: 纪念，缅怀；向……递交请愿书
items.def_en: 1. To preserve the memory of a person or event with a monument, ceremony, or tribute. 2. (formal) To submit a formal memorial or petition to.
To praise someone highly in speech or writing, especially in tribute after death

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on discursive, artistic, or material preservation of a person or heroic deed in the collective memory, creating an enduring legacy that resists oblivion.
groups.summary_zh: 通过立传、著书、艺术或丰碑让人物与事迹万古流芳，免遭遗忘。

groups.name: Mention & Allude · 提及与谈及 (Mention, Allude, Touch on)
groups.tip: 顺带说起或郑重声明某事

items.def_en: To introduce a particular subject or topic into a conversation or meeting for consideration
To speak or write about a subject briefly, in passing, or as part of a wider discussion
1. To speak or write about someone or something briefly or without going into detail.
(+ to) To refer to someone or something indirectly or in passing
To mention or refer to something as an example, proof, or authority in support of an argument

groups.summary_en: This frame pertains to briefly or cursorily introducing a subject into conversation or text without giving full elaboration or exhaustive treatment.
groups.summary_zh: 简要提及、带过或间接暗示某人某事。

groups.name: Mention & Refer · 提及与指涉 (Allude to, Refer to, Touch upon)
groups.tip: 言语间顺带提及或引出某话题

items.def_en: To mention something in an indirect, glancing, or roundabout way
To refer back to an earlier subject, memory, or historical period
To mention or speak about someone or something directly in discourse
To mention something as a reason or example to support a point

items.def_zh: 提及，谈及（常与 to 连用）；引起注意
items.def_en: ('advert to') To refer to, make mention of, or draw attention to a subject.

groups.summary_en: Concerns directing attention toward an existing matter, document, or precedent, ranging from explicit citation to oblique passing reference.
groups.summary_zh: 以直接提及或暗指的方式引述某事或前情。

groups.name: Mesmerize & Enchant · 入迷与沉醉 (Mesmerize, Spellbind, Captivate)
groups.tip: 心神完全被吸引，如坠梦境之中

items.def_zh: 使入迷，使沉醉；使发呆，使恍惚
items.def_en: To put someone into a trance, or enchant and captivate someone completely.
To attract and hold someone's interest and affection intensely
To hold someone's full attention completely as if by a hypnotic spell
To keep someone so deeply interested that they listen or watch with complete devotion
To capture complete fascination and attention, rendering listeners or viewers utterly silent

groups.summary_en: This frame captures high-intensity psychological states of awe, fascination, or cognitive paralysis induced by beauty, skill, or supernatural charm, rendering the subject spellbound and unable to divert attention.
groups.summary_zh: 指因极致的美、艺术或魅力而使人深度着迷、失魂落魄或恍惚凝神。

groups.name: Mess & Dishevel Hair · 弄乱头发 (Ruffle, Tousle, Muss)
groups.tip: 揉搓抓乱头发或使之蓬乱

items.def_en: To spoil the neat or orderly state of hair or an appearance

items.def_zh: 使凌乱，弄乱（尤指头发或衣服）
items.def_en: To make someone's hair or clothing untidy or messy, often used with 'up'
To touch or run fingers through someone's hair, feathers, or smooth surface, disturbing its smoothness
To make someone's hair untidy or disheveled.

items.def_zh: 使蓬乱，使发型或衣冠不整
items.def_en: To throw someone's hair or clothing into untidy disarray, typically through wind, struggle, or neglect

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe disturbing the neat arrangement of hair or feathers, often playfully, affectionately, or through wind and rough handling.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过抚摩、抓弄或风吹将头发或羽毛弄乱、弄蓬松。

groups.name: Message & Notify Digitally · 发信通知与联络 (Message, Text, Ping)
groups.tip: 正式将消息或情况传达对方

items.def_en: To send a written electronic message to someone via phone, computer, or messaging app.
To send a written SMS or electronic message to someone using a mobile phone

items.def_zh: 私信，发送直接私密消息
items.def_en: To send a direct private message to someone on a social media platform
(+ to) To contact someone electronically or by phone in order to communicate or seek assistance
To send a brief electronic message, notification, or alert to someone to get their attention

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate transmitting brief electronic communications, notifications, or alerts directly to individuals via digital devices, chat tools, or networks.
groups.summary_zh: 特指通过手机、即时通信软件等数字化媒介快速发送消息或提示。

groups.name: Misalign & Skew · 错位与偏离基准 (Misalign, Skew, Cock)
groups.tip: 失去规整对齐状态发生偏离

items.def_en: To tilt, lean, or pitch to one side out of a level or vertical position
To tilt or turn something (such as the head, a hat, or an ear) obliquely upward or to one side
To shift out of a straight row or orderly linear orientation
To turn or place at an angle rather than straight, or to suddenly swerve out of true alignment

items.def_zh: 使排列不当，使错位；错位，未对齐
items.def_en: 1. To position or fall out of proper straight alignment or coordination.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses spatial positioning where an object, component, or system veers out of a true straight line, parallel plane, or coordinated orientation. Verbs contrast deliberate asymmetrical tilt with mechanical errors or accidental distortion.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或部件偏离直线、基准面或既定坐标而失去对准。

groups.name: Misbehave & Transgress · 违规与越轨 (Misbehave, Transgress, Flout)
groups.tip: 从行为不当到逾矩违纪

items.def_en: To behave badly, disruptively, or inappropriately

items.def_zh: 行为不端，违规，举止失礼
items.def_en: To behave badly, inappropriately, or against rules.
(+ from) To depart noticeably from standard, accepted, or expected behavior

items.def_zh: 公然蔑视；无视（法规或习俗）
items.def_en: To openly disregard and break a rule, law, or accepted custom

items.def_zh: 越轨；逾越（道德或法律界限）
items.def_en: To cross moral, ethical, or legal boundaries

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote acting outside accepted codes of conduct, morality, or institutional rules, scaling from childish naughtiness to deliberate defiance and ethical violation.
groups.summary_zh: 指违背规矩、逾越道德界限或故意公然对抗守则。

groups.name: Mismatch & Clash · 错配与失调 (Mismatch, Clasp, Jar)
groups.tip: 使双方协调一致配合

items.def_en: (+ with) To be incompatible or in direct opposition in values, roles, or attributes
(+ with) To look awkward, disharmonious, or inappropriate together
(+ with) To be unpleasantly discordant, incongruous, or out of place

items.def_zh: 使错配，使不相称地结合
items.def_en: To pair or combine people or things that are unsuitable, incompatible, or unequal to each other.
To position components out of correct linear or functional alignment with each other

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame address faulty pairing, incongruity, or disharmony where coupled entities fail to align, fit together, or work cooperatively.
groups.summary_zh: 指搭配失当、未能形成平衡契合，导致相互冲突或不相称的关系。

groups.name: Misplace & Lose Track · 遗落与误放 (Mislay, Lose track of, Displace)
groups.tip: 因疏忽而失去或放错

items.def_en: To let something fall or be left inadvertently behind while moving
To forget to take something along when departing from a place
To fail to stay aware of the location, progress, or state of something or someone

items.def_zh: 放错地方；错误地寄托（信任、希望等）
items.def_en: 1. To put something in an unintended place and temporarily lose it. 2. To direct trust, affection, or confidence toward an unworthy person or cause.
To put something in an unremembered location so that it cannot be found for a while

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the unintentional putting of an object in the wrong place, resulting in temporary inability to find it while retaining legal ownership. It stresses human carelessness and accidental spatial confusion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因疏忽将物品误放错处而一时寻觅无果的动作情态。

groups.name: Misquote & Distort Citation · 误引与断章取义 (Misquote, Misattribute, Twist)
groups.tip: 引用原句或用自己语言转述

items.def_zh: 张冠李戴，错误归属（引文出处）
items.def_en: To incorrectly assign words, an artwork, or a quote to the wrong author or speaker

items.def_zh: 错误地引用，断章取义地引述
items.def_en: to repeat or cite someone's words incorrectly or inaccurately

items.def_zh: 严重歪曲，读错或转述错（原话）
items.def_en: To ruin, butcher, or badly misstate a quotation, text, or pronunciation

items.def_zh: 曲解，窜改，把…传得面目全非
items.def_en: To reproduce a message or quote in an inaccurate, confused, or distorted manner
To intentionally alter the meaning of someone's words or statement to suit one's own agenda

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame identify faulty, disingenuous, or inaccurate citations where someone's original words or context are mangled or falsely credited.
groups.summary_zh: 错误转述原话、曲解语境或张冠李戴地引证他人名言。

groups.name: Misspell & Miswrite · 拼写错误与笔误 (Misspell, Misprint, Mistype)
groups.tip: 拼写出现错漏或字母拼错

items.def_en: To make a careless mistake while writing, calculating, or performing a routine task
To print a letter, word, or symbol incorrectly in a publication
To make a mistake when typing a word, number, or document
To spell a word with the wrong letters or in the wrong order

items.def_zh: 错乱地拼写/表达；使混乱
items.def_en: To reproduce text, messages, or sounds in a confused or distorted way that is hard to understand

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe producing erroneous written forms, faulty orthography, or typographical slips during composition.
groups.summary_zh: 指在文字书写、拼读或排印过程中出现差错或笔误。

groups.name: Mix & Debase · 掺和与合金化 (Alloy, Adulterate, Blend)
groups.tip: 成分互相融合一体

items.def_en: To combine two or more distinct parts, elements, or ingredients into a single composite substance.
To join together or blend completely by melting, heating, or applying intense pressure.

items.def_zh: 将……铸成合金，使成合金；使减低成色，使受损
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To mix two or more metals together to form an alloy. 2. To impair, weaken, or lower the value or purity of something by adding an inferior element.
To mix or combine mercury with another metal, or more broadly to unite distinct elements into a whole.
To corrupt, debase, or make impure by adding inferior, alien, or improper substances.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to combining metals or mixing substances, often with the effect or intention of altering purity, quality, or value. They range from metallurgical fusing to diluting or corrupting a base material.
groups.summary_zh: 强调混合金属或加入次等成分以改变纯度、品质或强度。

groups.name: Moisten & Douse · 浇润与漫灌 (Drench, Saturate, Water)
groups.tip: 浇灌水流润透土地

items.def_en: To pour or spray water onto soil, crops, or plants to promote growth
To wet or wash down heavily using a high-flow water hose
To soak so thoroughly with moisture that no more liquid can be absorbed
To soak completely and thoroughly with a large volume of liquid
1. To supply dry land or crops with water through pipes, ditches, or sprinklers. 2. To wash out or clean a wound or body cavity with a flow of liquid.

groups.summary_en: Covers applying water or moisture to soil, plants, surfaces, or wounds, varying from gentle hydration to complete soaking.
groups.summary_zh: 通过喷洒、浇注等方式为土壤、植物或表面补给水分以达滋润或浸透。

groups.name: Monetize & Liquidate · 变现与套现 (Monetize, Liquidate, Cash in)
groups.tip: 将无形资产转化为流动现金

items.def_zh: 变现；把（财产等）换成现钱
items.def_en: To convert property, shares, or goods into money through sale

items.def_zh: 兑现；（借助有利时机）套现
items.def_en: To exchange securities or vouchers for cash, or to profit from an advantage or situation
To sell one's stake, shares, or chips in exchange for currency and exit an investment
To sell property or assets to obtain cash, especially to pay debts

items.def_zh: 将……变现，通过……赚钱；定为法定货币
items.def_en: 1. To convert an asset, service, or website traffic into money or revenue. 2. To establish something as legal currency.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in business and finance describing the conversion of intangible assets, inventory, or investments into immediate cash or revenue.
groups.summary_zh: 指将无形资产、库存或金融投资兑换为现款或营业收入。

groups.name: Monopolize & Corner · 垄断与操纵 (Corner, Monopolize, Control)
groups.tip: 从占据优势到全面垄断

items.def_en: To gain complete control of a market, business opportunity, or deal so that others cannot participate
To take or use more than one's fair share of something selfishly, preventing others from sharing it

items.def_zh: 垄断（市场等）；将……逼入绝境，使走投无路
items.def_en: 1. To gain control of all or most of a particular stock, commodity, or market; monopolize. 2. To force a person or animal into a place from which escape is difficult or impossible.
To buy up wholesale commodities in large quantities to secure a monopoly and raise prices
To obtain or maintain exclusive possession or complete control of a trade, market, or resource

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe aggressively seizing dominant control over a market, commodity, or supply to dictate terms or exclude competitors. While 'corner' emphasizes securing control of a limited supply, 'monopolize' refers to holding exclusive power over an entire sector.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过囤积或施加绝对控制来操纵、垄断市场或供应以排除竞争。

groups.name: Mooch & Solicit · 蹭要与索取小利 (Bum, Mooch, Scrounge)
groups.tip: 放低姿态向人求取物品

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To ask for and get something for free from someone. 2. ('bum around') To wander around lazily without doing useful work.
To approach someone to ask for money, a loan, or a favor
To obtain something from someone else without paying or working for it
To collect or obtain something scarce or needed by searching around or asking others
To drain resources, money, or favors persistently from another like a parasite

groups.summary_en: This colloquial frame highlights coaxing, cadging, or scrounging petty consumables (cigarettes, drinks, change) off friends or acquaintances without intent to repay.
groups.summary_zh: 指占便宜向熟人讨要烟酒零钱等小恩小惠。

groups.name: Moralize & Preach · 说教与好为人师 (Moralize, Preach, Sermonize)
groups.tip: 好为人师居高临下大谈道德教条

items.def_en: To talk to someone in an angry or dismissive way, reprimanding their conduct as if to a child
To give unwanted, patronizing moral advice to someone in a pious, self-righteous manner
To express moral judgments or talk about good and bad behavior in a self-righteous, lecturing way

items.def_zh: 布道般说教；发长篇大论
items.def_en: To deliver a pompous, tedious lecture on proper conduct to someone

items.def_zh: 武断表态；自命不凡地宣讲
items.def_en: To express one's opinions in a dogmatic, pompous, or self-important manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey giving unsolicited, patronizing, or self-righteous ethical lectures, often causing irritation in the listener.
groups.summary_zh: 指自以为是地讲大道理、训诫或令人厌烦的说教。

groups.name: Mortgage & Pledge · 抵押与质押 (Mortgage, Pledge, Pawn)
groups.tip: 以财物作担保换贷款

items.def_zh: 抵押（借款）；以……为担保；使受拖累
items.def_en: 1. To give a lender the legal claim to property as security for a loan. 2. To pledge or put something at risk for future gains.
To give something valuable as a formal security deposit until a debt is paid.
(formal/law) To pledge property as collateral without surrendering possession of it.
To change your mortgage provider or borrow extra money against your property.
To leave an article of personal property with a pawnbroker in exchange for borrowed cash.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on transferring property rights or physical chattels to a creditor as a security pledge for borrowed money, risking forfeiture upon default.
groups.summary_zh: 将不动产或贵重动产典当、质押以获取借贷担保。

groups.name: Mothball & Postpone · 封存与搁置 (Shelve, Pigeonhole, Table)
groups.tip: 将项目搁置或封存设备

items.def_en: To postpone consideration of a motion or proposal indefinitely (especially US usage)
To postpone, delay, or keep a plan or project in an inactive state for a period of time
To decide not to proceed with a project, proposal, or plan for the present or permanently
to put equipment, a facility, or a project into long-term storage or on hold, keeping it intact for possible future use.
To put aside a proposal, matter, or problem and intentionally neglect or defer taking action on it

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this administrative frame describe placing operations, equipment, infrastructure, or policy initiatives into prolonged suspension while maintaining the capability to reactivate them later.
groups.summary_zh: 暂停并长期封存设施、项目或议案，留待未来重启处置。

groups.name: Motion & Direct by Gesture · 手势指引与示意 (Motion, Gesture, Signal)
groups.tip: 借肢体手势动作传情达意

items.def_en: to extend a finger or hand to show someone a specific direction or location
to make a movement or sound that sends a specific instruction or piece of information to someone
to make a movement of the hand, head, or body to give someone an instruction or direction
to move your hands, head, or arms to express an idea, instruction, or feeling
to politely guide or direct someone where to go, often using sweeping hand gestures

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on using bodily gestures—typically of the hands, head, or eyes—to direct someone's movement, indicate a seat, or convey a specific non-verbal instruction. They emphasize instructional direction rather than merely saying hello.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手势或眼神指引他人移动、就座或遵照具体无声指令行动。

groups.name: Mount & Ready Weaponry · 装置弹药与搭弦就位 (Nock, Mount, Prime)
groups.tip: 把箭尾准确扣上弓弦待发

items.def_en: To fit or press a mechanical part, valve, or round firmly and accurately into place
To set up or fix a weapon, camera, or piece of equipment firmly in place for use
To insert a cartridge into the firing chamber of a firearm ready to be shot
To tilt, set, or raise the hammer of a gun back into firing position

items.def_zh: 把（箭）搭在弦上；在……上刻凹痕
items.def_en: 1. To fit the notched end of an arrow onto a bowstring ready for shooting. 2. To make a notch in something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe seating, fitting, or locking a projectile, weapon, or component into its designated firing position or launch apparatus so it stands ready for discharge.
groups.summary_zh: 指将箭、弹药或部件对位卡入发射装置，使其处于待发就位状态。

groups.name: Multitasking & Juggling Demands · 协调多务与应付周旋 (Balance, Juggle, Keep in the air)
groups.tip: 用双手灵活操控或应付

items.def_zh: 平衡，兼顾（多项职责或需求）
items.def_en: Give equal attention or appropriate priority to competing commitments, needs, or duties

items.def_zh: 频繁调换，随机倒换（日程或任务）
items.def_en: Reorder, shift, or manipulate schedules and duties continuously to accommodate demands

items.def_zh: 维持，应付（多项繁杂事务不致断档）
items.def_en: Manage to sustain a rapid tempo of simultaneous commitments without failing

items.def_zh: 多任务处理，同时处理多项事务
items.def_en: Perform more than one activity, project, or role at the same time

items.def_zh: 耍弄，玩杂耍（抛接物体）；同时兼顾，巧妙应付
items.def_en: 1. To keep several objects in the air at the same time by tossing and catching them. 2. To manage several activities, responsibilities, or requirements at the same time.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures handling, balancing, and shuffling multiple conflicting obligations, tasks, or resources simultaneously, requiring continuous dexterity and prioritization to prevent collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 指同时巧妙兼顾、周旋处理多项繁复任务或相互冲突的职责。

groups.name: Mumble & Slur · 咕哝与含糊不清 (Slur, Mumble, Mutter)
groups.tip: 口齿不清且音节粘连含混

items.def_en: To form words with the lips without uttering clear sound, or to speak insincerely and indistinctly

items.def_zh: 含糊不清地发音，含糊地念；诋毁，诽谤
items.def_en: 1. To pronounce words unclearly or indistinctly so that the sounds run together. 2. To make an insulting remark that damages someone's reputation.
To speak in a low, unclear voice with the mouth barely open
To say something in a quiet, indistinct voice, often in complaint or irritation
To distort or jumble speech or a message so much that it becomes incomprehensible

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe producing speech where phonetic boundaries blur and syllables run together indistinctly, caused by intoxication, tiredness, shyness, or speech impediments.
groups.summary_zh: 因含糊、醉酒或说话不清导致音节混杂或吐字难以辨识。

groups.name: Mural & Wall Painting · 壁画与湿壁画绘制 (Fresco, Mural, Stencil)
groups.tip: 美术技艺，在壁面创作

items.def_zh: 在墙壁上作画；绘制壁画
items.def_en: To execute or apply a large painting or decorative design directly onto a wall surface
To draw or spray paint unauthorized words or images on a public wall or structure
To cover a decorative surface, molding, or painted surface with a thin layer of gold leaf or paint
1. (art) To paint a picture directly onto fresh, wet plaster on a wall or ceiling.

items.def_zh: 用模版印刷图案；模印涂绘
items.def_en: To apply designs, letters, or shapes onto a surface by brushing ink or paint through a cut-out pattern

groups.summary_en: This specialized fine-arts frame focuses on applying artistic imagery, decorative designs, or pigments onto architectural surfaces such as interior walls, ceilings, and plasterwork using specific architectural and decorative techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 特指在建筑墙体、灰泥或天花板等基面上运用特定工艺绘制壁画与图案。

groups.name: Murmur & Chatter · 喃喃与絮语 (Babble, Gabble, Prattle)
groups.tip: 压低声音含混不清地自语

items.def_en: To talk informally, easily, and continuously about trivial or everyday matters
To talk quickly in a way that is confused, foolish, or difficult to understand
To talk a great deal about unimportant things in an idle or childish manner

items.def_zh: 嘟嘟囔囔地说，连珠炮似地念叨；发出潺潺声，作汩汩响
items.def_en: 1. To speak rapidly, excitedly, or foolishly for a long time. 2. (of water) To make a continuous soft, bubbling sound.
To speak so fast and indistinctly that others cannot understand clearly

groups.summary_en: Highlights continuous, rapid, or inconsequential flow of speech resembling running water or childish babble. Contrasts rambling nonsense with cheerful stream-like babbling.
groups.summary_zh: 表示滔滔不绝、含糊或孩子气地絮叨，常比作流水潺潺。

groups.name: Muscle & Force Passage · 挤入与凭力硬闯 (Muscle, Elbow, Barge)
groups.tip: 施加蛮力强行挤入通过

items.def_en: To insinuate or move oneself slowly and persistently into a tight space or exclusive organization
To force a route through a dense crowd by pushing people aside with one's elbows
To force a passage through a crowd by thrusting with one's shoulders

items.def_zh: 硬挤，强行推入；施加蛮力（介入）
items.def_en: To move, force, or elbow one's way into a place or situation through sheer strength or determination.
To move forward aggressively and clumsily, knocking into people or obstacles along the way

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies using raw physical power or aggressive bodily intrusion to carve a path through crowds, obstacles, or entrenched social circles.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借蛮力强行穿过人群拥挤处，或硬闯进某封闭圈子。

groups.name: Musical Accord & Agreement · 和弦与融洽 (Harmonize, Blend, Chime in)
groups.tip: 声音或关系融洽一致

items.def_en: (+ with) To join in vocally, or express agreement with what is being said
To combine smoothly into a cohesive, pleasing musical or tonal whole

items.def_zh: 与……协调，和谐一致；弹奏和弦
items.def_en: 1. To harmonize or be in accord with something. 2. (music) To play or arrange in musical chords.
(+ with) To sing, play, or sound in musical concord; to cause distinct parts to blend pleasingly
(+ to) To adjust musical pitch accurately, or bring thoughts and feelings into sympathetic rapport

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe musical sound blending into pleasant harmony or, metaphorically, ideas and sentiments resonating smoothly in agreement. Collocates include voices, tones, chords, and parallel opinions.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重音乐和声的共鸣协调，或隐喻意见与基调的高度契合。

groups.name: Nag & Badger · 唠叨催逼与训斥 (Nag, Badger, Pester)
groups.tip: 没完没了念叨挑刺、数落责备

items.def_zh: 唠叨，数落，对……唠叨不休；使烦恼，折磨
items.def_en: 1. (+ at/about) To annoy someone by constantly criticizing them, complaining, or asking them to do something. 2. (of pain or worry) To cause persistent discomfort or anxiety.
To trouble or annoy someone persistently with frequent, irritating interruptions or requests
To repeatedly pester or harass someone with questions, requests, or demands
To continually harass, dominate, and find fault with one's partner
To remonstrate with or rebuke someone angrily for wrongdoing

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve persistent verbal harassment, petty scolding, and annoying demands intended to prod, criticize, or compel someone into compliance.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过持续唠叨、挑剔抱怨或纠缠施压来迫使他人顺从。

groups.name: Nail & Ace · 拔得头筹与出色发挥 (Breeze through, Crush, Nail)
groups.tip: 达成目标并取得佳绩

items.def_en: (informal) To do exceptionally well at a performance, presentation, or challenge
(informal) To perform, execute, or complete something successfully and flawlessly
To pass an exam or overcome a challenge effortlessly and quickly

items.def_zh: 顺利通过；毫无困难地完成
items.def_en: To succeed in a test or stage of an endeavor smoothly without stumbling

items.def_zh: 在……中表现极其优异，轻松取得高分；（网球）发球直接得分
items.def_en: (informal) To achieve an exceptionally high score in a test, interview, or competition; to perform brilliantly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this informal frame describe flawlessly executing a test, audition, challenge, or performance, yielding superior results with apparent ease.
groups.summary_zh: 指完美通过考验、出色发挥并大获全胜的口语动词群。

groups.name: Name & Christen · 命名与受洗 (Dub, Baptize, Denominate)
groups.tip: 主持洗礼仪式正式命名，赋予船只名称

items.def_en: To give a specific name to a child, animal, enterprise, or object
To give someone or something a particular unofficial name, descriptive nickname, or title
To administer the Christian sacrament of initiation using water, often giving a personal name in the rite

items.def_zh: 为……施洗礼并命名；命名，给……起名字；初次使用
items.def_en: 1. To officially baptize and give a name to a baby in a Christian ceremony; to give a name to someone or a vessel. 2. (informal) To use something for the first time.
To formally designate, name, or classify someone or something with an official label

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers conferring a formal name, ceremonial title, or ceremonial initiation on a person, object, or vessel. It ranges from religious rites of baptism to secular renaming and affectionate moniker creation.
groups.summary_zh: 在宗教仪式中洗礼起名，或以特定称号、昵称正式命名事物。

groups.name: Narrate & Recount · 叙述与讲述 (Narrate, Recount, Relate)
groups.tip: 按次序道来亲身经历或故事

items.def_en: To give an account of something that has happened; to tell a story or report facts

items.def_zh: 载入编年史；按时间顺序记录
items.def_en: To record or describe a series of historical events in the order they occurred
To tell someone about an event or experience in sequential detail

items.def_zh: 编造并绘声绘色地讲（故事）
items.def_en: To tell or create a story or narrative, especially an imaginative or deceptive one

items.def_zh: 叙述，讲述；为（纪录片、节目等）作旁白解说
items.def_en: To tell a story or describe events in sequence; to provide spoken commentary for a film, documentary, or programme.

groups.summary_en: Verbs centered on setting forth sequences of events, personal stories, or factual experiences in continuous, descriptive detail.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重按时间或因果逻辑系统讲述、详细叙说经历或故事。

groups.name: Narrow & Constrict · 收拢收窄与缩小差距 (Narrow, Taper, Whittle down)
groups.tip: 受外力箍紧使口径孔洞变细

items.def_zh: 逐步缩减（范围/候选名单）
