items.def_en: To reduce the number of possibilities, candidates, or options in a group by systematic elimination
(+ off) To become gradually narrower or thinner toward one end, or to taper a physical contour

items.def_zh: 使瓶颈化收紧；约束限制
items.def_en: To squeeze, compress, or funnel flow or passage into a restricted bottleneck
To gradually diminish the size, scope, or number of candidates or expenses piece by piece
1. To become less wide or to make something less wide. 2. To reduce or become reduced in number, amount, or gap.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate a progressive reduction in physical width, options, or competitive leads. While 'narrow' covers both physical corridors narrowing and the shrinking of score gaps or shortlists, synonyms like 'taper' emphasize gradual geometric narrowing to a point.
groups.summary_zh: 指空间跨度由宽变窄，或比分分差、候选名单等逐渐收拢缩小。

groups.name: Nationalize & Expropriate · 征用与国有化 (Nationalize, Expropriate, Commandeer)
groups.tip: 政府征用私产收归国有管制

items.def_en: To take custody of property or assets suddenly and legally, or by sovereign force
To organize an industry or entire economy on socialistic principles of collective ownership

items.raw_cluster: 国有化与征用 Nationalize & Expropriate
items.def_zh: 将…收归国有，实行国有化
items.def_en: to bring an industry, company, or land under the control and ownership of the government
To officially take possession of private property or vehicles for urgent state or military use
To take away private property for official public use, often without full agreement

groups.summary_en: This frame involves state entities formally converting private enterprises, natural assets, or property into public ownership or sovereign control. Legal acquisition contrasts with unilateral government confiscation.
groups.summary_zh: 指国家依法或强制将私人产业、资产归为公有或收归国有。

groups.name: Naturalize & Assimilate · 入籍与同化 (Naturalize, Assimilate, Integrate)
groups.tip: 取得公民身份并融入异国文化

items.def_en: To successfully become part of a community or society, or bring different groups together
To get used to a new climate, culture, or set of living conditions
To feel that you belong to a particular group and are accepted by its members
To adopt the customs and attitudes of the prevailing culture, or bring a group into conformity

items.def_zh: 给予……国籍，使加入国籍；使（动植物等）顺化，移植
items.def_en: 1. To grant full citizenship to a person of foreign birth. 2. To introduce a non-native animal or plant into an area where it thrives.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to integrating foreigners, cultural minorities, or non-native species into a host nation, legal system, or biological habitat so that they acquire full status or conform to cultural norms.
groups.summary_zh: 指将外来人口、动植物或少数群体接纳入社会体系、法律或生态环境中。

groups.name: Nautical Hauling & Rigging Pull · 航海牵引与收紧缆绳 (Bouse, Haul, Heave)
groups.tip: 用力拖拽绳索牵引物体

items.def_zh: 连续收拢拉紧；奋力拉索
items.def_en: (nautical) To pull continuously on a rope or tackle until an object is secured or hoisted

items.def_zh: 横拉绳索收紧；用力紧缆
items.def_en: (nautical) To haul on a rope by pulling perpendicularly to take up slack before securing

items.def_zh: 用力拖拽；拉引（重物或缆绳）
items.def_en: To pull or drag something heavy with a continuous, steady effort

items.def_zh: 合力拉举；（用力）起吊缆索
items.def_en: (+ on/at) To pull, hoist, or drag a heavy line or object with a concerted physical heave
(nautical) To haul or pull firmly on a tackle or rope so as to hoist or tighten something.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mechanical or heavy manual traction, especially aboard vessels or in rigging, involving pulling firmly on lines, tackle, or ropes to hoist, tension, or drag heavy loads. Nuances contrast rhythmic collective hauling, tensioning, and sheer deadweight dragging.
groups.summary_zh: 特指在航海或工程索具中，用力收紧、拖曳或起升沉重缆绳。

groups.name: Need & Require · 需求与必要依靠 (Require, Demand, Call for)
groups.tip: 维持或成事所不可或缺

items.def_en: to require something because it is essential or very important, rather than just desirable
to have need of something for a purpose or because of an official rule
to require substantial amounts of skill, patience, energy, or attention
to make something necessary or appropriate as a required response
to depend completely on someone or something for basic survival or success

groups.summary_en: This frame encapsulates cognitive and conditional dependencies where something is deemed essential, indispensable, or obligatory for sustenance, function, or fulfillment.
groups.summary_zh: 指某事态或行动属必不可少之条件、硬性需求或依靠。

groups.name: Negate & Invalidate · 否定与作废 (Negate, Nullify, Annul)
groups.tip: 相互中和作用使不良影响归零

items.def_en: To balance each other out so that neither side has any final advantage or effect.
To declare a contract, election, or document legally invalid.

items.def_zh: 抵消，消除……的作用；否定，否认
items.def_en: 1. To stop something from having any effect or value; to cancel out. 2. (formal) To state or prove that something does not exist or is untrue.
To make something lose its legal force, value, or real-world consequence.
(law) To officially declare a marriage, law, or decision formally invalid from the outset.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this conceptual and legal frame signify rendering an assertion, contract, or effort entirely void, non-existent, or mathematically and logically cancelled.
groups.summary_zh: 在逻辑、法律或实质上消除其有效性，使之归零作废。

groups.name: Nestle & Nuzzle · 筑巢与依偎 (Nest, Nestle, Snuggle)
groups.tip: 飞鸟筑巢安家与落脚歇息

items.def_zh: 筑巢，做窠；巢居，落脚；嵌入，嵌套
items.def_en: To build or occupy a nest, or settle down comfortably like a bird in a nest.

items.def_zh: 给……掖好被子；把……塞入被窝
items.def_en: To arrange bedcovers securely and snugly around someone sleeping
(+ into / under) To press under or dig into blankets or cushions to create a cozy hideaway
(+ into / against) To settle or lie comfortably and snugly in a warm, protected position
(+ down / up / against) To curl up or press closely against someone or something for warmth

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on settling down comfortably, creating a cozy and protected resting niche, or nestling snugly against something warm and safe, mimicking the biological habits of nesting birds.
groups.summary_zh: 指营巢筑窝，或像幼鸟归巢般舒适地依偎安顿在温暖处。

groups.name: Neutralize & Disarm · 瓦解与制伏 (Neutralize, Disarm, Incapacitate)
groups.tip: 解除威胁或抵消敌对行动

items.def_en: To overcome, quieten, or bring an attacker or uprising under control by superior force.
To take away weapons from an enemy, or render an explosive device harmless.

items.def_zh: 消除威胁，制服；抵消，使中和；使中立化
items.def_en: 1. To stop an enemy, threat, poison, or weapon from being dangerous or having an effect. 2. To counteract something so that it has no effect. 3. To declare a country or area politically neutral.
To deprive an adversary of physical strength or cognitive ability to fight.
To remove the fuse from a bomb, or calm a volatile confrontation before violence erupts.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this military, tactical, or security frame denote rendering an opponent, combatant, or explosive device completely ineffective, non-threatening, or destroyed.
groups.summary_zh: 在安全或交锋中彻底制伏、缴械或解除敌方威胁。

groups.name: Nip & Pinch · 捏掐与轻夹 (Nip, Pinch, Tweak)
groups.tip: 用两指或钳口紧紧夹挤

items.def_en: To twist or pull something sharply with a small pinching movement using fingers

items.def_zh: 捏，掐，轻咬；剪去，掐掉；急忙赶去
items.def_en: 1. To bite, pinch, or squeeze someone or something sharply and lightly. 2. To snip off or clip something. 3. (British informal) To go somewhere quickly for a short time.
To cut or pinch off with a fast, light snipping or clipping action using scissors or teeth
To squeeze tightly between the thumb and a finger, or between two hard surfaces
To hold or press something tightly and immovably with or as if with a clamp or jaws

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on seizing or compressing a small portion of flesh or material sharply between two rigid or fleshy surfaces (such as fingertips, claws, or pliers). It emphasizes rapid, localized, and biting pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 用手指、利齿或夹具敏捷、锋利地捏掐或夹紧。

groups.name: Nominate & Propose · 提名与举荐 (Put up, Name, Shortlist)
groups.tip: 推选合适人选担任职务

items.def_en: To officially choose or specify someone for a particular position or honor
To enter or field someone as a competitor or candidate in an election
1. To officially propose someone as a candidate for an honor, office, or election. 2. To appoint someone to a job or duty.
To propose or sponsor someone as a candidate in an election or for a role
To select someone as one of a small final group being considered for a job or prize

groups.summary_en: Focuses on formally presenting candidates for elective office, awards, appointments, or governance selection.
groups.summary_zh: 正式提出人选以供选举、授奖或出任公职。

groups.name: Notice & Observe · 注意与觉察 (Perceive, Detect, Spot)
groups.tip: 从偶见端倪到留意关注

items.def_en: 1. To become conscious of, pay attention to, or observe something or someone.
To see, catch sight of, or identify something specific, especially when difficult to find
To discern or become aware of a subtle clue, meaning, tone, or nuance that others missed
To discover the presence or existence of something faint, subtle, or concealed
To become conscious of something through sensory organs or mental insight

groups.summary_en: This frame covers shifting visual or cognitive perception from simple casual detection to keen, deliberate scrutiny of stimuli in the environment.
groups.summary_zh: 指由浅入深对周围外界事物产生感知、察觉与审视。

groups.name: Nourish & Fatten · 滋养与增肥 (Fatten, Nourish, Plump)
groups.tip: 提供充分营养促使体态丰满

items.def_en: To feed an animal or person well to make them plump, fat, or ready for slaughter.
To feed an animal or human abundantly so they gain substantial body weight
To become rounder and fleshier, or to shake/fill something out fully
To make something heavier, stronger, or more substantial in bulk or power
To provide substances necessary for health, growth, and bodily maintenance

groups.summary_en: Covers feeding, enriching, or fattening animals or people through diet to build up flesh, body weight, or general vitality.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过大量喂食或充分营养补充使肉体丰满、增重或强健。

groups.name: Nourish & Feed · 喂养与滋养 (Nourish, Sustain, Nurture)
groups.tip: 提供食物养分以滋润滋养

items.def_en: To give food or sustenance to a person, animal, or living thing
To provide the physical necessities or strength required to keep someone alive or functioning
To give assistance, comfort, and vital relief to someone in hardship or distress
To care for, protect, and encourage the growth or development of someone or something

items.def_zh: 滋养，养育；助长，怀有（希望、情感等）
items.def_en: 1. To provide people, animals, or plants with food and nutrients necessary for life and growth. 2. To foster, encourage, or keep alive a feeling, idea, or belief.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying organic bodies or developing entities with the vital food, nutrients, or care necessary to sustain health, growth, and vigor. They extend naturally from physical feeding to emotional and intellectual enrichment.
groups.summary_zh: 指为生命或事物提供生存、成长所需的养分与支持。

groups.name: Nourish & Wean · 哺育与断乳 (Nurse, Suckle, Wean)
groups.tip: 幼崽喂奶后逐渐断绝母乳

items.def_en: To feed a baby or young mammal with milk from the breast or udder, or to suckle as an infant
To gradually detach someone from a dependency, source of nourishment, or habit
To supply with the substances necessary for life, growth, and good health
1. To gradually stop feeding a baby or young animal with mother's milk. 2. (+ from/off) To make someone gradually stop depending on or doing something.
To feed milk from the breast or teat, or to take nourishment by drinking mother's milk

groups.summary_en: This developmental frame covers the spectrum of early nourishment—from providing maternal milk through nursing or suckling, to systematically transitioning the young off milk onto solid foods.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖生命初期以乳汁哺育幼崽及逐步停止哺乳、断乳的过程。

groups.name: Nurture & Foster · 养育与培养 (Cultivate, Nourish, Rear)
groups.tip: 精心照料并助其成长

items.def_en: Bring up and educate a child, or breed and look after animals until they are fully grown
1. To take care of a child for a period of time, without becoming their legal parent. 2. To encourage the development, growth, or feeling of something.
Acquire or develop a quality, skill, or relationship through deliberate practice and patience
Care for and encourage the growth or development of someone or something
Provide with the substances necessary for growth, health, and good condition

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing emotional, developmental, or physical care to living beings, qualities, or ideas to help them grow, thrive, and reach their full potential.
groups.summary_zh: 给予关怀、呵护与资源，促使人、事物或才德茁壮成长。

groups.name: Nurture & Rear · 抚育与照料 (Nurture, Foster, Bring up)
groups.tip: 抚育后代并提供食物营养

items.def_en: Bring up and care for children or animals until they are fully grown
Take care of and bring up a child for a period of time without becoming their legal parent
Care for a child and educate them through childhood until adulthood
1. To feed, care for, and protect a child, animal, or plant while it is growing. 2. To encourage and support the development of a plan, idea, feeling, or talent.
Provide someone or something with food and substances necessary for growth, health, and good condition

groups.summary_en: Centers on caring for, feeding, educating, and fostering the development of children, young animals, or plants until maturity. It highlights sustained, protective commitment to healthy growth.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖照护、哺育幼小生命及培育其健康成长的全过程。

groups.name: Object & Protest · 反对与抗议 (Protest, Challenge, Remonstrate)
groups.tip: 从心存异议到公开走上街头抗议

items.def_zh: 挺身抗议；公开表态反对
items.def_en: (+ against) To state one's resolute objection to something publicly and courageously
To question whether something is right, true, or legitimate and invite scrutiny

items.def_zh: 反对，不赞成；提出……作为反对理由
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To feel or express disapproval, dissatisfaction, or opposition. 2. (+ that) To state something as a reason for objecting or disagreeing.
(+ against/about) To state publicly and forcefully that you oppose or condemn something
(+ with/against) To present strong reasons in complaint or protest against someone's act

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses openly articulating opposition, challenge, or resistance to a decision, ruling, plan, or injustice. The verbs range from formal parliamentary or judicial exceptions to public demonstrations of defiance.
groups.summary_zh: 通过言论、诉讼或公众抗议公开表达抵制与不服。

groups.name: Obliterate & Purge · 抹除与清洗 (Expunge, Eradicate, Wipe Out)
groups.tip: 从记录中彻底勾销抹净

items.def_en: To destroy or remove something completely and comprehensively
To rid an organization, memory, or conscience of unwanted, corrupt, or guilt-inducing elements
To pull up by the roots or eliminate entirely, especially a disease, pest, or vice
(formal) to completely erase, remove, or delete something, such as a name, record, or painful memory
To destroy completely so that not a single trace or sign remains

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the thorough, authoritative, or forceful eradication of records, memories, stains, or populations, leaving behind no physical or legal trace.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、强力手段彻底抹除记录、记忆或痕迹，不留分毫。

groups.name: Official Dismissal & Repudiation · 驳回与官方否决 (Reject, Dismiss, Disallow)
groups.tip: 不予接纳请求并予以当场驳回

items.def_zh: 拒绝接纳，驳回，否决；排斥，摈弃
items.def_en: To refuse to accept, approve, consider, or submit to something; to dismiss or turn down.

items.def_zh: 驳回（诉讼/请求）；不予理会
items.def_en: To formally decline to consider a legal case, proposal, or suggestion
To officially refuse to accept or allow something, stating it is illegal or against rules
To reject or annul a decision, objection, or proposal using higher authority

items.def_zh: 否认；拒不承认（协议或主张）
items.def_en: To formally refuse to accept, fulfill, or be bound by an agreement, claim, or charge

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on institutional, procedural, or authoritative refusal to admit, validate, approve, or entertain an application, claim, or doctrine. Nuances contrast judicial rejection, procedural invalidation, and ideological repudiation.
groups.summary_zh: 指权威机构、程序或主管方依据规定予以否定、驳回或不予受理。

groups.name: Official Dispatch & Notification · 简报通知与通报 (Bulletin, Notify, Advise)
groups.tip: 正式发公告通报重要事项

items.def_en: To give formal information or notice to someone regarding a matter
To send an official circular or written notice to many people simultaneously
To inform someone formally or officially of a fact or occurrence
To send off a prompt official message, report, or courier

items.def_zh: 以公报公布，发通告宣布
items.def_en: To announce or publish news by means of an official bulletin.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with issuing regular, formal dispatches, bulletins, or official written notifications informing specific stakeholders of critical updates.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过公报、通知书或官方简讯发布重要情况或进展。

groups.name: Official Record & Gazetting · 官方公报与登报发布 (Gazette, Chronicle, Tabulate)
groups.tip: 通过公报刊载正式昭告大众

items.def_en: To set down officially in writing or other permanent form for preservation

items.def_zh: 把……记入（正式簿册或登记簿）
items.def_en: To write down or register a formal record into an official ledger

items.def_zh: 将……写入会议纪要或正式记录
items.def_en: To take down or record officially in the minutes of a formal meeting

items.def_zh: 编年记述；按时间顺序记录
items.def_en: To record a series of events in factual and chronological order

items.def_zh: 在政府公报上公布，刊登公报
items.def_en: To publish or announce an official appointment, decree, or notice in a government gazette.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to recording, listing, or promulgating official appointments, decrees, and administrative acts in state journals or formal records.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过政府公报、公文或权威记录正式刊发与备案任命、法令。

groups.name: Omit & Leave Out · 遗漏与删减忽略 (Exclude, Drop, Pass Over)
groups.tip: 在表达或记录中略去或疏漏

items.def_en: To fail to include, mention, or take account of someone or something
To ignore, skip, or fail to mention or promote someone or something
To omit, discard, or eliminate an item, person, or topic from a roster or discourse
To deliberately leave out or keep someone or something out of a group, list, or consideration
To leave out, exclude, or fail to include someone or something.

groups.summary_en: Denotes leaving out, removing, or failing to mention specific items, facts, or individuals from a text, list, or account, whether intentionally for brevity or accidentally by oversight.
groups.summary_zh: 在清单、报告或表述中有意删减或无意漏掉特定细节或内容。

groups.name: Open & Unlock · 开启与开启通道 (Open, Unlock, Unlatch)
groups.tip: 解除闭锁状态并敞开通道

items.def_en: To open the lock of a door, box, or device using a key or code

items.def_zh: 解开；打开（钮扣、绳结、包裹）
items.def_en: To unfasten, untie, or loosen something wrapped, tied, or fastened
To open or undo a latch on a door, gate, or window
To open a door or window suddenly or wide
1. To move a door, lid, etc., so that it is no longer closed, or to become open. 2. To start or make available for business or public use.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers moving physical barriers such as doors, lids, or fasteners so that an enclosed space becomes accessible or unblocked.
groups.summary_zh: 开启门窗、锁具或容器，使出入或内部通道畅通。

groups.name: Opinion Polling & Social Survey · 民意测验与问卷抽样 (Poll, Survey, Canvass, Sample)
groups.tip: 社会调查与公众民意测验

items.def_en: To question a selected group of people in order to collect detailed information about their behavior, opinions, or lifestyles.
To test, question, or observe a representative subset of a population in order to draw conclusions about the whole.

items.def_zh: 对……进行民意调查；获得（票数）；投票
items.def_en: 1. To ask a group of people specific questions to discover their opinions. 2. To receive a particular number of votes in an election.
To administer a structured series of written questions to respondents for statistical analysis.

items.def_zh: 游说拉票；挨门征集民意
items.def_en: To visit individuals in an area or contact them systematically to solicit votes, solicit opinions, or assess support.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe collecting opinions, voting preferences, or statistical data from a representative sample of people. They highlight standardized data-gathering methods such as questionnaires, street interviews, and door-to-door consultations.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过问卷、访谈或挨户抽样等标准化手段采集大众观点或选民意向。

groups.name: Oppress & Subjugate · 压迫与奴役 (Subjugate, Enslave, Tyrannize)
groups.tip: 残暴统治并彻底剥夺自由

items.def_en: To suppress a group through force or discriminatory policy so that they cannot advance or gain rights

items.def_zh: 压迫，欺压；使压抑，使沉重
items.def_en: 1. To treat a group of people cruelly and unfairly, especially by restricting their freedom or rights. 2. (often passive) To make someone feel anxious, depressed, or uncomfortable.
(+ over) To treat people cruelly, harshly, and arbitrarily through abuse of authoritarian power
To defeat and place an entire country or group completely under political or military control
To deprive someone of their basic personal liberty and force them into perpetual bondage as property

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the systematic and harsh exercise of power to crush the autonomy, freedom, and human dignity of subjects. Distinctions turn on whether the dominance is institutionalized servitude, military subjugation, or arbitrary despotic cruelty.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借强权剥夺人身自由、施加苛政或彻底奴化奴役。

groups.name: Orbit & Revolve · 环绕与天体运行 (Revolve, Circle, Circumambulate)
groups.tip: 绕轴或轨道打转

items.def_en: To move around someone or something in a circular or looping path
To walk all the way around something, especially as part of a formal or religious ritual
To move in a curved path around a star, planet, or moon.
(+ around) To travel in a curved path or circular orbit around a central point or body
To sail or travel all the way around an island, continent, or celestial body

groups.summary_en: This frame captures objects moving around a central point, celestial body, or landmark in a closed circular or elliptical trajectory. 'Orbit' and 'revolve' typically govern gravitational paths in space, whereas 'circle' and 'circumambulate' apply widely to terrestrial movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指围绕中心天体或目标做闭合圆周或椭圆轨迹运动。

groups.name: Orbit & Wheel · 环绕与盘旋 (Orbit, Revolve, Hover)
groups.tip: 沿圆形轨道绕圈飞行

items.def_en: To fly or move in wide circles or curves

items.def_zh: 盘旋，绕圈移动；环绕，围绕
items.def_en: 1. To move in a circle or travel around someone or something, especially in flight. 2. To draw a circle around something.
To move around a star, planet, or object in a regular curved path
(+ around) To move in a circular or curved course around a central point or axis
To turn around quickly in a circle or spiral motion

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to continuous, dynamic movement in a curved, circular, or hovering path around an axis, center, or focal point.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿弯曲或环形轨道持续旋转、绕行或在空中盘旋飞行。

groups.name: Orient & Align · 定位与对准 (Align, Direct, Position)
groups.tip: 调整方向对齐准星

items.def_en: Move or turn in a specified heading or direction
Direct sight, weapons, or attention precisely toward a specific point
Align or position something relative to the points of a compass or specified reference points
Place or arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative positions

items.def_zh: 确定方向，定位；使朝向，使适应
items.def_en: 1. To determine one's position or find one's direction. 2. To direct or align something toward a particular goal, position, or audience.

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing determining one's bearing or positioning something physically or conceptually in relation to compass points, surroundings, or specific goals.
groups.summary_zh: 指确定自身方位，或使物体与目标在方向、位置上保持一致。

groups.name: Orient & Direct · 定位与定向 (Orient, Align, Geared toward)
groups.tip: 调整认知方向与思维定位

items.def_en: To aim, target, or set a product, speech, or tone at a particular level or audience

items.def_zh: 给…定位，使朝向；使适应，使熟悉；确定方向
items.def_en: 1. to direct or adapt something toward a particular group, activity, or purpose 2. [T, often reflexive] to familiarize oneself with a new situation or environment 3. to find one's direction or position, or align something with a particular direction

items.def_zh: 调整…以求一致，使协调对齐
items.def_en: To arrange or adjust things so that they form a line or are in agreement with goals
To design, organize, or adjust something so that it is suitable for a particular need or group

items.def_zh: 量身定制，专门调整以适应
items.def_en: To adapt or design something specifically to suit individual needs or conditions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to establishing directional position, adjusting mental focus, or tailoring products and actions toward a specific goal or audience.
groups.summary_zh: 确定方位，调整心智认知，或使行动策略专门迎合特定受众与目标。

groups.name: Outlast & Endure · 历久与经久耐用 (Outlast, Outwear, Weather)
groups.tip: 比对方更耐磨损且存留时间更长

items.def_en: To continue to survive, resist, or function under difficult conditions or sustained pressure
To remain alive or extant after the death, demise, or obsolescence of another
To continue to exist, work, or be effective for a longer period of time than someone or something else
To endure a crisis, hardship, or deterioration successfully and continue to stand or operate

items.def_zh: 比……更耐用，比……耐久；穿破，耗尽
items.def_en: 1. To last longer or remain usable for a greater time than something else. 2. (archaic) To wear out, exhaust, or spend

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey surviving, remaining functional, or persisting across time longer than competitors or beyond harsh conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调耐磨损、经受住岁月冲刷或比他物更持久。

groups.name: Outright Refusal & Declining · 坚定拒绝与推辞 (Refuse, Decline, Turn Down)
groups.tip: 从委婉推却到断然予以拒绝

items.def_en: To politely refuse an invitation, offer, or request
To reject or refuse an offer, request, applicant, or invitation
To state or show firmly that one is not willing to do, give, accept, or grant something.

items.def_zh: (+ at) 畏缩不前；断然拒绝去做
items.def_en: (+ at) To hesitate or flatly refuse to proceed with an action or idea
To refuse to give, disclose, or grant something that is requested or required

groups.summary_en: This core communicative frame captures expressing an unwillingness to comply, accept, grant, or participate in something. Nuances range from formal polite declination to resolute, direct, and unyielding refusal.
groups.summary_zh: 明确表明不肯做、不愿给予或拒绝接受某种要求或提议。

groups.name: Overact & Embellish · 矫饰表演与过火作态 (Chew the scenery, Melodramatize, Camp up)
groups.tip: 戏剧表演时表现过于夸张

items.def_en: to perform or present something in a deliberately theatrical, flamboyant, or ironic style

items.def_zh: 做怪相引人发笑；夸张扮相
items.def_en: to make exaggerated facial expressions, especially when performing before an audience or camera

items.def_zh: 渲染成情节剧；过分夸大渲染
items.def_en: to present a situation or emotion in an excessively dramatic and sensationally emotional manner

items.def_zh: 大肆卖弄演技；表演极尽夸张
items.def_en: to act in an exaggerated, uncontrolled, and theatrical way that draws excessive attention
to perform a dramatic role in an exaggerated, unnatural, and overly emotional way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe excessive, exaggerated theatricality or contrived posturing on stage or in public life, lacking subtlety and natural restraint.
groups.summary_zh: 指在表演、言辞或举止中过于夸张做作、极度情绪化，缺乏克制与自然感。

groups.name: Overexpose & Lay Bare · 过度暴露与显露无遗 (Lay Bare, Unmask, Baresark)
groups.tip: 胶片过曝或使事物显露

items.def_en: To publicly disclose a secret or private aspect of someone's identity or life

items.def_zh: 彻底暴露；使赤裸裸显现
items.def_en: To reveal or expose something hidden or secret completely to scrutiny
To remove all extra coverings or concealments to reveal the raw underlying structure
To show the true, often deceptive, character or identity of someone or something

items.def_zh: 使曝光过度；使过度暴露，使过度曝光
items.def_en: 1. (photography) To expose film or a sensor to too much light. 2. To expose someone or something to public view so frequently that interest is lost.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve bringing hidden parts, vulnerabilities, or identity completely into view, or subjecting something to excessive, damaging exposure and scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指将隐藏的事物、脆弱面或真实面目公之于众，或使其承受过多暴露与聚焦。

groups.name: Overextension & Strain · 过度拉伸与绷紧超负荷 (Overstretch, Strain, Overtax)
groups.tip: 过度拉长拉紧超出弹性极限

items.def_en: To injure or stretch a muscle or part of the body by working it too hard, or put extreme pressure on resources
To make or become pulled tight with little or no slack
To stretch a limb or physical object past its natural reach, or commit resources beyond capacity

items.def_zh: 拉伸过度；使负担过重，使透支
items.def_en: 1. To stretch a muscle, limb, or material beyond its normal or safe limit. 2. To put too great a demand on financial, human, or military resources.
To make excessive demands on someone's physical strength, resources, or capacity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate stretching physical materials, muscles, or abstract resources far beyond their safe or elastic limits, leading to tension, injury, or exhaustion. Nuances contrast anatomical strain, material overextension, and budgetary or mental overcommitment.
groups.summary_zh: 指将肌肉、弹性材质或精力资源绷拉至超出极限，引发损伤或过载。

groups.name: Overgrow & Proliferate · 疯长与丛生 (Overgrow, Invade, Proliferate)
groups.tip: 生物疯狂增殖乃至覆盖蔓生

items.def_en: To increase rapidly in numbers or reproduce profusely
To grow luxuriantly, wildly, and without control across an area
(+ off/out) To prevent the growth of desirable plants by growing densely over them

items.def_zh: （害虫、杂草等）成群滋生；大批侵扰
items.def_en: To exist in large, unwanted numbers in a place, spreading densely and causing damage

items.def_zh: 在……上蔓延覆盖，长满；长得过大
items.def_en: 1. To cover an area by growing thickly and aggressively over it. 2. To grow too large.

groups.summary_en: Denotes aggressive, dense, or unchecked biological expansion where vegetation, cells, or weeds overwhelm a space through rapid multiplication and rampant spreading.
groups.summary_zh: 指植物、细胞或生物不受控制地肆意蔓生、丛生或大量繁殖覆盖。

groups.name: Overlap & Intersect · 交错与重叠 (Intersect, Coincide, Crisscross)
groups.tip: 空间或时间上的交叉重叠

items.def_zh: （使）部分重叠；（时间或职责上）交叉，交错
items.def_en: 1. To cover part of the same area of something. 2. To happen at the same time as something else, or share some of the same qualities or responsibilities.
To occur at the same time or occupy the exact same space or position
To divide or cut across something by passing through it, or to meet and cross at a point
To fit together closely or harmoniously, especially of plans, schedules, or ideas
To move back and forth across an area or mark something with intersecting lines

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical areas, temporal schedules, or conceptual domains covering part of the same space or occurring concurrently. They range from literal geometric intersections to partial alignment in responsibilities or timelines.
groups.summary_zh: 指空间交叉、时间部分重叠或职责范围相重合。

groups.name: Overlook & Condone · 宽容与默许姑息 (Condone, Overlook, Wink at)
groups.tip: 默许包容错误予以原谅

items.def_en: To choose deliberately to ignore a fault, offense, or error

items.def_zh: 包容，宽恕；纵容，容忍（不良行为）
items.def_en: To accept, forgive, or overlook behavior that is considered morally wrong, unlawful, or offensive.
To pretend not to see something improper and deliberately allow it to continue
To secretly encourage or tacitly permit an illegal or unethical act

items.def_zh: 容忍；允许（常用于否定句）
items.def_en: To tolerate or allow dissent or bad behavior (usually with negation)

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on tolerating, sanctioning, or turning a blind eye to morally or legally reprehensible actions, treating them as acceptable.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对不正当或过错行为采取宽容、姑息、默许或视而不见态度。

groups.name: Overprice & Gouge · 标价过高与乱收费 (Overprice, Gouge, Overcharge)
groups.tip: 评估资产价值并制定价格

items.def_en: To increase the retail price of something above its wholesale or previous cost

items.def_zh: 宰客；收取极其昂贵的价格
items.def_en: To cheat someone by making them pay far more than something is worth
To force people to pay unfairly high prices, especially in emergency situations

items.def_zh: 给……定价过高，对……估价过高
items.def_en: To set the price of goods or services higher than their real value.
To demand too much money from someone for goods or services

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate setting or exacting monetary demands far above an item's reasonable market value, often exploiting scarcity, necessity, or ignorance.
groups.summary_zh: 指定价虚高或索取不合理的高额费用。

groups.name: Overshadow & Eclipse · 遮蔽与夺彩 (Eclipse, Outshine, Dwarf)
groups.tip: 投下阴影遮盖光华色彩

items.def_en: Spoil a good situation or diminish happiness by introducing worry or gloom

items.def_zh: 使相形见绌；使显得矮小
items.def_en: Cause something to appear small, inferior, or unimportant in comparison

items.def_zh: 使失色，使相形见绌；遮蔽，给…蒙上阴影
items.def_en: 1. To make someone or something seem less important, happy, or successful by comparison. 2. To cast a shadow over.
Block the light of a celestial body, or make another achievement look insignificant by being superior
Be much brighter, more impressive, or more successful than someone else

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote dominating perceptual or conceptual attention such that another entity is thrown into darkness, obscurity, or insignificance by comparison. 'Overshadow' emphasizes looming gloom or diminished joy, while 'eclipse' emphasizes total preeminence.
groups.summary_zh: 指投下阴影、遮蔽光彩，使他者相形见绌或黯然失色。

groups.name: Oversimplify & Trivialize · 简化与浮泛化 (Dumb Down, Boil Down, Gloss Over)
groups.tip: 把复杂问题过度简化以便于理解

items.def_en: To condense extensive information into a bare, essential statement

items.def_zh: 把……过分简化，使过于简单化
items.def_en: To describe or explain a complex situation or problem in a way that is too simple, leaving out important facts or details.
To treat a complex difficulty or flaw cursorily to avoid dealing with uncomfortable complexities

items.def_zh: 降低难度以迎合，通俗化（贬义）
items.def_en: To deliberately make something less intellectually demanding in order to cater to a popular audience
To make something seem unimportant, superficial, or less serious than it genuinely is

groups.summary_en: This manner frame describes reducing nuanced or technical concepts to an excessively rudimentary form. It often carries critical overtones of omitting vital subtleties, distorting truth, or patronizing the audience.
groups.summary_zh: 过分简化、删减关键细节，使复杂事物失去深度或失真。

groups.name: Overstock & Hoard · 囤积与过量储备 (Hoard, Stockpile, Accumulate)
groups.tip: 积聚储备物品以备不时之需

items.def_en: (+ on) To buy or obtain a large supply of goods for future use
To gradually gather an increasing amount or quantity of items over time
To accumulate a large supply of goods, weapons, or food for future emergencies
To collect and store large quantities of food, goods, or money, often secretly or greedily
To buy or stock more goods than are needed or can be sold.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on accumulating excessive quantities of goods, supplies, or raw materials far beyond immediate needs, often creating surpluses or artificial scarcity.
groups.summary_zh: 指囤积、超额备货或过量采购物资，导致存量过剩。

groups.name: Overturn & Upend · 倾覆与彻底颠倒 (Overturn, Upend, Capsize, Invert)
groups.tip: 车船底朝天彻底翻转

items.def_en: 1. To turn upside down or fall over onto one side, or cause something to do so. 2. To officially reverse, invalidate, or abolish a legal decision, law, or result.
To turn something upside down or reverse its customary order, position, or condition

items.def_zh: 翻转过来，里外翻个底朝天
items.def_en: To fold or turn something so that the inner surface faces outward
To set, turn, or flip something completely on its end or upside down
(especially of a boat or vessel) To overturn completely in the water

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail completely flipping an object upside-down or on its side by force, encompassing maritime capsizing, violent upsets, and complete inversion.
groups.summary_zh: 外力迫使物体底朝天完全颠倒、倾覆翻转。

groups.name: Overwhelm & Discourage · 威慑退缩与令人气馁 (Daunt, Cow, Dismay)
groups.tip: 施加强势威胁令人望而却步

items.def_en: Cause someone distress, apprehension, and loss of morale in the face of daunting adversity
Deprive someone of courage, composure, confidence, or psychological resolve
Subdue or repress someone's spirits through sustained threats or shows of power
Frighten someone deliberately into submitting or doing what one wants
(often passive) To make someone feel intimidated, overwhelmed, or discouraged by a difficult task.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify disarming someone's courage, resolve, or hope by presenting an intimidating presence or an overwhelmingly arduous obstacle.
groups.summary_zh: 以压倒性声势或艰巨挑战挫败他人勇气，使其畏葸不前。

groups.name: Overwhelm & Inundate · 淹没与压倒 (Swamp, Inundate, Overload)
groups.tip: 漫灌淹没压垮正常运转

items.def_zh: 使工作过多而无法招架
items.def_en: (often passive) To overwhelm someone with a massive amount of work, correspondence, or responsibilities
To overpower someone or something with superior numbers, force, or an excess of concurrent demands

items.def_zh: 使应接不暇，压垮；淹没，浸没
items.def_en: 1. (often passive, 'be swamped with/by') To overwhelm someone or something with a vast quantity of things or work. 2. To fill or sink a boat, or flood land, with a large volume of water.
To overwhelm someone with a huge influx of things to deal with, or to cover an area completely with water
To sweep over and swallow something completely, rendering it unseen or incapacitated

groups.summary_en: This frame involves incapacitating someone or something by subjecting them to a deluge or vast excess of demands, tasks, physical water, or stimuli.
groups.summary_zh: 因数量或负荷过大而彻底压垮、淹没目标。

groups.name: Overwhelm & Overpower · 压倒与击溃 (Engulf, Overcome, Overpower)
groups.tip: 情感或力量过于庞大，彻底将人冲垮

items.def_en: (usually passive) To affect someone so strongly with an emotion, fume, or fatigue that they cannot act normally

items.def_zh: 击溃，压倒；（强烈情感）使难以承受，使不知所措；淹没
items.def_en: 1. To defeat someone or something completely by using vastly superior force. 2. To affect someone so strongly with an emotion that they cannot think clearly or cope. 3. To completely submerge or cover with water.
To overwhelm someone with a huge, unmanageable volume of things to deal with
To defeat, subdue, or gain control over someone through clearly superior strength or emotional force
To sweep over and swallow up someone completely, both physically and emotionally

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes subjecting a person, mind, or force to an irresistible surge of emotion, sensory input, or physical might that utterly subdues them.
groups.summary_zh: 指强烈情感、感官刺激或绝对力量让人无力招架。

groups.name: Overwinter & Winter · 度冬与避寒 (Overwinter, Hibernate, Estivate)
groups.tip: 熬过寒冬与季节性休眠

items.def_zh: 过冬，越冬；使（动植物等）过冬
items.def_en: 1. To spend the winter in a particular place. 2. To keep, feed, or protect animals or plants during the winter.
(+ up) To retreat into a secluded lair or shelter to rest or survive cold weather conditions
To stay in a secure or warm interior space without emerging, especially to escape severe weather
To pass the winter in a state of suspended animation or deep prolonged metabolic dormancy
To spend the winter season in a particular place, or keep organisms protected throughout winter

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this biological and lifestyle frame describe passing the cold winter season in a specific sheltered location, enduring climatic hardship, or entering a dormant physiological state.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及人、动物或植物在特定环境中度过严冬、避寒或进入冬眠状态。

groups.name: Overwork & Exhaust · 过度使用与耗尽 (Overuse, Exhaust, Wear Out)
groups.tip: 投入使用乃至过度磨损

items.def_en: to become damaged, useless, or exhausted through prolonged or excessive use
to use something too much or too often so that it becomes less effective or damaged

items.def_zh: 使负担过重，使劳累过度
items.def_en: to demand too much of someone's physical strength, endurance, or a system's capacity
to use or work something or someone so hard that it is ruined or completely exhausted
to use up completely so that nothing remains; to drain entirely of energy

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights the harmful extreme of use, where tools, resources, body parts, or systems are strained past their limit, leading to degradation, fatigue, or depletion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调使用过频过猛导致耗损、疲劳或衰竭的极端状态。

groups.name: Owe & Incur · 欠负与借债 (Incur, Run up, Fall behind)
groups.tip: 身负债务或欠下人情

items.def_zh: 欠（债、钱）；欠（人情、情谊）；归功于
items.def_en: 1. To have to pay someone money that you have borrowed or that is due. 2. To feel an obligation to give someone gratitude, respect, or an explanation.

items.def_zh: 积欠，迅速累积（账单、债务）
items.def_en: To allow debts or bills to increase rapidly without paying them off
To record an unpaid amount on a tab or register an ongoing debt
To fail to make regular payments on time, dropping into arrears

items.def_zh: 招致，招惹（债务、费用或惩罚）
items.def_en: To bring a debt, expense, or undesirable consequence upon oneself

groups.summary_en: Focuses on financial and moral indebtedness, capturing the accumulation or burden of unpaid sums and contractual dues.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖产生债务、拖欠款项及累积债务的财务情景。

groups.name: Pace & Stride · 踱步与大步走 (Stride, Stroll, Prowl)
groups.tip: 踱步测量或阔步昂首前行

items.def_zh: 踱步，缓慢走动；用步丈量；给……定步速
items.def_en: 1. To walk with slow or regular steps, often back and forth in anxiety or thought. 2. To measure a distance by walking over it and counting steps. 3. To set the speed for oneself or others in a race or activity.
To increase one's walking pace or stride out briskly and purposefully
To walk with long, energetic, and confident steps in a determined direction
To walk heavily, steadily, and tirelessly over long distances
To move stealthily or restlessly around an area, like a hunter seeking prey

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rhythmic, purposeful, or emotionally charged walking patterns. 'Pacing' evokes repetitive, anxious steps, while related verbs highlight either expansive, confident strides or predatory, restless roaming.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有特定节奏、情绪或仪态的步行方式（如焦虑踱步、大步迈行）。

groups.name: Page & Summon · 传呼与传唤 (Summon, Bleep, Call Overhead)
groups.tip: 通过广播或呼叫器指名找人

items.def_zh: （通过广播或寻呼机）呼叫，传唤；翻阅（书页）；给……编页码
items.def_en: 1. To call or summon someone by announcing their name over a loudspeaker or using an electronic pager. 2. (+ through) To turn the pages of a book or magazine. 3. To number the pages of a document.
To summon someone to leave a place or activity urgently

items.def_zh: 通过公用广播系统呼叫
items.def_en: (informal, British) To broadcast a message or summon someone over a public address system
To authoritatively order someone to come or be present
(especially British) To contact someone via an electronic pager that emits a bleeping sound

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies alerting, locating, or summoning an individual through public address systems, electronic beepers, pagers, or organizational dispatch signals.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过广播扩音、电子寻呼机或调度系统公开呼叫并传唤特定人员。

groups.name: Pair & Match · 配对与契合 (Couple, Mate, Yoke)
groups.tip: 两两组合对应成双互相契合

items.def_en: To join, link, or associate two things or concepts closely together

items.def_zh: 使相配，使结成对；使（两城镇）结为友好关系
items.def_en: 1. To pair or combine two things closely together. 2. (British English) To link one town or city officially with another in a different country.
To pair two matching parts or animals together for operation or breeding
To form into pairs or form romantic couplings from a larger group
To harness two animals together, or link two disparate entities intimately

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on linking, coupling, or combining two distinct entities into a coherent, functioning, or balanced unit.
groups.summary_zh: 指将两个独立实体连接、匹配或结合为互补对偶。

groups.name: Palpitate & Flutter · 心脏悸动与异常剧跳 (Palpitate, Flutter, Race)
groups.tip: 心脏或脉搏急促剧烈跳动

items.def_en: Beat with a light, rapid, and irregular tremor, as felt during moments of nervousness

items.def_zh: 心跳漏了一拍（极度震惊）
items.def_en: Experience a momentary pause or hesitation in regular heartbeat caused by shock or surprise
Beat much faster than usual because of excitement, fear, exertion, or anxiety
Beat unusually heavily and loudly within the chest, often accompanied by strong physical distress

items.def_zh: （心脏）急促剧烈跳动，悸动；发抖
items.def_en: (of the heart) To beat rapidly, strongly, or irregularly, typically because of fear, anxiety, or excitement.

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the involuntary, unnerving biological sensation of one's heart beating abnormally fast, fluttering, or pounding erratically due to acute fear, panic, illness, or intense exertion.
groups.summary_zh: 心脏因惊恐、亢奋或病理原因而出现急促、紊乱或剧烈的心悸跳动。

groups.name: Pamper & Baby · 溺爱与娇宠 (Baby, Coddle, Mollicoddle)
groups.tip: 像对待婴儿般娇惯纵容

items.def_en: To treat someone with excessive indulgence, care, or gentleness as if they were an infant.
To protect and care for someone in an overly warm, sheltering, and tender manner
To provide someone with so much constant help that they need no self-reliance
To treat someone with excessive care, protection, and softness
To overprotect and pamper someone to an extreme, debilitating degree

groups.summary_en: Covers treating someone with overprotective, infant-like care that shields them from hardship and fosters dependence.
groups.summary_zh: 像对待婴儿般过度呵护、免除责任，使其免受任何挫折与压力。

groups.name: Pan-Frying Technique & Pan Sauces · 锅底释香与调汁 (Deglaze, Brown, Sear)
groups.tip: 运用特定手法烹饪料理食材

items.def_en: To boil liquid, sauce, or stock down so it becomes thicker and more intensely flavored
To cook food until its exterior turns a rich brown color and develops Maillard flavor
To brown meat quickly at high heat to develop crust and render fond for sauce
To cook chopped ingredients rapidly in a small amount of hot oil or butter in an open pan

items.def_zh: 调制锅底酱（烹饪中加液体溶解锅底残留肉汁）
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To add wine, stock, or water to a hot pan and stir to dissolve browned food bits into a flavorful sauce.

groups.summary_en: Culinary verbs in this frame relate to pan-cooking meat, creating caramelized residue (fond), and utilizing liquids to lift and incorporate these concentrated drippings into savory sauces.
groups.summary_zh: 烹饪中通过煎出焦香并在锅底加液体化解浓缩肉汁的系列技艺。

groups.name: Panhandle & Beg · 沿街行乞与强讨 (Panhandle, Beg, Cadge)
groups.tip: 低声下气地求助或沿街乞讨

items.def_en: To ask for and obtain money, food, or small items from others without paying
To ask people for money, food, or assistance in public out of urgent destitution
(chiefly North American informal) To beg for money from strangers in a public street.
To rely shamelessly on another person for money, food, or shelter
To make a humble, earnest, and submissive petition or entreaty to someone powerful

groups.summary_en: This frame captures demanding or pleading for petty money, food, or goods from passersby in public streets, ranging from quiet entreaty to aggressive solicitation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在街头公然向陌生人乞求施舍零钱或口粮。

groups.name: Panic & Freak · 惊慌与失控 (Freak, Panic, Unhinge)
groups.tip: 恐惧导致失去理智、手足无措

items.def_en: To make someone lose their confidence, courage, or calm by unsettling them

items.def_zh: 惊恐发作；吓坏；情绪失控
items.def_en: To lose control of your emotions through sudden intense panic, shock, or anger
To completely lose self-control or composure by exploding in anger, terror, or tears

items.def_zh: 使惊慌失措，使极度不安；惊慌失措，发疯
items.def_en: (informal) To suddenly feel or cause someone to feel extremely surprised, upset, angry, or panicked.
To suddenly feel or cause to feel an overpowering fear that prevents rational thought and action

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express losing self-control, composure, or mental stability under sudden fear, shock, anger, or sensory overload.
groups.summary_zh: 指由于突发恐惧、震惊或巨大刺激而失去镇定、阵脚大乱或陷入歇斯底里。

groups.name: Paralyze & Incapacitate · 瘫痪与使完全失去机能 (Palsy, Paralyze, Incapacitate)
groups.tip: 神经失调导致肢体麻木至完全瘫痪

items.def_en: To make someone or something severely weak and infirm

items.def_zh: 使不能移动；使固定不动
items.def_en: To prevent someone or something from moving or operating normally
To cause a person or body part to lose motor power or feeling, or render a system unable to function

items.def_zh: 使无能力；使伤残而丧失行动力
items.def_en: To deprive someone of the ability or fitness for normal physical or mental activity
(literary) To affect with paralysis or involuntary tremors; to make completely powerless or unable to act.

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote depriving an organism, limb, or organizational system of the capacity to move, act, or function normally, either physically or metaphorically through shock or dread.
groups.summary_zh: 指使肢体、生命体或运行系统失去行动或运作能力。

groups.name: Paralyze & Numb · 麻痹与瘫痪 (Paralyze, Numb, Incapacitate)
groups.tip: 从局部麻木到彻底无法动弹

items.def_en: to deprive a body part or emotion of sensation and responsiveness

items.def_zh: 使麻木呆滞；使失去知觉
items.def_en: to make someone unable to think or feel clearly, often through drugs or shock

items.def_zh: 使瘫痪，使麻痹；使无法正常运转，使陷于瘫痪
items.def_en: 1. To cause a person or body part to lose the ability to move or feel. 2. To bring an activity, system, or organization to a complete standstill.
to deprive someone of strength, fitness, or legal ability to function

items.def_zh: 使固定不动；使无法移动
items.def_en: to prevent something or someone from moving or operating normally

groups.summary_en: This frame covers depriving muscles, nerves, or entire operational entities of motility, feeling, or functional capacity. Physical sensory deadening extends metaphorically into complete systemic freeze.
groups.summary_zh: 肉体机能瘫痪、知觉钝化乃至系统机制彻底陷入僵死停摆。

groups.name: Parasitic Draining & Exploitation · 寄生榨取与搜刮 (Sponge, Bleed, Milk)
groups.tip: 如水蛭般榨干底层劳动成果

items.def_en: Exploit a situation, system, or person thoroughly to gain the maximum profit or sympathy
(+ off/on) Habitually accept money, food, or hospitality from others without giving in return
Extort or continuously drain vast amounts of money or resources from someone
Deprive someone of large sums of money through deceit, overcharging, or extortion

items.def_zh: 榨取，依附……吸血；用蚂蟥（水蛭）吸血
items.def_en: (+ off/on) To rely on and drain money, resources, or support from someone without giving anything back.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers predatory or parasitic extraction of wealth, resources, or emotional strength from another entity without reciprocal return. Leech evokes parasitical attachment, bleed stresses exhausting reserves till dry, and milk suggests calculating extortion.
groups.summary_zh: 像寄生虫一样无偿吸取、榨干他人钱财、精力或资源。

groups.name: Pardon & Spare · 宽恕与宽免饶恕 (Spare, Pardon, Forgive)
groups.tip: 免除惩罚或手下留情

items.def_en: To stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense or mistake

items.def_zh: 饶恕，放过；免除，使免遭；抽出，省出
items.def_en: 1. To refrain from harming, punishing, or killing someone. 2. To save someone from experiencing something difficult or unpleasant. 3. To make something available or give it to someone.
To decide not to punish someone severely or at all for an offense
To grant official forgiveness for a crime or offense without punishment

items.def_zh: 暂缓执行刑罚；缓刑宽免
items.def_en: To postpone or cancel the punishment of someone, especially a prisoner condemned to death

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe using authority or mercy to refrain from executing, punishing, or destroying someone who is at one's mercy.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借宽容或权力开恩免罚，饶恕受制者的性命或过错。

groups.name: Park & Station · 停放与驻留 (Station, Garrison, Billet)
groups.tip: 车辆停止并安放

items.def_zh: 停放（车辆），泊车；暂搁，搁置（想法等）
items.def_en: 1. To bring a vehicle to a halt and leave it in a designated place. 2. (informal) To set an issue, idea, or proposal aside for later discussion.
Assign a person, vehicle, or military unit to stand or remain in a particular place
(of a vehicle) Stop, pause, or draw to a halt at a curb or specific spot
Provide a town, base, or fortress with a stationary force of troops
Lodge soldiers temporarily in civilian houses or designated quarters

groups.summary_en: Pertains to positioning a vehicle, machine, or military personnel in a specific location for an extended resting period or tactical deployment, alongside colloquial extensions of shelving ideas or placing people.
groups.summary_zh: 指将车辆、重型设备停放，或将人员、部队派驻某地长期停留。

groups.name: Parody & Satirize · 戏仿与嘲弄 (Caricature, Lampoon, Send up)
groups.tip: 通过夸张模仿他人言行来进行滑稽讽刺

items.def_zh: 讽刺模仿，幽默滑稽地戏仿；哄骗
items.def_en: To imitate the style of someone or something humorously in order to make people laugh.

items.def_zh: 插科打诨地调侃；讽刺模仿
items.def_en: To imitate someone or something in an amusing, slightly mocking way
To imitate the characteristic style of an author, artist, or work for comic effect or ridicule
To represent someone or something in a way that emphasizes their distinctive traits for comedic or grotesque effect
To criticize or ridicule a person or institution using pointed satire or humor

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote imitating, exaggerating, or ridiculing individuals, works, or genres through creative caricature, satire, and comedic performance.
groups.summary_zh: 通过夸张模仿、讽刺作秀来恶搞与戏谑的动词群。

groups.name: Parry & Deflect · 格挡与化解 (Deflect, Ward off, Block)
groups.tip: 以武器弹开攻势化解打击

items.def_en: Stop the movement of an opponent, punch, or ball by standing or holding something in its way
Push away or defend oneself against an attacker, danger, or unwanted inquiry
Prevent someone or something from harming or touching you by putting up a defense

items.def_zh: 使偏斜；转移（注意力/攻击）
items.def_en: Cause an incoming blow, object, or question to change direction and glance away

items.def_zh: 挡开，避开（攻击）；回避，巧妙避开（提问）
items.def_en: To block or deflect a blow or weapon in fighting, or to skillfully avoid answering a difficult question.

groups.summary_en: Verbs highlighting the skillful evasion or redirection of physical strikes, incoming projectiles, or contentious questions and criticisms.
groups.summary_zh: 指敏捷地挡开来击、偏转攻击，或巧妙避开尖锐提问与指责。

groups.name: Pass Water & Urinate · 排尿与小便 (Pee, Pass Water, Urinate)
groups.tip: 机体生理排遗与废物释放

items.def_en: To discharge urine; vulgar in polite company though very common in slang
To discharge urine; used as a polite or medical euphemism
To urinate; used primarily by or when speaking to small children
1. (informal) To discharge urine from the body.
To discharge liquid waste from the bladder through the urethra

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on mild, polite, and colloquial verbs describing the standard bodily function of relieving one's bladder, distinguishing formal, clinical, and idiomatic euphemisms.
groups.summary_zh: 描述解小便的生理动作，涵盖中性日常词、委婉表达与医学词汇。

groups.name: Passage of Time · 时间流逝与过去 (Slip by, Tick away, Wear on)
groups.tip: 时间悄悄流走逝去

items.def_en: To pass quickly, quietly, and often unnoticed
To continue steadily and relentlessly forward as time advances
To pass steadily and audibly second by second, especially when counted down toward a deadline
To pass slowly, tediously, or wearily, as of a long day, season, or night
(formal) (of time) to pass or slip by

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture the inexorable passage or sliding away of temporal intervals, whether swift, imperceptible, or painfully protracted.
groups.summary_zh: 指光阴、时限或岁月不知不觉或沉闷缓慢地逝去。

groups.name: Patch & Piece Together · 拼凑与修补 (Piece, Patch, Cobble together)
groups.tip: 用零碎布片补缀或拼整原形

items.def_en: To repair a tear, leak, or damage hastily or temporarily by covering it with a patch
To join separate parts or pieces together to make a whole; to repair by patching
To assemble something quickly and roughly from whatever disparate materials or parts are available
To assemble separate parts, details, or clues to recreate a whole object, narrative, or truth
To join different pieces of fabric by stitching, or figuratively assemble distinct factions or ideas

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture the physical or figurative act of assembling fragmented, disparate, or makeshift items to reconstruct a workable whole.
groups.summary_zh: 指用零碎材料拼凑组装、粗糙缝补或凑成整体。

groups.name: Patrol & Guard · 巡视与巡逻 (Prowl, Police, Walk the beat)
groups.tip: 按路线巡查警戒

items.def_en: to maintain law and order in an area, or to enforce regulations and check for non-compliance
to go regularly around an area to maintain security, keep order, or inspect it.
to explore or reconnoiter an area in advance to observe conditions, threats, or locations
to patrol an assigned regular route or neighborhood on foot to monitor safety
to move stealthily or restlessly around an area in search of prey, intruders, or illicit activity

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on traversing a perimeter, territory, or district repeatedly to prevent crime, safeguard security, enforce order, or detect danger.
groups.summary_zh: 指在特定防区或管界内按规程走动巡查，以维持治安与防范险情。

groups.name: Pattern & Model · 依样塑形与仿模 (Model, Shape, Tailor)
groups.tip: 依照样板参考仿制模仿

items.def_zh: 模仿，仿效，仿造；用图案装饰；形成图案
items.def_en: To design, model, or form something according to a particular pattern or plan.
Adapt or modify something to fit a specific blueprint or distinct requirement
(+ on/after) Design, create, or structure something following a recognized exemplar
Form an object or conceptual entity within a preformed mold or template
Influence or shape the character or form of something according to a design

groups.summary_en: Verbs here emphasize constructing, configuring, or designing something explicitly based on an established prototype, blueprint, or paradigm. 'Pattern' and 'model' involve deliberate structural alignment with an exemplar.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据既定模板、样本或蓝图进行造型与设计。

groups.name: Pave & Surface · 铺设与铺筑 (Pave, Cobble, Flag)
groups.tip: 在物体表面铺垫或镀层

items.def_en: To apply a top layer such as asphalt, tar, or concrete to a road, court, or area to make it smooth and durable
To pave an area or walkway with large, flat slabs of stone (flagstones)
To cover a road, driveway, or airfield runway with tarmac or asphalt
To pave a street or pathway with rounded cobblestones
1. (+ with) To cover a road, path, or surface with flat stones, bricks, or concrete to make it firm and level.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe covering the ground or an outdoor pathway with durable materials like stone, brick, asphalt, or concrete to create a firm, even surface. Nuances distinguish between traditional stone-setting, mechanical surfacing, and modern roadwork.
groups.summary_zh: 指用石块、沥青或砖石铺砌道路或地表以使其平整坚固。

groups.name: Paw & Scrape · 抓挠与刨抓 (Paw, Scrape, Scratch)
groups.tip: 爪掌扒拉抓挠表面

items.def_zh: 用爪子轻扒，毛手毛脚抓取
items.def_en: To touch or scrape repeatedly with paws or clumsy, unwelcome hands
To rub or scrape the skin or a surface with claws, nails, or a rough implement

items.def_zh: （用爪子）抓挠，扒；（笨拙地）乱摸，拉扯
items.def_en: 1. To scrape, touch, or strike something with a paw or hoof. 2. To touch or handle someone roughly, clumsily, or inappropriately.
To drag a hard or sharp object forcefully along a surface, abrading it or making a grating sound
To feel about clumsily or touch someone intimately without their consent in an unwanted way

groups.summary_en: This frame covers touching, raking, or striking surfaces repeatedly using animal paws, hooves, or blunt, clumsy hands.
groups.summary_zh: 用爪蹄或笨拙的手掌抓挠、刨地或毛手毛脚地触碰。

groups.name: Pay Off & Amortize · 清偿与摊销 (Amortize, Liquidate, Redeem)
groups.tip: 按期分摊清偿贷款本息

items.def_en: To make regular scheduled interest and principal payments on an outstanding debt.
To pay the entire remaining balance of a debt or loan so that nothing more is owed.
To fulfill completely and relieve oneself of a financial or legal obligation or liability.
To pay off a loan, mortgage, bond, or pledged security in exchange for receiving title or freedom from obligation.

items.def_zh: 分期偿还（债务）；摊销（资产成本）
items.def_en: To gradually pay off a debt or spread the cost of an intangible asset over a fixed period through regular payments.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this financial frame denote discharging liabilities, settling debts systematically, or writing down capital expenditures over an agreed schedule. They contrast piecemeal installments against full, final clearance.
groups.summary_zh: 指按计划或协议逐步分期偿还债务、分摊资产成本或一次性清结。

groups.name: Peak & Summit · 登顶与征服顶峰 (Summit, Peak, Conquer)
groups.tip: 向上攀爬直至顶峰

items.def_en: Reach the very summit or peak of a mountain, ridge, or climbing pitch
Ascend all the way up a steep elevation to its highest reach
Reach the top of a hill, ridge, wave, or mountain peak
1. To reach the summit or peak of a mountain.
Succeed in climbing to the summit of a challenging or dangerous mountain

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on successfully reaching the absolute crest or highest peak of a mountain or altitude barrier, conveying achievement, culmination, and altitude progression.
groups.summary_zh: 指经过艰难攀爬最终登上山巅、征服顶峰的顶点动作。

groups.name: Peck & Dab · 啄食与轻击 (Peck, Dab, Tap)
groups.tip: 用喙或硬物轻快击打

items.def_en: To press or touch lightly and swiftly against a surface
To work gradually and persistently on a task in small, piecemeal increments
To strike lightly and repeatedly with a quick, rhythmic movement
To jab or prod sharply with a finger, stick, or pointed implement
1. (+ at) To strike, bite, or pick up something with a beak. 2. To kiss someone quickly and lightly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs here delineate short, pointed, strike-like contacts characteristic of bird beaks or rapid finger prods, extending naturally to hurried, slight kisses.
groups.summary_zh: 表示类似鸟喙啄食的短促轻敲、轻戳动作，亦指轻吻。

groups.name: Peel & Flake · 脱落与剥落 (Peel, Chip, Scale)
groups.tip: 表层风化成薄片剥离脱落

items.def_en: (+ off) To come off a surface in dry, scalelike pieces or coatings
(+ off/away) To lose skin, paint, or an outer layer in strips or thin sheets

items.def_zh: 剥落，成片脱落；使成薄片
items.def_en: 1. (+ off/away) to fall off in small, thin layers or pieces (such as paint, rust, or dry skin) 2. to break or cut something into small, thin slices or pieces
To cast off dead skin or an unwanted outer layer naturally
To lose small fragments or pieces from the edge or surface through a knock or decay

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail surfaces shedding dry layers, skin, coating, or fragments bit by bit through weathering, dryness, or physical damage.
groups.summary_zh: 指表层物质、漆皮或死皮逐渐翘起、剥落或成片掉落。

groups.name: Pension & Retire · 退休供养与遣散 (Superannuate, Retire, Sever)
groups.tip: 官方或机构拨发补贴

items.def_en: Cause someone to stop working, typically granting customary retirement benefits

items.def_zh: 发给养老金；发退休金让……退休
items.def_en: 1. To grant or pay a pension to someone. 2. ('pension off') To dismiss or retire someone and pay them a regular pension.
Retire an employee with a pension, especially on grounds of age or infirmity
Pay an employee or executive an agreed lump sum to terminate their employment contract
Grant someone a generous severance payment when they leave an executive post

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote releasing someone from service accompanied by regular income, pension disbursements, or structured severance allowances.
groups.summary_zh: 指随附定期年金、退休金或遣散费用的解职与赡养安排。

groups.name: Perch & Settle · 栖息与歇足 (Roost, Perch, Alight)
groups.tip: 禽鸟在树枝或横木上落脚安歇

items.def_en: (+ on / upon) To land and come to rest securely on a spot after movement
To squat close to the ground or settle into a sheltered, protective posture for rest
(+ on / atop) To alight or sit on a high, narrow, or precarious resting place
When birds or bats roost, they settle on a branch or in a shelter to rest or sleep.
(+ on / upon) To descend from the air and gently land or settle on a surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe landing, settling down, or perching precariously or temporarily upon a branch, elevated ledge, or resting spot, especially of birds, winged creatures, or people sitting high up.
groups.summary_zh: 指鸟兽落在高处枝条停歇，或人居高悬坐、暂时落脚停留。

groups.name: Perforate & Punch Holes · 打孔与穿孔撕裂 (Perforate, Punch, Riddle, Puncture)
groups.tip: 刺透破孔，分解隔断形体

items.def_en: To cut or press clean circular holes in paper, metal, or leather with a specific tool
To make tiny holes in a surface using a needle, fork, or sharp tip

items.def_zh: 刺破；戳穿（使漏气或破裂）
items.def_en: To make a small hole in something with a sharp point, compromising its seal

items.def_zh: 打孔于，在……上穿孔；穿透，刺穿
items.def_en: To make a row of small holes in something so it can be torn easily, or to pierce completely through a surface.

items.def_zh: 打得满是孔洞；使千疮百孔
items.def_en: To pierce something with numerous holes, typically through gunfire, shrapnel, or rot

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on creating rows or clusters of small openings or penetrating through a barrier with sharp tools or projectiles, often to weaken a seam or riddle an object with apertures.
groups.summary_zh: 用尖锐器物或冲具打穿一系列小孔，使之贯通或便于沿虚线撕开。

groups.name: Perforating Heavily · 弹孔密布与穿孔破坏 (Pepper, Perforate, Shot-through)
groups.tip: 打出孔洞使之千疮百孔

items.def_en: Pierce or breach a surface to break its containment
Make a series of holes or cuts in something, often in a line or pattern

items.def_zh: 连环射击；密密麻麻击打
items.def_en: Hit repeatedly with rapid bursts of small missiles, bullets, or blows

items.def_zh: 使布满窟窿，使千疮百孔；充斥；筛选
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To make a lot of holes in something. 2. (be riddled with) To be full of something undesirable, such as errors, disease, or corruption.
Pierce throughout with projectiles or permeate with defects

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate causing a surface or structure to be full of numerous holes, usually through sustained ballistic gunfire or widespread defects. Riddle emphasizes multiple penetrations, while pepper stresses rapid scattered impacts.
groups.summary_zh: 指密集射穿、打成筛子或造成满布孔洞的破坏状态。

groups.name: Perform Oral Sex · 施行口交与口部性爱 (Fellate, Perform oral sex, Blow)
groups.tip: 生理性交与亲密性行为

items.def_en: Stimulate someone's penis orally; give a blowjob (slang)
Stimulate a partner's genital organs using the lips, mouth, or tongue
Engage in oral sex on someone's genitals as an informal, direct idiom

items.def_zh: 施行女性口交（名词常作动用）
items.def_en: Perform oral stimulation of female genitalia (strictly clinical)

items.raw_cluster: 交媾与性行为 Copulate & Caress
items.def_en: (formal, clinical) To stimulate a penis with the mouth; perform oral sex on a male.

groups.summary_en: Lexical units denoting the performance of oral-genital stimulation, spanning clinical terminology, formal registers, and familiar idioms.
groups.summary_zh: 通过唇舌口腔对性器官施以性刺激或进行口部性爱。

groups.name: Perfume & Scent · 散发气味与赋香 (Perfume, Scent, Aromatize)
groups.tip: 喷洒香精让芬芳弥漫

items.def_en: Give a pleasant, distinctive fragrance to an environment, cosmetic, or object

items.def_zh: 使散发香气，使芳香；洒香水于
items.def_en: To give a pleasant, sweet smell to something, or to apply perfume to.

items.def_zh: 净化除臭，使气味清新芳香
items.def_en: Make the smell of the air, breath, or a place fresh and pleasing
Impart an aromatic odor or savory herbal aroma to air or a food product
Infuse a room, fabric, or cosmetic product with a sweet, delicate aroma

groups.summary_en: This frame covers imparting pleasant fragrances to an atmosphere or space, as well as substances naturally diffusing sweet, aromatic odors.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动赋香使充满芳香，或自然弥漫幽香。

groups.name: Perjure & Prevaricate · 伪证与诡辩 (Prevaricate, Equivocate, Bear false witness)
groups.tip: 法庭作伪证或故意说谎，违背真实誓言

items.def_en: To give false testimony against someone, especially under sworn oath in a formal setting
To alter a document, testimony, or record dishonestly so as to convey untruth
(perjure oneself) (law) To deliberately make a false statement while under oath in a court of law.

items.def_zh: 说模棱两可的话，含糊其词
items.def_en: To use ambiguous language deliberately to conceal the truth or mislead an audience

items.def_zh: 支吾其词，闪烁其词以推托
items.def_en: To speak or act evasively in order to avoid telling the absolute truth

groups.summary_en: Pertains to intentional deceit in legal, solemn, or forensic contexts, where an oath, sworn testimony, or strict obligation to truth is deliberately violated.
groups.summary_zh: 特指法庭作证、宣誓下提供伪证，或有意避重就轻狡辩弄假。

groups.name: Permute & Reorder · 字符重排与置换 (Permute, Scramble, Rearrange)
groups.tip: 打乱顺序重新组合排列

items.def_en: To put things into a different order or position
1. To rearrange the letters of a word or phrase to form a new word or phrase.
To restore jumbled letters, puzzle clues, or scrambled signals back to readable form
To mix up the components, letters, or sequence of something so they are not orderly
To change the order or arrangement of a set of items, especially in math or linguistics

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this linguistic and combinatorial frame denote the deliberate or puzzle-like repositioning of letters, digits, or sequence tokens to produce alternative words, codes, or arrangements. It stresses discrete, algorithmic manipulation.
groups.summary_zh: 指对字母、顺序或离散元素进行字谜式或置换式的重构。

groups.name: Perpetuate & Prolong · 维持延续与使永久化 (Prolong, Sustain, Immortalize)
groups.tip: 从日常维持到长久延续

items.def_en: To continue doing, keeping up, or maintaining a custom, activity, or lineage
To maintain or keep something going over a continuous period of time without letting it fail
To deliberately make something last longer than usual in duration
1. (formal) To cause a situation, belief, or system—especially an unfair one—to continue for a long time.
To cause someone or something to be remembered, celebrated, or preserved forever

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actions that cause conditions, beliefs, institutions, or states of affairs to continue indefinitely, often prolonging their lifespan far into the future.
groups.summary_zh: 延续、维系或使某种状态、制度或观念长期存续下去。

groups.name: Persistent Tugging & Plucking · 抽拉与扯动 (Tug, Pluck, Tweak)
groups.tip: 短促用力拉拽拖引

items.def_en: To apply force to someone or something so as to move them towards oneself
To pull, pinch, or twist something with a quick, small movement
To take hold of something and pull or pick it away with fingers in a quick motion
To exert continuous or intermittent pulls upon a hem, sleeve, or cord
1. (+ at/on) To pull something forcefully, quickly, or repeatedly. 2. To tow a boat or ship using a tugboat.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers repeated, localized, or small-scale pulling actions, such as pulling on a rope in intervals, plucking strings, or gently tweaking clothing.
groups.summary_zh: 强调局部的、反复的或间断性的牵拉、抓扯、拔拽细微动作。

groups.name: Persuade & Coax · 劝说与促成行动 (Persuade, Coax, Urge)
groups.tip: 循循善诱劝人信服

items.def_en: Convince someone to do something through conversation or argument
(formal) (+ upon) Persuade someone to do something after repeated requests
1. To convince someone to do something by giving good reasons. 2. To make someone believe that something is true.
Persuade someone gently and patiently to do something they may feel hesitant about
Persuade someone to do something by using flattering words, sweet talk, or false promises

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote actively motivating or inducing someone to take a specific course of action, employing reasoning, persistent urging, gentle enticement, or personal charm.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重积极运用说理、软磨硬泡或劝导手段促使当事人付诸行动。

groups.name: Pertain & Belong · 关联与属于 (Apply, Relate, Appertain)
groups.tip: 属于某个范畴或与此相关

items.def_en: (+ to) Have a logical or thematic connection to something
(+ to) Be relevant to, have a bearing on, or affect a particular person, group, or circumstance
(+ to) Be the property of someone, or be a member or proper part of a group or category

items.def_zh: 适于，属于（法言法语，+ to）
items.def_en: (+ to) Belong to or be connected as a rightful part or attribute, used chiefly in legal contexts
('pertain to') To relate directly to or have a connection with a particular subject, thing, or situation.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate an intrinsic connection, ownership, or formal applicability between an element, condition, or rule and a broader domain or context. Prepositional linkage (typically with 'to') is central to these relational predications.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在归属、适用性或固有性质上与特定领域或主体直接相关。

groups.name: Peter Out & Fizzle · 渐趋消逝与虎头蛇尾 (Peter Out, Fizzle, Taper Off, Wane)
groups.tip: 从声势浩大到草草收场

items.def_en: To gradually decrease in number, intensity, or activity towards a stop

items.def_zh: （尤指虎头蛇尾地）夭折，告吹，不了了之；发微弱嘶嘶声
items.def_en: 1. (often 'fizzle out') To gradually lose energy, enthusiasm, or strength and end in a weak or disappointing failure. 2. To make a weak, spluttering hissing sound.

items.def_zh: 逐渐消失；逐渐减弱以至完全停止
items.def_en: To gradually become smaller, weaker, or less active until it stops altogether

items.def_zh: 衰退；减退（影响力或兴趣）
items.def_en: To gradually become weaker or less important, powerful, or noticeable

items.def_zh: 烟消云散；骤然化为乌有
items.def_en: To disappear or vanish completely, especially of feelings, hope, or enthusiasm

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe events, processes, or enthusiasm that start with great promise or momentum but gradually lose vigor and end anticlimactically or weakly, rather than stopping abruptly.
groups.summary_zh: 指势头、计划或热情逐渐减退，无疾而终或虎头蛇尾。

groups.name: Philander & Womanize · 猎艳与调情 (Philander, Womanize, Flirt)
groups.tip: 不忠诚地到处留情嬉戏

items.def_en: (+ with) To behave playfully towards someone showing casual romantic or sexual attraction without serious intent

items.def_zh: 乱搞男女关系；调情厮混
items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in casual, illicit, or irresponsible sexual activity or flirting

items.def_zh: 调情，玩弄女性，到处留情
items.def_en: (disapproving) To engage in casual, non-committal sexual or romantic relationships with many partners.
To deceive a romantic partner by secretly having a relationship with someone else at the same time
To habitually engage in numerous casual sexual affairs with different women

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize entering into multiple casual, noncommittal, or deceptive romantic and sexual liaisons, often carrying strong connotations of unfaithfulness or superficial seduction.
groups.summary_zh: 多含贬义，指四处寻花问柳、猎艳调情且不愿承担感情承诺。

groups.name: Pierce & Impale · 刺穿与穿透 (Transfix, Pierce, Skewer)
groups.tip: 利器重度刺穿贯透

items.def_en: Force a sharp or pointed object through or into the skin or material surface
Thrust a spear or pointed implement into or through something with force
Fasten or pierce through meat or an object using a long pin, spit, or pointed skewer
Pierce completely through with a pointed weapon or sharp object, pinning in place

items.def_zh: 刺穿，扎透（尤指被尖物穿透）
items.def_en: To pierce through someone or something with a sharp, pointed object like a stake, spear, or spike.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the violent or forceful act of penetrating completely through a solid surface or body using a sharp, pointed, or rigid weapon/implement, pinning or piercing it thoroughly.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以尖锐利器强力刺入或贯穿物体与肉体。

groups.name: Plagiarize & Crib · 抄袭与剽窃 (Crib, Plagiarize, Copycat)
groups.tip: 暗中剽窃并照搬他人作品

items.def_en: To take and use passages, motifs, or concepts directly from another creator's work without credit
To reproduce, distribute, or exploit copyrighted intellectual property without authorization
To blatantly copy, duplicate, or steal someone else's original creative work or design
To copy someone else's written work, answers, or ideas dishonestly, especially in schoolwork or an exam.
To copy ideas, text, or work from another author and pass them off dishonestly as original creations

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe illicitly appropriating someone else's written material, ideas, or intellectual output and presenting them as one's own.
groups.summary_zh: 未经许可抄袭、剽窃他人作品或学术观点为己用。

groups.name: Plagiarize & Infringe · 抄袭与侵权盗用 (Plagiarize, Infringe, Appropriate)
groups.tip: 非法盗用他人智力创作成果

items.def_en: (informal) Steal or plagiarize words, tunes, or jokes directly from another source
Take someone else's intellectual or cultural ideas for one's own use without authorization
Illegally reproduce, copy, or distribute copyrighted music, software, or printed material
(+ on/upon) Violate or encroach upon someone else's legal rights, trademark, or patent
To take someone else's work, ideas, or words and pretend that they are your own.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express dishonest intellectual or artistic theft—misappropriating another's creative writing, ideas, patents, or intellectual property and falsely presenting them as original.
groups.summary_zh: 指盗用侵占他人的智力成果、学术观点或版权并据为己有。

groups.name: Plan & Scheme Strategically · 筹划与策划 (Design, Plot, Map out)
groups.tip: 预先设定步骤与策略

items.def_en: To plan the details of how something will happen, be done, or proceed
1. To decide on and arrange a set of actions in advance to achieve something. 2. To intend or hope to do something.
To make clever, secretive, or deceitful plans to achieve personal gain
To invent or plan a method, system, or solution cleverly in your mind
To make a secret plan with others to do something harmful, illegal, or wrong

groups.summary_en: This frame involves projecting steps forward, structuring intentions, and organizing strategies to accomplish a specific objective, whether benign or devious.
groups.summary_zh: 预先设定步骤、组织资源或谋划行动策略以达成目标。

groups.name: Play & Strum · 弹拨与演奏 (Strum, Pluck, Pick, Fingerpick)
groups.tip: 手指划拉琴弦演奏

items.def_en: Sound individual strings cleanly with a plectrum or fingertips
Pull and quickly release the strings of an instrument with the fingers or a plectrum

items.def_zh: 弹拨，轻弹（吉他等弦乐器）；漫不经心地弹奏
items.def_en: to play a guitar or other stringed instrument by moving your fingers or a plectrum across the strings
Pluck a taut string so that it produces a sharp, vibrating sound
Play a stringed instrument idly or monotonously by tapping or light strumming

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the manual techniques used to strike, brush, or pluck strings across musical instruments to produce notes or chords.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手指或拨片拂动、弹拨乐器琴弦发声的手法。

groups.name: Play to the Crowd & Posture · 哗众取宠与作秀 (Grandstand, Posture, Pander)
groups.tip: 卖弄吹嘘以引起大众关注

items.def_zh: 迎合低级趣味，讨好大众
items.def_en: To behave or speak in an exaggerated, populist way designed solely to win cheap applause
To adopt an artificial manner or take public stances solely to impress or deceive spectators
To express opinions publicly primarily to demonstrate one's good character or moral rectitude

items.def_zh: 趾高气扬地走，卖弄炫示
items.def_en: To walk or behave with an affected, arrogant swagger meant to draw admiration
1. (disapproving) To behave or speak showily in order to attract public applause and attention.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses theatrical public behavior, rhetorical posing, and calculated speech intended to garner applause, political clout, or moral superiority.
groups.summary_zh: 通过做作的姿态、夸张的言行博取公众掌声、选票或道德优越感。

groups.name: Pledge & Vow · 承诺与发誓 (Pledge, Swear, Vow)
groups.tip: 从口头承诺到立誓保证

items.def_en: To commit oneself formally to perform a task, fulfill an obligation, or enter into an agreement
To state or promise with extreme solemnity, often invoking a sacred entity or formal oath
1. To make a formal, solemn promise to do something or give support. 2. To give something valuable as security against a loan.
To make a determined and deeply serious commitment to do something or maintain a principle

items.def_zh: 立誓保证，以…起誓（常指婚约）
items.def_en: To solemnly pledge or give one's word or loyalty, especially in marriage or formal allegiance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate solemn, public, or legally binding promises committing the speaker to a specific cause, duty, or moral standard.
