groups.summary_zh: 以庄严、公开或誓言形式立下坚定承诺与支持。

groups.name: Plot & Conspire · 密谋与策划 (Hatch, Machinate, Cook up)
groups.tip: 暗中串通策划阴谋

items.def_en: To secretly make plans with others to achieve an unlawful, treasonous, or harmful goal
To engage in intricate, sinister schemes or intrigue to bring about a desired result
To invent, fabricate, or concoct a false story, plot, or fraudulent scheme

items.def_zh: 策划，密谋酝酿（尤指诡计）
items.def_en: To devise or concoct a secret plan, deception, or plot, usually over a period of time

items.def_zh: 密谋，图谋；（事物）合力促成（不良后果）
items.def_en: 1. To plan secretly with other people to do something illegal or harmful. 2. (of circumstances or events) To act together to bring about an unfortunate result.

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame covers hatching complex underhanded schemes against authorities or rivals, as well as the figurative sense where external circumstances combine unfavorably against an individual.
groups.summary_zh: 暗中运筹策划有害行动；或喻指外部客观条件对某人不利。

groups.name: Pluck & Pick · 拔取与摘采 (Pluck, Cull, Gather)
groups.tip: 捏住并用力向外拽拔

items.def_en: To pinch or cut off a shoot, bud, or small growth sharply between the fingers or shears
To break or pull flowers, fruit, or leaves away from a plant with the fingers
To pull or pinch something with a sudden, sharp twist or jerk
1. To pull something, especially feathers, hairs, or fruit, quickly and firmly off or out. 2. To sound the strings of a musical instrument by pulling and releasing them.
To select and remove individuals or parts from a larger group, especially to reduce numbers or improve quality

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on detaching or removing individual small items—such as feathers, hairs, leaves, or fruit—using a quick, pinching, or selective grasping motion. It contrasts bulk removal with selective, delicate gathering.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过掐、捏、拔等敏捷细巧的动作，逐个脱除毛羽或挑选采摘果实花叶。

groups.name: Plug & Block · 填塞与堵截 (Plug, Tamp, Pack)
groups.tip: 紧塞空腔防止液体漏出

items.def_en: To compress soft material into a compact ball and stuff it into a cavity or aperture
To press, strike, or pack down loose filling material firmly into a hole or cavity
To fill a body cavity or deep wound with gauze or absorbent dressings to control hemorrhage
To stop up an opening or leak by inserting a tightly fitting piece of material into it

items.def_zh: （用止血棉塞等）填塞，塞住（伤口或腔孔）以止血
items.def_en: (medical) To plug or pack a wound or body cavity with a tampon or absorbent material to stop bleeding.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on forcing an absorbent pad, mechanical plug, or dense mass into an orifice, puncture, or wound cavity to stem liquid leakage (notably blood), prevent airflow, or stabilize internal pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 指用材料填塞腔体、孔洞或伤口以止血或阻止流体外泄。

groups.name: Pock & Pit Surfaces · 使呈麻点与凹陷坑痕 (Pock, Pit, Scar, Dappling)
groups.tip: 留下麻点凹坑破坏完好

items.def_en: To make a notch, hollow, or impression in the surface or edge of something

items.def_zh: 使留伤疤；留下永久痕迹
items.def_en: To mark skin or a landscape with permanent tissue damage, marks, or deep disfigurements
To mark a surface or skin with numerous small hollow depressions or cavities

items.def_zh: 使有麻点，使留痘痕或凹坑
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To mark a surface or skin with small pits, hollow marks, or scars.
To form large bowl-shaped depressions or cavities across a landscape or surface

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe marking or disfiguring a surface or skin with many small indentations, hollow pits, craters, or corrosive depressions.
groups.summary_zh: 使物体表面或皮肤密布凹坑、麻点、疤痕或凹印。

groups.name: Poetic Phonetics & Verse Devices · 音律修辞与押韵 (Alliterate, Rhyme, Assonate)
groups.tip: 押头韵或依音律节奏朗诵排列

items.def_en: To end with the same final vowel and consonant sound as another word
To produce harmonious, matching, or melodious poetic sounds
To exhibit resonance or resemblance of internal vowel sounds in nearby words
To repeat consonant patterns in proximity while having differing vowel sounds
(of words or phrases) To begin with the same consonant sound or letter for poetic or literary effect.

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies linguistic and poetic articulation techniques where words are deliberately arranged according to recurring consonant or vowel sound patterns.
groups.summary_zh: 指向诗歌文学中头韵、尾韵等声音共鸣与对称修辞手法。

groups.name: Point & Gesture · 指向与标示 (Point, Indicate, Gesture)
groups.tip: 引导视线或标明具体方向

items.def_zh: 指，指向；指明，指出；对准，瞄准
items.def_en: 1. To direct someone's attention toward a place, direction, person, or thing by extending a finger or object. 2. To aim or direct something at someone or something
To indicate direction or intent using a gesture, movement, or signaling device

items.def_zh: 打手势示意（方向或动作）
items.def_en: To direct someone toward a place or action with a movement of your hand or head
To direct someone's attention to someone or something by pointing with a finger or mentioning them
To move your hands, head, or arms to direct attention toward something or someone

groups.summary_en: These verbs focus on directing physical or visual attention toward an object, person, or coordinate using gestures, limbs, or physical markers. The frame centers on spatial and physical orientation rather than symbolic meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助肢体动作、手势或实体标记在空间上标示方位与对象。

groups.name: Poke & Nudge · 戳捅与轻推促动 (Prod, Poke, Nudge)
groups.tip: 用尖状物反复戳捅推撞

items.def_en: To push someone gently with your elbow or hand, especially to attract attention
To quickly push a finger, sharp object, or stick into someone or something
To give a slight push or shake to someone, or stimulate a memory gently
1. To push someone or something with a finger or a pointed object. 2. To encourage or remind someone to do something.
To push a sharp or blunt object abruptly, roughly, and hard into something

groups.summary_en: Involves tactile contact using a finger, elbow, or blunt implement to draw attention, stir movement, or prompt action, smoothly transitioning to mental urging or nagging.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手指、胳膊肘或棍棒轻推、戳捅以引起注意或督促行动。

groups.name: Poke & Pierce · 刺破与扎穿 (Puncture, Pierce, Perforate)
groups.tip: 尖物扎入并贯穿孔洞

items.def_en: To make a very small hole in skin or a surface with a needle or sharp point

items.def_zh: 刺穿，刺破；揭穿，削弱；（轮胎等）被刺破
items.def_en: 1. To make a small hole in something with a sharp point, or to develop such a hole. 2. To suddenly lessen or destroy someone's confidence, pride, or enthusiasm.
To make a hole in or through something with a sharp, pointed object
To make a series of small holes in something, or puncture an internal organ
To push a sharp, pointed stake or weapon entirely through someone's body

groups.summary_en: Describes sharp mechanical penetration that breaches an outer envelope, membrane, or barrier. Encompasses surgical incisions, pneumatic punctures, and metaphoric deflation of arrogance.
groups.summary_zh: 指尖锐物体刺透外皮、隔膜或屏障造成孔洞，亦指戳破气焰。

groups.name: Polarize & Alienate · 分化与离间 (Factionalize, Estrange, Drive a wedge)
groups.tip: 挑动对立使阵营彻底两极化

items.def_en: To make someone feel isolated, estranged, or hostile toward others
To act in a way that damages or destroys harmonious relations between people or groups
To break or cause a political party, group, or organization to divide into smaller warring factions
To cause someone to stop being friendly or affectionate toward family or friends

items.def_zh: （使）两极分化，（使）截然对立；（物理）（使）偏振，（使）极化
items.def_en: 1. To cause people or opinions to divide sharply into two completely opposing camps. 2. (physics) To restrict the vibrations of a wave, especially light, wholly or partially to one direction.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey dividing groups or individuals into sharply opposing, hostile factions, or severing emotional bonds. They emphasize the creation of ideological rifts, animosity, or social estrangement.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重制造对立阵营、瓦解团结或使群体与人际关系产生深刻裂痕。

groups.name: Police & Patrol · 治安与巡卫 (Patrol, Guard, Regulate)
groups.tip: 治安巡查与秩序维护

items.def_en: 1. To keep order and maintain security in an area using police or armed patrols; to control or supervise an activity to ensure rules are kept.
To watch over in order to protect against assault, escape, or infringement
To control an activity, industry, or public behavior using detailed rules and standards
To walk or drive around an area regularly to prevent crime or ensure security
To stay in a designated post alertly to monitor security and prevent intrusion

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to exercising law enforcement, guarding public order, making regular rounds of security, or supervising compliance with rules.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过巡逻、护卫等行政安保手段维持秩序与监督法规。

groups.name: Polish & Refine · 润色与完善 (Polish up, Finesse, Tweak)
groups.tip: 由粗糙磨砺到精益求精的完善

items.def_en: To make someone or something look much neater, cleaner, and more stylish with quick adjustments

items.def_zh: 重温；打磨修整；使更完美
items.def_en: To practice, review, or edit something so as to bring it to a high, flawless standard

items.def_zh: 擦亮，磨光；润色，修饰；变光滑发亮
items.def_en: 1. To make something smooth and shiny by rubbing it. 2. To improve or refine a piece of work by making minor changes.
To make subtle improvements to an idea, method, or text in order to make it more elegant or precise
To adjust or handle something with great delicacy, tactical skill, or artistic craftsmanship

groups.summary_en: Covers both the physical act of brightening a surface and the pervasive figurative extension of improving drafts, speeches, or skills through small, elegant adjustments to eliminate residual clumsiness.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理抛光或对文字、技能、方案进行精修润色，祛除瑕疵。

groups.name: Political Unification & Federation · 联邦化与政治联合 (Federalize, Confederate, Centralize)
groups.tip: 建立联邦达成组织联合

items.def_en: To combine diverse political, economic, or territorial systems into a harmonious, functioning whole
To unite or form an alliance of states, bodies, or individuals into a loose political federation
To consolidate authority, administration, or control under a single central governing body
To join together or organize distinct states or organizations into a unified federal framework

items.def_zh: 使形成联邦，使联盟；归联邦管辖
items.def_en: 1. To unite separate states under a central federal government, or bring an issue or agency under federal authority.

groups.summary_en: This constitutional and institutional frame involves binding distinct regional territories, states, or autonomous entities into an organized political union under a centralized governing authority, transferring local powers to the federal level.
groups.summary_zh: 特指将分散的地方、邦国或机构整合并入中央联邦体系的建制行为。

groups.name: Pollute & Contaminate · 污染与玷污 (Pollute, Taint, Defile)
groups.tip: 混入有害物破坏纯净

items.def_en: 1. To make a substance or place impure, dirty, or dangerous by adding a harmful or toxic agent.
To make land, air, or water dirty and dangerous by adding harmful chemicals or waste
To spoil or damage the purity, taste, or reputation of something slightly but noticeably
To spoil something sacred, pure, or beautiful with deliberate disrespect or filth
To make foul, filthy, or disgusting with dirt or sewage

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to introducing impurities, toxins, or moral corruptions that spoil the cleanliness, integrity, or safety of a substance, environment, or reputation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过有毒有害物质或道德污渍破坏纯洁与安全。

groups.name: Pool & Centralize · 归拢与统筹聚合 (Pool, Amalgamate, Centralize)
groups.tip: 聚集各方资源共同使用

items.def_en: To join with several people to collect a shared sum of money for a common purchase

items.def_zh: 合伙汇集，共用（资金、资源或想法）；汇成水潭
items.def_en: 1. to collect together money, equipment, or ideas from different people or groups for shared use 2. (of liquid) to collect in a pool or puddle
To bring together different things such as funds, debts, or businesses into a single unified whole
To bring the control and distribution of resources or activities under one single central authority
To merge different organizations, resources, or operations into one single group

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the strategic combining of disparate assets, funds, or materials into a unified collective cache. The focus is on consolidating divided resources so they can be managed more efficiently or deployed for common benefit.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将分散的资金、物资集中归拢以便统筹使用。

groups.name: Portray & Delineate Vividly · 传神描摹与细致刻画 (Limn, Delineate, Depict)
groups.tip: 用生动文字刻画描摹形象

items.def_en: To make a brief or quick drawing or description giving only the essential outlines
To represent someone or something in a picture, sculpture, or detailed verbal description
To show or describe someone or something in a particular way in art, film, or literature
To describe, portray, or outline with sharp precision and exact boundary definitions
To depict or describe something vividly in words; to draw or paint.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses descriptive representation—in painting or literature—where artists and writers render scenes, contours, and character features with exceptional clarity.
groups.summary_zh: 用文字或笔触生动刻画轮廓细节，生动呈现形象。

groups.name: Pose & Present · 提出与呈现 (Present, Postulate, Put forward)
groups.tip: 将方案或问题正式摆上台面

items.def_en: To introduce or cause an issue, challenge, or question to arise and be dealt with
To introduce a subject or question for consideration or debate

items.def_zh: 提出（问题、疑问等）；造成，引起（威胁、风险等）；摆姿势
items.def_en: 1. To put forward a question, problem, or suggestion for consideration. 2. To create or cause a threat, danger, or difficulty. 3. To assume a particular position for a picture or artist.
To suggest an idea, proposition, or candidate for people to discuss or decide upon
To suggest or assume the existence, fact, or truth of something as a basis for reasoning

groups.summary_en: Focuses on setting forth problems, queries, or challenges for consideration, or projecting an obstacle directly into someone's path.
groups.summary_zh: 提出问题、假设或对局面构成直接挑战。

groups.name: Possess Ability · 能力与胜任 (Can, Manage, Be able to)
groups.tip: 具备完成某事的潜能与条件

items.def_en: To possess the physical or mental skill, capacity, or opportunity to do something

items.def_zh: 能，可以；可能；（用于委婉请求、建议或许可）可以
items.def_en: (modal auxiliary) Used to express past ability, possibility, or polite requests and suggestions.
(+ to do) To succeed in doing something difficult or demanding through effort
(informal, often with can/can't) To be able to endure, manage, or successfully perform under pressure
(+ with) To successfully deal with a challenging problem or difficult situation

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses expressing inherent, learned, or situational competence and capability to perform actions or achieve results.
groups.summary_zh: 指主语具备执行某动作、克服困难或达成目标的潜能与能力。

groups.name: Pot & Transplant · 盆栽与移栽培育 (Pot, Repot, Bed out)
groups.tip: 把幼苗栽入花盆或土壤栽培

items.def_zh: 把……栽入盆中；（台球等）击球入袋
items.def_en:
1. to plant or transplant a flower, plant, or seedling in a pot
2. to hit a ball into a pocket in snooker or billiards
to shift an established young plant into the next size container to support root expansion
to transplant greenhouse or potted seedlings into open garden beds for seasonal flowering
to dig up a growing plant from one location and root it firmly into another plot or vessel
to transfer a growing potted plant into a different, usually larger container with fresh compost

groups.summary_en: This horticultural frame focuses on planting, housing, or moving seedlings and domestic flora into containers or dedicated nursery beds. It highlights hands-on gardening manipulation of delicate roots and soils.
groups.summary_zh: 指将植物幼苗移栽至花盆、苗床或花园容器中进行培植管理。

groups.name: Potter & Potter Around · 悠闲游逛与磨蹭 (Putter, Potter, Dally)
groups.tip: 悠闲随意漫无目的地行走

items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To walk around slowly and aimlessly, or spend time doing small, relaxed, unhurried tasks.
To manage to get through a situation or activity without clear organization, plan, or urgency

items.def_zh: 慢悠悠地闲逛或做琐事
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To spend time in a relaxed, pleasant way doing small, unimportant tasks or wandering slowly
(+ with/around) To make small, casual changes or minor repairs to something in an amateur or leisurely way
To act or move slowly and waste time aimlessly when one ought to be proceeding

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving about slowly and unhurriedly while occupying oneself with pleasant, trivial, or aimless tasks. They highlight a relaxed, unstructured tempo without urgent intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指不紧不慢地游逛、闲逛或漫无目的地摆弄琐事。

groups.name: Praise & Bless · 赞扬与祝祷 (Bless, Sanctify, Exalt)
groups.tip: 虔诚祈福与由衷赞美之词

items.def_zh: 祝福，祈福；保佑；赞美，称颂
items.def_en: 1. To ask God to protect someone or something. 2. To praise or thank God. 3. (usually passive) To endow or favor someone with something pleasant or advantageous.
To worship and honor God, or to praise someone or something in an exalted way
To praise or honor someone or something very highly, often raising them to elevated status
To officially dedicate something to God or religious purposes, conferring sacred status

items.def_zh: 使神圣化，批准/使合法化
items.def_en: To declare or make holy, or to give official moral or religious sanction to something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame combine spoken adoration, religious veneration, and the invocation of divine favor or spiritual safeguarding. They bridge solemn prayerful reverence and elevated moral praise.
groups.summary_zh: 兼具祈福与敬颂之意，通过宗教或至高崇敬之辞施加护佑与赞美。

groups.name: Prank & Play Practical Jokes · 恶搞与捉弄 (Prank, Bamboozle, Hoodwink)
groups.tip: 设局恶作剧或整蛊戏弄人

items.def_en: To perform a mischievous act or deception designed to confuse or embarrass someone harmlessly
1. (informal) To play a practical joke or mischievous trick on someone. 2. (archaic) To dress up or decorate showily.
To trick someone good-naturedly, or to satirize and mock something through clever imitation
To subject someone to an elaborate practical joke or deceptive prank, often publicly
To deceive, trick, or fool someone into believing something that is not true

groups.summary_en: This frame covers playing mischievous tricks or practical jokes on others, typically intended for amusement, embarrassment, or lighthearted mockery rather than malicious theft. Nuances range from silly social gags to elaborate deceptive hoaxes.
groups.summary_zh: 出于取乐或恶作剧目的捉弄、开涮或愚弄他人。

groups.name: Preach & Evangelize · 布道与宣讲 (Evangelize, Proselytize, Preach)
groups.tip: 热忱宣讲宗教福音，积极传播信仰教义

items.def_en: (+ to) To talk publicly about personal religious faith to persuade others
To lecture someone tediously or give moral advice in an unwelcome way
To deliver a religious sermon or advocate a moral principle earnestly

items.def_zh: 劝诱改宗；极力兜售观点
items.def_en: To try to persuade someone to change their religious or political beliefs

items.def_zh: 传教，宣讲福音，使皈依基督教；热心鼓吹，热忱倡导
items.def_en: 1. To preach the Christian gospel in order to convert people. 2. To advocate or promote an idea, cause, or product with great enthusiasm.

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote proclaiming religious doctrine, moral tenets, or fervent ideological beliefs, often with the explicit intention of converting or convicting the listener.
groups.summary_zh: 指热情宣讲宗教教义或劝诱他人改变信仰与立场。

groups.name: Precede & Lead · 先行与居前 (Precede, Lead, Antedate)
groups.tip: 在时间或位次上走在前面

items.def_en: To walk or travel in front of others, or be the first to do something innovative
To have existed or happened before another event or period
To mark or cause the beginning of a new period, era, or development

items.def_zh: （在时间、顺序或空间上）先于，早于，走在……前面
items.def_en: To happen, exist, or go before someone or something in time, order, or position.
To be a sign that a particular event or change is about to begin

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses verbs describing an entity occurring, moving, or being ranked ahead of another in time, sequence, or spatial progression. They highlight temporal order or comparative precedence in hierarchical structures.
groups.summary_zh: 指在时间、序列或空间上位于另一事物之前，强调时序与排列前位。

groups.name: Precipitate & Spark · 骤然引发与促成 (Precipitate, Trigger, Spark)
groups.tip: 外界刺激促使快速发生

items.def_en: To start a sequence of events, an argument, or an alarm abruptly

items.def_zh: 触发，引起（连锁反应、事件）
items.def_en: To make something happen very quickly, especially a chain of events or a strong reaction
To cause the start of something energetic, intense, or violent, such as protest or debate

items.def_zh: 煽动，发起（冲突或不良行为）
items.def_en: To deliberately initiate or provoke an action, inquiry, revolt, or bad situation

items.def_zh: 促成，使突发；使沉淀；猛抛，使陷入
items.def_en: 1. to make something serious or bad happen suddenly or sooner than expected 2. (chemistry) to separate, or cause to separate, as a solid substance from a solution

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe acting as the sudden catalyst that accelerates, triggers, or brings about a major event or crisis prematurely.
groups.summary_zh: 作为诱因瞬间引爆危机、剧变或使事态急剧恶化。

groups.name: Precision Extraction & Plucking · 细微拔除与镊取 (Tweeze, Pluck, Weed out)
groups.tip: 用工具或手指夹拔拔除

items.def_en: To extract something embedded or anchored by gripping and pulling
To pull something out or remove hairs and feathers with a quick, sharp tug
To pluck, pull out, or remove tiny objects or hairs using tweezers.
To remove or pull something out carefully, especially with effort or instruments
To pull something out by the roots, or seek out and completely eradicate

groups.summary_en: This manipulation frame deals with pulling or extracting small, delicate, or embedded items (such as hairs, splinters, or weeds) with precision tools or careful finger grips. Nuances distinguish cosmetic grooming, agricultural removal, and delicate tool-based extraction.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用镊子或手指导向，精细拔出或剔除细小毛发、杂物。

groups.name: Predate & Antiquate · 早于与溯源 (Predate, Antedate, Pre-exist)
groups.tip: 在时间或顺序上走在前面

items.def_zh: 在时间上早于；早于……出现
items.def_en: To have occurred, originated, or existed at a date prior to another
To exist prior to a particular event, point in time, or subsequent entity
To have been made or started at a specific, earlier period in history

items.def_zh: 在时间上早于，先于；倒填……的日期
items.def_en: 1. To exist or happen at an earlier time than something else. 2. To put a date on a document that is earlier than the actual date.
To act as an early indication or warning of a future event

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify an exact historical or chronological priority where one event, artifact, or concept existed before another. They focus strictly on objective temporal sequence rather than spatial leadership.
groups.summary_zh: 专注于历史年代或客观时间线上早于某事物，强调渊源先后。

groups.name: Predetermine & Destine · 预先决定与注定 (Predetermine, Foreordain, Preordain)
groups.tip: 下定决心提前做裁定

items.def_en: To appoint, decree, or determine an outcome beforehand by fate or divine will
To decide, decree, or fix something irrevocably in advance
To predetermine someone or something to an inevitable, often adverse outcome
To intend or set apart someone or something for a particular fate or purpose
(formal) to decide, establish, or control an outcome or fate in advance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to settling, dictating, or establishing events, outcomes, or fates ahead of time through authority, destiny, or causal necessity. They emphasize advance control that leaves little room for contingency.
groups.summary_zh: 指在事态发生前通过命运、权威或因果规律预先确定结局或走向。

groups.name: Preempt & Eliminate · 预防与免除 (Preclude, Forestall, Rule Out)
groups.tip: 提前采取措施使困难不再必要

items.def_en: To remove or get rid of completely, especially a risk, variable, or defect
To decide that something is impossible or unsuitable and eliminate it from consideration
To make something impossible in advance, especially by an existing condition
To act beforehand to prevent an anticipated event or action from occurring

items.def_zh: 消除，排除；使不再需要，避免
items.def_en: (formal) to remove a difficulty, risk, or need so that something is no longer necessary

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify taking anticipatory action to render difficulties, requirements, risks, or possibilities impossible or completely unnecessary.
groups.summary_zh: 通过前瞻性行动使困难、需要或可能性不再存在，起到免除或杜绝作用。

groups.name: Prelude & Foreshadow · 发起与成为序曲 (Herald, Usher in, Presage)
groups.tip: 作为序幕掀开某一进程

items.def_en: To signal or cause the beginning of a major period, change, or state
To occur immediately before and serve as a sequential introduction to an event
To be a sign that a major event or new era is about to happen

items.def_zh: 作为……的序幕，成为……的前奏
items.def_en: To serve as an introduction or opening event to something more important.
To act as a warning or omen of a future event

groups.summary_en: Covers events or actions that precede, introduce, or foreshadow a major subsequent development. Emphasizes an opening act or signaling of a significant shift.
groups.summary_zh: 作为重大事件的前奏或序幕，预示并开启新阶段。

groups.name: Prepare & Cook Food · 烹制与配餐 (Cook, Bake, Whip Up)
groups.tip: 煎炒烘焙烹调美味食物

items.def_en: 1. To prepare food by heating it, or to be heated and prepared as food.
Cook food by dry heat without direct exposure to a flame, typically in an oven.
Prepare a meal or dish very quickly and effortlessly.

items.def_zh: 临时张罗，迅速做成（饭菜）
items.def_en: Quickly prepare a meal or snack using whatever ingredients are available.
Cook meat or vegetables in an oven or over an open fire.

groups.summary_en: This broad culinary frame covers preparing meals through dry heat, baking, or assembling ingredients by cooking. It ranges from standard oven techniques to quick, informal food preparation.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖通过加热或快手制作准备膳食的核心烹饪动作与日常表达。

groups.name: Preserve & Conserve · 防腐与生物定质保存 (Pickle, Embalm, Mummify)
groups.tip: 利用腌渍等手段长期储藏

items.def_en: to preserve meat, fish, or hides by salting, smoking, or drying

items.def_zh: 腌制，用盐水（或醋）腌渍；酸洗
items.def_en: 1. To preserve vegetables, fish, or eggs in vinegar or salt water.
to treat a dead body with special chemicals to prevent decay
to convert organic remains into stone or a mineralized petrified state

items.def_zh: （把尸体）制成木乃伊；干枯成木乃伊
items.def_en: 1. To preserve a dead body by drying or embalming it so it does not decay, or to dry up like a mummy.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail chemical or physical treatments applied to organic matter (food, dead bodies, tissues) to halt microbial decomposition and permanently maintain its state.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过浸渍、脱水或化学药物处理有机体以防止腐化变质。

groups.name: Preserve & Mummify · 防腐与保存 (Embalm, Mummify, Preserve)
groups.tip: 使用药物技术长久保存

items.def_en: To treat food, biological specimens, or corpses to prevent organic decay and microbial spoilage
To treat, stuff, and mount the skin of a dead animal to recreate a lifelike appearance
To preserve organic specimens or biological material by submerging them in a chemical solution such as formalin or alcohol

items.def_zh: 对（尸体）进行防腐处理；使不朽，使铭记
items.def_en: 1. To treat a dead body with chemicals, oils, or spices to prevent it from decaying. 2. (literary) To keep the memory of someone or something fresh forever.
To preserve a dead body by desiccating it and treating it with special oils, salts, or spices

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve chemical, culinary, or funerary treatments designed to halt biological decomposition and decay, preserving human tissue, specimens, or perishable organic matter over prolonged periods.
groups.summary_zh: 采用药剂、化学品或特殊工艺处理尸体或有机物，防止腐烂分解。

groups.name: Preside & Officiate Officially · 依职权主持与掌管 (Preside, Officiate, Convene)
groups.tip: 执掌主位主持大局

items.def_zh: 带领；引导（代表团、正式流程）
items.def_en: to be in charge of or guide a delegation, prayer, or official protocol

items.def_zh: 主持，主管，掌管（会议、仪式、组织等）
items.def_en: (+ over/at) to be in charge of a meeting, ceremony, or organization and direct its proceedings.

items.def_zh: 召集；主持召开（正式会议）
items.def_en: [I/T] to call together and open a formal assembly, court, or council

items.def_zh: 主持（仪式、宗教典礼）；行使职务；担任裁判
items.def_en: (+ at/in) to perform official duties and lead a formal event, such as a religious ceremony or sports match.
[I/T] to act as a judge in a dispute or formal institutional hearing

groups.summary_en: An official, judge, priest, or high executive exercises statutory or ceremonial authority over formal legal proceedings, solemn rites, or parliamentary bodies. Verbs highlight legal mandate ('preside over'), religious/ritual authority ('officiate'), or administrative power ('direct').
groups.summary_zh: 依官方或宗教职权主持法律诉讼、宗教典礼或正式会议。

groups.name: Press & Compact · 压制与压实 (Pack, Ram, Compact)
groups.tip: 向下施压使之密实紧固

items.def_en: To press loose earth, snow, or powder firmly into a solid layer
To exert continuous pressure on something so that it forms a firm, tight, and solid mass
To force the parts of something into less space by applying mechanical pressure
(+ down) To ram or press something down firmly by repeated light blows.
(+ down/in) To drive or push something down firmly with repeated violent impact

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting forceful, repeated, or heavy downward pressure on loose material to compress it into a denser, firmer mass.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过向下挤压、夯击或碾压使松散物料紧实致密。

groups.name: Press & Compress · 挤压与压实 (Compress, Squeeze, Flatten)
groups.tip: 施加垂直压力使其受压变形

items.def_zh: 压，按，挤压；逼迫，催促；熨烫
items.def_en: 1. To push firmly against or apply steady force to something; to squeeze. 2. To urge or strongly persuade someone to do something
To press firmly from both or all sides, especially with the hands to force liquid out or reduce size
To press or squeeze something together so that it takes up less space or becomes denser
To make something level, even, or flat by applying downward or rolling pressure
To pack or press loose particles or earth tightly together into a solid, firm mass

groups.summary_en: This frame captures applying continuous, direct mechanical force onto an object to compact it, flatten it, extract its contents, or reduce its volume. 'Press' denotes direct perpendicular pressure, while 'compress' focuses on volumetric shrinkage, and 'flatten' on transforming 3D shape into a sheet.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加持续压力使物体压紧、压实、压扁或挤出汁液内部物质。

groups.name: Prevent & Bar · 阻碍与禁止 (Bar, Block, Ban)
groups.tip: 立设门槛严令阻绝

items.def_en: To exclude someone from entering a location, joining an activity, or having access to an opportunity
To stop something from moving forward, or to close off an entrance, path, or process

items.def_zh: 阻拦，阻挡；禁止，阻止；用门闩闩上
items.def_en: 1. To close or secure an entrance with bars or a door bolt. 2. To prevent someone from going somewhere, or ban them from doing something.
To forbid someone officially from doing something or entering a place, usually by law or regulation

items.def_zh: 正式剥夺资格；排斥在外
items.def_en: To officially exclude or prohibit someone from an activity, right, or privilege

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on officially, legally, or physically barring an agent from access, participation, or forward progress through authoritative or physical obstacles.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法律、权威或物理障碍强行禁止进入或阻隔行动。

groups.name: Prevent & Preclude · 阻碍与杜绝 (Prevent, Preclude, Bar)
groups.tip: 防患未然阻断发生

items.def_zh: 正式阻止；封堵（权利或途径）
items.def_en: to officially forbid someone from doing something, or prevent an action or entry
1. (+ from) To stop something from happening or prevent someone from doing something.
to take action to stop something unpleasant from happening before it starts
1. (+ from) (formal) To make something impossible, or to prevent someone from doing something.
to prevent something from happening or someone from doing something by doing something first

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stopping an action, event, or condition from happening in advance, ranging from general proactive deterrence to absolute structural or logical exclusion.
groups.summary_zh: 指预先采取行动或因条件限制而使某事无法发生。

groups.name: Preview & Pre-screen · 试映与预先审看 (Preview, Screen, Sample)
groups.tip: 提前预览把关整体效果

items.def_en: Try, hear, or inspect a small part of a work or product before experiencing the whole
Show a film or video to a selected audience before public release

items.def_zh: 预览，预先审查；试映，预演
items.def_en: To inspect, view, or exhibit something before it is officially released or shown to the public.
Get an informal, early look at an unreleased product, movie, or presentation
Examine material thoroughly before allowing it to be shown or disseminated publicly

groups.summary_en: Verbs centered on seeing, examining, or displaying creative works, media, or exhibits in advance of broad release to evaluate quality, readiness, or reaction.
groups.summary_zh: 指在正式公开放映、出版或展出前预先观摩、审查或试看。

groups.name: Prickling & Thrilling Sensations · 麻刺与微颤感 (Prickle, Throbbing, Thrill)
groups.tip: 皮肤如针扎般麻木微刺

items.def_zh: 嗡嗡鸣响；有微颤麻刺感
items.def_en: Vibrate or tingle continuously with energy, excitement, or sensory overload

items.def_zh: 感到刺痛，发麻；（因强烈情感而）激动
items.def_en: To have a slight prickling, stinging, or vibrating feeling on your skin, especially from cold, excitement, or fear.
Experience a slight, sharp prickling or itching feeling across the skin
(of skin/flesh) Feel as if tiny insects are creeping over it from fear or revulsion

items.def_zh: 感到阵阵震颤；使激动颤抖
items.def_en: Produce or experience a sudden wave of keen physical excitement or shivering sensation

groups.summary_en: This frame covers slight prickling, tingling, or crawling sensations on the skin, triggered by cold, returning circulation, or intense emotion. Tingle and prickle describe subtle electrical or needle-like skin sensations, whereas thrum and thrill suggest vibrant resonance.
groups.summary_zh: 因寒冷、血液流通或情绪激动引起的皮肤发麻、刺痒或震颤感。

groups.name: Prime & Undercoat · 打底与涂封 (Undercoat, Prime, Precoat)
groups.tip: 给工件打底漆涂抹保护涂层

items.def_en: To lay down an initial priming foundation layer on canvas or board prior to painting
To coat a porous material like paper, plaster, or canvas with gelatinous size to seal it
To brush or spray a clear protective sealant over a porous base to prevent fluid penetration
To apply a preliminary coat of primer onto an untreated surface before the main paint layer
to apply a base layer of paint or protective primer to a surface before adding the top coat

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this technical preparation frame concern applying a preliminary foundational layer of paint, sealant, or primer before adding finishing topcoats. This provides adhesion, prevents absorption, or blocks corrosion.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及在涂刷面漆前施加底漆或密封层，以增强附着力和防腐封闭性。

groups.name: Privatize & Denationalize · 私有化与民营转制 (Privatize, Denationalize, Deregulate)
groups.tip: 把公有资产转为私有民营

items.def_zh: 非国有化；使脱离国家所有
items.def_en: to restore a nationalized enterprise, industry, or public property to private ownership
to arrange for external private companies to supply public or municipal services
to sell off enterprise assets, business holdings, or subsidiary investments

items.raw_cluster: 私有化与转移 Privatize & Transfer
items.def_en: to sell or transfer a state-owned business, industry, or public service to private ownership
to remove or reduce state regulations, restrictions, and statutory oversight in a sector

groups.summary_en: This macroeconomic policy frame describes divesting state assets, nationalized monopolies, or public utilities to private corporations or market investors, alongside reducing bureaucratic state controls.
groups.summary_zh: 指政府将国有资产、公共服务或专营权出售转让给民营企业或资本。

groups.name: Procreate & Bear · 繁育与孕育 (Beget, Sire, Conceive)
groups.tip: 生物繁衍诞下新生命

items.def_zh: 做……的父亲，生（子）；创立，首创
items.def_en: 1. To be the biological father of a child; to make someone pregnant. 2. To initiate or create a new idea or invention.
To become pregnant with a child in the womb

items.def_zh: 成为…的父亲；（雄性动物）配种繁殖
items.def_en: To be the male parent of an animal or, more rarely, a human child
To produce children as a father, or literary to cause something to happen
To produce young or offspring through sexual reproduction

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the biological or metaphorical generation of offspring and lineages. It distinguishes between male paternal acts of siring, maternal acts of conceiving and bearing, and broader figurative procreation.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖生育、孕育后代以及引申的催生事物，区分父系与母系生殖角色。

groups.name: Procure & Source · 采购与物色 (Procure, Requisition, Purvey)
groups.tip: 寻找货源并采购

items.def_en: To obtain materials, components, or services from a particular supplier, place, or business.
Obtain goods or services from an outside or foreign supplier instead of an internal source
Provide or supply food, goods, or services as a business
Obtain goods or supplies, especially with care or through formal organizational channels
Demand the use or supply of materials by an official order

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the systematic, professional, or logistical acquisition of goods, materials, or suppliers for organizational or commercial purposes.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过特定渠道、供应链或正规流程系统性采购与物色物资。

groups.name: Procurement & Pandering · 居间拉皮条与色情揽客 (Pimp, Procure, Pander)
groups.tip: 暗中拉拢涉足灰色非法交易

items.def_zh: 招揽顾客；兜售色情服务
items.def_en: To aggressively solicit business, patronage, or illicit services from passersby

items.raw_cluster: 拉皮条与包办 Procure & Pimp
items.def_zh: 拉皮条；包办拉拢；（俚语）打扮，改装
items.def_en: 1. To act as a pimp by procuring clients for prostitutes. 2. (slang, usually 'pimp out/up') To customize, decorate, or make something showy.
To obtain or provide a person to act as a prostitute, especially in a legal context
To accost someone in public or private to offer sex work or obtain clients for another

items.def_zh: (+ to) 迎合恶俗；充当淫媒
items.def_en: (+ to) To cater to base desires or illicit vices, or to act as a pimp

groups.summary_en: This legal and social frame involves acting as an intermediary to solicit, manage, or provide individuals for illicit sexual exploitation or prostitution. Nuances range from legal statutory procurement to street solicitation and metaphorical catering to vulgar desires.
groups.summary_zh: 指充当掮客操纵、物色或拉拢他人从事色情交易的非法行为。

groups.name: Promise & Assure · 承诺与保证 (Promise, Assure, Guarantee)
groups.tip: 从口头许诺到立下郑重誓言

items.def_en: To tell someone positively that something is true or will definitely happen to dispel doubt

items.def_zh: 做出许诺，以个人名誉担保
items.def_en: To make a sincere, binding personal promise to carry out an action or keep confidence
1. To state clearly that you will definitely do something or give something. 2. To show signs of a particular, usually positive, future outcome.
To give an absolute assurance that conditions will be met or a product/outcome is assured

items.def_zh: 担保，立誓担保品质或事实
items.def_en: To state with confidence or legally attest that a specific fact, state, or standard holds true

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover verbal declarations designed to instill confidence that an event will occur or that expectations will be fully satisfied.
groups.summary_zh: 给予口头保证或承诺以使人安心信任。

groups.name: Promise in Marriage · 订婚与联姻许配 (Affiance, Espouse, Plight)
groups.tip: 家族传统下约定终身与定下婚约

items.def_en: To make a formal, solemn commitment to give someone in marriage
To promise someone solemnly in marriage, typically used in passive forms
To solemnly pledge one's faith or promise to marry another person
To marry a person, or to give a woman in marriage to someone
(formal or archaic) To promise someone in marriage to another person.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the formal, legal, or ceremonial commitment of promising someone (or oneself) to enter into matrimonial union.
groups.summary_zh: 缔结正式婚约，将自己或他人以誓言许配给对方。

groups.name: Promote & Upgrade · 晋升与提档 (Promote, Elevate, Advance)
groups.tip: 提升职级、档次或待遇

items.def_en: To help someone succeed or move forward in their career or life
To advance someone to a higher position or rank in an organization

items.def_zh: 提升，提拔；使（系统、机器等）升级
items.def_en: To promote someone to a higher position or rank; to raise something to a higher standard or newer version.
To promote someone to a position with an impressive title but less real power
To raise someone to a more important or higher moral, cultural, or professional level

groups.summary_en: Covers advancing a person to a higher rank, grade, or level, or raising a system or product to a more functional standard.
groups.summary_zh: 在职级、待遇或系统品质上进行提升与升级。

groups.name: Pronounce with Accent · 地方腔发音与卷舌 (Lisp, Drawl, Trill)
groups.tip: 带特有腔调清晰或含混发音

items.def_en: To articulate sibilants like 's' and 'z' as dental fricatives 'th'

items.def_zh: 发粗喉音（r音），带粗喉音腔调说话；发出嗡嗡声
items.def_en: To speak with a rough, rolling pronunciation of the letter 'r', or to produce a low whirring sound.
To speak in an unhurried manner, drawing out vowel sounds deliberately
To speak with a sharp, resonant nasal quality characteristic of specific regional dialects
To pronounce a consonant with rapid vibrating movements of the tongue against the palate

groups.summary_en: Focuses on speech articulation characterized by idiosyncratic regional accents, guttural coloring, prolonged vowels, or specific tongue vibrations.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有浓厚口音特征、特异舌音或喉音的发声方式。

groups.name: Proofread & Cross-Check · 校对与核查 (Proof, Copyedit, Cross-check)
groups.tip: 出版审核文字细节差错

items.def_en: Read printer's proofs or draft texts to detect and correct errors
Edit written material by checking style, grammar, accuracy, and typography
Verify figures, facts, or information by using an alternative source or method
Investigate a document, report, or person carefully for accuracy or suitability
To read a written or printed text carefully in order to find and correct spelling, grammar, or typing errors.

groups.summary_en: Verbs detailing the meticulous scrutiny of text, data, or documents to identify typos, formatting inconsistencies, or factual errors before publication or distribution.
groups.summary_zh: 指出版或定稿前逐字逐句审阅排查错别字、语法或格式错误。

groups.name: Prop & Shore · 物理撑起与加固维稳 (Shore, Prop, Truss)
groups.tip: 架起支柱顶住斜壁以防坍塌

items.def_en: To physically hold something in an upright position by placing something underneath or against it, often artificially sustaining it
To support, brace, or steady a mast, wall, or upright structure with stays, guy wires, or braces

items.def_zh: 用支柱加固；竭力挽救支撑
items.def_en: To support something physically using props or beams, or to intervene to keep a weak institution or system from failing

items.def_zh: 用支柱撑住，加固（常与up连用）；支持
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To support or hold up something with props or beams. 2. (+ up) To strengthen or help a system, organisation, etc., that is weak or failing.
To physically reinforce or steady an object with structural supports to prevent movement under strain

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying physical posts, struts, or timber to prevent a sagging or collapsing structure from falling, with extensive metaphorical extension to struggling systems or failing economies. 'Shore up' highlights buttressing weakened bases, while 'prop up' often carries overtones of artificial or precarious support.
groups.summary_zh: 通过斜撑支架防止坍塌倒下，常引申为挽救风雨飘摇的系统。

groups.name: Propel & Energize · 供能驱动与推进 (Power, Fuel, Propel)
groups.tip: 为机构或机器供给运行动力

items.def_zh: 驱动，向……提供动力；快速前行
items.def_en: 1. To supply a machine or vehicle with energy or mechanical power to make it work. 2. To move with great power and speed.
To provide the physical or mechanical energy that causes a machine, shaft, or mechanism to run
To supply a vehicle, engine, or system with fuel or energy to keep it operating
To push, drive, or force an object or vehicle forward using physical or mechanical power
To adapt a system, line, or device to use electricity as its source of power

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to supplying physical, mechanical, or electrical energy to drive a vehicle, system, or mechanism forward. It ranges from continuous supply of energy ('fuel', 'electrify') to delivering mechanical driving force ('propel', 'drive').
groups.summary_zh: 指为机械、交通工具或系统提供能量与动力，使其运转或强力推进。

groups.name: Propel Body into Air · 跃起与腾空跃度 (Jump, Leap)
groups.tip: 从小跳步到大跨越

items.def_en: to move by making small, quick jumps on one foot or both feet together

items.def_zh: 跳跃，跳起；跃过；猛涨，暴增；猛跳，受惊
items.def_en: 1. To push yourself off the ground into the air using your legs, or leap over something. 2. To increase suddenly and sharply. 3. To move suddenly from shock or excitement.
to move suddenly and swiftly upward or forward in a single elastic movement

items.def_zh: 跳跃，腾跃，跃过；暴涨，猛增
items.def_en: 1. To jump high or a long distance into the air, or move suddenly and eagerly. 2. To increase suddenly by a large amount.
to run with long, energetic, leaping strides

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses using leg muscles to spring off the ground into the air. 'Jump' denotes the basic upward or forward propulsion from a stationary or moving stance, while 'leap' designates a much wider, higher, or more athletic bounding flight across distance.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用双腿弹力使身体离地腾空，体现从普通跳起到大步腾空的幅度。

groups.name: Propel Watercraft Manually · 撑篙与划桨 (Pole, Punt, Paddle)
groups.tip: 施加推力使物体向前运动

items.def_en: To move a canoe, kayak, or small boat through water using a handheld paddle
To propel a flat-bottomed boat across shallow water by pushing against the riverbed with a long pole
To propel a boat with a pair of sculls or by sweeping a single stern oar side to side
To propel a boat across water using oars anchored to rowlocks
To propel or steer a boat through water using a pole.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers manual techniques used to guide and push boats across shallow water using handheld implements like poles, paddles, or oars.
groups.summary_zh: 利用竹篙、船桨等工具手动撑行或划动小船。

groups.name: Propel in Water & Submerge · 游动与潜水 (Fin, Swim, Dive)
groups.tip: 水中的行进方式

items.def_zh: 游泳、游动（原形词元补充）
items.def_en: [I/T] to propel oneself through water by rhythmic movements of the limbs, fins, or tail
(+ into) to plunge headfirst into water or swim underwater using breathing equipment

items.def_zh: （潜水时）用脚蹼划水；（鱼等）扇动鳍；割取（鲨鱼等）的鳍
items.def_en: 1. To swim underwater using fins or flippers; (of a fish) to move its fins. 2. To slice the fins off a fish or shark.
to propel oneself slowly in shallow water by moving hands and feet up and down
to swim near the surface of the water using a breathing tube and face mask

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario cover self-propulsion through water by animals or humans using limbs, fins, or gear, as well as plunging beneath the surface. Nuances range from aquatic limb movements to intentional submerging.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖人或生物通过肢体、鳍蹼在水中划水前进，以及潜入水下的动作场景。

groups.name: Proportion & Harmonious Balance · 均衡比例与结构调配 (Proportion, Balance, Scale)
groups.tip: 调整比例使其达均衡协调

items.def_en: To size or adjust an object, diagram, or system in fixed proportion to a standard or model.
To arrange or adjust contrasting elements, amounts, or dimensions so that they are in equilibrium or harmony.

items.def_zh: 使成比例，使相称，使协调
items.def_en: To adjust the size, amount, or parts of something so that they are in the correct and pleasing relation to each other.
To bring conflicting forces, loads, or chemical components into an exact state of mutual balance.
To adjust different design elements, qualities, or components so that they complement one another pleasingly.

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to modifying the relative sizes, volumes, weights, or dimensions of constituent parts so they achieve harmony, symmetry, or functional fitness within a unified whole.
groups.summary_zh: 指调节各要素在体量、尺度或份额上的相互比例以达到美观或结构平衡。

groups.name: Propose & Propound · 提议与阐述 (Set forth, Advance, Submit)
groups.tip: 郑重提出理论、方案供人探讨

items.def_en: To formally present a proposal, document, or argument for others to judge
To state or explain facts, arguments, or plans clearly and systematically
To formally offer a bill, amendment, or motion for debate in a meeting
To introduce a theory, plan, or hypothesis for consideration

items.def_zh: 提出，提议（理论、观点等供讨论）
items.def_en: To put forward an idea, theory, or proposal for others to consider and examine.

groups.summary_en: Involves articulating systematic ideas, theories, hypotheses, or formal schemes for rigorous evaluation and deliberation.
groups.summary_zh: 系统性阐述或提交方案、学说以供审议评判。

groups.name: Proscribe & Outlaw · 严禁与法律取缔 (Proscribe, Outlaw, Ban)
groups.tip: 以法令正式宣布取缔禁止

items.def_en: to legally or officially forbid the use, publication, or occurrence of something
to make something illegal by passing a statute, or to strip legal protections from a group
to impose an official government ban on trade or commercial relations with another nation

items.def_zh: 正式禁止，取缔；剥夺……的法律保护
items.def_en: (formal) to officially forbid or prohibit something by law; to denounce or ban as dangerous or illegal
to authoritatively prohibit or restrain an action by judicial decree or ecclesiastical censure

groups.summary_en: This high-intensity legal frame denotes authoritative decrees rendering specific actions, organizations, or ideologies strictly illegal, illegitimate, or subject to severe state penalties. The tone is formal, imperative, and punitive.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或司法机构发布禁令，依法彻底取缔或定罪某行为与组织。

groups.name: Prosecute & Try · 刑事起诉与法庭审判 (Prosecute, Try, Indict)
groups.tip: 司法起诉并在法庭审理

items.def_en: To examine evidence in a court of law and decide whether someone is guilty of a crime

items.def_zh: 起诉，检举；继续从事，进行
items.def_en: 1. To officially charge someone in a court of law and direct proceedings against them. 2. (formal) To continue doing, pursuing, or conducting something.

items.def_zh: 正式起诉，控告（通常由大陪审团作出）
items.def_en: (+ for/on) To officially accuse someone in court of having committed a serious crime

items.def_zh: 弹劾；控告公职人员渎职
items.def_en: To formally charge a public official with serious misconduct committed while in office

items.def_zh: 传讯，提堂（宣读起诉书并要求答辩）
items.def_en: (+ on/for) To bring a prisoner to a court of law to hear the charges and state whether they are guilty or not

groups.summary_en: Refers to state authorities formally charging a suspect with a crime, conducting court proceedings, and adjudicating guilt. While 'indict' focuses on issuing a formal grand jury charge, 'try' centers on hearing and judging the case in court.
groups.summary_zh: 指司法机关对刑事犯罪提起公诉、进行审理和裁决的法定程序。

groups.name: Prosper & Accumulate Wealth · 繁荣与富足兴旺 (Boom, Thrive, Pan Out)
groups.tip: 生命力旺盛，蓬勃向前发展

items.def_zh: （经济、产业）景气猛增；急速繁荣
items.def_en: To experience sudden, intense economic growth, popularity, or profitability
To be successful, especially in business, work, or financial standing

items.def_zh: 出人头地；积累财富获得成功
items.def_en: To make progress and become successful in one's life, career, or finances
To increase gradually in size, power, or prosperity, especially contrasting with wane
1. To become wealthy, successful, and thriving, especially financially or economically.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on achieving sustained economic success, material wealth, or business fortune over time. It stresses financial gain, commercial buoyancy, and advantageous advancement.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦于经济上的兴旺发达、积累财富或在商业中持续成功。

groups.name: Protect & Defend · 保护与捍卫 (Protect, Safeguard, Shield)
groups.tip: 遮风挡雨防范侵害

items.def_zh: 保护，保卫，防护；（经济）保护（国内产业）
items.def_en: To keep someone or something safe from harm, injury, damage, or loss.
to take action to protect someone or something from physical attack or legal challenge
to keep something intact, safe, or free from decay, harm, or alteration
to protect someone or something by putting an obstacle or oneself between them and danger
(+ against/from) To protect something valuable, such as rights, health, or interests, from harm, loss, or danger.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify keeping people, rights, or territory safe from harm, attack, erosion, or adverse conditions, spanning everyday security to institutional or physical defense.
groups.summary_zh: 指抵御外来攻击、危险或损害，保全人身、权益及体制的安全与完整。

groups.name: Provision & Replenish · 筹措补给与配发物资 (Provision, Victual, Replenish)
groups.tip: 调配与发放生活或军需物资

items.def_en: to supply someone, a vessel, or an expedition with food, drink, or necessary equipment
(+ on) to collect or buy a large quantity of provisions for future use
to fill something up again with supplies or stock after it has been depleted

items.def_zh: 为……提供食物（或军粮）；储备食物
items.def_en: (archaic) to supply a ship, army, or expedition with food and provisions; to obtain food supplies
to supply food, services, or provisions as a regular business or official duty

groups.summary_en: This frame describes gathering, stocking, or issuing rations, stores, and logistical necessities required to sustain expeditions, ships, garrisons, or remote operations.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为长途航行、探险队或军队筹备、补发粮饷物资。

groups.name: Prowl & Sneak · 潜行与逡巡 (Prowl, Sneak, Stalk)
groups.tip: 暗中鬼祟地潜伏潜行

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚地走；缓慢爬行潜行
items.def_en: To move slowly, quietly, and carefully, usually staying close to the ground to escape notice
To walk quietly on the balls and tips of one's toes to avoid making any audible noise

items.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟地走；偷偷摸摸溜进
items.def_en: (+ into/out of/around) To go or move in a furtive, stealthy way so as not to be seen or heard

items.def_zh: 潜行，偷偷溜达；徘徊搜索
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/through) To move around quietly and secretly, like an animal hunting prey or a thief looking for an opportunity.
To follow or approach quarry or a person stealthily and relentlessly, often intending harm

groups.summary_en: This frame captures quiet, stealthy forward movement intended to avoid detection, characteristic of predators stalking prey, criminals casing a target, or intruders evading notice.
groups.summary_zh: 指为了捕猎、刺探或避免被发觉而悄声潜行巡查。

groups.name: Prune & Trim · 修剪与规整 (Trim, Lop, Cut Back)
groups.tip: 剪除枝权或多余多长部分

items.def_zh: 砍去，截掉（大树枝或赘物）
items.def_en: To chop or saw a substantial branch, limb, or bulky portion completely off

items.def_zh: 剪短植物；大幅削减开支
items.def_en: To cut plants to shorten growth, or reduce spending, size, or output
To cut off the top branches of a tree to encourage a dense head of new foliage
To cut off irregular, ragged, or overgrown edges to make something neat

items.def_zh: 修剪（树枝等）；删减，削减（开支、人员等）
items.def_en: 1. to cut off dead or overgrown branches from a tree or shrub. 2. to reduce the size or extent of something by removing unnecessary parts.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve selectively clipping away excessive, dead, or overgrown growth on plants, gardens, or budgets to foster healthier shape, efficiency, and growth.
groups.summary_zh: 指剔除多余枯枝或冗杂部分，以促成植物健康形态或精简开支规模。

groups.name: Publish & Release · 发行与出版 (Reissue, Release, Put out)
groups.tip: 公之于世，印刷印发刊物

items.def_en: to distribute officially or produce publications, currency, or formal statements
to make a film, record, software, or book publicly available for sale or viewing
to produce and circulate a publication, product, or official announcement
to launch and make a new product or service widely available in phases

items.def_zh: 重新发行，再版；补发，再发
items.def_en: To publish, release, or issue a book, record, film, or document again.

groups.summary_en: Centers on making media, printed literature, sound recordings, or official decrees accessible for commercial distribution or broad public consumption.
groups.summary_zh: 指将书籍、唱片、影视作品或声明公开发行、推出或面市。

groups.name: Pulsate & Throb Rhythmically · 律动与节律性搏动 (Pulsate, Throb, Pulse)
groups.tip: 规律性震颤起伏

items.def_en: Make regular rhythmic sounds or movements, such as a heart pumping or wings flapping
Shake or vibrate with a slight, rapid, tremulous motion
Move, vibrate, or shine with steady, measurable regular pulses
Beat or sound with a strong, continuous, regular rhythm, or cause continuous pulsating pain

items.def_zh: 有节奏地跳动，搏动；充满活力，震颤
items.def_en: To expand and contract with strong regular movements; to beat with a steady rhythm or vibrate with energy.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers rhythmic expansion, contraction, vibration, or illumination occurring at periodic intervals. It applies equally to physical organs, rhythmic lights, acoustic basslines, or throbbing pain.
groups.summary_zh: 身体器官、光线、声音或钝痛呈现出规律而强劲的周期性搏动震颤。

groups.name: Pulsate Rhythmically · 搏动与抽痛跳动 (Pulse, Throb)
groups.tip: 心脏脉搏律动或神经抽痛

items.def_zh: 节律性搏动；有规律地膨胀收缩
items.def_en: to expand and contract with strong, regular rhythmic movements

items.def_zh: 搏动，跳动；悸动，规律振动
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To beat, throb, or flow with a strong, regular rhythm.

items.def_zh: 阵痛，抽搐跳痛；悸动，有节奏地跳动
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To beat, pulse, or vibrate with a strong, regular, often painful rhythm.

items.def_zh: （心脏等）咚咚狂跳；重重击打跳动
items.def_en: to beat heavily and thuddingly against the ribs with great force
to beat rapidly, strongly, or irregularly, typically from excitement, fear, or illness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate rapid or heavy, repeating mechanical or physiological contractions, especially of hearts, blood vessels, pain, or machinery. 'Pulse' signifies a steady, rhythmic surge or vibration, whereas 'throb' conveys a strong, pulsating ache or heavy pounding sensation.
groups.summary_zh: 指心脏、血管或身体部位呈周期性地起伏、强力跳动或隐痛抽动。

groups.name: Pump & Siphon Fluids · 机械泵送与虹吸抽取 (Siphon, Draw, Evacuate)
groups.tip: 用机械泵或虹吸法抽吸流体

items.def_zh: 抽取或排出（容器中的液体）
items.def_en: To remove or tap a specified quantity of liquid from a larger reservoir or tank

items.def_zh: 排放（系统中的多余空气或液体）
items.def_en: To let out excess liquid, air, or gas from a closed pipe, radiator, or hydraulic system
1. To force liquid, gas, or air into or out of something using a pump; to move quickly up and down or in and out like a piston.

items.def_zh: 抽空或排空（容器中的气体或液体）
items.def_en: To remove air, gas, or liquid completely from a vessel or space so as to create a vacuum

items.def_zh: 用虹吸管吸出或输送（液体）
items.def_en: To convey or draw off liquid from a container over an intermediate elevation through a siphon tube

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe using mechanical differential pressure, vacuum mechanisms, or tubes to draw, transfer, or expel liquids and gases between containers.
groups.summary_zh: 利用泵力、负压或管路机械式抽取、输送或排空流体。

groups.name: Punish & Discipline · 惩戒与管教 (Discipline, Chastise, Penalize)
groups.tip: 通过立规与惩罚纠错

items.def_en: 1. To punish someone for doing something wrong. 2. To train someone to obey rules and control their behavior.
To inflict a penalty or unpleasant consequence on someone for wrongdoing or an offense
To impose a formal sanction, disadvantage, or forfeit on someone for breaking a rule
To rebuke, reprimand, or severely discipline someone for undesirable behavior
(+ on) To take severe and decisive disciplinary measures to enforce laws or eradicate bad behavior

groups.summary_en: This frame covers imposing formal or parental sanctions, corrections, and behavioral conditioning to enforce compliance and deter transgressions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过施加制裁、惩罚或严厉纠正来推行行为规范、惩戒过错或促使服从。

groups.name: Purge & Eradicate · 摆脱与清除 (Purge, Eliminate, Expel, Disencumber)
groups.tip: 免除负担除掉杂质

items.def_en: To make someone or something free of an unwanted person, thing, or condition.
To free someone or something from an encumbrance, heavy burden, or obstacle
To deliberately throw aside or free oneself from unwanted ties, habits, or clothing
To thoroughly remove unwanted elements, impurities, or political opponents from a group or place
To destroy, uproot, or wipe out an unwanted condition, disease, or problem completely

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on ridding an entity of burdens, impurities, unwanted individuals, or harmful conditions to restore cleanliness, liberty, or baseline function.
groups.summary_zh: 指彻底清除、驱逐或肃清附着的赘物、负担、杂质或不受欢迎之人。

groups.name: Pursue & Chase · 追捕与穷追 (Pursue, Track, Run down)
groups.tip: 从后方紧追不舍力图捕获

items.def_en: To follow the trail, footprints, or markers left by someone or an animal
To pursue someone or something until they are finally overtaken or captured
To follow someone closely and unyieldingly over a long period
1. To follow or chase someone or something in order to catch or kill them. 2. To engage in or work hard to accomplish a goal, activity, or plan.
To follow or pursue someone or prey stealthily, keeping hidden until ready to strike

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on purposeful, sustained pursuit aimed at overtaking an elusive or fleeing target, or systematically striving to achieve an ambition or course of action.
groups.summary_zh: 指为了捕捉或达成目标而进行的持续追赶与追求。

groups.name: Pursue Closely & Covertly · 尾随与暗中盯梢 (Shadow, Tail)
groups.tip: 如影随形追踪行动踪迹

items.def_zh: 紧紧追随；形影不离地尾随
items.def_en: to follow someone closely and continuously without leaving them alone

items.def_zh: 秘密尾随，跟踪；跟随观察，影子实习；投阴影于
items.def_en: 1. To follow someone closely and secretly without their knowledge. 2. To accompany someone to observe and learn their job. 3. To cast a shadow over.

items.def_zh: 尾随，盯梢，跟踪；装尾巴于
items.def_en: 1. To follow closely behind someone in order to observe their movements. 2. To provide or attach a tail to.

items.def_zh: 潜行追踪；盯梢伺机靠近
items.def_en: to follow stealthily and menacingly, as a predator following prey
to pursue or follow relentlessly and aggressively, giving no respite

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote pursuing someone closely and usually without their consent or knowledge in order to monitor their movements. 'Shadow' emphasizes remaining unseen while mimicking the quarry's movements like a dark outline, whereas 'tail' evokes closely sticking behind a target's vehicle or path.
groups.summary_zh: 指紧跟在某人身后进行暗中监视、盯梢，以掌握其行踪。

groups.name: Put Down & Set Firmly · 猛放与撂下 (Plump, Flump, Set Down)
groups.tip: 平稳安放摆在某处

items.def_en: Put down or drop something heavily and carelessly in a heap or pile
Set something down suddenly, heavily, or without care onto a surface
Drop or place something down heavily and clumsily with a dull thud
Forcefully and noisily smash or thrust an object down against a surface
1. (usually 'plank down') To put or set something down heavily or firmly. 2. To cover or floor with thick wooden boards.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on setting, dropping, or slamming an object down emphatically, abruptly, or heavily onto a flat surface.
groups.summary_zh: 强调重重地、突兀或果断地放下某物。

groups.name: Put Out Fire & Cool Down · 扑灭与熄灭 (Quench, Extinguish, Douse)
groups.tip: 用水或外力扑灭火与渴

items.def_en: Extinguish a fire, cigarette, or flame using water, smothered blankets, or effort.
Cause a fire or light to stop burning or shining completely.
Extinguish a fire by depriving it of oxygen using sand, earth, or a heavy blanket.
1. To put out or extinguish a fire or flame. 2. To satisfy a thirst by drinking liquid. 3. To cool hot metal rapidly in liquid to harden it.
Pour a large amount of liquid over a fire or light to extinguish it rapidly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the suppression of fire, glowing heat, or burning embers by using water, smothering blankets, foam, or depriving the flame of oxygen.
groups.summary_zh: 指泼水泼液、隔绝氧气以扑灭火苗，或使炽热物体冷却降温的操作。

groups.name: Qualify & Certify · 认证与获得资质 (Certify, Accredit, License)
groups.tip: 具备资格达到标准

items.def_en: Grant formal legal permission to someone to practice a trade or carry out an activity

items.raw_cluster: 胜任与使合格 Qualify & Certify
items.def_zh: 取得资格，具备资格；使合格；修饰，限定（陈述）
items.def_en: 1. To reach the necessary standard or have the required qualities to do or be something. 2. To give someone the legal right or ability to do something. 3. To limit or modify the meaning of an assertion or word.

items.def_zh: 颁发合格证书，证明合格
items.def_en: Officially attest that someone has reached a required standard or passed an exam
Confirm the official validity, suitability, or legal competence of someone or something
Officially recognize an institution or person as meeting essential quality standards

groups.summary_en: This frame captures formally verifying, testing, and granting legal or institutional approval for a person or institution to practice an activity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威考核、审核，正式授予法定资格或执业认证。

groups.name: Quantify & Enumerate · 计数与列举 (Count, Enumerate, Quantify)
groups.tip: 运用数字与统计算法定量核算

items.def_en: To add together individual items one after another to determine the entire total
To measure or describe something as a specific number or measurable quantity
To name things separately, one by one, especially in a systematic list
To write a list of things item by item, giving specific details for each

items.def_zh: 列举，数出，计算；读出（数字）
items.def_en: 1. To count, list, or enumerate items one by one. 2. To express or read out a number in words.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe determining the total number of items, itemizing entities in a systematic sequence, or expressing abstract concepts in precise numeric form.
groups.summary_zh: 逐一清点、列出清单或以明确数值表达总量。

groups.name: Quarantine & Cloister · 隔离与封闭 (Isolate, Quarantine, Cloister)
groups.tip: 从物理分开到彻底孤立隔绝

items.def_en: To seal off an area by means of police tape, barriers, or guards to prevent entry

items.def_zh: 使隔离，使孤立；分离，脱析
items.def_en: 1. To separate someone or something physically or socially from others; place in quarantine. 2. (science) To separate a particular substance or organism from others for study.
To seclude or enclose someone in or as if in a monastery or convent away from the world
To isolate a person, animal, or ship to prevent the spread of infectious disease
To keep someone or a group apart from other people, especially a jury during a trial

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey forceful, strict, or protective physical segregation of individuals or entities from the wider population or environment, often due to infection, security, or seclusion.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于防疫、安全或避世需要，对人或事物实施严格的物理隔离与封禁。

groups.name: Quarter & House Troops · 军宿安排与征集寄宿 (Quarter, Lodge, Canton)
groups.tip: 分配军人或人员临时宿营

items.def_en: Supply troops or groups with living quarters or institutional shelter
Assign military personnel or officials to a specific base, post, or territory

items.def_zh: 派驻，为（军人）提供营房/住处
items.def_en: Provide housing or operational living quarters for military personnel
Provide someone with temporary sleeping quarters or live in rented/provided rooms

items.def_zh: （尤指为军队）安排临时住宿；使寄宿
items.def_en: To assign or provide temporary lodging for soldiers or other personnel, especially in civilian accommodation.

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns requisitioning or assigning civilian, temporary, or communal quarters for military personnel or government workers. Nuances highlight forced requisition, civilian homestay lodging, and organized base quarters.
groups.summary_zh: 指依指令为军人或外勤人员分配、征集临时住处或借宿于民宅与驻地。

groups.name: Quell & Stifle · 平息与扼杀 (Quell, Stifle, Squelch)
groups.tip: 果断彻底地压制反对声音

items.def_zh: 防患于未然；扼杀于萌芽中
items.def_en: To stop or destroy a problem, protest, or conspiracy at an early stage before it can grow
To smother or prevent the open expression or development of protests, debate, or dissent
To extinguish or eliminate something undesirable (like corruption or rebellion) forcefully and completely
To completely put an end to a riot, rebellion, or rising wave of fear and disorder

items.def_zh: 平息，遏止，压制；发咯吱咯吱声；踩着泥泞噗嗤作响
items.def_en: 1. To stop, crush, or suppress a rumor, protest, or idea firmly and completely. 2. To make a wet, sucking sound when stepping in mud or wet shoes.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers extinguishing, choking off, or silencing disturbances, rumors, protests, or expressions of dissent before they escalate. It highlights neutralizing the unrest quickly and decisively, restoring silence or order.
groups.summary_zh: 指迅速平息动乱、掐灭苗头或强行压制谣言与异见。

groups.name: Quest & Search · 寻索与求索 (Scour, Seek, Pursue)
groups.tip: 主动追寻未知事物与答案

items.def_en: To search persistently and actively through various places to find a missing person, thing, or clue
To attempt to find, obtain, or attain something valuable, tangible or intangible
to search or seek for something, especially for a long time.
To search through an area, records, or items minutely and systematically
To search an entire area, place, or collection very thoroughly and rigorously in order to locate something

groups.summary_en: This frame covers earnest, prolonged, or exhaustive searches for physical objects, knowledge, spiritual enlightenment, or ambitious goals across space or time.
groups.summary_zh: 怀有明确目标进行的执着搜寻、探索或人生求索。

groups.name: Rack & Afflict · 痛楚煎熬与折磨 (Rack, Afflict, Scourge)
groups.tip: 身体受剧烈苦痛与精神折磨

items.def_en: (often passive) Trouble, plague, or threaten someone persistently from all sides

items.def_zh: 折磨，使痛苦；施刑，拷问；绞尽（脑汁）
items.def_en: 1. (often passive, 'be racked with/by') To cause someone extreme physical pain or mental anguish. 2. ('rack one's brains') To think very hard to find an answer or remember something. 3. (historical) To torture someone on a rack.
(often passive) Cause severe physical pain, chronic suffering, or lasting unhappiness to someone
Cause great suffering, devastation, or punishment to a person or population

items.def_zh: 使抽搐；使剧烈震颤痛楚
items.def_en: Cause sudden, violent, involuntary spasms or uncontrollable bouts of pain in the body

groups.summary_en: Focuses on being gripped or seized by intense, unbearable internal pain, spasms, coughing, fever, or guilt. Frequently used in passive constructions with 'with' or 'by'.
groups.summary_zh: 指身心被剧烈阵痛、痉挛、疾病或内疚强烈煎熬折磨。

groups.name: Racket & Clatter · 嗡鸣与喧闹 (Clatter, Blare, Rattle)
groups.tip: 嘈杂吵闹声浪喧嚣嘈杂

items.def_en: To make a rapid succession of short, sharp, knocking sounds

items.def_zh: 喧闹，大声吵嚷；过放荡喧闹的生活
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To make a loud, continuous noise; to engage in noisy, lively social revelry.

items.def_zh: 发出哗啦撞击声；咔嗒作响
items.def_en: To make a continuous rapid sequence of loud, hard, rattling sounds

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳轰鸣；高声尖叫
items.def_en: To make a very loud, harsh, piercing sound, often continuous
(+ for/against) To make a loud and confused noise, especially of people shouting loudly

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on making loud, disorderly, and grating acoustic disturbances, often involving raucous movement, rattling metal, or continuous blaring uproar.
groups.summary_zh: 指制造喧嚣刺耳的噪音、持续轰鸣或伴随剧烈运动的骚乱之声。

groups.name: Radicalize & Incite · 激化与煽动 (Radicalize, Incite, Inflame)
groups.tip: 推动立场激进化与极端化

items.def_zh: 煽风点火；助长（火势、情绪）
items.def_en: To make a grievance, dispute, or strong feeling burn hotter and spread further
To deliberately excite or rouse intense enthusiasm, fury, or hysteria among a group
To make feelings of anger, passion, or hostility significantly more intense and violent
1. To cause someone or become someone who adopts extreme political, social, or religious views.
(+ to) To encourage or stir up violent, unlawful, or disruptive behavior in a crowd or individual

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to escalating political, social, or personal tensions, converting parties toward extreme doctrines or rousing them into violent unrest.
groups.summary_zh: 指使思想走向极端、煽动对抗或激化矛盾冲突。

groups.name: Rage & Fume · 狂怒与盛怒 (Display or Contain Intense Fury)
groups.tip: 从怒气郁积到彻底暴怒发狂

items.def_en: to be extremely angry but unable or unwilling to express it openly

items.def_zh: 暴怒咆哮，气冲冲地行动
items.def_en: to shout angrily or move forcefully while showing intense anger

items.def_zh: 暴怒，大发雷霆；猛烈发作，肆虐
items.def_en: 1. To feel, display, or express violent, uncontrolled anger. 2. (of a storm, fire, or illness) To continue with extreme violence and intensity.
to speak or shout at length in an angry, impassioned way
1. (+ over/about/at) To feel or express strong, often silent or suppressed, anger and irritation. 2. To emit smoke, gas, or strong-smelling vapor.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey extreme anger, differing along internal burning versus violent outward explosion. 'Fume' suggests simmering, silent or suppressed indignation, whereas 'rage' and 'seethe' involve uncontrollable tempestuous fury.
groups.summary_zh: 表达由内敛压抑到狂暴爆发的极度愤怒情绪。

groups.name: Rally & Reorganize · 聚集与重整 (Rally, Reassemble, Regroup)
groups.tip: 溃散队伍重新清点集结整军

items.def_en: To come together again after separating, or to put the parts of something back together
To meet again or call a formal meeting together again after a pause
To gather together and arrange people, facts, or resources in an organized way for a purpose

items.def_zh: 重新集结，重组，重新部署
items.def_en: To organize people, soldiers, or resources into a new and effective formation after a setback or break, or to do this as a group.
To bring people or resources together to make a united effort, especially after a setback

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to gathering forces, supporters, or thoughts together again, especially after a setback, defeat, or period of disarray, in order to mount a renewed effort.
groups.summary_zh: 指在受挫或分散后重新集结力量、整顿队伍或重振旗鼓。

groups.name: Rampage & Tear · 横冲直撞与暴冲 (Tear, Storm, Charge)
groups.tip: 失控乱窜极具破坏力

items.def_zh: 气势汹汹地冲；暴怒闯入
items.def_en: Move with great anger, noisy force, and aggressive intent
Move or rush with wild, reckless speed and forceful momentum
(+ down/through) Move very fast and recklessly without heed of obstacles
Move violently through a place, causing rapid, severe destruction

items.raw_cluster: 横冲直撞与暴走 Rampage & Riot
items.def_en: To rush around wildly and violently, causing widespread damage or destruction.

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts violent, uncontrolled, high-velocity movement through a space, typically leaving disruption or physical damage in its wake. 'Rampage' captures widespread destructive frenzy, while 'tear' and 'barrel' emphasize unstoppable kinetic rush.
groups.summary_zh: 指狂暴、不受控制地高速冲撞并造成破坏。

groups.name: Rank & Grade · 评估与定级 (Rank, Rate, Grade, Classify)
groups.tip: 考核品质并排列先后位次

items.def_en: To judge the value, quality, or ability of someone or something on a recognized numerical or qualitative scale
To separate or assign items into categories according to standard qualities, sizes, or performance levels

items.def_zh: 把……分等级，评定……的位次；名列，位居
items.def_en: 1. To assign someone or something to a specific position or grade in a hierarchy. 2. To hold a particular position or grade within a ranking system.
To arrange or organize individuals, concepts, or goods into structured groups based on common traits
To structure or arrange services, access, or products into distinct successive levels or tiers

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with systematically evaluating people, entities, or items according to specific scales of merit, quality, or hierarchy, positioning them accordingly.
groups.summary_zh: 依据标准对主体进行量化评估，划分等级、名次或归属位阶。

groups.name: Ransom & Extort · 赎金扣押与索赎 (Hold to ransom, Buy off, Extort)
groups.tip: 付代价换回被扣财物人质

items.def_en: Keep someone captive in order to force others to meet financial or political demands
Pay someone money to stop them from causing trouble, demanding release, or prosecuting
Pay money to secure the release of an accused person from custody before trial
1. To pay money to free someone who has been captured or kidnapped. 2. To hold someone captive and demand money for their release.
Obtain money or concessions by coercion, threats of violence, or abuse of power

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on coercive custody where captive persons or hijacked assets are released only upon monetary payoff or extortion demands.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及劫持人质或财产，以强制性支付换取其安全解脱。

groups.name: Rationalize & Excuse · 辩解与开脱 (Rationalize, Justify, Excuse)
groups.tip: 找寻合理化理由为行为开脱

items.def_en: To provide reasons to reduce the blame or responsibility attached to an offense
To make a mistake, offense, or wrongdoing seem less serious by providing mitigating context
To give reasons why a fault, mistake, or doubtful behavior is not as bad as it seems
To provide a good reason or acceptable explanation for an action that others might criticize

items.def_zh: 为……找借口辩解；使合理化，精简整顿
items.def_en: 1. To invent reasons to justify an action or belief. 2. To restructure a company or organization to improve efficiency.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers cognitive and verbal acts of making questionable, selfish, or erroneous behavior seem acceptable, logical, or blameless. Verbs range from internally inventing self-serving explanations to formally pleading extenuating circumstances.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为不当或自私行为寻找借口、使之合理化的言行。

groups.name: Rationalize & Self-Justify · 辩解与合理化 (Explain away, Sugarcoat, Gloss over)
groups.tip: 为自身行为找合理理由

items.def_en: to make something dubious or objectionable seem acceptable, lawful, or proper
to give an explanation that minimizes, dismisses, or excuses a fault or questionable action
to deliberately treat an unpleasant mistake or offense as trivial to deflect censure

items.def_zh: 为……辩解，找理由合理化；使合理化，精简整顿
items.def_en: 1. To invent plausible but false reasons to explain or excuse one's behavior. 2. To make an organization or system more efficient and logical.
to conceal or exonerate errors, misconduct, or atrocities through biased presentation

groups.summary_en: Involves cognitive self-deception or linguistic manipulation to make dubious, selfish, or blameworthy actions appear acceptable and logical. It emphasizes superficial justification over genuine truth.
groups.summary_zh: 指在认知或言辞上寻找看似合理的借口，以美化或开脱不当行径。

groups.name: Rationalize & Streamline · 精简与优化提效 (Streamline, Rationalize, Trim down)
groups.tip: 精简流线以消减阻力工序

items.def_en: To adapt, refine, or configure a system or process to make it as effective and functional as possible

items.def_zh: 削减，精简（冗余开支或人员）
items.def_en: To reduce the size, costs, or components of something in order to make it leaner and more economical

items.def_zh: 精简，使合理化；使成流线型
items.def_en: 1. To make an organization, process, or system simpler, faster, and more efficient. 2. To design a vehicle or aircraft with a smooth, streamlined shape.
To identify and eliminate restrictions or delays in a process or operational flow

items.def_zh: 合理化，重组以提高效益
items.def_en: To reorganize an organization or operational process to eliminate superfluous parts and improve efficiency

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote reorganizing processes, operations, or structures to eliminate bottlenecks, cut waste, and boost productivity. The emphasis is on structural lean-making, procedural speed, and modern efficiency.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重对流程、体系或机构进行结构性裁汰多余环节，提高运作效率。

groups.name: Reach Highest Point · 达到极点与高潮 (Peak, Culminate, Climax)
groups.tip: 发展攀升至最高点或高潮

items.def_en: to bring something to an appropriate, impressive, or climactic conclusion
to reach the highest point, level, or value
to reach the highest point or level of a wave, trend, or development

items.def_zh: 达到高潮，达到顶峰；以……告终
items.def_en: to reach the highest point, climax, or decisive final result after a series of events
to reach or bring something to the most exciting, important, or highest point

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express a process, state, or event rising to its utmost intensity, completion, or decisive high point after a progressive buildup.
groups.summary_zh: 表示事物随时间或历程累积递增，最终攀升至最高峰、终局或高潮时刻。

groups.name: Reactivate & Restore · 激活与恢复 (Reactivate, Reinstate, Revive)
groups.tip: 从静止再次启动运转

items.def_en: To provide a strong initial push to help an inactive system or stagnant process get underway
To bring something back to life, consciousness, popular usage, or operational strength
To restart a computational system or relaunch an existing operation or program from scratch
To restore someone or something to a previous position, post, or authorized condition
1. To make an account, machine, dormant virus, or military unit active again.
