groups.summary_en: This frame centers on restoring dormant, suspended, or inactive operations, systems, rights, or mechanisms back into active functional service.
groups.summary_zh: 指重启停滞或休眠的系统、账户、机制并恢复其运作。

groups.name: Read & Scrutinize · 阅读与细读研读 (Scan, Peruse, Pore over)
groups.tip: 从字面浏览到精细研读

items.def_en: To read quickly over a surface or text, noting only the salient points and headings
To look through a text rapidly in order to locate specific information or get a general impression

items.def_zh: 阅读，朗读；理解，领会；显示，读数为
items.def_en: 1. To look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words. 2. To understand or interpret something in a particular way. 3. (of an instrument) To show or register a specific measurement or value.
To read or examine written material with thorough care, attention, and diligence
To examine, study, or read printed words with intense absorption and meticulous concentration

groups.summary_en: This frame spans the spectrum of text processing, from superficial glancing and rapid skimming to deep, analytical, and exhaustive textual examination. Nuances center on depth of concentration.
groups.summary_zh: 由粗略浏览到字斟句酌地研读文字材料。

groups.name: Reaffirm & Uphold · 重申与确认 (Reaffirm, Reiterate, Restate)
groups.tip: 再次确证并重申既定立场

items.def_zh: 重申；换个方式重新表述
items.def_en: To state something again or in a different way, especially to emphasize a position
To state a fact or belief firmly, confidently, and forcefully
To say something again or several times, typically to emphasize or make it completely clear
To defend, confirm, or maintain a law, principle, or previous legal decision as valid
to state something again strongly and clearly to confirm a belief, agreement, or decision

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express speaking, declaring, or confirming an allegiance, promise, or conviction with renewed force, clarity, and authority.
groups.summary_zh: 指以坚决明确的口吻再次陈述、强化或确认既有的立场与原则。

groups.name: Realize & Perceive · 察觉与顿悟 (Grasp, Fathom, Dawn on)
groups.tip: 从感官觉察到心中恍然大悟

items.def_en: To suddenly or gradually become perceived or understood by someone after initial oblivion

items.raw_cluster: 察觉与意识到 Realize & Perceive
items.def_zh: 领悟，认识到，意识到；实现；变卖为现款
items.def_en: 1. To become fully aware of something as a fact; to understand clearly. 2. To achieve or bring into reality something planned or hoped for. 3. To convert an asset into cash.
To comprehend or understand a complex fact, idea, or implication thoroughly
To perceive, recognize, or become mentally conscious of the nature or meaning of something
To penetrate into the underlying meaning of something puzzling and understand it completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this intensity frame capture the mental transition from unawareness or incomprehension to full clarity, comprehension, and conscious awareness.
groups.summary_zh: 意识由模糊转变为主观上的清晰洞悉与顿悟领会。

groups.name: Receive & Accept · 接收与接纳 (Receive, Accept, Take in)
groups.tip: 收下并获得送来的物品

items.def_zh: 收到，接到；接纳，接待；遭受，承受
items.def_en: 1. To get or accept something that is sent, given, or offered. 2. To welcome or formally greet guests or visitors. 3. To experience or be given a particular kind of treatment or injury.

items.def_zh: 接受，接纳；同意，认可；承认，承担
items.def_en: 1. To agree to take or receive something offered. 2. To believe, agree with, or approve of something. 3. To take responsibility for something.

items.def_zh: 将…装入口袋，收下（钱财或物品）
items.def_en: to take or accept money or small items, sometimes inappropriately
to formally report or confirm that one has received something
to receive deliveries, items, or lodgers into one's home or care

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate taking delivery of or willingly consenting to hold goods, payments, or communications provided by another party.
groups.summary_zh: 指收取他人送来或交付的物品、款项或信息，并予以收下或同意持有。

groups.name: Reciprocal Exchange & Mutual Return · 互换与互惠回报 (Reciprocate, Interchange, Requite)
groups.tip: 双方互换位置或以物易物

items.def_zh: 相互交换（意见、目光、言语）
items.def_en: [I/T] to exchange remarks, insults, or glances back and forth between each other
to show appreciation or make return for a kind action, feeling, or favor

items.def_zh: （使）互相交换，互换位置；交替，轮换
items.def_en: to exchange things with each other, or alternate in sequence.

items.def_zh: 回报，报答；互换；往复运动
items.def_en: 1. to return a favor, feeling, or action in kind. 2. (of a machine part) to move backwards and forwards alternately.

items.def_zh: 报答，回报（恩情、关爱或怨恨）
items.def_en: to make an appropriate return for a favor, service, or affection (often formal or literary)

groups.summary_en: Centers on mutual and corresponding give-and-take in relationships, sentiments, or standardized items. 'Interchange' emphasizes reciprocal switching or alternating of items or ideas, whereas 'reciprocate' and 'requite' emphasize answering a received favor, feeling, or action in kind.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重双向对等回馈、情感或行为的投桃报李及对等互换。

groups.name: Reckless Velocity & Uncontrolled Speed · 疾驰与失控狂奔 (Speed, Career, Tear)
groups.tip: 高速不受控地狂奔

items.def_en: (+ down/along) to move with frantic, reckless, and uncontrolled speed
To move forward at high speed in an uncontrolled and dangerous manner.

items.def_zh: 疾行，飞驰；超速驾驶；加速，促进
items.def_en: 1. To move along very quickly. 2. To drive a motor vehicle faster than the legal speed limit. 3. To cause to move faster or accelerate.
to move violently with tremendous force and dangerous velocity

items.def_zh: 摇晃狂奔；倾斜失控地疾驰
items.def_en: to hurtle forward while swaying dangerously and swerving out of control

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale depict high velocity progressing from intentional swift driving to precarious, wild, and violently uncontrolled runaway motion.
groups.summary_zh: 从单纯超速平稳疾行递进至失控、癫狂前冲的危险速度梯次。

groups.name: Recommit & Rededicate · 重申承诺与再赋责 (Recommit, Rededicate, Reaffirm)
groups.tip: 再次许下承诺并竭力履行

items.def_zh: 续展，重振更新（誓言/协议）
items.def_en: To restore, re-establish, or repeat a formal pledge, vow, or contractual relationship

items.def_zh: 重申（誓言/承诺），再次确认
items.def_en: To state emphatically again that one remains firmly dedicated to a commitment, belief, or policy

items.def_zh: 加倍下注，坚定强化既定立场
items.def_en: (+ on) To strengthen one's commitment to a risky strategy, stance, or policy despite pushback

items.def_zh: 重新致力于，再次承诺；将（法案等）重新提交委员会审议
items.def_en: 1. To commit or dedicate oneself again to a cause, principle, or course of action. 2. To refer a bill or proposal back to a committee for further consideration.
To pledge oneself, one's energy, or resources anew to a particular mission, cause, or belief

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on revitalizing previous obligations, formally reaffirming devotion to an ideal, or returning institutional mandates to committee review.
groups.summary_zh: 重新确立责任信念、再次表态投入或重审议案。

groups.name: Record & Identify · 采证与鉴定 (DNA-profile, Log, Catalog)
groups.tip: 提取指纹痕迹用于身份核验

items.def_en: To officially register the personal details and criminal charges of a suspect in police custody
To write down or enter forensic data or incidents systematically in an official record
To analyze and record someone's distinctive DNA characteristics for criminal identification
To record an item or evidence systematically in an inventory or registry

items.def_zh: 采集……的指纹，提取……的指纹
items.def_en: To take the fingerprints of a person, especially a crime suspect, for identification.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail forensic and administrative procedures designed to record biometric data, physical traits, or official evidence to establish identity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过提取生物特征或官方建档对嫌疑人或证物进行身份鉴定。

groups.name: Record & Transcribe · 记录与转录 (Audio/Visual to Textual Conversion)
groups.tip: 以录像或逐字听写形式保存记录

items.def_en: to record sound or video onto magnetic tape or equivalent electronic media
to take down and summarize official proceedings into formal written minutes

items.def_zh: 文字编辑，校订转录文本
items.def_en: to check and correct a written or transcribed text for style, grammar, and accuracy

items.def_zh: 给……录像，录影；把……录在录像带上
items.def_en: To record moving images and sound of something onto videotape or video recording equipment.

items.def_zh: 转录，笔录，抄写；改编（乐曲）
items.def_en: 1. To write down or type out spoken words, audio recordings, or shorthand notes into written text. 2. To adapt or arrange a piece of music for a different instrument or voice.

groups.summary_en: This technical communication frame covers capturing spoken utterances, events, or media into permanent visual, audio, or written formats, especially converting recorded sound into verbatim text.
groups.summary_zh: 将口语语音、视音频现场捕捉并转制为书面文字或媒体记录。

groups.name: Recover & Retrieve · 寻回获取与提取收回 (Retrieve, Recover, Reclaim)
groups.tip: 找回失落或存留之物

items.def_en: To regain possession of something stolen, lost, or misplaced after a search or process

items.def_zh: 取回，找回；检索（数据）；挽回
items.def_en: 1. To find and bring something back from a place. 2. To extract or recover stored computer data or information.
To go to where something or someone is and bring them back to the original place
To demand or obtain the return of one's property, territory, or rights from another party
To regain money, expenditure, or losses spent or invested through subsequent revenue

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to locating, repossessing, or bringing back items, money, property, or electronic data from a former resting place or custodian. 'Retrieve' typically suggests going somewhere specifically to fetch data or physical objects, whereas 'reclaim' and 'recoup' emphasize reclaiming rights or offsetting losses.
groups.summary_zh: 指去往某处取回、寻回遗落财物或从系统数据库中检索提取信息。

groups.name: Rectify & Remedy · 补救与除错 (Debug, Remediate, Rectify)
groups.tip: 修补破损恢复完好

items.def_en: to put right a mistake, problem, or undesirable condition
to correct, balance, or set right an unfair or undesirable situation or grievance

items.def_zh: 排除故障，调试（计算机程序等）；清除（某处的）窃听器
items.def_en: 1. To find and remove errors or bugs from a computer program or hardware. 2. To locate and extract hidden listening devices from a room or equipment.
[I/T] to analyze a mechanical or technical problem systematically to discover and fix the defect

items.def_zh: 补救，纠正；治理，净化（受污染的环境）；辅导，矫正（学习困难）
items.def_en: (formal) To correct, reverse, or remedy something undesirable, especially environmental pollution, contamination, or academic deficiencies.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on finding defects, flaws, pollutants, or software errors and taking technical or corrective measures to eliminate them and set things right.
groups.summary_zh: 指排查系统漏洞、软件缺陷、污染或程序性失误，采取针对性措施予以矫正。

groups.name: Recur & Cycle · 周期轮转与循环 (Alternate, Rotate, Recur)
groups.tip: 周而复始按轨运转

items.def_zh: 逐一经历一系列循环阶段
items.def_en: To move sequentially through a series of stages, options, or states before repeating

items.def_zh: 循环，周而复始地运转；使循环；骑自行车
items.def_en: 1. to move, pass, or operate through a recurring series of events or a cycle; to cause to go through a cycle 2. to ride a bicycle
To occur or cause to occur in turn repeatedly between two states or conditions
To pass or cause to pass through a regular sequence of duties, positions, or crops
To happen, occur, or appear again repeatedly at intervals

groups.summary_en: Focuses on processes, phases, or systems passing through a recurring sequence of stages or alternating states. Emphasizes cyclical repetition over continuous spatial flow.
groups.summary_zh: 强调事物按固定阶段周而复始、轮替交替或循环运转的动态。

groups.name: Redeem & Cash In · 赎回与兑换 (Cash in, Encash, Repurchase)
groups.tip: 付代价取回抵押或权益

items.def_en: Exchange a coupon, bond, or token for real money
Convert a draft, check, or financial instrument into cash
Recover something pledged as security by paying off the underlying debt
1. To get something back by paying money or paying off a debt. 2. To exchange a coupon, voucher, or share for money or goods. 3. To make up for faults, mistakes, or bad behavior.
Buy back goods, shares, or property that were previously sold

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses recovering pledged items, converting vouchers or securities into tangible value, or discharging pledges via settlement.
groups.summary_zh: 指凭凭证兑现收益、清偿债务赎还抵押品或回购资产。

groups.name: Redress & Compensate · 纠偏与匡正补救 (Right, Remedy, Make Up For)
groups.tip: 平反冤屈并对损失做出补偿

items.def_en: To do something good to compensate for an injury, unfair loss, or mistake
To act to make amends or reparation for a moral wrong or offense
To provide an effective countermeasure or solution to an undesirable or unfair state of affairs
To inflict punitive retribution in response to a wrong, injustice, or harm

items.def_zh: 纠正，平反，补救（不公或损害）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To correct an unfair situation, wrong, or imbalance by providing compensation or justice.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on restoring moral, legal, or social justice by repairing grievances, setting right historic inequalities, or compensating victims for unfair damage.
groups.summary_zh: 纠正社会或法律上的不公，平反冤屈并通过补偿实现匡正求平。

groups.name: Reflate & Stimulate Economy · 宏观调控与通货回补 (Reflate, Pump-prime, Stimulate)
groups.tip: 宏观干预给经济再注水通胀

items.def_zh: 注资启动，采取景气刺激措施
items.def_en: To stimulate the expansion of a sluggish economy by heavy government spending and credit expansion

items.def_zh: 启动，促使快速启动（经济）
items.def_en: To take energetic, immediate steps to restart or revive a stalled project, economy, or process
To encourage greater economic activity or investment through policy interventions or capital expenditure
(+ into) To introduce large sums of public money or liquidity into a financial market to restore stability

items.def_zh: 使（经济）通货再膨胀，刺激（经济）复苏；经历通货再膨胀
items.def_en: (economics) To stimulate a depressed economy by increasing the money supply, lowering interest rates, or boosting public spending.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame pertain to macroeconomic governance where policymakers inject liquidity, ease fiscal constraints, or prime investment to reverse deflationary stagnation without triggering excessive inflation.
groups.summary_zh: 指宏观政策通过降息、注资或财税手段刺激需求以逆转经济停滞。

groups.name: Reforge & Reconstruct · 熔铸与浴火重建 (Rebuild, Re-create, Reconstitute)
groups.tip: 投入火炉重新淬炼改造

items.def_en: To reconstruct a coherent whole or narrative from scattered fragments or facts
To form an organization, alliance, or substance anew in a different or restored shape
To form or create an alliance, agreement, or identity with great effort and resilience
To build something again after it has been destroyed, damaged, or broken down
1. To heat and hammer metal into a new shape again, or rebuild an alliance or relationship with renewed strength.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on rebuilding, reconstituting, or renewing durable bonds, institutions, or physical materials through intense effort, hardship, or heat. The verbs emphasize overcoming complete rupture or breakdown to create a robust new entity.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重经历断裂或严酷考验后的强力重构与再造。

groups.name: Reform & Amend · 改革与修订 (Modify Official Texts, Laws, or Systems)
groups.tip: 修正旧章法制度以求完善革新

items.def_zh: 改革，革新，改良；使改过自新，洗心革面
items.def_en: 1. To improve a system, organization, or law by making changes to it. 2. To change your behavior and become a better person, or to make someone do so.

items.def_zh: 修订，修正（法规、政策或文稿）
items.def_en: to alter or update a text, policy, or law to correct errors or reflect changes

items.def_zh: 重新起草，重拟（法案、协议）
items.def_en: to write a piece of legislation, agreement, or document again in order to improve it

items.def_zh: 修改，修订（法律、文件、宪法等）；修正
items.def_en: To change the words of a text, especially a law, contract, or bill, in order to improve or correct it.

items.def_zh: 彻底革新，全面检修（系统、法律框架）
items.def_en: to examine thoroughly and make extensive changes or repairs to a system or institution

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe officially altering, improving, or revising laws, institutions, constitutions, or practices to eliminate faults or modernize standards. 'Reform' targets institutional or systemic improvement, while 'amend' specifically modifies official texts, legislation, or constitutional clauses.
groups.summary_zh: 针对体制、法律或官方文件进行正式修正、改良或增删修订。

groups.name: Refrain & Abstain · 戒除与断绝 (Abstain, Forgo, Renounce)
groups.tip: 主动克制欲望放弃投票享乐

items.def_en: To stop doing or consuming something you did regularly

items.def_zh: 戒绝，克制（欲望等）；（投票时）弃权
items.def_en: 1. To deliberately choose not to do something enjoyable, especially drinking alcohol. 2. To choose not to vote for or against something.
To decide not to have or do something that you would otherwise enjoy

items.def_zh: 发誓戒掉；下决心不再碰
items.def_en: To promise decisively to avoid or give up something harmful, such as alcohol or gambling
To state publicly that you no longer have a belief, claim, or bad habit

groups.summary_en: This frame captures high-intensity, rigorous self-denial where one intentionally gives up pleasures, habits, votes, or practices on moral, physical, or religious grounds. Nuances span from voluntary asceticism to permanent renunciation.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于健康、宗教或伦理考量，彻底戒除嗜好或自愿放弃享乐与权利。

groups.name: Refund & Rebate · 退款与折让 (Refund, Rebate, Reimburse)
groups.tip: 交易后退还或折让部分款项

items.def_en: To return money owed or given to someone earlier
To pay back money previously received from someone, as for unsatisfactory goods
To pay back part of an amount someone has already paid for goods, services, or taxes.
(+ for) To pay back money that someone has spent on official or out-of-pocket expenses
To cancel or refund a debt, fine, or tax obligation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail transferring funds back to a payer, including official refunds for returned merchandise, retroactive discounts, and expense compensations.
groups.summary_zh: 指在消费或商务活动中退还款项、返还差额或报销费用。

groups.name: Refurbish & Redecorate · 翻新布置与居室整修 (Redecorate, Refurbish, Revamp)
groups.tip: 重新粉刷与摆设美化空间

items.def_en: To repair, repaint, and decorate an old room, building, or car
To restore a room or building to a former better state by repairing and modernizing
To give new form, structure, or visual style to a room, building, or system
To renovate, re-equip, and clean up a building or room to restore its good condition
To paint, wallpaper, or furnish a room or building again to improve its appearance.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on renovating, refinishing, or overhauling an interior space, building, or room by repainting, papering, and installing fresh furnishings to restore or improve visual and functional appeal.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过重新粉刷、更换壁纸、置办家具等对室内空间进行翻新与整修。

groups.name: Register & Log · 登记与建档归册 (Docket, Log, Roster)
groups.tip: 在法院或官方案卷中立案登记

items.def_en: To place documents officially in records or present a legal application or lawsuit to an authority
To record a name, fact, or details in an official book, list, or system
To make a systematic, official record of events, numbers, or actions in an official register

items.def_zh: 把……记入名册；注册入学/入伍
items.def_en: To officially register someone on the roll or list of members in a course or organization

items.def_zh: 将……记入案卷，在案卷上登记；给……编摘要
items.def_en: (law) To enter a legal case or matter onto an official court schedule or register of proceedings.

groups.summary_en: This frame revolves around officially entering names, cases, transactions, or documents into formal records, lists, or databases for administrative tracking or judicial scheduling.
groups.summary_zh: 指将事务、案件或名单正式录入台账、日程或系统备查。

groups.name: Regurgitate & Ruminate · 反刍与倒流 (Regurgitate, Ruminate, Bring up)
groups.tip: 胃内容物倒流经食管喷涌而出

items.def_en: To chew again the cud regurgitated from the stomach, or to meditate deeply on a matter
To regurgitate or cough up swallowed food or phlegm from the throat or stomach
To gently regurgitate small quantities of milk or swallowed food without violent retching
To flow back up through the esophagus, especially of acidic gastric liquids

items.def_zh: 涌出，反刍，呕出；机械地重复（事实或想法）
items.def_en: 1. To bring swallowed food back up through the throat into the mouth. 2. (disapproving) To repeat information or ideas mechanically without really understanding them.

groups.summary_en: This physiological frame refers to bringing swallowed food or digestive fluids back up from the stomach into the esophagus or mouth, often without the violent muscular convulsing of sickness, or metaphorically repeating unassimilated ideas.
groups.summary_zh: 指将吞下的食物倒回口中（反刍/返流），或生搬硬套复述信息。

groups.name: Rehash & Regurgitate · 炒冷饭与老调重弹 (Regurgitate, Churn out, Trott out)
groups.tip: 如炒冷饭般反复絮叨重提旧事

items.def_en: To reuse obsolete ideas, plotlines, or slogans instead of developing new ones

items.def_zh: （改头换面地）重提，翻炒（旧观点、旧材料）
items.def_en: 1. (disapproving) To reuse old ideas, stories, or arguments in a slightly new form without adding anything original or useful.

items.def_zh: 搬出（老借口或陈词滥调）
items.def_en: To produce an old excuse, argument, or claim that has been heard many times before

items.def_zh: 再端出（陈旧构想）；温旧货
items.def_en: To present old ideas, stories, or films again with only slight modifications

items.def_zh: 机械重复；生搬硬套（旧言论）
items.def_en: To repeat facts, ideas, or statements mechanically without understanding or critique

groups.summary_en: Verbs here carry an explicitly disapproving evaluative load, referring to repeating stale arguments, hackneyed plots, or recycled ideas without any novel insight or artistic refinement. The framing highlights exhaustion of creativity or intellectually lazy recycling.
groups.summary_zh: 含贬义，指毫无新意地重复旧思想、陈旧言论或炒冷饭。

groups.name: Reheat & Warm Rapidly · 快速加热与温热 (Microwave, Reheat, Zap)
groups.tip: 日常加热与熟化过程

items.def_en: To make food or liquids pleasantly warm ready for consumption, or become warm

items.def_zh: 用微波炉加热，微波烹调
items.def_en: 1. To cook or heat food or drink quickly in a microwave oven.
To cook or heat thoroughly in a microwave oven
To cook or heat food quickly using a microwave oven
To heat food or drink that has gone cold after being previously cooked

groups.summary_en: This frame covers domestic and commercial kitchen methods for quickly bringing cold or pre-cooked food and drinks to eating temperature using appliances or gentle heat.
groups.summary_zh: 利用微波炉或炊具将已烹好的冷食迅速温热或重新热透。

groups.name: Reincarnate & Regenerate · 转世与再生 (Transmigrate, Rebirth, Resurrect)
groups.tip: 生命轮回或再次获得新生

items.def_en: To be born again into a new form of existence or spiritual awareness
To bring a dead person back to life, or bring back an obsolete custom or practice
To grow again after damage or loss, or breathe new life and vigor into an organism or area

items.def_zh: 使转世，使再生；转世，获得新生
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To cause a soul or spirit to be born again into another body after death. 2. To be born again into another body or form.
To pass into another body after death, used of the soul or spirit

groups.summary_en: This spiritual and biological frame covers the passing of life, consciousness, or essence into a new physical body or state after death. It extends to mythical resurrections and metaphorical revitalization of depleted vitality.
groups.summary_zh: 表示灵魂转世受身、肉身再造或生机重现的生命形态流转。

groups.name: Reinstate & Leave Intact · 保留原样与撤销删除 (Restore, Stand, Leave)
groups.tip: 校对符号示意保持原样不改

items.def_en: To remain valid, unaltered, or in full force despite challenges or proposed changes
To decide not to cut, edit out, or delete a piece of text or footage
To refrain from changing, interfering with, or editing something

items.def_zh: 恢复（原职、原状或原条文）
items.def_en: To restore a deleted item, former condition, position, or rule to effective status

items.def_zh: （在校对稿上）注以“保留”字样，指示维持原状
items.def_en: (printing) to mark proofread text with 'stet' to instruct that a previously deleted or altered word should remain unchanged

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this technical and procedural frame govern countermanding an alteration, deletion, or amendment so that the original text, decision, or state remains in force.
groups.summary_zh: 指推翻修改或删除决定，指示维持原貌、恢复原有文本或条款。

groups.name: Reinstate & Put Back in Place · 重新就位与恢复安装 (Reinstate, Restore, Re-seat)
groups.tip: 放置安装于指定空间

items.def_en: Bring something back to its former location, functional condition, or active use
Return an item or component to the exact physical place it previously occupied

items.def_zh: 使复职，使恢复原职/原位
items.def_en: Restore someone or something to their previous position, post, or operational status
To put equipment, software, or an official back into place or position again.
Fit out, replace parts, or repair equipment and fixtures inside a vessel or structure

groups.summary_en: This frame involves putting mechanical equipment, functional systems, or human officials back into their previous physical mounts or authorized operational positions after removal. The key nuance is repetition and return to a prior state.
groups.summary_zh: 指将设备、部件或人员重新安装到原有物理位置或恢复其既定职能与地位。

groups.name: Relay & Pass Along · 转达与中继传递 (Relay, Pass on, Forward)
groups.tip: 将信息、指令中转接力传达

items.def_en: To resend a received message, email, or letter to a new address
To act as a conduit to pass words, ideas, or feelings from someone else
To give someone something that another person has given or told you
To deliver a formal decision or pass knowledge down through an intermediary

items.def_zh: 转达，传达；转播，接力传送
items.def_en: 1. To receive information, news, or a message and pass it on to someone else. 2. To receive and pass on a television or radio broadcast signal.

groups.summary_en: Verbs focusing on the intermediate step of receiving a message, instruction, or signal from one source and dutifully transmitting it along the chain to its destination.
groups.summary_zh: 指作为中间环节接收信息并向后继人员或节点转达。

groups.name: Relocate & Resettle Displaced People · 重新安置与妥善庇护 (Resettle, Relocate, Billet)
groups.tip: 重新安排居民或拆迁户住房

items.def_en: Provide shelter, living quarters, or residential space for individuals or families
Provide lodging, rooms, or sufficient physical space for persons needing shelter
Move people or whole establishments to a different place or accommodation

items.def_zh: 重新定居，安置（移民/难民）
items.def_en: Settle people in a new area, community, or country, especially following displacement

items.def_zh: 给……提供新住所，为……重新安排住房
items.def_en: To provide a new home or housing for people whose existing homes have been damaged, demolished, or are unsuitable.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to administrative or state actions providing new dwelling spaces, refuge, or community accommodation to displaced, homeless, or evacuated individuals. Distinctions reflect permanent community moving versus emergency sheltering.
groups.summary_zh: 指政府或机构为流离失所、拆迁或灾后群众安排新居所或整体迁移落户。

groups.name: Rely & Count On · 依靠与寄托信任 (Depend, Rely, Lean)
groups.tip: 倚仗依托外界助力

items.def_zh: 依靠，指望（depend on/upon）；取决于，视……而定
items.def_en: 1. (depend on/upon) to rely on someone or something for help, support, or money. 2. (depend on/upon) to be determined or conditioned by something.
(+ on/upon) to trust or need someone or something to provide help, support, or a required result
to expect and trust that someone or something will be reliable and help you

items.def_zh: 依靠，依仗（精神或外在支持）
items.def_en: to depend on someone heavily for emotional or financial support, especially in difficulty
to be confident about something happening and base your plans entirely upon it

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses relational and functional reliance, where an agent needs the assistance, support, or loyalty of someone or something to survive or function.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在生活、情感或事务上仰仗、托付他人或外物的支持。

groups.name: Rely & Depend · 依赖与倚仗 (Count On, Lean On, Bank On)
groups.tip: 笃信对方托付依靠

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To need someone or something in order to survive, function, or succeed

items.def_zh: 依赖，依靠（rely on/upon）；指望，信任
items.def_en: (rely on/upon) to depend on or trust someone or something to provide support, help, or a particular result
To expect and trust someone to assist you or act reliably in times of need
To base your hopes or future plans on something definitely happening
To turn to someone for guidance, comfort, or financial support during adversity

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize instrumental dependence, where one leans upon another party, system, or expected outcome for vital support, assistance, or fulfillment.
groups.summary_zh: 指在生活、行动或决策上倚靠、指望特定人事物提供支撑或保障。

groups.name: Remark & Comment · 置评与指陈 (Remark, Comment, Observe)
groups.tip: 正式声明观点并顺带评点

items.def_en: (+ on) To utter an evaluative opinion or critical appraisal regarding a matter
To mention something important so that people notice it or pay attention to it
(+ on) To express an opinion, explanation, or judgment about an event, person, or situation
To make a formal remark or state an observation regarding what one has seen or deduced

items.def_zh: 谈及，说起，发表评论；注意到
items.def_en: 1. To say or write something as a comment or observation. 2. (formal) To notice or observe something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing an evaluative observation, spontaneous perception, or short critical thought in response to an event or circumstance.
groups.summary_zh: 针对观察到的现象发表评述、见解或感想。

groups.name: Remind & Prompt · 提醒与提示 (Prompt, Jog, Cue)
groups.tip: 唤起记忆或提示下一步行动

items.def_en: 1. To tell someone something they might have forgotten or to prompt them to take action. 2. To cause someone to remember or think of something.
To remind an actor of their line, or nudge someone to remember or speak
To give a signal or reminder to someone to say or do something
To stimulate someone's memory through a clue or reference (+ one's memory)
To gently remind or coax someone to take a necessary action

groups.summary_en: Denotes stimulating someone's memory, jogging their awareness, or nudging them into saying or performing an intended action.
groups.summary_zh: 唤起对方记忆或及时给予提示以促成行动。

groups.name: Reminisce & Recall · 回忆与追忆 (Recall, Look back, Recollect)
groups.tip: 抚今追昔重温往日记忆

items.def_en: (+ to) To remember or refer to an earlier event, topic, or bygone period
(+ on/at) To reflect on or think about events that happened in the past
To retrieve a memory of someone or something from the past into consciousness
To deliberately bring facts or events back into memory
(+ about/over) To talk, write, or think with pleasure about past events and experiences.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on mentally retrieving past episodes and sentimentally sharing nostalgic memories of earlier times with wistfulness, pleasure, or reflection.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动调取往昔记忆或带有怀旧温情地重温、倾诉旧事。

groups.name: Renege & Default · 违约与背信 (Renege, Welsh, Back out)
groups.tip: 赌输赖账背弃先前承诺

items.def_en: (+ of) To decide not to do something previously agreed upon
(informal) To avoid doing something that one ought to do through fear or dishonesty
(+ on) To fail to honor a debt, bet, or agreement

items.def_zh: 赖账，失信，违约（尤指赌债）
items.def_en: (+ on) (informal) To fail to pay a debt or honor an agreement (variant spelling of welsh).
(+ on) To fail to carry out a promise, agreement, or formal commitment

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe failing to honor a promise, deal, or financial debt, especially in an informal or dishonorable way. They contrast between backing out of a pledged agreement and dodging an outright payment.
groups.summary_zh: 指违背诺言、协定或赖账不还的背信与逃避行为。

groups.name: Rent & Lease Property · 租借与租赁 (Rent, Lease, Hire, Charter)
groups.tip: 支付租金获取使用权

items.def_en: To allow someone to live in or use a room, house, or land in exchange for regular rent payments
To pay money to borrow something such as a car, tool, or clothes for a short period

1. to pay money regularly to use land, a house, car, or other property
2. to allow someone to use something you own in exchange for regular payments
To make a formal legal agreement to use or let someone use land, buildings, or equipment for a set period
To rent an entire aircraft, boat, or vehicle for a particular journey or group

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the contractual arrangement where temporary use of property, vehicles, or goods is granted in exchange for periodic payments. It contrasts long-term formal agreements with short-term hires.
groups.summary_zh: 以定期支付费用为条件，出租或承租房屋、车辆等资产的行为。

groups.name: Reopen & Resume · 开放与复业 (Reopen, Restart, Revive)
groups.tip: 公共场所重新开门营业或开放

items.def_zh: 重新开门营业；解封恢复
items.def_en: To reopen to the public or customers after being shut down
To begin again after an interruption or cessation
To start operating, functioning, or providing services again

items.def_zh: 重新开放，重开；重新审理
items.def_en: To open or begin again after being closed or paused, such as a business, school, or investigation.

items.def_zh: 使重新运作；恢复有效状态
items.def_en: To make something active, operational, or effective again

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on restoring operations, public access, or legal and institutional processes after a period of closure, suspension, or recess.
groups.summary_zh: 结束休整、停摆或封锁，重新开放或恢复运营。

groups.name: Replace & Substitute · 替换、替代与换置 (Substitute, Exchange, Swap)
groups.tip: 以新换旧顶替原有

items.def_zh: 代替，取代；更换，替换；把……放回原处
items.def_en: 1. To take the place of someone or something, or put a new thing or person in place of another. 2. To put something back in its correct place.

items.def_zh: 调换；更换（有缺陷物品等）
items.def_en: To give something and receive something of equal value or type in return
(+ for) To use or act as an alternative in place of someone or something else
To replace one item, role, or component with another specific alternative
To give one thing in exchange for another, or exchange positions

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing or using an alternative person, component, or item in place of another, whether permanently, symmetrically, or as a temporary expedient.
groups.summary_zh: 指用另一人、事、物来替代现有者，涵盖对调、以物易物或作为临时备用。

groups.name: Replace & Supplant · 取代与篡位 (Displace, Oust, Supersede)
groups.tip: 普通替代乃至强行排挤夺位

items.def_en: To take over the role or position of someone or something, forcing them out of place
To take the place of an older concept, rule, or machine because of superior effectiveness
To drive someone out from a position of authority, power, or possession forcibly
To take the place of a person, system, or idea, especially by force or superior advantage.
To seize a throne, office, or legitimate authority wrongfully and without right

groups.summary_en: Covers taking over the position, role, or authority of another, often through superiority, force, technological evolution, or political intrigue.
groups.summary_zh: 通过实力、权力更迭或优胜劣汰而取代、废黜原主。

groups.name: Replay & Relive · 画面回放与重历 (Relive, Reenact, Re-create)
groups.tip: 历史或场景再次重放显现

items.def_en: To listen to sounds or watch images that have just been recorded

items.def_zh: 重现，再现；重播，重放；重赛
items.def_en: 1. To experience, imagine, or perform an event or scene again. 2. To play recorded video or audio again. 3. To play a sports match again because of a draw or invalidation.
To make a copy of something or cause an effect, sound, or image to happen again
To experience an intense past event again in the imagination or emotional memory
To repeat the actions of an earlier event or historical battle as an actor or demonstrator

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote mentally experiencing past events again, acting out historical or past occurrences, or playing recorded media once more. Nuances balance between psychological nostalgia/trauma, deliberate staged performance, and technological reproduction.
groups.summary_zh: 指在心中重现、舞台上重演或多媒体回放往昔场景。

groups.name: Repress & Crush · 镇压与强力遏制 (Repress, Subdue, Crush)
groups.tip: 动用国家或强力手段武力弹压

items.def_en: To forcefully put an end to an uprising, rebellion, or dissemination of critical information
To bring a person, group, or rebellious faction under control by force or strategy
(+ on) To take sudden, stringent punitive measures to stop or restrict illegal or rebellious activity

items.def_zh: 镇压，平息；抑制，克制（情感、欲望）
items.def_en: 1. To use force or authority to put down a protest, rebellion, or political movement. 2. To consciously control or suppress strong feelings, desires, or memories.
To defeat or destroy an opposition movement or rebellion completely using overwhelming force

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote using political, military, or authoritarian force to quell revolts, subdue dissidence, or choke out public opposition. They focus on systemic domination and forceful containment of resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 指统治者或军队使用强权或暴力扑灭叛乱及政治反抗。

groups.name: Reprieve & Stay · 缓刑与暂缓执行 (Reprieve, Stay, Commute)
groups.tip: 由权威暂缓或免除刑罚

items.def_en: To legally stop, suspend, or delay an action or judicial execution
To defer the enforcement of a legal sentence or rule for a specified period
To grant a temporary relief or postponement from a sentence, obligation, or execution
(+ to) To officially reduce a legal punishment to a less severe one, especially a death sentence to life imprisonment

items.def_zh: 暂缓执行刑罚（尤指死刑）；暂缓，延期
items.def_en: 1. (law) To officially cancel or delay the punishment of a prisoner, especially a death sentence. 2. To give temporary relief or an postponement from something unpleasant or dangerous.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with executive or judicial interventions that postpone, reduce, or suspend an impending severe punishment (such as capital punishment) or detrimental administrative ruling.
groups.summary_zh: 行政长官或法庭依法暂缓、减轻或推迟严重刑罚及判决执行。

groups.name: Repurpose & Reclaim · 再次使用与循环利用 (Reuse, Recycle, Repurpose)
groups.tip: 投入使用或物尽其用

items.def_en: to adapt an existing object, tool, or space for a completely new function
to reuse discarded materials to create a product of higher quality or artistic value
to process used materials so that they can be made into new products
to recover useful materials or substances from waste products or natural sources
to use an item, container, or material again instead of throwing it away

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on using items, materials, or resources again rather than discarding them, ranging from industrial reprocessing to creative functional adaptation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调避免丢弃，将物品或资源重新利用或改造。

groups.name: Rescale & Coordinate Transformation · 变换度量衡与比例缩放 (Rescale, Calibrate, Resize)
groups.tip: 校正量度、比例并依规调控

items.def_zh: 换基校正；调整指数基准
items.def_en: To recalculate or shift an economic or statistical index to a new baseline reference point.
To change the physical, visual, or digital dimensions of an item or digital image.
To transform values or data measured on different scales to a notionally common scale.
To mark units of measurement on an instrument or adjust it so that its readings match a recognized standard.

items.def_zh: 重新调整尺度，按新比例调整
items.def_en: To adjust the size, proportions, or measurement scale of something, such as an image, data, or model.

groups.summary_en: This frame entails converting, expanding, or contracting numeric ranges, coordinate frameworks, or digital dimensions so that disparate datasets or visual models align to a consistent measurement standard.
groups.summary_zh: 指改变图像、数学模型或度量衡的比例尺度以实现量纲归一或适配。

groups.name: Rescue & Save · 营救与解救 (Save, Deliver, Extricate)
groups.tip: 将处于危险中的人救出

items.def_en: to keep someone or something safe from death, injury, disaster, or loss

items.def_zh: 解救，拯救（脱离险境/苦难）
items.def_en: (+ from) to rescue or set someone free from evil, danger, captivity, or suffering
to save someone or something from danger, harm, or difficulty
to help a person, company, or organization out of a difficult, usually financial, emergency

items.def_zh: 使脱困，拔出（从缠结或困境中）
items.def_en: (+ from) to release or free someone or something from an entangled, trapped, or awkward situation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray intervening proactively to liberate, protect, or pull people or objects out of immediate peril, confinement, disaster, or destructive harm.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动介入危险现场，将人员或财产从灾难、被困或厄运中营救、解脱出来。

groups.name: Reserve & Set Aside · 预留与保留 (Withhold, Retain, Set aside)
groups.tip: 留存预备后续使用

items.def_en: To hold back or set something aside for future use; to book a seat, room, or ticket in advance.
To continue to keep, possess, or hold on to something rather than losing or giving it up
To reserve a part of something rather than parting with the whole amount
To dedicate or reserve something solely for a dedicated special purpose
To deliberately hold back or refuse to grant something required or expected

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes keeping possession of, withholding, or protecting an asset, right, or resource specifically for a designated person, requirement, or future event.
groups.summary_zh: 保留、扣存或特意预留资源、权利以备将来使用。

groups.name: Reshape & Refashion · 重塑与改制 (Remodel, Rework, Transform)
groups.tip: 改变原有形态加以重新设计

items.def_en: To make significant changes to an existing text, composition, or design to improve it
To completely transform the visual appearance or style of someone or something
To alter the structure, interior design, or layout of a building or system

items.def_zh: 重新塑画；改写（结构或叙述）
items.def_en: To present something in a completely different way or reformulate its conceptual structure
1. To remake, reshape, or redesign something into a new form.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe altering the form, structure, or style of an existing object, garment, or conceptual framework to give it a fresh utility or look. It focuses on stylistic or functional adaptation rather than destructive overhaul.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对已有物品、样式或理念进行改良与重塑。

groups.name: Reshuffle & Reassign · 权力重组与职位洗牌 (Redistribute, Reallocate, Shuffle)
groups.tip: 重组内阁或重新分配人事

items.def_en: To mix up or change the relative positions of personnel, papers, or tasks
To share out work, power, or resources in a new or fairer arrangement
To allocate someone to a different job, duty, or geographical post

items.def_zh: 改组，重组（内阁或人员）；重新洗牌
items.def_en: 1. To reorganize government ministers, staff, or duties. 2. To shuffle playing cards again.

items.def_zh: 大举整顿；对…进行大洗牌
items.def_en: To institute radical changes in an organization or government to expose inefficiency

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to rearranging personnel, portfolios, or administrative posts within a cabinet, corporate board, or institution. The primary implication is altering interpersonal dynamics or organizational responsibilities without necessarily changing the individuals involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指对内阁成员、团队人事或权责分配进行换位调动。

groups.name: Reskill & Up-skill · 再培训与技能提升 (Retrain, Reskill, Upskill)
groups.tip: 传授知识技能并进行定向培训

items.def_en: (+ on) Refresh and improve one's practical knowledge of a skill that has grown rusty

items.def_zh: 使学习新技能，转岗培训
items.def_en: Teach someone or acquire new skills in order to qualify for a completely different job
Learn additional advanced skills to enhance competence within one's current career

items.def_zh: 再培训，重新训练；改行接受培训
items.def_en: To teach or learn new skills, especially for a different job or profession.

items.def_zh: 技能重组，改组适应新需要
items.def_en: Equip oneself or an organization with modern skills, machinery, or conceptual tools

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on acquiring new vocational competencies, refreshing technical expertise, or adapting worker skillsets to technological shifts.
groups.summary_zh: 针对职业转型或技术升级开展再次培训与赋能。

groups.name: Resonate & Reverberate · 回响与共鸣 (Echo, Resound, Vibrate)
groups.tip: 声波在空间内震荡余响

items.def_en: (+ through/around) To repeat or cause a sound to bounce back from a surface
To sound loudly, clearly, and suddenly in an environment
(+ with) To produce a deep, clear, continuing sound, or strike an emotional chord
(+ with) To fill an area with sound, echoing powerfully throughout

items.def_zh: 回响，回荡；产生巨大反响，造成持续影响
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/around) (of a loud sound) To echo repeatedly through an enclosed space. 2. (of an event or idea) To have a prolonged, widespread, or serious effect.

groups.summary_en: This frame involves the repetitive bouncing, persistence, and amplification of sound waves through physical acoustic spaces, as well as prolonged secondary emotional or social impacts.
groups.summary_zh: 指声音在空间中回旋震荡、久久不绝，或指事件产生深远反响。

groups.name: Resort & Turn To · 诉诸与求助 (Resort, Turn to, Fall back on, Call upon)
groups.tip: 借助特定手段谋求解决

items.def_zh: 诉诸，采取（某种手段）；常去
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To turn to or adopt a strategy or course of action, especially an unpleasant one, to resolve a problem. 2. (+ to) (formal) To go often or habitually to a place.
To ask a specific person or reliable source for help, advice, or comfort during a crisis
To make use of an alternative reserve or plan when primary options have collapsed
To officially or urgently invite someone to take action or draw upon internal reserves
To utilize a specific mechanism, law, or solution as an available remedy for difficulty

groups.summary_en: This frame covers choosing an extreme, undesirable, or secondary course of action, or asking an external party for assistance when standard methods have failed.
groups.summary_zh: 在穷尽常规办法后，迫不得已采用极端手段，或向外部资源寻求救助。

groups.name: Rest & Perch · 停留与栖息 (Roost, Alight, Settle)
groups.tip: 同场景高频动作归纳

items.def_en: Keep oneself or an object steady on a narrow or precarious edge without falling
(+ on) Land softly on a high branch or perch and remain resting there

items.def_zh: 栖息，停留；坐在……边缘；位于高处
items.def_en: To land and rest on a branch or high bar; to sit lightly on the edge of something high.
(of a bird or bat) Settle down to sleep or rest on a high perch
(+ on) Descend from the air and gently land or settle upon a surface

groups.summary_en: Depicts creatures (predominantly birds) or light objects coming to rest, usually atop an elevated, narrow, or precarious vantage point, maintaining balance rather than collapsing flat.
groups.summary_zh: 指鸟禽或人轻盈落在细窄高处停歇、栖息并保持平衡。

groups.name: Rest & Relax · 歇息与放松 (Unwind, Recline, Recuperate)
groups.tip: 暂时中断活动恢复精力

items.def_zh: 休息，歇息；依靠，支撑；倚放
items.def_en: 1. To stop working or moving in order to relax and recover strength. 2. To lean or support something against or on a surface.
To become less tense, anxious, or rigid, resting the body and mind

items.def_zh: 解乏，放松（从压力中解脱）
items.def_en: To gradually relax and let go of stress after a period of intense exertion or strain
To lean back or lie down comfortably in a supported, restful posture
To recover from fatigue, exhaustion, or illness back to normal strength

groups.summary_en: Concerns cessation of exertion to recuperate physical energy, relieve mental tension, or adopt an idle, restful posture.
groups.summary_zh: 指暂停劳作以恢复体力、消除紧张感或处于舒坦姿态。

groups.name: Restate & Reaffirm · 重申与强调性声明 (Reiterate, Reaffirm, Underscore)
groups.tip: 重复言说再次强调原本观点

items.def_en: To talk or complain about a particular subject continuously and tediously
To say something again or several times in order to make the meaning thoroughly clear
To emphasize the decisive truth or essential nature of something said
1. To state an idea, rule, or argument again, especially in a different way to clarify or emphasize it.
To declare state policy, commitment, or belief strongly again in a formal setting

groups.summary_en: Unlike derogatory rehash frames, this frame centers on formal, deliberate, or clarifying restatements intended to ensure clarity, reassert commitment, or underline paramount importance in discourse.
groups.summary_zh: 指为强调原则、澄清误会或重表决心而正式重申言论。

groups.name: Restrain & Forbear · 克制与包容 (Forbear, Hold back, Patiently endure)
groups.tip: 压制内在冲动并保持克制隐忍

items.def_en: To make a desperate, conscious effort to stop yourself from saying what you really think
To deliberately stop oneself from speaking, displaying emotion, or acting
To keep an impulse, emotion, or reaction under firm control
To manage to suppress strong feelings of anger, excitement, or grief
To refrain politely from doing or saying something, or to show patience and self-control.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on internal deliberate restraint and patient endurance, where an agent chooses not to speak, react, or enforce a right out of politeness, discipline, or mercy. Nuances range from mild self-control to stoic self-suppression.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于礼貌、耐心或修养而主观抑制反应、言论或情绪的隐忍行为。

groups.name: Restrain & Refrain · 自律与克制 (Refrain, Desist, Withhold)
groups.tip: 自我克制欲望或避免冲动

items.def_en: To deliberately delay taking an action until a later, more favorable time
To prevent yourself from doing something, or stop an impulse
To stop oneself from doing or saying something.
To deliberately refuse to give, express, or disclose something
(+ from) To stop doing something, especially after an official or formal request

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote consciously halting or choosing not to perform an action, typically due to formal rules, etiquette, or moral consideration. The focus is on active non-action and intentional self-governance.
groups.summary_zh: 表示基于道德、规则或礼节而主动停止或不去做某种动作。

groups.name: Restructure & Streamline · 架构重组与体制理顺 (Reorganize, Overhaul, Rationalize)
groups.tip: 调整内部框架与组织结构

items.def_en: 1. To organize a company, system, finance, or organization in a new and different way to improve efficiency.
To make an organization, process, or production line simpler, more modern, and efficient
To change the way in which a business, department, or system is structured

items.def_zh: 合理化整顿（常涉裁员减支）
items.def_en: To make a business or system more effective by cutting superfluous staff or unprofitable units
To thoroughly examine a machine, legal code, or system and implement repairs or updates

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on fundamental systemic, corporate, or financial reform aimed at increasing viability, eliminating redundancy, or saving a company from insolvency. The tone is strategic, administrative, and economic.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重针对企业机制、财务体系或机构运作的结构性重整。

groups.name: Result & Ensue · 产生与导致 (Ensue, Stem, Arise)
groups.tip: 因果链条引发的后果

items.def_zh: 发生，产生；（因……而）产生，（由……）造成；导致，结果是
items.def_en: To happen because of something else; to end in or lead to a particular outcome.
To happen as a logical or necessary consequence of a stated premise or prior occurrence
To begin to exist or become apparent as a consequence of a particular situation
To develop or originate as a result of a particular condition, cause, or event
To happen after something else, especially as a direct or natural consequence

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this causal frame trace how events, states, or outcomes follow from preceding conditions. They contrast direct consequences, temporal aftermaths, and logical developments growing organically out of a root source.
groups.summary_zh: 指某事件或状况由先前原因随之产生、引发或导出。

groups.name: Resume & Pick Back Up · 中断后继续 (Resume, Restart, Pick up)
groups.tip: 中断后重新拾起推进

items.def_zh: （中断后）重新开始，继续；恢复（职位或状态）
items.def_en: To begin again or continue after a pause or interruption; to return to a previous seat, place, or position
To start an activity again after a pause, especially from the point where it stopped
To continue an activity or task, especially after a disruption or interruption
To begin operating or occurring again after stopping
To begin again or cause something to begin again after a pause; formal equivalent of resume

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark re-initiating an activity, process, or posture precisely after a temporary hiatus, pause, or disruption.
groups.summary_zh: 特指在暂停、打断或停顿后重新开始或继续进行。

groups.name: Resurrect & Revive · 起死回生与复兴 (Revive, Resuscitate, Reanimate)
groups.tip: 失去生命机能后重获生机

items.def_en: To return someone to life or restore an extinct custom, fashion, or law to active use
To become conscious, healthy, or active again, or make someone or something do so

items.def_zh: （通过急救）使苏醒；使恢复生气
items.def_en: To make someone start breathing again after they have nearly died, or revive an ailing system

items.def_zh: 赋予新生命；使恢复生气
items.def_en: To bring something back to life or inject fresh vitality into a lifeless body or project

items.def_zh: 使复活，使起死回生；使复兴，恢复
items.def_en: 1. To bring a dead person back to life. 2. To bring an old idea, custom, or practice back into use.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on restoring life, vitality, or active existence to someone or something dead, unconscious, or lapsed. Nuances span literal medical resuscitation to metaphorical restoration of dormant practices, memories, or institutions.
groups.summary_zh: 指将濒死或已亡者救活，或使废弃的制度、观念、记忆等重现生机与活力。

groups.name: Retain & Hold · 保留与持有 (Withhold, Keep Back, Hang Onto)
groups.tip: 维持持有状态不脱手

items.def_zh: 保留，预留（专供日后使用）
items.def_en: To keep something available for a particular person, purpose, or future time

items.def_zh: 保留，保持；记住；聘用（律师等）
items.def_en: 1. to keep or continue to hold something in one's possession. 2. to absorb and keep something within. 3. to secure the services of a professional, especially a lawyer, by paying a preliminary fee.
To keep something in your possession instead of selling, discarding, or losing it
To reserve or refuse to surrender a portion of something
To refuse to give or release something that is expected, earned, or requested

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses holding onto physical possessions, control, employees, or internal attributes rather than surrendering, transferring, or discarding them.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动拥有、守住或不予让渡财物、权利、人才或特质。

groups.name: Retaliate & Strike Back · 反击与报复 (Strike Back, Hit Back, Avenge)
groups.tip: 遭受攻击后以牙还牙反扑

items.def_en: (+ against/at) To deliver an immediate or determined counter-blow against an aggressor
(+ at) To retaliate vigorously against attacks, accusations, or hostile actions
To do something unpleasant to someone to punish them for having hurt or offended you
To inflict punishment or damage on someone in return for an injury done to oneself or one's group
(+ against/by) To attack, harm, or take action against someone in return for an injury, insult, or attack.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inflicting counter-harm or attacking in response to a prior wrong, provocation, or aggression. Differences focus on the immediacy of the counterstrike versus planned personal revenge or punitive legal restitution.
groups.summary_zh: 针对此前遭受的攻击、伤害或侮辱进行反攻或施加报复。

groups.name: Retch & Gag · 干呕与反胃 (Retch, Gag, Heave)
groups.tip: 胃部痉挛反胃欲呕或吐出

items.def_en: To swallow down or suppress a wave of nausea, retching, or emotion

items.def_zh: 作呕，喉咙被卡得恶心欲吐
items.def_en: To choke or experience an involuntary throat reflex as if about to vomit
To undergo agonizing spasmodic efforts to vomit, characterized by heavy muscular contraction
To make the physical movement and sound of vomiting, especially without actually bringing anything up.
To make painful vomiting motions repeatedly when the stomach is empty

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the spasmodic, involuntary muscular contractions and choking throat reflexes of vomiting, typically without expelling stomach contents, or in anticipation of actual regurgitation.
groups.summary_zh: 指咽喉受到刺激或极度恶心引发的肌肉痉挛性干呕与欲呕反应。

groups.name: Retire & Withdraw · 退职与引退 (Retire, Resign, Step down)
groups.tip: 交出职权脱离工作并退隐

items.def_en: To withdraw gracefully from an activity, career, or contest
To resign formally from a prominent post, office, or leadership position

items.def_zh: 退职，退休；引退，隐退；就寝
items.def_en: 1. To stop working, especially after reaching a certain age. 2. (+ to) To withdraw to a quiet or private place; to go to bed.
(+ from) To give up a job, post, or membership voluntarily
To formally renounce a royal throne or supreme sovereign responsibility

groups.summary_en: This frame covers relinquishing a professional career, office, or public post, or retreating from public life and noisy environments into privacy or seclusion.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动辞任职务、达到年限退休或退隐避世。

groups.name: Retraction of Words & Statements · 收回言论与撤销 (Retract, Take back, Disavow)
groups.tip: 收回已说过的话或取消承诺声明

items.def_en: Admit that something one said was wrong, hurtful, or untrue and withdraw it
Formally declare that a previous public statement, claim, or accusation is invalid
Deny any responsibility, connection, or support for a statement or action

items.def_zh: 宣布放弃（信仰/见解），公开翻供
items.def_en: Formally reject or renounce a previously held belief, confession, or sworn opinion

items.def_zh: 收回（已说的话）；unsay的过去式和过去分词
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of unsay; to retract or take back something previously said.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve a speaker formally or informally rescinding, revoking, or wishing away a prior statement, accusation, or promise.
groups.summary_zh: 指发言者主动或被迫收回、撤销、否认或声明先前的言论作废。

groups.name: Reunite & Rejoin · 重聚与复合 (Rejoin, Reconnect, Reassemble)
groups.tip: 分散群体重新聚合融为一体

items.def_zh: 重新建立联系；再续旧情
items.def_en: (+ with) To meet or communicate again with someone after a long break in contact

items.def_zh: （使）重聚，（使）再结合；（使）重新统一
items.def_en: To bring together or come together again after being separated.
To return to and become part of a group, organization, or companion after separation
To come together again or bring separated members back into a unified group
To restore an alienated or split faction or individual back into a cohesive whole

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing people, factions, or divided territories back together after a period of estrangement, conflict, or physical separation.
groups.summary_zh: 指人、阵营或分裂地区在分离或冲突后再次相聚或重新统合。

groups.name: Reveal Private Identity or Secrets · 强制公开隐私与曝光 (Out, Expose, Blow the Whistle)
groups.tip: 揭露秘密公开隐情

items.def_zh: 揭露，公开（某人是同性恋或不愿公开的身份）；揭发（秘事）
items.def_en: To reveal someone's homosexuality, transgender identity, or other secret without their consent.

items.def_zh: 告发；揭发内幕（当吹哨人）
items.def_en: Bring covert wrongdoing or a private institutional secret to public attention by alerting authorities or the press

items.def_zh: 人肉搜索并公开个人隐私
items.def_en: Search for and publish private or identifying information about an individual on the internet, typically with malicious intent

items.def_zh: 无意或故意泄露（秘密或个人身份）
items.def_en: Inadvertently or deliberately betray someone's true identity, hidden feelings, or secret

items.def_zh: 揭开面具；暴露真实身份
items.def_en: Reveal the true, often disreputable identity or deceptive nature of someone previously hidden

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly disclosing someone's closely guarded private identity, hidden orientation, or concealed personal secrets without their consent. The tone typically ranges from invasive personal betrayal to controversial public disclosure.
groups.summary_zh: 违背当事人意愿曝光其隐秘身份、性取向或私人底细，带有强烈争议性。

groups.name: Revile & Berate · 痛骂与肆意辱骂 (Revile, Vituperate, Berate)
groups.tip: 言辞粗暴侮辱中伤

items.def_en: to speak to or treat someone in a disrespectful, offensive, or scornful manner
to protest violently or scold bitterly and furiously against someone or something
to speak angrily and criticize someone at length for doing something wrong
to speak or write about someone in an intensely disparaging and defamatory way
to criticize someone in an extremely hostile, hateful, and abusive manner

groups.summary_en: This frame covers high-intensity, abusive speech acts intended to debase, vilify, or savagely condemn a person using cruel or contemptuous verbal attacks.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用恶毒、轻蔑或攻击性语言对他人进行激烈谩骂或痛斥。

groups.name: Revive & Resuscitate · 复苏与苏醒 (Revive, Resuscitate, Resurrect)
groups.tip: 起死回生恢复生命机能

items.def_en: to make someone conscious again after they have fainted or been anaesthetized
to regain life, strength, or consciousness, or restore someone or something to this state
to bring back to life from death, or reinstate a forgotten custom, practice, or enterprise
to revive someone from unconsciousness or apparent death by emergency medical procedures

items.def_zh: 使复活，使苏醒；给……以新生，鼓舞
items.def_en: 1. to bring someone or something back to life, consciousness, or physiological functioning 2. to give fresh vigor, enthusiasm, or activity to something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe restoring someone or something to life, consciousness, vigor, or functional vitality following death, unconsciousness, decay, or decline.
groups.summary_zh: 指使人从昏厥、垂死状态苏醒，或使衰败已久之物恢复生机与运作。

groups.name: Revive & Resuscitate · 起死回生与急救苏醒 (Resuscitate, Revive, Reanimate)
groups.tip: 实施人工呼吸等急救挽回心跳

items.def_en: Restore someone who has lost consciousness back to an alert, waking state
Apply an electric shock to the heart to stop fibrillation and restore regular cardiac rhythm
Bring someone back to consciousness, physical vigor, or life after fainting or illness

items.def_zh: 使复苏，使苏醒；使恢复生机，复兴
items.def_en: 1. To make someone who has stopped breathing or is unconscious become conscious again. 2. To revive or revitalize something that is declining or dormant.
Restore to life or vitality something or someone that is inanimate or apparently dead

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate restoring life, breath, or consciousness to a person who is moribund or unconscious, often extended metaphorically to dying ventures.
groups.summary_zh: 使濒死、昏厥或停止呼吸者恢复知觉与生命体征，亦指使绝处逢生。

groups.name: Revolt & Defy Authority · 反叛与抗争 (Rebel, Defy, Insurge)
groups.tip: 从不从反抗到集体兵变

items.def_en: (+ against) To actively resist and oppose the government, an authority, or social conventions
To openly and courageously refuse to obey an order, law, or ruling authority
(+ against) To unite and act aggressively to overthrow an oppressive government or master
(+ against) To take violent action against the existing ruler or political leadership
(+ against) To openly rebel against lawful authority, especially soldiers or sailors defying their officers.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict refusing compliance and aggressively taking up arms or resistance against institutional hierarchy, commands, or sovereign masters. The lexical spectrum spans active armed insurrections to willful structural disobedience.
groups.summary_zh: 公然对抗建制权威、拒绝服从命令并采取叛乱行动。

groups.name: Rewrite & Redraft · 重写与改写 (Revise, Rework, Redraft)
groups.tip: 重订书写以修正原稿

items.def_en: To reconsider and change text or plans to correct mistakes or add improvements
To compose a new draft of an essay, document, or legal agreement
To produce a new or improved written version by writing directly over the original
To write something again in a different, updated, or improved form.
To change, reorganize, or improve text, music, or a plan substantially

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses returning to existing written, coded, or scripted material to alter its structure, improve expression, or transform it into a significantly renewed iteration.
groups.summary_zh: 指对已有文章、代码或文稿进行全面修改、另行起草或重新撰写。

groups.name: Rig & Fraudulent Manipulation · 操纵舞弊与弄虚作假 (Rig, Fix, Tamper)
groups.tip: 暗中舞弊以掌控全局

items.def_zh: （通过欺诈或暗中手段）操纵，作弊；装配（船只、装置）
items.def_en: 1. To dishonestly arrange or manipulate the outcome of an election, contest, or process. 2. To provide or equip a ship, device, or structure with necessary gear or ropes.

items.def_zh: 虚报，做手脚窜改（数字、账目）
items.def_en: Manipulate or alter figures or facts dishonestly to make them fit a desired conclusion
Secretly arrange a deal or predetermine a decision unfairly behind closed doors

items.def_zh: 暗中窜改，非法乱动（证据、投票系统等）
items.def_en: Interfere secretly or illicitly with a system, ballot, or evidence to cause harm or change outcomes

items.def_zh: 暗中内定，操纵（比赛、选举等）
items.def_en: Dishonestly organize or influence the result of an election, match, or trial ahead of time

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail corrupt, clandestine, or underhanded tampering with contests, elections, or official mechanisms to predetermine an unfair outcome in violation of rules.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中做手脚、串通舞弊以不正当控制比赛、选举或裁决结果。

groups.name: Ring & Chime · 鸣响与回荡 (Ring, Chime, Toll)
groups.tip: 金属撞击般的清脆声响

items.def_en: to make a melodious, clear bell-like sound, especially signifying the hour

items.def_zh: （使）鸣响，（使）发出清脆声响；响铃，按铃，敲钟；包围，环绕
items.def_en:
1. to make a clear, resonant sound, or to cause a bell or other object to do this
2. to surround or encircle
to echo loudly and fill an area with continuous clear sound
to strike a large bell with slow, solemn, regular strokes, often for funerals
to ring out in a loud, joyous, continuous burst of bells

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes clear, metallic, reverberating tones produced by percussion or acoustic resonance. Distinctions focus on pitch, interval, cadence, and solemnity.
groups.summary_zh: 金属器物敲击或钟表运作引发的清脆鸣奏、定点报时与悠长回响。

groups.name: Ripen & Mellow · 成熟与醇化 (Flesh out, Mellow, Mature)
groups.tip: 植物或事物走向成熟

items.def_en: To treat, dry, or prepare wood, cast iron, or food by letting it cure naturally
To become milder, softer, or richer in flavor or temperament over time
To develop into a complete, balanced, and mature form
To reach full natural growth, development, or readiness
To become fully grown and ready to eat or harvest, or to cause crops or fruit to do so.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe natural progression toward full development, flavor enhancement, or readiness for harvesting and utilization.
groups.summary_zh: 指农作物或事物逐渐长成、成熟醇化达到顶峰状态的动词群。

groups.name: Rise & Ascend · 浮出与重现 (Surface, Emerge, Re-emerge)
groups.tip: 物体由低处向高处运动

items.def_en: To rise up to the top of a liquid, or become visible after being hidden
(+ from) To come out into view from an obscured, concealed, or submerged place
To rise quickly or buoyantly to the surface of water
To ascend to a higher level, surface, or stage of visibility

items.def_zh: 重新浮出水面，再次升起；重新露面，再次显现；重铺（路面等）
items.def_en: 1. To rise back up to the surface of water. 2. To reappear or become noticeable again after being hidden or absent. 3. To put a new surface on a road, floor, or other structure.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the motion of breaking through a liquid boundary or hidden background to become physically visible or publicly noticeable once again.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或现象由隐匿、水下或沉寂状态重新浮出、显露或升至表层。

groups.name: Roar & Bellow · 咆哮与怒吼 (Bellow, Snarl, Roar)
groups.tip: 怒气冲冲地发出低沉吼叫

items.def_en: To utter an order, retort, or command in a harsh, curt, snapping tone

items.def_zh: （动物）低吼，咆哮；怒气冲冲地嘟囔；（肚子）咕咕叫
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To make a low, deep, threatening sound in the throat, or say something angrily in this way. 2. (of a stomach) To make a rumbling sound.
To make a prolonged, deep, loud sound, or to shout out statements with uncontrolled anger
To shout or roar in a loud, deep, resonant voice, typically out of rage or acute pain
To show the teeth and make an angry, vicious, deep sound, or to say words in a vicious, snapping manner

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe aggressive, low-pitched, or animalistic vocalizations made to express fury, intimidate rivals, or convey hostility. Contrast low resonant throat rumbles with explosive loud cries.
groups.summary_zh: 发出低沉、凶猛或震耳的声响以宣泄愤怒或进行威吓。

groups.name: Roast & High-Heat Processing · 煅烧与热解 (Calcine, Roast, Pyrolyze)
groups.tip: 高温焙烧引发生化质变

items.def_en: To decompose organic or inorganic matter thermally at high temperatures without oxygen
To heat metalliferous ore strongly in the presence of air to oxidize or desulfurize it
To burn or blacken something on its surface through exposure to intense dry heat
To coalesce powdered material into a coherent solid mass by heating without liquifying
1. (chemistry / metallurgy) To heat a mineral or substance to a high temperature without melting in order to oxidize it or drive off volatile matter.

groups.summary_en: Pertaining to pyrometallurgy, geology, and material sciences, this frame encompasses heating solids and ores to high temperatures below melting point to induce oxidation, volatilization, or thermal decomposition.
groups.summary_zh: 在冶金或化工中高温焙烧矿石或固相物料，促使其氧化或热解。

groups.name: Rock & Cradle · 摇撼与前后摇晃 (Cradle, Lurch, Jolt, Pitch)
groups.tip: 左右前后往复摆动

items.def_en: To hold gently and securely in one's arms, typically rocking softly
1. To move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side, or cause something to do this. 2. To shock or distress someone greatly.
To dip and rise rhythmically bow-to-stern or front-to-back in rough water or air
To shake or dislodge violently with a sharp, sudden blow or jerk

items.def_zh: 突然颠簸前倾，猛烈晃动
items.def_en: To make an abrupt, uncontrolled, and jarring sway or forward heave

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate heavy, rhythmic front-to-back or side-to-side tilting—ranging from soothing rocking motions used to calm an infant to violent vessel pitching on turbulent seas.
groups.summary_zh: 指前后左右的有节奏摇动，既可指温和安抚摇晃，亦可指船车剧烈颠簸摇撼。

groups.name: Roil & Turmoil · 搅混水体与掀起动荡 (Roil, Churn, Turbidate)
groups.tip: 剧烈搅动使液体浑浊翻滚

items.def_en: Make a liquid dark or opaque with mud, or confuse an issue so it becomes hard to understand
Cause sediment at the bottom of liquid to swirl up, or deliberately incite conflict or emotion
Shake or stir a fluid vigorously, or make people troubled, anxious, or rebellious

items.def_zh: 搅乱，扰乱；搅浑，使（液体）翻滚浑浊
items.def_en: 1. To make a liquid cloudy or muddy by stirring up sediment. 2. To agitate, disturb, or throw someone or something into disorder.

items.def_zh: 剧烈翻腾；搅动（水流或内心情感）
items.def_en: Move or agitate a liquid or sea violently, or experience deep inner turbulence or nausea

groups.summary_en: This frame captures disturbing a settled fluid by stirring up sediment, making it opaque and swirling, and readily extends metaphorically to throwing markets, emotions, or social systems into violent agitation.
groups.summary_zh: 搅起沉淀使水体浑浊，比喻使局势、情绪或市场陷入混乱动荡。

groups.name: Roof & Ground Surface Layering · 铺设草皮与木瓦 (Sod, Shingle, Slate)
groups.tip: 铺设瓦片或草皮覆盖表面

items.def_en: to cover a roof or surface with ceramic or composite tiles
to cover a roof with slate tiles
to lay pieces of turf over an area of bare soil or lawn

items.def_zh: 用木瓦（或沥青瓦等）铺盖（屋顶或外墙）
items.def_en: (construction) To cover a roof or outer wall with overlapping wooden or asphalt shingles.
(chiefly North American) To cover bare ground with strips of grass and soil (sod).

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized exterior construction and landscape framing denote applying overlapping or interlocked protective outdoor surfacing materials—such as turf sods or roofing shingles—to ground or roof frameworks.
groups.summary_zh: 指在户外地面或屋面铺设草皮块、瓦片等专用表面防护层。

groups.name: Roster Demotion & Exclusion · 撤换上场与禁赛 (Bench, Sideline, Suspend)
groups.tip: 撤下替补席或处以停赛

items.def_zh: 撤下（场上队员），罚…坐替补席；使停赛
items.def_en: To withdraw a sports player from active play and keep them on the bench.

items.def_zh: 暂停参赛资格，停赛，停职
items.def_en: Officially bar someone from playing, working, or attending for a fixed period as a penalty

items.def_zh: 退出比赛，将…从参赛名单剔除
items.def_en: Withdraw a competitor or horse from an official event before it begins
Take an active player off the field and replace them with a substitute

items.def_zh: 靠边站，使无法参赛/参与
items.def_en: Remove someone from participating actively, especially due to injury, tactical choice, or politics

groups.summary_en: Relates to sports management and institutional contexts where an active participant or player is removed from play, sidelined, or disqualified temporarily from duties.
groups.summary_zh: 用于体育或机构场景，指将现役队员按在替补席、撤下首发或勒令停赛停职。

groups.name: Rotary Abrade & Mill · 旋转钻切与研磨 (Mill, Grind, Countersink)
groups.tip: 机械旋转钻孔或打磨去刺

items.def_en: To enlarge the top rim of a drilled hole so a screw or bolt head can lie flush
To make a deep, round hollow in a hard substance using a revolving tool
To shape or cut metal or stone using a high-speed rotating cutting tool

items.def_zh: 用钻头钻；用牙钻去腐；打磨去刺
items.def_en: 1. (dentistry / engineering) To drill, cut, or smooth metal, bone, or a tooth using a rotary bur tool.
To make something smooth, sharp, or contoured by rubbing it against an abrasive stone or wheel

groups.summary_en: A specialized tooling and machining frame describing the cutting, drilling, smoothing, or excavating of dense media (tooth enamel, bone, steel, wood) using fast-spinning abrasive heads or fluted rotary cutters.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用旋转刀头、磨具或金刚砂对坚硬材质进行钻孔磨光。

groups.name: Rotate & Pivot · 转动与枢转 (Swivel, Rotate, Revolve)
groups.tip: 以支点为核心转向旋转

items.def_en: To turn or cause to turn continuously around an internal axis or central line
To move in a curved or circular path centered around an external point

items.def_zh: 在枢轴上转动；以……为支点旋转；改变方向，调整策略
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/around) To turn or rotate on or as if on a central point or pivot. 2. (+ to) To change direction or adjust a strategy, business focus, or opinion.
To turn around quickly on a fixed socket, pin, or central point
To spin around abruptly and face the opposite direction in a sweeping arc

groups.summary_en: This frame covers turning around a fixed axis or fulcrum. While 'pivot' stresses an immediate shift in focus or direction anchored by a pin, related verbs denote circular rotational mechanics or swiveling swings.
groups.summary_zh: 指围绕定点、轴心或支点进行的旋转、转动与急变方向。

groups.name: Roughen & Texturize · 使变粗糙与磨损表面 (Roughen, Coarsen, Scuff)
groups.tip: 使质地或物理特征发生变化

items.def_en: Make or become harsh, thick, or coarse in texture or tone
Make sore, warm, or worn by continual rubbing against an abrasive surface
Scrape or wear away the outer texture of a surface by sustained mechanical friction
Mark or scrape the smooth surface of something by abrasive scraping or dragging
To make something rough or uneven, or to become rough.

groups.summary_en: These verbs detail modifying the tactile surface of an object or body part, stripping away smoothness to create coarse, uneven, or abrasive textures.
groups.summary_zh: 改变物体或皮肤表质，使其失去平滑而变得粗糙、不平整。

groups.name: Row & Paddle · 划桨与荡舟 (Paddle, Scull, Oar)
groups.tip: 手握双桨划水破浪

items.def_en: to exert physical force on an oar to propel a rowboat through water
1. to propel or steer a boat using oars, or convey someone in a boat by rowing 2. (British informal) to quarrel noisily with someone
to move a canoe or small boat through water using a handheld paddle with repeated short strokes
to drive or cause a boat to move forwards across the water by mechanical or manual force
to propel a racing boat using a pair of oars (sculls), or work a stern oar back and forth

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe manually propelling and steering a vessel through water by human muscle power using oars or paddles. They contrast synchronized multi-oar pulling against single double-bladed stroking.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用人力操纵划桨、双桨或单叶桨以推进水上舟艇。

groups.name: Rub & Burnish · 摩擦抛光与擦亮 (Burnish, Buff, Shine)
groups.tip: 用力摩擦使金属表面发亮

items.def_en: To rub metal or wood vigorously so as to bring out its natural luster or clean away tarnish
To clean and rub shoes, brass, or silverware with paste or cloth so they reflect light

items.def_zh: 擦亮；打磨光亮；提升（形象）
items.def_en: To rub something until it gleams brightly; also used figuratively to enhance an image or presentation
To polish a metal, leather, or painted surface using a soft cloth or a motorized wheel

items.def_zh: 擦亮，打磨；提升，改善（形象、声誉）
items.def_en: 1. To polish metal or another hard surface by rubbing it until it shines. 2. To enhance or improve your public image or reputation.

groups.summary_en: Encompasses actions where hard friction, cloths, or rotating wheels are applied to solid surfaces to create a mirror-like shine or sheen, often extended metaphorically to elevating public stature, pride, or reputation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过用力摩擦或抛光轮使表面生辉发亮，多引申为提升形象声誉。

groups.name: Rub Out & Remove · 擦除与消除 (Erase, Rub Out, Blot Out)
groups.tip: 抹去痕迹直至完全消失

items.def_en: To draw a line through written or printed words to indicate deletion
To remove pencil marks, chalk, or stains by rubbing with an eraser or cloth
To obscure from sight or completely suppress an unpleasant thought or memory

items.def_zh: 擦除，抹去（字迹、数据等）；消除，使忘却（记忆）
items.def_en: 1. to rub out or remove marks, text, or recorded data 2. to remove something completely from the mind or from existence
To wear away or eliminate a surface mark, inscription, or memory gradually

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the mechanical or deliberate removal of marks, texts, recorded signals, or impressions through physical friction or direct cancellation.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重通过物理摩擦、涂改或直接取消手段擦除字迹、痕迹或记忆。

groups.name: Ruffle & Dishevel · 拨乱与弄蓬松 (Ruffle, Tousle, Muss)
groups.tip: 揉搓拨弄平整表面使凌乱

items.def_zh: （常与 up 连用）弄乱；弄皱
items.def_en: (+ up) To make something, such as hair or clothes, untidy or wrinkled

items.def_zh: 弄乱，拨乱（头发、羽毛等）；使泛起波纹；使心烦意乱
items.def_en: 1. To disturb the smoothness of something, such as hair, feathers, or water. 2. To upset someone's calm or composure.
To make something untidy, disordered, or dirty

items.def_zh: 使蓬乱；使头发衣冠不整
items.def_en: To cause hair or clothes to hang loosely or look untidy
To make someone's hair untidy or messy, often playfully

groups.summary_en: This frame captures disrupting the smooth, orderly arrangement of hair, feathers, clothing, or composure through light, brushing, or careless manual disturbance.
groups.summary_zh: 拨弄、揉乱头发、衣着或平整表面，使之凌乱。

groups.name: Rule & Reign Imperiously · 称尊与擅权 (Reign, Domineer, Preside)
groups.tip: 行使最高政治统治与皇权

items.def_zh: 立为女王（或王后）；（国际象棋中）使（兵）升变为后；摆谱，显威风
items.def_en: 1. (chess) To promote a pawn to a queen, or become a queen. 2. (often queen it) To behave in an imperious or superior manner.
(+ over) To rule as a monarch, or to dominate a particular sphere or group
To be in a position of supreme authority or control over a situation or group
To exercise dominant power, rule, or influence over a realm or people
(+ over) To assert one's will arrogantly and tyrannically over other people

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve assuming regal status or behaving in an imperious, haughty manner by asserting absolute social superiority over others.
groups.summary_zh: 表现出高高在上的女王/君王作风，擅权专断或执掌大权。

groups.name: Rush & Bustle · 匆忙与急行 (Hurry, Flurry, Scurry)
groups.tip: 步伐匆匆或忙碌奔走状态

items.def_zh: 奔忙，匆忙走动；熙熙攘攘，充满活力
items.def_en: 1. (+ about/around) To move around in a hurried, busy, and energetic manner. 2. (+ with) To be full of bustling activity or people.
To move around in an agitated, confused, and bustling manner
To run with quick, hurried steps, typically seeking shelter or concealment

items.def_zh: 小步急促跑动；仓促奔忙
items.def_en: To move quickly with short, hurried steps, often out of anxiety or haste
To rush or dash about recklessly and frantically

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on energetic, agitated, or rapid movement, typically characterized by brisk steps, self-important busyness, or chaotic commotion.
groups.summary_zh: 表现因繁忙、急促或纷乱而迈着细碎脚步或慌忙动作的走动状态。

groups.name: Sabotage & Subvert · 暗中破坏与颠覆 (Undermine, Scupper, Torpedo)
groups.tip: 暗中潜伏破坏以颠覆政局

items.def_en: To gradually or insidiously weaken someone's power, authority, or credibility

items.raw_cluster: 暗中破坏与破坏 Sabotage & Subvert
items.def_zh: 暗中破坏，暗中颠覆；潜入水下
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To undermine, sabotage, or defeat something secretly and unexpectedly. 2. To move or submerge underwater like a submarine.
To deliberately ruin or destroy a project, policy, or negotiation unexpectedly
To secretly weaken and destroy the authority of a political system, institution, or established belief
To deliberately prevent something from succeeding or destroy a scheme completely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe covert, deceitful, or calculated actions aimed at wrecking plans, sinking operations, or destroying authority from within or under the surface.
groups.summary_zh: 指从内部或暗处策划破坏、掣肘或摧毁计划、行动及体制的隐秘颠覆行为。

groups.name: Sabotage & Undermine · 蓄意破坏与暗中颠覆 (Sabotage, Undermine, Subvert)
groups.tip: 暗中破坏设施瘫痪敌方行动
