items.def_zh: 彻底破坏；破坏（计划或关系）
items.def_en: To spoil or destroy a plan, relationship, or chance of success completely
To weaken or ruin someone or something gradually or insidiously, often by covert means

items.def_zh: 暗中破坏，蓄意毁坏；阻挠
items.def_en: to deliberately destroy or damage machinery, equipment, or systems; to spoil a plan or process secretly so that it cannot succeed

items.def_zh: 颠覆；暗中破坏（体制、权威）
items.def_en: To undermine the power and authority of an established system, institution, or belief

items.def_zh: 阻挠；故意挫败（计划或机会）
items.def_en: To deliberately prevent something such as a plan or opportunity from succeeding

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe covert, intentional actions taken to disrupt, damage, or weaken an adversary's equipment, operations, or plans from within.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过隐蔽或间接手段蓄意阻挠、破坏设备或削弱计划。

groups.name: Sacrifice & Self-Immolate · 献祭与自焚 (Sacrifice, Burn, Consecrate)
groups.tip: 以火焚烧杀戮作为献祭

items.def_en: Slaughter an animal or person, or surrender a valued possession, as an offering to a deity
Deliberately destroy someone or something by throwing or leaving them in fire
Destroy or be destroyed completely by fire
Kill someone because of their religious beliefs or devotion to a cause

items.def_zh: 宰杀作祭品，杀戮以献祭；以火焚死
items.def_en: (formal) To kill or offer someone or oneself as a sacrifice, especially by burning.

groups.summary_en: Verbs involving solemn, destructive ritual offerings or fatal acts of self-sacrifice, predominantly characterized by consuming by fire or dedicating something valuable to a deity or ideal.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过火焚、祭祀等极端方式杀戮或自我牺牲以示信仰或抗议。

groups.name: Sag & Slump · 下垂与沉陷 (Slump, Settle, Cave in)
groups.tip: 因重力作用松弛下垂

items.def_en: To descend slowly to a lower level, especially through soft ground or under weight
To sink, bend, or hang down in the middle under weight, pressure, or fatigue; to decrease or weaken.
To sink or fall heavily into a lower, shapeless position
To collapse inward or sink downward under external pressure
To break or collapse downward under strain or pressure

groups.summary_en: Captures the downward yielding or settling of structures and flexible bodies under gravity, continuous weight, or structural fatigue. It stresses hollow bending and loss of horizontal tension rather than total collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 描述物体受重力或负荷影响在中部弯曲、松弛下陷。

groups.name: Sail & Navigate · 航海与驾驭 (Sail, Cruise, Navigate)
groups.tip: 驾驶船舶在水面上航行

items.def_en: to travel over water in a ship or boat propelled by sails or engine, or to direct its course
to sail along leisurely around an area of water for recreation or pleasure rather than speed
to take a long, adventurous journey across the sea or ocean
to sail, race, or cruise in a yacht for sport or recreation
to plan, direct, and steer the course of a ship through stretches of water

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses navigating, piloting, or embarking on open waters via sophisticated marine vessels for transport, pleasure cruising, or competitive sport.
groups.summary_zh: 指驾驶游艇、帆船等船只在水面或公海航行、巡游。

groups.name: Salivate & Drool Excessively · 垂涎与流涎 (Drool, Drivel, Salivate)
groups.tip: 口水流淌分泌黏稠体液

items.def_en: To produce saliva naturally or copiously, especially in anticipation of food or a coveted prize
To let saliva dribble unconsciously from the lips, as an infant or dotard does
(often + over) To allow saliva to run out of the mouth; to exhibit unrestrained desire or lust
1. (+ over) To let saliva run from the mouth; to show excessive desire or admiration toward someone in a servile way.
To let saliva or liquid run wetly and untidily from the mouth

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the physiological oozing of excess saliva from the lips, as well as figurative displays of uninhibited craving or doting desire.
groups.summary_zh: 口腔分泌过量唾液并外溢，亦引申指贪婪或垂涎欲滴。

groups.name: Salute & Pay Homage · 致敬与庄重问候 (Hail, Honor, Acknowledge)
groups.tip: 以礼貌言行打招呼或致敬意

items.def_en: To show that one has seen, noticed, or recognized someone with a polite gesture or nod

items.def_zh: 敬礼，向……行军礼；向……致敬，赞颂；打招呼，问候
items.def_en: 1. To raise the right hand to the head as a formal sign of military respect. 2. (formal) To express admiration and public respect for someone or an achievement. 3. To greet someone politely.
To express formal praise, respect, and gratitude publicly toward someone
To show deep respect, admiration, or public deference toward someone for their character or deeds
To greet or acclaim someone or something enthusiastically with loud praise and admiration

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote formal, deferential, or solemn gestures of respect and recognition toward rank, achievement, or authority. They contrast military physical protocol with public verbal tributes.
groups.summary_zh: 向权威、军职或卓越成就表达敬意与庄重问候。

groups.name: Salvage & Rescue · 打捞与挽救 (Retrieve, Recover, Reclaim)
groups.tip: 从废墟灾难中挽回物资

items.def_en: To regain possession of something lost or stolen, or recover submerged wreckage
To pull or extract something out of water or deep enclosed space
To find and bring something back from a particular place, especially after losing it
To make abandoned, waste, or damaged materials usable again

items.def_zh: 打捞，抢救，挽救（受损财物）
items.def_en: To save goods, a ship, or materials from being lost or destroyed in a disaster, shipwreck, or fire.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on finding, extracting, and recovering endangered, sunken, or abandoned possessions, vehicles, or materials from disaster sites or wreckage.
groups.summary_zh: 指从水下、废墟或灾难残骸中挽救、打捞或回收财物与材料。

groups.name: Sanctify & Glorify · 崇奉与封圣 (Canonize, Venerate, Deify)
groups.tip: 宗教式册封与极度尊崇

items.def_en: to regard someone with deep respect, religious reverence, or profound awe
to praise, glorify, or elevate someone to a remarkably high rank, moral dignity, or divine status

items.def_zh: 封为圣徒；将……奉为经典/圣典
items.def_en: to officially declare a deceased person to be a saint, or to treat someone or something as authoritative and sacred

items.def_zh: （天主教）为……行宣福礼，宣布……为真福；使极其幸福，赐福
items.def_en: 1. (in the Catholic Church) to officially declare a deceased person to be blessed, as a step toward sainthood. 2. (formal) to make someone blissfully happy.
to make a god of someone, or to revere or worship a person as divine or supreme

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses religious or ideological acts of elevating human beings to holy, divine, or supreme moral status through formal declaration or deep reverence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过宗教仪式或至高崇奉，将某人封圣、神化或奉为至善典范。

groups.name: Sate & Surfeit · 餍足与使厌腻 (Satiate, Sate, Glut)
groups.tip: 食欲充分满足甚至发腻

items.def_en: To eat greedily until uncomfortably stuffed and swollen with food
To supply or feed something with vastly more than is desired or needed

items.def_zh: 使充分满足，使饱足；使厌腻
items.def_en: To satisfy a hunger, desire, or appetite fully or to excess so that one wants no more.
To satisfy a desire or appetite fully or to excess
To feed, supply, or indulge someone to disgustingly sickening excess

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes feeding an appetite, lust, or curiosity to total fullness or beyond—often resulting in cloying surfeit and lethargy.
groups.summary_zh: 指食欲、欲望被彻底满足甚至过量填充，致使生厌、腻烦的状态。

groups.name: Savor & Relish · 品味与赏析 (Relish, Appreciate, Luxuriate)
groups.tip: 细细咂摸体会美妙滋味

items.def_en: To recognize the full worth, subtle qualities, and refined value of food, art, or moments
To take great and self-indulgent pleasure in a sensation of sumptuous comfort or sensory delight
To derive acute joy, keen amusement, or satisfaction from an action or sensory sensation
To gain immense enjoyment or satisfaction from an experience, taste, or prospect

items.def_zh: 细品，体味，慢慢享受；带有……味道或意味
items.def_en: 1. (British English spelling of savor) To enjoy food, an experience, or a moment slowly and thoroughly. 2. (+ of) To show or suggest a particular quality or flavor.

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes deep psychological enjoyment and lingering appraisal of exquisite sensations, flavors, or experiences, deliberately prolonging contact to extract maximal pleasure.
groups.summary_zh: 从容咀嚼并全身心沉浸于美味、美好时光或感官体验的乐趣中。

groups.name: Scan & Render · 成像与投影 (Render, Scan, Visualize)
groups.tip: 在脑海或屏幕上呈现图像

items.def_zh: 显像，给……拍成像；在脑海中描绘，想象
items.def_en: 1. To make an image or scan of something, especially by means of a medical scanner or camera. 2. To form a mental picture of something.
To capture and record the likeness of someone or something on film or digital media
To pass a beam of light, radiation, or ultrasound over something to capture an image or data
To generate a two- or three-dimensional digital image from a model by means of software
To convert abstract data, signals, or internal structures into an interpretable visual display

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe generating, capturing, or displaying visual representations through technical instruments, digital graphics, or imaging hardware.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助仪器或数字化技术捕捉并生成图像的动词群。

groups.name: Scientific & Analytical Projection · 数据预测与趋势预报 (Forecast, Predict, Project)
groups.tip: 依据模型与趋势推断前瞻

items.def_en: To estimate or extrapolate a future situation or quantity based on current trends
To state what will happen in the future on the basis of existing evidence or reasoning
to say what is likely to happen in the future, based on available information, models, or trends
To prophesy or forecast future outcomes from present symptoms and analytical signs
(+ to/from) To extend or project known data into an unknown area to deduce likely trends

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify extrapolating future occurrences, trends, or conditions using calculated models, analytical patterns, evidence, or professional expertise (such as weather, economic output, or demographics).
groups.summary_zh: 依托客观数据、科学模型、专业研判对未来趋势、气象或产出作出的理性预测。

groups.name: Scoop & Gather · 舀取与拢抱 (Scoop up, Gather, Shovel)
groups.tip: 用长柄大勺捞取盛装

items.def_en: to bring together scattered things or draw them into one's arms or lap
to quickly lift or gather someone or something up with a sweeping motion of arms or hands

items.def_zh: （用勺等）舀，盛；快速捞起；抢先报道
items.def_en: 1. (+ out/up) to pick up, lift, or gather something using a scoop, spoon, or cupped hands 2. to publish a news story before competing journalists or news outlets
to lift, move, or clear away large quantities of earth, snow, or loose material using a shovel
to forcefully hollow out, scoop, or cut away material or flesh using a curved or pointed tool

groups.summary_en: This frame covers lifting, extracting, or gathering pliable, loose, or granular substances using a concave tool or cupped bodily limbs. It highlights sweeping concave motions directed outward or lifting upward in bulk.
groups.summary_zh: 指用凹面工具或双手兜起、拢聚并舀出松散物或物品。

groups.name: Scout & Reconnoiter · 侦察地形与踩点踏勘 (Scout, Case, Reconnoiter)
groups.tip: 暗中踩点调查周围环境

items.def_zh: （作案前）踩点，侦察探查；把……装入箱中
items.def_en: 1. (informal) to inspect or scout a place carefully, especially with the intention of robbing it. 2. to enclose or surround something in a case or container.
to explore an area secretly or ahead of others to gather information about conditions or risks
to keep a continuous, secretive watch on a building or place for suspicious activity
to examine or look at something closely in order to evaluate its potential or situation

items.def_zh: 侦察，踏勘（军事或专业行动）
items.def_en: to make a military or strategic observation of an area to locate an enemy or evaluate terrain

groups.summary_en: This frame involves covert, exploratory, or tactical surveillance of a target location or premise to gather intelligence prior to a military strike, crime, or expedition.
groups.summary_zh: 强调行动前对目标现场进行探查、踩点或战术侦察。

groups.name: Scrabble & Grope Frantically · 仓促摸索与抓挠翻寻 (Scrabble, Fumble, Grope)
groups.tip: 手脚慌乱盲目抓挠摸索

items.def_en: Move hands or fingers clumsily while trying to find, hold, or manipulate an object
Feel about blindly or hesitantly with the hands in search of something in the dark

items.def_zh: 盲目摸索，乱抓，扒寻；急忙攀爬
items.def_en: To scratch, claw, or grope frantically with the hands or paws to find or hold onto something.
Scratch or dig violently with fingernails or paws in an effort to get hold of something
Move, crawl, or struggle hurriedly and clumsily on hands and knees to reach or seize something

groups.summary_en: This physical action frame depicts frantic, clumsy, or desperate tactile searching, scratching, or pawing around blindly to locate an object or gain a physical handhold.
groups.summary_zh: 因慌乱或看不清而用双手盲目、抓挠式地摸索、搜寻抓握之物。

groups.name: Scramble & Clamber · 艰难攀爬与手足并用攀登 (Scramble, Clamber, Claw)
groups.tip: 手脚并用费力向上攀爬

items.def_en: Climb to the top of a steep and tall surface like a cliff or a high wall

items.def_zh: （手脚并用费力地）攀登，攀爬；争抢，抢占；仓促行动
items.def_en: 1. To climb or move quickly and with difficulty over rough ground using one's hands and feet. 2. (+ for) To compete hurriedly or aggressively with others for something.

items.def_zh: 攀附着向上爬（如抱树或抱杆）
items.def_en: Climb up or down quickly using both hands, arms, and legs to grip a pole or tree
Climb or crawl awkwardly and with difficulty, typically using both hands and feet
Make one's way uphill or up an incline with great exertion by grasping at every handhold

groups.summary_en: Verbs here depict rough, awkward, or frantic climbing over steep, uneven terrain using both hands and feet, characterized by physical exertion and precarious balance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在陡峭坎坷地势上用手抠脚蹬、手足并用且略显费力的攀登。

groups.name: Scramble & Randomize · 打乱与混淆 (Jumble, Scramble, Shuffle)
groups.tip: 颠倒原有次序，使其毫无规律

items.def_en: To put things into the wrong order or confuse one thing with another
To change the order of a set of items such as cards or files randomly
To alter the order or structure of something so it is mixed up or unintelligible

items.raw_cluster: 打乱与随机化 Scramble & Randomize
items.def_en: To arrange, choose, or organize items, numbers, or experimental subjects in an unpredictable and completely random order.
To mix things together in a confused or disordered way

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote disrupting an ordered state or systematic arrangement by mixing, shuffling, or encrypting items into a chaotic, arbitrary, or unpredictable sequence.
groups.summary_zh: 指打乱原有次序或组织，使其变得杂乱、随机或不可预测。

groups.name: Scream & Shriek · 尖叫与高声嘶吼 (Shriek, Screech, Yowl)
groups.tip: 从高声大喊到刺耳尖叫破音

items.def_zh: 发出粗厉尖叫；高声抱怨
items.def_en: To make a loud, harsh, discordant screech like an alarmed bird

items.def_zh: 尖叫，高声惊呼；发出尖厉呼啸声
items.def_en: 1. To give a loud, high-pitched cry or shout, especially because of fear, pain, or excitement. 2. To make a harsh, piercingly loud sound.
To utter words or a cry in a sudden, piercingly loud scream

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳尖啸声；尖声喊叫
items.def_en: To make a harsh, high-pitched strident cry or sound
To utter a high-pitched, piercing cry indicative of terror or acute pain

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve releasing piercing, high-frequency, extremely loud vocalizations driven by terror, acute pain, hysteria, or intense exhilaration.
groups.summary_zh: 指因极度恐惧、剧烈疼痛或亢奋而发出极高分贝、尖锐刺耳的喊叫。

groups.name: Scrimp & Stint · 节约与克扣 (Scrimp, Skimp, Pinch)
groups.tip: 极度节省甚至克扣用度

items.def_en: to be excessively careful about spending small amounts of money
to manage to spend less money and endure economic hardship
(+ on) to be frugal or sparing with something, especially by withholding or limiting the amount given or used

items.def_zh: 克扣，敷衍，省掉不该省的
items.def_en: (+ on) to spend too little money, time, or care on something, producing an inadequate result
(+ on) to spend very little money on the necessities of life in order to save

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing or spending as little money, food, or resources as possible, often borderlining on deprivation, miserliness, or excessive frugality. They often take prepositions like 'on'.
groups.summary_zh: 强调过度省吃俭用、极力缩减开支或克扣资源的节约与吝啬行为。

groups.name: Scrub & Scour · 用力刷洗与擦刮 (Scrub, Scour, Rub)
groups.tip: 用力擦洗刷除顽固污渍

items.def_en: To clean, smooth, or dry a surface thoroughly by rubbing it firmly with a cloth or abrasive.
To remove dirt, paint, or residue from a surface by dragging an edge or hard tool firmly across it.

items.def_zh: 用力擦洗，刷洗；取消（计划等）
items.def_en: 1. To clean a surface thoroughly by rubbing hard with a brush, soap, and water. 2. (informal) To cancel or abandon a planned event or idea.
To scrape away or wear down a surface layer by friction, sanding, or mechanical action.

items.def_zh: 用力擦洗；刮洗（锅、地板等）
items.def_en: To clean or brighten a hard surface thoroughly by rubbing it vigorously with an abrasive agent or rough pad.

groups.summary_en: This frame represents forceful, abrasive cleaning by vigorously applying pressure and friction with an implement, wire pad, or bristled brush to remove stubborn grime, grease, or dirt.
groups.summary_zh: 使用刷子或研磨物施加重压与摩擦，以清除顽固污渍或硬壳。

groups.name: Sculpt & Carve · 雕刻与塑形 (Carve, Chisel, Mold)
groups.tip: 刀刻泥塑塑造立体形象

items.def_en: to shape a soft, malleable substance or pour liquid into a frame to set
to carve an object by repeatedly slicing thin shavings off a piece of wood
to shape a solid material such as wood or stone by cutting parts away

items.def_zh: 雕刻，塑造；使具有特定外形
items.def_en: 1. to create a three-dimensional figure or object by carving or shaping material. 2. to shape or form something carefully to give it a particular contour
to cut or shape stone, wood, or metal with a sharp-edged tool called a chisel

groups.summary_en: Verbs of physical creation and form modification involving cutting, chiseling, molding, or modeling materials into distinct three-dimensional artistic forms.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过雕、凿、塑等手法赋予材料三维艺术形态或外形轮廓。

groups.name: Seal & Close Hermetically · 密封与封闭 (Caulk, Fasten, Waterproof)
groups.tip: 严密关紧以防气体液体漏出

items.def_zh: 封上，密封；盖印确认；确定
items.def_en: 1. To close an entrance or container securely to prevent entry or escape of gas, liquid, or people. 2. To make an agreement or decision official, final, or certain.
To prevent people from entering or leaving an area or building by placing barriers across all access points
To make an enclosure completely airtight and impervious to external gases or fluids
To fill the crevices between tiles or masonry stones with a thin, hardening mortar
To fill the seams, joints, or cracks in a structure with a waterproof sealant

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe securing containers, seams, or openings tightly so as to render them completely impermeable to air, moisture, contaminants, or intrusion.
groups.summary_zh: 通过涂胶、嵌缝等物理手段使容器或开口严密不漏气、不渗水。

groups.name: Search & Frisk · 搜查与搜身 (Pat down, Shake down, Rummage)
groups.tip: 执法人员对身体物品搜查

items.def_en: To search someone for weapons or illegal goods by running one's hands over the outside of their clothing
To carry out an intensive, disruptive search of someone or their quarters for concealed items
To search someone for concealed items after requiring them to take off all their clothes
1. To pass hands quickly over someone's body and clothes to search for concealed weapons or illegal items. 2. To leap or skip playfully.
To search thoroughly and messily through a person's pockets, bags, or belongings

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical searches of a person's body, clothing, or personal premises to detect concealed weapons, contraband, or hidden evidence. Nuances span lawful police procedures to aggressive street-level inspections.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及对人体、衣物或私密处所进行摸查翻找以查获违禁品或证物。

groups.name: Search & Navigate Electronically · 电子查图与定位导航 (Map, Navigate, Look Up)
groups.tip: 搜寻路径方位并锁定具体坐标

items.def_zh: 用谷歌搜索（地点或信息）
items.def_en: Search for information, locations, or directions about someone or something on the internet using a search engine

items.def_zh: 在网络地图上查询路线，网上定位导航
items.def_en: (informal) To search for driving directions, maps, or locations using an online mapping service.

items.def_zh: 在地图上标出（路径或点位）
items.def_en: Mark positions, coordinates, or an intended course carefully on a digital or paper map
Direct or follow a course toward a destination using electronic maps, GPS, or nautical compasses

items.def_zh: 精准定位；确认精确位置
items.def_en: Find or identify the exact location, place, or time of something with complete precision

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this modern pragmatic frame refer to searching, locating coordinates, and charting routes or geographical destinations using digital tools, internet search systems, or navigational services.
groups.summary_zh: 使用电子地图、数字终端或搜索引擎查询路线、地点及地理坐标。

groups.name: Season & Flavor · 调味与赋香 (Season, Flavor, Spice)
groups.tip: 烹饪中增添风味或熟成

items.def_zh: 给……调味，加调料于；风干，晒干（木材）；使成熟，使历练
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To add salt, herbs, or spices to food to enhance its flavor. 2. To dry wood or timber to condition it for use. 3. To render someone experienced through long practice.
To season food by adding salt to heighten flavor or to preserve it
(+ with) To give a particular taste to food or drink by adding an ingredient or flavoring agent

items.def_zh: 加调料增添风味；使更振奋
items.def_en: To make food tastier or more pungent by adding zesty seasonings, or to add vigor to something
(+ with / + up) To season food with aromatic spices to give it piquancy and warmth

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with culinary manipulation through salt, herbs, spices, or condiments to elevate base flavors, balance taste profiles, and produce nuanced culinary depth.
groups.summary_zh: 指在烹饪中加入食盐、香草或香料，以去腥提鲜、赋予风味层次。

groups.name: Secede & Splinter · 脱离与分裂 (Break away, Splinter, Secede)
groups.tip: 地方脱离联邦导致阵营分裂

items.def_en: To separate a subsidiary part or business department from a larger corporate entity
(+ from) To separate from an established group, state, or organization to form an independent unit
To separate from a larger mass, organization, or body to form a distinct entity
To divide or cause an organization to split into smaller, conflicting factions

items.def_zh: 正式脱离，退出（联邦、组织等）
items.def_en: (+ from) to formally break away from a country, federation, or political organization in order to become independent

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the formal, ideological, or organizational severance where a faction, region, or subsidiary separates from a parent entity to become autonomous or fragmented.
groups.summary_zh: 指派系、地区或团体自母体正式分离、独立或分裂解体。

groups.name: Seclude & Cloister · 隐遁与深居 (Seclude, Retire, Shut away)
groups.tip: 遁入深闺空门或与世俗隔绝

items.def_en: (+ to) to withdraw to a quiet, private place away from company
to confine someone or keep oneself isolated from contact with other people
to hide or stay in a safe, secluded place for an extended period
to keep someone or oneself away from other people in a private, quiet place

items.def_zh: 使与尘世隔绝，使幽居，使遁入修道院
items.def_en: (often passive) to shut someone away in a quiet, secluded place away from the outside world

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on withdrawing oneself or confining someone to a remote, solitary, or monastic environment away from worldly bustle and public scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动隐遁或幽闭于偏远、幽静之处，远离尘世纷扰。

groups.name: Sedate & Tranquilize · 镇静与麻醉 (Sedate, Anesthetize, Dope)
groups.tip: 用药使人镇静安定麻木

items.def_zh: 用药物使昏睡；麻醉过去
items.def_en: To cause a patient or animal to lose consciousness or fall into a deep drug-induced sleep
(often 'dope up') To give drugs to a person or animal to calm them, render them unconscious, or alter performance
To calm someone down or make them sleepy by administering a medical sedative
To administer an anesthetic to render a patient temporarily unable to feel pain or consciousness

items.def_zh: 使镇定，使镇静（尤指通过药物）
items.def_en: 1. To make a person or animal calm, sleepy, or unconscious by administering a sedative drug.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to administering pharmacological agents to calm agitation, induce sleep, relieve pain, or render a patient or animal insensible. Nuances range from mild anxiolysis to total chemical immobilization.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过药物使人或动物镇定、入睡或失去知觉与行动力。

groups.name: Seem & Appear · 表象与显得 (Appear, Look, Strike)
groups.tip: 感官接收到的外部表象

items.def_en: to give a specific visual impression or indicate a certain state by appearance
to give the impression of being or having a particular quality; to appear
to convey a particular impression when heard or described
to give the impression of being or doing something, based on visible evidence
to produce a particular mental impression or opinion upon someone

groups.summary_en: This frame captures verbs describing the impression an entity makes on an observer's senses or mind, conveying subjective appearances that may or may not reflect reality.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或人在感官与心智中呈现的表象、印象或似乎具备的性质。

groups.name: Seize & Confiscate · 查扣与罚没 (Impound, Confiscate, Commandeer)
groups.tip: 执法部门依法查封并没收财产

items.def_en: To take possession of illicit or contested property by legal authority or sudden force
To seize goods or chattels from a debtor in order to compel payment or satisfy a debt
To officially seize property without compensation as a penalty or legal measure

items.def_zh: 扣押，查封，没收（财产、车辆等）；圈禁（牲畜）
items.def_en: 1. (of police or the law) To seize and hold property or a vehicle officially. 2. To shut up stray animals in an enclosed pound.
To take possession of private property or transport officially for urgent or military use

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the lawful or authoritative taking of property, vehicles, or goods by police, courts, customs, or military agents. It highlights formal custody, forfeiture, or compulsory appropriation.
groups.summary_zh: 执法机关或当权机构依法、依规强制扣押、没收或征用财物。

groups.name: Sell & Distribute · 批发与分销 (Wholesale, Retail, Distribute)
groups.tip: 大宗批发走量分销

items.def_en: To buy and sell goods in small batches or lots as a middleman or wholesale broker
To sell goods directly to the public in small quantities
To supply goods to stores, businesses, or agents for subsequent sale
To promote, market, or sell goods through display and advertising strategies
To sell goods in large quantities to retailers or businesses rather than directly to individual consumers.

groups.summary_en: Commercial verbs covering intermediary supply channels, from bulk trading down to merchant supply networks.
groups.summary_zh: 描述商业供应链中的大宗买卖、批量转售与渠道分销行为。

groups.name: Sense & Perceive · 感官察觉 (Sense, Detect, Perceive)
groups.tip: 依靠身体感官觉察事物

items.def_en: To become aware of something by using physical senses or intuition; to perceive.
To discover or notice the presence of something subtle, hidden, or faint
To become directly aware of something through any of the senses or conscious observation
To notice or intuit a subtle hint, change, or emotional cue that others might miss
To perceive, recognize, or distinguish something clearly despite ambiguity or faintness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote registering subtle physical stimuli, external presences, or intangible shifts through intuitive awareness or sensory faculties.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助感官或直觉隐约捕获、察觉外界迹象、微小变化或存在。

groups.name: Sensitize & Heighten · 敏化与提升觉知 (Sensitize, Attune, Alert)
groups.tip: 感官敏锐地体会并捕捉

items.def_en: (+ to) To make someone keenly aware of a potential danger, opportunity, or developing situation
(+ to) To arouse an interest, sensation, or conscious realization that previously lay dormant
To make an emotion, perception, or sensory awareness sharper and more intense
(+ to) To adjust or make someone receptive, aware, and responsive to subtle cues or environments
1. (+ to) To make someone aware of and sensitive to a problem, situation, or feeling. 2. To make a body, substance, or material chemically or biologically sensitive.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe calibrating, conditioning, or raising an organism's or person's responsiveness to specific stimuli, concerns, or subtleties.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过引导、磨砺或生理激发，使人或感官对特定外界刺激与细节更具敏感度。

groups.name: Sensory Overwhelm & Splendor · 耀目与眩惑 (Dazzle, Blind, Overwhelm)
groups.tip: 耀眼强光令人迷乱晃眼

items.def_zh: 压倒；在感官或情感上征服
items.def_en: To have such a strong emotional, sensory, or visual effect on someone that they are rendered helpless
To temporarily overpower vision with intense light, or to greatly impress with brilliance or skill
To hold the complete attention of someone as if spellbound or hypnotized by beauty or brilliance

items.raw_cluster: 使目眩与迷惑 Dazzle & Bedazzle
items.def_zh: 使目眩，使眩目；使陶醉，使迷乱
items.def_en: To greatly impress, confuse, or overpower someone with brilliance, bright light, or splendor.
To cause someone to be unable to see, either temporarily through strong light or permanently

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote overpowering sensory faculties—particularly vision or comprehension—with intense radiance, brilliance, or staggering display.
groups.summary_zh: 以强烈光芒或惊艳表现压倒视觉感官，使人目眩神迷或暂时失神。

groups.name: Sentence & Punish · 判刑与量刑处罚 (Sentence, Condemn, Penalize)
groups.tip: 法官居中裁判并宣判刑罚

items.def_en: to state officially in a court of law what someone's punishment will be
To officially declare someone to be guilty and specify a severe punishment like death or hard labor
To order someone by judicial authority to pay a sum of money as a legal punishment
To announce or deliver an official judgment, sentence, or verdict in court
To impose a penalty, forfeiture, or handicap on someone for breaking a rule or law

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the judicial imposition of formal punishment on a convicted offender. It shifts focus from evaluating guilt to decreeing penal consequences such as imprisonment or fines.
groups.summary_zh: 指司法机关对已定罪者依法下达监禁、罚款等具体刑罚判决。

groups.name: Serve & Work · 任职与服务 (Officiate, Serve, Preside)
groups.tip: 履行职务与日常行政工作

items.def_en: To perform official duties in a designated post, term of office, or organization

items.def_zh: 当文书，当办事员；当店员，做售货员
items.def_en: (chiefly US) To work as an office clerk, court clerk, or store assistant.
To occupy the seat of authority and oversee proceedings at a meeting, trial, or official assembly
(informal) To hold a secondary job, often secretly, in addition to regular primary employment
To perform the official duties of a referee, judge, priest, or presiding administrator

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this vocational and civic frame describe performing professional or institutional duties, carrying out administrative functions, or holding an active seat in public office or courts of law.
groups.summary_zh: 指在政府、法庭或机构中履职、主持事务或从事工作。

groups.name: Service & Overhaul · 维护与检修 (Maintain, Overhaul, Tune up)
groups.tip: 对器械设备进行日常维护

items.def_zh: 维护，保养，检修（机器、车辆等）；偿付（债务利息）
items.def_en: 1. To check and repair a vehicle, machine, or appliance regularly. 2. (finance) To pay the interest on a debt.
To keep an engine, building, or piece of equipment in good repair by regular care and checkups
To adjust and clean an engine or piece of machinery to ensure optimal running condition
To thoroughly examine a machine, engine, or system and make all necessary repairs or improvements
To repair and clean a vehicle or piece of machinery so that it is in good working order again

groups.summary_en: This frame covers routine, preventative, or deep mechanical and technical inspections, repairs, and adjustments to keep machines, vehicles, and systems in working order.
groups.summary_zh: 定期或针对性地对机械、车辆进行检修、调校与维护保养。

groups.name: Setting Out & Directing Motion · 启程前往与朝向行进 (Bound, Make for, Set off)
groups.tip: 朝特定方向行进

items.def_zh: 朝特定方向行进，前往；率领，主管
items.def_en: 1. To move or travel in a particular direction. 2. To lead, be in charge of, or be at the top of something.
Continue in an orderly fashion or travel in a specified direction
Move quickly with large leaping strides toward a place
Move directly and intentionally towards a place
Begin a journey or start moving toward a destination

groups.summary_en: This frame describes orienting oneself and moving deliberately toward a specific destination. Head emphasizes general chosen trajectory, make for highlights purposeful advancing, and set off focuses on departure.
groups.summary_zh: 朝着特定目的地行进、动身启程或向某处奔去。

groups.name: Settle & Finalize Disputes · 终结纠纷与平息争端 (Settle, Resolve, Patch up)
groups.tip: 化解分歧恢复平稳

items.def_zh: 解决，平息；定居，安顿；降落，沉降；付清
items.def_en: 1. To end an argument, dispute, or problem by reaching an agreement. 2. To go to live permanently in a place. 3. To become calm or comfortable. 4. To pay an amount of money owed.
To find an acceptable or conclusive solution to a contentious problem, crisis, or conflict.
To repair a damaged relationship or quickly heal a rift between arguing parties.
To eliminate smaller problems, misunderstandings, or sticking points through patient discussion.
To deal with and finish arranging a disputed, messy, or unfinished matter completely.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing a conflict, disagreement, or unpaid obligation to a peaceful, mutually agreed, and definitive conclusion, eliminating the source of contention.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过谈判、协议或妥协彻底化解矛盾，恢复安定状态。

groups.name: Sever & Divest · 割裂与脱钩 (Divorce, Sever, Disentangle)
groups.tip: 解除关系割裂脱离

items.def_en: 1. To separate or sever two things completely from each other. 2. To legally end a marriage with someone.
To separate products, services, or investments that were formerly offered together as a single package
To break off or end a relationship, agreement, or connection completely
To rid oneself of a subsidiary, asset, or business holding; strip of rights or property
To free someone or something from a complicated, confused, or restricting situation

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this conceptual frame emphasize total and deliberate severance between two deeply entwined ideas, institutions, or operations, declaring that one must not be confounded with or reliant upon the other.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在观念、体制或运营上使原本紧密纠缠的两事物彻底割裂分离。

groups.name: Severe Muscle Spasm · 剧烈痉挛与绞痛 (Cramp, Seize up, Convulse)
groups.tip: 肌肉突发剧烈收缩痉挛

items.def_en: To become tightly constricted or tense, forming a hard, painful lump in a muscle
1. To contract or cause a muscle to contract painfully and involuntarily. 2. To restrict or inhibit the development, freedom, or movement of someone or something.

items.def_zh: 僵住；突发痉挛无法活动
items.def_en: To suddenly become rigid, stiff, or unable to move due to muscle contraction or pain
To become rigidly fixed in a single position through spasm or joint strain
To suffer violent, uncontrollable, and rhythmic contractions of the entire body or a limb

groups.summary_en: This frame covers intense, painful, and immobilizing muscle contractions. The focus is on the severity of tightening and the temporary loss of normal muscular function.
groups.summary_zh: 强调肌肉剧烈收缩、僵死绞痛以及伴随而来的肢体僵硬与抽搐。

groups.name: Sew & Blindfold · 缝合与蒙目 (Stitch shut, Blindfold, Hood)
groups.tip: 用针线穿引缝合闭口

items.def_zh: 给（鹰等）戴头罩；罩住头部
items.def_en: To cover the head of a hawk or falcon with a specialized leather hood to calm it
To close off or obscure eyes or apertures firmly against light or inspection
To cover someone's or an animal's eyes with a piece of cloth so they cannot see

items.def_zh: （缝住猎鹰眼睑以驯化）缝眼；合上，蒙骗
items.def_en: 1. (falconry / archaic) To temporarily sew shut the eyelids of a newly caught hawk to tame it.
To close an opening or eyelids completely by fastening with needle and thread

groups.summary_en: This specialized historical/falconry frame describes forcibly closing an animal's eyelids, eyes, or orifices by sewing or shrouding to block out vision, suppress wild instincts, and induce docility.
groups.summary_zh: 多用于驯鹰或特殊处置，指缝合眼睑或遮蔽视觉以驯服野性、消除外界刺激。

groups.name: Sex & Sexualize · 唤起性欲与性化 (Arouse, Turn On, Eroticize)
groups.tip: 激发感官与生理冲动

items.def_en: To stimulate or excite someone sexually or sensually, often in a superficial or teasing way
To cause someone to feel sexually excited or intensely attracted

items.def_zh: 引起……的性冲动，激起……的性欲；确定……的性别
items.def_en: 1. To arouse or stimulate sexually. 2. To determine the biological sex of an animal.
To stimulate sexual desire or excite strong physical passion in someone
To make something sexual in character or quality, or to view someone strictly in sexual terms

groups.summary_en: This frame covers eliciting sexual desire or reinterpreting someone or something through an explicit sexual lens, spanning erotic stimulation and physical arousal.
groups.summary_zh: 指激发性欲、从性角度对待某人或使之充满性色彩。

groups.name: Shade & Screen · 遮阳与挡光 (Shield, Screen, Block out)
groups.tip: 遮挡强光提供阴凉视界

items.def_en: To protect or conceal something by placing a screen or structure in front of it

items.def_zh: 遮护，庇护（使免受强光照射）
items.def_en: To protect someone or something from strong light or heat by interposing a barrier

items.def_zh: 遮蔽（光线），给……遮阴；（在绘画中）加阴影；微变
items.def_en: 1. To protect something from direct sunlight or bright light. 2. To make a drawing or painting darker in some parts to create depth. 3. To change very gradually from one state or color into another.
To stop light from entering a room or reaching an area completely
To position an object so that its shadow falls across something, shading it

groups.summary_en: This frame covers protective actions aimed at blocking harsh light, glare, or intense sun from striking someone's eyes or an exposed surface.
groups.summary_zh: 指遮挡刺眼光线或强烈阳光以提供阴凉或视觉防护。

groups.name: Shake & Tremble · 发抖与战栗 (Tremor, Shudder, Quiver)
groups.tip: 因寒冷恐惧产生身体战栗

items.def_en: To tremble or shake slightly, especially from nervousness, fear, or weakness.
to shake slightly with rapid, delicate movements due to strong emotion or physical sensitivity
to shake repeatedly and involuntarily because of feeling cold or fearful
to shake or vibrate intensely from great fear or physical upheaval
to shake violently and convulsively, typically from horror, disgust, or intense cold

groups.summary_en: Describes involuntary, rapid micro-movements of the body or ground caused by fear, cold, weakness, or seismic disturbance, ranging from subtle fluttering to violent convulsions.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因恐惧、寒冷、虚弱或震动而引起的身体或地面不自主的抖颤。

groups.name: Shape & Construct · 构筑与地貌塑造 (Grade, Terrace, Contour)
groups.tip: 堆土造台改变地形构造

items.def_en: To level or create a uniform slope on ground or earth before building or planting
To build up earth, snow, or mud into a raised protective ridge, barrier, or slope
To shape a hillside or sloping bank into a series of flat, level stepped platforms
To shape or form earth or material along natural curved elevations and profiles

items.def_zh: 修筑梯田，将（斜坡等）筑成阶梯状台地
items.def_en: (landscaping / architecture, variant of terrace) To shape sloping ground into a series of flat stepped platforms or levels.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this civil engineering and landscape frame deal with physically carving, leveling, and sculpting raw ground, earthworks, or slopes into stepped, leveled, or sculpted agricultural and structural forms. They emphasize deliberate topographic contouring.
groups.summary_zh: 指对土地、斜坡等地形进行切削、平整或修筑台阶式地形。

groups.name: Sharp Stinging Pain · 刺痛与灼痛 (Smart, Burn, Bite)
groups.tip: 蜂蜇般尖锐火辣的痛感

items.def_en: Hurt or sting with sharp, pinching sensation, typically through cold
Produce or feel a hot, painful sensation on the skin or inside the body
Feel a sharp, stinging physical pain, or feel upset and hurt by criticism

items.def_zh: 蜇，刺痛；感到灼痛；使心痛（sting的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of sting: to cause or feel a sharp prickling pain; to upset or hurt someone emotionally.
Cause a sharp, stinging physical sensation, especially of extreme cold or wind

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe sharp, acute physical sensations or emotional hurt that prickles, burns, or hurts keenly. While sting denotes a sudden prickling jab, smart emphasizes persistent throbbing pain and bite evokes a harsh, cutting pang.
groups.summary_zh: 描述身体或心理上剧烈尖锐的刺痛、灼痛或咬噬感。

groups.name: Sharpen & Hone · 削尖与磨砺 (Whet, Hone, Sharpen)
groups.tip: 磨快刃口使其锐利锋芒

items.def_en: To sharpen an edge or smooth a hard surface by rubbing against a rough whetstone
To make or become sharp or sharper, physically on an edge or mentally in acuity
To sharpen a blade, or to refine and polish a skill or technique over time

items.def_zh: 磨快，磨砺；刺激（欲望、兴趣等）
items.def_en:
1. to sharpen the blade of a tool or weapon
2. to stimulate or increase someone's desire, interest, or appetite
To sharpen a razor or fine blade on or with a leather strap

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover both grinding an edge to acute physical sharpness and figuratively refining a skill, appetite, or mental facility to peak keenness.
groups.summary_zh: 既指研磨刃具使其锋利，也比喻提升技能或激发欲望兴趣。

groups.name: Sharpen & Keen · 磨利与尖锐化 (Sharpen, Grind, Whetting)
groups.tip: 利其器必先打磨其锋芒

items.def_en: To provide something with a cutting edge or to renew its sharpness
To sharpen or shape a tool or blade by pressing it against an abrasive rotating wheel or rough stone

items.def_zh: 磨快，削尖；提高，使敏锐；变锋利，变敏锐
items.def_en: 1. To make an edge, point, or blade sharp, or to become sharp. 2. To improve or make a skill, feeling, or sense more acute.
To make senses, feelings, or perceptions more acute, receptive, and lively
To sharpen a blade by friction; or figuratively, to stimulate and sharpen an appetite, desire, or interest

groups.summary_en: Denotes making an instrument's cutting edge or point acute, or intensifying human senses, mental focus, and feelings. Stresses an increase in acute cutting ability or enhanced perceptual vigilance.
groups.summary_zh: 指将刃口或尖端磨尖锐，亦指感官、思维或感受的敏锐化与强化。

groups.name: Shear & Shave · 剪割与剃剪 (Fleece, Crop, Clip)
groups.tip: 大剪修齐或削去外层

items.def_en: To cut short or tidy hair, wool, or nails using scissors or clippers
To cut hair, plants, or edges very short or close to the base
To remove thin layers or hair from a surface with a razor or sharp blade

items.def_zh: 剪（羊毛等）；剪断，剪切；折断
items.def_en: 1. to cut wool or hair off an animal or person with shears. 2. to break or snap under lateral force or stress.
To shear the wool from a sheep or other animal

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mechanical cutting actions specifically using scissor-like blades or shears to strip coats, fleece, hair, or physical surface layers cleanly off.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用剪刃、羊毛剪等工具整片切断、剪掉毛发或表层覆物。

groups.name: Shed Light Upon · 照亮与阐释 (Illuminate, Light Up, Clarify)
groups.tip: 投射光芒驱散黑暗处

items.def_en: Make something bright with light, or become bright and animated.
Provide clarifying information that makes an obscure situation easier to understand.
1. To shine light on something and make it bright or visible. 2. To make a complex subject, text, or issue clear and easy to understand.
Make something more luminous or clear, or become lighter in appearance.
Light something up physically or enlighten someone spiritually or intellectually.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to casting physical radiance upon objects to make them clearly visible, or metaphorically shedding intellectual light upon obscure ideas, texts, and problems.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在物理上投射光芒使其明亮可见，或在比喻义上阐释、澄清疑难问题。

groups.name: Shelter & Canopy with Foliage · 绿荫庇护与笼罩 (Bower, Canopy, Shade)
groups.tip: 绿荫或掩蔽处提供庇护

items.def_en: To shelter someone or an area from direct sunlight or intense glare

items.def_zh: 遮蔽，笼罩（多用于文学描写）
items.def_en: (literary) To cover or enclose completely from view, like vegetation, mist, or darkness

items.def_zh: 用树木/屏障隔开或遮挡
items.def_en: To shelter or obscure an area from sight or wind using hedges, trees, or screens
To cover, overarch, or form a protective natural roof over something
(literary) To enclose, shade, or shelter someone or something with leafy branches or trees.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on natural or overhead shielding, specifically enclosing, arching over, or sheltering people or spaces beneath foliage, trees, or vegetative coverings.
groups.summary_zh: 指用树木枝叶、绿植或顶盖如凉亭般庇护、遮蔽或笼罩。

groups.name: Shelter & Safeguard · 庇护与遮蔽 (Shield, Screen, Protect)
groups.tip: 提供遮蔽并防受伤害

items.def_en: To provide shelter or accommodation for people, animals, or objects
To conceal, protect, or shelter someone or something behind a barrier

items.def_zh: 保护，掩蔽，庇护；躲避（风雨、危险等）
items.def_en: 1. to protect someone or something from danger, bad weather, or harm. 2. to seek protection or take refuge.
To hide or take shelter in a secure or secluded place until danger passes
To provide lodging, space, or shelter for someone

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on shielding living beings or fragile things from external harm, inclement weather, or immediate physical danger, whether providing refuge or actively seeking it.
groups.summary_zh: 指提供或寻求物理屏障与安全处所，免受风雨、灾害或外界危害侵袭。

groups.name: Shoe & Iron Livestock · 挂掌与装配 (Shoe, Calhoon, Plate)
groups.tip: 为器具进行装配、修补或调校

items.def_en: To fit a horse or other animal with iron horseshoes
To replace worn horseshoes with a new set of protective metal shoes
To shoe a racehorse with lightweight aluminum or steel racing plates

items.def_zh: 为（马）钉蹄铁；用渡船运送
items.def_en: 1. (rare) To shoe a horse (as a farrier); or to transport by ferry.
To fit a horseshoe with pointed cleats or studs to prevent slipping

groups.summary_en: This specialized mechanical-husbandry frame involves trimming hooves and nailing or fitting protective metal shoes onto draught animals and horses.
groups.summary_zh: 给牲畜修剪蹄质并钉上护蹄铁掌或专用金属垫片。

groups.name: Shortcut & Work Around · 取巧与变通提效 (Hack, Bodge, MacGyver)
groups.tip: 巧用妙招提高操作效率

items.def_zh: 绕开，变通避开（限制或困难）
items.def_en: To bypass or circumvent a problem or procedural restriction using an alternative method
To devise an ingenious, pragmatic modification or shortcut to handle a task or problem

items.def_zh: 巧用妙招提高效率，运用生活窍门
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To use clever, simple tricks or shortcuts to manage daily tasks or work more efficiently.
To make, fix, or adapt something in an improvised and inventive way using whatever objects are at hand

items.def_zh: 仓促拼凑，草草搭凑应急
items.def_en: To assemble, build, or repair something hastily using makeshift or improvised materials

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying informal, clever improvisations or pragmatic shortcuts to circumvent complexity and solve problems quickly. Unlike institutional streamlining, these actions rely on personal ingenuity and resourceful workarounds.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用聪明技巧、变通窍门或临时拼凑手段来快捷省事地解决问题。

groups.name: Shout & Yell · 大声呼喊与叫嚷 (Holler, Shout, Bellow)
groups.tip: 放开喉咙高声呼喊，声音响亮传远

items.def_en: To speak or cry out in a very loud voice, usually to be heard at a distance
To shout something very loudly, especially because of strong emotion or noise
To shout in a deep, booming voice, typically in anger or pain
(informal) To shout or yell very loudly; to complain or protest.
To shout or call out noisily and unrestrainedly, often accompanied by tears

groups.summary_en: Everyday and colloquial verbs describing loudly projecting one's voice across distance to attract attention, impart urgency, or express anger.
groups.summary_zh: 表示拉开嗓门高呼、扯着喉咙喊叫以引起注意或发泄情绪。

groups.name: Show & Demonstrate · 展示与演示 (Demonstrate, Exhibit, Display)
groups.tip: 陈列展示公开呈现

items.def_en: to introduce, display, or set forth something formally for consideration, inspection, or viewing
to clearly show the existence, truth, or practical operation of something by giving proof or an active exhibition
to show something publicly in an exhibition, museum, or formal demonstration
to guide someone through a process or demonstrate each step of a system systematically

items.def_zh: 演示，示范，展示；录制样本唱片
items.def_en: (informal) 1. to demonstrate how a product or software works. 2. to record a demonstration version of a song.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on showing how something works or presenting its features to an audience or customer, often for instructional, persuasive, or promotional purposes.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过实操、展览或说明向他人具体展示产品功能或事物面貌。

groups.name: Shower with & Lavish Gifts · 倾倒式赏赐与厚赠 (Shower, Lavish, Heap)
groups.tip: 慷慨且大量地倾洒给予

items.def_zh: 大量给予，倾注；大量泼洒；淋浴
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a great number of gifts, compliments, or insults in lavish amounts. 2. To fall or pour down in a shower; to wash oneself in a shower.

items.def_zh: 大量给予；堆积（赞誉或礼物）
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To bestow large quantities of gifts, praise, or criticism upon someone
(+ on/upon) To give something generously, profusely, or in extravagant amounts

items.def_zh: 接连供给；不断塞给（食物/礼物）
items.def_en: (+ with) To continually provide or urge someone with food, drink, or gifts

items.def_zh: 铺天盖地送给；使应接不暇
items.def_en: (+ with) To overwhelm someone with a huge, uncontrollable flood of gifts, letters, or offers

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes an excessive, overwhelming intensity of giving, bestowing gifts, praises, or favors in great abundance. It highlights the sheer volume, extravagance, and relentless generosity of the benefactor.
groups.summary_zh: 极尽慷慨地大量赠予礼品、宠爱、赞赏或资源。

groups.name: Shrink & Constrict · 紧缩勒窄与挤压压迫 (Constrict, Contract, Stragulate)
groups.tip: 体积变小或管径收紧

items.def_en: To become smaller, shorter, or tighter through physiological tension, cooling, or compression
To squeeze painfully between two hard surfaces, causing localized compression or tightness
To become firmer or narrower with increased tension, or to pull a strap, grip, or passage taut
To kill or restrict by squeezing the neck, throat, or supply conduits tightly so air or flow ceases
1. To become tighter and narrower, or to make something tighter and narrower. 2. To limit or restrict someone's freedom or ability to act.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical tightening, compressive narrowing, or vascular spasm that pinches, limits, or chokes passage and blood supply. 'Constrict' emphasizes squeezing inwards (e.g., pupils or airways), distinct from thermal 'contract' or mechanical 'pinch'.
groups.summary_zh: 指生理肌体、管道或物理对象受压迫收紧挤窄，甚至窒息受限。

groups.name: Shuttle & Commute · 往返与定期穿梭 (Shuttle, Commute, Ferry)
groups.tip: 在两地之间频繁来回奔波

items.def_en: To transport people or goods frequently from one place to another across water or along a fixed route

items.def_zh: 穿梭往返，往返穿行；往返运送
items.def_en: to travel or carry people or goods frequently back and forth between two places
To travel regularly between one's place of work and one's home
To travel regularly along a route, especially a nautical or commercial trade path
To walk repeatedly or wearily from one place to another, often without enthusiasm

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses repetitive transit between two specific fixed locations. It covers both individual travelers navigating habitual routes and transport vehicles designated to convey passengers back and forth.
groups.summary_zh: 指在两个固定地点之间周期性、固定路线往返运送或通勤。

groups.name: Sift & Cherry-Pick · 挑拣与抽选 (Sift, Winnow, Cherry-Pick)
groups.tip: 去粗取精挑选可用之才

items.def_en: To choose someone or something from a larger group for special treatment or attention

items.def_zh: 择优挑选，挑选最有利的
items.def_en: To choose the best or most desirable items or people selectively and self-servingly

items.def_zh: 挑选，甄选；（为控制种群而）捕杀
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To select or gather best or useful items or information from various sources. 2. To kill selected animals from a group to control the population.
(+ through) To examine information or items closely to isolate what is useful or valuable
(+ out) To separate the good, useful, or desirable parts of something from the bad

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on sorting through a large mass of material, data, or individuals to extract the finest elements or purge the defective ones.
groups.summary_zh: 指以甄别或精细辨别的方式从庞杂对象中择优录取或剔除次品。

groups.name: Sigh & Moan · 叹息与呻吟 (Sigh, Groan, Moan)
groups.tip: 伴随情绪或痛楚的深沉叹息

items.def_en: To draw and release a deep, noticeable breath expressing weariness or resignation
To breathe out slowly and audibly, expressing sadness, tiredness, relief, or frustration; to say something with a sigh.
To utter a long, low sound of distress, physical suffering, or sexual pleasure
To catch one's breath suddenly in shock, amazement, or breathlessness
To make a deep, involuntary sound expressing severe pain, grief, or annoyance

groups.summary_en: Verbs designating low, involuntary, or emotive vocal exhalations registering fatigue, despair, relief, frustration, or bodily pain.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因悲伤、疲乏、释然或肉体痛苦而深呼气或发出低沉哼声。

groups.name: Signal & Gesture · 视觉示意与旗语传达 (Semaphore, Flag, Signal)
groups.tip: 用旗语或手势无声传递指令信号

items.def_en: To convey an order, warning, or information by means of gestures, lights, or audible sounds

items.def_zh: 摇旗示意；标出引起注意
items.def_en: To signal someone or a vehicle to stop or pay attention by waving one's arms or a cloth indicator

items.def_zh: 发旗语，用信号机发信号；用手势示意
items.def_en: to send information or communicate using hand-held flags or visual mechanical apparatus
To wave your hand repeatedly to signal the driver of a moving vehicle to halt

items.def_zh: 打手势；用肢体动作示意
items.def_en: To use dramatic or agitated hand and arm movements while expressing oneself

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve communicating messages or alerting others using visible movements, apparatuses, hand-held indicators, or non-verbal body language.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过挥舞旗帜、手势、器械或视觉动作传达明确的信息或警示。

groups.name: Signpost & Map Out · 指引路径与框架 (Signpost, Map out, Delineate)
groups.tip: 树立指示标牌以指引方向路径

items.def_en: To give the main points, structure, or essential shape of something without detailed commentary
To plan or explain carefully the steps, details, or structure of a course of action or presentation
To draw someone's direct visual or cognitive attention to a fact, place, or detail
To describe, explain, or establish the borders or characteristics of something in vivid, exact detail

items.def_zh: 设路标于；（在演讲、文章中）提示结构，指引方向
items.def_en: To mark a path or road with signs; to clearly indicate the direction, structure, or main points of a text or speech

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve providing clear orienting cues, structural landmarks, or advance outlines to guide a listener, reader, or traveler through complex material.
groups.summary_zh: 指设立标志、指引路径或预先理清逻辑结构与导向。

groups.name: Silence & Hush · 沉默与肃静 (Silence, Quiet, Shush)
groups.tip: 发出嘘声让全场安静闭嘴

items.def_en: To cause to become quiet and peaceful, or become calm and quiet yourself
To make someone stop speaking or prevent criticism from being voiced
To stop talking, shouting, or making noise, especially when ordered to
1. To become quiet or silent, or make someone stop speaking or crying. 2. ('hush up') To suppress mention of or conceal something.
To tell someone to be quiet by saying 'shh' or whispering softly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve causing persons or noisy environments to become quiet, or falling silent oneself through suppression, tact, or emotional tension.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动使人闭嘴息声，或环境陷入肃静与沉寂。

groups.name: Silence & Suppress · 压制与禁声 (Gag, Muffle, Muzzle)
groups.tip: 施加强权封口并扼杀言论

items.def_en: To tell or signal someone to be quiet by making a soft rushing sound or gesture
(informal) To stop talking or making noise, especially when ordered to do so

items.raw_cluster: 压制与使沉默 Silence & Suppress
items.def_zh: 使沉默，使噤声；压制，压服（批评或异议）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone stop speaking, making noise, or expressing their opinion. 2. To suppress or put an end to criticism, protests, or opposition.
To prevent someone from speaking or expressing an opinion publicly, often via legal or coercive force
To stop people or the press from criticizing or expressing independent opinions freely

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent compelling someone to stop speaking or restricting free expression through intimidation, legal injunctions, or physical obstruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法律、威胁、封口等手段强行剥夺发声权利。

groups.name: Silence & Withhold · 缄默与隐瞒 (Clam up, Stonewall, Keep mum)
groups.tip: 闭口不言并拒绝透露信息

items.def_en: To hold back strong feelings or information instead of expressing them freely

items.def_zh: 闭口不言，守口如瓶；捞蛤
items.def_en: 1. ('clam up') (informal) To suddenly become silent and refuse to talk or disclose information. 2. To dig for or gather clams.
To suppress discussion of a scandal or crime to stop the public learning about it
To stop talking abruptly or refrain completely from disclosing speech
To refuse to answer questions, cooperate, or disclose information intentionally

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on deliberately maintaining secrecy, withholding testimony, or stonewalling interrogators by refusing to utter a word.
groups.summary_zh: 指抗拒询问、拒不招供或刻意保守秘密的缄默态度。

groups.name: Simulate & Replicate · 模拟与仿真 (Replicate, Emulate, Reproduce)
groups.tip: 再现运行过程与行为仿真

items.def_en: Exhibit biological, chemical, or operational properties remarkably like another
Produce an identical copy, image, or simulated manifestation of something
1. To create a model of a process or situation that reproduces its conditions. 2. To imitate the appearance or character of something.
Duplicate or reproduce an exact condition, experiment, or outcome precisely
Match or imitate the internal hardware, software, or operating mechanisms of another system

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote creating computational, theoretical, or experimental conditions that recreate real-world phenomena or behavior. 'Simulate' and 'emulate' highlight computational mimicry or functioning equivalence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过模型或实验环境再现真实条件与运行机制。

groups.name: Sing & Chant · 歌唱与咏唱 (Chant, Intone, Croon)
groups.tip: 伴随旋律歌唱与有节奏咏诵

items.def_en: To utter words with a slow, low, and even solemn musical cadence
To sing or hum softly, gently, and intimately, typically romantic tunes
1. To make musical sounds with the voice, usually following a tune or words; (of birds/insects) to produce whistling or musical sounds.

items.def_zh: 咏唱，反复有节奏地吟诵
items.def_en: To utter or sing rhythmic, repetitive phrases, often in a unison or liturgical manner
To sing a song forcefully, loudly, and enthusiastically

groups.summary_en: Covers making melodic, rhythmic, or ritualistic musical sounds with the voice, varying from softly murmured ballads to solemn religious recitations.
groups.summary_zh: 指以人声发出具有节奏、旋律或仪式性的歌咏与朗诵诵唱。

groups.name: Single Out & Pick · 甄选与单选 (Single Out, Handpick, Winnow)
groups.tip: 从群体中单独挑出目标

items.def_en: (+ for) To designate or set something aside for a specific purpose or person
To choose one person or thing from a group for special attention, praise, or criticism

items.def_zh: 单独挑出，选出；（棒球中）击出一垒安打
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'single out') To choose, select, or separate someone or something from a group for special attention or treatment. 2. (baseball) To hit a single
To select only the best or most favorable items from a set while ignoring others
To choose someone or something very carefully and personally for a particular purpose

groups.summary_en: This cognitive and operational frame denotes separating or isolating one individual or item from a broader collective for special attention, praise, criticism, or assignment. The choice involves focused differentiation.
groups.summary_zh: 指从群体中单挑或特选出某一个体，给予特殊对待、褒贬或任命。

groups.name: Sip & Sample · 啜饮与慢品 (Sup, Sip, Nibble)
groups.tip: 小口慢酌与悠闲饮酒

items.def_en: To drink a small amount of something to experience its quality or taste
To take up liquid with rapid, delicate tongue movements
To drink a liquid by taking very small mouthfuls at a time
1. (literary or regional) To drink a liquid by taking small mouthfuls. 2. (archaic) To eat supper.
To taste or drink something slowly in order to appreciate its full flavor

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights delicate, measured liquid intake taken in tiny mouthfuls, focusing on tasting, savoring, or careful ingestion.
groups.summary_zh: 细品浅尝的饮用方式，以小口慢饮、啜品汤水或饮品为核心特征。

groups.name: Siphon & Drain · 抽取与分流 (Siphon, Drain, Bleed)
groups.tip: 借助外力或管道抽引排出

items.def_en: To force liquid or gas to move in a particular direction using mechanical suction.
To pierce a container or pipeline to draw off liquid, or draw on a resource.
To cause liquid to flow away from a container, or deplete someone's supplies or energy.
To draw fluid or air from a system, or extort and continuously exhaust money from someone.

items.def_zh: （用虹吸管）虹吸，抽取；暗中挪用（资金、资源）
items.def_en: 1. (+ off/out) To draw liquid out of a container through a siphon tube. 2. To divert money or resources gradually and often dishonestly.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe conveying liquid away through conduit/suction or, metaphorically, illicitly draining capital, fuel, or vital resources from a reserve.
groups.summary_zh: 通过管道汲取液体，或暗中转移、抽干资金资源。

groups.name: Situate & Position · 安置与布局定位 (Situate, Locate, Position, Station)
groups.tip: 安置或使之坐落某处

items.def_en: To arrange for the headquarters or primary center of operations to be in a given area

items.def_zh: 将……安置在合适位置；安放
items.def_en: To carefully place someone or something in a specific location for an operational advantage

items.def_zh: 驻扎；安置人员在固定岗位
items.def_en: To assign someone to a fixed post or deploy personnel at a designated spot
To establish, set up, or build something in a particular place or area

items.def_zh: 使位于，使坐落于；将……置于（特定背景中）
items.def_en: To place, locate, or build something in a particular position or environment.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this causative frame denote the purposeful act of placing, founding, or stationing an object, institution, or observer in an intentional physical or contextual spot.
groups.summary_zh: 有目的地将设施、人员或事物设置、安置在确切方位或环境之中。

groups.name: Skimp & Shortchange · 偷工减料与克扣 (Shortchange, Cut corners, Stint)
groups.tip: 精打细算甚至过度克扣

items.def_en: to do something in the easiest, cheapest, or quickest way, often disregarding safety or quality
(+ on) to restrict, limit, or be stingy in the amount of food, care, or resources provided
(+ on) to use too little money, time, or resources on something, often compromising quality or sufficiency
to pinch, cut down, or pare costs in a petty, miserly fashion to the detriment of quality
to treat someone unfairly by giving them less money, time, or value than they deserve

groups.summary_en: This frame involves stingily withholding, reducing, or under-allocating materials, effort, time, or funds to an endeavor, typically harming the quality, outcome, or recipient who receives less than their rightful due.
groups.summary_zh: 指在质量、投入或供给上克扣短缺、偷工减料或吝啬给予。

groups.name: Skipper & Helm Command · 统领与领航 (Captain, Steer, Pilot)
groups.tip: 担任领队或船长发号施令

items.def_en: To serve as the designated head of a sports team, vessel, or operational crew
To direct the course of an enterprise or steer a vessel/craft through challenging waters
To control the direction of a vessel or guide the course of an organization or project
To direct and guide a group or venture successfully through intricate conditions

items.def_zh: 担任队长；担任船长（或机长）
items.def_en: To act as the captain or leader of a ship, boat, aircraft, or sports team.

groups.summary_en: Anchored in maritime, vehicular, and team-governance metaphors, this frame denotes direct operational command, tactical steering, and managerial stewardship.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重团队领军、航向把控与现场执行层面的指挥掌舵。

groups.name: Slander & Defame · 口头诽谤与中伤 (Slander, Defame, Vilify)
groups.tip: 恶意捏造事实毁人名誉

items.def_en: To publish false and malicious written or visual statements that damage someone's reputation
To make false, spoken statements about someone that harm their character or reputation.
To speak or write about someone in an extremely derogatory, abusive, and malicious manner
To harm the reputation of someone by making false, malicious, or derogatory statements
To criticize, disparage, or speak ill of someone behind their back in an informal setting

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally making false, disparaging, or malicious statements that damage another party's reputation, character, or social standing, often specifically distinguishing spoken attacks from written libel.
groups.summary_zh: 指恶意捏造或散布虚假言论，公开破坏他人名誉与人格尊严。

groups.name: Slang Masturbation & Sexual Release · 粗俗手淫与宣泄 (Wank, Jerk off, Jack off)
groups.tip: 自慰宣泄或性快感动作

items.def_en: Stimulate one's own penis to ejaculate (colloquial taboo)
Perform masturbation, especially by rapid manual stimulation (informal/vulgar)
Masturbate by stroking the penis, or stimulate someone else sexually (chiefly US slang)
Masturbate to the point of orgasm through friction
(British, slang, often taboo) To masturbate.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures colloquial, coarse, and taboo vernacular verbs referring to acts of solitary masturbation and physical sexual release.
groups.summary_zh: 日常口语、俚语及粗俗语境中指称打手枪、宣泄性欲的词汇。

groups.name: Sleet & Hail · 降雨雪与冻雨固态降水 (Hail, Flurry, Precipitate)
groups.tip: 天空降下雨夹雪等气象

items.def_en: to fall from the sky as pellets of frozen ice
(meteorology) to condense from atmospheric vapor and fall as rain, snow, or sleet
to rain very lightly in fine, mist-like drops
to fall intermittently in brief, light bursts of snow
(impersonal) to fall from the sky as a mixture of rain and snow or hail

groups.summary_en: Meteorological verbs designating atmospheric frozen, liquid, or mixed water particles descending from clouds to the ground as precipitation.
groups.summary_zh: 指冰雹、雨夹雪、飘雪等各类气象降水过程。

groups.name: Sleuth & Probe · 探查与私下侦破 (Sleuth, Probe, Snoop)
groups.tip: 像侦探般敏锐侦查并深入求证

items.def_en: To search curious, secretive places trying to find out hidden facts or contraband
(+ around/into) To look around stealthily or pry into other people's private affairs or possessions
(+ into) To examine or investigate a mystery, allegation, or problem thoroughly and incisively
(informal) To act as a detective and investigate clues to solve a mystery or crime.
To discover or unearth hidden information, secrets, or people through persistent search

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail actively searching for obscure clues, prying into hidden circumstances, or employing investigative tactics to decipher crimes, mysteries, or undisclosed secrets.
groups.summary_zh: 指以侦探或暗中查访的方式细致排查线索，揭露隐秘真相。

groups.name: Slow Liquid Cooking · 文火慢炖 (Simmer, Stew, Braise)
groups.tip: 文火慢熬细炖，改变食材质地

items.def_en: Cook an item such as fish or eggs gently in simmering or still hot liquid.
Cook food, especially eggs, in water just below the boiling point.
Cook food slowly in liquid in a closed dish or pan over low heat.

items.def_zh: 煨，文火慢炖；即将爆发，按捺（怒火）
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To cook food gently in liquid just below boiling point. 2. To be in a state of suppressed anger, excitement, or tension.
Fry food lightly and then stew it slowly in a closed container with a small amount of liquid.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cooking food gently and slowly in liquid or steam just below or at a low boil, often to tenderize tough ingredients. They contrast primarily by whether the vessel is tightly sealed, the liquid volume, and the degree of steam involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指用文火慢煨、炖煮使食材软化入味的方式，在汤汁用量与密封程度上各有侧重。

groups.name: Slump & Lounge · 瘫坐与萎靡颓垮 (Slouch, Slump, Flop)
groups.tip: 无精打采地弓背耷拉或塌坐

items.def_zh: 扑通瘫坐；四仰八叉倒下
items.def_en: (+ down/into) To sit or lie down in a heavy, sudden, and relaxed or exhausted manner
(+ over) To bend the back and shoulders into a rounded curve

items.def_zh: 耷拉着坐（或站、走），无精打采地弓背
items.def_en: To sit, stand, or walk with a lazy, drooping posture, bending your shoulders forward.
(+ down/into) To sit or fall down heavily and limply, usually due to exhaustion, injury, or despair

items.def_zh: 体力不支倒下；瘫软瓦解
items.def_en: To fall down suddenly and completely lose strength because of illness or severe fatigue

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe assuming limp, collapsed, or rounded body postures, typically expressing exhaustion, indolence, demoralization, or utter defeat.
groups.summary_zh: 指由于疲惫、懒散或沮丧而软塌塌地坐着、瘫倒或弯腰驼背。

groups.name: Smile & Radiate Joy · 展颜微笑与满面春风 (Grin, Smirk, Glow)
groups.tip: 面露笑容或容光焕发

items.def_en: To form one's features into an expression of pleasure, amusement, or friendliness

items.def_zh: 面容容光焕发，喜形于色
items.def_en: To suddenly become bright, animated, and cheerful, especially of one's face or eyes

items.def_zh: 面露喜色，绽开笑容；发光，照射；播送
items.def_en: 1. To smile broadly and radiantly with great joy. 2. To send out beams of light or radio/television signals.
To look radiant with warmth, health, happiness, or pride
To smile broadly, often showing the teeth in genuine amusement or mischief

groups.summary_en: Expressing positive emotion, approval, or delight through facial expressions ranging from subtle warm smiles to unrestrained, broad grins that illuminate the face.
groups.summary_zh: 通过面部表情流露愉悦、喜悦或得意，从含笑到满面红光、喜笑颜开。

groups.name: Smoke & Inhale · 抽吸与吞云吐雾 (Smoke, Puff, Inhale)
groups.tip: 口鼻吞吐烟草气体

items.def_zh: 吸烟，抽（烟）；冒烟，冒气；熏制（食物）
items.def_en: 1. To inhale and exhale the smoke of tobacco or drugs. 2. To emit smoke. 3. To preserve meat or fish by exposing it to smoke.
(+ on/at) To draw on a cigarette, cigar, or pipe in short, intermittent breaths
To inhale and exhale vapor produced by an electronic cigarette
To suck air through a cigarette or cigar to ignite and smoke it
To draw smoke or vapor deeply into the lungs

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote drawing vapor or smoke from tobacco, herbal blends, or related devices into the mouth and lungs and subsequently exhaling it.
groups.summary_zh: 用嘴将烟草、烟气吸入体内并吐出的抽吸动作。

groups.name: Smooth & Fair · 打磨与修顺 (Smooth down, Sand, Plane)
groups.tip: 修整打磨以消除表面凹凸

items.def_en: To make a rough, raised, or uneven surface flat and even by pressing or rubbing

items.raw_cluster: 使平滑与光顺 Smooth & Fair
items.def_zh: 使光顺，把……修整打磨平滑；（天气）转晴
items.def_en: 1. To smooth, shape, or adjust the surface or joints of a structure so that external parts blend smoothly together. 2. (of weather) To clear up.

items.def_zh: 羽化边缘；将边缘打磨渐薄顺接
items.def_en: To sand or blend the edges of paint or filler so they taper smoothly into the surrounding surface
To make a piece of wood flat and smooth using a hand plane or planer
To make a surface smooth or ready for painting by rubbing it with sandpaper

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to removing irregularities, rough edges, or imperfections from physical surfaces using tools or abrasion to produce a flush, streamlined finish. They contrast primarily by tool type and trade (woodworking, bodywork, or drafting).
groups.summary_zh: 强调使用工具去除表面凹凸不平，使构件轮廓顺畅平整。

groups.name: Smuggle & Traffic · 走私与非法贩运 (Smuggle, Traffic, Run)
groups.tip: 非法偷运贩卖违禁物品

items.def_en: To transport and distribute contraband or prohibited supplies unlawfully, as in 'run guns'
(+ in) To buy and sell illegal substances, arms, or vulnerable people unlawfully
To covertly convey prohibited items or unauthorized people into a restricted place
To take goods or people secretly and illegally into or out of a country or restricted place

items.raw_cluster: 走私与非法贩运 Smuggle & Traffic
items.def_zh: 非法私运；非法盗录，私卖（唱片、软件等）
items.def_en: 1. To manufacture, distribute, or sell alcoholic drinks, recordings, or software illegally without paying tax or copyright.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve the illicit transportation, concealment, and distribution of contraband goods, prohibited substances, or persons across controlled borders or black markets.
groups.summary_zh: 秘密夹带、逃避海关监管或在黑市非运贩卖违禁品与人员。

groups.name: Snap & Snarl · 厉声训斥 (Bite, Bark, Snarl)
groups.tip: 神色凶恶且语气粗暴地回绝

items.def_zh: 厉声呵斥；吠叫般大声命令
items.def_en: (+ out) To utter words, orders, or reproaches loudly, abruptly, and harshly

items.def_zh: 暴躁吼斥；无端厉声斥责
items.def_en: To respond to someone with disproportionate and ferocious verbal irritability
(+ at) To suddenly attack someone verbally with extreme anger and bitterness

items.raw_cluster: 厉声说与怒斥 Snap & Snarl
items.def_zh: 厉声说，斥责；（使）咔嚓折断；（突然）失控崩溃
items.def_en: 1. To say something quickly in an angry, sharp, or irritable tone. 2. To break suddenly with a sharp cracking noise, or cause something to do so. 3. To suddenly lose control of one's emotions or patience.
To speak or utter words in an angry, aggressive, and vicious tone

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey abrupt, aggressive verbal outbursts delivered with acute irritation, spite, or fierce anger.
groups.summary_zh: 指因烦躁或盛怒而厉声喝叱、反唇相讥或粗暴打断。

groups.name: Sniff & Snuffle · 嗅闻与抽鼻 (Sniff, Snort, Scent)
groups.tip: 抽噎吸鼻用鼻子嗅探闻嗅

items.def_en: To detect, smell, or track something using the sense of smell
To draw air audibly up through the nose to smell something or clear nasal passages

items.def_zh: 抽鼻子，闻嗅；带鼻音说话
items.def_en: 1. To breathe noisily or repeatedly sniff through a blocked nose. 2. (of an animal) To sniff around while exploring.
To discover or detect something by tracking its scent or investigating clues
To make a sudden, explosive sound by forcing air violently through the nose

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail taking air short and audibly through the nostrils, whether to clear nasal congestion, cry quietly, detect odors, or express scorn.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过鼻腔短促或有声地吸气，用于辨别气味、擤鼻吸涕或表达轻蔑。

groups.name: Snow & Frozen Precipitation · 降雪与冻水凝结 (Snow, Sleet, Flurry)
groups.tip: 天气现象发生降水降雪

items.def_zh: 下雪；似雪般飘落；被雪困住
items.def_en: 1. to fall as frozen precipitation in the form of white flakes (usually impersonal: 'it snows') 2. to fall or shower down like snowflakes 3. (usually passive: 'be snowed in') to cover, trap, or enclose with snow
to snow severely accompanied by high-velocity freezing winds and near-zero visibility
to precipitate hard pellets of frozen rain from convective clouds
to snow lightly and briefly in swirling, intermittent gusts
to fall as a mixture of rain and snow or as partly frozen precipitation

groups.summary_en: Encompasses impersonal atmospheric occurrences involving frozen, crystalized water droplets falling from the sky in varying intensities and forms.
groups.summary_zh: 指冷空气作用下，液态水凝华结冰并以降雪、霰或雨夹雪等形式降落的气象。

groups.name: Snub & Cold-Shoulder · 冷落与傲慢蔑视 (Slight, Snub, Spurn)
groups.tip: 态度傲慢不敬，有意轻视他人

items.def_en: To dismiss or ignore someone curtly, showing that you do not value their presence
To treat someone with disrespect, contempt, or deliberate indifference.
To intentionally treat someone with unfriendliness or disdain, especially by ignoring them

items.def_zh: 冷落；故意怠慢；给软钉子碰
items.def_en: To deliberately ignore or insult someone by refusing to acknowledge them or their overtures
To reject an offer, person, or gesture with disdain or contempt

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote showing intentional disrespect, coldness, or insolent disregard toward another person. They focus on subtle or overt social insults that wound pride or status.
groups.summary_zh: 强调故意摆出冷淡傲慢姿态，给予社交侮辱或冷待。

groups.name: Soak & Steep · 浸泡与腌渍 (Steep, Pickle, Souse)
groups.tip: 浸入盐卤液体中吸汁入味

items.def_en: To treat food, leather, or other materials with salt, brine, or smoke to preserve them
To cure or preserve meat by soaking it in seasoned brine or coating it with coarse salt
To leave something immersed in a liquid bath so it thoroughly absorbs fluid
To soak dried leaves, grains, or ingredients in liquid to extract flavor or medicinal qualities

items.def_zh: 用盐水浸泡，用卤水腌制
items.def_en: to soak or preserve food, especially meat, poultry, or vegetables, in salt water

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe immersing solid substances (especially food or leaves) into water or a chemical/saline bath to draw out flavor, extract essence, or achieve curing.
groups.summary_zh: 指把固体浸入盐水或液体中浸渍提取风味，或使液体成分充分渗入。

groups.name: Socialize & Pal Around · 结交往来与混在一起 (Hobnob, Chum, Fraternize)
groups.tip: 建立人际关系与日常为友

items.def_zh: 结交；亲密往来（尤指违背规矩）
items.def_en: (+ with) To associate with people in a friendly, brotherly way, especially when prohibited
(+ with) To spend a great deal of informal, unstructured leisure time in someone's company
(+ with) (chiefly British informal) To quickly form a close, affectionate friendship with someone
1. ('pal up/around with') (informal) To become close friends with someone and spend time together.

items.def_zh: 亲切结交；周旋于（名流圈子）
items.def_en: (+ with) To spend time socializing familiarly with wealthy, prominent, or influential figures

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate informal, companionable social mixing, hanging out, or forming casual buddy relationships. They often imply sharing leisure time or fraternizing across usual social boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 指日常同伴式的频繁往来、打成一片或混迹于特定圈子。

groups.name: Solemn Announcement · 郑重宣布与昭告天下 (Proclaim, Herald, Trumpet)
groups.tip: 公开正式向大众宣告与通报

items.def_en: To make widely known to the public at large without discretion
To display or publicize conspicuously or pompously
To announce or signal that something momentous is starting or arriving

items.def_zh: 宣告，公布；明确显示，表明
items.def_en: 1. To announce something publicly, officially, and solemnly. 2. To make clear or show distinctly.
To welcome, announce, or salute someone or something enthusiastically with public praise

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this group express the solemn, grand, or momentous announcement of major events, titles, sovereign decisions, or historic truths.
groups.summary_zh: 指庄严、隆重且声势浩大地向全社会宣告重大决断、政绩或时期。

groups.name: Solemnize & Consecrate · 举行圣典与仪式 (Solemnize, Commemorate, Consecrate)
groups.tip: 以庄严仪式隆重举行典礼

items.def_en: To celebrate a festival or adhere formally to a ritual, custom, or holiday
To honor the memory of a person or historic event with a formal ceremony or memorial

items.def_zh: 主礼，执事（宗教或法定仪式）
items.def_en: (+ at) To perform the official duties of a ceremony, such as a wedding or funeral

items.def_zh: 庄严举行（婚礼或仪式）；隆重庆祝
items.def_en: (formal) To perform an official ceremony, especially a marriage, with due formality; to celebrate solemnly.
To make or declare something sacred through a solemn religious ceremony

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey performing sanctified, formal, or ritualized public ceremonies, such as marriages, memorial rites, or religious celebrations.
groups.summary_zh: 指依法定程序或宗教礼节隆重举行典礼仪式。

groups.name: Solicit & Canvass · 恳请与游说 (Solicit, Appeal, Canvass)
groups.tip: 从礼貌请求到极力恳请支持

items.def_zh: 极力招徕，竭力争取（支持或业务）
items.def_en: To work hard to gather, encourage, or increase support, business, or interest through energetic effort
(+ for/against) To make a formal written request to an authority or court seeking a particular course of action

items.def_zh: 恳求，请求，征集；招揽（生意）
items.def_en: 1. (+ for/from) To ask someone earnestly for money, help, votes, or information. 2. (formal) To approach people to offer sexual services in exchange for money.
(+ for) To systematically visit people or contact them to ask for votes, political support, or opinions
(+ to/for) To make a serious, urgent, or heartfelt request to the public or an authority for money, help, or mercy

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote formally or persistently approaching individuals or groups to request financial support, political backing, or specific contributions. They range from earnest public appeals to systematic door-to-door petitions.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动向个人或公众正式、执着地恳求援助、捐款或拉票。

groups.name: Solidify & Cement Bonds · 巩固与牢固结合 (Cement, Solidify, Entrench, Galvanize)
groups.tip: 用水泥强力胶结巩固

items.def_zh: 稳固，强化加固（地位/实力）
items.def_en: To strengthen the position, alliance, or power of something so that its foundation becomes unshakable
To make an agreement, plan, or relationship definite, permanent, and hard to disrupt
To unite people or entities into a durable, cohesive relationship or legal commitment

items.def_zh: 巩固，加深（关系等）；用水泥粘结
