items.def_en: 1. To strengthen a relationship, agreement, or position so it lasts. 2. To join bricks, stones, or surfaces together with cement.
To establish an idea, bond, or status so firmly and securely that change is very difficult

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses both literal cementing and its powerful metaphorical extension: permanently consolidating, validating, and sealing alliances, agreements, reputations, or emotional bonds so they endure.
groups.summary_zh: 从字面胶固延伸至抽象层面，牢固巩固盟约、关系、地位或共识。

groups.name: Solidify & Firm Up · 变硬固化与夯实 (Solidify, Firm Up, Harden, Congeal)
groups.tip: 由松散变坚硬稳固

items.def_en: To become physically tighter or more solid, or to finalize and confirm arrangements

items.def_zh: （使）变坚实，（使）变牢固；（使）稳定，确定
items.def_en: 1. To make or become physically firmer, more solid, or compact. 2. (often 'firm up') To make or become settled, definite, or steady.
To become firm, stiff, or solid, or to make something so
To become solid or hard, or to make an agreement, plan, or alliance strong and definite

items.def_zh: 凝结；凝滞（尤指油脂、血液）
items.def_en: To change from a liquid to a thick, soft solid, especially when cooled

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote transitioning from a soft, fluid, or tentative consistency into a firm, rigid, or well-compacted state, applied both to physical substances and to stabilizing agreements or proposals.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理质地变结实硬化，或指计划方案确定夯实。

groups.name: Solo Sexual Stimulation · 手淫与自我性抚慰 (Masturbate, Please oneself, Autoeroticize)
groups.tip: 本能生理发泄与性爱

items.def_en: Stimulate one's own body sexually to reach climax, used as a polite euphemism
Fondle or stroke one's own genital organs for sexual excitement

items.def_zh: 手淫，施行手淫（文雅/书面）
items.def_en: Engage in masturbation or non-conceptive sexual self-pleasure (literary/archaic)

items.raw_cluster: 性行为与自慰 Sex & Masturbate
items.def_en: To stimulate one's own or someone else's genitals for sexual pleasure.
Touch or stroke an intimate body part lovingly or erotically

groups.summary_en: Covering formal, neutral, and polite idiomatic descriptions of stimulating one's own genitalia to attain sexual gratification without a partner.
groups.summary_zh: 通过自我抚弄生殖器官以获取性快感或宣泄冲动。

groups.name: Sorb & Soak Up · 渗透吸收与浸润 (Sorb, Soak up, Permeate)
groups.tip: 液体被介质吸附渗入

items.def_en: To draw in liquid through a porous surface like a sponge or paper
To absorb an excess pool of liquid using an absorbent material
To pass liquid slowly into a substance through small interstices or pores

items.def_zh: （物理/化学）（通过吸收或吸附）吸纳，吸着
items.def_en: (chemistry, physics) To take up and hold a gas, liquid, or solute by either absorption or adsorption.
To spread completely throughout every part of a porous substance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the dual processes of fluids penetrating porous matrices, encompassing both capillary action, surface intake, and complete volumetric saturated penetration.
groups.summary_zh: 液体渗入多孔性介质并滞留，兼具吸收、吸附与全透特性。

groups.name: Soundproof & Acoustic Insulate · 防护与隔离 (Soundproof, Insulate, Deaden)
groups.tip: 安装隔音材料隔绝外界

items.def_en: To install panels, screens, or deflectors designed to deflect and disperse sound waves
To cover or surround an area with a material that prevents the passage of sound, heat, or electricity
To wrap, cover, or line an object or room to deaden sound and prevent acoustic projection
1. To insulate a room, studio, or building so that sound cannot enter or escape.
To reduce, muffle, or absorb sound reverberations through dampening panels or thick fabrics

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve fitting acoustic dampening materials, baffling, or seals to prevent sound vibrations from penetrating, reflecting within, or escaping an enclosed space.
groups.summary_zh: 利用吸音阻隔材料做声学处理，阻断声音出入或消除杂音回响。

groups.name: Sowing & Agricultural Planting · 播种与下种 (Seed, Sow, Drill)
groups.tip: 播下种子悉心培育成苗木

items.def_en: Put a seed, bulb, or young plant into ground so that it will grow
1. To plant seeds in an area of ground. 2. To produce or shed seeds. 3. To remove the seeds from fruit or vegetables.
Sow seeds in regular furrows or rows using an agricultural seeding machine
Throw seeds broadly across the surface of the soil by hand
Plant seeds in or on the ground by scattering or inserting them systematically

groups.summary_en: Covers the agricultural and horticultural act of scattering, burying, or placing seeds, bulbs, or seedlings into prepared earth to foster germination and crop growth.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及农事耕作，指将种子、种苗撒播、点播或植入土壤中以待生长。

groups.name: Spawn & Give Rise To · 催生与促成 (Beget, Breed, Generate)
groups.tip: 孕育孵化并促成新事物

items.def_en: To produce, create, or bring an outcome or state into existence
To cause or cultivate feelings, conflicts, or social conditions to develop
To cause a particular feeling, situation, or phenomenon to happen or emerge
1. To cause something new, large in quantity, or influential to develop or appear. 2. (of fish, frogs, etc.) To lay eggs.
To cause or bring about a subsequent state, reaction, or condition

groups.summary_en: This frame describes giving rise to new ideas, conflicts, movements, or phenomena, often resulting in widespread proliferation or unexpected consequences.
groups.summary_zh: 指催生、衍生或诱发大量新事物、观点与后续事态。

groups.name: Spawn & Reproduce · 繁殖与产卵 (Spawn, Breed, Propagate)
groups.tip: 产生孢子产卵繁殖后代

items.def_en: To mate and produce offspring, or to keep animals or plants for the purpose of reproduction
To release or deposit eggs in water, or to produce or generate something in large numbers
To increase greatly in number by natural reproduction
To reproduce plants or animals naturally or through artificial horticultural cuttings
(biology) To produce or release reproductive spores.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this biological frame refer to organisms producing offspring, releasing gametes, or multiplying through specialized life cycles. They distinguish between mass egg-laying in aquatic life, microscopic spore production, and controlled plant or animal breeding.
groups.summary_zh: 描述生物繁育后代、释放卵子孢子或进行组织繁殖。

groups.name: Spearhead & Coordinate · 统领筹划与调度 (Spearhead, Orchestrate, Steer)
groups.tip: 运筹帷幄主导团队行动方向

items.def_en: To guide the direction, progress, or policy of an organization, committee, or undertaking

items.def_zh: 统领，主导，统筹；担任四分卫
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To lead, direct, or organize a project or activity. 2. (American football) To play the position of quarterback.
To plan and direct a complex, difficult, or covert operation
To arrange and coordinate all the elements of a complex plan or situation to achieve a desired result

items.def_zh: 带头，发起，作为先锋统率
items.def_en: To act as the proactive leader of an attack, project, campaign, or initiative

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on driving, organizing, and executing a major project or campaign from the front, calling tactical plays and aligning team execution.
groups.summary_zh: 统筹谋划并在前线积极调度、牵头推进项目行动。

groups.name: Spearhead & Pioneer · 带头与率先开拓 (Champion, Pioneer, Helm)
groups.tip: 充当带头先锋发起重大攻势

items.def_en: To aggressively fight for, advocate, or lead support for a doctrine or cause
To act as the primary director or leader steering an organization or production
To be the very first person or group to open up, develop, or introduce a new method or idea
To break innovative ground in an unexplored area and guide others behind

items.def_zh: 带头，作……的先锋，做发起人
items.def_en: To lead or act as the driving force behind an attack, campaign, or major project.

groups.summary_en: Verbs here highlight energetic, forefront initiative—breaking ground, launching campaigns, and physically or symbolically driving forward collective enterprises.
groups.summary_zh: 处于行动最前端，带头发起、开拓或推进重大举措。

groups.name: Specialize & Delve · 钻研与精专 (Delve, Specialize, Major)
groups.tip: 由专注投入到融会精通

items.def_en: (+ in) To pursue a specific academic discipline as one's principal subject of study
(+ into) To examine or investigate data, topics, or root causes in thorough detail
To read, study, or examine written material with deep, concentrated absorption

items.def_zh: 专攻，专门研究；专门从事
items.def_en: (+ in) To devote time and attention to a particular subject, area of work, or skill.
(+ into) To search deeply, systematically, and laboriously for information or knowledge

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deep, committed intellectual exploration and sustained professional dedication to a narrow niche. They emphasize profound analytical digging rather than broad, superficial coverage.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重在特定专业或学术领域内做深层剖析与持久专攻。

groups.name: Specialize in Academic Study · 专业修读与主修 (Major, Specialize, Minor)
groups.tip: 求知钻研专攻专业

items.def_en: (+ in) (especially North American) To have something as your main subject of study at a university or college.
(+ on) Center one's academic attention or coursework on a particular topic
(+ in) Pursue a subsidiary academic subject alongside a primary field in college
(+ in/on) Direct one's academic studies toward a specific subfield or discipline
(+ in) Devote oneself to a particular subject, skill, or field of study

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to pursuing a specific discipline or academic concentration in higher education. They contrast in academic hierarchy (primary versus secondary subjects) and the breadth of intellectual focus.
groups.summary_zh: 指在高等教育中选定特定学科深造或主修，体现主次专业与研究重心的差异。

groups.name: Spew & Disgorge · 呕出与喷吐 (Spew, Disgorge, Chunder)
groups.tip: 生理反胃将胃物吐出

items.def_en: (slang, chiefly Australian & British) To vomit or vomit loudly, especially after excessive drinking
To violently discharge stomach contents out onto the ground or floor
To eject stomach contents violently or spray liquid outwards in large quantities
To expel or pour out contents violently from the mouth, belly, or an orifice
(informal, especially North American) To vomit or throw up.

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes the violent, voluminous, or explosive ejection of vomit, liquid, or bile. It focuses visually on the messy, uncontrollable trajectory of fluid discharged outwards.
groups.summary_zh: 指恶心时胃液或秽物像喷泉一样被猛烈喷吐出来。

groups.name: Spin Off & Separate · 剥离与拆分 (Hive off, Spin off, Carve out)
groups.tip: 如分巢般将附属部分剥离独立

items.def_en: To split a company, asset package, or integrated service into its distinct constituent parts
To separate a specific segment or operational unit from a company in order to sell or float it separately
To separate a subsidiary or departmental unit from a larger parent organization, often for independent operation or sale
To form an independent company from a subsidiary or division of a larger existing organization

items.def_zh: 剥离，分立；进入蜂巢，如蜂般群居
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'hive off') To separate a subsidiary or part of a business from a parent organization to form an independent unit. 2. To enter, place in, or live together as in a hive.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on corporate, institutional, or administrative separation, where a unit, division, or function is detached from a parent body to operate independently or be sold off.
groups.summary_zh: 特指将组织、企业或政府机构的部分业务剥离独立或拆分转让。

groups.name: Spiral & Gyrate · 盘旋与螺旋运动 (Spiral, Gyrate, Corkscrew)
groups.tip: 绕轴旋转或呈螺旋状上升

items.def_en: To move in a circular, spiraling current, typically said of water, air, smoke, or dust

items.def_zh: 呈螺旋式移动，盘旋；急剧变化
items.def_en: 1. To move in a continuous circular curve that rises or descends around a central point. 2. To increase or decrease rapidly and continuously.
To move or advance along a twisting, helical trajectory like that of a corkscrew
To move rapidly in circles or in a spiraling motion around a central axis
To whirl rapidly in a circular or spiraling funnel

groups.summary_en: This frame captures motion that traces a continuously widening, tightening, climbing, or descending helix or spiral curve. It contrasts pure flat rotation with 3D helical trajectories or figurative runaway upward/downward trends.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿三维螺旋、盘旋轨迹上升或下降的运动，亦引申为急剧失控的走势。

groups.name: Spit & Expectorate · 咳出与吐出 (Cough up, Spit out, Hawk)
groups.tip: 喉咙咳痰或用力吐出口中物

items.def_en: To force saliva or secretions out of the mouth, often as an uncouth or reflex action
To force phlegm, blood, or foreign matter out of the lungs or throat by coughing
To eject liquid, phlegm, or an objectionable morsel forcefully from the mouth

items.def_zh: 咳出，吐痰，吐出（呼吸道痰黏液）
items.def_en: (formal or medical) To cough up and spit out phlegm or mucus from the throat or respiratory tract.
To clear the throat harshly and bring up phlegm from deep in the chest to spit it out

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the physiological ejection of mucus, saliva, or foreign matter from the lungs, throat, or mouth through respiratory action or deliberate spitting.
groups.summary_zh: 通过咳嗽、清嗓或口腔动作将呼吸道黏液及分泌物排出体外。

groups.name: Splash & Scatter · 飞溅与泼洒 (Splatter, Splash, Spatter)
groups.tip: 液体碰撞击打后向外飞散

items.def_en: To mark or scatter with small spots, specks, or droplets
To move around irregularly with a splashing sound, or spill messy liquid around
To strike a liquid or surface noisily, sending drops or sheets of fluid scattering
To scatter or splash drops of liquid messily onto a surface; to cause a liquid to do this.
To cover a surface with scattered small drops of liquid, or fly out in such drops

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe liquids or semi-liquids striking surfaces or flying outward in scattered, messy droplets.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体或泥浆击打平面后不规则四散飞溅、形成斑驳污渍。

groups.name: Split & Burst Open · 开裂与自然绽破 (Dehisce, Burst, Rupture)
groups.tip: 物体沿缝隙张开或爆裂

items.def_en: To divide or gape along a seam, crack, or natural line of separation
To be or become wide open, as of a fissure or deep wound
To break open or apart suddenly and violently under internal pressure
(botany / medicine) to split or burst open spontaneously along a natural seam, as a seed pod or surgical wound
To break or tear open suddenly, especially an anatomical structure or membrane

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe natural, biological, or pressurized rupture along lines of structural weakness or natural seams. They convey organic splitting or spontaneous popping open rather than fractured mechanical shattering.
groups.summary_zh: 指囊状物、伤口或组织沿缝线自然破裂、绽开或受压爆裂。

groups.name: Spoon & Portion · 匙取与分盛 (Spoon out, Dish out, Dollop)
groups.tip: 用勺子舀出流体食物

items.def_en: to serve food onto plates from a communal serving dish or pot
to transfer food or liquid from a container into a dish using a spoon
to give food to someone, especially baby or invalid, often by spooning it into their mouth

items.def_zh: 用匙舀出，用勺盛取；调情；（两人）紧密相拥而卧
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/out/up) to transfer, lift, or serve food or liquid using a spoon 2. (informal) to cuddle close together facing the same direction, or engage in amorous kissing and petting

items.def_zh: 团盛，随手舀上一大团（稀软物）
items.def_en: to serve or drop a soft, shapeless mass of food onto a plate with a spoon

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail transferring, serving, or measuring food and soft, semi-viscous substances using small cupped domestic utensils. The focus is on measured portioning, domestic food handling, and careful serving.
groups.summary_zh: 强调使用勺匙等细小器具分取、盛出或舀送流质食物。

groups.name: Spread & Disperse · 散布与蔓延 (Disperse, Scatter, Circulate)
groups.tip: 向四面八方扩散蔓延

items.def_en: To move freely around an area, or to pass information, money, or rumors continuously from person to person
To move away from a central point and spread out over a wide expanse in a fan-like formation

items.def_zh: 散播，扩散，蔓延；展开，铺开；涂，敷
items.def_en: 1. To affect a larger area or group of people, or to make something do so. 2. To open out, unfold, or stretch over an area. 3. To apply a thin layer of a substance over a surface.
To quickly move or throw things in different directions over a wide area
To scatter in different directions and disappear, or to cause a crowd, cloud, or substance to do so

groups.summary_en: Describes dynamic spatial propagation across a geographic region, population, or surface—encompassing the rapid transmission of news, diseases, rumors, or moving crowds scattering outward from a focal point.
groups.summary_zh: 指空间上的向外延展、传播或人群散开，如疫情、消息与群体的散布。

groups.name: Spurt & Squirt · 喷射与迸涌 (Squirt, Spurt, Gush)
groups.tip: 液体受压向外细细喷射

items.def_zh: （使）喷出，喷射（细流）；向……喷射液体
items.def_en: To force liquid out in a thin, fast stream, or to be emitted in this way.
To shoot out vigorously in a concentrated, high-velocity stream
To expel large quantities of liquid, gas, or debris rapidly and violently
To gush out in a sudden, forceful, and intermittent stream
To flow or surge out suddenly in vast, powerful quantities

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture liquids or semi-fluids being ejected under sudden hydrostatic pressure in tight, rapid, or pulsatile streams. Nuances distinguish slender pressurized jets from heavier, voluminous torrents.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体在压力下呈线状或脉冲状骤然喷射、涌流。

groups.name: Sputter & Crackle · 噼啪与喷溅 (Crackle, Pop, Sizzle)
groups.tip: 火花迸溅或不连贯噼啪声

items.def_en: To make a short, quick, explosive sound

items.def_zh: 发嘶嘶声；煎得滋滋作响
items.def_en: To make a hissing sound when frying or heating up
To make a series of short, sharp, snapping sounds like dry wood burning

items.def_zh: 发噼啪声，喷溅；结结巴巴地说，气急败坏地嘟囔
items.def_en: 1. To make a series of short popping or spitting sounds, or spray out spitting drops. 2. To speak quickly, incoherently, or in a confused, angry manner.

items.def_zh: 发噗噗声；结结巴巴地嘟囔
items.def_en: To make rapid spitting sounds or speak rapidly and unclearly in confused agitation

groups.summary_en: This frame captures erratic, sharp popping or explosive acoustics accompanied by spattering sparks, droplets, or speech delivered in short, indignant, choking bursts.
groups.summary_zh: 指火星迸裂、油脂煎炸时发出的断续清脆爆破声或激愤含混的话语。

groups.name: Squander & Fritter · 挥霍与耗散 (Squander, Fritter away, Blow)
groups.tip: 不加节制地空耗挥霍资财

items.def_zh: 挥霍，浪费（常与away连用）；切碎
items.def_en: 1. ('fritter away') To waste time, money, or energy gradually on trivial, unimportant things. 2. To cut or tear into small pieces.
To gradually waste time, money, or resources bit by bit on trifling, insignificant things
To spend an enormous sum of money impulsively and wastefully in a very short duration
To gradually scatter and waste away wealth, vitality, or energy until nothing remains
To waste money, assets, or valuable opportunities in a reckless, completely foolish manner

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on expending money, wealth, time, or opportunities foolishly, carelessly, or incrementally until they are completely exhausted. 'Squander' denotes large-scale reckless ruin, while 'fritter away' focuses on bleeding resources through trivial, petty dispersals.
groups.summary_zh: 指愚蠢、漫不经心或琐碎地挥霍浪费金钱、精力与光阴。

groups.name: Squat & Shack · 陋居与混住 (Pig, Shack, Camp out)
groups.tip: 居住定居或混迹生活于某处

items.def_zh: 像猪一样肮脏（或挤在一起）生活；大吃大喝
items.def_en: 1. (+ it / together) (informal) To live in crowded, dirty, or squalid conditions. 2. (+ out) (informal) To eat excessive amounts of food greedily.
(+ with) To live or cohabit casually, often in makeshift quarters or without formal marriage

items.def_zh: 露营；在简陋条件下凑合过日子
items.def_en: To sleep or lodge temporarily in rough, unconventional, or cluttered quarters
To hide or lodge in a secluded or cramped place for an extended period
To stay in temporary, improvised living quarters with minimal shelter

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe living, sleeping, or holing up in untidy, overcrowded, squalid, or makeshift conditions, often evoking disordered domesticity or roughing it informally.
groups.summary_zh: 指在拥挤、杂乱、简陋或不卫生的环境中凑合居住或混居。

groups.name: Squire & Attend · 献殷勤陪同与应酬随侍 (Squire, Attend, Escort out)
groups.tip: 陪同或护卫他人一同前往

items.def_en: (formal) Travel with or accompany an important person as a companion, attendant, or assistant
Go with someone to a station, airport, or doorway to say goodbye when they leave
(old-fashioned, + with) Court, date, or accompany someone socially as an acknowledged romantic partner
Go somewhere socially with someone, such as to a restaurant or theatre, paying for them as host

items.def_zh: 护送，陪同（尤指男子侍从女子）
items.def_en: 1. (dated or humorous) When a man squires a woman, he accompanies and attends her to a social event.

groups.summary_en: Describes gallantly or formally attending, escorting, and waiting upon someone (often in social, romantic, or high-society functions) with chivalry, polite attentiveness, or subservient courtesy.
groups.summary_zh: 带绅士风度或应酬色彩地陪同、服侍特定宾客或异性出游。

groups.name: Stack & Overlap · 叠覆与层叠 (Overlap, Shingle, Lap)
groups.tip: 鳞次栉比逐层重叠覆盖

items.def_en: To fold, project over, or lay one edge over another edge so that they partly cover each other
To cover part of the edge of another object, or to lie partly over another surface

items.def_zh: （使）鳞状重叠，（使）如瓦片般层叠
items.def_en: (formal, biology / architecture) To overlap or cause to overlap in a regular pattern, like roof tiles or fish scales.
To arrange or position items in successive rising horizontal rows, layers, or levels
To lay or arrange boards, tiles, or hair in regular, overlapping rows

groups.summary_en: This structural and geometric frame describes arranging flat, thin, or segmented items so that the edge of one surface partially covers or extends over the edge of the adjacent one in regular, interlocking patterns (as seen on rooftops, scales, or foliage).
groups.summary_zh: 指使物体（如瓦片、鳞片）边缘相互叠盖以形成规则排列的表面。

groups.name: Staff & Command Militarily · 配备将官与统辖 (Staff, Man, Command)
groups.tip: 统领居上位行使号令

items.def_en: To supply a post, fortification, or ship with people to operate or defend it
1. To command, lead, or supply with officers.
To provide a military unit, organization, or office with the necessary personnel or officers
To have formal military authority over a group of soldiers, ship, or operation
To be in charge of an organization, team, or military task force

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on supplying personnel with leadership cadres or exercising formal military authority to supervise, lead, and direct units.
groups.summary_zh: 为部队或机构配备军官/指挥官，并进行正规军事管理统辖。

groups.name: Staff & Post Personnel · 配备人员与守候 (Staff, Crew, Garrison)
groups.tip: 安排人手统管运作

items.def_en: 1. To provide a place, machine, or vehicle with the people needed to operate or defend it.
To provide an organization, service, or facility with employees or workers

items.def_zh: 为（船只、飞机等）配备乘员
items.def_en: To serve as or supply the operating personnel for a ship, aircraft, or vehicle

items.def_zh: 占驻；驻扎（工作岗位或据点）
items.def_en: To take up position in or fill an official post, post station, or premises
To station soldiers in a fortress, base, or town to defend it

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote supplying human operators, guards, or workers to service a post, station, vessel, or operational desk. They emphasize providing functional manpower or establishing active occupancy.
groups.summary_zh: 指为设施、岗位或载具调配并派驻必要的操作及值守人员。

groups.name: Stamp & Trample · 重踏与践踏 (Tramp, Stomp, Tread)
groups.tip: 用力跺脚甚至将物体踩碎

items.def_zh: 重踏，跺（脚），踩碎；盖章于，印上；贴邮票于
items.def_en: 1. To bring down the foot heavily on the ground or onto an object. 2. To print a pattern, mark, or words onto a surface with a special tool. 3. To affix a postage stamp to.

items.def_zh: 沉重步行；迈着沉重的步子走
items.def_en: To walk with heavy, firm footsteps over a long distance
To extinguish a fire by treading forcefully upon it, or eliminate an undesirable practice
To step heavily and noisily onto the ground, often out of anger or frustration
To tread heavily upon someone or something, causing destruction, injury, or flattening

groups.summary_en: This frame covers heavy, forceful downward foot movements driven by emotional turbulence (rage, impatience) or the intent to crush, squash, or punish ground-level entities beneath the soles. Nuances range from noisy auditory beats to destructive crushing.
groups.summary_zh: 强调双足沉重跺击、因怒顿足或以脚底狠踩碾碎物体的动作。

groups.name: Stash & Secret Cache · 隐匿与秘密存留 (Cache, Squirrel Away, Hide Away)
groups.tip: 将物品妥善存放或暗中隐藏

items.def_en: To place something in a secure, concealed location where it cannot easily be found
To save or secretly put away money or valuables for future security
To hide or store money or supplies carefully in a safe place for the future
To store items secretly in a secure hidden location
To store or hide money, valuables, or possessions in a safe or secret place.

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to concealing or setting aside money, valuables, or contraband in a secret or out-of-the-way hiding spot for future retrieval.
groups.summary_zh: 指将财物、贵重品等隐秘存放或藏于暗处以备后用。

groups.name: State & Proclaim Firmly · 声明与郑重宣布 (Declare, Assert, Pronounce)
groups.tip: 从正式声明到昭告天下

items.def_en: To express something definitely or clearly in speech or writing
To make a public and typical formal statement about a fact, event, or intention

items.def_zh: 正式宣布，宣告；郑重声明；申报（应纳税品等）
items.def_en: 1. To announce or state something clearly, firmly, or officially. 2. To formally state taxable goods, income, or possessions.
To state an opinion, decision, or judgment authoritatively or officially
To state something firmly and publicly as true or valid

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses verbs denoting unambiguous, authoritative, and binding announcements, ranging from formal state declarations to personal assertions of fact.
groups.summary_zh: 强调明确、坚定且具权威性地公开陈述立场、裁定或决定。

groups.name: State-Appropriate & Take Over · 强行征用与公有化 (Requisition, Impound, Confiscate)
groups.tip: 将关键命脉收归公有并管辖

items.def_en: To gain full operational control of a business, agency, or country by sovereign authority or force
To officially take possession of a vehicle, goods, or funds until legal requirements are satisfied
To take a person's property away as a legal penalty or sovereign expropriation without payment
To officially demand and take possession of property, supplies, or facilities for government or military service

items.def_zh: 将…收归国有，实行国有化
items.def_en: (chiefly British English) to bring an industry, company, or land under the control and ownership of the government

groups.summary_en: This manner frame highlights the intrusive enforcement and statutory mechanisms of sovereign acquisition. It emphasizes authoritarian commandeering, seizure of private assets, or overriding private property rights under regulatory or state powers.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重公权力通过行政或强制手段接管、扣押私有资产。

groups.name: Sterilize & Disinfect · 消毒与灭菌 (Sterilize, Disinfect, Sanitize)
groups.tip: 清除有害病菌，达到无菌状态

items.def_en: To make hygienic and safe by reducing microorganisms to acceptable public health levels
1. to make something completely clean and free from all bacteria and microorganisms 2. to make a person or animal unable to produce offspring
To clean something with chemicals to destroy the harmful bacteria living on it
To remove hazardous, toxic, chemical, or biological agents from an area or object
To apply chemical fumes or gases to an enclosed area to exterminate pathogens or pests

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the rigorous removal, killing, or inactivation of pathogens, germs, and bacteria from surfaces, instruments, or wounds to achieve sanitary or aseptic safety.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理或化学手段杀灭或清除病原微生物，以达到卫生或无菌状态。

groups.name: Stick Together & Cohere · 凝聚与抱团 (Cling, Congeal, Cleave)
groups.tip: 各部分互相黏附合为一体

items.def_en: (+ to) To stick firmly to a surface or join tightly with other material components
(+ together/to) To hold on tightly to something or stick together securely
To solidify, thicken, or merge into a dense mass; to take a stable unified shape
1. (formal) When parts of an argument, group, or substance cohere, they stick together and form a logical, unified whole.
(+ to) (archaic/literary) To adhere strongly and unshakeably to a person, faith, or bond

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physical cohesion or rational solidarity, where distinct elements stick firmly together to form a stable, indivisible whole or logically unified argument. It spans literal molecular binding and abstract ideological solidarity.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理上的相互粘连凝聚，或抽象层面上紧密粘合、逻辑自洽。

groups.name: Stiffen & Reinforce · 浆硬与加固 (Starch, Stiffen, Taut)
groups.tip: 质地转为僵硬，失去柔软弯折性

items.def_en: To make a structure, material, or position stronger and firmer by adding extra support
To reinforce or support something firmly to make it rigid and steady against physical force
To become tight, rigid, or stretched without slack, or to cause something to do so
to make clothes, linen, or fabric stiff and crisp by applying starch
To make or become firm, taut, rigid, or less flexible

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe treating fabrics, limbs, or structures so that they lose pliability, becoming crisp, firm, and upright.
groups.summary_zh: 指对织物上浆或使肢体结构变得挺括、僵硬而不易弯曲。

groups.name: Stifle & Muffle · 隔音与捂住 (Deadensound, Smother, Gag)
groups.tip: 包裹阻隔减弱发声响度

items.def_en: To prevent a sound or physiological impulse from escaping by holding it back

items.def_zh: 消音，捂住使声音减弱；包裹以保暖
items.def_en: 1. to make a sound quieter or less clear by wrapping or covering the source 2. to wrap someone or something up warmly
To reduce the resonance, sharpness, or clarity of sound through padding or insulation
To suppress or cover a sound, flame, or breath by smothering it with a heavy layer
To put a cloth or object into or over someone's mouth to prevent vocal noise

groups.summary_en: Covers physically covering, wrapping, or obstructing an acoustic source or vocal tract to deaden, dull, or smother the sound produced.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理包裹、遮盖或封堵发声源，达到隔音或压制声响的效果。

groups.name: Still Photography & Snapshot · 照相与抓拍 (Photograph, Snap, Capture)
groups.tip: 运用镜头或绘图记录画面

items.def_en: To photograph a subject, person, or setting with a camera
1. To take a picture of someone or something using a camera. 2. To appear or look in a particular way when photographed.
To take a photograph quickly, casually, or informally
To take a quick series of photographs or snap an immediate picture

items.def_zh: 定格；拍摄捕捉到（画面/神态）
items.def_en: To record or depict a scene, atmosphere, or expression accurately in a photograph

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to taking still images using a camera, capturing a frozen optical likeness of people, scenes, or objects. Nuances contrast formal portrait photography, spontaneous amateur snapping, and high-fidelity artistic capture.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过照相机按动快门凝固瞬间、拍摄静止照片的行为。

groups.name: Stir & Mix Liquids · 搅拌与调和 (Stir, Swirl, Whisk)
groups.tip: 用工具在流体中打转翻动混合

items.def_zh: 翻拌（轻柔混合烘焙配料）
items.def_en: Mix an ingredient gently into another with a lifting, turning motion to avoid knocking out air

items.def_zh: 搅动，搅拌；激起，打动；微动
items.def_en: 1. To move an implement through a liquid or other substance in order to mix it thoroughly. 2. To arouse strong feelings or memories. 3. To move slightly.
Stir or agitate a vat of thick mixture using a paddle or broad flat blade
Move around or cause a liquid to move gently in a circular or spiral pattern
Beat or stir a substance, especially eggs or cream, rapidly with a light wire fork or whisk

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate circular or repetitive mechanical actions used to mix, blend, dissolve, or aerate liquids and loose culinary ingredients using an implement.
groups.summary_zh: 用勺、棒等器具在液体或物料中做圆周运动以混合或溶解。

groups.name: Stir Up Strife & Unrest · 煽动叛乱与挑起冲突 (Foment, Stir Up, Agitate)
groups.tip: 煽风点火挑起事端

items.def_en: Deliberately cause trouble, arguments, or bad feelings among people.
Deliberately excite or escalate intense emotions, enthusiasm, or anger in a crowd.
Arouse or inspire an intense emotion, passion, or dispute as if setting a fire.
Campaign vigorously and publicly to stir public concern or political unrest.
1. (formal) To deliberately stir up or instigate trouble, rebellion, or violent discontent. 2. (medical, dated) To bathe a body part with warm liquids.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this political and conflict frame describe deliberately generating, nurturing, and spreading rebellion, ideological discontent, or mass unrest from behind the scenes.
groups.summary_zh: 指在幕后蓄意挑起、策划并滋长反叛、动乱或群体敌对情绪。

groups.name: Stopper & Block · 堵塞与封塞 (Plug, Obstruct, Clog)
groups.tip: 用塞子或屏障堵截孔道流通

items.def_en: To block or close an opening or hole by inserting a piece of suitable material firmly into it
To block or become blocked with an accumulation of thick or solid matter so movement stops
to close or seal an opening or container with a stopper or plug.
To overcrowd, block, or clog an artery, passage, or system with an excessive volume of matter
To restrict or stop the flow, passage, or development of something entirely

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on inserting a solid obstruction or allowing a substance to accumulate in a conduit, opening, or pipe, halting the flow of liquids, gases, or traffic.
groups.summary_zh: 以栓塞填塞孔道或沉积阻碍物，阻断流体通行流动。

groups.name: Store & Keep Safe · 存储与留存备用 (Keep, Reserve, Hold)
groups.tip: 妥善存放以备后用

items.def_en: To retain possession of something or store it continually in a specific spot

items.def_zh: 储藏，储存；（在计算机中）保存，存储
items.def_en: 1. To keep or put something away for future use. 2. To keep data or information in a computer.
To keep something back or set it apart for a particular future use
To place items, furniture, or goods inside a warehouse or storage facility
To contain, shelter, or hold something within an enclosure or structure

groups.summary_en: This frame centres on retaining, holding, or archiving physical objects, provisions, or digital data in a designated location so that they remain available for future use.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物品、物资或数据存放在指定场所保存备用。

groups.name: Straddle & Span · 跨立与横跨 (Span, Bridge, Bestride)
groups.tip: 跨立或定位于某一支撑点

items.def_en: To pass or extend from one side of a surface, line, or border to the other
To build a passage over an obstacle, or reduce the difference between two contrasting things
To extend across or bridge a physical distance, time period, or range of topics

items.def_zh: 跨立于，跨坐于；横跨（两地或两领域）
items.def_en: To sit, stand, or lie with one leg on each side of something, or to extend across two different areas or periods.
To stand or sit with one leg on each side of something, or to dominate an entire sphere

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical or figurative positions where a body or structure extends across two sides, boundaries, or categories, maintaining a stance over an intervening space or divide.
groups.summary_zh: 指双腿分开跨立，或在物理与抽象意义上横跨两个领域或界限。

groups.name: Strand & Trap · 受困与搁浅 (Maroon, Trap, Corner)
groups.tip: 陷于困境动弹不得

items.def_en: To run a ship onto the seabed or shallow shore, or prohibit aircraft from flying
To drive an opponent or prey into a tight location leaving no avenue for flight
To confine someone or an animal in a hazardous place from which escape is impossible

items.def_zh: 使搁浅；使陷于困境，使滞留
items.def_en: To leave someone, a boat, or a vehicle stuck in a place with no way of leaving.
To leave someone abandoned in an isolated place, such as a deserted island, without means of return

groups.summary_en: Pertains to isolating people, vessels, or animals in a precarious or isolated environment without resources or practical means of escape.
groups.summary_zh: 指因事故、地理阻断或危险境地而受困或滞留无法离开。

groups.name: Stratify & Grade · 分层与分级 (Gradate, Rank, Tier)
groups.tip: 按梯次与类别，界限分明划层

items.def_en: To classify or separate things according to quality, rank, size, or difficulty
To pass or arrange through imperceptible or successive stages or shades
To arrange or organize things into multiple levels or layers of hierarchy
To position people or things in an ordered sequence of seniority, value, or excellence
1. (sociology / geology) To divide or form into distinct social classes, layers, or strata.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with ordering items, society, or materials into ranked levels, geological strata, or hierarchical tiers. They emphasize progressive gradation, structural layers, or institutional ranking.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将事物、社会或物质依层次、高低等级或结构分层归类。

groups.name: Stray & Derail · 偏离与脱轨 (Derail, Run aground, Go astray)
groups.tip: 车体脱轨或走离正轨

items.def_en: Become lost or go off track physically, or fail to follow the proper course morally or procedurally

items.def_zh: 使转入岔道；使脱离主旨
items.def_en: Divert someone or something from the main topic, task, or course of action
Come onto the shore or hit bottom; metaphorically encounter an insurmountable impasse
1. (of a train) To run off its tracks, or cause a train to do this. 2. To obstruct, spoil, or prevent a plan or process from continuing successfully.
Deliberately derail or cause a plan, venture, or negotiation to fail

groups.summary_en: Focuses on vehicles or processes losing their guided track, causing systemic breakdown, disruption, or failure. It strongly contrasts physical derailment with metaphorical sabotage of negotiations, plans, and initiatives.
groups.summary_zh: 指火车出轨或规划、进程脱离预设轨道并走向失败中断。

groups.name: Strengthen & Enhance · 强化与增效 (Supercharge, Boost, Amp up)
groups.tip: 大幅提升威力与效能

items.def_en: To increase, improve, or encourage the power, value, or performance of something
To make something much stronger, louder, more exciting, or more intense

items.def_zh: 给……装涡轮增压；强力加速
items.def_en: To make something grow, develop, or operate much faster and more forcefully than normal
To become or make something become more active, energetic, or productive

items.def_zh: 大幅增强，给……强力增效；为（发动机）增压
items.def_en: 1. To greatly increase the power, efficiency, or intensity of something. 2. To supply an internal combustion engine with air or fuel at greater than atmospheric pressure.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this dynamic frame describe drastically ramping up the speed, output, intensity, or capability of an engine, system, process, or asset far beyond its baseline parameters.
groups.summary_zh: 指大幅提升系统、效能或力量，使其进入高强度的运行状态。

groups.name: Stretch & Sprawl · 伸展与摊开 (Loll, Spread out, Stretch out)
groups.tip: 手脚摊开或无序扩张

items.def_en: To extend your arms and legs wide across a space while resting or lounging

items.def_zh: 躺下伸展身体；舒展四肢
items.def_en: To lie down at full length to rest or relax your muscles comfortably

items.def_zh: 懒散惬意地躺卧或闲坐
items.def_en: To lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed and lazy way, typically in a soft chair or sofa

items.def_zh: 伸开四肢坐（或躺）；（城市、植物等）杂乱无章地蔓延，随意扩展
items.def_en: 1. To sit or lie with arms and legs spread out untidily or carelessly. 2. To spread out in an irregular or uncontrolled way over a large area.

items.def_zh: 懒洋洋地坐卧；懒散倚靠
items.def_en: To sit, lie, or stand in a lazy, relaxed, or floppy posture without firm support

groups.summary_en: Describes adopting a relaxed, careless, or languid posture where the limbs or body are loosely extended across a surface. Often contrasts purposeful stretching with lazy recumbence.
groups.summary_zh: 描述肢体随意舒展或懒散瘫坐的姿态，强调松弛与无拘无束。

groups.name: Strike & Swipe · 侧扫与挥击 (Swipe, Lash out, Flail)
groups.tip: 侧向抡动武器或利爪挥击

items.def_zh: 挥击，猛打；刷（磁卡）；滑屏；偷窃
items.def_en: 1. To hit or swing at someone or something with a wide, sweeping blow. 2. To pass a card through an electronic reader, or slide a finger across a screen. 3. (informal) To steal
To hit someone or something forcefully, making a loud, dull slapping or thudding sound
To hit something, especially an insect, with a sharp, quick, sweeping blow using a flat object
To suddenly attempt to hit someone with a sweeping blow of a limb, weapon, or verbal fury
To hit someone or something hard with the hand or a heavy blunt object in a swinging arc

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts sudden lateral or sweeping arm/limb movements aimed at striking an opponent or target, often with wide trajectory and variable precision. 'Swipe' indicates a swift horizontal cut or blow, while 'lash out' conveys aggressive kicking or swinging.
groups.summary_zh: 指甩动肢体或器具横向扫击、侧抡，常带迅猛攻势或防卫性质。

groups.name: Strike Resonantly · 鸣金与振响敲击 (Gong, Chime, Toll)
groups.tip: 重力击打发出响声

items.def_en: To ring out with a clear, resonant musical bell sound
To strike a large bell slowly and repeatedly to signal a solemn event
To strike a gong to produce a resonant sound, often as a signal.
To make or cause to make a loud, resonant metallic ringing sound
To ring out loudly and sonorously, especially a set of church bells

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on striking a metal or acoustic instrument/object to yield a deep, sustained, resonant sound, typically functioning as an auditory announcement or solemn signal.
groups.summary_zh: 指敲击锣、钟等金属或发声物件使其发出浑厚鸣响，多用于鸣钟报时或信号传递。

groups.name: Strip & Divest · 剥夺头衔与褫夺公权 (Strip, Divest, Dispossess)
groups.tip: 从取消权利到剥个精光

items.def_en: (+ of) Dismiss someone from a duty, command, or post, often due to misconduct
(+ of) Officially deprive someone of power, rights, or possessions

items.def_zh: 剥除；彻底抹去（表象、特权）
items.def_en: Systematically remove layers, advantages, or protections from someone or something

items.def_zh: 剥夺，夺走；剥去，脱去（衣服）；拆卸
items.def_en: 1. To take away an honor, possession, or rank from someone. 2. To take off your clothes, or remove the surface covering of something.
(+ of) Deprive someone of the possession of land, property, or heritage

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote forcefully, legally, or punitively stripping someone of ranks, titles, possessions, or official privileges, often as a severe public sanction.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、法律或强力强行削夺当事人的职衔或财产。

groups.name: Stroke & Brush · 抚摩与轻擦 (Stroke, Pat, Brush)
groups.tip: 动作温柔缓慢地顺着单向抚摸

items.def_en: Touch or sweep lightly past someone or something in passing with a smooth movement
Touch someone or something gently several times with a flat hand as an expression of affection or reassurance
Touch something lightly in passing without hitting or gripping it firmly
1. To move your hand, a brush, or another object gently and repeatedly over a surface, usually in one direction.
Move your hand, a cloth, or an object back and forth firmly or gently over a surface

groups.summary_en: Covers moving one's hand, finger, or an implement gently and repetitively along a surface. It emphasizes smooth, soothing, or tactile directional contact rather than necessarily sexual touch.
groups.summary_zh: 强调手或工具顺着表面平稳、轻柔、有方向地滑动抚摩。

groups.name: Strut & Stride · 阔步与昂首行进 (Strut, Stride, Stalk)
groups.tip: 大步流星与昂首阔步

items.def_en: (+ into/across) To walk purposefully with long, decisive, and confident steps

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步，趾高气扬地走；支撑
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To walk proudly and stiffly with your chest out, trying to look important.

items.def_zh: 蹦蹦跳跳地走；得意扬扬地大摇大摆
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To walk or move with bouncing, ostentatious, or exaggerated steps

items.def_zh: 摇曳生姿地走；招摇而行
items.def_en: To walk in an airy, showy, or conspicuous manner, typically with exaggerated hip movements

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆；昂首晃肩地走
items.def_en: To walk in a defiant, arrogant, or boastfully confident way with swinging shoulders

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies manners of walking characterized by visible arrogance, supreme confidence, self-importance, or imposing, purposeful strides designed to assert presence.
groups.summary_zh: 指昂首挺胸、大步迈进或得意洋洋展现威势与自负的步态。

groups.name: Sublime & Elevate · 升华与提炼 (Sublime, Transmute, Elevate)
groups.tip: 去除粗劣杂质，提升内在本质

items.def_zh: （使）升华，提升（思想、情感或品质）；（使）（物质）升华
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To elevate, purify, or refine feelings, thoughts, or desires into something noble or high-minded. 2. (chemistry) To change directly from a solid into vapor without melting, or cause to do so.
To give someone or something a noble quality or dignity
To purify or free from material considerations by infusing with spiritual character

items.def_zh: 蜕变；使质变为更高级形态
items.def_en: To change or be changed completely into something different and usually higher or better
To direct strong emotional or sexual desires into more socially acceptable or productive activities

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to purifying, elevating, or transforming raw feelings, base instincts, or physical substances into higher, morally refined, or noble states. The focus is on qualitative spiritual, artistic, or chemical transmutation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将粗陋情感、本能或原始物质升华、提炼为高尚优美状态。

groups.name: Submerge & Inundate · 漫灌与没顶 (Inundate, Submerge, Swamp)
groups.tip: 被大量液体彻底没过

items.def_en: To dip or plunge completely into a liquid so that it is thoroughly covered.
To drench or soak thoroughly by pouring liquid over or plunging directly into liquid.
To overwhelm or fill something, especially a boat, with water so that it flounders or sinks.
To cause something to go underwater or beneath the surface of a liquid completely.

items.def_zh: 淹没，浸水；使应接不暇，使充满
items.def_en: 1. To cover an area of land with a large flood of water. 2. (+ with) (usually passive) To overwhelm someone with a huge number of things to deal with.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physical immersion or swamping of objects or land beneath water, or metaphorically burying someone under an unmanageable load of demands, tasks, or information.
groups.summary_zh: 强调水位升高将物体没顶浸入水中，或引申为负担过于沉重以致无法招架。

groups.name: Submerge & Plunge · 下潜与潜水 (Submerge, Dip, Duck)
groups.tip: 头朝下纵身扎入或向下扑

items.def_en: To briefly immerse oneself or an object into liquid and quickly emerge
To plunge downward or submerge the head and body rapidly beneath water

items.def_zh: 跳水；头朝下扑；俯冲，急降
items.def_en: To jump headfirst into water; to plunge or move steeply downward through air or space.
To go below the surface of water or cover completely with liquid
To sweep down through the air with a sudden, sweeping motion

groups.summary_en: Addresses moving deliberately beneath the surface of a liquid or swooping steeply through an enveloping medium. Nuances differentiate between formal submersion, brief dips, and tactical descents.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重主体主动钻入水下、没入液体或向下俯冲潜行。

groups.name: Substantiate & Corroborate · 证实与充实佐证 (Substantiate, Corroborate, Back up, Bear out)
groups.tip: 提出实据佐证论点，证实推断真实可信

items.def_en: To support an assertion, argument, or individual with convincing facts or data
To prove that a claim, prediction, or hypothesis was correct all along
To provide fresh, independent evidence or details that confirm a theory, story, or finding
To demonstrate that a contested statement, decision, or person was right and justified after skepticism
(formal) To provide facts or evidence to prove that an accusation, statement, or claim is true.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses bringing forward solid empirical evidence, records, or independent testimony to verify claims, allegations, or theories that would otherwise remain unproven.
groups.summary_zh: 提供确凿的事实、物证或外部记录，支撑并坐实某项主张或说法。

groups.name: Succeed & Triumph · 成功与达成 (Prevail, Prosper, Triumph)
groups.tip: 顺利达成既定目标取得胜果

items.def_zh: 成功，达到目的；继任，接替
items.def_en: 1. To achieve the desired aim or result. 2. To take over an official position, title, or role after someone else.
(informal) To turn out well or develop successfully according to expectations
(+ over) To achieve a decisive victory or great success against odds
(+ against / over) To prove more powerful or effective and win out after struggle
To become financially successful, healthy, or strong over a sustained period

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses achieving deliberate goals, flourishing over time, or emerging victorious against adversity and resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 表示达成既定目标、走向繁荣或最终胜出的动词群。

groups.name: Sudden Sharp Pulls · 猛抽与骤拉 (Jerk, Yank, Snap)
groups.tip: 施加拉力拽动位移

items.def_en: To pull or jerk something with a quick, slight suddenness
To move or pull into a position with a quick, sharp cracking sound or motion

items.def_zh: 猛拉，急拽；猛然一动，抽动
items.def_en: 1. To pull, move, or twist suddenly and sharply. 2. To make a quick, sudden movement.
To pull someone or something with a sudden, forceful, and sharp movement
To pull, strain, or twist someone or something violently away from a fixed position

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote abrupt, violent, and highly sudden pulling or twitching motions delivered with sharp force rather than sustained traction.
groups.summary_zh: 指动作极其突兀、迅猛且干脆的猛扯、猝抽或反冲性拉动。

groups.name: Sue & Litigate · 民事起诉与索赔诉讼 (Sue, Litigate, File Suit)
groups.tip: 向法庭呈请诉讼追究刑民责任

items.def_zh: 控告，提起诉讼；请求，恳求
items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To make a formal legal claim against someone in a court of law. 2. (+ for) (formal) To make a humble, earnest request for something, such as peace.
(+ against) To formally begin a legal action or lawsuit against someone in court
To start legal proceedings against someone to resolve a disagreement or obtain financial compensation
To bring a lawsuit against someone who has already filed a lawsuit against you
To take a claim or dispute to a court of law, or to resolve a dispute through the court system

groups.summary_en: Pertains to private individuals or corporate entities initiating civil legal proceedings to claim damages or enforce rights. 'Sue' is standard and direct, while 'litigate' describes carrying out legal disputes in court more broadly.
groups.summary_zh: 指民事主体为索赔或维权依法向法院提起诉讼并进行民事抗辩。

groups.name: Suffocate & Gag · 哽呛与窒息 (Gag, Stifle, Suffocate)
groups.tip: 气道受阻无法换气窒息而亡

items.def_en: Struggle desperately to take in air with wide, convulsive mouth movements
Experience severe difficulty breathing or cause airway obstruction due to food, smoke, or constriction
Choke or retch involuntarily because something blocks the throat or triggers the gag reflex
Prevent someone from breathing easily, or feel oppressed by extremely hot, stuffy air
To die or cause someone to die because of not being able to breathe; to feel trapped or stifled.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses internal coughing/spasm sensations from swallowed matter or oppressive atmospheric lack of fresh air, leaving the subject gasping, stifled, or unable to draw breath.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重由吸入异物呛噎，或因空气闷滞憋闷而感到窒息。

groups.name: Sulk & Pout · 撅嘴与生闷气 (Pout, Sulk, Mope, Brood)
groups.tip: 面露愠色独坐一旁赌气噘嘴

items.def_en: To exhibit a morose or sullen facial attitude when crossed

items.raw_cluster: 生闷气与抱怨 Sulk & Pout
items.def_en: To push out your lips to show annoyance, sulkiness, or disappointment, or to look sexually attractive.
To wander about or sit listlessly, indulging in self-pity and gloom
(+ on/over) To dwell gloomily and persistently on unpleasant or resentful thoughts
To remain silent, bad-tempered, and uncommunicative out of annoyance or resentment

groups.summary_en: Verbs focused on non-verbal, petulant displays of resentment, silence, or withdrawal, commonly expressing childish displeasure or brooding irritation.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦以撅嘴、冷战沉默或郁郁寡欢宣泄不满与委屈的情态动作。

groups.name: Summarize & Encapsulate · 概括与浓缩 (Capsule, Digest, Synthesize)
groups.tip: 提炼要旨浓缩精髓，高度概括核心内容

items.def_en: Express the most important facts or points about something in a short statement
State again the primary points that have just been discussed

items.def_zh: 概括，浓缩；封装，装入胶囊
items.def_en: 1. To express or summarize the essential features of something concisely. 2. To enclose something in or as if in a capsule.
Serve as a perfect, concise example or summary of a quality or feature
Extract the essential meaning or most vital elements from complex information

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express condensing complex concepts, narratives, or datasets into their core essence or an overarching representation. 'Encapsulate' focuses on crystal-clear packaging of essentials, while 'sum up' and 'crystallize' capture synthesis and definitive closure.
groups.summary_zh: 指提炼并高度浓缩事物核心本质与主要特征。

groups.name: Summarize & Outline · 概述与提纲 (Delineate, Sketch, Draft)
groups.tip: 概括大意勾勒轮廓

items.def_en: 1. To describe the main facts, ideas, or structure of something briefly. 2. To draw or show the outer edge of something.
Give a brief, broad account or description without detailed exposition
Plan or indicate the overall shape or main features roughly before refining details
Add substantial details or substance to an outline or skeleton plan
Describe, outline, or present the boundary lines or specific stages of something

groups.summary_en: This frame describes laying out the structural skeleton, boundaries, or broad strokes of a plan, idea, or document without exhausting every minor detail. 'Outline' emphasizes framework, whereas 'sketch' highlights quick, provisional presentation.
groups.summary_zh: 指勾勒结构骨架、罗列大纲要点或作粗略说明。

groups.name: Summon & Convene · 召集与召开 (Convoke, Convene, Assemble)
groups.tip: 传讯或正式通知大家集合

items.def_en: To order or ask members of a group to assemble in one location
To come together in a single place, or to bring people or components together into one body
To arrange for people to come together for a formal meeting, or to assemble as a group
To bring people together, especially troops, for battle, inspection, or duty

items.def_zh: 召集（会议）；召集（人员）开会
items.def_en: (formal) To call people together for a formal meeting or assembly, or to arrange such a meeting.

groups.summary_en: Formal verbs governing the authoritative gathering of councils, parliaments, committees, or delegates for official proceedings.
groups.summary_zh: 指行使法定职权或官方名义集合会议、聚集代表讨论议事。

groups.name: Summon & Subpoena · 传唤与司法传讯 (Subpoena, Summon, Cite)
groups.tip: 法庭传票正式传讯出庭作证

items.def_en: To order someone to appear before a court of law, often for a minor offense

items.def_zh: 签发传票责令调取文件
items.def_en: To order a person under penalty of law to bring specified physical evidence to court
To officially order someone to appear or give evidence
To officially order someone to appear in a court of law
(law) To officially order someone to appear in court or produce evidence using a subpoena.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame involve formally and authoritatively commanding a witness, defendant, or document holder to appear before a court or investigative body under penalty of law.
groups.summary_zh: 指司法或监管机构依法正式传唤当事人或调取证物。

groups.name: Supersede & Oust · 取代、废替与罢黜 (Supersede, Supplant, Oust)
groups.tip: 后来居上直接接替旧事物

items.def_en: To take over the place or position of someone or something that previously dominated
To take precedence over or set aside an existing decision, rule, or mechanism
To force someone out of a position of authority, power, or place

items.def_zh: 取代；篡替（常带策略或竞争性）
items.def_en: To take the place of someone or something, often through superiority, force, or scheming
(variant of supersede) To take the place of a person or thing that is old, obsolete, or no longer useful.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate taking over the position, role, or primacy of an incumbent person, institution, or outdated standard, usually rendering the predecessor obsolete or dislodged.
groups.summary_zh: 指后来居上取代原有的人事、制度或旧标准，使其被废弃、挤走或淘汰。

groups.name: Supersede & Oust · 迭代与取代 (Supplant, Displace, Oust)
groups.tip: 更新换代更替，旧物被新物取代

items.def_en: To force something out or prevent it from flourishing by taking over available space or resources
To take the position or role of someone or something, forcing them out of their place
To take the place of someone or something, often by becoming superior or more effective
To force someone out of a position, job, or territory, especially through competition or authority
(formal) To take the place of a person or thing that is old, obsolete, or no longer useful.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe displacing or rendering previous entities, practices, or technologies obsolete through succession or competitive superiority. Nuances range from gradual technological obsolescence to forceful expulsion.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过技术革新、版本演进或强制排挤，使旧事物或在位者被淘汰。

groups.name: Support & Champion · 倡导与全力捍卫 (Champion, Espouse, Crusade)
groups.tip: 从日常支持上升为带头捍卫

items.def_en: To publicly recommend, urge, or argue in favor of a specific policy, cause, or course of action
To actively defend or vigorously support a person, belief, or right against criticism or attack
To choose to support, adopt, or promote a particular set of ideas, principles, or beliefs publicly
1. To vigorously support, defend, or fight for a person, principle, or cause.

items.def_zh: 为……发起长期的声讨或斗争
items.def_en: (+ for / against) To engage in a vigorous, impassioned concerted effort for or against a public issue

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on taking an active, visible, and combative role in defending or promoting a cause, movement, or vulnerable group. While 'champion' implies publicly fighting for and safeguarding rights or beliefs, related verbs convey committed advocacy or aggressive campaigning.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以战斗姿态或高度使命感积极倡导、捍卫某项事业或原则。

groups.name: Support & Endorse · 官方背书与公开赞同 (Endorse, Back, Sanction)
groups.tip: 赞同主张或背书支持

items.def_en: To support a plan, person, or organization with money, influence, or vocal agreement
To formally support a proposal, motion, or nomination in a meeting before debate or voting
To express confidence in someone's reliability, character, or the truth of a statement
To formally authorize, permit, or approve of an action or course of events

items.def_zh: 支持，赞同；（公开）代言（产品）；背书（支票等）
items.def_en: 1. To publicly declare approval or support of someone or something. 2. To appear in advertisements to recommend a product. 3. To sign the back of a cheque.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote granting public, official, or reputational backing to a person, candidate, product, or plan. Whereas 'endorse' signifies an explicit formal approval or celebrity sponsorship, synonyms like 'back' and 'vouch for' span from political financing to personal character warranties.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过名誉、权威或正式声明公开赞许并担保某人或某方案。

groups.name: Support & Fasten · 支架引缚与网格支撑 (Trellis, Lattice, Espalier)
groups.tip: 搭设棚架支撑植物攀爬

items.def_en: To fasten plants, stems, or vines to stakes or canes using cord or garden twine for vertical support
To tie or steady a growing plant to a wooden or metal post driven into the ground

items.def_zh: 装以格子架构；使呈网格状支撑
items.def_en: To furnish an opening or surface with crisscross framework, or to train foliage across a latticed screen

items.def_zh: 为……搭设棚架，把（植物）固定在棚架上
items.def_en: 1. To support, train, or grow climbing plants on a trellis or lattice framework.

items.def_zh: 使（树木）在攀缘架或墙面上修剪平展生长
items.def_en: To train a fruit tree or climbing shrub to grow flat against a wall, wire, or trellis pattern

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote training, supporting, or fastening growing plants along ornamental wooden, metal, or wire frameworks. 'Trellis' centers on guiding vines onto a lattice framework, whereas synonyms specify architectural training against flat walls or wire configurations.
groups.summary_zh: 指将藤蔓或枝条攀扎、引缚在特定棚架或网状构件上以助其生长。

groups.name: Support & Fortify · 构筑斜撑与加固强化 (Buttress, Fortify, Strengthen)
groups.tip: 设桩支托加固结构

items.def_en: To make a material, structure, or defensive line firmer, more unyielding, and less flexible
To support an unstable wall or ceiling using stout wooden or metal beams

items.def_zh: 设防加固；增强防卫能力
items.def_en: To strengthen a place against attack by building defenses, or to physically enhance resistance
1. To support or reinforce a wall with a buttress. 2. To strengthen or support an argument, belief, or system.

items.def_zh: 用皮带扎紧；为……加固准备
items.def_en: To encircle, bind, or secure with a belt or band, or to steel and reinforce someone or something for an ordeal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express the reinforcement of an exterior wall, barrier, or intellectual defense to withstand heavy strain or bombardment. 'Buttress' evokes exterior masonry supports or heavy corroboration of claims, whereas 'fortify' and 'stiffen' emphasize augmenting defensive strength.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重建造外部扶垛或注入加固力量以抵御外部冲击与负荷。

groups.name: Support & Fortify · 环栅圈护与桩栅设防 (Palisade, Stockade, Barricade)
groups.tip: 修筑栅栏工事设防

items.def_zh: 筑栅栏围护；用排桩设防
items.def_en: To enclose, fortify, or secure an area with an upright barrier of heavy timber posts
To completely surround or enclose a parcel of land or structure with a wooden or metal fence
To fortify, surround, or protect a location with a broad defensive embankment or earthwork wall
To build an impromptu defensive barrier across a road, entrance, or space to obstruct access
1. To surround, enclose, or fortify an area with a fence of pointed stakes.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on enclosing, defending, or barricading an perimeter by erecting stakes, timber palisades, or defensive barriers. While 'palisade' specifies planting a wall of pointed wooden stakes, kindred verbs cover surrounding enclosures with heavy logs or improvised obstacles.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过修筑木桩栅栏、路障等物理屏障实施外围设防圈护。

groups.name: Support & Sustain · 作为基底与深层根植 (Underlie, Ground, Undergird)
groups.tip: 作为底层基础提供长久支撑

items.def_en: (+ in) To base an argument, belief, or method firmly on reality, empirical facts, or primary principles

items.def_zh: 贯穿并深刻影响；构成的基础
items.def_en: To be the essential pervading quality, principle, or underlying influence shaping a style or philosophy
To embed or establish something deeply and immovably within a tradition, experience, or environment
To fix something firmly in place or establish a secure, immutable foundation for ideas or values

items.def_zh: 构成……的基础，作为……的内在原因；位于……之下
items.def_en: 1. To be the basis, cause, or foundation of something. 2. To lie under or beneath something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate being the latent foundation, fundamental cause, or subterranean stratum upon which visible phenomena rest. 'Underlie' denotes existing beneath the surface as the root origin, while 'anchor' and 'ground' emphasize giving firm, immovable stability to abstract concepts.
groups.summary_zh: 充当事物底层的根基、驱动原因或支撑性基岩。

groups.name: Support & Undergird · 奠定基石与巩固支撑 (Undergird, Underpin, Bolster)
groups.tip: 从底层构筑坚固支撑

items.def_en: To make an idea, belief, structure, or policy stronger and more dependable
To improve something or make it stronger, more resilient, or more confident
To give support, strength, or a basic structure to something such as an argument, economy, or system
To provide evidence, facts, or proof that underpins the validity of a claim or theory

items.def_zh: 从底层支撑，加固，夯实（基础）
items.def_en: 1. To support, strengthen, or provide the underlying foundation for a system, theory, or structure.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing a deep structural, theoretical, or institutional foundation that keeps a larger system, policy, or argument stable. While 'undergird' emphasizes supplying fundamental bedrock support, synonyms like 'underpin' and 'substantiate' focus on grounding claims and structures solidly.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重为制度、理论或体系提供底层支柱与根基性支撑。

groups.name: Suppress & Stifle · 压制与扼杀 (Hush, Smother, Stifle)
groups.tip: 以强力手段扼杀言论与异见

items.def_en: To prevent facts about an embarrassing, illegal, or unethical matter from becoming known

items.def_zh: 压制，扼杀，掩盖（丑闻或异见）；掐死，扼杀（为解剖谋杀）
items.def_en: 1. (dated) To suppress, stifle, or hush up a discussion, inquiry, or scandal quietly. 2. (historical) To murder someone by suffocation in order to sell the body.
To stop something from happening, developing, or continuing through heavy-handed control
To extinguish or suppress a movement, scandal, or discussion completely

items.def_zh: 迅速制止；压制（传言/异议）
items.def_en: To put a complete and forceful stop to a rumor, protest, or opposition immediately

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on deliberate, often underhanded or ruthless actions to choke off debate, kill investigations, or extinguish political dissent before it gains traction.
groups.summary_zh: 指动用手段封杀讨论、扼杀调查或悄然平息丑闻异见。

groups.name: Suppurate & Fester · 化脓与溃烂 (Fester, Weep, Ulcerate)
groups.tip: 伤口恶化感染排脓溃烂

items.def_en: To swell and fill with pus prior to bursting
To exude clear fluid, pus, or blood steadily from a surface lesion
To become infected and develop pus, deteriorating over time
(formal, medicine) To form or discharge pus.
To break out in or become afflicted with an open inflammatory sore

groups.summary_en: This biological frame captures progressive infection and tissue decay marked by inflammation, purulent discharge, and chronic rotting of untreated wounds.
groups.summary_zh: 描述伤口感染发炎、蓄积并排出脓液或软组织持续恶化腐烂的病理变化。

groups.name: Surface Exposure & Geological Emergence · 地表露出与岩层突现 (Outcrop, Protrude, Jut)
groups.tip: 岩层或现象由地下露头显出

items.def_en: Of rock or mineral strata, to appear exposed directly at the earth's surface
To stick out prominently beyond the surrounding surface or main body
To rise up and break above the surface of a liquid, ground, or surrounding cover
To stick out from or through something, becoming conspicuously visible
(geology) of a rock formation or stratum, to appear exposed above the surface of the ground

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on natural or geological features breaking through a covering plane to become visible above the ground or surrounding medium. It emphasizes physical exposure, structural protrusion, and spatial prominence.
groups.summary_zh: 强调地层、岩石或结构穿透表层、突出显露在地表或基质之上的状态与过程。

groups.name: Surge & Billow · 汹涌与翻腾 (Surge, Roll, Swell)
groups.tip: 大股巨浪或浓烟翻滚

items.def_en: To move in a circular or spiral direction like a whirlpool or curling smoke
To arrive or move across an area in large undulating waves or banks, as fog or tide
To become larger, rounder, or rise up in smooth undulating mounds
1. (of smoke, cloud, or fabric) To swell outward and roll upward in great waves or masses.
To move forward rapidly and powerfully in a sudden wave or flow

groups.summary_en: This frame describes large masses—such as water, smoke, cloud, or fabric—swelling, undulating, and rolling outward in powerful or majestic waves.
groups.summary_zh: 形容烟雾、水流或布匹大片翻滚涌动、波涛起伏。

groups.name: Surge & Skyrocket · 激增与暴涨 (Rocket, Soar, Surge)
groups.tip: 高高翱翔或如火箭般急升

items.def_en: To increase suddenly and powerfully in value, quantity, or intensity
To grow or increase dramatically in a very short period
To increase or rise extremely quickly and suddenly; to move very fast.
To rise, increase, or ascend rapidly to a remarkably high level
To rise extremely fast and steeply, especially of prices, costs, or demand

groups.summary_en: This frame covers sudden, steep upward trajectories in prices, numbers, or popularity, emphasizing explosive vertical momentum.
groups.summary_zh: 描述价格、数量或声誉极速垂直飙升、暴涨的强烈态势。

groups.name: Surge & Stampede · 奔涌与暴冲 (Surge, Charge, Bolt)
groups.tip: 人群或力量汹涌奔冲之势

items.def_en: To move forward with a sudden, forceful, wave-like mass motion
To rush forward aggressively in attack or headlong movement
To break away and run out of control suddenly due to fright
To move with immense speed and violently reckless velocity
To run wildly and suddenly together in panic, or force a herd or crowd to do so.

groups.summary_en: Describes masses of people, animals, or fluid forces moving forward with sudden, overwhelming velocity and uncontrolled momentum.
groups.summary_zh: 群体或狂暴力量受惊慌或冲动驱使，突发且失控地狂奔涌动。

groups.name: Surgical Excision & Ablation · 切除与切离 (Resect, Excise, Ablate)
groups.tip: 医学手术局部截除切离

items.def_en: To surgically remove a tumor, eyeball, or structure whole and intact from its enveloping sheath
To remove tissue, an organ, or a tumor by surgical cutting
To completely pull up, eradicate, or surgically excise an organ or malignant growth
1. (surgery) To surgically cut out part of an organ, bone, or diseased tissue.
To surgically or thermally remove, erode, or destroy body tissue (such as heart pathways or tumors)

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal clinical and surgical verbs denoting the precise operative removal of damaged, cancerous, or diseased tissue and anatomical structures from a living body.
groups.summary_zh: 专指外科手术中精确切除、剔除或消除病变组织与器官的医疗动作。

groups.name: Surgical Puncturing & Deep Piercing · 穿刺与切开引流 (Puncture, Incise, Pierce)
groups.tip: 尖锐长枪刺破并扎入

items.def_en: Force a sharp point through or into something to create a clear opening

items.def_zh: 用长矛刺穿；（用手术刀）切开，刺破（脓肿等）
items.def_en: 1. To pierce or strike with a lance. 2. (medicine) To cut or prick open a boil or abscess with a small sharp surgical blade.
Make a small hole in something with a sharp object, often causing sudden deflation or release
Cut into flesh or a surface cleanly and precisely with a sharp blade
Pierce completely through with a long, sharp instrument or stake

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate piercing deeply into tissue or bodily swelling using a sharp instrument, especially to relieve pressure or discharge fluid. Lance focuses on surgical opening, puncture denotes making a hole, and impale highlights violent deep penetration.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用尖锐器械深度穿透、刺入或切开肿胀组织引流。

groups.name: Surgical Removal & Alteration · 身体组织摘除与去势 (Declaw, Desex, Dock)
groups.tip: 医学手术切除身体部位

items.def_en: To surgically cut off or chemically cauterize the horns of livestock
To cut short an animal's tail, ears, or other anatomical extremities

items.def_zh: 阉割；为（动物）做绝育手术
items.def_en: To surgically remove the reproductive organs of an animal
To surgically alter or excise an animal's vocal cords to mute or soften its bark
1. (veterinary) To surgically remove the claws of an animal, especially a cat.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe elective or customary surgical alterations and tissue removals performed on animals or patients, such as amputating claws, docking tails, debarking, or neutering anatomical appendages.
groups.summary_zh: 多用于兽医或特定医疗场景，指切除、剥夺特定身体部位或附属结构。

groups.name: Surrender & Yield · 投降与让步 (Surrender, Yield, Concede)
groups.tip: 战局不敌放弃抵抗彻底认输

items.def_en: To stop fighting or competing and accept defeat
(+ arms/weapons) To surrender weapons and cease combat resistance
(+ to) To stop resisting, or give up control and possession under pressure
To admit defeat in a contest or election, or surrender an entitlement or point
1. To stop fighting and admit defeat, giving up resistance to an enemy. 2. To give up something or hand someone over into the control or possession of another.

groups.summary_en: Pertains to giving up a physical fight, position, or claim to an opponent, or ceding control to another party.
groups.summary_zh: 指放下武器认输、放弃阵地或主动做出让步放弃主导权。

groups.name: Surveil & Keep Tabs · 监控与追踪观察 (Monitor, Surveil, Keep tabs on)
groups.tip: 严密守望并监控进程

items.def_en: To supervise an industry, community, or regulation to ensure that laws or standards are obeyed

items.def_zh: 追踪；追踪观察（动态变化）
items.def_en: To follow the trail or observe the changing progress of someone or something continuously
To observe, supervise, and check the progress, quality, or condition of someone or something continuously over time.

items.def_zh: 严密监视；时刻关注……的动态
items.def_en: To monitor the actions, movements, or whereabouts of someone continuously
To keep a person, place, or group under close, often clandestine, visual or electronic observation

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses systematically keeping continuous or regular watch over individuals, communications, or changing situations to ensure compliance, gather intelligence, or detect deviations.
groups.summary_zh: 指为搜集情报、保证安全或督促合规而进行持续监视与复核。

groups.name: Survey & Inspect · 巡视与查勘 (Appraise, Reconnoiter, Scope out)
groups.tip: 居高临下大范围查看

items.def_en: to look at or investigate an area or situation thoroughly beforehand to find out what it is like
to look closely and formally at every part of something to assess its condition or detect defects

items.def_zh: 俯瞰，审视，巡视；全面考察，通盘考虑；测量，勘测；进行民意调查
items.def_en: 1. to look at, inspect, or examine something carefully, especially from a broad perspective. 2. to investigate or poll the opinions or behavior of a group. 3. to measure and map an area of land.
to look at someone or something carefully with an eye toward judging their value, quality, or status
to make a military or strategic observation of an area to gain situational intelligence

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote taking an overarching, comprehensive visual sweep or systematic examination of a physical landscape, property, or situation to gather information and assess conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 指居高临下或全局性地打量、勘测、考察某一处所或全局态势。

groups.name: Survive & Subsist · 存活与维持生计 (Eke out, Scrape by, Get by)
groups.tip: 在艰难条件下勉强维持生命

items.def_en: (+ on) To have just enough money or resources to survive without luxury
To support someone temporarily through a difficult period of shortage

items.def_zh: 靠微薄收入勉强维持生活，存活；存在
items.def_en: (+ on) (formal) To manage to stay alive with very little food, money, or resources.

items.def_zh: 勉强过活；东拼西凑度日
items.def_en: To manage to live with only barely enough money, food, or resources
To make a scarce supply last, or to earn a meager living with difficulty

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on precarious physical or economic survival under scarcity. Agents barely sustain life, relying on frugal means, frugal rations, or desperate resourcefulness.
groups.summary_zh: 表现面对资源匮乏时艰难求生、竭力维持最低生计的生活状态。

groups.name: Suspect & Disbelieve · 怀疑与否定 (Suspect, Doubt, Disbelieve)
groups.tip: 从存疑到认定不可信

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) feel doubt, curiosity, or uncertainty regarding the truth or reliability of something

items.def_zh: 怀疑，疑有；觉得……可疑，不信任；猜想
items.def_en: 1. To think or believe that something is likely or true, especially something bad or illicit. 2. To doubt the truth or honesty of someone or something; to distrust.
To feel uncertain about something or consider it unlikely to be true.
feel no confidence or trust in someone or something because you suspect bad motives
[I/T] feel sure that something is not true or that someone is not telling the truth

groups.summary_en: This frame captures an epistemic scale regarding propositions: from a preliminary inkling or hunch that something might be true/untrue (suspect), to active uncertainty and lack of conviction (doubt), culminating in categorical rejection of truth (disbelieve).
groups.summary_zh: 从猜度可能性递进至怀疑真实性，最终达到断然不信的程度。

groups.name: Suspect & Mistrust · 猜忌与戒备不信 (Suspect, Second-guess, Skepticize)
groups.tip: 从心生怀疑到丧失信任

items.def_en: To feel uncertain about the reliability, truth, or honesty of someone or something

items.def_zh: 斜视，以怀疑与不信任的目光看待
items.def_en: To regard someone or an idea with an attitude of suspicion, mistrust, or disapproval
To feel doubt or have an inkling about someone's integrity, guilt, or motives

items.def_zh: 事后质疑，妄加猜测怀疑
items.def_en: To criticize, doubt, or anticipate someone's judgment or actions with suspicion
To feel suspicious of someone or something, doubting their honesty, reliability, or safety.

groups.summary_en: Centering on affective wariness, unease, and interpersonal suspicion. One harbors apprehension that someone might be deceitful, unsafe, or acting with hidden ulterior motives.
groups.summary_zh: 偏向对人或事物意图与安全性的猜疑、戒备及防范心态。

groups.name: Suspend & Defer · 中止与延期 (Adjourn, Recess, Prorogue)
groups.tip: 会议或审理程序暂时休会

items.def_en: To stop something temporarily from operating, continuing, or being active
To postpone an action, event, or decision until a later time
To take a temporary break or pause during an official meeting, session, or court trial
To suspend or end a meeting, trial, or legislative session with the intention of resuming it later.
To discontinue the meetings of a parliament or legislative assembly without formally dissolving it

groups.summary_en: This frame covers formal, institutional, or procedural actions taken to halt proceedings, meetings, or sessions temporarily with the intention of reconvening later.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或会议程序中的暂停、休会或推迟重开。

groups.name: Suspend & Prorogue · 停会与延期 (Prorogue, Adjourn, Defer)
groups.tip: 议会官方暂停或延缓会期

items.def_en: To arrange for an event, debate, or legislative session to take place at a later time than scheduled
To officially delay an action, decision, or hearing until a future point in time
To break off proceedings formally and postpone them to a later specified date
To decide not to proceed with a project, bill, or agenda item for an indefinite period
(politics, chiefly British) To officially end a session of parliament without dissolving it, suspending meetings until the next session.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this constitutional and legislative frame involve formally putting off, concluding, or deferring parliamentary sessions and institutional proceedings. They emphasize executive intervention terminating a calendar period without formal dissolution.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据宪制权力中止议会会期或将议程法定延期。

groups.name: Suspend & Recess · 休会与中止 (Adjourn, Suspend, Break off)
groups.tip: 议会法庭暂时中断或休会

items.def_en: To temporarily prevent something from continuing or being in effect
To suddenly pause or terminate discussions, relations, or proceedings
To step down temporarily from a witness stand or pause active duties in an inquiry

items.def_zh: 休会，休庭，暂停工作；把……嵌入壁内，使凹进
items.def_en: 1. (formal, chiefly US) To stop work or proceedings temporarily, especially of a parliament, committee, or court. 2. To set something into a wall or surface.
To temporarily end a meeting, trial, or legislative session with the intention of resuming later

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this procedural frame denote pausing or breaking off an ongoing meeting, court trial, or legislative assembly for an interval, with the explicit intention of resuming later. They distinguish formal adjournments from temporary pauses.
groups.summary_zh: 指会议、审判或工作进程暂时中止或休会以待续行。

groups.name: Sustain & Uphold · 维持与支撑 (Sustain, Maintain, Uphold)
groups.tip: 持续供给能量维持状态

items.def_en: To continue to do something at the same brisk pace, quality, or standard
To cause something to continue at the same level, standard, or state without declining

items.def_zh: 维持，保持；支撑，供养；遭受，蒙受（损失、伤亡）
items.def_en: 1. To support, maintain, or nourish something over time. 2. To experience or suffer damage, injury, or loss
To make something last for a longer period of time than expected
To support, maintain, or defend a principle, decision, or law against challenge

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize continuously providing the energy, resources, legal backing, or effort needed to prevent an ongoing condition or level from dropping.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重持续提供力量、资源或支持以维系既有状态。

groups.name: Sway & Oscillate · 侧仰摇晃与摇曳 (Totter, Reel, Teeter, Billow)
groups.tip: 前后或左右规律摆动

items.def_zh: 摇摆，晃动；动摇，左右（看法或决定）
items.def_en: 1. To move slowly from side to side or back and forth. 2. To persuade or influence someone to change their mind or opinions.
To quiver, sway, or flicker gently instead of remaining upright and steady
To sway unsteadily or move balance-wise as if on the verge of toppling over
To move or stand in a feeble, unsteady manner, swaying from weakness
To walk, sway, or spin out of control due to dizziness, shock, or heavy intoxication

groups.summary_en: This frame captures ungrounded, rhythmic, or unsteady side-to-side tilting of tall upright structures, intoxicated individuals, or windblown foliage.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘高耸物体在风中摇曳，或人醉酒失衡时缓慢左右倾晃。

groups.name: Swear & Pledge · 发誓与立誓 (Plight, Pledge, Vow)
groups.tip: 庄严起誓并订立承诺保单

items.def_en: to affirm the truth or one's intention by taking an oath, often invoking God or truth
to formally commit oneself or one's resources to a cause, duty, or individual
to make a serious, deeply personal promise with sacred or solemn intent

items.def_zh: 发誓保证，立誓许婚（尤用于 plight one's troth）
items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To solemnly pledge or promise (one's faith or loyalty), especially in marriage.

items.def_zh: 使自身受约束，订立死约
