items.def_en: to place oneself under an unbreakable moral, legal, or verbal obligation

groups.summary_en: Denotes making binding, grave commitments to a cause, person, or principle, ranging from formal contractual promises to sanctified oaths invoking divine or moral duty.
groups.summary_zh: 指以名誉、信仰或庄严誓词作出具有约束力与道德重量的承诺。

groups.name: Sweat & Exude · 出汗与分泌 (Perspire, Exude, Secrete)
groups.tip: 腺体分泌体液或冒出汗水

items.def_zh: 出汗，流汗；渗出水汽；焦虑，担忧；努力工作
items.def_en: 1. To produce liquid through your skin because you are hot, ill, or nervous. 2. (informal) To worry or feel anxious about something. 3. To work very hard.
To flow out very slowly through small openings or cracks like a thick liquid
(of a gland or organism) To produce and discharge a substance, such as saliva, hormones, or venom
To release or ooze a liquid, substance, or distinct smell slowly and steadily through pores
To secrete sweat through the pores of the skin (more polite or medical than sweat)

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the biological, physiological, or metaphorical release of fluids (like sweat, moisture, or odor) through the skin, glands, or surfaces. They span clinical secretion to visceral sweating.
groups.summary_zh: 指人体、腺体或物体表面分泌出水分、汗液或汁液。

groups.name: Sweeten & Enrich Palate · 加糖与增甜 (Sweeten, Sugar, Honey)
groups.tip: 增添风味甜意，改善食物口感

items.def_en: To add sugar to food or drink to make it sweeter, or to sprinkle sugar over a surface
To sweeten food or drink with honey, or to coat with a sweet glaze
To make food sweeter, or figuratively to flatter someone to make them more compliant
To preserve or coat fruit or confectionery in heavy boiling sugar or syrup

items.def_zh: 使变甜，加糖于；使更具吸引力，使变温和；变甜
items.def_en: 1. To make food, drink, or substances sweeter by adding sugar or sweetener, or to become sweet. 2. To make a deal, offer, or condition more attractive or favorable.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on adding sucrose, honey, or artificial sweeteners to consumables to augment sweetness, mellow harsh bitterness, or metonymically make conditions more alluring or palatable.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过加糖增甘，中和苦涩滋味，亦引申为使条件更具诱惑力。

groups.name: Swelter & Suffer Heat · 酷热难耐与受暑熬 (Swelter, Roast, Sweat it out)
groups.tip: 受暑热中暑煎熬痛苦

items.def_zh: 忍受酷热煎熬；耐着性子熬过
items.def_en: To endure a period of oppressive heat or tense waiting until it passes

items.def_zh: 被晒得发烫，受干热炙烤
items.def_en: To become intensely hot and dry under direct sun or strong heat

items.def_zh: 闷热受熬；在湿热中受罪
items.def_en: To swelter or feel uncomfortably hot and humid, especially in an enclosed space
1. To feel uncomfortably, oppressively hot and sweat excessively.

items.def_zh: 感到极度烘热，热得受不了
items.def_en: To feel uncomfortably and excessively hot, as if being baked in an oven

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing suffering from intense, oppressive heat and sweating profusely. They range from natural physiological responses to figurative expressions of baking or stewing in high temperatures.
groups.summary_zh: 描述人体遭受酷暑炙烤、闷热难耐乃至挥汗如雨的生理与主观体验。

groups.name: Swing & Whiff · 挥空与抡击 (Swing and miss, Slash, Flail)
groups.tip: 手臂或器物划出弧线挥击

items.def_zh: 挥空，未击中（球）；轻轻地吹，喷气；吸入，闻到
items.def_en: 1. (baseball) To swing at a pitch and miss completely; to strike out. 2. To blow or puff lightly; to smell or sniff slightly.
To move or wave an object through the air with a soft, swift hissing or whistling sound
To make a forceful sweeping motion with a bat or arm to hit something but entirely miss contact
To wave or swing one's arms or implements wildly, erratically, and without control
To swing a blade, whip, or implement with wide, sweeping cuts through the air or across a surface

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses swinging a bat, blade, club, or limb aggressively through the air, often culminating in missing the intended target or whistling harmlessly through empty space. 'Whiff' represents the air-cutting sound of a strikeout or miss, whereas 'flail' connotes wild, uncontrolled swinging.
groups.summary_zh: 指挥动器械或手臂在空中猛抡，常伴随挥空或带起风声。

groups.name: Swoon & Collapse · 瘫软、虚脱与昏厥 (Collapse, Flake Out, Wilt)
groups.tip: 眼前发黑、失去意识软倒在地

items.def_en: To fall asleep or drop to the ground from extreme exhaustion
To become limp, weak, or exhausted, especially in oppressive heat or stress

items.def_zh: （沉重或无力地）软瘫坐下/倒下
items.def_en: To sit or fall down heavily and suddenly because of weakness, weariness, or shock

items.def_zh: 昏厥，昏倒；神魂颠倒，痴迷
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To faint, especially from extreme emotion or physical weakness. 2. (+ over) To feel extreme pleasure or romantic admiration.
To fall down suddenly because of loss of strength, illness, or injury

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes physical breakdown, extreme exhaustion, or dramatic emotional prostration where the body gives way. It ranges from dramatic literary fainting to utter physical exhaustion and crumbling to the ground.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重因极度疲劳、情绪冲击或虚弱导致身体瘫软、彻底垮掉或倒地晕厥。

groups.name: Tail Closely & Shadow · 紧随与尾随 (Shadow, Tail, Dog)
groups.tip: 紧跟其后甚至紧逼追踪

items.def_en: to follow someone everywhere they go quietly and closely without their noticing
to follow close behind someone, especially secretly in order to keep them under surveillance

items.def_zh: 紧跟（前车）行驶，咬尾行驶；紧逼尾随
items.def_en: 1. to drive dangerously close behind another vehicle. 2. to follow closely behind someone.

items.def_zh: 紧贴前车车尾开；贴后保险杠行驶
items.def_en: to drive dangerously close behind another vehicle's rear bumper
to follow closely at the heels of someone persistently and relentlessly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify intentional, close-range pursuit or following, either to monitor someone covertly or press dangerously close behind.
groups.summary_zh: 指紧跟其后、步步紧逼地尾随、追踪或暗中监视。

groups.name: Tailoring Alterations & Mending · 裁缝翻修与改样 (Bushel, Re-tailor, Remodel)
groups.tip: 修补破损残缺恢复旧貌

items.def_en: To tailor or adjust the structure of a garment again to change its fit or silhouette
To rip apart and restitch the structural seams of a garment
To replace or repair the inner fabric lining of a coat or suit
To change the design, cut, or structure of a garment to modernize or adapt it
(US) To mend, alter, or repair garments or tailored clothes.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized frame describe structural alterations, reshaping, and bespoke repairs made to finished garments or tailored clothing.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及高级西装、成衣的翻裁、修改结构及匠艺重塑。

groups.name: Take a Holiday · 度假与休憩 (Holiday, Break away, Get away)
groups.tip: 放下工作度假休养身心

items.def_en: To spend the summer season in a particular place
(chiefly British) To spend a vacation or holiday somewhere.

items.def_zh: 外出度假；逃离日常琐事
items.def_en: To leave home or work for a period of relaxation or vacation
To stay somewhere temporarily, especially during travels

items.def_zh: 抽身休假；摆脱常规事务
items.def_en: To stop what you are doing in order to take a brief break or holiday

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking time off work or routine obligations to travel, rest, and recharge, predominantly in Commonwealth contexts. They emphasize escaping daily pressures for leisure.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱离日常工作或杂务外出度假、休养身心。

groups.name: Take to & Warm to · 喜爱与亲近 (Warm to, Cotton to, Take to)
groups.tip: 产生好感并主动建立友善关系

items.def_zh: 喜欢上，亲近（与to连用）；领悟，发觉（与on连用）
items.def_en: 1. (cotton to) To begin to like someone or agree with something. 2. (cotton on) To begin to understand or realize something.
To develop a rapid or spontaneous liking for someone or something

items.def_zh: 逐渐喜欢，对…态度转温和
items.def_en: To become friendlier toward or more enthusiastic about someone or an idea

items.def_zh: 自然被吸引，倾向于靠近
items.def_en: To be naturally drawn or attracted toward a particular person or group

items.def_zh: 亲近并交朋友，友善对待
items.def_en: To act as a friend to someone, especially someone who is lonely or in need

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on developing an instinctive liking, affinity, or acceptance toward a person or concept over time. Many expressions rely on idiomatic phrasal verbs indicating an initial ice-breaking transition from detachment to affection.
groups.summary_zh: 表达从陌生逐步转为接受、喜欢或对某人事物产生亲近感。

groups.name: Tame & Cultivate · 驯养与归化 (Domesticate, Tame, Cultivate)
groups.tip: 驯养野生以适应环境

items.def_en: To calm, tame, or break in an unruly or skittish animal with kindness
To train a wild or young horse/animal to accept saddles and obey commands
To prepare land and grow plants or crops for human consumption and use
To make a wild animal gentle, obedient, and accustomed to human presence

items.def_zh: 驯化，驯养；使习惯于家庭生活
items.def_en: To tame an animal or cultivate a wild plant to live with or be used by humans; to make someone prefer domestic or home life.

groups.summary_en: This frame involves bringing wild animals, plants, or primal human traits into human custody, civil habituation, and agricultural utility.
groups.summary_zh: 指将野生动植物驯化、选育或使野性之人适应家庭与文明生活。

groups.name: Taste & Sample · 品尝与抽样 (Nibble, Sip, Try)
groups.tip: 尝一口来抽取样本检验

items.def_en: To eat or drink a tiny portion of something unfamiliar to find out if one enjoys its taste
To taste a small amount of food or drink; to test or experience a small part of something.
To sample food or drink in an evaluative or comparative setting to judge relative quality
To drink liquid in very small amounts, typically to evaluate temperature or flavor
To eat something by taking very small, tentative bites to test its flavor or texture

groups.summary_en: This scenario pertains to testing a minute portion of food, beverage, or broader goods to gauge quality, suitability, or flavor prior to fuller consumption or procurement.
groups.summary_zh: 取用极少份量的食品或饮料以探查风味、成色或决定取舍。

groups.name: Taste & Savor · 品尝与细品 (Savor, Discern, Smack)
groups.tip: 从浅尝味道到细细品味

items.def_en: To have a distinctive, often subtle or suggestive taste or trace flavor of something

items.def_zh: 品尝，尝；尝出……的味道；有……味道
items.def_en: 1. To eat or drink a small amount of something to test its flavor. 2. To perceive the flavor of something. 3. To have a particular flavor.
To detect, identify, or distinguish delicate flavors or constituent ingredients with the palate
To eat or drink something with lively, visible enjoyment and gustatory appreciation
To taste food or drink deliberately and slowly so as to appreciate its distinctive richness

groups.summary_en: This scale ranges from neutral sensory registration of flavor on the palate to analytical discernment and full-bodied gustatory appreciation of subtle notes in dishes or drink.
groups.summary_zh: 从基础感知味道递进到细腻辨识与深度品尝食物的风味层次。

groups.name: Taunt & Jeer · 讥诮与喝倒彩 (Taunt, Jeer, Sneer)
groups.tip: 用言语讥讽嘲笑挖苦他人

items.def_zh: 加倒钩；给言辞涂毒讽刺
items.def_en: To equip words or remarks with stinging, hurtful sarcasm
(+ at) To smile or speak in a mocking, contemptuous manner that shows disrespect
(+ at) To laugh or shout rude, mocking remarks at someone
(+ at) To make mocking, taunting, or sarcastic remarks at someone.
To provoke or challenge someone with insulting, cruel remarks

groups.summary_en: This frame describes issuing sharp, mocking, provocative, or malicious spoken barbs, often accompanied by snide facial expressions, vocal gibes, or crowd catcalls.
groups.summary_zh: 指当面或公然发出刻薄挑衅的言辞、嘲讽怪叫或冷笑。

groups.name: Tax & Duty-Charge · 课税与税率裁定 (Tax, Duty, Excise)
groups.tip: 国家依法征收税款与关税

items.def_en: To demand an official fee, tariff, or price for a specific product, border entry, or service
To place a legally required financial charge on wages, profits, goods, or transactions
To charge a specific fixed tariff for passage over a designated bridge, canal, or motorway

items.def_zh: 对…征收关税；按价目表计费
items.def_en: to impose a tariff, customs duty, or fixed rate on goods or services
To assess or compel payment of a traditional tenth-part levy on agricultural yield or earnings

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the administrative categorization and fiscal taxing of specific commodities, imports, or commercial transactions. It focuses on applying statutory rates, customs duties, and excises rather than punitive exactions.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重依据法定税率对商品、交易或关税进行征课。

groups.name: Tax & Levy Duties · 征税与摊派 (Tax, Levy, Assess)
groups.tip: 政府依法征纳税赋

items.def_zh: 向……征税；使负重荷，使承受重压；指责
items.def_en: 1. To levy or impose a compulsory financial charge on someone or something. 2. To put a heavy strain or demand on someone's physical or mental strength. 3. (+ with) (formal) To accuse or charge someone with a fault.
To demand and obtain money, payment, or compliance by legal authority or coercive power
To officially calculate the value of property or income in order to fix the amount of tax owed
To officially impose and collect a tax, fee, fine, or tariff by authority
To pay or collect a tenth part of one's income or produce as an ecclesiastical or civil tax

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to sovereign bodies or recognized authorities legally assessing, extracting, and enforcing statutory financial contributions, tariffs, or involuntary burdens upon citizens and commerce.
groups.summary_zh: 指法定政权或机构对公民、商品或财产强制评估并征收税款与规费。

groups.name: Tearing & Cutting into Strips · 撕碎与切细 (Shred, Rip, Tear up)
groups.tip: 扯碎裁切成细小碎条

items.def_en: Cut vegetables or meat into thin, uniform matchstick-like strips
Pull paper, cloth, or a document violently or thoroughly into many pieces
Reduce food to small shreds or particles by rubbing it against a serrated surface
Damage or destroy something by tearing and crushing it into mangled pieces
To tear or cut material into small, narrow pieces or strips.

groups.summary_en: Verbs designating the physical reduction of paper, fabric, or food into narrow strips, tiny scraps, or ragged remnants through mechanical slicing or tearing.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过撕扯或刀具将纸张、布料、食材等碎裂成细条或细末碎块。

groups.name: Tempt & Provoke Desire · 诱惑与勾引欲望 (Tempt, Tantalize, Coax)
groups.tip: 用利益或欲望驱使他人顺从

items.def_en: To encourage someone to believe something false, especially by falsely raising romantic hopes
(+ into/to) To persuade or attract someone to do something, especially something wrong or unwise, by offering pleasure or advantage.

items.def_zh: 挑逗，撩拨（引诱却不满足）
items.def_en: To torment or tease someone by showing them something desirable that remains just out of reach
To sharpen, heighten, or stimulate someone's appetite, interest, or desire

items.def_zh: 刺激，挑逗（感官或好奇心）
items.def_en: To excite someone's imagination or senses pleasantly, often in a superficial or mildly provocative way

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this emotional/motivational frame describe sparking an inner urge, desire, or appetite that leads someone toward an indulgence or an unwise step. They emphasize the subjective draw of an alluring prospect.
groups.summary_zh: 着眼于挑逗内在欲望、胃口或好奇心，使其难以抗拒诱惑或冲动。

groups.name: Tense & Tighten · 绷紧与肌肉收缩 (Tighten, Stiffen, Clench)
groups.tip: 拉紧绳索或神经肌肉高度绷紧

items.def_zh: （使肌肉、神经）拉紧，紧绷；（使局势）紧张
items.def_en: 1. To make or become physically tight, rigid, or anxious.
To become or make muscles rigid, pulled taut, or firm through strain or emotion
To suddenly become rigid or inflexible, especially through fear, tension, or cold
(+ oneself) To stiffen one's muscles and posture firmly in preparation for a physical or mental shock
To close your hands or teeth together tightly, especially in anger, determination, or pain

groups.summary_en: This frame represents the physiological and psychological hardening or constriction of muscles and sinews, causing the body or body parts to contract, lock, or rigidify.
groups.summary_zh: 生理或心理上使肌肉、肢体收缩、发紧僵硬或紧绷。

groups.name: Tentative Hypothesis & Possibility · 假设与或然推测 (Might, May, Posit)
groups.tip: 依据现有线索推导可能性

items.def_en: Used to express epistemic likelihood or that something is possible in reality

items.def_zh: 可能，也许（助动词，表示推测或假设）
items.def_en: [modal] Used to express possibility, uncertainty, or a hypothetical condition.

items.def_zh: 设想；假定（作为讨论基础）
items.def_en: To put forward or state a fact or belief as a basis for argument or principle
To suggest or assume the existence, fact, or truth of something as a foundation for reasoning
To propose an explanation or theory based on limited evidence as a starting point for investigation

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on epistemic possibility and tentative speculation where the speaker hedges commitment to an outcome or hypothetical state.
groups.summary_zh: 表达或然性假设与谨慎推断，保留不确定空间。

groups.name: Textile Mending & Weaving · 针线织补与打补丁 (Darn, Patch, Cobble)
groups.tip: 针线织补细致修葺

items.def_en: To cover a hole or worn spot in fabric or leather with a piece of matching material
To mend a hole in knitted clothes or fabric by weaving thread across it.
To restore or repair knitted material by relooping unraveled or broken yarn
To repair shoes or roughly piece worn leather goods back together
To weave or blend threads or strands together across an opening or surface

groups.summary_en: Manner verbs highlighting the intricate manual craft of mending holes or tears in fabrics, knitwear, and leather goods via interlacing thread or applying material patches.
groups.summary_zh: 强调手工穿针引线、经纬交织或贴补织物与鞋革的精细动作。

groups.name: Textual Segmentation & Structuring · 文本分段与结构化 (Paragraph, Section, Subdivide)
groups.tip: 将整体结构切割划分为各段落

items.def_en: To divide written text, documents, or instructional manuals into distinct titled sections
To divide written material, data, or audiences into discrete, meaningful segments
To separate a comprehensive text, project, or problem into smaller, easily manageable units

items.def_zh: 将（文章等）分段；写短文报道
items.def_en: 1. To divide a piece of writing into separate paragraphs. 2. To write about something in a paragraph.
To divide something that is already divided into smaller secondary sections or categories

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organizing, structuring, or carving written compositions, texts, or cataloged information into coherent hierarchical units such as paragraphs, chapters, or headings.
groups.summary_zh: 指对文章、法律条文或书面资料进行分段、分节与层次化结构编排。

groups.name: Thank & Acknowledge · 感谢与致谢 (Acknowledge, Appreciate, Credit)
groups.tip: 表达真诚感激与确认认同

items.def_en: 1. To tell someone that you are grateful for something they have done. 2. (have sb/sth to thank for) To hold responsible for a result.
(+ with / for) To officially acknowledge someone as the author, originator, or cause of an achievement
To show formal appreciation or honor for someone's achievements or long service
To feel or express genuine gratitude and value for what someone has done
To publicly express gratitude for help, services, or contributions received

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express gratitude or formally recognize someone's contribution, assistance, or merit, ranging from everyday polite appreciation to public attribution of credit.
groups.summary_zh: 表示表达感激、肯定他人贡献或正式鸣谢的动词群。

groups.name: Thermal Injury & Scorch · 烫伤与灼伤 (Scald, Sear, Blister)
groups.tip: 沸水热汤烫伤皮肤组织

items.def_en: To burn superficial hairs or skin edges slightly without inflicting deep damage
To burn the surface of skin or clothing slightly, changing its texture or color
To cause swellings under the skin filled with watery fluid, or break out in blisters

items.def_zh: 烫伤；用沸水烫；使（奶等）微沸
items.def_en: 1. To burn skin painfully with very hot liquid or steam. 2. (cooking) To heat liquid, especially milk, almost to boiling point.
To cause sudden, painful burning injury to the skin with direct dry heat

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physiological skin injuries caused by extreme heat, hot liquids, or steam, extending from superficial epidermal reddening to severe blistering and carbonization.
groups.summary_zh: 由沸液、蒸汽或炽热物体接触人体组织所造成的烫伤与灼创。

groups.name: Thermal Metal Joining · 钎焊与热熔连接 (Braze, Solder, Weld)
groups.tip: 用黄铜高温钎焊牢固接合

items.def_en: To fix, join, or seal components in place using molten or malleable lead
To join metal parts together using a soft metal alloy melted at a relatively low temperature

items.def_zh: 钎焊，铜焊（用黄铜等硬焊料焊接）
items.def_en: 1. (metallurgy) To join two metal pieces together by melting a brass or bronze filler alloy at high temperature.
To blend or melt separate pieces into a continuous mass through high thermal energy
To join pieces of metal or plastic together by heating the edges until they melt together

groups.summary_en: This frame covers technical craft and industrial processes of joining metal or plastic components by application of heat and filler material. The verbs contrast primarily by melting temperature and whether the base material itself melts.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过加热或添加熔料将金属等工件结合在一起的热加工工艺。

groups.name: Thermostatic & Homeostatic Regulation · 恒温与生理/环境反馈调控 (Thermostat, Modulate, Govern)
groups.tip: 调控参数使其平衡

items.def_en: To control or regulate the speed, output, flow, or operations of a mechanical, physical, or biological system.
To control the functioning, temperature, speed, or pressure of a device or biological system automatically.

items.def_zh: 使稳固；使稳定在正常水平
items.def_en: To make or become stable and resistant to undesirable environmental or operational fluctuations.
To exert a controlling or modifying influence on a continuous variable, signal, or process to suit conditions.
To control or regulate temperature by means of a thermostat.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the continuous, automated, or biological monitoring and adjusting of environmental variables (such as temperature, pressure, or hormonal balance) within preset safe or optimal limits.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过反馈控制回路或内在机制自动维持温度、压力或环境状态的稳定。

groups.name: Thinning & Rarefying · 削薄变细与稀释 (Dilute, Taper, Attenuate)
groups.tip: 打磨使厚度变薄或浓度稀释

items.def_en: 1. To become thinner, or make something thinner. 2. To become or make something less dense, crowded, or concentrated; dilute.
Become or make gradually narrower or thinner toward one end
Reduce the size, thickness, or number of something gradually by trimming away excess
Make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water or another solvent
Reduce the force, effect, density, or thickness of something

groups.summary_en: This frame covers reducing thickness, density, concentration, or width. While thin covers general diminution in cross-section or density, taper emphasizes gradual narrowing toward one end and dilute signifies lowering liquid concentration.
groups.summary_zh: 使物体截面变细、密度稀疏或液体浓度降低。

groups.name: Thread & Reeve · 穿引与走绳 (Reeve, Thread, Feed Through)
groups.tip: 将绳线等穿过孔道

items.def_en: Gradually push and guide a flexible line, wire, or sheet through an opening or mechanism
Carefully maneuver a flexible cable or hose through narrow, winding, or obstructed pathways
Thread small items onto a cord, or thread cord or wire through a series of holes
Pass a thread, wire, or thin cord through the eye of a needle or another small aperture
(nautical) To pass a rope, cable, or line through a ring, pulley block, or hole.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the delicate mechanical action of guiding a flexible line, cord, rope, or filament through an opening, narrow channel, eyelet, or block. It highlights precision alignment and manipulation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将绳索、线缆或细条引导穿过孔眼、滑轮或狭槽。

groups.name: Thwart & Foil · 阻碍与挫败 (Foil, Thwart, Frustrate)
groups.tip: 挫败对手企图使其计划落空

items.def_en: To prevent a plan or effort from progressing, succeeding, or being fulfilled
To prevent or hinder the progress of an effort or plan by presenting an insurmountable problem

items.def_zh: 挫败，阻挠，使受挫；贴箔于
items.def_en: 1. To prevent someone from carrying out an undesirable plan, plot, or crime successfully. 2. (dated) To cover or back something with metal foil.
To oppose successfully and prevent someone from accomplishing a purpose or carrying out a plan
To deliberately ruin, wreck, or prevent a plan, proposal, or opportunity from succeeding

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe successfully stopping an adversary's intentions, plots, or illicit plans before they can come to fruition.
groups.summary_zh: 彻底破坏、阻挠对立方的图谋或非法企图。

groups.name: Tilt & Angle · 翘起与别转 (Cock, Perch, Angle, Crook)
groups.tip: 使物体偏离水平或向一侧歪斜

items.def_zh: 向上翘起，抬起（下巴、脸等）
items.def_en: To lift or slant something (such as one's chin or cap) upwards
To place, direct, or turn something in an oblique direction

items.def_zh: 使翘起，歪斜；使竖起；扳上（枪的）扳机
items.def_en: 1. To tilt or turn something upward or to one side. 2. To raise the hammer of a gun so that it is ready to fire.
To bend one's finger, arm, or neck into a sharp angle or hooked shape
To stretch and twist one's neck in order to see something better

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate deliberately tilting, angling, or curling a body part (such as the head, eyebrow, or finger) or small object in a quizzical or distinctive gesture.
groups.summary_zh: 特指有意识地歪着、翘起或别转身体部位（头、眉毛等）。

groups.name: Tilt & Lean · 倾侧与斜靠 (Tilt, Lean, Bank, Cant)
groups.tip: 重心偏离垂直向一侧歪斜

items.def_en: To slope or deviate from an upright position, or to place an object at an angle against a support
1. To move, slope, or slant into a leaning position, or cause something to do so. 2. To lean toward or favor a particular opinion or side.
(especially of a ship) To tilt steadily to one side due to wind, water ingress, or uneven weight

items.def_zh: 侧倾转向（飞行器或车辆）
items.def_en: To tilt sideways when rounding a curve, especially of an aircraft or road vehicle
To tilt, bevel, or slant abruptly out of a level or vertical position

groups.summary_en: This frame describes shifting or resting at an angle away from the vertical plane, either deliberately during maneuvering (as in aviation or cycling) or through structural deflection.
groups.summary_zh: 偏离垂直轴线倾侧、斜靠或转弯时侧倾。

groups.name: Tilt & Slant · 斜倾与斜置 (Slant, Slope, Skew, Rake)
groups.tip: 偏离水平或垂直基准方向

items.def_en: To slope downwards or have a specific angle of incline, as of a roof
To lie or move at an upward or downward inclination from the horizontal
To set or be set at a deliberate sloping angle from perpendicular or horizontal
To deviate from a straight, symmetrical, or parallel alignment; to make crooked

items.def_zh: （使）倾斜，（使）歪斜；有偏向性地报道
items.def_en: 1. To slope or lean at an angle, or cause something to do so. 2. To present information with a particular bias or perspective.

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes static or progressive deviation from the horizontal or vertical lines, describing physical gradients, lines, and angled surfaces.
groups.summary_zh: 呈斜坡、倾角或不对称的斜向分布与偏斜。

groups.name: Tilt & Tip · 倾侧与翻落 (Tip, Tip over, Spill, Dump)
groups.tip: 重心失衡偏斜倒下

items.def_en: 1. To lean or slant, or cause something to fall over or onto its side. 2. To empty or pour contents out of a container by turning it over. 3. To give a small sum of money to someone for service.
To empty the contents of a container by turning it upside down or leaning it sharply
To fall onto its side or topple over, or cause an object to lose balance and fall
To flow, fall, or cause liquid/particulate matter to run over the edge of a container accidentally
To empty out or deposit a load of goods or materials heavily, carelessly, or all at once

groups.summary_en: This frame describes tilting a vessel or object past its tipping point so that it falls over or expels its contents, contrasting gentle tipping with accidental spills.
groups.summary_zh: 倾侧容器或物体，致其翻倒或内容物倾泻倒出。

groups.name: Time & Clock Duration · 计时与测算耗时 (Clock, Chronograph, Stopwatch)
groups.tip: 运用工具或数据度量事物

items.def_zh: 测定……的时间，记录……的时间，为……计时；安排……的时间
items.def_en: 1. to measure how long somebody or something takes to do something or how fast they go 2. to arrange when something should happen

items.def_zh: 为…记录时间；测定…的速度
items.def_en: To measure and register the time taken by someone or something to complete a distance or event
To measure the exact interval or lap time of an event using a stopwatch

items.def_zh: 用精密计时器记录…的时间
items.def_en: To record the precise time or duration of a fast-moving physical event with a chronographical instrument

items.def_zh: 累计达到（一定时间或里程）
items.def_en: To reach or accumulate a specified total number of hours, miles, or points

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve measuring the exact temporal duration of an event, performance, or competitor, typically employing a stopwatch, timer, or electronic sensor.
groups.summary_zh: 用跑表、计时器等测定动作、比赛或事件的持续时间与速度。

groups.name: Tinge & Imbue · 润色浸染与赋味 (Tincture, Tinge, Imbue)
groups.tip: 用色素浸染改变色泽

items.def_en: To impart a small amount of a color, flavor, or feeling to something
To apply a delicate or translucent shade of color to something
(+ with / into) To introduce or steep a substance or quality so as to permeate something thoroughly
(+ with) To inspire, permeate, or soak thoroughly with a feeling, quality, or moisture

items.def_zh: 给……微染颜色；使带有（轻微特征、气息）
items.def_en: (formal) To tint, color slightly, or impart a slight quality or trace to something.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote coloring, flavoring, or permeating an object or medium with a subtle, pervasive shade, quality, or emotional tone. They emphasize qualitative seasoning or delicate infusion rather than heavy, opaque coating.
groups.summary_zh: 指以微量色彩、气息或内在品性予以细微熏染与渗透灌注。

groups.name: Tinker & Meddle · 摆弄与瞎调 (Tinker, Meddle with, Tamper with, Mess with)
groups.tip: 漫不经心随手摆弄

items.def_zh: 漫不经心地拨弄，瞎摆弄；瞎搞，篡改；拉小提琴
items.def_en: 1. To touch, move, or play with something restlessly or nervously with the fingers. 2. (informal) To alter or manipulate dishonestly. 3. To play the fiddle or violin.
(+ with) To make small, experimental changes or minor repairs to something in an amateur way
To adjust, alter, or touch mechanisms or systems without knowing how to handle them properly
To touch or experiment with machinery foolishly or meddlesomely

items.def_zh: 非法篡改，乱动（机械/数据）
items.def_en: To interfere with or alter something unlawfully, secretively, or damagingly

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize amateurish, experimental, or unauthorized adjusting, repairing, or altering of mechanical devices, settings, or systems, often risking malfunction.
groups.summary_zh: 指缺乏专业技术的外行修调、乱动仪器，或暗中篡改捣弄。

groups.name: Toil & Slave · 苦干与奴役 (Drudge, Grind, Sweat)
groups.tip: 像奴隶般辛苦艰苦劳作

items.def_en: (+ away) to work or study incessantly and laboriously over a prolonged period
to work extremely hard under strenuous conditions; to toil for little reward
(British) to work very hard and persistently, especially at demanding manual labor
(+ away/at) to work extremely hard and continuously under difficult or exhausting conditions
to do dull, menial, hard, or exhausting work without complaint

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate exhausting, unremitting, often menial or thankless work performed under intense pressure, harsh subordination, or monotonous conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在压迫、机械或毫无乐趣的环境中日复一日地当牛做马、辛苦卖命。

groups.name: Toil & Slog · 苦工与苦行 (Toil, Trudge, Plod)
groups.tip: 迈着沉重步伐长久艰苦干重活

items.def_en: to exert strenuous bodily or mental effort under hard or oppressive conditions

items.def_zh: 步履沉重地走，蹒跚跋涉
items.def_en: to walk slowly with heavy steps, typically due to fatigue or severe conditions

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地走，埋头慢干
items.def_en: to walk with heavy, slow steps, or progress laboriously and unexcitingly on a job
to work extremely hard and continuously on demanding or exhausting physical labor

items.def_zh: 苦干，辛劳工作；艰难行进；猛击
items.def_en: 1. (+ away/through) to work hard and persistently at a difficult or tedious task 2. to walk or advance with heavy, laborious steps over a long distance or rough ground 3. to hit or strike something forcefully

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize the heavy, exhausting physical strain and slow, wearying momentum involved in working through difficult tasks or trekking through punishing terrain.
groups.summary_zh: 强调沉重、漫长且筋疲力竭的体力劳作，或步履蹒跚的艰难跋涉。

groups.name: Tone Down & Dim · 弱化与减色 (Soft-pedal, Mute, Subdue)
groups.tip: 捂住声音减弱声学传播

items.def_en: To make speech, writing, or color less forceful, harsh, or bright
To de-emphasize, play down, or treat something with deliberate restraint

items.def_zh: 减弱……的声音，消除……的声音；压抑，减弱（颜色或情感）
items.def_en: 1. to silence or lower the sound of a device or musical instrument 2. to make something, such as an emotion or color, less bright or intense
To soften or make tone, light, color, or feelings less intense
To diminish the strength, enthusiasm, or acoustic resonance of something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey decreasing the perceptual prominence, vibrancy, or intensity of sounds, colors, emotions, or outspoken opinions.
groups.summary_zh: 减弱声音音量、色彩亮度、情感烈度或言辞锋芒。

groups.name: Topple & Overbalance · 失去平衡与倾覆 (Overbalance, Topple, Keel over)
groups.tip: 失去重心导致的倾斜跌倒翻倒

items.def_en: To fall quickly, helplessly, and headlong, often rolling over repeatedly

items.def_zh: （使）失去平衡跌倒，（使）翻倒；在数量或重量上超过
items.def_en: 1. To lose balance and fall over, or cause someone or something to do so. 2. To outweigh or exceed in importance, weight, or quantity.
To fall over suddenly or collapse sideways, often from faintness, illness, or loss of balance
To lurch, fall, or plunge abruptly forward or headlong
To become unsteady and fall down from a tall or upright position, or cause something to do so

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture an entity losing equilibrium or structural stability, leaning excessively, and tumbling or collapsing downward.
groups.summary_zh: 物体或人失去重心与平衡，倾斜并栽倒在地。

groups.name: Torment & Torture · 恶意折磨与严刑 (Torment, Torture, Persecute)
groups.tip: 施加肉体酷刑或精神折磨

items.def_en: Cause someone persistent suffering, agony, or torment for a sustained period

items.def_zh: 折磨，摧残；纠缠，使极度痛苦
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone severe, repeated physical suffering or intense mental agony. 2. To annoy, tease, or worry someone persistently.

items.def_zh: 迫害；残害；无休止地困扰
items.def_en: Subject someone to systematic hostility, ill-treatment, or persistent harassment
Deliberately inflict severe physical or mental pain on someone, often to force information or for cruelty

items.def_zh: 严惩；残酷折磨；严厉斥责
items.def_en: Subject someone to extreme mental torment or ruthless, destructive criticism

groups.summary_en: Involves deliberately subjecting someone to excruciating physical pain, cruelty, or relentless mental anguish. The focus is on purposeful mistreatment, sadistic pleasure, or systematic persecution.
groups.summary_zh: 强调蓄意施加的残酷肉体虐待、精神折磨或恶意迫害。

groups.name: Torpedo & Ruin · 鱼雷击沉与骤然击垮 (Torpedo, Sink, Scuttle)
groups.tip: 如鱼雷命中使计划彻底毁坏

items.def_zh: 断然拒绝；驳回（建议或论点）
items.def_en: To reject or criticize an idea, proposal, or argument firmly and immediately

items.def_zh: 消灭；使（项目、法案等）彻底告吹
items.def_en: To stop or destroy something completely, preventing it from developing or continuing
To cause a business, proposal, or hope to fail completely

items.def_zh: 彻底破坏，毁坏（计划等）；用鱼雷击沉
items.def_en:
1. (figurative) to deliberately ruin, destroy, or prevent the success of a plan, policy, or negotiation
2. to attack or destroy a ship using a torpedo

items.def_zh: 故意破坏；凿沉（船只或计划）
items.def_en: To deliberately cause a plan, proposal, or enterprise to fail, or sink one's own ship intentionally

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey catastrophic, decisive actions that abruptly sink, destroy, or dismantle a proposal, negotiation, or venture.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过突发且致命的打击，彻底粉碎或蓄意断送方案或谈判。

groups.name: Touch & Palpate Medically · 触诊与探查 (Examine, Probe, Finger)
groups.tip: 用手指探触以感知病灶

items.def_en: To touch, feel, or handle something carefully with the fingers
To inspect a patient's body closely, often by touch or viewing, to check health
To explore, touch, or inspect physically or cautiously to gain information
To examine or explore physically using the hands, fingers, or a medical instrument
(medical) To examine a part of the body by feeling it gently with the hands or fingers to diagnose illness.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical touch used purposefully to examine, diagnose, or inspect someone or something by feeling textures, swelling, or internal conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过双手或手指触摸探查以诊断、检验或感应内部状况。

groups.name: Touch & Stroke Tenderly · 抚摩与爱抚 (Stroke, Fondle, Pet)
groups.tip: 动作柔和亲昵地抚摩表面

items.def_zh: 抚摸（尤指动物或所爱之人）
items.def_en: To stroke or pat an animal or child affectionately
To move your hand gently and repeatedly over a surface, person, or animal
To touch or stroke someone or something gently and lovingly.
To touch or stroke someone or something affectionately or erotically

items.def_zh: 用鼻子或面部亲昵地蹭/触碰
items.def_en: To touch or rub gently with the nose or face, especially to show affection

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe touching or moving one's hand gently, affectionately, or sensually over a person, animal, or object, emphasizing tenderness and tactile warmth.
groups.summary_zh: 强调带着温柔、爱意或亲昵抚摸人、动物或物品。

groups.name: Tour & Campaign · 巡回与巡演 (Stump, Whistle-stop, Troupe)
groups.tip: 巡回演出或各处游历穿梭

items.def_en: to travel around different places, typically giving a series of performances or lectures

items.def_zh: （在多地）作短暂停留巡回竞选
items.def_en: to make a series of brief stops in small towns to address crowds and rally voters or fans
to travel through a region giving speeches to build political support, especially during an election campaign
to visit homes or areas directly in order to solicit votes, opinions, or subscriptions

items.def_zh: 在乡村巡回演出，巡回竞选演说，穿梭巡回
items.def_en: to travel around rural areas giving theatrical performances, political speeches, or exhibition flights.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail traveling rapidly through regional districts, small towns, or venues to campaign for votes, solicit support, perform, or pitch to audiences.
groups.summary_zh: 指为竞选宣讲、文艺演播或推广，在各地小城镇进行密集巡游。

groups.name: Tout & Scalp · 黄牛倒卖与高价转售 (Scalp, Tout, Resell)
groups.tip: 转手倒卖赚取中间差价

items.def_en: To buy up tickets for an event and resell them outside the venue at inflated prices

items.def_zh: 倒卖（门票等）；剥去……的头皮
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly North American informal) To resell tickets or goods at an inflated price for quick profit. 2. To cut or tear the scalp from someone's head.
To strip someone of money or property by exorbitant overcharging or deceit
To charge an unfairly high or extortionate price, especially during a crisis or shortage
To sell something that one has previously bought, often for a profit

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe buying tickets, commodities, or securities to resell them rapidly at an exorbitant or inflated price, typically exploiting high demand.
groups.summary_zh: 指低买高卖、囤积居奇或倒卖紧俏票务与物资以牟取暴利的行为。

groups.name: Tower & Loom · 耸立与隐现 (Loom, Rear up, Overhang)
groups.tip: 高高耸立带来视觉压迫

items.def_en: To stick out over something from above, casting a shadow or creating a sense of overhang
To be the most prominent, noticeable, or highest feature in a landscape or skyline
To appear as a large, shadowy, or threatening form, especially from a distance or through mist
To rise up steeply or aggressively to an imposing height
To rise to a very great height, or to be much taller, larger, or more impressive than surrounding people or things.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe objects or figures rising to great heights or emerging menacingly above their surroundings, often evoking awe, dominance, or intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘物体或身形高高耸立、逼近或赫然显现，常带压迫感。

groups.name: Toxify & Contaminate · 施毒与毒害 (Poison, Envenom, Taint)
groups.tip: 摄入毒物致伤或受到侵害

items.def_en: To give poison to a person or animal to kill or injure them; to corrupt or spoil a feeling, relationship, or environment.

items.def_zh: 分泌/注入毒液；毒化（气氛）
items.def_en: To inject venom into someone or make an atmosphere, situation, or relationship bitterly poisonous
To make a substance or place impure, dangerous, or toxic by adding a pollutant or poison
To contaminate, foul, or subtly spoil the quality, purity, or moral standing of something
To poison an organism via a toxic substance, or affect someone through alcohol or drugs

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on administering toxic substances to harm or kill an organism, or figuratively corrupting atmospheres, minds, and relationships with malice.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加毒物致伤杀，或在精神、关系上进行毒化。

groups.name: Trace & Track · 追查与循迹 (Trace, Track down, Pinpoint)
groups.tip: 顺藤摸瓜追查踪迹

items.def_en: to understand or establish a complete picture by fitting scattered clues and facts together
to find someone or something after a thorough and determined physical or informational search

items.def_zh: 追查，追踪，查出；追溯；描摹，勾勒
items.def_en: 1. To find, detect, or follow the course or origin of something by careful investigation. 2. To copy or draw an outline of something.
to relentlessly pursue someone or something until they are caught or discovered
to identify or locate the exact position, cause, or nature of something with sharp precision

groups.summary_en: Emphasizes the rigorous, investigative method of reconstructing a path, origin, or lineage by scrutinizing subtle remnants, paper trails, or physical evidence.
groups.summary_zh: 强调循着线索、痕迹或历史记录一步步寻根溯源的探查方式。

groups.name: Track & Stalk · 尾随与追踪 (Stalk, Shadow, Tail, Trace)
groups.tip: 尾随留心行踪痕迹

items.def_en: To follow someone closely, persistently, and inescapably like a shadow
To follow the trail, footprints, electronic signals, or movements of an animal or person
To follow someone closely and discreetly everywhere they go without their knowledge
To follow closely behind someone in an ongoing, watchful, and often investigative manner

items.def_zh: 潜近（猎物）；非法跟踪骚扰；大步昂首走
items.def_en: 1. To follow a person or animal quietly and secretly in order to catch, attack, or harass them. 2. To walk in a proud, stiff, or angry manner.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on surreptitiously pursuing, following, or monitoring a target. 'Stalk' conveys predatory stealth or sinister harassment, whereas 'tail' and 'shadow' are typical covert surveillance terms.
groups.summary_zh: 指潜行跟在目标之后进行秘密监视、猎捕或恶意纠缠。

groups.name: Train & Apprentice · 培养与学徒 (Apprentice, Articled, Indenture)
groups.tip: 通过师徒制开展职业培训

items.def_en: To teach someone the practical skills and behavior required for a specific job, profession, or task
To advise, train, and guide a less experienced person in their professional career
To instruct or guide an individual student or learner directly and privately

items.def_zh: 使当学徒，送……去学艺；当学徒
items.def_en: (+ to) (usually passive) To place someone with a skilled master to learn a trade or craft.
To bind someone by a legal agreement or contract as an apprentice to a master or employer

groups.summary_en: This institutional frame specifies formally binding an individual to a master craftsperson, professional, or mentor to acquire practical skills over an extended contractual or developmental period. Nuances differentiate between guild crafts ('apprentice'), formal legal contracts ('indenture'), and professional practice ('articled').
groups.summary_zh: 指通过师徒制或专门合同对某人进行长期的技能培训与职业塑造。

groups.name: Transact & Trade · 交易与营商 (Conduct, Deal, Bargain)
groups.tip: 商业往来与钱货交割

items.def_en: (+ in/with) Buy and sell commercial commodities; do business
Buy and sell goods, currencies, or services commercially
(+ in) Deal or trade in something, often illicit or unregulated
Arrange or negotiate an agreement or commercial transaction as a mediator

items.def_zh: 办理，执行；进行（交易、业务）
items.def_en: To conduct, manage, or complete business, affairs, or financial negotiations.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to conducting commercial deals, negotiating terms, and carrying out formal business or financial operations.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及开展商业往来、磋商条款及执行正式经贸交易活动。

groups.name: Transfer & Shift · 转移与位移 (Relocate, Shift, Reassign)
groups.tip: 人或物品换地安置

items.def_zh: 转移，调动；转让；转车，换乘
items.def_en: 1. To move from one place, job, or situation to another, or move someone or something there. 2. To officially pass property, rights, or control to someone else.
To move something slightly or transfer emphasis, blame, or resources to another point
To relinquish possession, authority, or custodial responsibility formally to another
To move oneself, an office, or personnel to a completely different physical site
To appoint someone to a different duty, post, or operational task

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on conveying people, objects, rights, or obligations from one physical location, role, or administrative domain to another. It contrasts physical cartage with institutional redeployment.
groups.summary_zh: 指人、物、责任或职权从一地、岗位或系统迁移调换至另一处。

groups.name: Transform & Convert · 转化与形变 (Transmute, Convert, Metamorphose)
groups.tip: 形式或能量本质改变

items.def_en: To change the character, form, or function of something from one state to another
To direct energy, resources, or impulses into a specific new form or outlet
To undergo a total, striking physical or structural transformation
To change or alter completely in form, nature, or substance into a higher state
1. (physics / biology) To convert energy or a signal from one form into another.

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to modifying the nature, form, or energy state of a system into another distinct format. While 'transduce' focuses on biophysical signal translation, its synonyms emphasize structural, chemical, or operational transmutation.
groups.summary_zh: 指能量形式、物质结构或系统信号由一种状态转变为另一种状态。

groups.name: Transition & Segue · 过渡与转换 (Transition, Shift, Segue)
groups.tip: 平滑顺畅地过渡与转换

items.def_en: (+ to/from) To change position, direction, emphasis, or focus smoothly
(+ to/into) To undergo or carry out a change from one condition, stage, or topic to another
To merge gradually and smoothly into another state, sound, or picture so changes are indistinct

items.def_zh: 转向；敏锐转换方向/策略
items.def_en: (+ to) To sharply or adaptively change strategic direction, focus, or topic

items.def_zh: 平稳过渡，顺畅转换（至新话题、歌曲或场景）
items.def_en: (+ into/from) To move smoothly and without interruption from one song, topic, or scene to the next.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers fluid, uninterrupted motion or shifting from one state, stage, theme, or musical passage into another without jarring disruptions.
groups.summary_zh: 指在状态、主题、环节或音乐之间平滑、无缝地衔接与转换。

groups.name: Translate & Localize Audiovisual Media · 影视译配与转录 (Dub, Caption, Localize)
groups.tip: 为影像作品配字幕或添加译注

items.def_zh: 为（电影或电视节目）配音
items.def_en: To replace the original soundtrack of a film or broadcast with a synchronized recording in another language

items.def_zh: 为（视频或图片）配说明文字或闭合字幕
items.def_en: To provide a video, broadcast, or illustration with descriptive text or closed captions
1. To provide a film, video, or broadcast with printed subtitles translating or transcribing the dialogue. 2. To give a secondary title to a book or work.

items.def_zh: 对（媒体内容或软件）进行本土化转换
items.def_en: To adapt translated audiovisual content or software to meet the linguistic and cultural norms of a target region

items.def_zh: 将（口述或录音）转写为文字
items.def_en: To produce a written or typed copy of spoken words, audio recordings, or dictated dialogue

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe adapting recorded speech or dialogue across media, either by substituting spoken audio tracks or superimposing translated or transcribed text for viewers.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及影视媒体的对白转录、翻译、字幕制作及配音本地化。

groups.name: Transplant & Graft · 移植与嫁接 (Graft, Transplant, Implant, Splice)
groups.tip: 植物枝条嫁接移栽

items.def_en: To implant living tissue or a shoot into a host organism so that biological union occurs
To surgically transfer an organ or tissue to a body, or move a plant with its roots to new soil
To insert an artificial device, tissue, or medical substance firmly into a living body
To join a shoot from one plant or a piece of healthy skin/tissue onto another so that they grow together.

items.def_zh: 拼接；接合（基因、树枝或绳缆）
items.def_en: To join two ends of plant stems, ropes, or strands of genetic material so they function as one

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to the surgical or horticultural technique of physically excising tissue, organs, or plant shoots and fusing them into another living host so they integrate and grow.
groups.summary_zh: 将活体组织、器官或植物嫩枝切取并植入另一载体使之结合生长的动作。

groups.name: Trap & Snare · 设套诱捕与困陷 (Trap, Snare, Entrap, Enmesh)
groups.tip: 从直接抓捕到设陷阱诱捕

items.def_zh: 设陷阱捕捉，诱捕；困住，使陷入困境
items.def_en: 1. To catch an animal using a trap. 2. To keep someone in a dangerous, confined, or difficult place from which they cannot escape.
To catch an animal using a wire loop or noose, or to entice a person into a trap
To catch or entangle someone in or as if in a snare or web
To lure or coax someone into an inescapable situation, illegal act, or compromising position
To catch or involve someone in a complicated web of problems, deceit, or nets

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify capturing animals or individuals through cunning mechanical traps, snares, or deceptive situations. The subject is physically restrained or cornered with little or no possibility of immediate escape.
groups.summary_zh: 设陷阱、罗网或圈套捕捉猎物或使人受困入局。

groups.name: Trawl & Comb Sources · 广泛撒网与拉网式排查 (Trawl, Comb, Sift)
groups.tip: 撒网排查广泛搜索资料

items.def_zh: 深入挖掘（数据或宝贵资料）
items.def_en: Dig deeply through vast amounts of information, records, or archives to extract useful data
Examine a mass of information or evidence carefully to separate valuable components from the irrelevant
1. To search thoroughly through a large amount of information, documents, or places in order to find something. 2. To fish by pulling a large net along the seabed.
Search a place or record thoroughly and systematically in order to locate someone or something
Search an entire region, database, or collection of texts with intense, exhaustive thoroughness

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses exhaustive, systematic searching through massive quantities of documents, public databases, archives, or geographical areas to extract relevant clues, candidates, or evidence.
groups.summary_zh: 像撒网或梳头一样地毯式排查海量数据、文献或现场以搜求目标。

groups.name: Tread & Trample · 踩踏与践踏 (Stamp, Tramp, Crush)
groups.tip: 用脚踏地或重重踩踏蹂躏

items.def_en: (+ on) To place one's feet on a surface or press something downward by stepping on it
To bring one's foot down heavily and forcefully on the ground or onto an object
To walk or tread heavily with deliberately loud, forceful, and often angry steps

items.def_zh: 踩碎，践踏；无视，肆意践踏（权利、情感等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To tread heavily on someone or something so as to cause damage or injury. 2. (+ on) To treat someone's rights, feelings, or opinions with callous disregard.
To crush, flatten, or destroy completely beneath feet or heavy hooves

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on heavy, destructive, or forceful downward footsteps that crush, mark, or damage what lies beneath. Verbs vary in emotional violence from deliberate stamping to careless or crowded trampling.
groups.summary_zh: 指以重步下踩、踩踏造成破坏或碾压的激烈足部动作。

groups.name: Treasure & Prize · 珍视与珍藏 (Prize, Value, Hold Dear)
groups.tip: 视若珍宝，倾注深厚情感呵护

items.def_en: To consider someone or something to be important, desirable, or worth having
To regard someone or something as having supreme value or special worth
1. To value someone or something highly and hold them dear; to cherish carefully.
To regard someone or something with exceptional emotional devotion and care
To respect and admire someone or something profoundly

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes assigning exceptional personal worth, esteem, or priceless emotional value to a possession, memory, or relationship.
groups.summary_zh: 强调视某人或某物为极其珍贵的无价之宝，予以极高评价与珍惜。

groups.name: Treat & Deal With · 对待与处置 (Handle, Manage, Address)
groups.tip: 如何看待与待人接物

items.def_en: To direct one's practical care, effort, and service toward a client, request, or duty
To deal with, manage, or take direct operational control of a person, situation, or task

items.def_zh: 对待，看待；处理，处置；治疗，医治；款待，请客
items.def_en: 1. to act or behave towards someone or something in a particular way. 2. to deal with or handle a subject. 3. to give medical care to someone or an illness. 4. to buy or provide something special for someone.
To direct attention and effort toward understanding and resolving a specific issue or problem
To make a determined and vigorous effort to deal with a difficult task, challenge, or opponent

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the behavioral attitude and practical approach an agent adopts when handling other individuals, administrative affairs, materials, or challenges.
groups.summary_zh: 对人采取的态度，或对事件、事务采取的应对处置手法。

groups.name: Tremble & Quake · 震颤与剧烈发抖 (Tremble, Shiver, Shudder)
groups.tip: 因恐惧寒冷微颤至剧震

items.def_en: To shake slightly and rapidly due to feeling chilled, feverish, or momentarily afraid
To vibrate or shake with a slight, rapid, fluttery motion
To shake involuntarily, typically with subtle, rapid oscillating movements caused by cold, fear, or emotion
To shake or tremble violently from fear, cold, or shock; (of the ground) to vibrate or shake.
To shake convulsively and violently with horror, revulsion, or deep vibration

groups.summary_en: This physical and physiological motion frame covers oscillating, shaking movements varying from faint nervous twitches to massive geological or fear-induced convulsions.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖因恐惧、严寒或外力引起的从轻微打颤到剧烈摇晃。

groups.name: Trill & Warble · 颤音与婉啭 (Warble, Chirp, Yodel)
groups.tip: 运用声带歌唱或婉转颤音

items.def_zh: 突然用尖细高嗓发声或歌唱
items.def_en: To begin to sing or speak in a shrill, piercing, or distinctly high-pitched voice
To make a short, sharp, cheerful, high-pitched musical sound like a small bird

items.def_zh: 用颤音唱；发颤音，用颤音说；（鸟等）啼啭
items.def_en: 1. To sing, speak, or pronounce a consonant with a vibrating warbling sound; to produce a continuous trembling sound.
To sing in a gentle, melodic, and warbling manner with rapid pitch variations

items.def_zh: 用真假声交替歌唱（约德尔唱法）
items.def_en: To sing by continually alternating between an ordinary voice and a high falsetto

groups.summary_en: Denotes vocalizing with rapid pitch fluctuations, vibrating tongue/palate motions, or high musical undulations typical of birds and skilled vocalists.
groups.summary_zh: 指快速变音、舌音颤动或宛转如鸟语般的婉转歌鸣之声。

groups.name: Trip & Stumble · 绊倒与踉跄 (Trip, Stumble, Falter, Tumble)
groups.tip: 失足绊脚跌跌撞撞

items.def_zh: 绊倒，绊；绊倒某人；轻快地走；失误，犯错
items.def_en: 1. To catch one's foot on something and stumble or fall, or cause someone to do so. 2. To walk or move with light, quick steps. 3. To make a mistake, or cause someone to make a mistake.
To walk unsteadily or pause hesitantly as if on the verge of falling
To knock one's foot against an obstacle and stumble or lose balance as a direct consequence
(+ over/on) To hit one's foot against something while walking or running, losing balance and nearly falling
To fall suddenly, awkwardly, or violently, often rolling headlong downward

groups.summary_en: Captures catching one's foot on an obstruction or losing equilibrium, resulting in unsteady, clumsy stepping or a sudden fall. 'Stumble' highlights momentary loss of balance, while 'trip over' denotes the triggering contact.
groups.summary_zh: 指足部受阻绊顿或失去平衡导致的一过性踉跄或跌倒动作。

groups.name: Troll & Bait · 煽动与挑衅 (Troll, Bait, Goad)
groups.tip: 从言语挑逗到蓄意煽动事端

items.def_en: To deliberately say things that tease or annoy someone to get a rise out of them

items.def_zh: （在网上）发挑衅言论，故意引战；拖钓
items.def_en: 1. (internet) To post deliberately offensive or provocative messages online to upset people and cause arguments. 2. To fish by trailing a baited line behind a boat
To intentionally provoke or tease someone to make them react angrily or carelessly
To deliberately provoke or bring about a dispute, conflict, or negative reaction

items.def_zh: 刺激，激励（促成激烈反应）
items.def_en: (+ into) To keep irritating or provoking someone until they react, often violently

groups.summary_en: This frame captures maliciously or playfully provoking others—frequently online or in discourse—with deliberate hostility, taunts, or inflammatory remarks intended purely to elicit an emotional, irrational outburst.
groups.summary_zh: 指特意通过挑衅言论、设套或嘲弄来激怒他人以引出失控反应。

groups.name: Truncate & Curtail · 截断与缩短 (Clip, Curtail, Lop off)
groups.tip: 砍去尾部使长度减少

items.def_en: To cut off the edge, end, or small parts of something with shears or scissors
To cut away dead or overgrown branches, or trim back unwanted sections to reduce size
To reduce the duration, extent, or scope of an activity or privilege
To make something shorter, especially by cutting off the top, end, or a section.
To chop or sever an extremity, branch, or section cleanly from something

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe shortening the length, duration, or extent of an object, process, or text by lopping off an extremity or imposing a cutoff.
groups.summary_zh: 指削去末端、强行截断或缩减长度与期限的动词群。

groups.name: Trust & Confide · 信任与信赖 (Believe In, Confide In, Credit)
groups.tip: 对他人寄托信任与心理倚赖

items.def_zh: 信任，信赖，相信；指望，依靠；托付
items.def_en: 1. to believe in the reliability, honesty, or ability of someone or something. 2. to place something valuable in someone's care.
To accept something as true or treat a person's words as trustworthy
To share personal secrets or feelings with someone whom you trust completely
To feel confident that someone is reliable, capable, or has honest intentions
To completely believe, trust, and accept an idea, plan, or person's claims

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the psychological state of having unwavering faith in someone's integrity, truthfulness, benevolence, or loyalty, often extending to sharing private vulnerabilities.
groups.summary_zh: 指对他人人品、诚意或誓言抱有由衷确信，乃至托付隐秘或重托。

groups.name: Try & Adjudicate · 审理与裁决 (Try, Hear, Adjudicate)
groups.tip: 法庭重新审理并作出裁判

items.def_en: To examine evidence in court and decide whether someone is guilty of a crime
To listen to and evaluate formal legal evidence, witnesses, and arguments in a trial
To act as a judge in a dispute or make a formal decision about a legal problem
To act as an impartial referee to settle a dispute between two dissenting parties
To hear or try a legal case again in a court of law.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame describe the official examination of evidence, arguments, and testimony in a judicial forum to resolve a dispute or determine legal liability.
groups.summary_zh: 在法庭或司法程序中审理案情并做出裁决。

groups.name: Try Again & Reattempt · 重试与再次努力 (Reattempt, Have Another Go, Revisit)
groups.tip: 付诸行动再次开展试验努力

items.def_en: to make another attempt to accomplish or complete something that was previously unsuccessful
(+ at) to try doing something again after an initial attempt
to test someone or something a second or subsequent time to verify results or performance

items.def_zh: 再碰一次运气；重新试一试
items.def_en: (+ at) to undertake a fresh attempt at a task or challenge, especially in informal speech

items.def_zh: 再试，重新尝试；（法律）重审，再审
items.def_en: 1. to attempt or try doing something again. 2. (law) to try a defendant or legal case a second time in court.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on repeating an effort or initiating a second attempt after an initial failure, pause, or legal review.
groups.summary_zh: 指在经历失败或中断后重新尝试、再作努力或二次审查。

groups.name: Twiddle & Idle Manipulation · 摆弄与闲转 (Twirl, Toy with, Diddle)
groups.tip: 无意识转动手指摆弄小物件

items.def_en: To keep touching or moving something nervously and restlessly with one's fingers
To touch, stroke, or manipulate an object absent-mindedly or without serious purpose
To turn something round and round quickly, especially with light finger movements
To turn or twist something around restlessly or idly with the fingers.
To pass time idly moving, turning, or playing with small mechanisms or objects

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses idle, unconscious, or restless manual manipulation where small objects or body parts are spun, rotated, or trifled with without constructive intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指百无聊赖或紧张时，用手指漫不经心地捻弄、转动或把玩小物件。

groups.name: Twist & Contort · 扭曲与变形 (Contort, Deform, Warp)
groups.tip: 反向扭动使其形变

items.def_en: To squeeze or twist the facial muscles tightly together in reaction to pain, sunlight, disgust, or effort
To become bent, twisted, or uneven, especially of wood or plastic damaged by heat, damp, or age
To twist or bend out of its normal shape, or cause the face or body to twist in an unnatural way.
To bend, warp, or collapse under excessive pressure, extreme heat, or heavy weight
To spoil or distort the normal shape or structure of something through pressure, heat, or injury

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote twisting, bending, or forcing physical objects, the face, or the body into an unnatural, grotesque, or disfigured shape.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或身体部位受外力或痛苦挤压而呈现畸形怪样。

groups.name: Twist & Wrench · 拧拉与扭损 (Wrench, Yank, Wrest)
groups.tip: 施加旋转扭力甚至猛拧

items.def_en: To injure a joint by suddenly and painfully stretching or tearing the ligaments around it
To tear or wrench something away from where it is attached with fierce physical force
1. To pull or twist something violently away from its fixed position. 2. To injure a joint by suddenly twisting it.
To pull someone or something with a sudden, forceful, sharp tug
(+ from) To pull, twist, or force something away from another's grasp with deliberate violent effort

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey applying sudden, forceful rotary or pulling leverage to tear an object from its setting or violently sprain a biological joint.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加爆发性旋拉力量强行挣脱、拔离或致使关节扭伤。

groups.name: Twist & Writhe · 扭动与翻腾 (Twist, Writhe, Thrash)
groups.tip: 身体因痛苦挣扎而蜷曲翻转

items.def_zh: 翻腾，扭动（身体）；拧，旋转；扭曲，歪曲
items.def_en: 1. To bend or turn the body or a part of it, especially repeatedly or in pain. 2. To turn something around, or wind things together. 3. To deliberately distort or misrepresent meaning or facts.
To wave or swing arms or legs around wildly and erratically without control
(+ about/around) To flail, kick, or move one's limbs violently and uncontrollably in wild struggle
(+ in/with) To twist and roll one's body continuously from side to side in violent physical pain or agony
To shake or twist violently and uncontrollably due to seizure, agony, or intense emotion

groups.summary_en: This frame captures intense, convulsive, or agonized twisting and rolling motions of the entire body or limbs, commonly triggered by excruciating pain, distress, or physical struggle.
groups.summary_zh: 表示躯体因剧烈痛苦或挣扎而剧烈翻腾、辗转扭曲。

groups.name: Twitch & Quirk · 微动与挑弄 (Quirk, Twitch, Arched Curvature)
groups.tip: 物体受力拧转改变形状

items.def_en: To tilt or raise a part of the body, especially an eyebrow or head, upward or to one side inquisitively
To curve an eyebrow or body part upward into an arched shape to express surprise or disbelief
To curve upward or backward, especially of a lip expressing amusement, scorn, or contempt
To make a short, sudden, involuntary jerking movement, especially of a muscle or facial feature
To twist or curve suddenly, especially of someone's mouth or eyebrows in response to an emotion.

groups.summary_en: This frame captures quick, subtle, and often asymmetric movements of facial features—such as eyebrows or lips—that convey irony, skepticism, amusement, or nervous tension.
groups.summary_zh: 描摹面容局部轻巧、不对称的抽动挑起，多表疑虑或戏谑。

groups.name: Unclog & Clear · 疏通与解堵 (Unblock, Unclog, Free)
groups.tip: 排清淤塞恢复管路畅通

items.def_en: To free a route, pipe, or space of whatever blocks, clutters, or obstructs it
To release something from an obstruction so that movement or access can occur freely

items.def_zh: 冲洗疏通；清除积垢或杂质
items.def_en: To forcefully flush out or clear an unwanted blockage or impurity from a pipe or system

items.def_zh: 疏通，清除……的堵塞；解除封锁
items.def_en: To remove an obstacle or barrier from a pipe, passage, or account so that movement or access is restored.
To remove an accumulation of matter that impedes passage through a pipe, drain, or channel

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate removing accumulated obstacles, detritus, or physical barriers from tubes, drains, or passageways to restore fluid movement and clear flow.
groups.summary_zh: 指清除管道或通道内的堵塞物，恢复通畅运行。

groups.name: Uncork & Unseal · 开启与拔塞 (Uncork, Pop, Broach)
groups.tip: 拔开瓶塞开启封闭

items.def_zh: 打开（有塞或易拉罐的饮料）；拔塞
items.def_en: To open a bottle or can by removing the cork or tab with a popping sound
To take the stopper out of a bottle or flask
To break or remove the seal of an envelope, bottle, or container

items.def_zh: 开启（酒桶、瓶子）；引申为提出（话题）
items.def_en: To pierce or open a cask or bottle to draw off liquid; figuratively, to raise a sensitive topic

items.def_zh: 拔去（瓶）塞；宣泄，发泄（感情）
items.def_en: 1. To pull the cork out of a bottle. 2. (figurative) To release strong feelings or emotions that have been held back.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe removing stoppers, corks, or seals from containers to release liquid or contents, often extended figuratively to releasing pent-up emotions or topics.
groups.summary_zh: 拔去瓶塞、破封开瓶，或引申为释放压抑情绪。

groups.name: Uncouple & Estrange · 解离与隔绝 (Dissociate, Disconnect, Detach)
groups.tip: 从整体中脱钩或剥离

items.def_en: To become temporarily oblivious to one's surroundings by drifting into a daydream or daze
To separate oneself emotionally or mentally from a situation or person
To lose touch, empathy, or psychological contact with people, surroundings, or reality

items.def_zh: 使脱离关系，声明不赞同；使分离，使脱离；（化学）使离解
items.def_en: 1. (dissociate oneself from) To state clearly that you are not connected with or do not support a person, group, or belief. 2. To consider or treat two things as separate and unconnected.
To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged from their environment, peers, or society

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cognitive, psychological, or state-based separation where an entity detaches its feelings, consciousness, or identity from an external event or reality.
groups.summary_zh: 指心理、意识或状态层面上抽离自我，与外界现实或情感产生割裂。

groups.name: Uncover & Reveal · 揭露与揭示 (Uncover, Disclose, Expose)
groups.tip: 揭开掩盖探得内在真相

items.def_en: to reveal or uncover facts that had previously remained hidden or forgotten
to make secret or confidential information publicly or officially known

items.def_zh: 发现，揭示，揭露；揭开……的盖子
items.def_en: 1. To discover or make known something secret, hidden, or unknown. 2. To remove a cover or top from something so that it can be seen.
to make known the disreputable or shocking facts about a person, institution, or scheme
to strip away all concealment and present the raw, unvarnished truth

groups.summary_en: Deals with bringing hidden, scandalous, or concealed information into public view, ranging from stripping away physical covers to detonating explosive public exposures.
groups.summary_zh: 指将刻意隐瞒的真相、秘密或丑闻公之于众，揭去遮蔽。

groups.name: Undercut & Price Below · 低价竞争与自贬 (Undersell, Undercut, Underquote)
groups.tip: 以货物换取金钱进行贸易

items.def_en: To deduct a certain amount or percentage from the regular price of an item
To export or sell goods in large quantities at artificially low prices to dominate a market

items.def_zh: 报低价，报出低于对手的价格
items.def_en: To quote an estimated price lower than that of a competitor or lower than the true cost

items.def_zh: 削减价格竞争，以低于……的价格出售
items.def_en: To offer goods or services at a lower price or wage than a competitor

items.def_zh: 以低于竞争对手的价格出售；低估……的价值
items.def_en: 1. To sell goods or services at a lower price than a competitor. 2. ('undersell oneself') To undervalue or fail to do justice to one's own merits.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on selling goods or services at a lower price than competitors to gain market advantage, or downplaying one's own merits and skills.
groups.summary_zh: 指以低于竞争对手的价格抛售或压价竞争，亦指低估并贬低自身价值。

groups.name: Undervalue & Underestimate · 低估与轻看 (Underrate, Downplay, Undervalue)
groups.tip: 粗略估算直至最终裁决

items.def_en: To think or guess that the amount, cost, difficulty, or value of something is smaller than it actually is, or to undervalue someone's ability.
To try to make people think that something is less important or serious than it really is
To underestimate or fail to acknowledge the full merits or potential of someone or yourself
To fail to recognize how good, strong, clever, or important someone or something really is
To consider someone or something to be less valuable or significant than they actually are

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cognitive errors or deliberate rhetoric that judges a person, threat, capability, or value to be substantially smaller, weaker, or less important than reality proves.
groups.summary_zh: 对事物的重要性、能力、价值或危险性作出偏低的评估与判断。

groups.name: Unfold & Spread Out · 展开与铺平 (Spread out, Lay out)
groups.tip: 解开折痕并完全铺展开

items.def_en: to smooth down creases or make something level and flat after it has been folded or crumpled
to spread something out flat so that it can be inspected, worked on, or easily seen
to unfold or expand so as to become wider, more extensive, or completely accessible
to open something fully and arrange it across a flat surface so that the entire area is covered or visible

items.def_zh: 展开，摊开，打开（折叠物）；（情节、事件等）逐渐展现，显露
items.def_en: 1. to open out something that has been folded, or to become open and flat. 2. (of events or a story) to develop or become gradually revealed.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers opening out objects that have been folded or creased (such as maps, linens, or chairs) until they are wide and flat, as well as events opening up before someone.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将折叠之物拉开、摊平，使表面充分展现，亦指情节展开。

groups.name: Uniform & Standardize Attire · 统一着装与配发制服 (Uniform, Livery, Standardize)
groups.tip: 配齐整套工具或制服行头

items.def_en: To provide a person or group with garments or dress them in a specific style
To clothe someone in a distinctive religious habit or official dress
to provide someone or a group with uniforms

items.def_zh: 为（侍从等）穿仆服；配备特色制服
items.def_en: To dress servants, personnel, or vehicles in a distinctive institutional livery
To dress someone in particular or formal garments

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses dressing or supplying an entire workforce, military unit, or group in identical, regulation garments. It emphasizes institutional uniformity and visual conformity over individual protection.
groups.summary_zh: 指为集体、军队或雇员配发统一制服或使着装规范化。

groups.name: Unload & Shift · 卸载与转嫁 (Discharge, Jettison, Unburden)
groups.tip: 卸除货物转移安置

items.def_en: (+ onto/as) To dispose of something undesirable or counterfeit by transferring it to another
To unload cargo or release passengers from a ship, aircraft, or vehicle
To remove goods or freight from a carrier, or rid oneself of unwanted stock or obligations

items.def_zh: 卸载，卸（货）；转嫁，甩掉（责任、负担）
items.def_en: 1. To unload goods or passengers from a ship, aircraft, or vehicle. 2. (+ onto) To get rid of an unwanted thing, responsibility, or task by passing it on to someone else.
To throw cargo or fuel overboard in distress, or discard an unwelcome burden quickly

groups.summary_en: This frame involves removing cargo, passengers, or burdens from a vehicle or container, extending figuratively to ridding oneself of unwanted tasks, liabilities, or responsibilities.
groups.summary_zh: 指从运载体卸下载荷，或转嫁责任、摆脱累赘。

groups.name: Unpack & Take Out · 拆箱与取出 (Unpack, Unload, Empty)
groups.tip: 拆开包装封条倒出内部物品

items.def_en: To remove an object from the interior of a pocket, container, or case
To remove cargo, freight, or contents from a vehicle, container, or ship

items.def_zh: 从（箱包等中）取出；打开……收拾行李；分析，剖析
items.def_en: 1. To take things out of a suitcase, box, or package; to remove the contents of a container. 2. (figurative) To analyze and explain a complex concept or statement in detail.
To unroll or unfold something packed tightly, such as a tent, sail, or roll of fabric
To remove everything contained inside a box, bag, or room so that nothing remains

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on emptying containers, luggage, or vehicles by systematically taking contents out, transitioning an enclosed load into the open.
groups.summary_zh: 指将行李箱、箱盒或车体内的物品一件件取出并清空容器。

groups.name: Unroll & Roll Out · 展开与铺开 (Unfurl, Roll out)
groups.tip: 顺势摊开卷轴或平铺开来

items.def_en: to flatten out something by rolling it, or to introduce a new product or service gradually to the public
to unwind or take off material that is wound around a spool, bobbin, or reel
to remove the paper, cloth, or other covering that is wound around an object

items.def_zh: （使）展开，（使）铺开（卷状物）；展现，展现出来
items.def_en: 1. to open out something that has been rolled up, or to become flat and open. 2. to gradually reveal or unfold over time.

items.def_zh: 使展开展开；（卷起的旗帜、帆等）张开
items.def_en: to unroll and spread out, or to cause something folded or curled up (such as a flag or sail) to open flat

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe unwinding or flattening out something that was wound into a cylinder or coil, whether physical objects like carpets and scrolls or metaphorical plans.
groups.summary_zh: 指将卷起之物展平、铺开，或引申指逐步呈现与推行。

groups.name: Unseal & Unbox · 拆封与开包 (Unbox, Unseal, Unwrap)
groups.tip: 打开包装取出其中物件

items.def_en: To open containers or luggage and take the items out
To remove paper, plastic, or protective wrapping from an item or gift
To break or open the seal of an envelope, parcel, container, or official document

items.def_zh: 拆盒，拆箱（取出新物品并展示）
items.def_en: To remove a newly purchased product from its packaging, especially to examine or film it.
To rip or open packaging eagerly and forcefully

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail opening newly packaged items, removing protective wrappers, seals, or outer parcel layers, often with a focus on reveal and display.
groups.summary_zh: 指拆开包装盒、撕开封条或揭开外层包裹以取出并展示新物。

groups.name: Uproot & Exterminate · 连根拔起与除绝 (Root out, Extirpate, Exterminate)
groups.tip: 连根拔起并彻底消灭祸患

items.def_en: Remove inferior, unwanted, or harmful elements from a group or system
Find and completely eliminate something harmful, dangerous, or unwanted
Extinguish or eliminate completely by forceful, decisive measures
Tear something up by the roots or eradicate it completely from its native environment
(formal) To destroy or root out something completely, such as a disease, evil, or unwanted plant.

groups.summary_en: High-intensity verbs indicating the total, unsparing destruction or pulling out by the roots of vices, populations, or hazardous entities to prevent resurgence.
groups.summary_zh: 强调连根铲除、斩草除根以绝后患的高强度毁灭动作。

groups.name: Vacation & Holiday · 度假与休假 (Vacation, Holiday, Week-end)
groups.tip: 外出度假放松或度蜜月

items.def_en: To take a recreational break or travel somewhere enjoyable away from routine work
To spend time away from home or employment for relaxation and recreation
To stay temporarily as a visitor or traveler at a designated location

items.def_zh: 外出度假，逃离繁忙日常
items.def_en: To leave one's home or daily responsibilities to enjoy a short vacation or period of rest
To spend a holiday together immediately after getting married.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on spending dedicated recreational periods away from home, work, or routine responsibilities, often characterized by leisure travel or seasonal retreats.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱离日常工作或居家生活，前往他处进行专属度假与休闲游憩。

groups.name: Vacation & Unwind · 度假与休养 (Vacation, Recreate, Chill out)
groups.tip: 享受假期停工休整放松

items.def_en: To spend the winter months in a particular place, often somewhere warm
(chiefly North American) To spend a holiday or vacation somewhere.
To spend time relaxing and not doing very much
To stop working and relax completely, especially on vacation
To engage in recreational activities and relaxation for pleasure

groups.summary_en: Centered on North American and informal registers, these verbs denote spending extended leisure periods away from work to relax, tour, or decompress.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重美式表达，指休假、散心或外出游玩放松。

groups.name: Validate & Authenticate · 验证与确证 (Validate, Authenticate, Verify, Confirm)
groups.tip: 确证可靠性与逻辑真实

items.def_en: To state formally and officially in writing that certain required criteria or standards have been fulfilled
To check and prove the truth, correctness, or exact details of something through formal examination
To be examined carefully and found to be true, accurate, or above suspicion
1. To prove or confirm that something is true, valid, or logically correct. 2. To make something officially acceptable or legally binding.
To prove conclusively that an object, signature, identity, or document is genuine and not forged

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe evaluating something against rigorous technical, legal, or emotional criteria to establish that it is genuine, functionally legitimate, or logically sound.
groups.summary_zh: 通过系统检验、技术或官方程序，确证某物的真实性、合规性或有效性。

groups.name: Vent & Discharge · 宣泄与爆发 (Let out, Unleash, Blow off steam, Bottle up)
groups.tip: 由平铺直叙陈述转为激烈宣泄释放

items.def_en: to do or say something that helps get rid of excess energy, stress, or anger
to release or utter a sound, breath, or pent-up feeling openly
to talk openly and unrestrainedly about one's troubles, grief, or inner thoughts

items.def_zh: 发泄，宣泄；排出（气体、烟雾等）
items.def_en: 1. to express a strong, usually negative emotion openly and forcefully. 2. to allow air, smoke, or gas to escape through an opening
to suddenly release a powerful force, violent emotion, or strong impulse

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on forceful physical or verbal release of pent-up emotional pressure, especially frustration, anger, or distress.
groups.summary_zh: 指将胸中压抑已久的愤怒、怨气或压抑情绪强烈释放、发泄出来。

groups.name: Venture & Braving · 涉险与探进 (Brave, Sally Forth, Forge Ahead)
groups.tip: 甘冒风险迈向未知险境

items.def_zh: 冒险前往，涉险迈向；敢于，冒着……的风险
items.def_en: 1. To proceed somewhere despite the risk of danger or unpleasant conditions. 2. To dare to say or do something that may be criticized or fail.
To face and endure hazardous conditions or weather courageously
To set out boldly or briskly from a secure place on an expedition or foray

items.def_zh: 坚定迈进，克服险阻前行
items.def_en: To make progress steadily and resolutely despite obstacles or hazardous terrain
To cast oneself impetuously into a dangerous place or unpredictable situation

groups.summary_en: Encompasses moving outward or proceeding into unfamiliar, inhospitable, or perilous territories and situations despite clear hazards.
groups.summary_zh: 不顾潜藏危险、恶劣环境或未知挑战，冒险深入或挺进。

groups.name: Venture & Dare · 冒险与涉足 (Risk, Stake, Braving)
groups.tip: 涉险探索未知领域

items.def_en: Expose oneself or an asset to the possibility of danger, harm, or loss
1. To take risks or venture boldly into the unknown. 2. To risk or hazard something on an uncertain outcome.
Dare to go somewhere that may be dangerous or unpleasant, or risk a daring statement
Endure or face unpleasant, hostile, or dangerous conditions with courage
Put something at risk of being lost or damaged; boldly make a guess or proposal

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe daring to go into dangerous, uncharted, or precarious environments, or risking assets, safety, and reputation on an outcome fraught with uncertainty.
groups.summary_zh: 不惧未知或危险而勇敢涉足、探涉，或下注冒险行动。

groups.name: Venture an Attempt · 试行与探试 (Endeavor, Undertake, Venture)
groups.tip: 做出初步努力与试验探索

items.def_en: (+ at) to make a tentative or experimental attempt at solving or performing something
(formal) to attempt or try to do something, especially something difficult.
to dare to undertake a risky enterprise or put forward a tentative thought or attempt
to commit oneself to and begin executing a complex or demanding project or task
(+ to do) to make a strenuous and determined effort to accomplish something difficult

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses deliberate, often tentative or demanding efforts to execute a difficult enterprise, test an idea, or probe one's limits.
