groups.summary_zh: 指审慎试探、敢于承接艰巨任务或尝试未知行动。

groups.name: Verbalize & Voice Feelings · 语言表达与说出 (Voice, Put into words, Express)
groups.tip: 将内心感受用准确言辞表述出来

items.def_en: To give verbal utterance or public expression to concerns, feelings, or objections
To show, depict, or convey a thought, opinion, or emotion using words, looks, or actions
To express something complex, intangible, or deeply felt in explicit spoken or written language
To give one's opinions freely, honestly, and boldly, especially in defense or protest
1. To express thoughts, feelings, or ideas in spoken or written words.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses translating internal sentiments, abstract ideas, or bodily pain into externalized spoken or written language. The focus is on finding words to make the internal intelligible.
groups.summary_zh: 将内心的感受、思绪或直觉转化成言辞表达出来。

groups.name: Verge & Border On · 临近与濒临 (Verge, Border, Teeter)
groups.tip: 逐渐接近边缘或临界点

items.def_en: To stay close to a particular value, level, or boundary without decisively crossing it

items.def_zh: 近似，濒临（某种极端状态）
items.def_en: To come very close to being an extreme state, quality, or condition
To lie along the outer edge of something or come close to touching a controversial line

items.def_zh: 濒临，临近；接近（某种状态）
items.def_en: ('verge on/upon') To come close to or be on the brink of reaching a particular state or condition.
To stand or balance precariously on the brink of disaster or extreme change

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express being closely adjacent to an extreme, perilous, or decisive state, often indicating a precarious threshold before a complete transition.
groups.summary_zh: 指空间或状态上极度贴近、濒临某种临界点。

groups.name: Violent Cleaving & Sundering · 强力撕裂与劈开 (Sunder, Sever, Rend)
groups.tip: 彻底切断关联使之两隔

items.def_en: Break or cause to break into numerous sharp, thin, and jagged fragments
Divide or cut something cleanly or forcibly into distinct parts, or end a relationship abruptly
(literary) To split, tear, or break apart violently into two or more parts.
Split or sever something along a natural grain or with a sharp, heavy blow
Tear something violently and brutally apart into two or more pieces

groups.summary_en: Elevated or literary verbs describing severe, traumatic, and violent parting, splitting, or dividing of physical bodies, bonds, or territories into separate pieces.
groups.summary_zh: 多具文雅或戏剧色彩，指施加暴力使物体、肢体或关系彻底断绝、劈开。

groups.name: Wade & Tramp · 涉水与泥行 (Wade, Splash, Slosh)
groups.tip: 在泥水水坑中踩踏前行

items.def_en: To move through liquid causing drops to fly noisily about
To walk with effort through shallow water, mud, or deep liquid
To walk barefoot in shallow water for leisure or pleasure

items.def_zh: 在水坑（或泥水）中践踏；把（黏土）捣制成胶土
items.def_en: 1. to splash, dabble, or tramp about in muddy water or shallow puddles 2. to work wet clay into a dense, watertight lining

items.def_zh: 在烂泥/水中吧唧吧唧地走
items.def_en: To splash clumsily through water, slush, or mud while walking

groups.summary_en: Captures the act of walking or splashing through shallow water, mud, or wet substances where footing meets fluid resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 在浅水、淤泥或积水中艰难踩踏、涉行或戏水。

groups.name: Wag & Oscillate · 摆动与摇晃 (Wiggle, Swish, Wave)
groups.tip: 左右摇摆尾巴晃动

items.def_en: To move one's hand or an object back and forth repeatedly through the air
To whip or jerk an animal's tail sharply from side to side
To make quick, short movements from side to side or up and down

items.def_zh: 摇摆，摇动（尾巴或手指等）
items.def_en: To move rapidly back and forth or up and down, especially of an animal's tail or a finger.
To move or wave smoothly and quickly through the air, often with a soft hissing sound

groups.summary_en: Verbs here depict quick, repeated, expressive oscillating movements of appendages, bodily extremities (tails, fingers, hips), or slender flexible tools.
groups.summary_zh: 专指尾巴、手指、枝条或肢体末端轻快且富有表现力的来回摆动。

groups.name: Wager & Gamble · 打赌与押注 (Wager, Stake, Punt)
groups.tip: 赌博押注的风险交易

items.def_en: 1. To risk money on the unknown result of an event or competition. 2. To feel confident or certain that something is true or will happen.
To risk money, reputation, or one's future on the success of an enterprise or the outcome of a contest
To play games of chance for money, or to take huge speculative chances in hopes of gains

items.def_zh: （在赛马等中）下小注；冒险一试
items.def_en: (informal) To bet money on a horse, team, or venture; to take a speculative chance on an unknown
To risk an amount of money on a future outcome or competition, formalized under agreed odds

groups.summary_en: Involves staking money or value on an uncertain future outcome (sporting matches, dice, cards, or speculative ventures), ranging from formal bookmaking wagers to informal personal challenges.
groups.summary_zh: 以金钱或贵重物对不确定结果进行下注、博弈或立誓赌赛。

groups.name: Wager & Gamble · 押注与博彩 (Wager, Gamble, Stake)
groups.tip: 以财物作注博取回报

items.def_en: To bet a specific amount of money or offer odds on an event.
To risk money, one's reputation, or safety on the outcome of a contest or undertaking.
To play games of chance for money, or take risky actions hoping for success.
(informal/chiefly BrE) To bet money on a race or venture, or take a gamble on an opportunity.

items.def_zh: 押注，打赌；下赌注于；敢说，确信
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) (formal) To bet an amount of money on the outcome of an unpredictable event or competition. 2. To say or guess with confidence that something is true.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate placing money, assets, or status at hazard upon an uncertain contest, game of chance, or future event in hopes of winning gains.
groups.summary_zh: 在不可预测的结果或赌局中投入资金或资本博取收益。

groups.name: Wail & Howl · 哀号与恸哭 (Wail, Howl, Keens)
groups.tip: 由伤心落泪演变为嚎啕大哭

items.def_en: To make a sudden, loud vocalization because of intense pain, fear, or distress
To utter a loud, long, mournful cry in severe pain, grief, or rage

items.def_zh: 恸哭，哀号，嚎啕；呼啸，发出长而尖厉的声音
items.def_en: 1. To cry out with a long, high, mournful sound of pain or grief; to utter with wailing. 2. To make a prolonged, high-pitched mournful sound.
To weep loudly and noisily, typically like a distraught child
To utter a high-pitched, piercing wail in mourning for the dead

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate high-volume, vocalized outpourings of intense agony, mourning, or physical torment characterized by prolonged pitch and vocal strain.
groups.summary_zh: 指伴随高亢尖锐、长声嘶吼的极度痛苦或悲恸呼号。

groups.name: Wait & Tarry · 停留与等待 (Tarry, Linger, Bide, Mark time)
groups.tip: 静止逗留或等待时机

items.def_en: Pass time doing little while waiting for a better opportunity or command to proceed
Stay in a place longer than necessary because one is reluctant to leave

items.def_zh: 等待，等候（时机）；停留，逗留
items.def_en: (especially in 'bide one's time') To wait patiently for a good opportunity to do something.
Stay longer than intended, or delay leaving or arriving somewhere
Wait patiently until an unpleasant or stormy event comes to an end

groups.summary_en: Describes remaining in a place or delaying action instead of proceeding. Nuances highlight patient strategic waiting (biding), leisurely reluctance to depart (lingering), or archaic dilly-dallying (tarrying).
groups.summary_zh: 指停留不走、延迟离开或耐心驻守等待时机成熟。

groups.name: Wake & Rouse · 唤醒与使振奋 (Awaken, Rouse, Stir)
groups.tip: 从沉睡或昏睡中被唤醒

items.def_en: To emerge from sleep into consciousness, or to cause another person to do so
To begin to move slightly after sleep, or to provoke someone into movement or consciousness
To stop sleeping, or to wake someone up from slumber or inactivity
1. To wake someone up from sleep. 2. To make someone feel active, excited, or interested.
To restore to consciousness, life, or renewed strength after fainting, illness, or sleep

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate disturbing someone from sleep, stupor, or apathy, shifting an individual or group from dormancy into active physical consciousness or vigorous action.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人从睡眠、昏睡或麻木中叫醒，促使其清醒并活跃起来。

groups.name: Ward Off & Forfend · 禳除与防范 (Forfend, Avert, Ward off)
groups.tip: 祈求避开灾祸预先阻绝

items.def_en: To take active measures to repel or defend against danger, harm, illness, or unwanted advances
To successfully deflect or defend oneself against an incoming blow, attack, criticism, or difficulty
To delay, ward off, or prevent something harmful or unwelcome from taking effect for a period of time
To prevent an unpleasant, dangerous, or disastrous event from happening
1. (archaic or formal) To avert, ward off, or prevent something undesirable from happening.

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on anticipatory measures taken to protect against, drive away, or deflect an approaching danger, evil, or catastrophe.
groups.summary_zh: 在祸患来临之前主动采取行动加以避开或抵御。

groups.name: Warm Up & Limber · 热身与伸展拉伸 (Warm Up, Stretch, Limber Up)
groups.tip: 活动舒展筋骨使身体灵活

items.def_en: To extend one's limbs or body to full length in order to loosen and elongate the muscles
To prepare for physical activity by exercising gently to increase circulation and muscle suppleness
To make one's muscles or body flexible and pliable by performing stretching exercises
To perform light exercises to relieve physical stiffness and make joints move freely

items.def_zh: 使柔软，活动（肌肉）；做准备活动，热身
items.def_en: 1. (often 'limber up') To do light stretching exercises to make muscles flexible and ready for physical effort.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe performing gentle physical exercises, dynamic stretches, or calisthenics to loosen stiff joints, elevate heart rate, and prepare muscles for vigorous exertion. They contrast general calisthenics with targeted muscle lengthening.
groups.summary_zh: 指在剧烈运动前进行轻柔拉伸或活动，使身体舒展防伤。

groups.name: Warn & Admonish in Advance · 预先告诫与提醒 (Alert, Caution, Tip off)
groups.tip: 防患未然提前预警以促其警醒

items.def_en: To warn someone about possible danger, mistakes, or negative consequences
To give someone secret or advance information about something that is about to happen
To warn someone of a dangerous or surprising situation so they can take action
To advise or urge someone earnestly, or gently warn them not to do something
To warn someone about a possible danger, difficulty, or unpleasant event beforehand.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers acts of advising someone ahead of time regarding oncoming peril, hazards, or negative outcomes, varying from gentle cautions to urgent alerts.
groups.summary_zh: 就潜在危险或不利后果向当事人提前预警或严肃告诫。

groups.name: Water & Irrigate Soil · 浇灌与农田供水 (Irrigate, Hydrate, Sprinkle)
groups.tip: 向土壤或植物人工浇水润泽

items.def_zh: 给……浇水，灌溉；流泪，流口水；给……供水
items.def_en: 1. to pour water on plants or the soil to help them grow; to supply land with water 2. (of eyes) to fill with tears; (of the mouth) to produce saliva
To water thoroughly or wash down using a flexible hose

items.def_zh: 喷淋或洒水于（草坪、花园）
items.def_en: To scatter fine drops of water lightly over a lawn, field, or flowerbed

items.def_zh: 为（土壤或植物）补充水分
items.def_en: To restore or supply an adequate amount of water to parched soil, compost, or living tissue
To supply land, crops, or agricultural soil with water by means of channels, pipes, or automated systems

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate applying water artificially to crops, lawns, gardens, or dry soil via canals, sprinklers, or manual pouring to support plant growth.
groups.summary_zh: 向土地、植被或农作物注水浇灌，维持水土润泽与生长。

groups.name: Wave & Salute · 致意与挥手招呼 (Wave, Greet, Salute)
groups.tip: 用招手、挥手等动作打招呼

items.def_en: to lower and raise your head quickly as an informal acknowledgment or greeting
to bid farewell to departing people by waving, or to dismiss someone with a dismissive hand gesture

1. to move your hand or arm as a greeting, farewell, or signal
2. to move loosely back and forth or flutter in the wind
to greet, call out to, or wave enthusiastically to attract someone's attention from a distance
to bring a hand to the forehead as a formal military sign of respect, or to greet someone formally

groups.summary_en: This frame captures interpersonal physical signs used to acknowledge, greet, or bid farewell to someone. Nuances range from casual hand-waving to formal military saluting or warm physical acknowledgment across distances.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过挥手、敬礼等动作向他人致以问候、致意或告别。

groups.name: Waver & Distrust · 疑虑动摇与踌躇信任 (Waver, Hesitate, Hedge)
groups.tip: 由将信将疑到心生戒备

items.def_en: To pause before saying or doing something due to uncertainty or reluctance

items.def_zh: 闪烁其词，留退路以规避不测
items.def_en: To avoid making a definite decision or commitment out of skepticism or caution

items.raw_cluster: 怀疑与不信任 Doubt & Distrust
items.def_en: To feel that someone or something cannot be relied upon or trusted.
To become unsteady or falter in resolution, opinion, or faith

items.def_zh: 在两种选择或信任间摇摆不定
items.def_en: To alternate or waver between different opinions or actions indecisively

groups.summary_en: Highlights the behavioral paralysis or hesitation resulting from lack of trust and chronic doubt. Because one lacks confidence in an entity or claim, one wavers and delays commitment.
groups.summary_zh: 因内心缺乏信任与坚定信念，而在决断时动摇、游移与踌躇不前。

groups.name: Weatherproof & Protect · 防护与抵御 (Weatherproof, Waterproof, Winterize)
groups.tip: 抵御外界侵蚀提供防护

items.def_en: To coat a surface with a liquid protective substance that prevents moisture or air penetration

items.def_zh: 使作过冬准备；防冻处理
items.def_en: To adapt, insulate, or treat a building, engine, or system so that it can withstand freezing winter conditions
To treat a metal surface with chemicals or paint so that it resists oxidation and corrosion
To make a fabric, wall, or object impervious to water by coating or treating it with a sealant

items.def_zh: 使防风雨，使不受风雨侵蚀
items.def_en: 1. To treat, seal, or coat a surface, building, or garment so that it resists damage from rain, wind, and cold.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to treating, coating, or sealing physical structures, fabrics, or surfaces to make them resilient against harsh atmospheric elements like water, freezing cold, or wind. They emphasize protective material modification.
groups.summary_zh: 通过涂层、封堵等工艺改造表面或建筑，抵御风雨侵蚀或恶劣天气。

groups.name: Weave & Thread · 穿行与穿梭 (Weave, Thread, Wiggle Through)
groups.tip: 在狭窄空隙间巧妙穿针引线

items.def_en: Follow a curving, twisting, or sinuous path through terrain or spaces
Walk slowly and deliberately through a messy, dangerous, or obstructed area
Move by repeatedly turning and changing direction between obstacles, people, or vehicles
Squeeze or move slowly and furtively through a narrow passage or tightly packed crowd
1. To make one's way carefully through a crowded or narrow space. 2. To pass a thread, needle, or strip through an opening.

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies navigating a path by deftly winding, swerving, and passing through crowded, confined, or obstacle-laden spaces. It highlights continuous course adjustments and agility.
groups.summary_zh: 指在拥挤、狭窄或充满障碍的空间中敏捷游移穿行。

groups.name: Wed & Form Marital Alliances · 结为伉俪与联姻 (Wed, Espouse, Tie the knot)
groups.tip: 跨宗族或阶层通婚联合

items.def_en: (formal or literary) To marry someone; to join in matrimonial union
(+ with/by) To join forces or bind families/dynasties together, often through marriage
(idiomatic) To get married legally or ceremonially
(archaic or literary) To marry someone or give someone in marriage
1. (+ with) When people from different families, religions, or social groups intermarry, they marry each other.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses entering into matrimonial unions, whether viewed as romantic commitments, religious solemnities, or socio-political alliances between families or tribes. It covers both solemn rites and diplomatic pairings.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过婚姻结合，尤指家族、族群间缔结婚约以达成联姻。

groups.name: Wedge & Jam · 嵌塞与卡紧 (Jam, Cram, Squeeze into)
groups.tip: 楔入窄缝或用力塞紧

items.def_en: To succeed in getting oneself or an object into a very tight, crowded opening or compartment
To force a large number of people or things into a space that is too small for them
To force or squeeze someone or something into an inadequate space or schedule with great difficulty
To push, shove, or pack something into a narrow space so tightly that it becomes stuck or immovable
To force, pack, or squeeze something tightly into a narrow space so that it cannot move

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly pressing or packing an object or person into an extremely tight, constricted space so that movement is restricted or blocked. 'Wedge' suggests triangular taper or immobility, while 'jam' highlights obstruction, and 'cram' stresses overfilling.
groups.summary_zh: 指强行将人或物体挤压、嵌入狭窄缝隙，使其紧塞或动弹不得。

groups.name: Weep & Whimper · 哭泣与呜咽 (Sob, Weep, Whimper)
groups.tip: 断断续续抽泣抽噎流泪

items.def_en: To make low, feeble, intermittent sounds expressing fear, pain, or discontent
To cry and sniffle tearfully, often in a weak, fretful, or insincere manner

items.def_zh: 啜泣，抽噎，呜咽；抽噎着说
items.def_en: To cry noisily while taking sudden, sharp, gasping breaths; to say something while weeping in this way.
To shed tears quietly or continuously as an expression of deep sorrow or grief
To lose control of one's emotions and begin weeping uncontrollably

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on subdued, convulsive, or quiet expressions of grief and distress, highlighting uneven breathing, low gasps, and flowing tears rather than loud outcries.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重抽噎、落泪或低声呜咽等非高声哀号的悲伤哭泣表现。

groups.name: Welcome & Receive · 欢迎与接纳 (Greet, Receive, Usher in)
groups.tip: 对来访者致以热情问候接待

items.def_en: To formally meet, accommodate, or react to visitors or guests upon their arrival

items.def_zh: 欢迎，热情接待；乐于接受，欣然欢迎
items.def_en: 1. To greet a visitor or newcomer in a friendly or polite manner. 2. To receive or accept an idea, decision, or change gladly.
To accept, support, or welcome an idea, person, or change with enthusiasm and open arms
To mark the beginning of or formally introduce a new person, period, or phase
To give a sign of polite recognition or welcome to someone upon meeting or arrival

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on greeting a visitor, newcomer, or new initiative with hospitality, openness, or positive acceptance. It contrasts friendly personal receptions with formal institutional hospitality.
groups.summary_zh: 以热情或礼貌的姿态迎接访客，或欣然接纳新事物。

groups.name: Whimper & Whine · 呜咽与低泣 (Whine, Pule, Snivel)
groups.tip: 因痛苦或哀伤发出低沉呜咽

items.def_en: To cry weakly or plaintively like a baby or young animal
1. To make weak, low crying sounds expressing pain, fear, or unhappiness, or utter words in this manner.
To cry and sniffle in a tearful, complaining, or self-pitying way
To cry plaintively with a thin, weak voice
To emit a prolonged, high-pitched cry of distress, complaint, or petulance

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the production of weak, plaintive, high-pitched vocal sounds that communicate fear, helplessness, pain, or childish petulance.
groups.summary_zh: 指因疼痛、恐惧或委屈而发出微弱、尖细、哀怨的呜咽或哼唧声。

groups.name: Whisk & Bundle · 快速送走与敏捷转移 (Whisk, Hustle, Bundle)
groups.tip: 迅速动作或极速位移之势

items.def_zh: 紧急运送；急送（去医院等）
items.def_en: To transport someone or something somewhere with the greatest possible speed

items.def_zh: 匆忙塞进；粗暴快速带走
items.def_en: (+ into/off) To push or pack someone quickly and roughly into a car, room, or vehicle

items.def_zh: 推推搡搡迅速带走；催促快走
items.def_en: (+ into/out of) To cause someone to move quickly by pushing or urging them along firmly

items.def_zh: 暗中劫走；神不知鬼不觉地运走
items.def_en: To take someone or something away rapidly, secretly, and without attracting notice

items.def_zh: 飞快带走，匆匆送走；快速挥动；搅拌
items.def_en: 1. (+ away/off/into) To move or take someone or something somewhere very quickly and suddenly. 2. (cooking) To beat eggs, cream, or other liquid rapidly.

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies quickly and often stealthily transporting or sweeping someone or something away to safety, secrecy, or another location, with deftness and dispatch.
groups.summary_zh: 指迅速、果断甚至掩护性地把某人或物送离或转移。

groups.name: Whisper & Murmur · 低语与呢喃 (Murmur, Breathe, Sussurate)
groups.tip: 压低嗓音轻声细语

items.def_zh: 低语，耳语，私语；（风、树叶等）沙沙作响
items.def_en: 1. To speak very softly using breath rather than vocal cords. 2. (literary) To make a soft, rustling sound.

items.def_zh: 沙沙作响；发出柔和低语声
items.def_en: To make a soft, rhythmic whispering or rustling sound like leaves or light waves
To utter words very softly and quietly, like a gentle exhalation
To say something in a very quiet, gentle voice that is soft and subdued
To say something in an urgent, fierce, or threatening whisper with sibilant sounds

groups.summary_en: Denotes speaking with low acoustic volume without full vocal cord vibration, typically for secrecy, intimacy, or discretion. Also extends poetically to gentle ambient rustles.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于保密、亲密或谨慎而极轻柔地耳语，亦比喻微弱沙沙声。

groups.name: Whistle & Sound · 鸣响与发声 (Whistle, Pipe, Hiss)
groups.tip: 吹哨鸣响或发出声响

items.def_en: to speak up unexpectedly, usually in a high or shrill tone
to make a high-pitched, shrill sound, or speak in a thin treble voice
to produce a continuous sharp sibilant sound resembling escaping steam
to blow a short, quick blast on a horn or whistle

items.def_zh: 吹口哨，鸣笛；呼啸，发尖锐声
items.def_en: 1. To make a high sound by forcing air through your lips or teeth, or by blowing a whistle. 2. To move quickly making a sharp sound like a whistle.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the mechanics of sound generated by forced airflow through narrow apertures, whether human lips, windpipes, or pressurized conduits. Collocations range from signalling tunes to wind howling.
groups.summary_zh: 气流经狭窄孔隙挤出所发出的尖细鸣音、嘶鸣或哨音表达。

groups.name: Whiten & Blanch · 发白与褪色 (Blanch, Pale, Bleach)
groups.tip: 失去血色或因受热发白

items.def_en: To lose color in the face, typically through fear, illness, or shock
To become white or paler, or to make something white
To make or become white or lighter by chemical treatment or exposure to sunlight
To remove the color from a substance by chemical or thermal processing

items.def_zh: （脸色）变苍白；焯水，将（蔬菜、坚果等）汆烫
items.def_en: 1. To become pale suddenly from fear, shock, or pain. 2. (cooking) To plunge food into boiling water briefly, usually before plunging into cold water.

groups.summary_en: Verbs signifying a loss of skin color due to physical shock or terror, or chemically/physically stripping pigmentation from surfaces.
groups.summary_zh: 指因惊恐失血而面如土色，或通过物理、化学手段除去色素。

groups.name: Widen & Broaden · 拓宽与延展 (Broaden, Expand, Flange)
groups.tip: 物理或视界维度的延展

items.def_zh: 向外张开；呈喇叭形张开
items.def_en: To gradually become wider at the bottom or end, like a bell or funnel
To become wider, more spacious, or unobstructed, such as a narrow path entering a broad valley
To become wider physically, or to increase the range of someone's knowledge, experience, or opinions
To become larger in size, area, volume, or scope, or to make something do so
1. To become wider, or to make something wider. 2. To increase or broaden the scope, range, or degree of something.

groups.summary_en: Captures increase across transverse physical dimensions (such as roadways, doorways, and gaps) as well as the metaphorical broadening of perspective, horizons, knowledge bases, and disparities.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理横向跨度、孔径的加宽，或视野、范围、差距的拓展放大。

groups.name: Wiggle & Squirm · 扭动与蠕动 (Wiggle, Squirm, Writhe)
groups.tip: 身体小幅度扭动挣脱

items.def_en: To move, or make something move, with small, quick movements from side to side or up and down.
To twist and turn with quick, small writhing movements like a worm, often to escape or fit into a tight space
To make small, restless, continuous movements with the hands or feet because of boredom, anxiety, or impatience
(+ into/through) To crawl or wriggle slowly and laboriously through a narrow or crowded space

items.def_zh: 局促蠕动，骨碌骨碌地动
items.def_en: To twist and move the body about from side to side, especially because of nervousness, discomfort, or embarrassment

groups.summary_en: This frame covers subtle to restless involuntary or voluntary body movements characterized by undulating, twisting, or shifting motions, often signaling discomfort, amusement, or confinement.
groups.summary_zh: 表示躯体细碎扭转或蠕动，常伴随不安、局促或挣脱感。

groups.name: Wince & Flinch · 龇牙与抽搐躲闪 (Wince, Grimace, Flinch, Recoil)
groups.tip: 因剧痛或恐惧不由自主龇牙缩头

items.def_zh: 龇牙咧嘴，蹙眉皱面；畏缩，退避
items.def_en: (+ at) To make a sudden, brief facial expression or involuntary movement of pain, distress, or embarrassment.
To tremble convulsive-fashion throughout the torso from sharp revulsion or piercing pain
To spring or shrink back suddenly from bodily pain, shock, or revolting touch
To make a quick, automatic jerking movement away from sudden pain or danger
To distort one's facial features sharply in response to pain, disgust, or effort

groups.summary_en: Instantaneous somatic and facial micro-reactions to sudden physical pain, shocking impacts, or visceral discomfort, characterized by facial contortions and sharp bodily jerks.
groups.summary_zh: 指感知突发剧痛、冲击或尴尬刺激时，面部骤然咧嘴挤眼及身体本能抽搐闪躲。

groups.name: Winnow & Deseed · 脱粒与去杂 (Gin, Winnow, Thresh)
groups.tip: 轧棉提纯分离杂质

items.def_en: To remove the seeds from a fruit, vegetable, or plant tissue
To remove the outer covering or pod from seeds, fruits, or grains

items.def_zh: 轧（棉），用轧棉机去籽；用陷阱捕捉
items.def_en: 1. (agriculture) To separate cotton fibers from their seeds using a cotton gin. 2. To catch an animal in a trap.
To separate grain from stalks and husks by beating or using a machine
To blow air through grain in order to remove the chaff; metaphorically, to sift through to find what is valuable

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this agricultural processing frame denote separating desirable seeds or fibers from husks, chaff, or surrounding plant matter. They often invoke traditional farming or primary milling techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 指在农产品初加工中去除壳、籽或杂质以提取纯净纤维或粮食。

groups.name: Wither & Languish · 衰萎与消逝 (Wither, Languish, Fade)
groups.tip: 水分生机尽失，花叶干瘪黯淡

items.def_en: To gradually lose brightness, color, strength, or fresh vitality until nearly gone
1. (of a plant) To dry up, shrink, and die, or cause to do so. 2. To gradually become weaker, fade away, or disappear.
To become weak, feeble, or dull through neglect, confinement, or lack of vitality
To gradually decrease in power, vigor, or prominence after a peak
To waste away or cause to waste away from lack of use, nourishment, or disease

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the gradual decay, decline, and loss of life force, vigor, or intensity over time. Verbs range from botanical drying and dying to figurative fading away of power, hopes, or youth.
groups.summary_zh: 描述生命力、力量或生机逐渐衰竭、凋零并最终消散的过程。

groups.name: Wither & Shrivel · 凋谢与枯萎 (Wither, Shrivel, Droop)
groups.tip: 植物失水枯瘪凋零衰败

items.def_en: 1. (of a plant) To bend downwards and become limp from lack of water or heat. 2. (of a person) To lose strength, energy, or confidence.
To bend or hang downwards limply through exhaustion, sadness, or lack of water
To lose all moisture or sap completely and wither away
To become dry and shriveled, or cause a plant to lose its sap and life
(+ up) To wrinkle, shrink, and become dry and dead due to loss of moisture

groups.summary_en: This frame describes organic decay where vegetation loses moisture, vitality, and turgor, drying up and collapsing. Extended to humans, it signifies a loss of energy, confidence, or vigor.
groups.summary_zh: 指植物因失水或老化而萎缩干瘪，亦引申指人颓丧无力。

groups.name: Wonder & Baffle · 惊奇与困惑 (Boggle, Mystify, Baffle)
groups.tip: 诧异费解且摸不着头脑

items.def_en: To completely bewilder, puzzle, or confound someone so they cannot find an explanation

items.def_zh: 使不知所措；使眼花缭乱
items.def_en: To confuse someone severely by confronting them with many complicated or chaotic factors

items.def_zh: （因困惑或惊奇而）不知所措，感到难以置信；犹豫，畏缩
items.def_en: To be astonished, overwhelmed, or confused by something, especially to the point of being unable to grasp it; hesitate.

items.def_zh: 使大惑不解；使神秘莫测
items.def_en: To utterly confuse or perplex someone because an occurrence seems impossible to account for
To shock or surprise someone to a startling, near-speechless degree

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental states and effects where an observation or concept is so extraordinary, intricate, or illogical that human comprehension stumbles and fails.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或概念过于惊奇、离奇或费解，以致人的思维无法轻易理解或接受。

groups.name: Word & Formulate · 措辞与遣词 (Word, Phrase, Couch)
groups.tip: 斟酌措辞把思想表达出来

items.def_zh: 斟酌措辞表达，用言辞表达
items.def_en: 1. To choose and use particular words to express an idea or state something.
To express an idea, statement, or question in a specific combination of words
To present or articulate an idea, question, or proposition in a tailored perspective or specific structure

items.def_zh: 以特定语气表达（通常委婉或隐晦）
items.def_en: (often passive, + in) To express or frame something in language of a specified style, tone, or deliberate obscurity
To express thoughts, arguments, or policy in a clear, precise, and systematic manner

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights the deliberate, stylistic, or diplomatic selection of vocabulary and phrasing used to articulate a specific nuance or impression.
groups.summary_zh: 精选字眼与特定口吻来表达或构拟思想。

groups.name: Wordplay & Banter · 双关与戏谑 (Quip, Wisecrack, Banter)
groups.tip: 借双关幽默打趣或逗弄调侃

items.def_zh: 说双关语，用双关语戏谑
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To make a humorous or witty play on words that sound alike or have multiple meanings.
To speak or tease playfully and good-humouredly with someone
To make a witty, clever, or sarcastic remark quickly
To speak in a playful, humorous, or non-serious manner
To make a sharp, clever, often sarcastic or flippant joke

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe engaging in witty, humorous verbal sparring or making clever remarks and wordplays to amuse or tease.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及运用巧妙语言、俏皮话或文字游戏进行幽默调侃或戏谑互动。

groups.name: Worry & Fret · 担忧与发愁 (Fret, Stew, Agonize)
groups.tip: 表达心神不安与为琐事发愁焦虑

items.def_zh: 闷闷不乐；独自焦躁烦恼
items.def_en: (+ over) To worry, agitate, or remain angry and distressed in silence over a problem
(+ about/over) To constantly worry or be visibly anxious and discontented about something
(+ on/over/about) To dwell gloomily and persistently on distressing or upsetting thoughts

items.def_zh: 极度痛苦纠结；苦苦思虑
items.def_en: (+ over/about) To spend a great deal of time worrying intensely or suffering mental anguish about a decision

items.def_zh: 发愁，担忧；使烦恼，使焦虑
items.def_en: (archaic) To worry or fret; to burden with anxiety or distress.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe brooding, fretting, and being consumed by internal anxiety or distress over uncertain outcomes and nagging troubles.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖对烦恼、不确定性感到忧心忡忡、苦思焦虑或坐立难安的心态。

groups.name: Wound Healing & Scarring · 结痂与创口愈合 (Scab, Cicatrize, Crust)
groups.tip: 创口凝血硬化后长出硬痂

items.def_en: To mark or become permanently marked with a fibrous mark left on skin after an injury
To heal by forming scar tissue, or to cause a wound to develop a scar
To become covered with a hard, dry outer layer or surface coating during healing
To form a new, delicate layer of epidermal skin over an exposed lesion or sore

items.def_zh: 结痂；当工贼（罢工期间照常工作）
items.def_en: 1. (+ over) (of a wound) To form a hard protective crust while healing. 2. (disapproving) To work while other workers are on strike.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physiological frame describe the biological stages of tissue repair following an injury. They focus on the formation of hard protective coverings, crusts, or fibrous scar tissue as wounds close and heal.
groups.summary_zh: 表示伤口表面变干、形成保护性硬痂或纤维化疤痕的生理愈合过程。

groups.name: Wrack & Ravage · 摧残与折磨 (Wrack, Ravage, Tear apart)
groups.tip: 身心遭受极度痛楚与撕扯折磨

items.def_en: Cause someone extreme emotional distress, anguish, or inner turmoil
Completely absorb, exhaust, or wear away someone through relentless pain, grief, or disease

items.def_zh: 击溃（神经/身心）；使极度疲惫震颤
items.def_en: Completely destroy someone's physical vitality, composure, or mental resilience
1. (variant of rack, often passive) To cause severe physical or mental pain and torment to someone. 2. To wreck or destroy completely.
Cause extensive damage, ruin, or severe physical and mental deterioration to someone or something

groups.summary_en: Refers to inflicting severe, pervasive physical or emotional devastation that leaves the victim broken, strained, or exhausted. It emphasizes ruinous damage and agonizing strain over deliberate malice.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重剧烈病痛、悲痛对身心的深度摧残、耗竭与撕裂。

groups.name: Wrangle & Haggle · 争辩与纠缠交涉 (Wrangle, Haggle, Dispute)
groups.tip: 言语冲突针锋相对，喋喋不休争执争吵

items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in a spirited, brief, and often good-natured exchange of opposing arguments
To argue about, contest, or formally question the truth, validity, or fairness of something
(+ over/about) To dispute or argue persistently, especially over the cost or terms of something
(+ with/over) To disagree violently or enter into sharp, irreconcilable conflict with someone

items.def_zh: 争吵，争辩，长时间争论；放牧
items.def_en: 1. To argue or dispute noisily and stubbornly for an extended period. 2. (North American) To herd or round up livestock.

groups.summary_en: This frame covers protracted, contentious, and stubborn verbal contests, especially when negotiating terms, settling disputes, or contesting opposing viewpoints.
groups.summary_zh: 指就利益分配、条款细节等发生的旷日持久、激烈费力的争辩与讨价还价。

groups.name: Wrap & Enfold · 包裹与覆盖 (Envelop, Swaddle, Cloak)
groups.tip: 用外皮或织物紧紧包覆

items.def_en: 1. To cover or enclose something completely in paper, cloth, or other material. 2. (+ around/round) To fold or wind something around another object.
To dress someone warmly in multiple layers of clothing, or pack items together tightly
To cover, enclose, or surround something completely with a protective or concealing layer
To wrap a body for burial, or cover something so that it is concealed from sight
To wrap an infant snugly in cloth or blankets to restrict movement and provide security

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote encasing, draping, or shrouding an object or person with a pliable covering, whether for warmth, packaging, concealment, or physical protection.
groups.summary_zh: 指用织物、覆膜等柔软物料将人或物体全面裹覆、包藏或遮盖。

groups.name: Wreak & Inflict · 造成与降下祸端 (Wreak, Inflict, Unleash)
groups.tip: 引发后果，施加破坏影响

items.def_en: (formal/literary, + on/upon) To inflict punishment, plague, or vengeance onto someone
(+ on/upon) To force someone to experience something very unpleasant, painful, or damaging
To release a powerful, destructive force, feeling, or attack suddenly and uncontrollably
To carry out or commit a harmful, illegal, or cruel act

items.def_zh: 造成，招致（破坏、灾祸）；施加（报复、怒火）
items.def_en: To cause large amounts of damage, chaos, or harm; to inflict punishment or vengeance.

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on causing massive ruin, physical harm, trauma, or destructive vengeance directly upon an external target or environment. It emphasizes catastrophic outward impact.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对外强加严重的破坏、创伤、惩戒或灾祸，具有极强的破坏性与宣泄性。

groups.name: Write & Spell Out · 拼写与书写 (Spell, Write, Transcribe)
groups.tip: 文字的字母拼写与笔录成文

items.def_en: 1. To say, write, or form the letters of a word in the correct order. 2. To have something, usually bad, as a result; to mean
To write or say something letter by letter, or to explain something in clear and simple detail
To write something completely on paper, often in full words rather than abbreviations
To write something quickly on a piece of paper so that you remember it
To record spoken words, notes, or audio in written form, usually verbatim

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to forming words letter by letter, committing spoken or thought material into orthographic script, or detailing something letter-by-letter.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及逐字拼写、书面抄录或清晰书写表达的词汇群。

groups.name: Yell & Holler · 呼喊与高声叫唤 (Shout, Holler, Bawl)
groups.tip: 扯开嗓门大声喊叫或喧嚷

items.def_en: To shout or say something loudly to attract attention
To speak or utter loudly and forcefully

items.def_zh: 扯着嗓子大喊；大声抱怨
items.def_en: (informal) To shout or yell loudly across a distance

items.def_zh: 叫喊，大声叫嚷；吼叫着说
items.def_en: (+ at/out) To shout or say something in a very loud, sharp, or angry voice.
To shout very loudly, raucously, or weep noisily

groups.summary_en: This frame captures loud, forceful vocal shouting aimed at bridging a physical distance or expressing intense anger, excitement, or disciplinary warning.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过高分贝喉音大声叫嚷以呼唤远方的人、发泄怒气或警告示警。

groups.name: Adsorb & Surface-Bind · 吸附与界面结合 (Adsorb, Chemisorb, Physisorb)
groups.tip: 物质表面或内部吸附

items.def_en: To bind a substance to a surface through weak van der Waals forces without chemical bonding
(+ to) To adhere securely to a molecular receptor or solid surface substrate
(chemistry, physics) To gather a gas, liquid, or dissolved substance in a condensed layer on the surface of a solid.
To bind a substance to a surface through the formation of chemical bonds

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physico-chemical phenomenon where atoms, ions, or molecules of a gas or liquid adhere specifically to the surface of a solid phase rather than penetrating into its interior.
groups.summary_zh: 物理或化学层面上，流体分子在固相表面聚集并结合粘附。

groups.name: Auscultate & Listen In · 听诊与体察 (Auscultate, Listen in, Hark)
groups.tip: 利用听诊器细听体内声音

items.def_en: To examine or test the health or depth of something by listening to produced resonance
(+ to/on) To listen deliberately and intently to sounds, often as an observer
(+ to) To listen with intense care, attentiveness, and diagnostic focus
(medicine) To listen to internal sounds of the body, especially the heart or lungs, typically using a stethoscope.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve listening with diagnostic or intent acoustic precision to internal or faint physiological sounds, typically using instruments or tuned auditory focus.
groups.summary_zh: 借助专业仪器或屏息细听体内器官机能或极其细微的声响。

groups.name: Beak & Bill · 鸟喙啄咬与相触 (Beak, Bill, Pick)
groups.tip: 禽鸟用嘴尖戳啄取食

items.def_en: To stroke or touch bill-to-bill in bird courtship, or to nuzzle affectionately
To pull at, tear away, or peck small bits of something repeatedly with a beak
(of a bird) To strike, peck, or seize something with the beak.
To clean, smooth, and arrange feathers meticulously using the beak

groups.summary_en: This ornithological manipulation frame focuses strictly on avian actions using the beak or bill to probe, grasp, caress, or strike objects and companions.
groups.summary_zh: 专指鸟类用喙进行的啄击、夹取、互理羽毛或亲昵相触。

groups.name: Belch & Burp · 打嗝与嗳气 (Belch, Eruct, Hick)
groups.tip: 胃部气体由食道上涌反胃出声

items.def_en: (formal/medical) To belch forth stomach wind or matter
To make a sudden gulping sound caused by involuntary spasms of the diaphragm
1. (informal) To release air noisily from the stomach through the mouth. 2. To gently rub or pat a baby's back to make it burp.
To release gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth, often forcefully

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate involuntary or deliberate expulsions of trapped stomach gas upward through the esophagus and mouth, often accompanied by sound.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及胃部气体经食道自口腔排出的生理发声反应。

groups.name: Break Strike · 破卡与破坏罢工 (Scab, Strike-break)
groups.tip: 罢工期间擅自顶替复工

items.def_en: To act as a strikebreaker by continuing to work or hiring substitute labor
To enter a workplace to work despite fellow workers picketing and striking outside
To work during a strike or replace an employee who is striking

items.def_zh: 当工贼，（在罢工期间）擅自上工
items.def_en: (chiefly British, derogatory) To continue working while fellow workers are on strike.

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses specific workplace actions where an individual undermines collective labor solidarity by refusing to strike or taking a striking worker's job.
groups.summary_zh: 指在工潮中背弃集体团结、充当工贼破坏罢工。

groups.name: Choir & Harmonize · 诗班合唱 (Choir, Harmonize, Intone)
groups.tip: 多声部合唱或众人齐声歌唱

items.def_en: to say or sing slowly without much variation in pitch, as in prayer
to sing or repeat rhythmic, measured phrases together in religious or ritual style
(literary) to sing in a choir or together in harmony
to sing or play combined musical notes that produce pleasing chordal harmony

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame specifies artistic, liturgical, or communal choral singing, emphasizing structured polyphony, musical parts, and harmonious liturgical performance.
groups.summary_zh: 合唱团声部协作、多声部和声歌唱及仪式性诵唱场景。

groups.name: Cower & Cringe · 畏缩与谄缩 (Cringe, Shrink back, Grovel)
groups.tip: 因恐惧或羞惭而退缩蜷缩

items.def_en: To pull one's body backward involuntarily away from danger, touch, or repulsion
1. To shrink back or bend your head and body in fear, servility, or pain. 2. To feel acute embarrassment or awkwardness.
To reel or retreat physically while showing visible loss of composure and nerve

items.def_zh: 匍匐屈从；低三下四畏缩
items.def_en: To lie or creep with one's body prone on the ground in servile submission or sheer terror

groups.summary_en: Physical bodily postures adopted when bending down or drawing back out of fear, subservience, sudden distress, or agonizing social vicarious embarrassment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调身体受惊吓、羞耻感或奴颜卑躬驱使下而畏缩、弓背退后的躯体姿态。

groups.name: Dig & Exhume · 发掘与掘出 (Exhume, Disinter, Dig up)
groups.tip: 深挖泥土起出遗物

items.def_en: to remove something buried in the earth by cutting and loosening the surrounding ground
to find or bring to light something buried underground through excavation
To dig a dead body out of the ground after burial, especially for legal or medical investigation.
to dig up a dead body or item that has been formally buried, especially for legal inquiry

groups.summary_en: Refers to intentionally removing buried human remains, antiquities, or concealed objects from beneath the soil for legal, archaeological, or investigative scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指从地下掘出遗体、文物或隐匿物以供勘验、考古或调查。

groups.name: Discover & Detect · 发现与探查 (Discover, Detect, Spot)
groups.tip: 从觉察端倪到查明真相

items.def_en: to visually catch sight of someone or something, often among clutter or from a distance
To find or learn about something for the first time, or to become aware of something.
to notice or identify the presence of something subtle, hidden, or barely perceptible
to recognize or perceive clearly through careful intellectual or visual effort

groups.summary_en: Spans the spectrum of identifying unfamiliar facts, concealed cues, or physical anomalies, escalating from effortless sighting to subtle sensory or technological detection.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖从一眼瞥见到通过敏锐观察或仪器捕捉到隐秘迹象的发现过程。

groups.name: Groan & Moan · 呻吟与叹怨 (Moan, Grunt, Utter Pain)
groups.tip: 因痛苦或无奈发出沉重叹声

items.def_en: To make a short, low, guttural sound due to effort, pain, or reluctance
To make a long, low sound expressing physical or mental suffering

items.def_zh: 呻吟，叹息；呻吟着抱怨；发出吱吱嘎嘎声（如重压之下）
items.def_en: 1. (+ with/at) To make a long, deep sound of physical pain, grief, or disapproval, or say something while groaning. 2. (+ under) To make a strained creaking sound under heavy pressure.
To express deep grief, distress, or disapproval over something

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on uttering deep, low, prolonged, inarticulate vocal sounds expressing severe bodily torment, grief, despair, or heavy emotional dissatisfaction.
groups.summary_zh: 指因剧烈肉体痛苦、悲伤或极度不满而发出低沉、持久的呻吟声。

groups.name: Grow & Mature · 羽化与成熟 (Fledge, Mature, Ripen)
groups.tip: 幼鸟初生渐次长成丰羽

items.def_zh: （幼鸟）长齐飞羽，长羽毛；喂养（幼鸟）至能飞
items.def_en: (of a young bird) To grow wing feathers and develop the ability to fly; to care for a young bird until it can fly.
to develop to full readiness for harvest, consumption, or prime biological function
to reach full physical, mental, or biological development as an adult
to undergo a complete developmental transformation from one life stage into another

groups.summary_en: Charts the biological progression of an organism, plant, or offspring from vulnerable dependence toward full morphological plumage, adulthood, or functional capability.
groups.summary_zh: 指生物由幼态、稚嫩走向羽翼丰满、机能完备或性成熟的生长过程。

groups.name: Miscarry & Pregnancy Loss · 妊娠中止与流产 (Miscarry, Abort, Lose)
groups.tip: 妊娠分娩与繁衍后代

items.def_en: To suffer the spontaneous loss of an unborn child through miscarriage or stillbirth
(of female animals, especially livestock) to deliver a fetus prematurely and dead
To deliberately terminate or spontaneously expel a pregnancy before viable birth
1. (medical) To give birth to a fetus before it is able to survive independently. 2. (of a plan, endeavor, or justice) To go wrong, fail, or not succeed.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to premature termination or loss of a pregnancy before birth, distinguishing spontaneous loss from medical or intentional termination.
groups.summary_zh: 描述妊娠意外中断、自发流产或人工终止妊娠的相关生理事件。

groups.name: Occur & Coincide · 巧合与同步 (Coincide, Synchronize, Overlap)
groups.tip: 事件在时空上碰巧同时发生

items.def_en: to share part of the same timeframe, responsibility, or coverage
1. To happen at the exact same time. 2. (of ideas, opinions, or interests) To meet or agree fully.
(of events or circumstances) to happen together at the same time; to agree in opinion
to cause events or mechanisms to operate at the exact same time and rate

groups.summary_en: Captures temporal or situational alignment, where separate events occur at the exact same juncture or multiple interests harmoniously match by chance or design.
groups.summary_zh: 指不同事件在时间、空间或立场上的同时发生、巧合相遇或完全吻合。

groups.name: Parachute & Airdrop · 伞降与空中投放 (Parachute, Airdrop, Drop in)
groups.tip: 空中跳下并跳伞降落

items.def_en: To drop supplies, equipment, or troops from an aircraft by parachute into a designated area
(+ to) To parachute directly into a specific drop zone or hostile territory
To jump out of an aircraft in an emergency using a parachute

items.def_zh: 空降，跳伞；空投；空降（任职）
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To jump from an aircraft using a parachute, or drop people or supplies by parachute. 2. To appoint someone unexpectedly to a senior position.

groups.summary_en: Centers on descent from an airborne platform using decelerating canopies, or air-dropping personnel and supplies into targeted zones. Also used metaphorically for inserting specialists into troubled situations.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过降落伞从飞行器安全降落或实施空投救援/部署。

groups.name: Rediscover & Reconnect · 重新发现与拾回 (Rediscover, Reclaim, Reconnect)
groups.tip: 重新发掘掩盖的真相

items.def_en: to find or come across something unexpectedly after it has been long out of sight
to restore interest in or active use of an old custom, memory, or feeling
to recover possession, dignity, or cultural connection to something lost or neglected
To find, experience, or become interested in something again after it had been forgotten or lost.

groups.summary_en: Focuses on encountering, appreciating, or revitalizing ideas, talents, or relationships that were previously known but lapsed, neglected, or forgotten over time.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重对曾熟知但后来遗忘或忽视的事物重新产生认知与连接。

groups.name: Severe Starvation & Hunger · 极度饥饿与饥渴 (Famish, Starve, Perish)
groups.tip: 极度匮乏食物濒临饿死

items.def_en: To feel a powerful and agonizing desire or hunger for food or substance
To become steadily weaker, thinner, and waste away through starvation or grief
(dated or literary) To suffer extreme hunger, or to cause someone to starve.
To suffer severely or die from lack of nourishment, or subject someone to starvation

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the intense physical suffering, physical wasting, or colloquial hyperbole caused by an acute deficit of sustenance.
groups.summary_zh: 指极度缺乏食物所引发的肉体煎熬、濒临饿死或口语夸张的饿态。

groups.name: Skydive & Freefall · 跳伞与自由坠落 (Skydive, Freefall, Base-jump)
groups.tip: 从高空跃下或俯冲坠落

items.def_en: To plummet rapidly through the air without mechanical support before opening a parachute

items.def_zh: 定点跳伞（从悬崖或高楼跳伞）
items.def_en: To parachute from a fixed high structure, cliff, or bridge as an extreme sport
(+ down/into) To drop or fall steeply, suddenly, and rapidly from a great height
1. To jump from an aircraft and perform acrobatic freefalls before opening a parachute.

groups.summary_en: Encompasses intentional jumping from extreme heights (aircraft or high structures) involving prolonged freefall before deploying a parachute canopy.
groups.summary_zh: 指极限空中运动中从高空跳落、经历自由落体并最终开伞的行为。

groups.name: Straddle & Bestride · 跨立与骑跨 (Bestride, Straddle, Span)
groups.tip: 双腿跨在两侧的骑坐或跨越姿态

items.def_en: To extend across from one side or edge of an area, river, or obstacle to the other
To get up onto the back of a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle in order to ride it
To sit or stand with one leg on either side of something, or to extend across both sides of a divide

items.def_zh: 骑跨，跨坐；横跨；称霸，主宰
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To sit or stand with one leg on each side of something; to extend across. 2. To dominate or loom large over an era, field, or institution.

groups.summary_en: Involves positioning oneself or extending across an object with legs or boundaries spread to either side. 'Straddle' denotes everyday physical sitting/spanning, whereas 'bestride' possesses grand or literary overtones.
groups.summary_zh: 指双腿分开跨坐、跨立于某物两侧，或引申为横跨两界。

groups.name: Sublet & Farm Out Tenancies · 转租与分租 (Sublet, Underlet, Subcontract)
groups.tip: 支付租金获取使用权或转租

items.def_en: To lease premises that one holds as a tenant to someone else, or lease below standard market rate
To lease a property that is already leased by the lessor under a primary lease

items.def_zh: 外包；将部分场地或业务转让给他人经营
items.def_en: To assign work, obligations, or commercial tenancy space to an outside party
(+ to) To rent out a house, apartment, or office that you yourself are renting from a landlord.

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the secondary leasing of leased premises or obligations, where a tenant lets property out to a third party or delegates rented space.
groups.summary_zh: 将自身已租入的房屋、场地或合同责任二次出租给他人的行为。

groups.name: Teethe & Erupt Teeth · 长牙与出齿 (Teethe, Cut, Erupt, Come through)

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on introducing fresh air into enclosed physical spaces or materials, clearing out stale air, fumes, moisture, or unwanted odors.

groups.summary_en: Verbs representing early long-distance telecommunications, transmitting encoded text or financial credits via underwater cables or electrical telegraph wires.

items.def_en: To breathe quickly and loudly with an open mouth, especially after strenuous physical exertion

items.def_zh: 目瞪口呆地张开嘴；敞开
items.def_en: To stare with an open mouth in surprise or wonder, or to be wide open
To inhale suddenly and sharply with an open mouth, typically due to shock, pain, or breathlessness

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe involuntary or wide openings of the mouth, whether due to fatigue, shock, or hunger for air, extending metaphorically to wide chasms or apertures.
groups.summary_zh: 表示因困倦、震惊或缺氧而张大嘴，亦引申指深裂口洞开。
